items.title: US warns of more sanctions as UN, AU urge talks in Ethiopia’s Tigray
items.description: ADDIS ABABA (Somaliguardian) – The United States said it has tools to sanction more leaders in Ethiopia, while the United Nations and African Union urged restraint, after Tigrayan forces seized the airport in Tigray’s capital Mekelle on Wednesday. Tigray’s regional government said its forces had entered a “defensive war” after federal attacks. Getachew Reda, an adviser to Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, said Tigrayan fighters had taken federally administered airports and launched offensives in the neighbouring Afar and Amhara regions. Ethiopian Airlines suspended flights to Mekelle, Axum and Shire. U.S. Ambassador Ervin Massinga said the leadership of the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF), which Washington sanctioned earlier this year, had decided to launch a large-scale offensive . He said rejecting African Union-sponsored dialogue under former Nigerian President Olusegun Obasanjo and pursuing an “unwinnable fight” did nothing for the people. He warned other armed groups against joining the fighting. Massinga said political dialogue remained the right course. His statement did not specify the earlier sanctions. The State Department imposed visa restrictions on TPLF hardliners and their immediate family members without naming them. The U.S. Embassy barred government personnel from travelling to the Tigray and Afar regions and advised U.S. citizens there to shelter in place. Washington also condemned a reported drone strike on a Catholic Relief Services aid convoy in Tigray and called for a full investigation. U.N. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres called on all parties to show maximum restraint, protect civilians and allow unhindered humanitarian access. He urged them to avoid actions that could lead to a “broader and more devastating conflict,” his spokesperson Stephane Dujarric said in a statement. Guterres also backed African Union efforts, including Obasanjo’s engagement, and urged good-faith talks under the Pretoria agreement. African Union Commission Chairperson Mahmoud Ali Youssouf cited the seizure of the airports at Mekelle, Axum and Shire and the detention of federal personnel by the TPLF. He said the seizures were inconsistent with Pretoria obligations and called for direct talks without delay. Youssouf asked Obasanjo, the AU’s High Representative for the Horn of Africa, to engage the parties. He urged Ethiopia’s neighbours to refrain from actions that could add to the escalation. He did not name any country. The regional bloc IGAD also called for immediate de-escalation. The European Union cited both the airport takeover and drone strikes by Ethiopia’s army in recent weeks. Earlier this month, the TPLF said Obasanjo’s mediation lacked neutrality and concrete proposals, and questioned whether it was independent of the federal government. Obasanjo’s office rejected the claims of bias. Massinga and the U.S. mission to the AU had welcomed Obasanjo’s involvement after his August engagement in Mekelle. The 2022 Pretoria agreement ended a two-year war in which the African Union has estimated about 600,000 people were killed. More than one million remain displaced. The TPLF announced an alliance with six other armed groups days earlier, aimed at removing Abiy’s government. The Ethiopian government has accused the alliance of receiving Eritrean support. Eritrea has previously denied such allegations Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Daawo: Banaanbaxyo waa wayn oo ka dhacay Beledweyne + Ujeedka
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Beledweyne ee xarunta gobolka Hiiraan waxaa maanta ka dhacay dibadb-baxayo waa wayn oo looga soo horjeedo hannaanka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee dowlad-goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee HirShabelle. Boqolaal dadweyne ah ayaa isugu soo baxay bartamaha magaalada, kuwaas oo ka qayb-galay banaanbaxa oo ay soo qaban qaabiyeen xubnaha diidan musharraxnimada madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe oo dhawaan la siiyay kaarka Xisbiga Cadaaladda iyo Wajirka. Ka qayb-galayaasha dibadbaxa ayaa sheegay inay kasoo horjeedaan wax ay ku tilmaameen doorasho hal dhinac ah oo laga qaban-qaabinayo deegaannada maamulka HirShabelle. Sidoo kale, waxa ay intaasi ku daray inay la dareen yihiin Ugaaska Beesha Xawaadle, Ugaas Yuusuf Ugaas Xasan iyo siyaasiyiinta kale ee dhaqdhaqaaqyada ka wada Beledweyne, kuwaas oo looga soo horjeedo qorshaha dowladda Soomaaliya ee ku aadan doorashada HirShabelle. “Banaanbax maanta ka jiraa Beledweyne waa banaanbax nabadeed waxaa lagu taageeraa Ugaaskeenna qiimaha badan. Hiiraan waa saldhiggii Soomaaliya waa meeshii laga aas aasay Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri mid kamid dibadbaxayaasha ku sugan magaalada Beledweyne. Sidoo kale wuxuu intaas ku daray “Qof la caynaayo ma jiro ama la xumeynaayo waxaan rabnaa inaan calankii Soomaaliyeed ka taagno guul, Soomaaliya hanoolaato”. Arrimahan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli beesha Xawaadle ay muddooyinkii dambe dooneysay inay hesho xilka ugu sarreeya ee HirShabelle, waxayna haatan si adag u diidan tahay go’aanka uu xisbiga Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu musharaxa u siiyay Cali Guudlaawe oo haatan hoggaamiya maamulka. The post Daawo: Banaanbaxyo waa wayn oo ka dhacay Beledweyne + Ujeedka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wada-hadaladii mucaaradka iyo dowladda ee doorashooyinka oo fashilmay
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ku wargeliyay in dadaallo wada-hadal oo looga gol lahaa in dhinacyada siyaasadda Soomaaliya la isku soo dhoweeyo aysan weli horseedin heshiis laga gaaro qaabka doorashada dalka. Golaha ayaa sheegay in dadaalladaas ay qayb ka ahaayeen dowladda Turkiga iyo dalalka ku bahoobay Quad, kuwaas oo kala ah Mareykanka, Boqortooyada Midowday, Qatar iyo Turkiga. Sida uu Goluhu sheegay, wada-hadallada ayaa diiradda lagu saarayay sidii loo heli lahaa is-afgarad ku saabsan hannaanka doorashada Soomaaliya, balse dadaalladaasi aysan suuragelin in dhinacyada ay ka gaaraan heshiis mideysan. Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa sidoo kale Golaha Ammaanka la wadaagay walaacyadiisa ku aaddan xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka, iyadoo muhiimadda la saarayo in khilaafaadka jira lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad siyaasadeed. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay Soomaaliya ka taagan yihiin doodo siyaasadeed oo la xiriira hannaanka doorashada, muddo-xileedyada iyo sidii loo heli lahaa hannaan doorasho oo ay dhinacyada siyaasadeed ku wada qanacsan yihiin. Ma ahan markii ugu horeeysay oo kulamadii mucaaradka iyo dowladda ay fashilmaan, madaama dhinacyada ay miiska wada-hadalka la yimadaan qodobo culus oo dhinacyada ku adag. items.title: Italian Report: Houthi Escalation Puts Pressure on Djibouti, Threatens Ethiopian Interests
items.description: Yemen Monitor / Newsroom: An escalation by Yemen’s Houthi group and its seizure of strategic positions near the Bab al-Mandab Strait are placing growing security, economic and humanitarian pressure on Djibouti, with potential repercussions for neighboring Ethiopia, Italy’s Il Sole 24 Ore reported Wednesday. In a report by journalist Alberto Magnani, the newspaper said Djibouti, whose economy depends heavily on its strategic location and ports overlooking the Bab al-Mandab, is facing mounting challenges from the intensifying military situation in Yemen and the arrival by sea of thousands of Yemenis fleeing the fighting. Djibouti’s main port is a cornerstone of the country’s economy and serves as the primary trade gateway for landlocked Ethiopia. The country also hosts military bases operated by several foreign powers, making any deterioration in Red Sea security a direct concern for its economic and strategic interests. The report said the Houthis’ control of Mayyun, also known as Perim Island, in the Bab al-Mandab Strait has strengthened their ability to influence shipping through one of the world’s key maritime corridors linking the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden. The developments have coincided with a surge in displacement from Yemen’s western coast toward Djibouti. The International Organization for Migration (IOM) has reported that thousands of Yemenis have crossed the sea to Djibouti to escape the fighting, while UN estimates earlier this month put the number of people displaced within Yemen at more than 100,000. Analysts cited by Il Sole 24 Ore warned that a prolonged escalation could have significant security and economic consequences for Djibouti. A decline in shipping activity or an increase in maritime risks could reduce port traffic and cut revenues linked to the country’s position as a major regional trade hub. The report also warned that disruptions to trade through Djibouti could encourage Ethiopia to accelerate efforts to diversify its access to the sea, including by making greater use of other regional ports such as Berbera in Somaliland. Ethiopia has sought for years to expand its maritime access as it remains heavily dependent on the trade corridor through Djibouti. A prolonged disruption along that route could add pressure for Ethiopia to reassess its economic and strategic options across the Horn of Africa. The concerns come amid growing warnings over the regional impact of the Houthis’ expansion along Yemen’s western coast. The group seized Mokha, other areas and Mayyun Island during September, strengthening its position near one of the world’s most strategically important maritime chokepoint

items.title: Madaxweynaha Iran oo si cad Trump ugu sheegay in waligood aysan Jilbaha u dhigi doonin
items.description: New York ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweyne Masoud Pezeshkian ayaa sheegay in Iran aysan marnaba “u jilba-dhigi doonin” cadowgeeda ka dib ku dhawaad toddoba bilood oo dagaal ah oo ay kula jirtay Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil, balse ay diyaar u tahay xal diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu soo afjarayo khilaafka. Isagoo ka jawaabayey hanjabaadda Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ee ah inuu “baabi’in doono” Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah haddii aan heshiis degdeg ah la gaarin, ayuu u sheegay Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay: “Iska-caabbinta shacabka Iiraan way sii kordhi doontaa marka ay wajahayaan cunaqabatayn, cadaadis sii kordhaya iyo cagajugleyn”. Pezeshkian ayaa sidoo kale ku adkaystay in heshiis kastaa uu qasab ku yahay inuu ku daro joojinta xayiraadda Mareykanka ee ka horjoogsanaysa maraakiibta Iiraan inay isticmaalaan marin-biyoodyada muhiim ah oo ku yaalla Gacanka. “Ma noqon karto mid la aqbali karo in qof kastaa uu ka faa’iidaysto Marinka Hormuz, iyadoo annaga naloo diidayo inaan isticmaalno” ayuu yiri. Ma jirin wax jawaab degdeg ah oo ka timid dhinaca Mareykanka oo wafdigoodu ay ka baxeen hoolka shirka markii uu bilaabay khudbadda Pezeshkian. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo maanta la filayo inuu Khudbad ka jeediyo Shirka Qaramada Midoobay
items.description: New York ( Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa maanta la filayaa inuu khudbad ka jeediyo fadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha ayaa la filayaa in diiradda lagu saaro xaaladda Soomaaliya, horumarka laga sameeyay dhinacyada amniga, siyaasadda iyo dowlad-dhiska, iyo sidoo kale dadaallada dowladda ee xoojinta hay’adaha qaranka. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa la filayaa inuu ka hadlo caqabadaha weli horyaalla Soomaaliya, oo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, xasilloonida siyaasadeed, horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha bani’aadannimada. Fadhiga Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay wuxuu sidoo kale fursad u siinayaa Soomaaliya inay beesha caalamka la wadaagto mowqifkeeda ku aaddan arrimaha muhiimka ah ee dalka iyo gobolka. Khudbadda Madaxweynaha ayaa si gaar ah indhaha loogu hayaa, iyadoo la filayo inuu soo bandhigo aragtida dowladda Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan mustaqbalka dalka iyo xiriirka Soomaaliya la leedahay beesha caalamka. items.title: Netanyahu oo lagu qasbay in uu deg deg uga baxo New York
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa si weyn u soo gaabiyey safarkiisa magaalada New York, kadib digniino dhanka ammaanka ah oo loo gudbiyey, sida ay ku warrantay warbaahinta Israel. Netanyahu ayaa lagu wadaa inuu Mareykanka ku sugnaado dhowr saacadood oo keliya, isaga oo aan habeen ku hoyan doonin New York, kadib markii saraakiisha ammaanku kula taliyeen inuu yareeyo muddada safarkiisa. Channel 13 ee Israel ayaa sheegtay in maalmahan la qabtay kulamo heer sare ah oo dhinaca ammaanka ah, kuwaas oo qaarkood uu Netanyahu laftiisu ka qeyb galay. Saraakiisha ayaa la sheegay inay soo bandhigeen xog sirdoon iyo digniino gaar ah oo sababay talada ah in safarka la soo gaabiyo. Faahfaahinta khatarahaas si rasmi ah looma shaacin. Sida qorshaha cusub uu yahay, Netanyahu oo saaka yimid New York, waxa uu khudbad ka jeedin doonaa kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, kadibna waxa uu isla maanta dib ugu laaban doonaa Israel. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in booqashadiisa Mareykanka ay noqon karto mid ka mid ah safarradii ugu gaabnaa ee uu halkaas ku tago isagoo ra’iisul wasaare ah. Banaanbaxyo la filayo Booqashada Netanyahu ayaa ku soo aadeysa iyadoo New York laga filayo banaanbaxyo looga soo horjeedo siyaasadda Israel iyo dagaalka Gaza. Ammaanka magaalada ayaa si weyn loo adkeeyey toddobaadka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo kumannaan boolis iyo hay’ado federaal ah la geeyey agagaarka xarunta QM iyo goobaha ay madaxda caalamku ku sugan yihiin. Saraakiisha ammaanka Mareykanka ayaa sheegay inaysan shaacin jirin khatar gaar ah oo ku wajahan Golaha Guud, inkastoo tallaabooyinka ammaanka la kordhiyey. Netanyahu ayaa sidoo kale wajahaya amar qabasho oo Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah, ICC, ay soo saartay bishii November 2024. Maxkamadda ayaa Netanyahu iyo wasiirkiisii hore ee gaashaandhigga Yoav Gallant ku eedeysay dambiyo dagaal iyo dambiyo ka dhan ah bani’aadannimada oo la xiriira dagaalka Gaza. Israel ayaa diiday eedahaas, Mareykankuna xubin kama aha ICC. Ma jiro kulan Trump Safarka gaaban ee Netanyahu kuma jiro kulan uu la yeelanayo Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump, inkastoo mas’uuliyiinta Israel ay hore u doonayeen inay diyaariyaan kulan labada hoggaamiye dhex mara. Warbaahinta Mareykanka iyo Israel ayaa sheegtay in jadwalka labada hoggaamiye aanu is waafaqin. Sarkaal Mareykan ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Netanyahu aanu ka mid ahayn madaxda ajnabiga ah ee Trump loo qorsheeyey inuu kula kulmo New York. Trump ayaa New York joogay horraantii toddobaadka, halka Netanyahu uu yimid Khamiista, xilli madaxweynaha Mareykanka uu magaalada ka baxay. Netanyahu ayaa sidoo kale baajiyey safar uu ku tegi lahaa gobolka Texas, halkaas oo qorshuhu ahaa inuu kula kulmo ganacsadaha Elon Musk. Koox hordhac ah oo dhinaca ammaanka iyo qabanqaabada ah ayaa horey Texas u gaartay si ay booqashada ugu diyaar garowdo, balse qorshahaas ayaa markii dambe meesha laga saaray, cabsi darted. Isbeddelladan ayaa ka dhigaya in safarka Netanyahu ee Mareykanka uu si weyn ugu koobnaado khudbaddiisa Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, kadibna uu isla maanta dib ugu laabto Israel. items.title: Mareykanka oo muwaadiniintiisa Itoobiya ku sugan digniin u diray iyo xaaladda gobolka Tigray
items.description: Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Itoobiya ayaa sheegtay inay heshay warar sheegaya in ciidamada Tigray ay la wareegeen garoomada diyaaradaha ee Mekelle, Axum iyo Shire. Ethiopian Airlines ayaa hakisay dhammaan duulimaadyadii tagayay ama ka imaanayay saddexda garoon, iyadoo aan la ogeyn goorta dib loo bilaabi doono. Safaaradda Mareykanka ayaa muwaadiniinteeda kula talisay inaysan u safrin Tigray iyo Afar, halka kuwa ku sugan gobolladaas lagu boorriyay inay goobaha ay joogaan ku sugnaadaan ilaa xaaladdu ammaan caadi noqonayso.

items.title: Cutubyo ka tirsan Kumaandooska Soomaaliya oo Tababar Heer Sare ah loogu soo xiray Masar
items.description: Ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Soomaaliya ayaa soo gabagabeeyey tababar milatari oo heer sare ah oo ay ku qaateen dalka Masar, iyadoo labada dowladood ay sii xoojinayaan iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca, xilli Soomaaliya ay dadaal ugu jirto dhismaha ciidan qaran oo leh awood iyo isku-filnaansho dheeraad ah. Tababarkan oo qayb ka ah barnaamijyo iskaashi milatari oo u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Masar ayaa ciidamada Soomaaliyeed lagu baray xirfado gaar ah oo ay ka mid yihiin hawlgallada Kumaandooska, la-dagaallanka argagixisada, dagaalka magaalooyinka iyo hawlgallada baarashuudka . Munaasabadda lagu soo xirayay tababarka waxaa ka qaybgalay Taliyaha Ciidamada Kumaandooska Soomaaliya, Sarreeye Guuto Aadan Maxamed Cumar , oo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed kula dardaarmay inay xirfadaha iyo aqoonta ay ka heleen tababarka uga faa’iidaystaan gudashada waajibaadkooda qaran. Taliyaha ayaa muhiimadda tababarka ku xusay baahida loo qabo in ciidamada Soomaaliya ay yeeshaan xirfado casri ah oo u saamaxaya inay si hufan uga jawaabaan xaaladaha amni ee adag, gaar ahaan hawlgallada la xiriira la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab iyo howlaha u baahan cutubyo si gaar ah u tababaran. Munaasabadda waxaa sidoo kale ka qaybgalay Ku-simaha Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Masar, Cabdixakiin Axmed Maxamed , iyo u qeybsanaha ciidamada Soomaaliya ee Qaahira, Sarreeye Guuto Maxamed Cabdullaahi Maxamed , iyo Taliyaha Ciidamada Cirka ee Masar. Tababarkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay xoogga saarayso dhismaha iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, iyadoo dowladda federaalku dooneyso in ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si weyn ugu tiirsanaadaan awooddooda gudaha, isla markaana ay qaataan masuuliyad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan hawlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Cutubyada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ayaa door muhiim ah ku leh dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxaha hubeysan, maadaama ay awood u leeyihiin fulinta hawlgallo u baahan tababar dheeraad ah, dhaq-dhaqaaq degdeg ah iyo xirfado dagaal oo gaar ah. Tababarka ka dhacay Masar wuxuu sidoo kale qayb ka yahay iskaashi milatari oo sii ballaaranaya oo u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Qaahira. Labada dal ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyey xoojiyey xiriirkooda dhinacyada difaaca, amniga iyo tababarka ciidamada, iyadoo Masar ay ka mid noqotay dalalka Soomaaliya kala shaqeynaya horumarinta awoodda ciidamadeeda. Iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Masar wuxuu ku soo aadayaa xilli Muqdisho ay raadineyso taageero iyo iskaashi ay ku horumariso awoodda ciidamadeeda, gaar ahaan marka ay dalka ka socdaan dadaallo lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada qaranka iyo sidii ay si madax-bannaan ugu hoggaamin lahaayeen hawlgallada amniga. Tababarrada noocan ah ayaa Soomaaliya u noqon kara fursad ay ku kordhiso tirada ciidamada leh xirfadaha khaaska ah, iyadoo sidoo kale sare loo qaadayo diyaargarowga, hufnaanta iyo awoodda hawlgal ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Masar, oo leh ciidan tiro iyo khibrad badan oo ku saabsan hawlgallada gaarka ah iyo tababarrada milatari, ayaa Soomaaliya siisay fursad ay ciidamadeedu ku helaan aqoon iyo khibrad dheeraad ah oo ay ku dabaqi karaan hawlgallada gudaha. Soomaaliya ayaa weli wajahaysa caqabado amni oo ay ugu weyn yihiin dagaalka ay kula jirto Al-Shabaab, waxaana dhismaha ciidamo si wanaagsan u tababaran, qalabaysan, isla markaana leh awood ay ku fuliyaan hawlgallo casri ah ay muhiim u tahay qorshaha dowladda ee ku aaddan in ciidamada qaranku ay si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. Dhammaystirka tababarkan ayaa sidaas darteed noqonaya mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinka lagu xoojinayo awoodda cutubyada gaarka ah ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, iyadoo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Masar uu sii ballaarinayo fursadaha tababar iyo horumarinta xirfadaha ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa wajahaysa hawl adag oo ah sidii tababarka iyo aqoonta ay ciidamada ka helayaan dalalka saaxiibka ah loogu beddeli lahaa awood hawlgal oo joogto ah oo gudaha dalka ah.

items.title: Hoggaamiyeyaasha Caalamka oo Israa’iil Ku Cambaareeyey Dagaalka Gaza iyo Ballaarinta Degsiimooyinka
items.description: Arrimaha Gaza iyo Daanta Galbeed ayaa si weyn uga dhex muuqday khudbadaha hoggaamiyeyaasha caalamka ee ka qaybgalaya doodda guud ee Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo dalal kala duwan ay Israa’iil ku dhaliileen xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Gaza, dhimashada rayidka, barakicinta Falastiiniyiinta iyo ballaarinta degsiimooyinka Israa’iiliyiinta ee Daanta Galbeed. Doodda guud ee UNGA81, oo ka socota xarunta Qaramada Midoobay ee magaalada New York, ayaa sanadkan kusoo beegantay xilli dagaalka Gaza iyo xaaladda guud ee Bariga Dhexe ay weli yihiin qaar ka mid ah arrimaha ugu culus ee horyaalla beesha caalamka. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in xaaladda dhulka Falastiin ay ka mid tahay arrimaha ugu daran ee u baahan tallaabo degdeg ah, iyadoo Xoghayaha Guud António Guterres uu ku baaqay in dagaalladu istaagaan, gargaarka bani’aadannimadana la gaarsiiyo dadka rayidka ah. Madaxweynaha Turkiga, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan , ayaa khudbaddiisa Golaha Guud si xooggan uga hadlay Gaza, isaga oo cambaareeyey xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee halkaas ka jirta, isla markaana ugu baaqay beesha caalamka inay cadaadis saarto Israa’iil. Erdogan wuxuu sidoo kale dalalka aan weli aqoonsan Dowladda Falastiin ugu baaqay inay dib u eegaan mowqifkooda, isagoo taageeray in Falastiin hesho aqoonsi ballaaran oo caalami ah. Qatar ayaa iyaduna si weyn uga hadashay dhibaatada Gaza iyo mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee Falastiiniyiinta, ayadoo Wasiirka Koowaad ahna Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Qatar, Sheekh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, uu kulan heer sare ah oo ku saabsan xalka labada dowladood oo ka dhacay New York ka sheegay taageerada Doha ee xaqa Falastiiniyiinta ay u leeyihiin dowlad madax-bannaan oo ku dhisan xuduudihii 1967, iyadoo Qudus Bari ay tahay caasimaddeeda. Qatar waxay sidoo kale ugu baaqday beesha caalamka inay cadaadis saarto Israa’iil si loo fuliyo heshiisyada xabbad-joojinta iyo in la joojiyo xadgudubyada ka dhanka ah xuquuqda Falastiiniyiinta. Madaxweynaha Faransiiska, Emmanuel Macron , ayaa isna khudbaddiisa iyo kulamadiisa New York xoogga saaray muhiimadda xalka labada dowladood. Faransiiska, Britain iyo Canada waxay horraantii bishan si wadajir ah u sheegeen in ballaarinta degsiimooyinka Israa’iiliyiinta ee Daanta Galbeed, oo ay ku jirto qorshaha E1, ay khatar weyn ku tahay suuragalnimada in la dhiso dowlad Falastiini ah oo dhul ahaan isku xiran. Saddexda dal waxay sidoo kale ku dhawaaqeen tallaabooyin la xiriira ganacsiga badeecadaha ka yimaada degsiimooyinka iyo cunaqabateyn lagu beegsanayo qaar ka mid ah dhinacyada ku lug leh dhismaha degsiimooyinka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Britain, Andy Burnham , ayaa khudbaddiisa Golaha Guud si cad u kala saaray weerarkii Hamas ee 7-dii Oktoobar iyo tallaabooyinka milatari ee Israa’iil. Burnham wuxuu sheegay in weerarkii Hamas uu ahaa mid argagax leh oo Britain ay cambaareyneyso, balse uu intaas ku daray in weerarkaas uusan cudurdaar u noqon karin tallaabooyinka dowladda Israa’iil ee Gaza iyo Daanta Galbeed. Burnham wuxuu sheegay in dad aad u badan, oo ay ku jiraan carruur, ay ku dhinteen dagaalka, isla markaana gargaar bani’aadannimo oo aad u yar uu gaarayo Gaza. Wuxuu si gaar ah uga hadlay qorshaha ballaarinta degsiimada E1 , isaga oo sheegay in dhismaheedu uu kala qaybin karo Daanta Galbeed isla markaana uu halis gelin karo suuragalnimada dowlad Falastiini ah oo shaqayn karta. Britain ayaa sheegtay inay qaadday tallaabooyin ay ka mid yihiin mamnuucidda ganacsiga badeecadaha ka yimaada degsiimooyinka iyo cunaqabateyn lagu soo rogo dadka ku lug leh dhismaha degsiimooyinka. Madaxweynaha Brazil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva , ayaa isna Golaha Guud ka hadlay dagaalka Gaza iyo xaaladda Falastiin, isagoo cambaareeyey waxa uu ku tilmaamay xasuuq ka dhacaya Gaza iyo qabsashada dhulka Falastiin. Lula wuxuu ku baaqay in xal diblomaasiyadeed loo raadiyo colaadaha caalamka, wuxuuna sidoo kale dhaliilay awoodda Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo sida uu nidaamka caalamiga ah uga jawaabayo dagaallada socda. Dhanka kale, Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay António Guterres ayaa khudbaddii furitaanka doodda guud si gaar ah ugu hadlay xaaladda dhulka Falastiin. items.title: Maxaa ku qoran warqadda Golaha Mustaqbalka u direen Golaha Ammaanka QM?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online ) – Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa mar kale Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay u gudbiyay warqad ay walaac xooggan kaga muujinayaan xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee dalka, iyaga oo dalbaday qiimeyn madax-bannaan, xal siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay iyo dhexdhexaadin caalami ah. Warqadda ayaa lagu soo qaaday arrimo xasaasi ah oo ay kamid yihiin is-mariwaaga ka taagan doorashooyinka, arrimaha dastuurka, amniga, nidaamka federaalka, barakaca iyo duqeyntii ka dhacday guriga Taliye Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan (Shub) ee degmada Doolow. Ugu horreyn golaha ayaa nasiib-darro ah ku tilmaamay tallaabooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ee ay qaadday Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo ay sheegeen inay hor istaageen howlaha Midowga Afrika iyo ergada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo ah inay bixiyaan qiimeyn madax-bannaan oo ku saabsan horumarka siyaasadeed iyo amni ee dalka. Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa sidoo kale xusay in Soomaaliya ay hadda ku jirto xaalad khatar ah oo ay isku mar jiraan dhibaatooyin dastuur, amni iyo bani’aadannimo, iyada oo bayaanka lagu yiri “Waxaan fursaddan uga faa’iideysaneynaa inaan Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay si toos ah ugu wargelinno arrimaha walaaca leh ee ka jira gudaha daka”. Waxaa kale oo intaas lasii raaciyay “Muddadii Baarlamaanka Federaalka waxay dhacday 14-kii Abriil 2026, halka muddadii madaxweynuhuna ay dhammaatay 15-kii May 2026, taasoo maamulka federaalka ka dhigtay inuusan haysan waajibaad dastuuri ah oo sax ah”. Sidoo kale, golaha ayaa soo hadal qaaday arrimaha federaalka, gaar ahaan dagaalladii ka dhacay Koonfur Galbeed iyo Jubbaland oo ay isku wajaheen ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa maamulladaasi, waxayna eedda ugu wayn dhabarka u saareen hoggaanka Villa Soomaaliya. Golaha Mustaqbalka ayaa ka dalbay Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay inuu qabto kulan rasmi ah oo looga hadlo xaaladda dastuuriga ah iyo siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo warbixinno laga dhageysanayo wakiillo ka socda Xoghayaha Guud, Guddiga Midowga Afrika iyo IGAD. “Kulankaasi waa inuu dhacaa ka hor inta uusan dhammaan waajibaadka UNTMIS 31-ka Oktoobar 2026 iyo doodaha ku saabsan waajibaadka AUSSOM, ka hor inta aan la gaarin go’aan ku saabsan in dib loo cusboonaysiiyo waajibaadka hadda jira,” ayaa lagu yiri warqadda. Waxaa kale oo ay Golaha Ammaanka ka codsadeen in la taageero xal siyaasadeed oo degdeg ah, lana sameeyo qaab doorasho oo loo dhan yahay oo la fulin karo, maadaama muddo-xileedyada Dowladda Federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyadu dhammaadeen. Dhanka kale, waxay soo jeediyeen in baaritaan madax-bannaan lagu sameeyo duqeyntii ka dhacday Doolow 3-dii September, taas oo lagu beegsaday guriga Taliye Shub. Waxay sheegeen in dhacdaddu walaac weyn ku abuurtay Soomaalida, isla markaana ay saameyn ku yeelan karto xasilloonida siyaasadda Soomaaliya iyo gobolka. Ugu dambeyn waxaa qoraalka looga hadlay arrinta barakaca Muqdisho, iyadoo golugu ka codsaday Golaha Ammaanka inuu si gaar ah u tixgeliyo dadka ku barakacay gudaha, iyadoo la hubinayo in arrinta barakacayaashu ka muuqato qiimeynta iyo qorsheynta UN-ka, isla markaana gargaarka bani’aadantinimo laga ilaaliyo khilaafka siyaasadeed. items.title: Madaxweynayaasha Saddexda Dal ee Ugu Dhaqaalaha Weyn Afrika oo Ka Maqan Shirka Qaramada Midoobay
items.description: Indhaha caalamka ayaa si gaar ah ugu jeeda maqnaanshaha madaxweynayaasha saddexda dal ee Afrika ugu dhaqaalaha weyn, kuwaas oo dhammaantood aan si shaqsi ah uga qaybgelin doodda guud ee Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee ka socda magaalada New York. Koonfur Afrika, Masar iyo Nigeria ayaa marka loo eego saadaasha wax-soo-saarka guud ee gudaha ee sannadka 2026 ka mid ah dhaqaalaha ugu waaweyn qaaradda. Xogta IMF waxay dhaqaalaha Koonfur Afrika ku qiyaastay ku dhowaad 480 bilyan oo dollar, Masar 430 bilyan oo dollar, halka Nigeria lagu qiyaasay in ka badan 377 bilyan oo dollar. Si kastaba, inkastoo saddexdan dal ay New York ku leeyihiin wafdiyo heer sare ah, madaxweynayaashooda ayaa sanadkan ka maqnaa madasha ay madaxda dunidu kaga hadlaan arrimaha ugu waaweyn ee caalamka. Madaxweynaha Koonfur Afrika, Cyril Ramaphosa, ayaa ka maqnaanshihiisa lagu sheegay xaalad caafimaad, ayadoo Madaxtooyada Koonfur Afrika ay sheegtay in dhakhaatiirtiisu kula taliyeen inuu nasto kaddib safar uu kaga soo laabtay shirkii BRICS ee ka dhacay Hindiya. Wasiirka Xiriirka Caalamiga ah iyo Iskaashiga Koonfur Afrika, Ronald Lamola, ayaa hoggaaminaya wafdiga dalkaas ee ka qaybgalaya UNGA81, isaga oo ka wakiil ah dowladdiisa kulamada iyo doodaha muhiimka ah ee ka socda xarunta Qaramada Midoobay. Koonfur Afrika ayaa shirka u adeegsanaysa fursad ay ku sii xoojiso mowqifkeeda ku aaddan dib-u-habaynta nidaamka caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Pretoria waxay muddo dheer ku baaqaysay in Afrika loo sameeyo matalaad joogto ah oo Golaha Ammaanka ah, iyadoo ku doodaysa in qaab-dhismeedka hadda jira uusan si buuxda uga tarjumayn miisaanka iyo doorka qaaradda Afrika ee dunida. Dhanka Nigeria, Madaxweynaha Bola Ahmed Tinubu ayaa sidoo kale ka maqnaa New York, iyadoo madaxtooyada dalku sheegtay inuu ku jiray fasax sannadeed. Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka Nigeria, Kashim Shettima, ayaa loo diray inuu dalka ku matalo Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud. Shettima ayaa loo xilsaaray inuu jeediyo khudbadda Nigeria, isla markaana uu ka qaybqaato kulamada heerka sare iyo wada-hadallada laba-geesoodka ah ee ay dowladda Nigeria la yeelanayso dalalka iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah. Nigeria, oo ah mid ka mid ah quwadaha dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed ee ugu waaweyn Galbeedka Afrika, ayaa UNGA81 uga faa’iidaysanaysa sidii ay u soo bandhigi lahayd danaha dalka iyo aragtideeda ku aaddan arrimaha Afrika iyo caalamka. Joogitaanka Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijinaya in maqnaanshaha Tinubu uusan ka dhignayn in Nigeria ay hoos u dhigtay heerka matalaaddeeda diblomaasiyadeed. Masar ayaa iyaduna ka mid noqotay saddexda dal ee waaweyn ee Afrika ee madaxweynahoodu uusan si shaqsi ah uga qaybgelin shirka, ayadoo Madaxweyne Abdel Fattah El-Sisi uu Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Masar, Mostafa Madbouly, u igmaday inuu hoggaamiyo wafdiga dalkaas ee New York. Madbouly ayaa ka qaybgalaya doodaha iyo kulamada dhinacyada badan ee shirka, isaga oo gudbinaya mowqifka rasmiga ah ee dowladda Masar. Inkasta oo Qaahira aysan si faahfaahsan u shaacin sababta Madaxweyne Sisi uga maqnaaday shirka, dowladda Masar waxay xaqiijisay in Ra’iisul Wasaare Madbouly uu hoggaaminayo wafdiga rasmiga ah. Masar ayaa si gaar ah diiradda u saaraysa arrimaha Bariga Dhexe, xaaladda Falastiin iyo Gaza, iyo sidoo kale doorka dalalka Afrika iyo kuwa soo koraya ee nidaamka caalamiga ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee maqnaanshaha isku marka ah ee madaxweynayaasha Koonfur Afrika, Masar iyo Nigeria ayaa soo jiitay dareenka diblomaasiyiinta iyo warbaahinta caalamka, maadaama saddexdan dal ay leeyihiin saameyn siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale oo weyn gudaha Afrika.

Koonfur Afrika ayaa shirka u adeegsanaysa fursad ay ku sii xoojiso mowqifkeeda ku aaddan dib-u-habaynta nidaamka caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Pretoria waxay muddo dheer ku baaqaysay in Afrika loo sameeyo matalaad joogto ah oo Golaha Ammaanka ah, iyadoo ku doodaysa in qaab-dhismeedka hadda jira uusan si buuxda uga tarjumayn miisaanka iyo doorka qaaradda Afrika ee dunida. Dhanka Nigeria, Madaxweynaha Bola Ahmed Tinubu ayaa sidoo kale ka maqnaa New York, iyadoo madaxtooyada dalku sheegtay inuu ku jiray fasax sannadeed. Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka Nigeria, Kashim Shettima, ayaa loo diray inuu dalka ku matalo Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud. Shettima ayaa loo xilsaaray inuu jeediyo khudbadda Nigeria, isla markaana uu ka qaybqaato kulamada heerka sare iyo wada-hadallada laba-geesoodka ah ee ay dowladda Nigeria la yeelanayso dalalka iyo hay’adaha caalamiga ah. Nigeria, oo ah mid ka mid ah quwadaha dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed ee ugu waaweyn Galbeedka Afrika, ayaa UNGA81 uga faa’iidaysanaysa sidii ay u soo bandhigi lahayd danaha dalka iyo aragtideeda ku aaddan arrimaha Afrika iyo caalamka. Joogitaanka Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijinaya in maqnaanshaha Tinubu uusan ka dhignayn in Nigeria ay hoos u dhigtay heerka matalaaddeeda diblomaasiyadeed. Masar ayaa iyaduna ka mid noqotay saddexda dal ee waaweyn ee Afrika ee madaxweynahoodu uusan si shaqsi ah uga qaybgelin shirka, ayadoo Madaxweyne Abdel Fattah El-Sisi uu Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Masar, Mostafa Madbouly, u igmaday inuu hoggaamiyo wafdiga dalkaas ee New York. Madbouly ayaa ka qaybgalaya doodaha iyo kulamada dhinacyada badan ee shirka, isaga oo gudbinaya mowqifka rasmiga ah ee dowladda Masar. Inkasta oo Qaahira aysan si faahfaahsan u shaacin sababta Madaxweyne Sisi uga maqnaaday shirka, dowladda Masar waxay xaqiijisay in Ra’iisul Wasaare Madbouly uu hoggaaminayo wafdiga rasmiga ah. Masar ayaa si gaar ah diiradda u saaraysa arrimaha Bariga Dhexe, xaaladda Falastiin iyo Gaza, iyo sidoo kale doorka dalalka Afrika iyo kuwa soo koraya ee nidaamka caalamiga ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee maqnaanshaha isku marka ah ee madaxweynayaasha Koonfur Afrika, Masar iyo Nigeria ayaa soo jiitay dareenka diblomaasiyiinta iyo warbaahinta caalamka, maadaama saddexdan dal ay leeyihiin saameyn siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale oo weyn gudaha Afrika.

items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Iran Masoud Pezeshkian ayaa Arbacadii Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ku eedeeyay inuu adeegsado “maskax cagajugleyn ah”, isaga oo sheegay in dalkiisu uusan isu dhiibi doonin Mareykanka, balse uu weli diyaar u yahay wada-hadallo lagu soo afjaro dagaalka. Pezeshkian ayaa hadalkan ka jeediyay Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee New York, xilli dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Iran uu galay bishii toddobaad, isla markaana xiisadda gobolka ay sii saameyneyso dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta ee Khaliijka. Madaxweynaha Iran ayaa sheegay in hanjabaadaha Washington aysan Tehran ku qasbi doonin inay beddesho mowqifkeeda, isaga oo si gaar ah uga jawaabay hadal uu Trump maalin ka hor ka jeediyay Qaramada Midoobay, kaas oo uu uga digay Iran cawaaqib aad u culus haddii heshiis la gaari waayo. “Dadka Iran cadaadiska uma jilci doonaan,” ayuu yiri Pezeshkian, isaga oo hadalka Trump ku tilmaamay mid muujinaya hab-feker ku dhisan cagajugleyn. Si kastaba, Pezeshkian ayaa dhowr jeer ku celiyay in Iran aysan albaabka ka xirin wadahadalka, wuxuuna sheegay in Tehran ay diyaar u tahay in khilaafka lagu xalliyo miiska wada-xaajoodka, balse aysan aqbali doonin in wadahadallada lagu saleeyo hanjabaad iyo awood ciidan. Wafdiga Mareykanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa ka baxay hoolka markii Pezeshkian bilaabay khudbaddiisa, sida ay werisay Reuters. Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Qaramada Midoobay isla markiiba kama aysan jawaabin codsi faallo ah. Dhimashada rayidka Pezeshkian ayaa qayb weyn oo khudbaddiisa ka mid ah ku soo qaaday khasaaraha rayidka ee dagaalka, isaga oo Mareykanka ku eedeeyay inuu mas’uul ka yahay dhimashada dad rayid ah. Waxa uu madasha ku soo bandhigay sawirro uu ku sheegay inay muujinayaan qaar ka mid ah dhibbanayaasha, oo ay ku jireen gabdho iskuul dhigta. Mas’uuliyiinta Iran ayaa sheegay in weerar gantaal oo 28-kii Febraayo lagu qaaday dugsi hoose oo ku yaalla magaalada Minab uu dilay in ka badan 175 carruur iyo macallimiin ah. Weerarkaasi wuxuu dhacay saacado kaddib markii weerarro ay Mareykanka iyo Israel ku qaadeen Iran ay bilowdeen dagaalka hadda socda. Pentagon-ka weli si rasmi ah uma soo bandhigin natiijada baaritaankiisa weerarka Minab. Reuters ayaa bishii Maarso werisay in baaritaan hordhac ah oo gudaha militariga Mareykanka laga sameeyay uu muujiyay in ciidamada Mareykanka ay u badan tahay inay mas’uul ka ahaayeen weerarka. Warbixin ay dhowaan soo saartay guddi xaqiiqo-raadin oo Qaramada Midoobay ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inay jiraan sababo macquul ah oo lagu rumeysan karo in weerarro Mareykanku ka geystay goobaha rayidka ee Iran ay jebin karaan sharciga caalamiga ah. Barnaamijka Nukliyeerka Madaxweynaha Iran ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay muranka muddada dheer ka taagan barnaamijka nukliyeerka dalkiisa. Waxa uu sheegay in Iran aysan dooneyn inay yeelato hub nukliyeer ah, balse aysan sidoo kale ka tanaasuli doonin aqoonta iyo tiknoolajiyadda nukliyeerka ee loo adeegsan karo ujeeddooyin nabadeed. Tehran ayaa muddo dheer ku adkeysaneysay in barnaamijkeeda nukliyeerka uu yahay mid rayid ah, halka Washington iyo xulafadeedu ay ka walaacsan yihiin in Iran ay awood u yeelan karto inay horumariso hub nukliyeer ah. Khilaafka nukliyeerka ayaa weli ka mid ah qodobbada ugu waaweyn ee caqabadda ku ah heshiis lagu soo afjaro dagaalka. Marinka Hormuz Pezeshkian ayaa sidoo kale soo qaaday xaaladda Marinka Hormuz, oo ah marin istiraatiiji ah oo ay maraan ku dhowaad shan meelood meel shidaalka iyo gaaska dabiiciga ah ee dunida laga ganacsado. Xiisadda ka taagan marinka ayaa sii kordheysa iyadoo dagaalku saameeyay isu-socodka maraakiibta iyo suuqyada tamarta caalamka. Iran ayaa Mareykanka u gudbisay, iyada oo adeegsaneysa dhex-dhexaadiyeyaal, shuruudo ay ku sheegtay inay diyaar ugu tahay dib u furista marinka. Reuters ayaa Talaadadii werisay in Tehran ay dalbaneyso in Washington ay yareyso cadaadiska militari iyo xannibaadaha saaran dekedaha Iran. Pezeshkian ayaa sheegay in Iran aysan aqbali karin xaalad ay dalalka kale ka faa’iideystaan Marinka Hormuz halka iyada laga hor istaagayo inay si caadi ah u isticmaasho marin-biyoodkaas. Waxa uu sidoo kale ka digay in joogitaanka joogtada ah ee maraakiib dagaal oo Tehran u aragto kuwo cadow ah iyo sii ballaarinta dagaalka aysan horseedi doonin nabad. Hadallada Pezeshkian ayaa muujinaya in Tehran ay isku dayeyso inay laba fariimood isku mar dirto: inaysan diyaar u ahayn inay cadaadis militari iyo dhaqaale darteed isu dhiibto Mareykanka, balse ay weli u furan tahay waddo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu soo afjaro dagaalka. Dagaalka toddobada bilood socda ayaa saameyn xooggan ku yeeshay dhaqaalaha Iran, ganacsiga gobolka iyo suuqyada tamarta, iyadoo walaaca ugu weyn uu yahay in colaadda ay sii ballaarato oo ay ku faafto dalal kale oo Bariga Dhexe ah. items.title: Dowladda UK oo malaayiin dollar ugu deeqday Soomaalia
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Britain ayaa ku dhawaaqday £5 milyan oo gargaar bani’aadannimo oo cusub, oo loogu talagalay in Soomaaliya looga diyaargaroobo fatahaado la filayo inay la xiriiraan El Niño inta lagu jiro xilli-roobaadka Deyrta ee bilaha October ilaa December. Safaaradda Britain ee Muqdisho ayaa sheegtay in lacagta lagu xoojin doono nidaamyada digniinta hore, laguna taageeri doono qoysaska ku nool goobaha halista ugu jira fatahaadaha si ay ugu guuraan meelo ammaan ah, iyadoo sidoo kale la ilaalinayo adeegyada caafimaadka, nafaqada, biyaha iyo fayadhowrka. Qorshahan ayaa la filayaa inuu gaaro ilaa 600,000 oo qof oo ku nool deegaannada ay fatahaaduhu halista ku yihiin. Taageerada ayaa sidoo kale lagu ilaalin doonaa ilaa 71 xarumood oo caafimaad si ay shaqadooda u sii wataan xilliyada fatahaadaha, waxaana la ballaarin doonaa adeegyada caafimaadka guur-guura si loo gaaro dadka ay biyuhu go’doomiyaan ama guryahooda ka barakiciyaan. Qeyb ka mid ah taageerada ayaa gaari doonta dadka ku nool ku dhawaad 100 xero oo barakacayaal gudaha ah, halka barnaamijku sidoo kale diiradda saari doono ilaalinta nolol-maalmeedka bulshada ku nool meelaha fatahaadaha u nugul. Jowhar iyo Beledweyne ayaa ka mid ah magaalooyinka sida gaarka ah loogu tilmaamay goobaha halista weyn wajahaya. Chris Pycroft, oo ah Agaasimaha Horumarinta ee Safaaradda Britain ee Muqdisho, ayaa sheegay in tallaabooyin hore loo qaado ay yareyn karaan khasaaraha ka dhasha fatahaadaha. “Fatahaaduhu khasab ma aha inay isu beddelaan masiibo bani’aadannimo. Haddii tallaabo hore la qaado, qoysasku waxay u guuri karaan meelo ammaan ah, adeegyada muhiimka ah way sii shaqeyn karaan, nolol-maalmeedkana waa la ilaalin karaa,” ayuu yiri. “Markaan hadda maalgelinno, waxaan badbaadin karnaa nafaf, waxaana bulshada Soomaaliyeed ka caawin karnaa inay u adkeysato dhibaatooyinka cimilada ee mustaqbalka,” ayuu intaas ku daray. Dowladda Britain ayaa sheegtay in Soomaaliya ay isu diyaarineyso xaalado cimilo oo la xiriira El Niño, xilli abaaraha soo noqnoqda, colaadaha iyo barakacu ay horey cadaadis ugu hayeen malaayiin qof. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka, qiyaastii 2.5 milyan ilaa 3.5 milyan oo qof ayaa saameyn kala duwan kala kulmi kara fatahaadaha la filayo, taas oo sare u qaadaysa baahida loo qabo diyaargarow iyo wax ka qabasho ka hor inta aysan xaaladdu kasii darin. Ku dhawaaqista lacagta cusub ayaa Arbacadii 23-ka September lagu sameeyay Madasha Bani’aadannimada Dalka ee Muqdisho, oo ay isugu yimaadeen Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, hay’adaha bani’aadannimada iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah. Lacagta £5 milyan ah ayaa loo qeybin doonaa laba barnaamij oo Britain horey uga taageereysay Soomaaliya. Barnaamijka Caafimaad Plus ayaa heli doona £2.5 milyan, waxaana fulintiisa hoggaaminaya hay’adda Action Against Hunger. Lacagtaas ayaa lagu taageeri doonaa adeegyada caafimaadka, nafaqada, biyaha, fayadhowrka iyo ilaalinta dadka nugul. £2.5 milyan oo kale ayaa loo qoondeeyay barnaamijka RESTORE , oo ay wada fulinayaan Hay’adda Cuntada iyo Beeraha Qaramada Midoobay ee FAO, Hay’adda Socdaalka Adduunka ee IOM iyo World Vision. Barnaamijkan ayaa xoogga saari doona digniinta hore, daad-gureynta ku-meel-gaarka ah ee dadka ku jira meelaha halista ah, tallaabooyinka looga hortagayo fatahaadaha iyo kaalmo lacageed oo la gaarsiiyo qoysaska nugul. Dowladda Britain ayaa sheegtay in taageeradan cusub ay qeyb ka tahay £15 milyan oo ay u qoondeysay waddamada sida weyn ugu nugul saameynta El Niño. Soomaaliya ayaa sanadihii dambe dhowr jeer la kulantay fatahaado baaxad leh oo sababay dhimasho, barakac iyo burbur hantiyeed. Fatahaadihii la xiriiray El Niño ee 2023 ayaa saameeyay qiyaastii 2.48 milyan oo qof, halka 1.2 milyan oo qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha dalka, sida lagu sheegay xogta ay soo bandhigtay Dowladda Britain. Dowladda UK ayaa sheegtay in taageerada hadda la shaaciyay ay qeyb ka tahay dadaallo ballaaran oo ay Soomaaliya kaga taageereyso gargaarka degdegga ah iyo dhismaha awoodda bulshada si ay mustaqbalka ugu adkeysato abaaraha, fatahaadaha iyo dhibaatooyinka kale ee la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada. Sida lagu sheegay bayaanka, qiyaastii 2.5 milyan ilaa 3.5 milyan oo qof ayaa saameyn kala duwan kala kulmi kara fatahaadaha la filayo, taas oo sare u qaadaysa baahida loo qabo diyaargarow iyo wax ka qabasho ka hor inta aysan xaaladdu kasii darin. Ku dhawaaqista lacagta cusub ayaa Arbacadii 23-ka September lagu sameeyay Madasha Bani’aadannimada Dalka ee Muqdisho, oo ay isugu yimaadeen Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, hay’adaha bani’aadannimada iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah. Lacagta £5 milyan ah ayaa loo qeybin doonaa laba barnaamij oo Britain horey uga taageereysay Soomaaliya. Barnaamijka Caafimaad Plus ayaa heli doona £2.5 milyan, waxaana fulintiisa hoggaaminaya hay’adda Action Against Hunger. Lacagtaas ayaa lagu taageeri doonaa adeegyada caafimaadka, nafaqada, biyaha, fayadhowrka iyo ilaalinta dadka nugul. £2.5 milyan oo kale ayaa loo qoondeeyay barnaamijka RESTORE , oo ay wada fulinayaan Hay’adda Cuntada iyo Beeraha Qaramada Midoobay ee FAO, Hay’adda Socdaalka Adduunka ee IOM iyo World Vision. Barnaamijkan ayaa xoogga saari doona digniinta hore, daad-gureynta ku-meel-gaarka ah ee dadka ku jira meelaha halista ah, tallaabooyinka looga hortagayo fatahaadaha iyo kaalmo lacageed oo la gaarsiiyo qoysaska nugul. Dowladda Britain ayaa sheegtay in taageeradan cusub ay qeyb ka tahay £15 milyan oo ay u qoondeysay waddamada sida weyn ugu nugul saameynta El Niño. Soomaaliya ayaa sanadihii dambe dhowr jeer la kulantay fatahaado baaxad leh oo sababay dhimasho, barakac iyo burbur hantiyeed. Fatahaadihii la xiriiray El Niño ee 2023 ayaa saameeyay qiyaastii 2.48 milyan oo qof, halka 1.2 milyan oo qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha dalka, sida lagu sheegay xogta ay soo bandhigtay Dowladda Britain. Dowladda UK ayaa sheegtay in taageerada hadda la shaaciyay ay qeyb ka tahay dadaallo ballaaran oo ay Soomaaliya kaga taageereyso gargaarka degdegga ah iyo dhismaha awoodda bulshada si ay mustaqbalka ugu adkeysato abaaraha, fatahaadaha iyo dhibaatooyinka kale ee la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Masar oo New York ku yeeshay wada hadalo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga labada dal
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Abdisalam Abdi Ali, ayaa magaalada New York kulan kula yeeshay dhiggiisa dalka Masar, Dr. Badr Abdelatty, iyadoo ay socdaan shirarka iyo kulamada heerka sare ee Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Kulanka labada wasiir ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Masar , iyo sidii labada dowladood ay u sii adkeyn lahaayeen isku-duwidda mowqifyadooda ku aaddan arrimaha gobolka. Waxa si gaar ah looga hadlay xaaladda Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika , oo ah laba goobood oo muhiim u ah amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Masar ayaa kulanka ka sii muujisay mowqifkeeda ku aaddan midnimada, madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya , iyadoo Cairo ay horey dhowr jeer u caddeysay inay taageersan tahay hay’adaha qaranka Soomaaliya iyo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka. Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Masar ayaa sannadkan si gaar ah diiradda u saaray iskaashi dhinacyo badan leh, oo ay ku jiraan amniga, dhismaha hay’adaha dowladda, horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha gobolka. Labada dal ayaa sidoo kale horey uga wada hadlay doorka Masar ee Howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Taageerada iyo Xasilinta Soomaaliya (AUSSOM) iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa taageerada caalamiga ah ee howlgalka. Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee Soomaaliya iyo Masar ayaa kulamo dhowr ah yeeshay sanadkan, waxaana wada-hadalladii hore lagu soo qaaday amniga Geeska Afrika, xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha iyo amniga. Masar ayaa sidoo kale si joogto ah u sheegtay inay taageersan tahay ilaalinta madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya , iyadoo arrintaas ku xirtay muhiimadda xasilloonida Soomaaliya u leedahay nabadda iyo amniga guud ee Geeska Afrika. Dhanka Soomaaliya, kulamada noocan ah waxay qeyb ka yihiin dadaallada dowladda federaalka ay ku xoojinayso xiriirrada ay la leedahay dalalka gobolka iyo kuwa caalamka, gaar ahaan waddamada ay wadaagaan danaha amni iyo istiraatiijiyadeed ee Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika. Kulanka labada wasiir ayaa ugu dambeyn muujinaya in Soomaaliya iyo Masar ay doonayaan inay sii xoojiyaan xiriirkooda istiraatiijiga ah , iyagoo xoogga saaraya isku-duwidda diblomaasiyadda, taageerada madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya iyo iskaashiga lagu horumarinayo nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida Geeska Afrika.

items.title: Mareykanka oo fiisaha Al-Burhan ku xiray qorshe xabbad-joojin ah oo 90 maalmood ah
items.description: Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa weli aan siin fiisaha gelitaanka Jeneraal Cabdifataax Al-Burhan, madaxa Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Suudaan iyo madaxa Golaha Sare ee Ku-meelgaarka ah, xilli uu qorshuhu ahaa inuu magaalada New York uga qeybgalo kulamada Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Sida ay ilo xog-ogaal ah u sheegeen Reuters, arrinta fiisaha ayaa lala xiriiriyay qorshe Mareykanku taageerayo oo lagu doonayo in lagu gaaro xabbad-joojin 90 maalmood ah oo ka dhaqan gasha dagaalka Suudaan. Qorshahan xabbad-joojinta ah ayaa la sheegay inuu soo jeediyay Massad Boulos, oo ah la-taliyaha sare ee Mareykanka u qaabilsan arrimaha Carabta iyo Afrika, iyadoo Washington ay doonayso in labada dhinac ee dagaallamaya ay qaadaan tallaabooyin bani’aadannimo oo horseedi kara in dagaalka la joojiyo, kadibna loo gudbo wada-hadallo siyaasadeed oo lagu raadinayo xal waara. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta Reuters, bixitaanka fiisaha Al-Burhan ayaa u muuqda inuu ku xiran yahay mowqifka dowladda Suudaan ee ku aaddan qorshaha xabbad-joojinta. Ciidamada Suudaan ayaa walaac iyo shuruudo ka muujiyay hindisaha, iyagoo dalbanaya in Ciidamada Taageerada Degdegga ah ee RSF ay ka baxaan magaalooyinka iyo deegaannada ay qabsadeen tan iyo markii uu dagaalku billowday bishii Abriil 2023. Mareykanka ayaa xabbad-joojinta 90-ka maalmood ah u arka tallaabo bilow ah oo lagu fududeynayo gargaarka bani’aadannimo iyo ilaalinta dadka rayidka ah, ka hor inta aan loo gudbin wada-hadallo ku saabsan xabbad-joojin joogto ah iyo geeddi-socod siyaasadeed oo rayidku hoggaamiyo. Arrintan ayaa muujinaysa in Washington ay isku dayayso inay cadaadis diblomaasiyadeed ku kordhiso dhinacyada dagaalka ku jira si loo abuuro waddo loo maro wada-hadal siyaasadeed. Dhinaca kale, dowladda Suudaan ayaa arrinta fiisaha u gudbisay Qaramada Midoobay, ayadoo Danjiraha Suudaan u fadhiya Qaramada Midoobay, Al-Harith Idriss Al-Harith, uu warqad u diray Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay António Guterres, isaga oo ka codsaday inuu Washington kala hadlo arrinta oo uu gacan ka geysto sidii loo xallin lahaa muranka ka dhashay fiisaha madaxweynaha Golaha Sare ee Suudaan. Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa muujiyay walaac ku saabsan in fiisaha Al-Burhan aan weli la soo saarin, ayadoo afhayeenka Guterres, Stéphane Dujarric, uu sheegay in Xoghaynta Qaramada Midoobay ay arrinta kala hadashay mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka isla markaana ay sii waddo dadaallada lagu raadinayo xal. Muranka ayaa sidoo kale taabanaya arrin diblomaasiyadeed oo xasaasi ah, maadaama xarunta Qaramada Midoobay ay ku taallo New York oo Mareykanku yahay dalka martigeliya. khilaafka ka dhashay fiisaha Al-Burhan wuxuu hadda isku xirayaa laba arrimood oo diblomaasiyadeed oo xasaasi ah : ka qeybgalka madaxda Suudaan ee shirarka Qaramada Midoobay iyo dadaallada Mareykanka ee lagu doonayo in dhinacyada dagaallamaya lagu qanciyo xabbad-joojin 90 maalmood ah.

items.title: Maxaa looga hadlay kulanka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo Dhaxal-sugaha Kuwait ?
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada New York kulan doceed kula yeeshay Dhaxal-sugaha Dowladda Kuwait, Sheekh Sabah Khaled Al-Hamad Al-Sabah, iyadoo ay socdaan kulamada heerka sare ee Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Kulanka labada mas’uul ayaa looga hadlay xoojinta iyo ballaarinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Kuwait, gaar ahaan dhinacyada muhiimka u ah horumarka iyo danaha labada shacab. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa is-weydaarsaday aragtiyo ku saabsan xaaladda gobolka iyo isbeddellada amni ee ka jira Bariga Dhexe. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa kulanka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda uu xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Kuwait u leeyahay labada dal, isaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in la sii xoojiyo lana ballaariyo iskaashiga labada dhinac. Madaxweynaha ayaa si gaar ah u tilmaamay muhiimadda iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, diblomaasiyadda iyo horumarka, kuwaas oo qeyb muhiim ah ka ah danaha labada dowladood. Kulanka ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay dadaal ugu jirto xoojinta xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga ay la leedahay dowladaha saaxiibka ah, iyadoo Madaxweynaha iyo wafdigiisa ay New York ka wadaan kulamo doceedyo ay la yeelanayaan madax iyo mas’uuliyiin ka qeybgalaya shirarka Qaramada Midoobay. Dhanka kale, xaaladda amni ee Bariga Dhexe ayaa kamid ahayd qodobada lagu lafa-guray kulanka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen isbeddellada gobolka iyo arrimaha amni ee saameynaya xasilloonida Bariga Dhexe.

items.title: “Soomaali Heshiis ah”: When Agreement Means Submission
items.description: By Isha Qarsoon Somalia’s conflicts are often treated as separate stories: a regional election, a commander’s defection, a disputed appointment, a militia clash. Yet families flee fighting, soldiers turn their weapons on other Somali soldiers, and communities carry old grievances into new political confrontations. The connection is a government promising Soomaali heshiis ah while pursuing an agreement that increasingly resembles submission. Those who accept its preferred arrangements are included; those who resist are treated as obstacles. Hassan Sheikh Mohamud did not create every conflict now unfolding across Somalia. His responsibility lies in how he responds to the country’s divisions. A president can establish rules that allow opponents to coexist, contest authority and accept decisions. Or he can exploit those divisions to win a series of temporary victories. Such victories may protect an officeholder while making the country harder to govern. That pattern is visible across Somalia’s federal states. For ordinary citizens, public authority has become difficult to read. A uniform no longer identifies a dependable authority. An election announcement does not guarantee an accepted process. A reconciliation ceremony does not show which concessions were made, whose interests were traded or how long the arrangement will last. People bear the consequences while decisions about their safety remain hidden in negotiations among powerful men. This lack of transparency is a governance failure: the public cannot hold a bargain accountable when its terms are concealed. After Puntland rejected his constitutional and electoral programme, HSM tried to weaken its resistance by placing local forces under federal command, turning a political dispute into an armed confrontation. In August, Puntland seized federal-aligned bases and expelled or absorbed the forces stationed there. General Jimcaale’s men at Ligle camp also returned to Puntland’s command. Mogadishu lost military influence, and the underlying dispute remained unresolved. HSM had secured neither Puntland’s agreement nor its submission; he had added fighting to a political rupture. Jubaland had already shown the danger of trying to overcome a member state’s political resistance by force. After Ahmed Madobe proceeded with a regional election that Mogadishu rejected, HSM deployed federal troops to Ras Kamboni. Jubaland’s forces defeated them in December 2024. Madobe remained in office, and the electoral dispute remained unresolved. The intervention secured neither his removal nor his cooperation; it sent Somali soldiers into battle against other Somali soldiers over a dispute that military defeat could not settle. In Gedo, HSM relied on Abdirashid Janan to strengthen federal control in a region contested by Mogadishu and Jubaland. In August 2026, Janan reached an accommodation with Jubaland and took his forces with him. The commander Mogadishu had used to extend its influence became the vehicle for losing it, revealing how heavily federal authority depended on one man’s political arrangements. Janan resolved his dispute with Jubaland, but not the competing claims over Gedo or the risks residents face when the next alliance breaks down. In Southwest, the armed conflict followed the federal effort to remove Laftagareen. Political tension over elections and constitutional authority had been building, but the dispute became a military confrontation when federal troops and allied forces entered Baidoa in March. Laftagareen resigned after they took control. His removal did not end the crisis it had triggered: forces loyal to him later fought federal and regional government forces in May, August and September, injuring civilians and repeatedly bringing violence into Baidoa. HSM replaced the regional president, but the method of removal turned a political dispute into an armed struggle that residents continued to endure. In Hirshabelle, HSM’s support for Ali Guudlaawe’s return to office has sharpened a dispute over which communities hold power in the regional government. Vice-President Yusuf Dabageed accuses him of abandoning a promise that the presidency would pass to a leader from Hiiraan. Armed men have already seized voter-registration centres in Beledweyne. These events unfold amid recurrent communal fighting along the Hiiraan–Middle Shabelle boundary, including around Ceel Baraf. In September, army soldier Ahmed Shire Hussein was captured near Ceel Baraf and killed in a reported clan-revenge attack after being filmed pleading for his life. The killing exposed the government’s inability to protect even its own soldiers travelling home. The electoral dispute is therefore entering communities already divided by violence and unresolved grievances. Pressing ahead without addressing objections to the process risks turning the election into another cause for armed mobilisation. Installing a preferred president would not resolve the divisions that make his authority contested. Galmudug faces an electoral dispute while older conflicts remain unsettled. In western Mudug, neighbouring communities have repeatedly fought over land and water, with killings provoking retaliation across the Puntland–Galmudug boundary. Those conflicts predate the current controversy, but they define the conditions in which HSM is pursuing his political programme: communities remain armed, grievances unresolved, and regional institutions unable to provide a dependable means of settling disputes. An election that excludes significant constituencies could give those communities another reason to mobilise. The dispute involving Towfiiq, led by Sheikh Shakir of Ahlu Sunna, raises a related question of political inclusion. After successfully challenging the earlier election, the party rejected the rerun timetable. The commission says Towfiiq did not apply to participate. That explanation matters, but it does not remove the political risk posed by a significant organised constituency remaining outside the process. Renewed war is not inevitable, but an uncontested announcement is not evidence of reconciliation. In the Northeast, federal recognition has added a member state without settling the disputes that threaten its survival. Local aspirations for self-government are real, but Somaliland and Puntland both claim territory within its proposed boundaries, and agreement among the communities it seeks to govern remains incomplete. HSM’s support cannot resolve those conflicts by conferring federal status. If the new state becomes a means of weakening Puntland, its residents will bear the consequences of a confrontation shaped by federal political interests. They need an administration that can protect them and settle disputes with their neighbours. Recognition alone provides neither. Mogadishu has also borne the cost of unresolved political disputes. In June, government forces and opposition-aligned militias fought in residential neighbourhoods, forcing civilians to flee. Elsewhere, protests over Turkey’s military role and allegations of civilian casualties demanded a government response. Parliamentary Speaker Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur instead attributed the burning of Turkish flags to a foreign agenda. The accusation did not address whether civilians had been harmed, who authorised the operations or how those responsible would be held accountable. It shifted suspicion onto the protesters while leaving their complaints unanswered. The opposition offers little assurance that replacing the president would change this practice. A candidate can condemn HSM’s conduct while expecting to exercise the same discretion once in office. The relevant test is whether he would accept rules governing appointments, public spending and security operations even when those rules constrain him. Would he accept a court decision against his government? Would he allow an unqualified supporter to lose a position? Opposition to the incumbent establishes none of those commitments. These conflicts have different histories, but they expose the same institutional failure: political settlements repeatedly leave unanswered who has authority, what limits apply and who can enforce them. Negotiation may stop fighting temporarily. But when a settlement gives participants only enough to suspend confrontation, the dispute remains ready to resume. A commander changes sides, a promised position goes to somebody else or an election threatens an incumbent, and the bargain collapses. The country must then negotiate again because its institutions were never empowered to settle the issue. HSM’s government is also embedding political obligations in the daily operation of public institutions. Appointing an unqualified person as a favour makes that employee dependent on the patron who secured and protects the position. Accountability runs to the benefactor, while the public receives poor service. Over time, employees and patrons develop a shared interest in resisting reform. A future president who enforces attendance, requires qualifications or removes an incompetent employee may discover how many powerful people the decision threatens. Appeasing them creates further obligations and makes the next correction harder. Each appointment may solve an immediate political problem while making institutional reform more costly and destabilizing. State building requires public institutions that can function despite political resistance. A ministry must be able to discipline an employee. A court must be able to decide a dispute and have its judgment enforced. An election must allow political competition without sending the losers to war. Each improvement makes government more dependable; each exemption secured through political influence weakens it. Soomaali heshiis ah must mean that Somalis can disagree while living under institutions that protect them. If the president secures agreement by rewarding compliance, excluding opponents or overpowering them, his victories will continue to deepen the conflicts they claim to resolve. Those who accept its preferred arrangements are included; those who resist are treated as obstacles. Hassan Sheikh Mohamud did not create every conflict now unfolding across Somalia. items.title: Northeastern State Says It Detained Somaliland-Linked Forces Near Las Anod
items.description: Security Minister Says Nearly 10 Personnel and Three Vehicles Were Seized After Crossing Into State-Controlled Territory Laascaanood (WDN) — Tensions around the disputed Sool region have resurfaced after the Northeastern State administration said it detained nearly 10 armed personnel and seized three vehicles after they crossed into territory under its control. Northeastern State Security Minister Abdirisaq Farah Warsame said the forces were detained on Tuesday afternoon after entering the administration’s area from the direction of Somaliland. The minister said the border between the two sides has remained closed since the fighting between Somaliland and local forces in 2023, and suggested that the administration would maintain the closure until what he described as fundamental political conditions were met. “We will open the road when they acknowledge that they are Somali and recognize Northeastern State as a Somali state. Until then, it will remain closed,” Warsame said. Forces Referred to Legal Authorities Warsame alleged that the personnel and vehicles had been sent from the Somaliland side but were subsequently intercepted by Northeastern State forces. He said those detained would be dealt with through the law, although no further details were immediately provided about their identities, mission or the circumstances that led to their crossing. The incident highlights the continuing sensitivity of movement and security operations around Las Anod and the wider Sool region, where competing political claims have remained unresolved since the 2023 conflict. The minister also accused Somaliland President Abdirahman Irro of failing to recognize what he described as the new political reality in the region, saying his administration remained alert to any developments. Political Rhetoric Raises the Temperature In particularly strong remarks, Warsame accused the Somaliland leadership of continuing to pursue its claims over Sool and made allegations concerning Somaliland’s alleged relationship with Israel. Those accusations reflect the minister’s political position and were not independently substantiated in the report. The latest incident comes as relations between Somaliland and Northeastern State remain strained, despite recent signals from both sides about the possibility of dialogue and reconciliation. The detention of the personnel could therefore add another layer of tension to an already sensitive security environment. For now, the Northeastern State administration says the detained personnel and their vehicles remain in its custody and will be handled according to law. Further clarification from Somaliland on the incident could determine whether the episode remains a localized security matter or develops into a wider political dispute WardheerNews The post Northeastern State Says It Detained Somaliland-Linked Forces Near Las Anod appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Eastleigh Tensions Soar as Somali-Owned Building Faces Demolition
items.description: Debt Dispute Draws Demolition Crews, Security Forces and Crowds Seeking Building Materials Nairobi (WDN) — A routine-looking demolition operation in Nairobi’s Eastleigh district erupted into tension on Tuesday after Kenyan authorities moved against a Somali-owned multi-storey building, drawing security personnel and crowds seeking to remove materials from the site. The building, located along 11th Street, was reportedly ordered demolished after its Somali owner allegedly failed to repay an outstanding debt. The precise nature of the debt and the legal proceedings behind the demolition were not immediately clear from the reports. Demolition crews arrived at the property in the morning and began preparations to bring the building down. Their arrival was soon followed by groups of people attempting to take construction materials from the structure. Crowds Converge as Demolition Begins The situation became increasingly tense as people reportedly targeted metal components being removed from the building. Security personnel and workers intervened to prevent the materials from being taken, leading to a confrontation at the site. Reports described shouting and physical altercations as authorities attempted to control the crowd and continue the demolition operation. The presence of people seeking materials added an unexpected dimension to what had begun as a property enforcement operation, turning the site into a scene of heightened activity and tension. Questions Surround Legal Basis The immediate reports did not establish whether the property owner had contested the demolition order, whether a court had issued a final enforcement ruling, or what specific debt was cited as the basis for the action. Those details are significant because the demolition of a privately owned building involves legal and property-rights questions that cannot be resolved solely from reports emerging from the scene. Kenyan authorities have yet to provide a detailed public account of the operation, including the legal order authorizing the demolition and the measures taken to prevent the removal of property from the site. Eastleigh Watches Closely The incident is likely to attract particular attention in Eastleigh, one of Nairobi’s most prominent commercial districts and a major centre of the city’s Somali community. For now, the central facts remain relatively limited: authorities moved to demolish a Somali-owned building over an alleged unpaid debt; demolition crews arrived at the site; groups attempted to remove materials; and a confrontation followed. The larger questions — why the demolition was ordered, what legal process preceded it, and what will happen to the property and its owner — remain to be clarified. This version gives the story a stronger front-page lead while keeping the debt, legal authorization, and events at the site appropriately attributed rather than treating disputed details as established facts. items.title: Uganda-Türkiye Rift Puts Somalia’s Security Partnerships Under the Spotlight
items.description: Kampala Suspends Military Cooperation with Ankara as Dispute Raises Questions Over Uganda’s Role in Somalia KAMPALA (WDN) — Somalia has emerged as an important backdrop to a widening dispute between Uganda and Türkiye after Kampala suspended all defence and military cooperation with Ankara, raising questions about the potential implications for Somalia’s increasingly complex security partnerships. A Dispute Unfolds The sequence of events has drawn particular attention. On September 18, 2026, supporters of Uganda’s Patriotic League demonstrated outside the Turkish Embassy in Kampala, demanding the return of Ugandan political commentator Fred Lumbuye, whose extradition Uganda has previously sought. On September 19, the Uganda People’s Defence Forces announced the immediate suspension of all military and defence cooperation with Türkiye, citing unresolved bilateral defence issues. The official statement did not mention either Somalia or Lumbuye and did not publicly identify the specific dispute behind the decision. On September 21, Middle East Eye , citing sources familiar with the matter, reported that the dispute was linked to Uganda’s military presence in Somalia and Türkiye’s expanding security role there. The sources reportedly said disagreements had emerged over the future of Ugandan forces in Somalia, with Mogadishu seeking a gradual transfer of greater security responsibility to Somali forces. Neither Uganda nor Somalia had publicly confirmed that explanation, making it important to distinguish the reported Somalia connection from the official Ugandan announcement. Somalia at the Centre of a Wider Strategic Contest The dispute nevertheless has particular significance for Somalia.Uganda has thousands of troops serving in Somalia under AUSSOM, following its participation in earlier African Union missions. Türkiye, meanwhile, has developed a substantial security partnership with Mogadishu, including military training, defence cooperation and support for Somali forces. Uganda is also expected to withdraw its forces from Somalia by August 2027, according to recent reporting, adding another dimension to the debate over the future of Somalia’s security arrangements. Financial and Strategic Stakes Some reports have suggested that Uganda could lose tens of millions of dollars annually if its military presence in Somalia were significantly reduced. Those figures have not been officially confirmed by either Uganda or Somalia and should therefore be treated cautiously. The broader strategic picture is clearer: Uganda remains a major contributor to international military efforts against Al-Shabaab, while Türkiye has steadily expanded its role in training and supporting Somalia’s security institutions. The two partnerships are not inherently incompatible. But the deterioration in Kampala-Ankara relations raises questions about whether their competing strategic interests could eventually affect Somalia’s security environment. For now, neither Uganda nor Türkiye has announced any change to its military activities in Somalia as a direct consequence of the dispute. The immediate question is whether the September 19 rupture—and the Somalia-related explanation reported two days later—will eventually have consequences for the security partnerships on which Somalia continues to depend. items.title: Muxuu Xasan Sheekh kala hadlay madaxweynaha Serbia iyo dhaxal-sugaha Kuwait?
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa magaalada New York ee dalka Mareykanka kulamo doceedyo kula yeeshay Madaxweynaha Serbia, Aleksandar Vučić iyo Dhaxal-sugaha dalka Kuwait, Sheekh Sabah Khaled Al-Hamad Al-Sabah. Kulamadan oo barbar socday meertada 81-aad ee shir madaxeedka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa waxaa looga hadlay arrimo la xiriira xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo labada dal. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo Madaxweynaha Serbia, Aleksandar Vučić, ayaa ka wada-hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal iyo sidii loo horumarin lahaa danaha wadajirka ah ee labada dhinac. Sidoo kale, kulanka uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh la yeeshay Dhaxal-sugaha Kuwait ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Kuwait iyo fursadaha lagu sii xoojin karo iskaashiga labada dal. Kulamadan ayaa sidoo kale waxaa looga wada-hadlay xaaladda gobolka, gaar ahaan arrimaha nabadda iyo amniga iyo isbeddellada ka socda Bariga Dhexe. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la ballaariyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo labada dal, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, diblomaasiyadda iyo horumarka. Kulamadan ayaa qeyb ka ahaa kulamada diblomaasiyadeed ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu ka wado magaalada New York, iyadoo uu halkaasi kaga qeyb-galayo shirarka iyo howlaha la xiriira Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyey dagaalka ka qarxay Itoobiya oo gaaray saddex gobool
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) — Dagaal culus ayaa dib uga qarxay waqooyiga Itoobiya, iyadoo ciidamada Tigray ay la wareegeen garoomo diyaaradeed oo muhiim ah, isla markaana ay dagaallo la galeen ciidamada dowladda federaalka ee gobollada deriska la ah Tigray. Dagaalladan ayaa si weyn u kordhiyay cabsida laga qabo in Itoobiya ay dib ugu laabato colaad baaxad leh, afar sano kadib heshiiskii nabadeed ee soo afjaray dagaalkii dhiigga badan ku daatay ee dowladda federaalka iyo Tigray. Ilo kala duwan ayaa wakaaladda wararka AFP u sheegay in ciidamada Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) ay weerarro ka fuliyeen gobolka Afar, halkaas oo ay dagaallo kula galeen ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya. Maamulka gobolka Afar ayaa xaqiijiyay in weerar lagu qaaday magaalada Abala oo ku taalla dhulka buuraleyda ah ee xadka Tigray, halka shaqaale samafal ay sheegeen in dagaallo sidoo kale ka dhaceen Erebti, oo qiyaastii 100 kiiloomitir gudaha Afar u jirta Abala. Mid ka mid ah shaqaalaha samafalka ayaa sheegay in laga cabsi qabo in dagaalku ku sii fido deegaanno kale, islamarkaana gargaar cunto ah loo diray dad hor leh oo colaadda awgeed barakacay. Ilo dhinaca ammaanka ah oo ajaanib ah ayaa AFP u sheegay in ciidamada Tigray ay la wareegeen Abala. Sarkaal hore oo sare oo ka tirsanaa TPLF ayaa isna sheegay in xoogagga Tigray ay gacanta ku dhigeen dhowr magaalo oo kale oo Afar ku yaalla, inkastoo sheegashadaas aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin. Sarkaalkaasi wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada federaalka ay si degdeg ah uga baxayaan qaar ka mid ah goobaha uu dagaalku ka socdo. Dagaalka oo fiday Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale gaaray dhinaca gobolka Amxaarada. Hay’adda ACLED oo la socota colaadaha caalamka ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada Tigray ay weerareen fariisimo ku yaalla gobolkaas, iyagoo meelo ka mid ah dagaalka kala shaqeynaya xoogagga Fano. TPLF iyo Fano, oo dhinacyo iska soo horjeeday dagaalkii hore ee Tigray, ayaa hadda ka mid ah isbahaysi cusub oo ay sameysteen toddoba urur oo hubeysan oo ka kala socda qaybo kala duwan oo Itoobiya ah. ACLED ayaa sheegtay in iskaashiga cusub iyo dagaallada ka socda dhowr jiho ay abuuri karaan walaac ah in kooxaha kale ee isbahaysiga ku jira ay iyaguna dhaqdhaqaaqyo ka bilaabaan gobollada ay ka howlgalaan. Dhanka kale, dowladda federaalka Itoobiya ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga hadlin dagaalladii ugu dambeeyay. Maamulka Tigray ayaa sheegay in howlgallada ciidamadiisu ay jawaab u yihiin duqeymo xooggan oo uu sheegay in ciidamada federaalka ay Talaadadii ku qaadeen Tigray, iyagoo adeegsanaya diyaarado, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo madaafiic. AFP ma aysan awoodin inay si madax-bannaan u xaqiijiso sheegashada duqeymahaas. “Waa bilowga dagaalka,” ayuu madaxweyne ku-xigeenka TPLF Amanuel Assefa u sheegay AFP. Wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada dowladda ay Tigray ka soo weerareen dhinacyada koonfurta iyo bariga, taasna ay keentay in ciidamada Tigray lagu amro inay iska difaacaan. “Ma arko hadda suurta-galnimada in xiisadda la dejiyo,” ayuu yiri. Ciidamada Tigray ayaa sidoo kale la wareegay garoomada diyaaradaha ee magaalooyinka Mekelle, Shire iyo Axum, sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha TPLF. Shaqaale ka tirsan garoonka Alula Aba Nega ee Mekelle ayaa AFP u sheegay in isaga iyo shaqaale kale loo sheegay inay guryahooda ku laabtaan kadib markii la ogaaday in ciidamada Tigray ay qabsadeen garoonka. Shirkadda Ethiopian Airlines ayaa hakisay duulimaadyadii ay ku tagi jirtay Mekelle, Shire iyo Axum, iyadoo xaaladda ammaanka ee waqooyiga dalka ay sii xumaaneyso. Baaqa Midowga Afrika Midowga Afrika ayaa ku baaqay in si degdeg ah loo joojiyo sii xumaanshaha xaaladda, lana ilaaliyo heshiiskii nabadda ee Pretoria ee sanadkii 2022 soo afjaray dagaalkii hore. Dagaalka cusub ayaa yimid maalmo kadib markii TPLF iyo lix urur oo kale ay ku dhawaaqeen isbahaysi cusub oo ka dhan ah dowladda federaalka ee Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed. Itoobiya ayaa durba wajahaysa kacdoonno iyo dagaallo ka socda gobollo kala duwan, gaar ahaan Amxaarada iyo Oromia, halka xiriirka dowladda federaalka iyo Tigray uu bilihii ugu dambeeyay si joogto ah u sii xumaanayay. TPLF ayaa Itoobiya xukumaysay intii u dhaxeysay 1991 iyo 2018, balse awoodda siyaasadeed ka lumisay markii Abiy Ahmed uu noqday ra’iisul wasaare. Khilaafkii labada dhinac ayaa November 2020 isu beddelay dagaal weyn oo socday laba sano. Qiyaasaha Midowga Afrika ayaa sheegaya in ilaa 600,000 oo qof ay ku dhinteen colaaddaas. Heshiiskii Pretoria ee November 2022 ayaa joojiyay dagaalka, balse qodobo badan oo heshiiska ka mid ah ayaan weli si buuxda loo fulin. Xiisadda ayaa mar kale xoogeysatay dhammaadkii 2025 iyo sanadkan 2026, iyadoo dagaallo goos-goos ah, duqeymo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah iyo ciidamo la geeyay xuduudaha Tigray ay sare u qaadeen cabsida laga qabo dagaal kale. Tigray weli kama soo kaban dagaalkii hore. Qiyaastii hal milyan oo qof ayaa weli barakac ah, halka hay’adaha xuquuqda aadanaha ay sidoo kale TPLF ku eedeeyeen inay sanadkan sameysay qorista dad lagu khasbayo inay ku biiraan ciidamadeeda. Dagaallada hadda ka socda Afar, Amxaarada iyo hareeraha Tigray ayaa sidaas darteed noqonaya tijaabadii ugu weynayd ee soo wajahda heshiiskii Pretoria tan iyo markii la saxiixay afar sano ka hor.
