items.title: Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo kormeeray Taliska Sirdoonka Militariga
items.description: Kusimaha Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ahna Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka, Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa galabta kormeeray Xarunta Taliska Sirdoonka Militariga ama Taliska Sahanka iyo Sirdoonka ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Magaalada Muqdisho. Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa la kulmay Madaxda Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga, iyadoona la sheegay in kulanka looga hadlay xoojinta amniga Caasimadda Muqdisho iyo adkaynta difaaca dalka. “Kusimaha Madaxweynaha ayaa kulan la qaatay madaxda sare ee Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed iyo Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga, iyadoo kulanka diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta amniga Caasimadda Muqdisho, adkaynta difaaca iyo kor u qaadista wada-shaqaynta hay’adaha amniga iyo difaaca dalka.” Ayaa lagu yiri war lagu daabacay bogga wararka ee Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. “Intii uu socday kormeerka, Kusimaha Madaxweynaha waxaa ku weheliyay Wasiirka Gaashaandhiga, Wasiiru Dowlaha Gaashaandhiga, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Gudoomiyeyaasha Maxkamadda iyo Taliyaha Taliska Sahanka iyo Sirdoonka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Madaxda ayaa si wadajir ah u dhagax-dhigay xarumo cusub oo xabsi ah, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay xubnaha dembiileyaasha ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, taas oo qayb ka ah horumarinta iyo tayeynta kaabeyaasha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.” Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa 13-kii bishii September ee sanadkii hore daahfuray Xarunta Taliska Sahanka iyo Sirdoonka ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, taas oo loo dhisay qaab casri ah, iyadoona uu ujeedku ahaa in lagu xoojiyo awoodda difaaca iyo sugidda amniga qaranka.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ugu dambeyn Pakistan ka heshay diyaaradda casriga ee JF-17
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud ayaa dhiggiisa Pakistan, Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz ka guddoomay haddiyad ay ka muuqayo diyaarad casriga ah ee JF-17 ah xilli Taliyaha Difaaca Cirka Pakistan uu booqasho ku tagay xarunta Taliska Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed ee magaalada Muqdisho. Guddoonsiinta diyaaraddan ayaa dhacday kaddib kulan dhexmaray labada taliye, kaas oo looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, gaar ahaan dib-u-dhiska iyo horumarinta Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Labada taliye ayaa sidoo kale is-weydaarsaday xog ku saabsan xaaladda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo kulanka diiradda lagu saaray baahiyaha mudnaanta leh ee dhinacyada tababarka, qalabka iyo horumarinta awoodda ciidamada cirka. JF-17 Thunder waa diyaarad dagaal oo hal matoor leh, waxaana si wadajir ah u horumariyay Pakistan iyo Shiinaha. Diyaaraddan ayaa loogu talagalay inay fuliso hawlgallo kala duwan, oo ay kamid yihiin difaaca hawada, weerarrada dhulka iyo hawlgallada kale ee dagaalka. Nooca JF-17 Block III ayaa ah nooca ugu casrisan ee diyaaraddan, waxaana lagu sameeyay horumarin dhinacyada radar-ka, nidaamyada avionics-ka, isgaarsiinta iyo awoodda ay u leedahay inay adeegsato hub casri ah. Diyaaraddu waxay sidoo kale awood u leedahay inay qaaddo noocyo kala duwan oo hub ah, oo ay ku jiraan gantaallada hawada, gantaallada lagu weeraro bartilmaameedyada dhulka iyo bambooyinka, iyadoo ku xiran nooca hawlgalka loo adeegsanayo. Booqashada Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz ayaa qayb ka ahayd dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka milatari ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, iyadoo wafdiga Pakistan uu sidoo kale kormeer ku sameeyay xarunta Taliska Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Intii uu socday kormeerka, saraakiisha Pakistan ayaa la kulmay madaxda iyo saraakiisha ka howlgasha qaybaha kala duwan ee Taliska, iyagoo xog ka helay xaaladda iyo baahiyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Booqashada ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli wafdi sare oo ka socda dowladda Pakistan uu maalmahan ku sugnaa Muqdisho, halkaas oo ay kulamo gaar-gaar ah kula yeesheen madaxda sare ee dowladda Soomaaliya. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sanadihii la soo dhaafay dadaal ugu jirtay sidii ay heli laheyd diyaaradda JF-17 oo ah mid casri ah. Si kastaba, iskaashiga dhinaca milatariga ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan ayaa kamid ah arrimaha ay labada dowladood diiradda saarayaan, iyadoo kulamadan ay qayb ka yihiin qorshayaasha lagu xoojinayo awoodda iyo tayada Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Guddoonsiinta diyaaraddan ayaa dhacday kaddib kulan dhexmaray labada taliye, kaas oo looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, gaar ahaan dib-u-dhiska iyo horumarinta Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Labada taliye ayaa sidoo kale is-weydaarsaday xog ku saabsan xaaladda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo kulanka diiradda lagu saaray baahiyaha mudnaanta leh ee dhinacyada tababarka, qalabka iyo horumarinta awoodda ciidamada cirka. JF-17 Thunder waa diyaarad dagaal oo hal matoor leh, waxaana si wadajir ah u horumariyay Pakistan iyo Shiinaha. Diyaaraddan ayaa loogu talagalay inay fuliso hawlgallo kala duwan, oo ay kamid yihiin difaaca hawada, weerarrada dhulka iyo hawlgallada kale ee dagaalka. Nooca JF-17 Block III ayaa ah nooca ugu casrisan ee diyaaraddan, waxaana lagu sameeyay horumarin dhinacyada radar-ka, nidaamyada avionics-ka, isgaarsiinta iyo awoodda ay u leedahay inay adeegsato hub casri ah. Diyaaraddu waxay sidoo kale awood u leedahay inay qaaddo noocyo kala duwan oo hub ah, oo ay ku jiraan gantaallada hawada, gantaallada lagu weeraro bartilmaameedyada dhulka iyo bambooyinka, iyadoo ku xiran nooca hawlgalka loo adeegsanayo. Booqashada Air Marshal Muhammad Sarfraz ayaa qayb ka ahayd dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka milatari ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, iyadoo wafdiga Pakistan uu sidoo kale kormeer ku sameeyay xarunta Taliska Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Intii uu socday kormeerka, saraakiisha Pakistan ayaa la kulmay madaxda iyo saraakiisha ka howlgasha qaybaha kala duwan ee Taliska, iyagoo xog ka helay xaaladda iyo baahiyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. Booqashada ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli wafdi sare oo ka socda dowladda Pakistan uu maalmahan ku sugnaa Muqdisho, halkaas oo ay kulamo gaar-gaar ah kula yeesheen madaxda sare ee dowladda Soomaaliya. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sanadihii la soo dhaafay dadaal ugu jirtay sidii ay heli laheyd diyaaradda JF-17 oo ah mid casri ah. Si kastaba, iskaashiga dhinaca milatariga ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan ayaa kamid ah arrimaha ay labada dowladood diiradda saarayaan, iyadoo kulamadan ay qayb ka yihiin qorshayaasha lagu xoojinayo awoodda iyo tayada Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed. items.title: IGAD oo ku baaqday in si degdeg ah loo dejiyo xiisadaha ka taagan Waqooyiga Itoobiya
items.description: Jabuuti, Sebteembar 23, 2026: Urur-goboleedka IGAD ayaa walaac xooggan ka muujiyay kororka xiisadaha ka taagan waqooyiga Itoobiya, iyadoo ay soo baxayaan warar ku saabsan dagaallo dib u soo cusboonaaday, la wareegidda garoomo diyaaradeed oo rayid ah iyo hakad ku yimid adeegyada duulimaadyada. IGAD ayaa dhinacyada ugu baaqday inay joojiyaan colaadda, muujiyaan is-xakameyn buuxda, kana fogaadaan tallaabo kasta oo halis gelin karta nolosha dadka rayidka ah ama wiiqi karta geeddi-socodka nabadda. Ururku wuxuu xusay in Heshiiskii Pretoria ee 2-dii Nofeembar 2022, kaas oo lagu gaaray joojinta colaadda, uu weli yahay qaabka lagu heshiiyey ee wax looga qabanayo arrimaha aan weli xal loo helin, isagoo ku baaqay in si buuxda loo ilaaliyo qodobbada heshiiska. IGAD ayaa sidoo kale ku baaqday in dhinacyadu si degdeg ah ugu laabtaan wada-hadal toos ah, iyadoo dalalka deriska ah loogu baaqay inay taageeraan dadaallada lagu dejinayo xiisadda ayna ka fogaadaan tallaabooyin xaaladda sii xumeyn kara. Urur-goboleedka ayaa sheegay inuu taageersan yahay dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Midowga Afrika iyo ilaalinta natiijooyinkii laga gaaray Heshiiskii Pretoria, isagoo ka digay in dib ugu noqoshada dagaal baahsan ay cawaaqib culus ku yeelan karto Itoobiya iyo guud ahaan gobolka.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo New York kula kulmay Kaaliyaha Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ee Afrika
items.description: New York, Sebteembar 23, 2026: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada New York kulan doceed miro-dhal ah kula yeeshay Kaaliyaha Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ee Arrimaha Afrika, Mudane Frank Garcia. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay is-weydaarsadeen aragtiyo ku saabsan arrimaha mudnaanta u leh labada dal iyo danaha ay wadaagaan. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa uga mahadceliyay Dowladda Mareykanka taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dowlad-dhiska, amniga iyo horumarinta hay’adaha dowliga ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, si loo horumariyo xiriirka labada dal iyo danaha ay wadaagaan.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo kulan miro-dhal New York kula yeeshay Frank Garcia + Sawirro
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa magaalada New York kulan doceed miro-dhal ah kula yeeshay Kaaliyaha Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ee Arrimaha Afrika, Mudane Frank Garcia. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada-hadleen arrimaha mudnaanta u leh labada dal. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo Frank Garcia ayaa sidoo kale is-weydaarsaday aragtiyo ku aaddan sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka ee dhinacyada kala duwan. Wada-hadallada ayaa lagu soo qaaday danaha ay labada dal wadaagaan iyo muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii horumariyo xiriirka u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa uga mahadceliyay Dowladda Mareykanka taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dowlad-dhiska iyo xoojinta hay’adaha dowladda. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa uga mahadceliyay Mareykanka taageerada dhinaca amniga, oo qeyb ka ah iskaashiga labada dal, isaga oo adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii wadista taageeradaasi. Kulanka ayaa kusoo dhammaaday iyadoo labada dhinac ay adkeeyeen muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga istiraatiijiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Mareykanka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa magaalada New York uga qayb-galay Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, oo ka socota xarunta Qaramada Midoobay ee magaaladaas ee dalka Mareykanka. The post Xasan Sheekh oo kulan miro-dhal New York kula yeeshay Frank Garcia + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Bannaanbax lagu diidan yahay doorashada Hirshabelle oo lagu qabanayo Beledweyne
items.description: Siyaasyiinta, odayaasha iyo waxgaradka Gobolka Hiiraan ee maalmihii u dambeeyay ku sugnaa Magaalada Beledweyne, isla-markaana ka soo horjeeda in wax doorasho ah oo la xiriira Hirshabelle laga qabto gobolkaasi ayaa dadka reer Beledweyne ugu baaqay inay Khamiista isugu soo baxaan bannaanbax nabadeed. Bannaanbaxan ayaa lagu diidan yahay in doorasho lagu kala qaybsan yahay in laga qabto Gobolka Hiiraan, iyadoo horey loo muddeeyay in 30-ka bishan uu Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka uu doorasho qof iyo cod ah ka qaban doono Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Shabellaha Dhexe ama labada gobol ee Hirshabelle. Doorashadan ayaa la sheegay in si isku sidkan loogu tartami doono Kuraasta Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo kuwa Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Hirshabelle. Hoggaanka siyaasadeed iyo dhaqanka ee ku sugan Beledweyne ayaa war ay soo saareen dadka deegaanka loogu baaqay inay maalinta berrito ah isugu soo baxaan Afarta Waaxood ee Beledweyne, si ay u caddeeyaan mowqifkooda ku aaddan doorashada soo socota. Dadweynaha ayaa waxaa lagu wargeliyay in bannaanbaxa uu socon doono 8:00 subaxnimo illaa 12:00 duhurnimo. Masuuliyiinta ayaa qorsheynaya inay dibadbaxayaasha kula hadlaan nawaaxiga Isbitaalka Weyn ee Beledweyne, halkaas oo loo asteeyay goobta la isugu imaanayo. Ciidamo gaar ah ayaa la sheegay inay sugi doonaan amniga bannaanbaxa, oo macnaheedu yahay in la diyaariyay unugyo ciidan oo ka duwan kuwa caadiga ah.

items.title: Puntland Official Warns of Possible Parallel Government Amid Somalia Election Dispute
items.description: MOGADISHU —Puntland officials and Somali opposition figures have raised concerns over the country’s unresolved electoral dispute, warning that failure to reach a political agreement could deepen divisions and lead to competing political arrangements. The remarks were made during a PDRC Talks forum, where political figures discussed Somalia’s electoral process, the ongoing disagreements between the Federal Government and opposition groups, and the potential consequences of failing to reach a consensus on the country’s political transition. Mohamed Dhabancad, Puntland’s envoy for negotiations on Somalia’s electoral process, warned that continued deadlock could prompt some political actors to pursue an alternative political arrangement outside the framework currently centered in Mogadishu. “Another Somali government could be formed. Whatever Mogadishu holds, every region could claim for itself, and there would be no central government if Hassan does not allow the election to take place,” Dhabancad said. His comments come amid continued disagreements between the Federal Government, several federal member states and opposition figures over the electoral framework, the timing of the elections and the management of the country’s political transition. Puntland and opposition leaders have called for an electoral process based on an agreement among Somalia’s political stakeholders. The Federal Government has maintained that preparations for the elections should proceed under the framework it has put forward. The latest remarks underscore the growing political tensions surrounding Somalia’s electoral process, as efforts continue to bring the Federal Government, federal member states and opposition groups to a negotiated agreement. A failure to resolve the dispute could have broader implications for Somalia’s political institutions and relations between the country’s federal and opposition actors, particularly as the political transition and electoral timetable remain unresolved. items.title: Türkiye Denies New Visa Restrictions on Somali Travel
items.description: ANKARA (Raxanreeb Online) — Türkiye has denied reports circulating on social media claiming that Somalia has introduced new visa and travel restrictions targeting Turkish citizens. Türkiye’s Directorate of Communications’ Center for Combating Disinformation said the reports were baseless and stressed that no new decision had been taken by the Somali government to impose restrictions on the travel of Turkish nationals. The agency said the existing visa and travel procedures governing citizens of Türkiye and Somalia remain unchanged. It also urged the public to exercise caution and rely on official sources when seeking information about travel and immigration regulations. The clarification followed the circulation of social media posts alleging that Somalia had changed its entry procedures for Turkish citizens. The reports generated widespread discussion and speculation online. Türkiye and Somalia maintain close and longstanding bilateral relations, with the two countries cooperating in a range of areas, including security, defense, trade, infrastructure development and humanitarian affairs. The Turkish authorities’ clarification comes amid continued efforts to counter misleading information circulating online and to encourage the public to verify claims through official sources. The post Türkiye Denies New Visa Restrictions on Somali Travel appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

The agency said the existing visa and travel procedures governing citizens of Türkiye and Somalia remain unchanged. It also urged the public to exercise caution and rely on official sources when seeking information about travel and immigration regulations. The clarification followed the circulation of social media posts alleging that Somalia had changed its entry procedures for Turkish citizens. The reports generated widespread discussion and speculation online. Türkiye and Somalia maintain close and longstanding bilateral relations, with the two countries cooperating in a range of areas, including security, defense, trade, infrastructure development and humanitarian affairs. The Turkish authorities’ clarification comes amid continued efforts to counter misleading information circulating online and to encourage the public to verify claims through official sources. The post Türkiye Denies New Visa Restrictions on Somali Travel appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Muqdisho oo lagu soo xiray Shirka Madasha Bani’aadannimada Soomaaliya 2026
items.description: Muqdisho, 23 Sebteembar 2026 — Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa maanta lagu soo xiray Shirka Madasha Bani’aadannimada Soomaaliya (CHF 2026), kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray diyaar-garowga saameynta laga filayo Super El Niño 2026, digniinta hore iyo tallaabooyinka degdegga ah ee lagu yareyn karo khataraha bani’aadannimo. Shirka waxaa ka qeyb galay Wasiiro ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Qaranka (SoDMA), mas’uuliyiin ka socday dowlad-goboleedyada, hay’adaha bani’aadannimada, bah-wadaagta caalamiga ah iyo bulshada rayidka ah. Intii uu socday shirka, waxaa si gaar ah looga hadlay xoojinta diyaar-garowga fatahaadaha, qorshayaasha gurmadka, abaabulka taageerada bani’aadannimo iyo sidii digniinta hore iyo xogta khataraha loo gaarsiin lahaa bulshada nugul, gaar ahaan dadka ku nool deegaannada fogfog. Ka qeybgalayaasha ayaa sidoo kale adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay wada-shaqeyn iyo isku-duwid ka dhexeysa Dowladda Federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo hay’adaha bani’aadannimada, si tallaabooyin hore loo qaado loona yareeyo saameynta fatahaadaha, barakaca iyo xaaladaha kale ee bani’aadannimo ee ka dhalan kara El Niño. Guddoomiyaha SoDMA, Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle, ayaa sheegay in loo baahan yahay isku-duubni iyo abaabul buuxa oo bulshada Soomaaliyeed ay kaga hortagto khataraha ka dhalan kara El Niño. Shirka ayaa ugu dambeyn soo xiray Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta XFS, Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh), oo dhammaan dhinacyada ay khuseyso ugu baaqay inay si buuxda ula shaqeeyaan SoDMA, oo ah hay’adda u qaabilsan hoggaaminta iyo isku-duwidda howlaha maareynta musiibooyinka dalka. Shirkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay xoojinayso diyaar-garowga khataraha cimilada, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo in digniinta hore loo beddelo tallaabo wax-ku-ool ah oo lagu badbaadinayo dadka iyo hantida.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ansixisay qorshe $56 milyan ah oo loogu talagalay dhalinyarada
items.description: Muqdisho, 23 Sebteembar 2026 — Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa dhammaystirtay ansixinta Qorshaha Qaranka Dhalinyarada, Nabadda iyo Amniga 2026–2030, oo lagu qiyaasay kharash dhan $56 milyan. Qorshahan shanta sano ah ayaa lagu doonayaa in lagu xoojiyo doorka dhalinyarada Soomaaliyeed ee arrimaha nabadda, amniga iyo horumarka dalka, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo dhowr arrimood oo muhiim ah. Qorshuhu wuxuu mudnaan siinayaa ka-qaybgalka dhalinyarada ee siyaasadda iyo geeddi-socodka nabadda, ilaalinta iyo badbaadada dhalinyarada, abuurista fursado shaqo, ka-hortagga colaadaha iyo xoojinta adkaysiga dhalinyarada ee saameynta isbeddelka cimilada. Sidoo kale, waxaa qorshaha qayb ka ah xoojinta iskaashiga hay’adaha dowladda, iyo dib-u-dhexgelinta dhalinyarada ay saameeyeen colaadaha iyo duruufaha kale ee bulshada. Dowladdu waxay qorshahan u aragtaa hannaan lagu mideynayo dadaallada la xiriira dhalinyarada, nabadda iyo amniga, iyadoo dowlad-goboleedyada iyo dhinacyada kale ee ay khuseyso laga filayo inay qayb ka qaataan hirgelintiisa muddada u dhexeysa 2026 iyo 2030. Qorshahan ayaa noqonaya mid ka mid ah qorshayaasha qaranka ee lagu doonayo in dhalinyarada Soomaaliyeed laga dhigo qayb firfircoon oo ka mid ah nabad-dhisidda, horumarinta iyo mustaqbalka dalka.

items.title: Dagaallada Yemen oo boqollaal qof kusoo riixay xeebaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Dagaallada ka socda dalka Yemen ayaa sababay barakac ballaaran, iyadoo boqollaal qof oo Yemen ka soo gudbaya ay gaareen xeebaha Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan deegaannada Puntland iyo Somaliland. Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan qaxootiga UNHCR ayaa sheegtay in dagaallada Yemen ay barakiciyeen in ka badan 130,000 qof tan iyo bilowgii Sebteembar. Qaar ka mid ah dadka ka soo cararaya colaadaha ayaa gaaray dalalka ku yaalla Geeska Afrika. In ka badan 3,000 qof ayaa la sheegay inay gaareen Jabuuti, halka boqollaal kale oo isugu jira Yemeniyiin iyo Soomaali dib ugu soo laabanaya dalkooda ay soo gaareen xeebaha Puntland iyo Somaliland. UNHCR ayaa sidoo kale ka digtay in tirada dadka isku dayaya inay badda kasoo gudbaan ay kordhi karto bartamaha bisha Oktoobar, xilligaas oo la filayo inay yaraadaan dabaylaha iyo hirarka badda. Soomaaliya ayaa muddo dheer kamid ahayd meelaha ay soo gaaraan dadka ka soo cararaya colaadaha Yemen, iyadoo dadka dalka kasoo gudba ay u baahan yihiin hoy, cunto, biyo, caafimaad iyo adeegyo kale oo bani’aadannimo.o Si kastaba, UNHCR weli ma aysan shaacin tirada saxda ah ee dadka cusub ee gaaray dekedaha iyo xeebaha Puntland iyo Somaliland. Xaaladda Yemen oo sii xumaanaysa ayaa sidaas darteed kordhin karta cadaadiska bani’aadannimo ee ka jira gobolka Geeska Afrika, gaar ahaan meelaha ay dadka kasoo gudbaya badda ku soo gaaraan.

items.title: Muxuu yahay iskaashiga cusub ee Somaliland rajeynayso inay la yeelato Israel?
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Somaliland ayaa rajaynaysa in iskaashi dhinaca amniga ah oo ballaaran ay la yeelato Israa’iil uu hirgalo ka hor inta uusan dhammaan sannadkan, sida uu sheegay Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro). Qorshahan ayaa kamid ahaa arrimaha uu Cirro ka hadlay kaddib safar laba toddobaad qaatay oo uu ku tegay Washington, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay mas’uuliyiin iyo xubno ka tirsan bulshada Yuhuudda ee Mareykanka, sidoo kalena uu wareysiyo siiyay warbaahinta Mareykanka. “Waxaan rajaynaynaa in ka hor dhammaadka sannadka ay bilaabaan iskaashiga dhinaca amniga,” ayuu Cirro. Marka laga yimaado amniga, Cirro wuxuu sheegay in Somaliland ay mudnaanta koowaad siinayso xal u helidda baahida biyaha. Wuxuu xusay in 50 injineer oo reer Somaliland ah ay Israa’iil tababar siisay, kuwaas oo la filayo inay ka shaqeeyaan mashaariic ay kamid tahay sifaynta biyaha badda Berbera. Xiriirka amni ee la qorsheynayo ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmaya xilli Somaliland ay Washington u bandhigtay iskaashi ku saabsan la-dagaallanka argagixisada, sugidda amniga badda iyo ilaalinta maraakiibta mara biyaha gobolka, sida lagu sheegay warbixin uu siiyay warbaahinta JNS. Dhinaca Mareykanka, Cirro wuxuu sheegay in saraakiil ka tirsan maamulka Washington iyo Waaxda Dagaalka ay u sheegeen in dowladda Mareykanku doonayso in xiriirka ay la leedahay Somaliland uu sii kobco. Arrintan ayaa warbixintu la xiriirisay muhiimadda istaraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland, gaar ahaan goobta ay kaga taallo meel u dhow Yemen iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandeb. Intii uu ku sugnaa Washington, Cirro wuxuu sidoo kale la kulmay xubno ka tirsan bulshada Yuhuudda ee dalkaas, isagoo sheegay inuu rajaynayo in xiriirradaasi ay horseedaan maalgashi Yuhuudda ama Israa’iil ka yimaadda oo lagu sameeyo Somaliland. Isagoo ka hadlayay dhinaca dhaqaalaha, Cirro wuxuu sheegay in dagaallada gobolka ay saameyn ku yeesheen isu-socodka ganacsiga ee dekedda Berbera, iyadoo tirada konteenarrada halkaas soo mara ay hoos u dhacday ku dhowaad 48 boqolkiiba. Madaxweynaha ayaa hoos-u-dhacaas ku tilmaamay mid ku-meel-gaar ah, isagoo rajo ka muujiyay in isu-socodka ganacsigu soo kaban doono marka ay dhammaadaan dagaallada gobolka. Si kastaba, xiriirka Israel iyo Somaliland ayaa si degdeg ah u kordhay bilihii u dambeeyay, kadib markii Israel ay bishii December ku dhawaaqday inay aqoonsatay maamulka Somaliland, tallaabadaas oo dowladda Soomaaliya ay si adag uga hortimid. Muqdisho ayaa sheegtay in Somaliland ay tahay qeyb ka mid ah dhulka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, waxayna tallaabada Israel ku tilmaamtay “weerar ula kac ah” oo lagu qaaday madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada Soomaaliya. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda ku adkeysaneysa in heshiis kasta oo militari, diblomaasiyadeed ama ganacsi oo la xiriira maamulka Somaliland uu u baahan yahay oggolaanshaha Dowladda Federaalka ee fadhigeedu yahay Muqdisho, maadaama gobolkaas uu yahay qeyb ka mid ah dhulka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. The post Muxuu yahay iskaashiga cusub ee Somaliland rajeynayso inay la yeelato Israel? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweynaha Somaliland Oo New York kulan kula yeeshay Danjiraha   Israel u fadhiya Qaramada Midoobay
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa magaalada New York kulan muhiim ah oo taariikhi ah kula yeeshay Danjiraha Dalka Israa’iil u fadhiya Qaramada Midoobay, Mudane Ambassador Danny Danon, xilli Madaxweynaha JSL iyo weftiga uu hoggaaminayo ay safar shaqo ku joogaan New York, iyaga oo halkaas ka wada kulammo iyo dedaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo ku xeeran Kalfadhiga 81aad ee Golaha loo dhan yahay ee Qaramada Midoobay. Kulanka Madaxweynaha iyo Danjiraha Israa’iil waxa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xidhiidhka istiraatijiga ah ee Somaliland iyo Israa’iil, horumarinta iskaashiga labada dhinac Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Cirro ayaa Dawladda iyo Shacabka reer Israa’iil si mug leh uga mahadnaqay tallaabadii geesinnimada iyo ku-dhaca lahayd ee Dawladda Israa’iil ay si rasmi ah Somaliland ugu aqoonsatay dal madax-bannaan 26-kii Disembar, 2025-kii. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu adkeeyey muhiimadda ay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland u leedahay xidhiidhka cusub ee ay la leedahay Dawladda Israa’iil, isaga oo xusay in aqoonsigii ay Israa’iil siisay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland uu noqday bog cusub oo taariikhi ah oo ka furmay geeddi-socodka diblomaasiyadeed ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Dhankiisa, Danjiraha Dawladda Israa’iil ee Qaramada Midoobay, Mudane Ambassador Danny Danon, ayaa sheegay in uu aad ugu faraxsan yahay la kulanka Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee magaalada New York, isaga oo xaqiijiyey in Dawladda Israa’iil ay aad u qiimaynayso xidhiidhka sii kobcaya ee u dhexeeya labada dal, isla markaana ay ka go’an tahay sii xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada danaha guud, gaar ahaan amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka, ilaalinta xorriyadda maraakiibta iyo ganacsiga badda, horumarinta dhaqaalaha, tiknoolajiyadda, biyaha, beeraha iyo maalgashiga.

Madaxweynuhu waxa uu adkeeyey muhiimadda ay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland u leedahay xidhiidhka cusub ee ay la leedahay Dawladda Israa’iil, isaga oo xusay in aqoonsigii ay Israa’iil siisay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland uu noqday bog cusub oo taariikhi ah oo ka furmay geeddi-socodka diblomaasiyadeed ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Dhankiisa, Danjiraha Dawladda Israa’iil ee Qaramada Midoobay, Mudane Ambassador Danny Danon, ayaa sheegay in uu aad ugu faraxsan yahay la kulanka Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee magaalada New York, isaga oo xaqiijiyey in Dawladda Israa’iil ay aad u qiimaynayso xidhiidhka sii kobcaya ee u dhexeeya labada dal, isla markaana ay ka go’an tahay sii xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada danaha guud, gaar ahaan amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka, ilaalinta xorriyadda maraakiibta iyo ganacsiga badda, horumarinta dhaqaalaha, tiknoolajiyadda, biyaha, beeraha iyo maalgashiga.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Jarmalka oo ka wada hadlay dardargelinta iskaashiga labada dal
items.description: Kusimaha Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ahna Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa ku qaabilay Safiirka Jarmalka u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Mudane Sebastian Groth, iyo ku-xigeenkiisa Marwo Katrin Josten. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xoojinta iyo dardargelinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Jarmalka, iyadoo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray iskaashiga dhinacyada siyaasadda, horumarinta iyo xiriirka baarlamaaniga ah. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada-shaqeynta Soomaaliya iyo Jarmalka, lana abuuro fursado cusub oo lagu ballaarinayo xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka Soomaaliya ay la leedahay Jarmalka iyo horumarinta iskaashiga labada dhinac ee dhinacyada kala duwan.

items.title: Daawo: BF Soomaaliya oo laalay go’aankii R/W Xamza
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka oo maanta kulan xasaasi ah ku yeeshay xarunta Villa Hargeysa ayaa laalay qaraarkii dhawaan kasoo baxay xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza ee ku aadanaa in xilalka agaasime-waaxeedyada wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha kale ee dowladda lagu buuxiyo hannaan tartan ah. Xamza ayaa maalmo kahor faray dhammaan golihiisa wasiirrada iyo mas’uuliyiinta kale ee dowladda in si buuxda loo hirgeliyo hannaanka cusub ee shaqaalaysiinta iyo magacaabista ku salaysan kartida iyo mudnaanta. Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa si gaar ah u faray guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka in 20-Sebteembar la bilaabo wajiga 1-aad ee dib-u-habaynta lagu sameynayo agaasime waaxeedyada, maadaama ay laf-dhabar u yihiin maamulka hey’adaha dowladda, ayna door muuqda ka qaataan hoggaaminta, hirgalinta siyaasadda, fulinta qorsheyaasha iyo joogtaynta shaqada hey’adaha. Ujeedada laga leeyahay nidaamkan ayuu xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaaraha ku sheegay in dowladda federaalka ay yeelato hoggaan maamul oo xirfad leh, joogto ah, awoodda in uu hirgaliyo siyaasadda dowladda, una beddelo natiijooyin muuqda oo ay markhaati ka noqdaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed. “Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, Isaga oo ka duulaya Dastuurka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Qodobka 161aad farqadda (1), Sharciga Shaqaalaha Rayid ah qodobkiisa 7aad, iyo dhammaan xeerarka, shuruucda iyo qaraarada la xiriira Shaqaalaha Rayidka ah ee Dowladdda Federaalka ah, ayuu faray dhammaan Wasiirrada iyo Mas’uuliyiinta kale ee dowladda in si buuxda oo aan dib-u-dhac lahayn loo hirgeliyo hannaanka shaqaalaysiinta iyo magacaabista ku salaysan kartida iyo mudnaanta,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka kasoo baxay xafiiska Xamza Cabdi Barre. Intaas kadib xildhibaannada Baarlamaanka ayaa maanta ka dooday wareegtada uu soo saaray Ra’iisul wasaaraha dalka, iyaga oo meesha ka saaray kadib codeyn gacantaag ah oo golaha laga dhex sameeyey. 136 Xildhibaan ayaa ogolaatay in laalo qaraarka Ra’iisul wasaaraha, waxaa diiday 2 xildhibaan, halka ay ka aamuseen 2 kale, sida uu ku dhawaaqay guddoomiye ku xigeenka labaad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullahi Abshiroow. “Sidaad la socotiin waxaa jiray qaraar ay ka shaqeeyeen xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaaraha iyo qaar kamid ah wasaaradaha oo ku saabsanaa in agaasime waaxeedyada hay’adaha dowladda ee shaqaalaha rayidka iyadoo aysan jirin shuruuc nidaamineysa ayaa waxaan u maleyneynaa in hay’adda fulinta ay ku deg-degtay arrintan,” ayuu yiri guddoomiye ku xigeenka labaad ee Golaha Shacabka. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii daray “Maanta dooda waxay ku saabsaneyd in arrintaas laga doodo waxaan u codeynay in lalaalo oo aysan shaqeyn karin wareegtadii xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaaraha kasoo baxday xidhibaannadu waxay ugu codeeyeen sidan; waxaa ka aamusay 2 xildhibaan waxaa diiday laba xildhibaan oo kale waxaa ogolaatay 136 mudane”. The post Daawo: BF Soomaaliya oo laalay go’aankii R/W Xamza appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ingiriiska Oo £5 Milyan Ku Taageeraya U-diyaargarowga Fatahaadaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Dowladda Ingiriiska ayaa ku dhawaaqday £5 milyan oo gargaar bani’aadannimo ah oo lagu taageerayo u-diyaargarowga fatahaadaha la filayo inay Soomaaliya ka dhacaan xilliga roobabka Deyrta. Taageerada ayaa la filayaa inay gaarto ilaa 600,000 oo qof oo ku nool deegaannada halista ugu jira fatahaadaha. Dhaqaalahan ayaa lagu xoojin doonaa nidaamyada digniinta hore, daadgureynta qoysaska khatarta ku jira iyo sii wadidda adeegyada caafimaadka, nafaqada, biyaha iyo fayadhowrka. Waxa kale oo lagu taageerayaa dadka ku nool ku dhowaad 100 xero oo barakacayaal ah iyo bulshooyinka ay fatahaaduhu go’doomin karaan. Qorshaha ayaa mudnaan gaar ah siinaya Jowhar iyo Beledweyne oo ka mid ah magaalooyinka sida joogtada ah u wajahaya fatahaadaha webiyada. Taageerada waxaa kale oo ka mid noqon doona adeegyo caafimaad oo guurguura, gargaar lacageed iyo tallaabooyin lagu ilaalinayo nolol-maalmeedka qoysaska ku nool goobaha nugul. Lacagta waxaa loo qaybinayaa laba barnaamij oo hore uga shaqaynayey Soomaaliya. Barnaamijka Caafimaad Plus wuxuu helayaa £2.5 milyan si loo joogteeyo ilaa 71 xarumood oo caafimaad, halka RESTORE uu helayo £2.5 milyan oo lagu xoojinayo digniinta hore, daadgureynta ku-meel-gaarka ah iyo difaacyada fatahaadaha. Caafimaad Plus waxaa hoggaaminaysa hay’adda Action Against Hunger, halka RESTORE ay fulinayaan FAO, IOM iyo World Vision. Dowladda Ingiriiska waxay sheegtay in dhaqaaluhu qayb ka yahay Sanduuqa Dhibaatooyinka Bani’aadannimo ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, isla markaana uu ka tirsan yahay qorshe £15 milyan ah oo lagu taageerayo dalalka ugu nugul El Niño. Agaasimaha Horumarinta ee Safaaradda Ingiriiska ee Muqdisho, Chris Pycroft, ayaa sheegay in tallaabooyinka hore ay badbaadin karaan nolosha, ilaalin karaan adeegyada aasaasiga ah, isla markaana yareyn karaan khasaaraha nololeed. Maalgelintan ayaa lagu dhawaaqay 23-ka Sebteembar intii uu Muqdisho ka socday Madasha Bani’aadannimada Dalka, iyadoo la xusuustay in fatahaadihii El Niño ee 2023 ay saameeyeen 2.48 milyan oo qof, ayna barakiciyeen 1.2 milyan.

items.title: ONLF Oo Xaqiijisay Ku Biirista Isbahaysiga Itoobiya, Diiddayna Bayaan Ka Soo Horjeeday
items.description: Jabhadda Waddaniga Xoreynta Ogaadeenya ONLF ayaa xaqiijisay inay xubin ka tahay isbahaysiga cusub ee toddobada urur ee Itoobiya, iyadoo diidday bayaan hore oo magaceeda lagu faafiyey oo sheegayey inaysan qayb ka ahayn isbahaysigaas. Isbahaysiga oo lagu magacaabo Isbahaysiga Ciidamada Shacabka Itoobiya ee Badbaadada ayaa lagu dhawaaqay 20-kii Sebteembar. Waxaa ku jira ururro ka kala socda gobollada Tigray, Amxaarada, Oromada, Canfarta, Soomaalida, Benishangul-Gumuz iyo Gumuz, kuwaas oo sheegay inay doonayaan in xilka laga qaado dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Axmed. Bayaan 21-kii Sebteembar lagu faafiyey magaca ONLF ayaa sheegay in ururku uusan ku biirin isbahaysiga, isla markaana uu weli yahay xisbi sharciyeysan oo ujeeddooyinkiisa ku raadinaya hannaan nabadeed. Bayaankaas wuxuu ku adkaystay in ONLF ay ku taagan tahay heshiiskii nabadeed ee ay dowladda Itoobiya la saxiixatay sannadkii 2018. Hase yeeshee, ONLF ayaa 22-kii Sebteembar sheegtay in bayaanka diidmada ahi uusan ka soo bixin hoggaankeeda la aqoonsan yahay ama hay’adaheeda dastuuriga ah. Waxay sheegtay in Guddiga Dhexe uu oggolaaday ku biirista isbahaysiga, Guddoomiyaha ONLF Cabdiraxmaan Sheekh Mahdina uu hoggaaminayey wafdiga wada-hadallada. Bayaannada is-diidan waxay bannaanka soo dhigeen khilaaf ku saabsan cidda sharci ahaan ugu hadli karta ONLF iyo jihada siyaasadeed ee ururka. ONLF waxay sidoo kale ku doodday in qaab-dhismeed kale oo ka jira Jigjiga uusan matalin hoggaankeeda rasmiga ah, balse eedaha la xiriira cidda taageeraysa dhinacaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Ku biirista ONLF ee isbahaysiga waxay saameyn gaar ah ku yeelan kartaa xaaladda Dowlad-Deegaanka Soomaalida Itoobiya iyo xasilloonida xuduudaha gobolka. Hase yeeshee, weli ma cadda heerka wada-shaqeynta militari ee ururrada, awoodda isbahaysiga ama sida khilaafka hoggaanka ONLF u saameyn doono doorkeeda gudaha isbahaysiga cusub.

items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo ansixiyey Hindise Sharciyeedka Maareynta Deegaanka
items.description: Muqdisho, 23 Sebtembar 2026 — Xildhibaanada Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta yeeshay Kalfadhiga 8-aad, kulankiisa 18-aad, waxaana shir guddoominayay Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Golaha Shacabka, Mudane Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow. Xildhibaanada ayaa cod u qaaday Hindise Sharciyeedka Maareynta Deegaanka, waxaana oggolaaday 140 xildhibaan, iyadoo uusan jirin xildhibaan diiday ama ka aamusay. Sidaas ayuu Golaha Shacabka ku ansixiyey hindise sharciyeedka. Sidoo kale, Golaha ayaa Akhrinta Saddexaad marsiiyey Hindise Sharciyeedka Iskaashiga Garsoorka Caalamiga ah, iyadoo warbixinta hindisaha uu Golaha ka hor akhriyey Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Garsoorka, Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta, Xildhibaan Cali Xaaji Daahir. items.title: Maxaa sababay in go’aankii Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa la diido?
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya — Go’aankii Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ee ahaa in xilalka Agaasime Waaxeedyada dowladda lagu buuxiyo hannaan tartan furan ayaa 23-ka Sebteembar 2026 la kulmay diidmo ka timid Golaha Shacabka, taasoo dhalisay dood ku saabsan awoodda sharciyeed, habraaca shaqaaleysiinta iyo doorka hay’adaha kala duwan ee dowladda. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa 17-kii Sebteembar ku dhawaaqay in wajiga koowaad ee dib-u-habaynta adeegga rayidka uu bilaabmo 20-ka Sebteembar, iyadoo Agaasime Waaxeedyada lagu qiimeynayo karti, aqoon, khibrad, hoggaamin iyo waxqabad. Waxa kale oo la faray in shaqaalaha rayidka ah ee u qalma ay helaan fursad siman oo ay ugu tartamaan xilalka. Wararka laga helayo doodda Baarlamaanka ayaa muujinaya in sababta ugu weyn ee diidmada ay la xiriirtay saldhigga sharciyeed ee hannaanka cusub. Guddiga ay arrintu khuseyso ayaa qaba in ka hor inta aan la bilaabin tartanka iyo magacaabista Agaasime Waaxeedyada, loo baahan yahay in si cad loo qeexo habraaca sharci ee lagu maamulayo. Sidaas darteed, dooddu ma ahayn oo keliya in Agaasime Waaxeedyada lagu xusho tartan ama magacaabis, balse waxay ku saabsanayd hay’adda awoodda u leh inay dejiso, maamusho oo fuliso nidaamkaas. Doorka Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka Go’aanka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha wuxuu Guddiga Shaqaalaha Rayidka siinayay door muuqda oo ah inuu bilaabo wajiga koowaad ee dib-u-habaynta laga bilaabo 20-ka Sebteembar. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay in tani qayb ka tahay dib-u-habaynta adeegga rayidka oo muddo socotay. Hase yeeshee, mucaaradka go’aanka ayaa su’aal geliyay in guddiga iyo Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaruhu ay si toos ah u bilaabi karaan hannaan cusub oo saameynaya jagooyinka sare ee dowladda iyada oo aan marka hore si buuxda loo caddeyn saldhigga iyo habraaca sharciyeed. Madaxbannaanida hay’adaha dastuuriga ah Arrinta waxaa sii murjiyay mowqifka Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud. Xafiiska ayaa sheegay in madaxbannaanidiisa dastuuriga ah la dhowro, gaar ahaan marka ay timaaddo maamulka iyo shaqaalaha xafiiska. Tani waxay muujisay in hannaanka guud ee lagu dabaqayo dhammaan hay’adaha dowladda uu leeyahay arrin gaar ah: hay’adaha dastuuriga ah iyo kuwa madax-bannaan ma lagu dabaqi karaa isla habraaca loo adeegsanayo wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha hoos yimaada Xukuumadda. Baarlamaanka oo adeegsaday awooddiisa kormeer Golaha Shacabka ayaa ah hay’adda sharci-dejinta iyo kormeerka dowladda, waxaana wararka maanta soo baxay ay sheegayaan in xildhibaannadu ay laaleen go’aankii Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ee dib-u-habaynta Agaasime Waaxeedyada. Website-ka rasmiga ah ee Baarlamaanka ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaya in Golaha Shacabka uu leeyahay waajibaadyo ay ka mid yihiin kormeerka iyo isla-xisaabtanka howlaha dowladda, iyo hubinta in howlaha dowladda ay waafaqsan yihiin sharciga. Sida xogta hadda la heli karo muujinayso, diidmada go’aanka Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa waxaa saldhig u ah dood sharci iyo mid hay’adeed, gaar ahaan su’aasha ah cidda awoodda u leh inay dejiso oo hirgeliso nidaamka tartanka xilalka Agaasime Waaxeedyada iyo habka loo dabaqayo hay’adaha madax-bannaan. Dhanka Xukuumadda, ujeeddada lagu sheegay go’aanka ayaa ahayd in shaqaalaha dowladda lagu xusho kartida iyo mudnaanta, lana abuuro hannaan tartan furan.

items.title: Ciidamada Tigray oo qabsaday garoonka diyaaradaha Mekelle
items.description: Mekelle (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Tigray ayaa Arbacadii la wareegay gacan ku haynta garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaalada Mekelle, caasimadda gobolka Tigray ee waqooyiga Itoobiya, xilli ay mar kale sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha u dhexeeya maamulka gobolka iyo dowladda federaalka. Ilo dhinaca ammaanka ah iyo kuwo maxalli ah ayaa wakaaladda wararka AFP u sheegay in ciidamada Tigray ay la wareegeen garoonka Alula Aba Nega, iyadoo duulimaadyadii magaalada laga hakiyey. Shaqaale ka tirsan garoonka ayaa sheegay in isaga iyo shaqaale kale loo sheegay inay guryahooda ku laabtaan kaddib markii ay soo baxday in ciidamada Tigray ay gudaha u galeen garoonka. “Annaga oo ku sii jeedna garoonka si aan shaqada u aadno ayuu kormeerahayagu wacay darawalka, wuxuuna u sheegay in ciidamada Tigray ay la wareegeen garoonka. Maadaama aysan jirin wax duulimaad ah, wuxuu nagu amray inaan guryaha ku laabanno,” ayuu shaqaaluhu u sheegay AFP. Ilo amni oo ajnabi ah oo ku sugan Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyey in ciidamada Tigray ay la wareegeen garoonka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in tiro yar oo ka tirsan booliska federaalka ay ilaalinayeen garoonka, balse aan si rasmi ah loo ogeyn xaaladdooda kaddib markii ciidamada Tigray ay halkaas gaareen. Duulimaadyada oo la joojiyey Shirkadda diyaaradaha Itoobiya ee Ethiopian Airlines ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay si ku-meel-gaar ah u hakisay duulimaadyadii ay ku tegi jirtay Mekelle, Axum iyo Shire sababo la xiriira xaaladda amni ee ka jirta gobolka Tigray. “Ethiopian Airlines waxay si ku-meel-gaar ah u hakisay duulimaadyada Mekelle, Axum iyo Shire laga bilaabo maanta, sababo la xiriira xaaladda hadda ka jirta gobolka Tigray,” ayay shirkaddu ku sheegtay bayaan. Xogta FlightRadar, oo la socota dhaqdhaqaaqa diyaaradaha, ayaa sidoo kale muujisay in duulimaad Arbacadii subaxnimo isku xiri lahaa Mekelle iyo caasimadda Addis Ababa la baajiyey. Tallaabadan ayaa imaanaysa xilli ay sii kordhayaan calaamadaha muujinaya in xiriirka u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka Itoobiya iyo Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) uu mar kale sii xumaanayo. TPLF, oo gacanta ku haya inta badan maamulka Tigray, ayaa dagaal ba’an kula jirtay dowladda federaalka intii u dhaxeysay 2020 iyo 2022. Qiyaaso uu soo bandhigay Midowga Afrika ayaa sheegaya in dagaalkaasi ay ku dhinteen ku dhowaad 600,000 oo qof. Heshiiskii nabadda ee Pretoria ee la saxiixay 2022 ayaa soo afjaray dagaalka, balse xaaladda gobolka ayaa mar kale kacsaneyd tan iyo dabayaaqadii 2025, markii ay dib u billowdeen iska horimaadyo goos-goos ah. Cabsi laga qabo dagaal cusub Dowladda federaalka ayaa bilihii lasoo dhaafay fulisay duqeymo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah oo ka dhacay gudaha Tigray, iyadoo sidoo kale ciidamo badan lagu ururiyey xuduudaha gobolka. Dhinaca kale, ururrada xuquuqda aadanaha ayaa TPLF ku eedeeyey inay sanadkan wadday olole dad si khasab ah loogu qorayo ciidamada, iyadoo la cabsi qabo inay isu diyaarineyso dagaal kale. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kaddib markii Axaddii lagu dhawaaqay in TPLF ay ku biirtay isbaheysi cusub oo ay sameysteen kooxo hubeysan oo kasoo horjeeda dowladda federaalka Itoobiya. Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale wajahaysa jabhado iyo colaado hubeysan oo ka jira gobollo kale, gaar ahaan Oromia iyo Amhara, oo ah labada gobol ee ugu dadka badan dalka. TPLF ayaa Itoobiya oo dhan ka talinaysay intii u dhaxeysay 1991 iyo 2018, balse awooddeeda ayaa hoos u dhacday markii Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed uu xukunka qabtay, taasoo ugu dambeyn horseeday khilaafkii isu beddelay dagaalkii Tigray. Inkastoo dagaalkaasi si rasmi ah loo soo afjaray 2022, gobolka Tigray weli si buuxda ugama soo kaban burburkii ka dhashay. Qiyaastii hal milyan oo qof ayaa weli ku barakacsan gudaha gobolka, halka qeybo badan oo ka mid ah heshiiskii Pretoria aan weli la fulin. Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale TPLF ku eedeysay inay xiriir la sameysatay Eritrea iyo kooxo hubeysan oo Itoobiya ka dagaallama. Dowladda federaalka ayaa dhankeeda leh awood ciidan oo ka weyn tii ay lahayd dagaalkii hore, gaar ahaan kaddib markii ay sare u qaadday soo saarista iyo adeegsiga diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. La wareegidda garoonka Mekelle ayaa hadda noqonaysa mid ka mid ah dhacdooyinka ugu culus ee muujinaya sida ay mar kale u sii xumaaneyso xaaladda Tigray, iyadoo cabsi weyn laga qabo in colaaddii dhiigga badan ku daatay ay dib u soo laabato. The post Ciidamada Tigray oo qabsaday garoonka diyaaradaha Mekelle appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Calanka Turkiga oo lagu gubay Somalia Iyo Nacaybka loo qabo oo sii siyaadaaya
items.description: Turkigu waa cadawga ummadda Somaaliyeed ee uu xasuuqa dad banned iyo boobka hantidooda uu ku hayo xiligani. Erdogan waa khaayin u badheedhaaya in uu booboo khayraadka dadka masaakiinta ah ee Koonfur Soomaaliya halkaasi oo uu kala qaybiyay imadii deganayd. Waxa uu hada ku shaqaystaa madaxweynahii hore ee xilkiisu dhamaaday ee Somalia Xasan Sheekh. Erdogan waxa uu diyaarado ku garaacay koonfur galbeed ee Somalia isga oo ku xasuuqay dad masaakiin ah taasi oo sababtay mudaharaado lagaga soo hor jeedo Turkiga isla markaasina lagu gubay calanka Turkiga. Waxa Soomaaliya ku soo badanaaya nacaybka loo qabo Turkiga kadib markii uu dad shicib ah ku xasuuqay diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Dhamaan maamul goboleedyada Somalia ayaa ka soo hor jeeda dawlada Turkiga kuwaasi oo ay ku jirto maamulka Puntland oo ay dawladda Turkigu ku xasuuqday dad shicib ah

items.title: Ethiopia: Tigray forces seize Mekelle airport
items.description: ADDIS ABABA (Somaliguardian) – Tigrayan forces seized control of Alula Aba Nega Airport in Mekelle overnight, taking the facility from federal police in a major escalation just days after the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) announced a new alliance with six other armed groups aimed at overthrowing Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government. An airport employee told AFP that staff heading to work Wednesday were turned back after a supervisor said Tigrayan forces had taken the facility and flights had been suspended. A security source at a Western embassy confirmed the takeover. Ethiopian Airlines has halted flights to the region as a result. items.title: Qorshe xukunka looga tuurayo Afwerki oo ka socda Israa’iil
items.description: Tel Aviv (Caasimada Online) — Kooxo Eritrean ah oo mucaarad ku ah xukuumadda Madaxweyne Isaias Afwerki ayaa dibadda ka wada abaabul siyaasadeed iyo mid bulsho oo ay ku doonayaan inay dhisaan awood mideysan oo mustaqbalka isbeddel ka dhalisa Eritrea, sida lagu sheegay warbixin uu daabacay wargeyska Haaretz . Warbixinta ayaa xarun yar oo ku taal koonfurta Tel Aviv ku tilmaantay mid ka mid ah goobaha ay ku kulmaan xubnaha dhaqdhaqaaqa loo yaqaan Brigade N’Hamedu, oo ay ku jiraan Eritrean ku nool Israel, Mareykanka, Canada, Sweden, Germany iyo Ethiopia. Dhaqdhaqaaqa ayaa sheegaya inuu doonayo inuu mideeyo qurbajoogta Eritrea, isla markaana diyaariyo qaab siyaasadeed oo lagu beddeli karo xukuumadda hadda jirta. Dawit Teferi, oo ah ganacsade Eritrean-Canadian ah kana tirsan hoggaanka dhaqdhaqaaqa, ayaa Haaretz u sheegay in mucaaradkii Eritrea uu muddo labaatan sano ah ku adkaa inuu yeesho saameyn muuqata, balse tan iyo 2022 ay soo baxeen wejiyo, habab iyo qaabab abaabul oo cusub. Dhaqdhaqaaqa ayaa hadda sameystay qaab-dhismeed ay ku jiraan dhinacyada maaliyadda, diblomaasiyadda, abaabulka bulshada iyo qorsheynta amniga. Bishii hore, ku dhowaad 1,300 Eritrean ah ayaa magaalada Nes Tziona ee Israel kaga qeyb galay doorasho lagu soo xulayay wakiillo ka mid noqda gole caalami ah oo dhaqdhaqaaqa matala. Haaretz ayaa sheegtay in 17 munaasabadood oo la mid ah lagu qabtay dalal kala duwan, waxaana la dhisay gole ka kooban 51 xubnood. Mulu Sultan, oo ka tirsan golahaas, ayaa sheegay in xubnuhu toddobaad kasta kulmaan, iyagoo ka wada hadla dhaqaalaha, qeybsiga masuuliyadaha, xiriirka gudaha Eritrea iyo qorshaha lagu dhisayo saldhig abaabul oo Ethiopia ah. Hoggaamiyaha dhaqdhaqaaqa, Beyene Gerezgher, ayaa ku sugan Addis Ababa. Waxa uu sheegay in ururku xiriir la leeyahay dad gudaha Eritrea ku sugan, oo ay ku jiraan dad rayid ah iyo shaqsiyaad ka tirsan hay’adaha dowladda iyo ciidamada. Sheegashadaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Dhanka kale, dhaqdhaqaaqa ayaa dadaal diblomaasiyadeed ka wada Washington. Dawit Teferi ayaa Haaretz u sheegay inuu la kulmo xubno ka tirsan Congress-ka iyo mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan maamulka Mareykanka, isagoo ku doodaya in Mareykanka, Israel iyo dalalka Khaliijka ay dan istiraatiiji ah ka leeyihiin inay saaxiib ku yeeshaan gobolka Badda Cas. Gerezgher ayaa sheegay in xiriirradaas aysan weli la micno ahayn aqoonsi ama taageero rasmi ah, balse dhaqdhaqaaqu u baahan yahay taageero caalami ah si uu isbeddel uga hirgeliyo Eritrea. Sida ay Haaretz u xigatay Crisis Group, Ethiopia ayaa tan iyo horraantii 2025 si furan u martigelineysay dhaqdhaqaaqa. Gerezgher ayaa sheegay inay Addis Ababa ka haystaan xorriyad ay ku shaqeeyaan, isla markaana halkaas laga dhisayo awoodda ay mustaqbalka doonayaan inay gudaha Eritrea kula galaan. Gerezgher ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in dhaqdhaqaaqu isku dayayo inuu fariimihiisa gaarsiiyo gudaha Eritrea, halkaas oo internet-ka iyo warbaahinta madaxa-bannaan ay aad u xaddidan yihiin. Sida uu sheegay, fariimaha qaar waxaa loo diyaariyaa qaab muuqaal iyo heeso ah si ay u fududaato faafintooda. Eritrea waxaa tan iyo xornimadeeda hoggaaminayay Madaxweyne Isaias Afwerki, oo xilka haya tan iyo 1993. Dalka weli kama dhicin doorasho qaran oo tartan ah, dastuurkiina si buuxda looma dhaqan gelin, halka warbaahinta madaxa-bannaan ay xiran tahay. Hay’adaha xuquuqda aadanaha ayaa sidoo kale muddo dheer ka digayay xarig aan maxkamad lahayn, adeeg qaran oo waqti aan xadidneyn leh iyo cadaadis lagu hayo dadka dowladda dhaliila. Xiisadda u dhexeysa taageerayaasha iyo mucaaradka dowladda Eritrea ayaa sanadihii dambe marar badan ka qaraxday dalalka ay qurbajoogtu ku badan yihiin. Tel Aviv waxaa Sebtembar 2023 ka dhacay isku dhacyo culus oo ka dhashay munaasabad ay safaaradda Eritrea qorsheysay. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sidoo kale ka digtay cabsi gelin, hanjabaad iyo cadaadis xuduudaha ka gudba oo lagu hayo Eritrean-ka dibadda ku nool. Dhaqdhaqaaqa laftiisa ayaa sidoo kale wajahaya eedeymo la xiriira rabshado. Xeer-ilaaliyeyaasha federaalka Germany ayaa bishii Maarso 2025 baaritaanno ku sameeyay 17 qof oo looga shakiyay inay hoggaan ka ahaayeen laanta Brigade N’Hamedu ee dalkaas, iyagoo ku tuhmay sameynta ama ka mid ahaanshaha urur argagixiso gudaha ah. Eedeymahaas waxay khuseeyaan laanta Germany, mana aha xukun kama dambeys ah oo lagu riday dhammaan dhaqdhaqaaqa caalamiga ah. Hoggaamiyeyaasha Brigade N’Hamedu waxay ku adkeysanayaan in ujeeddadoodu tahay in la dhiso nidaam dimuqraadi ah oo beddela xukunka Afwerki. Hase yeeshee, dhaqdhaqaaqu weli ma haysto aqoonsi rasmi ah oo caalami ah, mana cadda awoodda uu dhab ahaan gudaha Eritrea ku leeyahay ama sida uu isbeddelka uu ku baaqayo u hirgelin karo. The post Qorshe xukunka looga tuurayo Afwerki oo ka socda Israa’iil appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maxaa looga hadlayaa shirka Qaramada midoobe ee sanadkan?
items.description: Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay waa hay’adda ugu weyn ee doodaha iyo dejinta siyaasadaha guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, waxaana ku mideysan 193 dal , iyadoo dal kasta uu leeyahay hal cod. Golaha ayaa looga hadlaa arrimo badan oo khuseeya nabadda, amniga, horumarka, dhaqaalaha, cimilada iyo arrimaha bani’aadannimada. Toddobaadka shirka heerka sare ee Golaha Guud ee sanadkan ayaa ka socda New York, iyadoo doodda guud ee kalfadhiga 81-aad ay bilaabatay 22-ka Sebtembar , waxaana qorshuhu yahay in madaxda iyo wakiillada sare ay khudbado jeediyaan illaa 28-ka Sebtembar. Qaramada Midoobay waxay sheegtay in ku dhowaad 130 madax dowladeed iyo madax dal ay si toos ah uga qeybgalayaan toddobaadka heerka sare. Madasha Golaha Guud ayaa muddo dheer ahayd goob ay hoggaamiyayaashu kaga hadlaan arrimaha ugu waaweyn ee xilliyadooda. Khudbadaha qaar waxay diiradda saareen colaadaha iyo hanjabaadaha amni, halka kuwo kalena ay taabteen dagaallada, xuquuqda aadanaha, horumarka iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Haddaba oraahyo laga soo qaatay khudbadihii hoggaamiyayaal kala duwan, ayaa waxay qofka akhrisanaya uu aqoonsado hoggaamiyihii lahaa hadal kasta. Barnaamijkan ayaa soo baxay xilli Golaha Guud uu wajahayo ajande ballaaran oo ay ku jiraan arrimo la xiriira nabadda iyo amniga caalamka, isbeddelka cimilada, diyaar-garowga cudurrada faafa, kor u kaca heerka badda, horumarka waara iyo la-dagaallanka takoorka . Qaramada Midoobay waxay sheegtay in kulamada sanadkan lagu qabanayo mowduucyo dhowr ah oo u baahan iskaashi caalami ah. Waxaa maanta, 23-ka Sebtembar , sidoo kale Qaramada Midoobay lagu qabanayaa kulan heer sare ah oo lagu xusayo 40-guuradii Bayaanka Xuquuqda Horumarka , kaas oo Golaha Guud lagu ansixiyey 1986. Bayaankaasi wuxuu xoogga saarayaa ka-qaybgalka bulshada, fursadaha loo siman yahay iyo qaybsi cadaalad ah oo khayraadka dhaqaale ah. Maalmaha soo socda waxaa ajandaha ku jira kulamo kale oo heer sare ah, oo ay ka mid yihiin kulan ku saabsan khatarta ka dhalanaysa kor u kaca heerka badda , kulan ku saabsan ka-hortagga iyo u diyaar-garowga cudurrada faafa , iyo kulan lagu xusayo 25-guuradii Bayaanka iyo Barnaamijka Waxqabadka Durban ee la-dagaallanka cunsuriyadda iyo takoorka. Khudbadaha laga jeediyo Golaha Guud ma aha oo keliya hadallo loo jeediyo wakiillada dalalka xubnaha ka ah Qaramada Midoobay; waxay sidoo kale noqdeen qeyb ka mid ah diiwaanka siyaasadda iyo diblomaasiyadda caalamka. Hadallada qaarkood waxay noqdeen kuwo lagu xuso buugaagta taariikhda, warbaahinta iyo doodaha siyaasadeed ee caalamiga ah. Golaha Guud ee 81-aad ayaa sanadkan ku shaqeynaya hal-ku-dhigga “Restoring trust, managing transformation: A United Nations that delivers for all” , waxaana doodda guud ay soconaysaa iyadoo hoggaamiyayaasha iyo wakiillada 193-ka dal ay soo bandhigayaan mowqifyadooda iyo mudnaanta ay siinayaan arrimaha caalamka.

items.title: Dagaallo u dhexeeya ciidamada Itoobiya iyo xoogagga Tigray oo ka dhacay gobolka Canfarta
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Itoobiya ayaa sheegaya in iska horimaadyo hubeysan ay ka dhaceen gobolka Canfarta (Afar), halkaas oo ay isku dhaceen ciidamada dowladda Itoobiya iyo dagaalyahanno lala xiriirinayo Jabhadda Xoreynta Dadka Tigray (TPLF). Sida ay baahisay Wakaaladda Wararka ee AFP , laba ilo oo ka tirsan dhinacyada gargaarka bani’aadannimada ayaa xaqiijiyay in dagaallo ay ka dhaceen deegaanno ku dhow xuduudda u dhexeysa gobollada Tigray iyo Canfarta. Iskahorimaadkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa milatari ee ka dhex jira dowladda federaalka Itoobiya iyo xoogagga Tigray. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Kuwait oo ka wada hadlay xoojinta la-dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa
items.description: Wasiirka Cadaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Macallin Maxamuud , ayaa kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda La-dagaallanka Musuqmaasuqa ee Dowladda Kuwait, Rana Al-Fares , iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen sidii loo xoojin lahaa iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Kuwait ee dhinaca ka-hortagga iyo la-dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal, gaar ahaan is-dhaafsiga khibradaha, aqoonta iyo habraacyada wax-ku-oolka ah ee la xiriira la-dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa ka hadlay dhisidda awoodda hay’adaha dowladda iyo sidii loo horumarin lahaa hufnaanta iyo isla-xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowliga ah. Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda La-dagaallanka Musuqmaasuqa ee Kuwait, Rana Al-Fares, ayaa soo jeedisay in Soomaaliya iyo Kuwait ay sii xoojiyaan khibrad-wadaagga iyo is-dhaafsiga aqoonta , si Soomaaliya ay uga faa’iideysato waayo-aragnimada iyo habraacyada Kuwait ee ku aaddan ka-hortagga iyo la-dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa. Wasiir Xasan Macallin Maxamuud ayaa soo dhaweeyey soo jeedinta, isaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in labada dal ay yeeshaan iskaashi joogto ah, gaar ahaan dhinacyada tababarrada, horumarinta xirfadaha iyo dhisidda awoodda hay’adaha . Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo dalalka gobolka ee dhinacyada cadaaladda, hufnaanta maamulka iyo la-dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa, iyadoo khibrad-wadaagga iyo iskaashiga hay’adaha loo arko inay muhiim u yihiin horumarinta nidaamyada isla-xisaabtanka iyo maamulka wanaagsan.

items.title: Turkiga oo beeniyay in Soomaaliya ay xayiraad Fiiso ku soo rogtay muwaadniinteeda
items.description: Ankara ( Raxanreeb Online) Dowladda Türkiye ayaa beenisay warar maalmihii u dambeeyay lagu faafiyey baraha bulshada, kuwaas oo sheegayay in Dowladda Soomaaliya ay xayiraado cusub oo dhinaca fiisaha iyo socdaalka ah kusoo rogtay muwaadiniinta u dhashay Türkiye. Hay’adda Türkiye u qaabilsan la-dagaallanka wararka marin-habaabinta ah ayaa sheegtay in wararkaasi aysan sal iyo raad toona lahayn, isla markaana aanu jirin go’aan cusub oo Dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku xaddidayso socdaalka muwaadiniinta Türkiye. Hay’addu waxay caddeysay in nidaamka socdaalka iyo fiisaha ee khuseeya muwaadiniinta labada dal aanu waxba iska beddelin, iyadoo bulshada loogu baaqay inay ka digtoonaato wararka aan laga soo xigan ilo rasmi ah. Beenintan ayaa timid kaddib markii baraha bulshada lagu faafiyey qoraallo sheegaya in Soomaaliya ay wax ka beddeshay habraacyada gelitaanka dalka ee muwaadiniinta Türkiye, arrintaas oo dhalisay hadal-hayn. Türkiye iyo Soomaaliya ayaa leh xiriir dhow oo muddo dheer soo jiray, waxaana labada dowladood ka dhexeeya iskaashi dhinacyo badan taabanaya, oo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, difaaca, ganacsiga, horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha bani’aadannimada. Kenya oo wajaheysa qiimo kororka Gaaska wax lagu karsado
items.description: Nairobi ( Raxanreeb Online) Sida wararka soo baxaya ay sheegayaan dalka Kenya ayaa lagu wadaa inay bisha October 2026 wajahdo qiimo-koror ku yimaada gaaska wax lagu karsado , kaddib markii ay sare u kacayaan kharashaadka la xiriira maadooyinka iyo waxyaabaha loo adeegsado soo saarista iyo diyaarinta gaaska. Sida ay sheegayaan ilo kala duwan, kororka qiimaha ayaa la xiriira lacago dheeraad ah oo lagu soo rogay qaar ka mid ah maadooyinka lagu farsameeyo gaaska, taas oo kordhinaysa kharashaadka shirkadaha ka shaqeeya soo dejinta, farsamaynta iyo qaybinta Gaaska. Qiimo-korkaan ayaa si gaar ah u saameyn kara qoysaska ku tiirsan gaaska wax lagu karsado, maqaayadaha iyo ganacsiyada kale ee isticmaala Gaaska, iyadoo la filayo in kharashaadka dheeraadka ah ay qayb ahaan ugu gudbaan macaamiisha. Kenya ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay dadaal ugu jirtay sidii loo kordhin lahaa isticmaalka gaaska, gaar ahaan iyadoo la doonayo in bulshada lagu dhiirrigeliyo inay ka guurto isticmaalka shidaallada kale ee wax lagu karsado. Haddii qiimaha Gaaska uu kordho bisha October, waxaa sidoo kale laga yaabaa inuu saameyn ku yeesho kharashaadka nolosha iyo qiimaha adeegyadaqaarkood, gaar ahaan kuwa si weyn ugu tiirsan gaaska. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, qiimaha rasmiga ah ee kororka iyo inta uu gaarsiisan yahay weli waxay ku xirnaan doonaan go’aannada iyo xogta rasmiga ah ee hay’adaha iyo shirkadaha ka shaqeeya suuqa Gaaska ee Kenya. Waxaa kale oo uu Madaxweynuhu ka hadlay fursadaha iskaashi ee Soomaaliya ay la yeelan karto dalalkaasi, maadaama ay jiraan isbeddallo iyo guulo waa wayn oo ay sanadihii u dambeeyay xaqiijisay Dowladda Federaalka. Kulamada ayaa sii socon doono, waxaana sidoo kale Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo hoggaaminayo wafdiga Soomaaliya ee ka qayb-galaya shirka guud ee Qaramada Midoobay uu soo bandhigayaa horumarka Soomaaliya ka samaysay dhinacyada dowlad-dhiska, dimuqraadiyeynta, amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada. Sidoo kale wuxuu ka hadli doonaa mudnaanta Soomaaliya iyo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo nabadda iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale doonaysa in madashan caalamiga ah lagu muujiyo xaaladaha bani’aadamnimo ee Soomaaliya iyo baahida loo qabo in la kordhiyo taageerada iyo maalgashiga caalamiga ah ee dalka. Waxaa kale oo ay Dowladda Federaalka doonaysaa in ka qeyb-galka shirka Golaha Guud uu noqdo fursad lagu xoojiyo taageerada caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo ajandayaasheeda amni, bani’aadamnimo iyo dhaqaale. items.title: Kooxo hubeysan oo dad badani ku dilay Koonfur Afrika (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Ugu yaraan 11 qof oo ay ku jirto haweeney uur leh ayaa la dilay, ka dib markii kooxo hubeysan ay xalay xoog ku galeen guri ku yaala xaafad ka tirsan Magaalada Durban ee dalkaasi Koonfur Afrika. Kooxahan ayaa la sheegay inay beegsadeen dad ku sugnaa gurigan oo ku yaala xaafadda KwaMakhutha, xilli dadka la weeraray ay halkaasi uga socotay xaflad. Madaxa Maamulka Gobolka KwaZulu-Natal, Thamsanqa Ntuli ayaa sheegay in laba qof ay ka badbaadeen weerarka, isagoo intaasi ku daray in aan si dhakhsa ah loo ogaan karin sababta ka dambeysa dilka dadkaasi. “Dhacdadu waxay bulshada ku abuurtay naxdin iyo murugo.” Ayuu yiri Thamsanqa Ntuli. Warbaahinta maxaliga ayaa ku warantay in kooxahaasi ay dadka isugu geeyeen hal qol, ka hor inta aysan rasaas ku furin. Sidoo kale waxay dab qabadsiiyeen bay Warbaahintu sheegtay gaari uu lahaa mid ka mid ah dadkii la dilay. Booliska Koonfur Afrika ayaa war ay soo saareen ku sheegay in baaritaanada horudhac ah ay muujinayaan in qaar ka mid ah dadka la dilay ay ku jireen diiwaanka dembiyada ee hay’adaha ammaanka, sababo ku aaddan falal sharci darro ah oo looga shakisnaa. Dembiileyaasha ayaa ka baxsaday goobta, booliskana waxay sheegeen in ay ku daba joogaan. Dalka Koonfur Afrika ayaa ka mid ah dalalka adduunka ugu sarreya dhinaca dembiyada dilalka ah. Dalkan ayaa waxaa la sheegaa in ay ka dhacaan 26,000 illaa 27,000 oo dil sanadkii. Inta badan dilalka ayaa waxaa gaysta kooxo burcad oo hubeysan, iyagoo ka cawda shaqo la’aan iyo faqri. Kooxahan ayaa dhibaato ba’an ku haya dadka rayidka ah, gaar ahaan ajaaniibta ay ku jiraan ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed ee dalkaasi ku nool.

Kooxahan ayaa la sheegay inay beegsadeen dad ku sugnaa gurigan oo ku yaala xaafadda KwaMakhutha, xilli dadka la weeraray ay halkaasi uga socotay xaflad. Madaxa Maamulka Gobolka KwaZulu-Natal, Thamsanqa Ntuli ayaa sheegay in laba qof ay ka badbaadeen weerarka, isagoo intaasi ku daray in aan si dhakhsa ah loo ogaan karin sababta ka dambeysa dilka dadkaasi. “Dhacdadu waxay bulshada ku abuurtay naxdin iyo murugo.” Ayuu yiri Thamsanqa Ntuli. Warbaahinta maxaliga ayaa ku warantay in kooxahaasi ay dadka isugu geeyeen hal qol, ka hor inta aysan rasaas ku furin. Sidoo kale waxay dab qabadsiiyeen bay Warbaahintu sheegtay gaari uu lahaa mid ka mid ah dadkii la dilay. Booliska Koonfur Afrika ayaa war ay soo saareen ku sheegay in baaritaanada horudhac ah ay muujinayaan in qaar ka mid ah dadka la dilay ay ku jireen diiwaanka dembiyada ee hay’adaha ammaanka, sababo ku aaddan falal sharci darro ah oo looga shakisnaa. Dembiileyaasha ayaa ka baxsaday goobta, booliskana waxay sheegeen in ay ku daba joogaan. Dalka Koonfur Afrika ayaa ka mid ah dalalka adduunka ugu sarreya dhinaca dembiyada dilalka ah. Dalkan ayaa waxaa la sheegaa in ay ka dhacaan 26,000 illaa 27,000 oo dil sanadkii. Inta badan dilalka ayaa waxaa gaysta kooxo burcad oo hubeysan, iyagoo ka cawda shaqo la’aan iyo faqri. Kooxahan ayaa dhibaato ba’an ku haya dadka rayidka ah, gaar ahaan ajaaniibta ay ku jiraan ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed ee dalkaasi ku nool.

items.title: TPLF la wareegtay garoonka diyaaradaha ee Mekelle iyo duulimaadyadii oo hakad galay
items.description: Shirkadda diyaaradaha Itoobiya ee Ethiopian Airlines ayaa si ku-meel-gaar ah u hakisay dhammaan duulimaadyadii ay ku tagi jirtay magaalooyinka Mekelle, Axum iyo Shire ee gobolka Tigray, iyadoo shirkaddu ku sababaysay go’aanka “xaaladda hadda ka jirta gobolka Tigray.” Shirkaddu waxay sheegtay in hakinta duulimaadyadu ay dhaqan gashay Arbacada, 23-ka Sebtembar 2026 , iyadoo raalli-gelin ka bixisay dhibaatada ay tani ku keeni karto rakaabka. Ethiopian Airlines waxay sidoo kale sheegtay inay macaamiisha ogeysiin doonto marka duulimaadyada magaalooyinkan dib loo bilaabo. Go’aanka shirkadda ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo ilo amni iyo kuwo maxalli ah ay sheegeen in ciidamo Tigray ah ay la wareegeen garoonka caalamiga ah ee Alula Aba Nega , oo ku yaalla magaalada Mekelle, caasimadda gobolka Tigray. Sida ay Reuters u werisay, laba ilo maxalli ah ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Tigray ay garoonka kala wareegeen ciidamo boolis federaal ah habeenkii, inkastoo aanay dowladda federaalka Itoobiya iyo dhinacyada kale ee ay arrintu khusayso si degdeg ah uga jawaabin wararkaasi. Warbixinno kale oo ay soo xigatay AFP ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ciidamo Tigray ah lagu arkay agagaarka garoonka, iyadoo shaqaale ka tirsan garoonka uu sheegay in loo sheegay in garoonka la wareegeen ciidamada Tigray, taasina ay sababtay in shaqaalihii dib loogu celiyo guryahooda. Hakinta duulimaadyada ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli xiriirka u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka Itoobiya iyo hoggaanka Tigray uu mar kale wajahayo xiisad. TPLF , oo ah xoogga siyaasadeed ee ugu weyn Tigray, ayaa bishan ku biirtay isbahaysi ay sameeyeen toddobo kooxood oo hubaysan oo Itoobiya ka kala socda, kuwaas oo sheegay inay doonayaan inay ka hor yimaadaan dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed. Xiisaddan ayaa dib u soo cusboonaatay inkastoo labada dhinac ay Nofeembar 2022 kala saxiixdeen heshiis nabadeed oo soo afjaray dagaalkii Tigray ee 2020–2022.

items.title: Lafta-gareen oo diiday inuu joojiyo dagaalka Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Bayaan kooban oo ay soo saareen kooxda madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen) ayaa waxaa looga hadlay xaaladda weli ka taagan maamulkaasi, gaar ahaan bannaanka magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. Afhayeenka kooxda Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo qoraal ku daabacay bartiisa Facebook-ga ayaa beeniyay wararka sheegaya in Lafta-gareen uu aqbalay xabad-joojin laga sameeyo Koonfur Galbeed, wuxuuna meesha ka saaray in heshiis uu la gaaray shaqsiyaad ku howlan xalinta xiisadda taagan. “Ma jiraan wadahadal go’aan looga gaaray xabad joojin oo shaqsiyaad iyo Madaxweynaha DKGS Mudane Abdiasis Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen,” ayuu yiri afhayeenku. Ugaas Xasan ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in ay sii wadi doonaan howlgalka, isla markaana ujeedkooda uu yahay inay xoreeyaan Koonfur Galbeed, sidoo kalena ay gacantooda kusoo celiyaan, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Halganka iyo dib u xoreynta deegaanada KGS wuu sii socon doonaan ilaa laga xoreeyo dakeenuna gobonimadooda iyo sharfkoodu gacantooda kusoo laabto insha allah,” ayuu sii raaciyey Ugaas Xasan. Hadakan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo haatan ay dagan tahay xaalada Koofur Galbeed, inkastoo weli ciidamada labada dhinac ay isku horfadhiyaan duleedka magaalada Baydhaba oo ay horay uga dhaceen dagaallo kala duwan. Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Koonfur Galbeed ayaa hadda abaabul ka wada Baydhaba oo ciidamo badan la geeyay, halka ciidanka daacadda u ah Lafta-gareen ay joogaan xeryahooda, halkaas oo ay ka wadaan dhaq-dhaqaaq culus. The post Lafta-gareen oo diiday inuu joojiyo dagaalka Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan oo New York kula kulmay madax kala duwan oo ka qeyb  galeysa Shirka QM
items.description: News York (Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada New York ee dalka Mareykanka kulamo doceedyo kula yeeshay Madaxweynaha Serbia, Aleksandar Vučić, Madaxweynaha Senegal, Bassirou Diomaye Faye, Madaxweynaha Zimbabwe, Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa, iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Jamhuuriyadda Pakistan, Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif. Kulamada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo dalalkaasi iyo arrimo la xiriira nabadda, amniga, horumarka iyo danaha wadajirka ah ee ay wadaagaan dhinacyadaasi. Madaxweynaha ayaa mas’uuliyiinta uu la kulmay la wadaagay horumarka iyo guulaha Soomaaliya ka xaqiijisay nabadda iyo amniga, dowlad-dhiska, dimuqraadiyeynta, dhaqaalaha iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, isagoo sidoo kale ka hadlay fursadaha iskaashi ee Soomaaliya ay la yeelan karto dalalkaasi. The post Madaxweyne Xasan oo New York kula kulmay madax kala duwan oo ka qeyb galeysa Shirka QM appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Amiirka Qatar oo Qaramada Midoobay ka hor sheegay taageerada dalkiisa ee madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada Soomaaliya
items.description: Amiirka Dowladda Qatar, Sheekh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, ayaa khudbad uu ka jeediyay furitaanka kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ku celiyay taageerada Qatar ee madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya . Amiirka Qatar ayaa hadalkiisa ku sheegay in dalkiisu si adag u taageerayo Soomaaliya, isagoo Soomaaliya ku tilmaamay dal walaal ah, wuxuuna si cad u yiri in Qatar ay si adag u taageereyso madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Hadalkan ayaa yimid xilli Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay uu New York ka socdo, iyadoo madaxda dalalka dunidu ay ka hadlayaan arrimo ay ka mid yihiin nabadda, amniga, madax-bannaanida dowladaha iyo xallinta khilaafaadka. Kalfadhiga 81-aad ayaa furmay 8-dii Sebtembar, halka doodda guud ee madaxda dowladuhuna ay socoto 22–28-ka Sebtembar 2026. Khudbaddiisa, Sheekh Tamim wuxuu sidoo kale ka hadlay muhiimadda ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida dowladaha, wadajirka dhuleed iyo xallinta khilaafaadka iyadoo loo marayo wada-hadal iyo diblomaasiyad . Wuxuu arrimaha Soomaaliya ku daray mowqifyada Qatar ee ku aaddan dalalka gobolka, isaga oo si gaar ah u xaqiijiyay taageerada Doha ee Soomaaliya. Taageerada uu Amiirka Qatar ku celiyay Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay waxay muujinaysaa in mowqifka rasmiga ah ee Doha uu yahay ilaalinta midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya . Hadalka Amiirka ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmaya xilli arrimaha madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya ay si weyn uga mid yihiin doodaha diblomaasiyadeed ee gobolka iyo caalamka.

items.title: Eritrean exiles build network to topple Afwerki
items.description: TEL AVIV (Somaliguardian) – An Eritrean opposition movement operating out of a warehouse in southern Tel Aviv says it has built the most organized diaspora network yet assembled against President Isaias Afwerki, and is actively courting political support from the United States, Israel and Gulf states, according to a Haaretz report published September 18, 2026. The movement, known as Brigade N’Hamedu – roughly “For the Homeland” in Tigrinya – says it now coordinates community structures in Israel, the United States, Canada, Sweden, Germany and Ethiopia, drawing on a diaspora Haaretz estimated at nearly two million Eritrean refugees and asylum seekers. Formed in 2022, the group elected a 51-member international council last month through 17 simultaneous community votes held around the world, including one attended by roughly 1,300 people in Nes Ziona, Israel. Afwerki, 82, has led Eritrea since its 1993 independence from Ethiopia. The country has held no national elections, has not implemented its constitution, and has shut down its independent press. Conscription can begin at age 14 with no fixed discharge date, and Haaretz cited a UN report from May 2025 documenting surveillance and reprisals against Eritreans that extend into exile. Diplomatic outreach, not a foreign operation Dawit Teferi, the movement’s Canadian-Eritrean treasurer, told Haaretz he spends his time in Washington meeting members of Congress and US officials. “The U.S., Israel, and the Gulf states have a major interest in having a partner in the Red Sea region,” he said, adding that the movement is “in a very good position” despite not yet having secured formal recognition. Movement leader Beyene Gerezgher, who operates from Addis Ababa, was more cautious, telling Haaretz that contacts in Washington “do not yet amount to official recognition” and that “we cannot bring about a democratic revolution in Eritrea on our own; we need international support.” According to the research organization Crisis Group, Ethiopia has openly hosted the movement since early 2025, giving it what Gerezgher called “a free hand to operate.” Haaretz’s reporting describes a diaspora movement seeking outside backing for a future push against Afwerki’s government. It does not report any UAE or Israeli government decision, operation or plan to remove Afwerki, and no Israeli, Emirati or US official is quoted endorsing regime change in Eritrea. The backdrop: Washington just lifted sanctions on Asmara The Haaretz feature published one day after a separate, unrelated development: the US Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control announced on September 18 that it had rescinded 2021 sanctions on Eritrea’s ruling People’s Front for Democracy and Justice, the Eritrean Defence Force, and state-linked entities including the Red Sea Trading Corporation, according to the Associated Press and Reuters. Those sanctions were imposed by the Biden administration over Eritrea’s role backing Ethiopian federal forces during the 2020–2022 Tigray war, in which UN investigators documented mass killings, sexual violence and abductions. The Trump administration said the move was intended to “advance US regional interests” as Red Sea shipping faces continued threats from Houthi forces in Yemen near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, close to Eritrea’s port of Assab. A separate Magnitsky Act sanction against Eritrean defense forces chief of staff Filipos Woldeyohannes remains in place, and US arms-export restrictions on Eritrea’s security services are unaffected. The sanctions move and the Haaretz feature on Brigade N’Hamedu are separately reported developments; Haaretz does not draw a connection between the two, and this report treats them as distinct. Israel’s own Eritrean fault line The report also traces the movement’s roots to violent clashes between pro- and anti-Afwerki Eritreans in south Tel Aviv in September 2023, in which more than 110 people were injured. Similar clashes occurred the same period in Sweden, Germany, Canada and the US. A May 2025 UN report cited by Haaretz found at least nine Eritreans have been killed in Israel since the 2023 unrest. Community organizers quoted in the piece, including Atekilti Abraham Michael and Mulu Sultan – both longtime Eritrean residents of Israel – described personal costs from their activism, including relatives detained or conscripted in Eritrea, and called for Israeli authorities to distinguish between regime opponents and government supporters at community events. Gerezgher told Haaretz the movement has contacts “from ordinary people to senior figures in the army and government” inside Eritrea and believes momentum is building toward a decisive moment, though he did not give a timeline. “The dictator won’t just let us walk right in,” he said. “We are ready for the right moment, and I think we are close – very close.” Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com
