Gerezgher told Haaretz the movement has contacts “from ordinary people to senior figures in the army and government” inside Eritrea and believes momentum is building toward a decisive moment, though he did not give a timeline. “The dictator won’t just let us walk right in,” he said. “We are ready for the right moment, and I think we are close – very close.” Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Trump oo UN-ka Ka Hadlay Iran iyo ICC
items.description: Trump oo UN-ka ka hadlay Iran iyo ICC, Turkigana oo adkeeyay tallaabooyinka LGBTQ+ Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa 22-ka Sebtembar 2026 khudbad ka jeediyay Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee New York, isagoo difaacay dagaalka Mareykanka ee Iran, weeraray Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah (ICC), isla markaana ku baaqay in dalalka xubnaha ka ah maxkamaddu ay ka baxaan. Isla maalintaas, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa Qaramada Midoobay kaga hadlay waxa uu ku tilmaamay siyaasado caalami ah oo lagu wiiqayo qaabka qoyska, xilli dowladda Turkigu ay waddo howlgallo ka dhan ah kooxaha LGBTQ+. Trump oo UN-ka ka difaacay siyaasadda Iran Trump ayaa khudbaddiisa ku sheegay in Iran aysan heli doonin hub nukliyeer ah, isagoo sidoo kale muujiyay inuu weli filayo in heshiis laga gaari karo Tehran.Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in heshiis lala gaaro Iran uu dhici karo kaddib doorashada dhexe ee Mareykanka ee bisha November. Khudbaddiisa wuxuu sidoo kale ku sheegay in Mareykanku uu sii wadi doono taageerada horumarinta sirdoonka macmalka ah, isaga oo ka digay in xeerar adag ay hor istaagi karaan kobaca tiknoolajiyadda.Trump wuxuu xitaa soo jeediyay in erayga “artificial intelligence” loo beddelo “super intelligence”, isagoo ku dooday in tiknoolajiyaddu ay yeelan karto saameyn ka weyn tii Kacaankii Warshadaha ama internet-ka. Trump oo dalalka ugu baaqay inay ka baxaan ICC Qaybta ugu adag ee khudbadda Trump waxay ku wajahneyd Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah. Wuxuu dalalka xubnaha ka ah ICC ugu baaqay inay ka baxaan maxkamadda, isagoo si adag u dhaliilay hay’adda iyo awooddeeda.ICC waxaa loo sameeyay in lagu qaado dacwadaha shaqsiyaadka lagu eedeeyo qaar ka mid ah dambiyada ugu culus ee caalamiga ah, oo ay ku jiraan dambiyada dagaalka, dambiyada ka dhanka ah aadanaha iyo xasuuqa. Maamulka Trump ayaa horey tallaabooyin cunaqabateyn ah uga qaaday qaar ka mid ah saraakiisha maxkamadda, waxaana hadda jira qorshe lagu ballaarinayo cadaadiska lagu saarayo hay’adda. Qorshahaas weli waa in loo kala saaraa tallaabo la qorsheynayo iyo cunaqabateyn si rasmi ah u dhaqan gashay.Cadaadiska Mareykanka ayaa imanaya xilli ICC ay ku lug leedahay dacwado iyo baaritaanno la xiriira dambiyo caalami ah oo ka dhacay dalal dhowr ah. Taageerada Trump oo hoos u dhacday Khudbadda UN-ka waxay timid iyadoo taageerada gudaha Mareykanka ee Trump ay hoos u dhacday. Sahan cusub oo la sameeyay 1,277 qof oo qaangaar ah ayaa muujiyay in 32% ay ansixiyeen sida Trump u gudanayo xilkiisa, halka 35% ay sidaas ahaayeen toddobaadkii ka horreeyay. Taageerada Trump ee Jamhuuriyiinta ayaa sidoo kale hoos uga dhacday 82% ilaa 73% muddadaas.Sahanku wuxuu sidoo kale muujiyay in qiimaha maciishadda iyo dagaalka Iran ay ka mid yihiin arrimaha dadka Mareykanka ku abuura walaaca ugu badan. Tirooyinkan waa natiijooyin sahan oo cabbiraya ra’yiga dadweynaha xilliga la sameeyay, mana aha saadaal ku saabsan natiijada doorasho. Turkiga oo ballaarinaya tallaabooyinka ka dhanka ah LGBTQ+ Dhanka kale, dowladda Turkiga ayaa kordhisay tallaabooyinka ay ka qaadayso kooxaha iyo ururrada LGBTQ+. Howlgallada ayaa lagu magacaabay “My Family is Safe” , iyadoo dowladda Turkigu sheegtay in ujeeddadu tahay ilaalinta carruurta iyo qiyamka qoyska.Sida xogta la soo sheegay, 82 qof ayaa loo xiray si ay u sugayaan maxkamadeyn, halka in ka badan 100 qof lagu xiray mudaharaadyo la xiriiray tallaabooyinkaasi.Dhinaca kale, kooxaha xuquuqda aadanaha iyo siyaasiyiin mucaarad ah ayaa walaac ka muujiyay waxa ay ku tilmaamayaan xannibaad sii kordheysa oo lagu hayo kooxaha LGBTQ+ iyo bulshada rayidka ah. Madaxweyne Erdoğan ayaa khudbaddiisa UN-ka ku sheegay inuu ka soo horjeedo waxa uu ku tilmaamay “global gender-neutralisation policies”, isaga oo ku baaqay in la ilaaliyo qoyska uu ku qeexay inuu ka kooban yahay nin iyo haweeney. Arrintan ayaa muujinaysa kala duwanaanshaha aragtida dowladda Turkiga iyo kooxaha xuquuqda aadanaha ee ku saabsan siyaasadaha ku wajahan LGBTQ+. Dood kale oo ka dhalatay buugga walaalka Diana Dhanka Britain, Charles Spencer, walaalka Princess Diana, ayaa soo saaray buug xusuus-qor ah oo dib u kiciyay dood ku saabsan qoyska boqortooyada.Spencer wuxuu buuggiisa ku qoray sheegashooyin ku saabsan sida King Charles III uga falceliyay geeridii Diana sanadkii 1997. Sheegashadaas waxaa diiday Buckingham Palace, taasoo ku doodday in murugada qoyska ay saameyn karto xusuusta iyo qiimeynta dhacdooyinkii hore.Sidaas darteed, sheegashada ku saabsan falcelinta King Charles waa xog uu Spencer ku qoray xusuus-qorkiisa , mana aha xaqiiqo madax-bannaan oo la xaqiijiyay.   The post Trump oo UN-ka Ka Hadlay Iran iyo ICC first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Toogasho wadareed oo ka dhacay magaalada Durban
items.description: Durban ( Raxanreeb Online) Ugu yaraan 11 qof ayaa lagu dilay toogasho wadareed ka dhacday guri ku yaalla deegaanka KwaMakhutha, oo u dhow magaalada Durban ee Koonfur Afrika. Booliska ayaa sheegay in rag hubeysan ay guriga gudaha u galeen fiidkii Talaadadii, kadibna rasaas ku fureen 14 qof. Toban qof ayaa goobta ku dhintay, halka afar kalena isbitaal loo qaaday, balse mid ka mid ah uu markii dambe u geeriyooday dhaawacii soo gaaray. Boolisku waxay sheegeen in qaar ka mid ah dadka la beegsaday ay ku jireen baaritaanno la xiriira falal sharci-darro ah, balse aysan faahfaahin karin arrintaas si aanay u carqaladeyn baaritaanka socda. Waxay intaas ku dareen in aan meesha laga saari karin suurtagalnimada in weerarku la xiriiro colaad u dhexeysa kooxo iska soo horjeeda. Bayaan boolisku soo saareen ayaa lagu sheegay in 13 nin iyo haweeney la rumeysan yahay inay uur lahayd ay xaflad ku lahaayeen guriga, markii ay yimaadeen saddex nin oo rasaas ku furay. Haweeneyda ayaa ka mid ah dadka dhintay. Weriye ka tirsan telefishinka eNCA oo goobta ku sugnaa ayaa sheegay in ragga weerarka geystay ay sidoo kale dab qabadsiiyeen gaari uu lahaa mid ka mid ah dhibbanayaasha, ka hor inta aysan baxsan. Booliska ayaa sheegay inay bilaabeen baadigoobka tuhmanayaasha. Koonfur Afrika ayaa ka mid ah dalalka uu heerka dilalku aadka ugu sarreeyo dunida. Xogta booliska ayaa muujinaysa in dalka maalin kasta lagu dilo in ka badan 60 qof. The post Toogasho wadareed oo ka dhacay magaalada Durban appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Heshiiska Drones-ka Pakistan iyo Shirkad Maraykan ah oo Su’aalo Dhaliyay
items.description: Pakistan ayaa heshiis cusub oo dhinaca diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn (drones) ah la gashay shirkadda Maraykanka ee Powerus, taas oo ay maal-gashadaan Eric Trump iyo Donald Trump Jr, oo ah labada wiil ee waaweyn ee Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump. Heshiiskan ayaa dhaliyay su’aalo la xiriira xiriirka shirkaddu la leedahay Hindiya, oo ah dal ay Pakistan xafiiltamaan, iyo sidoo kale xiriirrada qaar ka mid ah madaxda shirkadda ee Israa’iil. Heshiiska ayaa yimid kadib markii wafdi ka socday Powerus iyo safaaradda Maraykanka uu 16-kii Sebtembar kula kulmay Field Marshal Asim Munir, madaxa ciidamada Pakistan, xarunta militariga ee magaalada Rawalpindi. Maalintii xigtay, Powerus waxay shaacisay inay heshay amar xaddidan oo wax-iibsi ah oo ka yimid Wasaaradda Difaaca Pakistan, kaas oo ku saabsan nidaamyada diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Qiimaha heshiiska iyo nooca ama tirada drones-ka Pakistan iibsanayso lama shaacin, balse Powerus ayaa sheegtay in heshiiska is-afgaradku uusan ahayn heshiis kama-dambeys ah oo khasab ka dhigaya in Pakistan wax ka iibsato shirkadda, balse uu yahay qaab-dhismeed ay labada dhinac mustaqbalka uga wada shaqeyn karaan arrimaha difaaca, waxaana heshiisyada noocan ah ku dabaqi doona shuruucda Maraykanka iyo oggolaanshaha dowladda. heshiiskan ayaa si gaar ah indhaha loogu hayaa kadib markii la ogaaday in Powerus ay dhowaan heshiis kale la gashay shirkad Hindi ah, waxaana bishii Juun 2026, shirkadda Paras Defence and Space Technologies ee Hindiya ay sheegtay in Powerus ay siisay ruqsad gaar ah oo ay Hindiya ugu soo saarto uguna iibiso teknoolojiyadda Guardian-1, oo ah drone loogu talagalay inuu qabto ama burburiyo drones kale. Arrintan ayaa su’aalo ka dhalisay sida shirkad isku mid ahi ula macaamili karto laba dal oo xiriirkoodu xasaasi yahay. Hindiya iyo Pakistan ayaa muddo dheer ku jiray loollan amni iyo milatari, iyadoo labada dal ay dagaallo hore u galeen, isla markaana ay isku hayaan arrimo ay ka mid yihiin gobolka Kashmir.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Muqdisho Ka Daah-furtay Shirka Madasha Arrimaha Bani’aaddannimada ee CHF 2026
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha, Federaalka iyo Dib-u-heshiisiinta Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh) , ayaa magaalada Muqdisho si rasmi ah uga daah-furay Shirka Madasha Arrimaha Bani’aadannimada Soomaaliya (CHF 2026) . Shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Soomaaliya, isku-duwidda dadaallada gurmadka iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa diyaar-garowga ka hortagga khataraha dabiiciga ah ee laga cabsi qabo inay saameeyaan bulshada. Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha ayaa sheegay in shirka uu ku soo beegmay xilli loo baahan yahay diyaar-garow hore iyo qorshe mideysan , iyadoo la saadaalinayo roobab xooggan iyo fatahaado la xiriira xaaladda cimilada ee El Niño . Mudane Cali Xoosh ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in hay’adaha dowladda, dowlad-goboleedyada, hay’adaha samafalka iyo bah-wadaagta caalamiga ah ay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan yareynta saameynta musiibooyinka iyo ka jawaabista baahiyaha bulshada. Shirka CHF 2026 ayaa sidoo kale fursad u ah dhinacyada ka shaqeeya arrimaha bani’aadannimada inay iska xog-warramaan, qiimeeyaan khataraha soo socda, isla markaana yeeshaan qorsheyaal lagu xoojinayo gurmadka iyo u-diyaargarowga xaaladaha degdegga ah. Diyaar-garowga fatahaadaha iyo roobabka culus ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Soomaaliya, maadaama dhacdooyinka cimiladu ay horey u saameeyeen deegaanno badan, isla markaana ay kordhin karaan barakaca iyo baahiyaha bani’aadannimo ee bulshada.

Shirka CHF 2026 ayaa sidoo kale fursad u ah dhinacyada ka shaqeeya arrimaha bani’aadannimada inay iska xog-warramaan, qiimeeyaan khataraha soo socda, isla markaana yeeshaan qorsheyaal lagu xoojinayo gurmadka iyo u-diyaargarowga xaaladaha degdegga ah. Diyaar-garowga fatahaadaha iyo roobabka culus ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Soomaaliya, maadaama dhacdooyinka cimiladu ay horey u saameeyeen deegaanno badan, isla markaana ay kordhin karaan barakaca iyo baahiyaha bani’aadannimo ee bulshada.

items.title: Trump oo hanjabaad kulul u jeediyay Iran
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump ayaa Talaadadii khudbaddiisii Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobey ku muujiyay laba waddo oo u furan maamulkiisa, si loo soo afjaro dagaalka toddobada bilood ay kula jiraan dalkaasi Iran. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa tilmaamay inuu wajahayo go’aan adag, oo ah inuu heshiis la galo Iran ama uu baabi’iyo dalkaasi. Madaxweynaha ayaa Hoggaamiyeyaasha Caalamka hortooda ka sheegay inuu cadaabta u diri doono Iran, iyagoo aan wax fursad ah siinin ama rajo ay ku badbaadi karto. Trump ayaa ku adkeystay inuusan marnaba u ogolaan doonin Iran inay hesho hubka nuclear-ka. Trump ayaa dhanka kale xusay inuu aaminsan yahay in Iran ay heshiis la geli karto Mareykanka, marka ay dhammaato doorashada xilliga dhexe Mareykanka ee bisha November. Inkasta oo hanjabaadda Trump ay ahayd mid kulul, haddana isla shalay wufuud labada dal ah ayaa ku kulmay Magaalada New York. Ergeyga Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe, Steve Witkoff iyo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran, Abbas Araghchi ayaa yeeshay kulan saddex saacadood qaatay oo uu dhexdhexaadinayay dalka yar ee Qatar. Donald Trump, Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa kulankaasi ku tilmaamay mid aad u wanaagsan.

items.title: Boqor Salmaan oo sheegay in la soo weeraray Maka
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) — Boqorka Sacuudi Carabiya Salman bin Abdulaziz ayaa si kulul u cambaareeyay waxa Riyadh ay sheegtay inuu ahaa isku day ay Xuutiyiinta Yemen ku beegsanayeen magaalada barakeysan ee Maka, isagoo kooxda ku tilmaamay “maleeshiyo argagixiso”. Boqor Salman ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay shir ay Golaha Wasiirrada Sacuudiga yeesheen Talaadadii, sida ay baahisay wakaaladda rasmiga ah ee wararka Sacuudiga ee SPA. Waxa uu sheegay in isku dayga lagu beegsanayo Maka uu yahay “dambi fool xun” oo dhaawacaya dareenka Muslimiinta caalamka. “Isku dayga maleeshiyada argagixisada ah ee Xuutiyiinta ay ku beegsanayaan Maka” ayaa kiciyay cambaareyn caalami ah, ayuu yiri Boqorka, sida ay sheegtay SPA. Hadalka Boqor Salman ayaa ah mid si gaar ah indhaha loogu hayo, maadaama uu sanadihii dambe si dhif ah uga hadlo arrimaha maalinlaha ah ee siyaasadda iyo amniga, kuwaas oo inta badan uu hoggaamiyo Dhaxal-suge Maxamed bin Salman. Boqorka ayaa sidoo kale ammaanay ciidamada qalabka sida iyo laamaha ammaanka Sacuudiga, isaga oo ku bogaadiyay difaaca dalka iyo waxa uu ku tilmaamay ka hortagga weerarrada ka dhanka ah goobaha barakeysan, dadka xajka iyo cumrada u yimaada, muwaadiniinta iyo dadka kale ee ku nool boqortooyada. Hadalkiisa ayaa yimid maalmo kadib markii Sacuudigu sheegay in difaaciisa cirka uu qabtay diyaarad aan duuliye lahayn oo Xuutiyiintu soo rideen, taas oo Riyadh sheegtay inay ku sii jeedday dhinaca Maka ka hor inta aysan gaarin hawada mamnuuca ah ee magaalada. Xuutiyiinta ayaa si adag u beeniyay inay Maka bartilmaameedsadeen. Afhayeenka militariga Xuutiyiinta Yahya Saree ayaa sheegay in kooxda aysan weerar ku qaadin magaalada barakeysan, isagoo ku eedeeyay Sacuudiga inuu arrinta u adeegsanayo dacaayad. Hoggaamiyaha Xuutiyiinta Abdel-Malik al-Houthi ayaa isaguna eedeynta Sacuudiga ku tilmaamay “been aad u fool xun”. Dhacdada ayaa sababtay digniin amni oo laga dhaqan geliyo Maka, taas oo Al Jazeera ay sheegtay inay ahayd markii ugu horreysay muddo ku dhow 10 sano oo magaaladaas laga qaado tallaabo amni oo noocaas ah. Maka waxaa ku yaalla Kacbada, oo ah goobta ugu barakeysan Islaamka. Xiisadda Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta Eedeynta la xiriirta Maka ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli dagaalka Yemen iyo iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga ay markale xoogeysanayaan. Toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay, Xuutiyiintu waxay gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku weerareen bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla Sacuudi Carabiya, halka ciidamada taageersan dowladda Yemen iyo kuwa Sacuudiga ay weerarro ka fuliyeen gudaha Yemen. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in weerarrada cusub ay dagaalka Yemen dib ugu soo celiyeen heer colaadeed oo sare kadib sanado ay xaaladdu ka degganeyd sidii hore. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sidoo kale Sabtidii sheegtay inay qabatay gantaal ballistic ah oo Xuutiyiintu kusoo rideen caasimadda Riyadh. Kooxdu waxay dhankeeda sheegtay inay bartilmaameedsatay goobo xasaasi ah oo gudaha boqortooyada ku yaalla. Xuutiyiinta, oo ay taageerto Iran, ayaa tan iyo 2014 gacanta ku haya caasimadda Yemen ee Sanca iyo qeybo badan oo waqooyiga iyo galbeedka dalka ah. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa 2015 hoggaamisay isbahaysi militari oo dagaalka Yemen ku galay taageerada dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay. Xiisadda hadda taagan ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeelatay ammaanka marin-biyoodka Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab, halka Sacuudiga iyo dalal kale ay ka walaacsan yihiin weerarrada lagu hayo maraakiibta iyo kaabeyaasha tamarta. Hadalka Boqor Salman ayaa sidaas darteed muujinaya sida Riyadh ay muhiimad gaar ah u siineyso eedeynta la xiriirta Maka, iyadoo Sacuudigu arrinta u arko mid ka gudbeysa khilaafka militari ee Yemen oo taabaneysa amniga goobaha ugu barakeysan Muslimiinta. Xuutiyiinta, dhankooda, waxay ku adkeysanayaan in aysan Maka beegsan, taasoo ka dhigeysa cidda iyo halka uu ku wajahnaa diyaaradda aan duuliyaha lahayn arrin ay labada dhinac si weyn isugu khilaafsan yihiin. The post Boqor Salmaan oo sheegay in la soo weeraray Maka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sidee ayay Xuutiyiinta ugu suuro gashay in ay bahdilaan dawladda Sucuudiga?
items.description: Horraantii bishii September, ololihii militari iyo dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed iyo kuwa dhaqaale ee Sucuudigu tobannaanka sano soo waday ayaa si lama filaan ah u fashilmay. Weerar kedis ah oo ay Xuutiyiintu soo qaadeen ayaa ku qasbay maleeshiyaadkii daacadda u ahaa dowladda rasmiga ah ee Yemen inay ka cararaan goobihii ay gacanta ku hayeen. Kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee loo yaqaanno Ansaar Allah ayaa qabsatay xeebta galbeed ee Yemen ee Badda Cas ku taal, waxayna hadda u sii siqayaan dhanka marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ee Baab Al-Mandab, kaasoo ah laf-dhabarta dhoofinta shidaalka Sucuudiga. Bishii February ee sannadkii hore, markii Mareykanku weeraray Iran oo Tehran ay xirtay marin-biyoodka Hormuz, Sucuudigu wuxuu beddel ahaan u isticmaalayay marin-biyoodka Baab Al-Mandab. Xuutiyiintu markii ay Sucuudiga ku tilmaameen “cadawgayaga” ayna xayiraad saareen isku-socodka badda, ciidamadoodu waxay maalmo gudahood ku qabsadeen dhulal cusub. Waxay xoojiyeen duqeymaha ay ku hayaan magaalooyinka Sucuudiga iyo xarumaha tamarta, iyagoo adeegsanaya gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn. Dr. Aziz Alghashian oo ka tirsan Golaha Caalamiga ah ee Khaliijka ayaa tilmaamay in xaaladdan ay ka dhigan tahay in riyadii laga cabsanayay ay run noqotay. “Xudunta dhaqaalaha Sucuudiga, oo ah waddada dhoofinta shidaalka, ayaa si xun loo hakiyay,” ayuu BBC-da u sheegay. Wuxuuna intaa ku daray, “Waxaa adag in laga fikiro xaalad ka sii xun tan.” Ka dib markii la xiray marin-biyoodka Hormuz, Sucuudigu wuxuu ku tiirsanaa dhuumaha shidaalka ee Bari-Galbeed si uu shidaalkiisa uga dhoofiyo dekedda Yanbu ee Badda Cas. Xogta Ururka wadamada shidaalka dhoofiya ee OPEC waxay sheegaysaa in ku dhawaad 80% shidaalka ceeriin ee Sucuudiga loo iib geeyo suuqyada Aasiya. Tani waxay Baab Al-Mandab ka dhigaysaa marin aad muhiim u ah. Hase yeeshee labadii toddobaad ee la soo dhaafay Xuutiyiintu waxay la wareegeen magaalooyinka Mocha iyo Dhubab oo u dhow marin-biyoodka; waxayna gacanta ku dhigeen jasiiradda Perim oo ah qeyb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah marin-biyoodka. Xuutiyiinta oo xaruntoodu tahay Sanca ayaa gacanta ku haya inta badan waqooyiga Yemen oo uu ku jiro xuduudda Sucuudiga. Sannadkii 2015-kii dowladda Sucuudi Carabiya waxay bilowday isbahaysi caalami ah si loo soo celiyo dowladdii caalamku aqoonsanaa ee Yemen. Isbahaysigan uu Sucuudigu hoggaaminayay ayaa qaaday kumanaan duqeyn cirka ah oo ay ku dhinteen kumanaan qof, sida ay sheegtay Qaramada Midoobay. Arrintaasi waxay keentay in isbahaysiga si weyn loo dhaleeceeyo. Sanadkii 2021-kii, Madaxweynihii Mareykanka Joe Biden wuxuu joojiyay taageeradii uu Mareykanku siin jiray dagaalka Yemen, taageeradaas oo ay ku jirtay iibinta hubka. Dagaalku wuxuu galaaftay nolosha in ka badan 150,000 oo qof, wuxuuna dhaliyay musiibo bani’aadamnimo oo sababtay in 4.8 milyan oo qof ay guryahooda ka barakacaan, halka in ka badan kala bar shacabka oo dhan oo ah 19.5 milyan oo qof ay u baahan yihiin gargaar noocyo kala duwan leh. Inkastoo ay jirtay xasillooni iska qaraabo ah tan iyo markii la gaaray heshiiskii 2022-kii, haddana weerarka cusub ee ay Xuutiyiintu hadda wadaan wuxuu muujinayaa sida ay u xoogeysteen awooddooda militari iyo abaabulkoodaba. Dr. Elizabeth Kendall oo ka tirsan Jaamacadda Cambridge ayaa BBC-da u sheegtay, “Waxa aan maanta aragno ma aha oo kaliya dhaqdhaqaaq khibrad leh oo nidaamsan, balse waa mid sidoo kale adeegsanaya tignoolajiyad casri ah oo ku shaqeysa sirdoonka macmalka ah, si ay farriimo u gudbiyaan iyo si ay u aqoonsadaan bartilmaameedyada.” Sucuudiga iyo Mareykanka ayaa Iran ku eedeeyay inay Xuutiyiinta siisay hub ay ku jiraan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, gantaallada Cruise-ka iyo kuwa ridada dheer, taas oo ah jebinta cunaqabateynta hubka ee ay Qaramada Midoobay saartay. Iran dhinaceeda waxay beenisay inay hub siiso Xuutiyiinta, waxayna sheegtay in taageerada ay siiso ay tahay mid siyaasadeed oo kaliya. Si kastaba, sida uu sheegay Machadka Talyaaniga ee Daraasaadka Siyaasadda Caalamiga ah, Iran waxay ka caawisay fallaagada Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen inay dhistaan warshado u suurtagelinaya inay iyagu soo saaraan diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Xarunta Mareykanka ee La-dagaallanka Argagixisada ee ku taal Akadeemiyadda Milatariga ee West Point ayaa sheegtay in Xuutiyiintu ay taageero iyo talooyin ciidan ka heleen Xisbullah ee Lubnaan. Xuutiyiintu laftigoodu waxay diidaan in loo arko inay fulinayaan ajandaha Iran. Faria Al-Muslimi oo ka tirsan Machadka Chatham House ee Arrimaha Caalamiga ayaa sheegay in markii ay Xuutiyiintu gaareen marin-biyoodka Baab Al-Mandab, ay taasi xoojisay mowqifka ay Tehran ku leedahay gobolka. “Waxay Iran hadda ka haysataa awood ka badan sidii hore wadahadalladii ay Mareykanka la lahayd,” ayay tiri. Hase yeeshee Kendall ayaa BBC News u sheegtay, “Xitaa haddii aysan jirin taageerada Iran, waxaan filayaa in Xuutiyiintu ay sii wadi doonaan waxa ay hadda sameynayaan. Waxay leeyihiin dhiirigelin iyo ujeeddooyin u gaar ah. Xilligan, dhiirigelintoodu waxay u muuqataa inay ku saabsan tahay lacag, awood, saameyn iyo ugu dambeyn aqoonsi siyaasadeed.” “Xuutiyiintu ma gaari karaan heerkan ay hadda joogaan haddii aysan jirin hubka, tababarka iyo xogta ay ka helaan Iran, hase yeeshee ma cadda in Iran ay si toos ah u amarto oo u maamusho Xuutiyiinta.” Hase yeeshee Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Mareykanka J.D. Vance ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Washington ay si toos ah ula hadashay Xuutiyiinta wixii ku saabsan dhacdooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ee ka dhacay Yemen. Mareykanka ayaa sheegay inuu ka walaacsan yahay kooxdaas oo la wareegtay jasiiradda Perim, isla markaana uu si dhow ula socdo arrintaas. Faallada uu Vance bixiyay ayaa timid kadib markii Trump uu sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay sheegeen inaysan dooneyn in Washington ay farageliso arrimaha Yemen, isla markaana aysan dooneyn wax iska-hor-imaad militari ah oo lala galo Mareykanka. Toddobaad ka hor, Taliyaha Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka Adam Brad Cooper ayaa u safray Sucuudi Carabiya, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay Amiir Maxamed Bin Salmaan. CNN oo soo xiganaysa ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegtay in Salmaan uu laba jeer la hadlay Trump oo uu ka codsaday inay u oggolaadaan weerar militari oo ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta, balse codsigiisa lama aqbalin. Alghashian wuxuu BBC News u sheegay, “Tani waa arrin qalbi-jab ku ah Sucuudiga oo xiriir amni oo wanaagsan la leh Mareykanka,” wuxuuna intaa ku daray, “Sucuudigu waxay garawsanayaan inaysan ku tiirsanaan karin Mareykanka oo keliya.” Riyadh waxay si adag u sheegaysaa inay xaq u leedahay inay ilaaliso madax-bannaanideeda, muwaadiniinteeda iyo danaha Sucuudiga. Waxay sidoo kale sheegaysaa in Xuutiyiintu ay Sucuudi Carabiya ku eedeeyeen inay fulisay duqeymo badan oo cirka ah oo lagu qaaday bartilmaameedyo badan oo ku yaalla Yemen maalmihii la soo dhaafay. Afhayeenka Xuutiyiinta Maxamed Cabdulsalaam ayaa sheegay in ololahoodii ugu dambeeyay uusan halis gelinayn maraakiibta caalamiga ah. Wuxuu sheegay in isla marka Sucuudigu qaado xayiraadda uu saaray Yemen iyo weerarka uu ku hayo dalku uu joojiyo, ololuhu isla markiiba istaagi doono. “Dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta caalamiga ah iyo ganacsiga ka socda Badda Cas iyo Baab Al-Mandab waa mid sii socda, iyadoo amnigiisa iyo nidaamkiisaba la ilaalinayo,” ayuu hadalkiisa ku sii daray. Kendall waxay BBC-da u sheegtay, “Xuutiyiintu aad bay uga taxadaraan fariimaha ay dirayaan, sababtoo ah ma doonayaan inay ku casuumaan ol’ole militari oo caalami ah oo si wadajir ah loo soo abaabulay. Waqtigan xaadirka ah, waxay ololahooda intooda badan ku wajahan yihiin Sucuudi Carabiya.” Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil intii uu socday dagaalkii ay la galeen Tehran, Sucuudi Carabiya waxay ahayd bartilmaameedka gantaallada Iran iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Xitaa kadib heshiiskii xabbad-joojinta, mas’uuliyiinta Sucuudiga ayaa sheegay in weerarradu ay sii socdeen oo ay ka imaanayeen maleeshiyaad taageersan Iran oo ka howlgala dhulka Ciraaq iyo Xuutiyiinta. items.fullContent: Horraantii bishii September, ololihii militari iyo dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed iyo kuwa dhaqaale ee Sucuudigu tobannaanka sano soo waday ayaa si lama filaan ah u fashilmay. Weerar kedis ah oo ay Xuutiyiintu soo qaadeen ayaa ku qasbay maleeshiyaadkii daacadda u ahaa dowladda rasmiga ah ee Yemen inay ka cararaan goobihii ay gacanta ku hayeen. Kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee loo yaqaanno Ansaar Allah ayaa qabsatay xeebta galbeed ee Yemen ee Badda Cas ku taal, waxayna hadda u sii siqayaan dhanka marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ee Baab Al-Mandab, kaasoo ah laf-dhabarta dhoofinta shidaalka Sucuudiga. Bishii February ee sannadkii hore, markii Mareykanku weeraray Iran oo Tehran ay xirtay marin-biyoodka Hormuz, Sucuudigu wuxuu beddel ahaan u isticmaalayay marin-biyoodka Baab Al-Mandab. Xuutiyiintu markii ay Sucuudiga ku tilmaameen “cadawgayaga” ayna xayiraad saareen isku-socodka badda, ciidamadoodu waxay maalmo gudahood ku qabsadeen dhulal cusub. Waxay xoojiyeen duqeymaha ay ku hayaan magaalooyinka Sucuudiga iyo xarumaha tamarta, iyagoo adeegsanaya gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn. Dr. Aziz Alghashian oo ka tirsan Golaha Caalamiga ah ee Khaliijka ayaa tilmaamay in xaaladdan ay ka dhigan tahay in riyadii laga cabsanayay ay run noqotay. “Xudunta dhaqaalaha Sucuudiga, oo ah waddada dhoofinta shidaalka, ayaa si xun loo hakiyay,” ayuu BBC-da u sheegay. Wuxuuna intaa ku daray, “Waxaa adag in laga fikiro xaalad ka sii xun tan.” Ka dib markii la xiray marin-biyoodka Hormuz, Sucuudigu wuxuu ku tiirsanaa dhuumaha shidaalka ee Bari-Galbeed si uu shidaalkiisa uga dhoofiyo dekedda Yanbu ee Badda Cas. Xogta Ururka wadamada shidaalka dhoofiya ee OPEC waxay sheegaysaa in ku dhawaad 80% shidaalka ceeriin ee Sucuudiga loo iib geeyo suuqyada Aasiya. Tani waxay Baab Al-Mandab ka dhigaysaa marin aad muhiim u ah. Hase yeeshee labadii toddobaad ee la soo dhaafay Xuutiyiintu waxay la wareegeen magaalooyinka Mocha iyo Dhubab oo u dhow marin-biyoodka; waxayna gacanta ku dhigeen jasiiradda Perim oo ah qeyb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah marin-biyoodka. Xuutiyiinta oo xaruntoodu tahay Sanca ayaa gacanta ku haya inta badan waqooyiga Yemen oo uu ku jiro xuduudda Sucuudiga. Sannadkii 2015-kii dowladda Sucuudi Carabiya waxay bilowday isbahaysi caalami ah si loo soo celiyo dowladdii caalamku aqoonsanaa ee Yemen. Isbahaysigan uu Sucuudigu hoggaaminayay ayaa qaaday kumanaan duqeyn cirka ah oo ay ku dhinteen kumanaan qof, sida ay sheegtay Qaramada Midoobay. Arrintaasi waxay keentay in isbahaysiga si weyn loo dhaleeceeyo. Sanadkii 2021-kii, Madaxweynihii Mareykanka Joe Biden wuxuu joojiyay taageeradii uu Mareykanku siin jiray dagaalka Yemen, taageeradaas oo ay ku jirtay iibinta hubka. Dagaalku wuxuu galaaftay nolosha in ka badan 150,000 oo qof, wuxuuna dhaliyay musiibo bani’aadamnimo oo sababtay in 4.8 milyan oo qof ay guryahooda ka barakacaan, halka in ka badan kala bar shacabka oo dhan oo ah 19.5 milyan oo qof ay u baahan yihiin gargaar noocyo kala duwan leh. items.title: Mareykanka oo xayiraad fiiso saaray Cabdifataax al-Burhan
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa wali fiisaha gelitaanka dalkaasi siin hoggaamiyaha ciidamada Sudan, Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, iyadoo maalmo yar ay ka harsan yihiin khudbad la qorsheeyay inuu ka jeediyo shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee magaalada New York. Arrintan ayaa lagu sheegay warqad uu safiirka Sudan ee Qaramada Midoobay, Al-Harith Idriss Al-Harith, u diray Xoghayaha Guud ee QM Antonio Guterres, isagoo ka codsaday hay’adda caalamiga ah inay si degdeg ah arrinta u farageliso. Ilo diblomaasiyadeed oo Sudanese ah iyo falanqeeye reer galbeed ah oo xog-ogaal u ah wada-hadallada labada dhinac ayaa sheegay in bixinta fiisaha lala xiriiriyay in al-Burhan uu oggolaado qorshe xabbad-joojin ah oo soconaya 90 maalmood. Qorshahaas waxaa soo jeediyay Massad Boulos, oo ah la-taliyaha sare ee Mareykanka ee arrimaha Carabta iyo Afrika. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka iyo mas’uuliyiinta Sudan ayaan markiiba jawaab ka bixin codsiyo loo diray oo ku saabsanaa arrintan. Al-Burhan ayaa lagu wadaa inuu Khamiista khudbad ka jeediyo Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Warqadda Sudan, oo ku taariikhaysan 21-ka Sebtembar, ayaa QM ka dalbatay “faragelin degdeg ah” oo ay la sameyso dowladda Mareykanka si loo xaqiijiyo in fiisaha loo soo saaro al-Burhan. “Haddii xaaladdan ay sii socoto, waxay dhab ahaan ka hor istaagi doontaa madaxa dowlad xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay inuu si shaqsi ah uga qeyb galo howlaha Golaha Guud,” ayaa lagu yiri warqadda. Afhayeenka Qaramada Midoobay Stéphane Dujarric ayaa sheegay in Guterres uu si weyn uga walaacsan yahay wararka sheegaya in wali aan fiisaha loo soo saarin madaxa Golaha Sare ee Ku-meelgaarka ah ee Sudan. Dujarric ayaa sheegay in xoghaynta Qaramada Midoobay ay arrinta si toos ah ula xiriirtay mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka, ayna sii waddo wada-hadallada. Khilaaf la xiriira xabbad-joojinta Xiisadda cusub ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli xiriirka Mareykanka iyo hoggaanka ciidamada Sudan uu sii xumaanayay. Ciidamada Sudan ayaa xagaagan muujiyay diidmo iyo shuruudo ku saabsan qorshaha xabbad-joojinta ee uu soo jeediyay Boulos, iyagoo dalbanayay in heshiis kasta uu ku jiro in ciidamada Rapid Support Forces (RSF) ay ka baxaan magaalooyinka ay gacanta ku hayaan. Al-Burhan ayaa maqaal Isniintii lagu daabacay wargeyska Mareykanka ee Foreign Policy ku sheegay inuusan aqbali doonin amarro dibadda looga yeeriyo oo ku saabsan sida loo wajahayo dagaalka Sudan. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku dooday in xabbad-joojinnadii hore ay RSF iyo taageerayaasheeda siisay fursad ay dib isugu abaabulaan. “Xabbad-joojinnadu way burbureen intii uu dagaalkani socday, sababtoo ah waxaa laga qoray Sudan iyadoo aan Sudan qeyb ka ahayn,” ayuu yiri al-Burhan. Mareykanka ayaa isku dayaya inuu dhex-dhexaadiyo dhinacyada ku dagaallamaya Sudan, isagoo adeegsanaya qaab loo yaqaan “Quad”, oo ay sidoo kale ku jiraan Imaaraadka Carabta, Masar iyo Sacuudi Carabiya. Dalalkaas ayaa loo arkaa kuwa saameynta ugu weyn ku leh dhinacyada iyo xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Sudan. Dagaal galay sanadkii afraad Dagaalka Sudan ayaa billowday bishii Abriil 2023, markii uu dagaal toos ah dhex maray ciidamada dowladda ee uu hoggaamiyo al-Burhan iyo RSF oo uu hoggaamiyo Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, oo loo yaqaan Hemedti. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa dagaalka Sudan ku tilmaantay mid sababay dhibaatada bani’aadannimo ee ugu weyn dunida. Hemedti ayaa dhankiisa sameystay maamul la tartamaya dowladda ay taageeraan ciidamada Sudan, inkastoo maamulkaasi uusan weli helin aqoonsi caalami ah oo ballaaran. Al-Burhan ayaa ahaa hoggaamiyaha dhabta ah ee Sudan tan iyo 2019-kii, waxaana isaga iyo Hemedti ay 2021-kii afgambi ku rideen dowladdii rayidka ahayd, taasoo keentay in Midowga Afrika iyo quwadaha reer galbeedka ay ka noqdaan aqoonsigii nidaamka cusub. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, al-Burhan ayaa sanadihii ka dambeeyay afgambiga Sudan ku matalay kulammada Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Khilaafka fiisaha ayaa sidoo kale keenaya su’aalo ku saabsan waajibaadka Mareykanka ee ah dalka martigeliya xarunta Qaramada Midoobay. Heshiiska martigelinta QM ayaa guud ahaan dhigaya in Mareykanku fududeeyo gelitaanka wakiillada dowladaha xubnaha ka ah ee u socda howlaha Qaramada Midoobay. Xiriirka Washington iyo hoggaanka ciidamada Sudan ayaa toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay horey ugu jiray xaalad kacsan, gaar ahaan kadib markii Mareykanku soo jeediyay in cunaqabateynta hubka ee hadda saaran gobolka Darfur lagu ballaariyo Sudan oo dhan. Taageerayaasha al-Burhan ayaa ku doodaya in tallaabadaasi ay si weyn u saameyn doonto ciidamada dowladda marka loo eego RSF. Ra’iisul wasaarihii rayidka ahaa ee Sudan ka hor afgambigii 2021, Abdalla Hamdok, ayaa isna toddobaadkan ku sugan New York, isagoo halkaasi kula sugan xubno ka tirsan isbahaysigiisa ka soo horjeeda dagaalka. Afhayeenka Qaramada Midoobay Stéphane Dujarric ayaa sheegay in Guterres uu si weyn uga walaacsan yahay wararka sheegaya in wali aan fiisaha loo soo saarin madaxa Golaha Sare ee Ku-meelgaarka ah ee Sudan. Dujarric ayaa sheegay in xoghaynta Qaramada Midoobay ay arrinta si toos ah ula xiriirtay mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka, ayna sii waddo wada-hadallada. Khilaaf la xiriira xabbad-joojinta Xiisadda cusub ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli xiriirka Mareykanka iyo hoggaanka ciidamada Sudan uu sii xumaanayay. Ciidamada Sudan ayaa xagaagan muujiyay diidmo iyo shuruudo ku saabsan qorshaha xabbad-joojinta ee uu soo jeediyay Boulos, iyagoo dalbanayay in heshiis kasta uu ku jiro in ciidamada Rapid Support Forces (RSF) ay ka baxaan magaalooyinka ay gacanta ku hayaan. Al-Burhan ayaa maqaal Isniintii lagu daabacay wargeyska Mareykanka ee Foreign Policy ku sheegay inuusan aqbali doonin amarro dibadda looga yeeriyo oo ku saabsan sida loo wajahayo dagaalka Sudan. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku dooday in xabbad-joojinnadii hore ay RSF iyo taageerayaasheeda siisay fursad ay dib isugu abaabulaan. “Xabbad-joojinnadu way burbureen intii uu dagaalkani socday, sababtoo ah waxaa laga qoray Sudan iyadoo aan Sudan qeyb ka ahayn,” ayuu yiri al-Burhan. Mareykanka ayaa isku dayaya inuu dhex-dhexaadiyo dhinacyada ku dagaallamaya Sudan, isagoo adeegsanaya qaab loo yaqaan “Quad”, oo ay sidoo kale ku jiraan Imaaraadka Carabta, Masar iyo Sacuudi Carabiya. Dalalkaas ayaa loo arkaa kuwa saameynta ugu weyn ku leh dhinacyada iyo xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Sudan. Dagaal galay sanadkii afraad Dagaalka Sudan ayaa billowday bishii Abriil 2023, markii uu dagaal toos ah dhex maray ciidamada dowladda ee uu hoggaamiyo al-Burhan iyo RSF oo uu hoggaamiyo Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, oo loo yaqaan Hemedti. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa dagaalka Sudan ku tilmaantay mid sababay dhibaatada bani’aadannimo ee ugu weyn dunida. Hemedti ayaa dhankiisa sameystay maamul la tartamaya dowladda ay taageeraan ciidamada Sudan, inkastoo maamulkaasi uusan weli helin aqoonsi caalami ah oo ballaaran. Al-Burhan ayaa ahaa hoggaamiyaha dhabta ah ee Sudan tan iyo 2019-kii, waxaana isaga iyo Hemedti ay 2021-kii afgambi ku rideen dowladdii rayidka ahayd, taasoo keentay in Midowga Afrika iyo quwadaha reer galbeedka ay ka noqdaan aqoonsigii nidaamka cusub. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, al-Burhan ayaa sanadihii ka dambeeyay afgambiga Sudan ku matalay kulammada Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Khilaafka fiisaha ayaa sidoo kale keenaya su’aalo ku saabsan waajibaadka Mareykanka ee ah dalka martigeliya xarunta Qaramada Midoobay. Heshiiska martigelinta QM ayaa guud ahaan dhigaya in Mareykanku fududeeyo gelitaanka wakiillada dowladaha xubnaha ka ah ee u socda howlaha Qaramada Midoobay. Xiriirka Washington iyo hoggaanka ciidamada Sudan ayaa toddobaadyadii la soo dhaafay horey ugu jiray xaalad kacsan, gaar ahaan kadib markii Mareykanku soo jeediyay in cunaqabateynta hubka ee hadda saaran gobolka Darfur lagu ballaariyo Sudan oo dhan. Taageerayaasha al-Burhan ayaa ku doodaya in tallaabadaasi ay si weyn u saameyn doonto ciidamada dowladda marka loo eego RSF. Ra’iisul wasaarihii rayidka ahaa ee Sudan ka hor afgambigii 2021, Abdalla Hamdok, ayaa isna toddobaadkan ku sugan New York, isagoo halkaasi kula sugan xubno ka tirsan isbahaysigiisa ka soo horjeeda dagaalka. The post Mareykanka oo xayiraad fiiso saaray Cabdifataax al-Burhan appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland president hopes for security cooperation with Israel by end of year
items.description: Somaliland president hopes for security cooperation with Israel by end of year Andrew Bernard Posted 8 hrs ago at 5: 31 PM Stories appearing in our World pages originate from aggregated news feeds obtained from various subscription news Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi expects security cooperation with Israel to begin by the end of the year after the Jewish recognized the breakaway republic in December. Speaking to reporters at the conclusion of a two-week visit to Washington last week, Abdullahi left open the possibility of an Israeli military presence in the country that most of the world, including the United States, still recognizes as part of Somalia. “My priority is water,” Abdullahi said. Israel “gave training for 50 Somaliland water engineers, and they will start some water projects, including desalination of Berbera seawater.” “Hopefully, before the end of the year, they will start to cooperate in the security sector,” he told reporters, including JNS. Berbera is the main port of Somaliland, which declared independence from Somalia in 1991. Abdullahi and Somaliland’s supporters in the United States are pressing for a greater degree of normalization for the country, which has no official diplomatic relations with the United States and is currently recognized only by Israel. Those measures include access to the SWIFT banking system, separating the State Department’s travel advisory for Somaliland from that of Somalia and greater military cooperation. That potential military cooperation may now have greater importance for the United States given Somaliland’s proximity to Yemen and the Bab al-Mandeb Strait, which is under threat from the Iran-backed Houthi terrorist group. “We gave an offer to the United States for partnership in security, whether it’s counterterrorism, maritime security, protection of ships in the area,” Abdullahi told reporters. “Officials from the administration, the Department of War, confirmed that they wish for the relationship to grow.” (U.S. President Donald Trump refers to the Pentagon as the War Department.) During his time in Washington, Abdullahi also met with representatives of the Jewish community, including the American Jewish Committee, and said that he hopes that those talks might lead to greater economic development for the country of six million people, which if it gained independence would be one of the poorest in the world. “We’re discussing with these Jewish organizations that we now have full cooperation with Israel, and hopefully they will encourage Jewish or Israeli investment in Somaliland,” he said. He described some of the economic challenges the country faces, including its reliance on shipping traffic to generate tax revenue, which has plummeted amid the conflict between the United States and Iran. “Because of the war, the number of containers coming to Berbera became maybe 48% less,” he said. “We don’t know if that continues how long we can manage.” “Hopefully, this will be a temporary issue. The war will be over. The problem will be solved,” Abdullahi said. “We pray for that.”

items.title: Hantidhowrka Guud oo Guddiga Shaqaalaha U Digay
items.description: DHOWRIDDA MADAXBANNAANIDA HAY’ADDA HANTIDHOWRKA GUUD Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee JFS waa hay’ad dastuuri ah 00 madax-bannaan, lehna madax-bannaani maamul iyo mid maaliyadeed, laguna dhisay Qodobka 177aad ee Dastuurka JFS. Awoodaha, waajibaadka iyo shaqooyinkiisa waxaa lagu faahfaahiyey Sharciga Maareynta Maaliyadda Guud, Sharci Lr. 17 ee 2019, iyo Sharciga Hantidhowrka Guud, Sharci Lr. 14 ee 2023. Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud waa hay’adda ugu sarreysa ee u xilsaaran hantidhowrista, diiwaangelinta iyo ilaalinta hantida danta guud iyo macaamillada maaliyadeed ee dowladda, isla markaana fulisa kormeer iyo daba-gal ku saabsan maareynta kheyraadka guud. Sidoo kale, waxa uu hubiyaa dhowrista iyo ku dhaqanka shuruucda maamulka maaliyadda iyo miisaaniyadda Dowladda.Sidaas awgeed, si waafaqsan Qodobka 63aad (2) ee Xeer-nidaamiyaha Sharciga Nidaamka Xukuumadda, Xeer Lr. 174 ee 15/02/2025: “Guddiyada iyo Xafiisyada madax-bannaan ee dastuuriga ah, waxaa lagu nidaaminayaa mabaadi’da dastuuriga ah iyo qodobbada ku qeexan xeerarkooda gaarka ah.” Marka la eego qodobbada kor ku xusan, waxaa waajib sharci ku ah Guddiga Qaranka ee Shaqaalaha Rayidka Dowladda in uu si buuxda u dhowro madax-bannaanida dastuuriga ah ee Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee JFS, isla markaana tallaabo kasta, go’aan kasta ama habraac kasta oo khuseeya Xafiiska lagu saleeyo Dastuurka JFS iyo shuruucda kale ee lagu dhisay laguna nidaamiyo Xafiiska. Sidaas darteed, Guddiga Qaranka ee Shaqaalaha Rayidka Dowladda waa in uusan qaadin ama dhaqan-gelin tallaabo wax u dhimaysa, xaddidaysa ama ka hor imaanaysa madax-bannaanida, awoodaha iyo nidaamka sharciyeed ee Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee JFS. The post Hantidhowrka Guud oo Guddiga Shaqaalaha U Digay first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Qasaare ka dhashay roob dabeyl watay oo saamayn ku yeeshay danyar oo ku nool Bari
items.description: (ERGO) – Cunto yari, hoy xumo iyo dhaqaale darro saameysay ayay wajahayaan boqollaal qoys oo toddobadii bishan dhibane u noqday roob dabeylo watay oo ku dhuftay deegaanka Ceel-gaal oo hoos taga degmada Qandala ee gobolka Bari. Qoysaskan ayaa ah kuwo ay ku adag tahay in maalinkii ay helaan hal waqti oo cunto ah. Waa musiibo aan laga sii baaraan dagin oo ay ku naf waayeen dad iyo duunyo, isla markaana dumisay bollaal guri. Waxaa lagu waayay ilihii dhaqaale oo ay ku tiirsanaayeen qoysas danyar ah oo ay ku adag tahay inay ka soo kabtaan saameynta taban ee ay ku reebtay. Cabdimudalib Axmed Maxamed, waa 18 jir ay mustaqbal ka sugayaan siddeed walaalo ah oo ka yar. Qoyska waxaa u shaqeyn jiray isaga iyo hooyadiis oo geeriyootay, markii uu ku dumay gurigii ay degganaayeen. Wuxuu tilmaamay in hadda aysan laheyn ildhaqaale, ayna ku tiirsan yihiin kaalmo yar oo baahidooda aan dabuuli karin oo uga timaada dadka dariskooda ah. “Garab la’aan ayaa nagu dhacday. Waxaan hadda isku maareynaa waxay noo keenaan dadka na dhaama ee nagu hareereysan, iyaguna wax badan oo la sheego nooma ay keenin.” Cabdimudalib ayaa sheegay inay ku nool yihiin aqal cooshad ah oo dantu bidday, markii uu ka dumay hoygoodii oo ka koobnaa labo qol. Wuxuu xusay inaysan hadda heli karin dhaqaale dib loogu dhiso. Qoyska ayaa ku tiirsanaa goob ganacsi oo lagu gado dhuxusha iyo hilibka cayriin, isaga iyo hooyadiis ayaana wadajir uga shaqeyn jiray. Dhaqaalaha maalinkii ka soo gali jiray oo uu sheegay inuu ahaa $7 illaa $10 ayay ku tiirsaneyd noloshoodu. Waa da’yar la’ meel uu wax ka billaabo, ayna garabkiisa ka baxday hooyadiis, aabbahiina yahay 85 jir aan shaqeyn karin. “Awood iyo itaal lama hayo wax Ilaahay keeni doono maahee, waxaa carruurta haya caluul xanuun, waana wax u badan carruurta iyo waayeelka oo magaalada ka jira. Meeshu caafimaad malahan, mana la awoodo in meel kale aan u tagno.” Cabdimudalib ayaa tilmaamay in dhaqaale la’aan uu uga haray waxbarashada dugsiga dhexe, sanadkii 2023, haddana ay xaaladaas oo kale wajahayaan walaalihiis oo dhigan jiray iskuulka hoose iyo dhexe ee Cumar binu-cabdi casiis ee deegaanka Ceel-gaal, kaas oo ku dumay dabeylaha roobka. Waa iskuulka kaliya ee deegaanku lahaa, waxaana dhiganayay 300 oo arday. Ma jirto cid ku howlan dhisamahiisa, sida uu sheegay maamulka deegaanka. Cabdimudalib ayaa sheegay in haddii dib loo dhiso ay wali hor taallo caqabad dhanka dhaqaalaha ah, maadaama aysan awoodin bixinta boqol Doollar oo bishii ay wax ku baran jireen afar walaalihiis ah oo iskuulka dhigan jiray. Saameynta ka dhalatay roobka dabeylaha watay ma ah mid ku kooban magaalada ee waxay taabatay xoolo dhaqatada iyo dadka ku tiirsanaa xabagta geedka xijigga. Maxamuud Maxamed Cabdikariim oo ka mid ah dadka ay saameeysay ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in dabeyshu wax yeeleysay ilihii dhaqaale ee qoyskiisu ku tiirsanaa oo ahaa xoolo iyo xabagta xijigga. Qoyskiisa oo ku nool miyiga ku dhow deegaanka Ceelgaal ayuu xusay in sidoo kale ay dabeyshu ka dumisay hoygii ay ku noolaayeen. “Tuuladan wax walba waa qaali oo labolaab ah ayay ka sareeyaan qiimaha ay ka joogaan Boosaaso. Waa tuulo ku taal meel fog oo gaariga ka soo baxa Boosaaso wuxuu jidka ku jiraa labo habeen. Galab hadduu ka soo baxo, habeenka dambe ayuu tagaa.” Maxamuud ayaa tilmaamay in musiibadan ay uga dhinteen 20 ari ah, sidoo kalana ay dabeyshu ka goysay geedaha xijigga oo xabagtooda uu sheegay inuu ka heli jiray sanadkii ku dhowaad kun Doollar. Ninkan oo ah aabbaha toddobo carruur ah ayaa intaas ku daray in dabeyshu ka dumisay guri deegaanka uu ku lahaa oo bishii uu ka qaadan jiray kiro $25 ah. Maareynta nolosha reerka oo uusan ka warwari jirin ayuu sheegay in hadda ay tahay caqabad uu xalkeedu ku adag yahay. Xaaladan ayuu xusay in qoyskiisa ay dhaxal siisay cunno yari. “Xoolaha iyo maydiga ayaan ku tiirsaneyn, xoolihiina dee dabeyl iyo abaartaas ayaa ku dhacday. Haddii wax naloo heli karo, miyi iyo magaalada nalooga soo gurman karo waan u baahanahay.” Maxamuud ayaa tilmaamay in roobka dabeylaha watay da’ayay lix saacadood uu ahaa mid aysan fileyn, xilliga oo jiilaal ah awgeed. Wuxuu intaas ku daray inaysan soo gaarin digniinaha la xiriira El Nino oo ah roobab dabeyl wata oo saadaashu sheegeyso inay Soomaaliya ka da’ayaan bisha tobnaad ee October illaa dhammaadka sanadkan. Dhanka kale maamulka deegaanka Ceelgaal ee gobolka Bari ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in qoysaska dhibaatadu gaartay ay wajahayaan xaalad hubanti la’aan ah oo ay adag tahay inay ka soo kabtaan. Shire Cabdullaahi Siciid oo ah guddoomiye ku xigeen ayaa xusay in maamul ahaan aysan hayn waxay ku taageeraan qoysaska dhibban. Shire ayaa tilmaamay in roobka dabeylaha wata ay ku dhinteen saddex qof,  xoolo gaaraya  saddex boqol, ayna ku ku dumeen 150 guri. Qiimeyn ay sameeyeen ayuu xusay inay ku ogaadeen in saameyntu ay gaartay saddex boqol iyo konton qoys oo iskugu jira dadka ku nool deegaanka Ceelgaal iyo miyiga ku xeeran, kuwaas oo lumiyay ilihii dhaqaale ee ay ku tiirsanaayeen oo ahaa xoolo, beero  iyo mehrado ganacsi. “Dadkii hadda waxay noqdeen isku duruuf oo wax badan isma dhaamaan. Dhulka qaar xataa hadda biyo ayaa laga dhaamiyaa oo ma gaarin roobka noo da’ay. Dhibaatooyinka noocaas ah oo awood aan loo hayn ayaa jira.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in musiibadan ay ku soo beegantay xilli adag oo aysan xoolo dhaqatadu ka soo kaban abaaro iyo jiilaal nacfi tiray xoolaha. The post Qasaare ka dhashay roob dabeyl watay oo saamayn ku yeeshay danyar oo ku nool Bari appeared first on Radio Ergo - Somali Humanitarian News and Information .

Maxamuud Maxamed Cabdikariim oo ka mid ah dadka ay saameeysay ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in dabeyshu wax yeeleysay ilihii dhaqaale ee qoyskiisu ku tiirsanaa oo ahaa xoolo iyo xabagta xijigga. Qoyskiisa oo ku nool miyiga ku dhow deegaanka Ceelgaal ayuu xusay in sidoo kale ay dabeyshu ka dumisay hoygii ay ku noolaayeen. “Tuuladan wax walba waa qaali oo labolaab ah ayay ka sareeyaan qiimaha ay ka joogaan Boosaaso. Waa tuulo ku taal meel fog oo gaariga ka soo baxa Boosaaso wuxuu jidka ku jiraa labo habeen. Galab hadduu ka soo baxo, habeenka dambe ayuu tagaa.” Maxamuud ayaa tilmaamay in musiibadan ay uga dhinteen 20 ari ah, sidoo kalana ay dabeyshu ka goysay geedaha xijigga oo xabagtooda uu sheegay inuu ka heli jiray sanadkii ku dhowaad kun Doollar. Ninkan oo ah aabbaha toddobo carruur ah ayaa intaas ku daray in dabeyshu ka dumisay guri deegaanka uu ku lahaa oo bishii uu ka qaadan jiray kiro $25 ah. Maareynta nolosha reerka oo uusan ka warwari jirin ayuu sheegay in hadda ay tahay caqabad uu xalkeedu ku adag yahay. Xaaladan ayuu xusay in qoyskiisa ay dhaxal siisay cunno yari. “Xoolaha iyo maydiga ayaan ku tiirsaneyn, xoolihiina dee dabeyl iyo abaartaas ayaa ku dhacday. Haddii wax naloo heli karo, miyi iyo magaalada nalooga soo gurman karo waan u baahanahay.” Maxamuud ayaa tilmaamay in roobka dabeylaha watay da’ayay lix saacadood uu ahaa mid aysan fileyn, xilliga oo jiilaal ah awgeed. Wuxuu intaas ku daray inaysan soo gaarin digniinaha la xiriira El Nino oo ah roobab dabeyl wata oo saadaashu sheegeyso inay Soomaaliya ka da’ayaan bisha tobnaad ee October illaa dhammaadka sanadkan. Dhanka kale maamulka deegaanka Ceelgaal ee gobolka Bari ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in qoysaska dhibaatadu gaartay ay wajahayaan xaalad hubanti la’aan ah oo ay adag tahay inay ka soo kabtaan. Shire Cabdullaahi Siciid oo ah guddoomiye ku xigeen ayaa xusay in maamul ahaan aysan hayn waxay ku taageeraan qoysaska dhibban. Shire ayaa tilmaamay in roobka dabeylaha wata ay ku dhinteen saddex qof,  xoolo gaaraya  saddex boqol, ayna ku ku dumeen 150 guri. Qiimeyn ay sameeyeen ayuu xusay inay ku ogaadeen in saameyntu ay gaartay saddex boqol iyo konton qoys oo iskugu jira dadka ku nool deegaanka Ceelgaal iyo miyiga ku xeeran, kuwaas oo lumiyay ilihii dhaqaale ee ay ku tiirsanaayeen oo ahaa xoolo, beero  iyo mehrado ganacsi. “Dadkii hadda waxay noqdeen isku duruuf oo wax badan isma dhaamaan. Dhulka qaar xataa hadda biyo ayaa laga dhaamiyaa oo ma gaarin roobka noo da’ay. Dhibaatooyinka noocaas ah oo awood aan loo hayn ayaa jira.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in musiibadan ay ku soo beegantay xilli adag oo aysan xoolo dhaqatadu ka soo kaban abaaro iyo jiilaal nacfi tiray xoolaha. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Costa Rica oo horumarinaya xariirkooda dublumaasiyadeed
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Costa Rica ayaa magaalada New York ku yeeshay kulan heer wasiir ah, kaas oo looga hadlay xoojinta xiriirka laba geesoodka ah iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada horumarinta. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cali , ayaa kulan la yeeshay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Cibaadada ee Costa Rica, Manuel Tovar Rivera , iyadoo kulanku ka dhacay magaalada New York, xilli uu socdo Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNGA81) . Labada wasiir ayaa ka wada hadlay sidii loo xoojin lahaa xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Costa Rica , iyo fursadaha lagu horumarin karo iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada horumarinta. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu muujiyay danaha ay labada dal ka wadaagaan iskaashiga horumarineed, iyadoo la doonayo in la sii ballaariyo xiriirka iyo wada-shaqeynta Soomaaliya iyo Costa Rica. Kulankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya ay ku ballaarinayso xiriirkeeda caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan Latin America , iyadoo dowladda Soomaaliya ay raadineyso iskaashi iyo xiriirro cusub oo ay la yeelato dalalka ku yaalla gobolkaas. Kulamada Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya uu la yeelanayo dhiggiisa dalalka kala duwan ayaa ka dhacaya iyadoo ay socdaan shirarka iyo kulamada heerka sare ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay , kuwaas oo fursad u siinaya Soomaaliya inay xoojiso xiriirkeeda laba geesoodka ah iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Morooko oo ka wada hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Morocco ayaa magaalada New York ku yeeshay kulan heer wasiir ah, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo horumarinta iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaam Cali, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda, Iskaashiga Afrika iyo Qurbajoogta Morocco, Nasser Bourita, iyadoo kulanku ka dhacay inta lagu guda jiray Kalfadhiga 81-aad ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay. Labada wasiir ayaa kulankooda kaga wada hadlay xaaladda xiriirka laba geesoodka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Morocco, iyagoo isla eegay sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga u dhexeeya labada dowladood. Sidoo kale, waxaa kulanka lagu soo qaaday muhiimadda ay leedahay isku-duwidda mowqifyada labada dal ee arrimaha gobolka iyo kuwa dhinacyada badan leh, gaar ahaan goobaha ay Soomaaliya iyo Morocco ku wada leeyihiin dano iyo iskaashi. Kulanka ayaa qeyb ka ah kulamada diblomaasiyadeed ee ay Soomaaliya ka waddo magaalada New York inta uu socdo shirweynaha Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo mas’uuliyiinta dowladda Soomaaliya ay kulamo kala duwan la yeelanayaan dhiggooda caalamka, si loo xoojiyo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya la leedahay dalalka kale. Kulanka Soomaaliya iyo Morocco wuxuu sidoo kale muujinayaa dadaallada labada dowladood ee lagu horumarinayo xiriirkooda, iyadoo la xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta iyo isku-duwidda arrimaha muhiimka u ah labada dal iyo guud ahaan qaaradda Afrika.

Mareykanka iyo Iiraan oo wada-hadallo ku yeeshay New York
items.description: Mareykanka iyo Iiraan ayaa magaalada New York ku yeeshay wada-hadallo diblomaasiyadeed oo loo marayo dhexdhexaadiyayaal, xilli dadaallo lagu doonayo in lagu soo afjaro dagaalka labada dhinac iyo in dib loo furo Marinka Hormuz ay socdaan. Ergeyga gaarka ah ee Mareykanka, Steve Witkoff , ayaa sheegay in dhexdhexaadiyayaashu maalintii oo dhan u kala gooshayeen wafdiyada Mareykanka iyo Iran, iyagoo gudbinayay farriimo iyo soo-jeedimo. Witkoff wuxuu sheegay in wareegga wada-hadallada la soo gabagabeeyay, isla markaana uu rajeynayo in natiijadu noqoto mid wax-ku-ool ah, iyadoo dhexdhexaadiyayaashu ay sii wadi doonaan dadaallada. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa isna sheegay in Witkoff iyo Jared Kushner ay kulan qaatay ku dhowaad saddex saacadood la yeesheen mas’uuliyiin Iiraan ah. Trump wuxuu kulanka ku tilmaamay mid wanaagsan oo wax-ku-ool ah, isagoo sheegay inuu jiro dhaqdhaqaaq ku wajahan heshiis, xilli Aqalka Cad uu markii dambe caddeeyay in Trump uusan kulankaas ka qaybgelin, balse Witkoff iyo Kushner ay matalayeen dhinaca Mareykanka. Dhinaca Iran, warbaahinta dowladda ayaa xaqiijisay in Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iran Abbas Araghchi uu la kulmay Witkoff, taas oo noqonaysa xiriir toos ah oo dhexmaray labada dhinac kaddib toddobaadyo oo aanay jirin kulamo noocaas ah. Sida ay sheegtay warbixinta Caalamiga ah, kulanka waxaa xoogga lagu saaray farriimaha iyo shuruudaha Tehran, gaar ahaan arrinta Marinka Hormuz . Iiraan ayaa ku xirtay dib-u-furista marinka muhiimka ah shuruudo ay ka mid yihiin in Mareykanku qaado xannibaadda dekedaha Iiraan, la sii daayo hantida Iiraan ee la xanibay, isla markaana la joojiyo dagaalka. Sarkaal sare oo Iiraan ah ayaa sidoo kale Reuters u sheegay in Tehran ay dib u furi karto Hormuz muddo toddoba maalmood gudahood ah haddii Mareykanku yareeyo cadaadiska milatari oo uu qaado xannibaadda dekedaha Iiraan. Marinka Hormuz ayaa ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga tamarta adduunka, waxaana xiisadda ka taagan gobolka ay saameyn ku yeelatay dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta iyo suuqyada shidaalka. Dadaallada lagu dejinayo xiisadda kuma koobna Mareykanka iyo Iiraan oo keliya, waxaana Qatar ay sheegtay inay la shaqaynayso Pakistan si loo yareeyo xiisadda Washington iyo Tehran, loo ilaaliyo xorriyadda maraakiibta ee Hormuz, loona abuuro xaalad u saamaxaysa labada dhinac inay wada-hadal sii wadaan. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha iyo Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Qatar, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, ayaa sidoo kale New York kula kulmay Araghchi, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xaaladda gobolka iyo dadaallada lagu dhimayo xiisadda. Warbixinno ay Reuters soo xigatay ayaa intaas ku daraya in Qatar ay soo jeedisay qaab-dhismeed amni oo ay ka qayb qaataan Iiraan iyo dalalka Khaliijka, inkastoo faahfaahinta qorshaha aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin. Wada-hadalladan ayaa yimid saacado kaddib khudbaddii Trump ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, halkaas oo uu sheegay in Washington ay haysato doorasho adag oo u dhexeysa heshiis Iiraan u oggolaanaya inay dib u dhisto dhaqaalihii iyo sii wadista cadaadiska militari. Si kastaba ha ahaatee kulamada New York ayaa dib u soo nooleynaya waddada wada-xaajoodka Mareykanka iyo Iiraan, balse natiijada ugu dambeysa ayaa ku xirnaan doonta sida labada dhinac uga jawaabaan shuruudaha iyo ballanqaadyada miiska saaran.

items.title: Culimada Soomaaliyeed oo cambaareeyay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee Sacuudiga
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa maanta si adag uga hadlay weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, gaar ahaan kuwa lagu waxyeelleynayo amniga magaalada barakeysan ee Makkah iyo hareeraheeda, iyaga oo ku tilmaamay fal xadgudub ku ah xurmada goobaha barakeysan iyo amniga dadka ku nool iyo booqdayaasha. Bayaan ay soo saareen culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa lagu sheegay in ay si adag u cambaareynayaan beegsiga Makkah iyo isku day kasta oo lagu waxyeelleynayo amniga magaaladaasi Culimada ayaa sidoo kale cambaareeyay weerarrada lagu qaadayo gudaha Sacuudi Carabiya, iyaga oo sheegay in falalkaasi ay yihiin kuwo aan la aqbali karin oo waxyeello u geysanaya amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka. “Waxaan si ada u cambaareyneynaa beesiga Makkah iyo hareeraheeda waxyeelleynta amnigeeda iyo cabsi gelinta dadka deggan iyo booqdayaasha. Waa dambi wayn iyo ku xadgudub xormada Alle. Weerarrada Sacuudi Carabiya iyo beegsiga xarumaha muhiimka ah ee dalkaas waa gar-darro iyo fasahaadin,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Dhanka kale, culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa bayaankooda ku soo hadal qaaday xaaladda adag ee dalka Yemen, iyaga oo cambaareeyay beegsiga culimada, dilka dadka rayidka ah, burburinta masaajidda iyo xiritaanka xarumaha dacwada, kuwaas oo ay ku eedeeyeen Xuutiyiinta. “Sidoo kale waxaan cambaareyneynaa beegsiga culimada, daadinta dhiigga dadka aan waxba galabsan, burburinta masaajidda iyo xirtaanka xarumaha dacwadaha Xuutiyiinta ka gaysteen dalka Yemen,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri bayaanka. Ugu dambeyn, culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa sheegay in dowladda Sacuudi ay xaq u leedahay inay difaacdo dalkeeda iyo dadkeeda, waxayna Muslimiinta ugu baaqeen inay ku garab istaagaan iska caabinta gardarrada. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay haatan sii kordhayaan weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee lagu bartilmaameedsanayo Sacuudi Carabiya, kadib markii uu sii xoogeystay dagaalka labada dhinac. Ugu dambeyn, culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa sheegay in dowladda Sacuudi ay xaq u leedahay inay difaacdo dalkeeda iyo dadkeeda, waxayna Muslimiinta ugu baaqeen inay ku garab istaagaan iska caabinta gardarrada. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ay haatan sii kordhayaan weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee lagu bartilmaameedsanayo Sacuudi Carabiya, kadib markii uu sii xoogeystay dagaalka labada dhinac. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo madaxda dhowr dal kula kulmay New York
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Talaadadii Magaalada New York kula kulmay Raysal Wasaaraha Pakistan, Shehbaz Sharif. Kulanka ayaa dhacay, intii lagu guda jiray furitaanka Meertada 81aad ee Golaha Loo Dhanyahay ee Qaramada Midoobey, sida uu Raysal Wasaaraha Pakistan ku sheegay bartiisa xiriirka bulshada. War qoraal ah oo ka soo baxay Villa Somalia ayaa lagu sheegay in Madaxweynuhu uu New York kulamo doceedyo kula yeeshay Madaxweynaha Serbia, Aleksandar Vučić, Madaxweynaha Senegal, Bassirou Diomaye Faye, Madaxweynaha Zimbabwe, Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa iyo Raysal Wasaaraha Pakistan. “Kulamada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Somaliya iyo dalalkaasi iyo arrimo la xiriira nabadda, amniga, horumarka iyo danaha wadajirka ah ee ay wadaagaan dhinacyadaasi.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Madaxweynaha ayaa masuuliyiinta uu la kulmay la wadaagay horumarka iyo guulaha Somaliya ka xaqiijisay nabadda iyo amniga, dowlad-dhiska, dimuqraadiyeynta, dhaqaalaha iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, isagoo sidoo kale ka hadlay fursadaha iskaashi ee Somaliya ay la yeelan karto dalalkaasi.” Bog cusub ayaa u furmay xiriirka iskaashiga Somaliya iyo Pakistan ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, ka dib heshiiskii is afgaradka ahaa ee ay labada dowladood bishii August ku kala saxiixdeen Magaalada Islamabad. Heshiiskan ayaa Somaliya looga taageerayaa dhismaha awoodda ciidanka, amniga badda iyo cirka.

items.title: Madaxweynaha Koonfurta Suudaan oo kala diray xukuumaddii ku-meelgaarka ahayd
items.description: Madaxweynaha Koonfurta Suudaan, Salva Kiir Mayardit, ayaa kala diray xukuumaddii midnimada ku-meelgaarka ahayd, isagoo magacaabay maamul ku-meelgaar ah xilli dalka uu isu diyaarinayo doorashadii ugu horreysay ee qaran. Wareegto uu madaxweynuhu soo saaray ayaa meesha ka saartay madaxweyne-ku-xigeennadii, wasiirradii iyo qaar ka mid ah maamulayaasha deegaanka. Sidoo kale waxaa la kala diray goleyaashii baarlamaanka heer qaran iyo heer dowlad-goboleed, halka hay’adaha garsoorka iyo amniga ay sii shaqaynayaan. Go’aankan ayaa yimid maalin kadib markii baarlamaanka Koonfurta Suudaan uu ansixiyay wax-ka-beddel lagu sameeyay Sharciga Doorashooyinka Qaranka , kaas oo u oggolaanaya Madaxweyne Kiir inuu xilka sii hayo inta lagu jiro xilliga doorashada. Doorashada ayaa loo qorsheeyay 22-ka Diseembar , waxaana wax-ka-beddellada cusub ay meesha ka saarayaan shuruuddii ahayd in doorashada laga hor mariyo dhamaystirka dastuur rasmi ah iyo tirakoobka dadweynaha. Si kastaba, mucaaradka dalka ayaa diiday isbeddelladan, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah falanqeeyayaasha ay walaac ka muujiyeen awoodda ballaaran ee Madaxweynaha ay siinayaan. Michael Wani, oo ah qareen hore uga tirsanaa guddigii diyaarinta dastuurka, ayaa sheegay in haddii isbeddelladan la dhaqan geliyo, Kiir uu noqonayo qofka ugu awoodda badan dalka, maadaama madaxweyne-ku-xigeennada, baarlamaanka iyo hay’adaha kale ee fulinta la kala diray. Doorashada Koonfurta Suudaan ayaa muddo dheer dib u dhacday, waxaana markii hore la qorsheeyay in la qabto 2022 , balse laba jeer ayaa dib loo dhigay. Waxaa weli jira arrimo muhiim ah oo ku xusan heshiiskii nabadda ee 2018 oo aan si buuxda loo dhammaystirin, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin diyaarinta dastuur rasmi ah, diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaasha iyo mideynta ciidamada ay kala taageeraan dhinacyada siyaasadda. Heshiiskaas nabadeed ayaa soo afjaray dagaal sokeeye oo socday muddo shan sano ah, kaas oo sida Qaramada Midoobay sheegtay sababay dhimashada ku dhowaad 400,000 oo qof , halka malaayiin kalena ay barakaceen. Dhanka kale, hoggaamiyaha mucaaradka iyo madaxweyne-ku-xigeenkii hore, Riek Machar , ayaa weli ku jira xabsi guri, isagoo wajahaya dacwado ay ka mid yihiin khiyaano qaran iyo dil, eedeymahaas oo uu isagu beeniyay. Amnesty International ayaa sheegtay in kala dirista xukuumaddu ay noqon karto tallaabo muhiim ah oo loo qaaday doorashada ugu horreysa ee dalka, balse waxay ugu baaqday mas’uuliyiinta inay hubiyaan in shacabka ay helaan jawi ammaan ah oo ay ku codeyn karaan, musharraxiintuna ay si xor ah uga qayb geli karaan doorashada. Xaaladda amni ee caasimadda Juba ayaa sidoo kale si weyn loo adkeeyay, iyadoo la soo sheegay isbaarooyin iyo waddooyin la xiray agagaarka xarumaha dowladda, halka ciidamada ammaanka lagu amray inay feejignaan sare ku jiraan.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Magaalada Beledweyne ayaa waxaa ka socda dhaqdhaqaaq siyaasadeed iyo mid ciidan, oo lagu diidan yahay in wax doorasho ah oo la xiriira Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle in laga qabto Gobolka Hiiraan. Siyaasiyiinta, odayaasha iyo waxgaradka gobolkaasi qaarkood ayaa Beledweyne ka wada abaabul ciidan iyo diyaargarow ku aaddan dhismaha maamul ka madaxbannaan kan Hirshabelle. Ciidamada dadka deegaanka ayaa loogu talagalay inay taageeraan hannaanka dhismaha maamulka cusub ee la doonayo in laga yegleelo gobolkaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in qorista ciidamada dadka deegaanka ay sidoo kale ka socoto qaybo ka mid ah bariga gobolkaasi, si ay uga hortaggaan doorashada soo socota Hirshabelle ee Dowladda Federaalka taageereyso. Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa qorsheynaya in 30-ka bishan ay gobolka ka qabtaan doorasho qof iyo cod ah, oo shacabku ay ku soo dooranayaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Hirshabelle. Xiisadda siyaasadeed gobolka ee aadka u kacsan ayaa caqabad ku noqon karta in doorasho nabdoon oo xasilloon laga qabto degmooyinka gobolkaasi ee horey loo shaaciyay in doorashada ay ka dhaceyso. Dowladda Federaalka iyo hoggaanka siyaasadeed iyo dhaqanka gobolkaasi ayaa kala dhaqaaqay, ka dib markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu taageeray musharaxnimada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe). Urur Siyaasadeedka JSP ee Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu hoggaamiyo ayaa 13-kii bishan si rasmi ah Cali Guudlaawe ugu xushay inuu noqdo musharaxooda uga qaybgelaya doorashada madaxtinimada Hirshabelle. Madaxweyne Kuxigeenka Hirshabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Yuusuf Dabageed) ayaa horey u sheegay inaanan wax doorasho ah oo ku saabsan Hirshabelle laga qaban karin Gobolka Hiiraan, iyadoo aan siyaasiyan laga heshiin khilaafka taagan. Khilaafka siyaasadeed ayaa laga cabsi qabaa in uu isku bedelo gacan ka hadal, taasoo saamayn ku yeelaneysa amniga dalka, gaar ahaan midka gobolkaasi. Khilaafkan ayaa wax aad mooddo dabin ku ah Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, oo Villa Somalia ay ku riixeyso inay Ciidamada Militariga gacan ka gaystaan sugidda amniga ee doorashada laga qabanayo degmooyinka gobolkaasi, xitaa haddii ay noqoto in askartaasi laga qaado Caasimadda Muqdisho. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud oo fahamsan cawaaqibka amni ay arrintan leedahay ayaa ka cararaya in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee deegaanka u dhashay iyo kuwa Macawiisleyda ee ka taageera la dagaalanka maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ay soo banneeyaan furimaha hore ee dagaalka. Khilaafkan kala irdheeyay reer Hiiraan iyo Dowladda Federaalka iyo Hirshabelle oo isku garab ah ayaa khatar gelinaya wadajirka iyo isku duubnida ciidamada, wuxuuna fursad siinayaa kooxaha argagixisada inay dib u soo xoogeystaan, iyadoo gobolku uu xudun u yahay kacdoonka dadka deegaanka (Macawiisleyda) ee ka dhanka ah Al Shabaab.

items.title: Trump oo ku hanjabay inuu burburin doono Iiraan, haddii…
items.description: New York (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump ayaa khudbaddiisa Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay kaga hadlay dagaalka iyo barnaamijka nukliyeerka Iiraan. Reuters waxay sheegtay in Trump uu khudbadda ku difaacay tallaabooyinka milatari ee Maraykanka ee ka dhanka ah Iiraan. Madaxweyne Trump ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in haddii heshiis lala gaari waayo Iiraan, uu Maraykanku “burburin doono Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan.” Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay inuu aaminsan yahay in Iiraan ay ugu dambayn heshiis la geli doonto Maraykanka kadib doorashooyinka dhexe ee Maraykanka. Trump ayaa mar kale Iiraan ku tilmaamay dalka uu sheegay inuu yahay maalgeliyaha ugu weyn ee argagixisada caalamka, isagoo intaas ku daray in Iiraan aysan hadda khatar ahayn, sida uu sheegay, maadaama Maraykanku uu burburiyay barnaamijkeeda nukliyeerka. Madaxweynaha dalka Maraykanka ayaa sidoo kale ku celiyay sheegashada ah in tobannaan kun oo dibadbaxayaal ah lagu dilay Iiraan xilliyadii u dambeeyay. Waxaa kale oo uu dhaleeceeyay dalalka Yurub, isagoo sheegay inaysan si ku filan uga fiirsan khatarta gantaallada Iiraan. Donald Trump ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in ciidanka iyo dhaqaalaha Iiraan si weyn loo burburiyay. items.title: Trump oo Dalalka Xubnaha Ka Ah Maxkamadda ICC ugu Baaqay Inay Si Degdeg ah uga Baxaan
items.description: WASHINGTON (Goobjoog News) — Madaxweynaha Mareykanka, Donald Trump, ayaa ku baaqay in dhammaan dalalka xubnaha ka ah Maxkamadda Dambiyada Caalamiga ah (ICC) ay si degdeg ah uga baxaan maxkamaddaas.  Baaqan cusub ee uu soo saaray Trump ayaa qayb ka ah cadaadiska joogtada ah iyo mucaaradnimada adag ee uu hore ugu hayay maxkamadda fadhigeedu yahay magaalada Hague, isagoo ku dooday in hay’addani ay ka gudubtay awooddeeda sharciga ah ayna bartilmaameedsato danaha dalalka madaxa-bannaan iyo hoggaamiyeyaashooda. Hadalka Trump ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli maxkamadda ICC ay waddo dacwado iyo baaritaanno xasaasi ah oo la xiriira dambiyo dagaal iyo kuwo ka dhan ah bini’aadannimada, kuwaas oo qaarkood si toos ah u taabanaya xulafada Mareykanka iyo xiisadaha ka taagan gobollo kala duwan oo caalamka ah. Baaqan ayaa la filayaa inuu falcelin xooggan ka dhex dhaliyo dowladaha xubnaha ka ah heshiiskii Rome Statute ee lagu aasaasay ICC, gaar ahaan waddamada reer Yurub iyo hay’adaha u dooda caddaaladda caalamiga ah, kuwaas oo maxkamadda u arka tiir muhiim u ah la-xisaabtanka dambiyada dagaalka.

items.title: Hantidhawrka oo u digay guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka kadib amarkii Xamza
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xafiiska hantidhawrka guud ee qaranka, Mudane Axmed Ciise Guutaale oo bayaan culus soo saaray ayaa u digay guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka oo haatan ku hawlan dib-u-habeynta shaqaalaha iyo saraakiisha sar sare ee dowladda, kadib markii xafiiska Ra’iisul wasaaruhu uu soo saaray amar saameynaya dhammaan wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha dowladda oo ay ku jiraan xafiisyada hantidhawrka iyo xeer-ilaaliyaha guud ee qaranka. Guutaale ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in xafiiska hantidhawrka uu yahay hay’ad dastuuri ah oo madax-bannaan, isla markaana leh madax-bannaani maamul iyo mid maaliyadeed, laguna dhisay qodobka 177-aad ee Dastuurka JFS. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in awoodaha, waajibaadka iyo shaqooyinka hantidhawrka lagu faah-faahiyey sharciga maareynta maaliyadda guud, sharci Lr. 17 ee 2019 iyo sharciga hantidhawrka guud, sharci Lr. 14 ee 2023. Qoraalka ayaa sidoo kale lagu yiri “Xafiiska Hantidhawrka Guud waa hay’adda ugu sarreysa ee u xil-saaran hantidhawrka, diiwaangelinta iyo ilaalinta hantida guud iyo macaamilada maaliyadeed ee dowladda, isla markaana fulisa kormeer iyo daba-gal ku saabsan maaraynta khayraadka guud. Sidoo kale, waxa uu hubiyaa dhowrista iyo ku dhaqanka shuruucda maamulka maaliyadda iyo miisaaniyadda Dowladda”. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Sidaas oo kale, waxa uu hubiyaa dhowrista iyo ku dhaqanka shuruucda maamulka maaliyadda iyo miisaaniyadda Dowladda”. Dhanka kale, wuxuu u digay guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka dowladda oo haatan ku howlan fulinta amar kasoo baxay Ra’iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamza Cabdi Barre oo ku aadan in dib u habeyn lagu sameeyo shaqaalaha rayidka iyada oo ujeedka uu yahay in tartan furan loo galo shaqooyinka dowladda. “Marka la eego qodobada kor ku xusan, waxaa waajib sharci ku ah Guddiga Qaranka ee Shaqaalaha Rayidka Dowladda in uu si buuxda u dhowro madax-bannaanida dastuuriga ah ee Xafiiska Hantidhawrka Guud ee JFS, isla markaana tallaabo kasta, go’aan kasta ama habraac kasta oo khuseeya Xafiiska lagu saleeyo Dastuurka JFS iyo shuruucda kale ee lagu dhisay laguna nidaamiyo Xafiiska,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri warqadda. Hawtidhawrka ayaa si gaar ah u faray guddiga shaqaalaha rayidka in aysan qaadin ama dhaqan-gelin tallaabo wax u dhimaysa, xaddidaysa ama ka hor imaanaysa madaxbannaanida, awoodaha iyo nidaamka sharciyeed ee Xafiiska Hantidhawrka Guud ee JFS. items.title: Somaliland president discusses expanded military cooperation with U.S. officials
items.description: Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi, the president of Somaliland, the pro-Western region that broke away from Somalia, discussed deepening partnerships with the U.S., including expanded U.S.-Somaliland military cooperation, during a visit to Washington, D.C. Israel was the first state to recognize Somaliland’s independence last year, more than three decades after the region declared independence, though the U.S. has maintained direct and indirect relationships with the government, based in Hargeisa. The territory in the Horn of Africa is located along the Gulf of Aden and is seen as a potential site for an American or Israeli military base in the Horn of Africa, particularly in light of the growing Houthi control over the Bab al Mandeb Strait. Abdullahi told reporters at a media briefing that he met with representatives of the State Department, Pentagon, Treasury and Department of Energy as well as at least one representative from the National Security Council. “We had [with] all of them fruitful conversations. Short of recognizing Somaliland, we feel that there is progress in our conversation, and we shall continue that conversation,” Abdullahi said. “In the meantime, we understand that our cooperation [in] different sectors, will increase and will expand, and we hope that some American presence will be in Somaliland in the near future.” Full story: https://ji.news/5jea4

items.title: Taiwan launches Somaliland seed development project
items.description: Taiwan has launched a seed industry development project and opened an agricultural demonstration and training farm in Somaliland. Speaking at the farm’s opening ceremony Sunday, Taiwan Representative Allen C. Lou said Taiwan and Somaliland are working together to strengthen farmers’ capabilities through demonstrations, training, and technology transfers. The project will run through 2030 and aims to strengthen food security and climate resilience, according to the Taiwan Representative Office in Somaliland. The office said the two sides were “sowing seeds of friendship, growing a sustainable future together.” “This project will establish a seed quality management system, strengthen testing and inspection capacities, and improve seed production techniques,” the Taiwan International Cooperation and Development Fund said. The fund added that these efforts would help Somaliland advance toward the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal of zero hunger. Deputy Foreign Minister Francois Wu (吳志中) said in June that bilateral cooperation spans agriculture, healthcare, infrastructure, and other areas. Wu described Somaliland as Taiwan’s first major partner in East Africa and said the relationship could serve as a model for broader engagement across the continent. Last year, President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) met Somaliland Foreign Minister Abdirahman Dahir Adam and pledged to deepen the partnership. Lai said authoritarian regimes had intensified efforts to suppress Taiwan’s and Somaliland’s international participation. He said the two sides should work together to demonstrate the resilience of democratic alliances and their commitment to shared values. Source Taiwan news
