Türkiye Türkiye has become one of Somalia’s most important security partners, training thousands of Somali troops and providing military capabilities including drones and F-16 aircraft. Ankara also has extensive strategic and economic interests in Somalia. United States Washington says it intends to continue bilateral counter-terrorism operations, including air capabilities, even as it moves away from supporting UNSOS. Uganda Ugandan forces have maintained a major presence around Mogadishu and have been central to the African Union mission since its beginning. Kenya Kenyan forces remain particularly important in areas near Somalia’s southern border. Ethiopia Ethiopian forces maintain a significant security role along their border and within Somalia. It is national security planning. Somali units may have fewer resources and remain dependent on external support. A one-for-one substitution could therefore be dangerous. It should be: How many Somali soldiers can sustainably hold each strategically important area with the logistics, intelligence, mobility and political support required to prevent its loss? That is a much harder calculation. What happens to Mogadishu? Mogadishu is likely to remain the centre of gravity of the new security order. The city has benefited from improved security in recent years, and the Somali government retains control of the capital. Crisis Group argues that Al-Shabaab remains largely concentrated in rural areas even though it continues to threaten the government and conduct attacks. That can eventually translate into economic pressure, taxation, recruitment and attacks against government-controlled areas. Urban security and rural security are therefore not separate problems. They are connected. What happens to rural Somalia? This could be the hardest part of the transition. Al-Shabaab has historically demonstrated that it does not need to control every major city to remain a powerful insurgent organisation. Its rural presence allows it to: move fighters; collect taxes; establish checkpoints; gather intelligence; launch attacks; threaten supply routes; and impose its authority in areas where government institutions are weak. But it does not amount to a decisive resolution of Somalia’s security problem. Medical evacuation A force operating without dependable casualty evacuation becomes vulnerable quickly. /UNSOS currently provides medical infrastructure and MEDEVAC/CASEVAC support. 3. Mobility Somali forces must be able to move rapidly between threatened areas. 4. Intelligence Operations against an adaptive insurgency depend on reliable intelligence. 5. Air support Foreign air capabilities have become an important component of operations against Al-Shabaab. 6. Command and control Federal and state forces need a clearer national security framework. 7. Financing A sustainable national army requires predictable domestic and international financing. 8. Territorial governance Military operations need to be followed by functioning civilian administration. 9. Political agreement Federal and member-state authorities need to agree on who is responsible for what. 10. Accountability A national security force needs public legitimacy as well as battlefield capability. That is what makes the transition so difficult. Somalia is not merely building an army. That would be a change in architecture, but not necessarily a complete transition to self-reliance. But it also makes clear that this should be viewed as a temporary bridge while Somali forces develop the capacity to assume greater responsibility. The distinction is crucial. But the year could also disappear quickly. By the time the logistical drawdown is fully under way, Somalia cannot still be debating basic questions about who will provide fuel, transport and medical evacuation. Those decisions need to be made before the infrastructure disappears. Crisis Group therefore argues that Somalia and its partners should use the temporary reprieve to construct a new security system capable of operating from the second half of 2027. Its security forces have expanded. Thousands of troops have received foreign training. Somali forces increasingly lead operations. The government has developed greater domestic revenue capacity. International partners remain willing to provide forms of bilateral support. But Somalia is not yet fully self-sufficient. Its forces remain dependent on external logistical and operational assistance. Some areas transferred to Somali forces have subsequently been lost. Political disputes continue to weaken national security coordination. Federal and state security structures remain fragmented. AUSSOM itself still provides an important security buffer. And the logistical infrastructure behind that mission is now approaching its own transition. That is why the most accurate answer is neither “Somalia is ready” nor “Somalia is incapable.” The evidence suggests that Somalia can assume more responsibility, but a rapid one-for-one replacement of AUSSOM by Somali forces would carry significant risks. What Somalia should do now The Crisis Group report points toward a practical roadmap. First: Build the replacement system before dismantling the old one The transition should not be based on hope that another arrangement will emerge later. Second: Keep bilateral partners coordinated Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Türkiye, the United States and other partners should operate within a coherent Somali-led security framework. Third: Prioritise strategic territory Somali forces should be ready to move into areas where foreign troops withdraw, particularly around major towns, roads and infrastructure. Fourth: Avoid overextending the army Crisis Group argues that Somalia should be cautious about launching major new offensives while the security architecture itself is being transformed. Fifth: Resolve political disputes A fragmented political system cannot easily produce a unified national security force. Sixth: Create predictable financing Somalia and its partners need a realistic multi-year funding model for both international support and the Somali security forces. Seventh: Give federal member states a place in the security transition A national security plan that excludes powerful regional actors risks reproducing the very divisions that have weakened the security sector. The biggest mistake would be to confuse withdrawal with transition There is a temptation to see the end of UNSOS as simply the end of international involvement. That would be wrong. The real story is about what comes after the international system. If the withdrawal is coordinated, Somalia could emerge with a more genuinely Somali-led security architecture, supported by carefully structured bilateral partnerships. If the withdrawal is chaotic, Somalia could face shrinking security coverage, increased pressure on vulnerable towns and roads, financial crises inside security institutions and greater opportunities for Al-Shabaab. The outcome is therefore not predetermined. It depends on what happens during the transition. Somalia’s security order is being rewritten For nearly twenty years, the international community has helped Somalia keep the lights on in its security sector. Now the scaffolding is coming down. The United States has granted another year for the UN to wind down its support, giving Somalia and its partners additional time. But the direction of travel remains unmistakable. UNSOS is approaching the end of its current role, while AUSSOM faces the difficult task of determining whether and how it can survive without the logistical system that sustains it. Somali forces have made real progress. But progress is not the same as readiness for complete independence. The decisive test will be whether Somalia can convert an expanding army into a sustainable national security institution — one capable not merely of fighting, but of supplying itself, holding territory, protecting roads, working with regional authorities and maintaining security after foreign partners reduce their presence. Al-Shabaab will be watching that transition. So will Somalia’s neighbours. So will Türkiye, the United States, the African Union, the European Union and the Gulf states. And perhaps most importantly, so will ordinary Somalis living in the towns and villages where the difference between a functioning security system and a security vacuum is measured in whether a road remains open, a market remains accessible, a school remains protected and a family can travel without fear. The coming transition is therefore larger than the fate of one UN office. It is a test of the Somali state itself. Can Somalia take responsibility for its own security? The evidence suggests that it is moving toward that goal. But the evidence also suggests that it is not yet ready to do so without substantial external support. That is precisely why the next year matters. The clock has not stopped. It has merely been reset. And when UNSOS finally begins to disappear, Somalia will discover whether the security architecture built in its place is strong enough to stand on its own. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

Somalia has improved its domestic revenue collection and has financed some military operations itself, according to Crisis Group. But the country’s fiscal capacity remains limited relative to the scale of its security requirements. That makes donor coordination essential. Somalia’s foreign partners could become the bridge The end of UNSOS does not necessarily mean the end of international military assistance. Far from it. Crisis Group identifies an increasingly important network of bilateral relationships. Türkiye Türkiye has become one of Somalia’s most important security partners, training thousands of Somali troops and providing military capabilities including drones and F-16 aircraft. Ankara also has extensive strategic and economic interests in Somalia. United States Washington says it intends to continue bilateral counter-terrorism operations, including air capabilities, even as it moves away from supporting UNSOS. Uganda Ugandan forces have maintained a major presence around Mogadishu and have been central to the African Union mission since its beginning. Kenya Kenyan forces remain particularly important in areas near Somalia’s southern border. Ethiopia Ethiopian forces maintain a significant security role along their border and within Somalia. These relationships could provide the security bridge Somalia needs. But there is a condition. They have to be coordinated. Somalia needs a security coalition, not competing security arrangements This may be the most important recommendation emerging from the Crisis Group report. Mogadishu should establish a regular forum bringing together: the Federal Government; federal member states; AUSSOM troop contributors; bilateral military partners; the African Union; the United Nations; major donors. The purpose would be simple: Who is responsible for what after UNSOS? Which force protects which city? Who supports which road? Who provides aviation? Who pays? Who supplies Somali units? Where will foreign forces remain? Which positions will Somali forces inherit? What happens if Al-Shabaab attacks? And how does Somalia ensure that foreign security partnerships strengthen rather than fragment the national security system? Crisis Group argues that such coordination is essential to prevent bilateral security relationships from turning into competing zones of influence. This is not diplomatic housekeeping. It is national security planning. The 14,000-soldier question Mogadishu said in early August that it had approximately 14,000 troops available for military operations who could potentially be used as holding forces in areas vacated by departing AU troops, according to Crisis Group. That figure sounds substantial. But numbers alone can be deceptive. A force of 14,000 soldiers cannot automatically substitute for an international mission simply because the headcount appears comparable in some locations. The real comparison is capability. AUSSOM brings foreign contingents with established command structures, external financing, military logistics and access to the UNSOS support network. Somali units may have fewer resources and remain dependent on external support. A one-for-one substitution could therefore be dangerous. The question should not be: How many Somali soldiers can replace departing AU soldiers? It should be: How many Somali soldiers can sustainably hold each strategically important area with the logistics, intelligence, mobility and political support required to prevent its loss? That is a much harder calculation. What happens to Mogadishu? Mogadishu is likely to remain the centre of gravity of the new security order. The city has benefited from improved security in recent years, and the Somali government retains control of the capital. Crisis Group argues that Al-Shabaab remains largely concentrated in rural areas even though it continues to threaten the government and conduct attacks. That means a future security architecture is likely to prioritise: Mogadishu; major regional capitals; airports; ports; major roads; economic corridors; strategically important towns. But concentrating resources in urban centres carries a risk. If rural areas are abandoned too quickly, Al-Shabaab can consolidate its influence outside the cities. That can eventually translate into economic pressure, taxation, recruitment and attacks against government-controlled areas. Urban security and rural security are therefore not separate problems. They are connected. What happens to rural Somalia? This could be the hardest part of the transition. Al-Shabaab has historically demonstrated that it does not need to control every major city to remain a powerful insurgent organisation. Its rural presence allows it to: move fighters; collect taxes; establish checkpoints; gather intelligence; launch attacks; threaten supply routes; and impose its authority in areas where government institutions are weak. A smaller international footprint could therefore produce a geographic imbalance: government control in cities, insurgent influence in the countryside. That may be sustainable for a period. But it does not amount to a decisive resolution of Somalia’s security problem. What Somali forces need before the final handover If Somalia is to assume the security burden successfully, troop recruitment cannot be the only priority. The country needs to build the supporting architecture around its soldiers. 1. Logistics Somali forces must increasingly be able to supply themselves with food, fuel, transport and equipment. 2. Medical evacuation A force operating without dependable casualty evacuation becomes vulnerable quickly. /UNSOS currently provides medical infrastructure and MEDEVAC/CASEVAC support. 3. Mobility Somali forces must be able to move rapidly between threatened areas. 4. Intelligence Operations against an adaptive insurgency depend on reliable intelligence. 5. Air support Foreign air capabilities have become an important component of operations against Al-Shabaab. 6. Command and control Federal and state forces need a clearer national security framework. 7. Financing A sustainable national army requires predictable domestic and international financing. 8. Territorial governance Military operations need to be followed by functioning civilian administration. 9. Political agreement Federal and member-state authorities need to agree on who is responsible for what. 10. Accountability A national security force needs public legitimacy as well as battlefield capability. That is what makes the transition so difficult. Somalia is not merely building an army. It is trying to build a state capable of sustaining an army. The danger of replacing one dependency with another There is an uncomfortable possibility hidden inside the transition. Somalia could successfully reduce its dependence on a UN-AU security structure only to become more dependent on several bilateral partners. That would be a change in architecture, but not necessarily a complete transition to self-reliance. Crisis Group sees bilateral relationships as the most pragmatic short-term way of preventing a major security deterioration. But it also makes clear that this should be viewed as a temporary bridge while Somali forces develop the capacity to assume greater responsibility. The distinction is crucial. Bilateral assistance can buy time. It cannot permanently substitute for a functioning Somali security state. The 2027 question The most important date may no longer be simply 31 December 2026. The real question is what Somalia looks like during and after the expected 2027 drawdown. The additional year gives Mogadishu and its partners an opportunity to plan. But the year could also disappear quickly. By the time the logistical drawdown is fully under way, Somalia cannot still be debating basic questions about who will provide fuel, transport and medical evacuation. Those decisions need to be made before the infrastructure disappears. Crisis Group therefore argues that Somalia and its partners should use the temporary reprieve to construct a new security system capable of operating from the second half of 2027. That makes 2026–27 less a period of waiting than a period of preparation. Is Somalia ready? The evidence points to a nuanced answer. Somalia is more capable than it was. Its security forces have expanded. Thousands of troops have received foreign training. Somali forces increasingly lead operations. The government has developed greater domestic revenue capacity. International partners remain willing to provide forms of bilateral support. But Somalia is not yet fully self-sufficient. Its forces remain dependent on external logistical and operational assistance. Some areas transferred to Somali forces have subsequently been lost. Political disputes continue to weaken national security coordination. Federal and state security structures remain fragmented. AUSSOM itself still provides an important security buffer. And the logistical infrastructure behind that mission is now approaching its own transition. That is why the most accurate answer is neither “Somalia is ready” nor “Somalia is incapable.” The evidence suggests that Somalia can assume more responsibility, but a rapid one-for-one replacement of AUSSOM by Somali forces would carry significant risks. What Somalia should do now The Crisis Group report points toward a practical roadmap. First: Build the replacement system before dismantling the old one The transition should not be based on hope that another arrangement will emerge later. Second: Keep bilateral partners coordinated Kenya, Ethiopia, Uganda, Türkiye, the United States and other partners should operate within a coherent Somali-led security framework. Third: Prioritise strategic territory Somali forces should be ready to move into areas where foreign troops withdraw, particularly around major towns, roads and infrastructure. Fourth: Avoid overextending the army Crisis Group argues that Somalia should be cautious about launching major new offensives while the security architecture itself is being transformed. Fifth: Resolve political disputes A fragmented political system cannot easily produce a unified national security force. Sixth: Create predictable financing Somalia and its partners need a realistic multi-year funding model for both international support and the Somali security forces. Seventh: Give federal member states a place in the security transition A national security plan that excludes powerful regional actors risks reproducing the very divisions that have weakened the security sector. The biggest mistake would be to confuse withdrawal with transition There is a temptation to see the end of UNSOS as simply the end of international involvement. That would be wrong. The real story is about what comes after the international system. If the withdrawal is coordinated, Somalia could emerge with a more genuinely Somali-led security architecture, supported by carefully structured bilateral partnerships. If the withdrawal is chaotic, Somalia could face shrinking security coverage, increased pressure on vulnerable towns and roads, financial crises inside security institutions and greater opportunities for Al-Shabaab. The outcome is therefore not predetermined. It depends on what happens during the transition. Somalia’s security order is being rewritten For nearly twenty years, the international community has helped Somalia keep the lights on in its security sector. Now the scaffolding is coming down. The United States has granted another year for the UN to wind down its support, giving Somalia and its partners additional time. But the direction of travel remains unmistakable. UNSOS is approaching the end of its current role, while AUSSOM faces the difficult task of determining whether and how it can survive without the logistical system that sustains it. Somali forces have made real progress. But progress is not the same as readiness for complete independence. The decisive test will be whether Somalia can convert an expanding army into a sustainable national security institution — one capable not merely of fighting, but of supplying itself, holding territory, protecting roads, working with regional authorities and maintaining security after foreign partners reduce their presence. Al-Shabaab will be watching that transition. So will Somalia’s neighbours. So will Türkiye, the United States, the African Union, the European Union and the Gulf states. And perhaps most importantly, so will ordinary Somalis living in the towns and villages where the difference between a functioning security system and a security vacuum is measured in whether a road remains open, a market remains accessible, a school remains protected and a family can travel without fear. The coming transition is therefore larger than the fate of one UN office. It is a test of the Somali state itself. Can Somalia take responsibility for its own security? The evidence suggests that it is moving toward that goal. But the evidence also suggests that it is not yet ready to do so without substantial external support. That is precisely why the next year matters. The clock has not stopped. It has merely been reset. And when UNSOS finally begins to disappear, Somalia will discover whether the security architecture built in its place is strong enough to stand on its own. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Taliye Shub oo cid gaar ah ku eedeeyay duqaynta uu ka badbaaday
items.description: Taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, General Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan (Taliye Shub) ayaa markii ugu horreysay ka hadlay duqayntii xagga cirka ahayd ee 3-dii bishan lagu beegsaday hoyga uu ka deganaa Degmada Doolow ee Gobolka Gedo. Taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta ayaa sheegay in isaga iyo laba qof oo kale oo midi ay haweeney tahay ay ku dhaawacmeen duqayntaasi. Wareysi uu siiyay Channel-ka Youtube ee Geed Fadhi ayuu ku sheegay in duqaynta ay gaysatay diyaarad uu Turkigu leeyahay, balse ay ku lug lahaayeen saddex nin oo uu ku kala sheegay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) iyo Agaasimaha Hay’adda Nabad Sugidda & Sirdoonka Qaranka (NISA), Mahad Maxamed Salaad. “Diyaaradda waxaa na loogu soo diray guriga, annaga iyo wixii meesha ku noolba in dhulka na lagu daro. Waa waxay dad ay colaadi idiinka dhexeyso ay suubin lahaayeen.” Ayuu yiri General Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan. Jananka ayaa Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka si gaar ah ugu eedeeyay in uu dadaal badan u galay, sidii Turkiga u duqayn lahaa hoygiisii Doolow, isagoo xusay in uu Turkiga iska diiday, balse ay u suurtagashay in uu ku qanciyo. Eedeynta Taliye Shub uu u jeediyay Dowladda Federaalka ayaa ah eedayn siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo culus, waxayna xoojineysaa eedeyntii ay horey garabka mucaaradka ee Koonfur Galbeed ugu jeediyeen Villa Somalia inay ka masuul ahayd weerarkaasi, iyadoo kaashaneysa Dowladda Turkiga. Duqayntan oo dhacday 3-dii bishan ayay Dowladda Federaalka maalintii xigtay ee 4-tii September ay iska fogeysay masuuliyadda duqayntaasi, waxayna sheegtay in xogaha horudhaca ah ee heleen hay’adaha ammaanka ay muujinayaan in qaraxyadu ay ka dhasheen waxyaabo qarxa oo lagu diyaarinayay gurigaasi. Taliye Shub ayaa warka Dowladda Federaalka ku tilmaamay mid xaqiiqda ka fog, cid walbana ay ogtahay in aanu isagu ahayn Al Shabaab. “Aniga Shabaab ma ihi oo sida qarax loo sameeyo ma aqaan. Ninkii marka Shabaabka yaqiinay oo dadka leynayay, haddii laga soo leexiyay oo aniga Shabaabnimo la igu soo leexiyay oo diyaaradda igu garaaceyso, dowlad la’aanaa jirto waaye macnaha.” Ayuu yiri Taliye Shub. Taliye Shub ayaa waxaa loo arkaa xubinta ugu caansan Saraakiisha Ciidamada ee xulafada la ah Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ee dagaalka kula jira ciidanka maamulka cusub ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed iyo kuwa Dowladda Federaalka ee ku sugan Magaalada Baydhabo. Duqaynta hoyga Taliye Shub ayaa dhalisay guux siyaasadeed iyo dibadbaxyo lagu diidan yahay, laguna gubay Calanka Turkiga.

items.title: Daawo: Jahwareer ka dhashay Dastuurkii 2012 iyo kan cusub oo ka taagan BF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Gobsan Muxumed ayaa Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka dhex abuurtay dood xooggan oo ku saabsan dastuurka dalka, xilli uu muuqdo is-qabqabsi wayn oo ka taagan arrimaha dastuurka, kuwaas oo hareeyay golaha dhexdiisa. Gobsan ayaa soo bandhigtay su’aal ay sheegtay inay muhiim u tahay shaqada Baarlamaanka, taas oo ku saabsan in dalka uu weli ku shaqeynayo Dastuurkii KMG ahaa ee 2012 ama inuu si buuxda ugu gudbay dastuurka cusub ee dhawaan ay ansixiyeen labda Aqal. “Xildhibaanka mucaarad ama muxaafad ha ahaado, waxaa noo dhexeeya waa sharci. Haddii sharciyaddii muran ku jirto, ihaano ayay ku tahay Baarlamaanka, guddoomiye waxaa la rabaa dastuurka lagu murmayo muddo bil ah in aad caddeyso, ma Dastuurkii 2012 mise waxaa ku jirnaa Dastuurkii 2026 ee la ansixiyay?” ayay tiri Xildhibaan Gobsan. Sidoo kale waxa ay tilmaamtay in khilaafka ka taagan ku dhaqanka dastuurka uu si toos ah u saameynayo sharciyada la horgeynayo Baarlamaanka, iyadoo xustay inay muhiim tahay in la caddeeyo dastuurka dalka oo saldhig u ah nidaamka sharci ee ay ku shaqeeyaan hay’adaha dowladda. Xildhibaanadda ayaa sidoo kale su’aal gelisay mowqifka xukuumadda Dan-Qaran ee ku aaddan dastuurka cusub, maadaama ay si buuxda ula socotay geeddi-socodkii lagu ansixiyay wax ka beddelka Dastuurkii 2012. Waxaa kale oo ay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha iyo xukuumaddiisa ka dalbatay inay si cad u kala saaraan Dastuurkii 2012 iyo dastuurka cusub, iyadoo sheegtay in sharciyada Baarlamaanka la horkeeno ay weli ku xiran yihiin qodobo ka tirsan Dastuurkii ku-meel-gaarka ahaa. “Xukuumadda oo markii Dastuurka la ansixinayay aan ogeyn, waxa aad ka qabateen Ra’iisul Wasaare, adiga iyo Golahaaga Wasiirrada, ma is ogtihiin mise in la isku kiin sheegaa rabtaan?. Laba soo kala saara Dastuurkii la ansixiyay iyo system-kan maanta jooga ee is khilaafaya. Sharci kasta oo la keenaa wuxuu ku lifaaqan yahay Dastuurkii 2012-kii,” ayay mar kale tiri Xildhibaannaddu. Ugu dambeyn, waxay ku baaqday in arrinta Dastuurka si rasmi ah loo caddeeyo, si meesha looga saaro jahwareerka ka dhex jira Baarlamaanka iyo hay’adaha kale ee dowladda Soomaaliya, loona helo hannaan sharci oo ay ku wada shaqeeyaandhammaan dhinacyada dowladda. Si kastaba, Doodda Xildhibaan Gobsan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli haatan Baarlamaanka uu wajahayo dooddo la xiriira saldhigga dastuuriga ah ee sharciyada iyo nidaamka dowladeed, iyadoo ay weli ay taagan yihiin su’aalo ku saabsan sida la’isku waafajinayo dastuurka cusub iyo habraacyadii hore ee dalka. The post Daawo: Jahwareer ka dhashay Dastuurkii 2012 iyo kan cusub oo ka taagan BF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Former Somali Commander Accuses Government Over Doolow Attack, Claims F-16 Targeted His Home
items.description: DOOLOW— Former commander of the Somali Custodial Corps, Brig. Gen. Mahad Abdirahman Adan, widely known as Taliye Shub, has provided a new account of the attack on his residence in Doolow district, Gedo region. Gen. Mahad said his home was targeted by an F-16 fighter jet, rejecting government statements that the incident was caused by explosives allegedly being manufactured inside the residence. He further alleged that the airstrike was facilitated by the driver of a vehicle transporting him, claiming that the driver helped guide the aircraft toward the target. He did not provide publicly verifiable evidence to substantiate the allegation. Gen. Mahad also denied having any knowledge of explosives manufacturing and accused the federal government of maintaining links with individuals whom he alleged had previously been involved in the production of explosives. The former commander also sharply criticized the federal government over recent fighting and airstrikes in the city of Baidoa, questioning its handling of the security situation. His remarks come amid continuing conflicting accounts over the circumstances surrounding the attack on his residence in Doolow. The federal government has denied involvement in the incident, while the South West State administration and other parties have maintained that the residence was deliberately targeted. The competing accounts have not been independently verified, and the circumstances surrounding the Doolow incident remain disputed. The post Former Somali Commander Accuses Government Over Doolow Attack, Claims F-16 Targeted His Home appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Mareykanka iyo Denmark oo heshiis cusub ka gaaray amniga Greenland
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in Mareykanka, Denmark iyo Greenland ay gaareen heshiis cusub oo lagu ballaarinayo joogitaanka militariga Mareykanka ee Greenland, iyadoo sidoo kale la xaddidayo awoodda dalalka aan xulafada la ahayn Mareykanka ee ay saldhigyo ama maalgashi xasaasi ah ka sameysan karaan jasiiradda. Trump ayaa sheegay in heshiisku siinayo Washington awood joogto ah oo ay ku xaqiijiso amniga Greenland iyo danaha amni ee Mareykanka. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in aanay jirin waqti uu heshiisku ku egyahay, isla markaana dalalka Mareykanka ka soo horjeeda aan loo oggolaan doonin inay saldhigyo ciidan ka sameystaan Greenland ama ay sameeyaan maalgashi xasaasi ah iyada oo aan oggolaansho laga helin Mareykanka. Denmark iyo Greenland ayaa sheegay in heshiisku uu xoojinayo amniga gobolka Arctic-ga iyo Waqooyiga Atlantic, isla markaana uu ilaalinayo madax-bannaanida Denmark iyo xaqa dadka Greenland ay u leeyihiin aayo-ka-tashigooda. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Greenland, Jens-Frederik Nielsen, ayaa sheegay in heshiisku uu aqoonsanayo danaha Greenland iyo kaalinta ay ku leedahay iskaashiga caalamiga ah. Dhanka kale, dowladda Denmark waxay tilmaantay in heshiisku yahay mid lagu xoojinayo amniga wadajirka ah ee Arctic-ga iyo Waqooyiga Atlantic. Heshiiskan ayaa imanaya kadib bilo uu Trump si joogto ah u muujinayay danaha Mareykanka ee Greenland, xitaa isagoo horey u sheegay in Washington ay dooneyso inay gacanta ku dhigto jasiiradda. Denmark iyo Greenland, ma wareejinayo lahaanshaha ama madax-bannaanida Greenland , balse wuxuu xoogga saarayaa iskaashiga amniga iyo ballaarinta joogitaanka militariga Mareykanka. Mareykanka wuxuu horey Greenland uga haystay joogitaan militari, waxaana heshiiskii 1951 ee u dhexeeyay Mareykanka iyo Denmark uu Washington siiyay xuquuq ballaaran oo ku saabsan isticmaalka saldhigyada iyo hawada Greenland. Heshiiska cusub ayaa u muuqda inuu sii ballaarinayo ama adkeynayo nidaamkaas, iyadoo Mareykanku qorsheynayo joogitaan militari oo ka ballaaran kan hadda jira. Waxaa sidoo kale la sheegay in heshiiska si rasmi ah loo saxiixi doono inta lagu guda jiro shirka Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ee New York toddobaadka soo socda, balse weli wuxuu u baahan yahay in la maro habraacyada baarlamaanada Denmark iyo Greenland ka hor inta uusan si buuxda u dhaqan gelin. Haddaba, heshiiskan wuxuu calaamad u noqon karaa isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada qaabka amniga Arctic-ga, iyadoo Mareykanku doonayo inuu xoojiyo joogitaankiisa istiraatiijiga ah ee Greenland, halka Denmark iyo Greenland ay ku adkeysanayaan in madax-bannaanidooda iyo xaqa dadka Greenland ee aayo-ka-tashiga ay sii ahaanayaan kuwo la aqoonsan yahay .

items.title: President Lai launches Taiwan-led World Alliance for Disaster Management
items.description: President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) has formally launched the Taiwan-initiated World Alliance for Disaster Management (WADM), calling it a major breakthrough in Taiwan’s international participation. Twelve nations have joined the organization that aims to strengthen cooperation on disaster preparedness. Speaking at the second Resilient Taiwan for Sustainable Democracy International Forum in Taipei on Saturday, September 19, Lai said 11 of Taiwan’s diplomatic allies, as well as Somaliland, have joined the organization as founding members. Central and local governments, disaster-prevention agencies, and organizations from 21 countries have also joined as observers or partners, Lai added. The alliance will promote joint training and exercises, mutual assistance, and information sharing covering early warning, emergency response, and post-disaster recovery, according to the Presidential Office. “To all our international partners, I want to emphasize that Taiwan is a Taiwan of the world,” Lai told the forum’s audience, which the president said included more than 500 experts, foreign representatives, and other guests who had gathered to discuss topics such as military-civilian cooperation, psychological defense, and resilience partnerships. Lai said two years of work through the Presidential Office’s Whole-of-Society Defense Resilience Committee, established in June 2024, have given Taiwan confidence that its approach could serve as a reference for other countries. Back Last page

items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo la kulmay Senator Cruz
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliland Dr Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi ayaa la kulmay Senator Cruz. Qoraal uu madaxweunahu uu ku baahiyay baraha buldhada waxa uu u dhignaa sidan hoos ku xusan Waxa aan Washington, D.C., kulan muhiim ah kula yeeshay Senator-ka Gobolka Texas, Ted Cruz. Waxa aanu ka wada hadalnay dedaalka aqoonsiga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, xoojinta xidhiidhka istiraatijiyadeed ee Somaliland iyo Maraykanka, amniga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iyo ballaadhinta iskaashiga dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga. Waxaan Senator Cruz si weyn uga mahadceliyey taageeradiisa joogtada ah iyo sida uu ugu ololeeyo qaddiyadda aqoonsiga Somaliland. Somaliland waxay diyaar u tahay inay Maraykanka la dhisto iskaashi waara oo aan ku dhisnayn samafal ama ku-tiirsanaan, balse ku salaysan dano wadaag, kalsooni, is-qaddarin iyo ilaalinta amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka.

items.title: Weriye Xasan Kaafi Qoyste oo ku geeriyooday Muqdisho
items.description: Waxaa saacadihii lasoo dhaafay magaalada Muqdisho la xaqiijiyay geerida weriye Xasan Kaafi, oo muddo dheer ku soo jiray mihnadda saxaafadda Soomaaliyeed, kana mid ahaa wariyeyaasha sida weyn looga yaqaanay bulshada. Xasan Kaafi ayaa sannado badan ka shaqeynayay warbaahinta Soomaaliya, isagoo soo qabtay shaqooyin kala duwan oo la xiriira saxaafadda. Waxa uu ka mid ahaa suxufiyiinta muddo dheer ku dhex jiray shaqada warbaahinta, waxaana lagu xusuusan doonaa doorkii uu ku lahaa tebinta iyo soo gudbinta wararka iyo barnaamijyada bulshada. Geerida Xasan Kaafi waxaa si weyn uga tacsiyeeyay bahda warbaahinta Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo saaxiibbadiis, wariyeyaal iyo shaqsiyaad kale oo bulshada ka tirsan ay ka hadleen. Xasan Kaafi wuxuu ahaa mid ka mid ah wariyeyaasha muddo dheer ka shaqeynayay, waxaana si gaar ah loogu xasuustaa sheekada caanka ah ee adeegto oo uu akhrin jirey. Xasan kaafi wuxuu muddooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ka tirsanaa laanta af-soomaaliga ee VOA oo dhowaan la joojiyay qaar kamid ah barnaamijyadeeda, geeridiisana faahfaahin dheeraad ah lagama bixin.

items.title: Hoggaamiyaha Xuutiyiinta oo war soo saaray kadib markii la sheegay inay weerareen Maka
items.description: Sanca (Caasimada Online) – Hoggaamiyaha kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen, Cabdul-Malik Al-Xuuthi, ayaa si kulul u beeniyay eedeyn ah in kooxdiisu ay diyaarad drone ah ku weerartay magaalada barakeysan ee Maka ee dalka Sacuudiga. Al-Xuuthi ayaa sheegay in warkaasi uu yahay “been weyn”, isagoo ku adkeystay in Xuutiyiintu ay ka go’an tahay ilaalinta goobaha barakeysan ee Islaamka, halkii ay bartilmaameed ka dhigan lahaayeen. Khudbad laga sii daayay telefishinka ayuu ku sheegay in khatarta dhabta ah ee ku wajahan Maka iyo goobaha kale ee barakeysan ay ka imaneyso Israel, oo uu ku tilmaamay “cadowga Sahyuuniyadda”. “Khatarta dhabta ah waa cadowga Sahyuuniyadda, kaas oo doonaya inuu bartilmaameedsado dhammaan goobaha barakeysan ee Islaamka, oo ay ku jiraan Maka, Madiina iyo Masjidka Al-Aqsa,” ayuu yiri Al-Xuuthi. “Waxaan diyaar u nahay inaan kaga hortagno annagoo ah isbahaysi Islaami ah,” ayuu raaciyay. Hoggaamiyaha Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay Sacuudiga inuu faafinayo sheegashada ku saabsan weerarka Maka si taageero loogu helo tallaabooyinka militari ee ka dhanka ah Yemen. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli dagaalka Yemen uu galay marxalad cusub, iyadoo Xuutiyiintu ay maalmihii la soo dhaafay qabsadeen dhul ballaaran oo xeebaha Yemen ah, gaar ahaan aagga ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab Al-Mandab. Marin-biyoodkan ayaa ka mid ah jidadka ugu muhiimsan ee ganacsiga iyo shidaalka caalamka, wuxuuna isku xiraa Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale lagu eedeeyay weerarro lagu qaaday dhuumaha shidaalka East-West Pipeline ee gudaha Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo qaada qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah shidaalka boqortooyada. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in dowladda Sacuudiga ay u baahan karto muddo shan ilaa lix toddobaad ah si ay si buuxda ugu dayactirto khasaaraha ka dhashay weerar drone ah oo lagu qaaday dhuumahaasi. Qiimaha shidaalka caalamka ayaa horey sare ugu kacay kadib markii weerar degdeg ah oo ay Xuutiyiintu qaadeen uu kooxda u suurtageliyay inay gacanta ku dhigto qeybo muhiim ah oo ka tirsan xeebaha Yemen ee Bab Al-Mandab. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sheegay in howlgaladooda militari ay yihiin jawaab ay ka bixinayaan weerarro uu Sacuudiga ka fuliyay Yemen, oo uu ku jiro weerar drone ah oo lagu qaaday magaalada caasimadda ah ee Sanca. “Mar kasta, dhinaca kale ayaa ahaa kan bilaaba gardarrada,” ayuu yiri Al-Xuuthi. “Annagu waxaan ku jirnaa xaalad is-difaac ah. Ma nihin kuwa bilaaba weerarka,” ayuu hadalkiisa ku daray. Dagaallada cusub ayaa sidoo kale sii kordhiyay xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Yemen. Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Socdaalka ee IOM ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 112,000 oo qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha Yemen labadii toddobaad ee la soo dhaafay. Hay’adda Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in ku dhawaad 3,000 oo qof oo ka soo qaxay deegaannada ku dhow Gacanka Cadmeed ay badda uga gudbeen dalka deriska ah ee Jabuuti. Mas’uuliyiinta Jabuuti ayaa isku diyaarinaya inay qaabilaan illaa 10,000 oo qaxooti ah, iyadoo hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay ay ka digayaan in qulqulka dadkaasi uu cadaadis dheeraad ah saarayo adeegyada caafimaadka, waxbarashada iyo gargaarka bani’aadannimo ee dalka. Tirada cusub ee barakacayaasha ayaa muujineysa koror weyn marka loo eego bilowgii bishan, xilligaas oo IOM ay sheegtay in in ka badan 100,000 oo qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha Yemen tan iyo markii dagaalladu dib u qarxeen. items.title: Siidhiga digniinta weerarada oo markii u horaysay laga maqlay caasimada Sucuudiga
items.description: Hay’adda Difaaca Madaniga ah ee Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in magaalada Riyadh laga hawlgeliyay nidaamka digniinta hore iyo seeriga xaaladaha degdegga ah. Tani waxay noqotay digniintii ugu horreysay ee noocan ah ee laga bixiyo caasimadda Sacuudiga tan iyo markii uu sii xoogaystay dagaalka u dhexeeya Sacuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Digniinta ayaa timid saacado kadib markii afhayeenka milatariga Xuutiyiinta uu sheegay in ay fashiliyeen waxa uu ku tilmaamay “falal dambiyeed” oo ka dhacay magaalada Sanca. Waxa uu falalkaas ku eedeeyay Sacuudiga, isaga oo sheegay in laga jawaabi doono. Hay’adda Difaaca Madaniga ah ee Sacuudiga ayaa markii dambe, subaxnimadii Sabtida, sheegtay in xaaladdu caadi tahay. Xuutiyiinta oo gacanta ku haya deegaannada ugu dadka badan Yemen iyo inta badan waqooyiga dalka, ayaa tan iyo markii Riyadh bishii July ku dhawaaqday go’doomin dhinaca badda ah, weerarro ku qaaday Sacuudiga iyo maraakiibta Sacuudiga ee ku sugan Badda Cas. Xuutiyiinta ayaa tan iyo toddobaadkii hore si degdeg ah ugu sii fidayay dhulka Yemen, iyaga oo la wareegay dhammaan xeebaha Yemen ee ku teedsan Badda Cas. Waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in diyaaradaha dagaalka Sacuudigu maalmihii u dambeeyay boqollaal duqeyn ah ka fuliyeen deegaannada ay Xuutiyiintu gacanta ku hayaan.

items.title: Maraykanka oo ka qaaday cunaqabateyntii saarnayd Ciidamada Eritrea
items.description: Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa ka qaaday cunaqabateyntii saarnayd Ciidamada Difaaca Eritrea iyo hay’ado kale oo Eritrean ah, tallaabadan ayaana loo arko mid wax ka beddeli karta xiriirka Washington iyo Asmara, xilli Mareykanka iyo beesha caalamku ay si gaar ah isha ugu hayaan amniga iyo maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Badda Cas. Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ayaa 18-kii Sebtembar 2026 ku dhawaaqday in hay’adihii Eritrea ee lagu bartilmaameedsaday cunaqabateynta la xiriirtay dagaalkii Tigray laga saaray nidaamka cunaqabateynta Mareykanka. Waxaa ka mid ahaa Ciidamada Difaaca Eritrea iyo People’s Front for Democracy and Justice (PFDJ) , oo ah xisbiga talada haya dalka. Cunaqabateyntaas waxaa lagu soo rogay 2021-kii xilligii madaxweynihii hore ee Mareykanka Joe Biden, iyadoo Washington ay ku salaysay doorka ciidamada Eritrea ee dagaalkii Tigray ee waqooyiga Itoobiya. Xilligaas, Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Mareykanka waxay ciidamada Eritrea ku eedaysay inay ku lug lahaayeen falal ay ka mid yihiin dilka dad rayid ah, boob, tacaddiyo galmo iyo xannibaadda gargaarka bani’aadamnimo. Go’aanka cusub ayaa imanaya xilli Badda Cas ay noqotay meel muhiim ah oo dhinaca amniga iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah ah, gaar ahaan kadib markii xiisadaha Bariga Dhexe ay saameeyeen isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo tamarta. Eritrea waxay leedahay xeeb dheer oo ku taalla Badda Cas, waxayna ku dhowdahay mid ka mid ah marinnada muhiimka ah ee isku xira Badweynta Hindiya iyo Badda Mediterranean-ka. falanqeeyayaasha ayaa tallaabadan u arka mid suuragal ka dhigi karta in Mareykanka iyo Eritrea ay yeeshaan xiriir istiraatiiji ah oo dhow, iyadoo Washington ay sii kordhinayso danaha ay ka leedahay amniga Badda Cas.

items.title: Sucuudiga oo qaar kamid ah magaalooyinkiisa ka hawlgeliyay nidaamka digniinta degdegga ah
items.description: Boqortooyada Sucuudiga ayaa magaalada caasimadda ah ee Riyadh ka hawlgelisay nidaam digniin hore iyo seeriga xaaladaha degdegga ah, xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha militari ee u dhexeeya Sucuudiga iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Hay’adda Difaaca Madaniga ah ee Sucuudiga ayaa xaqiijisay in nidaamka digniinta laga hawlgeliyay Riyadh, iyadoo dadka magaalada lagu wargeliyay xaaladda. Hay’addu waxay markii dambe sheegtay in xaaladdu caadi ku soo noqotay, isla markaana aysan jirin wax khatar ah oo cusub oo ay shaacisay. Hawlgelinta nidaamkan ayaa timid wax yar kadib hadal kasoo baxay afhayeenka militariga Xuutiyiinta, kaas oo sheegay in kooxdu ay fashilisay waxa uu ku tilmaamay “falal dambiyeed” oo ka dhacay magaalada Sanca. Afhayeenku wuxuu falalkaasi ku eedeeyay Sucuudiga, isagoo sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay ka jawaabi doonaan. Xiisadda u dhexeysa labada dhinac ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo Xuutiyiintu ay weli gacanta ku hayaan qaybo badan oo Yemen ah, gaar ahaan waqooyiga dalka iyo deegaannada ay ku nool yihiin inta badan shacabka Yemen. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiintu waxay sheegeen in ciidamada Sucuudigu ay maalmihii lasoo dhaafay duqeymo ka fuliyeen deegaano ay kooxdu maamusho, iyagoo tirada duqeymaha ku sheegay boqollaal. Wararka kasoo baxaya labada dhinac ayaa muujinaya in xaaladda amni ee gobolka ay sii adkaanayso, gaar ahaan meelaha ku dhow Badda Cas, halkaas oo xiisadaha militari ay saameyn ku yeelan karaan ammaanka magaalooyinka iyo isu-socodka maraakiibta. Ilaa hadda, Sucuudigu ma uusan bixin faahfaahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan sababta gaarka ah ee keentay hawlgelinta seeriga Riyadh, halka hay’adda Difaaca Madaniga ahi ay xaqiijisay in xaaladdu markii dambe caadi ahayd.

items.title: Kumuu ahaa Wariye Maxamed Aweys Muudey “Boqorka Bartamaha” ?
items.description: Allaha u naxariistee, waxaa geeriyooday wariye ruugcaddaa ah Maxamed Aweys Muudey , oo si weyn loogu yaqaanay magaca “Boqorka Bartamaha” , kana mid ahaa wejiyadii muddada dheer kasoo muuqday warbaahinta Soomaaliyeed. Geeridiisa waxaa la xaqiijiyay inuu ku geeriyooday dalka Jarmalka , halkaas oo uu sannadihii dambe ku noolaa. Sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Soomaaliya, Muudey waxaa la sheegay in lagu dilay mindi , waxaana socday baaritaanno la xiriira dhacdada. Dad goobjoogayaal ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in markii hore dhaawac ahaan loo qaaday balse uu markii Isbitaalka la geeyey u geeriyooday dhaawicii gaaray, waxaana la sheegay in dilkiisa u ka dambeeyay nin soomaali ah oo ay murmeen. Boqorka Bartamaha ayaa ka mid ahaa Wariyayaasha caanka ah ee mudada ka shaqeynayey Saxaafadda Soomaaliya isagoo sanadkii 2017 tagay dalka Jarmalka kadib markii lagasoo daayey xabsi uu muddo ku xirnaa oo ku yaalla dalka Itoobiya. Boqorka bartamaha oo ahaa wariye, Jilaa, iyo suugaanyahan muddo dheer ku soo jirey saxaafadda fanka soomaalida ayaa sanadkii 1958-kii ku dhashay magaalada muqdishu, gaar ahaan degmada shibis. Barisamaadkii wuxuu kamid ahaa wariyaashii aad loo jeclaa ee radio muqdishu iyo tiyaatarka qaranka, waxaana si gaar ah loogu xusuustaa iidhahda iyo xariirinta riwaayadaha. Maxamed Aweys Muudey wuxuu ka mid noqday wariyeyaashii muddada dheer kasoo shaqeeyay warbaahinta Muqdisho, wuxuu sidoo kale ka soo shaqeeyay barnaamijkii ololaha reer miyiga ee sanadkii 1974-tii. Mid ka mid ah dhinacyada uu si weyn ugu dhex jiray wuxuuna sidoo kale ahaa wariye caan ku noqday codkiisa, qaabkiisa werin iyo xiriirinta barnaamijyada fanka iyo madadaalada. 3-dii December 2009 , Maxamed Aweys Muudey wuxuu ka mid ahaa wariyeyaashii ku dhaawacmay qaraxii ka dhacay Hotel Shamo ee Muqdisho, xilligaas oo uu u shaqeynayay idaacaddii Somaliweyn Radio . Qaybta ugu xusuusta badan taariikhda Maxamed Aweys Muudey waxay ahayd sannadihii uu ku qaatay xabsiga Itoobiya. Waxaa la xiray dabayaaqadii 2013 , isagoo ku sugnaa Addis Ababa, sannadkii 2014-kii ayayna maxkamad Itoobiya ku taalla ku xukuntay 27 sano oo xabsi ah , iyadoo dacwaddiisa lagu xiriiriyay eedeymo la xiriiray argagixiso iyo xog ku saabsan hawlgallo Al-Shabaab. Qoyska wariyaha ayaa eedeymahaas beeniyay, ayadoo sidoo kale ururro caalami ah oo u dooda xuquuqda saxafiyiinta ay walaac ka muujiyeen habka loo maareeyay dacwaddiisa. Qoraal ka soo baxay Qaramada Midoobay ayaa lagu diiwaangeliyay eedeymo la xiriiray xarig aan sharci ahayn, jirdil iyo xadgudubyo la sheegay inay ka dhaceen intii uu xirnaa. Inkasta oo lagu xukumay 27 sano, Maxamed Aweys Muudey wuxuu xabsiga Itoobiya ku qaatay in ka badan afar sano, ayadoo Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa dadaal diblomaasiyadeed ku bixisay sii deyntiisa, waxaana December 2017 laga sii daayay xabsiga Itoobiya. 17-kii December 2017 ayuu Muqdisho ku soo laabtay, waxaana garoonka Aadan Cadde ku soo dhaweeyay qoyskiisa, wariyeyaasha iyo bahda saxaafadda. Sanadihii dambe ee noloshiisa, Muudey wuxuu ku noolaa Jarmalka , halkaas oo uu sii watay xiriirkii uu la lahaa saxaafadda iyo dhaqanka Soomaaliyeed. Geerida Maxamed Aweys Muudey ayaa la xaqiijiyay September 2026 , isagoo ku sugnaa Jarmalka, waxaana wasaaradda Warfaafinta Soomaaliya ayaa tacsi u dirtay qoyskiisa, ehelkiisa, qaraabadiisa iyo guud ahaan bahda saxaafadda Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Mareykanka oo ka fiirsanaya in dib loo dhigo iibka hubka waaweyn ee Taiwan
items.description: Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa la sheegay inay ka fiirsanayso in dib loo dhigo ku dhawaaqista heshiisyo waaweyn oo hub loogu iibinayo Taiwan, iyadoo go’aanka laga yaabo inuu dib uga dhaco shir-madaxeedka APEC ee bisha November lagu qabanayo Shenzhen, Shiinaha. Arrintan waxaa markii hore werisay South China Morning Post, oo soo xigatay ilo xog-ogaal ah. Warbixintu waxay sheegtay in dib-u-dhigista aysan ku ekaan karin shirka APEC oo keliya, balse ay suuragal tahay in Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu go’aanka ku sii riixo ilaa dhammaadka sannadka 2026. Sababta loo xusay waxaa ka mid ah kulamada la qorsheeyay ee u dhexeeya Trump iyo Madaxweynaha Shiinaha Xi Jinping, oo ay ku jiraan shirarka caalamiga ah ee dabayaaqada sannadka. Taiwan ayaa muddo dheer ka iibsanaysay Mareykanka hub iyo qalab ciidan oo ay ugu talagashay xoojinta awooddeeda difaaca. Washington waxay xiriirka difaaca Taiwan ku salaysaa heshiiska loo yaqaannoTaiwan Relations Act ee 1979, kaas oo oggolaanaya in Mareykanku siiyo Taiwan qalab ay isku difaacdo. Si kastaba, Beijing waxay si joogto ah uga soo horjeeddaa iibka hubka Mareykanka ee Taiwan, iyadoo u aragta arrintaas faragelin ku saabsan waxa ay Shiinuhu u arkaan arrin gudaha ah. Warbixinno hore oo sanadkan soo baxay ayaa muujinaya in Mareykanku horey u hakiyay ama dib u dhigay qaar ka mid ah iibka hubka Taiwan. Bishii May, saraakiil Mareykan ah ayaa sheegay in xirmo hub oo qiimaheedu gaarayo ku dhowaad $14 bilyan la hakiyay, iyadoo sidoo kale la tilmaamay baahida loo qabo in la ilaaliyo kaydka hubka Mareykanka xilli uu socday dagaalka Iran. items.title: Muwaadin Soomaaliyeed oo Sweden ku xiran oo gargaar ka dalbaday xukuumadda Soomaaliya
items.description: Qaar ka mid ah Soomaalida ku nool Sweden ayaa wajahaya qorsheyaal masaafurin ah, gaar ahaan dadka aan haysan oggolaansho sharci ah oo ay dalka ku sii joogaan, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin dad muddo dheer ku noolaa Sweden. Dadka ugu badan ee arrintani khusayso ayaa ah kuwa codsiyadooda magangelyo la diiday ama loo soo saaray go’aan kama dambays ah oo masaafurin ah. Mid ka mid ah dadka wajahaya masaafurinta ayaa ah Ca baas Bashiir Shiikh Xuseen , oo ah aabbe Soomaaliyeed oo lix carruur ah leh. Cabaas ayaa sheegay inuu Sweden muddo dheer ku noolaa, halkaasna uu ka shaqeeyay waxna ku bartay, waxaana sida uu sheegay, hadda lagu hayaa xarun dadka masaafurinta sugaya lagu xiro, ayadoo loo qorsheeyay in 22-ka September 2026 dib loogu celiyo Soomaaliya. Waxa uu sheegay in qaar ka mid ah carruurtiisa ay ku dhasheen Sweden, isla markaana uu dalkaas ku noolaa sannado badan. Cabaas ayaa sheegay in hay’adaha socdaalka Sweden ay kiiskiisa gacanta ku hayeen ku dhowaad saddex sano, isaga oo sheegay in tan iyo October 2025 lagu hayay xarunta dadka masaafurinta sugaya. Waxa uu sidoo kale ku dooday in xog aan sax ahayn lagu qoray faylkiisa socdaalka, taas oo uu aaminsan yahay inay saameyn ku yeelatay go’aanka laga gaaray xaaladdiisa sharci. Sida uu sheegay, arrintaas ayuu maxkamad uga dacwooday, isagoo sheegay inuu hayo dukumentiyo uu ku taageerayo cabashadiisa. Cabaas wuxuu sheegay in xarunta lagu hayo ay sidoo kale ku jiraan Soomaali muddo dheer Sweden ku noolaa, qaarkoodna ay leeyihiin carruur iyo qoysas ku nool dalkaas. Aabbahan ayaa dawladda Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ka codsaday in dowladda Soomaaliya ay wax ka qabato kiiskiisa, gaar ahaan haddii ay jiraan wada-hadallo ama qorshe ay labada dowladood uga wada shaqeynayaan soo celinta dadka Soomaaliyeed. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay eedeyn ah in saddex qof oo ka tirsan Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ay ku lug leeyihiin dadaallada lagu masaafurinayo, balse eedeyntaasi ma ahan mid si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijiyay. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo dowladda Soomaaliya ay October 2025 beenisay warar sheegayay in Soomaaliya iyo Sweden ay gaareen heshiis qarsoodi ah oo ku saabsan masaafurinta muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo lagu beddelanayo kaalmo horumarineed. Dowladda Soomaaliya xilligaas waxay sheegtay in eedeymahaasi ay ahaayeen kuwo aan sal lahayn, iyadoo xustay in gargaarka iyo mashaariicda horumarineed ee Soomaaliya loo maamulo hannaan ay ku jiraan Bangiga Adduunka, hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay iyo nidaamka maaliyadeed ee Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, xogta rasmiga ah ee Sweden ee safarrada Soomaaliya waxay sheegaysaa in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Sweden ay weli ka digayso safarrada Soomaaliya sababo la xiriira xaaladda amni ee dalka. Tirakoobka Statistics Sweden ayaa muujinaya in ku dhowaad 70,000 oo qof oo asal ahaan Soomaali ah ay Sweden ku noolaayeen sannadkii 2024 , taas oo ka dhigaysa bulshada Soomaaliyeed mid si weyn uga dhex muuqata dalkaas. Si kastaba ha ahaatee arrinta Cabaas ayaa dib u soo nooleynaysa doodda ku saabsan masaafurinta Soomaalida, xuquuqda dadka leh kiisaska socdaalka ee muranku ka taagan yahay, iyo kaalinta ay dowladda Soomaaliya ku yeelan karto kiisaska muwaadiniinteeda dibadda ku nool.

items.title: To stop the Houthis, recognize Somaliland and South Arab
items.description: Rather than double down on failure, the State Department must calibrate policy to reality. By Michael Rubin, Middle East Forum Last week, Houthi forces in Yemen captured the Red Sea port city of Mokha. It’s the most consequential Houthi victory since the Iranian-backed group seized the Yemeni capital Sanaa 12 years ago. While the Houthis have long targeted shipping with missiles and drones launched from the inland highlands, Mokha and nearby Perim Island give the Houthis direct control over the Bab el Mandeb gateway into the Red Sea. The price hikes American consumers have already weathered are now just the tip of the iceberg, nor will that be the end of the pain. S omali pirates are already stepping up to get their pound of flesh from ships heading around Africa. The Saudi response, bombing Mokha Airport, is laughable. The airport handled only two flights a week. The Houthis seized Mokha for its location, not its airport. Saudi whack-a-mole strikes will be no more effective now than they have been for the past decade. The Houthis’ assault on Mokha is the result of a decade of international naivete, Washington’s lack of reliability, and Riyadh’s cynicism. The Houthis seized Hodeidah, Yemen’s major Red Sea port, less than a month after they took Sanaa. Read Secret US-Houthi talks yield shocking result for Israel The international coalition was ready to wrest the port from the Houthis in 2017, but human rights organizations voiced concern that any interruption of port activities could have humanitarian ramifications. While true, they ignored that the Houthis hijacked aid and used food as a weapon. Instead of eradicating the Houthis, the United Nations brokered the 2018 Stockholm Accords. In theory, the Houthis would leave the port, and the U.N. would inspect ships. But in practice, the Houthis stayed, the U.N. paid their salaries, and the U.N. agreed only to inspect ships that volunteered for inspection. Far more Yemenis have now died because of such smoke-and-mirrors than would have if the coalition military had just finished the job. Amnesty International has blood on its hands because of its reflexive hostility to military action. President Donald Trump also blew an opportunity. He both began and ended his bombing campaign with zero coordination with allies or anti-Houthi forces in Yemen. Worse, he cut a separate deal: The U.S. would cease bombing Houthis, and the Houthis would not attack U.S. targets. He left the Israelis, Greek ships, Indian crewmen, and others at the mercy of the Houthis. The region saw it as weak and concluded they could not trust Washington. Read UN Security Council to discuss Houthi takeover of Yemen’s Red Sea coast Saudi cynicism was also self-defeating. Saudi Crown Prince Muhammad bin Salman struck a similar bargain with the Houthis, trading a cessation of Saudi bombing for Houthi silence. He then sought to empower the Yemeni Muslim Brotherhood as his proxy, even as its personnel smuggled weaponry to the Houthis. Finally, by kneecapping southern Yemeni fighters, bin Salman hobbled the only Yemeni group capable of standing up to the Houthis. Rather than double down on failure, the State Department must calibrate policy to reality. International relations have no do-over, but there is a way forward if Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio want to win rather than send the U.S. economy into a tailspin. First, there is Somaliland. Somaliland has operated independently of Somalia longer than it was ever part of that failed state. It is a pro-Western democracy with the strongest counter-terror record in the region. Sitting astride the Gulf of Aden, its Berbera Airport once served as an emergency landing site for the Space Shuttle. Four-man aircrews can patrol the Bab el Mandeb faster and for cheaper than an aircraft carrier. Berbera, with its highway straight into Ethiopia, can also accommodate the oilers that replenish U.S. carriers at sea. If the Houthi conquest of Mokha holds and Riyadh’s Yemeni proxies turn over the keys of southern Yemen to the Houthis, Iran will control 1,750 miles of key Indian Ocean coastline from Pakistan to Djibouti. Read US boots hit the ground in Saudi Arabia as Houthi war intensifies Recognizing South Arabia, the original post-colonial plan for the region, would bypass Saudi incompetence and isolate the Houthis. Defeating the Houthis would be possible only if the State Department stopped playing by an artificial set of rules.

items.title: Mareykanka oo ogolaaday in Soomaaliya ay hal sano sii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa oggolaatay in Qaramada Midoobay la siiyo sanad dheeri ah oo ay si tartiib ah ugu soo afjarto taageerada ay siiso ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, xilli weli uu mugdi weyn ku jiro mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM. Go’aankan ayaa meesha ka saaraya cabsi laga qabay in taageerada muhiimka ah ee Qaramada Midoobay ay si lama filaan ah u joogsato dhammaadka sanadkan, balse ma baabi’inayo khatarta dhaqaale iyo midda saadka ee wajahaysa howlgalka Midowga Afrika. Sida ay Reuters ku warrantay, qoraal diblomaasiyadeed oo Mareykanku la wadaagay safaarado toddobaadkii hore ayaa lagu sheegay in Washington ay diyaar u tahay inay taageerto muddo 12 bilood ah oo lagu dhimayo howlaha Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, UNSOS, ka hor inta aan gebi ahaanba la xirin. “Dowladda Mareykanka waxay diyaar u tahay inay taageerto muddo 12 bilood ah oo howlaha lagu dhimayo, taas oo isla markiiba ay ku xigi doonto xiritaanka xafiiska,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka ay aragtay Reuters. Laba diblomaasi iyo mas’uul ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa Reuters u sheegay in muddadaas 12-ka bilood ah ay bilaaban doonto Janaayo 2027. Tallaabadan ayaa Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadeeda siinaysa waqti dheeri ah oo ay ku raadiyaan ilo kale oo dhaqaale iyo hannaan cusub oo lagu taageero ciidamada AUSSOM, balse waxay sidoo kale caddeyneysaa in Washington aysan doonayn in taageerada hadda jirta ay sii socoto muddo dheer. UNSOS ayaa laf-dhabar u ah howlgalka AUSSOM, waxaana uu ciidamada Midowga Afrika siiyaa adeegyo muhiim ah oo ay ka mid yihiin cunto, biyo, shidaal, adeeg caafimaad iyo gaadiidka ciidamada. AUSSOM ayaa dowladda Soomaaliya ka taageerta dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo sugidda ammaanka deegaanno muhiim ah. Mareykanka ayaa bishii Luulyo Midowga Afrika ku wargeliyay inuu ka soo horjeedo in Qaramada Midoobay ay sii waddo taageerada howlgalka laga bilaabo sanadka soo socda, arrintaas oo sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo mustaqbalka ciidanka. Reuters ayaa markaas sheegtay in Washington ay sii kordheysay walaaca ay ka qabto xaaladda dowladda Soomaaliya iyo joogtaynta taageerada caalamiga ah ee howlgalka. Afhayeen u hadlay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa Reuters u sheegay in Washington aysan mustaqbalka maalgelin doonin ama taageeri doonin UNSOS, oo miisaaniyaddiisa guud lagu qiyaaso ku dhowaad $500 milyan. “Waxaan filaynaa in hannaanka iyo jadwalka dhimista howlaha laga wada hadlo marka Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay uu arrintan ka doodo bisha Diseembar,” ayuu afhayeenku yiri. Shan ilo diblomaasiyadeed iyo mas’uul ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa Reuters u xaqiijiyay qorshaha muddada 12-ka bilood ah. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, UNSOS iyo Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaan markiiba ka jawaabin codsiyo Reuters ay u dirtay si ay uga hadlaan arrintan. Mustaqbalka AUSSOM oo weli mugdi ku jira In kasta oo muddada cusub ay yareyneyso halista ah in taageerada si degdeg ah loo joojiyo, haddana dhibaatada ugu weyn ee AUSSOM waa mid weli taagan: cidda bixin doonta dhaqaalaha iyo saadka howlgalka marka taageerada Qaramada Midoobay dhammaato. Afyare Elmi, oo bare ka ah City University of Mogadishu, ayaa sheegay in AUSSOM uu muhiim u yahay xasilloonida dowladnimada Soomaaliya. “AUSSOM waa tiir muhiim u ah dowladda Soomaaliya,” ayuu Reuters u sheegay. “La’aantiis, dalka wuxuu wajihi karaa khatar dhab ah oo ah kala daadasho iyo burbur dowladeed.” Samira Gaid, oo ah falanqeeye dhinaca ammaanka gobolka ah, ayaa iyaduna sheegtay in xiritaanka UNSOS uu halis gelin karo sii jiritaanka howlgalka AUSSOM. “Midowga Afrika waa inuu helaa hannaan kale oo saadka lagu maareeyo, ama waa inuu ciidamadiisa dhimaa oo baxaa,” ayay Reuters u sheegtay. Maalgelinta AUSSOM ayaa muddooyinkii dambe noqotay mid sii adkaaneysa, iyadoo howlgalka uu wajahayo farqi dhaqaale oo weyn. Mareykanka ayaa sanadkii hore hor istaagay qorshe la doonayay in lagu dabaqo hannaan cusub oo maalgelin ah, kaas oo Qaramada Midoobay ay ku bixin lahayd saddex meelood afar meelood miisaaniyadda sanadlaha ah ee howlgalka, oo lagu qiyaasay $190 milyan. Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika ayaa muddo dheer ku baaqayay maalgelin la saadaalin karo oo joogto ah, iyagoo ka digayay in dhaqaale la’aantu ay wiiqi karto howlgalka xilli ciidamada Soomaaliya ay weli dagaal culus kula jiraan Al-Shabaab. Go’aanka cusub ee Washington sidaas darteed wuxuu dib u dhigaya khatarta degdegga ah ee ka dhalan lahayd joojinta taageerada dhammaadka Diseembar, balse wuxuu Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika siinayaa muddo kooban oo ay ku helaan xal kale. Haddii aan la helin cid beddesha taageerada UNSOS ama hannaan cusub oo lagu maalgeliyo saadka AUSSOM, howlgalka Midowga Afrika ayaa wajahaya go’aan adag marka muddada 12-ka bilood ah ay dhammaato: in si weyn loo dhimo ciidamadiisa ama gebi ahaanba laga baxo Soomaaliya. Go’aankan ayaa meesha ka saaraya cabsi laga qabay in taageerada muhiimka ah ee Qaramada Midoobay ay si lama filaan ah u joogsato dhammaadka sanadkan, balse ma baabi’inayo khatarta dhaqaale iyo midda saadka ee wajahaysa howlgalka Midowga Afrika. Sida ay Reuters ku warrantay, qoraal diblomaasiyadeed oo Mareykanku la wadaagay safaarado toddobaadkii hore ayaa lagu sheegay in Washington ay diyaar u tahay inay taageerto muddo 12 bilood ah oo lagu dhimayo howlaha Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, UNSOS, ka hor inta aan gebi ahaanba la xirin. “Dowladda Mareykanka waxay diyaar u tahay inay taageerto muddo 12 bilood ah oo howlaha lagu dhimayo, taas oo isla markiiba ay ku xigi doonto xiritaanka xafiiska,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka ay aragtay Reuters. Laba diblomaasi iyo mas’uul ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa Reuters u sheegay in muddadaas 12-ka bilood ah ay bilaaban doonto Janaayo 2027. Tallaabadan ayaa Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadeeda siinaysa waqti dheeri ah oo ay ku raadiyaan ilo kale oo dhaqaale iyo hannaan cusub oo lagu taageero ciidamada AUSSOM, balse waxay sidoo kale caddeyneysaa in Washington aysan doonayn in taageerada hadda jirta ay sii socoto muddo dheer. UNSOS ayaa laf-dhabar u ah howlgalka AUSSOM, waxaana uu ciidamada Midowga Afrika siiyaa adeegyo muhiim ah oo ay ka mid yihiin cunto, biyo, shidaal, adeeg caafimaad iyo gaadiidka ciidamada. AUSSOM ayaa dowladda Soomaaliya ka taageerta dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo sugidda ammaanka deegaanno muhiim ah. Mareykanka ayaa bishii Luulyo Midowga Afrika ku wargeliyay inuu ka soo horjeedo in Qaramada Midoobay ay sii waddo taageerada howlgalka laga bilaabo sanadka soo socda, arrintaas oo sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo mustaqbalka ciidanka. Reuters ayaa markaas sheegtay in Washington ay sii kordheysay walaaca ay ka qabto xaaladda dowladda Soomaaliya iyo joogtaynta taageerada caalamiga ah ee howlgalka. Afhayeen u hadlay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa Reuters u sheegay in Washington aysan mustaqbalka maalgelin doonin ama taageeri doonin UNSOS, oo miisaaniyaddiisa guud lagu qiyaaso ku dhowaad $500 milyan. “Waxaan filaynaa in hannaanka iyo jadwalka dhimista howlaha laga wada hadlo marka Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay uu arrintan ka doodo bisha Diseembar,” ayuu afhayeenku yiri. Shan ilo diblomaasiyadeed iyo mas’uul ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa Reuters u xaqiijiyay qorshaha muddada 12-ka bilood ah. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, UNSOS iyo Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaan markiiba ka jawaabin codsiyo Reuters ay u dirtay si ay uga hadlaan arrintan. Mustaqbalka AUSSOM oo weli mugdi ku jira In kasta oo muddada cusub ay yareyneyso halista ah in taageerada si degdeg ah loo joojiyo, haddana dhibaatada ugu weyn ee AUSSOM waa mid weli taagan: cidda bixin doonta dhaqaalaha iyo saadka howlgalka marka taageerada Qaramada Midoobay dhammaato. Afyare Elmi, oo bare ka ah City University of Mogadishu, ayaa sheegay in AUSSOM uu muhiim u yahay xasilloonida dowladnimada Soomaaliya. “AUSSOM waa tiir muhiim u ah dowladda Soomaaliya,” ayuu Reuters u sheegay. “La’aantiis, dalka wuxuu wajihi karaa khatar dhab ah oo ah kala daadasho iyo burbur dowladeed.” Samira Gaid, oo ah falanqeeye dhinaca ammaanka gobolka ah, ayaa iyaduna sheegtay in xiritaanka UNSOS uu halis gelin karo sii jiritaanka howlgalka AUSSOM. “Midowga Afrika waa inuu helaa hannaan kale oo saadka lagu maareeyo, ama waa inuu ciidamadiisa dhimaa oo baxaa,” ayay Reuters u sheegtay. Maalgelinta AUSSOM ayaa muddooyinkii dambe noqotay mid sii adkaaneysa, iyadoo howlgalka uu wajahayo farqi dhaqaale oo weyn. Mareykanka ayaa sanadkii hore hor istaagay qorshe la doonayay in lagu dabaqo hannaan cusub oo maalgelin ah, kaas oo Qaramada Midoobay ay ku bixin lahayd saddex meelood afar meelood miisaaniyadda sanadlaha ah ee howlgalka, oo lagu qiyaasay $190 milyan. Dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika ayaa muddo dheer ku baaqayay maalgelin la saadaalin karo oo joogto ah, iyagoo ka digayay in dhaqaale la’aantu ay wiiqi karto howlgalka xilli ciidamada Soomaaliya ay weli dagaal culus kula jiraan Al-Shabaab. Go’aanka cusub ee Washington sidaas darteed wuxuu dib u dhigaya khatarta degdegga ah ee ka dhalan lahayd joojinta taageerada dhammaadka Diseembar, balse wuxuu Soomaaliya iyo Midowga Afrika siinayaa muddo kooban oo ay ku helaan xal kale. Haddii aan la helin cid beddesha taageerada UNSOS ama hannaan cusub oo lagu maalgeliyo saadka AUSSOM, howlgalka Midowga Afrika ayaa wajahaya go’aan adag marka muddada 12-ka bilood ah ay dhammaato: in si weyn loo dhimo ciidamadiisa ama gebi ahaanba laga baxo Soomaaliya. items.title: Maxaa ka jira in Soomaaliya ay xanibaad dal ku-gal saartay muwaadiniinta Turkiga?
items.description: Ankara (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Turkiga ayaa beenisay warar lagu faafiyay baraha bulshada oo sheegayay in Soomaaliya ay xannibaad dal-ku-gal ku soo rogtay muwaadiniinta Turkiga, iyadoo caddeysay in aanu jirin wax isbeddel ah oo lagu sameeyay nidaamka isu-socodka labada dal. Qoraal kasoo baxay xarunta DMM ee la-dagaallanka wararka been-abuurka ah ee Madaxtooyada Turkiga ayaa lagu sheegay in wararka sheegaya in “Soomaaliya ay muwaadiniinta Turkiga xannibaad dal-ku-gal saartay” ay yihiin kuwo been abuur ah oo marin-habaabin ah. Dowladda Turkiga ayaa sheegtay in labada dal ay weli leeyihiin heshiisyo iyo nidaamyo u oggolaanaya isu-socodka muwaadiniintooda, iyadoo xustay in aan wax isbeddel ah lagu sameyn shuruudaha dal-ku-galka (Visa-ha) ee u dhexeeya Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya. Bayaanka ayaa sidoo kale waxay dowladda Turkiga ku caddeysay in aysan jirin wax go’aan cusub ah oo lagu xannibayo ama lagu adkeynayo isu-socodka muwaadiniinta labada dal. DMM ayaa ugu dambeyn bulshada ugu baaqday inay ka taxaddaraan wararka aan kasoo bixin ilo rasmi ah, isla markaana ay xogta ku saabsan isu-socodka iyo shuruudaha dal-ku-galka ka raadsadaan hay’adaha dowladda ee ay khuseyso. Beeninta Turkiga ayaa imanaysa kadib markii baraha bulshada lagu baahiyay sheegashooyin la xiriiray in dowladda Soomaaliya ay diiday dal-ku-galka muwaadiniin Turki ah oo doonayay inay dalka yimaadaan. Warkan ayaa waxaa si weyn u faafiyay baraha bulshada kooxaha mucaaradka Turkiga, kuwaas oo saacadihii lasoo dhaafay soo gudbinayay inuu isbeddel ku yimid nidaamka Visa-da Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga. items.title: Maraykanka oo taageeray in hal sano lagu kordhiyo muddada taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee AUSSOM
items.description: Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa oggolaatay in Qaramada Midoobay ay hal sano oo dheeraad ah sii waddo taageerada saadka ee howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya AUSSOM, sida lagu sheegay dukumenti diblomaasiyadeed ay heshay Reuters. Qorshahan ayaa dhigaya in laga bilaabo Janaayo 2027 si tartiib-tartiib ah loo dhimo howlaha UNSOS, oo ah xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee taageera AUSSOM, halkii taageerada si degdeg ah loo soo afjari lahaa. UNSOS ayaa AUSSOM u fidisa adeegyo muhiim ah oo ay ka mid yihiin cunto, biyo, shidaal, gaadiid, adeegyo caafimaad, duulimaadyo iyo taageero farsamo iyo saadka. Go’aankan ayaa AUSSOM siinaya waqti dheeraad ah oo ay ku qorsheysato mustaqbalka howlgalka, xilli ay weli jiraan caqabado dhinaca maalgelinta ah. Qaramada Midoobay waxay hore u sheegtay in miisaaniyadda AUSSOM markii hore lagu qiyaasay $190.2 milyan sanadkii, inkastoo qiyaasta dambe lagu sheegay $166.5 milyan iyadoo lagu saleynayo heerka lacag-bixinta ciidamada. AUSSOM ayaa hadda haysata mandate-ka Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay oo soconaya ilaa 31 Diseembar 2026, iyadoo UNSOS-na loo igmaday taageerada saadka ee howlgalka muddadaas.

items.title: Beesha Cayr oo Muqdisho ku soo dhaweysay Musharraxa Madaxweynaha Galmudug Liibaan Axmed Xasan
items.description: Muqdisho, 18 Sebteembar 2026 — Musharraxa Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Liibaan Axmed Xasan, ayaa magaalada Muqdisho kaga qeyb galay kulan soo dhaweyn iyo maamuus ah oo ay u sameeyeen bulshada, siyaasiyiinta iyo waxgaradka beesha Cayr. Kulanka waxaa sidoo kale musharraxa ku wehliyay xubno ka tirsan labada Aqal ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya. Liibaan Axmed Xasan ayaa uga mahadceliyay beesha Cayr soo dhaweynta iyo taageerada ay u muujisay, isagoo sheegay in kalsoonida loo muujiyay ay tahay masuuliyad weyn iyo dhiirrigelin ku aaddan dadaallada uu ugu jiro hoggaanka iyo horumarka Galmudug. Musharraxa ayaa xusay in beesha Cayr ay door muuqda ku lahayd geeddi-socodkii doorashadii hore ee Galmudug, isagoo sheegay in kulanka maanta uu muujinayo sida ay beesha uga go’an tahay inay kaalin dheeraad ah ka qaadato mustaqbalka siyaasadeed iyo bulsho ee Galmudug. Liibaan Axmed Xasan ayaa ah musharraxa rasmiga ah ee Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ugu tartamaya hoggaanka Galmudug muddo-xileedka 2026–2031. Kulankan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Galmudug uu ka socdo diyaar-garowga doorashada ku-celiska ah, kaddib markii Maxkamadda Sare ay laashay natiijadii doorashooyinkii hore, iyadoo musharraxa JSP uu soo dhaweeyay go’aanka dib-u-qabashada doorashada.

items.title: Tigray Conflict Intensifies Amid Sudan’s Tumultuous Civil War
items.description: Addis Ababa (WDN) – Fighting between the Ethiopian federal forces and TPLF troops has intensified over the past two days, with reports of military movements and skirmishes emerging from various parts of Tigray and areas near the Ethiopia-Sudan border. In western Tigray, particularly in Wolqayt and along the Tekeze River, the TPLF has reportedly initiated troop movements, mobilizing a significant number of forces in the region. Reports indicate that heavy weaponry has been employed in some of the skirmishes, signaling that tensions between the two sides have escalated from minor clashes to the brink of major confrontations. The Ethiopian government claims that nearly 300 TPLF fighters have surrendered to its forces in the Tekeze area. According to state media outlet Fana, these surrendered fighters were handed over to the Ethiopian military along with over 280 various types of weapons, ammunition, military equipment, and documents. It was also stated that some of the defectors included officers and commanders of various ranks. However, the Ethiopian government’s claims and those from supportive media require independent verification, as reports from the Tigray conflict are often conveyed inconsistently by the opposing sides. On another front, TPLF-supportive media have reported that their forces shot down or destroyed an uncrewed aerial vehicle being used by Ethiopian forces. If verified independently, this would represent a significant development in the ongoing Tigray conflict. So far, this claim has not received sufficient independent confirmation. Battlefronts Merge At the same time, the civil war in Sudan is increasingly encroaching on Ethiopia’s borders, particularly in the Blue Nile region. The Rapid Support Forces (RSF) and their allied forces are conducting attacks across various areas in the Blue Nile, while the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) are working to defend critical roads and bases near the Ethiopian border. A recent report from Sudan War Monitor indicated that the RSF released footage claiming to show Tigrayan fighters and leaders battling Sudanese forces. One individual featured in the video was identified by RSF as a TPLF officer. However, the report clarifies that independent verification of the individuals’ identities or their alleged TPLF affiliations is not possible. This situation underscores the interconnectedness of the conflicts in Ethiopia and Sudan, particularly as Tigray shares a border with Sudan, while the Blue Nile region borders Ethiopia. In recent days, the Sudanese government has directly accused Ethiopia of exploiting the ongoing conflict in Sudan to expand its influence or seize land along the border, including parts of Al-Fashaga and Blue Nile. Sudanese officials have also accused Ethiopia of orchestrating attacks launched by the RSF from its territory. Ethiopia has previously denied such allegations. The tension has escalated to a point where Sudanese forces reported days ago that they had shot down drones targeting critical facilities close to the Ethiopian border. They claimed these drones were aimed at the Upper Atbara and Setit dams, as well as Khashm al-Girba. Consequently, the regional conflict is taking on a multi-faceted battlefield appearance. On one side, clashes are occurring between Ethiopian forces and the TPLF, with Wolqayt and Tekeze highlighted as key areas of focus. On the other hand, the Sudan conflict expands into Blue Nile and towards the Ethiopian border, with the RSF and its allies striving to broaden the territory under their control. Previous reports this month have also indicated significant military activity inside Ethiopia, particularly around Asosa, linking that region to the RSF’s fighting and the ongoing conflicts in Blue Nile. All of these factors illustrate that the conflicts in Ethiopia and Sudan are increasingly intertwined, with the border between the two countries becoming a nexus for military activities involving Ethiopian forces, TPLF, RSF, and the Sudanese military. The situation remains rapidly changing, making it crucial to distinguish claims from the fighting sides from information verified by independent sources. The continued escalation is deeply disappointing, as it suggests that a resolution to these conflicts is still far from reach. items.title: Milateriga Pakistan oo ku dhawaaqay difaacista Sacuudiga
items.description: Islamabad (Caasimada Online) – Milateriga Pakistan ayaa sheegay inay qaadi doonaan tallaabo kasta oo lagama maarmaan ah si uu u difaaco Sacuudiga, xilli xiisad amni ay ka jirto gobolka, isla markaana walaac laga muujinayo weerarro lagu beegsanayo boqortooyada. Afhayeenka milateriga Pakistan, Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry ayaa wareysi uu siiyay wargeyska Arab News ku sheegay in Islamabad ay Sacuudiga ka taageereyso dhinacyada diblomaasiyadda iyo milatariga. “Waxaan qaadi doonnaa tallaabo kasta oo lagama maarmaan ah si loo xaqiijiyo amniga labada Masjid ee barakaysan iyo Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya,” ayuu yiri Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry. Hadalkan ayaa yimid kadib weerar lagu qaaday dhuunta shidaalka ee tagta dekedda Yanbu, kaas oo sababay hakad ku yimid shidaalka uu Sacuudiga dhoofiyo. Xuutiyiinta ayaa dhankooda sheegay in weerarrada ay qaadayaan ay jawaab u yihiin duqeymo ay Sacuudigu si joogto ah uga fuliyo cirka, halka Riyaad ay kooxda ku eedeysay inay weerar “fulaynimo ah” ku qaaday Makah. Xuutiyiinta ayaa beeniyay eedeynta ku saabsan weerarka Makah. Weerarka la sheegay in lagu qaaday Makah ayaa dhaliyay falcelin xooggan, waxaana walaac ka muujiyay dalal badan oo Islaam ah, iyadoo indhaha lagu hayo xaaladda amni ee Sacuudiga iyo saameynta ay xiisadaha gobolka ku yeelan karaan goobaha barakaysan. Pakistan, Sacuudiga iyo Turkiga ayaa 6-dii August kala saxiixday heshiis loogu magac daray “heshiiska difaaca Makah”, kaas oo ay ku caddeeyeen in weerar lagu qaado mid kamid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsan doono weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Pakistan ayaa haatan si cad u muujinaysa sida ay uga go’an tahay taageerada Sacuudiga, gaar ahaan ilaalinta amniga boqortooyada iyo labada Masjid ee barakaysan.
