items.title: Melodies of Change: Somaliland’s Decision to Curb Tribal Songs
items.description: Hargeisa (WDN) – The Somaliland administration, specifically its Ministry of Information, has made a groundbreaking decision to prohibit artists from creating and performing songs that promote or glorify clan identities. This marks the first time local authorities have taken such a step, reflecting a significant shift in their approach to addressing clan-based divisions in a region where tribal affiliations have historically played a substantial role in social dynamics. Music instrument The Minister of Information, who also serves as the government spokesperson, announced the decision on September 17, 2016. He emphasized that the move aims to prevent songs from encouraging tribalism or exacerbating social divisions, which can lead to conflict and instability. “Today marks a pivotal moment as the Ministry of Information has halted the production of songs that praise or motivate clan affiliations, which could ultimately foster clan-based tensions and societal fragmentation. Music is a reflection of our culture and identity—it should not be used as a tool for tribalism and division,” stated the Minister. This directive represents a significant stand against the longstanding tradition of tribal-themed music, which has often celebrated clan pride at the expense of national unity. By recognizing the power of music in shaping public sentiment, the government is attempting to reshape the cultural narrative to promote inclusiveness rather than division. Moreover, the Minister urged security agencies and relevant institutions to collaborate with the government in enforcing this directive as per established regulations. This call to action indicates a comprehensive approach to addressing the issue, involving multiple stakeholders in the effort to foster a more cohesive society. The implications of this decision extend beyond the music industry; it highlights the critical influence that local media and artistic expression can have on societal cohesion in Somaliland. Art, particularly music, wields significant power in shaping cultural narratives and public perceptions. By taking a stand against tribalism in music, the government not only seeks to protect national unity but also underscores the importance of responsible media practices in nurturing a collective identity. As Somaliland continues to navigate its post-civil war identity and the challenges of clan politics, this bold move by the Ministry of Information serves as a crucial step in promoting social harmony and reducing the sectarian tensions that have historically plagued the region. The outcome of this initiative will likely prompt ongoing discussions about the role of artists and the media in society, as well as the balance between cultural expression and social responsibility. items.title: US gives UN more time to end support for Somalia peacekeepers
items.description: The United States has agreed to give the UN another ​year to wind down its support for African peacekeepers in Somalia, a document showed – a move that gives some ‌breathing space to a force that was fearing quicker cuts, but still leaves its future in peril. Reuters reported in July that Washington – increasingly frustrated with the fragile administration in Mogadishu – said it would block the UN from supporting the African Union force which props up the government and helps it fight al Qaeda-linked militants. Analysts have warned ​that any weakening of the African Union peacekeepers would severely undermine the government there and could exacerbate the political turmoil ​in a combustible region bordering the Red Sea. ‘A REAL RISK OF STATE FRAGMENTATION’ The peacekeepers, known as the AU ⁠Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia, rely heavily on UN support for essential logistics such as food, water, fuel, medical services and transportation ​of troops. The administration of U.S. President Donald Trump, which has pulled back from many international commitments, had told the African Union in a diplomatic note in ​July that it would use its clout to prevent the UN supporting the peacekeepers from the start of next year. In another diplomatic note seen by Reuters and shared with embassies last week, Washington said “the United States is willing to support a 12-month drawdown followed immediately by liquidation” of the UN Support Office in ​Somalia (UNSOS). Without that 12-month window, the funding could have stopped at the end of December, when the mandate of that UN office expires. Two diplomatic sources ​and a Somali government source said the new 12-month countdown would start in January. A spokesperson for the US State Department told Reuters that Washington would no longer ‌fund or ⁠support the UN office in Somalia, whose total budget is around $500 million. “We would expect any drawdown processes and timelines to be discussed during UN Security Council deliberations in December,” the spokesperson said in a statement. Five diplomatic sources and the Somali government source, speaking on condition of anonymity, confirmed the 12-month deadline. Somalia’s defence ministry, UNSOS and the African Union Commission did not immediately respond to requests for comment. FUNDING GAPS The move will ​buy Somalia and its partners some ​more time to find other ⁠backers, but does not lift the threat over the peacekeeping force’s future. “AUSSOM is a key pillar of Somalia’s state,” Afyare Elmi, professor at the City University of Mogadishu, said. “Without it, the country would face a ​real risk of state fragmentation and disintegration.” Samira Gaid, a regional security analyst, told Reuters the shutdown of ​UNSOS could spell ⁠the end for AUSSOM. “The AU either (needs) to find alternative logistics arrangements or to draw down and exit,” she said. Financing for the AU mission has become increasingly precarious, leading to a huge funding shortfall. Washington last year blocked a plan to shift to a financing model that would have seen UN ⁠funds cover ​three-quarters of the peacekeeping mission’s $190 million annual budget. Somalia has been mired in chaos and internal ​conflict since the fall of autocratic ruler Mohamed Siad Barre in 1991. Islamists have strengthened their control of the countryside and two decades ago, seized the capital before being ​forced out by a joint Ethiopian and Somali government force. Reuters .

items.title: Muxuu Cabdirashiid JANAN ka wadaa Beledxaawo?
items.description: Beledxaawo (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha Hay’adda Nabad-sugidda iyo Sirdoonka Qaranka ee Jubaland ahna hoggaanka guud ee amniga maamulkaasi, Cabdirashiid Xasan Cabdinuur (Janan) ayaa howlo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga gobolka Gedo ka wada magaalada Beledxaawo, halkaasi oo uu ka qabsoomay kulan looga hadlayo xaaladda amni ee gobolka. Kulanka uu Janan guddoomiyay ayaa diirada lagu saaray xaaladda nabadgelyada Gedo iyo tallaabooyinka la xiriira amniga deegaanada gobolka, waxaana ka qeyb-galay saraakiil ka tirsan ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya, booliska iyo maamulka degmada Beledxaawo. Janan ayaa kulanka ka sheegay in heshiiskii nabadeed ee ay gaareen dhinacyadii ku kala aragti duwanaa arrimaha Gedo uu marayo heer gaba-gabo ah, isagoo ku baaqay in la ilaaliyo xasilloonida iyo nabadda deegaanka. Arrinta kale ee uu si gaar ah u dul istaagay ayaa ahayd ciidamada ku sugan deegaanka Cumar Jilicoow, kuwaas oo uu faray ciidamada kale in aan lala hadlin ama dhibaato loo geysan haddii ay magaalada Beledxaawo yimaadaan. Taliyaha ayaa sidoo kale ciidamada ku amray inay si buuxda ugu diyaar garoobaan xaalad kasta oo amni, taas oo qeyb ka ah qorshaha lagu wajahayo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada cusub ee ka socda gobolka Gedo. Sidoo kale, Janan ayaa faray ciidamada inay isu diyaariyaan dhaqaaq ku wajahan magaalada Doolow ee Soomaaliya, xilli dowladda iyo maamulka degmadaasi ay heshiiyeen, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda ay haatan ku sugan yihiin magaalada. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli gobolka Gedo uu wajahayo xaalad siyaasadeed iyo amni oo xasaasi ah, iyadoo hadalka Janan iyo amarrada uu bixiyay ay muujinayaan in dhinacyada kala duwan ay isu diyaarinayaan marxalad cusub oo la xiriirta maamulka iyo amniga gobolka. The post Muxuu Cabdirashiid JANAN ka wadaa Beledxaawo? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Navigating Turbulent Times: Former Somali Leader Urges Somalis to Confront Challenges Together
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN)- Former Somali President Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed has warned that Somalia is currently experiencing a challenging political, security, and economic phase. He emphasized the need for the Somali people to unify their thoughts and efforts in addressing the country’s prevailing issues. Speaking at an event organized by the Himilo Qaran party, Ahmed highlighted that the gathering comes at a critical juncture for the nation. “This meeting arrives during a heavy political crisis. Its purpose is to exchange ideas on how to navigate the existing challenges, unite the Somali people, and advance the country’s development,” he stated. The former president reflected on the difficulties Somalia has faced over the past 35 years, including death, displacement, and social fragmentation. He acknowledged the various efforts that had been made during this period to restore governance, stability, and unity among the Somali people. Ahmed stressed that the current political, security, and economic climate requires a collective approach from the Somali people to overcome existing challenges. “We are at a difficult stage that demands the Somali people come together to share their opinions and unify their thoughts to move beyond this phase,” he remarked. He also emphasized that the national situation should not be viewed solely through the lens of elections and political contests but rather understood as a matter affecting the fate and existence of the Somali people. “This is not just about positions and elections; it touches on the destiny and survival of our nation,” he stated. Furthermore, Sheikh Sharif highlighted that Somalia cannot ignore the changes and events occurring in the region and globally, noting that external circumstances could impact the country’s security, politics, and economy. He underscored the importance of formulating a comprehensive understanding and strategy tailored to internal conditions and regional developments. In his closing remarks, the former president urged both Somalis residing within the country and those in the diaspora to collaborate on finding solutions to the existing challenges. He asserted that the problems caused by displacement, death, and loss among the Somali people cannot continue, expressing hope that ongoing political discussions and gatherings could lead to actionable steps to address the country’s situation. Sheikh Sharif’s remarks come at a time when Somalia is embroiled in political discourse regarding the country’s direction, the electoral process, and the relationship between the federal government, regional administrations, and various political factions. items.title: Political Violence Addressed: 14-Month Sentence for Attacker of Ilhan Omar
items.description: Minneapolis – (WDN) – A federal court in Minnesota has sentenced 56-year-old Anthony James Kazmierczak to 14 months in prison after he was found guilty of assaulting U.S. Representative Ilhan Omar during a town hall meeting in Minneapolis on January 27, 2026. Kazmierczak was sentenced on Thursday to 14 months in prison, followed by three years of supervised release, after admitting to the assault. In May, he previously confessed to attacking a federal officer. Court documents reveal that he had premeditated the assault, fueled by his political opposition to Omar’s views. During the incident, Kazmierczak was seated in the front row of the event when he unexpectedly approached Omar. He was carrying a syringe filled with a liquid later confirmed to be apple cider vinegar, which came into contact with Omar’s clothing and skin. Kazmierczak also shouted abusive remarks at Omar before being swiftly subdued by her security team and subsequently arrested by Minneapolis police. Fortunately, Omar was unharmed and continued with the town hall meeting despite the attack. Prosecutors indicated that the assault was not a spontaneous act. According to filings presented to the court, Kazmierczak had sent messages to at least three individuals prior to the meeting, indicating his intent to disrupt the event. Further evidence presented to the court revealed that Kazmierczak had spoken with a neighbor about caring for his dog and had sought information regarding bail arrangements, which the prosecution argued demonstrated he anticipated being arrested after the incident. Following the assault, Kazmierczak sent Omar an apology text stating, “I’m sorry if I scared you.” Judge Joan N. Ericksen characterized the attack as a deliberate act rather than a random occurrence, noting that Kazmierczak had obtained tickets to the meeting weeks prior. Prosecutors also shared posts Kazmierczak made on social media, in which he criticized former President Joe Biden and the Democratic Party while expressing support for former President Donald Trump. The U.S. Department of Justice noted that Kazmierczak acknowledged his attack was linked to his opposition to Omar’s political beliefs. Minnesota U.S. Attorney Daniel N. Rosen remarked that this case exemplifies instances where some individuals transform their political grievances into criminal acts. Kazmierczak expressed regret for the incident during the court proceedings and extended his apologies to Omar. The new sentencing order also prohibits Kazmierczak from contacting Omar during his supervised release. Ilhan Omar, a Somali-American congresswoman representing Minnesota, has long been a prominent figure in U.S. political debates, particularly concerning immigration and federal policies. items.title: Further Sanctions on Cuba’s Mineral Wealth and Military Modernization Apparatus
items.description: Further Sanctions on Cuba’s Mineral Wealth and Military Modernization Apparatus Press Statement Marco Rubio, Secretary of State September 17, 2026 For decades, the Cuban regime has channeled all of the island’s resources into the hands of a narrow and corrupt military elite, leaving ordinary Cubans without reliable power, food, or dignity. Today, pursuant to President Trump’s Executive Order (E.O.) 14404, “Imposing Sanctions on Those Responsible for Repression in Cuba and for Threats to United States National Security and Foreign Policy,” I am designating 11 actors that fuel this exploitation: four state-run enterprises that strip Cuba’s nickel reserves for regime profit, four military enterprises dedicated to research and development for weapons systems, naval capabilities, and battlefield simulation, and three military officials leading them. The Trump Administration will not stand by as Cuba’s elite enrich themselves through resource extraction and hoard resources for Cuba’s repressive security apparatus while the Cuban people go without. President Trump remains committed to a Cuba governed by its people, not by a military class that treats the island’s future as its own private inheritance. The Department’s actions are being taken pursuant to E.O. 14404, which authorizes sweeping sanctions on Cuba, including against persons who support the Cuban regime’s security apparatus and those responsible for repression in Cuba and other threats to U.S. national security. These actions also further both E.O. 14380, “ Addressing Threats to the United States by the Government of Cuba ” and National Security Presidential Memorandum 5 , which directs the Executive Branch to improve human rights, encourage the rule of law, foster free markets and free enterprise, and promote democracy in Cuba

items.title: Mareykanka oo digniin kasoo saaray Doolow kadib markii…
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa digniin cusub oo dhinaca amniga ah u dirtay muwaadiniinteeda, iyadoo uga digtay inay u safraan aagga Doolow ee Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida Itoobiya, sababo la xiriira walaac laga qabo xaaladda amni ee deegaanka. Warbixinta digniinta ayaa xustay in qaybo ka mid ah Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida iyo dhulka ku dhow xuduudda Soomaaliya loo arko goobo ay ka jirto khatar amni oo sare. Khataraha la tilmaamay waxaa kamid ah argagixiso, afduub iyo qalalaase amni. Shaqaalaha dowladda Mareykanka ee ku sugan Itoobiya ama qorsheynaya inay u safraan dalkaasi ayaa iyagana lagu wargeliyay xannibaad gaar ah oo ku saabsan Doolow. Sida ay sheegtay Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Addis Ababa, shaqaalaha dowladda looma oggola inay tagaan aaggaasi haddii aysan haysan oggolaansho gaar ah. Sidoo kale, digniinta ayaa muwaadiniinta Mareykanka kula talisay inay ka fogaadaan meelaha loo aqoonsaday inay khatartu ka jirto, ayna muujiyaan feejignaan dheeraad ah marka ay ku sugan yihiin ama u safrayaan deegaanada ku dhow xuduudda. Inkasta oo Doolow si gaar ah loogu xusay digniinta, Safaaradda Mareykanka ma aysan shaacin faahfaahin ku saabsan khatarta gaarka ah ee keentay digniinta cusub. Sidoo kale, ma aysan magacaabin koox ama dhinac gaar ah oo ay la xiriirinsay xaaladda amni ee ay ka digtay. Doolow iyo deegaanada ku dhow xuduudda Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ayaa muhiim u ah isku socodka labada dal, maadaama ay yihiin marinno ay isaga gudbaan dadka iyo gaadiidka. Safaaradda ayaa ugu dambeyntiina muwaadiniinta Mareykanka ku boorisay inay si joogto ah ula socdaan xaaladda amni, ayna qaataan taxaddarrada lagama maarmaanka ah marka ay ku sugan yihiin ama u safrayaan deegaanada uu Mareykanku u aqoonsaday inay khatartu ka jirto. Si kastaba, ilaa hadda ma jirto jawaab rasmi ah oo kasoo baxday dowladda Itoobiya ama maamulka Dowlad Deegaanka Soomaalida oo ku aaddan digniinta ay soo saartay Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Addis Ababa. items.title: Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo dhisay xukuumad cusub
items.description: Nairobi (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Lafta-gareen ayaa soo saaray warqad uu ku sheegay wareegto magacaabis, taas oo uu ku dhisay xukuumad cusub. Magacaabistan oo kasoo baxday xafiiska Lafta-gareen ayaa waxaa xubnaha la magacaabay loo kala xilsaaray wasaarado kala duwan oo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, waxbarashada, caafimaadka bulshada, beeraha iyo waraabka, iyo gaadiidka. Xubnaha cusub ee Lafta-gareen uu sheegay inuu wasiirro u magacaabay ayaa waxaa ka mid ah Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo loo magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta iyo Wacyigelinta Bulshada ee Koonfur Galbeed. Sidoo kale, Ilyaas Cali Nuur ayuu Lafta-gareen sheegay inuu u magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Isboortiga, halka Cabdi Axmed Qaasim uu u magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Hawlaha Guud iyo Dib-u-dhiska ee maamulkaasi. Macallin Aadan Cali Arbow ayuu sheegay inuu u magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Sidoo kale, Ibraahim Aadan Cali Naja ayuu u magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Dowladaha Hoose ee Koonfur Galbeed, halka Maxamed Yuusuf Cali uu u magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Beeraha iyo Waraabka. Maxamed Ibraahim Cali ayaa isna wuxuu u magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Shaqada iyo Arrimaha Bulshada, halka Xasan Cabdulaqaadir Maxamed loo magacaabay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha. Waxaa sidoo kale Lafta-gareen uu sheegay inuu xilal wasiirnimo u magacaabay Xasan Cabdinuur Albaro iyo Mustaf Axmed Idow. Magacaabista Lafta-gareen ee xubnahan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli maamulka Koonfur Galbeed uu leeyahay xukuumad shaqeysa, isla markaana uu meel adag marayo dagaalka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya maamulka cusub iyo kii hore ee uu hoggaaminayo Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. items.title: Mareykanka oo $5 milyan ku raadinaya gabar Soomaali ah
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa ku dhawaaqday abaalmarin gaareysa illaa $5 milyan oo la siinayo cid kasta oo keenta xog ku saabsan Khadra Essa, oo ah haweeney Soomaali ah oo haysata dhalashada Netherlands, taas oo Washington ku eedeysay inay door sare ku lahayd koox haween ah oo ka tirsanaa ururka Daacish ee ka dagaallamay Suuriya. Barnaamijka Rewards for Justice ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in Khadra Essa, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Umm Qaqa al-Somali, ay ahayd macallimaddii ugu sarreysay ee shareecada ee Nusaybah Katibah, oo ahayd guuto haween ah oo Daacish ka tirsan. Sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, Khadra waxay Suuriya u safartay sanadkii 2014 si ay ugu biirto ISIS, waxaana halkaas lagu tababaray hubka, walxaha qarxa iyo weerarrada ismiidaaminta ah. Maamulka Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeeyay inay si joogto ah u dhiirrigelin jirtay rabshadaha, xubnaha Daacish-na ku boorrin jirtay inay weerarro ka fuliyaan dalal kala duwan. Waxaa kale oo lagu eedeeyay inay baraysay fikrado xagjir ah oo lagu marmarsiyoon jiray weerarrada ismiidaaminta iyo dilka dadka rayidka ah, isla markaana ay ururka u qori jirtay xubno cusub. Guuto haween ah Nusaybah Katibah, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan ISIS-NK, ayaa sanadkii 2016 laga aas-aasay magaalada Raqqa ee Suuriya, si loo ururiyo loona tababaro haweenka dagaalyahannada ah. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in guutadan ay xilligii ay ugu xoogga badneyd lahayd boqolaal haween ah oo tababaran, kuwaas oo ay ku jireen muwaadiniin Mareykan iyo Yurub u dhashay. Inkastoo tiradeedu hoos u dhacday kadib markii Daacish laga qabsaday dhulkii ballaarnaa ee ay ka talin jirtay Suuriya iyo Ciraaq, haddana Washington waxay sheegtay in unuggan uu weli firfircoon yahay. Khadra Essa ayaa sidoo kale lagu eedeeyay inay hoggaamin jirtay koox si xoog ah ugu fulisa haweenka xeerarkii Daacish. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay inay bixisay amarro sababay ciqaabo jireed, oo ay ku jireen garaacis iyo dilal. Warbixinta Rewards for Justice ma sheegin da’da Khadra ama halka ay hadda ku sugan tahay, balse Suuriya ayay ku xustay goobta la xiriirta kiiskeeda. Carruur Mareykan ah oo la waayay Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale Khadra Essa ku xiriiriyay maqnaanshaha laba carruur ah oo Mareykan ah, Yusuf iyo Zahra Shikder. Sida ay sheegayaan mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka, hooyada carruurta ayaa sanadkii 2015 u kaxeysay Suuriya iyadoo aan oggolaansho ka haysan aabbahood, si ay ugu biirto Daacish. Kadib markii hooyadood ay ku dhimatay duqeyn militari oo lagu qaaday Daacish sanadkii 2019, Khadra ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay carruurta la wareegtay, kadibna geysay meel aan la ogeyn oo Suuriya ku taalla. Mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Khadra lagu ogaa inay gacanta ku haysay carruur kale oo la afduubtay ama la kaxeystay. Rewards for Justice ayaa si gaar ah u bixineysa abaalmarin gaareysa illaa $5 milyan oo lagu helayo xog horseedda in la helo, dib loo soo celiyo ama la soo badbaadiyo Yusuf iyo Zahra. Barnaamijka Rewards for Justice waxaa la aas-aasay sanadkii 1984, waxaana maamula Waaxda Amniga Diblomaasiyadda ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka. Barnaamijku wuxuu abaalmarin lacageed ku bixiyaa xog ka caawin karta Mareykanka inuu aqoonsado ama helo dadka lagu raadinayo arrimaha argagixisada, ka hortago weerarro ama carqaladeeyo maalgelinta kooxaha argagixisada. Soomaaliya oo Codkeeda Ku Biirisay Doodda Nabadda iyo Amniga ee Shiinaha iyo Afrika
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa khudbad ka jeediyay Madasha 4-aad ee Shiinaha iyo Afrika ee Nabadda iyo Amniga, oo uu martigeliyay Wasiirka Difaaca Qaranka ee Jamhuuriyadda Shacabka Shiinaha, Admiral Dong Jun. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa madasha kaga hadlay arrimaha la xiriira nabadda, amniga iyo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca, isagoo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha, iyo guud ahaan iskaashiga Shiinaha iyo dalalka Afrika. Madasha ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sidii loo horumarin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo difaaca, iyadoo dalalka ka qeybgalaya ay ka wada hadlayaan caqabadaha amni ee ka jira qaaradda Afrika iyo fursadaha lagu xoojin karo wada-shaqeynta caalamiga ah. Ka qeybgalka Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale qeyb ka ah dadaallada dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso xiriirrada caalamiga ah ee dhinaca tababarka, tayeynta iyo dhismaha hay’adaha amniga iyo ciidamada qaranka. Madasha ayaa magaalada Beijing ku soo uruurisay masuuliyiin iyo wakiillo sare oo ka kala socda Shiinaha iyo dalal badan oo Afrikaan ah, si looga wada hadlo mustaqbalka iskaashiga nabadda iyo amniga.

items.title: Joshua Meservey: Somaliland way qeexi waysay sabab uu Mareykanka ku aqoonsado
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Joshua Meservey, oo ah khabiir sare oo ka tirsan machadka Hudson Institute ee fadhigiisu yahay Washington, ayaa sheegay in Somaliland ay ku guul-darreysatay in ay soo bandhigto sabab uu Mareykanka u aqoonsado ama aqoonsigeedu muhiim ugu yahay danaha istaraatiijiyadeed iyo kuwa amni ee Washington. Meservey ayaa hadalkan ku sheegay wareysi uu siiyey telefishinka Israel ee i24NEWS, kaddib kulan 14-kii September ka dhacay Hudson Institute oo uu la yeeshay madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi Cirro. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray doorka Somaliland ee Geeska Afrika iyo fursadaha iskaashi ee dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo arrimaha istaraatiijiyadda, xilli maamulka Hargeysa uu dadaal xooggan ugu jiro inuu taageero uga helo Washington ololihiisa aqoonsi raadinta. Isagoo la hadlayey weriyaha i24NEWS Nicole Zedeck, Meservey ayaa sheegay in Somaliland mararka qaar soo bandhigto doodo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo sal leh, balse aysan weli si joogto ah u qeexin sababta Mareykanku dan ugu leeyahay inuu qaado tallaabada siyaasadeed ee aqoonsiga. “Somaliland si joogto ah uma aysan awoodin inay qeexdo sababta aqoonsigeedu muhiim u yahay,” ayuu yiri Meservey. Waxa uu sheegay in marka laga hadlayo siyaasadda juqraafiyeed iyo danaha qaranka, aysan ku filneyn in la soo bandhigo keliya muhiimadda goobta juqraafiyeed ama rabitaanka iskaashi, balse loo baahan yahay dood si gaar ah u caddeyneysa waxa Mareykanku ka helayo aqoonsiga Somaliland. “Marka laga hadlayo geopolitics-ka iyo danaha qaranka, waa inaad soo bandhigtaa dood cad oo lagu qanci karo, taas oo sharxeysa sababta ay muhiim ugu tahay Mareykanka inuu aqoonsado Somaliland,” ayuu yiri. Meservey ayaa tilmaamay in Hargeysa ay u baahan tahay inay diyaarsato dood istaraatiiji ah oo isku xiraysa danaha Somaliland iyo mudnaanta siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Mareykanka, kaddibna fariintaas si joogto ah looga gudbiyo Washington iyo caasimadaha kale ee ay taageerada ka raadineyso. Hadalladiisa ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Somaliland, maadaama sanadihii dambe ay ololaheeda aqoonsiga si weyn ugu saleysay goobta ay ku taallo, dekedda Berbera iyo u dhowaanshaha marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah ee Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Maamulka Somaliland ayaa isku dayaya inuu Washington tuso in Berbera iyo goobta istaraatiijiga ah ee ay ku taallo ay Mareykanka siin karaan fursado dhinacyada amniga, ganacsiga iyo la socodka dhaqdhaqaaqyada ka socda gobolka. Dooddaas ayaa sii xoogeysatay xilli Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ay noqdeen goob ay isku hayaan dano amni iyo kuwo istaraatiiji ah, gaar ahaan kaddib weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee maraakiibta iyo kororka tartanka quwadaha waaweyn ee Geeska Afrika. Kulankii Hudson Institute waxaa sidoo kale looga hadlay xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas, weerarrada Xuutiyiinta, ganacsiga maraakiibta iyo loollanka ay quwadaha waaweyn ugu jiraan saameynta gobolka. Safarka Madaxweyne Cirro ee Mareykanka ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaal ballaaran oo maamulkiisu ku doonayo inuu sare ugu qaado xiriirka Washington, isla markaana Somaliland uga dhigo arrin si weyn uga dhex muuqata doodaha siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Mareykanka. Hase yeeshee, hadalka Meservey wuxuu muujinayaa in helitaanka dhageysi siyaasadeed oo Washington ah uusan keliya ku xirneyn sheegashada ah in Somaliland leedahay goob istaraatiiji ah, balse ay sidoo kale u baahan tahay inay si faahfaahsan u muujiso sababta aqoonsigeedu u beddeli karo ama u xoojin karo danaha Mareykanka ee gobolka. Meservey ayaa horey uga mid ahaa dadka Washington ka taageera doodda ku saabsan in Mareykanku dib u eego siyaasaddiisa Somaliland, gaar ahaan iyadoo la eegayo isbeddellada ka socda Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika. Arrinta aqoonsiga Somaliland ayaa mar kale si weyn uga soo muuqatay Washington sanadihii u dambeeyey, iyadoo taageerayaasheedu ku doodayaan in xiriir dhow oo lala yeesho Hargeysa uu Mareykanka siin karo saameyn dheeraad ah oo gobolka ah. Dhinaca kale, dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya waxay Somaliland u aragtaa qeyb ka mid ah dhulkeeda, waxayna si joogto ah uga soo horjeeddaa tallaabo kasta oo lagu aqoonsanayo inay tahay dal madax-bannaan. Somaliland ayaa sheegatay inay Soomaaliya ka go’day sanadkii 1991-kii, waxaana tan iyo markaas ay waday dadaallo caalami ah oo ay ku raadineyso aqoonsi. Israel ayaa December 2025 noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyey ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland tan iyo ku dhawaaqistii 1991-kii, tallaabadaas oo sii kordhisay dadaallada Hargeysa ay ugu jirto inay waddamo kale ku qanciso inay qaadaan tallaabo la mid ah. Hadalka Meservey ayaa sidaas darteed Somaliland hor dhigaya su’aal ka weyn sheegashada muhiimadda Berbera ama goobta ay ku taallo: waxa ay tahay sababta gaarka ah ee Mareykanku uga faa’iideysanayo aqoonsiga, iyo sida Hargeysa ay dooddaas ugu beddeli karto mid si joogto ah uga dhaadhicin karta siyaasiyiinta iyo go’aan-qaadayaasha Washington. The post Joshua Meservey: Somaliland way qeexi waysay sabab uu Mareykanka ku aqoonsado appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xamza Bin Laden oo farriin soo diray sanado kadib markii la sheegay in la dilay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Ururka Al-Qaacida ayaa baahiyay muuqaal hore aan loo arag oo uu ka soo muuqanayo Xamza Bin Laden, oo ah wiilka aasaasihii ururkaas Usama Bin Laden, kaas oo hadal uu jeedinayo ku sheegay in Muslimiintu ay wajahayaan dagaal dhinacyo badan leh, isaga oo ku baaqaya in la sii wado jihaadka. Muuqaalka ayaa qayb ka ah barnaamij soconaya ku dhowaad 52 daqiiqo oo ay 10-kii September baahisay As-Sahab, oo ah garabka warbaahinta Al-Qaacida, maalin ka hor sanad-guuradii 25-aad ee weerarradii 11-kii September ee Mareykanka. Barnaamijka ayaa isku daraya muuqaallo hore oo la xiriira weerarrada 9/11, hadallo iyo muuqaallo cusub oo Xamza Bin Laden ah, sida ay sheegtay hay’adda MEMRI oo kormeertay baahinta. Xamza ayaa muuqaalka ka soo muuqda isagoo xiran dhar dhaqameed Afghanistan ah, isla markaana si toos ah ula hadlaya kaamaradda. “Islaamku maanta wuxuu marayaa imtixaan adag, marxalad culus iyo dagaal dhan walba ah,” ayuu ku yiri muuqaalka, sida ay MEMRI u turjuntay hadalkiisa. Waxa uu sheegay in dagaalka uu ka hadlayo uusan ku koobnayn dhinaca militariga, balse uu sidoo kale ku fidsan yahay dhinacyada diinta, dhaqanka iyo dhaqaalaha. Xamza ayaa mar kale kasoo muuqda qaybaha dambe ee muuqaalka, halkaas oo lagu arkayo isaga oo tirinaya gabay. Su’aalo ka dhashay xaaladdiisa Muuqaalka cusub ayaa si gaar ah indhaha loogu hayaa, maadaama Mareykanka uu sanadkii 2019 shaaciyay in Xamza Bin Laden lagu dilay howlgal la dagaallanka argagixisada ah oo ka dhacay gobolka u dhexeeya Afghanistan iyo Pakistan. Madaxweynihii Mareykanka ee xilligaas Donald Trump ayaa 14-kii September 2019 sheegay in Xamza la dilay, isaga oo xilligaas ku tilmaamay shaqsi sare oo ka tirsanaa Al-Qaacida, kana qayb qaadanayay howlaha ururka. Hase yeeshee, muuqaalka hadda la baahiyay ma caddeynayo goorta hadallada Xamza la duubay, mana xaqiijinayo inuu maanta nool yahay. Al-Qaacida sidoo kale ma aysan bixin faahfaahin cad oo meesha ka saaraysa is-maandhaafka u dhexeeya sheegashadii Mareykanka ee dhimashadiisa iyo muuqaalka cusub. MEMRI ayaa xustay in As-Sahab ay muuqaalka ugu magac-dartay si fudud “Xamza Bin Laden”, iyada oo aan raacin erayo caadi ahaan loo adeegsado xubnaha dhintay ee kooxaha jihaadiga ah. Arrintaas ayaa sii kordhisay su’aalaha ku saabsan xaaladdiisa dhabta ah. Magaca Bin Laden Xamza Bin Laden ayaa kamid ahaa wiilasha Usama Bin Laden, oo Mareykanku ku dilay Pakistan sanadkii 2011. Ka hor inta aan la shaacin dhimashadiisa, Xamza wuxuu si joogto ah uga soo muuqan jiray fariimaha codka ee Al-Qaacida, isaga oo ku baaqayay weerarro ka dhan ah Mareykanka iyo xulafadiisa. Mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka ayaa xilligaas u arkayay inuu noqon karo shaqsi muhiim ah oo mustaqbalka hoggaan sare ka qaban kara ururka. Muuqaalka cusub ayaa hadalladiisa lagu dhex daray muuqaallo badan oo ku saabsan aabihiis iyo weerarradii 11-kii September, taas oo muujinaysa in Al-Qaacida ay weli magaca iyo dhaxalka qoyska Bin Laden u adeegsaneyso dacaayaddeeda. Barnaamijka ayaa sidoo kale soo bandhigaya cod hore oo Usama Bin Laden ah, isagoo weerarradii 9/11 ku tilmaamaya dhacdo wax weyn ka beddeshay xiriirka u dhexeeya Al-Qaacida iyo Mareykanka. items.title: Shariif oo ku dhawaaqay in Somalia ay gashay marxalad adag, loona baahan yahay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda guud ee dalka, isagoo sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ku jirto marxalad adag oo dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga iyo dhaqaalaha ah. Shariif ayaa adkeeyay baahida loo qabo in la helo aragti mideysan oo ku aaddan sidii looga gudbi lahaa caqabadaha taagan, xilli dalka uu wajahayo marxalad adag oo kala guur ah. “Shirkaan Himilo Qaran waxa uu imaanayaa marxalad siyaasadeed oo culus oo dalku marayo. Ujeeddadu waxay tahay in ra’yi la is dhaafsado oo ku saabsan dalka sida loo badbaadinayo, ummadda Soomaaliyeed sida loo mideynayo iyo sida hore loogu soconayo,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynihii hore oo ka hadlayay shir uu Muqdisho ku qabtay xisbigiisa Himilo Qaran. Madaxweynihii hore ayaa tilmaamay in xaaladda hadda jirta ay u baahan tahay in Soomaalidu ay isu keento aragtideeda, isla markaana ay si wadajir ah uga shaqeyso sidii dalka looga saari lahaa marxaladda adag ee uu ku jiro. “Waxaan joognaa marxalad adag oo u baahan in Soomaalidu ra’yigooda isu keento, fikirkeedana mideyso, una istaagto sidii marxaladdan looga gudbi lahaa,” ayuu yiri Shariif. items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa ka qayb-galay Qado-Sharaf ay isaga iyo weftigiisa ku maamuuseen Hay’adda International Conservation Caucus Foundation (ICCF), oo uu fadhigeedu yahay Washington, D.C. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray muhiimadda ay leedahay ilaalinta khayraadka dabiiciga ah, deegaanka iyo badaha, iyo fursadaha iskaashi ee Somaliland iyo Hay’adaha dalka Maraykanka ee ka shaqeeya arrimaha ilaalinta deegaanka iyo horumarka faa’iido u leh aadamaha. Hay’adda International Conservation Caucus Foundation (ICCF) waa Hay’ad madaxbannaan oo uu fadhigeedu yahay Washington, D.C., kana shaqaysa arrimaha ilaalinta deegaanka, khayraadka dabiiciga ah, duurjoogta, badaha iyo horumar aayatiin leh. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa si mug leh ugu mahad naqay martiqaadka iyo soo-dhoweynta diirran ee ay u fidisay Hay’adda International Conservation Caucus Foundation (ICCF), isaga oo adkeeyey in ilaalinta khayraadka dabiiciga ah iyo horumarinta dhaqaale waara ay yihiin tiirar muhiim u ah mustaqbalka Somaliland, isaga oo muujiyey in iskaashi caalami ahi uu door weyn ka qaadan karo kobcinta khayraadka, ilaalinta deegaanka iyo abuurista fursado dhaqaale oo waara. Qado-Sharaftani waxa ay qayb ka tahay dedaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee is-daba-joogga ah ee Madaxweynaha iyo weftiga ballaadhan ee uu hoggaaminayo ay ka wadaan Washington, D.C., si loo ballaadhiyo iskaashiga Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Maraykanka, loona dhiso xidhiidho ku salaysan dano-wadaag, ilaalin khayraadka dabiiciga ah iyo aragti fog oo istaraatiiji ah. items.title: Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Koonfur Galbeed oo is-casilay
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Koonfur Galbeed, Axmed Cali Muuse ayaa iska casilay xilkii, isagoo si rasmi ah ugu gudbiyay Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Madoobe warqaddiisa is-casilaadda. Warqadda is-casilaadda ee uu gaarsiiyay hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed ayuu ku sheegay inuu si ikhtiyaari ah uga degayo xilka Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, isaga oo codsaday in la aqbalo is-casilaaddiisa. Sidoo kale wuxuu ku xusay in intii uu xilka hayay uu ku dadaalay ilaalinta caddaaladda, madax-bannaanida garsoorka, dhowrista dastuurka iyo u adeegidda shacabka maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. “Waxaan go’aansaday inaan si ikhtiyaari ah uga dago xilka Guddoomiyenimada Maxkamadda Sare, laga bilaabo taariikhda la aqbalo is-casilaaddan,” ayuu ku sheegay warqaddiisa is-casilaadda. Guddoomiyaha ayaa waxa kale oo uga mahadceliyay hoggaamiyaha maamulka, garsoorayaasha iyo hay’adaha dowladda wada-shaqeyntii ay lahaayeen intii uu xilka hayay, isagoo muujiyay in uu qadarinayo taageeradii iyo iskaashigii uu kala kulmay intii uu xilkaasi hayay. Is-casilaadda Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa dhaqan-geli doonta marka si rasmi ah loo aqbalo. Ilaa hadda ma jirto wax war ah oo kasoo baxay xafiiska hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Madoobe oo tilmaamaya in la aqbalay iyo in kale warqadda is-casilaadda ee uu Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare gudbiyay. items.title: Sawirro: Fiqi oo kulan weyn la yeeshay dhiggiisa Shiinaha
items.description: Beijing (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa kulan heer sare ah la yeeshay Wasiirka Difaaca Shiinaha, Admiral Dong Jun. Kulanka oo ku qabsoomay jawi saaxiibtinimo iyo is-afgarad leh ayaa diiradda lagu saaray sii xoojinta xiriirka taariikhiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha iyo ballaarinta iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga. Labada dhinac waxay adkeeyeen muhiimadda wada-shaqeyn ku dhisan is-ixtiraam, ilaalinta madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed, kana jawaabta xaaladaha amni ee Soomaaliya iyo isbeddellada ka socda gobolka iyo caalamka. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa dhiggiisa Shiinaha uga warramay horumarka ay Soomaaliya ka sameysay dhinacyada amniga iyo xasilloonida, guulaha laga gaaray dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada iyo dib-u-dhiska ciidanka xoogga dalka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale wuxuu tilmaamay in mudnaanta Dowladda Federaalka ay tahay dhismaha ciidan qaran oo tababaran, qalabeysan, awoodna u leh difaaca dalka iyo la wareegidda mas’uuliyadda amniga qaranka. Admiral Dong Jun ayaa bogaadiyey horumarka muuqda ee Soomaaliya ka gaartay amniga, dowlad-dhiska iyo tayeynta ciidanka qaranka. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa dhankiisa Dowladda Shiinaha uga mahadceliyey taageerada soo jireenka ah ee wax-ku-oolka ah iyo garab-istaagga joogtada ah ee ay u fidiso Soomaaliya. Labada wasiir ayaa isla gartay in la dardar-geliyo hirgelinta is-afgaradyada jira, lana sii ballaariyo iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga, si xiriirka istaraatiijiga ah ee labada dal loogu beddelo tallaabooyin la taaban karo oo wax ka tara nabadda iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan gobolka. items.title: Dawladda Jabuuti oo diiday in dalkeeda laga weeraro Xuutiyiinta Yemen
items.description: Dawladda Jabuuti ayaa sheegtay in aanay oggolaan doonin in dhulkeeda loo isticmaalo hawlgallo militari oo ka dhan ah kooxda Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen, sida uu BBC-da u sheegay Wasiirka Maaliyadda Jabuuti, Ilyaas Muuse Dawaale. Dawaale wuxuu sheegay in mowqifka Jabuuti aanu isbeddelin, isaga oo ka jawaabayay su’aal la weyddiiyayoo ahayd in dawladdu dib uga fiirsatay diidmadii hore ee codsi uga yimid Maraykanka oo ahaa in ciidammada Maraykanku isticmaalaan xarumaha millitari ee Jabuuti si ay u weeraraan Xuutiyiinta. “Uma malaynayo in su’aashaasi xilligan taagan tahay. Ciddii wax weerari jirtay ama naga dalban jirtay, waxaan filayaa iyaga ayaan xitaa diyaar u ahayn. ” ayuu yidhi Dawaale. Wuxuu sheegay in Jabuuti aanay doonayn in ay si millitari ah ugu lug yeelato colaadda, isla markaana ay rabto in dagaalka u dhexeeya dhinacyada kala duwan ee Yemen uu ku ekaado gudaha Yemen. “Ma doonayno cid, gaar ahaan deriskeenna, in ay millatari ahaan noogu timaaddo,” ayuu yidhi. Jabuuti waxay ku taallaa dhinaca kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed, iyadoo Yemen ka xigta, waxayna aad ugu dhowdahay marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, oo ka mid ah meelaha ugu muhiimsan ee maraakiibtu isticmaalaan, iskuna xidha Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Dawaale wuxuu sheegay in furfurnaanta iyo amniga Bab al-Mandab ay udub-dhexaad u yihiin siyaasadda Jabuuti. “Bab al-Mandab waa in uu furnaadaa,” ayuu yidhi, isaga oo dhowr jeer ku celceliyay hadalkaasi. Wuxuu sheegay in Jabuuti ay doonayso in dhinacyada ku lugta leh dagaalka Yemen ay helaan xal nabadeed. Wuxuuna ku tilmaamay Jabuuti dal deggan oo aan doonayn in qalalaasaha Yemen uu uga soo gudbo badda oo uu saameeyo Jabuuti. Qaxootiga Yemen oo soo gaadhaya Jabuuti. Wasiirku wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in dagaallada cusub ee Yemen ay Jabuuti ku keenayaan culays bani’aadamnimo oo sii kordhaya, iyadoo dadku ay ka soo cararayaan Yemen oo ay Gacanka Cadmeed ka soo gudbayaan. Wuxuu sheegay in dadka badan ee imanaya ay u badan yihiin haween iyo carruur lagu qasbay in ay guryahooda ka cararaan sababo la xidhiidha dagaalka. Dawaale wuxuu sheegay in Jabuuti ay dhaqan ahaan albaabadeeda u furto dadka ka soo cararaya colaadaha, inkasta oo dalku uu baaxad ahaan yar yahay kheyraadkiisuna xaddidan yahay. “Mar walba waxaan u furnaa qalbiyadeenna iyo gacmaheenna, inta Alle iyo awooddeennu noo saamaxayso,” ayuu yidhi. Wuxuu sheegay in dadka cusub ee ka imanaya Yemen ay sii biirinayaan culaysyo hore uga jiray Jabuuti oo ay sababaan qulqulka kale ee muhaajiriinta iyo qaxootiga ah. Dad ka imanaya meelo kale oo gobolka ah oo u socda dalalka Carabta ayaa inta badan Jabuuti ku hakada, taas oo dalka ku keenta culays dhaqaale iyo mid bulsho. Laakiin wuxuu sheegay in dadka Yemen ka imanaya ay xaaladdoodu ka duwan tahay, sababtoo ah iyaga dagaalka Yemen ayaa ku qasbaya in ay dalkooda ka cararaan. Wasiirku wuxuu sheegay in juqraafi ahaan Jabuuti ay si gaar ah ugu nugushahay xaaladda Yemen. Wuxuu sheegay in masaafada u dhexeysa labada dal ay tahay qiyaastii 70 ilaa 80 km, halka meelaha qaarkood ee xeebuhu isku dhow yihiin ay u dhexeeyaan kaliya 22 ilaa 23 km. Wuxuu sheegay in doonyaha yaryar ay safarka Yemen ilaa Jabuuti qaadan karaan wax ka yar hal saac, taasoo dadka dagaalka ka cararaya u sahlaysa in ay Jabuuti gaadhaan. Saamaynta dhaqaale Xigashada Sawirka, VOA Dawaale, oo masuul ka ah dhaqaalaha iyo maaliyadda Jabuuti, wuxuu sheegay in colaadda gobolka ay sidoo kale si weyn u saameynayso dhaqaalaha dalka. Wuxuu sheegay in ganacsigii lala lahaa dalalka Khaliijka uu hoos u dhacay, isla markaana carqaladaha ku yimaadda maraakiibta iyo gaadiidka badda ay saamaynayaan dakhliga Jabuuti. “Wax kasta oo ku dhaca ganacsiga waxay saameeyaan dakhligayaga,” ayuu yidhi. Wuxuu sidoo kale ka digay in kharashka gaadiidka oo kordha uu sare u qaadi karo qiimaha badeecadaha muhiimka ah, taasna ay culays dheeraad ah saari karto bulshada. Wuxuu tusaale u soo qaatay qiimaha lagu keeno konteenarrada Jabuuti. Wuxuu sheegay in kharashka hal konteenar uu hore u ahaa qiyaastii 200,000 ilaa 250,000 oo lacagata faranka Jabuuti ah, balse hadda uu gaadhay inta u dhexeysa 1 milyan iyo 1.4 milyan oo faran Jabuuti ah. Wuxuu sheegay in dadka ku tiirsan ganacsiga yaryar iyo wax-is-dhaafsiga ay si gaar ah ugu nugul yihiin korodhka kharashaadka. Dawaale wuxuu sheegay in dawladdu si dhow ula socoto xaaladda, isla markaana ay isku dayayso in ay shacabka ka ilaaliso saamaynta dhaqaale ee ka dhalanaysa qalalaasaha gobolka. Arrimaha amniga Dhanka amniga, Dawaale wuxuu sheegay in mas’uuliyadda ugu weyn ee dawladdu tahay ilaalinta nabadda iyo xasilloonida Jabuuti. Wuxuu sheegay in dawladda ay feejigan tahay oo ay ka warqabto suurtagalnimada in xaaladda Yemen ay saameyn ku yeelato Jabuuti, balse wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in dawladdu aanay doonayn in dagaalku kusoo faafo dhulka Jabuuti. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in Jabuuti diyaar u tahay in ay gargaar bani’aadamnimo siiso dadka ka soo cararaya dagaalka, isagoo isla markaana dalbaday taageero caalami ah oo dheeraad ah. “Waxaan hore uga codsanay adduunka,” ayuu yidhi, isaga oo sheegay in dadka dagaalka ka soo cararay ee Jabuuti yimaada aan lagu dayn karin dalka iyagoo aan helin taageero ku filan. Dawaale wuxuu sheegay in Jabuuti ay doonayso in dalalka deriska ah, gaar ahaan dalalka Khaliijka, ay ka shaqeeyaan sidii xal loogu heli lahaa dagaalka Yemen. Wuxuu diiday fikradda ah in Jabuuti laga dhigo saldhig ama goob laga abaabulo hawlgallo militari oo ay isticmaalaan quwadaha gobolka. Wasiirku wuxuu sheegay in Jabuuti ay sii wadi doonto taageerada furfurnaanta iyo amniga marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, wuxuuna ugu baaqay dhinacyada ku lugta leh dagaalka in ay is-xakameeyaan oo ay raadiyaan xal nabadeed.

Dawaale wuxuu sheegay in mowqifka Jabuuti aanu isbeddelin, isaga oo ka jawaabayay su’aal la weyddiiyayoo ahayd in dawladdu dib uga fiirsatay diidmadii hore ee codsi uga yimid Maraykanka oo ahaa in ciidammada Maraykanku isticmaalaan xarumaha millitari ee Jabuuti si ay u weeraraan Xuutiyiinta. “Uma malaynayo in su’aashaasi xilligan taagan tahay. items.title: Midowga Afrika oo walaac ka muujiyay xiisadda sii xoogaysanaysa ee Badda Cas
items.description: Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa walaac xooggan ka muujiyay kororka colaadaha militari ee ka socda gobolka Badda Cas, gaar ahaan weerarrada lagu beegsanayo dhulka Sacuudiga iyo hanjabaadaha ku wajahan maraakiibta ganacsiga ee isticmaasha marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah. Midowga Afrika ayaa cambaareeyay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee lagu beegsanayo, sida ay bayaanka ku sheegtay, bartilmaameedyo rayid iyo kaabayaal dhaqaale oo ku yaalla Sacuudiga , iyo sidoo kale weerarrada iyo hanjabaadaha ka dhanka ah maraakiibta ganacsiga ee maraysa Badda Cas. Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay wararka sheegaya isku-dayo weerarro lagu bartilmaameedsaday Makkah iyo magaalooyin kale oo barakeysan oo ku yaalla Sacuudiga . Guddigu wuxuu sheegay in goobaha barakeysan, dadka rayidka ah iyo xujeyda ama dadka cibaadada u tagaya goobahaas ay tahay in si buuxda loo ilaaliyo, isla markaana aysan marnaba noqon bartilmaameed militari. Midowga Afrika wuxuu sidoo kale dib u xaqiijiyay muhiimadda xorriyadda maraakiibta ee Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab , isagoo sheegay in arrintan loo baahan yahay in lagu ilaaliyo waafaqsanaanta sharciga caalamiga ah. Guddigu wuxuu ka digay in tallaabo kasta oo lagu carqaladeynayo ama lagu khatar gelinayo maraakiibta isticmaasha marin-biyoodkan ay saameyn ku yeelan karto waddamada ku teedsan Badda Cas, ganacsiga caalamiga ah, silsiladaha sahayda, amniga tamarta iyo dhaqaalaha dalalka Afrika. Arrintan ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah Geeska Afrika iyo dalalka ku yaalla xeebaha Badda Cas , maadaama Bab al-Mandab uu yahay marin istiraatiiji ah oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa sidoo kale ka digay in dagaallada iyo iska horimaadyada ka socda Bariga Dhexe ay isu beddeli karaan colaad gobolka oo dhan ku baahda. Sida uu sheegay Midowga Afrika, haddii xaaladdu sii xumaato, saameynteedu ma ku ekaan doonto Bariga Dhexe oo keliya, balse waxay si toos ah u taaban kartaa Afrika dhinacyada amniga, xaaladda bani’aadannimo iyo dhaqaalaha . Guddiga Midowga Afrika wuxuu ku baaqay in si degdeg ah loo joojiyo weerarrada ka dhanka ah dadka rayidka ah, kaabayaasha rayidka iyo dhaqaalaha, iyo maraakiibta ganacsiga. Waxa kale oo uu ku baaqay in la dhowro xorriyadda maraakiibta iyo in si degdeg ah loo yareeyo xiisadda, isagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay in wada-hadal iyo xalal siyaasadeed mudnaanta la siiyo si looga hortago in colaadaha sii fidaan loona ilaaliyo nabadda, amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka Badda Cas.

items.title: Nin weerar ku qaaday Ilhaan Cumar oo xukun lagu riday
items.description: Nin 56 jir ah oo lagu eedeeyay inuu dareere ku buufiyay Xildhibaanad Ilhaan Cumar xilli ay kulan dadweyne ku qabanaysay magaalada Minneapolis ayaa lagu xukumay 14 bilood oo xabsi ah , kadib markii uu heshiis la gaaray xeer-ilaalinta. Ninka oo lagu magacaabo Anthony Kazmierczak ayaa sidoo kale lagu xukumay saddex sano oo kormeer ah marka uu xabsiga ka soo baxo, iyadoo shuruudaha kormeerka lagu daray inuusan wax xiriir ah la sameyn karin Ilhaan Cumar. Dhacdadu waxay dhacday 27-kii Janaayo 2026 , xilli Ilhaan ay magaalada Minneapolis ku qabanaysay kulan ay bulshada kula hadlaysay. Sida ay sheegeen markhaatiyaal, Kazmierczak ayaa ka dhex kacay dadkii kulanka fadhiyay, isaga oo adeegsanaya qalab cirbad u eg oo uu ku buufiyay dhanka Xildhibaanadda, wuxuuna ku dhawaaqay inay Minnesota kala qaybinayso. Saraakiisha amniga ee ilaalinaysay Ilhaan ayaa si degdeg ah u qabtay Kazmierczak, kadibna booliska ayay ku wareejiyeen, xildhibaanaddana wax dhaawac ahi kama soo gaarin dhacdadaas.

items.title: War on Terrorism: Up Close and Personal
items.description: By Abukar Arman Twenty-five years after the morning that redefined the modern world, the attacks of September 11, 2001, remain less of a closed chapter than an enduring enigma. While the official narrative points to 19 al‑Qaida hijackers, the unanswered questions, the collective punishment of Muslim communities, the weaponization of patriotism to silence enquiries, the geopolitical aftershocks that reshaped the world order, and the ongoing secrecy surrounding classified documents demand a critical reexamination of that day’s legacy. Meanwhile, new reports, documentaries, and books that challenge the old narrative continue to appear in public space. Families of victims and independent researchers continue to question whether the full truth about the attackers’ support network has ever come to light. Key documents from the FBI’s investigation remain classified, withheld under the guise of national security. This sustained secrecy fuels justified perception of cover‑up. Demand for Investigation Last year, journalist Tucker Carlson released a documentary series—The 9/11 Files—that tore apart the official narrative. His stated objective was to push for a new, independent 9/11 commission, one “not committed to protecting politicians.” He accused U.S. intelligence agencies and the George W. Bush administration of deliberately withholding critical information from investigators and the public. One of the people that Mr. Carlson interviewed was former FBI official Mark Rossini who worked at the CIA’s “Alec Station.” He revealed that U.S. authorities had tracked two hijackers as they travelled from Dubai through Malaysia into the United States. An FBI report was blocked from circulation by CIA officials; authorities knew the suspects had arrived in Los Angeles, yet no alert was issued. Brett Eagleson, who lost his father on 9/11, told Carlson: “Our government has failed us, just as they failed us 20 years ago… they’re pouring salt on our wounds.” Former Congressman Weldon went further on Carlson’s show, saying: “The 9/11 Commission itself was a cover‑up from the start.” These kinds of claims can no longer be dismissed as conspiracy theories. After all, no one yet explained the “five dancing Israelis” who were arrested on 9/11 for filming the towers’ collapse and allegedly celebrating. Community Under Siege The most tangible and tragic legacy of 9/11 is the collective punishment inflicted upon Muslim communities worldwide. Within days of the attacks, President Bush declared a “Global War on Terrorism,” and within a few weeks the Senate passed the USA PATRIOT Act—the most draconian domestic law in U.S. history. There was no thorough debate to scrutinize that infamous bill, yet it passed in a 98-1 vote. Against that background, a ‘counterterrorism’ dragnet that, in the eyes of many, blurred the line between al‑Qaida and the global Muslim population was immediately activated. Especially in the West, Muslims became ‘legitimate targets’ of suspicion. Their identities were conflated with terrorism. This backlash was not spontaneous but fueled by a “perfect storm” of Zionist driven Islamophobia and right-wing driven xenophobia that had been brewing for decades. In the following years, many Muslims in the U.S. were incarcerated, renditioned, deported lost jobs, got ostracized, and faced surge in hate crimes. In that period, the more active a Muslim person was, the more likely he became targeted. I was one of those Muslims. Guilty till Proven Innocent In 2001, at a time when many Imams were pressured off the pulpit, I became one of a few local Muslim volunteers who were invited to fill the vacuum and start giving sermon on Fridays- a role that I am honored to say: I keep it to this day. So, my sermons were not limited to spiritual topics. As in my writings, I talked about Islamophobia, injustice, corruption, oppression, Zionism, US foreign policy and the neocon madness known as global war on terrorism. And that was enough to put me in the crosshairs of the usual suspects- FrontPage Magazine, Little Green Footballs, Jihad Watch, and the Middle East Forum. It started with periodic bullying emails and public accusations that peaked in 2007. In July of that same year, on a Saturday afternoon while driving with family, I received a phone call from an anxious friend. He told me that I was the topic of discussion in a local conservative radio program named Radio Deli hosted by Dirk Thompson. His guest was a man named Patrick Poole, a right-wing/neocon operative who used to present himself as a “counterterrorism expert.” The 3-hour program was all about me- how I was a “terrorist sympathizer” who supported Hamas and al-Shabaab. The following Saturday, that same program invited the same guest and dedicated the entire show to implicating me as a ticking bomb. Shortly after, Patrick Poole published a series of articles in FrontPage Magazine—the online arm of a Zionist, conservative organization named Freedom Center that was founded by the late David Horowitz. Every witch-hunt article they published reverberated within their network fear-mongering media. So, in due course, their orchestrated vicious accusations had severe consequences on me. I lost my job with the Columbus Public Schools, but that was not of much value to the Islamophobic network and their funders. They were after my membership of the Criminal Justice Planning Board – a board with oversight authority over all homeland security programs of Franklin County. That Board included all 20 elected officials in that county and two civilians- one African American and one immigrant who were appointed by the 3 County Commissioners. Abukar at CPD training Capitalizing on that climate of fear, Poole and his wide network started a letter campaign.  Each member of said board was flooded with letters condemning me and demanding my immediate removal and threatening well-financed campaigns to defeat each one of them in the next election should he or she fail to deliver.   At our next meeting, I was part of the agenda. Kathy Crandall, Director of the Franklin County Office of Homeland Security who sat across from me stated this on record: ‘Since a board member said Abukar must be investigated, my office has no choice but to conduct an investigation, though we have done one on him for his second nomination only a few months ago.’ Long story short, another investigation was conducted on me. The conclusion was reported in a front-page article titled Investigation Clears A Hilliard Man that was published by the Columbus Dispatch. “We did a background check and found no criminal or terrorist connections. Mr. Arman was not a person of interest,” said Don Brown—the County Administrator—to the Dispatch. That was great, but the damage was already done. I had to resign from the Franklin County Criminal Justice Board. Also, the Columbus Police Academy aborted a training program that I and a CAIR colleague used to provide to the graduating police cadets on how to engage Muslims with respect and not deny them their constitutional rights.      Muzzling Scrutiny In the decade of 2007-2017, though I had dozens of articles already published in various media outlets, any Google search on my name or one of my articles was likely to lead the searcher to various misleading articles or commentaries aimed to sustain the vicious campaign against me. In contrast, today, while the malicious articles and commentaries have subsided, the campaign to keep me in the dark continues to this day. Since October 7, 2023, due to my long stance on Palestine, the social media platform X has placed me in an algorithmic dungeon that froze my followers on 147K for the first 2 years of the genocide. Now my numbers are reduced to 143K with periodical loss of followers. That said, my story was no different than the stories of a numerous other vocal Muslims who were targeted as I have been. Many, like Dr. Sami Al-Arian, had to endure much worse experiences. Endless End Poole who made a career out of his ruthless campaign to spread Islamophobia and accuse Muslims as sleeping cells and ticking bombs has died a violent death on May 15, 2026. Poole barricaded himself inside a home after stabbing two people to death. Arkansas State Police and SWAT personnel responded to the scene. When law-enforcement made it into the house and officers attempted to arrest Poole, he resisted. During a struggle, he attempted to grab an officer’s gun, leading a second deputy to fatally shoot him. A prosecutor later ruled the shooting justified. In the meantime, the neocon lust for perpetual wars that serve the Zionist project continue. items.fullContent: By Abukar Arman Twenty-five years after the morning that redefined the modern world, the attacks of September 11, 2001, remain less of a closed chapter than an enduring enigma. While the official narrative points to 19 al‑Qaida hijackers, the unanswered questions, the collective punishment of Muslim communities, the weaponization of patriotism to silence enquiries, the geopolitical aftershocks that reshaped the world order, and the ongoing secrecy surrounding classified documents demand a critical reexamination of that day’s legacy. Meanwhile, new reports, documentaries, and books that challenge the old narrative continue to appear in public space. Families of victims and independent researchers continue to question whether the full truth about the attackers’ support network has ever come to light. Key documents from the FBI’s investigation remain classified, withheld under the guise of national security. This sustained secrecy fuels justified perception of cover‑up. Demand for Investigation Last year, journalist Tucker Carlson released a documentary series—The 9/11 Files—that tore apart the official narrative. His stated objective was to push for a new, independent 9/11 commission, one “not committed to protecting politicians.” He accused U.S. intelligence agencies and the George W. Bush administration of deliberately withholding critical information from investigators and the public. One of the people that Mr. Carlson interviewed was former FBI official Mark Rossini who worked at the CIA’s “Alec Station.” He revealed that U.S. authorities had tracked two hijackers as they travelled from Dubai through Malaysia into the United States. An FBI report was blocked from circulation by CIA officials; authorities knew the suspects had arrived in Los Angeles, yet no alert was issued. Brett Eagleson, who lost his father on 9/11, told Carlson: “Our government has failed us, just as they failed us 20 years ago… they’re pouring salt on our wounds.” Former Congressman Weldon went further on Carlson’s show, saying: “The 9/11 Commission itself was a cover‑up from the start.” These kinds of claims can no longer be dismissed as conspiracy theories. After all, no one yet explained the “five dancing Israelis” who were arrested on 9/11 for filming the towers’ collapse and allegedly celebrating. Community Under Siege The most tangible and tragic legacy of 9/11 is the collective punishment inflicted upon Muslim communities worldwide. Within days of the attacks, President Bush declared a “Global War on Terrorism,” and within a few weeks the Senate passed the USA PATRIOT Act—the most draconian domestic law in U.S. history. There was no thorough debate to scrutinize that infamous bill, yet it passed in a 98-1 vote. Against that background, a ‘counterterrorism’ dragnet that, in the eyes of many, blurred the line between al‑Qaida and the global Muslim population was immediately activated. Especially in the West, Muslims became ‘legitimate targets’ of suspicion. Their identities were conflated with terrorism. This backlash was not spontaneous but fueled by a “perfect storm” of Zionist driven Islamophobia and right-wing driven xenophobia that had been brewing for decades. In the following years, many Muslims in the U.S. were incarcerated, renditioned, deported lost jobs, got ostracized, and faced surge in hate crimes. In that period, the more active a Muslim person was, the more likely he became targeted. I was one of those Muslims. Guilty till Proven Innocent In 2001, at a time when many Imams were pressured off the pulpit, I became one of a few local Muslim volunteers who were invited to fill the vacuum and start giving sermon on Fridays- a role that I am honored to say: I keep it to this day. So, my sermons were not limited to spiritual topics. As in my writings, I talked about Islamophobia, injustice, corruption, oppression, Zionism, US foreign policy and the neocon madness known as global war on terrorism. And that was enough to put me in the crosshairs of the usual suspects- FrontPage Magazine, Little Green Footballs, Jihad Watch, and the Middle East Forum. It started with periodic bullying emails and public accusations that peaked in 2007. In July of that same year, on a Saturday afternoon while driving with family, I received a phone call from an anxious friend. He told me that I was the topic of discussion in a local conservative radio program named Radio Deli hosted by Dirk Thompson. His guest was a man named Patrick Poole, a right-wing/neocon operative who used to present himself as a “counterterrorism expert.” The 3-hour program was all about me- how I was a “terrorist sympathizer” who supported Hamas and al-Shabaab. The following Saturday, that same program invited the same guest and dedicated the entire show to implicating me as a ticking bomb. Shortly after, Patrick Poole published a series of articles in FrontPage Magazine—the online arm of a Zionist, conservative organization named Freedom Center that was founded by the late David Horowitz. Every witch-hunt article they published reverberated within their network fear-mongering media. So, in due course, their orchestrated vicious accusations had severe consequences on me. I lost my job with the Columbus Public Schools, but that was not of much value to the Islamophobic network and their funders. They were after my membership of the Criminal Justice Planning Board – a board with oversight authority over all homeland security programs of Franklin County. That Board included all 20 elected officials in that county and two civilians- one African American and one immigrant who were appointed by the 3 County Commissioners. Abukar at CPD training Capitalizing on that climate of fear, Poole and his wide network started a letter campaign.  Each member of said board was flooded with letters condemning me and demanding my immediate removal and threatening well-financed campaigns to defeat each one of them in the next election should he or she fail to deliver.   At our next meeting, I was part of the agenda. Kathy Crandall, Director of the Franklin County Office of Homeland Security who sat across from me stated this on record: ‘Since a board member said Abukar must be investigated, my office has no choice but to conduct an investigation, though we have done one on him for his second nomination only a few months ago.’ Long story short, another investigation was conducted on me. The conclusion was reported in a front-page article titled Investigation Clears A Hilliard Man that was published by the Columbus Dispatch. “We did a background check and found no criminal or terrorist connections. Mr. Arman was not a person of interest,” said Don Brown—the County Administrator—to the Dispatch. That was great, but the damage was already done. I had to resign from the Franklin County Criminal Justice Board. Since October 7, 2023, due to my long stance on Palestine, the social media platform X has placed me in an algorithmic dungeon that froze my followers on 147K for the first 2 years of the genocide. Now my numbers are reduced to 143K with periodical loss of followers. That said, my story was no different than the stories of a numerous other vocal Muslims who were targeted as I have been. Many, like Dr. Sami Al-Arian, had to endure much worse experiences. Endless End Poole who made a career out of his ruthless campaign to spread Islamophobia and accuse Muslims as sleeping cells and ticking bombs has died a violent death on May 15, 2026. Poole barricaded himself inside a home after stabbing two people to death. Arkansas State Police and SWAT personnel responded to the scene. When law-enforcement made it into the house and officers attempted to arrest Poole, he resisted. items.title: Somalia’s Digital Iron Curtain: Who Is Making Critics Disappear?
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s battle over freedom of expression appears to be entering a new and unsettling arena: the digital space. Several prominent Somali journalists and political figures have reportedly seen their Facebook accounts suspended, removed or falsely memorialized as belonging to people who have died, triggering allegations of a coordinated campaign against critical voices. But one distinction is essential: the account disruptions are documented; responsibility for them has not been established. The Evidence: What Is Known and What Is Alleged The Somali Journalists Syndicate (SJS) reported on September 14 that journalist Farah Abdulkadir Mohamed and journalist Abdijalil Osman had their Facebook profiles falsely memorialized while both were alive. Their accounts were subsequently restored. SJS also reported that journalist Zakariye Mohamud Timacadde, whose Facebook presence reportedly reaches more than one million followers, had his Facebook page and personal profile suspended. The Syndicate further reported the removal of the Facebook pages of the presidents of Puntland and Jubaland . SJS described the incidents as part of what it considered an apparent wave of online attacks targeting Somali journalists and media organizations. It also raised concerns over alleged misuse of copyright complaints to remove critical content and reported that a person involved in such claims said he worked in communications for the Somali government. These are reported incidents and allegations; they do not, by themselves, establish that the Somali government ordered or carried out the Facebook actions. SJS said Meta’s East Africa team did not respond to its request for comment. The latest incidents also come against a broader documented record of pressure on Somali journalists. Human Rights Watch has reported intimidation, detention and prosecution of journalists and media workers by federal and regional authorities. The Federation of Somali Journalists separately reported 78 violations involving journalists and media professionals between May 2025 and May 2026, including arrests, detention, threats, assaults, harassment, abductions, censorship and interference with reporting. That broader record provides important context, but it does not establish that government authorities were responsible for the specific Facebook disruptions now under scrutiny. The most striking cases remain the false memorializations of living journalists. How were living people classified as deceased? Were fraudulent reports submitted? Were accounts compromised? Did automated moderation systems make errors? Or were multiple incidents connected? Those questions remain unanswered. There is currently no publicly established evidence showing that President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud personally ordered the removals, that federal cyber-security personnel carried them out, or that his government instructed Meta to target particular journalists or political figures. That distinction matters. The reported disruptions deserve investigation, but allegations of direct government responsibility require evidence beyond the fact that the affected individuals are prominent critics or political actors. The Hassan Sheikh Question The controversy nevertheless places renewed attention on the government’s approach to freedom of expression. If federal institutions had no role in the Facebook actions, officials could help settle the matter by making that position clear and supporting an independent investigation. If government agencies did communicate with Meta concerning the affected accounts, the public deserves to know what was requested, under what authority and on what grounds. The same transparency should be expected from Meta. Account suspensions, removals and false memorializations can have serious consequences when Facebook functions as a major channel for political debate and journalism. For Somali journalists and politicians, Facebook is not merely a social-media platform. It has become an important part of the country’s public information space. When a prominent account disappears, so too can access to years of reporting, political commentary and communication with hundreds of thousands of followers. That is why the latest incidents warrant scrutiny without premature conclusions. The evidence establishes that accounts have been disrupted. It does not yet establish who was responsible. And that leaves Somalia with a question that remains unanswered: Who is making Somalia’s political voices disappear from the digital public square—and why? items.title: Gudoomiyihii ugu waqtiga dheeraa Maxkamadda Sare ee Koonfur Galbeed oo is casilay
items.description: Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Garyaqaan Axmed Cali Muuse ayaa shaaciyay in uu iska casilay xilkaasi, isagoo aan wax sabab ahi sheegin. “Laga bilaabo maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 18/9/2026, waxaan iska casilay xilka Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, anigoo ah Axmed Cali Muuse.” Ayuu Garyaqaan Axmed Cali Muuse ku sheegay warqad uu ku saxiixnaa. Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ayaa is casilaaddiisa la wadaagay Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe), isagoona yiri “Waxaan si ixtiraam iyo xilkasnimo leh kugu soo gudbinayaa warqaddan is casilaaddayda rasmiga ah.” Garyaqaan Axmed Cali ayaan sheegin asbaabta uu shaqada uga tagayo aan ka ahayn, sida uu warqadda ku sheegay in uu si ikhtiyaari ah u go’aansaday inuu uga dego xilka Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare. “Waxaan go’aansaday inaan si ikhtiyaari ah uga dego xilka Gudoomiyenimada Maxkamadda Sare, laga bilaabo taariikhda la aqbalo is casilaaddan.” Ayuu yiri Garyaqaan Axmed Cali. Waxa uu sheegay in muddadii uu xafiiska joogay uu ku dadaalay madaxbannaanida garsoorka, dhowrista dastuurka iyo u adeegidda bulshada Koonfur Galbeed, wuxuuna u mahadceliyay madaxda maamulka, garsooreyaasha iyo hay’adaha kale ee maamulka wada-shaqayntii dhex martay. Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa bishii June ee sanadkii 2019 xeer Madaxweyne ku magacaabay Axmed Cali Muuse inuu noqdo Gudoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare ee Koonfur Galbeed. Axmed Cali Muuse ayaa noqday Gudoomiyihii labaad ee taariikhda qabta xilka Maxkamadda Sare ee Koonfur Galbeed, tan iyo markii la dhisay Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Axmed Cali Muuse ayaa sidoo kale noqonaya Gudoomiyihii ugu waqtiga dheeraa ee maamula Maxkamadda Sare ee maamulkaasi. Is casilaaddiisa ayaa ku soo beegmeysa, xilli Koonfur Galbeed ay ka taagan tahay xiisad siyaasadeed iyo mid ciidan oo u dhexeysa maamulka cusub ee Aadan Madoobe uu hoggaamiyo iyo hoggaankii hore.
