items.title: Hablaha Garxajis cadaalad bay doonayaan.
Taliyaha Ilaalada Madaxtooyada Qaranka oo gaaray deegaanka Masagawaa (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Taliyaha Guutada 77 ee Ciidanka Ilaalada Madaxtooyada Qaranka, Korneyl Maslax Maxamuud Maxamed ayaa booqasho shaqo ku tegay deegaanka Masagawaa ee Gobolka Galgaduud. Deegaankan ayaa waxaa degan cutub ka tirsan Guutada 77, gaar ahaan Ururka 86aad ee Aar, iyadoo sidoo kalena ay halkaasi fariisimo ku leeyihiin Ciidanka Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley. War Talaadadan ka soo baxay Taliska Guutada 77 ayaa lagu sheegay in Taliyuhu uu Masagawaa u tegay kormeer uu ugu kuurgelayo xaaladda ciidanka iyo howlaha ay ka hayaan deegaanka. “Taliyaha ayaa mid mid u booqday fariisimaha iyo goobaha ay Guutada 77aad kaga sugan yihiin magaalada Masagawaa iyo deegaanada ku xeeran, isagoo indha-indheeyay xaaladda ciidanka iyo habsami-u-socodka howlaha shaqo.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa lagu xusay “Korneyl Maslax Maxamuud Maxamed ayaa sidoo kale warbixinno ka dhageystay Saraakiisha iyo Taliyeyaasha Ururada Guutada 77aad ee ka hawlgala deegaanka, kuwaas oo ka warbixiyay xaaladda amni, howlaha ciidanka iyo adeegyada ay u hayaan bulshada ku nool deegaanada bariga Gobolka Galgaduud.” Masagawaa ayaa looga diyaargaroobayaa doorashada isku sidkan ee 30-ka bishan laga qabanayo Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Doorashada ku celiska ah ee Galmudug ayay shacabku ku soo dooranayaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Galmudug.

items.title: Ganacsatada Soomaaliya oo billaabay qorshe cusub kadib markii is-beddel uu ku yimid…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ganacsatada Soomaaliya ayaa bilaabay inay raadiyaan marinno cusub oo ay badeecooyinka dalka ku soo geliyaan, xilli walaac xooggan uu ka taagan yahay ammaanka marinnada muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab iyo Hormuz, oo ay saameeyeen dagaallada iyo xiisadaha sii xoogeysanaya ee gobolka. Arrintan ayaa soo baxday kaddib markii Xuutiyiinta Yemen, oo taageero ka hela Iran, ay qabsadeen magaalo deked muhiim ah iyo jasiirad istaraatiiji ah, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga ee isaga kala goosha Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Shirkadaha Soomaaliyeed ayaa muddo dheer badeecooyinka ka yimaada Aasiya dalka soo marin jiray dalalka Khaliijka, gaar ahaan Imaaraadka Carabta, Cumaan iyo Sacuudi Carabiya. Hase yeeshee, xaaladda cusub ayaa ku qasabtay qaar ka mid ah ganacsatada inay tijaabiyaan safarro toos ah oo aan ku xirneyn dekedaha Khaliijka. Maareeyaha Dekedda Muqdisho, Maxamed Cali Nuur Ameeriko, ayaa sheegay in xiisadaha ka taagan Bab al-Mandab iyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz ay saameyn ku yeesheen ganacsiga iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta. “Xiisadihii ugu dambeeyay ee Bab al-Mandab, iyo sidoo kale kuwa ka jira marin-biyoodka Hormuz, si taban ayay noo saameeyeen,” ayuu yiri Ameeriko. “Laakiin sidoo kale waxaan qaadnay tallaabooyin aan uga fogaaneyno carqaladdaas.” Waxa uu sheegay in maamulka dekedda iyo ganacsatada wax dhoofisa ay ka wada shaqeynayaan sidii loo heli lahaa marinno kale. “Markii ugu horreysay waxaan keenay markab sonkor si toos ah uga soo qaaday Sri Lanka,” ayuu yiri. “Tani waxay noqon kartaa istaraatiijiyad aan sameynay sababo la xiriira xiisadahan.” Tallaabadan ayaa muujineysa sida xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas iyo Khaliijka ay u beddeli karto habka ay Soomaaliya ku hesho badeecooyinka muhiimka ah, iyadoo dalka uu si weyn ugu tiirsan yahay ganacsiga badda. Dekedda Muqdisho ayaa maalin kasta qaabisha maraakiib sida raashinka, qalabka iyo badeecooyinka kale ee muhiimka u ah nolosha shacabka. Dhibaato kasta oo ku timaadda marinnada badda ayaa sidaas darteed si toos ah ama dadban u taaban karta suuqyada gudaha. Haddii maraakiibtu isticmaalaan marinno dheer ama kharash badan, waxaa kordhi kara qarashaadka gaadiidka, halka badeecooyinkuna ay dib uga dhici karaan waqtigii la filayay inay suuqyada soo gaaraan. Kabtan Cali Jemdi, oo asal ahaan kasoo jeeda Suuriya isla markaana qaada shixnado sonkor ah, ayaa wakaaladda wararka AP u sheegay in hubanti la’aanta gobolka ay walaac ku abuurtay maraakiibta isticmaasha marinnadaas. “Dhibaato ayaa halkaas ka jirta dagaalka awgiis,” ayuu yiri, isagoo ka hadlayay Gacanka Carabta iyo biyaha ku hareeraysan. “Bab al-Mandab-na sidoo kale waxaa laga yaabaa inuu dhibaato ku noqdo markabka.” Waxa uu sheegay in xaaladda amni-darro ay sii adkeyn karto gaadiidka badda iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Dhanka Yemen, dowladda caalamku aqoonsan yahay iyo Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa muddo 12 sano ah dagaal kula jiray Xuutiyiinta. Xiisadda cusub ayaa soo afjartay xabbad-joojin tan iyo 2022 si weyn u yareysay dagaalladii sokeeye ee dalkaas. Dagaallada soo cusboonaaday ayaa sidoo kale horseeday barakac ballaaran. Hay’adda Socdaalka Adduunka ee IOM ayaa Axaddii sheegtay in in ka badan 85,000 oo qof ay barakaceen tan iyo bilowgii bishan. In ka badan 2,000 oo qof ayaa sidoo kale gaaray Jabuuti, oo dhinaca kale ee Bab al-Mandab kaga beegan Yemen isla markaana daris la ah Soomaaliya. Isbeddellada ka socda Yemen iyo marinnada muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab iyo Hormuz ayaa sidaas darteed saameyn ka baxsan goobaha dagaalka ku yeelan kara dalalka gobolka, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay hadda isku dayeyso inay yareyso khatarta ku iman karta silsiladda sahayda iyo badeecooyinka ay dibadda kala soo degto. items.title: Yemen: Yemen conflict enters new phase as clashes move toward Bab Al-Mandab Strait
items.description: Shotlist FILE: Yemen – March 2024 (CCTV – No access Chinese mainland) 1. Various of cityscape, national flag of Yemen Sanaa, Yemen – Sept 12, 2026 (CGTN – No access Chinese mainland) 2. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Hizam al-Asad, member, Political Bureau of Ansar Allah (Houthis): “There are no implications for the security and safety of navigation in the Red Sea, and there is no reason for concern in this regard. We assure everyone that there is no cause for concern about maritime security. Navigation is safe and stable, operating normally and smoothly, and there are no intentions in this regard.” FILE: Yemen – 2022 (CGTN – No access Chinese mainland) 3. Various of Mayun Island in Bab al-Mandab Strait, armed soldiers on vehicles Sanaa, Yemen – Sept 12, 2026 (CGTN – No access Chinese mainland) 4. SOUNDBITE (Arabic)Rashad Al-Wutairi, military expert (starting with shot 3): “The Israeli enemy is trying today, in various ways, to strengthen its presence near the Bab Al-Mandab Strait by building relations with Somaliland. It has also made significant moves and visits to Al Mokha and other areas. However, recent developments have weakened this strategy and undermined the plans and arrangements Israel had built.” FILE: Red Sea – 2024 (CGTN – No access Chinese mainland) 5. Various of ships at sea Storyline Conflict in Yemen between the Houthis–officially known as Ansar Allah, and Saudi-backed government forces has entered a new phase along the western coast, with clashes moving toward the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, a key maritime route in the region. Houthis announced Friday that they had taken control of six districts in the western provinces of Taiz and Al-Hudaydah, covering about 5,400 square kilometers, in an operation that began on Sept. 3. The group also said commercial ships would not be targeted, with the exception of Saudi vessels. “There are no implications for the security and safety of navigation in the Red Sea, and there is no reason for concern in this regard. We assure everyone that there is no cause for concern about maritime security. Navigation is safe and stable, operating normally and smoothly, and there are no intentions in this regard,” said Hizam al-Asad, a member of the Political Bureau of Ansar Allah (Houthis). Yemeni government sources said that Houthis has also taken control of the Mayun Island, also known as Perim, in the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, a strategic waterway linking the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden. In response, forces loyal to Yemen’s internationally recognized government, with backing from Saudi Arabia, launched a military operation described as a “kill zone”. The operation designates areas along the western coast, including Al Mokha and Dhu Bab, as zones for intensive military strikes. “The Israeli enemy is trying today, in various ways, to strengthen its presence near the Bab Al-Mandab Strait by building relations with Somaliland. It has also made significant moves and visits to Al Mokha and other areas. However, recent developments have weakened this strategy and undermined the plans and arrangements Israel had built,” said Rashad Al-Wutairi, a military expert. The escalation is now extending beyond Yemen’s front lines, with fighting reaching areas that overlook the southern entrance to the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, one of the world’s most strategically important shipping routes. The developments are also raising concerns beyond Yemen. Egyptian government has formed a crisis cell, a high-level committee tasked with monitoring the situation along Yemen’s western coast. Egyptian government is concerned that any disruption to shipping through the Red Sea could have a direct impact on traffic through the Suez Canal, a vital artery for global maritime trade.

The operation designates areas along the western coast, including Al Mokha and Dhu Bab, as zones for intensive military strikes. “The Israeli enemy is trying today, in various ways, to strengthen its presence near the Bab Al-Mandab Strait by building relations with Somaliland. It has also made significant moves and visits to Al Mokha and other areas. However, recent developments have weakened this strategy and undermined the plans and arrangements Israel had built,” said Rashad Al-Wutairi, a military expert. The escalation is now extending beyond Yemen’s front lines, with fighting reaching areas that overlook the southern entrance to the Bab Al-Mandab Strait, one of the world’s most strategically important shipping routes. The developments are also raising concerns beyond Yemen. Egyptian government has formed a crisis cell, a high-level committee tasked with monitoring the situation along Yemen’s western coast. Egyptian government is concerned that any disruption to shipping through the Red Sea could have a direct impact on traffic through the Suez Canal, a vital artery for global maritime trade.

items.title: The Red Sea Fight Needs an African Shore
items.description: By Jonah Brody and MajGen Robert Sofge The United States (US) military presence in East Africa is well positioned to help defend the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, but its basing arrangements and host-country restrictions were designed primarily for counterterrorism rather than a maritime confrontation with Yemen’s Iran-backed political-military movement Ansar Allah, better known as the Houthis. As the war with Iran exposes the vulnerability of Red Sea commerce, Washington should develop distributed access at Berbera, in Somaliland, and Bosaso, in the semi-autonomous Somali region of Puntland. These footholds would support surveillance, maritime security, and contingency operations. Such arrangements would reduce dependence on Djibouti, bridge the operational divide between Africa Command and Central Command, and strengthen the US military’s ability to defend the chokepoint without requiring immediate recognition of Somaliland. Introduction The war between the US and Iran has opened a new maritime front along the Red Sea. As Washington and Tehran contest the Strait of Hormuz, Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis have declared a blockade of Saudi commerce through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait—the narrow waterway splitting Yemen and Djibouti that forms the southern gateway to the Red Sea. The corridor’s importance has grown for the global economy as Saudi Arabia now leans on the passage to export oil, now that the Strait of Hormuz has seized up. Ships still transit, but under enough risk that Saudi tankers now run dark and reroute . The threat reaches past Saudi Arabia: Houthi missiles have struck vessels flying non-Saudi flags and left merchant crews dead. That southern access point to the Red Sea is now contested, and the US posture there was built for an important but entirely different fight. The Counterterrorism Posture Meets a Maritime War The US military posture in East Africa is well placed but too narrowly tasked. For two decades, US Africa Command (AFRICOM) has optimized its East Africa presence for counterterrorism in Somalia : surveillance flights, strikes, special operations, and partner training against al-Shabaab, the Somalia-based al-Qaeda affiliate, and the Islamic State. That fight is necessary, and it has helped prevent al-Shabaab from overtaking the Somali capital of Mogadishu and driven the Islamic State’s Somalia branch into hiding . But while US forces in Africa, concentrated in Djibouti, sit almost exactly where a Red Sea fight would want them, their basing arrangements were built for striking and advising inland counterterrorism operations , and Djibouti’s restrictions constrain the offshore operations the Houthi threat now requires. The strategic landscape has outgrown an access architecture built for a narrower fight. Geography compounds the problem. The Bab el-Mandeb divides two US combatant commands, AFRICOM to its west and Central Command (CENTCOM)—which remains focused on the fight against Iran—to its east. Adversaries have long worked that seam. Recent public reporting from the Wall Street Journal describes Houthi technicians supplying al-Shabaab with drone and explosive-device expertise. The two groups have not merged their campaigns, but they share a common enemy. Their cooperation shows how untenable it is to treat the two shores as separate files. Djibouti Is Not Enough On the African shore, the American presence rests solely on one installation. Camp Lemonnier in Djibouti sits close to the strait —offering prime real estate for operations—but Djibouti has refused to let US forces strike Houthi positions that threaten the Bab el-Mandeb. Ironically, America’s only base in Africa cannot be used to defend the strait critical to its economic well-being. China’s only overseas base sits a few miles away, a separate reason not to stake America’s presence on one location. On the Arabian side, major CENTCOM operating locations sit well away from the chokepoint. A single base in Djibouti is not enough; Washington needs options. Build a Distributed Network at Berbera and Bosaso The near-term answer to the Houthi challenge is distributed access, and the US can build it quickly. Somaliland has offered the US the use of Berbera, which pairs one of the longest runways in Africa with a deep-water port on the Gulf of Aden. From Berbera, US forces could fly persistent surveillance over the strait; base maritime patrol and counter-drone assets; refuel and stage naval and special operations; and hold a recovery airfield on the chokepoint’s southern flank. Berbera would not win the maritime fight by itself, but it would give the US an additional, politically unencumbered foothold that Djibouti will not provide. The semi-autonomous Somali state of Puntland offers a second option. The US has agreed to expand the base at Bosaso, another Gulf of Aden port, for counterterrorism and maritime security. The deal is young and its results are unproven, but its significance is the shift it represents: the US has demonstrated a willingness to make direct security arrangements with capable sub-federal authorities when operations demand it, rather than wait on the federal government in Mogadishu. Bosaso and Berbera together would give American forces a network across the coast that matters most. Access at Berbera would also align the US with Israel, which recognized Somaliland in December and, according to Bloomberg , has established a small intelligence presence there and is exploring a base from which to monitor and strike the Houthis. Somaliland’s leaders have been guarded about hosting foreign forces, so this remains unsettled. But a shared foothold on the southern flank would knit together partners already hitting the same Iranian adversary. Access Without Immediate Recognition The US needs only enough access to improve its ability to defend the Bab el-Mandeb, and that does not require recognizing Somaliland now. Skeptics will call a base at Berbera a de facto recognition of Somaliland, even if the US does not say so in an official capacity. But access can rest on a security agreement with the Somaliland authorities that govern Berbera by dealing with them as the party in control on the ground, which avoids recognizing Somaliland as a sovereign state. That is the approach the US just took at Bosaso, where it dealt directly with Puntland’s local authorities instead of Somalia’s federal government in Mogadishu. Going around the federal government does carry real costs: strain on a fragile federal system; propaganda for al-Shabaab; and friction with the African Union, Turkey, the UAE, and Ethiopia. But two facts blunt the sovereignty charge. The federal government cannot deliver quick, reliable coastal access in a crisis. And in early 2025 Somalia itself offered the US its strategic ports, Berbera and Bosaso among them, that it does not control. The Houthi threat predates this war and will likely outlast it. The tools to manage it—runways, ports, sensors, patrol aircraft, and counter-drone systems—are available on both shores of the chokepoint. If we have learned anything from the current fight in the Persian Gulf, it is that getting the geography right in front of a full-blown crisis matters.     Source Smallwarsjournal

items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo weerarro cusub ku qaaday Sacuudiga
items.description: Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa qaaday weerarro cusub oo ay ku beegsanayaan gudaha Sacuudiga, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan dagaallada Yemen, isla markaana ay hakadeen dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu doonayay in dib loogu furo Marin-biyoodka Hormuz oo muhiim u ah isu-socodka shidaalka caalamka. Sida ay Reuters werisay, Xuutiyiinta ayaa Isniintii sheegay inay dhowr iyo toban gantaal iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ku weerareen saldhigga cirka ee Khamis Mushait ee koonfurta Sacuudiga. Waxay sheegeen in weerarka lagu bartilmaameedsaday hangarrada diyaaradaha, nidaamyada radar-ka, runway-yada iyo bakhaarada rasaasta. Isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo ee ka dagaallama Yemen ayaa sheegay in weerarradaasi ay ku dhaawacmeen 13 qof oo rayid ah , halka maamulka Sacuudigu uu digniino degdeg ah ka bixiyay Khamis Mushait iyo saddex magaalo oo kale oo ku yaalla koonfurta dalka. Weerarradan ayaa imanaya iyadoo Xuutiyiintu maalmihii u dambeeyay ay ballaarinayeen dhaq-dhaqaaqooda milatari, gaar ahaan xeebaha galbeed ee Yemen ee ku teedsan Badda Cas. Saraakiil ka tirsan dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay weli si wax ku ool ah u maamulaan inta badan xeebaha galbeed ee dalka, oo ay ku jirto jasiiradda Perim , oo ku taalla afka laga galo Badda Cas. Dhanka kale, ciidamada cirka Sacuudiga iyo kuwa dowladda Yemen ayaa kordhiyay duqeymaha ay ku qaadayaan goobaha ay Xuutiyiintu maamulaan, oo ay ku jiraan deegaanada ku dhow dekedda taariikhiga ah ee Mocha . Saraakiil Yemeni ah ayaa sheegay in inkastoo Xuutiyiinta cadaadis milatari lagu hayo, haddana ay iyaguna kordhinayaan weerarrada gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee ka dhanka ah Sacuudiga. Xiisadda ayaa sidoo kale cadaadis ku sii kordhinaysa dhoofinta shidaalka Sacuudiga, kaddib markii weerar cirka ah oo dhacay Khamiistii uu shaqada ka joojiyay dhuumaha shidaalka ee isku xira bariga iyo galbeedka dalka. Riyadh ayaa weerarka ku eedeysay maleeshiyaad Iran taageerto oo ka howlgala Ciraaq. Dhuumahaasi oo dhererkoodu yahay ku dhowaad 1,200 kiiloomitir ayaa Sacuudigu u dhisay inuu shidaalka uga gudbiyo Gacanka una diro Badda Cas, taasoo u oggolaanaysa inuu ka fogaado Marin-biyoodka Hormuz haddii marin-biyoodkaasi halis galo. Ganacsatada shidaalka ayaa sheegay in haddii dhuumahaasi muddo dheer xirnaadaan, iyadoo Hormuz-na uu si weyn u xanniban yahay, ay suuragal tahay in saameyntu gaarto ilaa 4 boqolkiiba sahayda shidaalka adduunka . Qiimaha saliidda cayriin ayaa Isniintii kor u kacay in ka badan 4 boqolkiiba, inkastoo uu markii dambe ku soo xirnaa koror ku dhow 1 boqolkiiba. Mareykanka oo ka gaabsanaya faragelin toos ah Dagaalka cusub ee Yemen ayaa caqabad kale ku noqday madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump. Saddex ilo-wareed oo Reuters la hadlay ayaa sheegay in Washington ay ilaa hadda ka gaabsatay codsiyada Sacuudiga ee ku aaddan faragelin militari oo toos ah, iyadoo taageerada Mareykanka ay inta badan ku kooban tahay xogta sirdoonka. Trump ayaa sheegay inuu dhammaadka toddobaadkii la hadlay dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga, Maxamed bin Salmaan, halka Xuutiyiintuna ay Washington kala xiriireen inay Mareykanka ka fogaato dagaalka. Warbaahinta dowladda Sacuudiga ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Maxamed bin Salmaan uu Isniintii magaalada Jeddah kula kulmay Admiral Brad Cooper, oo ah taliyaha ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Dhanka kale, rajadii laga qabay in xiisadda gobolka lagu dejiyo wada-hadal ayaa sii yaraanaysa. Cumaan ayaa qorsheynayay inuu Isniintii martigeliyo kulan ay Iran iyo dalalka Khaliijku kaga wada hadlaan sidii dib loogu furi lahaa Marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Hase yeeshee, kulanka ayaa dib loo dhigay. Trump ayaa mar kale sheegay in Iran ay diyaar u tahay heshiis degdeg ah, balse Mohsen Rezaei, oo ka tirsan Golaha Sare ee Amniga Qaranka Iran, ayaa hadalkaas ku tilmaamay wax mashquulinaya, isagoo sheegay inaysan jiri doonin wada-hadallo ilaa shuruudaha Iran la buuxiyo. Xiisadda badda ayaa sidoo kale sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo maraakiibta isticmaasha Hormuz. Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran ayaa sheegtay in markabka shidaalka El Gaia , oo sita calanka Panama, uu ku dhacay miinooyin badeed isagoo marayay aag Iran ay mamnuucday oo ku yaalla koonfurta Hormuz. Hase yeeshee, Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka ayaa si degdeg ah u beeniyay sheegashadaas, isagoo sheegay in markabka uu bishii hore ku dhacay gantaal laga soo riday Iran, taasoo ka dhigtay mid aan shaqayn karin. Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Badaha ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa xaqiijisay in markabka uu waxyeello soo gaartay Sabtidii, balse ma aysan sheegin sababta, iyadoo sidoo kale sheegtay in Reuters ayaa sheegtay inaysan si degdeg ah ula xiriiri karin milkiilayaasha markabka oo ku sugan Dubai si ay u xaqiijiso wararka iska soo horjeeda. Hormuz ayaa weli ah mid ka mid ah marinnada shidaalka ee ugu muhiimsan dunida, waxaana Reuters ay sheegtay in isu-socodkiisu si weyn u hakaday tan iyo markii dagaalku billowday 28-kii Febraayo. Xuutiyiinta iyo Iran ayaa sii wada tallaabooyinka kordhinaya khatarta ku wajahan maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo sahayda tamarta caalamka.

items.title: Soomaaliya Oo Ka Qaybgalaysa Kalfadhiga Degdegga Ah Ee Wasiirrada IGAD
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali, ayaa gaaray magaalada Jabuuti, halkaas oo uu wafdiga Soomaaliya uga hoggaaminayo kalfadhiga 74-aad ee aan caadiga ahayn ee Golaha Wasiirrada urur-goboleedka IGAD. Kalfadhiga oo loo qorsheeyey 15-ka Sebteembar ayaa waxaa ka qayb-galaya wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda iyo wakiillo ka socda dalalka xubnaha ka ah IGAD. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa xaaladda nabadda iyo ammaanka gobolka iyo arrimo la xiriira howlaha ururka. Wasiirrada ayaa la filayaa inay qiimeeyaan isbeddellada siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee ka jira Geeska Afrika, xilli gobolka uu wajahayo colaado, xiisado diblomaasiyadeed iyo xaalado bani’aadannimo. Shirka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadli doonaa qodobbo hay’adeed, oo ay ku jirto xoojinta heshiiska lagu aasaasay IGAD iyo kor u qaadidda awoodda ururka ee wax ka qabashada caqabadaha gobolka. Ka qaybgalka Soomaaliya wuxuu ku soo beegmayaa xilli dalku door muuqda ku leeyahay wada-hadallada gobolka ee ku saabsan amniga, iskaashiga siyaasadeed iyo xallinta khilaafaadka, hase yeeshee, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda weli ma faahfaahin mowqifyada ama soo-jeedimaha gaarka ah ee wafdiga Soomaaliya uu shirka la tegayo. Natiijada kalfadhiga ayaa la filayaa inay muujiso sida dalalka IGAD uga jawaabayaan xaaladaha isbeddelaya ee Geeska Afrika iyo jihada dib-u-habeynta ururka. War-murtiyeedka shirka ayaa sidoo kale caddeyn kara go’aannada laga gaaro arrimaha nabadda, ammaanka iyo xoojinta wada-shaqeynta gobolka.

items.title: G Maraykanka oo markii ugu horreysay xaqiijiyay inuu hawada sare geeyay hub dagaal
items.description: Maraykanka ayaa xaqiijiyay inuu hawada sare, meeraha Dhulka ku wareegsan, geeyay hub loo adeegsado dagaalka hawada sare, taas oo ah markii ugu horreysay ee uu si rasmi ah u qiro inuu leeyahaP0P0⁰Tetd886w awood noocaas ah oo weerar ah. Xoghayaha Ciidanka Cirka ee Maraykanka, Troy Meink, ayaa sheegay in hubka ku sugan hawada sare uu muhiim u yahay ilaalinta ciidamada Maraykanka iyo ka hortagga weerarrada cadowga. Isagoo Isniintii ka hadlayay shirkii Ciidanka Cirka, Hawada Sare iyo Internet-ka ee loo yaqaan Air, Space and Cyber Conference, Meink wuxuu sheegay in Maraykanku diyaar u yahay inuu wajaho “khataraha isbeddelaya”, balse ma uusan faahfaahin awoodda hubkan ama xiligii hawada sare la geeyay. Hoggaamiyeyaasha sare ee milatariga Maraykanka ayaa horey u sheegay inay qorsheynayaan in la xoojiyo awoodda milatari ee hawada sare, iyagoo tilmaamay barnaamijyada Ruushka iyo Shiinaha ee lagu horumarinayo habab lagu weerari karo ama lagu carqaladeyn karo dayax-gacmeedyada Maraykanka haddii uu mustaqbalka dagaal dhaco. Maamulka Trump ayaa sheegay in awoodaha milatari ee hawada sare iyo gantaallada wax-ka-qabta ay qayb muhiim ah ka yihiin nidaamka difaaca uu qorsheeyay ee loo yaqaan “Golden Dome”, kaas oo loogu talagalay in Maraykanka laga ilaaliyo gantaallada iyo khataraha kale ee hawada. Heshiis caalami ah oo la saxiixay sannadkii 1967 ayaa mamnuucaya in hubka wax gumaada la geeyo ama lagu keydiyo hawada sare. Tan iyo markaas, quwadaha waaweyn oo ay ka mid yihiin Maraykanka, Ruushka iyo Shiinaha ayaa baarayay awoodo kale oo aan heshiiskaas si toos ah uga hor imaanayn, sida in la bartilmaameedsado dayax-gacmeedyada dalalka ay iska soo horjeedaan. Dayax-gacmeedyadu waxay muhiim u yihiin isgaarsiinta milatariga, la socodka iyo hagidda ciidamada. Sannadkii hore, Madaxweyne Donald Trump wuxuu soo saaray amar fulineed oo xoojinaya doorka Ciidanka Hawada Sare ee Maraykanka , isaga oo sheegay in ciidanku uusan ku koobnaan doonin oo keliya difaaca hantida Maraykanka ee hawada sare, balse uu sidoo kale yeelan karo awood weerar. US Space Force, oo ah laanta ugu cusub ee ciidamada qalabka sida ee Maraykanka muddo ka badan 70 sano, waxaa la aas-aasay sannadkii 2019 si loo ilaaliyo hantida Maraykanka ee hawada sare, oo ay ku jiraan boqolaal dayax-gacmeed oo loo adeegsado isgaarsiinta iyo kormeerka. Afhayeen u hadlay Ciidanka Hawada Sare ee Maraykanka ayaa sheegay in “xakamaynta hawada sare” ay ka kooban tahay hawlgallada looga baahan yahay in lagu tartamo laguna xakameeyo goobta hawada sare, iyadoo la adeegsanayo habab waxyeello geysta iyo kuwo aan waxyeello toos ah geysan si loo carqaladeeyo, loo wiiqo ama xitaa loo burburiyo awoodaha cadowga haddii loo baahdo. Afhayeenku wuxuu sheegay in awoodahan loo adeegsan karo difaac iyo weerarba, iyadoo lagu salaynayo amarrada hoggaanka ciidamada dagaalka. Horraantii bishii Febraayo, waxaa la shaaciyay in laba dayax-gacmeed oo Ruushku leeyahay ay u badan tahay inay qabteen ama dhexgaleen isgaarsiinta ugu yaraan 12 dayax-gacmeed oo Yurub leeyahay tan iyo markii Ruushku duullaanka ku qaaday Ukraine sannadkii 2022-kii. Dhexgalka noocaas ah ayaa laga yaabaa inuu sirdoonka Ruushka u saamaxay inuu akhriyo xogta xasaasiga ah ee ay dayax-gacmeedyadu gudbinayeen, ama, aragti ahaan, xitaa inuu la wareego gacan-ku-haynta dayax-gacmeedyada. Sannadkii 2024, Maraykanku wuxuu sheegay in Ruushku hawada sare u diray dayax-gacmeed uu Maraykanku aaminsanaa inuu awood u leeyahay inuu weeraro dayax-gacmeedyo kale. Ruushku si rasmi ah ugama uusan hadlin arrintaas. Ciidanka Hawada Sare ee Maraykanka ayaa sheegay in Shiinuhu “horumariyo oo isticmaalo awoodo hawada sare iyo kuwa lidka-hawada sare ah, taas oo qayb ka ah istaraatiijiyaddiisa casriyeynta milatariga.” Waxa kale oo uu sheegay in Ruushku “hawada sare u arko goob dagaal, isla markaana aaminsan yahay in ka sarreysnaanta hawada sare ay noqon doonto arrin go’aamisa dagaallada mustaqbalka.” Bbc somali

items.title: Duurjoog gaajaysan oo qasaare gaarsiiyay dalagyada beeraleyda Togdheer
items.description: (ERGO) – Xayn daab la’aan haysa beeraha tuulooyin hoostaga dagmada Sheekh ee gobolka Togdheer ayaa ka hor istaagay 150 beeraley ah in sii wataan beero falashada oo ahaa ishooda dhaqaale, markii xayawaano ku hungoobay helidda roobka ay caqabd u noqdeen dalagga beeraha. Waxay wajahayaan cunno xumo ka sii daraysa tan bishii Juun ee sanadkan, markaas oo ay joojiyeen tacabka beeraha, kaddib qasaare ay u gaysteen daanyeerro, doofaarro iyo xayawaano kale, kuwaas oo cunay dalagyo ay beerteen labo fasal oo is-xigay. Dhir yaraanta ka jirta deegannadooda Cagaarey, Ximin, Boodhlay ayaa u saamixi wayday in ay beeraha u helaan gaashaan ka difaaca xayawaanka, halka sidoo kale ay iibsan waayeen silig ay ku wareejiyaan sida uu sheegay Axmed Cumar Cige oo ah gudoomiye iskaashato ay leeyihiin. “Ood uun baa celin karta, lamana samayn karo. Xabad laguma ridi karo, gacan kuma dili kartid oo magaaraysidba. Habeenkii iyo maalintiiba way soo galayaan. Haddii aad sumayso xayawanka iyo bini’aadamka waxwalb way sumoobayaan. Waxay noqotay fursad adag oo aan waxba la beeran karin.” Beeraleydii ugu danbeeyay ee qasaraha uu gaaaray beerahooda waxaa ka mid ah Maxamed Cismaan Warsame. Duurjoog u badan daanyeer ayaa ka cunay dalag u saarnaa beer 2 hiktar ah, isla markaana iskugu jiray noocyada kala duwan ee khudaarta, galay iyo digir. Wuxuu tilmaamay in billowgii sanadkan uu joojiyay in uu dalag galiyo beertiisa oo ku taalla cirifka dhul-beereedka deegaanka Cagaarey, halkaas oo uu ku wajahay weerarka xayawaanka oo qasaare gaarsiiyay dalagyo uu ku beertay. Bishii Abriil ayuu kiraystay dhul ku yaalla bartamaha dhul beereedka si uu u helo meel uu kaga badbaado Daanyeerka iyo duurjoogta kale, balse bishii Juun oo dalaggu gurasho ku dhawaa ayuu la kulmay weerar kale, wuxuuna ku waayay dhamaan mirihii uu beertay. “Aniga oo dhex jooga ayuu daanyeerku isaga oo malaha 500 oo xabbo ah 3 qayb inta uu iskadhigay ayuu dhinac waxba ka soo galay, dabadeedna circle buu igaliyay. Waan ka niyad jabay, haddana marka duruuftu ku kalifayso waxaad is oranaysaa, haddana wax tabco; Marka waa kuuna taag li’i, kaamana tagi karo.” Dalagga uu ka cunay xayawaanka ayuu galiyay lacag dhan $800, taas oo qayb ka mid ah uu dayn ku helay, sida kirada dhulka uu beertay oo ahaa $200 iyo abuurka. Waa qasarihii saddexaad ee ka soo gaaray xayawaanka labadii sano ee u danbeeyay, taas oo kaliftay in uu ka quusto beero-falashada. Beertiisa waxaa ku tiirsanaa qoyskiisa oo 12 ah, kuwaas duruufta nolol xumo ay sababtay in ay labo u qayb samaan. Lix ka mid ah ayuu u geeyay qoys ay ehelo yihiin oo ku nool dagmada Sheekh, markii uu awood u waayay in uu dhamaantood wada quudiyo. Carruurta la joogta 48 saacba mar ayay helaan cunno ay dabka saartaan. Toban ari ah oo uu dhaqdo ayuu ka lisaa caano uu suuq geeyo. Wuxuu sheegay in labadii maalinba mar uu ka helo $3. Wuxuu ugu iibiyaa kiilooyin raashin ah. Xoolaha u jooga ayuu sheegay in uu ku quudiyo bal uu kaydiyay, kaas oo ka sii dhamaanaya iyo biyo uu ka helo ceel sii guraya oo beerta uu ku waraabin jiray. Wuxuu ka dayriyay ku tiirsnaanta xoolaha oo roob la’aanta dabadheeraatay ay galaafan karto. Wuxuu sheegay in muddo 22 sano ah oo beeraley uu ahaa uusan horay u la kulmin qasaare la mid tan ay bideen xayawaanka doogga cuna, kuwaas ku kalifay in uu iskaga tago beertiisa. “Wixii aan quudan jirnay ama aan ciyaalka wax ka bari jirnay waa nalooga xoog roonaaday. Marka waxaan doorbiday in carruurta aan kala fogeeyo cidihii ehelkooda ahaa midba aan reer u geeyo. Wax la quutaa ma jiraa ee waa iska maqade-ma-dharge.” Todoobo ka mid ah carruurtiisa waxay ka mid yihiin ku dhawaad 80 carruur ah oo waxbarasho la’aan noqday. Waxaa u sabab ah markii uu xirmay dugsi hoose oo ku yaallay deegaanka Cagaarey bishii Julay. Iskuulka oo lagu dhiganayay lacag ayaa dhaqaale la’aan u xirmay. Wuxuu ku tiirsanaa dhaqaalaha laga qaadayay qoysaska ay ka soo jeedaan carruurta oo beeraley u badan, kuwaas awoodi waayay in ay helaan qarashka waxbarshada sida uu Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay Axmed Cumar Cige guddoomiyaha iskaashatada beeralayda. Dhibaatada xawawaanka uu u gaystay waxaa ugu biirtay kaydadkii biyaha oo guray, kaddib roob yari haysay deegaannadooda labadii sano ee u danbeeyay. Beeralayda qaar malahan ceelal, halka kuwa leh shidaalka oo qaali ah ay ku dhiiran waayeen in ay wax beertaan. Cabdiraxmaan Abokar Axmed oo beer labo hiktar ah ku leh deegaanka Cagarey tan bishii May beertiisa ma tabcin, markii uu ku qaasaray dalag u badnaa galey, digir iyo masago oo xayawaanku uu ka cunay. Wuxuu sheegay in qoyskiisa oo afar ah ay la daalaadhacayaan xumo ka dhalatay xaaladdaas, maaddama ay ku tiirsanaayeen raashinka iyo dhaqaalaha laga helo beerta. Wuxuu maciin-biday dad ay helo yihiin, kuwaas oo ku kala nool Sheekh, Burco iyo Barbara. Marka uu cabto ayuu sheegay in ay taleefoonkiisa gacanta ay ugu soo tuuraan lacag uu ku iibsado kiilooyin raashin. Waa cunno aan joogto ahayn, isla markaana aan ku filnayn haddii ay helaan. Xaaladdan quusta ah ayuu xusay in aysan hayn awood ay kaga dabaashaan haddii aysan kaalmo ka helin Somaaliland si looga difaaco xayawaanka, beerahana ay u helaan gaashaan. “Ood la’aan baan ka cabanaynaa iyo xayawaankii oo noocyo badan oo doofaar leh, daanyeer leh oo ugaartii deeradu ka mid tahay, kuwaas oo saraha sidii riyaha u cunaya. Dhul bannaan oo wixii aad kaga oodan lahayd ama uga ilaalsan lahayd aysan jirin oo bannaan ah oo adiga oo xagaas jooga ay xaga kale ka soo galayso (xayawaanka). Howlaheedu way badan yihiin.” Wuxuu tilmaamay in ay rajaynayaan helidda roob ku filan deegaanka, kaas oo xal u noqon karha dhibaatada ay wajahayaan, maaddama ay meesha ka bixi karto baahida keentay in xayawaanku ay ku soo duulaan dalagga. Cabdiraxmaan wuxuu iskudayay helidda shaqo xoogsi ah oo nolosha uu ku maareeyo, balse wuu ku hungoobay, maaddama deegaankiisa fursado shaqo aysan ka jirin. Waxaa la mid ah beeraleyda kale, kuwaas oo ku haminaya helidda il-kale oo dhaqaale uu ka soo galo. Waxay quus ka muujiyay ceelsha biyaha ee sii guraya, kuwaas oo sababay biyo yari. Wuxuu xusay in qoyskiisa hadda ay ku tiirsan yihiin biyo ku jira bac uu dhulka galiyay si uu u kaydsado. Waxaa ugu shubay nin qaraabo ay yihiin oo gaadiidley ah. Wuxuu ka cabanayaa heerka biyo yarida oo ku qasbi kara in ay ka hayaamaan deegaanka haddii aysan helin roob ku filan. “Roob yarida ayaa biyo la’aanta keentay. Roobabkii ayaa dhulka ku yaraaday. Ilaahey baa leh cabashada. Laakiin ciddii wax naga caawin karta in ay naga caawiso waan u baahannahay.” Roob la’aanta dabadheeraatay waxay si guud u saamaysay dadka iyo xayawaanka iskugu jira kuwa la dhaqdo iyo duurjoogta ku nool daaqa, kuwaas oo duruuftu ku qasabtay in ay weeraraan beeraha isla markaana ay beeraleyda ka cunaan dalagyada ay beerteen. items.fullContent: (ERGO) – Xayn daab la’aan haysa beeraha tuulooyin hoostaga dagmada Sheekh ee gobolka Togdheer ayaa ka hor istaagay 150 beeraley ah in sii wataan beero falashada oo ahaa ishooda dhaqaale, markii xayawaano ku hungoobay helidda roobka ay caqabd u noqdeen dalagga beeraha. Waxay wajahayaan cunno xumo ka sii daraysa tan bishii Juun ee sanadkan, markaas oo ay joojiyeen tacabka beeraha, kaddib qasaare ay u gaysteen daanyeerro, doofaarro iyo xayawaano kale, kuwaas oo cunay dalagyo ay beerteen labo fasal oo is-xigay. Dhir yaraanta ka jirta deegannadooda Cagaarey, Ximin, Boodhlay ayaa u saamixi wayday in ay beeraha u helaan gaashaan ka difaaca xayawaanka, halka sidoo kale ay iibsan waayeen silig ay ku wareejiyaan sida uu sheegay Axmed Cumar Cige oo ah gudoomiye iskaashato ay leeyihiin. “Ood uun baa celin karta, lamana samayn karo. Xabad laguma ridi karo, gacan kuma dili kartid oo magaaraysidba. Habeenkii iyo maalintiiba way soo galayaan. Haddii aad sumayso xayawanka iyo bini’aadamka waxwalb way sumoobayaan. Waxay noqotay fursad adag oo aan waxba la beeran karin.” Beeraleydii ugu danbeeyay ee qasaraha uu gaaaray beerahooda waxaa ka mid ah Maxamed Cismaan Warsame. Duurjoog u badan daanyeer ayaa ka cunay dalag u saarnaa beer 2 hiktar ah, isla markaana iskugu jiray noocyada kala duwan ee khudaarta, galay iyo digir. Wuxuu tilmaamay in billowgii sanadkan uu joojiyay in uu dalag galiyo beertiisa oo ku taalla cirifka dhul-beereedka deegaanka Cagaarey, halkaas oo uu ku wajahay weerarka xayawaanka oo qasaare gaarsiiyay dalagyo uu ku beertay. Bishii Abriil ayuu kiraystay dhul ku yaalla bartamaha dhul beereedka si uu u helo meel uu kaga badbaado Daanyeerka iyo duurjoogta kale, balse bishii Juun oo dalaggu gurasho ku dhawaa ayuu la kulmay weerar kale, wuxuuna ku waayay dhamaan mirihii uu beertay. “Aniga oo dhex jooga ayuu daanyeerku isaga oo malaha 500 oo xabbo ah 3 qayb inta uu iskadhigay ayuu dhinac waxba ka soo galay, dabadeedna circle buu igaliyay. Waan ka niyad jabay, haddana marka duruuftu ku kalifayso waxaad is oranaysaa, haddana wax tabco; Marka waa kuuna taag li’i, kaamana tagi karo.” Dalagga uu ka cunay xayawaanka ayuu galiyay lacag dhan $800, taas oo qayb ka mid ah uu dayn ku helay, sida kirada dhulka uu beertay oo ahaa $200 iyo abuurka. Waa qasarihii saddexaad ee ka soo gaaray xayawaanka labadii sano ee u danbeeyay, taas oo kaliftay in uu ka quusto beero-falashada. Beertiisa waxaa ku tiirsanaa qoyskiisa oo 12 ah, kuwaas duruufta nolol xumo ay sababtay in ay labo u qayb samaan. Lix ka mid ah ayuu u geeyay qoys ay ehelo yihiin oo ku nool dagmada Sheekh, markii uu awood u waayay in uu dhamaantood wada quudiyo. Carruurta la joogta 48 saacba mar ayay helaan cunno ay dabka saartaan. Toban ari ah oo uu dhaqdo ayuu ka lisaa caano uu suuq geeyo. Wuxuu sheegay in labadii maalinba mar uu ka helo $3. Wuxuu ugu iibiyaa kiilooyin raashin ah. Xoolaha u jooga ayuu sheegay in uu ku quudiyo bal uu kaydiyay, kaas oo ka sii dhamaanaya iyo biyo uu ka helo ceel sii guraya oo beerta uu ku waraabin jiray. Wuxuu ka dayriyay ku tiirsnaanta xoolaha oo roob la’aanta dabadheeraatay ay galaafan karto. Wuxuu sheegay in muddo 22 sano ah oo beeraley uu ahaa uusan horay u la kulmin qasaare la mid tan ay bideen xayawaanka doogga cuna, kuwaas ku kalifay in uu iskaga tago beertiisa. “Wixii aan quudan jirnay ama aan ciyaalka wax ka bari jirnay waa nalooga xoog roonaaday. Marka waxaan doorbiday in carruurta aan kala fogeeyo cidihii ehelkooda ahaa midba aan reer u geeyo. Wax la quutaa ma jiraa ee waa iska maqade-ma-dharge.” Todoobo ka mid ah carruurtiisa waxay ka mid yihiin ku dhawaad 80 carruur ah oo waxbarasho la’aan noqday. Waxaa u sabab ah markii uu xirmay dugsi hoose oo ku yaallay deegaanka Cagaarey bishii Julay. Iskuulka oo lagu dhiganayay lacag ayaa dhaqaale la’aan u xirmay. Wuxuu ku tiirsanaa dhaqaalaha laga qaadayay qoysaska ay ka soo jeedaan carruurta oo beeraley u badan, kuwaas awoodi waayay in ay helaan qarashka waxbarshada sida uu Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay Axmed Cumar Cige guddoomiyaha iskaashatada beeralayda. Dhibaatada xawawaanka uu u gaystay waxaa ugu biirtay kaydadkii biyaha oo guray, kaddib roob yari haysay deegaannadooda labadii sano ee u danbeeyay. Beeralayda qaar malahan ceelal, halka kuwa leh shidaalka oo qaali ah ay ku dhiiran waayeen in ay wax beertaan. Cabdiraxmaan Abokar Axmed oo beer labo hiktar ah ku leh deegaanka Cagarey tan bishii May beertiisa ma tabcin, markii uu ku qaasaray dalag u badnaa galey, digir iyo masago oo xayawaanku uu ka cunay. Wuxuu sheegay in qoyskiisa oo afar ah ay la daalaadhacayaan xumo ka dhalatay xaaladdaas, maaddama ay ku tiirsanaayeen raashinka iyo dhaqaalaha laga helo beerta. Wuxuu maciin-biday dad ay helo yihiin, kuwaas oo ku kala nool Sheekh, Burco iyo Barbara. Marka uu cabto ayuu sheegay in ay taleefoonkiisa gacanta ay ugu soo tuuraan lacag uu ku iibsado kiilooyin raashin. Waa cunno aan joogto ahayn, isla markaana aan ku filnayn haddii ay helaan. Xaaladdan quusta ah ayuu xusay in aysan hayn awood ay kaga dabaashaan haddii aysan kaalmo ka helin Somaaliland si looga difaaco xayawaanka, beerahana ay u helaan gaashaan. “Ood la’aan baan ka cabanaynaa iyo xayawaankii oo noocyo badan oo doofaar leh, daanyeer leh oo ugaartii deeradu ka mid tahay, kuwaas oo saraha sidii riyaha u cunaya. Dhul bannaan oo wixii aad kaga oodan lahayd ama uga ilaalsan lahayd aysan jirin oo bannaan ah oo adiga oo xagaas jooga ay xaga kale ka soo galayso (xayawaanka). Howlaheedu way badan yihiin.” Wuxuu tilmaamay in ay rajaynayaan helidda roob ku filan deegaanka, kaas oo xal u noqon karha dhibaatada ay wajahayaan, maaddama ay meesha ka bixi karto baahida keentay in xayawaanku ay ku soo duulaan dalagga. Cabdiraxmaan wuxuu iskudayay helidda shaqo xoogsi ah oo nolosha uu ku maareeyo, balse wuu ku hungoobay, maaddama deegaankiisa fursado shaqo aysan ka jirin. Waxaa la mid ah beeraleyda kale, kuwaas oo ku haminaya helidda il-kale oo dhaqaale uu ka soo galo. Waxay quus ka muujiyay ceelsha biyaha ee sii guraya, kuwaas oo sababay biyo yari. Wuxuu xusay in qoyskiisa hadda ay ku tiirsan yihiin biyo ku jira bac uu dhulka galiyay si uu u kaydsado. Waxaa ugu shubay nin qaraabo ay yihiin oo gaadiidley ah. Wuxuu ka cabanayaa heerka biyo yarida oo ku qasbi kara in ay ka hayaamaan deegaanka haddii aysan helin roob ku filan. “Roob yarida ayaa biyo la’aanta keentay. Roobabkii ayaa dhulka ku yaraaday. Ilaahey baa leh cabashada. Laakiin ciddii wax naga caawin karta in ay naga caawiso waan u baahannahay.” Roob la’aanta dabadheeraatay waxay si guud u saamaysay dadka iyo xayawaanka iskugu jira kuwa la dhaqdo iyo duurjoogta ku nool daaqa, kuwaas oo duruuftu ku qasabtay in ay weeraraan beeraha isla markaana ay beeraleyda ka cunaan dalagyada ay beerteen. items.title: TİKA Oo Qalab Tababar Ku Wareejisay Machadka Qaranka Ee Umulisooyinka
items.description: Hay’adda Iskaashiga iyo Isku-duwidda Turkiga ee TİKA ayaa qalab caafimaad ku wareejisay Machadka Qaranka ee Umulisooyinka Soomaaliya. Qalabka ayaa loogu tala-galay in ardayda machadku ay ku qaataan tababarro wax-ku-ool ah oo la xiriira daryeelka hooyada iyo dhallaanka. Munaasabadda wareejinta qalabka waxaa ka qaybgashay Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Daryeelka Bulshada, Dr. Maryama Maxamed Xuseen. Waxay sheegtay in taageeradani ay qayb ka tahay dadaallada lagu tayeynayo xarumaha lagu tababaro shaqaalaha caafimaadka, gaar ahaan umulisooyinka. Qalabkan ayaa la filayaa inuu ardayda ka caawiyo inay si toos ah ugu tababartaan xirfadaha ay u baahan yihiin ka hor inta aysan bilaabin adeegga caafimaadka. Tababarka wax-ku-oolka ah ayaa muhiim u ah diyaarinta umulisooyin awood u leh inay si badbaado leh ula tacaalaan xaaladaha uurka iyo dhalmada. Machadka Qaranka ee Umulisooyinka ayaa door muhiim ah ka qaata soo saaridda xirfadlayaal ka shaqeeya xarumaha caafimaadka ee dalka. Tayeynta machadka waxay gacan ka geysan kartaa kordhinta tirada umulisooyinka tababaran iyo hagaajinta adeegyada ay helaan haweenka uurka leh iyo carruurta dhalanaysa. Taageerada TİKA waxay qayb ka tahay iskaashiga caafimaad ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, kaas oo ay ku jiraan tababarrada shaqaalaha, qalabaynta xarumaha caafimaadka iyo horumarinta adeegyada caafimaad. Hay’addu waxay Soomaaliya ka fulisay mashaariic kala duwan oo la xiriira caafimaadka iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada. Faahfaahin dhammaystiran lagama bixin noocyada iyo tirada qalabka lagu wareejiyey machadka, qiimihiisa ama tirada ardayda ka faa’iidaysanaysa. Si kastaba, taageeradan waxay xoojin kartaa tababarka umulisooyinka iyo dadaallada lagu dhimayo khataraha la xiriira caafimaadka hooyada iyo dhallaanka.

items.title: Dalalka Khaliijka oo wajahaya xaalad laba daran mid dooro ah
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) — Qabsashada Xuutiyiinta ee qeybo muhiim ah oo ka tirsan xeebaha Badda Cas ee Yemen ayaa si weyn u beddeleysa miisaanka awoodda Bariga Dhexe, iyadoo Iran siinaysa awood dheeraad ah oo ay ku cadaadiso Sacuudiga iyo dalalka kale ee Khaliijka. Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Tehran ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyay gaaray jasiirado iyo goobo istaraatiiji ah oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, oo ah marin ay maraan qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah ganacsiga iyo shidaalka dunida. Horumarkan ayaa Iran iyo xulafadeeda siinaya awood ay cadaadis uga saaraan laba dhinac oo muhiim u ah dhoofinta tamarta gobolka: Marinka Hormuz ee dhinaca bari iyo Bab al-Mandab ee dhinaca galbeed. Sacuudiga ayaa intii uu socday dagaalka qayb badan oo ka mid ah shidaalkiisa u wareejiyay dekedaha Badda Cas, kadib markii qalalaasaha ka taagan Hormuz uu wiiqay isticmaalka marinkaasi. Hase yeeshee, Riyadh ayaa Jimcihii xirtay dhuun muhiim ah oo shidaalka u qaadda dhinaca Badda Cas kadib markii weerar lagu qaaday, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca ku saabsan awoodda Boqortooyada ay ku sii wadi karto dhoofinta saliidda iyadoo labada marin ee waaweyn ee gobolka ay halis ku jiraan. Khabiirro iyo saraakiil gobolka ah ayaa sheegaya in xaaladdan ay Tehran siinayso fursad ay ku kordhiso cadaadiska dhaqaale iyo kan siyaasadeed ee dalalka Khaliijka, iyadoo sicirka shidaalka iyo qiimaha badeecadaha kale ee caalamka ay kor u kici karaan haddii maraakiibta Badda Cas iyo Hormuz ay sii wajahaan khatar. “Qabsashada Xuutiyiinta ee jasiiradaha istaraatiijiga ah ee ku dhow Bab al-Mandab waa isbeddel weyn,” ayuu yiri Fawaz Gerges, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay arrimaha Bariga Dhexe. “Waxay beddeleysaa miisaanka awoodda, waxayna siinaysaa Xuutiyiinta awood siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale oo aad uga ballaaran tii ay horey u haysteen marka laga hadlayo Sacuudiga, Khaliijka, Mareykanka iyo ganacsiga caalamka.” Cadaadis ku wajahan dalalka Khaliijka Horumarka Xuutiyiinta ayaa imanaya xilli dalalka Khaliijka ay wajahayaan go’aan adag oo ku saabsan sida ay ula macaamilayaan Iran. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa lagu soo warramay inuu diiday codsi uu dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Maxamed bin Salmaan ku dalbaday in Mareykanku weerarro Xuutiyiinta. Go’aankaas, oo ay weheliso khasaaraha dhaqaale ee sii kordhaya, ayaa saraakiil gobolka ah ku riixaya aragtida ah in wada-hadal lala galo Tehran aanu hadda ahayn oo keliya doorasho diblomaasiyadeed, balse uu noqon karo arrin la xiriirta ilaalinta danaha dhaqaale iyo ammaanka. Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda dalalka Khaliijka iyo dhiggooda Iran, Abbas Araqchi, ayaa lagu waday inay Isniinta ku kulmaan dalka Cumaan si ay uga wada hadlaan heshiis ku saabsan maamulka maraakiibta isticmaasha Marinka Hormuz. Kulanka ayaa dib loo dhigay kadib markii la isku khilaafay shuruudaha wada-hadallada, sida uu Reuters u sheegay ilo ka tirsan Khaliijka. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Cumaan Badr Albusaidi ayaa sheegay in kulanka lagu waday inuu ka dhaco magaalada Salalah loo baajiyay “danaha is-afgaradka”, isagoo intaa ku daray in dalkiisu weli ka go’an tahay taageeridda wada-hadalka gobolka. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Iran Masoud Pezeshkian ayaa sheegay inuu wadahadallo wanaagsan la yeeshay Dhaxal-sugaha Imaaraadka Carabta, Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, xilli ay ku sugnaayeen New Delhi oo ay kaga qeyb-galayeen shir madaxeedka BRICS. “Waxaan ku heshiinnay inaan wixii hore iska dhaafno oo aan mustaqbalka eegno, iyo sida aan mustaqbal wadajir ah u dhisi karno,” ayuu yiri Pezeshkian. Arrinta ugu weyn ee dalalka Khaliijka hortaalla ayaa ah in juqraafi ahaan Iran aan laga saari karin nidaamka ammaanka gobolka. Iran waxay ku taallaa meel aad ugu dhow marinada ugu muhiimsan ee shidaalka iyo ganacsiga caalamka, taas oo ka dhigaysa awood aysan Sacuudiga, Imaaraadka iyo dalalka kale ee gobolka si fudud uga gudbi karin. Dagaalka ka dhashay weerarradii Mareykanka iyo Israel ku qaadeen Iran ayaa sidoo kale dhaawacay dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed ee sanadaha badan lagu doonayay in lagu xakameeyo khilaafka Tehran iyo dalalka Khaliijka. Trump oo Axaddii wax laga weydiiyay kulamada u dhexeeya dalalka Khaliijka iyo Iran ayaa sheegay in go’aankaasi iyaga u yaallo. Istaraatiijiyadda tallaabo-tallaabada ah Alex Vatanka oo ka tirsan Machadka Bariga Dhexe ayaa sheegay in su’aasha ugu weyn ee dalalka Khaliijka aysan hadda ahayn inay Iran ku kalsoonaan karaan iyo in kale, balse ay tahay sida ay u ilaalin karaan danahooda xilli Mareykanku u muuqdo in uusan si degdeg ah u soo afjari karin dagaalka. Taasi waxay dalalka Khaliijka ku riixi kartaa inay Tehran la yeeshaan waddo diblomaasiyadeed oo u gaar ah, isla markaana mustaqbalka yareeyaan ku-tiirsanaantooda Mareykanka dhinaca ammaanka. “Dalalka Khaliijka waxay hadda ka fikirayaan xaqiiqada aasaasiga ah ee ah inay khasab ku noqon karto inay iyagu heshiis la galaan Iran, iyadoon loo eegin sida Mareykanku uga falceliyo, sababtoo ah Mareykanku kama saari karo dhibaatadan,” ayuu yiri Vatanka. Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga waxaa ka dhexeeyay dagaallo muddo dheer ka horreeyay colaadda hadda dhex taalla Mareykanka iyo Iran. Xuutiyiinta, oo ka soo jeeda bulshada Zaydiga ee Shiicada Yemen, ayaa dhowr dagaal la galay Sacuudiga ka hor inta aysan 2014 qabsan caasimadda Sanca. Sacuudiga ayaa sanadkii xigay hoggaamiyay isbahaysi militari oo galay Yemen, balse sannado duqeymo iyo dagaallo xuduudeed ah kadib Xuutiyiinta ma aysan burburin. Taa beddelkeeda, waxay ballaariyeen awooddooda militari, iyagoo noqday mid ka mid ah xulafada ugu awoodda badan Iran ee gobolka. Khabiirkii hore ee Mareykanka Aaron David Miller ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiinta aan loo arki karin wakiillo caadi ah oo Iran u shaqeeya. “Waxay hub ka dhigi karaan juqraafiga, waxayna saameyn weyn ku yeelan karaan dhaqaalaha caalamka iyo suuqa shidaalka dunida,” ayuu yiri. Sarkaal ka tirsan gobolka ayaa isna sheegay in horumarka Xuutiyiinta uu qeyb ka yahay istaraatiijiyad ay Tehran si tartiib ah u waddo. “Iran arrintan waxay u aragtaa ciyaar shax ah. Waxay qorsheeyaan waxa xiga. Dhammaan awooddooda isku mar uma adeegsadaan cabsi darteed,” ayuu yiri. “Xuutiyiinta ayaa hadda ah xulafada keliya ee Iran ee weli leh awood militari oo xooggan.” Cadaadiska dhaqaale ee Washington ku hayso Iran ayaa saameynaya Tehran, balse ilo ka tirsan Khaliijka ayaa sheegay in cawaaqib kale oo ka dhalanaya uu yahay in xulafada Mareykanka ee gobolka ay dib uga fikirayaan in iska horimaad joogto ah oo lala galo Iran uu yahay mid ay sii wadi karaan. Qabsashada Xuutiyiinta ee xeebaha iyo jasiiradaha ku dhow Bab al-Mandab ayaa sidaas darteed ka dhigaysa Tehran mid leh kaarar cusub oo ay ku gorgortanto, halka Sacuudiga iyo deriskiisuna ay wajahayaan laba doorasho oo adag: inay sii qaataan kharashaadka dhaqaale iyo amni ee sii kordhaya, ama inay raadiyaan heshiis cusub oo ay Iran kula noolaadaan. Hase yeeshee, Riyadh ayaa Jimcihii xirtay dhuun muhiim ah oo shidaalka u qaadda dhinaca Badda Cas kadib markii weerar lagu qaaday, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca ku saabsan awoodda Boqortooyada ay ku sii wadi karto dhoofinta saliidda iyadoo labada marin ee waaweyn ee gobolka ay halis ku jiraan. Khabiirro iyo saraakiil gobolka ah ayaa sheegaya in xaaladdan ay Tehran siinayso fursad ay ku kordhiso cadaadiska dhaqaale iyo kan siyaasadeed ee dalalka Khaliijka, iyadoo sicirka shidaalka iyo qiimaha badeecadaha kale ee caalamka ay kor u kici karaan haddii maraakiibta Badda Cas iyo Hormuz ay sii wajahaan khatar. “Qabsashada Xuutiyiinta ee jasiiradaha istaraatiijiga ah ee ku dhow Bab al-Mandab waa isbeddel weyn,” ayuu yiri Fawaz Gerges, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay arrimaha Bariga Dhexe. “Waxay beddeleysaa miisaanka awoodda, waxayna siinaysaa Xuutiyiinta awood siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale oo aad uga ballaaran tii ay horey u haysteen marka laga hadlayo Sacuudiga, Khaliijka, Mareykanka iyo ganacsiga caalamka.” Cadaadis ku wajahan dalalka Khaliijka Horumarka Xuutiyiinta ayaa imanaya xilli dalalka Khaliijka ay wajahayaan go’aan adag oo ku saabsan sida ay ula macaamilayaan Iran. Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa lagu soo warramay inuu diiday codsi uu dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Maxamed bin Salmaan ku dalbaday in Mareykanku weerarro Xuutiyiinta. Go’aankaas, oo ay weheliso khasaaraha dhaqaale ee sii kordhaya, ayaa saraakiil gobolka ah ku riixaya aragtida ah in wada-hadal lala galo Tehran aanu hadda ahayn oo keliya doorasho diblomaasiyadeed, balse uu noqon karo arrin la xiriirta ilaalinta danaha dhaqaale iyo ammaanka. Wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda dalalka Khaliijka iyo dhiggooda Iran, Abbas Araqchi, ayaa lagu waday inay Isniinta ku kulmaan dalka Cumaan si ay uga wada hadlaan heshiis ku saabsan maamulka maraakiibta isticmaasha Marinka Hormuz. Kulanka ayaa dib loo dhigay kadib markii la isku khilaafay shuruudaha wada-hadallada, sida uu Reuters u sheegay ilo ka tirsan Khaliijka. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Cumaan Badr Albusaidi ayaa sheegay in kulanka lagu waday inuu ka dhaco magaalada Salalah loo baajiyay “danaha is-afgaradka”, isagoo intaa ku daray in dalkiisu weli ka go’an tahay taageeridda wada-hadalka gobolka. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha Iran Masoud Pezeshkian ayaa sheegay inuu wadahadallo wanaagsan la yeeshay Dhaxal-sugaha Imaaraadka Carabta, Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, xilli ay ku sugnaayeen New Delhi oo ay kaga qeyb-galayeen shir madaxeedka BRICS. “Waxaan ku heshiinnay inaan wixii hore iska dhaafno oo aan mustaqbalka eegno, iyo sida aan mustaqbal wadajir ah u dhisi karno,” ayuu yiri Pezeshkian. Arrinta ugu weyn ee dalalka Khaliijka hortaalla ayaa ah in juqraafi ahaan Iran aan laga saari karin nidaamka ammaanka gobolka. Iran waxay ku taallaa meel aad ugu dhow marinada ugu muhiimsan ee shidaalka iyo ganacsiga caalamka, taas oo ka dhigaysa awood aysan Sacuudiga, Imaaraadka iyo dalalka kale ee gobolka si fudud uga gudbi karin. Dagaalka ka dhashay weerarradii Mareykanka iyo Israel ku qaadeen Iran ayaa sidoo kale dhaawacay dadaalladii diblomaasiyadeed ee sanadaha badan lagu doonayay in lagu xakameeyo khilaafka Tehran iyo dalalka Khaliijka. Trump oo Axaddii wax laga weydiiyay kulamada u dhexeeya dalalka Khaliijka iyo Iran ayaa sheegay in go’aankaasi iyaga u yaallo. Istaraatiijiyadda tallaabo-tallaabada ah Alex Vatanka oo ka tirsan Machadka Bariga Dhexe ayaa sheegay in su’aasha ugu weyn ee dalalka Khaliijka aysan hadda ahayn inay Iran ku kalsoonaan karaan iyo in kale, balse ay tahay sida ay u ilaalin karaan danahooda xilli Mareykanku u muuqdo in uusan si degdeg ah u soo afjari karin dagaalka. Taasi waxay dalalka Khaliijka ku riixi kartaa inay Tehran la yeeshaan waddo diblomaasiyadeed oo u gaar ah, isla markaana mustaqbalka yareeyaan ku-tiirsanaantooda Mareykanka dhinaca ammaanka. “Dalalka Khaliijka waxay hadda ka fikirayaan xaqiiqada aasaasiga ah ee ah inay khasab ku noqon karto inay iyagu heshiis la galaan Iran, iyadoon loo eegin sida Mareykanku uga falceliyo, sababtoo ah Mareykanku kama saari karo dhibaatadan,” ayuu yiri Vatanka. Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga waxaa ka dhexeeyay dagaallo muddo dheer ka horreeyay colaadda hadda dhex taalla Mareykanka iyo Iran. Xuutiyiinta, oo ka soo jeeda bulshada Zaydiga ee Shiicada Yemen, ayaa dhowr dagaal la galay Sacuudiga ka hor inta aysan 2014 qabsan caasimadda Sanca. Sacuudiga ayaa sanadkii xigay hoggaamiyay isbahaysi militari oo galay Yemen, balse sannado duqeymo iyo dagaallo xuduudeed ah kadib Xuutiyiinta ma aysan burburin. Taa beddelkeeda, waxay ballaariyeen awooddooda militari, iyagoo noqday mid ka mid ah xulafada ugu awoodda badan Iran ee gobolka. Khabiirkii hore ee Mareykanka Aaron David Miller ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiinta aan loo arki karin wakiillo caadi ah oo Iran u shaqeeya. “Waxay hub ka dhigi karaan juqraafiga, waxayna saameyn weyn ku yeelan karaan dhaqaalaha caalamka iyo suuqa shidaalka dunida,” ayuu yiri. Sarkaal ka tirsan gobolka ayaa isna sheegay in horumarka Xuutiyiinta uu qeyb ka yahay istaraatiijiyad ay Tehran si tartiib ah u waddo. “Iran arrintan waxay u aragtaa ciyaar shax ah. Waxay qorsheeyaan waxa xiga. Dhammaan awooddooda isku mar uma adeegsadaan cabsi darteed,” ayuu yiri. “Xuutiyiinta ayaa hadda ah xulafada keliya ee Iran ee weli leh awood militari oo xooggan.” Cadaadiska dhaqaale ee Washington ku hayso Iran ayaa saameynaya Tehran, balse ilo ka tirsan Khaliijka ayaa sheegay in cawaaqib kale oo ka dhalanaya uu yahay in xulafada Mareykanka ee gobolka ay dib uga fikirayaan in iska horimaad joogto ah oo lala galo Iran uu yahay mid ay sii wadi karaan. Qabsashada Xuutiyiinta ee xeebaha iyo jasiiradaha ku dhow Bab al-Mandab ayaa sidaas darteed ka dhigaysa Tehran mid leh kaarar cusub oo ay ku gorgortanto, halka Sacuudiga iyo deriskiisuna ay wajahayaan laba doorasho oo adag: inay sii qaataan kharashaadka dhaqaale iyo amni ee sii kordhaya, ama inay raadiyaan heshiis cusub oo ay Iran kula noolaadaan. The post Dalalka Khaliijka oo wajahaya xaalad laba daran mid dooro ah appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Gobolka Hiiraan oo culeys ku ah Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka
items.description: Xiisadda siyaasadeed ee ka soo korortay Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa soo jiidatay indhaha Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, oo laga doonayo inay gacan ka gaystaan sugidda nabadgelyada magaalooyinka waaweyn ee gobolkaasi, gaar ahaan magaalooyinka laga qabanayo doorashada qofka iyo codka ee la rabo inay dadka deegaanka ku soo doortaan Xildhibaanada Baarlamaanka iyo Xubnaha Golaha Deegaanka ee Degmooyinka Hirshabelle. Magaalada Beledweyne ee Xarunta Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa waxaa ka socdo dhaqdhaqaaq lagu diidan yahay in laga qabto wax doorasho ah, dareenkaas oo la filayo in ay la qaataan shacabka kale ee ku dhaqan labada magaalo ee Buuloburde iyo Jalalaqsi iyo qaybo ka mid ah Matabaan, inkastoo tani ay keeneyso kala qaybsanaan. Xiisadda siyaasadeed ee u dhexeyso Dowladda Federaalka iyo Siyaasiyiinta Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa wadata khatar weyn oo amni, maadaama ay wiiqi karto dagaalkii lagu la jiray maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Walaaca ugu weyn ee soo food saaray Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa ah cabsi laga qabo in ciidamada qaarkood iyo Macawiisleyda reer Hiiraan ay soo faarujiyaan difaacyadooda gobolka, taasoo loo arko mid halis ku ah amniga dalka oo Al Shabaab siineysa dhul ballaarsi. Ciidamada qaybtood ayaa waxaa laga cabsi qabaa in ay ku aragti noqdaan siyaasiyiinta diidan dib-u-doorashada Madaxweynaha Hirshabelle, Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe), isla-markaana ay diidaan u hoggaansanaanta awaamiirta taliska. Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa waxaa ka hawlgala cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo ka soo jeeda deegaanka iyo xoogag Macawiisley ah oo ka taageera la dagaalanka Al Shabaab. Goob kasta oo furimaha difaaca ama aagagga hore ee dagaalka oo laga soo baxo ayaa noqoneysa bar maran, oo ay Al Shabaab si dhib yar ah dib ugu qabsan karto, tani oo cawaaqib ku yeelaneysa isu socodka dadka ee magaalooyinka waaweyn iyo waddooyinka sahayda ee gobolka. Xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa amni ee ka taagan Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa sidoo kale caqabad ku noqon kara diyaargarowgii ugu dambeeyay ee talisku uu ugu jiray inay Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed la wareegaan saldhigyada lagu wado inay banneeyaan Ciidanka Midowga Afrika ee Hawlgalka AUSSOM, marka la gaaro daba-yaaqada sanadkan. Daldaloolada amniga ayaa sii kordhisay baahida loo qabo askar dheeri ah oo haysata tababar iyo qalab ku filan. General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa Isniintii kormeeray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee General Dhega-badan, si loo helo amaba loo soo saaro cutubyo cusub oo buuxiya kaalinta ciidan yarida. Deganaansho la’aanta siyaasadeed ayaa khasbeysa in diiradda la saaro ammaanka magaalooyinka iyo deegaanada muhiimka ah, halkii ciidamadu ay si buuxda ugu weecan lahaayeen dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al Shabaab iyo xoreynta dhulka maqan. Dhibaatooyinka amniga ayaa waxaa looga gudbi karaa xallinta khilaafyada siyaasadeed ee dalka oo cirka isku shareeray.

items.title: Ciidamo Deegaan Oo Waajid Lagu Tababarayo Ka Hor Wareejinta Mas’uuliyadda Amniga
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa degmada Waajid ee gobolka Bakool ka bilaabay tababarka dhallinyaro deegaanka ah oo loo diyaarinayo sugidda amniga magaalada iyo deegaannada hoos yimaada. Tababarkan ayaa qayb ka ah qorshe lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ee ku sugan degmada. Ciidamada la tababarayo ayaa la sheegay inay la shaqayn doonaan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Daraawiishta Koonfur-galbeed, waxaana loo diyaarinayaa ilaalinta goobaha muhiimka ah, ka hortagga weerarrada iyo taageeridda howlgallada amni ee laga fulinayo Waajid iyo nawaaxigeeda. Qorshahan ayaa lagu xiriiriyey diyaar-garowga wareejinta mas’uuliyadda amniga marka ciidamada howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ay ka baxaan deegaanka, hase yeeshee, ma jiro jadwal rasmi ah oo la shaaciyey oo caddeynaya waqtiga ay ciidamada AUSSOM ka baxayaan Waajid. Waajid waa degmo istaraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah isku socodka gobolka Bakool iyo gaarsiinta sahayda deegaannada ku dhow. Magaalada ayaa sidoo kale ku dhow dhul laga soo sheegayo dhaqdhaqaaqyo ay sameeyaan Al-Shabaab, taas oo sare u qaadaysa muhiimadda ay leedahay sugidda amnigeeda. Tababarka ciidamada deegaanka ayaa la filayaa inuu yareeyo firaaqo amni oo ka dhalan karta dhimista ama bixitaanka ciidamada AUSSOM. Guusha qorshaha waxay ku xirnaan doontaa tayada tababarka, nidaamka hoggaanka, helitaanka qalab iyo sida ciidamada cusub loogu dhex daro hay’adaha amniga ee rasmiga ah. Ilaa hadda lama shaacin tirada dhallinyarada la tababarayo, muddada tababarka, hubka ama qalabka la siinayo iyo goobaha loo kala dirayo marka ay dhammaystaan. Sidoo kale, faahfaahin rasmi ah lagama bixin qaabka loo kala hagayo ciidamada federaalka, Daraawiishta Koonfur-galbeed iyo ciidamadan cusub.

items.title: Danta Somaliland ay ka leedahay 2,000 askari ee ay ku yaboohday qorshaha Trump
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Somaliland ayaa sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu ilaa 2,000 oo askari ku biiriyo ciidanka caalamiga ah ee madaxweyne Donald Trump uu doonayo in la geeyo Gaza, xilli Mareykanka uu weli raadinayo inuu helo tirada ciidamada looga baahan yahay howlgalkaas. Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi Cirro, ayaa intii uu ku sugnaa Washington sheegay in Hargeysa ay ciidamo diri karto haddii Mareykanka ama Israel ay si rasmi ah uga codsadaan. Dalabkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Somaliland ay Washington ka waddo olole ay ku doonayso xiriir siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo dhow, iyadoo dhinaca kalena sii xoojineysa dadaalkeeda aqoonsi raadinta. Taasi waxay dhalineysaa su’aal muhiim ah: maxay Somaliland ka rajeyneysaa inay ka hesho dalabkeeda ciidanka Gaza, iyadoo Mareykanku weli si cad u sheegay inuusan waxba iska beddelin mowqifkiisa ku aaddan midnimada Soomaaliya? Maxay Somaliland dhab ahaan bixineysaa? Cirro ayaa sheegay in Somaliland ay awooddo inay bixiso ilaa 2,000 oo askari, balse wuxuu caddeeyay inaan weli wax codsi rasmi ah uga iman Washington ama dhinacyada maamulaya ciidanka la qorsheynayo. “Weli nalama soo xiriirin arrintan, laakiin haddii nala weydiisto waan bixin karnaa,” ayuu Cirro u sheegay The Times of Israel . Wuxuu sheegay in Somaliland ay leedahay ku dhowaad 25,000 oo askari iyo 1,500 oo ka tirsan ilaalada xeebaha. Haddii 2,000 askari la geeyo Gaza, waxay noqon lahayd howlgal ciidan oo weyn marka loo eego awoodda ciidamada Somaliland, gaar ahaan maadaama aysan hore ciidamo ugu biirin howlgal nabad-ilaalin oo Midowga Afrika ah. Ciidanka Gaza, oo loo yaqaan International Stabilisation Force, waxaa oggolaaday Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, waxaana loo qorsheeyay inuu qeyb ka qaato sugidda ammaanka, ilaalinta howlaha gargaarka, tababarka booliska Falastiin iyo hirgelinta qeybaha amni ee qorshaha Gaza. Ilaa hadda, Somaliland looma soo dirin wax casuumaad ah, mana jiro heshiis dhigaya in ciidamadeedu ka qeybgalayaan howlgalka. Maxay 2,000 askari muhiim u noqon karaan? Muhiimadda dalabka Somaliland waxay ka imaaneysaa dhibaatada Washington ka haysata dhismaha ciidanka Gaza. Qorshaha Mareykanka wuxuu hiigsanayaa ciidan gaaraya ku dhowaad 20,000 askari, balse ballanqaadyada la helay ilaa hadda aad ayay uga hooseeyaan tiradaas. Uganda ayaa oggolaatay inay dirto ku dhowaad 1,200 askari, Morocco-na waxay ballanqaadday ilaa 500. Kosovo, Kazakhstan iyo Albania ayaa iyaguna ballanqaaday tiro kooban. Indonesia ayaa markii hore sheegtay inay diri karto ilaa 8,000 askari, taas oo ka dhigi lahayd dalka ugu ciidanka badan howlgalka, balse qorshahaas markii dambe waa la hakiyay. Haddii Somaliland ay 2,000 askari keento, waxay keli ahaan dabooli lahayd ku dhowaad 10 boqolkiiba tirada guud ee la doonayo. Taasi waxay dalabkeeda siin kartaa miisaan ka weyn midka uu yeelan lahaa haddii Mareykanku hore u helay ciidamadii uu u baahnaa. Washington waxay sidoo kale muujisay inay weli ka go’an tahay dhismaha ciidankan. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa Congress-ka ogeysiisay qorshe maalgelin oo ka badan $206 milyan, kaas oo loogu talagalay qalab, gaadiid, kaabayaal iyo howlaha ciidanka. items.title: Kumay ahayd Xaawo Aadan Camey ?
items.description: Allaha u naxariistee waxaa saacado ka hor la xaqiijiyay geerida Xaawo Aadan Camey oo kamid ahayd Haldoorka haweenka Soomaaliyeed Xaawo Aadan Camey waxay ahayd haweeney Soomaaliyeed oo muddo dheer u soo adeegaysay bulshada, gaar ahaan dadka nugul, qaxootiga iyo barakacayaasha gudaha dalka. Waxay ka mid ahayd shaqsiyaadkii Soomaaliyeed ee dadaalka weyn geliyay arrimaha bani’aadantinimada iyo difaaca xuquuqda dadka ay saameeyeen colaadaha iyo barakacu. Muddo sannado ah ayay si hagar la’aan ah uga shaqaynaysay danta guud, iyadoo door muuqda ku lahayd howlaha la xiriira taageerada iyo u adeegidda dadka barakacayaasha ah. Shaqadeeda ayaa ka dhigtay qof si weyn looga yaqaan bahda bulshada rayidka ah iyo hay’adaha ka shaqeeya arrimaha bani’aadantinimada ee Soomaaliya. Xaawo Aadan Camey waxay sidoo kale ka tirsanaan jirtay GECPD , oo ah hay’ad ka shaqaysa arrimaha bulshada iyo dadka nugul. Hawlaheeda iyo dadaalkeeda joogtada ah ayaa gaarsiiyay in shaqadeeda laga aqoonsado heer caalami ah. Guulihii ugu waaweynaa ee lagu xusuusto Xaawo Aadan Camey waxaa ka mid ah Abaalmarinta Nansen Refugee Award , oo ay sannadkii 2012 siisay Hay’adda Qaxootiga Adduunka ee UNHCR . Abaalmarintan waxaa lagu maamuusaa shaqsiyaadka ama kooxaha si gaar ah ugu dadaala u adeegidda iyo ilaalinta qaxootiga, barakacayaasha iyo dadka guryahooda ka hayaamay sababo la xiriira colaado ama dhibaatooyin kale. Helitaanka abaalmarintan ayaa ka tarjumaysay doorkii ay Xaawo Aadan Camey ku lahayd u adeegidda dadka Soomaaliyeed ee nugul iyo dadaalladii ay ku bixisay arrimaha bani’aadantinimada. Xaawo Aadan Camey waxay ka tagtay raad ku saabsan adeegga bulshada iyo u hiilinta dadka nugul. Shaqadeedii muddada dheer socotay iyo aqoonsigii caalamiga ahaa ee ay heshay ayaa ka dhigay mid ka mid ah haweenka Soomaaliyeed ee lagu xusuusan doono kaalintooda ku aaddan arrimaha bani’aadantinimada.

items.title: Qiimaha Shidaalka Muqdisho Oo La Sheegay Inuu Toddobaad Gudihiis 15% Kordhay
items.description: Qiimaha shidaalka magaalada Muqdisho ayaa la sheegay inuu qiyaastii 15% kordhay toddobaadkii la soo dhaafay, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan xiisadaha ka jira Bariga Dhexe. Kororkan ayaa laga dareemayaa kaalimo shidaal oo kala duwan, inkastoo qiimaha lagu iibinayo uusan isku mid ka ahayn guud ahaan magaalada. Carqaladaha ku yimaadda maraakiibta shidaalka ayaa kordhin kara kharashka gaadiidka, caymiska iyo muddada ay shixnaduhu ku soo gaarayaan Soomaaliya. Marka kharashka soo dejinta ama gaadiidka badda kordho, ganacsatadu waxay inta badan kharashkaas u gudbiyaan macaamiisha. items.title: Taliyaha Militariga oo kormeeray Dugsiga General Dhega-badan (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa gelinkii dambe ee Isniintii kormeeray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee General Dhega-badan ee Magaalada Muqdisho. Dugsigan oo horey loo oran jiray Jasiira, kuna yaala Degmada Wadajir ayaa waxaa lagu tababaraa dhallinyarada loo qaadanayo in ay ka mid noqdaan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa la sheegay in uu kormeer shaqo ku tegay xeradaasi, isagoo u kuurgelaya xaaladda guud ee dugsiga iyo habsami-u-socodka howlaha tababarka. War ka soo baxay Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa lagu sheegay in Taliyaha uu halkaasi ku soo dhaweeyay Taliyaha Taliska Tababarada iyo Doctrine-ka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Axmed Ciise Axmed iyo Taliyaha Dugsiga General Dhega-badan, Korneyl Maxamed Sheekh. “Intii uu kormeerka ku guda jiray, Taliyaha ayaa indha-indheeyay qaybaha kala duwan ee dugsiga, isagoo warbixinno ka dhageystay masuuliyiinta xarunta, kana warbixiyay xaaladda howlaha tababarka iyo diyaargarowga ciidamada.” Ayaa lagu yiri warka. Warka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Kormeerkan ayaa qayb ka ah dadaalada lagu horumarinayo xarumaha tababarka, tayaynta ciidamada iyo xoojinta diyaargarowga Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.” Dugsigan ayaa 20-kii bishii November ee sanadkii 2015 loogu magac-daray Abaanduulihii hore ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Cabdikariin Yuusuf Aadan (Dhega-badan), kaas oo 1-dii bishaasi ku geeriyooday weerar ay dabley ka tirsan Al Shabaab ka gaysatay Hotel Saxafi ee Magaalada Muqdisho.

items.title: Somali Regional State Emerges as Ethiopia’s Safest and Most Stable Region
items.description: By Abdikarim H. Abdi Buh The Somali Regional State of Ethiopia has undergone a remarkable transformation in security and stability, emerging as one of the country’s most peaceful and secure regional states after decades of conflict and instability. That transformation is perhaps most visible in Jigjiga, the regional capital, where senior political leaders can move among ordinary citizens with a level of public access and security that would be difficult to imagine during the region’s years of armed conflict. Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, Somali Regional State President Mustafa Omer, Somalia’s President Hassan Sheikh Mohamoud and Djibouti President Ismail Omar Guelleh have all been able to participate in public events in Jigjiga without the kind of extraordinary security environment often associated with high-level political gatherings elsewhere in the region. Jigjiga has consequently become more than the administrative capital of the Somali Regional State. It has increasingly developed into a venue for national and regional political meetings, conferences and public events. Indeed, major conferences involving Ethiopia’s regional states have increasingly been hosted in Jigjiga, reflecting the city’s growing reputation as a secure and accessible political centre. A Region That Has Changed Its Security Story The transformation becomes even more striking when viewed against the region’s recent history. For years, the Somali Regional State was associated with armed conflict, political instability and insecurity. Roads and commercial routes were vulnerable, communities lived with uncertainty, and the presence of armed groups profoundly affected daily life. Today, the picture is dramatically different. One of the clearest signs of the change is the movement of commercial trucks across the region. Trucks can now travel along major routes day and night without disruption and insecurity, strengthening trade and connecting communities to markets inside Ethiopia and across the wider Horn of Africa. For businesses, transporters and ordinary citizens, this may be one of the most important measures of whether security has actually improved. Security is not simply about the absence of fighting. It is about whether a farmer can take livestock to market, whether a trader can transport goods, whether a family can travel after dark and whether communities can conduct their daily lives without fear. By those measures, many residents believe the Somali Regional State has made enormous progress. Mustafa Omer: No Return to Armed Conflict It is against this backdrop that President Mustafa Omer has sharply criticized renewed calls by elements of the Ogaden National Liberation Front (ONLF) for a possible return to armed struggle. Mustafa said groups he described as politically failed were attempting to create expectations among the population that a new political transformation—or even renewed conflict—could emerge in the region. He argued that Ethiopia is currently facing serious political and security challenges, with armed confrontations continuing in parts of the country, creating an environment in which some groups may attempt to revive earlier conflicts. The President was particularly critical of organizations that, in his view, spent decades pursuing political and armed struggle without delivering the changes they promised the Somali population. “There are groups telling people that change is coming and seeking to create conflict in the region. These are politically failed groups that have spent more than 42 years pursuing an unproductive political struggle,” Mustafa said. He also dismissed what he described as narratives circulating through the media, arguing that such messaging could not fundamentally alter the political realities of the region. Mustafa urged residents not to be drawn into what he characterized as false expectations, saying the decades of armed and political struggle had failed to produce the promised progress. “For those 40 years, there has been nothing but decline; there has been no progress,” he said. His message was unequivocal: The Somali Regional State should not return to armed conflict. Why the Public Remembers the Past For many residents, the debate over ONLF is not an abstract political argument. The region’s decades-long conflict left deep memories of insecurity, displacement, economic disruption and fear. That history explains why calls for a return to armed struggle encounter resistance among the population. The strongest argument against renewed conflict may therefore come not from government officials, but from the experience of ordinary people who remember what life was like when armed confrontation dominated the region. For those residents, the period of ONLF’s armed struggle represents one of the darkest chapters in the modern history of the Somali Regional State. The prevailing public sentiment among many residents is increasingly straightforward: They do not want to go back. They want roads that remain open, markets that function, trucks that move safely, businesses that operate, children who attend school and communities that can live without the constant fear of renewed violence. ONLF Faces an Uncertain Future Mustafa’s remarks come as ONLF itself faces political and organizational divisions. Different factions have emerged within the movement, with competing leaders advancing different strategies for the organization’s future. The external faction led by Abdirahman Mohamed Sheikh Mahdi has remained strongly opposed to the policies of the Ethiopian government and the Somali Regional State administration. The faction recently suggested that a return to armed struggle could become possible, reigniting debate over ONLF’s future and the region’s political direction. Another faction, led by Abdikarim Sheikh Muse Qalbi-Dhagah, is based in Jigjiga and has pursued a political path, with ONLF’s internal organization moving toward participation in the region’s political and electoral system. The divisions illustrate a fundamental strategic choice confronting the movement: whether to pursue political change through institutions and elections or return to confrontation. For the Somali Regional State, the answer from the administration is clear. The region’s future should be determined through politics, dialogue and peaceful political competition—not through guns. Security as the Foundation of Development The importance of the region’s security transformation extends beyond politics. Peace has economic consequences. A secure road network allows livestock and commercial goods to move. Safe cities attract businesses. Political stability makes it easier to organize conferences and bring national and international visitors to the region. Improved security also creates opportunities for investment in infrastructure, tourism, trade and services. Jigjiga’s emergence as a conference destination is therefore symbolic of something larger. A city once associated with the instability of a conflict-affected region can now host national political gatherings and receive senior leaders without being defined by insecurity. That is a profound transformation. The Somali Regional State is not without challenges. Ethiopia continues to face serious political and security problems, and the region itself must continue strengthening institutions, economic opportunity and public accountability. But the security gains of recent years should not be underestimated. The Choice Before the Somali Regional State The debate over ONLF ultimately presents the Somali Regional State with a choice between two very different futures. One path leads backward—to armed confrontation, insecurity, disrupted trade and renewed fear. The other leads forward—to political competition, economic development, institutional strengthening and deeper integration with Ethiopia and the wider Horn of Africa. For residents who remember the consequences of conflict, the choice may already be clear. The Somali Regional State has experienced the cost of war. Its people now want to experience the benefits of peace. The region’s most powerful message to those advocating a return to armed struggle may therefore be found on its roads, in its markets and in its cities: life has changed, and the people do not want to surrender that progress. The transformation of the Somali Regional State is ultimately a reminder that security is not an abstract political slogan. It is the freedom to travel, trade, work, meet, build and live without fear. And for a region that once endured decades of conflict, that freedom may be its most valuable achievement. Abdikarim H.
