items.title: Tolkayow waan idiin maqanahay ee idinkuma maqni Fihiim Yuusuf Quuje
items.description: TOLKAYOOW WAAN IDIIN MAQANAHAY EE IDIN KUMA MAQNI Waxaan ahay Fihiim Yuusuf Quuje Tweet . Waxan ahay inantiinii. Waxaan ahay walaashiin. Waan idiin gar dhiganayaa. Ma ihi qof caadifadi qaado oo kolba dhinac u jeesata. Waan sahan tagaa, marka wixii aan u socday arko in aanu shaqaynayn ayaan dhinac kale uga wareegaa anigoo naftaydana qanciyay ciddii kalena qancin kara. Waxaan isleeyahay ma jiro ama wuu yar yahay qof Dhulbahante ah oo halgankii iyo naf-hurnimadaydii sameeyay. Anigoo heli karayay sida dadka qaarkood in aan magaalooyinka waaweyn iskaga soo raaxaysto oo halganka dusha kala socdo ayaan u badheedhay in aan dadkayga dhex joogo oo xabadda isku dhigo. Waxaan ahaa dadkii sida wayn ugu ololaynayay in aynu Muqdisho wax la qabsanno ee maamul goboleedka Waqooyi Bari soo dhiciyay. Hamse Cabdi Barre iyo Xassan Sheekh Maxamuud in ay yimaadaan Laascaanood anigaa kasoo shaqeeyay. Xamar maanta waxba kama hayno. Dhulbahante maanta dhulkiisii isagaa xor u ah, waxaase isweydiin mudan ma isku bixin karnaa sidan. Warsangali oo walaaladeen ah ma hayno oo waa xaqiiq. Puntland oo deriskeenna ah ma hayno. Somaliland oo wax badani inaga dhexeeyaan ma hayno. Xamar oo kumanaan KM inoo jirto oo aynu u godobownay, waynu aragnaa Xassan Sheekh inta jeer ee uu toos inoogu sheegay in aynaan wax jira ahayn. Hooyada iyo caruurta Dhulbahante ee ku nool Sanaag, Sool iyo Cayn waxay u baahan yahiin nabad. Waxay u rabaan nolol. Waxay u baahan yihiin waxbarasho. Waxay u baahan yihiin caafimaad. Waxay u baahan yihiin in la dareeyo oo xuquuqdooda la ilaaliyo. Dadku waa dhal iyo dhasheed. Waa abti iyo ilmaabti. Boqolaal sano ayaynu deegaanka kusoo wada noolayn, ilaa qiyaamuhu ka dhacayana waynu ku wada noolaanaynaa oo sidaasi ayaynu isku ag joogaynaa. Ma sheegin hadii Ilaahay labadeena mid ahaan Meesha ka qaado oo ay hallaagmaan. Ninka geel jiraha ah ee Jaamac Siyaad waxa dad ugu dhaw ninka habarjeclo ee ay derika yihiin ee isku bii’adda ku nool yihiin. Ka hadii roob soo da’o ay ka wada cabbayaan, ka hadii ay abbaari dhacdana ay wada saamaynayso. Waxaynu oghanay dunidii siday maanta tahay. Noloshii siday u adkaatay. Halgankii aynu galnay wixii khasaare inaga soo gaadhay waad ogtihiin. Inta agoon inoo joogta tiro malaha. Hadana inta hadhay in aan nolol u raadino oo caadifada ka korno ayaa loo baahan yahay maanta. Diinteennu iimaanka waxay ka horreysiisay nabadda iyo ammaanka. Nabad la’aan waa nolol la’aan. Koonfur maanta waxba inaga xigaan. Waan soo taabtay gunteeda. Ma aha meel dawladnimo iyo Soomaalinimo u jeedda. Markaan ka soo quustay ayaan xal ka eeg is idhi Hargeysadii aad ogaydeen wixii aynu kala mudannay. Dadka Ilaahay caqli buu siiyay ay ku kala gartaan xumaha iyo sammaha. Caqli ay ku kala gartaan saxa iyo qaladka. Caqli ay ku kala gartaan xaqa iyo baadilka. Maanta waxaynu u baahannay wixii aynu jiritaankeena iyo midnimadeena ku sii badhi-taari lahayn. Anigu waxaan kow ka ahaa dadkii Waqooyi bari aas aasay. Anigu waxaan tagay Muqdisho anigoo aaminsan in Soomaalinimo wax lagu raadiyo. Waxaan kala kulmay niyad jab. Waxaan soo arkay in aan reer Waqooyi la kala jeclayn, hadii cid mudnaan la siinayana ay Isaaq iyo Hargeysa mudnaanta siinayaan. Tusaalaha ugu yar ee in aynu ku hungownay Koonfur, waxa kow ka ah in ciidankeenii aanay wax mushahar ah ka helin Xamar, halka Puntland dhawr kun oo ciidan ahi mushahar ka qaataan Xassan Sheekh. Waxa la inoo quudhi waayay tallaalka Hirshabelle oo Jawhar maamusha la siiyay in la in siiyo. Dadkaygiiyow, tolkay’ow idinkama mudni in aad i caydaan. In aad i af lagaadaysaan. Dantiina ayaan u maqanahay. Idinka ayaan idiin maqanahay. Nabad iyo Horumar ayaan idiinku maqanahay. Haddii uu gaadhi kaa galo meel dhiiqo ah oo aad xaga horena ka aragto dhiiqo kasii badan, caqligu kuma siinayo in aad hore ugu sii socoto. Waxaynu u baahanahay in aynu noolaano. In aynu horumar gaadhno. In aynu la tartanno bulshooyinka qayrkeen ah. Cidda ina ogol ee aynu wax wada qabsan karno anigu waan ogohay, idinna waa ogtihin hadaan la is yeelyaalayn. Dagaalo way dhacaan. Waligeedna way dhici jireen. Ha noqdaan qabiilooyin is dila ama dawladaba. Markasta waxa colaada ka danbeeya nabad. Wax kasta oo dhaca waa laga heshiiyaa. Dalka yar ee Ruwaanda waxii ka dhacay waynu ku haynaa taariikhda, maantana waddanada horumarka Africa hoggaaminaya weeyaan. Bulshooyinkii halkaa ku noolaa dad aan ka yarayn Milyan qof ayay iska xasuuqeen oo waliba qoladi yarayd xasuuq ku dhacay. Waa laga heshiiyay, maanta waa meelaha Afrika ugu horumarsan dhinac kasta. Waxa taa keentay in ay iska illoobeen maalmihii madoobaa ee soo maray, iyo gummaadkii dhacay waayo wixii dhacay way dhaceen oo lama soo celin karo, ee waxa uun la isweydiinayaa sidii aanu wixii oo kale u dhici lahayn. Waana ta keentay in la is cafiyo nolol qurux bandanna la sameeyay. Dadka reer Ruwanda waliba badankoodu waa gaalo. Inaga oo ummad muslim ah, ilaahayna ina faray cafiska ma jirto wax ka wanaagsan in nabad iyo cafis aynu qaadano oo dadka derisnimo iyo walaalnimo u horseedno. Dhulbahantow, tolkaygiiyoow, anigu ma ihi qof la idiin isticmaali karo. Ma ihi qof lacagi goyn karto. Mana ihi qof damiirkeedu liito oo hunguri ku shaqaysata. Idinkaan idiin maqanahay. Wax aan idiin cuntaminna idiin keeni mayo. Wixii aad ka yeelaysaana taladeeda idinkaa leh. Anigu Hargeysa dalxiis umaan iman. Qof u riyaaqsan in la soo dhaweeyo oo qudha ma ihi, hadii aanan dadkayga uga keeni karin hadafkaan lahayn iyo wixii ay xaqa u lahaayeen. Qof cad quudheed soo qaadanaya ma ihi. Ogaadana anigu in aan idin kala furfuro oo khilaaf idin dhex dhigo uma joogo halkan, ee waxaan doonayaa in walaaladeen Dawlad ku dhisan caddaalad iyo sinnaan wada wadaagno.

Dhulbahante maanta dhulkiisii isagaa xor u ah, waxaase isweydiin mudan ma isku bixin karnaa sidan. Warsangali oo walaaladeen ah ma hayno oo waa xaqiiq. Puntland oo deriskeenna ah ma hayno. Somaliland oo wax badani inaga dhexeeyaan ma hayno. Xamar oo kumanaan KM inoo jirto oo aynu u godobownay, waynu aragnaa Xassan Sheekh inta jeer ee uu toos inoogu sheegay in aynaan wax jira ahayn. Hooyada iyo caruurta Dhulbahante ee ku nool Sanaag, Sool iyo Cayn waxay u baahan yahiin nabad. Waxay u rabaan nolol. Waxay u baahan yihiin waxbarasho. Waxay u baahan yihiin caafimaad. Waxay u baahan yihiin in la dareeyo oo xuquuqdooda la ilaaliyo. Dadku waa dhal iyo dhasheed. Waa abti iyo ilmaabti. Boqolaal sano ayaynu deegaanka kusoo wada noolayn, ilaa qiyaamuhu ka dhacayana waynu ku wada noolaanaynaa oo sidaasi ayaynu isku ag joogaynaa. Ma sheegin hadii Ilaahay labadeena mid ahaan Meesha ka qaado oo ay hallaagmaan. Ninka geel jiraha ah ee Jaamac Siyaad waxa dad ugu dhaw ninka habarjeclo ee ay derika yihiin ee isku bii’adda ku nool yihiin. Ka hadii roob soo da’o ay ka wada cabbayaan, ka hadii ay abbaari dhacdana ay wada saamaynayso. Waxaynu oghanay dunidii siday maanta tahay. Noloshii siday u adkaatay. Halgankii aynu galnay wixii khasaare inaga soo gaadhay waad ogtihiin. Inta agoon inoo joogta tiro malaha. Hadana inta hadhay in aan nolol u raadino oo caadifada ka korno ayaa loo baahan yahay maanta. Diinteennu iimaanka waxay ka horreysiisay nabadda iyo ammaanka. Nabad la’aan waa nolol la’aan. Koonfur maanta waxba inaga xigaan. Waan soo taabtay gunteeda. Ma aha meel dawladnimo iyo Soomaalinimo u jeedda. Markaan ka soo quustay ayaan xal ka eeg is idhi Hargeysadii aad ogaydeen wixii aynu kala mudannay. Dadka Ilaahay caqli buu siiyay ay ku kala gartaan xumaha iyo sammaha. Caqli ay ku kala gartaan saxa iyo qaladka. Caqli ay ku kala gartaan xaqa iyo baadilka. Maanta waxaynu u baahannay wixii aynu jiritaankeena iyo midnimadeena ku sii badhi-taari lahayn. Anigu waxaan kow ka ahaa dadkii Waqooyi bari aas aasay. Anigu waxaan tagay Muqdisho anigoo aaminsan in Soomaalinimo wax lagu raadiyo. Waxaan kala kulmay niyad jab. Waxaan soo arkay in aan reer Waqooyi la kala jeclayn, hadii cid mudnaan la siinayana ay Isaaq iyo Hargeysa mudnaanta siinayaan. Tusaalaha ugu yar ee in aynu ku hungownay Koonfur, waxa kow ka ah in ciidankeenii aanay wax mushahar ah ka helin Xamar, halka Puntland dhawr kun oo ciidan ahi mushahar ka qaataan Xassan Sheekh. Waxa la inoo quudhi waayay tallaalka Hirshabelle oo Jawhar maamusha la siiyay in la in siiyo. Dadkaygiiyow, tolkay’ow idinkama mudni in aad i caydaan. In aad i af lagaadaysaan. Dantiina ayaan u maqanahay. Idinka ayaan idiin maqanahay. Nabad iyo Horumar ayaan idiinku maqanahay. Haddii uu gaadhi kaa galo meel dhiiqo ah oo aad xaga horena ka aragto dhiiqo kasii badan, caqligu kuma siinayo in aad hore ugu sii socoto. Waxaynu u baahanahay in aynu noolaano. In aynu horumar gaadhno. In aynu la tartanno bulshooyinka qayrkeen ah. Cidda ina ogol ee aynu wax wada qabsan karno anigu waan ogohay, idinna waa ogtihin hadaan la is yeelyaalayn. Dagaalo way dhacaan. Waligeedna way dhici jireen. Ha noqdaan qabiilooyin is dila ama dawladaba. Markasta waxa colaada ka danbeeya nabad. Wax kasta oo dhaca waa laga heshiiyaa. Dalka yar ee Ruwaanda waxii ka dhacay waynu ku haynaa taariikhda, maantana waddanada horumarka Africa hoggaaminaya weeyaan. Bulshooyinkii halkaa ku noolaa dad aan ka yarayn Milyan qof ayay iska xasuuqeen oo waliba qoladi yarayd xasuuq ku dhacay. Waa laga heshiiyay, maanta waa meelaha Afrika ugu horumarsan dhinac kasta. Waxa taa keentay in ay iska illoobeen maalmihii madoobaa ee soo maray, iyo gummaadkii dhacay waayo wixii dhacay way dhaceen oo lama soo celin karo, ee waxa uun la isweydiinayaa sidii aanu wixii oo kale u dhici lahayn. Waana ta keentay in la is cafiyo nolol qurux bandanna la sameeyay. Dadka reer Ruwanda waliba badankoodu waa gaalo. Inaga oo ummad muslim ah, ilaahayna ina faray cafiska ma jirto wax ka wanaagsan in nabad iyo cafis aynu qaadano oo dadka derisnimo iyo walaalnimo u horseedno. Dhulbahantow, tolkaygiiyoow, anigu ma ihi qof la idiin isticmaali karo. Ma ihi qof lacagi goyn karto. Mana ihi qof damiirkeedu liito oo hunguri ku shaqaysata. Idinkaan idiin maqanahay. Wax aan idiin cuntaminna idiin keeni mayo. Wixii aad ka yeelaysaana taladeeda idinkaa leh. Anigu Hargeysa dalxiis umaan iman. Qof u riyaaqsan in la soo dhaweeyo oo qudha ma ihi, hadii aanan dadkayga uga keeni karin hadafkaan lahayn iyo wixii ay xaqa u lahaayeen. Qof cad quudheed soo qaadanaya ma ihi. Ogaadana anigu in aan idin kala furfuro oo khilaaf idin dhex dhigo uma joogo halkan, ee waxaan doonayaa in walaaladeen Dawlad ku dhisan caddaalad iyo sinnaan wada wadaagno.

items.title: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya Oo Gaaray Jabuuti
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali, ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Jabuuti. Wasiirka ayaa halkaasi u tegay si uu u hoggaamiyo wafdiga Soomaaliya ee ka qaybgalaya Kalfadhiga 74-aad ee aan caadiga ahayn ee Golaha Wasiirrada Urur-Goboleedka IGAD. Shirkan ayaa isu keenaya Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah IGAD, iyadoo looga arrinsan doono arrimo muhiim u ah dalalka gobolka iyo xoojinta iskaashiga ka dhexeeya waddamada Geeska Afrika. Ka qaybgalka Soomaaliya ee kalfadhigan ayaa muujinaya doorka firfircoon ee ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka qaadanayso arrimaha gobolka iyo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo wada-shaqeynta dalalka xubnaha ka ah Urur-Goboleedka IGAD. Wasiirka Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali ayaa la filayaa inuu kulamo iyo wada-hadallo la yeesho mas’uuliyiinta ka qaybgalaysa shirka, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo danaha Soomaaliya iyo iskaashiga gobolka.

items.title: Rebuilding America’s manufacturing workforce
items.description: Rebuilding America’s manufacturing workforce By ShareAmerica   Foundry School will train U.S. workers for jobs in advanced manufacturing facilities, such as this one in Hayward, California. (© Josh Edelson/AFP/Getty Images) The United States is launching Foundry School to build an advanced manufacturing workforce to support President Trump’s drive to restore American manufacturing. The State Department-led initiative, announced September 3, brings together the U.S. government, leading universities and global industrial leaders. Developed through a public-private partnership with Stanford University, Foundry School will prepare the next generation of American entrepreneurs, engineers, technicians and industrial leaders to build and operate the advanced manufacturing enterprises of the future. Foundry School begins in September with seven regional sessions hosted by Arizona State University, Georgia Institute of Technology, Ohio State University, Pennsylvania State University, the University of Kansas, Vanderbilt University and Washington University in St. Louis. The regional sessions will cover the fundamentals of modern factory design, materials and supply chains, assembly-line engineering, plant economics, regulation and permitting, and workforce development at scale. In January 2027, Stanford University will host a 10-session core program focused on advanced manufacturing capabilities and featuring live instruction from globally recognized advanced manufacturing leaders. The State Department plans to work with Congress to support Pax Silica economies’ participation in Foundry School. The department is working with Stanford to develop a curriculum for U.S. and foreign counterparts to strengthen allied manufacturing capacity and supply chain resilience. Foundry School is a flagship program of the State Department’s Pax Silica initiative, an economic security partnership connecting governments, industry and universities to strengthen the critical supply chains and industrial capabilities that underpin the AI economy. “For decades, our diplomats have built relationships with the companies that became the best in the world at making things,” Under Secretary for Economic Affairs Jacob Helberg said September 3 at a launch ceremony in Washington. “Now we are bringing it home.” Secretary of State Marco Rubio speaks September 3 at the launch of Foundry School in Washington. (State Dept./Freddie Everett) Foundry School joins the industrial scene amid a U.S. manufacturing revival. The manufacturing sector grew for the seventh straight month in July, which brought the strongest growth in the sector in four years, the White House says. Meanwhile, the U.S. is attracting trillions of dollars of industrial investment. At the launch ceremony, Vice President Vance referred to Foundry School as “reinvesting in American workers.” “We woke up to the reality just a few years ago,” said Secretary of State Marco Rubio at the announcement, “that we are suddenly, as a nation, dangerously dependent — dangerously dependent — on other nations for all sorts of things that we need.”

items.title: Muungaab iyo dhiggiisa Jabuuti oo saxiixday heshiis dhigaya in labada caasimad…
items.description: Jabuuti (Caasimada Online) – Duqa magaalada Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) iyo dhiggiisa magaalada Jabuuti, Said Daoud Mohamed ayaa maanta kala saxiixday heshiis is-afgarad oo lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga labada caasimadood, gaar ahaan dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga, maalgashiga, dhaqanka iyo horumarinta. Heshiiskan oo lagu saxiixay magaalada Jabuuti ayaa lagu sheegay inuu saldhig u noqonayo iskaashi toos ah oo dhex mara maamullada Muqdisho iyo Jabuuti, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan inay abuuraan fursado cusub oo ganacsi iyo maalgashi. Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Muqdisho, Muungaab, ayaa munaasabadda ka sheegay in xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti uu yahay mid qoto dheer oo ku dhisan xiriir bulsho, dhaqan iyo diin. “Waa xiriir aysan bir goyn karin, biyana meyri karin,” ayuu yiri Muungaab. Waxa uu sidoo kale safiirka Jabuuti u jooga Soomaaliya, Cusmaan Sugulle Dubad, uga mahadceliyay kaalinta uu ka qaatay fududeynta wada-hadallada iyo xiriirka labada maamul. Muungaab ayaa dhiggiisa Jabuuti u fidiyay casuumaad rasmi ah oo uu ku yimaado Muqdisho, waxaana uu sidoo kale ganacsatada iyo maalqabeennada reer Jabuuti ugu baaqay inay maalgashi ku sameeyaan caasimadda Soomaaliya. Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa sheegay in Muqdisho ay ku jirto marxalad koboc iyo ballaarin ah, taas oo abuureysa baahi loo qabo maalgashi dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan adeegyada, dhismaha, ganacsiga iyo kaabayaasha magaalada. Dhankiisa, Duqa Jabuuti Said Daoud Mohamed ayaa soo dhoweeyay heshiiska, isaga oo sheegay inuu horseedi karo fursado cusub oo labada magaalo ay ka wada faa’iideystaan. Waxa uu sheegay in Jabuuti ay diyaar u tahay inay sii xoojiso iskaashiga dhaqaale, ganacsi iyo horumarineed ee kala dhexeeya Muqdisho. Heshiiska labada caasimadood ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli dowladda Soomaaliya iyo Jabuuti ay iyaguna ballaarinayaan xiriirkooda siyaasadeed iyo diblomaasiyadeed. Dhawaan, wasaaradaha arrimaha dibadda ee labada dal ayaa Muqdisho ku kala saxiixday heshiis kale oo lagu dhisayo hannaan joogto ah oo wadatashiyo siyaasadeed ah, kaas oo labada dowladood u oggolaanaya inay si joogto ah isaga kaashadaan arrimaha gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Heshiiska Muqdisho iyo Jabuuti ayaa hadda isku dayaya in xiriirkaas taariikhiga ah loo ballaariyo heer magaalo, ganacsi iyo maalgashi, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan in xiriirka siyaasadeed uu sidoo kale dhalin karo iskaashi dhaqaale oo muuqda. The post Muungaab iyo dhiggiisa Jabuuti oo saxiixday heshiis dhigaya in labada caasimad… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Hiiraan Region Traditonal Community Leader Returns to Beledweyne Amid Anger and Calls for Mobilization
items.description: Beledweyne, Somalia (WDN) — A visibly angry delegation led by the traditional leader of the Hawadle clan arrived in Beledweyne on Monday afternoon after returning from Mogadishu, where efforts to secure the top leadership position in Hirshabelle reportedly ended in failure. Hundreds of residents gathered at Beledweyne airport to welcome the delegation, reflecting the deep political emotions surrounding the dispute over the leadership of Hirshabelle. Among those accompanying the traditional leader was Hirshabelle Vice President Yusuf Dabageed, whose presence added further political significance to the delegation’s return. But the mood at the airport quickly turned confrontational. Addressing the crowd in brief remarks, the Hawadle traditional leader appeared visibly angry and issued a call for mobilization, urging members of his community to prepare to contribute whatever they could—including manpower and financial support. His remarks were widely interpreted as a call to prepare for confrontation with the Federal Government of Somalia and the Hirshabelle administration. A Political Dispute Taking a Dangerous Turn The developments mark a sharp escalation in the dispute over political leadership in Hirshabelle. The Hawadle delegation had travelled to Mogadishu amid expectations that negotiations could produce a political settlement over the leadership of the regional administration. Instead, the delegation returned to Beledweyne without securing the position it had sought. The return has now transformed what began as a political dispute into a potentially dangerous mobilization. The traditional leader’s appeal for community members to contribute both fighters and financial resources suggests that the dispute may no longer be confined to political negotiations. If the mobilization translates into armed confrontation, the consequences could extend far beyond Hirshabelle’s political institutions. Beledweyne at the Center of the Crisis Beledweyne has long been one of the most politically sensitive cities in central Somalia. The city is the administrative center of Hiiraan and has repeatedly witnessed tensions over the relationship between Hiiraan and the Hirshabelle administration, as well as disputes over political representation and the distribution of power. The latest confrontation therefore comes against an already fragile political backdrop. The involvement of prominent traditional leaders and senior Hirshabelle officials makes the situation particularly sensitive. A Warning to Mogadishu The message from Beledweyne is unlikely to be ignored in Mogadishu. The Federal Government is already facing political disputes with several regional actors over elections, constitutional arrangements and the distribution of political authority. A new confrontation in Hiiraan would add another serious challenge to efforts to maintain political stability and prevent local disputes from becoming armed conflicts. For the moment, there has been no indication that a full-scale conflict has begun. But the language coming from Beledweyne is unmistakably more confrontational. A political disappointment in Mogadishu has now returned to Beledweyne as anger, mobilization and a warning of possible confrontation. The critical question is whether political leaders and traditional authorities can contain the situation before calls for mobilization translate into violence. For Hirshabelle—and for Somalia more broadly—the cost of allowing another political dispute to become an armed confrontation could be devastating. What failed at the negotiating table must not be allowed to become a war in the streets of Beledweyne. items.title: Mogadishu Faces Higher Prices and Revenue Pressure as Shipping Disruptions Hit Imports
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Security tensions around the Bab al-Mandab Strait and Strait of Hormuz are disrupting Somalia’s traditional shipping routes, forcing importers to seek alternatives and raising concerns over higher prices, shortages of essential goods and declining government tax revenues. Somali businesses typically import goods from Asia through Gulf hubs including the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudi Arabia. But growing insecurity along key maritime routes is prompting some traders to establish more direct supply lines. Mogadishu Port manager Mohamed Ali Nur said the security situation around Bab al-Mandab and Hormuz has significantly affected Somali traders and that the port is working with businesses to identify alternative routes. “For the first time, we directly received a ship carrying sugar from Sri Lanka,” Mohamed Ali said, describing the shipment as part of efforts to reduce disruptions caused by the regional security situation. Higher Costs, Higher Prices Alternative routes may keep supplies moving, but longer journeys increase freight, fuel, insurance and storage costs. Combined with shipping delays, these higher costs could push up prices and cause shortages of essentials such as sugar, rice, flour and cooking oil, particularly goods Somalia relies heavily on imports to supply. Captain Ali Jemdi, who works in sugar-cargo transportation, said uncertainty over regional shipping routes has increased concerns among traders and shipping companies operating between Asia, the Gulf and East Africa. The Revenue Problem The consequences extend beyond consumers and businesses. Somalia relies heavily on international trade for customs duties, import taxes and port-related revenues. If shipping disruptions reduce import volumes or discourage businesses from bringing goods into the country, government collections could also decline. That creates a potential fiscal problem. Lower trade-related revenue means less money available to meet government commitments, including salaries for civil servants and security personnel, as well as spending on public services and administration. The effect would not necessarily be immediate, particularly if disruptions remain temporary. But a prolonged decline in imports could widen the gap between government revenue and expenditure. A Chain Reaction Somalia Cannot Ignore The potential economic chain is straightforward: Shipping disruption → higher transport costs → higher import prices → reduced purchasing power → weaker demand and imports → potentially lower customs revenue → greater pressure on government finances. For Somalia, maritime security is therefore also an economic and fiscal issue. The government should closely monitor food prices, import volumes, shipping costs and customs collections while working with traders to diversify supply routes. In the longer term, reducing Somalia’s exposure to external shipping shocks will require stronger domestic production, more efficient ports and broader diversification of supply chains. Disruption thousands of kilometers away can ultimately raise the price of food in Mogadishu, Puntland and Somaliland—and, if it lasts long enough, make it harder for the government to pay its bills. items.title: Puntland oo xirtay saraakiil ciidan oo u dhoofayay Muqdisho
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Puntland ayaa maanta garoonka diyaaradaha magaalada Boosaaso ka xirtay saraakiil ciidan oo la sheegay inay u safrayeen magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimadda Soomaaliya. Laba sarkaal oo ka tirsanaa ciidamadii Dowladda Federaalka ay dhawaan kula wareegtay deegaanka Kuur-ilaalo ee degmada Rako-raaxo ayaa ka mid ah dadka lagu xiray garoonka, sida ay sheegayaan wararka laga helayo Boosaaso. Sidoo kale, garoonka ayaa waxaa lagu qabtay agaasimihii Isbitaalka Lafaha ee Carmo, Cabdiqaadir Xaaji Cabdullaahi (Waraabe) oo isna la sheegay inuu ku wajahnaa Muqdisho. Garoonka ayaa waxa kale oo lagu xayiray Suldaan Maxamuud Xaaji Cabdullaahi oo ka mid ah isimada dhaqanka ee gobolka Bari, iyadoo markii dambe la sii daayay. Suldaanka oo ka hadlay dhacdada ayaa ku baaqay in si degdeg ah loo sii daayo ragga kale ee la xiray, isagoo sheegay inay Muqdisho u safrayeen dano gaar ah oo ay leeyihiin. “Waxay u safrayeen danahooda gaarka ah, waana xaq ay leeyihiin,” ayuu yiri Suldaan Maxamuud Xaaji Cabdullaahi, oo maamulka ugu baaqayo in dadka la xiray loo ogolaado inay safarkooda sii wataan. Xariga saraakiisha ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli uu jiro khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo amni oo u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan arrimaha ciidamada iyo maamulka deegaannada qaarkood. Ilaa hadda Puntland si rasmi ah ugama hadlin sababta loo xiray saraakiisha iyo agaasimaha Isbitaalka Lafaha ee Carmo, mana jirto faah-faahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan tallaabada maamulka uu qaaday. items.title: Southwest Somalia conflict risks spiraling into inter-clan war, ACLED warns
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – A political and military standoff in Somalia’s Southwest state risks escalating beyond a power struggle into a protracted inter-clan conflict that could destabilize the wider Bay region, the Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project (ACLED) said in a new report. The conflict pits federal government forces and their regional allies against Darwish forces loyal to ousted Southwest State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. According to ACLED, the two sides have fought at least 78 armed engagements in the Bay region between Feb. 2 and Aug. 28, with fighting concentrated overwhelmingly in the Baidoa district. Twenty-two of those clashes occurred in a five-week window from Feb. 4 to March, ACLED found, as federal forces mobilized to remove Laftagareen from power. The push to unseat him followed his decision to hold a state election, in which he was re-elected on March 28 to a second term – a vote Mogadishu did not recognize. The federal government and a new Southwest administration, installed in June, have since branded the opposition forces as terrorists. Officials have accused Laftagareen’s fighters of coordinating with Al-Shabaab militants during an attack on Baidoa city on Aug. 17, and specialized federal forces have begun deploying to the region to launch an operation against them. Spokespersons and supporters aligned with the opposition have firmly rejected the terrorism allegations. ACLED warned that the prolonged standoff carries a strategic cost beyond Southwest state’s borders: it risks diverting federal military resources away from the national campaign against Al-Shabaab at a moment when the group is intensifying its own offensive in the region. Since the new Southwest administration took office on June 11, ACLED has recorded more than 75 Al-Shabaab attacks in the Bay region through Aug. 28 – a surge the group’s analysts linked directly to the political vacuum and security realignment triggered by the leadership dispute. “If left unresolved, this political standoff between the Opposition-SWSPF and the federal government could escalate beyond a simple power struggle and devolve into a protracted inter-clan conflict, severely exacerbating communal instability across the region,” ACLED said. The Southwest crisis has become one of the most closely watched flashpoints in Somalia’s internal politics this year, pitting Mogadishu’s authority to install a federal-aligned administration against a local leader who claims an electoral mandate – with implications for clan cohesion, regional security, and the broader fight against Al-Shabaab. Background: How the Southwest crisis reached this point Laftagareen had governed Southwest state since 2018 before the rupture with Mogadishu. Tensions escalated after President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government pushed through constitutional changes that extended his own term and altered Somalia’s power-sharing arrangement; Laftagareen rejected the changes and severed cooperation with the federal government in March. Federal troops, backed by allied clan militias, entered Baidoa on March 30, and Laftagareen resigned and left for Nairobi rather than fight – the moment that set the current standoff in motion. Since then, fighting around Baidoa has recurred in waves rather than settled into either war or peace: opposition-aligned fighters mounted an attempted incursion in May, came close to reaching the presidential palace in a June 21 assault, and clashed with federal and Southwest forces again in August, including the Aug. 17 attack federal officials have linked to Al-Shabaab. Casualty figures from these episodes are contested and have not been independently verified by either side. The clan dimension ACLED warns about is not abstract. Southwest’s federal-backed administration is led by figures including former parliamentary speaker Aden Mohamed Nur “Madobe,” who comes from the Hadamo sub-clan of the broader Rahanweyn clan family; Laftagareen belongs to the Harin sub-clan, also part of the Rahanweyn. Because both camps draw on branches of the same clan family, analysts have noted that a prolonged military standoff carries a distinct risk of hardening into intra-clan and inter-clan rivalry rather than remaining a straightforward contest between a federal government and a former regional president. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Price Shock Hits Bosaso and Hargeisa as Consumers Feel the Cost of Regional Shipping Disruptions
items.description: Bosaso / Hargeisa(WDN ) — The regional shipping crisis is no longer a story unfolding somewhere far beyond Somalia’s shores. It has reached the markets, the kitchens and the household budgets of ordinary Somalis. In Bosaso and Hargeisa, prices of essential commodities are already climbing, with consumers and traders reporting sharp increases in the cost of sugar, rice, flour, pasta and cooking oil. The sudden price shock has triggered complaints on social media, where some residents are questioning what their respective governments are doing to protect consumers and, in some cases, blaming authorities for failing to contain the increases. The numbers are beginning to tell the story. In Bosaso, a bag of sugar that previously sold for about $27.50 is now reportedly reaching $32.70. A bag of rice has risen from approximately $23 to $26, while flour has increased from $22 to $26. A carton of pasta has reportedly climbed from $9 to $11, while a container of cooking oil has increased from $4.50 to $5.50. For a wealthy household, the difference may appear manageable. For the masses, families already living close to the edge, however, simultaneous increases across several basic commodities can quickly become a serious cost-of-living crisis. And this may only be the beginning. Bosaso Feels the Shock Bosaso is one of Puntland’s principal commercial gateways and depends heavily on imported goods arriving through its port. The immediate cause of the latest price increases remains contested. Traders have not provided a definitive explanation for the increases, but the situation has been linked to recurring tensions between Bosaso businesses and the Puntland authorities over fees reportedly imposed by DP World, the operator involved in the management of Bosaso Port. Local traders have previously complained about port-related charges, arguing that additional costs ultimately make imported goods more expensive. The latest increases have therefore created an uncomfortable chain reaction: costs that traders say they are being forced to absorb may eventually be transferred to consumers. Hargeisa Faces the Same Pressure The problem is not confined to Bosaso. Consumers in Hargeisa have also taken to social media to complain about sudden increases in the prices of essential commodities. Some have blamed Somaliland authorities for failing to contain the rising cost of basic goods. These online reactions should not automatically be interpreted as representing the views of the wider population. But they provide a visible indication of frustration among some consumers who are already feeling the impact of higher prices. The parallel complaints in Puntland and Somaliland are significant because both economies depend heavily on imported food and consumer products. When shipping becomes more expensive or unpredictable, the effects can move rapidly through the supply chain—from importers to wholesalers, retailers and ultimately households. From the Red Sea to the Family Budget The broader regional security situation provides the context. Somali importers traditionally rely on maritime routes connecting Asia, the Gulf and East Africa. Disruptions around the Bab al-Mandab Strait and Strait of Hormuz can force ships to take longer or more expensive routes, increasing freight, fuel, insurance and security costs. Those additional costs do not simply disappear. They are eventually reflected in the price of goods arriving in Somali markets. The result can be a combination of higher prices, shipping delays and tighter supplies, particularly for commodities that Somalia relies heavily on imports to provide. Geopolitical crisis thousands of kilometers away can therefore become a very personal crisis at a Somali market stall. The Political Cost For Puntland and Somaliland authorities, the issue is rapidly becoming more than an economic problem. When the price of food rises suddenly, consumers naturally look to their governments for explanations. That is already happening online. Some residents in Bosaso and Hargeisa are publicly questioning why prices are rising and what their governments are doing to protect consumers. Whether the governments are actually responsible for the increases is a separate question. But politically, perception matters. If citizens conclude that authorities are failing to control unnecessary costs, ensure competitive markets or reduce avoidable fees, rising prices can quickly become a source of political anger. The Revenue Dilemma There is another potential consequence that governments cannot ignore: falling trade revenue. Puntland and Somaliland collect revenue from imports through customs duties, port charges and other trade-related taxes and fees. If higher prices reduce consumer demand or discourage businesses from importing goods, government revenue could eventually decline. That creates a difficult policy dilemma. Governments need revenue to pay salaries, finance security operations and provide public services. But excessive charges on trade can increase the cost of imported goods and potentially discourage commercial activity. Revenue collection must therefore be balanced against the need to keep essential goods affordable and trade competitive. The Warning from Bosaso and Hargeisa What is happening in Bosaso and Hargeisa should be treated as an early warning. The regional shipping crisis may have begun as a security problem at some of the world’s most dangerous maritime chokepoints. But Somalia experiences that crisis differently. It arrives in the price of sugar. It appears in the cost of rice. It shows up in the price of cooking oil. And eventually, it reaches the family budget. That is why the authorities in Puntland and Somaliland face growing pressure to explain the price increases, review trade-related charges and work with importers to prevent unnecessary supply disruptions. The longer-term solution will require more resilient supply chains, diversified shipping routes and efficient ports. But the immediate political test is much simpler: Can governments keep essential goods affordable while maintaining the revenues they need to run the state? Bosaso and Hargeisa are already demonstrating how quickly a distant maritime crisis can become a domestic economic and political problem. For ordinary Somalis, geopolitics is no longer something happening on the horizon. It is sitting on the market shelf—and it is getting more expensive. items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka Oo Ka Hadlay Ka Reebista Ururka Towfiiq Doorashada Ku-celiska ah ee Galmudug
items.description: Afhayeenka Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, Mudane Cabdifataax Faysal Xuseen, ayaa faahfaahin ka bixiyay sababta Ururka Towfiiq, oo uu hoggaamiyo Sheekh Shaakir, looga reebay doorashada ku-celiska ah ee ka socota Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug. Cabdifataax Faysal ayaa sheegay in go’aanka lagu reebay Ururka Towfiiq uusan ahayn mid siyaasadeed, balse uu salka ku hayo habraaca iyo shuruudaha looga baahan yahay ururrada doonaya inay ka qayb galaan doorashada. Afhayeenka ayaa xusay in Ururka Towfiiq uusan Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka u gudbin codsi rasmi ah oo muujinaya inuu doonayo ka qaybgalka doorashada ku-celiska ah ee Galmudug. Arrintan ayaa muhiimad gaar ah leh, maadaama Ururka Towfiiq uu hore qayb uga ahaa murankii doorashada Galmudug, kaas oo sababay in Maxkamadda Sare ay baabi’iso doorashadii hore, kadib markii ururkaasi laga reebay geeddi-socodkii doorashada. Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa hadda wada diyaarinta iyo hirgelinta doorashada ku-celiska ah ee Galmudug, iyadoo ururrada siyaasadeed ee doonaya inay ka qayb galaan looga baahan yahay inay buuxiyaan shuruudaha iyo habraacyada rasmiga ah ee guddigu dejiyay. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli ay weli jiraan su’aalo iyo dood siyaasadeed oo ku saabsan ka qaybgalka ururrada siyaasadeed iyo hannaanka doorashooyinka ka socda dowlad goboleedyada dalka.

items.title: General Sahal Cabdullaahi oo ciidamada ku sugan Baydhabo ku wargeliyay in hawlgal la bilaabayo
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka oo booqasho ku jooga Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa ciidamada u sheegay in hawlgal sifayn ah laga bilaabi doono deegaanada hoostaga magaaladaasi. General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar oo weli kormeer ku sameynaya difaacyada ay ciidamadu ku leeyihiin afaafka hore ee magaalada ayaa marka hore ku bogaadiyay, sida ay u gudanayaan waajibaadkooda qaran ee difaaca dalka. Taliyaha oo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka qaarkood kula hadlay mid ka mid ah goobihii uu booqday ayaa u sheegay in ay u diyaargaroobaan hawlgal lagu xasillinayo amniga magaalada, isagoona muujiyay in dhawaan hawlgalka laga bilaabi doono deegaanada ku xeeran magaaladaasi. Taliska Militariga Somaliya ayaa isku-dubaridaya cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed, oo la doonayo in ay ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ka saaraan deegaanada ku dhow dhow Magaalada Baydhabo. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa Sabtidii Baydhabo u tagey qorsheynta hawlgal dhul iyo cirba leh, oo laga sameeyo deegaanada loo arko in laga soo abaabulo weerarada ka dhanka ah magaaladaasi. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ka caawineysa in uu si ammaan ah ugu shaqeeyo Baydhabo. Aadan Madoobe ayaa waxaa walaac ku haya ciidamada diidan maamulkiisa ee ku sugan bannaanada magaalada.

items.title: Ugaashka beesha Xawaadle oo ka degay Beledweyne, kuna dhawaaqay in…
items.description: Beledweyne (Caasimada Online) – Ugaaska beesha Xawaadle, Ugaas Yuusuf Ugaas Xasan iyo siyaasiyiin ka tirsan labada Aqal ee baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Beledweyne ee gobolka Hiiraan, halkaas oo si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay. Wafdiga oo maanta ka soo baxay Muqdisho ayaa waxaa garoonka diyaaradaha Beledweyne kaga hortagay Guddoomiyaha gobolka Hiiraan, Maxamed Xuseen Carab iyo xubno ka tirsan maamulka HirShabelle oo kasoo jeeda beesha Xawaadle, iyadoo amaanka magaalada si weyn loo adkeeyay. Ciidamo, hub iyo gaadiid dagaal ayaa sidoo kale lagu arkayay qeybo ka mid ah magaalada, xilli wafdiga Ugaaska uu halkaas u tagay wada-tashi la xiriira xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo tan amni ee ka taagan gobolka. Ugaas Yuusuf Ugaas Xasan oo warbaahinta la hadlay sheegay in socdaalkoodu qeyb ka yahay qorshe ay beesha Xawaadle uga tashanayso xaaladda taagan, isagoo ku baaqay in la mideeyo talada iyo go’aannada beesha. Ugaaska ayaa ku dhawaaqay in beesha qaadi doonto tallaabooyin wadajir ah oo ka duwan kuwii hore, kadib wada-tashiga ay beesha Xawaadle ku yeelanayso Beledweyne. “Waxaan rabnaa Xawaadle inay tashato. Si guud ayay u tashan doonnaa, si wadajir ah ayay u tashan doonnaa, tallaabo wadajir ahna waan qaadi doonnaa. Tallaabada aan qaadno waxay ka duwanaan doontaa tallaabooyinkii hore,” ayuu yiri Ugaaska. Ugaas Yuusuf ayaa sidoo kale dadka kasoo jeeda beesha ugu baaqay inay u diyaar garoobaan go’aannada kasoo baxa wada-tashiga, isagoo sheegay in looga baahan yahay qof kasta oo leh awood, dhaqaale ama karti inuu ka qeyb qaato fulinta go’aannada. “Maanta waxaan rabnaa go’aanka aan soo gaarno inaan fulinno, cidda fulin kartana waa idinka shacabka ah. U diyaar garooba,” ayuu yiri. Guddoomiyaha gobolka Hiiraan, Maxamed Xuseen Carab ayaa dhankiisa sheegay in maamulka gobolka uu diyaar u yahay inuu kala qeyb qaato talooyinka iyo dadaallada ay mas’uuliyiinta iyo waxgaradka beesha u tageen magaalada Beledweyne. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka HirShabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) oo isna hadlay ayaa sheegay in bulshada Hiiraan ay tabashooyin ka qabto Dowladda Federaalka, balse uu xusay in ujeeddadu aysan ahayn diidmada dowladda, balse ay tahay sidii loo raadin lahaa xuquuqda gobolka iyo bulshada ay ku leeyihiin dowladda. “Calanka Hirshabeelle ayaa noo calan ah, fowdo ma rabno. Annaga wax baan tabanaynaa, dowladda iyo maamulka Hirshabeelle oo aan ka mid nahay ayaan ka tabanaynaa,” ayuu yiri Dabageed. Si kastaba, socdaalka Ugaaska iyo wafdiga la socda ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli beesha Xawaadle ay muddooyinkii dambe dooneysay inay hesho xilka ugu sarreeya ee HirShabelle, waxayna haatan si adag u diidan tahay go’aanka uu xisbiga Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu musharaxa u siiyay Cali Guudlaawe oo haatan hoggaamiya maamulka. items.title: Eritrea Warns Israeli Military Presence in Somaliland Could Ignite New Security Crisis in the Red Sea
items.description: Asmara (WDN) — Eritrean Foreign Minister Osman Saleh has warned that any Israeli plan to establish a military presence in Somaliland could have far-reaching consequences for the security and stability of the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden, questioning what strategic purpose such a deployment would serve. Saleh said Eritrea is closely monitoring military and strategic developments in the Red Sea and Horn of Africa, where growing competition among regional and international powers is already reshaping the security environment. His warning comes amid increasing discussion over the possibility of Israel establishing a military foothold in Somaliland. Saleh questioned the rationale behind any Israeli military base in the region and cautioned that such a development could alter the existing strategic balance. The Eritrean minister did not say that Israel had formally established such a base. Rather, his comments focused on the potential consequences should Israel establish a permanent military presence in Somaliland. The Red Sea and Gulf of Aden form one of the world’s most important maritime corridors, linking the Indian Ocean with the Suez Canal and carrying a significant volume of global trade. Eritrea’s concern is therefore that a new foreign military deployment could have consequences well beyond the territory hosting it. The threat of Israeli Presence Eritrea’s warning comes as the Red Sea has become an increasingly contested security environment. Israel already faces security challenges linked to attacks on commercial shipping and the activities of the Iran-aligned Houthi movement in Yemen. A permanent Israeli military facility on the African side of the Gulf of Aden could potentially provide Israel with greater access to maritime surveillance, intelligence gathering and regional security operations. But it could also make Somaliland more exposed to conflicts involving Israel and its adversaries. Eritrea’s central concern is that a military presence intended to strengthen one country’s security could create new risks for the wider region. An Israeli military installation in Somaliland could be viewed by the Houthis or other hostile actors as a strategic extension of Israeli military power into the Red Sea region. The danger, therefore, would not necessarily be the presence of Israeli troops itself. It would be the possibility that Somaliland could become drawn into a wider confrontation involving Israel, Iran and armed groups operating around the Red Sea. Eritrea’s Strategic Concern Saleh’s comments reflect Eritrea’s longstanding sensitivity to the militarization of the Red Sea. Eritrea has a long coastline along the Red Sea, directly opposite Yemen, giving developments on either side of the waterway immediate strategic significance for Asmara. By questioning the purpose of an Israeli military presence in Somaliland, Eritrea is effectively warning that the Red Sea should not become an arena for competing foreign military projects. For Eritrea, the concern is not limited to Israel. Every additional military actor potentially changes the calculations of every other actor already operating in the region. Somaliland Could Become a Front Line The greatest potential risk for Somaliland would be becoming a frontline location in conflicts originating elsewhere. A foreign military presence can bring investment, infrastructure, diplomatic leverage and security cooperation. But it can also make the host territory a potential target. If Israel were to establish a military facility in Somaliland, armed groups hostile to Israel could potentially regard the facility as a legitimate strategic target—even if Somaliland itself had no direct role in the underlying conflict. That could expose civilians, ports, airports and commercial infrastructure to heightened security risks. It could also complicate Somaliland’s relations with Somalia, Djibouti and Eritrea, all of which have strategic interests in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. The Houthi Factor The Houthi movement represents one of the most immediate potential security concerns. The group has demonstrated its willingness to attack commercial vessels and targets it associates with Israel and its allies in and around the Red Sea. A permanent Israeli military presence on the African side of the Gulf of Aden could therefore potentially become another target in the group’s strategic calculations. Even without an actual attack, the perception that Somaliland is hosting an Israeli military facility could alter the security environment. Shipping companies could reassess risks. Regional governments could increase military deployments. Intelligence activity could intensify. Armed groups could attempt to establish new networks along the coastline. That is how a military presence intended to provide security could generate a new layer of insecurity. A Wider Regional Arms Race Eritrea’s warning also points to a broader question: what would other powers do in response to a new Israeli military foothold? The Horn of Africa already hosts or attracts military facilities and strategic interests involving the United States, China, Turkey, Gulf states and other international actors. An Israeli military presence could encourage competing powers to seek greater access to ports, airfields and strategic coastline. The result could be a gradual militarization of the Gulf of Aden rather than greater stability. This is why Eritrea’s warning extends beyond Eritrea’s immediate national interests. The concern is that one new military arrangement could trigger a chain reaction involving several other powers. ForSomalia’s sovereignty question, Eritrea’s warning also intersects with Somalia’s unresolved dispute over Somaliland’s status. The Federal Government regards Somaliland as part of Somalia, while Somaliland operates as a self-governing entity and seeks international recognition as an independent state. Any agreement allowing a foreign military to establish a permanent presence in Somaliland would therefore carry significant political and sovereignty implications. Mogadishu could regard such an arrangement as a challenge to Somalia’s territorial sovereignty, potentially escalating tensions between the Federal Government and Somaliland. The prospect of an Israeli military presence could consequently add another layer to an already complicated political and security dispute. From Strategic Asset to Strategic Liability For Somaliland, the attraction of a military partnership with Israel would be understandable if it promised diplomatic recognition, investment, security cooperation or economic benefits. But Saleh’s warning highlights the other side of that calculation. A military base may increase geopolitical relevance while simultaneously increasing vulnerability. The territory hosting it becomes more important—but potentially more exposed. The critical question would therefore be whether Somaliland could obtain sufficient political and economic benefits to justify the additional security risks. Saleh’s remarks ultimately raise a question that extends beyond the Israeli-Somaliland relationship: Can the Red Sea absorb another major foreign military presence without becoming even more dangerous? Eritrea clearly believes the possibility deserves serious scrutiny.  The Red Sea and Gulf of Aden are already under pressure from regional conflicts, maritime insecurity and competition among external powers. Every new military base changes the regional security calculation. Every new military alliance creates potential targets. And every new foreign deployment risks drawing local territories into conflicts that originate elsewhere. If Israel were to establish a military presence in Somaliland, the question would therefore not simply be what Israel gains. It would also be what new risks Somaliland, Somalia, Eritrea and the wider Horn of Africa inherit. That is the core of Saleh’s warning: a military facility intended to strengthen one country’s strategic position could inadvertently make the surrounding region a more dangerous place. items.title: Xogta ciidamo deegaan oo lagu tababarayo Waajid
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa degmada Waajid ee gobolka Bakool ka bilowday tababarka ciidamo deegaan ah, kaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu xoojiyo ciidamada dowladda ee ka howlgala magaalada iyo deegaanada hoostaga. Dhalinyarada la tababarayo ayaa muujiyay doonis ay kaga mid noqonayaan ciidamada, taas oo keentay in la siiyo tababar ciidan oo u saamaxaya inay ka qeyb qaataan sugidda amniga deegaanadooda, sida ay sheegeen saraakiil ka tirsan ciidanka xoogga dalka. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sheegay in ujeeddadu tahay in la xoojiyo difaaca magaalada iyo deegaanadeeda, iyadoo la doonayo in laga hortago khatar kasta oo amni oo sababi karta in Waajid ay gacanta ka baxdo ciidamada dowladda. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale xoogga saaraysa tababarka iyo qalabaynta dhalinyarada deegaanka xilli deegaano hoostaga degmada Waajid lagu soo warramayo inay ka jiraan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ay wadaan dagaalyahannada Al-Shabaab. Waajid ayaa loo arkaa magaalo muhiim u ah dhinaca amniga iyo isku socodka gobolka Bakool, waxaana la qorsheeyay in ciidanka deegaanka ay ka hoos shaqeeyaan ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed. Ciidanka deegaanka ayaa door ka qaadan doona ka hortagga weerarrada iyo ilaalinta goobaha muhiimka ah, iyagoo garab siinaya ciidamada Federaalka iyo kuwa maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, sida ay sheegeen saraakiishu. Tababarka ka socda Waajid ayaa kusoo aadaya iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka ay waddo qorshe lagu kordhinayo awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, si ay ugu diyaargaroobaan mas’uuliyadda amni ee dalka iyo howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. The post Xogta ciidamo deegaan oo lagu tababarayo Waajid appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya oo Nidaaminaysa Baraha Bulshada: Maxaa Isbeddelaya, Yuuse Saamaynayaa?
items.description: Baraha bulshadu waxay noqdeen qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah nolosha bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram iyo aaladaha kale ayaa maanta loo adeegsadaa helitaanka wararka, faafinta xogta, ganacsiga iyo doodaha bulshada. Isla waqtigaas, waxaa kordhay walaaca laga qabo wararka been-abuurka ah, marinhabaabinta, hadallada nacaybka ah iyo waxyaalaha waxyeellada leh ee la baahiyo. Arrintan ayaa keentay in Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya ay bilowdo dadaallo lagu horumarinayo, laguna nidaaminayo hab-adeegsiga warbaahinta dhijitaalka ah. Siyaasadda Baraha Bulshada Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska ayaa bisha Luulyo 2025 qabatay kulan wadatashi qaran oo looga hadlayay diyaarinta siyaasadda baraha bulshada, si loo maareeyo halista ka dhalata adeegsigooda qaldan. Kulanka waxaa ka qaybgalay hay’adaha dawladda, xubnaha dawladgoboleedyada, Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, ururrada warbaahinta, bulshada rayidka ah iyo dadka saamaynta ku leh baraha bulshada. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in talooyinka ka soo baxay wadatashigaas ay gundhig u noqonayaan diyaarinta siyaasadda qaranka ee baraha bulshada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, lama helin nuqul rasmi ah oo muujinaya in siyaasaddii kamadanbaysta ahayd la ansixiyay, oo ay dhaqangashay. Sidaas darteed, waa muhiim in aan la isku qaldin siyaasadaha la diyaarinayo iyo sharciyada dhaqangalay. Arrintani waxay qayb ka tahay qorshe ka baaxad weyn nidaaminta baraha bulshada. Madasha Labaad ee Istiraatiijiyadda Xiriirka Warbaahinta Soomaaliyeed 2026, oo Muqdisho ka dhacday 7da iyo 8da bishan Sibteenbar, waxaa diiradda lagu saaray casriyaynta warbaahinta, helitaanka xog sugan, la dagaallanka xogta qaldan iyo xogta si ulakac ah loo been-abuuray, adeegsiga garaadgacmeedka (AI), anshaxa saxaafadda iyo xoojinta xiriirka warbaahinta dawladda. Dawladdu waxay, sidoo kale, xoogga saartay hirgelinta Istiraatiijiyadda Qaranka ee Isgaarsiinta iyo iskudduwidda farriimaha hay’adaha dawladda. Xorriyadda Hadalka iyo Saxaafadda Nidaaminta baraha bulshadu waxay si toos ah u taabanaysaa xorriyadda hadalka. Qodobka 18aad ee Dastuurka Kumeelgaarka ahi wuxuu tilmaamayaa xorriyadda ra’yiga iyo hadalka, wuxuuna xusaa xorriyadda warbaahinta, oo ay ku jiraan warbaahinta elektaroonigga ah iyo tan internedka. Sidaas darteed, nidaam kasta oo cusub waa in uu si cad u qeexaa waxa mamnuuca ah, cidda go’aanka qaadanaysa iyo hannaanka qofku uga caban karo go’aankaas. Haddaba, wax-isweyddiinta mudani waa: yaa go’aaminaya in xogtu ay tahay mid qaldan, ra’yi qofeed, dhaliil ama war sugan oo saxan? Dhinaca kale, haddii siyaasaddan la hirgeliyo, waxay saamayn, toos ah ama dadban, ku yeelanaysaa adeegsadayaasha, suxufiyiinta, warbaahinta, dadka saamaynta ku leh baraha bulshada, dadka soo saara xogaha lagu baahiyo barahaas, ganacsiyada iyo hay’adaha dawladda. Dadka soo saara waxyaalaha la baahiyo ayaa si gaar ah ahmiyad u leh, maadaama qof kasta oo taageerayaal badan haysta uu awood u leeyahay in uu xog gaarsiiyo dad aad u tiro badan. Sidaas darteed, waxaa loo baahanyahay in si cad loo qeexo xilka qofka saaran marka uu faafinayo war ama xog dadweyne. Waxaa jira weyddiimo badan oo muhiim ah oo weli taagan: goorma ayay siyaasadda kama dambaysta ah ee baraha bulshadu dhaqangelaysaa? Yaa fulinaya? Maxay yihiin tallaabooyinka laga qaadi karo qofka jebiya? Ma jiri doonaa hannaan racfaan? Sidee loo ilaalinayaa suxufiyiinta iyo dadka dawladda dhaliila? Sidee loo kala saarayaa xogta qaldan iyo xogta si ulakac ah loo been-abuuray? Maxayse siyaasaddani kaga duwantahay Sharciga Warbaahinta ee 2020kii la taabbageliyay iyo sharciyada kale ee dalka ka jira? Soomaaliya waxay ku jirtaa marxalad ay si joogto ah oo xawli leh isu beddelayaan warbaahinta iyo tegnoloojiyaddu. Dawladdu waxay doonaysaa in ay wax ka qabato khataraha ka dhasha xogaha qaldan, xogaha sida bareerka ah loo been-abuuray iyo arrimaha kale ee waxyeellada leh ee la baahiyo, isla markaasna ay casriyayso warbaahinta iyo xiriirka dawladda iyo shacabka. Hasayeeshee, hirgelidda nidaamkani kuma xirna in la xakameeyo faafidda xogaha marinhabaabinta ah oo keliya, ee waxay, dhab ahaantii, ku xirnaan doontaa hufnaanta lagu dhaqangeliyo, ilaalinta xorriyadda hadalka iyo in bulshada loo caddeeyo cidda go’aaminaysa waxa sharci ahaan ama siyaasad ahaan qaldan. Doodda muhiimka ahi, sidaas darteed, waa sida loo heli karo dheellitir u dhexeeya badbaadada bulshada iyo suurtagalnimada xorriyadda hadalka, heer kasta ha joogtee.

items.title: Sawirro: Maxay soo arkeen saraakiisha DF u dirtay Baydhaba?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wafdi saraakiil ah oo ka socda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta kormeer shaqo ku tegay difaacyada hore ee magaalada Baydhaba, si ay ugu kuurgalaan xaaladaha amniga ee ka jira halkaasi. Wafdigan oo uu horkacayay taliyaha ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar soo indha-indheeyay goobaha la difaacayo amniga Baydhaba, iyagoo soo arkay raadadka dagaalkii culsaa ee dhawaan halkaas ku dhex-maray ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen. Taliska militariga Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale soo bandhigay haraadiga gaari loo adeegsaday waxyaabaha qarxa oo billaawgii bishaan lagu soo weeraray magaalada Baydhaba ee caasimadda KMG ah ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Taliyaha iyo saraakiisha la socotay ayaa si gaar ah u qiimeeyay xaaladda guud ee amniga iyo tan nololeed ee magaalada, iyagoo sidoo kale u kuurgalay xaaladda ciidamada iyo goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin. Inta lagu guda jiray booqashada, taliyaha qeybta 60-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Gaashaanle Sare Isxaaq Aadan (Isxaaq Berdaale) ayaa taliyaha ciidanka Dhulka iyo saraakiisha wehlisa warbixin guud ka siiyay xaaladda amniga, howlgalladii iyo dagaalladii ugu dambeeyay ee ay ciidamadu galeen iyo guulaha laga gaaray intaba Dhankiisa Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa ciidamada ugu hambalyeeyay guulaha ay gaareen, isaga oo uga mahadceliyay sida joogtada ah ee ay uga feejigan yihiin dhaq-dhaqaaqyada cadowga iyo sida ay uga go’an tahay difaaca shacabka ay dhaarta u mareen inay u adeegaan. Maalmihii u dambeeyay waxaa dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan laga dareemayay bannaanka magaalada Baydhaba, kadib markii ay dhawr jeer oo hore ay soo weerareen ciidamada daacadda u ah madaxweyne hore Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen, kuwaas oo weli fariisimo ciidan ku leh duleedka magaalada. Xaaladda ayaa hadda deggan, inkastoo ciidamada labada dhinac ay isku horfadhiyaan goobihii laga dagaalamay, taas oo suuragal ka dhigeysa inuu mar kale qarxo dagaalka, culaysna ku noqneysa shacabka ku dhaqan halkaasi. Dagaalladan waxaa barbar socda duqeymo diyaaradeed oo qaar kamid ah saaxibada caalamiga ah ka fulinayaan aagga magaalada Baydhaba, iyada oo lala beegsanayo ciidamada ku sugan halkaas iyo maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab.   The post Sawirro: Maxay soo arkeen saraakiisha DF u dirtay Baydhaba? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Gudoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika oo taageeray weerarada bada ee Xuutiyiinta
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa Weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee Maraakiibta Ganacsiga Badda Cas ku tilmaamay Bartilmaameedyo Sharci ah. Ninka hadda hoggaaminaya Guddiga Midowga Afrika, oo hore u ahaa wasiir arrimo dibadeed oo Jabuuti u soo shaqeeyay muddo dheer, ayaa si aan caadi ahayn u qirtay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ee maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Badda Cas. Hadallo la duubay, wuxuu ku sheegay in dowladda Jabuuti aysan cambaareyn weerarrada markii ay bilaabeen. Taa beddelkeeda, wuxuu soo bandhigay wax u dhigma cudur daar, isagoo ku dooday in Xuutiyiintu ay u dhaqmayeen si ay u taageeraan “walaalahooda” Falastiiniyiinta ah. Wuxuu sii raaciyay, isagoo soo jeedinaya in maraakiibta ganacsiga ee lagu weeraray Badda Cas loo arki karo bartilmaameedyo sharci ah. Mowqifka noocaas ah wuxuu si qoto dheer uga walaacsan yahay madaxa hay’ad qaarad ah oo loo xilsaaray horumarinta nabadda, xasilloonida iyo ixtiraamka sharciga caalamiga ah. Kuwani ma ahayn hadallo aan caadi ahayn ama aan muhiim ahayn. Waxay halis ugu jiraan inay sharciyad siyaasadeed siiyaan koox xagjir ah oo weerarradoodu ay halis geliyeen badmaaxiinta rayidka ah, carqaladeeyeen ganacsiga caalamiga ah isla markaana halis geliyay mid ka mid ah marinnada badda ee ugu muhiimsan adduunka. Mas’uulka ugu sarreeya Midowga Afrika inuu qiil u sameeyo rabshadaha noocaas ah waxay wiiqaysaa kalsoonida ururka waxayna keenaysaa su’aalo culus oo ku saabsan sida ay uga go’an tahay amniga badda, xasilloonida gobolka iyo xeerarka loogu talagalay inay difaacdo. Source Inside Africa

items.title: Hirshabelle Vice President Rejects Cooperation With Guudlaawe as Political Tensions Escalate
items.description: BELEDWEYNE—Hirshabelle State Vice President Yusuf Hagar Dabageed has ruled out working with President Ali Abdullahi Hussein Guudlaawe if Guudlaawe is re-elected to lead the federal member state. Speaking in an interview, Dabageed said he would not resign from his position but would refuse to cooperate with Guudlaawe if he secures another term as Hirshabelle president. His remarks came a day after the Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP) endorsed Guudlaawe as its candidate for the Hirshabelle presidential election. “The JSP issue and who was given what does not concern us. It concerns the person who gave it and the person who received it. But we, the people of Hirshabelle, are part of whatever decision the people of Hirshabelle make,” Dabageed said. Dabageed said the Hiiraan community would hold a consultative meeting in Beledweyne to deliberate on the political developments following Guudlaawe’s endorsement. He said the gathering was expected to produce a unified position on the emerging political dispute. The vice president also dismissed reports that Hiiraan residents were seeking to withdraw from Hirshabelle State. He said the community remained committed to the state-building process but maintained that its principal grievance was what it considers the denial of a five-year period of leadership that Hiiraan representatives say was agreed as part of the state’s political arrangements. The dispute adds to growing political tensions within Hirshabelle ahead of the state’s leadership elections, with divisions over power-sharing and the political representation of Hiiraan continuing to shape the region’s political landscape. The post Hirshabelle Vice President Rejects Cooperation With Guudlaawe as Political Tensions Escalate appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Daawo: Baarlamanka oo ku dheggan wasiir FIQI: Aroosyada ayaan ugu imaan doonaa
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaanno ka tirsan Baarlamaanka Federaaka Soomaaliya ayaa baafinaya wasiirka gaashaandhigga Axmed Macallin Fiqi oo maanta ka baaqday kulanka Golaha Shacabka oo la geeyay Hindise-sharciyeedka Difaaca Qaranka. Hindise-sharciyeedkan ayaa waxaa golaha faah-faahin ka siiyay wasiiru dowlaha wasaaradda gaashaandhigga Xildhibaan Cumar Cali Cabdi oo golaha la wadaagay muhiimadda uu sharcigan u leeyahay dalka. “Sharcigan wuxuu xaqiijinayaa in ciidamadeenna ay ayeeshaan hannaan sharci oo lagula xisaabtao, si awoodda iyo waajibaadka ciidanka marwaliba uga shaqeeyaan xadka uu sharciga dhigayo,” ayuu yiri wasiir Cumar Cali Cabdi. Intaas kadib xildhibaannada qaar ayaa dood ka keenay maqnaashaha wasiir Fiqi oo isagu ah mas’uulka ugu sarreeya wasaaradda, waxayna sheegeen inuu tago xafladaha aroosyada, balse uu ka dhuumanayo baarlamaanka Soomaaliya. “Fiqi aroosyada iyo xafladaha ayuu dadka kasoo dhagax tuuraa ama kasoo caayaa baarlamaankana wuu ka dhuumanaayaa wasiiru dowle ayuu noo soo diraa ha ogaaado inaan aroosyada ugu imaan doono” ayuu yiri yiri Xildhibaan Cali Mahdi Qalato. Sidoo kale, Xildhibaan Saadaq Cabdullahi Cabdi ayaa ku baaqay in sharcigan dib loo celiyo, ilaa uu golaha ka hor imaanayo wasiirka, si su’aalo loo waydiiyo. “Sharcigaan dib haloo dhigo ilaa wasiir Fiqi uu golaha ka hor imaanaayo, fursadna waa uu haayaa fadhi ku dirirku ayuu joogaa waa in uu baarlamaanka uu hor imaadaa, si aan su,aalo uweydiino” ayuu yiri Saadaq Cabdullaahi Cabdi. Dhankeeda Xildhibaan Habdhowre Sahra Bundubte ayaa soo jeedisay in aan ciidamo cusub la aas-asin, int xuquuqdooda ay helayaan ciidamada hadda jooga. “Aniga ma qabo in ciidamo cusub in la aasaaso iyadoo ay ciidamadeeda hada xaalada aan aragnay ay ku sugan yihiin,” ayay tiri Sahra Bundubte. items.title: Danab Forces Capture Two Al-Shabaab Fighters in Bay Region
items.description: BAY —Somalia’s elite Danab Commandos have conducted a planned military operation south of the Leego area in Bay Region, targeting suspected Al-Shabaab positions, according to military sources. The operation, carried out by the Special Operations unit of the Danab forces, resulted in the arrest of two individuals identified as members of the Al-Shabaab militant group. The troops also seized two AK-47 rifles during the operation. Military forces further destroyed a site believed to have been used by Al-Shabaab militants to prepare explosive devices, the sources said. The operation forms part of ongoing counterterrorism efforts by Somali government forces in areas where Al-Shabaab maintains a presence. The military has intensified targeted operations aimed at disrupting the group’s activities and dismantling its bases and hideouts. Danab Special Forces have played a prominent role in Somalia’s counterterrorism campaign, carrying out specialized operations against Al-Shabaab fighters, weapons caches and suspected militant facilities. The Danab forces said they would continue conducting targeted operations as part of efforts to strengthen security and weaken Al-Shabaab’s operational capabilities in the region. items.title: Qiimaha Shidaalka Muqdisho oo markale kor u kacay
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Qiimaha shidaalka ee lagu iibiyo magaalada Muqdisho ayaa sare u kacay qiyaastii 15% muddo toddobaad ah, sida ay xaqiijiyeen darawalada gadiidka. Kororka qiimaha ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xaaladda amni iyo dagaallada ka socda Bariga Dhexe ay saameyn ku yeelanayaan suuqyada shidaalka iyo gaadiidka caalamka. Ganacsatada shidaalka ayaa sheegay in qiimaha gudaha uu si dhow ula socdo isbeddellada ka dhaca suuqyada caalamka, iyadoo xaalad kasta oo dagaal ama xiisad cusub ay keeni karto koror ku yimaada kharashka shidaalka iyo gaadiidka. Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in qiimaha shidaalka uu noqday mid si degdeg ah uga falceliya xaaladda Bariga Dhexe, iyadoo mararka qaar lacag dheeraad ah lagu daro qiimaha marka ay soo baxaan wararka ku saabsan dagaallo ama xiisado cusub. Kororka shidaalka ayaa walaac ku haya bulshada, maadaama isbeddelka qiimaha shidaalku uu si toos ah ama dadban u saameyn karo qiimaha gaadiidka, badeecadaha iyo adeegyada kale ee ku tiirsan shidaalka. Khabiirada dhaqaalaha ayaa muddo dheer tilmaamay in Soomaaliya ay si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay shidaalka dibadda laga keeno, taasina ay suuqa gudaha ka dhigto mid u nugul isbeddellada ku yimaada qiimaha shidaalka ee caalamka iyo kharashaadka gaadiidka. Sikastaba, xiisadaha Bariga Dhexe ay sii socdaan ama ay ka sii daraan, waxaa jirta cabsi laga qabo in qiimaha shidaalka ee Muqdisho uu mar kale kor u kaco, taasoo sii kordhin karta culayska dhaqaale ee saaran shacabka ku nool magaalada Muqdisho. items.title: Yuusuf Dabageed oo qaylo dhaan afka furtay kuna hanjabay tallaabo culus
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweyne ku xigeenka Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, Mudane Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) oo wareysi siiyay BBC-da ayaa ka hadlay arrimo ku aadan doorashada HirShabelle, isaga oo si cad u diiday hannaanka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee maamulkaasi. Dabageed ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in xilligan aysan HirShabelle ka dhici karin wax doorasho ah, illaa heshiis laga gaarayo khilaafka taagan, gaar ahaan tabashada ay qabto beeshiisa. Sidoo kale, wuxuu ku hanjabay in tallaabo ay qaadi doonaan, haddii aan xal loo helin tabashada taagan, kahor doorashooyinka ka dhacaya deegaanka. “Wax HirShabelle la yiraahda oo jiraya ma jiraan labadii gobol ee Hiiraan iyo Shabeellada Dhexe ayaa jiri doono haddii aaan hadda laga heshiinin oo aan la dhisin wax heshiis lagu yahay, mana ka dhacaysa wax doorasho ah HirShabelle.” ayuu wareysiga ku yiri Yuusuf Dabageed. Dhanka kale, wuxuu eedeyn culus u jeediyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, isaga oo uu tilmaamay inuu diidan yahay xaqa beesha Xawaadle, wuxuuna sheegay inay dagaalami doonaan, haddii aan la qancin, sida uu ku dooday. “HirShabelle amni darro iyo qalalaase ayay galeysaa sababta oo ah Xasan Sheekh hal reer ayuu wax u ogol yahay Xawaadle wixii kala dhaxeeyay walaalahood waa loo diiday,” ayuu mar kale yiri Madaxweyne ku xigeenku. Yuusuf Dabageed oo la weydiiyay cidda amni darada sameyn doonta ayaa carrabka ku dhuftay in isaga iyo reerkiisaba ay sameyn doonaan wax walba oo ay awoodaan, si ay u helaan xuquuqdooda. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, xiisadda haatan ka taagan HirShabelle ayaa sii laba kacleysay, kadib markii shalay kaarka xisbiga JSP la siiyay Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe, taas oo ka careysiisay siyaasiyiinta beesha Xawaadle, kuwaas oo hadda dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wada magaalooyinka Muqdisho iyo Beledweyne. Arrintan ayaa uga sii dareysa xaaladda adag ee HirShabelle oo tan iyo markii la aas-aasay wajaheysa khilaafaad gudaha oo ka dhashay dhisidda maamulka, kuwaas oo dib u dhigay horumarkii labada gobol ee Hiiraan iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe. items.title: Guddiga Xuquuqul Insaanka Somaliland oo Ka Walaacay Xarigga Suugaan-Yahan iyo Wariyeyaal
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Xuquuqul Insaanka Somaliland ayaa walaac xooggan ka muujiyay xarigga sharci-darada ah ee lagula kacay suugaan-yahan iyo wariyeyaal, kuwaas oo loo xiray amar maxkamadeed la’aan. Warsaxaafadeed ka soo baxay guddiga ayaa lagu sheegay in suugaan-yahan Ismaaciil Yuusuf (Jiheeye) iyo wariye Cabdiqani Xuseen Abokor (Baylood) ay ciidamada ammaanku xireen iyadoo aysan jirin wax waaran maxkamadeed ah, waxaana xariggooda la xiriiriyay gabay dhowaan la tiriyay oo la faafiyay. Labada nin ayaa weli ku jira xabsiga iyadoo aan wax maxkamad ah la horkeenin, ayadoo dhinaca kale, guddiga uu xaqiijiyay in wariye Xasan Saleebaan Haaruun (Galaydh), oo ay ciidamada baarista dambiyada ee CID-du qabteen 10-kii bishan Sebteembar, la sii daayay taariikhdu markay ahayd 12-ka Sebteembar. Wariye Galaydh ayaa guddiga u xaqiijiyay inaan wax jir-dil ah loo geysan intii uu xirnaa, balse lagu qabtay hab-raac aan waaran maxkamadeed lahayn. Guddiga Xuquuqul Insaanka Somaliland ayaa ku baaqay in la dhowro xorriyadda hadalka iyo xuquuqda dastuuriga ah ee muwaadiniinta, iyadoo booliska iyo hay’adaha garsoorkuna aysan ilaa hadda soo bandhigin eedeymo rasmi ah oo maxkamadeed ama bayaan ka jawaabaya sheegashada xarigga sharci-darrada ah.

items.title: Koonfur-Galbeed oo Rayidka uga Digtay Goobaha Hawlgallada iyo Duqeymaha
items.description: Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha ee Dowlad-Goboleedka Koonfur-Galbeed ayaa soo saartay digniin culus oo ku wajahan dadka rayidka ah, iyadoo ku wargelisay inay si degdeg ah uga fogaadaan goobaha iyo fariisimaha la qorsheynayo in laga fuliyo hawlgallo ciidan iyo duqeymo cirka ah. Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur-Galbeed, Isxaaq Maxamed, ayaa sheegay in maamulku uu wado diyaargaroowgii ugu dambeeyay ee hawlgallo ballaaran iyo duqeymo lagu beegsanayo saldhigyada iyo goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin kooxda Al-Shabaab. Wasiirka ayaa si gaar ah ugu baaqay shacabka ku dhaqan deegaannada maamulka inay ka fogaadaan goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab iyo sidoo kale ciidamada taageersan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur-Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen), si looga fogaado waxyeello soo gaarta dadka aan waxba galabsan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, bayaanka laguma shaacin goobaha rasmiga ah ee bartilmaameedka noqon doona, xilliga ay hawlgalladu bilaabanayaan, iyo cidda ama saaxiibbada caalamiga ah ee fulinaya duqeymahaas la qorsheeyay. Labada dhinac ee uu wasiirku farta ku fiiqay ayaa ah kuwo kala madax-bannaan oo ujeeddooyin kala duwan leh, iyadoo warbixintu aysan caddayn wax xiriir ah oo ka dhexeeya Al-Shabaab iyo ciidamada taageersan madaxweynihii hore, balse tallaabadan ayaa muujinaysa xaalad kacsanaan amni iyo mid siyaasadeed oo ka soo cusboonaatay guud ahaan deegaannada Koonfur-Galbeed.

items.title: Shabeellaha Hoose oo Noqday Gobolka Ay Ka Dhacaan Rabshadaha Ugu Badan Ee Al-Shabaab
items.description: Gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa noqday deegaanka ay ka dhaceen rabshadaha ugu badan ee lala xiriiriyay kooxda Al-Shabaab gudaha dalka Soomaaliya, sida lagu shaaciyay warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay hay’adda diiwaangelisa colaadaha caalamka ee ACLED. Daraasaddan, oo la faafiyay xilliga xuska 25-guurada weerarradii 11-kii Sebtembar, ayaa xaqiijisay in Al-Shabaab ay ku lug lahayd in ka badan 2,300 oo dhacdo oo rabshado siyaasadeed iyo amni-darro ah tan iyo bilowgii sanadkan 2026. Tiradan ayaa ka dhigan ku dhowaad kala bar dhammaan falalka rabshadaha ah ee caalamka oo dhan loo diiwaangeliyay dhammaan faracyada kale ee hoos yimaada shabakadda Al-Qaacida. Hay’adda ACLED ayaa Al-Shabaab ku tilmaantay awoodda aan dowliga ahayn ee ugu gacan-sarreysa dalka, isla markaana ah laanta ugu rabshadaha badan guud ahaan xulafada Al-Qaacida ee caalamka, iyadoo Shabeellaha Hoose uu weli yahay xudunta ugu weyn ee ay ka dhacaan isku dhacyada, weerarrada, iyo falalka amni-darrada ah ee kooxdaasi ku lugta leedahay. Dhinaca kale, hay’addu waxay soo saartay digniin ku aaddan cawaaqibka mustaqbalka, iyadoo muujisay in yaraanshaha taageerada caalamiga ah ee hawlgalka nabad-ilaalinta Midowga Afrika ay Al-Shabaab u abuuri karto fursado cusub oo ay ku ballaariso saameynteeda iyo weerarrada ay ka fuliso dalka.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo UNDP oo Ka Wada-hadlay Horumarinta iyo Kobcinta Wax-soo-saarka Xoolaha
items.description: Wasiirka Xoolaha, Dhirta iyo Daaqa ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Xuseen Maxamed, ayaa magaalada Muqdisho kulan kula yeeshay madaxa Barnaamijka Horumarinta ee Qaramada Midoobay (UNDP) u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, Christophoros Politis. Kulankan ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga farsamo ee u dhexeeya labada dhinac, kobcinta wax-soo-saarka xoolaha nool, iyo sidii qorshayaasha waaxda xoolaha loogu waafajin lahaa Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka (NTP). Sidoo kale, mas’uuliyiinta ayaa dib u eegis ku sameeyay dadaallada lagu taageerayo nolol-maalmeedka bulshada xoolo-dhaqatada ah iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha reer miyiga ee ku tiirsan xoolaha. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, warbixinta laguma shaacin wax maalgelin dhaqaale oo cusub, mashaariic gaar ah oo la bilaabayo, ama jadwal fulineed oo loo qabtay waxyaabihii ay labada dhinac ka wada-hadleen.

items.title: Qiimaha Raashinka Daruuriga ah oo Sare Ugu Kacay Suuqyada Magaalada Boosaaso
items.description: Suuqyada magaalada Boosaaso ee xarunta ganacsiga dowlad-goboleedka Puntland ayaa laga soo sheegayaa koror xooggan oo ku yimid qiimaha raashinka aasaasiga ah, arrintaas oo culeys dhaqaale ku keentay qoysaska danyarta ah ee ku nool deegaanka. Wararka la helayo ayaa muujinaya in qiimaha kiishka sonkorta ah uu kor uga kacay 32.7, halka kiishka bariiska ah uu isna gaaray 26, halka markii hore uu ahaa 23. Dhinaca kale, waxaa jira aragtiyo kala duwan oo ku aaddan waxa dhaliyay kororkan degdegga ah, waxaana qaar ka mid ah ganacsatada deegaanku ay sababta ku xireen saameynta colaadda Bariga Dhexe iyo kororka ku yimid qiimaha shidaalka caalamka, halka warbixinno kale ay tilmaamayaan in arrintani ay la xiriiri karto muran ka dhashay canshuuraha iyo khidmadaha lagu kordhiyay Dekedda Boosaaso. items.title: Duqeymaha Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya oo Gaaray 81 Sanadkan 2026 Sida Ay Sheegtay AFRICOM
items.description: Taliska Mareykanka ee Qaaradda Afrika (AFRICOM) ayaa xaqiijiyay inuu weerar dhinaca cirka ah ka fuliyay gobolka Jubbada Hoose, kaas oo lala beegsaday maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab meel u dhow deegaanka Qumbi, oo qiyaastii 80 kiiloomitir dhinaca waqooyi-galbeed kaga beegan magaalada Kismaayo. Duqeyntan, oo dhacday 8-dii bishan Sebteembar, ayaa tiradeeda guud laga soo xigtay inay tahay howlgalkii 81-aad ee diyaaradaha Mareykanku ka fuliyaan gudaha Soomaaliya tan iyo bilowgii sanadkan 2026, marka la eego xogta iyo bayaannada rasmiga ah ee ka soo baxay taliska AFRICOM. Dhinaca kale, xog-ururinta ay samaysay hay’adda cilmi-baarista ee New America ayaa tirada guud ee duqeymaha sanadkan ku sheegtay 83 weerar. Farqiga u dhexeeya labada tiro ee 81 iyo 83 ayaa loo sababeynayaa hab-raacyada kala duwan ee labada dhinac u adeegsadaan diiwaangelinta duqeymaha iyo kala saaridda howlgallada is-daba-joogga ah, taas oo ka dhigan inaan hal tiro oo keliya loo qaadan karin mid kama-dambeys ah. items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Qorsheynaysa Soo-Celinta Ku Dhowaad 1,900 Soomaali ah oo Ku Sugan Jarmalka
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa lagu soo waramayaa inay waddo qorshe dib loogu soo celinayo dalka ku dhowaad 1,900 oo muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed ah oo haatan ku sugan dalka Jarmalka. Qorshahan oo la filayo inuu dhaqangalo bisha Oktoobar ee soo socota ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallo la xiriira maaraynta arrimaha socdaalka iyo dib-u-dejinta dadka aan sharciga degenaanshaha ka helin waddamada Yurub. Sida ay faafiyeen warbaahinta maxalliga ah, tiradan ballaaran ayaa la qorsheynayaa in marxalado kala duwan dalka dib loogu soo celiyo, iyadoo xogta la helay ay muujinayso in arrintani ay daba socoto wadahadallo iyo is-afgaradyo dhexmaray saraakiisha labada dal oo ku saabsan fududeynta soo laabashada muwaadiniinta aan haysan oggolaanshaha joogtada ah ee dalka Jarmalka. Tirokoobyada rasmiga ah ee laga soo xigtay Baarlamaanka Jarmalka ayaa tilmaamaya in saddexdii sano ee u dambaysay ay hooseysay tirada dadka Soomaalida ah ee dalkaas laga masaafuriyay, iyadoo wadar ahaan dib loo soo celiyay 77 qof oo keliya intii u dhaxaysay 2023 iyo 2025. Xogtaas ayaa muujinaysa in 19 qof la masaafuriyay sanadkii 2023, 12 qof sanadkii 2024, halka sanadkii 2025 ay tiradu gaartay 46 qof. Haddii tallaabadan cusub ee la hadal-hayo ay u hirgasho sidii loo qorsheeyay, waxay noqon doontaa tiradii ugu ballaarnayd ee hal mar laga soo celiyo dalka Jarmalka muddooyinkii u dambeeyay, taas oo sidoo kale culeys ku noqon karta qorshayaasha dib-u-dhexgalka bulshada iyo fursadaha shaqo ee dalka ka jira xilli ay Soomaaliya la daalaa-dhacayso duruufo dhaqaale iyo mid bini’aadannimo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Jarmalka midkoodna weli si rasmi ah uma xaqiijin tirada saxda ah ee 1,900 qof, jadwalka ay ku bixi doonaan duullimaadyada soo daabulaya, iyo xaaladda sharciga ee qof kasta oo ka mid ah dadkaas, waxaana xogtan ay weli ku kooban tahay warbixinno warbaahineed oo sugaya xaqiijin dowladeed.
