items.title: Safiirkii Türkiye ee Soomaaliya oo ka tegay farriin cajiib ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Safiirkii Dowladda Türkiye u fadhiyey Soomaaliya, Alper Aktaş, oo xilka ka tegay, ayaa shaaciyay inuu soo gabagabeynayo muddo-xileedkiisii Muqdisho, kaddib markii uu Soomaaliya ka howlgalayay tan iyo bishii Maarso 2024. Safiirka ayaa sheegay inuu Soomaaliya uga ambabaxayo xil cusub oo uu ka qabanayo magaalada Skopje ee dalka North Macedonia , isaga oo farriin sagootin ah u diray shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana ka hadlay isbeddellada uu arkay muddadii uu dalka joogay iyo halka uu marayo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye. Aktaş ayaa sheegay in muddadii uu Muqdisho joogay uu si dhow ula shaqeynayay hay’adaha dowladda, bulshada rayidka ah iyo qaybaha kale ee bulshada, isaga oo xusay in xiriirka labada dal uu sii ballaartay. “Türkiye ahaan, Soomaaliya waxaan ka hirgelinaynaa hannaan ku dhisan caddaalad, is-ixtiraam, sinnaanta iyo in qofka bani’aadamka ahi udub-dhexaad u noqdo dadaallada horumarineed,” ayuu ku yiri farriintiisa. Safiirka ayaa sheegay in labada dal ay sii xoojiyeen iskaashiga dhinacyada dhaqaalaha, amniga, waxbarashada, caafimaadka, gargaarka bani’aadannimo, kobcinta awoodaha farsamo iyo maalgashiga. Waxa uu sidoo kale xusay mashaariicda iyo iskaashiga ku saabsan dhaqaalaha buluugga ah, shidaalka iyo gaaska, isaga oo sheegay in xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye uu galay marxalad ka ballaaran gargaarkii iyo taageeradii dhaqameed ee labada dal. Aktaş ayaa sheegay in Ankara ay Soomaaliya kala shaqeyneyso dhinacyo badan oo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo si toos ah ugu xiran mustaqbalka dalka, oo ay ku jiraan horumarinta kaabeyaasha, kobcinta ganacsiga iyo abuurista fursado dhaqaale oo cusub. Aktaş ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay isbeddellada uu ku arkay Soomaaliya, isaga oo sheegay in dalku maanta dhinacyo badan ka horumarsan yahay halkii uu markii hore joogay. Waxa uu tusaale u soo qaatay xaaladda Muqdisho, isaga oo sheegay in magaalada ay sannadihii dambe ka muuqatay nolol iyo dhaqdhaqaaq sii kordhaya, gaar ahaan xilliyada bisha Ramadaan. Waxa uu sheegay in horumarkaasi uu ka muuqdo isu socodka dadka, ganacsiga iyo nolol maalmeedka caasimadda, isaga oo tilmaamay in xaaladda magaalada ay sannadihii dambe si muuqata isu beddeshay. Safiirka ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay kobaca ganacsiga, maalgashiga tooska ah iyo shaqooyinka ay abuurayaan shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay qeyb ka yihiin rajada laga qabo horumarka dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in kororka maalgashiga iyo shaqo-abuurku ay muhiim u yihiin dhalinyarada Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo sida uu sheegay u baahan fursado ay dalkooda kaga dhisan karaan mustaqbalkooda. Dhanka siyaasadda, Aktaş wuxuu sheegay in ka-qaybgalka dimoqraadiyadeed ee Soomaaliya ka hanaqaadaya uu mustaqbalka noqon karo waayo-aragnimo muhiim u ah nolosha siyaasadeed ee dalka, isagoo sheegay in Türkiye ay taageertay geeddi-socodkaas. Safiirka ayaa sidoo kale ku booriyay Soomaalida inay ilaashadaan midnimada iyo wadajirka, isaga oo sheegay in wadajirku laf-dhabar u yahay xasilloonida iyo horumarka dalka. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in Ankara ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, xasilloonida iyo ilaalinta midnimada dhuleed ee dalka. “Türkiye waxay sii wadi doontaa taageerada ay siiso midnimada dhuleed, amniga iyo xasilloonida Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri safiirka. Aktaş ayaa sheegay in xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye, oo muddo dheer soo jiray, uu sii kobcayo, isla markaana iskaashiga labada dal uu yeelanayo dhinacyo cusub oo istiraatiiji ah. Alper Aktaş ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegay in Soomaaliya ay meel gaar ah kaga jirto qalbigiisa iyo siyaasadda dalkiisa, isaga oo u mahadceliyay dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed soo dhoweyntii iyo taageeradii ay u muujiyeen isaga, qoyskiisa iyo shaqaalaha safaaradda muddadii uu joogay Muqdisho. “Waxaan mar kale salaan xushmad, jacayl iyo kalgacal leh u dirayaa muwaadiniinteena ku sugan Soomaaliya iyo dhammaan walaalahayga Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu ku soo xiray farriintiisa sagootinta. items.title: Ganacsatada Soomaaliya Oo Bilaabay Inay Beddelaan Marinnada Badeecadaha
items.description: Ganacsatada Soomaaliya iyo maamulka Dekedda Muqdisho ayaa bilaabay inay raadiyaan marinnno cusub oo badeecadaha si toos ah looga keeno dalalka Aasiya. Tallaabadan ayaa jawaab u ah amni-darrada iyo carqaladaha ka jira marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab iyo Gacanka Hormuz, oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga Soomaaliya. Badeecadaha laga keeno Aasiya ayaa inta badan Soomaaliya loo soo mariyaa Imaaraadka Carabta, Cumaan ama Sacuudiga, ka hor inta aan dib loogu soo rarin dekedaha dalka, hase yeeshee, xaaladda amni ee gobolka ayaa ganacsatada ku qasbaysa inay tijaabiyaan safarro toos ah oo aan ku xirnayn dekedaha Khaliijka. Agaasimaha guud ee Dekedda Muqdisho, Maxamed Cali Nuur Ameeriko, ayaa sheegay in markii ugu horreysay dekeddu qaabishay markab sida sonkor oo si toos ah uga yimid Sri Lanka. Wuxuu tallaabadan ku tilmaamay istiraatiijiyad lagu yareynayo saameynta ay xiisadaha gobolka ku yeelan karaan soo dejinta badeecadaha. Maamulka dekedda ayaa la shaqaynaya ganacsatada iyo shirkadaha dhoofinta si loo helo marinnno kale oo lagu sii wadi karo sahayda dalka. Haddii marinka tooska ah ee Sri Lanka noqdo mid la isku halayn karo, wuxuu yareyn karaa ku-tiirsanaanta dekedaha dhexe ee Khaliijka, inkastoo joogtayntiisa iyo faa’iidada dhaqaale ee uu leeyahay aan weli la xaqiijin. Isbeddelka marinnada maraakiibta wuxuu sidoo kale keeni karaa safarro dheer, kharash gaadiid oo kordha iyo dib-u-dhac ku yimaada badeecadaha. Soomaaliya waxay si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay waxyaabaha dibadda laga soo dejiyo, sidaas darteed carqalad kasta oo ku timaadda gaadiidka badda waxay saamayn ku yeelan kartaa ganacsatada iyo qiimaha ay macaamiishu ku iibsadaan raashinka iyo badeecadaha kale. Lama shaacin xaddiga sonkorta laga keenay Sri Lanka, kharashka safarka ama in marinkan cusub si joogto ah loo adeegsan doono. Si kastaba ha ahaatee tijaabadan ayaa muujinaysa in ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed ay bilaabeen inay la qabsadaan khataraha ka jira marin-biyoodka gobolka, si loo ilaaliyo socodka badeecadaha iyo sahayda suuqyada gudaha.

items.description: Asmara (Raxanreeb Online) Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda dalka Eritrea Cismaan Saalax , ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu walaac ka qabo qorshe kasta oo ay Israa’iil ku doonayso inay joogitaan milatari ka samaysato Somaliland. Cisman Saalax ayaa su’aal geliyey ujeeddada ka dambaysa qorshe kasta oo Israa’iil ay saldhig milatari uga samaysanayso Geeska Afrika, isagoo tilmaamay in arrintan ay yeelan karto saameyn ballaaran oo ku saabsan amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Wasiirku wuxuu sidoo kale muujiyey in Eritrea ay si dhow ula socoto dhaqdhaqaaqyada milatari iyo kuwa istiraatiijiga ah ee ka socda Badda Cas iyo Geeska Afrika, oo ah deegaan muhiim u ah isu-socodka ganacsiga iyo ammaanka caalamka. Haddii Israa’iil ay dhab ahaan ka samaysato saldhig ama joogitaan milatari Somaliland, arrintaasi waxay noqon kartaa isbeddel istiraatiiji ah oo saameeya xiriirka iyo loollanka ka jira gobolka, gaar ahaan dalalka ku teedsan Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Eritrea waxay muddo dheer muhiimad gaar ah siisay ammaanka Badda Cas, waxaana dowladda Asmara ay si joogto ah uga digtaa faragelinno shisheeye oo ay u aragto kuwo wax ka beddeli kara dheelitirka amni ee gobolka. Sikastaba hadalka Cisman Saalax ayaa sidaas darteed kusoo beegmaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan doodaha ku saabsan doorka quwadaha shisheeye ee Geeska Afrika iyo muhiimadda istiraatiijiga ah ee Somaliland, gaar ahaan marka la eego goobta ay ku taallo oo ku dhow marin-biyoodka Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. The post Eritrea oo walaac ka muujisay joogitaanka milateriga Israa’iil ee Somaliland appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Tucker Carlson oo kashifay qorshe halis ah oo Israa’iil ay u maleegtay dalalka Khaliijka
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Faalleeyaha siyaasadda Mareykanka Tucker Carlson ayaa ku dooday in dagaalka ka socda Iran uu leeyahay ujeeddo ka ballaaran wiiqidda Tehran, isagoo sheegay in Israel ay dooneyso inay daciifiso dalalka Khaliijka, isla markaana ciidamada Mareykanka laga saaro gobolka si ay u hesho awoodda ugu sarreysa Bariga Dhexe. Carlson, oo wareysi siiyey barnaamijka Going Underground , ayaa sheegay inuu aragtidan la wadaagay madaxweyne Donald Trump ka hor inta aysan Mareykanka iyo Israel 28-kii Febraayo bilaabin weerarrada ballaaran ee Iran. “Waxaan ku iri ujeeddadu waa in Israel ay noqoto awoodda gobolka. Taasi waa sababta ay dagaalkan Iran u riixayaan. Waxay doonayaan inay gobolkooda maamulaan,” ayuu Carlson yiri. Waxa uu ku dooday in Israel aysan kaliya doonayn in Iran laga saaro kaalinta quwad goboleed, balse ay sidoo kale dooneyso inay meesha ka saarto awoodda kooxaha Tehran xulafada la ah, sida Hezbollah iyo Hamas. Carlson ayaa intaas ku daray in kobaca dhaqaale iyo siyaasadeed ee dalalka Golaha Iskaashiga Khaliijka ee GCC — oo ay ku jiraan Sacuudi Carabiya, Imaaraadka Carabta, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain iyo Cumaan — uu sidoo kale caqabad ku yahay himilada Israel, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Ma rabto GCC, sababtoo ah waxay dhisayaan bulshooyin aad u horumarsan,” ayuu yiri Carlson, isagoo ku tilmaamay kobaca Khaliijka mid uu rumeysan yahay in Israel ay u aragto tartan soo baxaya. Israel iyo maamulka Trump waxay si rasmi ah u sheegeen in hawlgalkooda Iran uu diiradda saarayo wiiqidda barnaamijka gantaallada Tehran, awooddeeda milatari iyo ka hortagga inay hesho hub nukliyeer ah. Ciidamada Israel waxay 28-kii Febraayo sheegeen in hawlgalka wadajirka ah ee Mareykanka iyo Israel looga gol leeyahay “in si weyn loo wiiqo” awoodaha Iran ee ay ku tilmaameen khatar ku wajahan Israel. Khaliijka oo dagaalka ku dhex dhacay Carlson ayaa sheegay in natiijada dagaalku ay noqotay in dalalka Khaliijka ay bixiyaan qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah kharashka amni iyo dhaqaale ee colaadda. “Ujeeddadu waxay ahayd in Iran laga saaro awood goboleed ahaan, GCC-na la jahawareeriyo oo awooddeeda la yareeyo, Mareykankana laga saaro Khaliijka,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu sheegay inuu Trump arrintan kala hadlay mar uu tegay Aqalka Cad qiyaastii 20-kii Febraayo, maalmo ka hor bilowgii weerarrada 28-kii Febraayo. Carlson ayaa sidoo kale ku dooday in joogitaanka ciidamada Mareykanka ee Khaliijka uusan mar walba waafaqsaneyn danaha Israel, isagoo sheegay in saldhigyadaas ay Washington siinayaan awood ay ku xakameyso tallaabooyinka xulafadeeda gobolka. Aragtidaas ayaa timid xilli dagaalka Iran uu si weyn u saameeyey ammaanka dalalka Khaliijka. Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Daraasaadka Istaraatiijiyadda ee IISS ayaa sheegay in Iran ay in ka badan 4,000 oo gantaal iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku ridday dalalka GCC ilaa 19-kii Maarso, inkastoo tiro yar oo ka mid ahi ay gaareen bartilmaameedyadii loo waday. Machadku wuxuu sheegay in weerarradu ay cadaadis saarayaan dalalka Khaliijka, isla markaana ay faafinayaan kharashka dagaalka. Weerarrada Iran ayaa sidoo kale waxyeello xooggan gaarsiiyey saldhigyada ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka. Baaritaan ay Washington Post ku sameysay sawirrada dayax-gacmeedka ayaa lagu ogaaday in ugu yaraan 228 dhisme ama qalab oo ku yaalla xarumo ay ciidamada Mareykanka isticmaalaan la burburiyey ama waxyeello loo geystay tan iyo bilowgii dagaalka. Joogitaanka Mareykanka oo dib loo eegayo Waxyeelladaas ayaa durba dhalisay dood ku saabsan mustaqbalka ciidamada Mareykanka ee Khaliijka. Pentagon-ka ayaa qiimeynaya in ciidamada Mareykanka ee gobolka la dhimi karo marka dagaalka Iran dhammaado, gaar ahaan iyadoo qaar ka mid ah saldhigyada waaweyn ay bilooyin la kulmayeen weerarro, sida ay Washington Post sheegtay bishii Agoosto. Qiimeyntu weli ma aha dib-u-eegis rasmi ah, balse waxaa ka mid ah su’aasha ah in Washington dib u dhisto dhammaan saldhigyada waxyeelladu gaartay iyo in ciidamada qaarkood laga raro goobaha aadka ugu nugul weerarrada Iran. Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale sii kordhiyey cadaadiska ka jira marin-biyoodka Hormuz iyo kaabayaasha tamarta Khaliijka, halka weerarrada Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay cadaadis dheeraad ah saareen Sacuudi Carabiya iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Carlson ayaa sheegay in xaaladdaas ay xoojineyso su’aal uu sheegay inuu weli jawaab u la’yahay: sababta Trump, oo xiriir dhow la leh hoggaamiyeyaasha Khaliijka, uu u galay dagaal sababay in dalalkaas ay la kulmaan weerarro iyo khasaare ballaaran. “Taasi waa su’aasha ay warbaahinta Mareykanku si taxaddar leh isaga indha-tireyso,” ayuu yiri. “Waxaan rajeynayaa in mar uun taariikhyahannadu jawaab u helaan.” The post Tucker Carlson oo kashifay qorshe halis ah oo Israa’iil ay u maleegtay dalalka Khaliijka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ciidanka koonfur galbeed oo gacanta kusoo dhigay Nin ka dambeeyey dil ka dhacay Baydhabo
items.description: Baydhabo (Raxanreeb Online) Wararka inaga soo gaaraya magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay, ayaa ku waramaya in ciidanka booliska koonfur galbeed, ay howlgal ku soo qabteen shaqsi xalay qof shacab ah ku dilay magaalada Baydhabo. Shaqsiga lasoo qabtay ayaa lagu eedeeyey in xalay gudaha magaalada Baydhabo uu ku dilay wiil dhallinyaro ah oo lagu magacaabi jiray Alle hau naxariiste Jamaal. Ninka dilka geystay ayaa la sheegay inuu goobta isaga baxsaday, balse howlgal dheer kaddib ay ciidanka maamulka koonfur galbeed, ay gacanta ku soo dhigeen. Weli faah faahin dheeraad ah laga mahayo sababta loo dilay marxuum Jamaal oo kamid ahaa dhallinyarada aad looga yaqaanay gudaha magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay. Sidoo kale taliska ciidanka booliska koonfur galbeed, kama aysan hadlin howlgalka ay ku soo qabteen shaqsiga lagu eedeeyay inuu ka dambeeyey dilka. items.title: “Doorashada HirShabelle qof hor istaagi karto ma jiro,” sidaas waxaa yiri…
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Wasiiru dowlaha warfaafinta HirShabelle Cabdikariin Xasan Nuur Doobyare (Doobyare) oo wareysi gaar ah siiyay Idaacadda Kulmiye ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan arrimaha doorashooyinka maamulkaas oo uu weli ka taagan yahay khilaaf xooggan. Cabdikariin Doobyare ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay khilaafka ka dhashay musharraxnimada Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe, kaddib markii shalay la guddoonsiiyay kaarka musharraxnimada Xisbiga JSP, isaga oo sheegay in aysan jirin cid awood u leh inay ka hor istaagto ama diido doorashada HirShabelle. “HirShabelle doorasho ayaa ka dhacaysa qof hor istaagi kara majiro,” Cabdikariin Xasan Nuur Doobyare (Doobyare). Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in doorashadu ka dhici doonto dhammaan goobihii loo qorsheeyay, isla markaana amniga goobaha doorashada ay sugi doonaan ciidamada Booliska. Waxaa kale oo uu soo hadal qaaday tabashada reer Hiiraan, isaga oo sheegay in arrimaha taagan lagu xallin doono wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad, isla markaana la qancin doono dhinacyada kasoo horjeedo hannaanka loo wado doorashad Xiisadda ka taagan HirShabelle ayaa sii laba kacleysay, kadib markii kaarka JSP uu qaatay Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe, taas oo ka careysiisay siyaasiyiinta Xawaadle, kuwaas oo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wada Muqdisho iyo Beledweyne. Si kastaba, Madaxweyne ku xigeenka HirShabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) oo kasoo jeeda beesha Xawaadle ayaa horay u sheegay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu si cad ugu sheegay in xilka maamulka HirShabelle uu u wado Cali Guudlaawe, taas oo maanta rumowday, maadaama la siiyay kaarka JSP, kuna metali doono doorashada guud ee HirShabelle. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) ayaa sidoo kale Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku eedeeyay inuu uga baxay ballan siyaasadeed oo uu la galay. Dabageed oo tilmaamay in Madaxweynaha ay horay ugu heshiiyeen, uguna ballanqaaday inuu hoggaanka HirShabelle isaga siiyo ayaa sheegay in Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu hadda waxba kama jiraan kasoo qaaday ballankaas, uuna kursiga siiyay Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe oo markale isa soo sharraxay. Cabdikariin Doobyare ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay khilaafka ka dhashay musharraxnimada Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe, kaddib markii shalay la guddoonsiiyay kaarka musharraxnimada Xisbiga JSP, isaga oo sheegay in aysan jirin cid awood u leh inay ka hor istaagto ama diido doorashada HirShabelle. “HirShabelle doorasho ayaa ka dhacaysa qof hor istaagi kara majiro,” Cabdikariin Xasan Nuur Doobyare (Doobyare). Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in doorashadu ka dhici doonto dhammaan goobihii loo qorsheeyay, isla markaana amniga goobaha doorashada ay sugi doonaan ciidamada Booliska. Waxaa kale oo uu soo hadal qaaday tabashada reer Hiiraan, isaga oo sheegay in arrimaha taagan lagu xallin doono wada-hadal iyo is-afgarad, isla markaana la qancin doono dhinacyada kasoo horjeedo hannaanka loo wado doorashad Xiisadda ka taagan HirShabelle ayaa sii laba kacleysay, kadib markii kaarka JSP uu qaatay Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe, taas oo ka careysiisay siyaasiyiinta Xawaadle, kuwaas oo dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wada Muqdisho iyo Beledweyne. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) ayaa sidoo kale Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku eedeeyay inuu uga baxay ballan siyaasadeed oo uu la galay. items.title: Trump oo shaaciyey arrin ay soo weydiisteen Xuutiyiinta xilli ay weerarayaan Sacuudiga
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay la soo xiriireen maamulkiisa, kana codsadeen in Washington aysan faragelin dagaalka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya kooxda iyo Sacuudi Carabiya. Trump ayaa hadalkan sheegay, xilli dagaalka Yemen uu galay marxalad cusub, Xuutiyiintuna ay si degdeg ah ugu fideen xeebaha Badda Cas, taas oo sare u qaadday walaaca laga qabo ammaanka marinka muhiimka ah ee Bab al-Mandab. “Xuutiyiinta ayaa nala soo xiriiray, waxayna noo sheegeen inaysan dooneyn inay nala dagaallamaan. Ma doonayaan inaan daba galno,” ayuu Trump yiri. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa intaas ku daray in Xuutiyiintu ay oggolaanayaan in maraakiibta intooda badan ay maraan Badda Cas, balse ay jirto “hal dal oo aysan aad ugu faraxsaneyn”, isagoo sheegay in arrintaas la xallin doono. Hadallada Trump ayaa imanaya iyadoo kooxda Iran taageerto ay toddobaadkan horumar ballaaran ka sameysay galbeedka Yemen, kuna sii dhawaatay goobaha muhiimka u ah isu socodka maraakiibta ee Bab al-Mandab. Xuutiyiinta ayaa qabsaday deegaanno xeebeed iyo jasiirado istiraatiiji ah, taas oo u sahleysa inay khatar weyn ku noqdaan maraakiibta maraysa Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Marinkaas ayaa isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, wuxuuna muhiim u yahay ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo dhoofinta shidaalka Khaliijka. Sacuudiga oo dalbaday duqeymo Warbaahinta Axios ayaa Jimcihii sheegtay in Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudi Carabiya Mohammed bin Salman uu laba jeer telefoon kula hadlay Trump, isaga oo ka codsaday Mareykanka inuu duqeymo ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta ka fuliyo Yemen. Codsiga ayaa yimid xilli ciidamada Xuutiyiinta ay ku sii siqayeen koonfurta xeebaha Yemen, halka ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudigu taageero ay dib uga gurayeen qeybo ka mid ah aagga. Trump ayaa diiday codsiga duqeymaha tooska ah, inkasta oo Washington ay oggolaatay inay Riyadh siiso xog sirdoon iyo macluumaad ka caawin kara bartilmaameedsiga Xuutiyiinta, sida ay Axios sheegtay. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sheegay in mudnaanta Washington ay tahay ilaalinta isu socodka maraakiibta Badda Cas, balse aysan dooneyn inay furto furin dagaal oo cusub, iyadoo ciidamada Mareykanka ay sidoo kale ku mashquulsan yihiin xiisadda Iran iyo marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Trump ayaa Sabtidii sheegay inuu sidoo kale la hadlay Mohammed bin Salman, oo uu ku tilmaamay “saaxiib”, isaga oo muujiyay rajo ah in xaaladda la dejin karo. Beegsiga shidaalka Sacuudiga Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay kaddib markii diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo laga soo riday gudaha Ciraaq ay weerareen dhuumaha shidaalka ee East-West Pipeline ee Sacuudi Carabiya. Dhuumahaas ayaa shidaalka ka qaada bariga Sacuudiga una gudbiya dekedda Yanbu ee Badda Cas, waxayna Riyadh siinayaan waddo kale oo ay shidaalka ku dhoofin karto iyadoo aan loo marin marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Sacuudiga ayaa si ku-meel-gaar ah u xiray dhuumaha kaddib weerarka, si loo qiimeeyo khasaaraha loona sameeyo dayactir. Baghdad ayaa sheegtay in baaritaan hordhac ah lagu ogaaday in weerarka laga soo qaaday gudaha Ciraaq, meel u dhow xadka Iran. Dowladda Ciraaq ayaa tallaabooyin amni qaaday, iyadoo xirtay qaar ka mid ah marinnada xadka Iran, isla markaana billowday baaritaan ku saabsan cidda ka dambeysay weerarka. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sheegtay inaysan hadda qaadi doonin tallaabo aargoosi ah, si dowladda Ciraaq loo siiyo fursad ay wax uga qabato weerarka. Trump, oo wax laga weydiiyay cidda ka dambeysay weerarka, ayaa sheegay inuu u maleynayo in Iran ay “u badan tahay” inay mas’uul ka ahayd, balse ma uusan soo bandhigin caddeyn taageereysa eedeyntaasi. Dhanka kale, Xuutiyiinta ayaa toddobaadkan sidoo kale weerarro gantaallo iyo diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn ku qaaday bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla Sacuudi Carabiya, iyadoo weerar kale oo Sabtidii ka dhacay meel u dhow xadka Yemen uu dhaawacay laba qof. Horumarka degdegga ah ee Xuutiyiinta ee xeebaha Yemen iyo weerarrada lagu hayo kaabayaasha tamarta Sacuudiga ayaa sare u qaaday cabsi laga qabo in dagaalku saameyn weyn ku yeesho isu socodka maraakiibta iyo suuqyada tamarta caalamka. Bab al-Mandab iyo Hormuz ayaa labaduba ka mid ah marin-biyoodyada ugu muhiimsan ee shidaalka iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Sidaas darteed, awoodda kooxaha Iran taageerto ay ku carqaladeyn karaan marinnadaas ayaa cadaadis cusub saaraysa Sacuudi Carabiya iyo xulafadeeda, xilli Washington ay ilaa hadda isku dayeyso inay ka fogaato furitaanka dagaal toos ah oo kale oo ka dhaca gobolka. items.title: Burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya oo dib u soo xoogeysanaysa iyo walaac laga muujiyay saameynta ganacsiga caalamka
items.description: Burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale muujinaysa dhaqdhaqaaq sii kordhaya oo ka jira xeebaha waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, iyadoo xaaladda amni ee Badda Cas ay sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo badqabka maraakiibta ganacsiga. Warbixin ay baahisay Xinhua , oo soo xiganaysa falanqeeyayaal iyo mas’uuliyiin, ayaa sheegtay in weerarro iyo afduubyo maraakiib ah oo dhacay tan iyo bishii Abriil ay dib u soo nooleeyeen walaaca laga qabo burcad-badeedda Soomaalida. Ururka Caalamiga ah ee Badaha (IMO) ayaa 24-kii Agoosto ka digay kororka falalka burcad-badeednimo, isagoo sheegay in in ka badan 90 shaqaale maraakiib ah ay weli gacanta ugu jiraan shabakadaha burcad-badeedda . Falanqeeyayaasha ayaa sababaha dib u soo laabashada burcad-badeedda ku xira arrimo ay ka mid yihiin saboolnimada, shaqo la’aanta, maamul-xumada xeebaha iyo kalluumeysiga sharci-darrada ah ee ay maraakiib shisheeye ka sameeyaan biyaha Soomaaliya. Mohamed Husein Gaas , oo ah agaasimaha Raad Peace Research Institute, ayaa sheegay in hoos u dhaca joogitaanka ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah ee Gacanka Cadmeed, kadib markii xoog badan loo weeciyay xiisadda Badda Cas, uu fursad cusub siiyay kooxaha burcad-badeedda. Gaas wuxuu sheegay in burcad-badeedda hore loo xakameeyay balse aan si dhab ah loo xallin sababihii salka u ahaa, isagoo tilmaamay in amni-darrada xeebaha, saboolnimada iyo dowladnimada daciifka ah ay weli yihiin caqabado waaweyn. Xiisadda ka taagan Yemen iyo weerarrada Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale wax ka beddelay isu-socodka maraakiibta caalamiga ah, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah maraakiibta ay beddeleen waddooyinkii ay mari jireen. Si kastaba, Gaas wuxuu ka digay in aan loo qaadan xaqiiqo la xaqiijiyay sheegashada ah in kooxaha Xuutiyiinta iyo burcad-badeedda Soomaalida ay leeyihiin xiriir hawlgal oo toos ah. Dhaqdhaqaaqa burcad-badeedda iyo khataraha kale ee amniga badda ayaa sidoo kale walaac ka abuuraya ganacsiga Soomaaliya, oo si weyn ugu tiirsan badeecooyinka dibadda laga keeno. Cabdirisaaq Sabriye , oo ka tirsan Rugta Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliya, ayaa sheegay in shirkadda maraakiibta ee Maersk ay hakisay ballamihii cusub ee xamuulka ee u socday ama ka imaanayay dekedda Berbera, iyadoo shirkaddu sabab uga dhigtay arrimo la xiriira jadwalka iyo dib-u-habeynta waddooyinka maraakiibta ee gobolka. Go’aankaas si toos ah looguma xiriirin burcad-badeedda, balse wuxuu tusaale u yahay caqabadaha saameynaya isku-socodka ganacsiga Geeska Afrika. Ganacsatada ayaa ka digaya in haddii khataraha badda ay sii socdaan ay kordhi karaan qiimaha caymiska maraakiibta, kharashaadka xamuulka iyo shidaalka , taas oo ugu dambeyn saameyn ku yeelan karta qiimaha badeecooyinka gudaha Soomaaliya. Yusuf Mohamed Mahadale, oo ganacsatada Soomaaliya looga yaqaan Shakirow , ayaa sheegay in qiimaha qalabka dhismaha, shidaalka iyo gaaska wax lagu karsado uu sare u kacay bilihii u dambeeyay. Wuxuu tilmaamay in badeecooyin badan oo Soomaaliya laga isticmaalo ay kasoo gudbaan marin-biyoodka Badweynta Hindiya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay inay waddo howlgallo dhulka iyo badda ah oo lagu wajahayo kooxaha burcad-badeedda. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa soo hadal qaaday howlgal 29-kii Agoosto lagu xoreeyay markabka MV Lutuf , oo la sheegay in kooxo burcad-badeed ah ay afduubteen. Dowladdu waxay sidoo kale ku baaqday in ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah ay taageeraan dadaallada Soomaaliya, iyadoo arrinta burcad-badeedda loo gudbinayo Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Warbixintu waxay xustay in Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya uu dhowaan ansixiyay sharciyo la cusbooneysiiyay oo la xiriira la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda. Falanqeeyayaasha ayaa, si kastaba, qaba in howlgalada badda oo keliya aysan ku filnayn xal waara, waxayna ku baaqayaan in la xoojiyo maamulka iyo amniga xeebaha, lana abuuro fursado dhaqaale oo dadka ku nool deegaannada xeebaha ka fogeeya ku biirista burcad-badeedda. Haddii falalka burcad-badeeddu isu beddelaan khatar joogto ah oo nidaamsan, waxaa laga cabsi qabaa in shirkadaha maraakiibta ay mar kale ka fogaadaan Gacanka Cadmeed, taas oo sare u qaadi karta kharashaadka gaadiidka iyo qiimaha badeecooyinka, isla markaana saameyn ku yeelan karta ganacsiga Soomaaliya iyo isu-socodka ganacsiga caalamka.

Dowladdu waxay sidoo kale ku baaqday in ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah ay taageeraan dadaallada Soomaaliya, iyadoo arrinta burcad-badeedda loo gudbinayo Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Warbixintu waxay xustay in Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya uu dhowaan ansixiyay sharciyo la cusbooneysiiyay oo la xiriira la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda. Falanqeeyayaasha ayaa, si kastaba, qaba in howlgalada badda oo keliya aysan ku filnayn xal waara, waxayna ku baaqayaan in la xoojiyo maamulka iyo amniga xeebaha, lana abuuro fursado dhaqaale oo dadka ku nool deegaannada xeebaha ka fogeeya ku biirista burcad-badeedda. Haddii falalka burcad-badeeddu isu beddelaan khatar joogto ah oo nidaamsan, waxaa laga cabsi qabaa in shirkadaha maraakiibta ay mar kale ka fogaadaan Gacanka Cadmeed, taas oo sare u qaadi karta kharashaadka gaadiidka iyo qiimaha badeecooyinka, isla markaana saameyn ku yeelan karta ganacsiga Soomaaliya iyo isu-socodka ganacsiga caalamka.

items.title: Cumaan oo sheegtay in dib loo furi doono Marin-biyoodka Hormuz
items.description: Dowladda Cumaan ayaa sheegtay in Marin-biyoodka Hormuz dib loo furi doono, iyadoo xaaladda ka taagan marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ku tilmaantay mid u badan inay noqon doonto mid muddo kooban socota. Hadalkan ayaa imanaya xilli ay gobolka ka jiraan xiisado siyaasadeed iyo amni oo saameyn ku yeeshay isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo gaadiidka badda ee mara Hormuz. Marin-biyoodka Hormuz ayaa ah marin muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamiga ah, gaar ahaan dhoofinta saliidda iyo gaaska ee ka baxa dalalka Khaliijka. Carqalad ku timaadda isu-socodka halkaas waxay saameyn ku yeelan kartaa silsiladaha sahayda iyo suuqyada tamarta ee caalamka. Cumaan, oo ku taalla dhinaca koonfureed ee marin-biyoodka, ayaa muddo dheer door ku lahayd dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu dejinayo xiisadaha gobolka. Inkasta oo Muscat ay sheegtay in xaaladdu tahay mid ku-meel-gaar ah, haddana weli waxaa jira walaac ku saabsan amniga maraakiibta iyo sii socoshada gaadiidka ganacsi ee mara marin-biyoodka, iyadoo shirkadaha maraakiibta iyo ganacsatada caalamiga ah ay si dhow ula socdaan xaaladda. Marin-biyoodka Hormuz wuxuu isku xiraa Gacanka Carabta iyo Gacanka Cumaan, waxaana loo arkaa mid ka mid ah marinnada badeed ee ugu muhiimsan dunida.

items.title: Ururka JSP oo si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay in Cali Guudlaawe uu yahay Murasharaxooda Hoggaanka Hirshabeelle
items.description: Urur Siyaasadeedka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ku qabtay kulan siyaasadeed oo lagu shaaciyay musharraxa uu ururku sheegay inuu u meteli doono tartanka doorashada hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabeelle. Kulanka oo ay ka qaybgaleen masuuliyiin iyo xubno ka tirsan JSP ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo diyaar-garowga doorashooyinka la filayo inay ka dhacaan Hirshabeelle. Munaasabadda ayaa si rasmi ah loogu guddoonsiiyay Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen ” Cali Guudlaawe” shahaadada musharraxnimada, iyadoo hoggaanka ururku uu sheegay inuu yahay qofka ay u xuleen inuu magaca JSP ku galo tartanka hoggaanka maamulka. Masuuliyiin ka hadlay kulanka ayaa soo sheegay in Cali Guudlaawe ay u arkaan qofka ugu habboon ee  waayo-aragnimada iyo kartida siyaasadeed u leh xilkaas, iyagoo sidoo kale xusay baahida loo qabo in la sii wado dadaallada la xiriira horumarinta Hirshabeelle. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, magacaabista musharraxa JSP waxay ku soo beegmaysaa xilli ay Soomaaliya ka socoto dhaqdhaqaaqyo siyaasadeed oo la xiriira doorashooyinka dowlad-goboleedyada iyo tartamada hoggaamineed ee soo socda. JSP ayaa tallaabadan ku tilmaamtay qayb ka mid ah diyaar-garowgooda siyaasadeed, iyadoo musharraxa la magacaabay uu hadda wajihi doono marxaladaha kale ee tartanka hoggaanka Hirshabeelle. Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen ” Guudlaawe” ayaa muddo 6 sano ah hoggaanka u hayay dowladda goboleedka Hirshabeelle, ayadoo muddadaas loo diiwaangeliyay waxqabadka iyo dhaliilo isku lammaan.

items.title: Falcelin aan caadi ahayn oo ka dhalatay kaarka xisbiga JSP ee la siiyay Cali Guudlaawe
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Fal-celin xooggan ayaa ka dhalatay in mar kale Cali Guudlaawe Xuseen isku sharraxo xilka Madaxweynaha HirShabelle, kadib markii shalay la siiyay kaarka musharraxnimada ee Xisbiga Cadaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Go’aankan ayaa yimid, kadib markii shalay xarunta dhexe Xisbiga JSP uu ku qabsoomay kulanka guddiga fulinta, kaas oo uu shir guddoomiyay xoghayaha guud ee xisbiga Dr. Xuseen Sheekh Maxamuud. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray u diyaar-garowga doorashada soo socota ee Dowlad Goboleedka HirShabelle, waxaana guddiga fulinta uu go’aamiyay in Madaxweyne Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen uu noqdo musharraxa rasmiga ah ee xisbiga ku metalaya doorashada HirShabelle. “Guddiga fulintu waxa uu si aqlabiyad leh ugu go’aamiyay in Mudane Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen uu noqdo musharraxa rasmiga ah ee Urur Siyaasadeedka Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ugu taagnaan doono doorashada hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka HirShabelle,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal kasoo baxay Ururka Caddaaladda iyo Wdaajirka (JSP) ee uu hoggaamiyo Xasan Sheekh. Go’aankan oo aad loo hadal-hayay, lana filayay ayaa xiisad horleh ka abuuray HirShabelle, iyada oo ay ka hor yimaadeen siyaasiyiinta reer Hiiraan oo markii horeba tabasho ka qabay dhismaha Maamul-goboleedka HirShabelle. Haddaba sidee looga fal-celiyay kaarka JSP ee la siiyay Cali Guudlaawe? Maxamed Maxamuud: “Xalka iyo dowlad dhiska maamulka HirShabelle sidaas kuma haboona ee waxay ahayd in diidmada reer Hiiraan la dhagaysto”. Abuukar Cabdullahi Gaandi: “Mudane madaxweyne soo dhawoow mar kale”. Cabdirisaaq Mustaq: “Waxaan doorasho ma ahan ee waa xulusho, adi leee dubo oo daangayso waayey”. Maxamuud Nuur Safiirka: “Dowladnimadii ma saas ayaa lo galay?”. Liibaan Cali Nuur: “Wey isku soo dhammaatay Guudlawe vote ugu shuba shacabkii HirShabelle guul weyn”. The post Falcelin aan caadi ahayn oo ka dhalatay kaarka xisbiga JSP ee la siiyay Cali Guudlaawe appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Haraad iyo gaajo ka dhashay guridda ilo ay biyaha ka heli jireen qoysas ku nool Bari
items.description: (ERGO) –  Oon daran ayay wajahayaan kummannaan dad ah oo ku nool deegaanka Tasjiic ee gobolka Bari iyo lix tuulo oo hoos yimaada tan iyo billowgii August, markii ay ka qallashy il-biyood dabiici ah oo ay bilaash ku cabbi jireen muddo dheer. Waxay iibsan la’yihiin biyo ay booyado $150 uga keenaan magaalada Waaciye oo qiyaastii 40 KM u jirta. Waxaa fuustadii la gadaa $6-$8 oo aysan awoodin. Arintan ayaa culays ku noqotay dadkan oo xoolo dhaqato roob la’aantu saamaysay iyo danyar u badan. Saytuun Mahad Maxamed ayaa sheegtay in qoyskeeda oo 10 qof ah ay ku tiirsan yihiin 20 liitar oo marmar darisku siiyaan. Waxay xustay in ay u adkaysan la’ yihiin xaaladan. “Biyuhu si xun ayay noo saameeyeen cabitaanka waa dhib, qubays iyo dhar dhaqidna ma jirto. Carruurta meel hoos ah ayaa lagu aruuriyaa oo qorraxda ayaa looga celiyaa. Dhibaato ayaan la kulanay.” “Abaar ayaa na haysa. Dadka biyo yar dhaansada ayaan ka barinaa hal caag oo nafta lagu celiyo.” Saytuun ayaa xustay in biyo yaraanta ay u dheertahay cunno xumo. Odaygeeda oo ka shaqayn jiray xijiga ayaa lixdii bil ee u danbaysay shaqo la’aan ah. Waxaa saameeyay go’aan ay Puntland ku amartay in laga baxo buuraha Calmiskaad oo howlgal Daacish ka dhan ah uu ka socdo. Ujeedku wuxuu ahaa in shacabku ka badbaadaan waxyeelada duqaymaha, balse waxaa meesha ka baxday fursadii gurashada xijiga oo dad badan ay ku tiirsanaayeen. Tuulada ayay joogto uga raadiyaan shaqooyin xoogsi ah oo aysan ka helin. Waxay sheegtay inay qatooyo ku joogaan carruurteeda oo kan ugu yar 3 jir yahay. Waxay xustay inay caatoobeen gaajaduna diif ku reebtay. “Dhaqaale darraa jirta. Heerkii aan saddex waqti ama labo wax karsan jirnay waa ka nimid, sababtoo ah waan gacan marannahay. Waxaan gaarnay in aan dadka ka tuugsanno wax aan hal mar cunno. Nolol aad u liidata ayaaan dareemaynaa xilligaan.” Saytuun oo 48 sano jir ah ayaa sheegtay inaysan xaaladaan oo kale horay ula kulmin. Waxaa qoyskeeda labadii sano ee u danbaysay isku raacay colaadda Calmiskaad, abaar xoolihii dhaafisay, barakac, cuno xumo, biyo yari iyo shaqo la’aan. Ari 95 ah oo ay dhaqanayeen waxay intii badnayd u le’deen biyo, daaq la’aan iyo cuduro aysan garayn oo isku raacay. Waxaa u joogta 10 neef oo aan wax nacfi ah lahayn, kuwaas oo aysan u awoodin calaf iyo biyo ay ku sii noolaadaan. Waxay tilmaamay in dukaamo ay daymo ka qaadan jireen ay ka joojiyeen bartamihii bishii sideedaad. Lacagta lagu yeeshay oo gaartay in ka badan $3,000 ayay waydiimo joogto ah kala kulmaysaa, wax kalena looma ogola. “Waxaan ku daymoobay biyaha iyo raashinka, kurbo weyn ayayna igu haysaa. Awood uma lihi in aan bixiyo waayo dhaqaale ma haysto. Xoolihii iyo xijjigii aan ku tiirsanayn midna ma hayno.” Saytuun ayaa sheegtay in labo qol oo sanad ka hor ay ku caawiyeen qoys ehelkeeda ah loo qabtay inay ka guuraan dhamaadka September. ma awoodaan kirada guryaha deegaanka oo labada qol ay $50 tahay. Saddex carruur ah oo u dhiganayay iskuul hoose iyo dugsi Qur’aan ayaa ka waxbarasho la’ tan iyo bishii June, markii ay bixin wayday isku darka $45 oo laga qaadi jiray. Qoyskeeda waxay 2025 uga soo guureen buuraha Calmiskaad dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxda Daacish. Dhanka kale Muumino Shire Nuur oo ka mid ah dadka ay dhibaatadaan saamaysay ayaa sheegtay inay ku adkaatay helitaanka biyo joogta ah tan iyo horraantii bishii August, markaas oo ishii dadka deegaanku ka cabbayeen ay engegtay. Dhowr liitar oo ay ka hesho dariskeeda ayay beeqaamisaa, maaddaama qoyskeedu ballaaran yahay. “Oon ayaa ka jira, hal labaatan qaad ayaan u qaybinaa cabitaan iyo cunno hal mar ah mana kala gaarayo. Daruuftaa noogu daran ee aanan ku sii noolaan karin waa taas. Ishii aan cabbi jirnay, markii roob la waayay waa gurtay.” Muumino ayaa sheegtay inay ka burburtay meherad ay ku iibin jirtay shaah, bur duban iyo bagaash oo ay nolol-maalmeedka uga soo saari jirtay sagaal carruur agoon ah oo keligeed ay korinayso. Wuxuu noqday qayb daymo looga qaatay iyo wax ay reerka ku masruuftay. Waxaa ka maqan in ka badan $800, halka lagu leeyahay $300. Waxay ku gashay biyaha, arrad-tirka, adeeg ay meherada u soo qaaday iyo waxyaabo kale oo reerku u baahnaa. Dukaamo ay daymo ka qaadan jirtay ayaa buugeeda xiray lacagta oo ku badatay darteed. Waxay sheegtay in ninkeeda uu sanadkii 2024 u geeriyooday dhiig-karka ay dhaqaatiirtu ku xaqiijisay oo ku sababay in maskaxda dhiig uga furmay. Toddobaad uu koomo ku jiray kadib ayuu ku dhintay isbitaal Hargaysa ku yaalla. Carruurteedu waxay wajaahayaan cunno xumo badday in 24 saac ay hal mar dabka ku shitaan ugu badnaan hal doollar oo ay ka helaan ehelkooda degan Boosaaso iyo Qardho. Waxaa intaas u dheer waxbarasho la’aan iyo adeeg xumo caafimaad. Muumino ayaa sheegtay in labo carruurteeda ah ay tan iyo billowgii September ku aragtay shuban iyo matag. Waxay u la’dahay qarash ay daawo ugu gado, deegaankuna ma leh mid bilaash ah. Afar iskuul u dhigan jiray ayaa ka waxbarasho la’, markii ay bxiin waysay $40 bil walba laga qaadi jiray. Qoyskeeda waxay sanadkii 2020 ka soo guureen miyiga deegaanka Tasjiic, markii abaaro xilligaas jiray ay kaga dhamaadeen 180 ari ah oo noloshooda ku tiirsanayd. Gobolka Bari oo hodan ku ah kalluumeysiga, fooxa, xoolo iyo ilo bilaash ah oo biyo laga helo, sanooyinkii danbe waxaa saamayay isbeddelka cimilada oo roob yaridu ka mid tahay. Guddoomiyaha deegaanka Tasjiic Faarax Nuur Cali ayaa sheegay in biyo yaridu saamaysay in ka badan 10 kun oo qof oo isugu jira qaar magaalada degan iyo kuwo ku soo barakacy dagaalka Calmiskaad. Dadka ku nool ku dhawaad 63 km oo u dhexeeysa deegaanka Tasjiic iyo magaalada Ufeyn ayaa ishaan si bilaash ah uga cabbi jiray, kuwaas oo hadda wajahaya daruufo adag. “Dadkii dhaqaale xumaa la soo daristay, biyo la’aan iyo macluul ayaa iskugu darsantay. Waxay ku tiirsanaayeen xijiga iyo xoolaha waxaana saameeyay abaaraha iyo dagaallada oo nacfigoodii waa la waayay. Waxaa ugu daran caafimaadka, biyaha iyo cunnada. Dhamaan waxyaabihii aas-aasiga ahaa ayaa ka maqan.” Wuxuu tilmaamay in Maamulka Puntland iyo hay’adaha samafalka ay gaarsiiyeen xaaladda dadkaan, balse aysan weli wax qabad ka helin. Haddii aan si deg deg ah wax looga baqan wuxuu sheegay in xaaladdu ay sidaan ka sii dari karto. Waxay xustay inay caatoobeen gaajaduna diif ku reebtay. “Dhaqaale darraa jirta. Heerkii aan saddex waqti ama labo wax karsan jirnay waa ka nimid, sababtoo ah waan gacan marannahay. Waxaan gaarnay in aan dadka ka tuugsanno wax aan hal mar cunno. Nolol aad u liidata ayaaan dareemaynaa xilligaan.” Saytuun oo 48 sano jir ah ayaa sheegtay inaysan xaaladaan oo kale horay ula kulmin. Waxaa qoyskeeda labadii sano ee u danbaysay isku raacay colaadda Calmiskaad, abaar xoolihii dhaafisay, barakac, cuno xumo, biyo yari iyo shaqo la’aan. Ari 95 ah oo ay dhaqanayeen waxay intii badnayd u le’deen biyo, daaq la’aan iyo cuduro aysan garayn oo isku raacay. Waxaa u joogta 10 neef oo aan wax nacfi ah lahayn, kuwaas oo aysan u awoodin calaf iyo biyo ay ku sii noolaadaan. Waxay tilmaamay in dukaamo ay daymo ka qaadan jireen ay ka joojiyeen bartamihii bishii sideedaad. Lacagta lagu yeeshay oo gaartay in ka badan $3,000 ayay waydiimo joogto ah kala kulmaysaa, wax kalena looma ogola. “Waxaan ku daymoobay biyaha iyo raashinka, kurbo weyn ayayna igu haysaa. Awood uma lihi in aan bixiyo waayo dhaqaale ma haysto. Xoolihii iyo xijjigii aan ku tiirsanayn midna ma hayno.” Saytuun ayaa sheegtay in labo qol oo sanad ka hor ay ku caawiyeen qoys ehelkeeda ah loo qabtay inay ka guuraan dhamaadka September. ma awoodaan kirada guryaha deegaanka oo labada qol ay $50 tahay. Saddex carruur ah oo u dhiganayay iskuul hoose iyo dugsi Qur’aan ayaa ka waxbarasho la’ tan iyo bishii June, markii ay bixin wayday isku darka $45 oo laga qaadi jiray. Qoyskeeda waxay 2025 uga soo guureen buuraha Calmiskaad dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxda Daacish. Dhanka kale Muumino Shire Nuur oo ka mid ah dadka ay dhibaatadaan saamaysay ayaa sheegtay inay ku adkaatay helitaanka biyo joogta ah tan iyo horraantii bishii August, markaas oo ishii dadka deegaanku ka cabbayeen ay engegtay. Dhowr liitar oo ay ka hesho dariskeeda ayay beeqaamisaa, maaddaama qoyskeedu ballaaran yahay. “Oon ayaa ka jira, hal labaatan qaad ayaan u qaybinaa cabitaan iyo cunno hal mar ah mana kala gaarayo. Daruuftaa noogu daran ee aanan ku sii noolaan karin waa taas. Ishii aan cabbi jirnay, markii roob la waayay waa gurtay.” Muumino ayaa sheegtay inay ka burburtay meherad ay ku iibin jirtay shaah, bur duban iyo bagaash oo ay nolol-maalmeedka uga soo saari jirtay sagaal carruur agoon ah oo keligeed ay korinayso. Wuxuu noqday qayb daymo looga qaatay iyo wax ay reerka ku masruuftay. Waxaa ka maqan in ka badan $800, halka lagu leeyahay $300. Waxay ku gashay biyaha, arrad-tirka, adeeg ay meherada u soo qaaday iyo waxyaabo kale oo reerku u baahnaa. Dukaamo ay daymo ka qaadan jirtay ayaa buugeeda xiray lacagta oo ku badatay darteed. Waxay sheegtay in ninkeeda uu sanadkii 2024 u geeriyooday dhiig-karka ay dhaqaatiirtu ku xaqiijisay oo ku sababay in maskaxda dhiig uga furmay. Toddobaad uu koomo ku jiray kadib ayuu ku dhintay isbitaal Hargaysa ku yaalla. Carruurteedu waxay wajaahayaan cunno xumo badday in 24 saac ay hal mar dabka ku shitaan ugu badnaan hal doollar oo ay ka helaan ehelkooda degan Boosaaso iyo Qardho. Waxaa intaas u dheer waxbarasho la’aan iyo adeeg xumo caafimaad. Muumino ayaa sheegtay in labo carruurteeda ah ay tan iyo billowgii September ku aragtay shuban iyo matag. Waxay u la’dahay qarash ay daawo ugu gado, deegaankuna ma leh mid bilaash ah. Afar iskuul u dhigan jiray ayaa ka waxbarasho la’, markii ay bxiin waysay $40 bil walba laga qaadi jiray. Qoyskeeda waxay sanadkii 2020 ka soo guureen miyiga deegaanka Tasjiic, markii abaaro xilligaas jiray ay kaga dhamaadeen 180 ari ah oo noloshooda ku tiirsanayd. Gobolka Bari oo hodan ku ah kalluumeysiga, fooxa, xoolo iyo ilo bilaash ah oo biyo laga helo, sanooyinkii danbe waxaa saamayay isbeddelka cimilada oo roob yaridu ka mid tahay. Guddoomiyaha deegaanka Tasjiic Faarax Nuur Cali ayaa sheegay in biyo yaridu saamaysay in ka badan 10 kun oo qof oo isugu jira qaar magaalada degan iyo kuwo ku soo barakacy dagaalka Calmiskaad. Dadka ku nool ku dhawaad 63 km oo u dhexeeysa deegaanka Tasjiic iyo magaalada Ufeyn ayaa ishaan si bilaash ah uga cabbi jiray, kuwaas oo hadda wajahaya daruufo adag. “Dadkii dhaqaale xumaa la soo daristay, biyo la’aan iyo macluul ayaa iskugu darsantay. Waxay ku tiirsanaayeen xijiga iyo xoolaha waxaana saameeyay abaaraha iyo dagaallada oo nacfigoodii waa la waayay. Waxaa ugu daran caafimaadka, biyaha iyo cunnada. Dhamaan waxyaabihii aas-aasiga ahaa ayaa ka maqan.” Wuxuu tilmaamay in Maamulka Puntland iyo hay’adaha samafalka ay gaarsiiyeen xaaladda dadkaan, balse aysan weli wax qabad ka helin. Haddii aan si deg deg ah wax looga baqan wuxuu sheegay in xaaladdu ay sidaan ka sii dari karto. items.title: Towfiiq Exclusion Raises Fears of New Political Confrontation in Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (WDN) — Galmudug’s repeat election is facing a serious political test after the Towfiiq Political Association, led by Sheikh Shakir Sheikh Mohamed, was excluded from the list of political organizations approved to participate in the vote scheduled for September 30. The decision is particularly significant because Towfiiq was a major participant in the previous election, winning 12 parliamentary seats before the results were annulled following a legal challenge that reached Somalia’s Supreme Court. Its exclusion from the rerun immediately raises a difficult question: why is a party that played such a significant role in the original election now absent from the process intended to replace it? The National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission has not publicly provided a detailed explanation for the decision. Towfiiq is not a marginal political organization in Galmudug. It has established a significant political presence, particularly in Dhuusamareeb and Guriceel, where the party and its leadership have maintained substantial political and community support. Its previous electoral performance demonstrated that this support could translate into parliamentary representation. Sheekh Shaakir That makes its exclusion more consequential than a routine administrative decision. It could remove a substantial bloc of voters from the competition while giving rival organizations an opportunity to compete for seats and support that Towfiiq previously contested. The result could significantly alter the political balance of the rerun before a single ballot is cast. From Court Challenge to Electoral Exclusion Towfiiq was among the political organizations that challenged the previous election, ultimately taking its case to the Supreme Court. The court’s annulment of the results created the need for a new electoral process. A rerun is normally expected to address the problems that undermined the original vote and restore confidence among competing political actors. Instead, Towfiiq now finds itself excluded from the very process intended to replace the election it helped challenge. If the party is legally ineligible, the commission should explain the legal basis for that decision. If it is eligible, excluding it raises questions about whether the rerun is correcting the previous process or changing the political field. The commission therefore faces a straightforward credibility test. It should explain the eligibility criteria applied to Towfiiq, identify the specific grounds for its exclusion and clarify whether the same standards were applied consistently to all political organizations. If the decision resulted from an administrative or procedural problem, there should be an opportunity to correct it before voting. If it is based on a statutory requirement, Towfiiq should have access to whatever appeal mechanism the law provides. This matters because the previous election was already annulled through judicial proceedings. The credibility of the rerun will consequently depend not simply on holding another vote, but on demonstrating that the new process genuinely addresses the weaknesses that caused the original election to fail. The central question is whether Towfiiq has been excluded for a clear and lawful reason—or whether the decision is effectively reshaping the field of competition. The Risk of Political Escalation The political consequences could extend well beyond the electoral commission. Towfiiq’s supporters are unlikely to regard the deliberate sidelining of a major political organization as a minor administrative matter. The party has a substantial constituency, a history of electoral participation and a direct connection to the legal dispute that resulted in the previous election being annulled. If its supporters conclude that meaningful political participation has been closed to them, the dispute could move beyond electoral procedures into protests, institutional confrontation and, if tensions are badly managed, armed mobilization. That outcome is not inevitable. But Somalia’s political history offers repeated warnings about what can happen when significant constituencies lose confidence in peaceful political mechanisms. The greatest danger would be allowing an electoral dispute to become a broader struggle over political legitimacy. Galmudug’s September 30 election was supposed to resolve an earlier political and legal crisis. The exclusion of Towfiiq risks creating another before voting even begins. The authorities still have an opportunity to prevent that outcome by providing a clear legal explanation and allowing a transparent review or appeal process. If Towfiiq is legally ineligible, the commission must explain why. If it is eligible, it should be allowed to compete. For Galmudug, the stakes extend beyond one party or one election. The immediate challenge is to ensure that political competition remains within the electoral system rather than allowing the exclusion of a major constituency to push the crisis into a far more dangerous arena. items.title: Turkey’s Somalia Narrative: Partnership or a Lecture to a Country on Its Knees?
items.description: By Abdiqani Haji Abdi The Turkish ambassador’s recent remarks about Somalia’s future were presumably intended to inspire optimism. Instead, they risk sounding remarkably disconnected from the realities facing the Somali people. The ambassador speaks of satellites, oil discoveries, Turkish fishing fleets, mining, agriculture, roads and ambitious infrastructure projects—as though Somalia were already a stable country preparing to enter an era of technological and economic transformation. There is, however, another Somalia. It is a country where state institutions remain fragile, where international assistance continues to play a major role in financing government functions, where foreign military forces remain essential to national security, where political authority is fiercely contested and where basic questions of governance and public accountability remain unresolved. Somalis are being told that the country will launch its first satellite into space in 2027. A satellite would undoubtedly be an achievement. But the question is not whether Somalia should aspire to space technology. The question is whether the priorities being presented to the public correspond to the country’s most urgent needs. Can the government secure its territory? Can it protect its citizens? Can it pay its civil servants and security personnel? Can it build a professional national army capable of eventually standing on its own? Can it secure its coastline, manage its natural resources and conduct elections that are broadly accepted as credible? These are the foundations of statehood. Without them, technological ambition risks becoming a spectacular symbol built on an unstable political and institutional foundation. The same problem applies to the ambassador’s optimism about Somalia’s oil and gas potential. Exploration is not production. Geological surveys are not producing oil fields. And a potential resource is not yet national wealth. Somalis have heard promises about the country’s natural resources for decades. What they need now is not another prediction of future prosperity, but transparency about the agreements that could determine who ultimately benefits from it. Who owns the resources? Who holds the licenses? What percentage of revenues will remain in Somalia? Who controls the contracts? What protections exist for the environment? What mechanisms will prevent politically connected interests or foreign companies from capturing a disproportionate share of the country’s wealth? Those are not hostile questions. They are the questions any sovereign country should ask before committing its natural resources to long-term foreign partnerships. The same principle applies to fisheries. Somalia possesses one of Africa’s longest coastlines and potentially enormous marine resources. Developing the country’s blue economy could create jobs, generate revenue and transform coastal communities. But the arrival of Turkish fishing vessels should not automatically be presented as development. Somalia’s marine resources belong to Somalia. Any foreign fishing operation should therefore operate under transparent licenses, clear fees, effective monitoring and enforceable environmental rules. Somali fishermen should know where foreign vessels are permitted to operate, how much they pay, who monitors their catches and what portion of the resulting economic value remains in Somalia. Otherwise, the language of partnership can easily conceal an unequal commercial relationship in which Somalia supplies the resources while foreign companies capture most of the value. There is an even more sensitive dimension to the relationship: military cooperation. Turkey has become one of Somalia’s most important security partners, providing training, equipment and weapons to Somali forces. Such assistance can play a legitimate role in the fight against Al-Shabaab and in strengthening Somalia’s national security institutions. But Somalia’s political crisis has increasingly blurred the boundary between national security and domestic political confrontation. When foreign-trained or foreign-equipped security forces become involved in disputes involving political opponents or Federal Member States, questions naturally arise over how foreign-supplied military capabilities are being used. Weapons supplied to defend Somalia should never become instruments for settling Somalia’s political disputes. Turkey therefore has a legitimate interest in ensuring that its military assistance is subject to strict safeguards, clear end-use controls and accountability. The same principle should apply to every foreign partner providing security assistance to Somalia. At the heart of the problem is the imbalance between the two countries. Turkey is a powerful regional state with a sophisticated military, substantial economic resources and growing influence across Africa and the Middle East. Somalia remains one of the world’s most institutionally fragile countries. That imbalance does not automatically make the relationship exploitative. But it means Somalia must negotiate with extraordinary caution. A genuine strategic partnership should strengthen Somali sovereignty and capacity. It should leave Somalia with stronger institutions, greater technical knowledge, better infrastructure and a larger share of the economic value created by its own resources. It should not leave Somalia dependent on a foreign power for security while that same partner gains expanding access to strategic infrastructure, fishing grounds, natural resources and other commercial opportunities. This is why the ambassador’s rhetoric about Somalia’s bright future needs to be accompanied by something far more concrete: details. Where are the satellite agreements? Who owns the infrastructure? Who finances it? Who controls the data and technology? What are the terms of the oil exploration agreements? What are the fishing licenses? How much will Turkish companies pay? Who will enforce the rules? What protections will Somali businesses and fishermen receive? And what safeguards govern Turkish military assistance? Somalis are entitled to ask these questions. Indeed, they have a responsibility to ask them. A country emerging from decades of state collapse cannot afford to build foreign partnerships around speeches, friendship and promises alone. It needs contracts that can be examined, institutions capable of enforcing them, parliamentary oversight, public disclosure and independent auditing. The problem with presenting spectacular future projects to a population struggling with basic state failures is not that the projects are inherently undesirable. It is that grand promises can distract from the much harder work of building the foundations required to make those promises meaningful. A satellite will not build a functioning state. Oil will not automatically create prosperity. Foreign fishing fleets will not automatically strengthen Somali coastal communities. Weapons will not automatically produce security. Roads and infrastructure will not automatically create accountable government. Institutions do Somalia needs a professional civil service, accountable security forces, credible elections, independent courts, transparent management of natural resources and public finances, and a government capable of negotiating with foreign partners from a position of institutional strength. Turkey has every right to pursue its interests in Somalia. Somalia has exactly the same right to pursue its own. That is what a genuine partnership means. If Turkey helps Somalia build a satellite program, Somalia should gain technology and expertise—not merely host the launch facility. If Turkey invests in fisheries, Somali fishermen should become more prosperous, not displaced. If Turkey participates in oil exploration, Somalia should receive a transparent and fair share of the resulting wealth. If Turkey supplies weapons, those weapons should strengthen national security rather than become associated with domestic political confrontation. And if Turkey builds infrastructure, the agreements and ownership structures should be clear to the Somali public. The ambassador may be right that Somalia possesses enormous potential. It does. But potential is not development. Development requires institutions capable of turning national resources into national wealth and foreign partnerships into genuine national capacity. Until those foundations are strengthened, Somalis should welcome investment while questioning the terms behind it. They do not need another foreign power telling them how bright their future will be. They need to know exactly what Somalia is giving away today—and what Somalia will actually receive in return. That is not hostility toward Turkey. It is what sovereignty looks like. items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo dadaal ugu jira in la adkeeyo amniga Baydhabo
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar oo weli ku sugan Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa magaaladaasi u jooga xoojinta amniga iyo isku xirka Ciidamada Qalabka Sida. Taliyaha ayaa magaalada kaga qaybgelaya kulamo looga hadlayo amniga iyo sidii Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ay u qaadi lahaayeen hawlgal wadajir ah, oo daafaha magaalada looga fogeynayo ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa dhowr jeer oo hore sheegay in ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen ay ku kulmeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, eedeymahaas oo mucaaradka uu Laftagareen hoggaamiyo ay beeniyeen. Hawlgalka wadajirka ah ee la qorsheynayo ayaa ah mid la isku-dubaridayo cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Daraawiishta iyo Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed, si loo adkeeyo amniga Baydhabo, loona sugo deegaanada ku teedsan. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo Sabtidii gaaray Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa geeyay agab ciidan oo loogu talagalay ciidamada. items.title: Muqdisho oo si rasmi ah looga furay Shirweynaha Qaran ee Adeegyada Cimilada Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho, Sebteembar 13, 2026 – Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa maanta si rasmi ah looga furay Shirweynaha Qaran ee Adeegyada Cimilada Soomaaliya (NCOF OND 2026), kaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo saadaasha cimilada iyo xogaha la xiriira isbeddelka cimilada. Shirweynahan ayaa ujeedkiisu yahay in la xoojiyo adeegsiga xogta cimilada, kor loogu qaado diyaar-garowga bulshada iyo hay’adaha dowladda, isla markaana go’aan qaadashada lagu saleeyo xog iyo saadaal cimiladeed oo sax ah. Munaasabadda furitaanka waxaa ka qeyb galay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda, khubaro ku takhasustay arrimaha cimilada, hay’ado iyo daneeyayaal kala duwan oo ka shaqeeya saadaasha hawada iyo la tacaalidda saameynta isbeddelka cimilada. Shirweynaha ayaa la filayaa inuu door muhiim ah ka qaato xoojinta iskaashiga hay’adaha kala duwan iyo horumarinta adeegyada saadaasha cimilada, xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahaysay saameyn xooggan oo ka dhalatay isbeddelka cimilada, oo ay ka mid yihiin abaaro iyo xaalado cimilo oo isbeddelaya.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo abaalmariyay Wasaaradaha ugu waxqabadka sarreeya dalka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa ka qaybgalay munaasabadda xiritaanka bandhigga sannadlaha ah ee la-xisaabtanka Wasaaradaha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Munaasabadda ayaa lagu soo bandhigay natiijooyinka waxqabadka Wasaaradaha, heerka ay ka gaareen fulinta qorshayaashii loo dejiyay, bartilmaameedyadii loo asteeyay iyo waajibaadyadii ay gudanayeen sannadka 2026. Madaxweynaha ayaa billado guddoonsiiyay Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, kuwaas oo kaalmaha ugu sarreeya ka galay qiimeyntii waxqabadka Wasaaradaha ee sannadkan. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ku abaalmariyay hirgelinta hannaanka danabaysan ee lagu la socdo laguna qiimeeyo waxqabadka Wasaaradaha dowladda. Madaxweynaha ayaa bogaadiyay dadaalka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee ku aaddan hirgelinta qorshayaasha dowladda iyo horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, isaga oo carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay la-xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowladda, hufnaanta shaqada iyo qiimeynta joogtada ah ee natiijooyinka waxqabadka. Ugu dambeyn, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Wasiirrada iyo hay’adaha dowladda ku booriyay in guulaha iyo natiijooyinka la gaaray ay noqdaan saldhig lagu sii xoojinayo waxqabadka, isla markaana la saxo meelaha ay ka jiraan gaabisyada u baahan dardargelinta. Wuxuu xusay in qorshayaasha dowladda ay muhiim tahay inay si muuqata uga tarjumaan baahiyaha iyo danta shacabka Soomaaliyeed.

items.title: Warbixin laga qoray qaar ka mid ah caruurtii Siyaad Bare
items.description: Wargeyska caanka ah ee Mareykanka New York Post ayaa baahiyay warbixin baaritaan ah oo xasaasi ah, taas oo lagu soo bandhigay halka ay maanta ku nool yihiin iyo waxa ay shaqadoodu tahay qaar ka mid ah carruurtii Madaxweynihii hore ee Dowladii dhexe ee Soomaaliya, Janaraal Maxamed Siyaad Barre. Warbixinta ayaa si gaar ah diiradda u saartay Ayaanle Maxamed Siyaad Barre iyo walaashiis Deeqo Maxamed Siyaad Barre, iyadoo sheegtay in labadooduba ay si deggan ugu nool yihiin agagaarka magaaladda Columbus ee Gobolka Ohio, oo ka mid ah meelaha ay ku badan yihiin Soomaalida ku nool Mareykanka. AYAANLE: “GACANTII MIDIG” EE AABBIHIIS Sida lagu sheegay baaritaanka New York Post, Ayaanle Maxamed Siyaad Barre ayaa xilligii ugu dambeeyay ee Dowladdii dhexe ee aabbihiis maamulayay lagu tilmaamay inuu ahaa qof door weyn ku lahaa maamulka Madaxtooyadda iyo arrimaha Amniga Qaranka Soomaaliya Warbixintu waxay Ayaanle ku tilmaantay inuu ahaa mid ka mid ah dadka ugu dhow Janaraal Maxamed Siyaad Barre, gaar ahaan sanadihii ugu dambeeyay ee Dowladdii Kacaanka ka hor inta aysan burburin Dowladdii dhexe sanadkii 1991. New York Post ayaa sheegtay in Ayaanle iyo Deeqo ay hadda ku nool yihiin agagaarka Magaaladda Columbus, iyadoo Ayaanle lagu sheegay inuu ku nool yahay guri caadi ah oo ku yaalla xaafadaha ka baxsan bartamaha magaaladda.Columbus Columbus ayaa sidoo kale hoy u ah jaaliyad Soomaaliyeed oo ballaaran, waxaana magaaladda iyo nawaaxigeeda ku nool Soomaali badan oo dalka u yimid sababo ay ka mid yihiin dagaalladii iyo qalalaasihii siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya ka dhacay kadib burburkii Dowladdii dhexe. $1.8 MILYAN OO MEDICARE AH Qodob kale oo xasaasi ah oo uu New York Post soo bandhigay ayaa la xiriira dhinaca Ganacsiga. Wargeysku wuxuu sheegay in xubno qoyska ka tirsan ama dad lala xiriiriyay qoyska ay ku lug leeyihiin shirkado bixiya adeegyada daryeelka caafimaadka ee guryaha (home-health), iyadoo mid ka mid ah shirkadahaas lagu sheegay inay heshay lacag dhan ku dhowaad $1.8 Milyan oo Dollar oo ka timid barnaamijka Dowladda Mareykanka ee Medicare. Warbixintu New York Post ayaa waxay sidoo kale xustay ganacsi la xiriira adeegyada turjumaadda iyo urur samafal oo magac qoyska Maxamed Siyaad Barre lala xiriiriyay Joogitaanka xubno ka mid ah qoyska Siyaad Barre ee Columbus ayaa, sida New York Post sheegtay, dib u soo celiyay xusuuso culus oo ku saabsan taariikhda Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dadka Soomaaliyeed ee dalka uga qaxay colaadaha iyo tacaddiyada loo aaneynayo inay gaysatay Dowladdii militariga ee Soomaaliya Wargeysku wuxuu soo xigtay xubno ka mid ah jaaliyadda Soomaaliyeed oo ka hadlay xusuusta qoysaskooda iyo dadkii ay waayeen xilligii dowladdii Kacaanka. Mid ka mid ah dadka la wareystay ayaa New York Post u sheegay inuu aad uga xumaaday markii uu arkay wiilka Siyaad Barre oo si xor ah ugu nool magaaladda waliba ku tukanaya Masaajida, isaga oo xusay inuu qoyskiisa ku waayay dhacdooyin uu ku eedeeyay Ciidamadii Dowladdii hore. Waxaa sidoo kale jira baaqyo ka imanaya qaar ka mid ah dadka Soomaaliyeed ee sheegaya inay dhibbanayaal u yihiin xukunkii hore, kuwaas oo doonaya in hay’adaha Mareykanka ay si dheeraad ah u eegaan xiriirrada ganacsi iyo dhaqaale ee dadka ay warbixintu xustay. Fiiro gaar ah: Qodobada kor ku xusan ee la daabacay waxay ku saleysan yihiin oo kaliya warbixinta New York Post iyo xogta lagu soo bandhigay baaritaankeeda, eedeymaha la xiriira dambiyada, Ganacsiyada ama lacagaha Dowladda lagama dhigan karo xaqiiqo qof gaar ah lagu xukumo ilaa ay helaan caddeyn madax-bannaan ama go’aan Maxkamadeed oo rasmi ah.   Codka Bulshada

items.title: To Those People Who Ignorantly Blame S/land Gov’t For Not Doing Anything About Dollar Increase And Higher Commoduty Prices
items.description: Beginning from 19th century, two measurements have been used to get a sense of how well developed countries are doing. One is gross domestic product, the monetary value of all finished goods and services made within a country during a specific period. The other measurement is a country’s unemployment rate. But when it comes to figuring out how well an underdeveloped country like Somaliland is doing and serving its citizens, the above measurements are not taken into consideration. There are other factors that are taken into account when assessing how well a third world country such as Somaliland is progressing and providing services to its people. There is nothing more common to measure economic strength and social progress of an underdeveloped country than self-sufficiency or self-reliance. First, self-sufficiency is having the ability and resources to take care of yourself without outside help. In other words, it is a country’s ability to meet the basic needs of its people, such as basic food and clothing, and/or a country’s ability to identify unmet needs and implement proper use of resources. One good example of self-sufficiency is growing your own food and making your own clothing. Secondly, self-reliance is the ability to depend on yourself to meet your own requirements. The capacity to rely on one’s own capabilities, and to manage one’s own affairs independetly. The concept of self-sufficiency is basically taken to mean the extent to which a country can satisfy its needs from its own domestic production. The difference between self sufficiency and self-reliance is that self-sufficiency relates to the fulfilment of a nation’s basic needs and proper use of its resources, while self reliance refers to control over decision making, which is the reliance on one’s own judgment, abilities, actions etc. Of all the needs that come under self-sufficiency concept, there are two elements for humans to survive. The first one is food, the second is water. Without food and water, human beings cannot live, but without other services humans can survive. How often does insufficiency of food and water supply come into Somaliland’s concern and consideration? Do Somaliland people hold any view of the extent to which their country can satisfy its food needs from its own domestic production, if global food scarcity or shortage will happen? A nation which fails to address its basic needs, encourage itself to improve its learning skills, arrange its ideas with the future challenges, protect the environment, and initiate projections to invest in getting its needs from its own domestic production is not succeeding. Taking life as it comes is simply never pursuing or predicting aspects of what the future would look like. It is a condition in which preparation for tomorrow is not part of one’s culture (How a society leads its own life). In such condition as this, things seem that going forward is unlikeliy to happen, because viewing the world through rose colored glasses is not the answer to overcoming adversity. What scope people wearing rose colored glasses see, determines what story they see and how they look at the world. Of course, seeing the world through different ways is about securing things, defending things, copying technology in order to save cost, as Chinese people do, controlling things, inventing things, protecting and preserving both renewable and non-renewable resources. It’s mostly a fear-based view of the world that is preparing for future events. This approach is humanly normal. Experience shows that developed countries always base their national strategies for their present and future needs on a fear-based stand to minimize the danger that may arise, for instances, from the occurrence of food scarcity or outbreak of world war, while underdeveloped nations mostly fail to set out strategies that can ensure the means to produce sufficient supply of their needs at the domestic level that will help them find a sweet space at which dependence on what others produce is minimized. The difference between the two approaches is that rich countries mostly utilise their mental mechanics for shaping their life as they want, while poverty-stricken countries neither use their effort nor their mental imagination for trying to tame their lives. The shame on Somaliland societies is that they take life as it comes to them. And taking life as it comes is fundamentally an “anti-change state.” That is, the way Somaliland people lead their lives is not about thinking in regards to the survival of the tribe. Nothing is more bitter than truth. Who among us can deny or disagree the fact that Somaliland has been, and still continues to be the dumping ground for the massively produced foreign goods? This reality goes further from this and probably begs the questions such as:- a) What do Somaliland people control? b) What do they own? c) What do they produce? e) What do they distribute? f) What are the goods that are the produce of Somaliland country that citizens of Somaliland consume? In fact Somaliland people are incredibly consumers and have no special creation. They never ever produced an iota of their basic needs in their entire life. Their food, their cloth, their cars, their tea, their phones, their mobiles, their lotion, their guns, all their white goods, etc, are not their own make, but all are made and controlled by people who don’t look like them, who may retain their goods for their own needs in hard times, who may not even be happy to see Somalis and their likes to survive. Academics had it right when they predicted 50 years ago on the prospect of parasite societies: “Non-productivity reduces output, represses levels of living standard for the masses and engenders strife.” A nation is alive only when it constantly revives and revitalises the way in which it manages its problems, aligns its national vision with what is going on in the world and discards its outdated traditions, habits, rituals and assumptions. Of all the problems Somaliland now faces, lack of local production is the elephant in the room. The old saying which goes to say “necessity is the mother of invention” is applicable to Somaliland. A bleak future is for he who knowingly ignores or escapes from this reality. How should Somaliland state get itself out of foreign-produce dependency? How Somaliland would deal with the lack of local production? The solution is simple. Doing what others did and still do, is the answer as to how Somaliland state can free itself from foreign goods and become self-reliant on its own resources rather than that of others. Apart from light, water and air, food is what makes humans survive; what provides human bodies with what they need to stay alive; what makes human beings grow, active, energetic, move and work; what keeps human bodies healthy and heal themselves; what every human who is born into this world requires. Thus, Somaliland must innovate and intellectuslise its weak policies towards its economic growth and come up with the ability, skill and knowledge to boost domestic yield to satisfy its basic needs from within its own domestic production without foreign produce? In the heat of these alarming moments, Somaliland must make sense of food insufficiency and insecurity, recognize climate change and global warming, protect its environment, dream of a regenerative agriculture, envision a green revolution, create an awareness throughout Somaliland, so that the population must plant sea and herd its animals, and dig the land for farms to produce more and better food. A lesson that sends a powerful message to every country that cannot stand on its feet without foreign aid is that, as a result of the sudden outbreak of the pandemic, Covid-19, rich nations have already started intensive researches on de-globalisation and indeed focused on setting up urgent objectives to develop their local production and measures to stop outsourcing supply chains. Remember, environment does not need humans to survive, but humans need it. So, let us get used to the truth that we are all connected to it and must like to live an environment-centered life. Nothing is more attractive than the reality to acknowledge that a healthy environment is the foundation for a healthy and sustainable society. This hope can only come true when all of us look ahead and always try to use our resources wisely for the sake of our future generations. Who knows what the nature will bring to us tomorrow? What matters to us is to get ready for how we can arrange our ideas with how we can shape the sense of tomorrow. By:JamaFalaag. Hargeisa, Somaliland. jamafalaag@gmail.com
