items.title: Abiy Ahmed oo billaabay in uu drone sameysto xilli uu weerar culus qorsheynayo
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Itoobiya ayaa si weyn u ballaarisay awooddeeda diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, iyadoo dalka gudihiisa ka hirgelisay laba warshadood oo soo saara drones-ka, halka khubaradu ay rumeysan yihiin in ciidamada federaalka ay hadda haystaan kumannaan noocyo kala duwan ah. Horumarkan ayaa dowladda Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed siinaya awood dheeraad ah oo ay kula dagaallanto kooxaha hubeysan ee ka dagaallama gobollo dhowr ah, gaar ahaan Amxaarada, Oromada iyo Tigray. Itoobiya ayaa si weyn u ogaatay muhiimadda drone-yada intii uu socday dagaalkii Tigray ee 2020 ilaa 2022. Diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Turkiga ayaa door muhiim ah ka qaatay markii ciidamada federaalka ay dib u riixeen xoogaggii Tigray ee xilligaas ku soo dhowaaday meel qiyaastii 200 km u jirta Addis Ababa. Tan iyo markaas, Addis Ababa waxay si joogto ah u ballaarineysay awooddeeda cirka, iyadoo iibsatay drone-yo casri ah isla markaana billowday inay qaar ka mid ah gudaha dalka ku farsameyso. Bishii Maarso 2025, Abiy Ahmed ayaa xarigga ka jaray warshadda SkyWin Aeronautics Industries ee Addis Ababa, taas oo dowladda Itoobiya sheegtay inay soo saarto diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo loogu talagalay isticmaalka rayidka iyo militariga. Wakaaladda wararka dowladda Itoobiya ee ENA ayaa xilligaas sheegtay in drone-yada lagu sameeyo warshadda ay naqshadeeyeen oo dhiseen xirfadlayaal Itoobiyaan ah. Abiy ayaa sheegay in ujeeddada barnaamijku aysan ahayn in colaado la huriyo, balse lagu xoojiyo awoodda ka-hortagga khataraha. Hase yeeshee, faahfaahinta dhabta ah ee awoodda wax-soo-saarka Itoobiya ayaan weli si buuxda loo ogeyn, waxaana dowladda lagu eedeeyay inay xaddiday xogta iyo gelitaanka warshadahaas. Pieter Wezeman, oo ka tirsan Machadka Caalamiga ah ee Cilmi-baarista Nabadda ee Stockholm, SIPRI, ayaa sheegay in bandhigga drone-yada gudaha lagu sameeyay uusan kaligiis caddeyn karin heerka ay Itoobiya dhab ahaan u gaartay isku-filnaanshaha teknoolajiyadda. “Hal hool oo ay yaallaan drone-yo dhalaalaya wax badan noogama sheegayo awoodda dhabta ah ee wax-soo-saarka iyo halka teknoolajiyadda, qaybaha muhiimka ah ama qalabka diyaar u ah isku-xirka laga keenay,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu sheegay inuu rumeysan yahay in qayb weyn oo ka mid ah qalabkaas dibadda laga keeno. Itoobiya ayaa hore uga iibsatay Turkiga drone-yada casriga ah ee Akinci iyo Bayraktar TB2, halka ay sidoo kale haysato Wing Loong oo Shiinuhu sameeyo iyo Mohajer-6 oo laga leeyahay Iran. Jeremy Binnie oo ka tirsan shirkadda difaaca iyo sirdoonka ee Janes ayaa sheegay in nooca SW01 ee lagu soo bandhigay warshadda SkyWin uu aad ugu egyahay drone ganacsi oo laga heli karo Shiinaha. Sida uu sheegay, haddii drone-yada noocaas ah tiro badan loo soo saaro ciidamada, waxay si weyn u kordhin karaan awoodda cutubyada dhulka ee ogaanshaha bartilmaameedyada iyo hagidda madaafiicda, iyadoo sidoo kale lagu rakibi karo bambooyin yaryar. Warshad labaad oo lagu magacaabo Aeroabay ayaa la furay dabayaaqadii 2025, waxaana lagu soo saaraa kumannaan drone oo yaryar oo hubeysan. Wim Zwijnenburg, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay drone-yada kana tirsan hay’adda PAX, ayaa sheegay in diyaaradahaas ay ku kacayaan inta u dhaxaysa $5,000 iyo $10,000 midkiiba. Intooda badan waa nooca FPV, ama First-Person View, oo duuliyaha u oggolaanaya inuu si toos ah u arko goobta ay diyaaraddu dul marayso, waxaana qaarkood lagu rakibi karaa walxaha qarxa. Qaar ka mid ah drone-yadaas waxaa lagu hago fiilooyin fibre-optic ah, taas oo adkeyneysa in lagu carqaladeeyo qalabka dagaalka elektarooniga ah. Dagaallada gudaha Ballaarinta awoodda drone-yada Itoobiya ayaa ku soo beegmeysa iyadoo dowladda federaalka ay wajahayo jabhado hubeysan oo ka dagaallamaya qaybo kala duwan oo dalka ah. Hay’adda ACLED ee la socota colaadaha ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada federaalka Itoobiya ay 102 weerar oo drone ah ka fuliyeen gobolka Amxaarada tan iyo markii uu halkaas ka billowday kacdoonka maleeshiyada Fano bishii Abriil 2023. Drone-yada ayaa sidoo kale loo adeegsaday dagaallada ka socda Oromada, oo ah gobolka uu kasoo jeedo Ra’iisul Wasaare Abiy Ahmed. Magnus Taylor oo ka tirsan International Crisis Group ayaa sheegay in drone-yada dhowr jeer lagu eedeeyay inay sababeen dhimashada dad rayid ah. Xiisadda ugu weyn ayaa hadda markale ka taagan Tigray. Ugu yaraan 14 weerar oo drone ah ayaa sanadkan laga diiwaangeliyay gobolkaas, toddobo ka mid ahna waxay dhaceen bishii Agoosto oo keliya, xilli ay isa soo tarayaan walaacyada laga qabo inuu dib u qarxo dagaal ballaaran. ACLED ayaa sheegtay in weerarradaasi ay u muuqdeen kuwo loogu talagalay in lagu carqaladeeyo abaabulka iyo qorsheynta ciidamada Tigray, xilli maamulka gobolka lagu eedeeyay inuu waday olole askareyn qasab ah. Zwijnenburg ayaa sheegay in ciidamada Itoobiya ay Tigray u muuqdaan inay ka adeegsanayaan diyaarado militari oo waaweyn oo meel fog laga hago, kuwaas oo ridi kara gantaallo ama bambooyin hagitaan leh. Amanuel Assefa, madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Tigray People’s Liberation Front, TPLF, ayaa ku eedeeyay dowladda federaalka inay drone-yada u adeegsaneyso “in cabsi lagu abuuro shacabka, lagu bartilmaameedsado mas’uuliyiinta siyaasadda iyo militariga, laguna burburiyo bartilmaameedyo gaar ah iyo kaabayaasha muhiimka ah ee rayidka”. Edward Bach oo ka tirsan shirkadda falanqeynta khataraha ee Verisk Maplecroft ayaa sheegay in weerarrada lagu beegsanayo bakhaarada hubka iyo waddooyinka saadka ay suuragal tahay inay qeyb ka yihiin diyaargarowga howlgal militari oo cusub. Hase yeeshee, qaar ka mid ah khubarada ayaa qaba in isticmaalka drone-yadu uu sidoo kale dowladda u saamaxayo inay cadaadis militari sii waddo iyadoo aan ciidamo badan dhulka gelin. Taylor ayaa sheegay in Abiy uusan xilligan u muuqan mid doonaya inuu markale galo dagaal dhulka ah oo qaali ku noqda Itoobiya. “Abiy wuxuu u muuqdaa inuu hadda arrintan u arko dagaal daal-gelin ah, waxaana maadaama uu drone-yada u adeegsan karo isaga oo aan la kulmin iska-caabin weyn, uu xaaladdan sii wadi karaa muddo dheer,” ayuu yiri. Safiirka ayaa sheegay in Turkigu uu Soomaaliya kala shaqeynayo mashaariic la xiriira hawada sare iyo Tiknolojiyada Dayax-gacmeedyada, iyadoo labada dal ay doonayaan in iskaashiga dhinaca farsamada iyo aqoonta loo ballaariyo. Haddii qorshahan la fuliyo, Soomaaliya waxay ku biiri doontaa dalalka Afrika ee adeegsanaya tiknoolajiyadda dayax-gacmeedyada si ay uga faa’iideystaan dhinacyada isgaarsiinta, saadaasha cimilada, maaraynta khayraadka dabiiciga ah, beeraha iyo la socodka deegaanka. Sidoo kale, dayax-gacmeedku wuxuu Soomaaliya siin karaa fursado cusub oo la xiriira xog-ururinta iyo kormeerka dhulka, gaar ahaan iyadoo dalka uu leeyahay dhul ballaaran, xeeb dheer iyo khayraad dabiici ah oo u baahan xog casri ah oo joogto ah. items.title: Golaha Ammaanka oo kordhiyay cunaqabateynta hubka ee Daafuur
items.description: New York ( Raxanreeb Online) Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa si aqlabiyad ah u ansixiyay qaraar lagu kordhinayo muddada cunaqabataynta hubka ee saaran gobolka Daafuur ee dalka Suudaan. Dhammaan 15-xubnood ee Golaha Ammaanka ayaa u codeeyay qaraarka, iyadoo aan la helin cod diidmo ah. Go’aankan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu xakameynayo qulqulka hubka iyo agabka militari ee gaara kooxaha hubeysan ee ka howlgala Darfur. Cunaqabataynta hubka ayaa si gaar ah muhiim ugu ah xaaladda Darfur, oo muddo dheer wajahaysay colaado iyo amni-darro. Dagaalka ka socda Suudaan ayaa sidoo kale sii kordhiyay walaaca laga qabo in hub iyo saanad militari ay gaaraan dhinacyada ku dagaallamaya gobolka. Golaha Ammaanka ayaa tallaabadan ku doonaya in la yareeyo awoodda kooxaha hubeysan ee sii wada dagaallada, isla markaana loo abuuro fursad lagu xoojiyo dadaallada lagu gaarayo xal siyaasadeed iyo nabad waarta. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa horey uga digtay xaaladda bani’aadamnimo ee sii xumaanaysa ee Suudaan, iyadoo malaayiin qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha dalka iyo dalalka deriska ah, halka colaadaha ay saameyn weyn ku yeesheen dadka rayidka ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, cunaqabataynta hubka ayaa wajahaysa caqabado ku saabsan sida loo dhaqan-gelinayo, gaar ahaan iyadoo ay jiraan eedeymo ku saabsan in hub iyo taageero militari ay weli gaaraan dhinacyada ku lugta leh dagaallada. The post Golaha Ammaanka oo kordhiyay cunaqabateynta hubka ee Daafuur appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Dawladda Soomaaliya oo ka digtay in la siyaasadeeyo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa ugu baaqay shacabka Soomaaliyeed inay ka fogaadaan falalka iyo hadallada sii xumeyn kara xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, xilli ay dalka ka socdaan dhaliilo iyo mudaharaadyo la xiriira doorka ciidamada Turkiga ee Soomaaliya. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa sheegay in calanka Turkiga aan loo qalmin in la gubo , isagoo ku boorriyay shacabka Soomaaliyeed in aan arrimaha siyaasadeed iyo khilaafaadka la xiriira dhacdooyin gaar ah loo adeegsan sidii lagu dhaawici lahaa xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Ankara. Hadalkan ayaa yimid xilli qaybo ka mid ah Soomaaliya ay ka dhaceen caro iyo dibadbaxyo ka dhashay warar iyo eedeymo la xiriira ka-qaybgalka ciidamada Turkiga ee hawlgallada milatari ee Soomaaliya . Wasiirku si toos ah uma taageerin eedeymahaas, balse wuxuu xoogga saaray muhiimadda ay leedahay in la ilaaliyo xiriirka labada dal. Turkiga ayaa muddo ka badan toban sano xiriir dhow la lahaa Soomaaliya, isagoo door weyn ka qaatay tababarka ciidamada Soomaaliyeed iyo taageerada dhanka milatariga , xilli dowladda federaalku ay dadaal ugu jirto dhismaha hay’adaha amniga iyo sidii ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si buuxda ula wareegi lahaayeen mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. Xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale ku fiday dhinacyada kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, maalgashiga, gargaarka bani’aadannimo iyo horumarinta , iyadoo iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca uu sannadihii dambe sii xoogaystay. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa sidaas darteed ku baaqay in khilaafaadka ama su’aalaha laga qabo arrimo gaar ah aan loo beddelin xiisad dhaawacda xiriirka labada dowladood. Hadalkiisa ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay wajaheyso xaalad amni oo xasaasi ah, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda ay sii wadaan howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, isla markaana socda dadaallo lagu xoojinayo awoodda iyo isku-filnaanshaha ciidamada qaranka. Xiriirka Ankara iyo Muqdisho ayaa loo arkaa mid istiraatiiji ah, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga iyo dhismaha awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga ayaa u muuqda inuu doonayo in arrimaha la isku khilaafsan yahay ee milatari ama siyaasadeed laga sooco xiriirka guud ee labada dal , si aanay xiisadaha gudaha Soomaaliya u dhaawicin iskaashiga muddada dheer ee labada dhinac.

items.title: Kooxaha Burcad-badeedd Soomaalida oo sii dayay Markab u afduubnaa
items.description: Boosaaso ( Raxanreeb Online) Kooxo burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ayaa la sheegay inay sii daayeen markab ay muddo afduub ahaan u haysteen, sida ay sheegeen ilo amni oo xogta u gudbiyay warbaahinta. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegay in markabka lagu sii daayay xaalad aan weli si rasmi ah loo faahfaahin, iyadoo aan la shaacin magaca markabka, calanka uu watay, halka lagu afduubtay iyo waqtiga saxda ah ee la sii daayay. Sidoo kale, weli ma cadda haddii sii deynta markabka ay timid kaddib wada-xaajood, heshiis ama lacag madax-furasho ah, maadaama ilaha amniga aysan bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan dhacdada. Markabka ka baxay gacanta Burcad Badeedda waxa ay kooxahaas afduubteen Bishii April ee Sannadkaan waxaana la socday 17 Rag ah sida ay ku warrantay Wakaaladda Wararka AFP oo xogtaan si kooban u faafisay. Wararka ku saabsan sii deynta markabkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli ay xeebaha Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan Badweynta Hindiya mararka qaar ka dhacaan weerarro iyo afduubyo loo geysto maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo kuwa kalluumeysiga. Inkasta oo burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya ay hoos u dhac weyn ku timid marka loo eego sannadihii ugu xumaa, haddana khatarta weerarrada badda ayaa weli ah arrin ay si dhow ula socdaan hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya iyo ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah. items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada Soomaaliya oo si kulul uga hadlay gubista calanka Turkiga + Video
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Qaar kamid ah Golaha Wasiirrada Soomaaliya oo xalay ka qeyb-galay munaasabad lagu sagootinayay Safiirka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya, Alper Aktaş, oo soo gabagabeeyay howlihiisii diblomaasiyadeed ee dalka, ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku saabsan xiriirka labada dal iyo xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee soo kordhay. Wasiirrada oo khudbado ka jeediyay madasha ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay dhacdadiid lagu gubay calanka Turkiga ee ka dhacday Jubbaland, kadib dibadbaxyo looga soo horjeeday Turkiga oo lagu meelo kamid ah maamulkaas. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) ayaa sheegay in koox gar ah aysan xumeyn karin xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Ankara, isla markaana Turkiga lagu xasuusan doono xilliga adag ee uu garab istaagay Soomaaliya. “Koox gooni ah cambaar uma yeeli karto saaxibtinimada Turkiga naga dhaxeysa, wadanka Turkiga xili adag ayay nasoo garab istaageyn waligeenana waan wada joogi doonaa,” ayuu yiri wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaliya. Sidoo kale, wasiirka gaashaandhigga Axmed Macalin Firi ayaa si adag uga falceliyay gubista calanka Turkiga, isagoo sheegay in Turkigu abaal weyn ku leeyahay dadka iyo dalka Soomaaliya. “Turkiga calankooda in lagubo mamudna nimanka careesan ee gobolada jooga iyo qolada AS ku biiray waxba kama qaadayaan Turkiga,” ayuu isna yiri Fiqi. Dhankiisa wasiirka wasaaradda tamarta iyo kheyraadka biyaha, Cabdullahi Bidhaan Warsame ayaa dhaleeceeyay dadka dhaawacaya xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, isagoo sheegay in siyaasiyiinta shisheeye u shaqeeya aysan waxba ka beddeli karin mowqifka dowladda, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Siyaasiyiin shisheeye u shaqeeyo waxba yeeli makaraan Turkiga, annaga ayaa garab taagan cidna ku badalan meyno,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Bidhaan. Hadalladan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo dhawaan dibadbaxyo ka dhan ah Turkiga ay ka dhaceen meelo kamid ah Jubbaland iyo Koonfur Galbeed, kadib markii xukuumadda Ankara lagu eedeeyay duqemyo ka dhacay aagga magaalada Baydhaba oo ay ka taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeysa ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo marar kala duwan gudaha magaaladaasi. Si kastaba, Turkiga ayaa ah saaxibka koowaad ee Soomaaliya, wuxuuna gashaday abaal wayn, kadib markii usoo gurmaday xilli adag oo abaaro daran ay ka jireen meelo badan oo kamid ah dalka. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale taageerada ugu xooggan siiya Dowladda Federaalka, wuxuuna ka caawiyaa dhanka milatariga iyo dib u dhiska ciidanka Xoogga dalka. Wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) ayaa sheegay in koox gar ah aysan xumeyn karin xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Ankara, isla markaana Turkiga lagu xasuusan doono xilliga adag ee uu garab istaagay Soomaaliya. “Koox gooni ah cambaar uma yeeli karto saaxibtinimada Turkiga naga dhaxeysa, wadanka Turkiga xili adag ayay nasoo garab istaageyn waligeenana waan wada joogi doonaa,” ayuu yiri wasiirka arrimaha dibadda Soomaliya. Sidoo kale, wasiirka gaashaandhigga Axmed Macalin Firi ayaa si adag uga falceliyay gubista calanka Turkiga, isagoo sheegay in Turkigu abaal weyn ku leeyahay dadka iyo dalka Soomaaliya. “Turkiga calankooda in lagubo mamudna nimanka careesan ee gobolada jooga iyo qolada AS ku biiray waxba kama qaadayaan Turkiga,” ayuu isna yiri Fiqi. Dhankiisa wasiirka wasaaradda tamarta iyo kheyraadka biyaha, Cabdullahi Bidhaan Warsame ayaa dhaleeceeyay dadka dhaawacaya xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, isagoo sheegay in siyaasiyiinta shisheeye u shaqeeya aysan waxba ka beddeli karin mowqifka dowladda, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Siyaasiyiin shisheeye u shaqeeyo waxba yeeli makaraan Turkiga, annaga ayaa garab taagan cidna ku badalan meyno,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Bidhaan. Hadalladan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo dhawaan dibadbaxyo ka dhan ah Turkiga ay ka dhaceen meelo kamid ah Jubbaland iyo Koonfur Galbeed, kadib markii xukuumadda Ankara lagu eedeeyay duqemyo ka dhacay aagga magaalada Baydhaba oo ay ka taagan tahay xiisad u dhexeysa ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen oo marar kala duwan gudaha magaaladaasi. Si kastaba, Turkiga ayaa ah saaxibka koowaad ee Soomaaliya, wuxuuna gashaday abaal wayn, kadib markii usoo gurmaday xilli adag oo abaaro daran ay ka jireen meelo badan oo kamid ah dalka. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale taageerada ugu xooggan siiya Dowladda Federaalka, wuxuuna ka caawiyaa dhanka milatariga iyo dib u dhiska ciidanka Xoogga dalka. The post Golaha Wasiirrada Soomaaliya oo si kulul uga hadlay gubista calanka Turkiga + Video appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Xoghayaha Guud ee Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka kala hadlay la-dagaallanka xagjirnimada
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa Qasriga Madaxtooyada Qaranka ku qaabilay Xoghayaha Guud ee Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka, ahna Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Culimada Muslimiinta, Dr. Mohammed bin Abdulkarim Al-Issa. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka , iyadoo si gaar ah looga wada hadlay arrimaha la xiriira fahamka saxda ah ee Diinta Islaamka, ka hortagga fikirka xagjirka ah iyo xoojinta nabadda iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa kulanka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo dadaallada lagu la-dagaallamayo fikradaha xagjirka ah iyo marin-habaabinta dhalinyarada , isagoo tilmaamay in iskaashi xooggan oo dhinacyada dowladda, culimada iyo hay’adaha Islaamiga ah uu muhiim u yahay ka hortagga fikirrada dhaawici kara nabadda iyo midnimada bulshada. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa uga mahadceliyay Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka mowqifkeeda ku aaddan taageerada midnimada, madaxbannaanida iyo qarannimada Soomaaliya , iyo sidoo kale doorka ay ka qaadato horumarinta bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale xambaarsanaa muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo wada shaqeynta dhinacyada diinta, nabadda, wacyigelinta bulshada iyo ka hortagga xagjirnimada , si loo kobciyo faham diimeed oo dhexdhexaad ah, loona dhiirrigeliyo nabad iyo wadajir bulshada dhexdeeda.

items.title: Qiimaha Lagu Kireeyo Maraakiibta Shidaalka oo Gaaray Heerkii ugu sarreeyey
items.description: Qiimaha lagu kireeyo maraakiibta waaweyn ee shidaalka qaada ayaa gaaray heerkii ugu sarreeyey ee abid la diiwaangeliyo, iyadoo xiisadaha ka jira marinnada badda ee Bariga Dhexe ay kordhiyeen khatarta iyo kharashka gaadiidka saliidda. Kirada markab weyn oo saliid ka qaada Gacanka Cumaan una socda Shiinaha ayaa gaartay qiyaastii $11.50 foostadii. Tani waa heerkii ugu sarreeyey tan iyo markii la bilaabay cabbirka lagu qiimeeyo kharashka maraakiibta waaweyn ee qaada saliidda cayriin. Kororka waxaa loo aaneynayaa weerarrada lagu qaaday maraakiibta, khatarta ka jirta marin-biyoodka Hormuz iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyada Xuutiyiinta ee Bab al-Mandab. Shirkadaha maraakiibta ayaa sidoo kale wajahaya caymis qaali ah iyo baahi loo qabo inay maraakiibta ka leexiyaan marinnada halista badan. Yaraanta maraakiibta diyaar u ah inay galaan safarrada khatarta leh ayaa sii kordhisay qiimaha kirada, ayadoo qaar ka mid ah milkiilayaasha maraakiibta ay ka gaabsanayaan marinnada ay weerarradu ka dhacayaan, halka kuwa aqbala safarradaas ay dalbanayaan lacag dheeraad ah oo khatarta lagu daboolayo. Kharashka sare ee gaadiidka badda wuxuu ku dambayn karaa inuu kordhiyo qiimaha shidaalka iyo badeecadaha kale ee caalamka. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in saameyntu aysan ku koobnayn Bariga Dhexe, balse ay gaartay marinnada shidaalka ee isku xira Galbeedka Afrika iyo Aasiya. Soomaaliya oo si weyn ugu tiirsan shidaalka iyo badeecadaha dibadda laga soo dejiyo ayaa laga yaabaa inay dareento kororka kharashaadka gaadiidka. Hase yeeshee, weli lama xaqiijin qiime cusub oo gudaha dalka ka dhashay arrintan, saameyntuna waxay ku xirnaan doontaa muddada ay carqaladaha badda sii socdaan.

items.title: Hindiya iyo Iiraan oo Ka Wada-hadlay Badbaadada Maraakiibta iyo Badmaaxiinta Hindiya
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Hindiya Narendra Modi ayaa Madaxweynaha Iiraan Masoud Pezeshkian kala hadlay ammaanka marin-biyoodka, xorriyadda isu-socodka ganacsiga iyo badbaadada shaqaalaha maraakiibta, xilli weerarrada gobolka ay khatar sii kordhaysa ku hayaan gaadiidka badda. Kulanka ayaa ka dhacay magaalada New Delhi, kahor shir madaxeedka hoggaamiyeyaasha BRICS. Modi ayaa ku adkaystay muhiimadda ay leedahay in marinnada badda ay furnaadaan, lana ilaaliyo maraakiibta iyo shaqaalahooda, si looga hortago carqalad ku timaadda ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Hindiya ayaa sheegtay in weerarradii dhowaan lagu qaaday maraakiibta gobolka lagu dilay ugu yaraan 10 badmaax oo u dhashay dalkaas. Dhacdooyinkan ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca New Delhi, maadaama Hindiya si weyn ugu tiirsan tahay marinnada badda ee ay ka soo gudbaan shidaalka iyo badeecadaha kale. Modi ayaa ku celiyey mowqifka Hindiya ee ah in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo diblomaasiyad. Madaxweynaha Iiraan ayaa isna ugu baaqay dalalka BRICS inay abuuraan jawi aan waddan keli ahi awood ugu yeelan karin inuu carqaladeeyo ganacsiga sharciyeysan ee dalalka kale. Amniga Hormuz, Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab wuxuu si dadban u saamaynayaa Soomaaliya, maadaama marinnadaas ay maraan shidaalka iyo badeecadaha dalka loo soo dhoofiyo. Carqalad kasta waxay kordhin kartaa kirada maraakiibta, caymiska iyo qiimaha badeecadaha ku yimaada dekedaha Soomaaliya. Kulanka Modi iyo Pezeshkian lagama gaarin heshiis cusub oo ku saabsan ammaanka marin-biyoodka ama xabbad-joojinta colaadaha gobolka. Wadahadalku wuxuu muujinayaa walaaca sii kordhaya ee laga qabo badbaadada badmaaxiinta iyo sii furnaanshaha marinnada muhiimka u ah ganacsiga caalamka.

items.title: Kaydka saliidda Sacuudiga oo gaaray heerkii ugu hooseeyey in ka badan 30 sano
items.description: Sahayda saliidda cayriin ee Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa bishii Agoosto hoos ugu dhacday lix milyan oo foosto maalintii, taas oo ah heerkii ugu hooseeyey muddo ka badan 30 sano, sida lagu sheegay qiimayn cusub oo ay soo saartay Hay’adda Tamarta Caalamiga ah (IEA). Tirada bishii Agoosto ayaa 2.3 milyan oo foosto maalintii ka yarayd sahaydii la diiwaangeliyey bishii Luulyo, ayadoo hoos-u-dhacani uu muujinayo culayska sii kordhaya ee saaran wax-soo-saarka iyo dhoofinta saliidda Sacuudiga, xilli ammaanka marinnada muhiimka ah ee gobolka uu sii xumaanayo. IEA ayaa hoos-u-dhaca qayb ahaan la xiriirisay weerarrada lagu qaaday xarumaha tamarta, maraakiibta iyo waddooyinka shidaalka ee ku dhow Bab al-Mandab. Weerarrada Xuutiyiinta iyo xiisadaha kale ee gobolka ayaa carqaladeeyey dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta, iyagoo sare u qaaday khatarta iyo kharashaadka gaadiidka badda. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa OPEC u gudbisay tiro ka sarreysa qiimaynta IEA, iyadoo sheegtay inay suuqa siisay 7.122 milyan oo foosto maalintii, halka wax-soo-saarkeeduna ahaa 6.238 milyan. Kala duwanaanshahan wuxuu ka dhashay hababka kala duwan ee loo cabbiro wax-soo-saarka iyo saliidda si dhab ah suuqa u gaarta. Carqalad sii dheeraata oo ku timaadda dhoofinta saliidda Sacuudiga waxay sare u qaadi kartaa qiimaha shidaalka iyo kharashaadka maraakiibta caalamiga ah. Bab al-Mandab ayaa ah marin muhiim u ah badeecadaha iyo tamarta isaga kala goosha Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Soomaaliya waxay saameynta ka dareemi kartaa kororka qiimaha shidaalka, gaadiidka iyo badeecadaha dibadda laga soo dejiyo, maadaama dhaqaalaha dalku si weyn ugu tiirsan yahay wax-soo-dejinta, hase yeeshee, weli lama xaqiijin koror gudaha Soomaaliya ka dhacay oo si toos ah loola xiriirin karo hoos-u-dhaca cusub ee sahayda Sacuudiga.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo daah-furay sannad-tacliimeedka 2026/2027 ee jaamacadaha dalka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta ka qayb galay munaasabadda furitaanka sannad-tacliimeedka 2026/2027 ee waxbarashada sare ee dalka, taasi oo ka dhacday xarunta dhexe ee Jaamacadda Ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha oo khudbad ka jeediyay munaasabadda ayaa tilmaamay in horumarka Soomaaliya uu si weyn ugu xiran yahay tayeynta waxbarashada, kobcinta aqoonta iyo maalgelinta dhallinyarada, isaga oo xusay in jaamacaduhu ay door muhiim ah ku leeyihiin diyaarinta jiil aqoon iyo xirfad u leh hoggaaminta dalka iyo ka qayb qaadashada horumarkiisa. Sidoo kale, madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa intii ay socotay munaasibaddu waxa uu daah-furay Hindisaha ABUUR, oo lagu kobcinayo hal-abuurka, curinta iyo xirfadaha ganacsi ee ardayda Soomaaliyeed, isaga oo sidoo kale xarigga ka jaray dhismayaasha cusub ee Kulliyadaha Jaamacadda, xarunta guddiga caafimaadka arrimaha Carabta iyo xarunta gurmadka degdegga ah iyo daryeelka xaaladaha halista ah Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale dhagax-dhigay dhismeyaasha guriga martida Jaamacadda Ummadda iyo dhismaha Hal-abuurka iyo cilmi baarista, kuwaasi oo ka qayb qaadanaya dadaallada lagu tayeynayo waxbarashada sare, tababarrada caafimaadka iyo cilmi-baarista dalka. Dhinaca kale, wuxuu madaxweynuhu soo hadal qaaday arrimo la xiriira habka loo qaato shaqaalaha hay’adaha dowladda Soomaaliya, isagoo shaaca ka qaaday in dhawaan laga gudbi doono nidaamka qabiilka ku saleysan ee shaqaaleysiinta, isagoo ku dhawaaqay barnaamij cusub oo shaqaalaha dowladda lagu qaadan doono aqoontooda, kartidooda iyo u-qalmitaankooda shaqada markaas loo xulanayo. “Qofka raba shaqada dowladda waa inuu ku helo aqoontiisa iyo awoodiisa ee uusan ku helin yaa qaraabo tihiin ama ii melee. Yaa taqaan inaan ka gudubno oo maxaa taqaanaa u gudubno ayaan rabnaa?,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynuhu. items.title: Sacuudiga oo hakiyey howlihii dhuumaha shidaalka ee Bariga-galbeed ka dib weerarii loo geystay
items.description: Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqday inay si ka hortag ah u hakisay hawlgallada dhuumaha shidaalka ee ka soo bilaabma Gobolka Bari kuna socda xeebta galbeed, kaddib markii Khamiistii lala beegsaday “weerarro dhowr ah,” kuwaas oo ay markii dambe sheegtay inay ka yimaadeen diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn oo laga soo qaaday Ciraaq. Talaabooyinkan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli ay sii kordhayaan xiisadaha u dhexeeya Riyaad iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa Xuutiyiinta ee Yemen. Wakaaladda Wararka Sacuudiga ee SPA, ayaa soo xigatay ilo ka tirsan Wasaaradda Tamarta oo sheegay in “dhuumaha shidaalka Bariga-Galbeed ee gobollada Riyaad iyo Madiina ay Khamiistii subaxnimadii, Sebtembar 10, 2026, la kulmeen weerarro dhowr ah, waxaana dhuumaha loo xiray si taxaddar ah, weerarraduna waxay sababeen dhaawacyo qaar ah.” Dhanka kale, wasaaradda arrimaha dibadda ee Sacuudiga ayaa cambaareysay weerarka ay fuliyeen dhowr diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn oo “ka soo baxay dhulka Ciraaq,” kaas oo sababay khasaare nafeed iyo mid hantiyeed , sida lagu sheegay bayaan ay wasaaraddu soo saartay.

items.title: Xuutiyiinta Yemen oo sheegay in ay la wareegeen dhul kihiim ah
items.description: Xuutiyiinta oo ku dhawaaqay inay la wareegeen lix degmo oo ku yaalla Taiz iyo Xudayda Afhayeenka milatariga Xuutiyiinta, Yaxya Sariic, ayaa sheegay in howlgalkii ay kooxdu billowday 3-dii Sebtembar uu ka dhacay lix degmo oo ku yaalla gobollada Taiz iyo Xudayda, iyadoo guud ahaan masaafada dhulkaas uu gaarayay 5,400 kiiloomitir oo laba jibbaaran. Wuxuu intaas ku daray, isagoo hadalkiisa ka jeediyay telefishanka Al-Masiirah, kaas oo ay la socotay waaxda kormeerka warbaahinta ee BBC, in howlgalku bartilmaameedsaday toddobo qaybood oo milatari, kuwaas oo ka koobnaa 38 guuto oo ka tirsan ciidamada dowladda ee Sacuudigu taageero. Sida uu sheegay Sariic, dagaalladu waxay sababeen in boqolaal ka tirsan ciidamadaas la dilo, la dhaawaco ama la qabto. Sariic wuxuu sheegay in ciidamada Xuutiyiintu ay intii uu dagaalku socday fuliyeen 32 hawlgal oo ka dhan ah diyaaradaha Sacuudiga, ayna soo rideen sagaal diyaaradood. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in Xuutiyiintu ay sii daayeen tiro aan la cayimin oo maxaabiis ah oo ay ka hayeen ciidamada dowladda.

items.title: Sacuudiga oo xiray dhuumaha muhiimka ah ee shidaalka kadib weerar diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn loo adeegsaday
items.description: Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa si ku-meel-gaar ah u xirtay East-West Pipeline , oo ah dhuumaha shidaalka ee muhiimka u ah dhoofinta saliidda dalka, kadib markii dhowr diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn lagu weeraray qaybo ka mid ah dhuumahaas. Riyadh ayaa sheegtay in diyaaradaha weerarka geystay ay ka yimaadeen dhulka Ciraaq, ayadoo Weerarku uu ka dhacay deegaannada Riyadh iyo Madiina , waxaana la sheegay inay jiraan dhaawacyo iyo burbur soo gaaray kaabayaasha dhuumaha. Wasaaradda Tamarta Sacuudiga ayaa sheegtay in xiritaanka dhuumaha uu yahay tallaabo taxaddar ah , iyadoo kooxaha farsamada iyo gurmadka ay qiimeynayaan khasaaraha. East-West Pipeline, oo dhererkiisu yahay qiyaastii 1,200 kiiloomitir, wuxuu isku xiraa goobaha saliidda laga soo saaro ee bariga Sacuudiga iyo dekedda Yanbu ee ku taalla Badda Cas. Muhiimadda dhuumahan ayaa si weyn u korortay kadib markii dagaalka gobolka uu sababay in maraakiibta shidaalka ay si weyn ugu adkaato inay maraan Marinka Hormuz . Dhuumahan ayaa Sacuudiga u saamaxaya inuu saliidda u gudbiyo Badda Cas, kadibna halkaas uga dhoofiyo suuqyada caalamka, isaga oo aan ku tiirsanaan marin-biyoodka Hormuz. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in dhuumuhu qaadi karaan malaayiin fuusto oo saliid ah maalintii, iyadoo isticmaalka dhuumaha uu kordhay xilli maraakiibta maraysa Hormuz ay aad hoos ugu dhaceen. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Sacuudiga ayaa si adag u cambaareysay weerarka, balse waxay sheegtay in aysan xilligan ka jawaabayn militari ahaan, kadib codsi ka yimid Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Ciraaq oo doonaya in dowladda Ciraaq loo daayo fursad ay ku baarto cidda ka dambeysay weerarka. Ciraaq ayaa dhankeeda cambaareysay weerarka, waxayna bilowday baaritaan lagu raadinayo kooxihii ka dambeeyay, wararka ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in Ciraaq ay tallaabooyin amni qaaday, iyadoo xilka laga qaaday taliye milatari kadib markii la sheegay in weerarku ka soo bilowday dhulka Ciraaq. Weerarkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiisadaha gobolka ay sii xoogeysanayaan, dhinaca Yemen, Xuutiyiinta oo xiriir dhow la leh Iiraan ayaa cadaadis ku kordhiyay maraakiibta iyo marinnada ganacsi ee Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab, wuxuuna Sacuudigu hadda wajahayaa xaalad adag oo dhinaca dhoofinta shidaalka ah maadaama uu Hormuz oo khatar ku jiro, halka waddada kale ee Badda Casna ay gacanta u gashay kooxda Xuutiyiinta.

items.title: Markab ku gooshayay calanka Soomaaliya oo lagu weeraray xeebaha Ukraine
items.description: Markabka lagu  magacaabo TEDY , oo ka diiwaangashan Soomaaliya kuna socda calanka , ayaa lagu weeraray meel u dhow dekedda Odesa ee Badda Madow, sida ay werisay shabakadda Euronews. Weerarka ayaa sababay dhimashada laba shaqaale oo u dhashay Azerbaijan, halka laba kale ay dhaawacmeen oo isbitaal la dhigay. Markabka TEDY waxaa iska leh oo maamusha shirkadda Turkiga ah Mert Marine Corporation, waxaana wararka la helay dhacdadani ay sheegayaan in markabka uu markii hore weerar diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn kula kulmay meel u dhow Odesa, kaddibna laba weerar oo kale lala beegsaday xilli uu u sii socday dekedda Constanța ee Romania. Dadka ku dhintay weerarka ayaa lagu kala magacaabay Aslan Aliyev iyo Asim Gasimov , halka Imran Novruzov iyo Rauf Aliyev ay dhaawacyo yihiin, gaar ahaan gubasho, soo gaartay. Markabka waxaa saarnaa 10 shaqaale ah oo dhalashooyin kala duwan haysta, waxayna Dowladda Ukraine sheegtay in weerarka uu geystay Ruushku , iyadoo ku tilmaantay weerar lagu qaaday maraakiib ganacsi oo rayid ah. Dhanka kale, Wasaaradda Difaaca Ruushka waxay sheegtay inay beegsatay maraakiib u socday Odesa, iyadoo ku andacootay in ay wadeen sahay militari. Dhacdadan waxay si gaar ah muhiim ugu tahay Soomaaliya, maadaama TEDY uu ku socday calanka Soomaaliya, waxaana s ida ku cad Xeerka Qaramada Midoobay ee Sharciga Badda (UNCLOS), markabka calan dal wata uu leeyahay dhalashada dalka uu calankiisa sito, waxaana dalka calanka leh saaran waajibaadyo ay ka mid yihiin diiwaangelinta markabka iyo awoodda maamul ee dhinacyada maamulka, farsamada iyo arrimaha bulshada oo ay ku jirto Difaaca bdeqabkiisu. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Soomaaliya maadaama ay tahay dalka uu markabkani ka diiwaangashan yahay waxay leedahay kaalin muhiim ah oo ku saabsan ilaalinta danaha markabka, baaritaanka dhacdada iyo la shaqaynta dowladaha kale ee ay arrintu khusayso.

items.title: Cirro oo booqday qabuuraha dhibanayaasha weerarkii 9/11
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) -Madaxweynaha Somaliland Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi (Cirro) ayaa maanta booqday National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial ee dalka Maraykanka, oo ah goobaha lagu xuso dadkii ku naf waayey weerarradii argagixiso ee dhacay 11-kii Sebtembar, 2001. Cabdiraxmaan Cirro ayaa intii uu ku sugnaa goobta xusuusta ku maamuusay 184 qof oo ku dhintay weerarkii lagu qaaday Pentagon-ka, isagoo muujiyay xushmad iyo tacsida uu u hayo dhibbanayaashii iyo qoysaskoodii. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Somaliland, iyadoo laga joogo 25 sano weerarradii 9/11, ay weli xasuusan tahay dadkii ku naf waayey weerarradaasi, isla markaana ay garab taagan tahay shacabka iyo dowladda Maraykanka. Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay mowqifka Somaliland ee ku aaddan la dagaallanka argagixisada, isaga oo sheegay in Somaliland ay taageersan tahay dadaallada caalamiga ah ee looga hortagayo kooxaha iyo falalka argagixisada. Booqashadaan ayaa xambaarsan farriin siyaasadeed iyo mid bani’aadamnimo, iyadoo Madaxweynuhu xusay dhibbanayaashii weerarrada, isla markaana muujiyay in Somaliland ay taageersan tahay dadaallada caalamiga ah ee ka dhanka ah argagixisada. Farriinta Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa mid muujinaysa doonista Somaliland ee ku aaddan xoojinta xiriirka ay la leedahay Maraykanka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah. items.title: Dagaal laba beelood ku dhexnmaray magaaladda Badhan
items.description: Wararka ka imaanaya magaalada Badhan ee gobolka Sanaag ayaa sheegaya in halkaasi uu ka dhacay dagaal u dhexeeya laba beelood oo muddo ku dhow sannad iyo bar uu khilaaf iyo dirir u dhexaysay. Dagaalka ayaa la isku adeegsaday hub noocyo kala duwan ah, iyadoo madaafiic iyo hub culus laga maqlayay qaybo ka mid ah xaafadaha magaalada. Wararka hordhaca ah ayaa sheegaya in dagaalka uu sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac, balse weli lama xaqiijin tirada rasmiga ah ee khasaaraha ka dhashay. Xaaladda ayaa weli kacsan, waxaana jira walaac laga qabo in dagaalku mar kale qarxo haddii aan si degdeg ah loo kala dhexgelin labada dhinac. Colaadda labada dhinac ayaa muddooyinkii dambe ka soo cusboonaatay deegaanno ka tirsan miyiga gobolka Sanaag, iyadoo ay jireen dadaallo kala duwan oo lagu doonayay in lagu soo afjaro khilaafka. Hase yeeshee, ilaa hadda ma jirto heshiis rasmi ah oo si buuxda u soo afjaray colaadda. Ciidamo ka tirsan Puntland oo ku sugnaa xerada tababarka General Giriin ayaa la sheegay inay dib uga baxeen xeradooda tababarka, kaddib markii ay ka baqeen in ay waxyeello ka soo gaadho dagaallada.

items.title: From Somali Refugee to Labour Candidate: Sagal Abdi-Wali’s Remarkable Journey to Parliament
items.description: London (WDN) — In a remarkable story of resilience, opportunity and public service, the British Labour Party has selected Sagal Abdi-Wali, a Somali woman who arrived in Britain as a refugee as a child, as its candidate for the forthcoming by-election in Holborn and St Pancras. The by-election is scheduled for October 8, following the resignation of former Prime Minister Keir Starmer as the constituency’s Member of Parliament on September 1. Starmer had represented the seat since 2015. Sagal’s selection represents a remarkable milestone—not only in her personal journey, but also in the story of a Somali refugee who has risen through local public service to become a leading political figure in the very community that welcomed her family decades ago. She has lived in Camden for nearly 35 years and currently serves as Leader of Camden Council. First elected as a councillor in 2022, she became council leader in May 2026, making history as the first Black woman to hold the position. From Refugee to Community Leader Sagal’s family fled Somalia when she was a child and arrived in Britain as refugees in the early 1990s. Camden became their new home, providing the family with safety, shelter and an opportunity to rebuild their lives. “This place welcomed my family as refugees and gave us hope when we needed it most,” Sagal said. Those words now carry particular significance. The young refugee who once arrived seeking safety could soon return to the same community as its prospective representative in the British Parliament. Before entering elected politics, Sagal spent years working in community and charitable organizations and was involved in school governance. She also previously led the Labour Party organization in Holborn and St Pancras, building a long-standing relationship with the constituency. Her political career has therefore grown from years of community engagement rather than a sudden entry into public life. A Historic Opportunity If elected on October 8, Sagal would represent in Parliament the same Camden community that helped give her family a new beginning after they fled Somalia. Her story offers a powerful illustration of what political inclusion and opportunity can mean for refugee families. It is also a reminder that migration can produce not only people seeking refuge, but future community leaders, public servants and elected representatives. Sagal’s candidacy has already attracted political attention, including controversy over her background after Reform UK figure Zia Yusuf referred on social media to her being born in Somalia. But the central political contest will ultimately be decided by voters in Holborn and St Pancras. The Green Party is expected to mount a strong challenge for the seat, making the by-election a competitive contest. For the Somali community in Britain, however, Sagal’s candidacy carries a significance that extends beyond one constituency. A Somali refugee child arrived in Britain seeking safety. Three decades later, she is seeking a seat in the Parliament of the country that gave her family a new home. If voters elect her, Sagal Abdi-Wali’s journey from refugee to council leader—and potentially to Member of Parliament—will stand as a remarkable story of resilience, integration and public service. items.title: When Clan Becomes a Death Sentence: Somalia Must End Collective Punishment
items.description: By Abdisalam Ali Farah (Biligsey ) A person who grows up in a society where government, police and courts function properly would struggle to understand how an innocent man could be killed because two clans fought somewhere else. Yet in parts of Somalia where state authority remains weak, a person’s clan identity can still become a death sentence. Two Victims, One Dangerous Pattern The recent killings of Ahmed Shire Hussein, a Somali National Army soldier near Ceel Baraf in Middle Shabelle, and Ahmed Yusuf Haamey, a respected businessman and community elder in Gaalkayo, illustrate the human cost of collective revenge. Ahmed Shire was reportedly travelling toward Hiiraan while on leave when armed men intercepted him and two other soldiers. The other two were reportedly released, while Ahmed was killed. A video reportedly shows him pleading for his life and explaining that he was ill and travelling to see his family. Local reports have linked the killing to clan revenge, although the motive and responsibility remain unverified. Days earlier, Ahmed Yusuf Haamey was reportedly shot dead in Gaalkayo while on his way to evening prayers. Local reports have also linked his killing to clan revenge, although authorities have not confirmed the motive. The circumstances of both killings raise the same disturbing question: How can a person become a target for something he did not do? The answer lies in the dangerous logic of collective punishment—when an individual is targeted not because of his own actions, but because of his identity or association with a particular community. I remember living in Gaalkayo in the late 1990s, when clan disputes could quickly turn ordinary citizens into potential targets. When killings occurred, respected members of the affected communities—including doctors, engineers, intellectuals, businessmen and traditional elders—were sometimes placed under protection in hotels while elders negotiated settlements. They had committed no crime. Their only vulnerability was their association with the community involved in the conflict. That experience demonstrated a basic truth that remains relevant today: a clan is not an individual, and one person’s actions cannot make another person guilty. When justice gives way to revenge, the question changes from “Who committed the crime?” to “Who can we kill from the other clan?” That is not justice. It is collective punishment. The Most Dangerous Form of Revenge The practice becomes even more destructive when respected members of a community are deliberately targeted because their deaths are expected to cause greater pain. A doctor, engineer, teacher, businessman, intellectual, elder or community leader may have nothing to do with the original dispute. Yet his status can make him a more valuable target for those seeking retaliation. The objective is no longer accountability. It is intimidation, humiliation and revenge. The killing of Ahmed Yusuf Haamey is particularly painful because he was reportedly a respected businessman and community figure who was on his way to pray when he was attacked. He never reached the mosque. The reported killing of Ahmed Shire Hussein is equally disturbing. Although he was a soldier, reports indicate that he was travelling on leave and away from his military duties when he was intercepted. Whatever investigations ultimately establish, neither death should become justification for another. One innocent death cannot justify another. Islam Rejects Collective Guilt For Somali society, there is also a powerful religious principle that should guide the response to this problem: “No bearer of burdens shall bear the burden of another.” The principle is straightforward. If one man commits murder, his brother is not the murderer. His neighbor is not the murderer. His clan member is not the murderer. The perpetrator must answer for his own actions. This principle should be central to Somalia’s efforts to rebuild justice, social cohesion and the rule of law. A Responsibility for Scholars and Elders Somali religious scholars have demonstrated that they can influence deeply rooted social practices. Their campaigns against harmful traditions, including female genital mutilation, have helped change public attitudes. They now face another important responsibility. They should speak with the same clarity against the killing of war-ma-qabto—people who have nothing to do with the dispute for which they are being punished. Traditional elders have an equally important role. The constructive elements of xeer—mediation, compensation, reconciliation and dialogue—should be strengthened. But traditional authority must never become a justification for killing innocent people. Elders should make one principle unmistakable: If you know who committed the crime, pursue the perpetrator. Do not manufacture another victim. The State Must Restore Individual Protection Ultimately, the long-term solution requires a functioning state. Where police cannot protect citizens, courts cannot reliably prosecute criminals and government authority does not extend effectively into communities, people naturally fall back on clan protection. That is how collective punishment survives. Somalia’s state-building challenge is therefore not simply about ministries, elections and security forces. It is also about restoring something much more basic: the individual’s right to live without being punished for somebody else’s actions. The government must investigate the killings of Ahmed Shire Hussein and Ahmed Yusuf Haamey and bring those responsible to justice. Neither case should be allowed to trigger another cycle of revenge. The same responsibility falls on traditional elders, religious scholars and community leaders. They must reject the logic that says: “Someone from our clan was killed, therefore someone from their clan must die.” That logic has no place in a society trying to rebuild a state. From Collective Revenge to Individual Justice Somalia cannot permanently escape clan violence while collective guilt remains socially acceptable. The question must change. Not: “Who should we kill from Clan X?” But: “Who committed the crime?” That is the difference between revenge and justice. The deaths in Middle Shabelle and Gaalkayo should not become merely two more names added to Somalia’s long list of victims. They should be a warning that the country cannot build lasting peace while innocent people remain vulnerable to crimes committed by others. Let the perpetrator answer for the crime. Let the innocent live. That is not only the foundation of the rule of law. It is the foundation of a society worthy of peace. items.title: Israel Backs Ethiopia’s Bid for Red Sea Access, Raising New Regional Questions
items.description: ADDIS ABABA (WDN) — Israel has publicly backed Ethiopia’s long-running efforts to secure direct access to the Red Sea, marking a significant diplomatic development in a dispute that could reshape political and security dynamics across the Horn of Africa. Israel’s ambassador to Ethiopia, Avraham Neguise, said support for Ethiopia’s pursuit of maritime access was part of Israel’s official policy. He argued that Ethiopia’s access to the sea was not only an economic issue but also a matter of regional security, given the strategic importance of the Red Sea and its surrounding waterways. Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed, speaking during celebrations marking the country’s New Year, said Ethiopia’s campaign to secure maritime access had received international support, an apparent reference to Israel’s position. Ethiopia has sought reliable access to the sea for years, particularly since becoming landlocked following Eritrea’s independence in 1993. But the latest Israeli endorsement raises questions about where Addis Ababa may ultimately seek that access. It remains unclear whether Ethiopia’s long-term options will involve Somalia, Somaliland, Djibouti or Eritrea, and no new agreement determining a specific route has been confirmed. The issue is particularly sensitive for Somalia, which has strongly opposed arrangements it believes could undermine its sovereignty and territorial integrity. Israel’s intervention therefore comes at a delicate moment for the region, as competition over the Red Sea, the Gulf of Aden and strategically located ports continues to intensify. The question now facing the Horn of Africa is not simply whether Ethiopia will secure maritime access, but where that access will be established and whether it can be achieved through agreements that respect the sovereignty and interests of neighboring states. This version keeps the story short while making the Israeli endorsement, Ethiopia’s response and the unresolved regional implications the central news points. items.title: Somaliland Opposition Condemns Cirro’s Gaza Troop Proposal as Political Backlash Grows
items.description: Washington (WDN) — Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi (Cirro) has triggered a political backlash after saying Somaliland could deploy up to 2,000 troops to Gaza if formally requested by the United States and Israel. Cirro made the remarks Wednesday in Washington while attending the MEAD conference, saying Somaliland was not volunteering to send forces to Gaza but would be prepared to contribute troops if Washington and Israel formally requested it. “If we are asked, we can provide them,” Cirro said, according to reports. “We are not putting ourselves forward, but if I am asked, I am ready.” The proposal has drawn strong criticism from Somaliland’s opposition parties, with several political groups condemning the idea and questioning the wisdom of involving Somaliland’s military in an international force for Gaza. Among the parties opposing the proposal is the Kaah Party, which has joined the broader political criticism of the government’s position. The opposition argues that Somaliland should not commit its soldiers to a foreign military mission without a clear national consensus, particularly one involving the highly sensitive Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Opposition Challenges the Government The backlash highlights a growing divide within Somaliland over the direction of President Cirro’s foreign and security policy. Opposition parties have questioned whether the government has the political mandate to make such a far-reaching military commitment, arguing that the deployment of Somaliland troops abroad would require careful public debate and broad political consultation. For critics, the issue is not simply whether Somaliland has soldiers available. It is why Somaliland should send them to Gaza, under whose command they would operate, what their mandate would be, and what political and security consequences Somaliland could face as a result. The criticism is particularly significant because Cirro’s proposal comes at a sensitive moment in Somaliland’s expanding relationship with Israel. A New Chapter in Somaliland-Israel Relations Somaliland has taken several steps to deepen its relationship with Israel. The government reportedly opened a diplomatic mission in Jerusalem in June, following Cirro’s official visit to Israel. Those moves have generated considerable debate within Somaliland and across the wider Somali political landscape. The relationship became even more consequential following Israel’s reported recognition of Somaliland in December 2025, a development that Somaliland has viewed as an important diplomatic breakthrough in its long campaign for international recognition. Cirro’s Gaza proposal could therefore be interpreted by critics as another step toward closer strategic alignment with Israel and the United States. The government, however, appears to view closer international partnerships as an opportunity to enhance Somaliland’s diplomatic position and increase its strategic relevance. The proposed international force for Gaza is expected to involve as many as 20,000 troops, according to reports. Uganda has reportedly agreed to contribute approximately 1,200 personnel, while Morocco has pledged up to 500. Albania, Kazakhstan and Kosovo have also reportedly expressed willingness to contribute troops to the U.S.-led force. The proposed mission would reportedly focus on maintaining security, supporting the training of Palestinian police forces, facilitating humanitarian assistance and preventing Hamas from rebuilding its military capabilities. For Somaliland, participation would represent a significant departure from its traditional security role. Its military has primarily focused on territorial security and maintaining control within Somaliland. items.title: Sawirro: Xasan Sheekh oo madaxtooyadda ku qaabilay Xoghayaha guud ee…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa Qasriga Madaxtooyada Qaranka ku qaabilay Xoghayaha Guud ee Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka ahna Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Culimada Muslimiinta, Dr. Mohammed bin Abdulkarim Al-Issa. Kulanka labada dhinac ayaa looga hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka, iyadoo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray arrimaha khuseeya bulshada iyo horumarinta fahamka saxda ah ee Diinta Islaamka. Madaxweynaha iyo Xoghayaha Guud ayaa sidoo kale ka wada-hadlay dadaallada lagu xoojinayo nabadda, wadajirka iyo wada noolaanshaha bulshada iyo sidii loo horumarin lahaa doorka hay’adaha diinta ee arrimaha bulshada. Qodobada kulanka lagu soo qaaday waxaa kamid ahaa ka hortagga iyo la-dagaallanka fikirka xagjirka ah, iyadoo la adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la helo wacyigelin iyo faham diini ah oo sax ah. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa uga mahadceliyay Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka mowqifkeeda ku aaddan taageerada midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya, iyo sidoo kale doorka ay ka qaadato horumarinta bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha ayaa adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo iskaashiga dhinacyada dowladda iyo hay’adaha diinta, si wax looga qabto caqabadaha la xiriira fikirka xagjirka ah iyo marin-habaabinta dhalinyarada. Kulanka ayaa kusoo dhammaaday is-afgarad ku aaddan sii xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Raabidada Caalamka Islaamka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada nabadda, wacyigelinta bulshada iyo ka hortagga fikradaha xagjirka ah. items.title: Xuutiyiinta oo gaaray Perim, qabsadayna Dhubab
items.description: Xoogagga Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa gaaray jasiiradda istaraatiijiga ah ee Perim, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Mayun, kuna taalla marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Afar ilo oo ka tirsan dowladda Yemen ayaa arrintan u xaqiijiyey Reuters⁠ Laba ilo oo kale oo ka tirsan dowladda Yemen ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiintu la wareegeen magaalada xeebta ah ee Dhubab, kaddib markii ciidamada dowladda ay halkaas ka baxeen. Dhubab iyo Perim ayaa ku yaalla meel istaraatiiji ah oo u dhow halka ay Badda Cas kaga biirto Gacanka Cadmeed. Horumarkan ayaa xoojinaya joogitaanka Xuutiyiinta ee xeebta galbeed ee Yemen, kaddib markii ay hore ula wareegeen magaalada dekedda leh ee Mocha. Warbixintii hore waxay sheegashada ku saabsan Mayun ku tilmaantay mid aan si madax-bannaan loo xaqiijin, balse Reuters ayaa hadda heshay xaqiijin ka timid ilo badan. Ciidamada dowladda Yemen ee Sacuudigu taageero ayaa sheegay inay diyaarinayaan weerar rogaal-celis ah oo lagu soo ceshanayo deegaannadii laga baxay. Faahfaahin rasmi ah lagama bixin waqtiga uu weerarku bilaabanayo, ciidamada ka qaybgelaya iyo taageerada militari ee ay heli doonaan. Perim waxay dhexda kaga taallaa Bab al-Mandab, waana goob muhiim u ah la socodka maraakiibta isaga kala goosha Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Si kastaba, gaaritaanka jasiiradda iyo qabsashada Dhubab macnaheedu ma aha in Xuutiyiintu si buuxda ula wareegeen marin-biyoodka, mana aysan soo bandhigin caddeyn muujinaysa inay xakameynayaan dhammaan isu-socodkiisa. Isbeddelkan cusub wuxuu sare u qaadayaa khatarta ku wajahan maraakiibta caalamiga ah iyo dalalka ku teedsan Gacanka Cadmeed, oo Soomaaliya ay ku jirto. Dagaal ka qarxa Bab al-Mandab wuxuu saameyn ku yeelan karaa ganacsiga, qiimaha shidaalka iyo ammaanka xeebaha gobolka.

items.title: Muqdisho: 40 Arday oo Lagu Maamuusay Cilmi-Baaris Lagu Daabacay Joornaallo Caalami ah
items.description: MUQDISHO (Goobjoog News) — Afartan arday oo Soomaaliyeed ayaa shalay oo Khamiis ahayd lagu maamuusay Madashii koowaad ee Cilmi-baarista iyo Hal-abuurka Soomaaliyeed, kaddib markii qoraallo cilmi-baaris ah oo ay ka diyaariyeen xaaladda dalka lagu daabacay joornaallo caalami ah oo la aqoonsan yahay. Munaasabaddan oo ka dhacday xarunta Jaamacadda Ummadda Soomaaliyeed ee magaalada Muqdisho, ayaa waxaa soo qabanqaabiyay xarunta Benaadir Research, Consultancy and Evaluation Center, waxaana ka qaybgalay bahda waxbarashada oo ay ku jiraan mas’uuliyiin ka socday Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, hoggaanka jaamacadaha, cilmi-baarayaal sar-sare, iyo ardayda wax ka barata dalka. Qabanqaabiyeyaasha madasha ayaa sheegay in qorshahani uu yahay mid sannadle ah oo lagu dhiirrigelinayo da’yarta aqoonta ku foogan, si kor loogu qaado tayada cilmi-baarista dalka iyo doorka ay ardaydu ku leeyihiin xallinta caqabadaha horyaalla bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Inkastoo madashu ahayd mid muhiimad weyn leh, haddana warbixinta laguma xusin magacyada 40-ka arday ee la abaalmariyay, noocyada joornaallada caalamiga ah ee lagu daabacay qoraalladooda, iyo hab-raacii loo maray qiimeynta tayada cilmi-baaristooda.

items.title: Breakaway Somaliland opens door to Israeli military presence
items.description: Washington (Somalia Today) — The leader of Somalia’s breakaway Somaliland region has said he would welcome a future Israeli military presence on the territory, arguing that closer security cooperation could provide protection and strengthen deterrence. “There is no Israeli security presence in Somaliland yet, but perhaps there will be one in the future,” Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro told Yedioth Ahronoth during a visit to Washington. “We will cooperate with any friendly country, and we need security partners, including Israel,” he said. “If Israel is present, it will provide deterrence. We need protection. I do not rule out Israel or the United States establishing a presence here.” Irro said the possibility had not yet been formally discussed with Israel, despite reports cited by Yedioth Ahronoth that Israeli security officials had already visited Somaliland. His remarks go further than previous statements by Somaliland officials, who had acknowledged growing military cooperation with Israel while denying that talks were under way over establishing an Israeli base. Security ties expand Somaliland Defence Minister Mohamed Yusuf Ali told Reuters in June that Israel was providing training to police and military personnel in the breakaway region, but dismissed reports of negotiations over a military base as rumours. “There is no Israeli military presence or military bases in Somaliland,” Ali said at the time. Irro had also told Reuters earlier this year that Somaliland wanted to develop military cooperation with Israel, but said the two sides had not discussed establishing Israeli bases. Relations have expanded rapidly since Israel formally recognised Somaliland on December 26, 2025, becoming the first UN member state to do so. Somalia rejected the decision as a violation of its sovereignty and territorial integrity, while the African Union reaffirmed its position that Somaliland remains part of Somalia. Irro led a delegation to Israel in June as the two sides sought deeper cooperation in security, technology, agriculture and investment. He told Yedioth Ahronoth that Somaliland has about 25,000 soldiers and a coastguard of roughly 1,500 personnel, but said the region could benefit from additional military technology and training. “We have enough military strength to defend ourselves,” he said, “but perhaps we need technology and training.” Red Sea tensions Irro’s comments come as tensions increase across the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden, with Iran-aligned Houthi forces expanding their presence towards the strategic Bab al-Mandab Strait. Houthi forces captured Yemen’s Red Sea port city of Mocha on Thursday and advanced towards the Hanish Islands, strengthening their position near the narrow waterway separating Yemen from the Horn of Africa. The Bab al-Mandab connects the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden and forms a critical maritime route for ships travelling between Europe and Asia. Somaliland lies directly across the Gulf of Aden from Yemen, while its port and airfield at Berbera have increasingly featured in discussions about possible Western and Israeli security operations in the region. Irro said, however, that Somaliland currently had no direct confrontation with the Houthis. “We have been neighbours with Yemen and the Houthis for thousands of years, and as a country we currently have no direct conflict with them,” he told Yedioth Ahronoth . The possibility of an Israeli military presence has drawn particular scrutiny because of Somaliland’s proximity to Yemen and the Bab al-Mandab. Somalia has repeatedly rejected foreign agreements involving Somaliland without the federal government’s approval, maintaining that the breakaway region remains part of Somali territory. Gaza troop offer Irro also told Yedioth Ahronoth that Somaliland would be prepared to contribute up to 2,000 soldiers to a planned international force expected to support security arrangements and demilitarisation in Gaza. The remarks follow his separate statement this week that the breakaway region was not volunteering troops but would respond positively if formally asked to contribute. Irro also rejected suggestions that closer relations with Israel included plans for Somaliland to receive Palestinians from Gaza, saying the issue was not relevant to the region. He said Israel’s recognition had opened opportunities for cooperation in security, trade and the economy, while acknowledging that the new relationship had also created political risks. “There are no free lunches,” Irro said. “We created enemies for ourselves because of the recognition, including Somalia and countries outside Africa that provide Somalia with weapons and intervene on the side of our rivals.” Irro accused foreign governments of providing Somalia with weapons and other military support, citing Turkish aircraft, and claimed Somali officials had threatened to invade Somaliland following Israel’s recognition. Yedioth Ahronoth reported the claims as part of its interview. Somalia Today could not independently verify them. Turkey is one of Somalia’s closest defence partners and operates a major military training facility in Mogadishu. Ankara has strongly opposed Israel’s recognition of Somaliland and continues to support Somalia’s sovereignty and territorial integrity. Israel remains the only UN member state to formally recognise Somaliland as independent. At the same time, Somalia and almost all other governments continue to regard the breakaway region as part of Somali territory. items.title: Israel backs Ethiopia’s Red Sea access push amid tensions
items.description: Addis Ababa (Somalia Today) — Israel has publicly backed Ethiopia’s push for access to the Red Sea, with its ambassador in Addis Ababa describing support for the effort as official Israeli policy and arguing that a stronger Ethiopian role could contribute to regional security. “Israel is behind Ethiopia in this effort. This is clear Israeli policy,” Ambassador Avraham Neguise told the state-run Ethiopian News Agency in an interview published on Thursday. Neguise said Israel viewed Ethiopia’s maritime ambitions as part of a wider question of economic and security stability around the Red Sea, rather than an issue affecting Addis Ababa alone. “Empowering and strengthening Ethiopia and creating stability in the Red Sea is the interest of all, not only for Ethiopia,” he said. The comments amount to unusually explicit Israeli support for a strategic objective that Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has increasingly placed at the centre of Ethiopia’s regional policy. Ethiopia has sought more reliable access to the sea to support its growing economy and international trade, while also arguing for a greater security role in the Red Sea. Neguise said access would help Ethiopia strengthen its economy, safeguard its sovereignty and contribute to regional security. He did not identify a particular port or say whether Israel supported commercial access, an Ethiopian naval facility or another arrangement. Security concerns around the route have intensified amid attacks by Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthis , which have disrupted commercial shipping and forced some vessels onto longer routes around southern Africa. He described Ethiopia as strategically important to the Horn of Africa and said greater maritime access could contribute to cooperation and stability across the region. “Ethiopia’s return to the Red Sea will be positive,” he said, citing the country’s involvement in peacekeeping and its stated commitment to regional stability. items.title: Daawo: Dabageed oo shaaciyay in Xasan Sheekh uga baxay heshiis hoose oo uu la galay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle, Yuusuf Axmed Hagar (Dabageed) ayaa Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku eedeeyay inuu uga baxay ballan siyaasadeed oo uu la galay. Dabageed oo sheegay in Madaxweynaha ay hore ugu heshiiyeen, uguna ballanqaaday inuu hoggaanka HirShabelle isaga siiyo ayaa sheegay in Xasan Sheekh uu hadda waxba kama jiraan kasoo qaaday ballankaas. Dabageed ayaa sheegay in xalay kulan albaabadu u xirnaayeen oo uu la yeeshay Xasan Sheekh uu ku wargeliyay in kursigii HirShabelle aan loo hayn, sidaas darteedna uu tanaasulo. “Madaxweynaha shalay markuu isoo wacay, waxaa u qabay laba qodob midkood: Madaxweynihii ayaa ku siinayaa ee reer HirShabelle ku hoggaami oo shaqadii la wareeg, ama inuu leeyahay waxaan ku ballannay waa shaqeyn waayay, oo nin kale oo Xawaadle ah oo ilma adeer tihiin ayaa kursigii la siiyay ee la shaqee ninkaas, sidaas ayuu ku dhihi islahaa hadduu adiga ku siin waayo,” ayuu yiri. Dabageed ayaa sheegay in Madaxweynuhu uu si cad ugu sheegay in xilka maamulka HirShabelle uu u wado Cali Guudlaawe, oo mar kale isku soo taagaya hoggaanka maamulka. “Madaxweynihii xalay waxaan kala kulmay wax uu nin fiyow oo ehel iyo mas’uul ah oo Madaxweyne Soomaaliyeed uu dhihi karo aanan u qabin. Ballankii reer abtigay waa ka baxay ee kursiga iiga doon, oo iga nabad doonee ayuu igu dhahay,” ayuu yiri Dabageed. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray: “Intee geyni baa dhahay haddaan kasoo helo oo doono. Cali Guudlaawe ayaa siin buu yiri. Madaxweynaha uma badin ee waxaan dhahay arrintaas kama nabad dooneyn karo, nin hadda iga dambeeya oo ka nabaddooneyn kara inuu jiro ilama aha. Raalli ahow, wax aan ka filanayay oo reer abtiga ka sugayeen ma aha, oo xaqoodi ma aha.” Inkastoo weli uusan jirin war rasmi ah oo kasoo baxay Villa Soomaaliya oo si cad u xaqiijinaya in heshiis kama dambeys ah laga gaaray musharraxa Madaxweynaha HirShabelle ama in Guudlaawe loo go’aamiyay inuu mar kale hoggaamiyo maamulka, haddana waxaa isa soo taraya wararka sheegay in Xasan uu kaarka JSP siinayo Guudlaawe, si mar kale loogu dhiso hoggaanka maamulka. Hoos ka daawo muuqaalka The post Daawo: Dabageed oo shaaciyay in Xasan Sheekh uga baxay heshiis hoose oo uu la galay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Taliska ciidanka xoogga oo qaaday tallaabo la xiriirta dhacdadii Ceelbaraf
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay inuu baaritaan ku hayo dilka askari ka tirsanaa ciidanka, kaas oo lagu dilay deegaanka Calaag ee degmada Ceelbaraf ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Taliska ayaa sheegay in marxuum Axmed Shire Xuseen xiliga la dilay uu fasax uga maqnaa shaqada ciidanka. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay taliska ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in baaritaanno ku aaddan dhacdada ay haatan socdaan, si loo xaqiijiyo faah-faahinta dilka iyo cid kasta oo ku lug lahayd. Taliska ciidanka xoogga ayaa sheegay in la qaadi doono tallaabooyin waafaqsan sharciga, marka la helo natiijada baaritaanka iyo cidda mas’uulka ka ahayd falka. Sidoo kale, Taliska ayaa tacsi u diray qoyska, ehelada iyo bahda ciidanka ee uu ka baxay marxuum Axmed Shire Xuseen. “Askarta Soomaaliyeed ay mudan yihiin in la dhowro noloshooda, sharaftooda iyo xuquuqdooda,” ayuu yiri taliska. Taliska ayaa adkeeyay in ciidanka xoogga uu yahay ciidan qaran oo u adeegaya dhammaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed, isla markaana ay muhiim tahay in la dhowro sharciga iyo xuquuqda askarta. Dilka askariga ayaa caro ka abuuray bulshada Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo falka lagu tilmaamay mid bahalnimo ah, waxaana lagu baaqay in caddaaladda la horkeeno cid kasta oo lagu helo inay ka dambeysay dilka. Axmed Shire ayaa maleeshiyaad hubeysan ay kala dageen mooto uu la socday, xilli uu kusii jeeday gobolka Hiiraan, kadibna ay sidaas ku toogteen. Ka hor inta aan la dilin askariga, maleeshiyaadka hubeysan oo u abaabulnaa hab beeleed ayaa muuqaal ka duubay marxuumka, iyadoo ehelladiisu ay sheegeen in jirkiisa uu googo’ay kadib markii jir-dil xooggan loo gaystay, taasoo sababtay in si dhib badan lagu aaso. Waa markii labaad oo dhacdo noocaan oo kale ah ay ka dhaceyso aagga Ceelbaraf, waxayna ay ahayd dhammaadkii bishii December ee 2024-kii markii sidaan oo kale aano qabiil darteed halkaas loogu dilay 7 askari oo ka tirsanaa Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, kana yimid dhanka furimaha hore. Askartaas oo fasax kasoo qaatay goobihii ay ka howl-galeen, kuna sii jeeday ehelladooda, ayaa waxaa gaari kala degay maleeshiyaad beeleed, kuwaas oo indhaha ka xiray, muuqaalna ka duubay, kadibna toogasho ku fuliyay. items.title: Xog: Gantaallada Xuutiyiinta iyo masaafooyinka ay gaari karaan
items.description: Sanca (Caasimada Online) – Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa muddooyinkii dambe soo bandhigay awood ciidan oo sii kordheysa, iyadoo kooxdii markii hore ahayd mid kooban ay hadda haysato hub iyo gantaallo kala duwan oo gaari kara masaafooyin fog. Awoodda Xuutiyiinta ayaa si gaar ah loo dareemay sannadihii lasoo dhaafay, kaddib markii ay bilaabeen inay adeegsadaan gantaallo iyo hub kale oo ay ku bartilmaameedsadaan goobo kala duwan. Hubka ay haystaan waxaa qeyb ka ah gantaallo ay soo saareen ama ay ka heleen dalal ay xiriir la leeyihiin, gaar ahaan Iran. Waxaa ka mid ah gantaallada ay adeegsadaan Scud Soviet B1C, kaas oo lagu qiyaaso inuu gaari karo masaafo dhan 300 kiiloomitir. Sidoo kale waxaa jira Hwasong-5 oo laga sameeyay Waqooyiga Kuuriya, kaas oo isna gaaraya ku dhowaad 300 kiiloomitir. Xuutiyiinta ayaa sidoo kale haysta Hwasong-6, oo la sheegay inuu gaari karo ilaa 600 kiiloomitir, halka Scarab Soviet 21 uu leeyahay masaafo lagu qiyaasay 70 kiiloomitir. Gantaalka Earthquake-3, oo lagu farsameeyo Iran, ayaa isna lagu sheegay inuu gaari karo qiyaastii 250 kiiloomitir. Waxaa kale oo liiska hubka Xuutiyiinta lagu xusay Qaher-1, oo asal ahaan kasoo jeeda nidaamyadii Midowgii Soofiyeeti, waxaana lagu qiyaasaa inuu gaaro masaafo dhan 250 kiiloomitir. Sidoo kale waxaa jira gantaalka C802, oo ah hub Shiine ah, kaas oo lagu sheegay inuu gaari karo masaafo u dhexeysa 120 iyo 180 kiiloomitir. Dhanka awoodda badda, Xuutiyiinta ayaa lagu xusay gantaallo ay kamid yihiin Mandab-1, oo lagu sheegay inuu yahay gantaal Shiine ah oo gaari kara 40 kiiloomitir, iyo Mandab-2, oo la xiriira Iran, kaas oo lagu qiyaasay inuu gaaro 250 kiiloomitir. Sidoo kale waxaa liiska ku jira Shaale, oo lagu sheegay inuu yahay gantaal laga sameeyo Iran, isla markaana gaara 180 kiiloomitir, iyo Rubies Soviet, oo masaafo ahaan lagu qiyaasay 80 kiiloomitir. Gantaallo kale oo loo aaneynayo hubka Xuutiyiinta waxaa kamid ah Quddus, oo lagu sheegay inuu Iran farsamayso, isla markaana gaari kara ilaa 800 kiiloomitir, iyo Duufaan, oo isna lala xiriiriyo Iran, iyadoo lagu qiyaasay inuu gaaro 450 kiiloomitir. Waxaa sidoo kale jira Fiyuus, oo lagu sheegay inuu gaaro 140 kiiloomitir, halka gantaalka loogu yeero Badda Cas la sheegay inuu kasoo jeedo Iran, balse aan si cad loo ogeyn masaafada uu gaari karo. Kala duwanaanshaha gantaalladan ayaa siinaya Xuutiyiinta awood ay ku gaaraan bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla masaafooyin kala duwan, iyadoo qaar kamid ah hubkan loogu talagalay weerarrada dhulka, halka kuwo kalena loo adeegsado bartilmaameedyada badda. Awooddan milatari ayaa Xuutiyiinta ka dhigtay koox saameyn weyn ku leh amniga gobolka, gaar ahaan marin-biyoodka Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab, halkaas oo dhaqdhaqaaqyada milatari iyo weerarrada maraakiibta ay walaac ka abuureen. Si kastaba, xogta ku saabsan qaar kamid ah gantaallada iyo halka ay ka yimaadeen ayaa ah mid ay ilo kala duwan si kala duwan u sheegaan. The post Xog: Gantaallada Xuutiyiinta iyo masaafooyinka ay gaari karaan appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Kala duwanaanshaha gantaalladan ayaa siinaya Xuutiyiinta awood ay ku gaaraan bartilmaameedyo ku yaalla masaafooyin kala duwan, iyadoo qaar kamid ah hubkan loogu talagalay weerarrada dhulka, halka kuwo kalena loo adeegsado bartilmaameedyada badda. Awooddan milatari ayaa Xuutiyiinta ka dhigtay koox saameyn weyn ku leh amniga gobolka, gaar ahaan marin-biyoodka Badda Cas iyo Bab al-Mandab, halkaas oo dhaqdhaqaaqyada milatari iyo weerarrada maraakiibta ay walaac ka abuureen. Si kastaba, xogta ku saabsan qaar kamid ah gantaallada iyo halka ay ka yimaadeen ayaa ah mid ay ilo kala duwan si kala duwan u sheegaan. The post Xog: Gantaallada Xuutiyiinta iyo masaafooyinka ay gaari karaan appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Retroactive pensions and the long-term financial burden on Local Governments
items.description: Retroactive pensions and the long-term financial burden on Local Governments If there were one mayor and one assistant for each of the 23 degmo doorasho in each of three terms, the basic number of beneficiaries would be: 23 areas × 3 terms × 2 people = 138 That is 138 people receiving pension benefits. Who decided 3 term Mayors and deputy mayors qualify for the pension and on what bases. For instance Burao changed Mayors this term three times then do they all deserve pension. Can Government avoid to pay such huge some yearly. Doesn’t this issue seem like a joke, although Xildhiban Cudhay said this filthy idea passed all levels but Somaliland should have clear legislation explaining: Who is eligible for a pension…. How many years of service are required…. Pension benefits should be earned through transparent rules. My two cent worth of advice to the government is a person should not automatically receive a pension merely because the title attached to the person’s position was “mayor.” The essence or the real meaning of a pension is financial security after retirement which is either for a long service or according to age.   Ahmed Saeed ahmsaeed@hotmail.com
