items.title: The Iran War Makes the Case for the United States to Recognize Somaliland
items.description: Center for International Maritime Security Alliances and Partners The Iran War Makes the Case for the United States to Recognize Somaliland September 7, 2026 Guest Author Leave a comment By Burhan Adam In December 2025, a journalist asked President Donald Trump whether the United States would recognize Somaliland, as Israel had just done. He answered with a single word: “No.” Then, as he often does, he tossed off a question of his own: “Does anyone even know what Somaliland is?” The jab landed partly because it’s fair – most Americans couldn’t say. But the answer now bears directly on a waterway the war with Iran has thrown into crisis. Somaliland is a stable, self-governing state that has held elections, each followed by a peaceful transfer of power, and kept the peace for thirty-five years. And of strategic significance, it sits on the southern approach to one of the two maritime chokepoints the war has put under strain. Officially recognizing Somaliland would be controversial. Somalia regards it as part of its territory, and nearly every member of the United Nations recognizes Somalia’s territorial integrity. But Somaliland reclaimed its sovereignty in 1991, after the collapse of the central Somali state, and has governed itself independently ever since. Israel was the first country to recognize it. However, recognizing Somaliland would be the single most strategic action Washington could take to secure maritime regional shipping for the long haul. Such an action would arguably be more useful than any individual base in the region for the purpose of ensuring the continued movement of shipping. The argument is straightforward. The war that began on 28 February 2026 has shown just how exposed America’s large, fixed bases near Iran really are, and the war’s dynamics are pushing the Pentagon toward a more dispersed approach built on access and reliable partners. But in that approach, strategic advantage isn’t gained by one more base. Any host can evict a tenant. However, recognition of Somaliland turns a temporary arrangement into a lasting one and closes a door that both Turkey and China are trying to hold open. For all the economic pressure and diplomatic pull coming from China, Turkey, and their partners, Somaliland has repeatedly chosen a strategic relationship with pro-Western democracies, as its formal ties with Taiwan and Israel show. Meetings with members of the Somaliland leadership in Hargeisa in March 2026 suggest this is a choice rooted in shared values, not merely transaction. Somaliland shows real institutional maturity: it keeps the peace at home, takes democratic governance seriously, and protects a real measure of free expression, which is not a small thing in its region. With instability rising across the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea, Somaliland offers the United States a stable, principled, and well-placed partner. Two Chokepoints, One Corridor The geography makes the point. The Strait of Hormuz and the Bab el-Mandeb are usually treated as separate chokepoints, but they are really the two ends of a single corridor, running from the Persian Gulf through Hormuz, across the Arabian Sea and the Gulf of Aden, through the Bab el-Mandeb and the Red Sea, and into the Mediterranean by way of the Suez Canal. Pressure at one end is felt along the whole length. For the first time, both ends are under strain at once. Hormuz normally handles about one-fifth of the world’s seaborne oil . After the United States and Israel struck Iran, Tehran declared the strait closed and began attacking any ship that tried to pass through it. The strait has been effectively closed since early March 2026, and by the reckoning of British parliamentary researchers, oil shipping from the Gulf has fallen by 95 percent . The Bab el-Mandeb was already choked. The Houthi attacks had pushed ships onto routes around Africa, cutting oil flows there from about 9.3 million barrels a day in 2023 to around 4 million . Hormuz decides how much Gulf oil reaches open water, while the Bab el-Mandeb decides whether Gulf oil can still take the short route to Europe. The system can usually absorb trouble at one end. It can’t absorb it at both. The War Broke the Base Model The war did more than disrupt shipping. It tested, under real conditions, the proposition that American power in the Gulf could rest on a handful of large bases near Iran, and that thesis failed. For weeks, Iranian drones and missiles hit radars, hangars, warehouses, and command centers across the Gulf. Consequently, the United States dispersed tens of thousands of troops rather than leave them concentrated where a single salvo could destroy masses of them in one blow. The officers who ran those bases got the message. As Mark Cancian of the Center for Strategic and International Studies put it, the war had shown how vulnerable all the fixed bases were . Retired General Frank McKenzie, who commanded American forces in the region from 2019 to 2022, was blunter, calling the forward headquarters in Qatar, about a hundred miles from Iran, a “monument to old thinking” and urging the military to move its bases west. A report on the Pentagon’s own deliberations describes exactly these changes: structural modifications at the Bahrain naval base , smaller facilities in Kuwait and Saudi Arabia, and hardened, dispersed sites farther from Iran’s reach. The rationale for change is simple. A base near Iran gives the United States a quick response time but places its forces inside the threat ring of most Iranian munitions. Forces and key platforms are easy to find and hard to protect. A fight stretching from the Gulf of Aden to the Red Sea is poorly served by a posture built for one corner of the Persian Gulf. The emphasis is shifting toward the far end of the corridor, and that is exactly where Somaliland sits. What Israel Saw On 26 December 2025, Israel became the first United Nations member state to officially recognize the Republic of Somaliland , signing a joint declaration in the spirit of the Abraham Accords and committing to exchange ambassadors. It wasn’t acting out of goodwill. Its ships had been under Houthi fire in the Red Sea for two years; it needed a reliable partner in the Gulf of Aden , and Somaliland had the coast. Somalia called the move illegal, and at the United Nations the Arab Group called it “null and void” . Recognition drew criticism. However, given the facts on the ground and the operational payoff, the decision remains strategically sound. To be clear, you don’t need to completely control the Bab el-Mandeb to influence events here, and no single country dominates it. Yemen sits on one side, Djibouti and Eritrea on the other. What you need is a stable position nearby, and Somaliland has one. Its anchor is the port and airfield at Berbera. During the Cold War, NASA leased the Berbera airfield, one of the longest runways in Africa , as an emergency landing site for the Space Shuttle, and United States Navy warships called at the port. Somaliland’s government has offered these facilities to the United States on several occasions. Compare that to Djibouti, which hosts America’s only permanent military base in Africa. The place is crowded. Five countries now keep permanent bases there: the United States, China, France, Japan, and Italy, and once you count smaller and secondary facilities, more than eight nations have some military presence in that small country at any given time. China’s base sits about seven miles from the American one and is built to hold thousands of troops. That kind of proximity constrains what the U.S. Joint Force can do and raises real operational security and counterintelligence concerns. It is part of why a willing partner at Berbera looks more attractive now, not less, and why the head of United States Africa Command and the American ambassador visited Somaliland in late 2025 . In August 2026, the commander of United States Special Operations Command Africa, Major General Claude Tudor, traveled to Hargeisa for talks focused on Red Sea and Gulf of Aden security. The Money is Already Moving Investors are already betting on Somaliland’s stability even though the world won’t say so out loud. DP World, the Dubai-based port operator, holds a thirty-year concession and has committed up to $442 million to expanding the port at Berbera. Ethiopia, landlocked and routing almost all its trade through Djibouti, has taken a 19 percent stake in the project. British International Investment reckons that by 2035 Berbera will handle trade worth close to a quarter of Somaliland’s economy . Ship turnaround times have subsequently fallen from sixty-four hours in 2018 to twenty-five by 2024. For Washington, the point is that recognition wouldn’t mean building an investment case out of nothing. It would mean reducing the risk for investors who have already committed, unlocking financing now held back by the unclear legal status, and giving the United States a real hand in shaping the most promising piece of friendly infrastructure on the corridor rather than standing on the sidelines. That is precisely the argument Somaliland’s president made at this year’s World Economic Forum in Davos . In addition, Somaliland’s value to its Western partners runs deeper than geography, a deep-water port, and an airfield. The territory is believed to hold significant deposits of critical minerals , among them lithium, chromium, nickel, and platinum-group metals, the inputs that matter for both the energy transition and defense technology. There may be oil, too: the British-led firm Genel Energy holds onshore exploration blocks , in partnership with Taiwan’s state oil company, that early seismic work suggests could hold billions of barrels. No commercial discovery has been confirmed yet. Fewer than twenty wells have ever been drilled in Somaliland, the last in 1989, but the long-term commercial and energy potential along this stretch of the Red Sea corridor is real. A Base Can Be Evicted, But a Partner Cannot None of this is a pitch for another base. A base is real estate you rent, and a landlord can evict you when the government changes, when circumstances shift, when a coup intervenes, as is mostly prevalent in Africa, or when someone makes a higher bid. Recognition, by contrast, secures the relationship. As long as Somaliland’s status remains undecided, that ambiguity is a liability: an unrecognized state has fewer options and weaker protections, leaving it exposed to pressure from outside powers. That is exactly what Turkey, working through Mogadishu, and China, working in the wider region, exploit for leverage. Settle the status, and most of that leverage disappears. The objection raised most often to proposals to recognize Somaliland is that this would set off a rush of secessions across Africa. It wouldn’t, because Somaliland isn’t seceding so much as restoring an independence it once had. British Somaliland became independent and was recognized by more than thirty countries in June 1960, for five days, before it voluntarily merged, with no binding treaty, into a union with the former Italian colony to its south. That unratified union broke apart in 1991 amid a war against a dictatorship whose campaign against the Isaaq clan killed tens of thousands , after which the central government collapsed. Recognizing Somaliland doesn’t draw a new border, but confirms a border that previously existed, and one that its people want to protect. South Sudan’s peaceful admission to the United Nations in 2011 shows the system can absorb that kind of change without the wave of copycat secessions that skeptics keep predicting. What Washington Should Do To maximize strategic advantage in this region, Washington should take the following actions in sequence. The State Department should open a representative office in Hargeisa, the capital of Somaliland, and stop treating stable Somaliland as part of volatile Somalia when it issues travel warnings. Congress should advance the Republic of Somaliland Independence Act , which the House Foreign Affairs Committee has held for the third Congress in a row. The Department of Defense should turn general interest into concrete action, cooperating with Somaliland on maritime monitoring and arranging contingency access at Berbera, so the relationship is in place before the next crisis rather than improvised during one. And the administration should treat diplomatic recognition of Somaliland as the destination all of these actions are aiming toward, not a reward left dangling. The obstacles are real. The international community is cautious, Somalia is pushing hard against any diplomatic overtures made toward Somaliland, and the U.S. president has already said “no” to the question of recognition. But a “no” in December 2025 need not last forever. The argument that recognition serves cold American interest, not just a preference for good governance, gets harder to dismiss the longer the corridor in the Gulf stays contested. The chokepoints are the symptom, but the region is the system. The big Gulf bases have just shown how vulnerable they are, and strategic inertia moves toward dispersal and partnership. In that setting, Somaliland offers something rare: a stable, democratic partner you can keep rather than rent, one whose own course is already making the argument. Israel has taken the step to seize the opportunities afforded by an official relationship with Somaliland. To best secure its regional interests, the U.S. should be the next country to do the same. Burhan Adam is the founder of Red Sea Meridian, a consultancy focused on national security and mission support in the Horn of Africa, the Red Sea region, and East Africa. He is a retired Department of Defense official with more than three decades of federal service. The views here are entirely his own. The Strait of Hormuz and the Bab el-Mandeb are usually treated as separate chokepoints, but they are really the two ends of a single corridor, running from the Persian Gulf through Hormuz, across the Arabian Sea and the Gulf of Aden, through the Bab el-Mandeb and the Red Sea, and into the Mediterranean by way of the Suez Canal. Pressure at one end is felt along the whole length. For the first time, both ends are under strain at once. Hormuz normally handles about one-fifth of the world’s seaborne oil . After the United States and Israel struck Iran, Tehran declared the strait closed and began attacking any ship that tried to pass through it. The strait has been effectively closed since early March 2026, and by the reckoning of British parliamentary researchers, oil shipping from the Gulf has fallen by 95 percent . The Bab el-Mandeb was already choked. The Houthi attacks had pushed ships onto routes around Africa, cutting oil flows there from about 9.3 million barrels a day in 2023 to around 4 million . Hormuz decides how much Gulf oil reaches open water, while the Bab el-Mandeb decides whether Gulf oil can still take the short route to Europe. The system can usually absorb trouble at one end. It can’t absorb it at both. The War Broke the Base Model The war did more than disrupt shipping. It tested, under real conditions, the proposition that American power in the Gulf could rest on a handful of large bases near Iran, and that thesis failed. For weeks, Iranian drones and missiles hit radars, hangars, warehouses, and command centers across the Gulf. Consequently, the United States dispersed tens of thousands of troops rather than leave them concentrated where a single salvo could destroy masses of them in one blow. The officers who ran those bases got the message. As Mark Cancian of the Center for Strategic and International Studies put it, the war had shown how vulnerable all the fixed bases were . Retired General Frank McKenzie, who commanded American forces in the region from 2019 to 2022, was blunter, calling the forward headquarters in Qatar, about a hundred miles from Iran, a “monument to old thinking” and urging the military to move its bases west. A report on the Pentagon’s own deliberations describes exactly these changes: structural modifications at the Bahrain naval base , smaller facilities in Kuwait and Saudi Arabia, and hardened, dispersed sites farther from Iran’s reach. The rationale for change is simple. A base near Iran gives the United States a quick response time but places its forces inside the threat ring of most Iranian munitions. Forces and key platforms are easy to find and hard to protect. A fight stretching from the Gulf of Aden to the Red Sea is poorly served by a posture built for one corner of the Persian Gulf. The emphasis is shifting toward the far end of the corridor, and that is exactly where Somaliland sits. What Israel Saw On 26 December 2025, Israel became the first United Nations member state to officially recognize the Republic of Somaliland , signing a joint declaration in the spirit of the Abraham Accords and committing to exchange ambassadors. It wasn’t acting out of goodwill. Its ships had been under Houthi fire in the Red Sea for two years; it needed a reliable partner in the Gulf of Aden , and Somaliland had the coast. Somalia called the move illegal, and at the United Nations the Arab Group called it “null and void” . Recognition drew criticism. However, given the facts on the ground and the operational payoff, the decision remains strategically sound. To be clear, you don’t need to completely control the Bab el-Mandeb to influence events here, and no single country dominates it. Yemen sits on one side, Djibouti and Eritrea on the other. What you need is a stable position nearby, and Somaliland has one. Its anchor is the port and airfield at Berbera. During the Cold War, NASA leased the Berbera airfield, one of the longest runways in Africa , as an emergency landing site for the Space Shuttle, and United States Navy warships called at the port. Somaliland’s government has offered these facilities to the United States on several occasions. Compare that to Djibouti, which hosts America’s only permanent military base in Africa. The place is crowded. Five countries now keep permanent bases there: the United States, China, France, Japan, and Italy, and once you count smaller and secondary facilities, more than eight nations have some military presence in that small country at any given time. China’s base sits about seven miles from the American one and is built to hold thousands of troops. That kind of proximity constrains what the U.S. Joint Force can do and raises real operational security and counterintelligence concerns. It is part of why a willing partner at Berbera looks more attractive now, not less, and why the head of United States Africa Command and the American ambassador visited Somaliland in late 2025 . In August 2026, the commander of United States Special Operations Command Africa, Major General Claude Tudor, traveled to Hargeisa for talks focused on Red Sea and Gulf of Aden security. The Money is Already Moving Investors are already betting on Somaliland’s stability even though the world won’t say so out loud. DP World, the Dubai-based port operator, holds a thirty-year concession and has committed up to $442 million to expanding the port at Berbera. Ethiopia, landlocked and routing almost all its trade through Djibouti, has taken a 19 percent stake in the project. British International Investment reckons that by 2035 Berbera will handle trade worth close to a quarter of Somaliland’s economy . Ship turnaround times have subsequently fallen from sixty-four hours in 2018 to twenty-five by 2024. For Washington, the point is that recognition wouldn’t mean building an investment case out of nothing. It would mean reducing the risk for investors who have already committed, unlocking financing now held back by the unclear legal status, and giving the United States a real hand in shaping the most promising piece of friendly infrastructure on the corridor rather than standing on the sidelines. That is precisely the argument Somaliland’s president made at this year’s World Economic Forum in Davos . In addition, Somaliland’s value to its Western partners runs deeper than geography, a deep-water port, and an airfield. The territory is believed to hold significant deposits of critical minerals , among them lithium, chromium, nickel, and platinum-group metals, the inputs that matter for both the energy transition and defense technology. There may be oil, too: the British-led firm Genel Energy holds onshore exploration blocks , in partnership with Taiwan’s state oil company, that early seismic work suggests could hold billions of barrels. No commercial discovery has been confirmed yet. Fewer than twenty wells have ever been drilled in Somaliland, the last in 1989, but the long-term commercial and energy potential along this stretch of the Red Sea corridor is real. A Base Can Be Evicted, But a Partner Cannot None of this is a pitch for another base. A base is real estate you rent, and a landlord can evict you when the government changes, when circumstances shift, when a coup intervenes, as is mostly prevalent in Africa, or when someone makes a higher bid. Recognition, by contrast, secures the relationship. As long as Somaliland’s status remains undecided, that ambiguity is a liability: an unrecognized state has fewer options and weaker protections, leaving it exposed to pressure from outside powers. That is exactly what Turkey, working through Mogadishu, and China, working in the wider region, exploit for leverage. Settle the status, and most of that leverage disappears. The objection raised most often to proposals to recognize Somaliland is that this would set off a rush of secessions across Africa. It wouldn’t, because Somaliland isn’t seceding so much as restoring an independence it once had. British Somaliland became independent and was recognized by more than thirty countries in June 1960, for five days, before it voluntarily merged, with no binding treaty, into a union with the former Italian colony to its south. That unratified union broke apart in 1991 amid a war against a dictatorship whose campaign against the Isaaq clan killed tens of thousands , after which the central government collapsed. Recognizing Somaliland doesn’t draw a new border, but confirms a border that previously existed, and one that its people want to protect. South Sudan’s peaceful admission to the United Nations in 2011 shows the system can absorb that kind of change without the wave of copycat secessions that skeptics keep predicting. What Washington Should Do To maximize strategic advantage in this region, Washington should take the following actions in sequence. The State Department should open a representative office in Hargeisa, the capital of Somaliland, and stop treating stable Somaliland as part of volatile Somalia when it issues travel warnings. Congress should advance the Republic of Somaliland Independence Act , which the House Foreign Affairs Committee has held for the third Congress in a row. The Department of Defense should turn general interest into concrete action, cooperating with Somaliland on maritime monitoring and arranging contingency access at Berbera, so the relationship is in place before the next crisis rather than improvised during one. And the administration should treat diplomatic recognition of Somaliland as the destination all of these actions are aiming toward, not a reward left dangling. The obstacles are real. The international community is cautious, Somalia is pushing hard against any diplomatic overtures made toward Somaliland, and the U.S. president has already said “no” to the question of recognition. But a “no” in December 2025 need not last forever. The argument that recognition serves cold American interest, not just a preference for good governance, gets harder to dismiss the longer the corridor in the Gulf stays contested. The chokepoints are the symptom, but the region is the system. The big Gulf bases have just shown how vulnerable they are, and strategic inertia moves toward dispersal and partnership. In that setting, Somaliland offers something rare: a stable, democratic partner you can keep rather than rent, one whose own course is already making the argument. Israel has taken the step to seize the opportunities afforded by an official relationship with Somaliland. To best secure its regional interests, the U.S. should be the next country to do the same. Burhan Adam is the founder of Red Sea Meridian, a consultancy focused on national security and mission support in the Horn of Africa, the Red Sea region, and East Africa. He is a retired Department of Defense official with more than three decades of federal service. The views here are entirely his own. items.title: Muqdisho oo si rasmi ah looga furay Shirweynaha Madasha Qaran ee Istiraatiijiyadda Xiriirka Warbaahinta 2026
items.description: Muqdisho, Soomaaliya – Magaalada Muqdisho waxaa maanta si rasmi ah uga furmay Shirweynaha Madasha Qaran ee Istiraatiijiyadda Xiriirka Warbaahinta 2026 (Strategic Communication Forum), kaas oo isu keenaya hay’adaha dowladda, warbaahinta, bulshada rayidka ah, bah-wadaagta horumarinta iyo daneeyayaasha kale ee muhiimka ah. Shirweynahan ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa xoojinta istiraatiijiyadda xiriirka iyo isgaarsiinta, kor u qaadidda wada-shaqeynta dowladda iyo warbaahinta, iyo sidii loo horumarin lahaa hababka casriga ah ee warbaahinta iyo gudbinta xogta. Inta uu shirku socdo, waxaa si gaar ah looga hadli doonaa anshaxa saxaafadda, isbeddellada degdegga ah ee ku socda warbaahinta casriga ah, iyo fursadaha iyo caqabadaha ka dhashay adeegsiga Garaadka Gacameedka (Artificial Intelligence – AI) ee dhinacyada warbaahinta iyo isgaarsiinta. Shirkan waxaa ka qeybgalaya masuuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, wakiillo ka socda dalalka saaxiibka la ah Soomaaliya, qubaro ku takhasusay warbaahinta iyo isgaarsiinta, xubno ka socda bulshada rayidka ah iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Madasha ayaa la filayaa inay noqoto goob muhiim ah oo lagu falanqeeyo mustaqbalka warbaahinta Soomaaliya, iyadoo la isku dhaafsanayo fikrado, khibrado iyo aragtiyo ku saabsan sidii loo dhisi lahaa xiriir warbaahineed oo hufan, mas’uuliyad leh, isla markaana la jaanqaadi kara horumarka tiknoolajiyadda casriga ah.

items.title: “Turkey cid ka hor imaan karto ma lahan,” sidaas waxaa tiri..
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Aamina Maxamed Mursal (Aamina Eelaay) oo ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ayaa ka hadashay arrimo ku aadan eedeynta loo jeediyay Turkiga, kadib qaraxii ka dhacay guriga Jeneraal Mahad Cabdiraxmaan ee degmada Doolow, kaas oo dhaliyay hadal-heyn xooggan. Aamina Eelaay ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in dowladda Turkiga ay tahay walaal ah dhab ah oo Soomaaliya garab istaagay, iyadoo tilmaantay in aan si fudud loo dhaliili karin doorka Turkiga ee Soomaaliya. “Dowladda Turkiga waa dowlad walaalaheenna ah, waana la ogyahay waxa ay annaga noo tahay, mana jirto cid ka hor imaan karta Turkiga,” ayay tiri Aamina Maxamed Mursal (Aamina Eelaay). Waxaa kale oo ay kusii dartay “Turkiga waa raacsanahay waa walaalaheenna wayn soo gurmadeen, iyagaa naga war qaba wax walba ayay innoo yihiin”. Mar wax laga weydiiyay weerarkii lagu qaaday guriga taliye Shub, ayay ku jawaabtay “Aniga ma dhihi kari Turkiyaa wax duqeysay, mana ah Turkiga gumeysi cusub”. Sidoo kale waxa ay sheegtay inay ka war sugayaan go’aanka iyo warbixinta kasoo baxda Golaha Wasiirrada, si loo ogaado natiijada baaritaanka iyo tallaabada xigta ee ay qaado dowladda dhexe oo guddi u saartay dhacdada. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo shalay xildhibaanno ku shiray gudaha magaalada Nairobi ay weerarka ku eedeeyeen dowladda Turkiga, waxaana ay tilmaameen in duqeynta lala beegsaday guriga taliyihii hore ee ciidanka Asluubta ay fuliyeen diyaaradaha dagaalka ee F-16 ee dalka Turkiga. Xildhibaannada ayaa sidoo kale dowladda Turkiga ugu baaqay inay si deg-deg ah u joojiso “duqeymaha ay diyaaradaheeda ka fulinayaan” deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed iyo Jubbaland. The post “Turkey cid ka hor imaan karto ma lahan,” sidaas waxaa tiri.. appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo tacsi u diray Madaxweynaha Tanzania
items.description: Muqdisho – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa tacsi tiiraanyo leh u diray Madaxweynaha Tanzania, Samia Suluhu Hassan, kadib geerida ku timid seygeeda Hafidh Ameer Hassan. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay inuu la wadaagayo murugada Madaxweynaha Tanzania, qoyskeeda iyo shacabka dalka Tanzania xilligan adag. “Waxaan tacsi qoto dheer u dirayaa Madaxweyne Samia Suluhu Hassan geerida ku timid seygeeda. Soomaaliya waxay garab taagan tahay qoyskeeda iyo shacabka Tanzania xilligan murugada,” ayuu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku yiri qoraal uu soo dhigay bartiisa bulshada. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale Alle uga baryay marxuumka inuu ku mannaysto Jannatul Firdowsa, samir iyo iimaanna uu ka siiyo qoyskiisa iyo dhammaan shacabka Tanzania.

items.title: Midowga Afrika oo soo dhoweeyay go’aanka Qaramada Midoobay ee muujinaya cabbirka dhabta ah ee Afrika
items.description: Addis Ababa – Midowga Afrika (AU) ayaa soo dhoweeyay qaraar ay Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ansixiyeen, kaas oo dhiirrigelinaya in khariidadaha dunida laga isticmaalo hab muujinaya cabbirka dhabta ah ee qaaradaha, gaar ahaan Afrika. Qaraarkan ayaa lagu boorrinayaa in si tartiib tartiib ah looga guuro Mercator Projection, oo ah habka khariidadaha dunida sida weyn loogu isticmaalo, loona wareego Equal Earth Projection, kaas oo si ka sax ah u muujinaya baaxadda dhabta ah ee dhulka iyo qaaradaha. Guddoomiyaha Guddiga Midowga Afrika, Maxamuud Cali Yuusuf, ayaa sheegay in go’aankani yahay tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu saxayo qaabka dunida loogu sawiro khariidadaha. Habka Mercator-ka, oo markii ugu horreysay la sameeyay qarnigii 16-aad si loogu adeegsado hagidda maraakiibta, ayaa lagu dhaliilaa inuu si weyn u qalloociyo cabbirrada qaaradaha, gaar ahaan kuwa ka fog dhulbaraha. Arrintan ayaa sababtay in Afrika ay khariidadaha qaar uga muuqato mid aad uga yar cabbirkeeda dhabta ah. Qaraarka cusub, oo loo yaqaan “Correct the Map”, ayaa Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay ku ansixiyay 164 cod oo oggol ah, hal dal oo diiday iyo lix dal oo ka aamusay. Midowga Afrika ayaa sheegay in tallaabadani aysan ku koobnayn oo keliya sawiridda khariidadaha, balse ay muhiim u tahay in Afrika lagu matalo xaqiiqadeeda dhabta ah iyo baaxaddeeda saxda ah. Waxaa sidoo kale lagu boorriyay hay’adaha caalamiga ah, nidaamyada waxbarashada, daabacayaasha iyo baraha dijitaalka ah inay si tartiib ah u adeegsadaan khariidado si cadaalad iyo saxnaan leh u muujinaya cabbirka dhabta ah ee qaaradaha.

items.title: Shacabka degmada Baardheere oo loo ballan qaaday in dib-u-dayactir loogu sameeyn doono buundada muhiimka ah
items.description: Baardheere ( Raxanreeb Online) Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed Sarreeye Guuto Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar oo ku sugan magaalada Baardheere ee Gobolka Gedo, ayaa kormeer ku tagay buundada magaalada, halkaas oo uu ka muuqdo burbur xooggan. Taliyaha iyo saraakiisha kormeerka ku wehlinaysay ayaa sidoo kale u kuurgalay xaaladda guud ee wabiga mara magaalada Baardheere, gaar ahaan labada dhinac ee jiinka wabiga, xaaladaha amni iyo kuwa nololeed ee halkaasi ka jira, iyadoo laga cabsi qabo fatahaado waaweyn oo la saadaalinayo inay ka dhacaan guud ahaan Soomaaliya. Taliyaha Guutada 36-aad, Qaybta 43-aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, G/Sare Cismaan Sheekh Cabdi iyo Maamulka Degmada Baardheere, oo uu wehlinayay Maareeyaha Garoonka Degmada Baardheere, Jaamac Cali Hirey, ayaa Taliyaha iyo saraakiisha la socotay warbixin ka siiyay xaaladda amniga ee jiinka wabiga iyo baahiyaha aasaasiga ah ee ka jira deegaanka. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka xoogga, ayaa ballanqaaday in wax laga qaban doono caqabadaha ka jira deegaanka, iyadoo mudnaanta koowaad la siinayo dib-u-dayactirka buundada, taas oo burburkeedu sababay in gabi ahaanba aysan shaqayn. items.title: Former South West Official Warns Against Foreign Interference
items.description: BAYDHABO, Somalia (Raxanreeb Online) Former spokesperson for Somalia’s South West State administration, Hassan Mohamed Abdi, has warned against foreign interference in the political and security affairs of South West Somalia, stressing that the region’s future should ultimately be determined by its people. Abdi said the Federal Government of Somalia is receiving support from foreign countries, including logistical and other forms of assistance. However, he argued that such support would not alter the right of local communities to determine the political future and governance of their regions. “You can bring foreign aircraft and vehicles, but the decision and destiny of the South West regions remain in the hands of our people,” Abdi said. His remarks reflect growing political sensitivities surrounding the role of external actors in Somalia’s internal affairs, particularly in relation to the political and security situation in South West State. Abdi emphasized that decisions concerning the future administration and governance of the region should be based on the wishes and interests of local communities rather than being dictated by outside powers. The statement comes amid continuing political tensions in South West Somalia, where disputes over governance, federal authority and the involvement of external actors have become increasingly prominent. items.title: Afhayeenkii hore ee Lafta-gareen oo farriin adag u diray dowladda federaalka…
items.description: Baydhabo ( Raxanreeb Online) Afhayeenkii hore ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, Xasan Maxamed Cabdi, ayaa ka hadlay doorka ay dhinacyada shisheeye ku yeelan karaan xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed. Afhayeenka ayaa sheegay in dowladda federaalka ay garab ka heleyso dalal shisheeye. Waxa uunta intaas ku daray in taasi aysan beddeli karin xaqiiqda ah in go’aanka iyo masiirka deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed ay leeyihiin dadka deegaanka. “Diyaarado iyo gaadiid shisheeye waad keensan kartaan, laakiin go’aanka iyo masiirka deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed wuxuu gacanta ugu jiraa dadkeena,” ayuu yiri afhayeenka. Hadalka afhayeenka, ayaa xambaarsan fariin siyaasadeed oo xooggan, iyadoo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed uu adkeynayo in arrimaha la xiriira mustaqbalka iyo maamulka deegaannadaasi lagu go’aamiyo rabitaanka dadka deegaanka, halkii ay saameyn weyn ku yeelan lahaayeen dhinacyo dibadeed. items.description: Daaru-salaam ( Raxanreeb Online) Seyga madaxweynaha Tanzania oo geeriyooday Seyga Madaxweyne Samia Suluhu Hassan, Hafidh Ameir Hassan, ayaa maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 7-da Sebtembar 2026 geeriyooday. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed uu maanta soo saaray Madaxweyne-ku-xigeenka Tanzania, Deogratius Ndejembi, Hafidh ayaa daaweyn ugu jiray Isbitaalka Emilio Mzena Memorial ee Zanzibar. items.title: Iiran: Imaaraatku wuxuu ka hor istaagay kaluumeysato Iiraani ah in ay ku soo noqdaan dalkooda
items.description: Xafiiska wakiilka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ee Iiraan ee gobolka Hormozgan ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Imaaraadka Carabta uu ka hortagay bixitaankii kalluumeysatada Hormozgani ee la xiray daqiiqaddii ugu dambeysay. Hawlgalku wuxuu yiri: “Tigidhada soo celinta kalluumeysatada lagu xiray Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa la siiyay Bandar Abbas, waxaana la sameeyay dhammaan isku-dubaridka lagama maarmaanka ah ee u dhexeeya mas’uuliyiinta Iiraan iyo Imaaraadka si ay u soo laabtaan, laakiin daqiiqaddii ugu dambeysay, dhinaca Imaaraadka ayaa ka hor istaagay bixitaanka muwaadiniintan Hormozgani iyagoon bixin sabab sax ah.” Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan ayaa sheegtay in 10 kalluumeysato Iiraaniyiin ah oo ku lumay biyaha Gacanka Faaris dhowr toddobaad ka hor ay nool yihiin oo ay ku sugan yihiin Imaaraadka, dhawaanna ay ku laaban doonaan Iiraan. Warka ku saabsan maqnaanshaha kalluumeysatadaas ayaa la daabacay dhammaadkii Agoosto. Markhaatiyaal ayaa u sheegay Shabakadda Wararka Iiraan in markii ugu dambeysay lagu arkay meel u dhow Jasiiradda Siri. Jasiiradda Siri waa mid ka mid ah jasiiradaha ugu koonfureed ee Iiraan ee Gacanka Faaris, oo u dhow Jasiiradda Abu Musa. Hay’adda Warbaahinta Iiraan (IBC) ayaa xilligaas sheegtay in duullaan aan loo baahnayn oo lagu qaaday biyaha dhulka ee deriska xeebaha aysan ahayn wax aan caadi ahayn, laakiin xaaladaha dagaalka ayaa kordhiyay “walaacyada.” Bbc somali

items.title: Afhayeenka Lafta-gareen: Diyaarado waad keensan kartaan, laakiin go’aanka iyo…
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Onlin) – Afhayeenka madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo ku sugan bannaanka Baydhaba, ayaa ka hadlay xaaladihii ugu dambeeyay ee maamulka iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ciidan ee haatan ka socda gudaha iyo hareeraha magaalada. Ugaas Xasan ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay diyaaradaha dagaalka ee howlgalka ka wada deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed, isaga oo sheegay in isticmaalka diyaaradaha iyo gaadiidka shisheeye aysan waxba ka beddeli karin xaaladda taagan, isla markaana masiirka Koonfur Galbeed iyo ka go’aan ka gaaritsa mustaqbalkooda ay leeyihiin shacabka maamulkaas. Sidoo kale, wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyay in aan cid kale loo oggolaan karin inay go’aan kama dambeys ah ka gaarto mustaqbalka maamulka, iyaguna sii wadi doonaan howlgallada. “Dalkeenna iyo deegaannadeenna Koonfur Galbeed waa hanti ay masiirkooda ka talinayaan dadka reer Koonfur Galbeed. Diyaarado iyo gaadiid shisheeye waad keensan kartaan, laakiin go’aanka iyo masiirka deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed wuxuu gacanta uga jiraa dadkeena,” ayuu yiri Ugaas Xasan Cabdi. Afhayeenka Lafta-gareen ayaa hadalkiisa ku muujiyay in ciidamo iyo qalab ciidan oo dibadda laga keenay aysan meesha ka saari karin doorka shacabka deegaanka, isaga oo tilmaamay in arrimaha siyaasadeed iyo kuwa maamul ee Koonfur Galbeed ay u baahan yihiin in lagu saleeyo rabitaanka iyo go’aanka dadka deegaanka. Waxaa kale oo ugu baaqay shacabka maamulka Koonfur Galbeed inay muujiyaan feejignaan iyo isku duubni, isla markaana ay ilaashadaan midnimadooda xilli ay jiraan xaalado siyaasadeed iyo amni oo sii kordhaya. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xaaladda magaalada Baydhaba iyo guud ahaan Koonfur Galbeed ay noqotay mid si weyn loo hadal hayo, iyadoo dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo kuwa amniga ay isku hayaan arrimo la xiriira maamulka, amniga iyo mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee maamulkaasi. The post Afhayeenka Lafta-gareen: Diyaarado waad keensan kartaan, laakiin go’aanka iyo… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Journalist Dies from Gunshot Injuries, NUSOJ Demands Justice and Accountability
items.description: The National Union of Somali Journalists (NUSOJ) is deeply saddened by the death of Bashir Mohamed Abdullahi, a reporter with Arlaadi Media Network, who died in the early hours of Monday, 7 September, from the serious injuries he sustained after being shot in Baidoa on 3 September 2026. According to information provided to NUSOJ by the local journalists, Bashir, 23, was at his home in the Al-Ahmaar neighbourhood, north of Baidoa, when fighting broke out between government forces and militias loyal to Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed (Laftagareen), the former South West State leader. Bashir contacted his director after noticing unidentified armed personnel moving around his neighbourhood and was advised to remain indoors until the situation became safer. Bashir later left his home to carry out his journalistic duties. He was reportedly stopped by unidentified armed men wearing uniforms and covering their faces. After questioning him, the men shot him twice in the back and left him seriously wounded. He was rushed to Bay General Hospital, where doctors performed emergency surgery. Since Bashir was wounded, NUSOJ had been closely following his condition and remained in contact with his colleagues as efforts were being made to secure further medical treatment for him. Arrangements had been made for Bashir to be transported from Baidoa to Mogadishu on Monday morning, 7 September, so that he could receive more specialised medical treatment. Sadly, before he could be transferred to Mogadishu, his condition deteriorated and he died from his injuries in the early hours of Monday. “Bashir’s death cannot be allowed to pass like so many attacks on journalists before it. We have had enough messages of condolence without justice. What we need now are answers. Bashir was a young journalist with a promising future ahead of him, and that future has been taken away. Who killed him, why was he killed and who will be held responsible? When attacks on journalists go unpunished, it only makes the next attack easier. This chronic impunity has to end. Bashir’s family deserves justice, and so does every Somali journalist who goes out to do their job with the simple expectation that they will return home safely,” said Omar Faruk Osman, Secretary General of NUSOJ. The killing of Bashir, a young aspiring journalist, is a painful reminder of the dangers facing journalists in Baidoa and other parts of Somalia when armed confrontations break out. Journalists are civilians doing their professional work who can easily be identified. All armed forces and groups have an obligation to respect their safety and must never target, threaten, detain or attack journalists because they are reporting on events of public interest. NUSOJ extends its solidarity and support to Bashir’s family, his colleagues and the entire Somali media community. Bashir is sadly the first journalist to be killed in Somalia this year. The post Journalist Dies from Gunshot Injuries, NUSOJ Demands Justice and Accountability first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Xogta ragga Soomaalida ah ee isku xiray Al-Shabaab iyo kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Laba nin oo Soomaali ah ayaa la sheegay inay door muhiim ah ka qaateen xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya kooxda Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen, iyaga oo fududeeyay helitaanka hub, tababbar militari iyo xiriir toos ah oo labada dhinac ah. Jibriil Yaxye Cali, oo loo yaqaanay Gacaamey, ayaa Yemen uga shaqeynayay sidii xiriiriyaha Al-Shabaab ee Xuutiyiinta, halka Sheekh Axmed Cilmi Samatar uu markii dambe noqday wakiil sare oo ku lug lahaa codsiyada hubka iyo qabanqaabada tababbarro militari. Faahfaahinta doorka labada nin ayaa lagu soo bandhigay baaritaanno kala duwan oo ay sameeyeen wargeyska Wall Street Journal iyo hay’adda cilmi-baarista Century International , kuwaas oo bixiyay sawir faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan sida xiriirka Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta uu sannadihii dambe u kobcayay. Saraakiil Mareykan iyo Soomaali ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in wada-shaqeynta labada koox ay gaartay hub, teknoolojiyadda diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo tababbarro militari. Jibriil Gacaamey iyo xiriirka Yemen Jibriil ayaa muddo sanado ah isaga kala gooshi jiray Soomaaliya iyo Yemen, waxaana uu jiray 38 sano markii bishii Febraayo lagu dilay bariga Yemen. Sida uu qoray Wall Street Journal , Jibriil wuxuu Yemen ku bartay cilmiga caafimaadka xoolaha, ka hor inta uusan Muqdisho ka maamulin hay’ad samafal, xarun sarif iyo shirkad soo dejin iyo dhoofin ah. Dhaawacyo rasaaseed oo hore uga soo gaaray ayaa reebay nabarro sababay in loo bixiyo naaneyska Gacaamey, inkastoo uu labada gacmoodba qabay. Jibriil ayaa la sheegay in uu si qarsoodi ah ugu kala safri jiray Soomaaliya iyo Yemen, isla markaana ugu yaraan tan iyo 2023 uu ahaa xiriiriyaha Al-Shabaab ee saraakiisha Xuutiyiinta. Wall Street Journal ayaa sheegay in Xuutiyiintu Jibriil siiyeen guri qalabeysan oo ku yaalla Sanca, isla markaana uu ka qeyb geli jiray munaasabado rasmi ah oo ay kooxdu qabanqaabiso. Dokumenti kale oo wargeysku arkay ayaa muujiyay in maamulka Xuutiyiinta uu Jibriil siiyay baasaboorka Yemen oo lagu qoray magac aan kiisii saxda ahaa ahayn. Doorkiisa kuma koobneyn oo keliya xiriirinta labada dhinac. Wall Street Journal wuxuu sheegay in nin ka ganacsada hubka uu Jibriil baray alaab-qeybiyeyaasha hubka ee Xuutiyiinta, kadibna uu kaalin ka qaatay soo iibinta hub militari oo loo waday Al-Shabaab iyo diyaarinta sidii Soomaaliya loogu soo gudbin lahaa. Qiimeyn sirdoon oo Yemen laga sameeyay, islamarkaana uu arkay wargeysku, ayaa Jibriil ku tilmaantay shaqsi muhiim u ahaa xoojinta xiriirka labada koox, gaar ahaan dhinacyada hubka iyo isdhaafsiga khibradaha militari. Shirkado loo sameeyay inay dabool u noqdaan hawlgalladaas ayaa lagu eedeeyay inay hubka u ekaysiin jireen badeecooyin rayid ah, ka hor inta aan laga dhoofin Mukalla iyo dekedo kale oo Yemen ku yaalla. Doomaha kalluumeysiga iyo kuwa dheereeya ayaa kadib hubka ka gudbin jiray Gacanka Cadmeed, iyaga oo geynayay qaybo ka mid ah xeebaha waqooyiga Soomaaliya oo aan si weyn loo ilaalin. Shabakado kale ayaa hubka halkaas uga sii gudbin jiray koonfurta, halkaas oo ay ku sugan yihiin cutubyo dagaal oo Al-Shabaab ah. Samatar iyo codsiyada hub casri ah Sannadkii 2024, Al-Shabaab ayaa ballaarisay xiriirkeeda Yemen, waxaana ay halkaas u dirtay Sheekh Axmed Cilmi Samatar, sida uu sheegay Wall Street Journal . Wargeysku wuxuu Samatar ku tilmaamay wakiil ka sareeyay Jibriil, kaas oo la shaqeynayay, isla markaana saraakiisha Xuutiyiinta u gudbiyay liis faahfaahsan oo hub ah oo Al-Shabaab ay dooneysay. Liiska waxaa ku jiray gantaallada lidka diyaaradaha ee garabka laga rido, gantaallada Katyusha ee 107mm, qoryaha shiishka ee Dragunov, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee qaraxyada qaada, gantaallada lidka taangiyada iyo qalabka aragga habeenkii ee Mareykanka lagu sameeyo. Sarkaal ka tirsan sirdoonka militariga Mareykanka ayaa Wall Street Journal u sheegay in Al-Shabaab ay Xuutiyiinta ka dalbatay hub casri ah, oo ka dheeraa qoryaha fudud, kuwa daran-dooriga u dhaca iyo rasaasta. Century International ayaa iyaduna Samatar ku tilmaantay shaqsi muhiim ka ahaa xiriirka joogtada noqday ee Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta. Warbixinta Century ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada ammaanka Yemen ay Samatar ku qabteen magaalada dekedda ah ee Mukalla. Sida ku xusan qoraallo laga diyaariyay su’aalo la weydiiyay oo ay heleen cilmi-baarayaasha Century, Samatar wuxuu qirtay inuu ahaa xiriiriyaha Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta. Century ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in laba cinwaan oo email ah oo lala xiriiriyay Samatar ay ku xirnaayeen akoonno laga sameeyay suuqyada internetka ee Shiinaha ee AliExpress iyo DHGate, kuwaas oo lagu iibiyo qalab elektaroonig ah iyo badeecooyin kale oo loo adeegsan karo ujeeddooyin rayid iyo kuwo militari. Saraakiil sirdoon oo reer galbeed iyo kuwo gobolka ah oo ay hay’addu wareysatay ayaa aaminsanaa in xiriirka Samatar iyo Xuutiyiinta markii hore uu ka bilowday ganacsiga hubka, balse markii dambe isu beddelay xiriir ballaaran. Tababbarayaal yimid Soomaaliya Baaritaanka Century ayaa sidoo kale Samatar la xiriiriyay dhaqdhaqaaq ay tababbarayaal isaga kala gudbayeen Yemen iyo Soomaaliya. Xog laga helay wareysiyo iyo diiwaanno safar ayaa muujisay inuu bishii June 2024 joogay deegaanno ay Al-Shabaab maamusho, oo ay ku jirto Jilib. Warbixinta ayaa sheegtay in Samatar uu isku dubbariday safarka rag Yemeniyiin ah oo loogu yeeray “marti”, kuwaas oo xubnaha Al-Shabaab tababbarro gaar ah ka siiyay farsameynta qaraxyada, wax ka beddelka diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo dayactirka hubka. Waxaa raggaas ka mid ahaa laba injineer oo militari oo ka tirsanaa Xuutiyiinta, kuwaas oo tegay dooxada Jubba, sida ay sheegtay Century. Samatar ayaa la sheegay inuu diyaariyay gaadiidkooda, la kulmay saraakiil Al-Shabaab ah, isla markaana maamulay arrimaha saadka iyo maamulka intii ay joogeen Soomaaliya. Qoraallada wareysiyada ee ay Century soo xigatay ayaa sidoo kale xusay kulamo looga hadlay “dhameystirka dukumentiga hubka” iyo “xulashada ragga tababbarka loo dirayo”. Samatar wuxuu sheegay inuu fududeeyay safarka ilaa 400 Soomaali ah oo loo qaaday deegaannada Yemen ee ay Xuutiyiintu maamulaan, halkaas oo lagu siinayay tababbar militari iyo mid fikradeed. Century ayaa sheegtay inaysan si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin dhammaan faahfaahinta sheegashadaas. Si kastaba, xogta ay soo bandhigtay ayaa sii xoojisay warbixinno hore oo sheegayay in la sameeyay marin joogto ah oo loogu kala gudbiyo dagaalyahanno iyo tababbarayaal Soomaaliya iyo Yemen. Xarig, sii-deyn iyo dib u laabasho Wall Street Journal iyo Century ayaa bixiyay waqtiyo kala duwan oo ku saabsan goorta Samatar la xiray. Century waxay sheegtay in ciidamada Yemen ay Mukalla ku xireen bishii September 2024, halka Wall Street Journal , oo soo xiganayay xog sirdoon, uu sheegay in la qabtay January 2025. Labada warbixin waxay isku raaceen in markii dambe lagu sii daayay is-weydaarsi maxaabiis oo ay sameeyeen Xuutiyiinta. Century waxay sheegtay in Samatar xabsiga ka baxay November 2025, kadibna uu soo maray Hargeysa ka hor inta uusan ugu dambeyn dib ugu laaban Jilib, iyadoo soo xiganeysa saraakiil sirdoon oo Soomaali ah iyo xog laga helay goobihii uu telefoonkiisu ku sugnaa. Wall Street Journal ayaa isna sheegay in Samatar uu ku soo laabtay Soomaaliya, halka Jibriil uu sii waday inuu Yemen ka matalo danaha Al-Shabaab. Jibriil ayaa sii waday inuu ku lug yeesho shixnadaha hubka, waxaana markii dambe ku biiray laba khabiir oo hubka ku takhasusay oo ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Waxaa Jibriil la dilay 12-kii February, xilli uu ku safrayay meel u dhow magaalada Al-Ghaydah ee bariga Yemen. Laba ilo-wareed oo Mareykan ah oo xog ogaal u ahaa howlgalka ayaa Wall Street Journal u sheegay in weerar Mareykan ah lagu dilay. Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka, CENTCOM, wuxuu sheegay inuusan howlgalkaas fulin militariga Mareykanka, halka CIA-du ay diiday inay sheegto inay ku lug lahayd iyo in kale. Dilka Jibriil kama uusan dhignaan dhammaadka xiriirka labada koox. Wall Street Journal ayaa sheegay in Al-Shabaab ay Yemen u magacowday wakiil cusub oo beddelay Jibriil, balse lama shaacin magaciisa. Warbixino kale oo soo baxay kadib ayaa muujiyay in wada-hadallada hubka, tababbarada iyo xiriirka tooska ah ee Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta ay sii socdaan. items.title: Shirka madasha Istiraatijiyadda Qaranka oo ka furmay Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho ( Raxanreeb Online) Shirweynaha Madasha Qaran ee Istiraatiijiyadda Xiriirka Warbaahinta 2026 (Strategic Communication Forum) ayaa maanta ka furmay magaalada Muqdisho, waxaana ka qeyb gelaya hay’adaha dowladda, warbaahinta, bulshada rayidka ah, bah-wadaagta horumarinta iyo daneeyayaasha kale. Shirkaan oo ay soo qaban-qaabisay Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska XFS, waxaa daah-furay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka labaad ee dalka Mudane Jibriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji, waxaana khudbado muhiim ah ka jeedinaya Wasiirka Warfaafinta Soomaaliya Mudane Cabdulfataax Qaasim, Wasiirrada Warfaafinta Dowlad Goboleedyada Dalka, masuuliyiin kale oo ka tirsan dowladda federaalka iyo qaar kamid danjirayaasha caalamka ee Soomaaliya. Madashan oo hal ku dhigeeda yahay “Qaabeynta Mustaqbalka Warbaahinta ee Xilligan Casriga ah” ayaa looga hadlayaa xoojinta isku-duwidda isgaarsiinta, lagu horumariyo isgaarsiinta dadweynaha, laguna dhiso kalsoonida bulshada. Madashaan waxaa sanadkan diiradda lagu saarayaa horumarinta warfaafinta dalka, jihada mustaqbalka warbaahinta Soomaaliyeed, xoojinta xiriirka dowladda iyo dadweynaha, fursadaha ay bixiyaan tiknoolajiyadda iyo baraha bulshada, iyo caqabadaha la xiriira wararka been-abuurka ah. Sidoo kale, waxaa shirkaan looga hadlayaa anshaxa saxaafadda, isbeddellada ku socda warbaahinta casriga ah iyo adeegsiga garaad gacameedka (AI) ee dhinaca warbaahinta iyo isgaarsiinta. Madasha ayaa ah fursad ay daneeyayaasha kala duwan ku wadaagayaan maanta iyo berri fikrado, waayo-aragnimo iyo aragtiyo ku saabsan sidii loo dhisi lahaa warbaahin Soomaaliyeed oo la jaanqaadda isbeddellada dhijitaalka ah, isla markaana door muuqda ka qaadata horumarinta bulshada. items.title: Xog: DF oo qorsheyneysa xayiraado dhaqaale iyo socdaal oo ka dhan ah Lafta-gareen
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inay ka fiirsanayaan tallaabooyin dhaqaale iyo kuwo socdaal oo ballaaran oo lagu beegsanayo madaxweynihii xilka laga tuuray ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen, iyo qaar ka mid ah xulafadiisa siyaasadeed ee ugu dhow. Xog aan helnay ayaa sheegeysa in tallaabooyinka la qorsheynayo ay ka mid yihiin in la xannibo hantida gaarka ah iyo akoonnada bangiyada ee Laftagareen, iyo sidoo kale dhaqaalaha iyo akoonnada ay leeyihiin shaqsiyaad ama hay’ado lala xiriirinayo maamulkiisii hore. Sidoo kale, mas’uuliyiinta federaalka ayaa la sheegay inay diyaarinayaan magacyada siyaasiyiin iyo shaqsiyaad kale oo sare oo ka tirsan garabka Laftagareen, si loogu gudbiyo hay’adaha socdaalka. Haddii tallaabooyinkan la dhaqan-geliyo, waxaa suurta-gal ah in shaqsiyaadkaasi laga xaddido safarrada, lagana joojiyo ama laga laalo baasaboorrada iyo dokumentiyada kale ee safarka ee ay haystaan. Sida aan xogta ku helnay, mas’uuliyiin sare oo dowladda federaalka ah ayaa arrintan kala hadlay hay’ado ay ka mid yihiin Wasaaradaha Maaliyadda iyo Amniga Gudaha, Booliska Soomaaliyeed, Hay’adda Socdaalka iyo Jinsiyadda, iyo Guddiga Qaranka ee La-dagaallanka Lacag-dhaqidda. Tallaabooyinkan, haddii la hirgeliyo, waxay noqonayaan sare-u-kac weyn oo ku yimaada khilaafka siyaasadeed ee Koonfur Galbeed, kaas oo bilihii lasoo dhaafay isu beddelay loollan hubeysan oo ku saabsan cidda maamuleysa dowlad-goboleedka. Khilaaf isu beddelay dagaal Ciidamada dowladda federaalka ayaa la wareegay magaalada Baydhaba 30-kii Maarso, laba maalmood kaddib markii xildhibaannada Koonfur Galbeed ay Laftagareen mar kale u doorteen xilka madaxweynaha muddo shan sano ah, doorashadaas oo dowladda federaalka ay diidday. Laftagareen ayaa markii ciidamada federaalka ay gudaha u galeen Baydhaba ku dhawaaqay inuu xilka ka degayo, balse markii dambe wuxuu beddelay mowqifkaas siyaasadeed. Tan iyo markaas, wuxuu dhowr jeer ku celceliyey in doorashadii 28-kii Maarso ay sharci tahay, isla markaana uu weli yahay madaxweynaha sharciga ah ee Koonfur Galbeed. Hadallo kala duwan oo uu jeediyey kaddib markii uu lumiyey gacan-ku-haynta Baydhaba, Laftagareen wuxuu diiday maamulka cusub ee magaalada laga dhisay, isaga oo ciidamada isaga taageersan ku tilmaamay ciidamada amniga Koonfur Galbeed ee doonaya inay dib u soo celiyaan maamul ay u arkaan inuu sharci yahay. Khilaafkaas ayaa tan iyo markaas marar badan u gudbay goobaha dagaalka. 17-kii Agoosto, ciidamo daacad u ah Laftagareen ayaa weerar culus ku qaaday Baydhaba, iyaga oo gudaha u galay qeybo ka mid ah magaalada, waxaana saacado badan halkaas ku dhexmaray dagaal xooggan oo ay la galeen ciidamada federaalka, ka hor inta aan dib loo riixin. Dagaalkaas ayaa ka mid ahaa kuwii ugu xooganaa ee Baydhaba ka dhaca tan iyo markii ciidamada dowladda federaalka ay magaalada la wareegeen bishii Maarso. Weerar kale ayaa dhacay waaberigii 3-dii September, markii dagaalyahanno taageersan Laftagareen ay dhowr jiho ka soo galeen Baydhaba, iyaga oo saacado la dagaallamay ciidamada federaalka iyo kuwa maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, ka hor inta aysan dib uga bixin magaalada. Laftagareen oo qaatay mas’uuliyadda Laftagareen ayaa weerarrada Baydhaba dhowr jeer si cad ugu nisbeeyey ciidamada isaga taageersan, isaga oo ku tilmaamay howl-gallo ay ciidamadiisu ku doonayaan inay dib ula wareegaan magaalada iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Hadalladaas ayaa si weyn uga duwan xaalad uu hoggaamiye siyaasadeed iska fogeynayo rabshadaha ay taageerayaashiisu geystaan, waxaana ay muujinayaan in Laftagareen uu aqbalay masuuliyadda siyaasadeed ee dagaallada ay ciidamadiisu kula jiraan ciidamada iyo maamulka dowladda ee Baydhaba gacanta ku haya. Waxay sidoo kale xoojinayaan doodda dowladda federaalka ee ah in khilaafku uusan hadda ku koobnayn muran siyaasadeed oo ku saabsan sharciyadda xilka, balse uu isu beddelay abaabul iyo adeegsiga xoog hubeysan oo lagu weerarayo maamul dowladeed laguna doonayo in awoodda dib loogu qabsado xoog. Dagaalkii 3-dii September ayaa sababay in dad rayid ah ay ka barakacaan xaafado dhowr ah, wuxuuna mar kale muujiyey in garabka Laftagareen uu weli leeyahay awood uu ku abaabuli karo weerarro hubeysan oo waaweyn oo ka dhan ah maamulka gacanta ku haya Baydhaba. Dowladda federaalka ayaa si isa soo taraysa howl-gallada ay fulinayaan ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen ugu tilmaamaysa halis amni. Marka lagu daro hadallada Laftagareen ee uu weerarrada ugu nisbeeyey ciidamadiisa, mas’uuliyiinta federaalka ayaa u arka dagaallada Baydhaba kuwo ka gudbay mucaarad siyaasadeed una gudbay abaabul hubeysan oo ka dhan ah hay’adaha dowladda. Aragtidaas ayaa ka mid ah sababaha la rumeysan yahay inay gadaal ka riixayaan tallaabooyinka dhaqaale iyo socdaal ee hadda laga fiirsanayo, iyadoo dowladda ay isku dayeyso inay cadaadis ku saarto hoggaanka iyo shabakadda siyaasadeed ee taageerta Laftagareen. Kadib weerarkii 3-dii September, Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa ku eedeysay ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen inay dagaalka kala qeyb-qaateen xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Eedeyntaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin, halka garabka Laftagareen uu marar badan diiday in ciidamadiisa lala xiriiriyo kooxda Al-Shabaab. Kala duwanaanshahaas ku saabsan sida labada dhinac u qeexayaan dagaalka ayaa hadda saldhig u ah sii xumaanaya khilaafka. Dowladda federaalka ayaa shabakadda hubeysan ee Laftagareen u aragta mid khatar ku ah amniga dowladda, halka Laftagareen uu weli isku tilmaamayo madaxweynaha la doortay ee Koonfur Galbeed, ciidamadiisana uu ku sheegay kuwo doonaya inay dib ula wareegaan maamulkooda. Haddii xayiraadaha la qorsheynayo la ansixiyo, waxay noqon doonaan tallaabadii ugu cusleyd ee dowladda federaalka ku beegsato Laftagareen iyo xulafadiisa tan iyo markii uu lumiyey gacan-ku-haynta Baydhaba, waxayna khilaafka Koonfur Galbeed u sii gudbin karaan marxalad cusub oo ay isku biiraan cadaadis siyaasadeed, mid dhaqaale iyo mid amni. The post Xog: DF oo qorsheyneysa xayiraado dhaqaale iyo socdaal oo ka dhan ah Lafta-gareen appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Qoysaska Badmaaxiinta Pakistan ee Afduubka Loogu Haysto Soomaaliya oo Dalbanaya Xorriyaddooda
items.description: Qoysaska 10 badmaaxiin oo u dhashay Pakistan, kuwaas oo in ka badan afar bilood gacanta ugu jira koox burcad-badeed Soomaali ah, ayaa magaalada Karachi ka dhigay bannaanbax ay dowladda Pakistan ugu baaqayaan inay dadajiso sii-deynta ehelladooda. Badmaaxiintan ayaa ka tirsanaa shaqaalaha markabka shidaalka qaada ee MT Honour 25 , oo wata calanka dalka Palau, kaas oo burcad-badeeddu ay qabsadeen 21-kii Abriil 2026, xilli uu marayay meel ka baxsan xeebaha Puntland. Afduubka ayaa hadda gaaray ku dhowaad 140 maalmood , iyadoo qoysasku ay sheegeen in muddo ku dhow bil iyo bar aysan wax xiriir ah la sameyn badmaaxiinta, taasina ay sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo caafimaadkooda iyo xaaladda nololeed ee ay ku jiraan. Ambreen Yousuf, oo ninkeeda Syed Hussain Yousuf uu ka mid yahay badmaaxiinta la haysto, ayaa sheegtay in muddada afarta bilood ka badan ay qoysasku ka daaleen sugitaanka, iyadoo dowladda Pakistan ka codsatay inay si ammaan ah dalkooda ugu soo celiso 10-ka qof. Bannaanbaxa ayaa yimid xilli dowladda Pakistan ay sheegtay inay waddo dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo sii-deynta shaqaalaha markabka. Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Pakistan, Ishaq Dar, ayaa sidoo kale kulan la yeeshay Xoghayaha Guud ee Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Badaha (IMO), Arsenio Dominguez, isagoo ka dalbaday hay’adda inay gacan ka geysato sidii loo heli lahaa xal degdeg ah oo lagu soo celinayo badmaaxiinta. Dowladda Pakistan ayaa sidoo kale horey u sheegtay in mas’uuliyiinteeda ay xiriir iyo wada-hadallo kala dhexeeyaan dhinacyada ay khuseyso, oo ay ku jiraan maamulka Soomaaliya iyo milkiilaha markabka. Islamabad waxay sidoo kale codsatay in la hubiyo in shaqaalaha markabka la gaarsiiyo cunto, biyo la cabbo iyo waxyaabaha kale ee aasaasiga ah . qoysaskan ayaa sheegay in aan la siin war ku filan oo ku saabsan halka ay marayaan dadaallada lagu sii deynayo ehelladooda. Mahwish Yasir, oo ninkeeda Yasir Khan uu ka mid yahay dadka la haysto, ayaa sheegtay in xiriirkoodii ugu dambeeyay uu dhacay qiyaastii bil iyo bar ka hor. Waxay sheegtay in maqnaanshaha xiriirka uu qoysaska geliyay xaalad hubanti la’aan ah oo ku saabsan caafimaadka iyo xaaladda badmaaxiinta. Waxay sidoo kale digniin ka bixisay in haddii dowladda Pakistan aysan bixin jawaab cad, qoysasku ay qaadi doonaan tallaabooyin dheeraad ah, oo ay ku jirto bannaanbax gaajo , si ay cadaadis ugu saaraan dowladda. Qoysaska ayaa sheegay in afduubka muddada dheer uu sidoo kale saameyn ku yeeshay carruurta badmaaxiinta. Ayesha Ameen, oo ninkeeda Ameen bin Shams uu ka mid yahay dadka la haysto, ayaa sheegtay inay leedahay gabar afar jir ah iyo wiil siddeed bilood jir ah, iyadoo muujisay walaaca ay ka qabto saameynta ay xaaladdan ku yeelan karto carruurteeda. Dhanka kale, dowladda Pakistan ayaa sheegtay in howlgal ciidan ama sharci-fulin ah oo lagu doonayo in markabka xoog looga soo furto uu yahay mid adag, gaar ahaan maadaama markabku xambaarsan yahay shidaal ama xamuul halis keeni kara , taas oo kordhin karta khatarta ka dhalan karta howlgal noocaas ah. Obaidullah Khan, oo walaalkii Rafiullah Khan uu ka mid yahay badmaaxiinta la haysto, ayaa sheegay in walaalkiis uu yahay qofka kaliya ee qoyskiisa dhaqaale ka soo gala, ayna ku tiirsan yihiin saddex carruur ah. Wuxuu dowladda ka dalbaday inay qoysaska siiso ugu yaraan xog cad oo ku saabsan waqtiga la filayo in dadkooda la soo celiyo. Qoysaska badmaaxiinta ayaa hadda wajahaya sugitaan dheer iyo hubanti la’aan, iyagoo ku adkeysanaya in mudnaanta koowaad ay tahay in 10-ka badmaax si nabad ah loo sii daayo. Bannaanbaxan ayaa muujinaya cadaadiska sii kordhaya ee saaran dowladda Pakistan, iyadoo qoysasku ay ka digayaan inay bilaabaan shaq o-joojin haddii aan la helin jawaab iyo tallaabo muuqata oo horseedda sii-deynta ehelladooda.

Badmaaxiintan ayaa ka tirsanaa shaqaalaha markabka shidaalka qaada ee MT Honour 25 , oo wata calanka dalka Palau, kaas oo burcad-badeeddu ay qabsadeen 21-kii Abriil 2026, xilli uu marayay meel ka baxsan xeebaha Puntland. Afduubka ayaa hadda gaaray ku dhowaad 140 maalmood , iyadoo qoysasku ay sheegeen in muddo ku dhow bil iyo bar aysan wax xiriir ah la sameyn badmaaxiinta, taasina ay sii kordhisay walaaca laga qabo caafimaadkooda iyo xaaladda nololeed ee ay ku jiraan. Ambreen Yousuf, oo ninkeeda Syed Hussain Yousuf uu ka mid yahay badmaaxiinta la haysto, ayaa sheegtay in muddada afarta bilood ka badan ay qoysasku ka daaleen sugitaanka, iyadoo dowladda Pakistan ka codsatay inay si ammaan ah dalkooda ugu soo celiso 10-ka qof. Bannaanbaxa ayaa yimid xilli dowladda Pakistan ay sheegtay inay waddo dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo lagu doonayo sii-deynta shaqaalaha markabka. Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Pakistan, Ishaq Dar, ayaa sidoo kale kulan la yeeshay Xoghayaha Guud ee Hay’adda Caalamiga ah ee Badaha (IMO), Arsenio Dominguez, isagoo ka dalbaday hay’adda inay gacan ka geysato sidii loo heli lahaa xal degdeg ah oo lagu soo celinayo badmaaxiinta. Dowladda Pakistan ayaa sidoo kale horey u sheegtay in mas’uuliyiinteeda ay xiriir iyo wada-hadallo kala dhexeeyaan dhinacyada ay khuseyso, oo ay ku jiraan maamulka Soomaaliya iyo milkiilaha markabka. Islamabad waxay sidoo kale codsatay in la hubiyo in shaqaalaha markabka la gaarsiiyo cunto, biyo la cabbo iyo waxyaabaha kale ee aasaasiga ah . qoysaskan ayaa sheegay in aan la siin war ku filan oo ku saabsan halka ay marayaan dadaallada lagu sii deynayo ehelladooda. Mahwish Yasir, oo ninkeeda Yasir Khan uu ka mid yahay dadka la haysto, ayaa sheegtay in xiriirkoodii ugu dambeeyay uu dhacay qiyaastii bil iyo bar ka hor. Waxay sheegtay in maqnaanshaha xiriirka uu qoysaska geliyay xaalad hubanti la’aan ah oo ku saabsan caafimaadka iyo xaaladda badmaaxiinta. Waxay sidoo kale digniin ka bixisay in haddii dowladda Pakistan aysan bixin jawaab cad, qoysasku ay qaadi doonaan tallaabooyin dheeraad ah, oo ay ku jirto bannaanbax gaajo , si ay cadaadis ugu saaraan dowladda. Qoysaska ayaa sheegay in afduubka muddada dheer uu sidoo kale saameyn ku yeeshay carruurta badmaaxiinta. Ayesha Ameen, oo ninkeeda Ameen bin Shams uu ka mid yahay dadka la haysto, ayaa sheegtay inay leedahay gabar afar jir ah iyo wiil siddeed bilood jir ah, iyadoo muujisay walaaca ay ka qabto saameynta ay xaaladdan ku yeelan karto carruurteeda. Dhanka kale, dowladda Pakistan ayaa sheegtay in howlgal ciidan ama sharci-fulin ah oo lagu doonayo in markabka xoog looga soo furto uu yahay mid adag, gaar ahaan maadaama markabku xambaarsan yahay shidaal ama xamuul halis keeni kara , taas oo kordhin karta khatarta ka dhalan karta howlgal noocaas ah. Obaidullah Khan, oo walaalkii Rafiullah Khan uu ka mid yahay badmaaxiinta la haysto, ayaa sheegay in walaalkiis uu yahay qofka kaliya ee qoyskiisa dhaqaale ka soo gala, ayna ku tiirsan yihiin saddex carruur ah. Wuxuu dowladda ka dalbaday inay qoysaska siiso ugu yaraan xog cad oo ku saabsan waqtiga la filayo in dadkooda la soo celiyo. Qoysaska badmaaxiinta ayaa hadda wajahaya sugitaan dheer iyo hubanti la’aan, iyagoo ku adkeysanaya in mudnaanta koowaad ay tahay in 10-ka badmaax si nabad ah loo sii daayo. Bannaanbaxan ayaa muujinaya cadaadiska sii kordhaya ee saaran dowladda Pakistan, iyadoo qoysasku ay ka digayaan inay bilaabaan shaq o-joojin haddii aan la helin jawaab iyo tallaabo muuqata oo horseedda sii-deynta ehelladooda.

items.title: Wariye u dhintay dhaawac ka soo gaaray dagaalkii Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Allaha u naxariistee waxaa xalay magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay ku geeriyooday wariye Bashiir Maxamed Cabdulaahi oo kamid ahaa wariyeyaasha ka howlgala gudaha magaaladaas oo sidoo kale xarun KMG u ah Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Wariyaha ayaa horay ugu dhaawacmay dagaalkii Khamiistii ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa daacadda u ah Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ku dhex-maray magaalada Baydhaba, isaga oo xalay ugu dambeyn u geeriyooday dhaawicii soo gaaray. Ilo wareedyo xilkas ah ayaa inoo sheegay in wariye Bashiir ay dhaawaca u gaysteen maleeshiyo hubeysan intii uu socday dagaalka, waxaana xaaladdiisa ay kasii dartay labadii maalmood ee lasoo dhaafay, isagoo xalay geeriyooday. Marxuumka ayaa si gaar ah uga tirsanaa shaqaalaha warbaahinta Arlaadi ee ku hadasha afka Mayga, waxaana maamulka uu tacsi u diray ehellada wariyaha oo uu sheegay inuu murugadda la qeybsanayo qoyska iyo asxaabta. “Maamulka iyo howlwadeenadda Warteelka Arlaadi waxay murugadda la qeybsanayaan qoyska iyo asxaabta wariye Bashiir Maxamed Cabdullaahi oo u dhintay dhaawacii kasoo gaarey dagaalkii Baydhabo ka dhacay September 3 2026,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Dagaalladii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba ayaa sababay khasaare baaxad leh, iyada oo dhibaatada ugu badan uu kasoo gaaray dadka shacabka ah ee lagu kor dagaalamay, iyadoo weli xaaladdu ay tahay mid aad u kacsan. Labada dhinac ayaa weli dhaq-dhaqaaqyo kasii wada duleedka magaalada, halkaas oo ay ka wadaan is uruursi ciidan, taas oo cabsi ku abuurtay rayidka. The post Wariye u dhintay dhaawac ka soo gaaray dagaalkii Baydhaba appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Kenya will respond if Turkey continues destabilising Somalia’s Jubaland.
items.description: Kenya will respond if Turkey continues destabilising Somalia’s Jubaland. Nairobi has also quietly rebuffed a request by Mogadishu to surrender opposition leader Abdiaziz Laftagareen (based in Nairobi). Kenya is following events in Somalia very closely. “Any attempt by any external actor to destabilise Jubaland and orchestrate violent regime change will be met with full force of our political, military and diplomatic might,” a Kenyan senior official told me today. The comments come as Mogadishu steps up violent campaign against opponents and pressures regional states to comply with its wishes. Key strong indicators of worsening situation in the last one week: 1. Law being amended to conflate terrorism with legitimate political armed struggle against oppression. Aim is to firmly brand the Laftagareen army in South West as terrorist. 2. Turkish air assets deployed to go after and decapitate Laftagareen forces. Doolow attack that targeted Gen Mahad ‘Shub’ just start of campaign. 3. Pro-government cleric Sheikh Ali Wajis gives ‘fatwa’ and green light to state to kill its opponents.     Rawhide Abdi

items.title: Maraakiibta Ganacsiga ee Marin-biyoodka Hormuz oo Hoos U Dhacday
items.description: Isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga ee Marin-biyoodka Hormuz ayaa hoos ugu dhacay heerkii ugu hooseeyay tan iyo bishii May, kaddib markii ay sii xoogeysatay xiisadda militari ee u dhexeysa Mareykanka iyo Iiraan, taas oo si weyn u saameysay amniga maraakiibta iyo dhoofinta badeecooyinka iyo shidaalka. Xog ay bixisay shirkadda dabagalka maraakiibta ee Kpler ayaa muujinaysa in 10-kii maalmood ee lasoo dhaafay celcelis ahaan ay maalin kasta Hormuz ka gudbeen 10 markab oo badeecooyin sida , halka tiradu Jimcihii ahayd in ka badan 15 markab, Sabtidana ay ku dhowdahay 13. Sabtidii waxaa marin-biyoodka ka gudbay laba markab oo keliya, halka Axaddii ay gudbeen lix markab, intooda badanna ay isticmaaleen waddada dhinaca Iiraan. Hoos u dhaca ayaa yimid kaddib weerarro is-daba-joog ah oo lala beegsaday maraakiibta, ayadoo ciidamada Mareykanku ay Sabtidii sheegeen inay weerareen saddex booyadood oo shidaal oo Iiraan leedahay, oo uu ku jiray mid ku dhow jasiiradda Kharg oo ah xarun muhiim u ah dhoofinta shidaalka Iiraan. Dhanka kale, Ilaalada Kacaanka Iiraan ayaa sheegay inay bartilmaameedsatay saddex booyadood oo shidaal oo marayay waddooyin aysan Iran oggolayn, iyo sidoo kale saddex markab oo Mareykan ah meelo kale. Hay’adda Maritime intelligence-ka ee Marisks ayaa dhacdooyinkan ku tilmaantay koror weyn oo ku yimid dagaalka badda , iyadoo sheegtay in maraakiibta ganacsiga ay hadda qayb ka noqdeen cadaadis dhaqaale oo ay labada dhinac isu adeegsanayaan. Sidoo kale, UK Maritime Trade Operations ayaa sheegtay in tan iyo 6-dii July la diiwaangeliyay 27 dhacdo oo weerarro gantaallo ama madaafiic ah oo ka dhacay gudaha ama agagaarka Marin-biyoodka Hormuz, kuwaas oo sababay waxyeello soo gaartay maraakiib. Axaddii, hal markab oo weyn oo shidaal qaada iyo saddex markab oo xamuul ah ayaa galay Hormuz, halka booyad shidaal oo badeecooyin la sifeeyay kasoo qaaday Sacuudiga ay isku dayday inay ka baxdo Gacanka balse dib loo celiyay. Marin-biyoodka Hormuz ayaa ah marin istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga tamarta adduunka, ayadoo Kahor dagaalka, in ka badan 100 markab ay maalin kasta mari jireen halkaas, xilligaas oo qayb aad u weyn oo shidaalka caalamka ah ay ku xirnayd marin-biyoodkan.

items.title: Ciidamada Danab oo laayay rag qaraxyo diyaarinayay
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa kasoo baxaya howlgal qorsheysan oo ay maanta ciidamada kumaandooska Danab ay ka sameeyeen aagga degmada Afmadow ee gobolka Jubbada Hoose, kaas oo lagu beegsaday maleeshiyaad ka tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab. Ciidamada Danab oo kaashanaya saaxibada caalamiga ah ayaa duleedka deegaanka Harboole ee degmada Afmadow ku weeraray shabakad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab oo xilligaas ku howlaneyd diyaarinta qaraxyo miino, sida lagu sheegay warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Taliska Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka. Qoraalka ayaa lagu sheegay in howlgalka lagu burburiyay koox miinooyin dhigaysay oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta, kuwaas oo ku howllanaa diyaarinta iyo dhigista miinooyin iyo waxyaabaha qarxa oo lagu bartilmaameedsanayo waddooyinka ay isticmaalaan gaadiidka shacabka. Sidoo kale, ciidamada ayaa baahiyay sawirro laga soo qaaday goobta uu ka muuqdo burbur xooggan iyo khasaare la gaarsiiyay maleeshiyada Al-Shabaab. Ujeedka howlgalkan ayaa ahaa mid lagu wiiqayo awoodda Al-Shabaab, laguna xaqiijinayo amniga shacabka iyo isu socodka bulshada, iyadoo ciidanka kumaandooska Danab ay kaashanayaan saaxiibada caalamiga ah. Dhanka kale, ciidamada ayaa weli sii wada howlgallada ka dhanka ah kooxaha Khawaarijta, si loo xaqiijiyo amniga iyo xasilloonida guud ahaan dalka. Muddooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ciidamada dowladda ayaa kordhiyay beegsiga Al-Shabaab, waxayna howlgallo ka fuliyeen meelo kala duwan oo kamid ah dalka. The post Ciidamada Danab oo laayay rag qaraxyo diyaarinayay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somali journalist Bashir Mohamed Abdullahi dies after being shot during Baidoa clashes
items.description: MOGADISHU, Somalia 7 September 2026 – The Somali Journalists Syndicate (SJS) expresses its deepest condolences over the death of journalist Bashir Mohamed Abdullahi, also known as Bashir Moalin, a reporter with the local Arlaadi Media Network, who succumbed to gunshot injuries sustained during armed clashes in Baidoa on Thursday, 3 September 2026. He becomes the second journalist killed in Somalia this year.

items.title: Kenya oo tallaabo ka qaadaysa ganacsatada ajaanibta ah
items.description: Dowladda Kenya ayaa bilowday tallaabooyin lagu xakameynayo ganacsiyada yaryar ee ay maamulaan ajaanibta, gaar ahaan dukaamada tafaariiqda yar-yar iyo ganacsiga waddooyinka, kaddib markii Madaxweyne William Ruto uu sheegay in ganacsiyada noocan ah mudnaanta la siinayo muwaadiniinta Kenya. Madaxweyne Ruto ayaa hadalkan jeediyay 2-dii Sebtembar, xilli uu magaalada Nairobi kulan kula lahaa ganacsatada ka shaqeeya shirkadaha iyo ganacsiyada yaryar iyo kuwa dhexdhexaadka ah. Waxa uu sheegay in Kenya ay soo dhoweynayso maalgashiga shisheeye, gaar ahaan maalgelinta waaweyn ee keenta raasamaal, shaqooyin, tiknoolajiyad iyo horumar dhaqaale, balse uusan habboonayn in ajaanibta ay si toos ah ula tartamaan dadka Kenyaanka ah ee ku tiirsan ganacsiyada yaryar sida dukaamada iyo wax ku iibinta waddooyinka. Ruto ayaa amar ku bixiyay in laga bilaabo 7-da Sebtembar la bilaabo tallaabooyin lagu xirayo ganacsiyada yaryar ee ay maamulaan ajaanibta, isagoo sidoo kale faray hoggaanka Baarlamaanka Kenya iyo Wasaaradda Ganacsiga inay dedejiyaan meel-marinta hindise-sharciga Local Content Bill 2025. Hindise-sharcigan oo weli baarlamaanka horyaalla ayaa looga gol leeyahay in shirkadaha shisheeye lagu qasbo ama lagu dhiirrigeliyo inay kordhiyaan isticmaalka shaqaalaha, adeegyada iyo wax-soo-saarka gudaha Kenya. Dowladda Kenya ayaa tallaabadan ku micneysay ilaalinta ganacsatada gudaha, iyadoo ay jiraan cabashooyin sheegaya in ganacsatada ajaanibta ah ay si toos ah ula tartamayaan dadka Kenyaanka ah ee ku shaqeysta ganacsiyada yaryar. Khubarada dhaqaale ayaa sidoo kale qaba aragti ah in haddii si habsami leh loo fuliyo, siyaasaddan ay fursado badan u abuuri karto ganacsatada Kenyaanka ah iyo shaqo-abuurka gudaha. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa weli taagan su’aalo ku saabsan sida amarka cusub loogu dabaqi doono ajaanibta horey u haysta rukhsadaha ganacsi iyo oggolaanshaha shaqada. Xoghayaha Joogtada ah ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Kenya, Korir Sing’Oei, ayaa sheegay in ajaanibta buuxisa shuruudaha sharciga Kenya, isla markaana haysata rukhsadaha iyo laysannada looga baahan yahay, ay weli sharci ahaan xaq u leeyihiin inay ganacsi ka sameystaan dalka. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay in hadallada madaxweynaha laga yaabo in si ka baxsan macnaha guud loo fasiray, maadaama dooddu ku saabsanayd hindise-sharciga Local Content Bill. Tallaabada ka dhanka ah ganacsiyada yaryar ee ajaanibta ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Kenya ay weli si weyn ugu baahan tahay maalgashiga shisheeye. Xogtii ugu dambeysay ee Xafiiska Tirakoobka Qaranka Kenya waxay muujineysaa in kaydka maalgashiga tooska ah ee shisheeye uu dhammaadkii 2023 gaaray 1.458 tiriliyan oo shilin Kenya ah, oo u dhiganta qiyaastii 11.27 bilyan oo doollar. Shirkadaha shisheeyuhu maalgeliyay ee la baaray waxay sidoo kale shaqaaleysiinayeen in ka badan 224 kun oo qof, kuwaas oo in ka badan 221 kun ay ahaayeen Kenyaan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee haddii go’aankani uu hirgalo waxaa dadka uu saamayn doono kamid ah Soomaali badan oo ka shaqaysta dalkaas, kuwaas oo aan intooda badan haysan rukhsado ganacsi.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo la filayo inuu u Socdaalo Mareykanka Si Uu uga Qaybgalo Shirka Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa la filayaa inuu safar shaqo ugu amba-baxo dalka Mareykanka, halkaas oo uu kaga qaybgali doono kalfadhiga sanadlaha ah ee Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo socdaalkiisu uu ku soo beegmay xilli hoggaamiyaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), uu isaguna ku sugan yahay dalkaas. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa khudbaddiisa golaha kaga warbixin doona horumarrada iyo duruufaha dalka ka jira, isagoo beesha caalamka ka codsan doona in la xoojiyo garab-istaagga dhanka amniga, dardargelinta howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, gurmadka arrimaha bini’aadannimada, iyo dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga caalamiga ah ee dalka. Kalfadhigan ayaa Soomaaliya muhiimad gaar ah u leh maadaama ay hadda ka mid tahay 15-ka dal ee xubnaha ka ah Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, xilkaas oo muddo-xileedkiisu ku eg yahay 31-ka Diseembar ee sanadkan 2026, taas oo dalka siinaysa fursad weyn oo uu ku saameeyo go’aannada caalamiga ah. Inta uu ku sugan yahay magaalada New York, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa la filayaa inuu kulamo doceedyo labo-geesood ah la qaato madaxda ugu sarreysa Qaramada Midoobay, saraakiil sarsare oo ka tirsan dowladda Mareykanka, iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha dalalka kale ee madasha isugu imaanaya, si loo sii xoojiyo iskaashiga diblomaasiyadeed iyo danaha qaranka.

items.title: Xero militari oo laga furayo Baardheere, xilli uu loolan u dhexeeyo Dowladda Federaalka iyo Jubbaland
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka ayaa lagu wadaa inay xero cusub oo ciidamada lagu tababaro ka furto Degmada Baardheere ee Gobolka Gedo. Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar iyo wafdi Saraakiil ah oo uu hoggaaminayo, ayna ku jiraan Taliyaha Taliska Tababarada iyo Doctrine-ka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Axmed Ciise Axmed iyo Madaxa Hoggaanka War-isgaarsiinta iyo Technology-ga Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, G/sare Faarax Cali Cartan ayaa Axaddii shalay gaaray Baardheere. Xeradan ayaa loogu talagalay in lagu tababaro cutubyo cusub oo ka mid noqonaya Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, gaar ahaan kuwa Taliska Qaybta 43aad ee ka hawlgala deegaanada Jubbaland. Saraakiisha Ciidaka Xoogga Dalka ee Gobolka Gedo ayaa kuu sheegaya in dhallinyaro cusub lagu diyaariyay Degmada Baardheere, kuwo kalena ay ka iman doonaan deegaano kale oo Caasimadda Muqdisho ay ku jirto, si loogu tababaro xerada laga furayo degmadaasi. Nin Sarkaal ah oo codsaday inaanan la soo xigan ayaa Universaltv u sheegay in Baardheere laga bilaabayo hawlgalo ka dhan ah maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, laguna xoreynayo deegaanada ka maqan gacanta Dowladda Federaalka. Socdaalka Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Baardheere ayaa lagu xoojinayaa isku xirka iyo dib-u-habaynta Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, si ay degmadu u noqoto saldhig weyn oo laga hago hawlgalada dhowr gobol. Gobolka Gedo ayaa waxaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ka jiray loolan dhanka maamulada maxaliga ah ee degmooyinka iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan oo iska soo horjeeda, una dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Jubbaland. Loolanka labada dhinac ee ku aaddan gacan ku haynta Gobolka Gedo ayaa ah mid qoto dheer, dhawaana isu bedelay weji cusub oo xasaasi ah. Khilaafka ugu weyn ee xiisadda sii huriyay ayaa ka dhashay qorshaha Dowladda Federaalka ay ku dooneyso inay doorasho qof iyo cod ah uga qabato gobolka, iyadoo adeegsaneysa Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka, halka Jubbaland iyo masuuliyiinta maamulada degmooyinka qaar ay diidan yihiin qorshahaas, iyagoona ku xiraya shuruud ah in ogolaansho iyo wada-xaajood dhab ah lala sameeyo Madaxtooyada Kismaayo.
