items.title: Bedqabka Aadanaha: Sannadaha ay Dawladi ku Suurtagelin Karto (1/2)
items.description: Qaybta Kowaad: Waxa ay Tirooyinku ka Maragkacaan Saboolnimada, Dawladnimada iyo Bedqabka Aadanaha ee Soomaaliya Maalin kasta Soomaaliya waxaa ku dhasha 1,900 ilaa 2,200 oo carruur ah. Sannad gudihiis, tiradu waxay mararka qaar gaartaa xaddi u dhexeeya 700,000 ilaa 800,000 oo muwaaddiniin soo kordhay ah, waxay taasi la macne tahay in magaalo hor leh ay sannad kasta ku kororto  dal ay ku nool yihiin ilaa 20 milyan oo qof. Qofna ma sheegi karo tirada saxda ah, maxaayeelay carruurtaasi ma helaan tirakoob rasmi ah oo dawladeed.  Hay’adda UNICEF waxay sheegtay in carruurta Soomaaliyeed ee shanta sano ka yar, qiyaastii 3 boqolkiiba oo qura dhalashadooda la diiwaangeliyey, 0.3 boqolkiibana ay haystaan shahaado dhalasho. Carruurta kale, oo ah 97 boqolkiiba ah, inkastoo ay hooyooyinkood u jiraan—oo ay yihiin nafley leh dhammaan astaamaha jiritaanka—misana, waa ayaandarree, weli kuma jiraan diiwaannada dawladdooda.¹ In yar bal suurayso: magaalo ay carruuri dhoobantahay, misana, waa yaabe, aysan dawladdoodu garan karin tiradooda, cayimi karin halka ay ku kala noolyihiin, ka warrami karin baahidooda, qorshana aysan ka lahayn! Dabadeed isweyddii su’aasha taas ka sii adag ee ah: immisa ayaa gaari doona sannadguuradooda shanaad? Qiyaastii ugu danbaysay waxay sheegaysaa in 1,000kii carruur Soomaaliyeed ahba ilaa 101 ay geeriyoodaan inta aysan shan jirsan. Saddex dal oo keliya—Nayjar, Nayjeeriya iyo Soomaaliya—ayaa weli leh heer dhimasho oo ka sarreeya 100 dhimasho 1,000kii dhalasho ee noolba. Haddii heerkaas lagu dabbaqo 700,000 ilaa 800,000 ee sannadkii dhasha, xisaabtu waa mid anfariir leh: haddii xaaladuhu sidooda iska sii ahaadaanna, qiyaastii 70,000 ilaa 80,000 oo ka mid ah dhallaanka sannadkan dhashay nolol kuma gaari doonaan da’da waxbarashada. Tiradani lagama soo dhiraandhirin diiwaannada dhimasho ee dawladda, waayo waddankeennu ma laha diiwaanno kaydiya dadkeenna dhinta iyo/ama kuweenna dhasha. Waase qiyaas muujinaysa baaxadda uu la egyahay ba’a na haysta oo tobankii carruur ahba mid ayaa dhinta inta uusan shan jirsan.² Dhimashooyinkani lama garan waayin sababaha keena(ya). Waa caadyaal! Qeybtood waxaa keena oofwareen; qaar fuuqbax ka dhashay shuban; qaar jadeeco aan la iska talaalin; qaarna nafaqadarro. Waxaa intaas dheer dhibaatooyin kale oo ay sababaan dayac ka dhasha xilliga dhalmada. Dhabtii, waa xaalado ay dalalka horumaray ay tobannaan ano horteed kaga adkaadeen tallaallo, biyo nadiif ah, ummulisooyin tababbaran iyo waddooyin u sahlaya hooyooyinka foolanaya gaaridda baraha caafimaad ee ay tahay in lagu baxnaaniyo. Si kale haddii loo dhigo, waa dhimashooyin ay dawlad xilkas ahi si foojigan uga hor tegi karto.  Sidaas daraaddeed, qormadani waxay ku saabsan tahay lafagurka shaqadaas joogtada ah, ee ka bilaabata hawsha maalinlaha ah ee dawladda, taas oo aan sida badan aad u muuqanin, sida kharashaadka oo waqtigooda lagu bixiyo, tallaallada oo tayadooda la dhowro, biyaha oo bedqabkooda la baaro, waddooyinka oo la dayactiro, dhalashada carruurta oo la diiwaangeliyo, xogaha muwaaddiniinta oo la hubiyo, iyo waxa ku dhaca jirka ilmaha marka hawlahaas la qabto ama la dayaco oo laga xisaabtamo ama wax la iska weydiiyo. Marka muwaaddinku arko ka dhabaynta iyo hirgelinta waxbqabadyadaas taxan, waa hubaal in ballanqaadka siyaasigu noqonayo wax la taaban karo. Waa hubaal in miisaaniyaddu noqonayso mid waxtar leh, oo tallaal u goysa cid kastoo u baahan; tallaalkuna uu badbaado u noqdo carruur faro badan oo u le’an lahaa jadeeco la dawayn karay ama laga sii hortegi karay. Waa hubaal in miisaaniyaddu dhisi karto waddooyin u suurtageliya hooyooyinka ay fooshu gubayso in ay si fudud ku gaari karaan cisbitaallada dadweynaha iyo rugaha loo asteeyay daryeelka hooyada iyo dhallaanka.  Haddaba, weydiimaha ay qormadani inna hor keenayso way fududyihiin in la istoydo, wayse adag tahay in laga jawaabo: maxaa u dhexeeya siyaasad warqad ku qoran iyo samatabixinta dhallaanka? Yaa diiwaangeliya dhalashada carruurta? Yaa bixiya dhaqaalaha tallaalka? Yaa dhowra fayaqabka biyaha? Yaa hooyada foolanaysa siiya daryeelka ay u baahantahay? Yaa waddooyinka dayactira? Yaa degaannada xasilloonidooda suga? Yay tahay in lala xisaabtamo marka nidaamku shaqayn waayo? Kuwani ma aha weydiimo bedqabka bulshada taabanaya oo keliya; waase su’aalo si toos ah farta ugu godaya amniga dadka iyo dawladnimada. Marka kowaad, wax kasta hortood, waa in laga bilaabo diiwaangelinta dhalashada carruurta, sababtoo ah waa halka ugu horraysa ee uu muwaaddinku kula kulmo dawladdiisa, dawladduna muwaaddinkeeda kula kulanto! Diiwaangelinta dhalashadu waa hawl dawladdu leedahay, xataa marka ay cid kale gacan ka geysato fulinteeda. Urur aan dawli ahayn (NGO), cusbitaal gaar loo leeyahay ama ummuliso xirfadle ah ayaa dhalashada dhallaanka sugi karta, diiwaanhayaha dawladda ku wargelin karta ama qalab dhijitaal ah soo gelin karta xogta hadba cunuggii soo kordha. Hase ahaatee, bixinta shahaadada dhalashada iyo haynta diiwaanka muwaaddinku waa masuuliyad dawladeed oo aysan cid kale buuxin karin marnaba! Soomaaliya waxay leedahay hannaan sharciyeed oo lagu diiwaangeliyo dhalashada iyo dhimashada dadka. Tan iyo 2023kiina waxaa jira nidaam dhijitaal ah oo sannadkii 2025 ka shaqaynayey 48 degmo oo guud ahaan dalka ah, laba sannadood gudahoodna lagu diiwaangeliyay in ka badan 43,000 oo carruur ah. Marka loo eego malaayiinta Soomaaliyeed ee aan weli diiwaannada dawladda fursadda u helin in ay galaan, waa tallaabo bogaadin mudan oo hore loo qaaday, Soomaaliduna waxay ku maahmaahdaa: “caano daatay dabadood la qabay”. Waa run oo in haddii qofku uusan helin shahaadada dhalashadu aysan macnaheedu ahayn in uusan jirin, waase arrin halis ah oo muujinaysa in uusan dawladdiisa u tirsanayn! Dawlad aan aqoon tirada dhallaanka ee had iyo goor dhasha ama dhinta, shaki ma laha in aysan si sugan u qorshayn karin tallaalkooda, waxbarashadooda iyo badbaadintooda.³ Arrinta kale waa dhererka cimriga la filan karo. Inkastoo maqaaddiirtu halkeeda tahay, haddana waxaa cad in ay jiraan xaalado saamaxaya in la saadaalin karo heerka nololeed ee ummad kasta, iyadoo laga duulayo heerka badbaadada iyo helidda adeegyada baxnaaninta. Tusaale ahaan, Xogta Bangiga Adduunka ee hadda la heli karo waxay cimriga qofka Soomaaliya ku dhasha, sannadkii 2024, ku qiyaasaystay 59.0 sannadood. Halka dalka Singabuur uu isla sannadkaas diiwaangeliyay in cimriga qofka dalkaas ku dhasha uu gaari karo celcelis dhan 83.5 sannadood. Farqigu waa qiyaastii afar iyo labaatan sannadood ama ku dhowaad rubuc qarni nololeed ah oo ay isdheeryihiin labada qof ee ku kala dhashay Soomaaliya iyo Singabuur.  Akhristuhu wuxuu meelo kale ku arki karaa qiyaaso Soomaaliya u dhigaya bartamaha kontomeeyada. Qiyaasuhu sannadba sannadka ka danbeeya way kaladuwanyihiin. Metelan, abaartii 2022kii saabatay geyiga Soomaaliyeed dhimashada si weyn ayay kor ugu qaadday. Sidaas darteed, sugidda kaladuwanaanta tirooyinku ma aha wax sii ridan, marba haddii qiyaas kasta oo la soo hadalqaado ay Soomaaliya aad uga hoosaysiinayso dalalka ay nidaamyadooda dadweyne muddo dheer yareeyeen halisaha dhimasho ee laga hortegi karo.⁴ Immisa sannadood ayuu qofka Soomaaliga ahi fili karaa in uu noolaado? Oddoroska dhererka cimriga la filan karo wuxuu ka midyahay halbeegyada dadweyne ee sida ugu mudan looga dheehan karo hannaanka dal loo maamulo. Dooddu ma aha in xalku yahay inta madaxweyne ama wasiir yimaaddo uu qaado olole, muddaxileedkiisaas, uu misana sidaas Soomaaliya kaga saari karo hogga hoosaynta, kuna dari karo safka dalalka horumaray ee yareeyay halisaha dhimasho ee laga hortegi karo. Dawladina taas ma samayn karto! Doodda qummani waxay tahay in cimriga dheeri suurtagal noqon karo oo keliya marka: dawladdu ka libhesho halisaha laga hortegi karo; oo ay dadkeeda ka dhowrto abaaraha iyo tabaalaha adduun ee asaaggood ka reebay; oo ay dhisto adeegyo bulsho oo la isku hallayn karo, had iyo jeerna la heli karo, kaddibna ku fara-adaygto joogtayntooda, oo jiilba jiil ka dhaxlo! Qodob kasta oo tallaabooyinkaas ka mid ahi waxaa sees u ah go’aan siyaasadeed oo aan afka baarkiisa ahayn. Waxa ay Tiradu ka Maragkacdo Cimriga la filan karo, mar kasta, waa qiyaas ee hubanti ma aha! Hayeeshee, qiyaas kasta waxaa hadba si yaab leh ugu lammaan oo laga fahmi karaa waxa bulsho walba hesho ama heli waydo oo ay lumiso, sida: carruurta badbaadada xilliga ay muluqa yihiin; hooyooyinka foolanaya ee hela daryeel caafimaad oo ku habboon; biyo bedqabka qofka u roon; cunto ku ku filan dadka; xakamaynta cudurrada faafa; ammaanka waddooyinka iyo xaafadaha; iyo kahortegidda xanuunnada inta aysan safmarka noqon ee aysan gallaafanin kummaanka nafood. Waxaa maragmaddoonto ah in aan hadal lagu wanaajin karin oddoroskaas, saa meel ‘hoo’ u baahan hadal waxba kama taree! Waxaa lagu wanaajin karaa oo keliya in la beddelo xaaladaha uu oddoroskaasi ka tilmaanbixinayo. Sidaas awgeed, sax ma aha caafimaadka bulshada mlagu soo koobo cisbitaallada. Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunku wuxuu tilmaamayaa in caafimaadka qofka ay qaabeeyaan wadajirka: xaaladaha uu ku dhasho, ku koro, ku shaqeeyo, ku noolaado, kuna gaboobo. Saboolnimada iyo fursadyarida bulsheed raadkooda ayaa si toos ah looga dhex arki karaa hadba xaddiga cudurrada dadka warjeefa iyo dhimashada sahalka ah. Waa dhab oo tallaalku waa dawo; ha ahaatee, in lala gaaro cududda ilmo ku nool tuulo saddex saacadood u jirta laamiga ugu dhow, dhabtii, waa guul dawladnimo; waxayse u baahan tahay in talaalkaas la soo iibiyo, gaadiid la soo saaro, heerkul qabow lagu kaydiyo, hawlwadeenno tababbaran loo carbiyo, dhabbe iyo waddo lagu gaari karo degaankaas la helo, xog lagu kalsoonaan karo laga duulo, la kasbado oo la hanto kalsoonida shacabka iyo, ugu danbayn, in la helo cid lagula xisaabtamo marka ay hawshaasi fuli waydo!⁵ Dhinaca kale, biyo nadiif ahi iskood uma yimaaddaan, ee waxay u baahanyihiin injineerro ugu taga gunta dhulka oo ka soo saara, dawlad u samaysa xeerar iyo habraacyo dhowra tayadooda, koronto iyo dayactir joogto ah. Sidoo kale, helidda waddo dhisan ama aan dhisnayn ayaa go’aamin karta in hooyo foolanaysaa cusbitaalka gaarto iyo in kale; in raashinku suuqa yimaaddo iyo in kale; iyo, waa midda ugu muhiimsane, in hawlwadeennada caafimaad ay gaari karaan tuulo bartamaha dalka ku taalla iyo in kale. Go’aannada dawladdu waa dhif inta ay si toos ah u kordhin kartaan cimriga dadka–waxayse hoos u dhigi karaan halis jirta; waxay tayayn karaan adeegbixinta; waxay sare u qaadi karaan dakhliga qoysaska; waxay fursad waxbarasho siin karaan gabar yar oo tuuladoodii ari ku raacaysa; waxay hay’adaha dalka ka dhigi karaan kuwo lagu kalsoonyahay oo shacabku isku hallayn karo. “Dhibic-dhibic baa balli ku buuxsamaaye”, tobannaan sano gudahood, saamaynta raadadkaas yaryar oo isbiirsaday baa miradhalkoodu noqdaa dantakeliya ee aan leennahay, taas oo ah: carruur Soomaaliyeed oo faro badan oo badbaada iyo dad badan oo cimriya! Maxaa Soomaaliya Dibdhigay? Halka ay Soomaaliya maanta joogto waa natiijada waayidda aasaasiyaadkii bulshada oo muddo dheer isa soo taraysay iyo nuglaanta hay’ado dawladeed oo jiitantay, kuwaas oo dhalay: burbur dawladeed, colaado lagu riiqmay, barakac, abaaro ba’an oo aan sannad walba geyiga oo dhan wada saabta, adeegyo bulsho oo liita, kaabayaal dhaqaale oo aan jirin ama aad u yar iyo saboolnimo baahsan. Qoysaska Soomaaliyeed waxay marxalad kasta kaga soo gudbayn/samatabaxeen karti iyo dadaal, kuwaas oo aan ka xusi karno lacagaha dibedda uga yimaadda, ganacsiyada gaarka ah, istaakulaynta dhaqanka ku aroorta iyo gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Adkaysigaasi waa mid dhab ah oo jira, wuxuuna mudanyahay in si dhiirran la bogaadiyo. Laakiin, waxaa iyaduna xusid mudan in adkaysigu yahay tab ay dadku isu bixiyaan, marka dawladdu dadkeeda gabto. Si kasta oo uu u qiimo badanyahay isxilqaankaas bulsheed, waxaan shaki ku jirin in uusan keligiis buuxin karin kaalinta nidaam dawladeed oo shaqaynaya, mana habboona in culayskaas oo dhan dusha laga saaro dadweynahan ay toodu cuslaysay. Saboolnimadu lacagla’aan (busaaradnimo) oo qura ma aha. Sidoo kale, waa xaalad uu qoysku tahli waayo gaadiidkii gaarsiin lahaa rugaha caafimaadka; iibsan waayo wax uu quuto; awoodi waayo in uu ilmihiisa waxbarasho ka sii bixiyo; heli waayo biyo nadiif ah; ama uu saddex toddobaad dakhli la’aan ku noolaado. Waxaa jiritaanka arrintaas maragfur u noqon kara qiimayntii ugu danbaysay ee uu Bangiga Adduunka, taasoo tibaaxaysa in wax ka badan kalabar dadka Soomaaliyeed ay ku noolyihiin wax ka hooseeya xadka saboolnimada ee caadiga ah, iyadoo bulshooyinka reerguuraagu ugu sii daranyihiin. Saboolnimada Soomaaliya ayay warbixintu ku sheegtay mid dhinacyo badan leh, sida biyayaraan, fayadhowrla’aan, korontayari, waxbarashada oo liidata iyo in aan laga gaashaaman aafooyinka la fili karo dhiciddooda. Sidaas darteed, saboolnimadeennu, waa ayaandarro inteeda la ege, waa isugeynta aafooyinkaas!⁶ Waayidda aasaasiyaadka noloshu waxay dadka u nugleeyaan dhibaato kasta oo la soo gudboonaata. Ilmo nafaqadarro hayso ayaa u dhiman kara caabuq yar oo uu kaga bogsan lahaa in uu helo cunto nafaqo ahaan dhammaystiran, yacnii waa qof durey ama hargab uu kaalmaati u waayay darteed u godgala! Hooyo xaammilo ah oo aan gaari karin rugaha daryeelka ee hooyada iyo dhallaanka ayaa u ummulraaci karta baxnaano la’aan. Bal suurayso qoys Soomaaliyeed oo neefkii xoolahoodaba ugu danbeeyay isaga iibiya si ay daawo u siistaan! Waa hubaal in qoyskaasu ceyroobayo, baylahna u noqonayo abaarta ugu soo horraysa ee asiibta. Sidaas awgeed, saboolnimadu waxay ku sidkantahay oo ku jirtaa doodgelinta oddoroska cimri ee bulsho kastaa filan karto, marna ma aha arrin ka baxsan. Dawladdii doonaysa inay dadkeedu cimri dheer noolaadaan waa in ay, wax kasta oo kale horteed, qoysaskeeda u suurtagelisaa inay wax tacbadaan, wax kaydsadaan oo dhigaal samaystaan, oo ka kabtaan dhibaatooyinka waayuhu ku markadaan—sababta oo ah, “belaayo kahortag mooyaane, kadabatag ma leh!” Teeda kale, in xaaladda maanta jirta hal hoggaamiye ama hal maamul dusha laga saaraa waa hadal meleggiis galay! Sababtoo ah, qaar ka mid ah duruufahaas waa kuwo la iska dhaxlay; qaarna waxay ka dhasheen dagaallo, abaaro, xasilloonidarro goboleed iyo/ama go’aanno laga gaaray dibedda dalka. Ma jiro hal masuul oo horjoogsan kara dhibaatooyinka oo dhan. Laakiin, taasi ma aha in masuuliyaddu tahay wax ka dhigan, “cadow ku cunay ama ku ciideeyay” ama in dhibta oo dhan dusha loo rito ama la iska wada diido; yacnii masuulku sida uusan wax kasta cawaaqibtooda u wada qaadaynin, ayuu, misana, uga wada madaxbannaanayn!  Haddii aan tagtadeenna milicsanno, tan iyo dhismihii Jamhuuriyadda Saddexaad, Dawladda Soomaaliyeed lama imaan rabitaan siyaasadeed oo dhab ah oo ay ilaalinta nolosha aadanaha ku siinaysa mudnaan iyo hortebin ka mid danaha qaranka. Si aan taas u garanno aan marka hore dul istaagno miisaaniyadda. Miisaaniyaddu kama maragkacayso niyadda siyaasiga; waxayse, miisaaniyaddu, muujinaysaa in ballanqaadka siyaasigu leeyahay dhaqaale lagu fuliyo, joogtayn lagu taabbageliyo iyo islaxisaabtan daba yaal—haddaan Soomaali nahayna—sooyaalka arrintaasi ma aha mid aan ku faani karno!  Maamulxumadeenna dawladeed ee isbarkan kuma koobna musuqmaasuq, kartidarro ama ujeeddooyin gurracan iyo dano shakhsi ah—inkasta oo ay misana intaasi jiraan–haddana waxaa dheeraad ku ah in si joogta ah loogu guuldarraysto in awoodda dawladnimo loo beddeli waayo badbaado muwaaddinku ku tashan karo, yacnii in adeegga dawladeed uu sii shaqeeyo marka xafladdii daahfurku/xarigjarku idlaato; in xogta la ururiyo oo la adeegsado; in wasaaraduhu yeeshaan wadashaqayn dhow; in qorshuhu noqdo mid ku salaysan hiigsi qaran oo fog iyo hiraal dhaafsiisan gurmadka degdegga ah ee looga falceliyo arrimaha soo-booddada ah; iyo in la helo cid lagula xisaabtamo marka ay hay’adi qaban waydo hawshii loo igmaday. Si aan taas dhab ahaan u fahanno, lacagta ayaa wax badan noo iftiiminaysa. WHO waxay sheegtay in 95 boqolkiiba maalgelinta daryeelka caafimaadka Soomaaliya ay ka timaaddo deeqbixiyayaasha dibedda, taas oo nidaamka oo dhan ka dhigaysa mid u qoobxiran go’aanno masiiri ah oo lagu soo gaaro caasimado shisheeye. Istaraatiijiyadda caafimaadka ee Soomaaliya qudheedu waxay diiwaangelisay in saamiga dawladdu ku lahayd kharashaadka caafimaadka dadweynaha ee la diiwaangeliyay uu dhanayahay xaddi u dhexeeya 7.8 boqolkiiba sannadkii 2018 ilaa 12.2 boqolkiiba sannadkii 2020. Inkastoo koror yari jiro, haddana, sida muuqata, waa mid ka soo kacay meel aad u hoosaysa. Isla istaraatiijiyaddaasina waxay ka digtay in qayb badan oo gargaarka ahi aysan haba yaraatee soo marin hannaanka dawliga ah.⁷ Daraasad la faafiyay sannadkii 2025 oo lagu sameeyey Xirmada Adeegyada Caafimaadka Aasaasiga ah (Essential Package of Health Services—EPHS), oo ah barnaamijka daryeelka aasaasiga ah ee dalka, ayaa muujisay in wax ka badan 90 boqolkiiba dhaqaalihii loo ballanqaaday muddada 2021–2026 uu ka yimid hay’ado caalami ah. Dawladda Federaalka ah iyo dawladaha xubnaha ka ah federaalka, marka la isku daro, waxay bixiyeen wax ka yar 10 boqolkiiba. Dhanka kale, qoysaska Soomaaliyeed iyaguna qayb weyn oo kharashka caafimaadka ah ayay jeebkooda ka bixiyaan. Tirooyinkan la iskuma dari karo, waayo hal wax ma wada qeexayaan. Hasayeeshee, dhammaantood hal meel ayay farta ku wada fiiqayaan: saaxiibbada caalamiga ah iyo qoysaska Soomaaliyeed ayaa dhaqaale ahaan garbaha ku haya nidaam maamulkiisu Soomaali yahay, tiirkiisa dhaqaalese aanu weli Soomaali ahayn. Sida aan u soo joognay, marka ay deeqda shisheeyuhu go’do, rugo badan oo caafimaad ayaa xirmi doona, masuul dawladeed oo arrintaas lagula xisaabtami doonaana ma jiri doono!⁷ Intani waa ka tilmaanbixinta iyo lafaguridda xaaladdeenna: dawlad aan weli carruurteeda tirakoobin, diiwaanna aan u yeelin; heer dhimasho carruureed oo dunida oo dhan ay laba dal oo keliya ay Soomaaliya kaga sarreeyaan; farqi ku dhow rubuc qarni oo u dhexeeya cimriga  qofka Soomaaliga ah ee la malayn karo iyo midka dadyowga ku dhaqan dalalka ay dawladahoodu wax isku falayaan, sida Singabuur oo aan hore u soo carrabownay; iyo nidaam caafimaad oo maamulkiisu Soomaali yahay, tiirarkiisa dhaqaale se ay shisheeye ku xiranyihiin.  Qaybta labaad ee maqaalkan ayaan lafaguridda waaqica uga gudbi doonnaa wax-iska-weydiinta masuuliyadda; innagoo su’aal ka keeni doonna kaalinta wasaarad kasta ay ku leedahay—Wasaaradda Caafimaadka oo qura ma ahee—cimriga qofka Soomaaliga ah iyo sida ay muwaaddiniintu ula xisaabtami karaan wasaaradahaas.  Qormadan waxaa laga soo dheegay cutubka 11aad ee buugga Fahandarrada Amniga ee uu qoray Guddoomiyaha Machadka Saldhig, Mudane Xuseen Sheekh Cali _______ 1. UNICEF Somalia, “Giving Every Child a Legal Identity: Somalia’s Progress towards a Birth Registration System,” 10kii Agoosto 2025, https://www.unicef.org/somalia/stories/legal-identity. UNICEF waxay soo xiganaysaa qiyaas sheegaysa in sannad kasta ay dhashaan 700,000 ilaa 800,000 oo carruur ah (Qaybta Dadweynaha ee Qaramada Midoobay, qiyaasta 2024). Iyadoo ka duulaysa Sahanka Caafimaadka iyo Tirakoobka Dadweynaha Soomaaliya ee 2020, waxay sheegaysaa in qiyaastii 3 boqolkiiba oo keliya carruurta shanta sano ka yar dhalashadooda la diiwaangeliyey, 0.3 boqolkiibana ay haystaan shahaado dhalasho. 2. UNICEF Data, “Somalia (SOM)—Demographics, Health & Infant Mortality,” la booqday 22kii Agoosto 2026, https://data.unicef.org/country/som/; World Health Organization, “Child Mortality (Under 5 Years),” 1dii Maajo 2026, https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/child-mortality-under-5-years. UNICEF waxay sheegtay in heerka dhimashada carruurta shanta sano ka yar ee Soomaaliya uu sannadkii 2024 ahaa 101.1 kunkii dhalasho nool; WHO-na waxay tibaaxday in heerka adduunku ahaa 37.4, waxayna Nayjar, Nayjeeriya iyo Soomaaliya ku tilmaantay saddexda dal ee keliya ee ka sarreeya 100. Tirada 70,000 ilaa 80,000 waa xisaab tusaale ah oo laga soo saaray qiyaasta dhalashada iyo heerka dhimashada, ee ma aha tiro laga helay diiwaan dhimasho. Waxay waafaqsan tahay qiyaasta Our World in Data ee ku dhow 78,300 oo carruur ah oo Soomaaliya ku dhintay iyagoo shan sano ka yar sannadkii 2024, taas oo ku salaysan xogta UN IGME: https://ourworldindata.org/profile/health/somalia. Sababaha ugu waaweyn waxaa laga soo qaatay dulmarka barnaamijka caafimaadka ee UNICEF Somalia: https://www.unicef.org/somalia/health. 3. UNICEF Data, “CRVS—Birth, Marriage and Death Registration in Somalia,” la booqday 22kii Agoosto 2026, https://data.unicef.org/crvs/somalia/; UNICEF Somalia, “Giving Every Child a Legal Identity,” sida kor ku xusan. Hay’adaha caafimaadka, bixiyayaasha gaarka loo leeyahay iyo ummulisooyinku way wargelin karaan ama taageeri karaan diiwaangelinta, laakiin shahaadooyinka waxaa bixiya nidaamka diiwaangelinta madaniga ah. UNICEF waxay sheegtay in nidaamka dijitaalka ah ee CRVS, oo 19 degmo lagu tijaabiyey sannadkii 2023, uu sannadkii 2025 ka shaqaynayey 48 degmo, laba sannadood gudahoodna lagu diiwaangeliyey in ka badan 43,000 oo carruur ah. Dadka dhowaan la diiwaangeliyey 70 boqolkiiba waxay ka weynayeen shan sano, taas oo muujinaysa baaxadda dibudhaca. Diiwaangelinta dhimashada qarankuna weli ma dhammaystirna. 4. World Bank, “Life Expectancy at Birth, Total (Years)—Somalia,” World Development Indicators , la booqday 22kii Agoosto 2026, https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/SP.DYN.LE00.IN?locations=SO. Bangiga Adduunku wuxuu 2024 diiwaangeliyey 58.97 sannadood; isla taxanuhu wuxuu muujinayaa 53.9 sannadkii 2022 iyo 58.8 sannadkii 2023, taas oo ka tarjumaysa dhimashadii abaarta iyo dibuhabaynta xogta. Singapore Department of Statistics, “Complete Life Tables for Singapore Resident Population, 2023–2024,” 27kii Maajo 2025, wuxuu 2024 diiwaangeliyey 83.5 sannadood; daabacaadda 2024–2025, oo la soo saaray Juun 2026, waxay 2025 u sheegtay 83.9 sannadood. Tirada Singabuur waxaa laga soo saaray jadwallada cimriga qaranka ee dadka deggan; tirada Soomaaliyana waa qiyaas hab-xisaabeed lagu sameeyey. Labadu si buuxda iskuma dhigmaan, laakiin baaxadda farqigu muran ma leh. 5. World Health Organization, “Social Determinants of Health,” la booqday 22kii Agoosto 2026, https://www.who.int/health-topics/social-determinants-of-health. 6. World Bank, “Five Facts About Poverty in Somalia,” 30kii Abriil 2025, https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/africacan/five-facts-about-poverty-in-somalia-afe-0425, oo laga soo dheegtay xogta sahanka 2022. 7. World Health Organization, “WHO: Sustaining Health Services in Somalia amid Unprecedented Funding Challenges,” 30kii Oktoobar 2025, https://www.who.int/news-room/feature-stories/detail/who-sustaining-health-services-in-somalia-amid-unprecedented-funding-challenges. WHO waxay sheegtay in 95 boqolkiiba maalgelinta daryeelka caafimaadka ay taageeraan deeqbixiyayaasha dibaddu. Ministry of Health and Human Services, Somalia, “Health Sector Strategic Plan III (HSSP III) 2022–2026,” 2022, https://moh.gov.so/so/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Health-Sector-Strategy-Plan-III.pdf. Saamiga dawladdu ku lahayd kharashka caafimaadka dadweynaha ee la diiwaangeliyey wuxuu ahaa 7.8 boqolkiiba sannadkii 2018 iyo 12.2 boqolkiiba sannadkii 2020; diiwaangelintu ma dhammaystirna, gargaar badanna miisaaniyadda ayuu ka baxsan yahay. Mohamud et al., “Equity in Health Funding: An Analysis of the Essential Package of Health Services (EPHS) in Somalia (2021–2026),” Discover Health Systems , 2025, https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s44250-025-00302-x. In ka badan 90 boqolkiiba dhaqaalaha EPHS wuxuu ka yimid deeqbixiyayaasha caalamiga ah; dawladdu waxay bixisay wax ka yar 10 boqolkiiba; qoysaskana waxaa lagu qiyaasay inay jeebkooda ka bixiyaan ilaa 45 boqolkiiba kharashka caafimaadka oo dhan. Cabbirradani waxay adeegsadaan saldhigyo kala duwan—tirada WHO waxay khusaysaa nidaamka dibadda laga maalgeliyo iyo kan dadweynaha, halka saamiga qoysasku yahay kharashka qaranka oo dhan—sidaas darteedna la iskuma dari karo.
items.fullContent: Qaybta Kowaad: Waxa ay Tirooyinku ka Maragkacaan Saboolnimada, Dawladnimada iyo Bedqabka Aadanaha ee Soomaaliya Maalin kasta Soomaaliya waxaa ku dhasha 1,900 ilaa 2,200 oo carruur ah. Sannad gudihiis, tiradu waxay mararka qaar gaartaa xaddi u dhexeeya 700,000 ilaa 800,000 oo muwaaddiniin soo kordhay ah, waxay taasi la macne tahay in magaalo hor leh ay sannad kasta ku kororto  dal ay ku nool yihiin ilaa 20 milyan oo qof. Qofna ma sheegi karo tirada saxda ah, maxaayeelay carruurtaasi ma helaan tirakoob rasmi ah oo dawladeed.  Hay’adda UNICEF waxay sheegtay in carruurta Soomaaliyeed ee shanta sano ka yar, qiyaastii 3 boqolkiiba oo qura dhalashadooda la diiwaangeliyey, 0.3 boqolkiibana ay haystaan shahaado dhalasho. Carruurta kale, oo ah 97 boqolkiiba ah, inkastoo ay hooyooyinkood u jiraan—oo ay yihiin nafley leh dhammaan astaamaha jiritaanka—misana, waa ayaandarree, weli kuma jiraan diiwaannada dawladdooda.¹ In yar bal suurayso: magaalo ay carruuri dhoobantahay, misana, waa yaabe, aysan dawladdoodu garan karin tiradooda, cayimi karin halka ay ku kala noolyihiin, ka warrami karin baahidooda, qorshana aysan ka lahayn! Dabadeed isweyddii su’aasha taas ka sii adag ee ah: immisa ayaa gaari doona sannadguuradooda shanaad? Qiyaastii ugu danbaysay waxay sheegaysaa in 1,000kii carruur Soomaaliyeed ahba ilaa 101 ay geeriyoodaan inta aysan shan jirsan. Saddex dal oo keliya—Nayjar, Nayjeeriya iyo Soomaaliya—ayaa weli leh heer dhimasho oo ka sarreeya 100 dhimasho 1,000kii dhalasho ee noolba. Haddii heerkaas lagu dabbaqo 700,000 ilaa 800,000 ee sannadkii dhasha, xisaabtu waa mid anfariir leh: haddii xaaladuhu sidooda iska sii ahaadaanna, qiyaastii 70,000 ilaa 80,000 oo ka mid ah dhallaanka sannadkan dhashay nolol kuma gaari doonaan da’da waxbarashada. Tiradani lagama soo dhiraandhirin diiwaannada dhimasho ee dawladda, waayo waddankeennu ma laha diiwaanno kaydiya dadkeenna dhinta iyo/ama kuweenna dhasha. Waase qiyaas muujinaysa baaxadda uu la egyahay ba’a na haysta oo tobankii carruur ahba mid ayaa dhinta inta uusan shan jirsan.² Dhimashooyinkani lama garan waayin sababaha keena(ya). Waa caadyaal! Qeybtood waxaa keena oofwareen; qaar fuuqbax ka dhashay shuban; qaar jadeeco aan la iska talaalin; qaarna nafaqadarro. Waxaa intaas dheer dhibaatooyin kale oo ay sababaan dayac ka dhasha xilliga dhalmada. Dhabtii, waa xaalado ay dalalka horumaray ay tobannaan ano horteed kaga adkaadeen tallaallo, biyo nadiif ah, ummulisooyin tababbaran iyo waddooyin u sahlaya hooyooyinka foolanaya gaaridda baraha caafimaad ee ay tahay in lagu baxnaaniyo. Si kale haddii loo dhigo, waa dhimashooyin ay dawlad xilkas ahi si foojigan uga hor tegi karto.  Sidaas daraaddeed, qormadani waxay ku saabsan tahay lafagurka shaqadaas joogtada ah, ee ka bilaabata hawsha maalinlaha ah ee dawladda, taas oo aan sida badan aad u muuqanin, sida kharashaadka oo waqtigooda lagu bixiyo, tallaallada oo tayadooda la dhowro, biyaha oo bedqabkooda la baaro, waddooyinka oo la dayactiro, dhalashada carruurta oo la diiwaangeliyo, xogaha muwaaddiniinta oo la hubiyo, iyo waxa ku dhaca jirka ilmaha marka hawlahaas la qabto ama la dayaco oo laga xisaabtamo ama wax la iska weydiiyo. Marka muwaaddinku arko ka dhabaynta iyo hirgelinta waxbqabadyadaas taxan, waa hubaal in ballanqaadka siyaasigu noqonayo wax la taaban karo. Waa hubaal in miisaaniyaddu noqonayso mid waxtar leh, oo tallaal u goysa cid kastoo u baahan; tallaalkuna uu badbaado u noqdo carruur faro badan oo u le’an lahaa jadeeco la dawayn karay ama laga sii hortegi karay. Waa hubaal in miisaaniyaddu dhisi karto waddooyin u suurtageliya hooyooyinka ay fooshu gubayso in ay si fudud ku gaari karaan cisbitaallada dadweynaha iyo rugaha loo asteeyay daryeelka hooyada iyo dhallaanka.  Haddaba, weydiimaha ay qormadani inna hor keenayso way fududyihiin in la istoydo, wayse adag tahay in laga jawaabo: maxaa u dhexeeya siyaasad warqad ku qoran iyo samatabixinta dhallaanka? Yaa diiwaangeliya dhalashada carruurta? Yaa bixiya dhaqaalaha tallaalka? Yaa dhowra fayaqabka biyaha? Yaa hooyada foolanaysa siiya daryeelka ay u baahantahay? Yaa waddooyinka dayactira? Yaa degaannada xasilloonidooda suga? Yay tahay in lala xisaabtamo marka nidaamku shaqayn waayo? Kuwani ma aha weydiimo bedqabka bulshada taabanaya oo keliya; waase su’aalo si toos ah farta ugu godaya amniga dadka iyo dawladnimada. Marka kowaad, wax kasta hortood, waa in laga bilaabo diiwaangelinta dhalashada carruurta, sababtoo ah waa halka ugu horraysa ee uu muwaaddinku kula kulmo dawladdiisa, dawladduna muwaaddinkeeda kula kulanto! Diiwaangelinta dhalashadu waa hawl dawladdu leedahay, xataa marka ay cid kale gacan ka geysato fulinteeda. Urur aan dawli ahayn (NGO), cusbitaal gaar loo leeyahay ama ummuliso xirfadle ah ayaa dhalashada dhallaanka sugi karta, diiwaanhayaha dawladda ku wargelin karta ama qalab dhijitaal ah soo gelin karta xogta hadba cunuggii soo kordha. Hase ahaatee, bixinta shahaadada dhalashada iyo haynta diiwaanka muwaaddinku waa masuuliyad dawladeed oo aysan cid kale buuxin karin marnaba! Soomaaliya waxay leedahay hannaan sharciyeed oo lagu diiwaangeliyo dhalashada iyo dhimashada dadka. Tan iyo 2023kiina waxaa jira nidaam dhijitaal ah oo sannadkii 2025 ka shaqaynayey 48 degmo oo guud ahaan dalka ah, laba sannadood gudahoodna lagu diiwaangeliyay in ka badan 43,000 oo carruur ah. Marka loo eego malaayiinta Soomaaliyeed ee aan weli diiwaannada dawladda fursadda u helin in ay galaan, waa tallaabo bogaadin mudan oo hore loo qaaday, Soomaaliduna waxay ku maahmaahdaa: “caano daatay dabadood la qabay”. Waa run oo in haddii qofku uusan helin shahaadada dhalashadu aysan macnaheedu ahayn in uusan jirin, waase arrin halis ah oo muujinaysa in uusan dawladdiisa u tirsanayn! Dawlad aan aqoon tirada dhallaanka ee had iyo goor dhasha ama dhinta, shaki ma laha in aysan si sugan u qorshayn karin tallaalkooda, waxbarashadooda iyo badbaadintooda.³ Arrinta kale waa dhererka cimriga la filan karo. Inkastoo maqaaddiirtu halkeeda tahay, haddana waxaa cad in ay jiraan xaalado saamaxaya in la saadaalin karo heerka nololeed ee ummad kasta, iyadoo laga duulayo heerka badbaadada iyo helidda adeegyada baxnaaninta. Tusaale ahaan, Xogta Bangiga Adduunka ee hadda la heli karo waxay cimriga qofka Soomaaliya ku dhasha, sannadkii 2024, ku qiyaasaystay 59.0 sannadood. Halka dalka Singabuur uu isla sannadkaas diiwaangeliyay in cimriga qofka dalkaas ku dhasha uu gaari karo celcelis dhan 83.5 sannadood. Farqigu waa qiyaastii afar iyo labaatan sannadood ama ku dhowaad rubuc qarni nololeed ah oo ay isdheeryihiin labada qof ee ku kala dhashay Soomaaliya iyo Singabuur.  Akhristuhu wuxuu meelo kale ku arki karaa qiyaaso Soomaaliya u dhigaya bartamaha kontomeeyada. Qiyaasuhu sannadba sannadka ka danbeeya way kaladuwanyihiin. Metelan, abaartii 2022kii saabatay geyiga Soomaaliyeed dhimashada si weyn ayay kor ugu qaadday. Sidaas darteed, sugidda kaladuwanaanta tirooyinku ma aha wax sii ridan, marba haddii qiyaas kasta oo la soo hadalqaado ay Soomaaliya aad uga hoosaysiinayso dalalka ay nidaamyadooda dadweyne muddo dheer yareeyeen halisaha dhimasho ee laga hortegi karo.⁴ Immisa sannadood ayuu qofka Soomaaliga ahi fili karaa in uu noolaado? Oddoroska dhererka cimriga la filan karo wuxuu ka midyahay halbeegyada dadweyne ee sida ugu mudan looga dheehan karo hannaanka dal loo maamulo. Dooddu ma aha in xalku yahay inta madaxweyne ama wasiir yimaaddo uu qaado olole, muddaxileedkiisaas, uu misana sidaas Soomaaliya kaga saari karo hogga hoosaynta, kuna dari karo safka dalalka horumaray ee yareeyay halisaha dhimasho ee laga hortegi karo. Dawladina taas ma samayn karto! Doodda qummani waxay tahay in cimriga dheeri suurtagal noqon karo oo keliya marka: dawladdu ka libhesho halisaha laga hortegi karo; oo ay dadkeeda ka dhowrto abaaraha iyo tabaalaha adduun ee asaaggood ka reebay; oo ay dhisto adeegyo bulsho oo la isku hallayn karo, had iyo jeerna la heli karo, kaddibna ku fara-adaygto joogtayntooda, oo jiilba jiil ka dhaxlo! Qodob kasta oo tallaabooyinkaas ka mid ahi waxaa sees u ah go’aan siyaasadeed oo aan afka baarkiisa ahayn. Waxa ay Tiradu ka Maragkacdo Cimriga la filan karo, mar kasta, waa qiyaas ee hubanti ma aha! Hayeeshee, qiyaas kasta waxaa hadba si yaab leh ugu lammaan oo laga fahmi karaa waxa bulsho walba hesho ama heli waydo oo ay lumiso, sida: carruurta badbaadada xilliga ay muluqa yihiin; hooyooyinka foolanaya ee hela daryeel caafimaad oo ku habboon; biyo bedqabka qofka u roon; cunto ku ku filan dadka; xakamaynta cudurrada faafa; ammaanka waddooyinka iyo xaafadaha; iyo kahortegidda xanuunnada inta aysan safmarka noqon ee aysan gallaafanin kummaanka nafood. Waxaa maragmaddoonto ah in aan hadal lagu wanaajin karin oddoroskaas, saa meel ‘hoo’ u baahan hadal waxba kama taree! Waxaa lagu wanaajin karaa oo keliya in la beddelo xaaladaha uu oddoroskaasi ka tilmaanbixinayo. Sidaas awgeed, sax ma aha caafimaadka bulshada mlagu soo koobo cisbitaallada. Ururka Caafimaadka Adduunku wuxuu tilmaamayaa in caafimaadka qofka ay qaabeeyaan wadajirka: xaaladaha uu ku dhasho, ku koro, ku shaqeeyo, ku noolaado, kuna gaboobo. Saboolnimada iyo fursadyarida bulsheed raadkooda ayaa si toos ah looga dhex arki karaa hadba xaddiga cudurrada dadka warjeefa iyo dhimashada sahalka ah. Waa dhab oo tallaalku waa dawo; ha ahaatee, in lala gaaro cududda ilmo ku nool tuulo saddex saacadood u jirta laamiga ugu dhow, dhabtii, waa guul dawladnimo; waxayse u baahan tahay in talaalkaas la soo iibiyo, gaadiid la soo saaro, heerkul qabow lagu kaydiyo, hawlwadeenno tababbaran loo carbiyo, dhabbe iyo waddo lagu gaari karo degaankaas la helo, xog lagu kalsoonaan karo laga duulo, la kasbado oo la hanto kalsoonida shacabka iyo, ugu danbayn, in la helo cid lagula xisaabtamo marka ay hawshaasi fuli waydo!⁵ Dhinaca kale, biyo nadiif ahi iskood uma yimaaddaan, ee waxay u baahanyihiin injineerro ugu taga gunta dhulka oo ka soo saara, dawlad u samaysa xeerar iyo habraacyo dhowra tayadooda, koronto iyo dayactir joogto ah. Sidoo kale, helidda waddo dhisan ama aan dhisnayn ayaa go’aamin karta in hooyo foolanaysaa cusbitaalka gaarto iyo in kale; in raashinku suuqa yimaaddo iyo in kale; iyo, waa midda ugu muhiimsane, in hawlwadeennada caafimaad ay gaari karaan tuulo bartamaha dalka ku taalla iyo in kale. Go’aannada dawladdu waa dhif inta ay si toos ah u kordhin kartaan cimriga dadka–waxayse hoos u dhigi karaan halis jirta; waxay tayayn karaan adeegbixinta; waxay sare u qaadi karaan dakhliga qoysaska; waxay fursad waxbarasho siin karaan gabar yar oo tuuladoodii ari ku raacaysa; waxay hay’adaha dalka ka dhigi karaan kuwo lagu kalsoonyahay oo shacabku isku hallayn karo. “Dhibic-dhibic baa balli ku buuxsamaaye”, tobannaan sano gudahood, saamaynta raadadkaas yaryar oo isbiirsaday baa miradhalkoodu noqdaa dantakeliya ee aan leennahay, taas oo ah: carruur Soomaaliyeed oo faro badan oo badbaada iyo dad badan oo cimriya! Maxaa Soomaaliya Dibdhigay? Halka ay Soomaaliya maanta joogto waa natiijada waayidda aasaasiyaadkii bulshada oo muddo dheer isa soo taraysay iyo nuglaanta hay’ado dawladeed oo jiitantay, kuwaas oo dhalay: burbur dawladeed, colaado lagu riiqmay, barakac, abaaro ba’an oo aan sannad walba geyiga oo dhan wada saabta, adeegyo bulsho oo liita, kaabayaal dhaqaale oo aan jirin ama aad u yar iyo saboolnimo baahsan. Qoysaska Soomaaliyeed waxay marxalad kasta kaga soo gudbayn/samatabaxeen karti iyo dadaal, kuwaas oo aan ka xusi karno lacagaha dibedda uga yimaadda, ganacsiyada gaarka ah, istaakulaynta dhaqanka ku aroorta iyo gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Adkaysigaasi waa mid dhab ah oo jira, wuxuuna mudanyahay in si dhiirran la bogaadiyo. Laakiin, waxaa iyaduna xusid mudan in adkaysigu yahay tab ay dadku isu bixiyaan, marka dawladdu dadkeeda gabto. Si kasta oo uu u qiimo badanyahay isxilqaankaas bulsheed, waxaan shaki ku jirin in uusan keligiis buuxin karin kaalinta nidaam dawladeed oo shaqaynaya, mana habboona in culayskaas oo dhan dusha laga saaro dadweynahan ay toodu cuslaysay. Saboolnimadu lacagla’aan (busaaradnimo) oo qura ma aha. Sidoo kale, waa xaalad uu qoysku tahli waayo gaadiidkii gaarsiin lahaa rugaha caafimaadka; iibsan waayo wax uu quuto; awoodi waayo in uu ilmihiisa waxbarasho ka sii bixiyo; heli waayo biyo nadiif ah; ama uu saddex toddobaad dakhli la’aan ku noolaado. Waxaa jiritaanka arrintaas maragfur u noqon kara qiimayntii ugu danbaysay ee uu Bangiga Adduunka, taasoo tibaaxaysa in wax ka badan kalabar dadka Soomaaliyeed ay ku noolyihiin wax ka hooseeya xadka saboolnimada ee caadiga ah, iyadoo bulshooyinka reerguuraagu ugu sii daranyihiin. Saboolnimada Soomaaliya ayay warbixintu ku sheegtay mid dhinacyo badan leh, sida biyayaraan, fayadhowrla’aan, korontayari, waxbarashada oo liidata iyo in aan laga gaashaaman aafooyinka la fili karo dhiciddooda. Sidaas darteed, saboolnimadeennu, waa ayaandarro inteeda la ege, waa isugeynta aafooyinkaas!⁶ Waayidda aasaasiyaadka noloshu waxay dadka u nugleeyaan dhibaato kasta oo la soo gudboonaata. Ilmo nafaqadarro hayso ayaa u dhiman kara caabuq yar oo uu kaga bogsan lahaa in uu helo cunto nafaqo ahaan dhammaystiran, yacnii waa qof durey ama hargab uu kaalmaati u waayay darteed u godgala! Hooyo xaammilo ah oo aan gaari karin rugaha daryeelka ee hooyada iyo dhallaanka ayaa u ummulraaci karta baxnaano la’aan. Bal suurayso qoys Soomaaliyeed oo neefkii xoolahoodaba ugu danbeeyay isaga iibiya si ay daawo u siistaan! Waa hubaal in qoyskaasu ceyroobayo, baylahna u noqonayo abaarta ugu soo horraysa ee asiibta. Sidaas awgeed, saboolnimadu waxay ku sidkantahay oo ku jirtaa doodgelinta oddoroska cimri ee bulsho kastaa filan karto, marna ma aha arrin ka baxsan. Dawladdii doonaysa inay dadkeedu cimri dheer noolaadaan waa in ay, wax kasta oo kale horteed, qoysaskeeda u suurtagelisaa inay wax tacbadaan, wax kaydsadaan oo dhigaal samaystaan, oo ka kabtaan dhibaatooyinka waayuhu ku markadaan—sababta oo ah, “belaayo kahortag mooyaane, kadabatag ma leh!” Teeda kale, in xaaladda maanta jirta hal hoggaamiye ama hal maamul dusha laga saaraa waa hadal meleggiis galay! Sababtoo ah, qaar ka mid ah duruufahaas waa kuwo la iska dhaxlay; qaarna waxay ka dhasheen dagaallo, abaaro, xasilloonidarro goboleed iyo/ama go’aanno laga gaaray dibedda dalka. Ma jiro hal masuul oo horjoogsan kara dhibaatooyinka oo dhan. Laakiin, taasi ma aha in masuuliyaddu tahay wax ka dhigan, “cadow ku cunay ama ku ciideeyay” ama in dhibta oo dhan dusha loo rito ama la iska wada diido; yacnii masuulku sida uusan wax kasta cawaaqibtooda u wada qaadaynin, ayuu, misana, uga wada madaxbannaanayn!  Haddii aan tagtadeenna milicsanno, tan iyo dhismihii Jamhuuriyadda Saddexaad, Dawladda Soomaaliyeed lama imaan rabitaan siyaasadeed oo dhab ah oo ay ilaalinta nolosha aadanaha ku siinaysa mudnaan iyo hortebin ka mid danaha qaranka. Si aan taas u garanno aan marka hore dul istaagno miisaaniyadda. Miisaaniyaddu kama maragkacayso niyadda siyaasiga; waxayse, miisaaniyaddu, muujinaysaa in ballanqaadka siyaasigu leeyahay dhaqaale lagu fuliyo, joogtayn lagu taabbageliyo iyo islaxisaabtan daba yaal—haddaan Soomaali nahayna—sooyaalka arrintaasi ma aha mid aan ku faani karno!  Maamulxumadeenna dawladeed ee isbarkan kuma koobna musuqmaasuq, kartidarro ama ujeeddooyin gurracan iyo dano shakhsi ah—inkasta oo ay misana intaasi jiraan–haddana waxaa dheeraad ku ah in si joogta ah loogu guuldarraysto in awoodda dawladnimo loo beddeli waayo badbaado muwaaddinku ku tashan karo, yacnii in adeegga dawladeed uu sii shaqeeyo marka xafladdii daahfurku/xarigjarku idlaato; in xogta la ururiyo oo la adeegsado; in wasaaraduhu yeeshaan wadashaqayn dhow; in qorshuhu noqdo mid ku salaysan hiigsi qaran oo fog iyo hiraal dhaafsiisan gurmadka degdegga ah ee looga falceliyo arrimaha soo-booddada ah; iyo in la helo cid lagula xisaabtamo marka ay hay’adi qaban waydo hawshii loo igmaday. Si aan taas dhab ahaan u fahanno, lacagta ayaa wax badan noo iftiiminaysa. WHO waxay sheegtay in 95 boqolkiiba maalgelinta daryeelka caafimaadka Soomaaliya ay ka timaaddo deeqbixiyayaasha dibedda, taas oo nidaamka oo dhan ka dhigaysa mid u qoobxiran go’aanno masiiri ah oo lagu soo gaaro caasimado shisheeye. Istaraatiijiyadda caafimaadka ee Soomaaliya qudheedu waxay diiwaangelisay in saamiga dawladdu ku lahayd kharashaadka caafimaadka dadweynaha ee la diiwaangeliyay uu dhanayahay xaddi u dhexeeya 7.8 boqolkiiba sannadkii 2018 ilaa 12.2 boqolkiiba sannadkii 2020. Inkastoo koror yari jiro, haddana, sida muuqata, waa mid ka soo kacay meel aad u hoosaysa. Isla istaraatiijiyaddaasina waxay ka digtay in qayb badan oo gargaarka ahi aysan haba yaraatee soo marin hannaanka dawliga ah.⁷ Daraasad la faafiyay sannadkii 2025 oo lagu sameeyey Xirmada Adeegyada Caafimaadka Aasaasiga ah (Essential Package of Health Services—EPHS), oo ah barnaamijka daryeelka aasaasiga ah ee dalka, ayaa muujisay in wax ka badan 90 boqolkiiba dhaqaalihii loo ballanqaaday muddada 2021–2026 uu ka yimid hay’ado caalami ah. Dawladda Federaalka ah iyo dawladaha xubnaha ka ah federaalka, marka la isku daro, waxay bixiyeen wax ka yar 10 boqolkiiba. Dhanka kale, qoysaska Soomaaliyeed iyaguna qayb weyn oo kharashka caafimaadka ah ayay jeebkooda ka bixiyaan. Tirooyinkan la iskuma dari karo, waayo hal wax ma wada qeexayaan. Hasayeeshee, dhammaantood hal meel ayay farta ku wada fiiqayaan: saaxiibbada caalamiga ah iyo qoysaska Soomaaliyeed ayaa dhaqaale ahaan garbaha ku haya nidaam maamulkiisu Soomaali yahay, tiirkiisa dhaqaalese aanu weli Soomaali ahayn. Sida aan u soo joognay, marka ay deeqda shisheeyuhu go’do, rugo badan oo caafimaad ayaa xirmi doona, masuul dawladeed oo arrintaas lagula xisaabtami doonaana ma jiri doono!⁷ Intani waa ka tilmaanbixinta iyo lafaguridda xaaladdeenna: dawlad aan weli carruurteeda tirakoobin, diiwaanna aan u yeelin; heer dhimasho carruureed oo dunida oo dhan ay laba dal oo keliya ay Soomaaliya kaga sarreeyaan; farqi ku dhow rubuc qarni oo u dhexeeya cimriga  qofka Soomaaliga ah ee la malayn karo iyo midka dadyowga ku dhaqan dalalka ay dawladahoodu wax isku falayaan, sida Singabuur oo aan hore u soo carrabownay; iyo nidaam caafimaad oo maamulkiisu Soomaali yahay, tiirarkiisa dhaqaale se ay shisheeye ku xiranyihiin.  Qaybta labaad ee maqaalkan ayaan lafaguridda waaqica uga gudbi doonnaa wax-iska-weydiinta masuuliyadda; innagoo su’aal ka keeni doonna kaalinta wasaarad kasta ay ku leedahay—Wasaaradda Caafimaadka oo qura ma ahee—cimriga qofka Soomaaliga ah iyo sida ay muwaaddiniintu ula xisaabtami karaan wasaaradahaas.  Qormadan waxaa laga soo dheegay cutubka 11aad ee buugga Fahandarrada Amniga ee uu qoray Guddoomiyaha Machadka Saldhig, Mudane Xuseen Sheekh Cali _______ 1. items.title: Cunnooyinka ay Soomaalidu isticmaasho ee aan u fiicneyn beerka
items.description: Shalay oo kale 28 July, waxaa caalamka laga xusaa maalinta ka hortagga iyo wacyigelinta cagaarshowga, oo saameeya dadyow badan oo dunida ku nool. Wasaaradda caafimaadka dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta magaalada Muqdisho ku qabatay xuska maalintan, iyo macluumaad ku saabsan cagaarshowga iyo bulshada Soomaalida. Xuska Maalinta Cagaarshowga Adduunka waxaa lagu muujiyaa muhiimadda beerku u leeyahay nolol caafimaad qabta, iyo baahida loo qabo in sare loo qaado ka-hortagga fayraska cudurkan. Soomaaliya waxay ka mid tahya dalalka hiigsanaya ciribtirka cagaarshoowga wixii loo gaaro sanadka 2030. Hal-ku-dhigga sannadkan ayaa ah “Hal Nolol, Beer”. Bbc somali

items.title: The Problem Is Not a Lack of Worship—It Is the Absence of Accountability: A Rejoinder
items.description: By Dayib Sh. Ahmed In the aftermath of a devastating war that has claimed countless lives, destroyed homes, scattered families, and shattered dreams, the people of Somalia have risen once more not in despair, but in determination; not in resignation, but with a spirit of resistance against humiliation and continued suffering. For decades, Somalia has endured conflict, poverty, displacement, political fragmentation, and institutional collapse. These realities provide important background to the question raised by Dr. Abdurahman Baadiyow in his article on WardheerNews, “ Much Worship, Little Morality, What Is Wrong with Us? ” His question invites us to look beyond the visible symptoms of Somalia’s crisis and examine the deeper moral, social, political, and institutional forces that have shaped the country’s prolonged tragedy. The Question Is Not “What Is Wrong with Us?” It Is “What Happened to Us?” If Somalia is a deeply religious society, why have we remained trapped for more than three decades in conflict, poverty, political division, corruption, and weak governance? Perhaps we are asking the wrong question. Full mosques, fasting, prayer, Qur’an recitation, hijab, and Hajj and Umrah do not necessarily mean that Somalis have failed in their religion. They may instead reveal a critical distinction between personal faith and political institutions. Ordinary citizens do not control national Branches of Governments, appoint political leaders, command security forces, or manage state institutions. Those responsibilities belong primarily to political leaders and institutions. Consequently, when state actors breach the public trust, citizens absorb the psychological fallout of structural failure. This is where the work of psychiatrist and trauma expert Professor Bruce D. Perry at Yale University School of Medicine, and co-author of What Happened to You? offers an important way of thinking about Somalia’s experience. Reflecting on his career studying trauma, Perry wrote, “Throughout my career, I have focused on understanding how stress and trauma alter the human experience behavior and emotional. When people have killed one another, taken each other’s property, and never confronted the past, expressed remorse, or sought redemption, deep behavioral and emotional wounds can develop. These unresolved experiences can produce suspicion, fear, resentment, and mistrust, making genuine reconciliation and the rebuilding of social trust extremely difficult.” His insight reminds us that prolonged violence, insecurity, displacement, poverty, and social breakdown can profoundly shape individuals and societies. Somalia has experienced generations of precisely these conditions. But understanding our wounds does not mean excusing our failures. The deeper question is therefore not simply, what is wrong with us? It is What happened to us? What happened to our institutions, and how to fixed, the public trust, justice, accountability, and political responsibility after state collapse, civil war, and decades of insecurity and poverty? Somalia has also been politically divided for far too long. We have yet to achieve Meaningful national healing and a lasting political agreement. What Somalia urgently needs is real reconciliation not temporary political bargains, but an honest settlement that addresses historical grievances, political differences, federalism, power-sharing, and disputes over governance and national resources. Without reconciliation, consensus, and trust, Somalia risks repeating the same cycle of political confrontation and institutional crisis. Understanding what happened to us does not remove individual responsibility, rather, it helps us identify the deeper causes of our collective failure. Somalia needs both personal morality and public accountability, religious devotion and good governance, individual responsibility and institutional justice. If we truly want to rebuild Somalia, we must stop asking only what is wrong with Somalis. We must have the courage to ask what happened to us, why it happened, who bears responsibility, and what we must do differently. After more than three decades, the answer cannot simply be more politics as usual. Somalia needs reconciliation, a genuine political settlement, accountable institutions, justice, and leadership capable of rebuilding public trust. Only then can we begin to build the country we have spent decades struggling to recover. In 1961, Yale psychologist Stanley Milgram conducted an experiment to understand how ordinary people could participate in atrocities such as those committed during Nazi Germany. His research explored whether people would obey an authority figure even when instructed to harm another person. Participants were told they were administering electric shocks as part of a learning experiment. Although the “victims” were actors pretending to be shocked, the participants believed the suffering was real. Surprisingly, most continued administering increasingly severe shocks simply because they were instructed to do so by an authority figure. Milgram concluded that people can be remarkably receptive to authority and to new rules in unfamiliar settings. His findings suggested that ordinary individuals may commit harmful acts when they believe they are serving a legitimate purpose under the direction of authority. As Milgram later recalled, “ I found so much obedience that I hardly saw the need for taking the experiment to Germany.” This insight can also be connected to Jared Diamond’s argument in his Book Collapse: How Societies Choose to Fail or Succeed . Diamond argues that societies are shaped not only by the crises they face, but also by the choices they make in responding to those crises. He identifies two crucial factors: “long-term planning” and “willingness to reconsider core values.” Somalia’s tragedy, therefore, should not be understood simply by asking, what is wrong with us? We must also ask, what happened to us? We are not the only society to have experienced civil war, but we are among those that have yet to achieve genuine truth and reconciliation or establish meaningful criminal accountability. The deeper challenge is not simply that we have suffered conflict, but that we have failed to fully confront the crimes, acknowledge the harm, and hold those responsible accountable. Without truth, justice, and reconciliation, the wounds of the past remain open, and the cycle of mistrust, impunity, and political division continues. History offers a powerful example of how societies can reach a point where crisis demands fundamental change. On the eve of the French Revolution, France, Europe’s most powerful land power, was facing a severe financial crisis. Much of its debt had accumulated from the enormous costs of supporting the American Revolution against Britain. At the same time, an extravagant and increasingly corrupt ruling elite had become disconnected from the realities of society, while a growing middle class, excluded from meaningful political influence, demanded greater representation and reform. Meanwhile, workers and peasants struggled with poverty, rising prices, and hunger. New Enlightenment ideas were also transforming political thinking, emphasizing individual rights, political representation, and new forms of government. Yet the French monarchy and its privileged court failed to recognize how deep public anger had become. They believed their wealth, status, and political power were secure. They were profoundly mistaken. The monarchy eventually collapsed, giving way to a turbulent and violent republic, and within a decade, Napoleon Bonaparte had emerged as emperor. The French experience does not provide a direct blueprint for Somalia, but it offers an important lesson, societies cannot preserve failing political arrangements indefinitely simply because those arrangements have existed for a long time. When leaders refuse to recognize legitimate grievances, reconsider outdated assumptions, or reform institutions, the consequences can become far more destructive than the reforms they sought to avoid. Somalia’s future depends on whether its leaders and citizens are willing to learn from history, confront the past honestly, and make the difficult choices that genuine reconciliation and institutional renewal require. The question is not whether Somalia has suffered enough, but whether we are finally prepared to choose a different future. Public Office Is an Amanah, Not, a Personal Privilege The challenge, therefore, is not simply to ask who should hold power, but how power itself can be structured so that it attracts responsible leaders and restrains those who would abuse it. As Brian Klaas, author of Corruptible and Professor of Global Politics at University College London, argues in his book, “If corruptible people want power more, are better at getting power, and some good people are corrupted by wielding it, how can we invert those dynamics? What can be done to fix it? It’s time to figure out how to make sure that more good people seek power, get it, and stay good once they’re in charge.” This question has particular relevance to Somalia, where public office is too often treated as a source of personal wealth, political reward, or patronage rather than as a responsibility to the public. Islam teaches that power is an Amanah a trust and a responsibility. Public wealth is not the private property of the person sitting in a government office; it belongs to the people and must be protected. Leadership is not merely obtaining a title, winning an election, securing an appointment, or occupying a ministerial chair. Leadership means accepting responsibility for results. A minister who spends years in office but leaves behind no meaningful institution must be questioned. A President and Prime minister, who controls public resources without transparent accounting must be questioned. A parliamentarian who remains silent while public money is misused must be questioned. A senior official who repeatedly fails to perform his duties must be questioned. And political leaders who surround themselves with incompetent or unaccountable officials must also answer to the public. Position without performance is not leadership. Power without accountability is not governance. Religious language without ethical conduct is not enough. We must stop treating government positions as personal investments or rewards for political loyalty. Public office should be earned through integrity, proficiency, and service not through clan connections, wealth, favoritism, or the ability to manipulate political networks. Ending the Culture of Impunity and Political Double Standards Human beings have been fascinated by power for thousands of years, but the modern study of power became increasingly systematic after World War II, as scholars sought to understand how ordinary people could participate in extraordinary acts of cruelty. The Milgram experiments demonstrated how readily individuals could obey authority even when doing so could cause serious harm, while Hannah Arendt’s concept of the “banality of evil” raised the disturbing possibility that terrible acts can be committed not only by monsters, but also by ordinary people operating within systems of authority. Philip Zimbardo’s Stanford Prison Experiment further contributed to debates about how roles, institutions, and environments can influence human behavior. These studies offer an important lens through which to examine Somalia’s experience, where decades of war, political violence, displacement, unresolved grievances, and the abuse of authority have left lasting effects long after the fighting stops. Such experiences can shape attitudes toward power, trust, responsibility, and other communities. When violence becomes normalized and accountability remains absent, individuals and institutions can develop patterns of behavior that reproduce fear, suspicion, domination, and political division. Understanding the relationship between power, human behavior, and institutions therefore helps us ask a deeper question about Somalia. What happened to us, and how did decades of conflict transform the way we understand power, responsibility, and one another? for decades, Somalis have witnessed individuals move from one political position to another without meaningful accountability for previous failures. People can participate in failed administrations, controversial decisions, corruption allegations, institutional destruction, or political crises and later reappear in another powerful position as though nothing happened. That culture of impunity must end. We cannot continue rewarding failure with another appointment or confusing political loyalty with competence. At the same time, citizens must examine their own behavior. We must stop defending corruption simply because the corrupt person belongs to our clan, family, political faction, or social network. If we condemn corruption when our opponents commit it but defend it when our own people benefit, then we become part of the problem. We cannot demand justice for ourselves while accepting injustice against others, nor can we condemn corruption in one administration while celebrating or excusing it in another. That is not justice; it is political tribalism disguised as principle. Somalia needs citizens courageous enough to ask: Where did the public money go? What was accomplished? Who benefited? Who was responsible? Where are the audits? Why was the official not investigated? And what happens when those entrusted with public power violate the law? furthermore, Somalia’s transformation requires both moral renewal and institutional accountability. Religion should produce honesty, justice, compassion, discipline, and responsibility, but those values must also be translated into functioning institutions. We need independent courts, transparent public finances, professional civil services, effective parliaments, credible oversight mechanisms, accountable security institutions, free media, and political systems in which citizens can reward performance and punish failure. A functioning state cannot depend on whether the individual occupying an office happens to be a good person. Institutions must be strong enough to constrain a bad leader and empower a good one. Citizens must also understand that questioning government is not disrespect, demanding transparency is not rebellion, investigating public expenditure is not hostility, and holding a president or minister accountable is not hatred of the nation. Accountability is patriotism. Somalia does not need citizens who blindly praise whoever occupies the presidential palace. It needs citizens who understand their rights, demand transparency, reject corruption regardless of who commits it, and recognize that public officials are servants of the people not masters of the people. How Small Compromises Normalize Extremism and Why Power Must Be Held Accountable Professor Timothy Snyder, a Yale University historian and author of On Tyranny: Twenty Lessons from the Twentieth Century , describes how professors, students, and intellectuals in Romania gradually became members of the Iron Guard. Their transformation often began with small compromises and the normalization of extremist ideas. His observation reminds us that authoritarianism grows not only through the ambitions of leaders, but also through the gradual surrender of principles by those who believe they can accommodate extremism without becoming part of it. rise of fascism in Romania, one witness recalled how university professors, students, and intellectuals were “turning Nazi, becoming Iron Guards, one after the other.” At first, many were not Nazis. They gathered to debate and oppose the movement, but gradually some began making small concessions admitting that they agreed with certain arguments. One by one, they became caught in what the witness called “the mechanism” and eventually accepted everything. In the end, only a few continued to resist. This historical experience offers a powerful lesson about the nature of power, political influence, and moral responsibility. People do not always abandon their principles in one dramatic moment. Sometimes the transformation begins with small compromises, silence, rationalization, or the acceptance of behavior that they once opposed. Over time, these compromises can become normalized, and what was once unacceptable can begin to appear ordinary. Ultimately, the real measure of leadership is not how frequently a person speaks about religion, how often they attend the mosque, or how convincingly they speak about patriotism. The real measure is what happens to society while that person is entrusted with power. Did poverty decrease? Did justice improve? Did corruption decline? Did institutions become stronger? Did citizens become safer? Did public resources benefit the public? Did the leader create opportunities for young people? Did the government provide basic services? Did the leader leave behind institutions stronger than those they inherited? These are the questions history will ask. Somalia needs leaders who fear Allah, but it also needs institutions capable of investigating and holding them accountable. It needs leaders with good character, but also laws capable of preventing the abuse of power. It needs citizens who pray, but also citizens who understand their rights and responsibilities. It needs reconciliation, but reconciliation without justice can preserve impunity. It needs elections, but elections without accountability can simply replace one failed leadership with another. It needs constitutions, but constitutions without enforcement are merely pieces of paper. Somalia’s future will not be secured by religious appearances alone. It will be secured when faith produces character, character produces responsibility, responsibility produces accountability, accountability produces competent institutions, and competent institutions produce a state that serves its citizens. The time has come to educate our people that government is not a private inheritance, public office is not personal property, and national resources are not political spoils. They belong to the people, and anyone entrusted with them must be prepared to account for every decision, every expenditure, every achievement, and every failure. Dayib Sh. Ahmed Email: Dayib0658@gmail.com —— Dayib is a writer, political analyst and WardheerNews contributor   The post The Problem Is Not a Lack of Worship—It Is the Absence of Accountability: A Rejoinder appeared first on WardheerNews .

Islam teaches that power is an Amanah a trust and a responsibility. Public wealth is not the private property of the person sitting in a government office; it belongs to the people and must be protected. Leadership is not merely obtaining a title, winning an election, securing an appointment, or occupying a ministerial chair. Leadership means accepting responsibility for results. A minister who spends years in office but leaves behind no meaningful institution must be questioned. A President and Prime minister, who controls public resources without transparent accounting must be questioned. A parliamentarian who remains silent while public money is misused must be questioned. A senior official who repeatedly fails to perform his duties must be questioned. And political leaders who surround themselves with incompetent or unaccountable officials must also answer to the public. Position without performance is not leadership. Power without accountability is not governance. Religious language without ethical conduct is not enough. We must stop treating government positions as personal investments or rewards for political loyalty. Public office should be earned through integrity, proficiency, and service not through clan connections, wealth, favoritism, or the ability to manipulate political networks. Ending the Culture of Impunity and Political Double Standards Human beings have been fascinated by power for thousands of years, but the modern study of power became increasingly systematic after World War II, as scholars sought to understand how ordinary people could participate in extraordinary acts of cruelty. The Milgram experiments demonstrated how readily individuals could obey authority even when doing so could cause serious harm, while Hannah Arendt’s concept of the “banality of evil” raised the disturbing possibility that terrible acts can be committed not only by monsters, but also by ordinary people operating within systems of authority. Philip Zimbardo’s Stanford Prison Experiment further contributed to debates about how roles, institutions, and environments can influence human behavior. These studies offer an important lens through which to examine Somalia’s experience, where decades of war, political violence, displacement, unresolved grievances, and the abuse of authority have left lasting effects long after the fighting stops. Such experiences can shape attitudes toward power, trust, responsibility, and other communities. When violence becomes normalized and accountability remains absent, individuals and institutions can develop patterns of behavior that reproduce fear, suspicion, domination, and political division. Understanding the relationship between power, human behavior, and institutions therefore helps us ask a deeper question about Somalia. What happened to us, and how did decades of conflict transform the way we understand power, responsibility, and one another? for decades, Somalis have witnessed individuals move from one political position to another without meaningful accountability for previous failures. People can participate in failed administrations, controversial decisions, corruption allegations, institutional destruction, or political crises and later reappear in another powerful position as though nothing happened. That culture of impunity must end. We cannot continue rewarding failure with another appointment or confusing political loyalty with competence. At the same time, citizens must examine their own behavior. We must stop defending corruption simply because the corrupt person belongs to our clan, family, political faction, or social network. If we condemn corruption when our opponents commit it but defend it when our own people benefit, then we become part of the problem. We cannot demand justice for ourselves while accepting injustice against others, nor can we condemn corruption in one administration while celebrating or excusing it in another. That is not justice; it is political tribalism disguised as principle. Somalia needs citizens courageous enough to ask: Where did the public money go? What was accomplished? Who benefited? Who was responsible? Where are the audits? Why was the official not investigated? And what happens when those entrusted with public power violate the law? furthermore, Somalia’s transformation requires both moral renewal and institutional accountability. Religion should produce honesty, justice, compassion, discipline, and responsibility, but those values must also be translated into functioning institutions. We need independent courts, transparent public finances, professional civil services, effective parliaments, credible oversight mechanisms, accountable security institutions, free media, and political systems in which citizens can reward performance and punish failure. A functioning state cannot depend on whether the individual occupying an office happens to be a good person. Institutions must be strong enough to constrain a bad leader and empower a good one. Citizens must also understand that questioning government is not disrespect, demanding transparency is not rebellion, investigating public expenditure is not hostility, and holding a president or minister accountable is not hatred of the nation. Accountability is patriotism. Somalia does not need citizens who blindly praise whoever occupies the presidential palace. It needs citizens who understand their rights, demand transparency, reject corruption regardless of who commits it, and recognize that public officials are servants of the people not masters of the people. How Small Compromises Normalize Extremism and Why Power Must Be Held Accountable Professor Timothy Snyder, a Yale University historian and author of On Tyranny: Twenty Lessons from the Twentieth Century , describes how professors, students, and intellectuals in Romania gradually became members of the Iron Guard. Their transformation often began with small compromises and the normalization of extremist ideas. His observation reminds us that authoritarianism grows not only through the ambitions of leaders, but also through the gradual surrender of principles by those who believe they can accommodate extremism without becoming part of it. rise of fascism in Romania, one witness recalled how university professors, students, and intellectuals were “turning Nazi, becoming Iron Guards, one after the other.” At first, many were not Nazis. They gathered to debate and oppose the movement, but gradually some began making small concessions admitting that they agreed with certain arguments. One by one, they became caught in what the witness called “the mechanism” and eventually accepted everything. In the end, only a few continued to resist. This historical experience offers a powerful lesson about the nature of power, political influence, and moral responsibility. People do not always abandon their principles in one dramatic moment. Sometimes the transformation begins with small compromises, silence, rationalization, or the acceptance of behavior that they once opposed. Over time, these compromises can become normalized, and what was once unacceptable can begin to appear ordinary. Ultimately, the real measure of leadership is not how frequently a person speaks about religion, how often they attend the mosque, or how convincingly they speak about patriotism. The real measure is what happens to society while that person is entrusted with power. Did poverty decrease? Did justice improve? Did corruption decline? Did institutions become stronger? Did citizens become safer? Did public resources benefit the public? Did the leader create opportunities for young people? Did the government provide basic services? Did the leader leave behind institutions stronger than those they inherited? These are the questions history will ask. Somalia needs leaders who fear Allah, but it also needs institutions capable of investigating and holding them accountable. It needs leaders with good character, but also laws capable of preventing the abuse of power. It needs citizens who pray, but also citizens who understand their rights and responsibilities. It needs reconciliation, but reconciliation without justice can preserve impunity. It needs elections, but elections without accountability can simply replace one failed leadership with another. It needs constitutions, but constitutions without enforcement are merely pieces of paper. Somalia’s future will not be secured by religious appearances alone. It will be secured when faith produces character, character produces responsibility, responsibility produces accountability, accountability produces competent institutions, and competent institutions produce a state that serves its citizens. The time has come to educate our people that government is not a private inheritance, public office is not personal property, and national resources are not political spoils. They belong to the people, and anyone entrusted with them must be prepared to account for every decision, every expenditure, every achievement, and every failure. Dayib Sh. items.title: Sacuudiga oo danaynaya maalgashiga dahabka Burkina Faso
items.description: Warshadaha dahabka ee Burkina Faso ayaa soo jiitay indhaha maalgashadayaal cusub oo ka socda Sacuudiga, kaddib markii dalka Galbeedka Afrika uu sannadkii 2025 dhoofiyay dahab lagu qiyaasay in ka badan 8 bilyan oo dollar . Shirkadda Sacuudiga laga leeyahay ee Sarmady Co ayaa muujisay xiisaha ay u qabto inay maalgashi ka sameyso waaxda dahabka ee Burkina Faso, kaddib wada-hadallo ay la yeelatay safiirka Burkina Faso u fadhiya magaalada Riyadh. Xiisaha shirkaddan ayaa imanaya xilli qiimaha dahabka ee suuqyada caalamku sare u kacayo, taas oo sii kordhisay soo jiidashada macdanta dahabka ee dalka. Burkina Faso ayaa ka mid ah dalalka Afrika ee ugu waaweyn ee soo saara dahabka, waxaana macdantani laf-dhabar u tahay dhaqaalaha dalka. Dowladda militariga ah ee hadda talada haysa ayaa muddooyinkii dambe xoogga saartay sidii dalka uu gacan weyn ugu yeelan lahaa khayraadkiisa dabiiciga ah , isla markaana faa’iido badan uga heli lahaa macdanta dalka laga soo saaro. Xukuumadda Ouagadougou ayaa doonaysa in dakhliga ka soo baxa dahabka iyo macdanta kale uu si weyn ugu noqdo dhaqaalaha gudaha, iyadoo sidoo kale la xoojinayo kaalinta shirkadaha iyo ganacsatada maxalliga ah. Maalgashiga shisheeye ayaa Burkina Faso u keeni kara dhaqaale iyo farsamo cusub, balse su’aasha ugu weyn ayaa ah sida loo hubin karo in faa’iidada khayraadka dahabka ay si weyn u gaarto shacabka iyo dhaqaalaha dalka , halkii ay ku koobnaan lahayd shirkadaha shisheeye.

items.title: Maraykanka iyo Ruushka oo ka wada hadlay tallaabooyinka xiga ee wada-hadallada Ukraine
items.description: Wakiillo sare oo ka socda Mareykanka ayaa Moscow kula kulmay Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin, iyadoo kulankaasi diiradda lagu saaray sidii dib loogu soo nooleyn lahaa dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka Ukraine. Wafdiga Mareykanka waxaa hoggaaminayay Steve Witkoff iyo Jared Kushner, kuwaas oo wakiil ka ah Madaxweyne Donald Trump, waxaana Kulanka oo ka dhacay Kremlin-ka uu socday in ka badan saddex saacadood. Aqalka Cad ayaa sheegay in labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen qorshayaal wax-ku-ool ah oo ku saabsan tallaabooyinka xiga , kuwaas oo la filayo in faahfaahintooda la shaaciyo toddobaadyada soo socda. Dhinaca Ruushka, la-taliyaha Putin ee arrimaha dibadda Yuri Ushakov ayaa sheegay in wada-hadalladu ahaayeen kuwo wax-ku-ool ah, furan oo toos ah, isaga oo xusay in wakiillada Mareykanku ay soo bandhigeen dhowr fikradood oo ku saabsan waddooyinka lagu gaari karo xal siyaasadeed oo lagu soo afjaro dagaalka. Putin ayaa sidoo kale ku adkeystay in Moscow ay doonayso in wax laga qabto waxa ay ugu yeerto sababaha asaasiga ah ee dagaalka , isaga oo sheegay in Ruushku uu horumar ka sameynayo goobaha dagaalka isla markaana uu ku kalsoon yahay inuu gaaro ujeeddooyinkiisa. Arrintan ayaa muujinaysa in Moscow aysan weli si buuxda uga tanaasulin mowqifkeeda ku aaddan dhulka iyo xaaladda amni ee Ukraine. Dhanka kale, wakiillada Mareykanka ayaa kulanka Moscow kadib u gudbay Ukraine, waxaana la qorsheeyay inay Kyiv kula kulmaan Madaxweyne Volodymyr Zelenskyy. Kulanka Kyiv ayaa qayb ka ah dadaalka Washington ee lagu doonayo in la isu soo dhoweeyo mowqifyada Ruushka iyo Ukraine, xilli farqi weyn uu weli ka dhexeeyo labada dhinac. Intii wada-hadalladu socdeen, Ruushka iyo Ukraine waxay ku heshiiyeen in muddo kooban la joojiyo weerarrada lagu beegsanayo caasimadaha Kyiv iyo Moscow . Kremlin-ka ayaa sheegay in Putin uu amray in aan Kyiv la duqeyn muddo saddex maalmood ah, halka Zelenskyy uu sheegay in Ukraine ay diyaar u tahay inay ka fogaato weerarrada lagu qaado Moscow muddadaas. inkastoo wada-hadalladan diblomaasiyadeed ay dib u soo nooleeyeen rajada laga qabo heshiis nabadeed, haddana illaa hadda lama shaacin heshiis kama dambeys ah ama xabbad-joojin guud .
