items.title: Masar oo Dadaal Xooggan ugu Jirta Badbaadinta 8 Badmaax oo Lagu Haysto Xeebaha Soomaaliya
items.description: QAAHIRA – Dowladda Masar ayaa xoojisay dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu doonayo in lagu sii daayo siddeed badmaax oo u dhashay dalkaas, kuwaas oo lagu haysto markab shidaal oo ku sugan meel u dhow xeebaha Soomaaliya. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Masar ayaa sheegtay inay xoojisay wada-shaqeynta ay la leedahay dowladaha Soomaaliya iyo Yemen, iyadoo ujeedadu tahay in si degdeg ah oo nabad ah xorriyadooda loogu soo celiyo muwaadiniinta Masar. Dowladda Qaahira ayaa sheegtay inay si dhow ula socoto xaaladda caafimaad iyo nololeed ee badmaaxiinta, isla markaana ay ku dadaalayso in loo fidiyo daryeelka iyo agabka aasaasiga ah inta lagu guda jiro dadaallada lagu sii deynayo. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar, Badr Abdelatty, ayaa faray hay’adaha ay khuseyso inay adeegsadaan dhammaan waddooyinka diblomaasiyadeed ee suuragalka ah. Waxa uu sidoo kale shirkadda leh markabka ku cadaadiyay inay qaaddo mas’uuliyadda ka saaran badbaadada shaqaalaheeda. Arrintan ayaa soo bilaabatay 11-kii May 2026, markii kooxo hubeysan ay gacanta ku dhigeen markabka shidaalka xilli uu ku sugnaa biyaha Soomaaliya. Ilaa hadda lama shaacin xilliga rasmiga ah ee la filayo in la sii daayo siddeedda badmaax, balse dowladda Masar ayaa sheegtay inay sii wadi doonto dadaallada iyo wadahadallada ilaa laga gaaro xal lagu badbaadinayo muwaadiniinteeda.

items.title: Geeska Afrika oo Yeeshay Guddi Cusub oo Fududeynaya Ganacsiga Gobolka
items.description: Wasiirrada Ganacsiga ee dalalka ku mideysan Hindisaha Geeska Afrika (HoAI) ayaa saxiixay baaq wadajir ah oo lagu aas-aasay Guddiga Fududeynta Ganacsiga Gobolka ee Geeska Afrika (RTFC), kaas oo looga gol leeyahay in la fududeeyo ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka badeecadaha dalalka gobolka. Go’aankan ayaa lagu gaaray shirkii ugu horreeyay ee wasiirrada ganacsiga ee madashan, kaas oo ay guddoominaysay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Shirka waxaa ka qaybgalay wasiirrada ganacsiga ee Soomaaliya, Jabuuti, Itoobiya, Kenya iyo Koonfurta Suudaan. Dalalka xubnaha ka ah ayaa sidoo kale meel mariyey Qorshe-hawleedka Fududeynta Ganacsiga Gobolka ee 2026–2031, iyadoo la isku raacay qorshe 45 maalmood ah oo lagu hawlgelinayo guddiga cusub laguna qabanayo kulankiisii ugu horreeyay. Guddigan ayaa isku xiri doona guddiyada qaran ee fududeynta ganacsiga, isla markaana ka shaqeyn doona yareynta caqabadaha hortaagan ganacsiga xuduudaha iyo isu-socodka badeecadaha. Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliya, Danjire Jamaal Maxamed Xasan, oo guddoominayay shirka, ayaa sheegay in guusha heshiiskan lagu qiimeyn doono natiijooyinka ay si dhab ah u dareemaan ganacsatada iyo shacabka gobolka. “Waxaan maanta yeellannay jihada mideysan, hannaan hirgelineed iyo jadwal cad. Waxa hadda la inaga sugayaa waa in ballanqaadkan siyaasadeed aan u beddelno natiijooyin ay arki karaan ganacsatada iyo shacabka gobolka,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Jamaal. Dalalka xubnaha ka ah ayaa laga doonayaa inay wakiilladooda guddiga cusub soo magacaabaan ugu dambayn 30-ka Sebteembar 2026. Dhismaha guddigan ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu dardargelinayo ganacsiga Geeska Afrika, laguna yareynayo waqtiga iyo kharashaadka ku baxa badeecadaha xuduudaha ku xayirma, iyadoo sidoo kale la filayo inuu furo fursado ganacsi iyo maalgashi oo cusub oo ay ka faa’iideystaan shacabka gobolka.

Dhismaha guddigan ayaa loo arkaa tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu dardargelinayo ganacsiga Geeska Afrika, laguna yareynayo waqtiga iyo kharashaadka ku baxa badeecadaha xuduudaha ku xayirma, iyadoo sidoo kale la filayo inuu furo fursado ganacsi iyo maalgashi oo cusub oo ay ka faa’iideystaan shacabka gobolka.

items.title: Jubaland oo dalab xasaasi ah u dirtay beesha caalamka kadib qaraxii guriga taliye Shub
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Jubaland ayaa si adag u cambaareeyay qarax xalay ka dhacay guriga Taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliya, General Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan (Shub) oo ku yaalla degmada Doolow ee gobolka Gedo. Qaraxan ayay dowladda ku sheegtay inuu ahaa mid ka dhashay waxyaabo qarxa oo lagu diyaarinayay guriga, halka garabyada mucaaradka ay sheegeen inay aheyd duqeyn lala beegsaday. Jubaland ayaa dhankeeda ku eedeeysay dowladda Turkiga inay fulisay duqeyn lagu beegsaday guriga Taliye Shub, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ku eedeeysay in u bartilmaameedsatay kaliya inuu ka aragti duwanaaday dhinaca siyaasadda. “Weerarkan bahalnimada ah wuxuu si toos ah u beegsaday guri uu degganaa Taliyihii hore ee ciidanka ssluubta, oo sababta Dowladda Federaalka ah iyo Turkigu ay u beegsanayeen ay ahayd oo kaliya inuu kaga aragti duwanaaday dhinaca siyaasada iyadoo gantaalada ay diyaaradu tuurtay oo labo ahaa mid kamid ah uu ku dhacay guriga gudoomiyaha degmada Doolow ee gobolka Gedo,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Jubaland. Falkaan oo Jubaland ku tilmaamtay inuu yahay danbi dagaal oo ay tahay in lagula xisaabtamo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo dowladda Turkiga oo ay sheegtay inay aheyd cida lahayd diyaarada weerarka fulisay, iyadoo Ankara ku eedeysay “in diyaaradaheedu noqdeen aalad madaxweynaha wakhtigiisu dhamaaday uu u adeegsado dadka ka fikir duwan.” Sidoo kale, maamulka Jubaland ayaa ugu baaqay Qaramada Midoobay inay sida ugu dhaqsaha badan dib ugu eegto go’aankii Soomaaliya lagaga qaaday cuna-qabateynta hubka, “inta laga helayo dowlad mas’uul ah iyo gacmo lagu aamini karo hubka ay dowladaha caalamku ugu deeqayaan Soomaaliya.” “Dowladda Jubaland waxay ugu baaqaysaa dhammaan daneeyayaasha Soomaaliya sida Qaramada Midoobay, Midowga Afrika, IGAD, Maraykanka iyo Midowga Yurub in il gaar ah lagu eego falalka aan caadiga ahayn ee Turkigu qaybta ka yahay, taas oo aanay ku jirin danta dadka Soomaaliyeed iyo mida gobolka,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka Jubaland. Hoos ka aqriso war-saxaafadeedka: Dowladda Jubaland waxay si adag u cambaaraynaysaa weerarka duqaynta ee xalay diyaaradaha dagaalka ee Dowladda Turkiga ay ka fuliyeen degmada Doolow ee gobolka Gedo. Weerarkan bahalnimada ah wuxuu si toos ah u beegsaday Guri uu degganaa Taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta Dowladda Federaalka ah Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan oo sababta Dowladda Federaalka ah iyo Turkigu ay u beegsanayeen ay ahayd oo kaliyah in uu kaga aragti duwanaaday dhinaca Siyaasada iyadoo gantaalada ay diyaaradu tuurtay oo labo ahaa mid kamid ah uu ku dhacay guriga Gudoomiyaha Degmada Doolow ee Gobolka Gedo. Weerarkan waxaa ku dhaawacmay Taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta Dowladda Federaalka ah Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan, iyo afar Qof oo kale oo shacab ah. Magaalada Doolow oo ahayd magaalo ka caagan falalka amni-darada ah dhowr iyo tobankii sano ee la soo dhaafay, in saqdhexe gantaalo lagu garaaco oo ay ku waxyeelooban dad aan Waxba galabsan Waa danbi dagaal oo ay tahay in lagula Xisaabtamo Madaxweynaha Wakhtigiisu dhamaaday iyo Dowladda Turkiga oo ah cida lahayd Diyaarada weerarka fulisay isla markana noqotay aalad Madaxweynaha Wakhtigiisu dhamaaday uu u adeegsado dadka ka fikir duwan. Ficilkan wuxuushnimada ah wuxuu astaan u yahay sida Madaxweynaha sharci darada xukunka ku jooga iyo Dowladda tunka ku wadata ee Turkiga ay meel halis ah ugu sii wadaan dalka, taas oo wakhti horaba la sii arki karay saamaynta iyo caadooyinka xun ee ay dalkeenna ku reebayan. Dowladda Jubaland waxay ugu baaqaysaa dhammaan daneeyayaasha Soomaaliya sida Qaramada Midoobay, Midowga Afrika, IGAD, Maraykanka iyo Midowga Yurub in il gaar ah lagu eego falalka aan caadiga ahayn ee Turkigu qaybta ka yahay, taas oo aanay ku jirin danta dadka Soomaaliyeed iyo mida gobolka. Waxaan sidoo kale ugu baaqaynaa Qaramada Midoobay in ay sida ugu dhakhsiyaha badan dib ugu eegaan go’aankii Soomaaliya lagaga qaaday cunaqabataynta hubka, inta laga helayo dowlad mas’uul ah iyo gacmo lagu aamini karo hubka ay dowladaha caalamku ugu deeqayaan Soomaaliya. Ugu danbayntii talaabadan waxay horseedaysa in Dowladda Turkiga aan loo arki doonin wixii hada ka danbeeya inay qeyb ka noqon karto dadaalada xal raadinta iyo dhexdhexaadinta Arrimaha gudaha Soomaaliya isla markana ay caqabad ku tahay wada hadalada iyo isku raadinta dadka Kala aragtida duwan ee Soomaaliyeed maadama ay cadaysatay in garab buuxa u tahay dhinac gaar ah. —DHAMMAAD— The post Jubaland oo dalab xasaasi ah u dirtay beesha caalamka kadib qaraxii guriga taliye Shub appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Gabar Soomaali ah oo loo saadaalinayo kursigii uu baneeyey R/W Keir Starmer
items.description: London (Caasimada Online) – Sagal Abdi-Wali, oo ah haweeney Soomaali ah oo hoggaamisa degmada Camden ee magaalada London, ayaa loo arkaa inay ka mid tahay musharraxiinta ugu cadcad ee xisbiga Labour-ka u xulan karo kursiga baarlamaanka ee uu dhowaan baneeyey ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Britain, Sir Keir Starmer. Kursiga Holborn and St Pancras ayaa bannaanaaday kadib markii Starmer uu Talaadadii 1-da September ku dhawaaqay inuu iska casilayo xubinnimadiisa baarlamaanka, taas oo dhalisay loollan xooggan oo gudaha Labour-ka ah oo ku saabsan cidda loo soo sharxayo doorashada ku-celiska ah. Warbaahinta Britain ayaa Arbacadii sheegtay in Sagal Abdi-Wali ay raadineyso magacaabista xisbiga, iyadoo dhowr siyaasi oo kale oo ka tirsan maamulka Camden sidoo kale magacyadooda lala xiriirinayo kursiga. Sagal ayaa bishii May loo doortay hoggaamiyaha Golaha Deegaanka Camden, waxaana haddii ay hesho musharraxnimada Labour-ka oo ay ku guuleysato doorashada baarlamaanka suuragal ah inay xilkaas ka degto bilo yar kadib markii ay qabatay. Waxay bishii May taariikh ka dhigtay Camden markii ay noqotay haweeneydii ugu horreysay ee madow ah ee hoggaamisa degmada, kadib markii hoggaamiyihii ka horreeyey Richard Olszewski uu kursigiisa waayey doorashooyinkii deegaanka. Sagal ayaa iyadoo carruur ah qaxooti ahaan ku timid Britain, waxaana qoyskeedu degay Camden. “Camden waxay na siisay hoy iyo meel aan ku nabadgalno markii aan dalkan ku nimid qaxooti ahaan, awoodda aan maanta ugu adeegayo bulshooyinkeenna waxay ka mid tahay sharafaha ugu waaweyn ee noloshayda,” ayay sheegtay markii loo doortay hoggaanka degmada. Khibraddeeda nololeed iyo koritaanka ay ka sameysay siyaasadda maxalliga ah ayaa hadda ka dhigi kara inay u gudubto heerka siyaasadda qaranka Britain. Warbixinnada soo baxay ayaa sheegay in siyaasiyiin dhowr ah oo Labour-ka ka tirsan markii hore loo arkayey inay doonayaan musharraxnimada, waxaana ka mid ahaa Richard Olszewski iyo xubnaha golaha wasiirrada degmada Adam Harrison, James Slater iyo Nasrine Djemai. Harrison ayaa sheegay inuusan tartamayn, isagoo xusay inuu xoogga saarayo waajibaadkiisa golaha deegaanka, halka Slater isna la sheegay inuu meesha ka saaray inuu doonayo kursiga. Wargeyska The Telegraph ayaa Arbacadii sheegay in Sagal Abdi-Wali ay si rasmi ah u raadineyso magacaabista Labour-ka, taas oo ka dhigeysa mid ka mid ah magacyada ugu waaweyn ee tartanka. Ma jiro sharci ka hor istaagaya hoggaamiye gole deegaan inuu isagoo xilka haya u tartamo baarlamaanka Britain. Hase yeeshee, haddii Sagal ay ku guuleysato kursiga Holborn and St Pancras, waxaa la filayaa inay ka degto hoggaanka Camden iyo xubinnimadeeda golaha deegaanka. Arrintaas ayaa markaas Labour-ka ku qasbi karta inuu doorto hoggaamiye cusub oo Camden ah, iyadoo sidoo kale laga yaabo in doorasho kale oo deegaanka ah loo qabto kursigeeda. Kursiga Holborn and St Pancras ayaa muhiimad siyaasadeed gaar ah leh, maadaama uu muddo dheer ahaa saldhigga siyaasadeed ee Keir Starmer. Starmer ayaa markii hore sheegay inuu sii ahaan doono xildhibaan kadib markii uu ka tagay Downing Street, balse Camden New Journal ayaa Talaadadii markii ugu horreysay shaaciyey inuu go’aansaday inuu baarlamaanka ka baxo. Starmer ayaa wargeyska u sheegay inay “sharaf iyo mudnaan weyn” u ahayd inuu matalo Holborn and St Pancras, balse uu hadda gaaray waqtigii uu “usha ku wareejin lahaa” qof kale, isaga oo sheegay inuu diiradda saarayo arrimaha caalamiga ah. Xisbiga Labour-ka ayaa sheegay in codsiyada musharraxnimada kursigan la xirayo Jimcaha 4-ta September, halka musharraxa rasmiga ah la filayo in la doorto Arbacada 9-ka September. Taariikhda doorashada ku-celiska ah weli lama shaacin. Tartanka ayaa sidoo kale yeelanaya dhinac siyaasadeed oo ballaaran, kadib markii hoggaamiyaha xisbiga Green Party, Zack Polanski, uu Khamiista xaqiijiyey inuu isna isu soo taagayo kursiga. Haddii Sagal Abdi-Wali ay hesho musharraxnimada Labour-ka kadibna ku guuleysato doorashada, waxay noqon doontaa tallaabo kale oo weyn oo ay ka sameyso siyaasadda Britain, iyadoo muddo kooban gudaheed uga soo gudbi karta hoggaanka degmada Camden una gudbi karta baarlamaanka dalkaas. The post Gabar Soomaali ah oo loo saadaalinayo kursigii uu baneeyey R/W Keir Starmer appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo shaacisay inay xirtay 82,000 bog – Maxay yihiin?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa shaacisay in sanadkan 2026 ay xirtay tobannaan kun oo bog oo baraha bulshada ah, kuwaas oo ay sheegtay in kooxaha hubeysan u adeegsanayeen faafinta fikradaha xagjirka ah iyo marin-habaabinta bulshada. Agaasimaha Guud ee Wasaaradda Warfaafinta, Cabdullaahi Xayir Ducaale ayaa sheegay in ilaa hadda la xiray ku dhowaad 82,000 bog, isagoo tilmaamay in tiradan aysan ahayn mid kama dambeys ah, maadaama sanadka 2026 uu weli socdo. Ducaale ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay dood looga hadlayay isku-xirka dadaallada lagula dagaallamayo kooxaha hubeysan iyo yareynta khataraha musiibooyinka ka jira deegaanada xeebaha Soomaaliya. Agaasimaha ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay hadda xoogga saareyso dhinaca fikirka iyo wacyigelinta bulshada. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay in dagaalka ka dhanka ah kooxaha argagixisada uusan ku koobnayn howlgalka milatari, balse uu leeyahay saddex weji oo kala ah dhinaca milatariga, dhaqaalaha iyo dagaalka fikirka ama ideolojiyadda. Dhinaca fikirka ayuu sheegay inuu yahay mid si gaar ah muhiim u ah, maadaama uu saameyn ku yeelan karo dad aad u tiro badan. Wasaaradda Warfaafinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inay sanadihii lasoo dhaafay xirtay kumannaan akoon iyo bogag ku jiray baraha ay kamid yihiin Facebook, TikTok iyo Telegram. items.title: Somalia Opposition Figure Injured in Doolow Airstrike as Tensions Surge
items.description: DOOLOW— Former Commander of the Somali Custodial Corps, General Mahad Abdirahman Aden,widely known as “Shub”, sustained minor shrapnel injuries following an airstrike targeting his residence near the Doolow airport in the Gedo region. He has since been relocated to a secure facility. According to security sources, two missiles hit General Shub’s compound, injuring the general, his wife, and two other family members, while a young domestic assistant lost her life. A third projectile reportedly targeted the nearby residence of the Doolow district commissioner. Ethiopian forces deployed to the scene shortly after the attack. The operation has ignited a political firestorm, with figures aligned with former South West State President Abdiaziz Laftagareen explicitly accusing Turkish unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) of carrying out the strike on behalf of the federal government. The regional administration categorized the event as a state-sponsored assassination attempt against a prominent military and political opponent of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. Political figures have strongly condemned the strike. Federal MP Abdirahman Mohamed Hussein Odowaa described the action as an illegal abuse of state power that threatens national stability, warning against the weaponization of military resources to settle internal political disputes. Neither Villa Somalia nor the Turkish government has officially responded to the allegations or issued a statement regarding the operation. items.title: Shiinaha oo dhoolatus ciidan ka sameeyay biyaha Soomaaliya xilli ay cabsi jirto
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada Badda Shiinaha ayaa dhoolatus militari ka sameeyay xeebaha Soomaaliya, xilli ay soo baxayaan walaacyo cusub oo ku saabsan amniga maraakiibta isaga kala goosha Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Dhoolatuskan ayaa ujeeddadiisu ahayd sidii looga hortagi lahaa weerarrada burcad-badeedda iyo sidii loo badbaadin lahaa shaqaalaha maraakiibta la qafaasho, iyadoo bilihii u dambeeyay la soo sheegay dhacdooyin la xiriira afduubka iyo weerarrada lagu qaado maraakiibta. Howlgalka waxaa fuliyay Guutada 49-aad ee Ciidamada Badda Shiinaha, waxaana intii uu socday lagu tijaabiyay awoodda ciidamada ee wax looga qaban karo xaalad markab ganacsi lagu qafaasho iyo sidii si degdeg ah loo badbaadin lahaa shaqaalaha saaran. Ciidamada ka qeybgalay tababarka ayaa soo bandhigay farsamooyin ay ku baarayaan markab laga shakisan yahay, ku qabanayaan kooxaha burcad-badeedda iyo ku samatabixinayaan shaqaalaha markabka. Tallaabooyinkan ayaa qeyb ka ahaa xaalad dagaal oo la sameeyay si loo qiimeeyo diyaar-garowga ciidamada. Dhoolatuska Shiinaha ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xasaasi ah, kaddib markii xeebaha Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ay dib uga soo muuqdeen dhacdooyin la xiriira burcad-badeednimo. Arrintan ayaa dib usoo celisay walaaca laga qabo badqabka maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara biyaha gobolka. 17-kii August ayaa markabka MV LUTUF lagu qafaashay xeebaha Puntland, halka 20-kii isla bishaas markab shidaal oo lagu magacaabo Sibu 1 lagu afduubtay meel ka baxsan xeebaha Yemen, kaas oo markii dambe loo weeciyay dhanka xeebaha Soomaaliya. Shiinaha ayaa muddo dheer door ku lahaa dadaallada lagu sugayo amniga maraakiibta ee biyaha Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Ciidamada Badda dalkaas ayaa tan iyo 2008 si joogto ah uga qeyb qaadanayay howl-gallada la xiriira ilaalinta maraakiibta iyo la-dagaallanka burcad-badeednimada ee gobolka. Si kastaba, Dhoolatuskan ayaa muujinaya sida Beijing ay weli muhiimad u siinayso amniga marin-biyoodka Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, gaar ahaan xilli dib usoo cusboonaanshaha burcad-badeednimadu uu walaac ku abuurayo maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo howlaha isu-socodka badda ee gobolka. items.title: QM oo shaacisay in Boosaaso noqotay xarun hub iyo dagaal-yahano looga gudbiyo RSF
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in magaalada Boosaaso ee xarunta ganacsiga Puntland ay noqotay marin joogto ah oo ay isticmaaleen shabakad caalami ah oo hub, qalab milatari iyo dagaalyahanno shisheeye u gudbineysay ciidamada RSF ee ka dagaallama dalka Sudan. Warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Xaqiiqo Raadinta Qaramada Midoobay ee Sudan ayaa lagu sheegay in ay jiraan sababo macquul ah oo lagu rumeysan karo in shabakad isku xirta Imaaraadka Carabta, Chad, koonfur-bari Libya iyo Puntland ay fududeysay howlgallada milatari ee RSF. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in goobo ku yaalla Chad, Libya iyo Puntland loo isticmaalay xarumo transit iyo saadka ah oo lagu gudbiyo hub, shaqaale iyo sahay kale oo milatari oo ku sii jeeday deegaannada ay RSF maamusho. Warbixinta ayaa si gaar ah faahfaahin uga bixisay Boosaaso. “Caddeymaha ayaa Boosaaso, Soomaaliya, u aqoonsaday xarun saadka iyo marin joogto ah,” ayay tiri guddiga Qaramada Midoobay. Sida warbixinta lagu sheegay, shaqsiyaad iyo hay’ado xiriir la leh Imaaraadka ayaa Boosaaso u adeegsan jiray gudbinta shaqaale iyo xamuul ku sii jeeday goobaha ay RSF maamusho. Markhaatiyaal ay la hadashay QM ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Boosaaso uu ku yaallay saldhig milatari oo ay sii mari jireen qandaraaslayaal iyo dagaalyahanno shisheeye. Hub iyo diyaarado xamuul Ilo ay soo xigatay Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegay in diyaaradaha waaweyn ee xamuulka qaada ee Ilyushin-76 ay isku xiri jireen Boosaaso, Kufra iyo Benghazi oo Libya ku yaalla iyo Chad, halkaas oo markii dambe shaqaale iyo xamuul looga sii gudbin jiray gudaha Sudan. Markhaatiyaasha ayaa sheegay in waddooyinka saadka ee Boosaaso qeybta ka ahayd lagu gudbin jiray madaafiicda NORINCO AH-4 ee 155mm, nidaamyada difaaca cirka FK-2000, raadaarro, gaadiid gaashaaman, Land Cruisers, rasaas, hub, dareys ciidan iyo sahay caafimaad. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah qalabkaasi ay la jaanqaadayeen hub horay loogu dhoofiyey Imaaraadka Carabta. Baarayaasha QM ayaa sidoo kale is barbardhigay xogta markhaatiyaasha iyo muuqaallo la xaqiijiyey, waxayna sheegeen inay heleen caddeymo muujinaya qaar ka mid ah hubkaas oo yaalla goobaha ay RSF ka howlgasho. Waxaa ka mid ahaa madaafiicda NORINCO AH-4 oo ciidamada dowladda Sudan dib uga qabsadeen RSF iyo nidaamyada FK-2000 oo lagu arkay Dubeibat bishii Febraayo iyo Luulyo 2026. Markhaatiyaal ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in waddooyinka gobolka loo mariyey RSF diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee CH-95, qalab dagaal elektaroonig ah iyo taageero farsamo oo la xiriirta. Si kastaba, warbixinta QM ma aysan soo gabagabeyn in dowladda Puntland ama dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay iyagu hubka bixiyeen ama si toos ah uga qeybqaateen shabakadda. Waxay taa beddelkeeda sheegtay in shirkado gaar loo leeyahay, dhexdhexaadiyeyaal iyo shaqsiyaad ka howlgala dalal dhowr ah, oo Soomaaliya ay ku jirto, ay fududeeyeen qeybo ka mid ah shabakadda taageerta RSF. Puntland oo isha lagu hayo Warbixinta Qaramada Midoobay ma aysan go’aamin in madaxda Puntland ay ka warqabeen ama ay oggolaadeen howlaha laga fulinayey Boosaaso. Hase yeeshee, ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa Caasimada Online u sheegay in Madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni uu ka warqabay isla markaana oggolaaday in Imaaraadku Boosaaso u isticmaalo xarun saadka ah oo sahay loogu gudbiyo RSF. Deni ayaa muddo sanado ah xiriir dhow la lahaa Imaaraadka Carabta, halka maamullada Jubaland iyo Somaliland ay sidoo kale Abu Dhabi la sameysteen iskaashi dhaqaale iyo mid amni oo gaar ah, xilli ay sii jiraan khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee gudaha Soomaaliya. Arrintan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli xiriirka dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Puntland uu muddo dheer ahaa mid aad u liita, isla markaana ay xaddidan tahay wada-shaqeynta amni iyo xog-isweydaarsiga labada dhinac. Guddiga QM ayaa sheegay inuu 11-kii June dowladda Soomaaliya ka codsaday xog ku saabsan howlaha laga fuliyey ama loo maray dhulkeeda, balse aanu helin jawaab wax ku ool ah ka hor inta uusan soo gabagabeyn warbixinta. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa markii dambe Reuters u sheegtay inay si dhab ah u qaadatay natiijooyinka warbixinta, isla markaana aysan oggolaan in dhulka, hawada ama dekedaha Soomaaliya loo adeegsado howlaha milatari ee dhinacyada dagaalka Sudan. Si kastaba, dowladda ayaa qiratay inay jireen “daldaloolo” dhanka xog-isweydaarsiga ah oo u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo maamullada gobollada. Qandaraaslayaal Colombian ah Boosaaso ayaa sidoo kale kasoo muuqatay waddooyinka loo maray dagaalyahanno iyo qandaraaslayaal milatari oo Colombian ah oo loo dirayey Sudan. QM ayaa sheegtay in askar hore oo Colombian ah ay noqdeen qeyb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah shabakadda taageerta RSF. Qiyaasaha tiradooda ayaa u dhexeeya 350 ilaa 2,000, iyadoo guddigu sheegay in xogta lagu kalsoon yahay ay muujineyso in tirada guud ay ku dhowaan karto 2,000 maadaama qoristu ay weli socotay. Markhaatiyaal ayaa sheegay in kooxihii ugu horreeyey ay kasoo gudbeen Imaaraadka, Boosaaso iyo Benghazi, ka hor inta aysan koonfurta Libya uga gudbin gobolka Darfur. Kooxo kale ayaa la sheegay inay mareen Boosaaso ama Imaaraadka, kadibna Chad uga sii gudbeen garoonka Nyala ee Sudan. Qandaraaslayaashan Colombian-ka ah ayaa qabtay howlaha farsamo ee milatari, oo ay ku jiraan hagidda iyo dayactirka diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, taageeridda madaafiicda iyo hubka casriga ah, sirdoon, dayactir farsamo iyo tababar ciidan. Warbixinta ayaa sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah Colombian-ka ay iyagu sii wadeen maamulidda diyaaradaha drone-ka, maadaama xirfadaha loo baahan yahay aysan si weyn uga dhex jirin ciidamada RSF. Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale helay caddeymo muujinaya in dagaalyahanno Colombian ah ay joogeen agagaarka El-Fasher ka hor, intii lagu jiray iyo kadib markii RSF ay qabsatay magaaladaas bishii October 2025. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa horay uga diiwaangelisay El-Fasher dambiyo dagaal, dambiyo ka dhan ah bani’aadannimada iyo falal ay sheegtay inay xambaarsan yihiin astaamo la xiriira xasuuq. Shabakad gobolka ku fidsan Boosaaso ma aysan ahayn goobta keliya ee ku jirtay shabakaddan. Benghazi, Kufra iyo Jufra oo ku yaalla koonfur-bari Libya ayaa lagu tilmaamay xarumo lagu uruuriyo hub, gaadiid, shidaal, cunto iyo shaqaale milatari ka hor inta aan loo gudbin Sudan. Guddiga QM ayaa sidoo kale helay xog ku saabsan xarumo tababar oo ku yaalla Benghazi iyo Kufra, halkaas oo dagaalyahannada RSF lagu baray adeegsiga iyo dayactirka hubka. Tababarayaal ajnabi ah, oo ay ku jiraan Colombian, ayaa la sheegay inay bixiyeen tababarradaas ka hor inta dagaalyahannada loo dirin Darfur, Kordofan iyo goobo kale. Chad ayaa sidoo kale loo adeegsaday marin muhiim ah, iyadoo markhaatiyaal ay sheegeen in diyaarado xamuul oo kasoo baxa Imaaraadka ay halkaas tagi jireen ka hor inta sahayda, shaqaalaha iyo qandaraaslayaasha shisheeye loo sii gudbin deegaannada RSF. Dowladda Chad ayaa beenisay in hub ama qalab milatari loo marsiiyey dhulkeeda, waxayna sheegtay inay dhexdhexaad ka tahay dagaalka Sudan. Hase yeeshee, guddiga QM ayaa sheegay in caddeymaha uu helay ay muujinayaan in shabakado gaar loo leeyahay ay qeybo ka mid ah dhulka Chad u adeegsadeen marin iyo howlaha saadka. Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa isna marar badan beeniyey inuu hub, dhaqaale ama taageero milatari siiyo RSF. Hase yeeshee, guddiga QM ayaa sheegay in shaqsiyaad iyo hay’ado ka howlgala, ka diiwaangashan ama xiriir la leh Imaaraadka ay door weyn ku lahaayeen shabakadaha qorista, maalgelinta, daad-gureynta iyo geynta qandaraaslayaasha milatari ee ajnabiga ah iyo taageerada milatari ee faa’iidada u leh RSF. Guddiga ayaa ugu baaqay Soomaaliya iyo dowladaha kale ee dhulkooda ay shabakaddu isticmaashay inay baaritaan ku sameeyaan oo ay joojiyaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada sharci-darrada ah. Waxay ku soo gabagabeysay in shabakaddan caalamiga ah ay RSF siisay hub, saad, tababar iyo shaqaale shisheeye, taas oo ka caawisay inay sii waddo howlgalladeeda milatari xilli dagaalka Sudan uu hareeyey xadgudubyo culus oo ka dhan ah sharciga caalamiga ah iyo dambiyo caalami ah. items.fullContent: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in magaalada Boosaaso ee xarunta ganacsiga Puntland ay noqotay marin joogto ah oo ay isticmaaleen shabakad caalami ah oo hub, qalab milatari iyo dagaalyahanno shisheeye u gudbineysay ciidamada RSF ee ka dagaallama dalka Sudan. Warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Xaqiiqo Raadinta Qaramada Midoobay ee Sudan ayaa lagu sheegay in ay jiraan sababo macquul ah oo lagu rumeysan karo in shabakad isku xirta Imaaraadka Carabta, Chad, koonfur-bari Libya iyo Puntland ay fududeysay howlgallada milatari ee RSF. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in goobo ku yaalla Chad, Libya iyo Puntland loo isticmaalay xarumo transit iyo saadka ah oo lagu gudbiyo hub, shaqaale iyo sahay kale oo milatari oo ku sii jeeday deegaannada ay RSF maamusho. Warbixinta ayaa si gaar ah faahfaahin uga bixisay Boosaaso. “Caddeymaha ayaa Boosaaso, Soomaaliya, u aqoonsaday xarun saadka iyo marin joogto ah,” ayay tiri guddiga Qaramada Midoobay. Sida warbixinta lagu sheegay, shaqsiyaad iyo hay’ado xiriir la leh Imaaraadka ayaa Boosaaso u adeegsan jiray gudbinta shaqaale iyo xamuul ku sii jeeday goobaha ay RSF maamusho. Markhaatiyaal ay la hadashay QM ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Boosaaso uu ku yaallay saldhig milatari oo ay sii mari jireen qandaraaslayaal iyo dagaalyahanno shisheeye. Hub iyo diyaarado xamuul Ilo ay soo xigatay Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegay in diyaaradaha waaweyn ee xamuulka qaada ee Ilyushin-76 ay isku xiri jireen Boosaaso, Kufra iyo Benghazi oo Libya ku yaalla iyo Chad, halkaas oo markii dambe shaqaale iyo xamuul looga sii gudbin jiray gudaha Sudan. Markhaatiyaasha ayaa sheegay in waddooyinka saadka ee Boosaaso qeybta ka ahayd lagu gudbin jiray madaafiicda NORINCO AH-4 ee 155mm, nidaamyada difaaca cirka FK-2000, raadaarro, gaadiid gaashaaman, Land Cruisers, rasaas, hub, dareys ciidan iyo sahay caafimaad. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah qalabkaasi ay la jaanqaadayeen hub horay loogu dhoofiyey Imaaraadka Carabta. Baarayaasha QM ayaa sidoo kale is barbardhigay xogta markhaatiyaasha iyo muuqaallo la xaqiijiyey, waxayna sheegeen inay heleen caddeymo muujinaya qaar ka mid ah hubkaas oo yaalla goobaha ay RSF ka howlgasho. Waxaa ka mid ahaa madaafiicda NORINCO AH-4 oo ciidamada dowladda Sudan dib uga qabsadeen RSF iyo nidaamyada FK-2000 oo lagu arkay Dubeibat bishii Febraayo iyo Luulyo 2026. Markhaatiyaal ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in waddooyinka gobolka loo mariyey RSF diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee CH-95, qalab dagaal elektaroonig ah iyo taageero farsamo oo la xiriirta. Si kastaba, warbixinta QM ma aysan soo gabagabeyn in dowladda Puntland ama dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay iyagu hubka bixiyeen ama si toos ah uga qeybqaateen shabakadda. Waxay taa beddelkeeda sheegtay in shirkado gaar loo leeyahay, dhexdhexaadiyeyaal iyo shaqsiyaad ka howlgala dalal dhowr ah, oo Soomaaliya ay ku jirto, ay fududeeyeen qeybo ka mid ah shabakadda taageerta RSF. Puntland oo isha lagu hayo Warbixinta Qaramada Midoobay ma aysan go’aamin in madaxda Puntland ay ka warqabeen ama ay oggolaadeen howlaha laga fulinayey Boosaaso. Hase yeeshee, ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa Caasimada Online u sheegay in Madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni uu ka warqabay isla markaana oggolaaday in Imaaraadku Boosaaso u isticmaalo xarun saadka ah oo sahay loogu gudbiyo RSF. Deni ayaa muddo sanado ah xiriir dhow la lahaa Imaaraadka Carabta, halka maamullada Jubaland iyo Somaliland ay sidoo kale Abu Dhabi la sameysteen iskaashi dhaqaale iyo mid amni oo gaar ah, xilli ay sii jiraan khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee gudaha Soomaaliya. Arrintan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli xiriirka dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Puntland uu muddo dheer ahaa mid aad u liita, isla markaana ay xaddidan tahay wada-shaqeynta amni iyo xog-isweydaarsiga labada dhinac. Guddiga QM ayaa sheegay inuu 11-kii June dowladda Soomaaliya ka codsaday xog ku saabsan howlaha laga fuliyey ama loo maray dhulkeeda, balse aanu helin jawaab wax ku ool ah ka hor inta uusan soo gabagabeyn warbixinta. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa markii dambe Reuters u sheegtay inay si dhab ah u qaadatay natiijooyinka warbixinta, isla markaana aysan oggolaan in dhulka, hawada ama dekedaha Soomaaliya loo adeegsado howlaha milatari ee dhinacyada dagaalka Sudan. Si kastaba, dowladda ayaa qiratay inay jireen “daldaloolo” dhanka xog-isweydaarsiga ah oo u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka iyo maamullada gobollada. Qandaraaslayaal Colombian ah Boosaaso ayaa sidoo kale kasoo muuqatay waddooyinka loo maray dagaalyahanno iyo qandaraaslayaal milatari oo Colombian ah oo loo dirayey Sudan. QM ayaa sheegtay in askar hore oo Colombian ah ay noqdeen qeyb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah shabakadda taageerta RSF. Qiyaasaha tiradooda ayaa u dhexeeya 350 ilaa 2,000, iyadoo guddigu sheegay in xogta lagu kalsoon yahay ay muujineyso in tirada guud ay ku dhowaan karto 2,000 maadaama qoristu ay weli socotay. Markhaatiyaal ayaa sheegay in kooxihii ugu horreeyey ay kasoo gudbeen Imaaraadka, Boosaaso iyo Benghazi, ka hor inta aysan koonfurta Libya uga gudbin gobolka Darfur. Kooxo kale ayaa la sheegay inay mareen Boosaaso ama Imaaraadka, kadibna Chad uga sii gudbeen garoonka Nyala ee Sudan. Qandaraaslayaashan Colombian-ka ah ayaa qabtay howlaha farsamo ee milatari, oo ay ku jiraan hagidda iyo dayactirka diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, taageeridda madaafiicda iyo hubka casriga ah, sirdoon, dayactir farsamo iyo tababar ciidan. Warbixinta ayaa sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah Colombian-ka ay iyagu sii wadeen maamulidda diyaaradaha drone-ka, maadaama xirfadaha loo baahan yahay aysan si weyn uga dhex jirin ciidamada RSF. Guddiga ayaa sidoo kale helay caddeymo muujinaya in dagaalyahanno Colombian ah ay joogeen agagaarka El-Fasher ka hor, intii lagu jiray iyo kadib markii RSF ay qabsatay magaaladaas bishii October 2025. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa horay uga diiwaangelisay El-Fasher dambiyo dagaal, dambiyo ka dhan ah bani’aadannimada iyo falal ay sheegtay inay xambaarsan yihiin astaamo la xiriira xasuuq. Shabakad gobolka ku fidsan Boosaaso ma aysan ahayn goobta keliya ee ku jirtay shabakaddan. Benghazi, Kufra iyo Jufra oo ku yaalla koonfur-bari Libya ayaa lagu tilmaamay xarumo lagu uruuriyo hub, gaadiid, shidaal, cunto iyo shaqaale milatari ka hor inta aan loo gudbin Sudan. Guddiga QM ayaa sidoo kale helay xog ku saabsan xarumo tababar oo ku yaalla Benghazi iyo Kufra, halkaas oo dagaalyahannada RSF lagu baray adeegsiga iyo dayactirka hubka. Tababarayaal ajnabi ah, oo ay ku jiraan Colombian, ayaa la sheegay inay bixiyeen tababarradaas ka hor inta dagaalyahannada loo dirin Darfur, Kordofan iyo goobo kale. Chad ayaa sidoo kale loo adeegsaday marin muhiim ah, iyadoo markhaatiyaal ay sheegeen in diyaarado xamuul oo kasoo baxa Imaaraadka ay halkaas tagi jireen ka hor inta sahayda, shaqaalaha iyo qandaraaslayaasha shisheeye loo sii gudbin deegaannada RSF. Dowladda Chad ayaa beenisay in hub ama qalab milatari loo marsiiyey dhulkeeda, waxayna sheegtay inay dhexdhexaad ka tahay dagaalka Sudan. Hase yeeshee, guddiga QM ayaa sheegay in caddeymaha uu helay ay muujinayaan in shabakado gaar loo leeyahay ay qeybo ka mid ah dhulka Chad u adeegsadeen marin iyo howlaha saadka. Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa isna marar badan beeniyey inuu hub, dhaqaale ama taageero milatari siiyo RSF. Hase yeeshee, guddiga QM ayaa sheegay in shaqsiyaad iyo hay’ado ka howlgala, ka diiwaangashan ama xiriir la leh Imaaraadka ay door weyn ku lahaayeen shabakadaha qorista, maalgelinta, daad-gureynta iyo geynta qandaraaslayaasha milatari ee ajnabiga ah iyo taageerada milatari ee faa’iidada u leh RSF. Guddiga ayaa ugu baaqay Soomaaliya iyo dowladaha kale ee dhulkooda ay shabakaddu isticmaashay inay baaritaan ku sameeyaan oo ay joojiyaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada sharci-darrada ah. Waxay ku soo gabagabeysay in shabakaddan caalamiga ah ay RSF siisay hub, saad, tababar iyo shaqaale shisheeye, taas oo ka caawisay inay sii waddo howlgalladeeda milatari xilli dagaalka Sudan uu hareeyey xadgudubyo culus oo ka dhan ah sharciga caalamiga ah iyo dambiyo caalami ah. items.title: Somaliland’s Irro departs for US to pitch region’s strategic value as Somalia sends rival team
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi Irro departed Hargeisa on Thursday for a working visit to the United States, part of an effort to present the self-declared republic as an emerging power of geoeconomic and geosecurity value to Washington and other Western capitals, with particular emphasis on the Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint. Officials said Irro will make a stopover in the United Arab Emirates en route to the US. The Somaliland leader is expected to pitch his territory’s importance to Washington on two fronts: its rare earth mineral deposits and its proximity to Yemen and the Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint, a position officials believe could support a US military footing there and help counter threats from Houthi rebels. Somalia’s federal government has moved in parallel, dispatching a delegation led by Deputy Prime Minister Salah Jama on a counter-diplomacy push aimed at undercutting Irro’s Washington trip. The rival missions have drawn attention to the family ties binding the two camps. “For those who don’t know – Jama is actually from Somaliland and Irro’s kin,” said Rashid Abdi, a Horn of Africa analyst at Sahan Research. “Fascinating diplomacy,” Abdi added. items.title: Maxaa ka dhacay guriga Taliye SHUB, waana sidee xaaladdiisa?
items.description: Doolow (Caasimada Online) – Taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliya, General Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan oo loo yaqaano Taliye Shub ayaa ku dhaawacmay qarax ay dowladda ku sheegtay inuu ahaa mid lagu diyaarinayay goobta, halka garabyada mucaaradka ay ku sheegeen duqeyn lala beegsaday. Qaraxan oo sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac ayaa la sheegay inuu xalay ka dhacay guriga uu taliyihii hore ka deganaa degmada Doolow ee gobolka Gedo. Weerarka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in haweeney Itoobiyaan ah oo ka shaqeynaysay guriga Taliye Shub ay geeriyootay, halka ugu yaraan saddex qof oo kale ay ku dhaawacmeen, sida ay sheegeen illo deegaanka. Waxaa weli socda xog-ururin ku saabsan khasaaraha dhabta ah ee ka dhashay dhacdadan iyo xaaladda dadka kale ee goobta ku sugnaa. Ilaa hadda si rasmi ah looma oga sida ay wax u dhaceen, waxaana socda baaritaan la xiriira dhacdadaan. Mahad Shub ayaa kamid ah saraakiishii hore ee ciidamada dowladda, waxaana xilligan uu ka tirsanaa garabka mucaaradka ee uu hoggaamiyo hoggaamiyihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen). Weerarka lagu qaaday gurigiisa ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Koonfur Galbeed ay aad u kacsan tahay, gaar ahaan magaalada Baydhabo oo shalay ay ka dhaceen dagaallo culus. Dagaalka Baydhabo ayaa billowday kaddib markii ciidamo taageersan Lafta-gareen ay weerar ku qaadeen magaalada, iyadoo iska horimaadkaasi uu sare u qaaday xiisadda ka taagan maamulkaasi. items.title: Hantidhowraha Guud ee Soomaaliya oo loo doortay Hantidhowraha Dibadda ee Kaydsan ee AFROSAI-A
items.description: Hantidhowraha Guud ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Ciise Guutaale , ayaa ka qaybgalay isla markaana hadal ka jeediyey Shirka Aasaaska Ururka Hay’adaha Hantidhowrka Sare ee Dalalka Afrika ee ku hadla Af-Carabiga AFROSAI-A , oo lagu qabtay magaalada Qaahira ee dalka Masar. Intii uu socday shirka, Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa loo doortay Hantidhowraha Dibadda ee Kaydsan (Alternate External Auditor) ee AFROSAI-A, muddo saddex sano ah oo ku eg 2026–2029 . Sidoo kale, Hantidhowraha Guud ee dalka Aljeeriya ayaa loo doortay Hantidhowraha Dibadda ee ururka muddada 2026–2029. Hantidhowraha Guud ee Soomaaliya ayaa AFROSAI-A uga mahadceliyey kalsoonida lagu muujiyey Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee JFS, isagoo tilmaamay in doorashadaasi ay muujinayso muhiimadda iyo doorka Soomaaliya ku leedahay iskaashiga hay’adaha hantidhowrka ee qaaradda Afrika. Mudane Axmed Ciise Guutaale ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in AFROSAI-A uu ka gudbo marxaladdii aasaaska, una gudbo heer hawlgal iyo wax-ku-oolnimo , si loo xoojiyo iskaashiga xirfadeed iyo is-dhaafsiga khibradaha Hay’adaha Hantidhowrka Sare ee xubnaha ka ah ururka. AFROSAI-A ayaa ka kooban sagaal dal oo Afrikaan ah , waxaana ujeeddadiisu tahay xoojinta iskaashiga, horumarinta xirfadda hantidhowrka iyo wadaagista khibradaha hay’adaha hantidhowrka sare ee dalalka Afrika ee ku hadla Af-Carabiga. Doorashada Soomaaliya ee xilka Hantidhowraha Dibadda ee Kaydsan ayaa sidoo kale fursad u abuureysa Xafiiska Hantidhowrka Guud ee JFS inuu sii xoojiyo xiriirka iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah ee dhinaca hantidhowrka iyo isla-xisaabtanka hay’adaha dowladda.

items.title: Ciidamada DF Soomaaliya oo dilay 450 Al-Shabaab ah…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya ayaa intii u dhexeysay bilihii May iyo August 2026 qaaday howlgallo culus oo dhulka iyo cirka ah oo ka dhan ah kooxda Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo lagu dilay in ka badan 450 xubnood oo kooxda ka tirsanaa, oo ay ku jiraan saraakiil sare iyo hoggaamiyeyaal muddo dheer ka tirsanaa ururka. Xog laga soo xigtay war-saxaafadeedyada Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabad-sugidda Qaranka ee NISA iyo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, ayaa muujineysa in qiyaastii 452 illaa 454 xubnood oo Al-Shabaab ah lagu dilay howlgalladaas afarta bilood socday. Saraakiisha la dilay waxaa ka mid ahaa madaxii guud ee sirdoonka Al-Shabaab, xubin ka tirsanaa golaha Shuurada oo ka mid ahaa xubnihii hore ee kooxda iyo tobannaan taliye oo ka howlgalayey gobollada dalka. Dowladda federaalka ayaa sheegtay in howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ay sii socon doonaan, gaar ahaan gobollada bartamaha iyo koonfurta Soomaaliya, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda ay taageero ka helayaan saaxiibada caalamiga ah. items.title: Kuuriyada Koonfureed oo isu diyaarinaysa inay ciidamo u dirto Marinka Hormuz
items.description: Warbaahinta Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaa sheegtay in dowladda dalkaasi ay diyaarinayso in ay u dirto qalab iyo ciidamo milatari si ay uga qayb qaataan waxa loogu yeero “xaqiijinta xorriyadda isu-socodka maraakiibta ee Marinka Hormuz”, iyadoo qorshuhu yahay in hawlgalkan la bilaabo ka hor dhammaadka sanadkan. Reuters ayaa Khamiistii, 3-dii Sebtembar, qortay in warbaahinta Kuuriyada Koonfureed, oo soo xiganaysa ilo ka tirsan dowladda iyo milatariga, ay sheegtay in Seoul ay waddo tallaabooyinka sharci ee lagama maarmaanka ah si ay u hesho oggolaanshaha Baarlamaanka ee dirista ciidamada. Sida ay wararku sheegayaan, kaddib marka qorshahan ay dib u eegto Golaha Wasiirradu, dowladda ayaa qorshaynaysa inay bishan Baarlamaanka u gudbiso codsi rasmi ah oo ku aaddan ansixinta dirista ciidamada. Suurtagalnimada in Kuuriyada Koonfureed ciidamo dirto ayaa soo baxaysa xilli xiisadaha amni ee ka jira Marinka Hormuz ay sare u kaceen toddobaadyadii u dambeeyay, sidoo kalena ay kordheen weerarrada lagu qaadayo maraakiibta ganacsiga. Dalal dhowr ah ayaa sidoo kale baaraya habab ay uga qayb qaadan karaan ilaalinta amniga maraakiibta ee marin-biyoodkan istiraatiijiga ah. Mas’uuliyiinta dowladda Kuuriyada Koonfureed ayaan weli si rasmi ah uga jawaabin wararkan. Bbc somali

items.title: Qaramada Midoobay oo shaacisay in ilaa 2,000 askari oo Colombian ah la geeyay Suudaan
items.description: War cusub oo uu soo saaray Howlgalka Madaxa-bannaan ee Xaqiiqo-raadin ee Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Suudaan ayaa sheegay in dagaalka Suudaan ay sii hurinayaan shabakado caalami ah oo keena dagaalyahanno ajaanib ah, hub, tababar iyo taageero dhinaca saadka ah. Warbixintu waxay sheegtay in baarayaashu diiwaangeliyeen dirista ilaa 2,000 oo qandaraaslayaal milatari oo hore uga tirsanaa ciidamada Colombia , kuwaas oo si toos ah uga hawlgalay diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee dagaalka, madaafiicda iyo hubka casriga ah, iyagoo la shaqeynayay ciidamada Rapid Support Forces (RSF) ee ka dagaallama gobollada Darfur iyo Kordofan. Baaritaanka Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay jiraan sababo macquul ah oo lagu aaminsan yahay in shirkado gaar loo leeyahay, dhexdhexaadiyayaal dhinaca saadka ah iyo shaqaale qorista dagaalyahannada ah oo ka hawlgala dalal ay ka mid yihiin Colombia iyo Imaaraadka Carabta, ay adeegsadeen goobo transit ah oo ku yaalla Chad, koonfur-bari Liibiya iyo Boosaaso Soomaaliya, si loo fududeeyo gudbinta shaqaale, tababar, hub iyo agab ciidan oo loo gudbinayo RSF. Arrintan ayaa Soomaaliya si gaar ah u taabanaysa, maadaama warbixintu xustay in garoonka Boosaaso uu ka mid yahay meelaha loo adeegsaday isku-xirka safarrada qaar ee qandaraaslayaasha Colombian-ka. Human Rights Watch ayaa sidoo kale hore u sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah qandaraaslayaashaas ay Boosaaso soo mareen ka hor inta aysan u gudbin Imaaraadka iyo ugu dambayn Suudaan. Howlgalka Qaramada Midoobay wuxuu sheegay in taageerada dibadda aysan keenin ilaalin dheeraad ah oo loo sameeyo shacabka Suudaan, balse ay sii kordhisay awoodda dhinacyada dagaallamaya. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in weerarro ay fuliyeen dhinacyada dagaalka qaarkood ay yeelan karaan astaamo dambiyo dagaal , gaar ahaan weerarrada lagu beegsaday dadka rayidka ah iyo goobaha rayidka sida guryaha, isbitaallada, iskuullada, suuqyada iyo goobaha ay barakacayaashu ku sugan yihiin. Qaramada Midoobay waxay dowladaha xiriirka la leh silsiladahan ku boorrisay inay baaritaan sameeyaan, joojiyaan shabakadaha sharci-darrada ah ee qorista iyo hubka, isla markaana ay dhaqan geliyaan waajibaadka ka saaran xayiraadaha hubka ee Suudaan. Dagaalka Suudaan , oo billowday 2023-kii, ayaa noqday dagaal ay ku lug leeyihiin shabakado iyo taageero ka gudbaya xuduudaha Suudaan, iyadoo shacabka rayidka ah ay weli yihiin kuwa ugu badan ee ka dhalanaya khasaaraha.

items.title: Faahfaahinno dheeraad ah oo ka soo baxaya weerar la sheegay in lagu qaaday guriga Taliyihii hore ee Asluubta Soomaaliya
items.description: Faahfaahinno dheeraad ah ayaa ka soo baxaya weerar duqayn ah oo la sheegay in lagu bartilmaameedsaday guriga Jeneraal Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan, oo loo yaqaan Taliye Shub , kuna yaalla degmada Doolow ee gobolka Gedo. Sida ay sheegeen ilo deegaanka ah iyo dhinacyo ka ag dhow madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen, Jeneraal Mahad Shub ayaa dhaawac fudud ka soo gaaray duqaynta, waxaana sidoo kale la sheegay in dad kale ay waxyeello ka soo gaartay weerarka, iyadoo uu jiro burbur soo gaaray hanti. Jeneraal Mahad Shub ayaa hore u soo noqday taliyaha Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, waxaana xilka laga qaaday bishii Maarso 2026, xilli uu cirka isku shareeray khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo hoggaankii Koonfur Galbeed ee Laftagareen. Weerarka gurigiisa ayaa kusoo beegmeya iyadoo ay magaalada Baydhabo uu dhowaan ka dhacay dagaal u dhexeeya ciidamada dowladda Federaalka iyo xoogag daacad u ah Laftagareen.

items.title: Raysal wasaaraha Israel ayaa sheegay inuu ku kalsoon yahay in xukuumadda Iiraan ay burburi doonto
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu ayaa sheegay inuu ku kalsoon yahay in xukuumadda Iiraan ay burburi doonto mustaqbalka dhow. Netanyahu oo ka hadlayay munaasabad ay ka qaybgaleen saraakiil sare oo ka tirsan milatariga Israa’iil ayaa sheegay in dowladda Iiraan ay “hadda ku jirto xaalad aad u jilicsan. Waxay ka daciifsan tahay sidii hore, waxayna u dagaallamaysaa sidii ay u badbaadin lahayd jiritaankeeda.” “Waxaan ku kalsoonahay inaan meesha ka saari karno khatartan mar keliya oo dhammaad ah, isla markaana aan ridno xukuumaddan. Tani waa hawsha ugu muhiimsan ee weli na hor taalla. Waan ku sii dhawaanaynaa, mana aha wax aan suurtagal ahayn, waana wax aan gaari karno,” ayuu yiri. Netanyahu ayaa sidoo kale ka hadlay bartilmaameedyada weerarrada Iiraan ee dagaalka ay kula jirto Mareykanka, isagoo yiri: “Ma aha wax iska dhacay inaysan na weerarin. Waxay weeraraan qof walba, laakiin nama weeraraan.” Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Iiraan ay ogtahay “awoodda Israa’iil.” Hadallada Netanyahu ayaa imanaya xilli ay soo dhowaanayaan doorashooyinka guud ee Israa’iil oo loo qorsheeyay 27-ka Oktoobar, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah sahannada ra’yiga dadweynuhu muujinayaan inuu ka dambeeyo mucaaradkiisa. Hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ayaa Benjamin Netanyahu ku eedeeya inuu ku guuldarreystay wax ka qabashada Iiraan.

items.title: Doolow Airstrike Raises Alarms Over Alleged Use of Turkish-Supplied Weapons Against Somali Opposition
items.description: Doolow, Gedo Region (WDN) — An airstrike on a residential compound in Doolow, Gedo region, has triggered fresh concerns over the escalating use of military force in Somalia’s political disputes, after reports emerged that senior figure Mahad Abdirahman, widely known as Taliye Shub linked to former President of South west State Abdiaziz Laftagareen, was wounded in the attack. Local sources said Gen. Mahad was rushed to hospital after a strike hit a house where he was staying in Doolow. The compound was reportedly heavily damaged by the impact. The reports said Gen. Mahad sustained injuries that were not considered life-threatening, apparently from fragments caused by the projectile that struck the building. A woman described as an Ethiopian national who worked at the residence was reportedly killed, while at least three other people were said to have been wounded. The circumstances surrounding the strike—including who carried it out, what weapon was used and whether Gen. Mahad was deliberately targeted—remain unclear and require independent verification. A Strike That Raises Bigger Questions The incident comes amid an increasingly militarized political confrontation in Somalia, raising concerns about whether military assets supplied or supported by foreign partners are being drawn into domestic political struggles. Somalia has received substantial military assistance from Turkey, including armed drones and other military equipment. Critics of the Federal Government have increasingly questioned whether such capabilities could be used against political opponents rather than being restricted to legitimate national-security operations. Those allegations are serious and should be independently investigated. There is currently insufficient publicly verified evidence to establish that Turkish-supplied drones carried out the Doolow strike or that Turkish aircraft were directly involved. Any such conclusion would require confirmation from credible military, governmental or independent sources. Claims of Turkish Military Pressure The Doolow incident has also revived broader allegations concerning Turkey’s growing military role in Somalia. Critics of President Hassan Sheikh’s government argue that Turkey has become increasingly aligned with Villa Somalia and that Turkish military support is being perceived as support for the Federal Government in its political confrontations with opposition forces and Federal Member States. Critics have alleged that Turkish-supplied drones have been used against individuals and forces viewed as opponents of the Federal Government. These claims have not been independently established and should not be treated as confirmed without evidence. The same controversy has surrounded reports of Turkish F-16 aircraft flying over Baidoa during the latest fighting. Witness accounts and political critics described the flights as intimidating to civilians, but the purpose and operational role of the aircraft would need independent confirmation. Similar claims have emerged from Mogadishu, where critics say Turkish military aircraft were visible during heightened tensions surrounding protests and resistance to government-backed land demolitions. The alleged air activity comes at a particularly sensitive moment. Fighting in Baidoa has deepened fears among civilians caught between rival political and security forces. Reports that military aircraft were operating over the city have added to public anxiety in an environment already marked by political confrontation and armed mobilization. In Mogadishu, meanwhile, controversy surrounding land demolitions and allegations of forced displacement has generated growing public resentment toward the Federal Government. Critics argue that the deployment of sophisticated foreign-supplied military capabilities during domestic political disputes risks transforming political disagreements into security confrontations. That would carry profound consequences for Somalia. Is Foreign Military Assistance Being Politicized? The central issue is not whether Somalia should receive military assistance. The country faces a serious security threat from Al-Shabaab and has legitimate reasons to strengthen its armed forces. The question is how that military assistance is used. Weapons supplied to strengthen Somalia’s national security should not become instruments in political disputes, factional struggles or campaigns against peaceful opposition. If allegations emerge that foreign-supplied weapons have been used against political opponents, civilians or Federal Member States for political purposes, those allegations deserve transparent investigation. The Somali government should therefore explain the operational and legal framework governing the use of armed drones and other foreign-supplied military equipment. Gen. Mahad’s family disputes reports of serious injury. Amid conflicting accounts of the Doolow strike, Gen. Mahad’s son, Abdi Fatah, publicly addressed the incident. He said his father was safe and had not suffered serious harm in the bombardment, contradicting some reports suggesting more severe injuries. The conflicting accounts underline the need for independent reporting and verification rather than reliance on competing political narratives. The reported death of the woman at the residence and injuries to others also require clarification, including their identities and circumstances. The incident is likely to increase pressure on both the Jubaland administration and the Federal Government to provide a clear account of what happened. Jubaland should explain whether Gen. Mahad was present at the residence and whether its forces or officials had prior knowledge of any planned military operation. The Federal Government, if its forces were responsible, should publicly explain the legal basis, operational objective and intelligence justification for the strike. If the government was not responsible, it should say so clearly and assist in establishing who conducted the attack. Silence will only fuel speculation. Turkey’s Somalia Role Under Growing Scrutiny Turkey has emerged as one of Somalia’s most important military partners, providing training, equipment and broader security assistance. That relationship has been welcomed by many Somalis because of Turkey’s role in strengthening national security institutions. But military partnerships can become politically controversial when the partner government is itself locked in a domestic political confrontation. Turkey risks damaging the perception of its role in Somalia if its military cooperation becomes indistinguishable, in the eyes of the public, from support for the political interests of Villa Somalia. For many Somalis, the distinction is becoming increasingly important: a foreign partner should help strengthen Somalia as a state, not become identified with one political faction within Somalia.  Somalia’s political crisis cannot be solved through air power. Whether the weapon involved in Doolow was Turkish-supplied, domestically operated or supplied through another channel, the principle remains the same: military force must not become a substitute for political dialogue and due process. If opposition figures believe they can be targeted from the air because they challenge those in power, political competition becomes dangerously militarized. If civilians believe foreign aircraft can appear over their cities whenever political tensions rise, public trust in both the government and its international partners will inevitably suffer. And if foreign military assistance becomes associated with domestic political repression, it could undermine the very security partnership it was intended to strengthen. The Doolow strike should therefore be independently investigated. Somali authorities should establish: Who ordered and carried out the strike; What aircraft or weapon system was used; Whether Gen. Mahad was the intended target; The identities and circumstances of those killed and wounded; Whether Turkish-supplied military equipment was involved; The legal and operational justification for the attack; and Whether civilians were placed at unacceptable risk. Until those questions are answered, competing political narratives will continue to dominate the public debate. The broader warning, however, is already clear. Somalia cannot build a stable political system if military power is increasingly perceived as an instrument for settling political disputes. Foreign partners—including Turkey—have an important role to play in helping Somalia strengthen its security institutions. But that partnership will remain sustainable only if Somali citizens believe that foreign-supplied military capabilities are being used to protect the Somali people and defend the country—not to intimidate civilians or eliminate political opponents. The Doolow strike has therefore become more than a single military incident. It is a test of transparency, accountability and the limits of military power in Somalia’s increasingly bitter political struggle. items.title: Who Guards the Guards? Somali Prison Officers Protest Nearly Two Years Without Pay
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Members of Somalia’s Custodial Corps closed roads leading to and from Mogadishu’s Central Prison on Thursday, protesting what they say are nearly two years of unpaid salaries and outstanding employment rights. The guards said they have continued performing their duties despite going without regular pay, leaving them struggling to support themselves and their families. Their action, they stressed, was not a refusal to work but a desperate attempt to force the government to address their grievances. “We have continued working for the government without receiving our rights,” some of the guards told the media, saying they had repeatedly raised the issue with the relevant authorities without receiving a satisfactory response. A Protest Born of Desperation The prolonged absence of salaries has placed serious financial pressure on the guards and their families. They said repeated appeals to officials produced neither a solution nor a clear explanation for the delays, prompting them to block access to the prison. The protest highlights a striking contradiction: personnel responsible for guarding prisoners and protecting a critical state institution say they have themselves been left without the basic financial support owed to them by the state. The guards said they remain ready to perform their duties and want the dispute resolved through dialogue and payment of legitimate outstanding salaries. The protest raises questions about why salary arrears have reportedly been allowed to accumulate for such an extended period and how many security personnel may be affected. Reported: The guards say they have made several attempts to bring their concerns to government officials and other responsible authorities but have received no response capable of resolving the dispute. The government has yet to provide a detailed explanation of the alleged arrears, including whether administrative, financial or payroll problems are responsible. The Somali Custodial Corps has also not publicly provided a detailed account of the situation. A Warning Beyond the Prison The incident carries significance beyond the prison itself. When security personnel responsible for maintaining order resort to public protest over unpaid wages, it can expose deeper weaknesses in government administration, morale and institutional accountability. The guards have made clear that they do not want to abandon their responsibilities. They are demanding recognition of their grievances and a credible plan to resolve them. The most striking aspect of the protest is its human dimension. These are Somali security personnel who have chosen to serve the state and are expected to protect prisoners, secure facilities and uphold public order. Yet they say they have gone for nearly two years without the wages on which their families depend. The immediate priority should therefore be a transparent explanation of the alleged salary arrears, verification of the personnel affected and a clear timetable for resolving legitimate outstanding payments. For now, the gates of Mogadishu’s Central Prison have become a symbol of a wider institutional problem: a state cannot reasonably expect unwavering service from its security personnel while leaving their most basic employment rights unresolved. The next move belongs to the government. WardheerNews The post Who Guards the Guards? Somali Prison Officers Protest Nearly Two Years Without Pay appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Somalia’s Election Crisis: No Deal, No Credible Vote
items.description: Mogadishu, Somalia (WDN) — Somalia’s already fragile electoral process is facing another serious obstacle after the presidents of Jubaland and Puntland reportedly rejected efforts to bring them to Mogadishu for the final stage of negotiations between the Federal Government and the opposition-led Future Council. The proposed meeting, facilitated by international partners, was intended to bridge the widening political divide and produce an agreement on the country’s electoral roadmap. But the refusal by Jubaland President Ahmed Mohamed Islam (Madobe) and Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni underscores a deeper problem: there is still no political settlement broad enough to command national confidence. Jubaland and Puntland have questioned the reliability of proposed guarantees and are reluctant to participate in an electoral process they believe could ultimately be shaped unilaterally by Villa Somalia. Their position reflects a growing concern that promises made during political negotiations may not provide sufficient protection once an electoral timetable is formally adopted. Why the Guarantees Matter The disagreement is not simply about whether leaders should travel to Mogadishu. It is about whether the political commitments reached there would actually be honoured. Jubaland and Puntland reportedly want any final agreement to contain clear guarantees and to include a formal role for international partners in witnessing or supporting its implementation. The Federal Government, by contrast, is understood to favour continuing negotiations without attaching special external guarantees to the final electoral agreement. That difference goes to the heart of Somalia’s political impasse. A political agreement that depends entirely on assurances from the same authorities whose decisions are being contested is unlikely to convince all sides. Trust cannot be created by asking opponents to rely on promises they have already questioned. There is another issue that must be addressed before Somalia can credibly move toward elections: the status of the South West State electoral process. Any roadmap that leaves the disputed South West election arrangements intact risks deepening rather than resolving the crisis. If the objective is a genuinely national election, the South West process should be annulled and reconsidered within a broader political settlement accepted by the concerned parties. The same principle should apply to Hirshabelle and Galmudug. Their elections should proceed only after the major political stakeholders reach and sign a comprehensive agreement establishing the electoral rules, guarantees, timelines and institutional responsibilities. Otherwise, Somalia risks holding elections that are technically organized but politically rejected. No One Will Accept a Villa Somalia Controlled Election The central lesson from Somalia’s current crisis is that an election imposed by one political centre will not automatically become a national election. No major political actor is likely to accept a sham or predetermined process designed unilaterally by Villa Somalia and presented afterward as a national consensus. For an election to have legitimacy, the rules must be negotiated before the vote—not rewritten around the interests of whoever controls the executive institutions. The Federal Government may argue that elections cannot be delayed indefinitely. That is true. But speed without political consensus could produce a more dangerous outcome: an election that deepens division, triggers institutional confrontation and leaves its legitimacy contested from the first day. The constitutional impasse must be part of the deal. The electoral dispute cannot be separated from Somalia’s unresolved constitutional crisis. Questions surrounding constitutional amendments, the distribution of powers between the Federal Government and Federal Member States, the mandate and authority of national institutions, and the legal framework governing elections must be addressed alongside the electoral roadmap. Holding elections while leaving those fundamental questions unresolved would merely postpone the crisis. A durable settlement therefore requires one political package: an agreed electoral framework, a mutually accepted constitutional process and clear guarantees for implementation. What a Credible Roadmap Would Require For the electoral process to regain credibility, the concerned political forces should agree on several basic principles: Annul and reconsider the disputed South West election process. Hold Hirshabelle and Galmudug elections only after a comprehensive political agreement is reached and signed by all major stakeholders. Establish clear and mutually accepted electoral rules and timelines. Resolve the outstanding constitutional disagreements through an agreed process. Provide credible guarantees for implementation and dispute resolution. Ensure that no single institution or political faction can unilaterally control the electoral process. International partners can facilitate, witness and support such an agreement, but the settlement must ultimately be owned by Somalis. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration has repeatedly presented dialogue and elections as the path out of Somalia’s political crisis. But the growing reluctance of key Federal Member States to rely on government assurances illustrates the central problem: political promises have lost much of their credibility. The answer is not another round of verbal commitments. Somalia needs a written, signed and enforceable political settlement in which every major stakeholder knows the rules before the electoral process begins. Without that, the country risks moving from a constitutional impasse into an electoral confrontation. The choice before Somalia is therefore stark: negotiate a genuine national agreement and hold elections that the major political forces can accept—or proceed with a process designed in Villa Somalia and face another disputed election whose legitimacy may be rejected before the ballots are even counted. Somalia does not need an election merely because a timetable has been announced. It needs an election whose rules are accepted, whose constitutional foundation is agreed, whose process is transparent and whose outcome the country can live with. Jubaland and Puntland have questioned the reliability of proposed guarantees and are reluctant to participate in an electoral process they believe could ultimately be shaped unilaterally by Villa Somalia. Their position reflects a growing concern that promises made during political negotiations may not provide sufficient protection once an electoral timetable is formally adopted. Why the Guarantees Matter The disagreement is not simply about whether leaders should travel to Mogadishu. It is about whether the political commitments reached there would actually be honoured. Jubaland and Puntland reportedly want any final agreement to contain clear guarantees and to include a formal role for international partners in witnessing or supporting its implementation. The Federal Government, by contrast, is understood to favour continuing negotiations without attaching special external guarantees to the final electoral agreement. That difference goes to the heart of Somalia’s political impasse. A political agreement that depends entirely on assurances from the same authorities whose decisions are being contested is unlikely to convince all sides. Trust cannot be created by asking opponents to rely on promises they have already questioned. There is another issue that must be addressed before Somalia can credibly move toward elections: the status of the South West State electoral process. Any roadmap that leaves the disputed South West election arrangements intact risks deepening rather than resolving the crisis. If the objective is a genuinely national election, the South West process should be annulled and reconsidered within a broader political settlement accepted by the concerned parties. The same principle should apply to Hirshabelle and Galmudug. Their elections should proceed only after the major political stakeholders reach and sign a comprehensive agreement establishing the electoral rules, guarantees, timelines and institutional responsibilities. Otherwise, Somalia risks holding elections that are technically organized but politically rejected. No One Will Accept a Villa Somalia Controlled Election The central lesson from Somalia’s current crisis is that an election imposed by one political centre will not automatically become a national election. No major political actor is likely to accept a sham or predetermined process designed unilaterally by Villa Somalia and presented afterward as a national consensus. For an election to have legitimacy, the rules must be negotiated before the vote—not rewritten around the interests of whoever controls the executive institutions. The Federal Government may argue that elections cannot be delayed indefinitely. That is true. But speed without political consensus could produce a more dangerous outcome: an election that deepens division, triggers institutional confrontation and leaves its legitimacy contested from the first day. The constitutional impasse must be part of the deal. The electoral dispute cannot be separated from Somalia’s unresolved constitutional crisis. Questions surrounding constitutional amendments, the distribution of powers between the Federal Government and Federal Member States, the mandate and authority of national institutions, and the legal framework governing elections must be addressed alongside the electoral roadmap. Holding elections while leaving those fundamental questions unresolved would merely postpone the crisis. A durable settlement therefore requires one political package: an agreed electoral framework, a mutually accepted constitutional process and clear guarantees for implementation. What a Credible Roadmap Would Require For the electoral process to regain credibility, the concerned political forces should agree on several basic principles: Annul and reconsider the disputed South West election process. Hold Hirshabelle and Galmudug elections only after a comprehensive political agreement is reached and signed by all major stakeholders. Establish clear and mutually accepted electoral rules and timelines. Resolve the outstanding constitutional disagreements through an agreed process. Provide credible guarantees for implementation and dispute resolution. Ensure that no single institution or political faction can unilaterally control the electoral process. International partners can facilitate, witness and support such an agreement, but the settlement must ultimately be owned by Somalis. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration has repeatedly presented dialogue and elections as the path out of Somalia’s political crisis. But the growing reluctance of key Federal Member States to rely on government assurances illustrates the central problem: political promises have lost much of their credibility. The answer is not another round of verbal commitments. Somalia needs a written, signed and enforceable political settlement in which every major stakeholder knows the rules before the electoral process begins. Without that, the country risks moving from a constitutional impasse into an electoral confrontation. The choice before Somalia is therefore stark: negotiate a genuine national agreement and hold elections that the major political forces can accept—or proceed with a process designed in Villa Somalia and face another disputed election whose legitimacy may be rejected before the ballots are even counted. Somalia does not need an election merely because a timetable has been announced. It needs an election whose rules are accepted, whose constitutional foundation is agreed, whose process is transparent and whose outcome the country can live with. items.title: Qoorqoor and Gacal Meet Behind Closed Doors as Galmudug Political Crisis Deepens
items.description: Dhuusamareeb, Somalia (WDN) — Galmudug President Ahmed Abdi Kariye (Qoorqoor) has held a closed-door meeting with the Speaker of the Galmudug House of Representatives, Mohamed Nur Gacal, amid growing political tensions within the regional administration. The two leaders met Thursday evening at President Qoorqoor’s residence in Dhusamareeb. Neither side has publicly disclosed the agenda or outcome of the meeting, leaving the political significance of the encounter open to speculation. The meeting comes after days of escalating tensions between senior figures in Galmudug, including a dispute surrounding a parliamentary motion and reports that Speaker Gacal was placed under security restrictions. The immediate crisis reportedly began when members of the Galmudug parliament initiated political proceedings linked to a motion against the regional leadership. The dispute subsequently moved beyond parliamentary debate, with reports that security personnel allegedly acting on orders associated with the Galmudug presidency restricted the movement of Speaker Gacal. That development raised broader questions about the relationship between Galmudug’s political institutions and its security forces—and whether political disagreements are increasingly being handled through administrative and security measures rather than parliamentary and legal procedures. Sources familiar with the situation say the closed-door meeting between Qoorqoor and Gacal focused in part on the parliamentary motion and the circumstances surrounding the reported restrictions placed on the Speaker. No independent confirmation of the details of those discussions has yet emerged. An Attempt to Defuse the Crisis? The meeting could represent an attempt to contain a dispute that has begun to threaten cooperation between Galmudug’s executive and legislative branches. A prolonged confrontation between the presidency and parliament could paralyze the regional administration, deepen political divisions and create additional instability in Dhusamareeb. If the two leaders reach an understanding, the immediate priority would likely be to restore normal relations between the executive and legislature and resolve the dispute through established political and constitutional mechanisms. That could also pave the way for an end to the reported restrictions on Gacal and reduce tensions surrounding the parliamentary motion. But until an official agreement is announced, the outcome remains uncertain. The confrontation in Galmudug reflects a broader problem confronting Somalia’s political system: institutions frequently become arenas for political competition rather than mechanisms for resolving it. When disagreements between elected officials spill into disputes involving security forces, questions inevitably arise about institutional independence, civilian authority and the limits of executive power. The episode also comes at a particularly sensitive time for Somalia, where disagreements over elections, constitutional arrangements, federal authority and political legitimacy have already strained relations between Mogadishu and the Federal Member States. Galmudug cannot be isolated from that wider national crisis. What Happens Next Matters The significance of the Qoorqoor-Gacal meeting will ultimately depend not on the fact that the two leaders met, but on what follows.A genuine political settlement would require more than temporarily easing tensions. It would need to clarify the status of the parliamentary motion, address the circumstances surrounding the reported restrictions on the Speaker, and establish safeguards against the use of security institutions in political disputes. The alternative is a renewed confrontation that could further weaken confidence in Galmudug’s institutions. For now, politicians and residents across Galmudug are waiting for an official explanation. Until one emerges, the closed-door meeting between Qoorqoor and Gacal remains a potentially important attempt to defuse a crisis whose implications extend well beyond the walls of Galmudug’s parliament.
