items.title: Qorshe Taariikhi ah: Prof. Eid Ali Ahmed iyo Horumarinta Baanka Somaliland
items.description: Qorshe Taariikhi ah: Prof. Eid Ali Ahmed iyo Horumarinta Baanka Somaliland iyo Hay’addaha Maaliyadda Dalka By Wargeyska Dawan -September 2, 2026063 Hargeysa (Dawan) Taariikhda horumarka hay’adaha maaliyadeed iyo qorshaynta istaraatiijiyadeed ee Somaliland waxa ku suntan aqoonyahanno iyo khubaro door muuqda ka qaatay dhismaha hay’adaha, tayaynta maamulka iyo dejinta jihada mustaqbalka. Waxaa ka mid ah Prof. Eid Ali Ahmed, oo aqoontiisa, waayo-aragnimadiisa iyo khibraddiisa xirfadeed si mutadawacnimo ah ugu adeegay horumarinta hay’adaha qaranka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada bangiyada, maamulka, qorshaynta istaraatiijiyadeed iyo horumarinta awoodda hay’adaha dawliga ah. Mid ka mid ah waxqabadkiisa ugu mudan in lagu xuso taariikhda Somaliland waa kaalintii uu ka qaatay diyaarinta iyo dejinta Qorshaha Ista… Axmed Maxamed: Qorshe Taariikhi ah: Prof. Eid Ali Ahmed iyo Horumarinta Baanka Somaliland iyo Hay’addaha Maaliyadda Dalka Hargeysa (Dawan) Taariikhda horumarka hay’adaha maaliyadeed iyo qorshaynta istaraatiijiyadeed ee Somaliland waxa ku suntan aqoonyahanno iyo khubaro door muuqda ka qaatay dhismaha hay’adaha, tayaynta maamulka iyo dejinta jihada mustaqbalka. Waxaa ka mid ah Prof. Eid Ali Ahmed, oo aqoontiisa, waayo-aragnimadiisa iyo khibraddiisa xirfadeed si mutadawacnimo ah ugu adeegay horumarinta hay’adaha qaranka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada bangiyada, maamulka, qorshaynta istaraatiijiyadeed iyo horumarinta awoodda hay’adaha dawliga ah. Mid ka mid ah waxqabadkiisa ugu mudan in lagu xuso taariikhda Somaliland waa kaalintii uu ka qaatay diyaarinta iyo dejinta Qorshaha Istaraatiijiyadeed ee Baanka Somaliland 2018–2022, kaas oo lagu tilmaamay qorshihii istaraatiijiyadeed ee ugu horreeyay ee Baanku yeesho. Qorshahani waxa uu noqday tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu horumarinayo hannaanka qorshaynta, maamulka iyo jihaynta hawlaha Baanka. Prof. Eid waa khabiir isku-darka aqoonta jaamacadeed, waayo-aragnimada bangiyada caalamiga ah iyo khibradda uu u leeyahay maamulka iyo horumarinta hay’adaha. Qorshahan dejinta Istaraatiijiyadda Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland waxaa sidoo kale barbar socday qorshe ballaadhan oo Professor Eid ku tababaray 17 agaasime oo ka tirsan Baanka Dhexe si ay qayb uga noqdaan hirgelinta iyo fulinta qorshahan oo dejiyey jihada, himilada iyo yoolalka Baanka muddo shan sano ah, isaga oo xoogga saaray xasilloonida lacagta iyo maaliyadda, horumarinta nidaamka maaliyadeed iyo kobaca dhaqaale ee waara. Waxa kale oo uu hiigsanayey in Baanka Somaliland loo horumariyo Bangi Dhexe oo casri ah oo hufan. Munaasibaddii daah-furka, Prof. Eid waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyey in xasilloonida lacagta iyo maaliyaddu muhiim yihiin, balse ay u baahan yihiin in lagu daro dib-u-habayn dhaqaale, kala-duwanaanshaha dhaqaalaha, shaqo-abuurka, yaraynta faqriga iyo koboc dhaqaale oo waara. Himilada Prof: Eid ee Casriyeynta Baanka Somaliland Mid ka mid ah himilooyinka qorshuhu waxa uu ahaa in Baanka Somaliland loo horumariyo Bangi Dhexe oo casri ah, iyadoo la xoojinayo maamulka, shaqaalaha, tiknoolajiyadda, nidaamka lacag-bixinta, isla-xisaabtanka iyo daah-furnaanta. Prof. Eid kuma koobnaan diyaarinta qorshaha oo keliya, balse waxa uu sidoo kale tababar iyo wacyigelin siiyey maamulayaasha sare iyo shaqaalaha Baanka. Tababarkan oo ay ka faa’iidaysteen 17 agaasime. Waxa uu isku daray qorshayn, talo-bixin, tababar iyo dhisidda awoodda hay’adeed, taas oo ka dhigtay kaalintiisa mid ka ballaadhan diyaarinta qorshe istaraatiijiyadeed. Prof. Eid waxa uu si gaar ah ugu mahadnaqay Mohamed Abdi Ibrahim, Guddoomiyihii Baanka iyo Cumar Moxamed Yusuf Booh (AHN) oo ahaa Guddoomiye-ku-xigeenkii xiligaas, iyo Cabdillaahi Xasan Aadan isla markaan ahaa Agaasimaha Guud ee Baanka Dhexe xiligii la dejinayay Istaariijiyadda Baanka imikana ah Wasiirka Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha JS isaga oo Prof Eid xusay kaalintii muhiimka ahayd ee ay ka qaateen hirgelinta iyo fududaynta qorshahan horumarineed. Aqoonsigii iyo mahadnaqa Bangiga Dhexe Kaalinta Prof. Eid waxa si rasmi ah u aqoonsaday Bangiga Dhexe ee Somaliland. 1-dii November 2017, waxaa Prof. Eid la guddoonsiiyay shahaado mahadnaq ah oo lagu muujiyay qaddarinta kaalintii uu ka qaatay diyaarinta Qorshaha Istaraatiijiyadeed ee ugu horreeyay ee Baanka, 2018–2022. Shahaadadaas oo uu ku saxeexnaa Guddoomiyihii Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland, Maxamed Cabdi Ibraahim, waxay noqotay dukumenti taariikhi ah oo xusuus u ah waxqabadka Prof. Eid. Prof Eid: Aqoonyahan isku daray aqoon iyo waxqabad Prof. Eid Ali Ahmed waxa uu aqoontiisa iyo waayo-aragnimadiisa caalamiga ah ugu beddelay adeeg iyo waxqabad hay’adeed oo uu ugu adeegay Somaliland, gaar ahaan dhinacyada bangiyada, maamulka iy…

items.title: Baanka dhexe ee Somaliland ayaa qaaday talaabo mihiim ah
items.description: Baanka Dhexe ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo xasilloonida maaliyadeed ee dalka, laguna horumarinayo nidaamka caymiska dhigaallada. Tallaabadani waxay muujinaysaa jihada cusub ee Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland ku wajahayo dhismaha hay’ado maaliyadeed oo awood leh, hufan, isla markaana ku shaqeeya hannaan wax ku ool ah oo casri ah lana jaanqaadaya nidaamyada caalamiga ah. Horumarka dhaqaale iyo maaliyadeed ee dal kastaaba wuxuu ku dhisan yahay hay’ado awood u leh inay ilaaliyaan kalsoonida shacabka, xoojiyaan nidaamka bangiyada, isla markaana abuuraan jawi maaliyadeed oo deggan oo la isku halayn karo. Sidaas awgeed, dadaalka Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland ku bixinayo dhismaha nidaamka caymiska dhigaalladu waa tallaabo mudan in si gaar ah loo bogaadiyo. Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland iyo Hay’adda Central Deposit Insurance Corporation (CDIC-Taiwan) ayaa yeeshay kulan lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga labada hay’adood, kaas oo salka ku haya Is-afgaradkii (MOU) ay hore u kala saxeexdeen 18-kii Juun 2026. Kulanka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray horumarinta nidaamka caymiska dhigaallada Somaliland, taageerada farsamo ee CDIC-Taiwan siin karto Baanka Dhexe, is-weydaarsiga aqoonta iyo khibradaha shaqaalaha, iyo dhisidda awoodda hay’adeed ee Baanka Dhexe. Iskaashigan wuxuu muujinayaa in Somaliland ay si qorshaysan ugu tallaabsanayso dhismaha nidaam maaliyadeed oo casri ah. Is-afgaradkii iyo heshiiskii hore u dhexmaray labada hay’adood iyo qorshaha cusub ee fulineed waxay tusaale u yihiin sida iskaashi farsamo, tababar iyo is-weydaarsi aqooneed loogu adeegsan karo horumarinta awoodda hay’adaha maaliyadeed ee dalka. Sidoo kale waxa mudan in si gaar ah loo xuso in Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland si qoto-dheer u fahamsan yahay in dhismaha hay’ad xooggan aanu ku koobnayn sharci iyo nidaam oo keliya, balse uu u baahan yahay aqoon, khibrad, tababar joogto ah iyo shaqaale xirfad leh. Sidaas darteed, taageerada farsamo iyo is-weydaarsiga khibradaha ee CDIC-Taiwan waxay door muhiim ah ka qaadan karaan dhismaha awoodda Baanka Dhexe iyo horumarinta nidaamka caymiska dhigaallada. Labada dhinac ayaa ku heshiiyey qorshe fulineed oo hal sano ah, kaas oo qeexaya hawlaha mudnaanta leh, dhinacyada iskaashiga farsamo iyo jadwalka lagu fulinayo qorshaha hawleedka. Qorshahani wuxuu taageerayaa horumarinta nidaamka caymiska dhigaallada, gaar ahaan dhinacyada farsamada, shuruucda, is-weydaarsiga aqoonta, tababarka shaqaalaha iyo kor-u-qaadista awoodda hay’adeed ee Baanka Dhexe. Sidoo kale Nidaamka caymiska dhigaalladu wuxuu muhiim u yahay ilaalinta kaydka shacabka iyo xoojinta kalsoonida ay dadweynuhu ku qabaan hay’adaha maaliyadeed. Marka la helo hannaan cad oo ilaaliya dhigaallada shacabka, waxay kor u qaadi kartaa kalsoonida nidaamka bangiyada, waxayna qayb ka noqon kartaa xasilloonida guud ee nidaamka maaliyadeed. Waxa kale oo bogaadin mudan in Baanka Dhexe uu arrintan u arko qayb ka mid ah xasilloonida maaliyadeed iyo xoojinta hawlaha kormeerka bangiyada. Tani waxay muujinaysaa in Baanku aanu ku koobnayn oo keliya hawlaha maalinlaha ah ee nidaaminta bangiyada, balse uu eegayo baahiyaha mustaqbalka fog ee nidaamka maaliyadeed ee Somaliland. Kulanka waxaa dhinaca Baanka Dhexe hoggaaminayey Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Baanka Dhexe, Mudane Xamse Cabdiraxmaan Khayre, iyo Agaasimaha Guud, Mudane Yaasiin Jaamac Axmed, waxaana ku wehelinayey saraakiil sare oo ka tirsan Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland. Sidoo kale Dhinaca CDIC-Taiwan waxaa kulanka hoggaaminaysay Ms. Yvonne Fan, oo ah Ku-xigeenka Madaxa Sare ee Fulinta CDIC-Taiwan, waxaana la socday saraakiil sare oo ka tirsan hay’adda caymiska dhigaallada ee Taiwan.
items.fullContent: Baanka Dhexe ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ayaa qaaday tallaabo muhiim ah oo lagu xoojinayo xasilloonida maaliyadeed ee dalka, laguna horumarinayo nidaamka caymiska dhigaallada. Tallaabadani waxay muujinaysaa jihada cusub ee Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland ku wajahayo dhismaha hay’ado maaliyadeed oo awood leh, hufan, isla markaana ku shaqeeya hannaan wax ku ool ah oo casri ah lana jaanqaadaya nidaamyada caalamiga ah. Horumarka dhaqaale iyo maaliyadeed ee dal kastaaba wuxuu ku dhisan yahay hay’ado awood u leh inay ilaaliyaan kalsoonida shacabka, xoojiyaan nidaamka bangiyada, isla markaana abuuraan jawi maaliyadeed oo deggan oo la isku halayn karo. Sidaas awgeed, dadaalka Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland ku bixinayo dhismaha nidaamka caymiska dhigaalladu waa tallaabo mudan in si gaar ah loo bogaadiyo. Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland iyo Hay’adda Central Deposit Insurance Corporation (CDIC-Taiwan) ayaa yeeshay kulan lagu xoojinayo iskaashiga labada hay’adood, kaas oo salka ku haya Is-afgaradkii (MOU) ay hore u kala saxeexdeen 18-kii Juun 2026. Kulanka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray horumarinta nidaamka caymiska dhigaallada Somaliland, taageerada farsamo ee CDIC-Taiwan siin karto Baanka Dhexe, is-weydaarsiga aqoonta iyo khibradaha shaqaalaha, iyo dhisidda awoodda hay’adeed ee Baanka Dhexe. Iskaashigan wuxuu muujinayaa in Somaliland ay si qorshaysan ugu tallaabsanayso dhismaha nidaam maaliyadeed oo casri ah. Is-afgaradkii iyo heshiiskii hore u dhexmaray labada hay’adood iyo qorshaha cusub ee fulineed waxay tusaale u yihiin sida iskaashi farsamo, tababar iyo is-weydaarsi aqooneed loogu adeegsan karo horumarinta awoodda hay’adaha maaliyadeed ee dalka. Sidoo kale waxa mudan in si gaar ah loo xuso in Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland si qoto-dheer u fahamsan yahay in dhismaha hay’ad xooggan aanu ku koobnayn sharci iyo nidaam oo keliya, balse uu u baahan yahay aqoon, khibrad, tababar joogto ah iyo shaqaale xirfad leh. Sidaas darteed, taageerada farsamo iyo is-weydaarsiga khibradaha ee CDIC-Taiwan waxay door muhiim ah ka qaadan karaan dhismaha awoodda Baanka Dhexe iyo horumarinta nidaamka caymiska dhigaallada. Labada dhinac ayaa ku heshiiyey qorshe fulineed oo hal sano ah, kaas oo qeexaya hawlaha mudnaanta leh, dhinacyada iskaashiga farsamo iyo jadwalka lagu fulinayo qorshaha hawleedka. Qorshahani wuxuu taageerayaa horumarinta nidaamka caymiska dhigaallada, gaar ahaan dhinacyada farsamada, shuruucda, is-weydaarsiga aqoonta, tababarka shaqaalaha iyo kor-u-qaadista awoodda hay’adeed ee Baanka Dhexe. Marka la helo hannaan cad oo ilaaliya dhigaallada shacabka, waxay kor u qaadi kartaa kalsoonida nidaamka bangiyada, waxayna qayb ka noqon kartaa xasilloonida guud ee nidaamka maaliyadeed. items.title: Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed oo ka warbixisay xaaladda amniga Baydhabo iyo dagaalka ciidamada taageersan Madaxweynihii hore
items.description: Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay inay si adag u bogaadinayso Ciidamada Qalabka Sida iyo shacabka magaalada Baydhabo, kaddib weerar ay magaalada ku soo qaadeen ciidamo taageersan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ayaa lagu sheegay in weerarkaasi uu sababay khasaare soo gaaray qaar ka mid ah shacabka iyo ciidamada ammaanka. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay in ciidamadu si degdeg ah uga jawaabeen weerarka, isla markaana ay ku guuleysteen inay fashiliyaan qorshihii ciidamada taageersan Madaxweynihii hore. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay in ciidanka ammaanku howlgallada ay sameeyeen ku dileen in ka badan 40 xubnood oo ka tirsanaa ciidamada taageersan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, halka tiro kale ay ku dhaawacmeen. Sidoo kale, waxaa la sheegay in ciidamada ammaanka iyo shacabka oo is garabsanaya ay soo afjareen dagaal saacado socday, kaas oo ka dhacay gudaha magaalada Baydhabo. Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed ayaa tacsi u dirtay dhammaan dadkii ku naf waayay dagaalka, waxayna caafimaad degdeg ah u rajeysay askarta iyo shacabka ku dhaawacmay. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale ku celisay inay sii xoojin doonto sugidda amniga iyo xasilloonida magaalada Baydhabo iyo guud ahaan deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: General Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan oo ku dhaawacmay weerar lagu qaaday hoygiisa
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Degmada Doolow ee Gobolka Gedo ayaa sheegaya in caawa ay duqayn diyaaradeed ka dhacday degmadaasi oo ku taala xuduudda. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in duqaynta lagu beegsaday guri uu degmadaasi ka deganaa Taliyihii hore ee Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, General Mahad Cabdiraxmaan Aadan oo bulshada ay u taqaano (Taliye Shub). Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in General Mahad Cabdiraxmaan uu ku sugnaa hoygiisa, xilligii ay duqayntu dhaceysay, isla-markaana uu ka soo gaaray dhaawac fudud. General Mahad Cabdiraxmaan ayaa tan iyo bishii July ku sugnaa Degmada Doolow, ka dib markii uu ka soo wareegay dhinaca Magaalada Nairobi oo muddo billo ah uu ku sugnaa. Jananka oo ka mid ah Saraakiisha iyo Siyaasiyiinta Koonfur Galbeed ee taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa 30-kii July ku hanjabay in Hoggaamiyaha cusub ee Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) aanu nabad ku joogi doonin Magaalada Baydhabo. Wararka soo baxaya ayaa sheegaya in duqaynta lagu bartilmaameedsaday hoygiisa ay fulisay diyaarad uu nooceedu ahaa drone, taas oo aan si dhab ah loo aqoon dalka laga leeyahay. Duqaynta ayaa ku soo beegmeysa, xilli saakay ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen ay weerar xoogan ku qaadeen Baydhabo. Dowladda Federaalka iyo Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaan weli ka hadlin duqayntan.

items.title: Saddex dal iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqii diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya toddobaadkan
items.description: Belgrade (Caasimada Online) – Toddobaadkan, hawlaha diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya ayaa ka qabsoomay saddex caasimadood oo kala ah Doha, Jeddah iyo Belgrade, taas oo muujinaysa sida Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay horumarinta hay’adaha qaranka, xoojinta iskaashiga iyo ballaarinta xiriirrada laba geesoodka ah, sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda. Doha, Qatar: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee JFS, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) ayaa xarunta hoggaaminta Qatar kula yeeshay wada-hadallo madax heer sare ah oo ka tirsan dowladda Qatar, kuwaas oo ku saabsanaa dhismaha Akadeemiyadda Qaranka. Waxaa la filayaa in dhawaan labada dhinac ay kala saxiixdaan heshiis is-afgarad (MoU). Intii ay socotay booqashada rasmiga ah ee Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre, Wasiirku wuxuu sidoo kale ka qeyb-galay shir uu la yeeshay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ahna Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda dowladda Qatar, Sheekh Maxamed bin Cabdulraxmaan bin Jaassim Al Thani. Shirka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray amniga, horumarka iyo taageerada joogtada ah ee dowladda Qatar u fidiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan ilaalinta madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Jeddah, Sacuudi Carabiya: Wasiir-ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, Xasan Maxamed Cali (Nadaara) ayaa hoggaaminayay wafdiga dowladda Soomaaliya ee ka qeyb-galay Kalfadhigii 23-aad ee Golaha Wasiirrada Arrimaha Dibadda ee Ururka Iskaashiga Islaamka (OIC) ee aan caadiga ahayn, kaas oo looga hadlay xaaladda Falastiin iyo Al-Quds Al-Sharif. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa mar kale xaqiijisay garab-istaagga ay la garab taagan tahay shacabka Falastiin, iyadoo sidoo kale hambalyo u dirtay Mudane Ismaïl Ould Cheikh Ahmed oo ka soo jeeda Mauritania, kaddib markii loo doortay Xoghayaha Guud ee OIC muddada u dhexeysa 2027–2032. Belgrade, Serbia: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa hoggaamiyay wafdiga dowladda Soomaaliya ee ka qeybgalay shirka heerka sare ee dhaq-dhaqaaqa dalalka aan isbahaysiga ahayn (NAM), kaas oo lagu xusayay sannad-guuradii 65-aad ee aasaaska dhaq-dhaqaaqa. Madaxweynaha ayaa kulan laba geesood ah la yeeshay Madaxweynaha Serbia, Aleksandar Vučić, waxaana kulanka diiradda lagu saaray ballaarinta iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo maalgashiga. Sidoo kale, Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda wuxuu kulamo laba geesood ah oo gaar ah la yeeshay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Serbia, Marko Đurić, iyo Wasiir-ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, Injineer Waleed bin Abdulkarim Al-Khereiji. Ugu dambeyntiina, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa sheegtay in hawlahaan diblomaasiyadeed ay muujinayaan sida Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay xoojinta awoodda hay’adaha qaranka, sii joogteynta xiriirrada laba geesoodka ah iyo horumarinta doorka Soomaaliya ee qaab-dhismeedyada iyo hay’adaha iskaashiga caalamiga ah. The post Saddex dal iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqii diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya toddobaadkan appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Homeland Return “Intaysan Lugaha Banjarin”
items.description: By Abdulkadir Osman Farah, PhD Once, two Somali diaspora friends met in a major Somali city. The first returned to the homeland decades earlier. Witnessing people’s suffering and helping them recover from a devastating civil war. The second returned periodically also offering his people qualified support. One day, during a casual conversation over coffee, the near-permanent returnee advised the temporary returnee: “Ku soo noqo dalkaaga/dadkaaga inta aysan qurabaha lugaha kaaga banjarin” (Return to your homeland and your people before exile leaves you physically or mentally immobile). The phrase “lugo banjar” evokes punctured wheels or tires. Suggesting the loss of movement across spaces. Human beings, of course, remain more valuable/incomparable to automobiles. Yet the phrase urges a friend to return while still energetic and capable. The mindful alert also implies a ticking biological clock. Somalis who migrated as young people during the start of the civil war now confront aging. Biological experts observe, “the worst that can happen to people’s health is to get old.” “lugo banjar” therefore confirms gradual physical decline. Involuntary exit   In most cases, people do not choose exile freely. Upheavals force them to leave the homeland. People seek safety where they find peace enabling them to express their abilities. Many confronted injustices at home, pressuring them to seek shelter and sanctuary elsewhere. Above all, they quest for dignified and worthwhile life. Likewise, returning to the homeland signifies more than people moving across borders. It involves shaping identity and opening to new possibilities. People do not simply wander but act upon serving and preserving life. Returning diasporas carry social, political, economic, and cultural values. They bring with them practical experience from exile. Log-term displacement does not fully detach them from the homeland. The homeland lives in their minds, bodies and hearts. People seek more than territory. They seek meaning, values, and dignity. They do not only find homes. They also create them, both real and imagined. For that reason, though avoiding “lugo banjar” matters, cultural memory, intergenerational conviction, and care for community sustains diaspora communities. Networks    The two friends discussing in the Somali city do not act in a social and political vacuum. Diaspora members belong to complex national and transnational networks. These networks can help them cooperate and collaborate. At times, they can also hinder them achieving their goals. Long-term returnees often become more pragmatic after absorbing realities on the ground. They learn to navigate a civil war-torn society/nation. In contrast, periodic returnees may feel anxious under such unpredictable informalized settings. They often lack familiarity with prevailing local conditions. Jeebleh, the protagonist in Links by Nuruddin Farah, shows this cultural livelihood tension. A Somali diaspora professor in the United States. Jeebleh returns due to family emergency. Subsequently confronting psychological and moral challenges. On one hand, he believes he belongs to the homeland. On the other, his long absence makes him an outsider. After decades of relative comfort in the United States, he finds the society in his memory no longer exists. To survive, he learns the new social, cultural, and political codes. Institutionalized civil war subversive realities. A believer of a noble Somali nationalism and civic responsibility, Jeebleh encounters a destroyed civil society with almost no visible rules. An incident of a militia attack on close relatives pushes him to abandon the passive detachment. Actively participating in the civil war, in the messy factional clan warfare. A situation in which a merciless strongmen and warlords took traditionally accommodating Somali social contract and heritage hostage. Abandoning any form of civic and moral responsibility. Meanwhile, locals occasionally consider returning diasporas as privileged outsiders. People who left during intense need and suffering. Years later returning with dollars, arrogance and snobbishness. The myth of returning    Returning to the homeland is not a simple one-way journey. This is especially true for those who left decades ago with pain and suffering. Many of them carry private memories and legacies. They often have few people with whom they can share these experiences. Returnees also keep parts of the lives they built in host societies. They maintain families, associations, businesses, and political networks. In the current digitalized connected world, they also work and link across borders. Transnational communities differ by generation, class, legal status, education, and memory. Returning from the Middle East, for example, differs returning from Scandinavia. Research documents “the myth of return.” A myth referring to migrants and diaspora persistently believing that “life in host societies is temporary” . Yet new generations grow up with different and sometimes conflicting wishes. The original homeland return research is more than four decades old. Today, transnational and global structures connect the world more deeply. People can now belong to several countries and remain active in them without returning. Multiple belongings and citizenships create a life more complex than a simple divide between here and there. More people, including many young people, now live in this interconnected life. Attachment to one place can offer rootedness and belonging. Transnational belonging provides opportunities across several spaces. The homeland link may strengthen identity, culture, history, memory, and belonging. The host society may provide legality, economic security, and education. For many people, the issue is, therefore, not choosing one nation over another. It is accessing possibilities from several places simultaneously. State-diaspora successes Today, China, India, and Turkey benefit strongly from a connected, transnational, and globalized world. These states do not treat their diasporas as separate from homeland societies. They treat them as citizens with rights and obligations toward the homeland. By contrast, Africans, including Somalis, have suffered disconnection/disruptions due recurring civil wars. African nations also suffer from continuing “brain drain.” Particularly, Somalis struggle to turn “brain drain” into “brain gain”. One major obstacle concerns the lack of justice and fairness in the homeland. This is not only a matter of comfort or economic priority. Today, Somalis prefer assembling into transnational hubs such as Nairobi, Kenya. Increased number of Somali diasporas prefer settling there, only about a one-hour flight from homeland. This is certainly related to the existence of “rule of law” in the country and the opportunity of living and moving around peacefully. Under such transnational circumstances, Somali communities create a form of a “third hybrid space”. A space that could not be squarely described as geographical. This is an alternative location that holds images, memory, culture and faith. Communities work carefully, step by step, creating what Edward Said called “imaginative geography.” A form of belonging and commitment that exceeds what single states and nations can grasp, capture, or dominate. Diasporic commitment   Recurring questions often inquire: whom do transnational diaspora communities serve? Do they act as economically and politically driven opportunity seekers? Do they settle wherever “cagaaran, doog leh oo uu mar walba roobku ka dao!” Or do they act as accountable people who accept moral, civic, and human responsibility? Do they help others and reduce suffering wherever they live? Certainly, not many people willingly migrate from a place with relative public justice, fairness, and opportunity. This reality leads to yet another common question: “Why not courageously return to the homeland and actively contribute to favourable social, political, and economic environment?” Examples of committed Somali diaspora members, who did their best, include the late Somali literary intellectuals and composers Axmed Naaji Sacad and Axmed Cali Cigaal. In their actions, the Somali artists exemplified diasporic life is far from categorical. Through their cultural commitments, enlightenment, and performances, they demonstrated Somalis remain undefeatable “unpuncturable” ( Ummad aan lugaheeda la banjarin karin ). They imagined a global and interconnected nation seeking dignity and accomplishing better prospects for people. A vibrant nation stretching across homeland, hostland, and the spaces between. Sadly, these two cultural leaders, like many other prominent Somali diasporas, did not had the opportunity to permanently return to the homeland. Let us hope and pray that Somalis will soon overcome the persistent avoidable/unnecessary social and political elite disputes. A hopeful process that could prevent “lugo banjar” by letting Somali diasporas, similar comparable diasporas, resettle, develop and expand the material and non-material resources of their homeland: “Haddii aynu nahayee qurba joogta Soomaaliyeed, dunida hareeraheeda halkii aynu joognaba, hoygii aan ku dhallannay hilmaami meynee, had iyo jeerba kal iyo labtaan ku heynaayo hilmaami meynee, dalkii hooyo hilmaami meynee. Horumarkii waddankeenna, himaladii shicibkeenna, had iyo jeer ku hammineynaayoo, ka hari meynee. Hiigsiga israaceenna, giddi waan u hiilineynaa. Halyeeyadeeniyo waxgaradkeenuba, haween iyo raggeenuba horseedayaasha oo idil, hambalyaanu leenahay Horumarkii dalkeennee, horukacii dadkeennee horuwadaay, horuwadaay, walaalayaalow, horuwadaay, ha noolaatee ” (Axmed Naaji Sacad & Axmed Cali Cigaal). “If we are the Somali diaspora, wherever we may be across the world, we will not fail our homeland, where we were born; we will always hold it in our hearts and minds and never forget it. We will not forget our motherland. We will always aspire to the progress of our country and the hopes of our people, and we will not abandon them. We will stand for the goal of our unity. To all our heroes and intellectuals, to our women and men, and to all our leaders, we offer our congratulations. For the progress of our country and the advancement of our people, keep moving forward, my brothers and sisters. And let it live and prosper .” (Ahmed Naji Saad & Ahmed Ali Egal). items.fullContent: By Abdulkadir Osman Farah, PhD Once, two Somali diaspora friends met in a major Somali city. The first returned to the homeland decades earlier. Witnessing people’s suffering and helping them recover from a devastating civil war. The second returned periodically also offering his people qualified support. One day, during a casual conversation over coffee, the near-permanent returnee advised the temporary returnee: “Ku soo noqo dalkaaga/dadkaaga inta aysan qurabaha lugaha kaaga banjarin” (Return to your homeland and your people before exile leaves you physically or mentally immobile). The phrase “lugo banjar” evokes punctured wheels or tires. Suggesting the loss of movement across spaces. Human beings, of course, remain more valuable/incomparable to automobiles. Yet the phrase urges a friend to return while still energetic and capable. The mindful alert also implies a ticking biological clock. Somalis who migrated as young people during the start of the civil war now confront aging. Biological experts observe, “the worst that can happen to people’s health is to get old.” “lugo banjar” therefore confirms gradual physical decline. Involuntary exit   In most cases, people do not choose exile freely. Upheavals force them to leave the homeland. People seek safety where they find peace enabling them to express their abilities. Many confronted injustices at home, pressuring them to seek shelter and sanctuary elsewhere. Above all, they quest for dignified and worthwhile life. Likewise, returning to the homeland signifies more than people moving across borders. It involves shaping identity and opening to new possibilities. People do not simply wander but act upon serving and preserving life. Returning diasporas carry social, political, economic, and cultural values. They bring with them practical experience from exile. Log-term displacement does not fully detach them from the homeland. The homeland lives in their minds, bodies and hearts. People seek more than territory. They seek meaning, values, and dignity. They do not only find homes. They also create them, both real and imagined. For that reason, though avoiding “lugo banjar” matters, cultural memory, intergenerational conviction, and care for community sustains diaspora communities. Networks    The two friends discussing in the Somali city do not act in a social and political vacuum. Diaspora members belong to complex national and transnational networks. These networks can help them cooperate and collaborate. At times, they can also hinder them achieving their goals. Long-term returnees often become more pragmatic after absorbing realities on the ground. They learn to navigate a civil war-torn society/nation. In contrast, periodic returnees may feel anxious under such unpredictable informalized settings. They often lack familiarity with prevailing local conditions. Jeebleh, the protagonist in Links by Nuruddin Farah, shows this cultural livelihood tension. A Somali diaspora professor in the United States. Jeebleh returns due to family emergency. After decades of relative comfort in the United States, he finds the society in his memory no longer exists. To survive, he learns the new social, cultural, and political codes. Institutionalized civil war subversive realities. A believer of a noble Somali nationalism and civic responsibility, Jeebleh encounters a destroyed civil society with almost no visible rules. An incident of a militia attack on close relatives pushes him to abandon the passive detachment. Actively participating in the civil war, in the messy factional clan warfare. A situation in which a merciless strongmen and warlords took traditionally accommodating Somali social contract and heritage hostage. Abandoning any form of civic and moral responsibility. Meanwhile, locals occasionally consider returning diasporas as privileged outsiders. People who left during intense need and suffering. Years later returning with dollars, arrogance and snobbishness. Many of them carry private memories and legacies. They often have few people with whom they can share these experiences. Returnees also keep parts of the lives they built in host societies. They maintain families, associations, businesses, and political networks. In the current digitalized connected world, they also work and link across borders. Transnational communities differ by generation, class, legal status, education, and memory. Returning from the Middle East, for example, differs returning from Scandinavia. items.title: Why the U.S. Military Presence in Bossaso Matters: A Strategic Shield on the Gulf of Aden
items.description: Bosasso, Somalia (WDN) — Bosasso, a strategically located port city on Somalia’s Gulf of Aden coast, occupies an increasingly important position in Red Sea–Gulf of Aden trade and commerce. Its proximity to one of the world’s most critical maritime corridors gives the port significant potential as a regional gateway for commercial shipping, trade, and investment, linking Somalia to markets across the Red Sea, Arabian Peninsula, and wider region. The city is becoming increasingly strategically important as the war between Iran and the United States drags on. A Lebanese website closely associated with Hezbollah’s political and ideological outlook has drawn attention to the U.S. military facility in Somalia’s Puntland region, highlighting the growing strategic importance of Bossaso and the expanding security relationship between Washington and Puntland. The website Al-Khanadeq, in a report published on August 26 under the title “Target Card,” focused on Bossaso’s location along the Gulf of Aden, its proximity to Yemen and its position near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a critical maritime chokepoint linking the Red Sea with the Indian Ocean. The report speculated that an expanded U.S. facility could support aerial operations, logistics and potentially future operations related to Yemen. There is, however, no publicly available official evidence that the United States plans to use the Bossaso facility to launch attacks against Yemen. There is also no confirmed evidence that Hezbollah or the Houthis have decided to target the facility. The report nevertheless underscores the growing strategic importance of Bossaso at a time when security cooperation between the United States and Puntland is expanding. A Strategic Location Bossaso’s importance begins with geography. Its position on the Gulf of Aden places it close to Yemen and major international shipping routes leading toward the Bab al-Mandab and the Red Sea. That location gives the city value for maritime surveillance, intelligence, logistics and rapid security response. The strategic environment has become more complicated because of instability in Yemen, threats to commercial shipping, arms trafficking and the continued presence of militant organizations on both sides of the Gulf of Aden. For Washington, a capable presence in Bossaso provides access to an important regional security corridor. For Puntland, the partnership offers additional capabilities to confront threats within its territory and along its coastline. Puntland has said that U.S. military cooperation is focused particularly on the fight against ISIS-linked militants operating in the Cal Miskaad and Calmadow mountain areas. An expanded U.S. presence could strengthen that campaign through intelligence, training, logistical support and faster deployment of specialized capabilities. This is particularly important in mountainous terrain, where militant groups can exploit difficult geography, limited infrastructure and remote communities. Greater cooperation can also help Puntland improve its ability to monitor militant movements, disrupt supply networks and coordinate operations with international partners. The partnership has significance beyond counterterrorism. Puntland controls a long stretch of coastline along the Gulf of Aden, making maritime security an important component of regional stability. A stronger security presence in Bossaso could improve monitoring of coastal waters and support efforts against illicit trafficking and other maritime threats. It could also contribute to the protection of commercial shipping moving through one of the world’s most important trade corridors. For Puntland, stronger maritime capabilities would provide security benefits while reinforcing its role as a regional partner in protecting the Gulf of Aden. Why the Al-Khanadeq Report Matters The Lebanese report is significant primarily because it reflects how closely outside actors are watching the military developments around Bossaso. Its suggestion that the facility could eventually be involved in operations connected to Yemen remains speculation. It should not be presented as evidence of an American plan to attack Yemen from Puntland. But the report does highlight a genuine strategic reality: Bossaso’s location gives the U.S. presence there importance far beyond Puntland’s borders. Any significant expansion of a foreign military facility in such a strategically sensitive location will inevitably attract attention from regional actors, including groups hostile to U.S. interests. That makes intelligence cooperation and protection of the facility increasingly important. The strongest case for the U.S. presence in Bossaso is not that it could become a platform for offensive operations. Its greater value lies in what it can provide before a crisis develops. A sustained partnership can improve intelligence collection, strengthen Puntland’s counterterrorism capabilities, enhance maritime surveillance and provide faster response to emerging threats. For Washington, Bossaso offers a strategically located partner close to Yemen, the Gulf of Aden and the Bab al-Mandab corridor. For Puntland, U.S. support can provide access to training, intelligence and capabilities that would be difficult to develop independently. Xulka Soomaaliya oo si cajiib ah uga adkaaday Sudan iyo Burundi
items.description: Kigali (Caasimada Online) – Xulalka wiilasha iyo gabdhaha Soomaaliya ee da’doodu ka yar tahay 15-ka ayaa guulo muhiim ah ka gaaray kulamadoodii ugu horreeyay ee tartanka African Schools Football Championship – CECAFA Zone, kaas oo ka socda magaalada Kigali ee dalka Rwanda. Xulka gabdhaha ayaa guul weyn ka gaaray kulankoodii ugu horreeyay, kaddib markii ay 5-0 kaga adkaadeen dhiggooda Sudan, taas oo u noqon karta bilow wanaagsan oo ay kaga gudbaan heerka group-yada tartanka. Gabdhaha ayaa soo bandhigay ciyaar ay ka muuqatay karti, dadaal iyo isku-xirnaan, iyagoo si buuxda uga faa’iideystay fursadihii ay heleen, waxaana guushoodu sare u qaaday rajada ay ka qabaan inay gaaraan wareegyada dambe. Dhanka wiilasha, xulka Ocean Stars ayaa isna guul muhiim ah gaaray, kaddib markii ay 2-1 kaga adkaadeen dhiggooda Burundi, ciyaar ka tirsan Group B oo ay sidoo kale ku jiraan xulalka Uganda iyo South Sudan. Guulaha ay labada xul gaareen ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh Soomaaliya, maadaama labada kooxood ee ugu sarreeya group kasta ay u gudbi doonaan wareegga semi-finalka, taas oo ka dhigaysa kulamada soo socda kuwo muhiim u ah xulalka dalka. Xulalka wiilasha iyo gabdhaha Soomaaliya ayaa tartankan ku matalaya dalka, iyagoo doonaya inay muujiyaan horumarka kubadda cagta da’yarta Soomaaliya iyo inay natiijo wanaagsan kasoo hoyaan tartanka qaaradda. Wasiirka Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha, Maxamed Cabduqaadir Cali iyo Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya ahna Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka CECAFA, Cali Cabdi Maxamed (Cali Shiine) ayaa hambalyo iyo bogaadin u diray ciyaartoyda labada xul, iyagoo ku ammaanay sida sharafta iyo geesinimada leh ee ay u mataleen dalkooda. The post Xulka Soomaaliya oo si cajiib ah uga adkaaday Sudan iyo Burundi appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: The Battle for Control of Baidoa Intensifies
items.description: Baidoa, Somalia (WDN) — Heavy fighting has erupted early this morning in and around Baydhaba between forces loyal to former Southwest State President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen and troops aligned with the Federal Government of Somalia, as the battle for control of the strategic city enters another dangerous phase. Reports from Baidoa indicate that Laftagareen-aligned forces launched attacks on federal government positions in and on the outskirts of the city, triggering exchanges of heavy gunfire and other weapons. The sound of heavy weapons has reportedly been heard across all parts of Baydhaba, raising fears among residents already traumatized by months of political tension and armed confrontation. At the time of this writing, the locals are reporting Turkish F16 planes flying over the city adding another layer of anxiety to the already traumatized civilians. A spokesman for Laftagareen’s forces, Ugas Hassan Abdi Mohamed, said in a recorded video that Southwest State forces had launched an operation against federal positions and that fighting was continuing. He urged residents to remain inside their homes while the fighting continued and called on federal and Southwest Darwish forces to surrender, promising that those who laid down their weapons would be treated well.  The extent of casualties remains unclear. For much of the past five months, Laftagareen’s locally mobilized forces have presented themselves not simply as another political militia, but as a home-grown liberation and popular resistance force defending what their supporters describe as the political and territorial rights of Southwest State. In the eyes of most of the Baidoa population, the force has increasingly been portrayed as a grassroots movement resisting what they regard as federal interference in the affairs of the state. That narrative has gained strength as federal forces have struggled to establish uncontested control over the city despite reinforcements and military deployments. The confrontation has consequently evolved beyond a conventional dispute between rival political authorities. It has increasingly become a contest between federal military power and a locally mobilized force claiming popular legitimacy. Echoes of the RRA Supporters of Laftagareen increasingly compare the current mobilization with the Rahanweyn Resistance Army (RRA), which emerged in the early 1990s and fought against armed factions and warlords in the Bay and Bakool regions. The RRA eventually played a major role in removing warlord forces from Baydhaba and establishing a measure of local security and political control. For Laftagareen’s supporters, the comparison is deliberate. They see the current force as a new generation of Rahanweyn resistance Army 2—an indigenous movement organized around the defense of Baydhaba and the political interests of the local population. This has led some supporters to describe Laftagareen as the leader of a “Second RRA”, portraying the present confrontation as a continuation of the region’s historic resistance movements rather than simply another episode in Somalia’s political rivalry. That characterization remains political rather than an established institutional designation, but it illustrates the depth of sentiment surrounding the conflict. The federal government retains important military advantages, including access to national security forces, aircraft and other logistical capabilities. But the conflict demonstrates the limits of military superiority when confronted by a locally embedded fighting force with knowledge of the terrain, community networks and a political narrative centered on defending the city. Federal reinforcements transported by aircraft may provide substantial firepower and mobility, but airlifted troops alone cannot guarantee control of an urban environment where local forces retain support and freedom of movement. The central question is therefore not simply which side possesses more weapons. It is which side can sustain its presence, maintain local support and ultimately establish legitimate authority over Baidoa. For Laftagareen’s supporters, capturing or reasserting control over Baydhaba would represent far more than a military victory. It would symbolize resistance to what they view as an attempt by Mogadishu to impose political authority over Southwest State through military force. For the federal government, losing effective control of Baidoa would carry equally serious consequences. It could undermine its political strategy in Southwest State and demonstrate the difficulty of imposing federal authority through security deployments alone. The fighting therefore has implications beyond the battlefield. It is becoming a test of whether political disputes within Somalia’s federal system can be resolved through dialogue and constitutional mechanisms—or whether armed confrontation will increasingly determine who controls regional capitals. The most important feature of the current confrontation may be the emergence of a locally rooted force capable of resisting substantially better-equipped federal units. Laftagareen’s supporters see their forces as a liberation movement defending Baidoa from external political domination. Their comparison with the RRA reflects a powerful historical memory in the region, where armed resistance was once used to remove warlords and reclaim the city. Whether today’s force can legitimately claim the same historical role remains a matter of political judgment. But its ability to sustain resistance demonstrates that military deployments from Mogadishu cannot automatically translate into political control on the ground. The federal government may possess greater conventional capabilities, but the struggle for Baidoa will ultimately depend on more than firepower. A government can transport troops into a city by aircraft. It cannot transport legitimacy. That is the fundamental challenge facing the federal authorities. For Laftagareen and his supporters, the objective is increasingly framed as reclaiming Baidoa through a popular resistance movement. For the federal government, the priority is maintaining control and preserving its authority over the state. As fighting continues, the outcome could shape not only the future of Baidoa but the wider balance between Mogadishu and Somalia’s federal member states. For residents caught between the two sides, however, the immediate priority is simpler: an end to the fighting, protection of civilians and a political settlement that prevents Baidoa from becoming another prolonged battlefield in Somalia’s unresolved federal crisis. items.title: Laftagaren forces attack Somali army positions in Baidoa again
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Heavy fighting erupted in Baidoa on Thursday after forces loyal to ousted Southwest State President Abdiasis Laftagaren attacked the city from multiple directions, seizing two federal army bases on its outskirts before entering the town and engaging government troops in fierce gun battles that lasted for hours. Laftagaren’s Darwish forces entered Baidoa early in the morning, according to a spokesman for the forces, who said they would continue fighting until the last federal soldier leaves the region and control of the region is fully restored to its people. The forces later withdrew from the city, bringing the fighting to an end. Southwest State Information Minister Nur Sidow told reporters in Baidoa after the fighting that those who had attacked the city were Al-Shabaab , and said the assault had begun with suicide car bombs. The Somali federal government made a similar claim last month after Laftagaren’s forces launched another attack on Baidoa. Regional authorities and the federal government have yet to provide any tangible evidence for the assertion that the attackers were Al-Shabaab. The latest fighting left multiple people dead and caused other casualties, although there are no official figures. Among those killed was the commander of the personal guards of current Southwest leader Adan Madobe. Isaq Abdulle, commander of the Somali army’s 8th Brigade of the 60th Division, sustained serious injuries. Baidoa was once a relatively peaceful town under Laftagaren, but it has become a battleground since he was toppled. The repeated attacks by his forces have exposed the inability of the federal government and its Southwest allies to defend the city, even after thousands of troops were deployed there since March, analysts say. The latest assault highlights the continuing security crisis in Baidoa, where recurrent fighting has challenged the federal government’s control of the Southwest State capital. items.title: U.S. Strengthens Rapid-Response Forces in Kismayo, Somalia
items.description: Kismayo, Somalia (WDN) — The United States military has conducted a major training exercise in Kismayo aimed at strengthening the readiness of its East African Response Force (EARF), highlighting Washington’s focus on rapid military response and force protection in southern Somalia, where Al-Shabaab maintains some of its most important operational strongholds. The exercise was conducted at the U.S. Cooperative Security Location Kismayo on August 18, 2026, with the U.S. military releasing details on September 1. It brought together elements of the East African Response Force, operating under the Combined Joint Task Force–Horn of Africa (CJTF-HOA), and U.S. Army National Guard personnel. The training focused on base defense and rapid-response operations, including the ability to reinforce U.S. personnel and facilities during a sudden security threat. According to the U.S. military, the Kismayo exercise tested the ability of EARF personnel to rapidly deploy, establish defensive positions and operate effectively in an unfamiliar environment. The exercise involved the movement of EARF personnel into Kismayo aboard a KC-130J Super Hercules, demonstrating the force’s ability to deploy rapidly by air. The location of the exercise is strategically significant, the port city of Kismayo, Jubaland, Somalia. Kismayo is a major coastal city in southern Somalia and provides access to the Lower Juba region and surrounding areas where Al-Shabaab has maintained a longstanding presence. Its position gives the United States a potentially important platform for protecting its personnel while maintaining the ability to respond quickly to security developments across southern Somalia. Jubaland is also central to Somalia’s counterterrorism campaign. Al-Shabaab has maintained networks and rural strongholds across parts of the region, allowing the group to sustain operations and exert pressure on government forces and local communities. Strengthening U.S. rapid-response capabilities in Kismayo therefore has implications beyond the defense of a single facility. It could give Washington greater flexibility to reinforce threatened positions, support partner forces and respond to emerging Al-Shabaab threats. The exercise does not by itself establish that the United States is preparing a new ground offensive or bombing campaign against Al-Shabaab from Kismayo. What it does demonstrate is a strengthened ability to protect U.S. forces, deploy rapidly and respond to security emergencies in a region where Al-Shabaab remains a significant threat. That capability could become increasingly important as Somali and allied forces seek to disrupt Al-Shabaab’s networks and regain control of territory in southern Somalia. Military pressure alone, however, is unlikely to eliminate the group. Sustained security gains will also depend on intelligence cooperation, effective local administration, community support and the ability of Somali forces to hold territory after military operations. For Jubaland, the significance is clear: a more capable U.S. rapid-response presence could add another layer of military pressure against Al-Shabaab while improving Washington’s ability to support its Somali partners. Kismayo is therefore becoming an increasingly important part of the U.S. security architecture in southern Somalia—not necessarily as the launch point for a new offensive, but as a strategic location from which American forces can protect personnel, respond to threats and support the broader effort to contain Al-Shabaab. items.title: Sawirro: Soomaaliya oo Addis Ababa ku guddoomisay shirkii ugu horeeyay ee…
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliya, Danjire Jamaal Maxamed Xasan ayaa maanta guddoomiyey furitaanka shirkii ugu horreeyey ee Wasiirrada Ganacsiga ee dalalka ku mideysan hindisaha Geeska Afrika (HoAI). Wasiirka oo ku hadlay magaca dalalka ku midoobay Hindisaha Geeska Afrika ayaa ku baaqay in gobolku si wadajir ah ugu dhaqaaqo dhismaha hal aag dhaqaale oo wadaag ah. “Waa in laga gudbo ballan-qaadyada siyaasadeed loona gudbo tallaabooyin wax-ku-ool ah oo natiijooyin la taaban karo u horseeda ganacsatada iyo shacabka gobolka,” ayuu yiri wasiir Jamaal. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay ansixinta iyo hirgelinta qorshe-hawleedka fududeynta ganacsiga gobolka ee 2026–2031, dhismaha guddiga goboleed ee fududeynta ganacsiga (RTFC) iyo in dalalka xubnaha ahi waqtigii loogu talagalay soo magacaabaan wakiilladooda guddiga. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale wuxuu ku baaqay isku-dubarid xooggan oo u dhexeeya dalalka, maalgelin ku filan iyo ka qaybgal dhab ah oo ay yeeshaan ganacsatada iyo hay’adaha gaarka loo leeyahay, si qorshaha gobolka loogu beddelo waxqabad la cabbiri karo. Wasiirrada ka kala socday Itoobiya, Jabuuti, Kenya, Koonfurta Suudaan iyo Suudaan ayaa muujiyey taageeradooda qorshe-hawleedka iyo dhismaha guddiga gobolka. Waxay si gaar ah diiradda u saareen horumarinta marinnada ganacsiga, fududeynta habraacyada kastamka, isku-xirka dekedaha iyo dalalka aan badda lahayn, casriyeynta xuduudaha, adeegyada dhijitaalka ah iyo ka qaybgalka ganacsatada. Dowladda Jarmalka oo ku hadlaysay magaca saaxiibbada horumarinta ayaa xaqiijisay taageerada joogtada ah ee ajendaha ganacsiga gobolka, iyadoo adkaysay muhiimadda hoggaanka dalalka, isku-dubaridka taageerada farsamo iyo midda maaliyadeed, iyo dejinta hannaan hirgelineed oo cad. “Himiladeennu waa Geeska Afrika oo xuduudihiisu isku xiran yihiin dhaqaale ahaan, halkii ay kala qaybin lahaayeen, halkaas oo badeecadaha, adeegyada iyo fursaduhu si fudud uga gudbaan dalalka ku yaalla Geeska Afrika ee ku midoobay hindisaha HoAI.” Si kastaba, shirkan ayaa muujinaya sida dalalka Geeska Afrika ugu gudbayaan iskaashi abaabulan oo lagu yareynayo caqabadaha ganacsiga, lagu hagaajinayo isu-socodka badeecadaha, laguna dhisayo dhaqaale goboleed isku xiran oo loo dhan yahay. items.title: Somaliland oo wakiillo u dirtay Midowga Yurub, IGAD, Midowga Afrika iyo Itoobiya
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Somaliland ayaa qaaday tallaabo cusub oo dhinaca diblomaasiyadda ah, iyadoo wakiillo cusub u magacawday inay maamulka ku metelaan Midowga Yurub, Midowga Afrika, Urur-goboleedka IGAD iyo Itoobiya. Magacaabistan ayuu Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) sameeyay ka hor inta uusan maanta u safrin Mareykanka, iyadoo safarkiisa uu maamulka ku tilmaamay mid muhiim u ah xoojinta xiriirrada dibadda iyo dadaallada Somaliland ee ku aaddan sidii ay u heli lahayd aqoonsi caalami ah. Wakiillada ay Somaliland u dirtay hay’adaha iyo dalalkaas ayaa la filayaa inay xoogga saaraan matalaadda danaha Somaliland iyo sidii loo sii ballaarin lahaa xiriirrada maamulka Hargeysa la leeyahay dhinacyada gobolka iyo kuwa caalamiga ah. Midowga Yurub, Midowga Afrika iyo IGAD ayaa kamid ah hay’adaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay Somaliland dooneyso inay si joogto ah ula macaamisho, halka Itoobiya ay muddo dheer kamid ahayd dalalka uu maamulku xiriir dhow la lahaa. Dhaq-dhaqaaqan diblomaasiyadeed ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli maamulka Somaliland uu kordhiyay dadaallada uu ugu jiro raadinta aqoonsi caalami ah. Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa safarkiisa Mareykanka ku doonaya inuu kulamo la yeesho mas’uuliyiin iyo dhinacyo muhiim ah, isagoo taageero u raadinaya ololaha aqoonsiga Somaliland. Sidoo kale magacaabista wakiilladan iyo safarka Cirro ay kusoo aadayaan xilli Israa’iil ay waddo dadaallo la xiriira aqoonsiga Somaliland, ayna ku rabto in dalal kale ku dhiiraadan tallaabaddii ay qaaday oo kale, inkastoo Tel Aviv ay dharbaaxo adag oo dibloomasiyadeed kala kulantay go’aankaasi. Si kastaba, Maamulka Somaliland ayaa muddo dheer ku doodayay inuu xaq u leeyahay aqoonsi caalami ah, iyadoo uu dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo kala duwan ku bixiyay sidii uu u heli lahaa taageero caalami ah, kuwaas oo inta badan miro-dhalin. Sidoo kale magacaabista wakiilladan iyo safarka Cirro ay kusoo aadayaan xilli Israa’iil ay waddo dadaallo la xiriira aqoonsiga Somaliland, ayna ku rabto in dalal kale ku dhiiraadan tallaabaddii ay qaaday oo kale, inkastoo Tel Aviv ay dharbaaxo adag oo dibloomasiyadeed kala kulantay go’aankaasi. Si kastaba, Maamulka Somaliland ayaa muddo dheer ku doodayay inuu xaq u leeyahay aqoonsi caalami ah, iyadoo uu dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo kala duwan ku bixiyay sidii uu u heli lahaa taageero caalami ah, kuwaas oo inta badan miro-dhalin. items.title: Turkiga oo Shidaal Badda Soomaaliya ugu Shubay Doon ka Tirsan Ciidamada Badda Soomaaliya
items.description: Dowladda Turkiga ayaa sheegtay in maraakiibteeda dagaalka ee ku sugan biyaha Soomaaliya ay shidaal ugu shubeen doon ka tirsan Ciidamada Badda Soomaaliya, iyadoo hawlgalkan lagu fuliyay badda dhexdeeda. Wasaaradda Difaaca Qaranka Turkiga ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in maraakiibta TCG Kemalreis iyo TCG Yzb. Güngör Durmuş, oo ka qeyb qaadanaya hawlaha Ciidanka Badda Soomaaliya, ay shidaal ku shubeen Doon Soomaaliyeed. Si fudud, waxa dhacay ayaa ah in markabkii Ciidamada Badda Soomaaliya loo geeyay shidaal isagoo badda ku jira, halkii uu markabku deked ku noqon lahaa si shidaal loogu shubo. Wasaaradda Difaaca Turkiga ayaa sheegtay in labada markab ay sii wadaan hawlahooda ka socda Badda Cas iyo biyaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo tallaabadan ay qeyb ka tahay taageerada iyo iskaashiga dhinaca ciidamada badda ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga. Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ayaa muddooyinkii dambe xoojinayay iskaashiga dhinaca difaaca iyo badda, waxaana Turkigu gacan ka geystaa tababarka iyo horumarinta Ciidamada Badda Soomaaliya, iyadoo ciidamadaasi ay hadda sii kordhinayaan awooddooda ilaalinta xeebaha iyo biyaha dalka.

items.title: Qoysas laga raray xeryo ku yaalla Kismaayo oo ka cabanaya shaqo la’aan iyo nolol xumo
items.description: (ERGO) –  Danyar soo barakacay oo laga saaray xeryo ku yaalla magaalada Kismaayo ayaa nolol xumo ku wajahaya dhul ka fog magaalada oo loo wareejiyay bishii April ee sannadkan. Waa saddex boqol oo qoys oo maamulka Jubbaland uu dajiyay dhul bannaan oo laga siiyay deegaanka Halgan. Waxay xuseen inay waayeen shaqooyin xoogsi ah oo noloshoodu ay ku tiirsaneyd oo ay ka qaban jireen magaalada Kismaayo oo ay ka soo fogaadeen masaafo 25 km ah. Qoys kasta ayaa la siiyay dhul uu mulkiyadiisa leeyahay oo cabbirkiisu yahay 600 mitir oo isku wareeg ah, balse caqabadda ay wajahayaan ayaa ah cunno yari, biyo yari iyo hoy xumo. Faadumo Xassan Xuseen ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay in carruurteeda oo siddeed ah ay la’dahay shaqo ay ka maarayso. Waxay horey noloshooda uga soo-saari jirtay shaqo dhar dhaqis ah oo aysan qaban afar bilood oo halkan ay deggan tahay. Waxay sheegtay in deegaanka ay joogto uu kulmiyay qoysas danyar ah oo uusan laheyn meel loo shaqo tago. Haddii ay u baahato Kismaayo, waa lagama maarmaan inay hesho $8 oo ay ku raacdo gaari ay ku tagto, ugana soo noqoto.” “Waa qarash ka badan dakhliga maalintii ay ka heli laheyd dhar dhaqaalka oo ahaa saddex Doollar. Xaaladaas ayay xustay inay ku riixday in nolosha qoyska ay ku maareyso shaxaad iyo kaalmo ay weydiisato dariska oo wixii ay awoodaan ku caawiya. “Meeshaan dayn wax ku siinaya malaha. Kismaayo dadkii aan naqaanay waxaa ku dhahaayaan qof guuray oo fogaaday waxba ma siinkaro oo iskuma halayn karo. Hal waqti haddaan hellno waqti labaad lama hellaayo cunno.” “Ninkii ama gabartii xamaali aadi lahaa gawaarida ayaa qaali noqotay. Shidaalkii ayaa qaali noqday ayay leeyihiin gawaaridu.” Faadumo ayaa tilmaamtay in adeegga kaliya ee ay heleen uu yahay waxbarasho bilaash ah.  Iskuul hoose iyo dhexe ah ayaa waxaa u dhigta shan carruur ah. Hoy xumadu, waa caqabad kale oo ay xal u la’dahay. Dhaqaale yarida ayaa sabab u noqotay inay dhisan waydo dhulkii la siiyay. Waxay sheegtay in dabeysha xagaaga ee xilligan dhaceysa ay ka dumisay bartamihii Agoosto aqal cooshad ah oo markii hore nuglaa, waxay intaas ku dartay in helitaanka musquluhu ay ciriiri yihiin. Boqollaalka qoys ee halkan la dejiyay ayaa wadaaga 70 musqulood. Halkan ayay sheegtay inaan qasab lagu keenin oo ogolaanshaheeda ay ku timid, waloow ay xustay inaysan ku baraarugsaneyn caqabadaha ay hadda wajaheyso, Hase ahaatee waxay ku fooggan tahay sidii ay uga bixi laheyd xerada Mareeray ee magaalada Kismaayo oo ay degganeyd 14 sano. “Dhulka aanu daganayn anigu manaan lahayn. danta ayaa nagu qasbeysay inaan halkan degno, sababtoo ah dhulkan anagaa iska leh, cid nagu dhibaateyneysa iyo cid nagu qash qashaadeysa malahan.” Qoyska faadumo ayaa sannadkii 2011 ka soo barakacay deegaanka Buulamareer ee gobolka Jubbada dhexe. Waxay noloshoodu ku tiirsaneyd beer 10 hektar ah oo abaar darteed ay sii tacban waayeen. Dhanka kale Maxamed Wali Dayib oo qoyskiisu ka kooban yahay 12 qof waxay dantu ku qasabtay inuu ka fogaado reerkiisa si uu ugu soo shaqeeyo. Lacagta gaari-raaca oo uusan bixin karin maalin kasta ayaa ku riixday in magaalada Kismaayo uu sii joogo, si qoysku ay dabka ugu shitaan $4 oo maalinkii uu ka helo dajinta rarka gaadiidka. “Maalintii anaga marka ugu badato waxaa wax la kariyaa hal waqti oo kaliya oo halkaas waqti raashinka loo yara badiyo. Ilmo yar oo nafaqo la’aan ah waaa jiraan.” “Waxyaabaha ugu horeeya ee aad wajahaysid waxaa weeye in aad shaqo raadisid. Shaqo haddii aad wayso waa in aad dayn raadisid. Waxaa laga yaaba dayntii inuu kuu diido qofkii aad u doonato.” Maxamed oo ah aabbaha toban carruur ah ayaa dul-saar ku ah qoys ku nool magaalada Kismaayo. Wuxuu sheegay in dhaqaalaha ka soo gala xamaalka uusan u qeyb samin gaari raac iyo biilka reerka, maalin kastana uusan awoodin inuu lug ku soo gaaro magaalada, ugana noqdo, masaafada oo fog darteed. Maalmaha qaar oo aysan shaqo jirin ayuu booqdaa qoyska oo uu xusay in cunno yarida ay u dheertahay hoy la’aan ka dhalatay dabeysha xagaaga oo ka dumisay guri uga dhisnaa dhulka la siiyay oo ah 600 oo mitir oo isku wareeg ah. “Dhibaatada Jirta waxaa ka mida dabaysha. Guriga waa wax aan tabar laheyn. Aniga hal qol oo jiingado kakab ah aan ku dhajiyey ayaa ii dhisan. Habeenkii iyo maalintii marka dabaysha jirto wuu sanqadhayaa lama seexan karo.” Maxamed ayaa sheegay in xaaladaas ay u dheer tahay biyo yari. Deegaanku malahan ceel biyood. Dadku waxay biyaha ka doontaan webiga Jubba oo u jira masaafo dhan saddex kiloomitir. Qoysaska aan awoodin inay soo dhaansadaan ayaa ku qasban inay iibsadaan biyo lagu keeno gaari dameero oo fuustadii uu qiimaheedu yahay $0.5 senti. “Culeys badan ayaa ka jira biyaha. Masaafadu waa dheertahay, qarash uma hayno aan ku shubano, mar haddaan shubano, mar kale ma awoodno inaan gadano.” “Mar islaanta ayaa dusha soo saarata, mar qolyo aan daris nahay ayaan baryaa oo aan dhahnaa gaari gacan isii aan biyo ku soo qaato.” Qoyska Maxamed ayaa degganaa xerada Tawakal 2 ee magaalada Kismaayo oo ay ku noolaayeen 12 sanno. Colaad iyo abaar ayay uga soo barakaceen gobolka Jubbada dhexe oo ay ku dhaqanayeen ari 75 neef ah iyo 60 lo’ ah oo ka la’day. Adeegyada waxbaarshada iyo cafimaadka ayaa ah waxa kaliya ee danyartan ay ka heli karaan deegaanka lagu asaasay ee Halgan. Maamulka Jubbaland ayaa sheegay in wajiga koowaad ee mashruuca ay fuliyeen, kaas oo dadku ay ku heleen waxbarasho hoose iyo dhexe ah, dhul ay leeyihiin oo wixii ay rabaan ay ka dhisan karaan iyo xarun caafimaad oo ah MCH oo adeegyadeedu bilaash yihiin. Maxamed Cumar Xassan oo ah madaxa xafiiska dib u dejinta hay’adda dadka soo barakacay ee Jubbaland ayaa sheegay in ay gacanta ku hayaan qorshe dhaqan galaya sanadkan oo danyartan looga taageerayo. Wuxuu xusay in ay heli doonaan xoolo ay dhaqdaan, xirfadda kalluumeysiga, tan beeraha iyo agabkii ay ku shaqaysan lahaayeen. “Wixii ka shaqaysanaya badda in loo abuuro shaqooyin kalluumaysi oo la siiyo doonyo iyo agabka kale u baahan yihiin. Wasaaradda Beeraha oo kale in ay beero siiso ayaa qorshaysan.” Maxamed ayaa sheegay in Jubbaland ay bilowday 2024 barnaamijka xalka waara oo ah in dadka soo barakacay lagu deegaameeyo. Wuxuu xusay in dowladdu diyaarisay dhul gaaraya 5km oo loogu talagalay in la dejiyo dadka ku barakacay gudaha deegaanada Jubbaland. The post Qoysas laga raray xeryo ku yaalla Kismaayo oo ka cabanaya shaqo la’aan iyo nolol xumo appeared first on Radio Ergo - Somali Humanitarian News and Information .

items.title: Islamic Finance in Italy: A Regulatory Vacuum Amidst Global Growth
items.description: By: Zubair Mughal, CEO – AlHuda CIBE, UAE How a €28 Billion Gulf Trade Partner Can Unlock a $6 Trillion Market Global Islamic finance is experiencing a remarkable growth phase, with total assets reaching approximately USD 5.2 trillion in 2025, reflecting a year-on-year increase of 14.9%, and is projected to hit the USD 6 trillion mark by 2026. The global sukuk market also reached record levels, with total issuance soaring to USD 264.8 billion in 2025, and some reports even citing figures exceeding USD 300 billion, representing a 25% year-on-year increase. While the epicenter of this growth remains in core Islamic finance countries, the industry is also extending its reach into Western markets, with Europe presenting a highly fragmented yet dynamic landscape. The United Kingdom continues to serve as the undisputed Western hub, hosting five fully-fledged Islamic banks, while the UK Islamic finance market itself was valued at approximately USD 7.81 billion in 2025. The London Stock Exchange remains the largest listing venue globally for hard-currency sukuk, with over a 40% market share. Meanwhile, smaller European jurisdictions such as Luxembourg have successfully leveraged their sophisticated fund industries to list green sukuk, and Malta recently published a consultation proposing definitive regulatory pathways for sukuk issuance and listing. In stark contrast to these European competitors, Italy presents a unique paradox. The country is home to a significant Muslim population of approximately 1.7 million, which now constitutes over 30% of the foreign resident demographic. It is also the second most practiced religion in the country, second only to Christianity. Deep and growing trade ties with the Gulf region further underscore the missed opportunity, as Italy trade with the Middle East is substantial. In 2025, Italy exports to the broader Middle East region, including Israel and Lebanon, exceeded €28 billion. Trade with the UAE alone is particularly robust, with exports projected to exceed €9 billion in 2025, after reaching €7.8 billion in 2024. In the first half of 2025, non-oil trade between the UAE and Italy reached approximately €6 billion. Similarly, Saudi Arabia, Italy’s 19th-largest export market, imported €6.3 billion worth of Italian goods in 2025, a 1.5% increase from the previous year. Furthermore, the growing halal market in Italy itself, with the halal meat market alone valued at USD 697.57 million in 2024 and projected to reach USD 789.46 million by 2027, signals a significant internal demand for Sharia-compliant products. Despite these compelling indicators, Italy has made no meaningful legislative progress towards accommodating Islamic finance. It has no enabling law for sukuk, no Sharia governance framework, and no tax equalization for Murabaha transactions, leaving it in a state of regulatory inertia. A notable development, however, occurred in February 2025, when Italy’s development finance institution, CassaDepositi e Prestiti (CDP), signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) Group. This marks the first collaboration initiative between the two financial institutions. The partnership focuses on knowledge-sharing, co-financing, and co-investment in sectors such as environmental sustainability, energy, food security, and infrastructure, aligning with Italy’s Mattei Plan for Africa. While this represents a significant diplomatic step, it does not yet address the domestic regulatory vacuum. On the regulatory front, Legislative Decree No. 208 came into force on January 9, 2026. Though not addressing Islamic finance directly, it signals Italy’s broader financial evolution. Academic and policy dialogue is slowly advancing: Deputy Minister Maurice Leo stated in 2025 that “Italy can be an important interlocutor for Islamic finance,” while the University of Salento and ICC Italia now offer courses on the subject. Still, the gap between talk and legislative action remains wide. The potential for Islamic finance to aid financial inclusion for Italy’s 1.7 million Muslims is gaining attention, as conventional interest-based banking is not Sharia-compliant. The Takaful insurance market is also growing. This dual opportunity—serving the Muslim community and attracting Gulf investment—makes reform compelling. The cost of inaction is high: Italy loses Gulf FDI and fails to serve its halal economy (worth ~USD 4 billion), while smaller European jurisdictions move ahead to capture a share of the $6 trillion global Islamic finance market. In the global effort to develop Islamic finance ecosystems, AlHuda Centre of Islamic Banking and Economics (AlHuda CIBE) has emerged as a pivotal player. As a globally recognized organization with extensive experience across Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Europe, AlHuda CIBE provides state-of- the-art advisory consultancy and education in Islamic banking and finance. The center has worked with central banks, commercial banks, and government entities to design regulatory frameworks, develop Shariah-compliant financial products, and build local capacity. items.fullContent: By: Zubair Mughal, CEO – AlHuda CIBE, UAE How a €28 Billion Gulf Trade Partner Can Unlock a $6 Trillion Market Global Islamic finance is experiencing a remarkable growth phase, with total assets reaching approximately USD 5.2 trillion in 2025, reflecting a year-on-year increase of 14.9%, and is projected to hit the USD 6 trillion mark by 2026. The global sukuk market also reached record levels, with total issuance soaring to USD 264.8 billion in 2025, and some reports even citing figures exceeding USD 300 billion, representing a 25% year-on-year increase. While the epicenter of this growth remains in core Islamic finance countries, the industry is also extending its reach into Western markets, with Europe presenting a highly fragmented yet dynamic landscape. The United Kingdom continues to serve as the undisputed Western hub, hosting five fully-fledged Islamic banks, while the UK Islamic finance market itself was valued at approximately USD 7.81 billion in 2025. The London Stock Exchange remains the largest listing venue globally for hard-currency sukuk, with over a 40% market share. Meanwhile, smaller European jurisdictions such as Luxembourg have successfully leveraged their sophisticated fund industries to list green sukuk, and Malta recently published a consultation proposing definitive regulatory pathways for sukuk issuance and listing. In stark contrast to these European competitors, Italy presents a unique paradox. The country is home to a significant Muslim population of approximately 1.7 million, which now constitutes over 30% of the foreign resident demographic. It is also the second most practiced religion in the country, second only to Christianity. Deep and growing trade ties with the Gulf region further underscore the missed opportunity, as Italy trade with the Middle East is substantial. In 2025, Italy exports to the broader Middle East region, including Israel and Lebanon, exceeded €28 billion. Trade with the UAE alone is particularly robust, with exports projected to exceed €9 billion in 2025, after reaching €7.8 billion in 2024. In the first half of 2025, non-oil trade between the UAE and Italy reached approximately €6 billion. Similarly, Saudi Arabia, Italy’s 19th-largest export market, imported €6.3 billion worth of Italian goods in 2025, a 1.5% increase from the previous year. Furthermore, the growing halal market in Italy itself, with the halal meat market alone valued at USD 697.57 million in 2024 and projected to reach USD 789.46 million by 2027, signals a significant internal demand for Sharia-compliant products. Despite these compelling indicators, Italy has made no meaningful legislative progress towards accommodating Islamic finance. It has no enabling law for sukuk, no Sharia governance framework, and no tax equalization for Murabaha transactions, leaving it in a state of regulatory inertia. A notable development, however, occurred in February 2025, when Italy’s development finance institution, CassaDepositi e Prestiti (CDP), signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) Group. This marks the first collaboration initiative between the two financial institutions. The partnership focuses on knowledge-sharing, co-financing, and co-investment in sectors such as environmental sustainability, energy, food security, and infrastructure, aligning with Italy’s Mattei Plan for Africa. While this represents a significant diplomatic step, it does not yet address the domestic regulatory vacuum. On the regulatory front, Legislative Decree No. 208 came into force on January 9, 2026. Though not addressing Islamic finance directly, it signals Italy’s broader financial evolution. Academic and policy dialogue is slowly advancing: Deputy Minister Maurice Leo stated in 2025 that “Italy can be an important interlocutor for Islamic finance,” while the University of Salento and ICC Italia now offer courses on the subject. Still, the gap between talk and legislative action remains wide. The potential for Islamic finance to aid financial inclusion for Italy’s 1.7 million Muslims is gaining attention, as conventional interest-based banking is not Sharia-compliant. The Takaful insurance market is also growing. This dual opportunity—serving the Muslim community and attracting Gulf investment—makes reform compelling. items.title: Somalia and China Discuss Joint Efforts to Combat Al-Shabaab
items.description: Somalia’s Minister of Defense, Ahmed Moallim Fiqi, met in Mogadishu with the Ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to Somalia, Wang Yu, to discuss deepening bilateral defense ties and accelerating joint counterterrorism efforts against Al-Shabaab. During the meeting, Ambassador Wang reaffirmed Beijing’s commitment to supporting the Federal Government of Somalia in rebuilding and modernizing its National Armed Forces. Minister Fiqi expressed gratitude to the Chinese government for its unwavering support of Somalia’s sovereignty, unity, and territorial integrity. The high-level discussions come at a critical juncture as Somalia prepares to take full ownership of its national security responsibilities ahead of the drawdown and exit of the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM). items.title: Jubaland oo si adag uga hortimid sharci ay DF u gudbisay Golaha Shacabka
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta ee Dowlad-goboleedka Jubaland ayaa si rasmi ah u qaaddacday hindise-sharciyeedka lagu dhisayo Golaha Culimada Soomaaliyeed, kaas oo ay Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya u gudbisay Baarlamaanka Federaalka oo ay ku sheegtay “mid uu muddo xileedkiisu dhammaaday.” Wasaaradda Jubaland ayaa sheegtay in hindisahaasi aanu waafaqsanayn nidaamka federaalka iyo awoodaha dastuuriga ah ee dowlad-goboleedyada, gaar ahaan kuwa khuseeya arrimaha diinta iyo bulshada. Mowqifkan ayaa lagu sheegay bayaan kasoo baxay xafiiska Wasiirka Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta ee Jubaland. Jubaland waxay ku doodday in arrimaha diinta iyo bulshada ay ka mid yihiin awoodaha ay leeyihiin dowlad-goboleedyada, iyadoo xustay dastuurka Jubaland iyo heshiisyada lagu dhisay nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in awoodahaasi aysan si gaar ah ugu koobnayn Dowladda Federaalka. “Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta Dowladda Jubaland ee Soomaaliya iyo Golaha Culimada Jubaland waxay si buuxda oo mug leh u qaadaceen Hindise-Sharciyeedka Dhismaha Golaha Culimada Soomaaliyeed,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Wasaaradda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in hindise-sharciyeedka aan laga sameyn wadatashi ku filan oo lala yeesho dowlad-goboleedyada iyo culimada deegaanka, taas oo ay ku tilmaantay inay ka hor imaanayso hannaanka federaalka iyo baahida loo qabo wada-tashi u dhexeeya dowladda dhexe iyo dowlad-goboleedyada. “Sharcigan waa mid aan lagala tashan dowladda xubnaha ka ah Dowladda Federaalka, gaar ahaan Jubaland iyo culimada deegaanka Dowladda Jubaland,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka, iyadoo lagu adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay wada-tashiga hay’adaha ay khusayso. Jubaland ayaa ka digtay in meel-marinta hindisahaasi ay saameyn ku yeelan karto awoodaha iyo madax-bannaanida hay’adaha diinta ee dowlad-goboleedyada iyo sidoo kale qaab-dhismeedka nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Diinta Jubaland ayaa ku adkaysatay mowqifkeeda ku aaddan qaadacaadda hindise-sharciyeedka, iyadoo sheegtay in Golaha Culimada Soomaaliyeed aan lagu dhisi karin hannaan aan laga wada tashan dowlad-goboleedyada iyo culimada Soomaaliyeed, ayna muhiim tahay in la dhowro awoodaha dastuuriga ah iyo heshiisyada salka u ah nidaamka federaalka.
