items.title: Macluumaad la xiriira: Dagaalka ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Inta la hubo toban qof ayaa geeriyootay, tiro tobanaan kalena ahna dhaawac ayaa soo gaaray, markii ciidamada taageersan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ay saakay weerar culus ku ekeeyeen Magaalada Baydhabo. Maamulka Isbitaal Goboleedka Baay ee Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa xaqiijiyay in la soo gaarsiiyay dhaawacyada 25 qof oo dad rayid ah ay ku jiraan. Afhayeenkii hore ee Maamulkii Madaxweyne Laftagareen, ninka lagu magacaabo Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed ayaa sheegay in Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ay beegsadeen magaaaldaasi, si ay uga saaraan waxa uu ku sheegay Salbalaar iyo Afbalaar. Afhayeenka Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed, Maxamed Sheekh Cabdullaahi (Xaayow) ayaa sheegay in Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Birmadka Koonfur Galbeed ay iska difaaceen weerar ay magaalada si wadajir ah ugu soo qaadeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab iyo ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen. Dagaalka ayaa waxa uu xooggiisu ka dhacay xeryo ciidan oo ku yaala darafyada magaalada, halkaas oo dadka deegaanka ay sheegeen in laga maqlay qaraxyo waaweyn. Goobjoogeyaal ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan laba gaari oo laga soo buuxiyay walxaha qarxa lagu bartilmaameedsaday xerada ay ciidamadu ku leeyihiin Boonkey oo jihada koonfureed uga beegan magaalada. Xaafadda dhanka bariga magaalada ku taala ee Towfiiq ayaa waxaa lagu arkay niman hubeysan oo wejiyada ay u duuban yihiin, kuwaas oo mar dambe ay goobta ka saareen ciidamo gurmad ah oo ka baxay bartamaha magaalada. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ayaa war ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ay Magaalada Baydhabo ku jebiyeen maleeshiyaadka taabacsan baa warka lagu yiri Cabdicasiis Laftagareen iyo Khawaarijta Al Shabaab oo isku milmay. Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed, Afhayeenkii hore ee Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa beeniyay in ciidamadooda ay ka garab dagaalamayeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Ugaas Xasan ayaa ku adkeystay inaysan iyagu iyo Al Shabaab isku ujeeddo ahayn, isla-markaana ay iyagu ku jiraan halgan ay dib ugu xoreynayaan sida uu yiri Koonfur Galbeed. Ciidanka Kumaandooska Gorgor, Danab, Polizia Militare, Haramcad, NISA, Daraawiishta, Birmadka iyo Booliska Koonfur Galbeed ayaa waxay maanta si weyn uga taxadareen in xoogaga weerarka soo qaaday ay si qoto dheer isugu soo fidiyaan gudaha magaalada. Xaaladda Baydhabo ayaa haatan degan, laakiin dadka deegaanka waxay qabaan cabsi ah in dagaalo kale ay soo socdaan, haddii aan xal loo helin loolanka dhanka awoodda maamulka ee u dhexeeya maamulka cusub ee uu hoggaamiyo Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) iyo hoggaankii hore.

items.title: Fighting erupts in southwestern Somalia between government and militias
items.description: Fighting erupted early Thursday between government forces and militias on the outskirts of Somalia’s southwestern city of Baidoa, with reports of heavy gunfire and civilians fleeing their homes. Somalia’s Defense Ministry said government forces were responding to an attack by fighters loyal to former South West state President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen. The ministry said that al-Shabab, an al-Qaida-linked extremist group, also took part in the attack. The claims could not immediately be independently verified. The clashes are the latest escalation in a political and security dispute between Somalia’s federal government and Laftagareen over control of South West state. Federal forces took control of Baidoa on March 30, after which Laftagareen resigned. He had governed the state since 2018. Clashes stopped in the early afternoon, but there was no official information on casualties or the extent of the fighting. Government troops patrolled the streets, ambulances rushed to the victims, and residents ventured out assessing damage and clearing out bloodied clothes from the pavement. Dr. Abdikafi Omar Mohamud, head of the emergency department at Bay Regional Hospital in Baidoa, told The Associated Press that 71 wounded, including 15 women, and one dead civilian were received by his staff. Abdullahi Haji, a Baidoa resident, told AP over the phone that he left his home as soon as he heard heavy gunfire and stray bullets landing in residential areas. Baidoa, about 245 kilometers (150 miles) northwest of Mogadishu, is a major humanitarian hub and hosts more than half a million people displaced by conflict and drought. Last month, fighting in and around Baidoa left at least four civilians dead and 98 others wounded. AP.

items.title: Daawo: Ciidamo gadoodsan oo xirtay waddada Xabsiga Dhexe
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa Asluubta Soomaaliyeed ayaa maanta gadood ka sameeyay aagga Xabsiga Dhexe ee Xamar, iyagoo xirtay waddada halkaasi marta oo ay isugu soo baxeen. Ciidamadan oo tiradooda ay gaareyso illaa 500 oo askari ayaa Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka dalbaday inay wax laga qabto cabashooyinkooda ku aaddan in muddo labo sano ah aysan helin wax mushaaraad ah. Qaar kamid ah askarta gadoodka sameeyay ayaa sheegay in muddo ay shaqeynayeen iyagoo aan helin xuquuqdooda, wuxuuna xusay in tallaabada ay qaadeen maanta ay tahay mid ay ku doonayaan in codkooda la maqlo, waxna laga qabto cabashadooda. “Annaga waxaan u taaganahay amniga inaan ka shaqeyno, labo sano ayaan xuquuq la’aan ugu shaqeyneynaa dowladda. Maanta waxaan waddadan u xiranay inay dowladdu jawaab naga siiso cabashadeenna,” ayuu yiri mid kamid ah askarta. Sidoo kale, askari kale oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa sheegay in ballamo horay loo siiyay ay dowladdu ka baxday, isaga oo hoosta ka xariiqay in ciidamadu ay doonayaan oo keliya inay helaan xuquuqdooda. “Ballanta mar kasta waa nooga baxayaan maanta waxaan u doodeynaa inaan xuquuqdeenna ka helno dowladda Soomaaliya, haddii aan xuquuqdeenna wayno, meesha noo furan mucaarad ha ahaato ama meel kale waan tageynaa,” ayuu yiri askariga. Gadoodkan ayaa noqonaya kii labaad oo ay sameynayaan ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas cabashooyin xooggan ka muujinaya xaaladda ay ku shaqeeyaan iyo xuquuqda ay sheegayaan in aysan helin. Si kastaba, ma jiro ilaa hadda wax war ah oo kasoo baxay dhanka dowladda oo ku aadan cabashada ciidamadaas xirtay waddada gasha Xabsiga Dhexe. Qaar kamid ah askarta gadoodka sameeyay ayaa sheegay in muddo ay shaqeynayeen iyagoo aan helin xuquuqdooda, wuxuuna xusay in tallaabada ay qaadeen maanta ay tahay mid ay ku doonayaan in codkooda la maqlo, waxna laga qabto cabashadooda. “Annaga waxaan u taaganahay amniga inaan ka shaqeyno, labo sano ayaan xuquuq la’aan ugu shaqeyneynaa dowladda. Maanta waxaan waddadan u xiranay inay dowladdu jawaab naga siiso cabashadeenna,” ayuu yiri mid kamid ah askarta. Sidoo kale, askari kale oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa sheegay in ballamo horay loo siiyay ay dowladdu ka baxday, isaga oo hoosta ka xariiqay in ciidamadu ay doonayaan oo keliya inay helaan xuquuqdooda. “Ballanta mar kasta waa nooga baxayaan maanta waxaan u doodeynaa inaan xuquuqdeenna ka helno dowladda Soomaaliya, haddii aan xuquuqdeenna wayno, meesha noo furan mucaarad ha ahaato ama meel kale waan tageynaa,” ayuu yiri askariga. Gadoodkan ayaa noqonaya kii labaad oo ay sameynayaan ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas cabashooyin xooggan ka muujinaya xaaladda ay ku shaqeeyaan iyo xuquuqda ay sheegayaan in aysan helin. Si kastaba, ma jiro ilaa hadda wax war ah oo kasoo baxay dhanka dowladda oo ku aadan cabashada ciidamadaas xirtay waddada gasha Xabsiga Dhexe. items.title: Soomaaliya oo Guddoomisay Shirkii Ugu Horreeyey ee Wasiirrada Ganacsiga Dalalka Hindisaha Geeska Afrika
items.description: Addis Ababa, Itoobiya – Soomaaliya ayaa guddoomisay shirkii ugu horreeyey ee Wasiirrada Ganacsiga dalalka ku midoobay Hindisaha Geeska Afrika (HoAI), kaas oo maanta ka qabsoomay magaalada Addis Ababa ee dalka Itoobiya. Shirka waxaa guddoomiyey Wasiirka Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Soomaaliya, Danjire Jamaal Maxamed Xasan, oo ku hadlay magaca dalalka ku midoobay Hindisaha Geeska Afrika. Wasiirku wuxuu ku baaqay in dalalka gobolka ay si wadajir ah uga shaqeeyaan dhismaha hal aag dhaqaale oo wadaag ah, isaga oo xusay in loo baahan yahay in laga gudbo ballanqaadyada siyaasadeed loona gudbo tallaabooyin wax-ku-ool ah oo natiijooyin muuqda u horseeda ganacsatada iyo shacabka dalalka gobolka. Wuxuu carrabka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay ansixinta iyo hirgelinta Qorshe-hawleedka Fududeynta Ganacsiga Gobolka ee sannadaha 2026 ilaa 2031, iyo dhismaha Guddiga Goboleed ee Fududeynta Ganacsiga, si loo xoojiyo isku-xirka iyo ganacsiga dalalka ku mideysan hindisahan. Sidoo kale, Wasiirka ayaa ku baaqay in dalalka xubnaha ka ah hindisaha ay xoojiyaan iskaashiga, maalgelinta iyo ka qaybgalka ganacsatada iyo hay’adaha gaarka loo leeyahay, si qorshayaasha gobolka loogu beddelo waxqabad la taaban karo. Wasiirrada Ganacsiga ee ka socday dalalka Itoobiya, Jabuuti, Kenya, Koonfurta Suudaan iyo Suudaan ayaa muujiyey taageeradooda qorshe-hawleedka cusub iyo dhismaha guddiga gobolka. Shirka ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray horumarinta marinnada ganacsiga, fududeynta habraacyada kastamka, isku-xirka dekedaha iyo dalalka aan badda lahayn, casriyeynta xuduudaha, adeegyada dhijitaalka ah iyo kor u qaadista ka qaybgalka ganacsatada. Dowladda Jarmalka oo ku hadlaysay magaca saaxiibbada horumarinta ayaa dhankeeda xaqiijisay taageerada ay u hayso ajendaha ganacsiga gobolka, iyadoo adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay hoggaanka dalalka, isku-dubaridka taageerada farsamo iyo tan maaliyadeed. Hindisaha Geeska Afrika ayaa lagu doonayaa in la dhiso dhaqaale goboleed isku xiran, iyadoo la yareynayo caqabadaha hortaagan ganacsiga iyo isu-socodka badeecadaha. “Himiladeennu waa Geeska Afrika oo xuduudihiisu isku xiran yihiin dhaqaale ahaan, halkii ay kala qaybin lahaayeen—halkaas oo badeecadaha, adeegyada iyo fursaduhu si fudud uga gudbaan dalalka ku yaalla Geeska Afrika ee ku midoobay Hindisaha HoAI,” ayaa lagu sheegay shirka. Shirkan ayaa muujinaya tallaabo cusub oo dalalka Geeska Afrika ay ugu gudbayaan iskaashi abaabulan oo lagu horumarinayo ganacsiga gobolka, laguna dhisayo dhaqaale isku xiran oo ay ka faa’iidaystaan shacabka iyo ganacsatada dalalka xubnaha ka ah hindisaha.

items.title: Guddiga Joogtada Golaha Shacabka oo jadwal u sameeyey kulamada toddobaadka soo socda
items.description: Guddoomiye ku-xigeenka labaad ee Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow, ayaa maanta shir-guddoomiyey kulanka 5-aad ee Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Golaha Shacabka, kaas oo ka dhacay xarunta Guddoonka iyo Guddiyada ee Villa Hargeysa. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray howlaha sharci-dejinta iyo hindise-sharciyeedyada horyaalla guddiyada Golaha Shacabka, iyadoo xubnaha Guddiga Joogtada ah ay warbixin ka dhageysteen guddiyada kala duwan. Guddi walba ayaa xubnaha kale la wadaagay shuruucda uu gacanta ku hayo, marxaladaha ay marayaan iyo waqtiga la qorsheynayo in hindise-sharciyeedyadaasi loo gudbiyo Golaha Shacabka si ay u maraan waajibaadkooda dastuuriga ah. Sidoo kale, Guddiga Joogtada ah ayaa ansixiyey hadal-qoraalka kulankii 4-aad, waxayna jadwal iyo ajande u sameeyeen kulamada guud ee Golaha Shacabka ee toddobaadka soo socda, iyadoo mudnaanta la siinayo howlaha sharci-dejinta iyo arrimaha muhiimka ah ee horyaalla Golaha. Ugu dambeyn, Guddoomiye ku-xigeenka labaad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow, ayaa xubnaha guddiga uga mahadceliyey dadaalkooda, isagoo ku boorriyey inay dardargeliyaan howlaha horyaalla guddiyada si shuruucda ay gacanta ku hayaan loogu gudbiyo Golaha waqtigii loogu talagalay.

items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo la sheegay inuu wado qorsho uu xafiis uu maamulkiisa ku shaqeeyo kaga dhisanayo Muqdisho (XOG)
items.description: Baraawe (Raxanreeb Online) Ilo ku dhow hoggaamiyaha dowlad goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Madoobe ayaa laga soo xigtay inuu qorsheynayo in si degdeg ah loo dhiso xafiisyada maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ee magaalada Baraawe, ama uu Muqdisho ka sameysan doono xafiis ku-meel-gaar ah oo uu howlaha maamulka ka sii wado. Arrintan ayaa la sheegay inuu yimid kaddib weerarkii saakay ka dhacay Baydhabo,isla markaana tallabadan lagu sheegay in ay tahay cabsi soo wajahday maamulka uu hoggaamiyo Aadan Madoobe. Sidoo kale hoggaamiye Aadan Madoobe, ayaa lagu dhaliilayay inuu ku guuldarreystay xaqiijinta amniga Baydhabo iyo inuu heshiis ama dib-u-heshiisiin la gaaro garabyada siyaasadeed ee ka aragti duwan maamulka. Xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Koonfur Galbeed ayaa weli ah mid kacsan, iyadoo saacadihii lasoo dhaafay Baydhabo ay ka dhaceen iska horimaadyo gudaha oo geystay khasaaro isugu jira dhimasho iyo dhaawac. items.title: DF oo eedeyn culus u jeedisay ciidanka Lafta-gareen kadib qaraxyo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ka hadashay dagaal saaka ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba, kadib markii ay weerar kusoo qaadeen ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen, kuwaas oo dagaal la galay ciidamada dowladda. Warsaxaafadeedka kasoo baxay wasaaradda ayaa lagu sheegay in dagaalkii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba lagu jabiyay ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen iyo Al-Shabaab oo si wadajir ah usoo weeraray magaalada, isla markaana khasaare culus la gaarsiiyay iska hor imaadka. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ay iska caabiyeen weerarka, ayna ka hortageen maleeshiyadii isku dayay inay soo galaan magaalada. Sidoo kale, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa ku eedeysay ciidamada Lafta-gareen ee weerarka soo qaaday in ay adeegsadeen qaraxyo ay doonayeen in lagu argagax geliyo shacabka, balse laga hor tegay. “Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliyeed ayaa saaka abaare 04:15 magaalada Baydhabo ku jabiyey maleeshiyadka taabacsan Cabdicasiis Laftagareen iyo Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab oo isku milmay, kuwaas oo weerar ku soo qaaday magaalada. Ciidamadu waxay si geesinimo leh uga hortageen weerarka, oo ku bilowday qaraxyo la doonayey in lagu argagax geliyo shacabka, waxayna jebiyeen gaarsiintii maleeshiyadkii weerarka soo qaaday,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Dhanka kale, wasaaradda gaashaandhigga ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in haatan waddo qiimeyn guud oo ku aadan dagaalka, ayna sii bandhigi doonto khasaaraha rasmiga ah ee la gaarsiiyay Maleeshiyaadka weerarka soo qaaday. “Waxaa hadda socda qiimeyn lagu xaqiijinayo khasaaraha gaaray maleeshiyadii weerarka soo qaaday. Faahfaahin rasmi ah ayaa shacabka lala wadaagi doonaa doonna marka qiimeyntaas la soo gabagabeeyo,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Xaaladda ayaa hadda deggan, waxaana lagu soo warramayaa in ciidamada Lafta-gareen ay dib ugu laabteen fariisamhooda oo ku yaalla bannaanka magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. items.title: Duulimaadyo Toos ah oo Maanta Ka Billowday Muqdisho iyo Muscat
items.description: Shirkadda duulimaadyada ee SalamAir⁠ ayaa maanta oo Khamiis ah, 3-da Sebteembar 2026, si rasmi ah u billowday duulimaadyo toos ah oo isku xiraya magaalooyinka Muqdisho iyo Muscat, caasimadaha Soomaaliya iyo Cumaan. Duulimaadyadan oo ah markii ugu horreysay ee xiriir duulimaad aan joogsi lahayn uu si toos ah u dhex maro Soomaaliya iyo Saldanadda Cumaan, ayaa la qorsheeyay inay dhacaan laba jeer toddobaadkii. Shirkadda ayaa sheegtay in qiimaha tigidhka hal jiho uu ka bilaabanayo 79.99 Riyaalka Cumaan, iyadoo adeeggan cusub uu sidoo kale rakaabka u fududeynayo inay Muscat uga sii safraan dalal iyo magaalooyin kale oo ku yaalla Bariga Dhexe iyo Aasiya. SalamAir waxay sheegtay in duulimaadyadan cusub ay xoojin doonaan isu socodka dadka, ganacsiga iyo xiriirka dhaqaale ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Cumaan, isla markaana ay Abuuri doonaan fursado cusub oo dhinaca ganacsiga iyo safarrada ah.

items.title: Ruto oo amar ku bixiyay in la xiro ganacsiyada yar yar ee Ajaanibta Kenya joogta lee yihiin
items.description: Nairobi (Raxanreeb Online) Madaxweynaha dalka Kenya William Ruto ayaa ku dhawaaqay in ganacsiyada yaryar iyo kuwa tafaariiqda ee dalka loo xaddidayo muwaadiniinta Kenya, isagoo amar ku bixiyay in ganacsiyada noocaas ah ee ay leeyihiin ajaaniibta la xiro. Tallaabadan ayaa saameyn ku yeelan karta ajaaniib badan oo ku nool Kenya, gaar ahaan Soomaalida aan haysan dhalashada dalkaas ee ku shaqeysta ganacsiyada yaryar iyo tafaariiqda. Go’aanka ayaa qeyb ka ah qorshe lagu doonayo in ganacsiyada yaryar fursad dheeraad ah loogu sameeyo muwaadiniinta Kenya, iyadoo faahfaahin dheeraad ah laga sugayo dowladda Kenya oo ku saabsan sida loo fulin doono amarka iyo ganacsiyada uu si gaar ah u saameynayo. items.title: Ciidamo ka tirsan Asluubta oo xirtay Xabsiga Dhexe iyo Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir
items.description: Ciidamo ka tirsan Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed ayaa maanta xirtay baraha muhiimka ah ee laga ilaaliyo Xabsiga Dhexe ee Muqdisho iyo Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir, iyagoo joojiyay isku socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka. Wararka laga helayo goobta ayaa sheegaya in mararka qaar la maqlayo rasaas ay ridayaan ciidamada gadoodsan, xilli xiisad ay ka taagan tahay agagaarka Xabsiga Dhexe. Ciidamadan ayaa la qoray ku dhawaad sanad ka hor, waxaana la sheegay in muddadaas aysan weli helin wax mushaar ah. Taliyaha cusub ee Ciidanka Asluubta ayaa dhawaan ciidamada marsiiyay habraaca qaadista faraha, taas oo qayb ka ah nidaamka loogu diyaarinayo in la bilaabo bixinta mushaarkooda.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay ee xaaladda Baydhabo
items.description: Xaaladda magaalada Baydhabo ayaa haatan lagu soo warramayaa inay inta badan degan tahay, kaddib dagaal culus oo aroornimadii maanta ka dhacay qaybo ka mid ah magaalada iyo duleedkeeda. Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa sheegay in ay magaalada ka saareen xoogaggii weerarka soo qaaday, kuwaas oo dowladda iyo Koonfur Galbeed ay ku eedeeyeen inay ahaayeen maleeshiyaad taageersan madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Laftagareen, isla markaana ay sheegtay inay ku jireen xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Eedeynta xiriirka Al-Shabaab iyo xoogagga Laftagareen weli waxaa jira dhinacyo diidan, mana jirto xaqiijin madax-bannaan oo buuxda. Dagaalka oo saacado ka socday xaafado iyo waddooyin ku yaalla gudaha iyo daafaha magaalada ayaa sababay in dad rayid ah ay dhaawacmaan, iyadoo dhaawacyada loo kala qaadayo xarumaha caafimaadka ee magaalada. Wararka hadda soo baxaya ayaa sheegaya in rasaas goos-goos ah weli laga maqlayo qaybo ka mid ah Baydhabo, hase yeeshee xaaladdu ay ka deggan tahay sidii ay ahayd saaka. Ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ayaa wada howlgallo lagu baacsanayo xoogaggii ka baxay magaalada. Sidoo kale, warar hordhac ah ayaa sheegaya in dad labada dhinac ka tirsan ay ku dhinteen iska horimaadka, balse tirada saxda ah iyo khasaaraha guud ayaan weli si rasmi ah loo shaacin.

items.description: Baydhabo (Raxanreeb Online) Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa si rasmi ah u xaqiijiyay inay si buuxda gacanta ugu hayaan nabadgelyada magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta gobolka Baay, kadib dagaal gudaha magaalada ku dhex maray ciidamo taabacsan Laftagareen iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Maamulka ayaa sheegay in xaaladda amni ee magaalada ay hadda gacanta ugu jirto hay’adaha ammaanka, iyadoo ciidamada maamulka ay wadaan sugidda amniga iyo xasilinta xaaladda. Sidoo kale dagaalka ayaa la sheegay in uu ku dhintay Taliye Xigenkii Ururka 11 aad Ee Ciidanka Booliiska Birmadka Qeeybta Gobalka Baay Baydhabo Maaya Fuulka Axmed Samakaay iyo ciidamo badan. items.title: Kadib cambaareyn xooggan, dowladda Mareykanka oo Soomaaliya dib ugu daraysa…
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay in Soomaaliya dib loogu dari doono warbixinnada dadweynaha ee nidaamka digniinta hore ee macluusha laga bilaabo bishan September, kadib markii dalka laga reebay laba qiimeyn oo waaweyn oo caalami ah oo lagu cabbiro baahida gargaarka cuntada. Soomaaliya, Afghanistan iyo Yemen ayaa ka maqnaa warbixintii ugu dambeysay ee sannadlaha ahayd ee Peak Food Assistance Needs Outlook iyo warbixinta billaha ah ee Food Assistance Outlook , kuwaas oo ay soo saarto hay’adda Famine Early Warning Systems Network (FEWS NET). Arrintan ayaa dhalisay walaac ku saabsan mustaqbalka iyo baaxadda shaqada FEWS NET, oo ah nidaam ay dowladaha iyo hay’adaha bani’aadannimada u adeegsadaan saadaalinta dhibaatooyinka cuntada iyo go’aaminta meelaha gargaarka degdegga ah looga baahan karo. Sarkaal ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa wargeyska EL PAÍS u sheegay Talaadadii in warbixinnada dadweynaha ee FEWS NET ee Soomaaliya, Afghanistan iyo Yemen “dib loo billaabi doono laga bilaabo September.” Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay inay sii qiimeyn doonto barnaamijyada si loo hubiyo in kheyraadka xaddidan lagu wajahayo mudnaanta siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Mareykanka. Afhayeen wasaaradda ka tirsan ayaa hore ugu sheegay wargeyska in FEWS NET ay “diiradda saareyso dalalka la jaanqaadaya mudnaanta guud ee siyaasadda xoghayaha arrimaha dibadda.” Si kastaba, ka maqnaanshaha Soomaaliya ee labada warbixin ma aysan ka dhignayn in FEWS NET ay gebi ahaanba joojisay qiimeynta xaaladda dalka. Hay’addu waxay weli soo saartaa warbixinno gaar ah oo Soomaaliya ku saabsan, oo ay ku jirto saadaal ku saabsan xaaladda sugnaanta cuntada ilaa Janaayo 2027. Walaaca saameynta siyaasadda Hay’adda USAID ayaa FEWS NET aas-aastay sanadkii 1985 si loo helo digniin hore oo ku saabsan macluusha iyo dhibaatooyinka kale ee daran ee sugnaanta cuntada. Nidaamka ayaa hadda hoos yimaada kormeerka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka, kadib markii maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu baabi’iyey USAID. Isbeddelladaas ayaa dhaliyay dhaleeceyn uga timid saraakiil hore oo Mareykan ah iyo khubaro dhinaca gargaarka bani’aadannimada ah, kuwaas oo ka cabsi qaba in arrimo siyaasadeed ay saameyn ku yeeshaan dalalka iyo xaaladaha ay FEWS NET si gaar ah ula socoto. Jeremy Konyndyk, oo ah madaxweynaha Refugees International isla markaana hore xil sare uga soo qabtay USAID, ayaa sheegay in maamulka Trump uu “si isa soo taraysa u siyaasadeenayo falanqeynta macluusha.” Hase yeeshee, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ma aysan sheegin in sabab siyaasadeed ay ka dambeysay ka maqnaanshaha Soomaaliya ee warbixinnadaas. Arrintan ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmeysa xilli Mareykanku dhimayo qeyb ka mid ah gargaarkii uu dibadda ku bixin jiray, taas oo cadaadis dheeraad ah saartay barnaamijyada bani’aadannimada ee dalal ay Soomaaliya ka mid tahay. Khatarta gaajada Soomaaliya Soomaaliya ayaa galeysa marxalad aad u nugul, iyadoo abaaro iyo isbeddello cimilo oo soo noqnoqday, dagaallo, barakac, sare u kaca qiimaha cuntada iyo hoos u dhaca maalgelinta gargaarka ay cadaadis xooggan saarayaan malaayiin qof. Hay’adda Cuntada Adduunka ee WFP ayaa sheegtay in lix milyan oo qof, oo u dhiganta ku dhowaad saddex-meelood meel dadka Soomaaliya, ay wajahayaan heerar gaajo oo qalalaase ah ama ka daran. Sidoo kale, 1.9 milyan oo carruur ah oo da’doodu ka yar tahay shan sano ayaa la ildaran nafaqo-darro ba’an. FEWS NET ayaa saadaalisay in baahida gargaarka cuntada ay sii ahaan doonto mid aad u sarreysa ilaa Janaayo, iyadoo tirada dadka u baahan gargaarka ay dhammaadka 2026 gaari karto inta u dhexeysa lix milyan iyo ku dhowaad toddoba milyan. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale saadaalisay xaalado heerka deg degga ah oo ka dhici kara qeybo ka mid ah Bay, Bakool, Gedo iyo Hiiraan, gaar ahaan deegaannada aadka ugu tiirsan wax-soo-saarka beeraha. Xaalado halis ah ayaa sidoo kale laga filayaa qaar ka mid ah deegaannada webiyada koonfurta, dhulka daaqsimeedka waqooyiga iyo bartamaha dalka iyo 12 xero oo waaweyn oo ay ku nool yihiin dadka gudaha ku barakacay. Qaar ka mid ah qoysaska ayaa laga yaabaa inay gaaraan heerka ugu daran ee sugnaan la’aanta cuntada ee loo yaqaan Catastrophe ama musiibo . Fatahaado halis cusub noqon kara FEWS NET ayaa sheegtay in khatarta ugu weyn ee soo socota aysan hadda ku koobneyn abaarta, balse ay u wareegi karto fatahaado culus inta lagu jiro xilli-roobaadka Deyrta ee bilaha October ilaa December. Hay’addu waxay ka digtay in fatahaado aad u daran oo baahsan ay abuuri karaan khatar dhab ah oo macluul ah inta u dhexeysa October iyo Janaayo, gaar ahaan deegaannada beeraleyda iyo xoolo-dhaqatada ee Bay, Bakool, Gedo iyo Hiiraan. Sidoo kale khatartaas ayaa saameyn karta inta badan deegaannada webiyada koonfurta Soomaaliya iyo xeryaha barakacayaasha ee Baydhaba, Jowhar, Beledweyne iyo Doolow. Saadaasha ugu badan ee FEWS NET hadda ma muujineyso fatahaado gaari doona heer sababi kara macluul. Si kastaba, hay’addu waxay ka digtay in haddii fatahaado aad u daran dhacaan ay sababi karaan burburka dalagyada, khasaaro ballaaran oo xoolaha iyo hantida ah, barakac cusub iyo hakad dheer oo ku yimaada suuqyada iyo gaarsiinta gargaarka. Digniinahaas ayaa imanaya xilli hay’adaha bani’aadannimada ay wajahayaan dhaqaale yari sii xoogeysaneysa. WFP ayaa sheegtay inay u baahan tahay ku dhowaad 194 milyan oo dollar si ay Soomaaliya uga sii waddo gargaarka naf-badbaadinta ah ilaa Janaayo 2027. Dib u billaabashada warbixinnada ballaaran ee FEWS NET ee Soomaaliya ayaa sidaas darteed kusoo aadeysa xilli dalka uu wajahayo baahiyo bani’aadannimo oo aad u sarreeya iyo khataro la xiriira isbeddellada cimilada. Digniinahaas ayaa imanaya xilli hay’adaha bani’aadannimada ay wajahayaan dhaqaale yari sii xoogeysaneysa. WFP ayaa sheegtay inay u baahan tahay ku dhowaad 194 milyan oo dollar si ay Soomaaliya uga sii waddo gargaarka naf-badbaadinta ah ilaa Janaayo 2027. items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo ku dhawaaqday in lasoo afjaray raggii soo weeraray Baydhaba
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya faah-faahin dheeraad ah ka bixiyay dagaalkii saaka ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba ee xrunta gobolka Baay, kadib markii ay soo weerareen ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ee ku sugan bannaanka magaaladaasi. Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Koonfur Galbeed ayaa waxaa lagu sheegay in ciidamada amniga ay soo afjareen xubno ay ku tilmaameen Khawaarij, kuwaas oo weerar kusoo qaaday Baydhaba oo ah xarunta KMG ah ee maamulka. Sidoo kale, Koonfur Galbeed ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in ay bandhigi doonto meydadka xubnaha la dilay iyo guud ahaan khasaaraha ka dhashay weerarka saaka oo saacado badan qaatay. “Guud ahaaan waxaa lasoo afjaray Khawaarijtii saaakay weerarka ku soo qaaday magaalada Baydhaba, waxaana goordhow lasoo bandhigi doonaaa maydadkoooda,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal lagu daabacay bogga Telefishinka Koonfur Galbeed. Waxaa kale oo farriin loo diray shacabka oo loogu baaqay inay is-dajiyaan, lana shaqeeyaan ciidamada ammaanka ee howlgalka ka wada magaalada. “Waxaa shacabka loogu baaqayaa inay is dejiyaan, lana shaqeeyaaan laamaha amniga ee ku howlan sifeenta haraadiga Khawaarijta soo weerartay magaalada Baydhaba,” ayaa mar kae lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Ciidanka taabacsan Lafta-gareen ayaa dhankooda guul ka sheegtay dagaalka, waxaana saraakiil u hadashay ay sheegeen inay gudaha u galeen magaalada, ayna ka fuliyeen howlgal qorsheysan, sida ay hadalka u dhigeen. Dhinaca kale, waxaa lasoo warinayaa in dagaalkan uu sababay khasaare dhimasho iyo dhaawacba leh oo soo kala gaaray labada dhinac, waxaana dadka dhintay kamid ah Daahir Macalin oo ahaa taliyaha ilaalada Gaarka ah ee Sheekh Aadan Madoobe, halka uu dhaawac uu soo gaara taliyaha guutada 8-aad e qaybta 60-aad ee Xoogga Dalka Jeneraa Isaq Cabdulle oo xaaladdiisa caafimaad lala tacaalayo. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Xaaladda Baydhaba ayaa hadda deggan, inkastoo weli xaafadaha qaar lag arkayo ciidamo dheeraad ah oo roono ka wada halkaasi. items.title: Clashes Erupt in Baidoa as Security Forces Battle Opposition Loyalists
items.description: Clashes and heightened security fears have gripped Baidoa, the interim capital of South West State, following armed confrontations between regional security forces and fighters loyal to former state leader Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed, known as Laftagareen. Local residents reported seeing masked fighters entering the city from several directions as tension rapidly escalated. Although large-scale fighting has subsided, sporadic gunfire continues to ring out across parts of the city. The outbreak of violence has brought daily life in Baidoa to a sudden halt. Public transit and general movement are frozen, with residents sheltering in their homes out of fear for their safety. Regional security forces and Federal Government troops already based in Baidoa are conducting joint operations to regain complete control and prevent further instability. Conflicting claims have emerged regarding the nature of the attack. Regional authorities claim the situation is now under control, maintaining that security forces successfully repelled an early-morning attack inside the city. State media outlets cited military officials describing the attackers as Al-Shabaab militants. However, a spokesperson for forces loyal to Laftagareen publicly refuted the administration’s statement, claiming responsibility for launching the assault on Baidoa. The conflicting narratives underscore deep political and military divisions in the region, as authorities continue working to fully stabilize the city amidst lingering sporadic gunfire. items.title: Xog: Dadaalladii Muqdisho lagu keenayay Deni iyo Axmed Madoobe oo hakad galay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynayaasha Jubaland iyo Puntland ayaa ku gacan-seeray qorshe la doonayay in Muqdisho lagu keeno, si loo dhamaystiro wada-hadallada u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka, loogana gaaro xal waara khilaafka ka taagan hannaanka doorashooyinka. Dadaalladan oo ay garwadeen ka ahayd beesha caalamka ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inay hakad galeen, kadib markii ay ka biyo diideen Axmed Madoobe iyo Saciid Deni oo khilaaf uu kala dhexeeyo Villa Soomaaliya. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, labada madaxweyne ayaa diidmadooda sabab uga dhigay in heshiiska doorashooyinka uusan lahayn dammaanad rasmi ah, sidaas daraadeedna aysan ku imaanayn caasimada Muqdisho. Wararka ayaa intaas kusii daraya Madaxweynayaasha Jubaland iyo Puntland ay ku adkaysanayaan in beesha caalamka laga siiyo saxiix heshiiska oo si cad loogu qoro nuqulka heshiiska, si ay u kaalin ugu yeeshaan marxaladda kala guurka. Doorka wakiilada beeha caalamka ayaa haatan ku kooban “fududayn” oo kaliya, waxayna garwadeen ka yihiin wada-hadallada oo galay dhowr wareeg, si xal loogu helo muranka hareeyay hannaanka guud ee doorashooyinka dalka. Dhankeeda qorshaha Villa Soomaaliya ayaa ah in aan dammaanad loo baahnayn heshiiska doorashooyinka oo ay tahay in horay loo socdo, si looga miradhaliyo wada-hadallada muddada dheer usoo socday labada dhinac. Xubno mucaaradka ayaa sidoo kale arrintan ay isaga aragti dhow yihiin madaxtooyada, hase ahaatee labada Dowlad-goboleed ee Jubaland iyo Puntland ayaa weli saluugsan siiqada loo dhigayo heshiiska. Labadan maamul ayaa horey xiriirka ugu jaray Dowladda Federaalka, kaddib markii uu sii xoogaystay khilaafka u dhexeeya oo saameyn weyn ku yeeshay wada-shaqeyntii iyo xiriirkii ka dhexeeyay Kismaayo, Garoowe iyo Muqdisho. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee, Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirto marxalad xasaasi ah, waxaana doodda ugu culus ay ka taagan tahay hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo wax ka beddelka lagu sameeyay dastuurka ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Soomaaliya. The post Xog: Dadaalladii Muqdisho lagu keenayay Deni iyo Axmed Madoobe oo hakad galay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sawirro: Madaxweyne Cirro oo u baxay dalka Mareykanka + Ujeedka
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) -Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdullaahi (Cirro) iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta u ambabaxay dalka Mareykanka, kadib casuumaad rasmi ah oo uu ka helay Washington. Cabdiraxmaan Cirro ayaa sidoo kale sii mari doona magaalada Abu Dubai ee Dalka Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta, sida ay shaacisay Madaxtooyada Somaliland. Safarka Cirro ee dalka Mareykanka ayaa noqonaya kii ugu horreeyey ee uu madaxweyne ahaan ku tego dalkaasi, taas oo ka dhigeysa booqasho muhiim ah oo xambaarsan arrimo siyaasadeed iyo kuwaa diblomaasiyadeed. Madaxtooyada Somaliland ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamtay in safarkan uu muhiim u yahay xoojinta xiriirka diblumaasiyadeed, iskaashiga amniga iyo dhaqaalaha, dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga iyo horumarinta qaddiyadda aqoonsiga Somaliland. “Booqashadan waxay muujineysaa in Somaliland ay dunida kula macaamilayso kalsooni, masuuliyad iyo aragti Qaran, isla markaana ay diyaar u tahay iskaashi istiraatiji ah oo ku dhisan danaha wadajirka ah,” ayay tiri Madaxtooyadu. Waxaa kale oo la filayaa in Madaxweynaha uu kulamo la yeesho mas’uuliyiin iyo dhinacyo muhiim ah, isaga oo gudbinaya codka, danaha iyo himilada Shacabka Somaliland. Safarkan ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh xukuumadda Somaliland, maadaama uu yahay mid ka mid ah socdaalladii ugu muhiimsanaa ee dibadda ee uu Cirro ku doonayo inuu ku xoojiyo xiriirrada Somaliland ay la leedahay saaxiibbada caalamka. Booqashadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Somaliland ay waddo dadaallo diblumaasiyadeed oo ay ku doonayso inay xoojiso xiriirkeeda caalamka, gaar ahaan Mareykanka. The post Sawirro: Madaxweyne Cirro oo u baxay dalka Mareykanka + Ujeedka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Dagaal culus oo ka qarxay Baydhaba kadib markii ciidanka Lafta-gareen…
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Wararka naga soo gaaraya gobolka Baay ayaa sheegaya in goordhow uu dagaal qaraar ka qarxay duleedka magaalada Baydhaba, kaas oo u dhexeeya ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen iyo kuwa dowladda Soomaaliya. Dagaalka ayaa yimid, kadib markii ciidanka Lafta-gareen ay weerar xoogan ku qaadeen magaalada, waxaana kadib sidaas ku qarxay dagaal foolka fool ah oo u dhexeeya labada dhinac, la’iskuna adeegsanayo hubka noocyadiisa kala duwan. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in haatan gudaha Baydhaba laga maqlayo daryanka hubka culus iyo rasaas ay dhinacyadu is-weydaarsanayaan, taas oo cabsi ku beertay dadka deegaanka oo marar badan lagu kor dagaalamay. Afhayeenka kooxda Lafta-gareen Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo muuqaal soo duubay ayaa ka warbixiyay xaaladda, wuxuuna sheegay inay weerareen fariisimaha ciidamada, welina uu socdo howlgalka ay ku qaadeen magaalada. “Ciidamadeenna sharafta leh ee Daraawiishta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed waxay saaka weerar ku ekeeyeen magaalada Baydhaba oo waayihii dambe ay dhibaato ku hayeen ciidamada Afballaar iyo Salballaar oo ay adeegsanayaan Aadan Madoobe iyo Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud,” ayuu yiri afhayeenku. Sidoo kale, wuxuu farriin u diray dadka deegaanka oo uu ugu baaqay in aysan bannaanka usoo bixin, isla markaana ay ku nagaadaan guryahooda, inta uu socdo howlgalka, si aysan waxyeello uga soo gaarin dagaalka haatan socda. Waxaa kale oo uu ugu baaqay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed in ay isa soo dhiibaan, isagoo ballan qaaday in lasoo dhaweyn doono, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Shacabkeenna waxaan leenahay guryihiinna ku sugnaada illaa operationka ay wadaan ciidamada uu ka dhammaanayo, ciidamadana waxaan leenahay marka aad gudaha u gashaan si fiican ula dhaqma, cid walba oo isa soo dhiibtana gacan u fidiya,” ayuu sii raaciyey. Dhanka kale, ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxa dhinaca maamulka Axmed Madoobe oo ku aadan dagaalka ka socda duleedka Baydhaba, mana cadda khasaaraha rasmiga ah ee ka dhashay, maadaama weli xaaladdu tahay mid kacsan. items.title: Laftagareen oo sheegay in ciidamadiisa duleedka Baydhabo jooga aaney kaligood ahayn
items.description: Madaxweynihii hore ee maamulka Koonfur galbeed Soomaaliya Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen, ayaa shegay in ciidamada isaga taabacsan ee jooga duleedka magaalada Baydhabo ay la socdaan wasiirro, agaasimayaal iyo guddoomiyaal horey uga tirsanaa maamulkiisii. Wuxuu sheegay in ay duurka ku shaqeeyaan isla markaana ay qabtaan howlahoodii caadiga ahaa. Qodobkaan ayaa madaxweyne hore Lafta gareen ku sheegay waraysi uu siiyay BBCSomali, isagoo intaa ku daray in ciidamadiisu aaney ka dheereyn magaalada. Dhanka kale, Golaha wasiirrada maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa maalmo ka hor mar kale ku eedeyay madaxweynihii hore ee maamulkaasi Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen in ciidamada isaga taabacsan ay ku biireen al-Shabaab oo ay isku deegaanno joogaan isla markaana khal-khal amni ku hayaan deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed. War laga soo saaray shir golaha wasiiradu maanta yeesheen ayaa lagu sheegay in wixii hadda ka dambeeya ay ciidamada madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed iyo kuwa al-Shabaab ay si isku mid ah ula dhaqmi doonaan. Warkaan ayaa ku soo aadaya iyadoo dhawaan uu beeniyay madaxweynihii hore ee maamulkaasi Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagreen in wax xidhiidh ah uu ka dhaxeeyo al-Shabaab iyo ciidamada isaga taabacsan ee ku sugan duleedka magaalada Baydhabo. Wuxuu sheegay in ujeedka ciidamadiisa ay tahay in ay dadka reer Koonfur Galbeed ka dul-qaadaan wax uu ku tilmaamay dulmi iyo tacaddi lagu hayo.

items.title: Iska hor imaad aga soo sheegayo magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Wararka ka imaanaya magaalada Baydhabo ee xarunta ku meel gaarka ah ee maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ee Soomaaliya ayaa sheegaya inuu halkaas ka socdo iska hor imaad u dhaxeeya ciidamada mamulka KGS iyo ciidamo taabacsan madaxweynihii hore ee maamulka Koonfur Glabeed Soomaaliya, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagreen Xogta aan halkaas ka heleyo waxay sheeegeysaa, in dadka deegaanku ay arkeen ciidamo jihooyin kala duwan ka soo galaya magaalada, inkastoo uusan jirin dagaal xooggan oo haatan dhex maraya labada dhinac. Dadka deeganka waxay kaloo sheegeen inay arkeen ciidamo afka u duuban yahay, balse BBC-da si madax banana uma xaqiijin karto waxa ay yihiin ciidankaas. Isu socodka magaalada ayaa hakad galay iyadoo dadka ay intooda badan ku sugan yihiin guryaha, iyagoo ka cabsi qaba waxa ka socda magaalada. Weerarkan ayaa bilowday aroortii, gaar ahaan markii laga soo baxay salaadda subax. Wixii ka ka soo kordha iska hor imaadkan Baydhabo, halkan ayaan idinkugu soo gudbin doonaa. Sidoo kale akhriso: Muxuu Laftagareen ka yiri eedeynta ah in ciidamadiisa iyo al-Shabaab ay isku milmeen? Maxay tahay sababta liiska argagixisada loogu daray saraakiisha iyo ciidanka Laftagareen? Ciidamada weeraray Baydhabo oo ka hadlay waxa ay ka ogaayeen weerarkii al-Shabaab ee xerada milatariga Soomaaliya

Xogaha isa soo taraya ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in ciidamada weerarka qaaday ay isku dayeen inay la wareegaan qaar ka mid ah goobaha magaalada, balse faahfaahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan halka ay hadda marayaan dagaalladu iyo cidda gacanta ku haysa goobahaasi weli lama hayo. Dhinaca kale, dowladda federaalka ayaa horey u sheegtay in ciidamo iyo maleeshiyaad taageersan maamulkii Laftagareen ay xiriir la leeyihiin kooxaha Al-Shabaab, eedeymahaas oo dhinaca kale uu horey u diiday. Wararka ku saabsan xaaladda magaalada ayaa weli isa soo taraya, waxaana la sugayaa faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan khasaaraha, xaaladda shacabka iyo sida uu dagaalku hadda u socdo.

items.title: Mareeg ku xiran Xizbullah oo saldhigga Boosaaso ku calaameysay bartilmaameed
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Mareeg Lubnaan laga leeyahay oo taageerta ururka Xizbullah ayaa daabacday warbixin ay ugu magac dartay “kaarka bartilmaameedka”, taas oo ku saabsan xarun militari oo ku taalla magaalada Boosaaso, xilli Puntland ay sheegtay in Mareykanku qorsheynayo inuu ballaariyo joogitaankiisa xaruntaas. Mareegta Al-Khanadeq ayaa warbixinta daabacday 26-kii Agoosto, iyadoo si gaar ah u soo bandhigtay goobta istaraatiijiga ah ee Boosaaso, oo ku taalla xeebta Gacanka Cadmeed, kana soo horjeedda Yemen, isla markaana u dhow marin-biyoodka muhiimka ah ee isku xira Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Baabul Mandab. Al-Khanadeq ayaa sheegtay in haddii la ballaariyo xarunta, ay noqon karto “saldhig hawlgallo” oo Mareykanku ka fuliyo hawlgallo cirka ah iyo kuwa saadka. Waxay sidoo kale soo jeedisay suurta-galnimada in mustaqbalka xarunta loo adeegsan karo waxa ay ku tilmaantay “falal gardarro ah oo ka dhan ah Yemen”. Hase yeeshee, mareegtu ma aysan soo bandhigin wax caddeyn ah oo muujineysa in Washington ay qorsheyneyso inay Boosaaso uga duusho weerarro ka dhan ah Yemen. Sidoo kale ma aysan shaacin weerar lagu hayo xaruntaas, mana aysan sheegin in Xizbullah ama kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee Iran taageerto ay go’aan ku gaareen inay bartilmaameedsadaan. Al-Khanadeq waxay isku tilmaantaa madal madax-bannaan oo ka faalloota arrimaha juqraafi-siyaasadeed, militari iyo amni. Hase yeeshee, cilmi-baarayaal ayaa ku tilmaamay khadkeeda tifaftirka mid si dhow ula jaanqaada Xizbullah iyo kooxaha Iran taageerto ee loo yaqaan “tiirka iska-caabbinta”, inkastoo aysan ahayn warbaahin rasmi ah oo Hezbollah leedahay. Mareykanka oo ballaarinaya joogitaankiisa Warbixintan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli Mareykanka uu xoojinayo iskaashiga dhinaca amniga ee uu la leeyahay Puntland, halkaas oo ciidamada Mareykanku muddooyinkii dambe ka taageerayeen howlgallada ka dhanka ah kooxda Daacish. Madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa 2-dii Agoosto magaalada Boosaaso kula kulmay Taliyaha Ciidamada Howlgallada Gaarka ah ee Mareykanka ee Afrika, Major General Claude Tudor. Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa sheegtay in labada dhinac ay saxiixeen heshiis u oggolaanaya Mareykanka inuu ballaariyo xaruntiisa militari ee Boosaaso, si loo xoojiyo dagaalka ka dhanka ah argagixisada iyo sugidda amniga badda. Ballaarintaas ayaa Mareykanka siin karta joogitaan militari oo weyn oo aad ugu dhow goobaha ay Daacish ku xooggan tahay ee waqooyiga Soomaaliya, isla markaana ku dhow marin-biyoodyada istaraatiijiga ah ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas. Faahfaahinta buuxda ee heshiiska lama shaacin, waxaana weli aan caddayn baaxadda dhismaha la qorsheeyey, tirada ciidamada halkaas joogi kara iyo howlaha ugu dambeeya ee xarunta loo adeegsan doono. Waxaa sidoo kale jira kala duwanaansho ku saabsan sida loo qeexayo xarunta. Puntland ayaa si rasmi ah ugu yeertay “saldhig militari oo Mareykan ah”, halka Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika ee AFRICOM uu sheegay in goobtu aysan ahayn saldhig militari oo Mareykanku leeyahay. Si kastaba, Puntland ayaa toddobaadkan muujisay in qorshaha horumarinta xarunta uu hore u socdo. Deni ayaa 31-kii Agoosto Boosaaso kula kulmay saraakiil sare oo Mareykan ah oo uu hoggaaminayey Colonel James Rose, taliyaha ciidamada howlgallada gaarka ah ee Mareykanka ee Bariga Afrika. Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa sheegtay in kulanka looga hadlay dardargelinta horumarinta xarunta iyo howlgallada ka dhanka ah Daacish iyo Al-Shabaab ee ka socda buuraha Cal-Miskaad iyo Calmadow. Waxaa sidoo kale laga wada hadlay la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda, sugidda amniga badda iyo tababarrada ciidamada Puntland. Muhiimadda istaraatiijiga ah ee Boosaaso Boosaaso waxay muddo dheer muhiim u ahayd howlaha amni ee gobolka. Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa taageero siiya Ciidanka Booliska Badda Puntland ee PMPF, oo markii hore loo aas-aasay la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda iyo ilaalinta xeebaha, wuxuuna sidoo kale gacan ka geystay dhismaha kaabeyaasha amni ee Boosaaso. Mareykanka ayaa dhankiisa marar badan duqeymo ka dhan ah Daacish ka fuliyey buuraha koonfur-bari kaga beegan magaalada. AFRICOM ayaa sheegay in duqeyn 6-dii May ka dhacday buuraha Golis, qiyaastii 75 kiiloomitir koonfur-bari ka xiga Boosaaso, lagu bartilmaameedsaday Daacish, islamarkaana howlgalka lala kaashaday dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Goobta ay Boosaaso ku taallo ayaa sidoo kale magaalada gelinaysa xudunta loollanka amni ee ka socda gobolka. Waxay ku taallaa xeebta koonfureed ee Gacanka Cadmeed, iyadoo Yemen ay ka xigto dhinaca kale ee badda, sidoo kalena ay u dhowdahay marinnada maraakiibta ee taga Baabul Mandab, oo kamid ah marin-biyoodyada ugu muhiimsan ganacsiga caalamka. Xuutiyiinta Yemen ee Iran taageerto ayaa xilliyadii xiisadaha gobolka sare u kaceen weerarro badan ku qaaday maraakiib ganacsi iyo kuwo militari oo marayay Badda Cas iyo hareeraheeda, taas oo sii kordhisay muhiimadda amni ee biyaha u dhexeeya Yemen iyo Geeska Afrika. Sidaas darteed, Al-Khanadeq waxay isku dayday inay qorshaha ballaarinta xarunta Boosaaso ku xiriiriso loollanka ballaaran ee ka socda Yemen iyo Badda Cas. Puntland, hase yeeshee, waxay si rasmi ah u sheegtay in ujeeddada ballaarinta xaruntu tahay la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo xoojinta amniga badda, mana jirto ilaa hadda wax caddeyn ah oo muujineysa in xarunta Boosaaso loogu talagalay howlgallo ka dhan ah Yemen. items.title: Dagaal xoogan oo ka socdo Magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Dagaal xoogan ayaa haatan ka socdo hareeraha Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta Gobolka Baay, iyadoona Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed ay isku dayayaan in ay dib u caabiyaan ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) oo soo weeraray magaaladaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in dagaalka ay ku lug leeyihiin ciidamo horey uga goostay Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed iyo maleeshiyaad qaab beeleed u abaabulan, isla-markaana ka biyo diidan is bedelkii siyaasadeed iyo midkii amni ee ka dhacay magaalada. Xaaladda magaalada ayaa ah mid aad u kacsan, waxayna dadka deegaanku ka cabsi qabaan in dagaalku uu ku soo fido bartamaha magaalada. Afhayeenkii hore ee Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed, Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo muuqaal soo duubay ayaa sheegay in Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ay hawlgal ka wadaan magaalada, waxaana uu shacabka ugu baaqay inay guryahooda joogaan. “Shacbigeenna sharafta leh waxaan leenahay ku sugnaada guryihiinna, illaa hawlgalka ay ciidamadu wadaan uu ka dhamaanayo.” Ayuu yiri Ugaas Xasan Cabdi. Ugaas Xasan Cabdi ayaa ciidamada weerarka ah kula dardaarmay “Ciidamada Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya waxaan leenahay walaalayaal si fiican ula dhaqma, markaad gudaha magaalada gashaan oo islaaxisaan, cid walboo isa soo dhiibtana gacan u fidiya.” Ugaas Xasan ayaa intaasi ku daray “Ciidamada kala duwan ee firxadka ah oo cararaya ee magaalada jiha kasta uga baxaayana waxaan leenahay isa soo dhiiba oo imaada goobo cayiman baa la idiin samayn doonnaa.” Dagaalka ayaa imanaya, xilli Saraakiisha iyo Siyaasiyiinta Mucaaradka ee Koonfur Galbeed ay shalay duleedka Baydhabo ku booqdeen xoogag ka tirsan taageereyaasha Laftagareen.

items.title: Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed oo dowladda weydiistay in loo soo diro General Cirro
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa sheegaya in Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu Dowladda Federaalka ka dalbaday in General Cabdullaahi Aadan Xuseen (Cirro) dib loogu soo celiyo Xarunta KMG Koonfur Galbeed ee Baydhabo. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa muddo bil ah General Cirro u xil saartay amniga Magaalada Baydhabo oo ka bilaabaneysay 15-kii bishii May, iyadoona uu ujeedku ahaa in qaab nabdoon ay ku qabsoomto Doorashada Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed oo 10-kii bishii June uu ku guuleystay Aadan Madoobe. Aadan Madoobe ayaa horey u amaanay waxqabadka amni ee General Cirro uu ka sameeyay magaalada, muddadii uu ku sugnaa. Aadan Madoobe ayaa sidoo kale ka warqaba in aysan jirin baahi ay hadda Dowladda Soomaaliyeed u qabto janaraalka, ka dib markii ay hoos u dhigtay shaqadiisa ciidamada, lana sheegayo in laga qaaday xilka Taliye Kuxigeenka Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, inkastoo dhanka Dowladda Federaalka aanu ka soo bixin wareegto rasmi ah oo lagu shaacinayo xil ka qaadista jananka. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in General Cirro ay is qabteen madaxda sare ee dalka, ka dib markii bartamihii bishii June ay Dowladda Federaalka ka soo celisay Baydhabo, isla-markaana uu ka horyimid qorshe loogu waday Magaalada Dhuusamareeb, looguna magacaabi lahaa Taliyaha Qaybta 21aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, isagoona ka cudurdaartay in uu ku milmo khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo mid maamul oo xilligaasi ka taagnaa Galmudug, isla-markaana ay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud is hayeen Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoorqoor). Cudurdaarka ama diidmada uu ka muujiyay in uu qayb ka noqdo khilaaf kala gayn kara dadka deegaanka amaba dhaawici kara masiirka amni iyo wadajirka dadka reer Galmudug awgeed ayaa waxay keentay in laga waayo Xarunta Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Magaalada Muqdisho. General Cirro oo dhowrkii sano ee u dambeeyay ahaa Taliye Kuxigeenka Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa la sheegaya in muddo laba bil ahba uu ka sii maqan yahay dalka. Aadan Madoobe oo xiriir adag la leh Villa Somalia ayay wararku sheegayaan in uu madaxda ku riixayo in General Cirro lagu soo celiyo Baydhabo, si uu u hoggaamiyo amniga iyo difaaca magaaladaasi. Xogaha la helayo ayaa sheegaya in aan weli laga jawaabin dalabka Aadan Madoobe, walow Dowladda Soomaaliyeed ay taageero weyn u muujisay maamulkiisa cusub. Aadan Madoobe ayaa la fahamsan yahay in uu gacan siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo xoogan uu ka helayo Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, laakiin haddii aan la aqbalin dalabkiisii ugu dambeeyay, waxay ka dhigan tahay in ay jiraan waxyaabo mudan in laga horreysiiyo danaha maamulka uu madaxda ka yahay.

Wararka ayaa sheegaya in General Cirro ay is qabteen madaxda sare ee dalka, ka dib markii bartamihii bishii June ay Dowladda Federaalka ka soo celisay Baydhabo, isla-markaana uu ka horyimid qorshe loogu waday Magaalada Dhuusamareeb, looguna magacaabi lahaa Taliyaha Qaybta 21aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, isagoona ka cudurdaartay in uu ku milmo khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo mid maamul oo xilligaasi ka taagnaa Galmudug, isla-markaana ay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud is hayeen Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoorqoor). Cudurdaarka ama diidmada uu ka muujiyay in uu qayb ka noqdo khilaaf kala gayn kara dadka deegaanka amaba dhaawici kara masiirka amni iyo wadajirka dadka reer Galmudug awgeed ayaa waxay keentay in laga waayo Xarunta Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Magaalada Muqdisho. General Cirro oo dhowrkii sano ee u dambeeyay ahaa Taliye Kuxigeenka Ciidanka Dhulka ayaa la sheegaya in muddo laba bil ahba uu ka sii maqan yahay dalka. Aadan Madoobe oo xiriir adag la leh Villa Somalia ayay wararku sheegayaan in uu madaxda ku riixayo in General Cirro lagu soo celiyo Baydhabo, si uu u hoggaamiyo amniga iyo difaaca magaaladaasi. Xogaha la helayo ayaa sheegaya in aan weli laga jawaabin dalabka Aadan Madoobe, walow Dowladda Soomaaliyeed ay taageero weyn u muujisay maamulkiisa cusub. Aadan Madoobe ayaa la fahamsan yahay in uu gacan siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo xoogan uu ka helayo Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh, laakiin haddii aan la aqbalin dalabkiisii ugu dambeeyay, waxay ka dhigan tahay in ay jiraan waxyaabo mudan in laga horreysiiyo danaha maamulka uu madaxda ka yahay.

items.title: Is Villa Somalia Turning Federalism into a Political Empire?
items.description: By Abdullahi A. No r Somalia’s latest electoral controversy is beginning to expose something far more dangerous than a disagreement over dates, ballots or electoral procedures. It is raising a fundamental question about the future of federalism itself: is Somalia building a democratic federal system—or is Mogadishu gradually converting the Federal Member States into political extensions of Villa Somalia? The question has become impossible to ignore. The National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission, despite its name, lacks genuine independence and is operating under the political influence of Villa Somalia. The Commission has now announced a new timetable for repeat elections in Galmudug and preparations for elections in Hirshabelle, citing a Supreme Court ruling issued on August 24, 2026. But there is a striking contradiction at the center of the process. The same electoral system whose Galmudug results were annulled by the Supreme Court is now being asked to conduct another electoral exercise. That should not be treated as a technical footnote. It goes directly to the credibility of the entire process. If the court found that the previous Galmudug elections violated Somalia’s constitutional and electoral framework, the obvious question is whether the underlying political problems have actually been fixed—or whether Mogadishu is simply pressing the reset button and preparing to repeat the same experiment. Opposition politicians and critics of the Federal Government have repeatedly alleged that the Galmudug process was designed to produce a predetermined political outcome rather than provide a genuinely competitive contest. Their argument is blunt: if everyone already knows who is going to win before the first ballot is cast, what exactly is the purpose of the ballot? That allegation cannot simply be dismissed as political rhetoric, particularly in light of the Supreme Court’s decision to annul the previous electoral results. The deeper concern is that elections are increasingly being used not to resolve political disputes, but to institutionalize them. A government can organize polling stations. It can print ballots. It can announce winners. It can install officials. But none of those actions automatically creates legitimacy. Legitimacy comes from political consent. And that is precisely what Somalia appears to be running out of. The speed with which the political crisis has moved from elections to institutional confrontation should worry every Somali. Galmudug was already politically fragile. Now, after the Supreme Court annulled the disputed electoral process, the country is watching a new chapter unfold under the same broader electoral framework. That creates the possibility of a dangerous cycle: contested election → disputed legitimacy → political confrontation → competing security forces → armed conflict. Somalia has experienced variations of this pattern before. The South West crisis demonstrated how quickly a dispute over political legitimacy can become a confrontation involving armed forces, rival administrations and competing claims to authority. What begins as an argument over who won an election can eventually become a struggle over who controls a city. There is no guarantee Galmudug will follow precisely the same path. But the ingredients for instability are already visible. Federal Member States in Name Only? Perhaps the most serious issue is the gradual erosion of the meaning of federalism. Somalia’s federal system was designed to distribute political authority between Mogadishu and the Federal Member States. In theory, regional governments should possess meaningful political legitimacy derived from their populations. But critics increasingly argue that Villa Somalia has pursued a different model: supporting regional administrations that are politically dependent on the Federal Government and marginalizing leaders who challenge Mogadishu. If that accusation is correct, then Somalia is not witnessing the strengthening of federalism. It is witnessing its hollowing out. A state can still have a president, parliament, cabinet and flag while lacking genuine political autonomy. That is the danger of federalism in name but centralization in practice. The situation in Hirshabelle is particularly sensitive. The state already faces deep political and geographical fragmentation, with competing political centers of gravity around Jowhar, Middle Shabelle and Hiiraan. If an electoral process is perceived as being imposed from Mogadishu rather than negotiated with local political stakeholders, the result may not be political stability. It could instead produce another disputed administration with insufficient popular legitimacy. And once legitimacy collapses, governments increasingly turn to the only instrument they can still control: security forces. That is when an electoral dispute becomes a security crisis. Somalia has too many weapons and too few trusted institutions to gamble with such a scenario. The Supreme Court Has Raised the Red Flag The Supreme Court’s intervention in the Galmudug election should have triggered a national political conversation about electoral credibility. Instead, the immediate response appears to be another timetable. That risks reducing a constitutional crisis to an administrative exercise. The fundamental question is not whether the commission can schedule another election. It is whether Somalia’s political class has agreed on the rules of the game. The country has not. The Federal Government and opposition forces remain divided over the electoral system, the electoral commission and constitutional amendments. If those fundamental disagreements remain unresolved, pushing ahead with unilateral regional elections risks deepening rather than resolving the national crisis. What Happens If the Ballot Produces Another Unpopular Government? This is where the situation becomes particularly dangerous. Suppose an election is held. Suppose a winner is announced. Suppose the opposition rejects the result. Suppose significant sections of the population refuse to recognize the new administration. And suppose the Federal Government backs that administration with security forces. At that point, the election has ceased to be a mechanism for peaceful political competition. It becomes the justification for competing claims of authority. That is the road to another Baidoa. And Somalia simply cannot afford another armed confrontation between forces claiming to defend competing versions of constitutional legitimacy. The Federal Government should therefore resist the temptation to interpret administrative control as political legitimacy. Mogadishu can appoint officials. It can deploy security personnel. It can recognize regional administrations. But it cannot manufacture popular consent. Nor can an electoral commission manufacture it with a ballot box. The only durable solution is political agreement. The ongoing negotiations between Villa Somalia and the opposition should produce a comprehensive national settlement covering the electoral system, the electoral commission, constitutional amendments and the relationship between the Federal Government and Federal Member States. Only then should disputed regional elections proceed. If necessary, elections already conducted under a framework rejected by the principal political stakeholders should be reviewed and replaced by elections conducted under the new national agreement. Somalia Is Running Out of Political Oxygen The greatest mistake Somalia’s leaders could make now is to believe that another election automatically means another step toward democracy. It does not. A flawed election can be more destabilizing than no election at all. A credible election transfers power peacefully. A manipulated or widely disputed election can transfer nothing except resentment. Somalia is already fighting Al-Shabaab, struggling to rebuild its security institutions and confronting an increasingly fragmented political landscape. It cannot simultaneously afford to manufacture new battlefields in Dhuusamareeb and Jowhar. The country needs institutions that command respect—not institutions that merely possess legal titles. It needs Federal Member States that represent their people—not administrations whose survival depends upon the political favor of Mogadishu. And it needs elections in which the outcome is determined by voters—not political negotiations conducted before voters ever enter the polling station. The Supreme Court has already delivered its warning on Galmudug. The question now is whether Somalia’s political leadership will listen. Because if Villa Somalia continues to treat electoral disagreements as problems to be defeated rather than political differences to be negotiated, the next election may not determine who governs. It may determine where the next conflict begins. Abdullahi A. items.title: Should India Officially Recognize Somaliland?
items.description: The Mecca Agreement, a trilateral collective defense agreement among Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan, has altered South Asia’s threat landscape. Pakistan and its terror proxies are no longer bilateral or regional headaches for India; Pakistan’s strengthened diplomatic heft in the Middle East, growing footprint in Bangladesh alongside Turkey , and its robust ties with Beijing have made it a behemoth with widespread networks of state and non-state actors, magnifying India’s security challenges. [Somaliland] occupies a strategic location astride the Gulf of Aden, not far south of the Bab el-Mandeb … connecting the Indian Ocean and the Red Sea. India needs to counter Pakistan’s machinations by building broad strategic alliances with like-minded state and non-state actors. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s Hexagon Alliance , a six-nation grouping of Israel, India, Greece, United Arab Emirates, Cyprus, and Somaliland, could emerge as a powerful bloc against the emerging Sunni Axis. However, the proposed network remains more theoretical than real. India, though, could take the lead by formally recognizing Somaliland. Somaliland, which formally won independence in 1960 before it voluntarily joined a union with Somalia five days later, reasserted its independence in 1991, but did not receive outside recognition for its move. It occupies a strategic location astride the Gulf of Aden, not far south of the Bab el-Mandeb, the global maritime chokepoint connecting the Indian Ocean and the Red Sea. Its deepwater Port of Berbera can both provide services for the world’s busiest shipping routes and support military efforts to counter the Houthis. While not initially envisioned as such, Somaliland can be a crucial anchor for the India-Middle East Economic Corridor and could also enable Indian commerce to better penetrate Ethiopia, Africa’s second-most populous country. The port of Berbera in Somaliland. Shutterstock On April 18, 2026, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps hit Indian commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. India cannot continue to live in a fantasy in which New Delhi considers Tehran a friend. While New Delhi may believe it is walking a tightrope, Tehran perceives India firmly in the U.S.-Israel camp. On August 4–5, 2026, Houthis attacked the Indian-flagged Faize Noore Oliya , sinking the ship. Though the crew members, including 13 Indian nationals, survived, India’s ships will likely face more lethal Houthi attacks in the Red Sea. About 20 to 35 percent of India’s foreign trade relies on the Suez Canal-Red Sea route; hence, Somaliland is crucial to securing maritime routes. Additionally, Somali piracy, a major threat to Indian shipping, has resurged due to the ongoing security crisis in the Red Sea. In August 2026, Somali pirates captured two Indian vessels, holding 22 Indian nationals captive. India can partner with Somaliland to neutralize the piracy threat. As Africa develops into a hotbed of great-power contestation and non-state actors, India must increase its outreach in Africa. India’s rivals—China, Pakistan and Turkey—have made inroads in Africa. Somaliland can help India counter the Chinese economic influence in the Horn of Africa, particularly in Djibouti, Kenya and Tanzania. If India is concerned about Somalia’s reaction to its recognition of Somaliland, then New Delhi must remember that its major adversaries have close ties with Somalia. Turkish advisors train Somali security forces and provide defense, space, humanitarian, and development support to Somalia in exchange for a foothold along a key global maritime route. Pakistan also strengthened its strategic ties with Mogadishu in August 2026, signing a broad defense agreement. On Kashmir, though Somalia does not support Pakistan, it aligns with the stance of the Organization of Islamic Countries, which is antagonistic to India. Further, Pakistan’s terrorist group Harkat-ul-Mujahidin, known for its terror activities in Kashmir, nurtured links with Al Ittihad Al Islamia, Al Qaeda’s East Africa affiliate in the early 1990s. Several Islamic State and Al Qaeda affiliates have increased their footprint and threaten weak and corrupt local governments. Additionally, Africa is a new hub of transnational jihadist organizations. Several Islamic State and Al Qaeda affiliates have increased their footprint and threaten weak and corrupt local governments. Pakistan-supported terrorist groups like Lashkar-e-Taiba and Jaish-e-Muhammad have robust ties with transnational jihadists in Africa. They can leverage these connections and use African soil as a base to threaten India’s national security. Seldom are their magic formulas in international relations, but it would be malpractice to ignore certain opportunities when they emerge. Somaliland and India share common history with both British rule and India Ocean trade relations. Both embrace the rules-based order and democracy. If India really is to take its rightful place in the twenty-first century, it must stop being passive or deferring to its adversaries and instead take initiative. Recognizing Somaliland would be a good place to start.   Meforum

items.title: Gudiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka Somaliland   oo xaruntooda ku qaabilay wefti ay hoggaaminayso Madaxa Xafiiska UK
items.description: Komishanka Doorashooyinka Qaranka JSL (KDQ) ayaa maanta xaruntooda ku qaabilay wefti ay hoggaaminayso Madaxa Xafiiska UK ee JSL, Marwo Louise Hancock, oo uu wehelinayo Khadar Muhumed, Madaxa Arrimaha Siyaasadda ee Xafiiska UK. Kulanka ujeeddadiisu ahayd is-xogwaraysi, xoojinta wada-shaqaynta labada dhinac. KDQ ayaa weftiga warbixin ka siiyey qorshaha hirgelinta Nidaamka Casriga ah ee Maareynta Diiwaangelinta Codbixiyeyaasha (EMIS), iyadoo qaybta ugu horreysa ay noqon doonto diyaarinta iyo hirgelinta Daraasadda (Feasibility Study) ee nidaamka cusub oo KDQ bilaabi doono todobaadkan. KDQ waxa uu dawladda Boqortooyada Ingiriiska (UK) uga mahadceliyey taageerada joogtada ah ee ay ka geysato hawlaha diiwaangelinta, doorashooyinka iyo kor-u-qaadista awoodda hay’adeed ee KDQ, iyo taageerooyinka kale ee lagu dardargelinayo geeddi-socodka dimuqraadiyadda Somaliland

items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo qorsheyneysa dib u habeyn lagu sameynayo maamulka…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa wada qorshe dib loogu habeynayo nidaamka maamulka iyo howlaha hay’adaha amniga gudaha, iyadoo qorshahan lagu doonayo in lagu xoojiyo isla xisaabtanka, wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha iyo awoodda dowladda ee maareynta amniga dalka. Qorshahan ayaa kamid noqday qodobadii muhiimka ahaa ee lagu gorfeeyay Shirweynaha Qaran ee Amniga Gudaha oo lagu qabtay Muqdisho, kaas oo ay isugu yimaadeen mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada, hay’adaha amniga, baarlamaanka iyo wakiillo ka socday beesha caalamka. Intii uu socday shirka, waxaa si gaar ah looga hadlay sidii loo adkeyn lahaa kormeerka hay’adaha amniga iyo isla xisaabtankooda, iyadoo tusaale ahaan diiradda la saaray booliska Soomaaliyeed, hay’adda sirdoonka iyo amniga qaranka iyo hay’adda socdaalka iyo jinsiyadda. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa sidoo kale falanqeeyay baahida loo qabo in si cad loo qeexo awoodaha, waajibaadka iyo xiriirka ka dhexeeya hay’adaha kala duwan, si loo yareeyo isku-dhacyada shaqo, loona kala saaro cidda qaabilsan kormeerka iyo hay’adda mas’uulka ka ah fulinta howlaha amniga. Qodob kale oo muhiim ah ayaa ahaa xiriirka amni ee dowladda federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada. Wasaaradda Amniga Gudaha ayaa kulamo gaar ah arrintan kala yeelatay wasiirrada amniga ee dowlad-goboleedyada, marka laga reebo Puntland iyo Jubbaland oo aan xilligan xiriir shaqo oo toos ah la lahayn Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Dhinaca kale, waxaa xoogga la saaray maalgelinta amniga iyo sidii loo dhisi lahaa nidaam dhaqaale ahaan waara. Dowladda ayaa dooneysa in hay’adaha amniga ay helaan dhaqaale joogto ah oo gudaha ah, si loo yareeyo ku-tiirsanaanta deeqaha dibadda, loona helo awood amni oo sii shaqeyn karta muddo dheer. Qorshahan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay si tartiib ah ula wareegayso mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka, iyadoo howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM la filayo inuu soo gaba-gaboobo dhammaadka 2026. items.title: Trump’s Somaliland decision? Irro heads to Washington
US Military Rings Alarm Over Expanding Houthi-Al-Shabaab Axis along East African Coast
items.description: General Dagvin Anderson, Commander of United States Africa Command (AFRICOM), has warned that Yemen’s Houthi rebels are actively planning to deploy maritime radar surveillance systems into Somalia to monitor international shipping and naval movements along the Somali coastline. In an interview with The Wall Street Journal , General Anderson revealed that the radar systems are slated for installation in territories controlled by the terrorist group Al-Shabaab. The move highlights a deepening operational alliance between the Iran-backed Houthis and the al-Qaeda-affiliated militant network, encompassing advanced weapons transfers, military tactics, and unmanned aerial vehicle (drone) technology. According to AFRICOM, the Houthis have already provided Al-Shabaab with specialized training and high-grade combat equipment—a dynamic Washington views as a grave escalation that threatens to transform Al-Shabaab from a domestic militant force into a formidable transnational threat. To counter this emerging axis, U.S. officials have convened closed-door briefings with partner nations across the Horn of Africa to share intelligence and coordinate countermeasures against the expanding cross-Gulf of Aden alliance. Concurrently, American forces have initiated targeted counter-terrorism operations aimed at disrupting the financial and logistical networks facilitating collaboration between the two insurgent groups. Highlighting recent kinetic operations, General Anderson noted that a targeted U.S. airstrike conducted earlier this year—approximately 50 kilometers outside Kismayo—killed a senior Al-Shabaab operative who served as a primary liaison to the Houthis. Intelligence assessments indicate that both organizations are seeking to leverage this strategic pact to expand their revenue streams and project operational influence beyond their respective strongholds in Yemen and Somalia. items.title: Dacwad ka dhan ah Mareykanka oo la geeyay maxkamadda ICC
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Ururka Bisha Cas ee Iran ayaa Maxkamadda Caalamiga ah ee Dambiyada (ICC) u gudbiyay warqad uu kaga dalbanayo in la baaro duqeyn Mareykanku ka geystay koonfurta Iran, taas oo lagu sheegay inay haleeshay goob ay ka socotay xaflad aroos. Hay’adda ayaa sheegtay in weerarkaasi uu sababay dhimashada afar qof, oo uu ku jiro ilmo, halka 67 qof oo kale ay ku dhaawacmeen. Bisha Cas ayaa tilmaantay in khasaaraha uu sii kordhi karo. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta hay’adda, duqeyntu waxay dhacday Talaadadii abaare 9:30 fiidnimo xilliga maxalliga ah, iyadoo xaflad aroos ay ka socotay deegaanka Kohistak ee Sirek, halkaas oo ay isugu yimaadeen dad rayid ah. Bisha Cas ayaa bayaan ay ku baahisay barta Telegram ku sheegtay in xaaladda qaar ka mid ah dhaawacyada ay tahay mid halis ah. Hay’addu waxay ka digtay in tirada dhimashada ay kordhi karto haddii xaaladda dhaawacyada culus ay kasii darto. Warqadda loo diray ICC ayaa lagu sheegay in dhacdada ay u baahan tahay in si gaar ah loo baaro, maadaama goobta la weeraray ay ahayd kulan ay isugu yimaadeen dad rayid ah oo ka qayb-galayay xaflad aroos. Ururka Bisha Cas ayaa ku dooday in dhacdadaasi ay dhalinayso su’aalo la xiriira waafaqsanaanta sharciga caalamiga ah ee bani’aadantinimada. Sidaa darteed, wuxuu ururku ku baaqay in la sameeyo baaritaan madax-bannaan, dhexdhexaad ah, dhammaystiran oo wax-ku-ool ah. Dhanka kale, milatariga Mareykanka ayaa sheegay inuu ka warqabo wararka la xiriira duqeynta iyo khasaaraha lagu soo warramay, inkastoo uu ku adkeystay in ciidamada Mareykanka aysan waligood si ula kac ah u bartilmaameedsan dadka rayidka ah. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan iska horimaadyada u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iran, iyadoo weerarrada labada dhinac ay sare u qaadeen walaaca laga qabo khasaaraha rayidka. items.title: Sheekhal Baladka Oo Madaxweyne Cirro Ugu Baaqay Inuu Kala Saaro Xisbiga Wadani Iyo Xukuumada
HirShabelle Election Under Fire: Armed Men Seize Beledweyne Registration Center
items.description: Beledweyne, Somalia (WDN) — HirShabelle’s disputed election process has been thrown into fresh turmoil after armed men reportedly seized a voter-registration center in Beledweyne, turning a political dispute over the credibility of the vote into a direct security challenge. The incident comes as the National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission moves ahead with plans to hold HirShabelle’s regional parliamentary and local council elections on September 30, 2026. The commission says the preliminary voter-registration list will be published on September 2, with registration and polling locations to be announced on September 15. But in Beledweyne, the dispute has already moved beyond political rhetoric. Abdulqadir Yusuf Elmi, who identified himself as leader of the armed group, told Universal TV that the men occupied the facility to protest what they described as an unfair electoral process. He alleged that parliamentary seats were effectively being assigned to predetermined individuals rather than decided through genuine competition. Former HirShabelle President Ali Abdullahi Osoble has also separately called on MPs from Hiiraan to oppose what he described as the commission’s electoral plans or resign. A Credibility Crisis The confrontation comes amid mounting questions over the independence of the national electoral commission. Critics accuse the commission of operating too closely to the Federal Government and President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, raising questions over whether it can function as a neutral referee in an increasingly polarized political environment. Those concerns have been intensified by the commission’s handling of the recent Galmudug elections, which were subsequently annulled by Somalia’s Supreme Court. The court ruled that the July 30 process failed to comply with the Constitution and national electoral law. That decision leaves a difficult question hanging over HirShabelle: Can the same electoral machinery deliver a credible process when its previous regional election has already faced judicial annulment? The crisis in Beledweyne exposes deeper tensions between Hiiraan and the HirShabelle administration over political representation and the distribution of power. The seizure of an electoral facility is particularly significant because it shows how quickly political disagreements can acquire a security dimension when communities believe an electoral outcome is being predetermined. The danger is not simply a disputed vote. A process rejected by significant political and community actors could produce competing claims to legitimacy, deepen federal tensions and further weaken public confidence in Somalia’s electoral institutions. The September 30 timetable therefore answers only one question: when the vote is supposed to take place. The more important question is whether HirShabelle can produce an election that voters, candidates and political stakeholders regard as legitimate. If that confidence is absent, the ballot box risks becoming another arena for Somalia’s political conflict rather than a mechanism for resolving it. Beledweyne may be the first warning that electoral scheduling without political consensus can create instability rather than democratic legitimacy. items.title: Puntland Escalates Anti-Piracy Campaign
items.description: Garacad, Somalia (WDN) — Puntland has launched a ground operation against suspected pirates in Garacad, killing one and capturing two others from a group accused of taking ransom for the Turkish-linked MV Lutuf, according to Puntland security officials cited by Puntland Post. Four other suspects reportedly escaped. The operation comes days after Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni warned in Garacad that his government would launch a campaign against piracy, suggesting the administration may be moving from warnings to direct action against pirate networks. The group is also accused of holding the MV Sward for ransom. The Garacad operation could be an early test of how far Puntland is prepared to go to dismantle the piracy networks operating along its coast. A serious crackdown cannot stop with capturing individual pirates. It would require targeting the wider infrastructure that enables hijackings—including financiers, ransom negotiators, recruiters, logistics networks and those providing safe havens along the coast. That makes the latest operation significant, but not yet conclusive. If Puntland intends to eradicate piracy rather than contain it temporarily, authorities will need sustained intelligence operations, coastal surveillance, arrests, prosecutions and efforts to disrupt the flow of ransom money. Puntland has confronted piracy before, and previous crackdowns helped drive the threat down for years. The recent return of hijackings has therefore raised questions about whether the authorities can prevent the networks from rebuilding. The Garacad operation sends a clear signal that Puntland is prepared to use force against suspected pirates. But force alone will not eliminate the business model. The decisive question is whether Puntland can dismantle the networks behind the pirates—not simply pursue the men carrying out the hijackings. That will determine whether President Deni’s pledge becomes a sustained anti-piracy campaign or another short-lived security operation. For Puntland, the stakes extend beyond individual vessels. Renewed piracy threatens commercial shipping, coastal livelihoods and the region’s wider maritime security. Garacad may be the beginning of Puntland’s new piracy crackdown. The real measure of success will be whether the authorities can make piracy financially, logistically and operationally impossible to sustain. items.title: Soomaaliya oo qaaday tallaabo cusub oo taariikhi ah – Maxaa dhacay maanta?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Kubadda cagta Soomaaliya ayaa qaaday tallaabo cusub oo taariikhi ah, iyadoo markii ugu horreysay laba xul oo Wiilal iyo Gabdho ah oo da’doodu ka yar tahay 15 jir ay dalka ku matalayaan tartanka African Schools Football Championship, oo berri ka furmaya magaalada Kigali ee dalka Rwanda. Ka-qaybgalka xulalka Soomaaliyeed ee tartankan ayaa da’yarta dalka u ah fursad muhiim ah oo ay ku helayaan khibrad heer caalami ah, isla markaana ay kula tartami doonaan dhiggooda ka socda dalal kala duwan oo Afrika ah. Labada xul ayaa sidoo kale tartanka ku soo bandhigi doona kartidooda iyo xirfadahooda ciyaareed, iyadoo tartankan loo arko mid kaalin muhiim ah ka qaadan kara horumarinta iyo kobcinta ciyaartoyda da’da yar ee Soomaaliyeed. Xiriirka Soomaaliyeed ee Kubadda Cagta ayaa sheegay in ka-qaybgalka Soomaaliya uu qayb ka yahay dadaallada lagu horumarinayo kubadda cagta dalka, gaar ahaan tartamada loogu talagalay ciyaartoyda da’yarta ah. Xiriirka oo uu hoggaamiyo Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Soomaaliyeed ee Kubadda Cagta, Cali Cabdi Maxamed (Cali Shiine) ayaa mudnaan siinaya horumarinta jiilka cusub iyo abuurista fursado ay ciyaartoydu ugu gudbi karaan heerarka sare ee kubadda cagta. Tartanka African Schools Football Championship ayaa sidoo kale fursad u noqonaya ciyaartoyda Soomaaliyeed inay helaan is-dhexgal iyo khibrad caalami ah, iyagoo la kulmaya ciyaartoy da’yar oo ka kala socda dalal kale oo qaaradda Afrika ah. Si kastaba, ka-qaybgalka labada xul ayaa loo arkaa bilow muhiim ah oo Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso joogitaankeeda tartamada kubadda cagta ee qaaradda, iyadoo la rajeynayo in ciyaartoydan da’yarta ah ay mustaqbalka noqdaan xiddigo matala xulka qaranka Soomaaliya.
