items.title: General Indhacadde oo ku sugan Baydhabo, xilli ay ka jiraan dhibaatooyin amni
items.description: General Yuusuf Maxamed Siyaad (Indhacadde) oo horey uga tirsanaa Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa booqasho ku jooga Magaalada Baydhabo, xilligan oo xiisado siyaadadeed iyo kuwa amni ay ka jiraan magaaladaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in jananku uu Axaddii ka degay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud, isla-markaana uu maanta Madaxtooyada Baydhabo kula kulmay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe). Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya Taliyaha Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, General Maxamed Sheekh Xasan Xaamud oo Sabtidii gaaray Baydhabo inay maanta isaga iyo General Indhacadde la kulmeen Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed. Ma cadda waxa uu la xiriiro safarka General Indhacadde ee Baydhabo, balse Taliyaa Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed ayaa la fahamsan yahay in uu magaaladaasi u tegay howlo shaqo oo la xiriira arrimaha amniga. Aadan Madoobe ayaa toddobaad ka hor Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ka codsaday in Baydhabo loo soo diro Saraakiil khibrad leh oo ka caawiya amniga iyo difaaca magaalada. Warar aan la xaqiijin ayaa sheegaya in General Indhacadde uu ku jiro jiro dhaqdhaqaaqyada siyaasadeed ee Koonfur Galbeed, isla-markaana uu raadinayo xil uu ka qabto maamulka cusub ee Aadan Madoobe. General Indhacadde oo lagu sheego sarkaal rugcaddaa ah ayaa ka mid ahaa Saraakiishii Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ka saaray Magaalada Muqdisho, sanadkii 2011. Socdaalkiisa Baydhabo ayaa ku soo beegmaya, iyadoo Hoggaamiyaha Koonfur Galbeed uu la kulmayo caqabado amni iyo abaabul dagaal oo kaga imaanaya garabka hubeysan mucaaradka ee taabacsan maamulkii hore. Baydhabo ayaa wajaheysa, xilli xasaasi ah oo loolan siyaasadeed iyo mid ciidan uu u dhexeeyo maamulka cusub iyo hoggaankii hore ee Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: Duulimaadyada Soomaaliya iyo Kenya oo hakad galay iyo mas’uuliyiin ku xayiran
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Duulimaadyada tooska ah ee u dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Kenya ayaa maalintii labaad hakad ku jira, iyadoo rakaab badan oo Soomaali ah iyo mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya ay ku xanniban yihiin Muqdisho iyo Nairobi. Hakadka ayaa saameeyay diyaaradaha isaga kala goosha labada dal, iyadoo duulimaadyadii Soomaaliya uga ambabixi jiray Nairobi aysan labadii maalmood ee lasoo dhaafay imaan Muqdisho. Diyaaradaha Soomaalida oo intooda badan u hoyda Nairobi ayaa shalay iyo maanta ka iman kadib markii uu istaagay isu-socodkii duulimaadyada ee labada dal. Wararka qaar ayaa sheegaya in hakadka uu ka dhashay shaqo-joojin ay sameeyeen shaqaalaha garoonka caalamiga ah ee Jomo Kenyatta ee Nairobi, taasoo saameyn ku yeelatay howlaha garoonka iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqa diyaaradaha. Arrintan ayaa sidoo kale saameysay rakaab qorsheynayay inay isaga kala safraan Muqdisho iyo Nairobi, iyadoo dadka qaar ay ku khasbanaadeen inay dib u dhigtaan safarradooda ilaa xaaladda garoonka laga xalliyo. Nairobi ayaa ah xarun muhiim u ah ganacsiga, caafimaadka iyo adeegyada kale ee ay Soomaalidu u safraan, taasoo hakadka duulimaadyada ka dhigaysa arrin saameyn ballaaran ku leh dadka labada dal isaga kala goosha. Ilaa hadda ma cadda muddada uu sii socon doono hakadka, waxaana la sugayaa in howlihii garoonka Jomo Kenyatta dib loogu soo celiyo si buuxda, taasoo suuragelin karta in duulimaadyada Soomaaliya iyo Kenya ay dib u billowdaan. The post Duulimaadyada Soomaaliya iyo Kenya oo hakad galay iyo mas’uuliyiin ku xayiran appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: The European Union Grants UNFPA EUR 3 Million to  Deliver Lifesaving Services for Women and Girls in Yemen
items.description: Press release The European Union Grants UNFPA EUR 3 Million to Deliver Lifesaving Services for Women and Girls in Yemen The European Union remains one of UNFPA’s key humanitarian partners in Yemen, with more than €60 million in financial contributions reaching over 6 million people with lifesaving services since 2018. Aden, 27 August 2026 — The European Union (EU) provided a EUR 3 million humanitarian contribution to UNFPA, the United Nations Population Fund to deliver lifesaving services for women and girls in Yemen. The funding will support nearly a quarter of a million of the most vulnerable, women and girls, including displaced persons with emergency relief, life-saving reproductive health and protection services and mental health support across southern-eastern governorates in Yemen. More than a decade of conflict, economic collapse, and climate shocks has displaced 5.2 million people across Yemen, placing immense pressure on already overstretched essential services. items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo wada hadal ugu baaqday mucaaradka hubeysan ee Laftagareen uu hoggaamiyo
items.description: Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa wada hadal nabadeed iyo is faham ugu baaqday garabka mucaaradka hubeysan ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa iyadoo ka duuleysa mabaadi’da wadatashiga iyo nabadeynta, waxay sheegtay in albaabadeedu ay u furan yihiin dhammaan cid kasta oo ka aragti duwan iyo cid kasta oo tabasho qabta. Afhayeenka Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed, Maxamed Sheekh Cabdullaahi (Xaayow) oo maanta shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Madaxtooyada Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa sheegay in Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) uu caddeynayo in cid kasta oo qabta aragti ka duwan tan maamulka ama tabasho gaar ah qabta ay u furan tahay madal wada hadal, isla-markaana uu maamulku diyaar u yahay in si nabdoon iyo is faham lagu xalliyo kala aragti duwanaanshaha. “Waxaan leeyahay cid kasta oo ka aragti duwan Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed waxaa u furan gacmo furan. Hoggaamiyaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, Mudane Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur wuxuu si cad oo laalaab lahayn uu u sheegayaa albaabadiisa inay furan yihiin. Cid kasta oo ka aragti duwan iyo cid kasta oo tabasho qabta wada hadal baa u furan, waana la imaan karaa.” Ayuu yiri Afhayeenka. Afhayeenka oo sii hadlayay ayaa yiri “Waxaan leeyahay walaalayaalow Ilaahay aan ka cabsano, walaalaheen walaaltnimada, darajada iyo sharafta aan ilaalino, dal-dhiska iyo dowladnimadana aan ilaalino.” Afhayeenka ayaa intaasi ku daray “Waxaan leenahay Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed dhammaan gacmaha ayay u hoorineysaa, way soo dhaweynaysaa, nolol ayayna ugu yeereysaa, illaa ninkii diido mooyee.” Gunaanadka ugu dambeeya, ee ah illaa ninkii diido mooyee ayaa waxay xambaarsan tahay digniin dadban oo sharciga iyo amniga ah, oo ka dhigan in wixii dhibaato dambe oo ka dhan ah shacabka ay masuuliyaddeeda qaadeyso kooxda diidda nabadda. Xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Koonfur Galbeed ayaa xoogeystay, ka dib doorashadii 10-kii bishii June ka dhacday Magaalada Baydhabo ee Aadan Madoobe loogu doortay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta KMG Koonfur Galbeed iyo agagaaraheeda ayaa waxaa muddooyinkan dambe ka taagnaa xaalad amni darro, oo ka dhalatay is bedelka Hoggaanka Maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Xiisaddan ayaa u dhexeyso maamulka cusub ee Aadan Madoobe uu hoggaamiyo iyo hoggaankii hore, iyadoona Laftagareen uu ku hanjabay inay xoog dib ugu la wareegi doonaan gacan ku haynta Baydhabo.

items.title: Somalia Calls on Arab States to Block Further Recognition of Somaliland
items.description: MOGADISHU—Somalia has urged Arab countries to use their diplomatic influence to prevent Israel’s recognition of Somaliland from encouraging other states to take similar steps. State Minister for Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation Ali Mohamed Omar, widely known as Ali Balcad, made the appeal in an interview with Asharq Al-Awsat, as Mogadishu steps up diplomatic efforts to challenge Israel’s decision. Balcad said Somalia is maintaining direct contacts with the administration of U.S. President Donald Trump to communicate Mogadishu’s position on Israel’s recognition of Somaliland. He said the Somali government is closely monitoring international discussions and diplomatic activity surrounding the possibility of additional countries recognizing Somaliland. “We do not consider Israel’s recognition of Somaliland merely symbolic,” Balcad said, describing the move as a development that could have implications for Somalia’s territorial integrity, national unity and regional security. Israel’s decision marked the first formal recognition of Somaliland by a United Nations member state, according to the minister. The two sides subsequently established diplomatic relations, including the exchange of ambassadors and the opening of a Somaliland diplomatic mission in Jerusalem. Balcad said Israel’s move has not, so far, triggered a broader wave of international recognition for Somaliland. He nevertheless called on Arab governments to take a more active role, arguing that condemnation alone would not be sufficient. He urged them to use their diplomatic relationships and political leverage to discourage other governments from recognizing Somaliland. Somalia regards Somaliland as part of its sovereign territory and has consistently rejected its bid for international recognition. Somaliland declared independence from Somalia in 1991 and has since pursued recognition as a separate state. The issue has become an increasingly sensitive diplomatic matter for Mogadishu, particularly as Somalia seeks to prevent further international moves that it believes could undermine its territorial unity and regional security. items.title: Daawo: Deni oo Mareykanka kala hadlay arrin xasaasi ah
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Puntland, Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa maanta Boosaaso kula kulmay wafdi saraakiil ah oo ka socday Taliska AFRICOM ee Mareykanka, waxaana wafdiga hoggaaminayay taliyaha howlgallada gaarka ah ee Mareykanka ee Bariga Afrika Colonel James Rose. Madaxweyne Saciid Deni waxaa kulanka kala qaybgalay xubno ka tirsan golaha xukuumadda, la-taliyeyaal Madaxweyne, agaasimaha guud ee Madaxtooyada Puntland iyo saraakiil ciidan. Kulanka oo ahaa mid xasaasi ah ayaa diiradda lagu saaray adkaynta xiriirka iyo wada-shaqaynta Puntland iyo dowladda Maraykanka, gaar ahaan iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo sugidda amniga badaha. Sidoo kale, kulanka waxaa lagu soo qaaday dardargelinta dhismaha saldhigga Maraykanka ee magaalada Boosaaso, iskaashiga howlgallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada Daacish iyo Al-Shabaab ee ku dhuumalaysanaysa buuraleyda Calmiskaad iyo Calmadow, la-dagaalanka burcad-badeedda iyo horumarinta tababarrada ciidamada difaaca Puntland. Labada dhinac waxaa kale oo ay isla garteen muhiimadda ay leedahay in la kordhiyo iskaashiga lagu sugayo amniga xeebaha Puntland iyo ka hortagga falalka khatarta ku ah maraakiibta iyo ganacsiga badda. Mareykanka ayaa kamid ah dowladaha waa wayn ee taageerada siiya Soomaaliya, wuxuuna si gaar ah diiradda u saaraa amniga iyo la dagaallanka kooxaha argagixisada ee ku sugan dalka, gaar ahaan Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish. Si kastaba, kulankan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ciidamada Puntland ay wadaan howlgallo ka dhan ah Daacish iyo Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan deegaanada buuraleyda ah ee Bari, waxaana iskaashiga Puntland iyo Mareykanka uu yahay mid si gaar ah diiradda loogu saarayo amniga iyo xasilloonida gobolka. items.title: Dekedda Berbera oo Soo Jiidanaysa Is-kaashiga ku Dhisan Kaydinta iyo Qaybinta Gargaarka Gees
items.description: Maareeyaha Hay’adda Dekedaha Somaliland, Cali Diiriye Axmed, ayaa Dekedda Berbera ku qaabilay wafti ka socday RIDNE Food Consortium ee Ukraine iyo Tony Blair Institute, kuwaas oo u yimid qiimaynta fursadaha iskaashi ee dhinacyada ganacsiga, saadka iyo gargaarka bani’aadamnimo. Booqashada waftiga ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray fursadda Dekedda Berbera loogu beddeli karo xarun muhiim ah oo lagu soo dejiyo, lagu kaydiyo laguna qaybiyo raashinka gargaarka bani’aadamnimo, ka hor inta aan loo gudbin dalalka Geeska Afrika, Sudan iyo Yemen. Sidoo kale, xubnaha Tony Blair Institute ayaa sameeyey xog-ururin iyo qiimayn ku saabsan fursadaha ay Somaliland uga bilaabi karaan iskaashi iyo hawlo horumarineed oo dhinacyo kala duwan leh. Gaba-gabaddii, booqashadu waxay xoojinaysaa fursadda Dekedda Berbera loogu beddeli karo xarun goboleed oo lagu gaadhsiiyo gargaarka bani’aadamnimo, isla markaana door muhiim ah ka qaadata ganacsiga iyo saadka gobolka

items.title: Taliska Ciidanka XDS oo Baaris Hordhac ah Ka Bilaabay Muuqaal Muujinaya Tacaddi Loo Geystay Maxbuus Dagaal
items.description: Taliska Ciidanka XDS ayaa sheegay inuu bilaabay baaris hordhac ah oo ku saabsan muuqaal baraha bulshada lagu faafiyay, kaas oo muujinaya tacaddi loo geystay maxbuus dagaal xilli uu socday howlgal ka dhan ah maleeshiyaadka Shabaab. Taliska ayaa sheegay in falka muuqaalka ka muuqda uu si cad uga hor imaanayo xeerarka anshaxa iyo nidaamka ciidanka, iyo sidoo kale shuruucda dagaalka ee ciidanka. War-saxaafadeedka ayaa lagu sheegay in tallaabo sharci iyo mid ciidan oo adag laga qaadi doono xubinkii lagu helo inuu ku xadgudbay xeerarka dagaalka, xuquuqda maxaabiista iyo xuquuqda aadanaha. Taliska Ciidanka XDS ayaa sidoo kale uga digay dhammaan xubnaha ciidanka inay ku kacaan falal noocan oo kale ah, isagoo xusay in cid kasta oo lagu helo xadgudub ay wajihi doonto tallaabo waafaqsan sharciga iyo nidaamka ciidanka. Baarista ayaa la sheegay inay tahay mid hordhac ah, iyadoo natiijada iyo tallaabooyinka ka dhalan kara ay ku xirnaan doonaan waxa ay soo saaraan baaritaannada socda.

items.title: Maxay McDonald’s Iyo KFC Uga Cabsadeen Soomaaliya?
items.description: Maxay Shirkadaha Cuntada Degdegga ah ee Reer Galbeedku uga Maqan Yihiin Soomaaliya? Soomaaliya ma leh McDonald’s, Starbucks ama KFC si rasmi ah shati loogu siiyay . Shirkadaha waaweyn ee cuntada degdegga ah ee reer Galbeedka ayaa muddo dheer ka fogaaday inay si rasmi ah uga howlgalaan dalka, inkastoo cuntada degdegga ahi ay si weyn uga jirto Soomaaliya. Magaalada Muqdisho waxaa si weyn looga helaa maqaayado bixiya shawarma, burgerro, digaag la shiilay iyo noocyo kale oo cunto degdeg ah. Sidaas darteed, maqnaanshaha shirkadaha caalamiga ah ma ahan mid ka dhashay in aysan jirin baahi ama macaamiil. Warbixinno iyo xog ururinno ku saabsan suuqyada caalamka ayaa Soomaaliya ku dara dalalka ay qaar ka mid ah shirkadaha waaweyn ee cuntada degdegga ahi weli si rasmi ah u gelin, iyadoo xaaladda amni iyo xasillooni-darrada muddada dheer jirta lagu tilmaamo caqabado waaweyn. Suuqa gudaha ayaa durba buuxa Waddooyinka Muqdisho waxaa ku badan ganacsiyada cuntada degdegga ah ee maxalliga ah. Burgerro, shawarma, digaag la shiilay iyo hilib la dubay ayaa laga heli karaa goobo badan oo magaalada ah. Ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed ayaa sidaas darteed sameystay suuq gudaha ah oo si weyn uga jawaabaya baahida macaamiisha, iyagoo aan haysan taageerada iyo nidaamka maalgashi ee shirkadaha caalamiga ah. Waxaa sidoo kale la soo sheegay in maqaaxi ku taalla Muqdisho ay adeegsatay magaca “KFC” oo ku qoran calaamaddeeda. Hase yeeshee, ma jirto caddeyn muujinaysa in goobtaasi ay xiriir ganacsi la leedahay shirkadda rasmiga ah ee Kentucky Fried Chicken. Sida muuqata, magaca ayaa loo adeegsaday si aan rasmi ahayn, mana aha laan KFC oo shati haysata. Maxaa shirkadaha waaweyn u diidaya inay yimaadaan? Shirkadaha caalamiga ah ee cuntada degdegga ahi marka ay suuq cusub galayaan waxay inta badan u baahan yihiin silsilad sahay oo la isku halayn karo, goobo ganacsi oo ammaan ah, sharciyo la saadaalin karo iyo jawi ganacsi oo xasilloon. Soomaaliya waxay caqabado waaweyn kala kulantay arrimahaas tan iyo burburkii dowladdii dhexe horraantii 1990-meeyadii. items.title: Dad colaad ka barakacay oo cuno yari, hoy xumo iyo waxbarasho la’an ku wajahaya Sanaag
items.description: (ERGO) – Boqollaal qoys oo dagaal qabiil uga barakacay deegaanka Dawaco ee gobolka Sanaag ayaa cunno yari, biyo yari iyo hoy xumo ku wajahaya dhul miyi ah iyo deegaano kale oo ay maciin bideen. Xaaladan ayay wajahaan tan iyo 25 bishii July ee sannadkan. Colaadda ayay ku waayeen kaabayaashii dhaqaale ee ay ku tiirsanaayeen oo ahaa ganacsi iyo xoolo ay dhaqanayeen. Waa dad faro-maran oo ay u suurta gali wayday inay badbaad sadaan hantidooda, dagaalka oo kedis ku billowday darteed. Leyla Maxamed Jaamac oo ka mid ah dadka uu saameeyay ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay inay ku adag in hal waqti ay dabka shitaan. Waxay ku barakaceen degmada Badhan ee gobolka Sanaag oo ay dul-saar ku noqdeen qoys ay qaraabo yihiin. “Markii hore dabka waxaan shidan jirnay saddex xilli, hadeerna hal waqti oo ciriiri ah ayaan helnaa. Aniga unbaa awalba shaqeyn jiray, hadana waan soo barakacay oo cidna nooma shaqeyso. Reerka aan dulsaarka ku nahay waxay na siiyeen hal qol oo yar oo naguma filna. Waa ciriiri.” Leyla ayaa tilmaamtay in qoyska ay ku tiirsan yihiin oo ka kooban 11 ay yihiin danyar dibadda looga soo diro biil yar. Waxay xustay in labada reer oo ka kooban 23 qof ay wadaagaan labo qol oo jiingad ah oo aan ku filneyn. Haweeynaydan ayaa xustay in cunno yarida ay u dheer tahay helitaanka biyaha oo ku adag. Waxay sheegtay in fuustada biyaha oo $4 ah aysan awoodin inay gataan. Qubeys iyo dhar-dhaqis ayay xustay inaysan tabar u hayn oo ay dirqi ku hesho maalinkii hal jiirkaan oo 20 liiter ah, kaas oo ay cabaan ama cuntada ku karsadaan, waxaana ku caawiya qoyska ay la nool yihiin. Leyla ayaa intaas ku dartay in colaaddu ay waxbarasho la’aan dhigtay carruurteeda oo dhiganayay iskuul iyo dugsi Qur’aan. Waxay sheegtay inaysan hadda heli karin $80 oo bishii ay ka dhiibi jirtay. “Waxay arkayaan carruurihii kale oo u dareeraya iskuul iyo malcaamad, waxay igu leeyihiin ardaydii kale tagtayee, iskuul nooma direysid miyaa hooyo?. “Warwar ayay igu haysaa waxbarasho la’aantaas, umana awoodo dee shan carruur ah oo calaa qof yahay $16. Baahiyihiisa asaasiga ahaa oo kale ayaaba maqan.” Leyla ayaa ah hooyo kaligeed korisa 11 carruur ah oo abbahood uu dhintay shan sano ka hor. Noloshooda ayaa ku tiirsaneyd mehrad ay ku iibin jirtay cuntooyinka bisil iyo bagaash. Ganacsigaas oo ay maalinkii ka heli jirtay $10 Illaa $15 ayay xustay in laga gubay oo aysan waxba uga badbaadin isaga iyo guri ay leedahay oo ka koobnaa labo qol oo jiingad ah. Waxay sheegtay in sidoo kale ay ka soo carareen ari labaatan neef ah oo ay dhaqan jireen, kaas oo aysan hadda ogeyn halka uu ku dambeeyo raq iyo ruux. Dagaalka oo billowday habeen saq dhexe ah, abbaara afartii habeenimo ayaa ku qasbay in naftooda oo kaliya ay bad-baad sadaan. Waxay xustay in markii hore ay lug uga baxeen deegaanka, kadibna meel dhexe uu ka qaaday gaari caawiyay oo geeyay degmada Badhan oo 130 km u jirta halka ay ka soo barakaceen. Haweeynaydan oo 43 jir ah ayaa tilmaamtay inay ku hungowday shaqo nadaafadeed oo masaxaad iyo dhar dhaqis ah oo ay raadisay toddobaadyada ay joogto degmada Badhan. Waxay sheegtay inaysan haysan cid garab u noqota xilligan adag, si ay uga soo kabato dhaqaale burburka ay ka dhaxashay dagaalka qabiilka. “Hooyo soo barakacday oo carruur yaryar haysata oo waxba aan u haynin oo aan shaqeyn oo cidna aysan taageereyn, wixii ay haysteenna laga gubay oo soo barakacay oo reer dulsaar ku ah, qof walba wuu garanayaa xaaladeeda.” “Aniga hadda wax ii qorsheysan oo aan ku dhaqaaqo ma jirto oo tabarba ma hayo. Barakacan oo kalana wali ma noqon oo dhulkii aanu joognay hadda ka hor nabad ayaan ku qabnay.” Qoysaska soo barakacay ayaan hadda awoodin inay dib ugu noqdaan deegaankooda, sababo la xiriira colaadda oo aan wali xal laga gaarin. Xaaladaas ayaa ah mid uga sii dareysa nolosha dadkan oo ah kuwo nugul oo aan haysan waxay ku sii dabaraan noloshooda. Adna Aadan Axmed ayaa sheegtay in qoyskeeda oo heli jiray saddex waqti oo cunto ah aysan hadda haysan waxay dabka ku shitaan muddo bil ah oo ay ku nool yihiin degmada Badhan. Waxay sheegtay inuu ka dhammaaday raashiin ay deyn ku soo qaadatay, kaas oo lacagtiisa oo ay bixin waday darteed ay ka hor istaagtay inay hesho deyn kale. Waxay xustay in hadda ay ku tiirsan yihin raashiin bisil oo si aan joogto aheyn ay ugu caawiyaan qoysas danyar ah oo dariskeeda ah. Waxay ka dayrisay dayn uu ku yeeshay ganacsade ay raashin ka qaadatay, taas oo aysan awoodin bixinteeda. “Hadda wuxuu igu leeyahay $300, kadibna wax kale oo deyn ah kama doonan oo tii hore ayaan iska bixin waayay. Cunnada hadda markay ugu badan tahay halmar ayaan u helaa ilmaha.” Adna ayaa ah hooyo kaligeed korisa 4 carruur ah oo lagu furay. Waxay sheegtay in iyadu ay dabari jirtay noloshooda iyo waxbarashadooda oo iskuul hoose aheyd, balse hadda aysan dhigan, dhaqaale la’aan darteed. Waxay tilmaamtay in reerka ay ka maareyn jirtay dukaan ay ku gaddo bagaash, kaas oo ay sheegtay inuu ka mid noqday ganacsiyo iyo guryo lagu gubay deegaanka ay ka soo carartay ee Dawaco. Waxay xustay in halkaas ay uga burburtay badeeco ay ku qiyaastay laba kun oo Dollaar iyo gurigii ay ku noolaayeen oo jiingad ahaa. Haddii nabad la helo ayay sheegtay in xataa aysan haysan dhaqaale ay ku noqdaan iyo mid ay dib ugu dhisato hoygii ay degganaayeen iyo ganacsigii isha dhaqaale u ahaa. “Xaaladda hadda aan ku jirno aniga iyo ilmuhu, marba marka ka sii dambeysa way ka sii xumaaneysaa. Duruuftii ayaan ka taaganahay meeshii ugu dambeysay. Hadda waxba uma awoodo oo duruufaha ayaa igu xumaaday.” Dagaalka qabiilka ayaa ka dhashay dhul daaq-simeed laysku qabsaday. Waxaa ku dhintay 7 qof waxaana ku barakacay 600 oo qoys, sida uu Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay Cabdi Askar Guuleed oo ah guddoomiyaha deegaanka Dawaco ee gobolka Sanaag. Colaadda ayuu tilmaamay inay ku soo beegantay xilli adag oo jiilaal ah, dadkuna wajahayeen dhaqaale xumo ka dhalatay abaaraha soo noqnoqday. Maamul ahaan ayuu sheegay inaysan hayn wax weyn oo ku caawiyaan, balse xaaladooda oo liidata ay la wadaageen maamulka gobolka Sanaag, in kastoo uu xusay inaysan jirin cid wali u soo gurmatay. “Nafaqadooda, noloshooda, caafimaad kooda intaba waa liidataa. Waxaa ugu daran helitaanka cuntada.  Anaggu waxaanu ku caawinay booyado ayaan biyo ugu geynay, dadkuna waxay u uruuriyeen cunto yar.” “Dadka Soomaaliyeed iyo hay’adaha waxaan ugu baaqayaa inay wixii ay u qaban karaan u qabtaan dadkaas guryahoodii cabsida uga barakacay ee maatada iyo carruuraha la barakiciyay ah.” Dagaalka qabiilka oo marar badan soo laalaabtay, wuxuu caqabad ku noqday nolosha kumannaan qoys oo aan wali ka soo kaban dhaqaale burburka ku dhacay. items.title: Dawlada Somalia oo dalalka Carabta ka codsatay in adeegsadaan xidhiidhkooda Diblomaasiyadeed si aan aqoonsi kale loosiin Somaliland
items.description: Soomaaliya ayaa ugu baaqday waddamada Carabta inay adeegsadaan xidhiidhkooda iyo awooddooda diblomaasiyadeed si looga hortago in aqoonsiga ay Israa’iil siisay Somaliland uu isu beddelo olole ay waddamada kale ee caalamkuna ku daydaan oo ay si rasmi ah u aqoonsadaan Somaliland, sida uu shaaciyay Wasiiru-dawlaha Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Cali Maxamed Cumar (Cali Balcad) Wareysi uu siiyay wargeyska *Asharq Al-Awsat* ee fadhigiisu yahay Bariga Dhexe, ayuu Wasiiru-dawlaha Arrimaha Dibadda, Mudane Cali Maxamed Cumar, ku sheegay in Soomaaliya ay xidhiidh toos ah la leedahay maamulka Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump, isagoo xusay in Soomaaliya ay muujin doonto sida ay uga soo horjeeddo aqoonsiga ay Israa’iil siisay Somaliland. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in Soomaaliya ay si dhow ula socoto dood kasta oo ku saabsan aqoonsi cusub. Wasiiru-dawlaha Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa sidoo kale shaaciyay in Israa’iil, oo xubin ka ah Qaramada Midoobay, ay noqotay waddankii ugu horreeyay ee si rasmi ah u aqoonsada Somaliland bishii Disembar 2025, isagoo xusay in labada waddan ay is-weydaarsadeen safiirro, isla markaana Somaliland ay si rasmi ah u furtay safaaraddeedii ugu horreysay ee dibadda oo laga furay magaalada Qudus (Jerusalem). Wuxuu kaloo xusay in Madaxweynaha Somaliland uu u safray Israa’iil booqasho shaqo oo rasmi ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wuxuu sheegay in aqoonsigan uusan weli dhalin mowjad aqoonsiyo caalami ah oo kale. Wuxuu sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya aysan u arkin aqoonsiga Israa’iil tallaabo calaamad uun ah, balse ay aaminsan tahay in tallaabo kasta oo dibadda ka timaada oo looga golleeyahay in lagu beddelo midnimada Soomaaliya ay yeelan karto cawaaqib xumo siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo waaweyn. Wuxuu sidoo kale xusay wax uu ku tilmaamay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo kan amniga ee ka dhexeeya Israa’iil iyo Somaliland, oo ay ku jirto kaalmada tababarka ciidamada amniga. Wasiiru-dawlaha ayaa ka digay isku-day kasta oo waddan shisheeye ku doonayo inuu saldhig militari ama mid sirdoon ka sameysto Soomaaliya iyadoo aysan jirin ogolaansho ka haysta Dowladda Federaalka, isagoo sheegay in militarimeynta arrinta Somaliland ay khatar ku noqon karto Soomaaliya iyo gobolka Geeska Afrika. Isagoo ka hadlaya mowqifka waddamada Carabta, Cali Maxamed Cumar ayaa sheegay in jawaab-celintii degdegga ahayd ee waddamada Carabta ee ku aaddan aqoonsiga Israa’iil ay ahayd mid muhiim ah, maadaama ay muujisay in go’aanka Israa’iil uusan beddelin mowqifka midaysan ee caalamiga ah iyo kan gobolka ee ku saabsan ilaalinta midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wuxuu xusay in Soomaaliya ay raadinayso tallaabooyin ka baxsan cambaareyn uun. “Ujeeddadu ma aha oo kaliya in la soo saaro cambaareyn, balse waa in laga hortago in aqoonsiga dhinac keliya ah uu isu beddelo olole ballaaran,” ayuu yiri Cali Maxamed Cumar. …iyagoo ugu baaqaya waddamada Carabta inay si firfircoon uga faa’iidaystaan ​​xidhuidhkooda diblomaasiyadeed iyo saamayntooda. Wuxuu ku dooday in midnimada Soomaaliya aysan ahayn arrin khuseysa Soomaaliya oo keliya, maadaama kala-baxa waddamada Carabta iyo Afrika uu noqon karo tusaale horseedi kara cawaaqib xumo.

items.title: US Court Clears Way to End TPS for Somali Nationals
items.description: Federal Court Clears Trump Administration to End TPS for Somali Nationals BOSTON, United States — A federal court in Boston has cleared the administration of President Donald Trump to proceed with its decision to terminate Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Somali nationals, a move affecting about 1,100 people living in the United States. The ruling was issued by Judge Allison D. Burroughs of the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts. She granted the government’s request to lift a temporary injunction that had prevented the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) from implementing the termination of Somalia’s TPS designation.TPS is a U.S. immigration programme that allows nationals of designated countries facing armed conflict, natural disasters or other extraordinary and temporary conditions to remain legally in the United States and obtain work authorization while the protection remains in effect.Somalia was first designated for TPS in 1991 , amid the country’s civil war. The designation has been extended and redesignated repeatedly over the years because of continuing security and humanitarian concerns. Why is Somalia’s TPS being terminated? In January 2026, DHS, then led by Secretary Kristi Noem, announced that the United States would terminate Somalia’s TPS designation. A notice published in the Federal Register said the decision followed a review of conditions in Somalia and consultations with other U.S. government agencies. The administration concluded that Somalia no longer met the statutory requirements for continued TPS protection. DHS argued that conditions related to the conflict in Somalia had changed significantly since the country was first designated in 1991. The department also cited considerations involving national security, foreign policy, public safety and what it described as problems associated with the U.S. immigration system. The administration further argued that the security situation in Somalia no longer prevented Somali nationals from returning to the country. According to DHS data, 1,082 people held approved TPS status as of December 8, 2025, while another 1,383 applications were pending at the time.The termination was initially scheduled to take effect on March 17, 2026. However, on March 13, a federal court temporarily blocked the move after Somali TPS holders and two immigrant advocacy organizations challenged the government’s decision. The legal challenge The lawsuit was brought by four Somali nationals, along with African Communities Together and the Partnership for the Advancement of New Americans .The plaintiffs argued that the decision to terminate TPS was unlawful and alleged that bias and discriminatory considerations had influenced the administration’s decision-making process.Judge Burroughs had previously paused implementation of the termination while the case proceeded. The legal situation changed significantly, however, after the U.S. Supreme Court issued a ruling on June 25, 2026 , involving TPS protections for nationals of Haiti and Syria. The Supreme Court removed lower-court orders that had temporarily blocked the termination of TPS for Haiti and Syria, giving the Trump administration greater ability to proceed with TPS terminations.Against that backdrop, Burroughs on August 14 granted the government’s request to lift the injunction blocking the termination of Somalia’s TPS designation.The judge acknowledged that the plaintiffs had demonstrated that they could face serious harm if TPS protections were removed. However, she concluded that the Supreme Court’s ruling made it difficult for her to issue the relief they were seeking. What does the decision mean for Somali TPS holders? The termination of TPS does not mean that every affected Somali national will automatically be deported on the day the court ruling was issued.However, people who rely solely on TPS to maintain lawful protection in the United States could lose their protection from removal as well as their employment authorization once the termination takes effect. U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) updated its guidance on Somalia’s TPS termination on August 5, noting that the original March 17 termination date had been delayed because of the court order. The American Immigration Lawyers Association (AILA) also reported in 2026 that the final court restriction preventing the termination of Somalia’s TPS had been lifted on August 14, and that USCIS had indicated that employment authorization associated with Somalia’s TPS would end on that date.The underlying legal dispute, however, did not necessarily end with the August 14 ruling. While the judge rejected the plaintiffs’ request for emergency relief and allowed the government to proceed with the termination, other legal arguments raised by the plaintiffs remain part of the broader case. The decision could have significant consequences for Somali nationals in the United States, particularly those who do not have another legal immigration status allowing them to remain and work in the country.The future of Somalia’s TPS designation will depend on the outcome of the continuing litigation and any further legal or administrative action by the U.S. government. The post US Court Clears Way to End TPS for Somali Nationals first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Tanzania: Somali Doctors Treat Nearly 1,000 People
items.description: EAC Officials Visit Tanzania Hospital as Somali Doctors Provide Free Medical Services DAR ES SALAAM, Tanzania — Officials involved in military cooperation among member states of the East African Community (EAC) visited Vijibweni Hospital in Kigamboni, Dar es Salaam, where Somali doctors are taking part in a free medical outreach programme serving local communities.The visit took place during the sixth edition of the EAC Armed Forces Civil-Military Cooperation (CIMIC) Week , being held in Tanzania from August 26 to September 1, 2026. The programme brings together medical teams from Burundi, Kenya, Rwanda, Somalia, Uganda and Tanzania. At Vijibweni Hospital, the visiting officials were briefed on the medical services being provided and the role of Somali doctors in delivering care to members of the local community.According to information released about the programme, Somali medical personnel have been providing treatment and medical consultations during the week, with services aimed particularly at people who may not be able to afford healthcare costs. Children, elderly people and mothers are among those receiving care. Tanzanian health authorities identify Vijibweni Hospital as a government district-level hospital located in Kigamboni District, Dar es Salaam. The facility is among the healthcare centres being used for the CIMIC activities, where participating medical teams are providing specialised services to members of the public.The EAC CIMIC Week extends beyond healthcare. Tanzanian officials said activities during the programme also include support for childcare facilities and prisons, as well as rehabilitation work at selected community service facilities. Medical outreach activities are being conducted at various locations across Dar es Salaam, Pwani, Arusha and Zanzibar.Tanzania previously hosted the EAC CIMIC Week in 2022. According to Tanzania’s government-run Daily News , Somalia is expected to host the next edition of the programme.The EAC CIMIC initiative is designed to strengthen cooperation among East African armed forces while bringing military personnel and civilian institutions together through humanitarian and community service activities. The regional bloc has previously highlighted healthcare, community development and stronger relations between military institutions and civilians as key areas of focus. The activities at Vijibweni Hospital have provided one of the clearest examples of Somalia’s participation in the regional initiative, with Somali doctors working alongside medical teams from other EAC member states to provide healthcare services to communities in Tanzania during the week-long programme. The post Tanzania: Somali Doctors Treat Nearly 1,000 People first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Soomaalida Haysta TPS-ka Oo Wajahaya Isbeddel Sharci
items.description: BOSTON, Mareykanka Maxkamad federaal ah oo ku taalla Boston ayaa 14-kii Agoosto u oggolaatay maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump inuu dhaqan geliyo go’aanka lagu soo afjarayo Temporary Protected Status (TPS) ee muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed, tallaabadaas oo saameynaysa ku dhowaad 1,100 qof oo dalka Mareykanka ku nool. Go’aanka waxaa soo saartay Garsoore Allison D. Burroughs oo ka tirsan Maxkamadda Degmada Federaalka ee Massachusetts. Waxay oggolaatay codsiga dowladda ee lagu qaadayay xannibaaddii ku-meelgaarka ahayd ee hor istaagtay Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka (DHS) inay fuliso joojinta TPS-ka Soomaaliya. TPS waa nidaam Mareykan ah oo siinaya muwaadiniinta dalal ay ka jiraan dagaallo, masiibooyin ama xaalado aan caadi ahayn oo ku-meelgaar ah inay si sharci ah ugu sii noolaadaan Mareykanka, isla markaana ay helaan oggolaansho shaqo inta ay ilaalintaasi socoto. Soomaaliya ayaa markii ugu horreysay TPS loo qoondeeyay 1991 , xilli dalka uu ku jiray dagaal sokeeye. Ilaalintaas ayaa sannado badan la kordhinayay, waxaana marar kala duwan dib loogu magacaabay Soomaaliya sababo la xiriira xaaladda amni iyo bani’aadamnimo. Maxaa sababay joojinta? Bishii Janaayo 2026, DHS oo uu xilligaas hoggaaminayay Xoghayihii Amniga Gudaha Kristi Noem ayaa ku dhawaaqay in TPS-ka Soomaaliya la soo afjarayo. Dukumenti lagu daabacay Federal Register ayaa sheegay in dowladda Mareykanku, kadib qiimeyn lagu sameeyay xaaladaha Soomaaliya iyo la-tashi lala yeeshay hay’adaha kale ee dowladda, ay go’aamisay in Soomaaliya aysan sii buuxin shuruudihii TPS-ka. DHS waxay ku doodday in xaaladda colaadda Soomaaliya ay si weyn uga duwan tahay tii 1991, isla markaana arrimo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, siyaasadda dibadda, amniga dadweynaha iyo waxa ay dowladda ku tilmaantay dhibaatooyin la xiriira nidaamka socdaalka ay qayb ka ahaayeen go’aanka. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in rabshadaha ka jira Soomaaliya aysan hadda si buuxda uga hor istaagin muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed inay si ammaan ah ugu laabtaan dalka. Xogta DHS waxay tilmaamaysay in 1,082 qof ay haysteen TPS la ansixiyay xilliga qiimeynta la sameeyay Diseembar 8, 2025, halka 1,383 codsi oo kale ay markaas sugayeen go’aan. Go’aanka dowladda waxaa lagu waday inuu dhaqan galo 17-kii Maarso 2026, balse maxkamad federaal ah ayaa 13-kii Maarso si ku-meelgaar ah u joojisay fulintiisa kadib markii muwaadiniin Soomaali ah iyo laba urur oo u dooda xuquuqda dadka soo-galootiga ah ay dacwad ka gudbiyeen dowladda. Dacwadda iyo go’aanka maxkamadda Dacwadda waxaa gudbiyay afar qof oo Soomaali ah iyo ururrada African Communities Together iyo Partnership for the Advancement of New Americans. Dacwad-oogayaashu waxay ku doodayeen in go’aanka lagu soo afjarayo TPS-ka uu sharci-darro yahay, isla markaana ay jiraan arrimo la xiriira eex iyo takoor oo saameeyay go’aanka dowladda. Garsoore Burroughs ayaa hore u hakisay fulinta go’aanka, iyadoo dacwaddu socotay. Hase yeeshee, xaaladda sharci ayaa si weyn isu beddeshay kadib markii Maxkamadda Sare ee Mareykanka ay 25-kii Juun 2026 go’aan ka gaartay kiisaska la xiriiray TPS-ka Haiti iyo Syria. Maxkamadda Sare waxay meesha ka saartay go’aamadii maxkamadaha hoose ee si ku-meelgaar ah u hakinayay joojinta TPS-ka Haiti iyo Syria, taas oo dowladda Trump siisay awood dheeraad ah oo ay ku fuliso joojinta ilaalinta TPS ee dalal badan. Iyadoo la tixraacayo xaaladdaas cusub, Burroughs ayaa 14-kii Agoosto oggolaatay codsiga dowladda ee lagu qaadayo xannibaaddii ka hor istaagtay joojinta TPS-ka Soomaaliya. Maxkamaddu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in dacwad-oogayaashu muujiyeen inay la kulmi karaan waxyeello weyn haddii ilaalinta laga qaado, balse ay ku adkaatay inay bixiso amarkii ay dalbanayeen iyadoo la tixgelinayo go’aankii Maxkamadda Sare. Maxay tani uga dhigan tahay Soomaalida haysta TPS? Joojinta TPS macnaheedu ma aha in dhammaan dadka ay khusayso si toos ah loo tarxiilayo isla maalinta go’aanka la gaaray. Hase yeeshee, dadka ku tiirsan TPS oo keliya si ay sharci ugu joogaan Mareykanka waxay lumin karaan ilaalintooda ka dhanka ah masaafurinta iyo oggolaanshahooda shaqo. Hay’adda USCIS waxay 5-tii Agoosto cusbooneysiisay tilmaamaheeda ku saabsan joojinta TPS-ka Soomaaliya, iyadoo sheegtay in joojintii markii hore loo qorsheeyay 17-kii Maarso ay dib u dhacday sababo la xiriira amarka maxkamadda. Ururka American Immigration Lawyers Association (AILA) ayaa sidoo kale 2026 xusay in 14-kii Agoosto la qaaday xannibaaddii ugu dambeysay ee maxkamadeed ee ka horreysay joojinta TPS-ka Soomaaliya, isla markaana USCIS ay sheegtay in oggolaanshaha shaqada ee TPS-ka Soomaaliya uu ku dhammaaday taariikhdaas. Si kastaba, dacwadda sharciyeed lafteedu ma aysan si fudud ku dhammaan go’aanka 14-ka Agoosto. Amarka garsooraha ayaa diiday codsigii degdegga ahaa ee dacwad-oogayaasha, iyadoo dowladda loo oggolaaday inay sii waddo joojinta TPS-ka, halka doodaha kale ee sharci ee dacwad-oogayaashu ay weli qayb ka yihiin kiiska. Go’aanka ayaa sidaas darteed muhiim u ah kumannaan Soomaali ah oo ku nool Mareykanka, gaar ahaan kuwa aan haysan waddo kale oo sharci ah oo ay ku sii joogaan dalka ama ku sii wataan shaqadooda. items.fullContent: BOSTON, Mareykanka Maxkamad federaal ah oo ku taalla Boston ayaa 14-kii Agoosto u oggolaatay maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump inuu dhaqan geliyo go’aanka lagu soo afjarayo Temporary Protected Status (TPS) ee muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed, tallaabadaas oo saameynaysa ku dhowaad 1,100 qof oo dalka Mareykanka ku nool. Go’aanka waxaa soo saartay Garsoore Allison D. Burroughs oo ka tirsan Maxkamadda Degmada Federaalka ee Massachusetts. Waxay oggolaatay codsiga dowladda ee lagu qaadayay xannibaaddii ku-meelgaarka ahayd ee hor istaagtay Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka (DHS) inay fuliso joojinta TPS-ka Soomaaliya. TPS waa nidaam Mareykan ah oo siinaya muwaadiniinta dalal ay ka jiraan dagaallo, masiibooyin ama xaalado aan caadi ahayn oo ku-meelgaar ah inay si sharci ah ugu sii noolaadaan Mareykanka, isla markaana ay helaan oggolaansho shaqo inta ay ilaalintaasi socoto. Soomaaliya ayaa markii ugu horreysay TPS loo qoondeeyay 1991 , xilli dalka uu ku jiray dagaal sokeeye. Ilaalintaas ayaa sannado badan la kordhinayay, waxaana marar kala duwan dib loogu magacaabay Soomaaliya sababo la xiriira xaaladda amni iyo bani’aadamnimo. Maxaa sababay joojinta? Bishii Janaayo 2026, DHS oo uu xilligaas hoggaaminayay Xoghayihii Amniga Gudaha Kristi Noem ayaa ku dhawaaqay in TPS-ka Soomaaliya la soo afjarayo. Dukumenti lagu daabacay Federal Register ayaa sheegay in dowladda Mareykanku, kadib qiimeyn lagu sameeyay xaaladaha Soomaaliya iyo la-tashi lala yeeshay hay’adaha kale ee dowladda, ay go’aamisay in Soomaaliya aysan sii buuxin shuruudihii TPS-ka. DHS waxay ku doodday in xaaladda colaadda Soomaaliya ay si weyn uga duwan tahay tii 1991, isla markaana arrimo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, siyaasadda dibadda, amniga dadweynaha iyo waxa ay dowladda ku tilmaantay dhibaatooyin la xiriira nidaamka socdaalka ay qayb ka ahaayeen go’aanka. Dowladda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in rabshadaha ka jira Soomaaliya aysan hadda si buuxda uga hor istaagin muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed inay si ammaan ah ugu laabtaan dalka. Xogta DHS waxay tilmaamaysay in 1,082 qof ay haysteen TPS la ansixiyay xilliga qiimeynta la sameeyay Diseembar 8, 2025, halka 1,383 codsi oo kale ay markaas sugayeen go’aan. Go’aanka dowladda waxaa lagu waday inuu dhaqan galo 17-kii Maarso 2026, balse maxkamad federaal ah ayaa 13-kii Maarso si ku-meelgaar ah u joojisay fulintiisa kadib markii muwaadiniin Soomaali ah iyo laba urur oo u dooda xuquuqda dadka soo-galootiga ah ay dacwad ka gudbiyeen dowladda. Dacwadda iyo go’aanka maxkamadda Dacwadda waxaa gudbiyay afar qof oo Soomaali ah iyo ururrada African Communities Together iyo Partnership for the Advancement of New Americans. Dacwad-oogayaashu waxay ku doodayeen in go’aanka lagu soo afjarayo TPS-ka uu sharci-darro yahay, isla markaana ay jiraan arrimo la xiriira eex iyo takoor oo saameeyay go’aanka dowladda. Garsoore Burroughs ayaa hore u hakisay fulinta go’aanka, iyadoo dacwaddu socotay. Hase yeeshee, xaaladda sharci ayaa si weyn isu beddeshay kadib markii Maxkamadda Sare ee Mareykanka ay 25-kii Juun 2026 go’aan ka gaartay kiisaska la xiriiray TPS-ka Haiti iyo Syria. Maxkamadda Sare waxay meesha ka saartay go’aamadii maxkamadaha hoose ee si ku-meelgaar ah u hakinayay joojinta TPS-ka Haiti iyo Syria, taas oo dowladda Trump siisay awood dheeraad ah oo ay ku fuliso joojinta ilaalinta TPS ee dalal badan. Iyadoo la tixraacayo xaaladdaas cusub, Burroughs ayaa 14-kii Agoosto oggolaatay codsiga dowladda ee lagu qaadayo xannibaaddii ka hor istaagtay joojinta TPS-ka Soomaaliya. Maxkamaddu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in dacwad-oogayaashu muujiyeen inay la kulmi karaan waxyeello weyn haddii ilaalinta laga qaado, balse ay ku adkaatay inay bixiso amarkii ay dalbanayeen iyadoo la tixgelinayo go’aankii Maxkamadda Sare. Maxay tani uga dhigan tahay Soomaalida haysta TPS? Joojinta TPS macnaheedu ma aha in dhammaan dadka ay khusayso si toos ah loo tarxiilayo isla maalinta go’aanka la gaaray. Hase yeeshee, dadka ku tiirsan TPS oo keliya si ay sharci ugu joogaan Mareykanka waxay lumin karaan ilaalintooda ka dhanka ah masaafurinta iyo oggolaanshahooda shaqo. Hay’adda USCIS waxay 5-tii Agoosto cusbooneysiisay tilmaamaheeda ku saabsan joojinta TPS-ka Soomaaliya, iyadoo sheegtay in joojintii markii hore loo qorsheeyay 17-kii Maarso ay dib u dhacday sababo la xiriira amarka maxkamadda. items.title: Mooshin xilka qaadis ah oo loo gudbiyay guddoonk BF + Video
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaano ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta guddoonka Baarlamaanka u gudbiyey mooshin xilka qaadis ah oo ka dhan ah wasiirka arrimaha gudaha xukuumadda Soomaaliya, Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh) oo ay xildhibaannadu u jeediyeen eedeymo culus. Xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Cagaweyne oo kamid ah xildhibaannada gudbiyay mooshinka ayaa sheegay in guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ay gaarsiiyeen mooshinka, isla markaana tabashada wasiirka ay muddo dheer soo taagnayd. “Halkan waxaan kusoo gudbineynaa mooshin ay xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka ka gudbiyeen wasiirka arrimaha gudaha xildhiban Cali Xoosh oo muddo dheer xildhibaannadu ay tabashadoodu qabeen, soona gudbinaayeen iyada oo maanta loo gudbiyay guddoomiyaha, sida uu qabo xeer-hoosaadka iyo dastuurka dalka,” ayuu yiri xildhibaan Cabdiraxmaan Cagaweyne. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in tirada xildhibaannada saxiixay mooshinka ay gaareyso illaa 60 mudane, kuwaas oo si wadajir ah u taageeray mooshinka ka dhanka ah wasiirka, ujeeddaduna tahay in xilka laga qaado. “Xildhibaannada mooshinka gudbiyay waxay gaarayaan 60 mudane, waxaana ujeedadiisu tahay xilka qaadista wasiirka oo lagu eedeeyay qodobo fara badan oo halkan aan lagu soo koobi karin,” ayuu mar kale yiri xildhibaanku. Waxaa kale oo uu carrabka ku dhuftay in guddoonka sare ee golaha uu haysto muddo 48 saacadood ah oo uu ku waajibayo inuu ka shaqeeyo mooshinka, iyadoo kadib la filayo in la horkeeno golaha, si looga doodo, loogana qaato go’aan rasmi ah oo ku aaddan eedaha loo jeedinayo wasiirka arrimaha gudaha, federaalka iyo dib-u-heshiisiinta, Mudane Cali Yuusuf Cali (Xoosh). Eedaha waa wayn ee wasiirka loo soo jeediyay waxaa kamid ah inuu gabay wajibaadkii loo igmaday, gaar ahaan fulinta hawlaha wasaaradda iyo inuu ka gaabiyay wax ka qabashada colaadaha sokeeye ee ka jira gudaha dalka. Xildhibaannada ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in wasiirka uu si joogto ah uga horyimaado habka federaalka iyo awood-qaybsiga u dhexeeya dowladda dhexe iyo dowlad-goboleedyada dalka Mooshinkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, xilli xasaasi ah oo ay taagan tahay xiisad ka dhalatay marxaladda kala guurka ah ee uu haatan ku jiro dalka, iyada oo weli is faham-waa xooggan uu u dhexeeyo Villa Somalia iyo kooxaha mucaaradka. The post Mooshin xilka qaadis ah oo loo gudbiyay guddoonk BF + Video appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia and Qatar Strengthen Security and Defense Cooperation
items.description: Somalia and Qatar Discuss Strengthening Security and Defence Cooperation DOHA, Qatar — Somali Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre met Qatar’s Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defence Affairs, Sheikh Saud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al Thani, in Doha on Monday, as the two sides discussed security, defence and ways to deepen bilateral cooperation. The meeting took place on August 31, 2026, during Prime Minister Hamza’s official visit to Qatar. According to Somalia’s government, the talks focused on strengthening security and defence ties between Mogadishu and Doha, as well as cooperation against cross-border security threats. Prime Minister Hamza briefed Sheikh Saud on Somalia’s security situation and the government’s ongoing military operations against Al-Shabaab. Somali authorities said he also highlighted progress in efforts to improve security in major cities and strengthen the capabilities of the country’s security forces. Sheikh Saud, for his part, expressed Qatar’s continued support for Somalia and its readiness to expand cooperation between the two countries in various areas. No new military agreement, specific arms package or additional defence assistance was announced following the meeting. Qatar’s official records identify Sheikh Saud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al Thani as the country’s Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defence Affairs . Qatar’s Ministry of Defence also reported in March 2026 that Sheikh Saud held a phone call with Somali Defence Minister Ahmed Macallin Fiqi, during which the two discussed regional security developments and bilateral defence cooperation. The latest meeting comes amid growing security and defence engagement between Somalia and Qatar. In January 2026, Sheikh Saud met Defence Minister Fiqi in Doha on the sidelines of the DIMDEX 2026 defence exhibition. Qatar’s state news agency reported at the time that the two sides signed a defence cooperation agreement aimed at strengthening ties between their respective defence institutions. Prime Minister Hamza’s visit has also included high-level talks with Qatar’s leadership. On August 30, he met Qatari Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani. Qatar’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said the meeting included discussions on bilateral relations and that the Qatari emir had received a written message from Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud concerning the strengthening and expansion of ties between the two countries. The relationship between Somalia and Qatar has expanded in recent years across security, defence, economic cooperation and support for Somalia’s state institutions. Security cooperation has remained an important component of the relationship as Somalia continues its campaign against Al-Shabaab and works to strengthen its national security institutions. Monday’s meeting therefore forms part of a broader series of high-level engagements between Mogadishu and Doha. However, neither government has announced a new specific defence agreement or military assistance package resulting directly from the latest talks. The post Somalia and Qatar Strengthen Security and Defense Cooperation first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Xamsa Iyo Qatar Oo Ka Wada Hadlay Xoojinta Amniga Iyo Difaaca
items.description: Soomaaliya iyo Qatar oo xoojinaya iskaashiga amniga iyo difaaca DOOXA, Qatar — Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa magaalada Dooxa kula kulmay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Qatar ahna Wasiirka Dowladda u qaabilsan Arrimaha Difaaca, Sheekh Saud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al Thani, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen amniga, difaaca iyo xoojinta iskaashiga labada dal. Kulanka ayaa dhacay 31-kii Agoosto 2026, intii uu Xamsa Cabdi Barre ku guda jiray booqasho rasmi ah oo uu ku joogo Qatar. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta dowladda Soomaaliya, wada-hadalladu waxay ku saabsanaayeen sidii loo sii adkeyn lahaa xiriirka amni iyo difaac ee Muqdisho iyo Dooxa, iyo iskaashiga looga hortagayo khataraha amni ee ka gudba xuduudaha. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya ayaa kulanka ku soo bandhigay xaaladda amni ee dalka iyo hawlgallada ay dowladda federaalku sheegtay inay ka waddo dagaalka Al-Shabaab. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Xamsa uu uga warramay horumarka laga sameeyay sugidda amniga magaalooyinka waaweyn iyo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Dhinaca Qatar, Sheekh Saud ayaa muujiyay in dowladdiisu ay diyaar u tahay inay sii ballaariso iskaashiga ay la leedahay Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, faahfaahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan heshiis cusub, taageero ciidan oo gaar ah ama qalab militari oo kulanka lagu kala saxiixday lama shaacin. Xogta rasmiga ah ee Qatar waxay xaqiijinaysaa in Sheekh Saud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al Thani uu yahay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Qatar iyo Wasiirka Dowladda u qaabilsan Arrimaha Difaaca , sidaa darteed xilka “Wasiirka Difaaca” oo keliya ee lagu sheegay qoraalka Soomaaliga ah ma ahan magaca rasmiga ah ee xilkiisa. Wasaaradda Difaaca Qatar ayaa sidoo kale 13-kii Maarso 2026 sheegtay inuu telefoon kula xiriiray Wasiirka Difaaca Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xaaladaha amni ee gobolka iyo iskaashiga labada dal. Kulanka cusub ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Qatar uu xoogga saarayay arrimaha amniga iyo difaaca. Janaayo 2026, Sheekh Saud ayaa Doha kula kulmay Wasiirka Difaaca Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi intii uu socday Bandhigga iyo Shirka Caalamiga ah ee Difaaca Badda ee Doha (DIMDEX 2026). Sida ay sheegtay Wakaaladda Wararka Qatar, labada dhinac waxay markaas saxiixeen heshiis iskaashi oo lagu xoojinayo dhinacyada difaaca ee labada dal. Booqashada Xamsa ee Qatar ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegantay kulamo heer sare ah oo uu la yeeshay madaxda dalkaas. 30-kii Agoosto ayuu la kulmay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Qatar ahna Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda, Sheekh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani. Dowladda Qatar ayaa xaqiijisay in kulankaas lagu helay farriin qoraal ah oo uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud u diray Amiirka Qatar, Sheekh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, taas oo ku saabsan xoojinta iyo ballaarinta xiriirka labada dal. Warbaahinta Shabelle ayaa iyaduna sheegtay in kulanka labada ra’iisul wasaare lagu soo qaaday xaaladda dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee Soomaaliya, horumarka dhinacyada amniga iyo xasilloonida, iyo arrimo caalami ah oo ay ku jiraan caqabadaha saameyn kara ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Dooxa ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyay ku fiday dhinacyo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, difaaca, horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo taageerada hay’adaha dowladda Soomaaliya. Kulamadii ugu dambeeyay waxay muujinayaan in amniga iyo iskaashiga difaaca ay weli yihiin qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah ee labada dowladood. Kulanka 31-ka Agoosto, oo qayb ka ah booqashada Xamsa ee Qatar, ayaa sidaas darteed kusoo kordhinaya wadahadallada socda ee labada dhinac, balse illaa hadda labada dowladood si rasmi ah uma shaacin heshiis cusub oo gaar ah oo ka dhashay kulankaas. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta dowladda Soomaaliya, wada-hadalladu waxay ku saabsanaayeen sidii loo sii adkeyn lahaa xiriirka amni iyo difaac ee Muqdisho iyo Dooxa, iyo iskaashiga looga hortagayo khataraha amni ee ka gudba xuduudaha. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya ayaa kulanka ku soo bandhigay xaaladda amni ee dalka iyo hawlgallada ay dowladda federaalku sheegtay inay ka waddo dagaalka Al-Shabaab. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in Xamsa uu uga warramay horumarka laga sameeyay sugidda amniga magaalooyinka waaweyn iyo dadaallada lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Dhinaca Qatar, Sheekh Saud ayaa muujiyay in dowladdiisu ay diyaar u tahay inay sii ballaariso iskaashiga ay la leedahay Soomaaliya. Si kastaba, faahfaahin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan heshiis cusub, taageero ciidan oo gaar ah ama qalab militari oo kulanka lagu kala saxiixday lama shaacin. Xogta rasmiga ah ee Qatar waxay xaqiijinaysaa in Sheekh Saud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al Thani uu yahay Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Qatar iyo Wasiirka Dowladda u qaabilsan Arrimaha Difaaca , sidaa darteed xilka “Wasiirka Difaaca” oo keliya ee lagu sheegay qoraalka Soomaaliga ah ma ahan magaca rasmiga ah ee xilkiisa. Wasaaradda Difaaca Qatar ayaa sidoo kale 13-kii Maarso 2026 sheegtay inuu telefoon kula xiriiray Wasiirka Difaaca Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xaaladaha amni ee gobolka iyo iskaashiga labada dal. Kulanka cusub ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Qatar uu xoogga saarayay arrimaha amniga iyo difaaca. Janaayo 2026, Sheekh Saud ayaa Doha kula kulmay Wasiirka Difaaca Soomaaliya Axmed Macallin Fiqi intii uu socday Bandhigga iyo Shirka Caalamiga ah ee Difaaca Badda ee Doha (DIMDEX 2026). Sida ay sheegtay Wakaaladda Wararka Qatar, labada dhinac waxay markaas saxiixeen heshiis iskaashi oo lagu xoojinayo dhinacyada difaaca ee labada dal. Booqashada Xamsa ee Qatar ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegantay kulamo heer sare ah oo uu la yeeshay madaxda dalkaas. 30-kii Agoosto ayuu la kulmay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Qatar ahna Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda, Sheekh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani. Dowladda Qatar ayaa xaqiijisay in kulankaas lagu helay farriin qoraal ah oo uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud u diray Amiirka Qatar, Sheekh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, taas oo ku saabsan xoojinta iyo ballaarinta xiriirka labada dal. Warbaahinta Shabelle ayaa iyaduna sheegtay in kulanka labada ra’iisul wasaare lagu soo qaaday xaaladda dhaqaale iyo bulsho ee Soomaaliya, horumarka dhinacyada amniga iyo xasilloonida, iyo arrimo caalami ah oo ay ku jiraan caqabadaha saameyn kara ganacsiga caalamiga ah. Xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Dooxa ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyay ku fiday dhinacyo ay ka mid yihiin amniga, difaaca, horumarinta dhaqaalaha iyo taageerada hay’adaha dowladda Soomaaliya. Kulamadii ugu dambeeyay waxay muujinayaan in amniga iyo iskaashiga difaaca ay weli yihiin qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah xiriirka istiraatiijiga ah ee labada dowladood. Kulanka 31-ka Agoosto, oo qayb ka ah booqashada Xamsa ee Qatar, ayaa sidaas darteed kusoo kordhinaya wadahadallada socda ee labada dhinac, balse illaa hadda labada dowladood si rasmi ah uma shaacin heshiis cusub oo gaar ah oo ka dhashay kulankaas. items.title: Tanzania: Dhaqaatiir Soomaaliyeed Oo Daweeyay Ku Dhawaad 1,000 Qof
items.description: Saraakiil ka tirsan EAC oo booqday Isbitaalka Vijibweni xilli dhakhaatiir Soomaali ah ay adeegyo bilaash ah ka wadaan Saraakiil ka tirsan iskaashiga milatari ee dalalka xubnaha ka ah Ururka Bulshada Bariga Afrika (EAC) ayaa booqday Isbitaalka Vijibweni ee degmada Kigamboni, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, halkaas oo dhakhaatiir Soomaali ah ay qeyb ka yihiin howl caafimaad oo bilaash ah oo loogu adeegayo bulshada.Booqashadu waxay ku soo beegantay toddobaadka lixaad ee EAC Armed Forces Civil-Military Cooperation (CIMIC) Week , oo Tanzania ka soconaya 26-ka Agoosto ilaa 1-da Sebtembar 2026. Barnaamijkan waxaa ka qeyb qaadanaya kooxo caafimaad oo ka kala socda Burundi, Kenya, Rwanda, Soomaaliya, Uganda iyo Tanzania.Intii ay saraakiishu ku jireen Vijibweni, waxaa loo soo bandhigay adeegyada caafimaad ee halkaas laga bixinayo iyo kaalinta ay dhakhaatiirta Soomaaliyeed ka qaadanayaan howlaha caafimaad ee bulshada loogu adeegayo. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta la bixiyay, dhakhaatiirta Soomaaliyeed ayaa toddobaadkan bixiyay adeegyo ay ka mid yihiin daaweyn iyo la-talin caafimaad, iyadoo adeegyada loogu talagalay dadka aan awoodin inay iska bixiyaan kharashaadka caafimaadka. Bukaannada ka faa’iideysanaya adeegyada waxaa ka mid ah carruur, waayeel iyo hooyooyin. Warbixinno laga helay Tanzania ayaa xaqiijinaya in Vijibweni Hospital uu ka mid yahay xarumaha caafimaad ee loo asteeyay barnaamijka CIMIC, kaas oo lagu bixinayo adeegyo caafimaad oo takhasus leh. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Tanzania waxay diiwaangelisay Vijibweni inuu yahay isbitaal heer degmo ah oo dowladeed, kuna yaalla degmada Kigamboni ee gobolka Dar es Salaam. Barnaamijka guud ee EAC CIMIC Week kuma koobna caafimaadka oo keliya. Saraakiisha Tanzania waxay sheegeen in howlaha toddobaadkan ay sidoo kale ka mid yihiin taageerada xarumaha carruurta, xabsiyada iyo dayactirka qaar ka mid ah xarumaha adeegga bulshada ee Tanzania. Adeegyada caafimaadkana waxaa laga fulinayaa goobo ku yaalla Dar es Salaam, Pwani, Arusha iyo Zanzibar. Tanzania waxay markii ugu dambeysay martigelisay barnaamijkan sanadkii 2022, halka Soomaaliya la filayo inay martigeliso munaasabadda xigta, sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta dowladda Tanzania ee Daily News . EAC CIMIC Week waxaa loo adeegsadaa xoojinta iskaashiga ciidamada dalalka Bariga Afrika, iyadoo ciidamada iyo shaqaalaha rayidka ah ay si wadajir ah uga qeyb qaataan howlaha bani’aadannimo iyo adeegyada bulshada. EAC ayaa hore u sheegtay in barnaamijyada noocan ah ay diiradda saaraan caafimaadka, horumarinta bulshada iyo xoojinta xiriirka u dhexeeya ciidamada iyo bulshada. Howlaha caafimaad ee Vijibweni ayaa sidaas darteed noqday mid ka mid ah goobaha ay ka muuqato ka-qaybgalka Soomaaliya ee iskaashiga gobolka, iyadoo dhakhaatiirta Soomaaliyeed ay qeyb ka yihiin kooxaha caafimaad ee adeegyada u fidinaya bulshada Tanzania inta uu socdo barnaamijka EAC. The post Tanzania: Dhaqaatiir Soomaaliyeed Oo Daweeyay Ku Dhawaad 1,000 Qof first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Bayaannada Muqdisho iyo Garoowe Maxay ka Sheegayaan Burcadbadeedda Xeebaha Buntilaan?
items.description: Buntilaan iyo Burcadbadeedda Markabkii MV Lutuf ayaa 17kii Agoosto 2026 laga afduubtay meel u dhow xeebta Jiifle ee degmada Eyl. Waxaa muddo toban maalmood ku dhow lagu haystay agagaarka Garmaal iyo Jiifle degaanno ay Buntilaan maamusho. 29kii Agoosto, Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ee Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya waxay sheegtay in Ciidanka Badda Turkiga iyo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed ay markabka soo furteen, burburiyeen afar doonood oo burcadbadeeddu adeegsanaysay, dileenna 14 ka mid ah kooxda. Burcaddii hartay ayaa ka carartay markabka, shaqaalihiisiina xorriyaddoodii dib u helay. Buntilaan waxay hawlgalka kaga jawaabtay laba doodood oo isburinaya. Dhinac, waxay ka dhiidhiday dadkii lagu dilay Jiifle iyo Garmaal, iyada oo ku sheegtay kalluumaysato. Dhinaca kalana, waxay Dawladda Federaalka ah ku eedaysay in ay xiriir la samaysay kooxdii markabka laga soo furtay, madaxfurashana siisay. Haddaba, sidee ayay Buntilaan mar isaga bariyeeli kartaa burcadbadeedda, mar kalana ugu doodi kartaa dadkii lagu beegsaday hawlgalkii markabka lagaga soo furtay? Haddii dadka la dilay ahaayeen kalluumaysato, Buntilaan waxaa ku waajib ah in ay soo bandhigto magacyadooda iyo caddayn muujinaysa in aysan ka tirsanayn kooxdii markabka haysatay. Haddii ay ahaayeen burcadbadeed, u doodiddoodu waxay maamulka gelinaysaa meel adag. Haddii kalluumaysatada iyo burcadbadeeddu goobta wada joogeen, baaritaan madaxbannaan ayaa lagu kala caddayn karaa cidda la dilay. Bayaanka Buntilaan arrimahaas midna ma caddayn. Wuxuu isku dhex daray sheegidda dhimashada rayidka, burcadbadeedda, duqaynta iyo madaxfurashada; mana uusan soo bandhigin magacyada dadka dhintay, diiwaanka isgaarsiinta ama caddaynta lacagta la bixiyay. Waxaa kale oo aan laga jawaabin sababta markab la afduubtay muddo intaas la eg loogu haystay xeeb ay Buntilaan ka arrimiso. Yaa burcadbadeedda sahayda siinayay?Maxay ciidamada Buntilaan u qaban waayeen? Immisa qof ayaa afduubka loo xiray? Haddii Garoowe taqaanay kooxda, goobta ay joogtay iyo cidda la xiriiraysay, maxay iyadu markabka u soo furan weyday? Heshiiskii Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga oo dhaqangalay Hawlgalku wuxuu muujiyay in Heshiiskii Iskaashiga Difaaca iyo Dhaqaalaha ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkigu uusan ku ekayn waraaqo la saxiixayn. Baarlamaanka Federaalku wuxuu heshiiska ansixiyay Febraayo 2024, muddadiisuna waa toban sannadood. Waxaa ka mid ah ilaalinta xeebaha, dhisidda Ciidanka Badda Soomaaliyeed iyo ladagaallanka burcadbadeedda iyo kalluumaysiga sharcidarrada ah. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiggu waxay si cad u sheegtay in hawlgalka MV Lutuf lagu fuliyay heshiiskaas. Farriinta siyaasadeed ee arrintaasi xambaarsanayd waxay ahayd in Dawladda Federaalka ahi heshiiskeeda caalamiga ah kaga hawlgeli karto xeebaha dalka, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa ay Buntilaan maamusho. Halkaas ayaa laga fahmi karaa sababta bayaanka Buntilaan u kululaa. Markab lagu haystay degaan ay maamusho ayaa waxaa soo furtay Dawladda Federaalka ah oo kaashanaysa Turkiga. Hawlgalku markabka oo keliya ma soo furin; wuxuu, sidoo kale, muujiyay dhaqangalka heshiiska iyo awoodda Dawladda Federaalka ah ee difaaca badda. Weli lama hayo caddayn lagu xaqiijin karo in maamulka Buntilaan uu gacansaar la leeyahay burcadbadeedda. Hase yeeshee, Garoowe waxay ku fashilantay in ay iska fogayso tuhunkaba. Waxay u doodday dadkii lagu dilay goobihii ay burcadbadeeddu ka hawlgalaysay, iyada oo aan aqoonsigooda caddayn; waxayna Dawladda Federaalka ah ku eedaysay in ay xiriir la samaysay burcadbadeedda, iyada oo aan daliil soo bandhigin. Buntilaan hal mar iskama bariyeeli karto burcadbadeedda, ugumana doodi karto dadkii lagu beegsaday hawlgalkii markabka lagaga soo furtay, ilaa ay caddayso in dadkaasi rayid ahaayeen. Waxaa hadda horyaal laba waajib: in ay xaqiijiso cidda la dilay iyo in ay sharraxdo sida burcadbadeeddu markab ugu haysatay xeebaha Nugaal muddo toban maalmood ku dhow.

items.title: Duulimaadyadii Soomaaliya iyo Kenya oo Maalintii Labaad Hakad ku Jira
items.description: Maalintii labaad waxaa hakad ku jira duulimaadyadii isku xiri jiray Soomaaliya iyo Kenya, iyadoo aan weli wax diyaarad ah u kala gooshin labada dal. Qiyaastii 4 ilaa 6 duulimaad ayaa maalin kasta u kala safri jiray Soomaaliya iyo Kenya. Hakadka duulimaadyadan ayaa sababay in labadii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay ay safarradii uga baaqdaan rakaab lagu qiyaasay ku dhowaad 500 qof oo qorsheystay inay u kala safraan labada dal. Ilaa hadda, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya wax war rasmi ah kama soo saarin sababta keentay baaqashada duulimaadyada. Inkastoo marar hore ay hakadyo noocan oo kale ah u dhaceen duulimaadyada Soomaaliya iyo Kenya, haddana sida la sheegay, marna hakadku ma qaadan muddo ka badan 24 saacadood, halka hakadka hadda socda uu galay maalintii labaad. Waxaa weli la sugayaa war rasmi ah oo ku saabsan sababta keentay hakadka iyo goorta ay dib u bilaaban doonaan duulimaadyada isku xira Soomaaliya iyo Kenya.

items.title: Taliska Militariga oo baaris ku wada askar tacaddi u gaysatay maxbuus ka tirsan Al Shabaab

items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo booqday cisbatalka guud ee Hargeisa qaybta Kelyaha
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa saaka booqasho shaqo ku tegay Qaybta Sifaynta Kelyaha ee Cusbitaalka Guud ee Hargeysa, halkaas oo lagu soo kordhiyey 12 mishiin oo cusub oo loogu talagalay adeegga sifaynta kelyaha. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu kormeer ku sameeyey adeegyada cusub, isaga oo warbixin faahfaahsan ka dhegaystay masuuliyiinta Cusbitaalka, isla markaana mid mid u dul istaagay bukaannada ku tiirsan adeegga sifaynta kelyaha, kana waraystay xaaladdooda caafimaad iyo adeegyada ay helaan. Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Cirro waxa uu sheegay in Xukuumaddu ay si dhab ah uga jawaabtay dareenkii iyo cabashooyinkii bukaannada kelyaha, isagoo xusay in daryeelka bukaannada iyo horumarinta adeegyada sifaynta kelyaha la siin doono mudnaan gaar ah oo ka mid ah siyaasadda Xukuumadda ee horumarinta adeegyada caafimaadka dalka. Kordhinta 12-ka mishiin ee cusub waxa ay qayb ka tahay fulinta ballanqaadkii Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee ahaa in la horumariyo adeegyada sifaynta kelyaha ee Cusbitaallada dalka, lana xaqiijiyo helitaanka agabka, daawooyinka iyo adeegyada lagama maarmaanka u ah daryeelka bukaannada kelyaha, gaar ahaan kuwa noloshoodu si joogto ah ugu xidhan tahay adeeggan muhiimka ah. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyey in daryeelka caafimaadku yahay masuuliyad Qaran, isla markaana Xukuumaddiisu ay ka go’an tahay in muwaadin kasta helo adeeg caafimaad oo tayo leh. Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Cirro waxa uu sidoo kale tilmaamay in horumarinta adeegyada caafimaadku aanay ahayn oo keliya jawaab laga bixinayo baahida maanta jirta, balse ay tahay dhisidda nidaam caafimaad oo waara, jiilasha maanta iyo kuwa mustaqbalkaba u adeega. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu sheegay in Mishiinnada soo kordhay la gaadhsiin doono Cusbitaallada Boorama iyo Burco, sidoo kalena Cusbitaalka Ceerigaabo mustaqbalka dhaw laga hirgelin doono qaybta Sifeynta kelyaha. Tallaabadan ayaa ka tarjumaysa himilada Xukuumadda ee ah in horumarka Qaranka lagu cabbiro adeegyada tooska ah ee nolosha bulshada wax ka beddelaya, gaar ahaan caafimaadka, isla markaana raad muuqda oo waara looga tago daryeelka iyo bedbaadada muwaadiniinta.

items.title: Why Western Fast-Food Chains Skip Somalia
items.description: Somalia has no McDonald’s, no Starbucks, and no officially licensed KFC. Western fast-food chains have avoided the country entirely, even though fast food itself is everywhere; shawarma stands, burger shops, and fried chicken spots fill Mogadishu’s streets. Industry trackers group Somalia with Eritrea and Sierra Leone as countries major Western brands have never entered, citing prolonged instability. The gap isn’t about demand for fast food. Somalis eat out constantly, and the local fast-food scene is thriving. However, the instability that has shaped Somalia’s economy for decades has kept international franchise investment away. Local Fast Food Already Fills the Market Mogadishu’s streets are full of fast, affordable food. Burger stands, shawarma shops, and grilled meat carts operate on nearly every block. As a result, Western chains would be entering an already crowded market, not an empty one. A Mogadishu shop has reportedly used the “KFC” name on its signage. That operation is not affiliated with the licensed Kentucky Fried Chicken chain, however, and appears to be an unauthorized copycat rather than a franchise. Why Global Brands Still Stay Away Western fast-food chains typically require stable supply chains, secure real estate, and predictable regulation before opening abroad. Somalia has struggled to offer all three since the early 1990s. Meanwhile, local entrepreneurs have built resilient food businesses without any of that formal backing. Could That Change? Somalia’s security situation remains fragile, and large-scale foreign investment still carries real risk. Still, some analysts point to growing diaspora investment and improving conditions in parts of Mogadishu as early signs that international retail interest could eventually follow. For now, Somalia’s fast-food scene stays homegrown, just without the global logos. items.title: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo howlgal ay ka fuliyeen deegaanka Basra ku diley laba hoggaamiye oo Al-Shabaab ah
items.description: Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee Soomaaliya ayaa howlgal ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab ka bilaabay deegaanka Basra , oo ku yaalla dhulka u dhexeeya gobollada Shabeellaha Dhexe iyo Shabeellaha Hoose. Howlgalkan oo ay ciidamada dowladdu ku beegsanayaan fariisimo ay kooxda Al-Shabaab ku lahayd deegaanka ayaa, sida lagu sheegay war ka soo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, lagu dilay xubno ka tirsan dagaalyahannada Al-Shabaab, oo ay ku jiraan laba taliye oo sare oo kooxda ka tirsanaa. Ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale howlgalka ku qabsaday hub iyo saanad militari oo ay lahaayeen dagaalyahannada Al-Shabaab. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa sheegtay in howlgalku uu weli socdo, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda ay baacsanayaan xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab oo ka cararay goobihii uu dagaalku ka dhacay. Ujeeddada ciidamada ayaa lagu sheegay inay tahay in deegaanka Basra laga saaro kooxda, isla markaana dib loogu soo celiyo amniga iyo xasilloonida dadka deegaanka. Basra ayaa ah deegaan istiraatiiji ah oo ku dhow isku xirka labada gobol ee Shabeellaha Dhexe iyo Shabeellaha Hoose, waxaana deegaanada ku dhow dhow marar kala duwan ka dhacay howlgallo ciidan oo lagu bartilmaameedsanayo Al-Shabaab. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa bogaadisay ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo ku ammaantay geesinimada, naf-hurnimada iyo dadaalka ay ku bixinayaan sugidda amniga dalka. Wasaaraddu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo dadaallada lagu doonayo in dib loogu soo celiyo deegaanada ay kooxdu maamusho ay sii socon doonaan, iyadoo dowladda ay ku adkeysatay in dagaalka lagu wiiqayo awoodda kooxda uu yahay mid ka mid ah mudnaanta amni ee dalka.

items.title: Ciidanka Cirka Turkiga oo duqayn ka gaystay deegaanka Basra oo xiriiriya Labada Shabelle
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya deegaanka Basra ayaa sheegaya in qaraxyo xoogan ay maanta ka dhaceen deegaankaasi, gaar ahaan nawaaxiga jiinka Webiga Shabelle ee deegaankaasi. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Booliska Gaarka ee Haramcad ayaa dhulka ku xeeran Webiga Shabelle ee deegaankaasi ka wada hawlgal ay kaga sifeynayaan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in qaraxyadan ay ka dhashayn duqaymo xagga cirka ah, oo ay deegaankaasi ka fuliyeen Ciidanka Cirka Turkiga. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in Ciidanka Cirka Turkiga ay sii wadi doonaan hawlgalka hawada ee lagu taageerayo ciidamada hawlgalka sifeynta ah ka wada dhulka hawdka ee ku teedsan webiga ee deegaanka Basra. Ilo wareedyo muhiim ah ayaa sheegaya in Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar uu dardargelinayo dagaalka Al Shabaab looga saarayo deegaankaasi, isla-markaana uu leeyahay isku xirka hawlgalada hawada iyo dhulka ee ka socda deegaan beereedka Basra. Ciidanka Gaarka ee Xoogga Dalka ayaa lagu wadaa inay fariisimo joogta ah ka sameystaan deegaankaasi, si aysan Shabaabku dib dambe ugu soo laaban deegaanka. Deegaanka Basra waa deegaan istiraatiiji ah oo dhaca xuduudda Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose iyo Shabellaha Dhexe, waana deegaan aad ugu dhow goobta uu maro Webiga Shabelle, waana deegaan isku xira Magaalooyinka Afgooye iyo Balcad.

Soomaaliya iyo Yemen oo ka wada hadlay xoojinta xiriirka iyo amniga Badda Cas
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa magaalada Dooxa kula kulmay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Qurbajoogta Yemen, Dr. Afrah Al-Zouba, iyadoo kulanka looga hadlay xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo arrimaha amniga gobolka. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Yemen, iyo sidii loo adkeyn lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga, gaar ahaan Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Geeska Afrika. Sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Yemen, labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay muhiimadda ay leedahay in dalalka ku teedsan Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ay xoojiyaan wada-shaqeynta iyo isku-duwidda amniga, si loo ilaaliyo badqabka maraakiibta loogana hortago khataraha ay ka mid yihiin argagixisada, tahriibinta iyo burcad-badeedda. Kulankan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli amniga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed uu yahay arrin muhiim u ah xasilloonida gobolka Geeska Afrika iyo isu-socodka ganacsiga caalamiga ah.

Sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Yemen, labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay muhiimadda ay leedahay in dalalka ku teedsan Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed ay xoojiyaan wada-shaqeynta iyo isku-duwidda amniga, si loo ilaaliyo badqabka maraakiibta loogana hortago khataraha ay ka mid yihiin argagixisada, tahriibinta iyo burcad-badeedda. Kulankan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli amniga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed uu yahay arrin muhiim u ah xasilloonida gobolka Geeska Afrika iyo isu-socodka ganacsiga caalamiga ah.

items.title: Wararkii ugu dambeeyay dagaalka deegaanka Basra
items.description: Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo garabsanaya Booliska Sida Gaarka ah u tababaran ee Haramcad ayaa hawlgal sifayn ah ka wada deegaanka Basra oo ku yaala xadka kala qaybiya Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose iyo Shabellaha Dhexe. Ciidamada ayaa illaa Sabtidii agagaarka jiinka Webiga Shabelle ee deegaanka Basra kula dagaalamayay maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, iyadoona la soo sheegayo in weli ay dagaalo goos goos ah ka socdaan aagga qarka uu maro webiga ee deegaankaasi. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadu ay la wareegeen inta badan goobihii lagu dagaalamay, isla-markaana ay wadaan guluf ballaaran oo haraadiga Shabaab ay uga saarayaan godadka ay horey uga qoteen halkaasi. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadu ay si buuxda isugu fidinayaan dhulka hawdka ee ku xeeran hareeraha dhulka uu webigu maro, oo la doonayo in laga ciribtiro maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Basra waa deegaan istiraatiiji ah oo xiriiriya Magaalooyinka Afgooye iyo Balcad, waana goob ay Shabaabku u adeegsadaan inay isaga kala gudbaan Labada Shabelle. Deegaanka istiraatiijiga ah ee Basra ayaa muhiim u ah sugidda amniga iyo isu socodka Shabellooyinka iyo duleedka Magaalada Muqdisho. Hawlgalka ay ciidamadu ka wadaan Basra ayaa u muuqdo mid lagu xasillinayo amniga deegaankaasi, isla-markaana looga suulinayo kooxaha argagixisada. Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa kuu sheegaya in qorshuhu uu yahay in ciidamadu ay deggaan deegaankaasi, iyadoo laga hortagayo in Shabaabku ay ku soo laabtaan amaba ay u adeegsadaan goob ay ku dhuuntaan. Hawlgalada ay horey ciidamadu uga fuliyeen deegaanka ayaa waxay inta badan ku dhamaan jireen dhameystir la’aan, iyagoo aan si joogta ah u degi jirin deegaankaasi.

items.title: Mareykanka oo weeraray qalabka gantaallada laga rido ee Iiraan oo ku yaala jasiiradda Larak
items.description: Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa duqeyn ku qaaday laba xarumood oo ay yaalleyn qalabka laga rido gantaallada oo Iiraan leedahay jasiiradda Larak, sida uu sheegay sarkaal Mareykan ah. Tani waxay noqonaysaa duqeyntii ugu horreysay ee la ogyahay oo Mareykanku ku qaado Iiraan tan iyo dhammaadkii bishii Luulyo. “Ciidamada Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah (IRGC) ayaa la arkayay iyagoo isu diyaarinaya inay gantaallo wata miinooyin badeed ku ridaan marinka Hormuz,” ayuu yiri taliyaha Tim Hawkins, oo ah afhayeenka Taliska Dhexe ee Mareykanka (CENTCOM), sida laga soo xigtay CBS News oo BBC bah-wadaag la ah. IRGC ayaa sheegtay in weerarkii Axaddii lagu dilay laba qof, laba kalena lagu dhaawacay, iyadoo ku hanjabtay “jawaab iyo ciqaab”. Warbaahinta dowladda Iiraan ayaa markii dambe sheegtay in IRGC ay weerar ku qaaday bartilmaameedyo militari oo Mareykanku leeyahay oo ku yaalla Urdun. BBC ayaa la xiriirtay CENTCOM si ay uga hesho faallo ku saabsan arrintan, balse kama soo jawaabin Ciidamada difaaca cirka ayaa qabtay siddeed gantaal oo ku soo xadgudbay hawada Boqortooyada waaberigii maanta oo Isniin ah,” ayay ciidamada qalabka sida ee Urdun ku sheegeen bayaan, sida ay werisay wakaaladda wararka dowladda ee Petra, iyagoo soo xiganaya afhayeenka ciidamada. Duqeynta Mareykanka ayaa ah weerarkii ugu horreeyay inta ee la ogyahay oo Iiraan lagu qaado tan iyo markii Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu hakiyay hawl-galladdii militari ee dhacay dhammaadkii bishii Luulyo. Jasiiradda Larak waxay wax yar u jirtaa dekedda muhiimka ah ee Bandar Abbas, waxayna ku taallaa si toos ah marinka Hormuz, oo ah marin-biyood muhiim u ah maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamka. Iiraan ayaa xilligan ku qasbaysa maraakiibta shidaalka qaada inay jasiiraddan agteeda maraan si loo baaro, waxaana la sheegayaa inay maraakiibta ku qasbeyso inay bixiyaan $2 milyan (£1.5 milyan) si ay uga gudbaan. Hosseïn Mohebbi, afhayeenka IRGC, ayaa weerarka ku tilmaamay “khalad istiraatiiji ah oo halis ah oo uu galay taliska Trump”, wuxuuna sheegay in “cadowgu uu bixin doono cawaaqibka xisaabtan-darradan dhinacyada dhaqaalaha iyo militarigaba”. Wakaaladda wararka Tasnim ee Iiraan, oo xiriir la leh IRGC, ayaa hore u sheegtay in weerarka lagu fuliyay diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn (drones). Saacado kadib, warbaahinta Iiraan ayaa baahisay bayaan ay IRGC ku sheegtay inay gantaallo ballistic ah ku weerartay saldhigyada Mareykanka ee King Hussein iyo Al-Azraq ee Urdun, taas oo ay ku tilmaantay jawaabtii weerarkii Jasiiradda Larak. IRGC waxay sheegtay inay geysatay “khasaaro xooggan”, ayna bartilmaameedsatay “kaabayaasha farsamada, xarumaha dayactirka iyo goobaha ay fadhiyaan diyaaradaha dagaalka ee cadowga”, sida lagu sheegay tarjumaad ay samaysay wakaaladda wararka AFP. Saacado kadib duqeynta, Trump ayaa bartiisa Truth Social soo dhigay muuqaallo muuqaal ahaan u ekaa kuwo AI lagu sameeyay, kuwaas oo muujinaya kaabayaal shidaal oo qarxaya. Mid ka mid ah muuqaaladaas waxaa uu ku qoray: “Jasiiradda Kharg oo burbureysa!” Qoraalkiisa faahfaahin dheeraad ah kama bixin. Trump ayaa toddobaadkii hore sheegay in dhammaan miinooyinkii ay Iiraan dhigtay marinka Hormuz iyada oo qayb ka ah dadaalladeeda lagu xannibayo marinka, la qarxiyay ama laga saaray. Wuxuu sheegay in Iiraan looga digay in markab ama doon kasta oo dhigta miinooyin cusub “la burburin doono”. Ku-xigeenka Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda ee Iiraan, Kazem Gharibabadi, ayaa hadalka Trump ku tilmaamay “dacaayad iyo marin-habaabin”. Iiraan ayaa wajahaysa cadaadis dhaqaale oo cusub kadib markii Washington ay 24-kii Agoosto ku dhawaaqday olole cusub oo cunaqabateyn ah, kaas oo looga gol leeyahay in Tehran sii go’doomiso isla markaana cunaqabateynaha labaad lagu ballaariyo xulafadeeda. Saraakiisha Iiraan iyo warbaahinta dowladda ayaa inta badan meesha ka saaray ololahan, iyaga oo ku tilmaamay inuu yahay sii wadidda tallaabooyinkii hore ee dhaqaale ee Mareykanka. Waxay ku doodayaan in tallaabooyinkaas ay daba socdeen fashilka militari ee Washington kala kulantay dagaalkii dhowaan dhacay. Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ayaa 28-kii Febraayo qaaday duqeymo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Iiraan. Iiraan ayaa iyaduna ka jawaabtay iyadoo weerartay Israa’iil, saldhigyada Mareykanka iyo dalalka xulafada la ah ee Khaliijka, waxayna si wax ku ool ah u xirtay marinka Hormuz oo ay maraakiibtu isticmaalaan. Dagaalka Iiraan ayaa hadda dhaafay lix bilood. Qiyaastii 20% shidaalka dunida iyo gaaska dabiiciga ah ee dareeraha ah (LNG) ayaa marayay marinkan ka hor inta uusan dagaalku bilaaban.
