items.title: Puntland Challenges Mogadishu’s ‘Rescue’ Claim Over MV Lutuf, Alleges Ransom Deal
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Puntland has sharply challenged the Federal Government of Somalia’s account of the release of the MV Lutuf, alleging that the vessel was not rescued in a military operation but released after a ransom was paid to the pirates who had held it hostage. The Puntland Ministry of Security condemned the reported ransom payment, describing it as a serious setback to efforts to combat piracy and warning that paying millions of dollars to hostage-takers risks creating a powerful financial incentive for future hijackings. Puntland also rejected the Somali Federal Government’s claim that the Turkish Navy, working alongside Somali forces, forcibly rescued the vessel from pirates. Mogadishu had presented the operation as a successful maritime-security intervention following the hijacking of the Cameroon-flagged vessel on August 17 off the Jifle coast near Eyl in Puntland’s Nugaal region. Instead, Puntland alleged that officials within the Federal Government of Somalia facilitated the ransom payment and established direct contact with the pirates holding the MV Lutuf, contradicting Mogadishu’s characterization of the vessel’s release as a successful military rescue operation. Puntland did not publicly provide independently verifiable evidence to substantiate the allegation. Nevertheless, the claim has added another layer of controversy to an already disputed account of how the vessel was freed. The conflicting narratives raise a fundamental question: Was the MV Lutuf actually liberated through a military operation, or was the release secured through a multimillion-dollar ransom agreement? That distinction matters. If the vessel was released following a ransom payment, portraying the outcome as a military rescue could obscure the reality of what happened and raise questions about the credibility of official statements concerning Somalia’s maritime security. The controversy is particularly striking given Somalia’s limited naval capabilities. Despite possessing one of Africa’s longest coastlines, the country has struggled to establish a sufficiently equipped and independent maritime force capable of consistently protecting its territorial waters and confronting organized piracy. The incident also carries significant political weight because the vessel was released off Puntland’s coast, where relations between Puntland and the Federal Government have deteriorated sharply. Puntland has repeatedly challenged Mogadishu’s authority and has accused the federal authorities of conducting security operations in its territory without proper consultation or authorization. The unresolved question of the ransom The reported ransom—estimated at $2.5 million—would represent a major financial reward for the pirates and could reinforce the economic model that has allowed piracy networks to survive despite years of international naval patrols. If confirmed, the payment could send a troubling message to criminal networks operating along Somalia’s coastline: hijacking a vessel can still produce millions of dollars in revenue. That is precisely why Puntland has condemned the reported payment. The controversy is further complicated by the fate of fourteen men who were reportedly killed when a small boat allegedly carrying supplies to the hijacked vessel was struck in a separate bombardment. Questions remain over who ordered the strike, who was responsible for the operation and whether those killed were pirates, fishermen or other civilians. Puntland has accused Turkish forces of conducting attacks along the Nugaal coastline and has demanded accountability over civilian deaths. Turkish authorities, however, have not publicly accepted responsibility for the alleged bombardments. Turkey’s expanding maritime role The MV Lutuf controversy comes as Turkey continues to expand its military and strategic involvement in Somalia. Turkish naval forces have increasingly operated in the wider Red Sea, Gulf of Aden and Indian Ocean region, while Ankara maintains close military ties with Mogadishu. For Puntland and Somalia’s political opposition, Turkey’s growing role has become increasingly controversial. Critics question whether foreign military deployments are genuinely focused on protecting Somalia’s maritime interests or are becoming intertwined with Mogadishu’s political and security calculations. The competing accounts over the MV Lutuf have therefore transformed what might otherwise have been a straightforward piracy incident into a broader dispute over sovereignty, accountability, foreign military involvement and the credibility of Somalia’s federal institutions. Mogadishu’s claim of a successful naval rescue projects an image of a government capable of defending Somalia’s territorial waters. Puntland’s account paints a very different picture: one in which pirates were ultimately paid to release their hostage and federal officials allegedly helped facilitate the deal. Until independent evidence establishes what actually occurred, neither narrative can be treated as definitive. But the questions will not disappear simply because the vessel has been released. Who negotiated with the pirates? Who authorized the payment? Where did the ransom money come from? Was a military rescue operation actually attempted? And if Turkish and Somali forces were involved, under whose authority were they operating? Those questions deserve clear answers. For Somalia, the deeper concern is not merely the fate of one ship. It is whether the country is building the institutions necessary to control its own maritime territory—or continuing to depend on foreign military powers, ransom negotiations and competing political authorities to manage crises along its coastline. The MV Lutuf case has exposed precisely that vulnerability. A ship may have been released, but the controversy surrounding Somalia’s maritime sovereignty is far from over. items.title: Somaliland Amid a Changing Geopolitical Landscape in the Region: Strategic Choices and Emerging Opportunities
items.description: Somaliland Amid a Changing Geopolitical Landscape in the Region: Strategic Choices and Emerging Opportunities   The political, economic, and geopolitical landscape of the Horn of Africa is increasingly volatile, with global powers and regional states competing for strategic influence. From a geopolitical perspective, the Horn of Africa is increasingly interconnected with the broader geopolitical dynamics of the Greater Middle East. Consequently, developments across the Greater Middle East can have a direct impact on the security, political, and socio-economic dynamics of the Horn of Africa The Horn of Africa is a volatile region, historically affected by failed states, prolonged authoritarian rule, conflict, and political instability. In contrast, Somaliland has emerged as a beacon of stability and democratic governance in the Horn of Africa. Its strategic geographical location further increas es its geopolitical importance. Why Somaliland Matters Strategically ? There are several strategic realities that make Somaliland increasingly important to global and middle powers and create emerging opportunities for the country First, Strategic geographical location: Somaliland is strategically located along the Gulf of Aden, near the Red Sea, with approximately 850 kilometers of coastline. Second, Berbera Port and maritime access: The deep-water Berbera Port, together with Somaliland’s broader coastline, provides a strategically important maritime position suitable for commercial port development and potentially for military and logistical facilities. Third, Proximity to critical maritime chokepoints: Somaliland is located close to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, one of the world’s most important maritime chokepoints, connecting the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden and the wider Indian Ocean. This geographical proximity gives Somaliland considerable strategic significance for global maritime trade and security. Fourth, marine and coastal resources: Somaliland’s extensive coastline contains significant marine resources and provides opportunities for investment in fisheries, maritime industries, logistics, and other sectors that can attract international investment. Fifth, Mineral and natural resources: Somaliland possesses potentially significant mineral resources, including rare earth elements and other underexplored natural resources. These resources could increase its attractiveness to global competitors seeking access to critical minerals and new investment opportunities. Sixth, Political stability and democratic governance: Somaliland has maintained relative peace and political stability and has developed a system of democratic governance characterized by peaceful political transitions and elections. This distinguishes Somaliland from several states in the wider Horn of Africa. Seventh, Maritime security: Somaliland’s Coast Guard plays an important role in monitoring and protecting its extensive coastline along the Gulf of Aden. It also contributes to wider maritime security efforts and the protection of international commercial shipping, despite having limited internat ional assistance and resources. These strategic realities are making Somaliland increasingly important to global and middle powers. Its strategic geographical location, political stability, proximity to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, modernization of Berbera Port, marine and natural resources, and maritime security capabilities provide a strong foundation for deeper economic, diplomatic, and defense cooperation Who are major Global Powers Competing for Influence in the region? The major global powers competing for strategic influence in the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea include the United States, China, and Russia. Their engagement in the region is driven by a combination of security, economic, maritime, and broader geopolitical interests. The United States ​ The United States has maintained a significant presence and strategic interest in the Horn of Africa for decades. Its engagement has included humanitarian assistance, development programs, diplomatic engagement, and counterterrorism efforts aimed at addressing extremist gro ups and protecting broader its national security interests. However, the changing geopolitical environment is creating new strategic calculations for Washington. China has significantly expanded its presence in the region, including through its military base in Djibouti and its broader infrastructure and economic investments unde r the Belt and Road Initiative. Although China has financed major infrastructure projects across Africa, its growing economic engagement has created substantial economic relationships. However, some African countries have accumulated significant levels of debt to Chinese lenders and face challenges in servicing these obligations, raising concerns about debt sustainability and the potential for long-term strategic dependence . This changing environment provides the United States with an incentive to diver sify its strategic partnerships and strengthen its engagement with strategically located coastal states such as Somaliland, which is geographically positioned away from China’s military presence in Djibouti. The United States has also had a historical connection with Berbera. During the Cold War, the United States used Berbera’s strategic facilities, while the port and military infrastructure later became associated with wider regional strategic competition. T oday, the United Arab Emirates, a close U.S. ally, has played an important role in the development and modernization of Berbera Port and its surrounding infrastructure . China China has become one of the most influential external powers in the Horn of Africa. Its presence in Djibouti, combined with its investments in infrastructure, ports, roads, and other strategic sectors across the region, has significantly increased Be ijing’s geopolitical influence. China’s Belt and Road Initiative has strengthened its economic connectivity with countries across the Horn of Africa and the wider Red Sea region. Its expanding economic and military presence has consequently become an important factor in the strategic calculations of the United States and other global po wers. In this context, Somaliland’s geographical position provides an alternative strategic location for the United States to enhance its presence in the region and strengthen its position in the Gulf of Aden and the Red Sea, while maintaining a degree of strategic distance from China’s established military presence in Djibouti. Russia Russia also has a historical relationship with the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea. During the Soviet era, Moscow maintained a significant presence in the reg ion and had a military base with Berbera in Somaliland. Decades later, Russia is seeking to rebuild and expand its influence in the Red Sea , and the wider Horn of Africa, particularly interest to establish military base in Port Sudan. Moscow’s renewed interest in establishing strategic maritime access and strengthening its relations with regional states demonstrates that the Horn of Africa is once again becoming an important arena of global geopolitical competition. Who are the Midd le powers competing for Influence in the region? There are five middle powers have significant influence in the Horn of Africa and seek to protect their security, economic, and stra tegic interests in the Red Sea. 1. Turkey Turkey entered the Horn of Africa in 2011 through humanitarian diplomacy, providing humanitarian assistance to Somalia during its crisis. However, it has now moved beyond humanitarian diplomacy and has invested heavily in Somalia, including establishing its largest overseas military base in Mogadishu. Turkey’s main interest in the Horn of Africa is to expand its geopolitical, economic, and maritime influence near vital Red Sea trade routes, while using Somalia as its primary regional anchor. For Somaliland, Turkey’s close ties with Somalia and opposition to Somaliland’s recognition reflect concerns over its strategic interests in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden, as well as Israel’s growing regional presence and its relations with Somaliland, alongside potential concerns over the surveillance of sensitive facilities in Somalia, including its spaceport and missile-testing facilities . 2. Iran Iran has direct influence in the Red Sea through its regi onal proxy networks notably the Houthis in Yemen, which pose a significant threat to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and the Red Sea by targeting Western and Israeli-linked vessels. Iran’s main interests are to expand its regional influence, counter the Sunni Gulf states, pressure Western powers, and influence critical maritime routes in the Red Sea. For Somaliland , the security situation created by Houthi activity backed Iran increases the strategic importance of its location along the Gulf of Aden and strengthens the potent ial value of maritime security cooperation. 3. Saudi Arabia Saudi Arabia considers the Red Sea to be closely connected to its national security. It has maintained a long-standing rivalry with Iran in order to protect its interests in the Red Sea and the wider region. Saudi Arabia has developed relations with Djibouti and Eritrea and provides military and economic support to Yemen’s internationally recognized government and Sudanese forces led by General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan. Saudi Arabia continues to oppose Somaliland’s recognition and maintains engagement with Somalia, while the UAE and Israel, both partners of Somaliland, and compete for influence in the Red Sea. However, Somaliland continues to seek Saudi and broader Islamic recognition, emphasizing that its relations with Israel do not undermine Arab and Muslim interests. 4. United Arab Emirates (UAE) The UAE has made significant economic investments in Berbera Port and has maintained a military presence there. Its main interests in the Horn of Africa are securing critical Red Sea shipping lanes, expanding commercial logistics, and pro jecting geopolitical influence. For Somaliland, relations with the United Arab Emirates create opportunities for economic cooperation, security partnerships, and broader international engagement . 5. Israel Israel has increasingly developed a strategic presence in the region, particularly following its formal recognition of Somaliland. Israel’s primary interests in the Horn of Africa are securing vital Red Sea shipping lanes, countering threats from Iran and the Houthis, and expanding dip lomatic and security alliances . For Somaliland, cooperation with Israel creates a new diplomatic avenue to broaden its international position, strengthen its security and defense capabilities, and expand engagement with Western countries, particularly the United States . Somaliland’s strategic choice s and Emerging opportunities Somaliland’s formal recognition by Israel in late December 2025 mar ked a significant development in it’s the global stage. However, Somaliland continues to seek broader international recognition, particularly from Western powers led by the United States. Its strategic location along the Gulf of Aden, proximity to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, extensive coastline, relative political stability, and developing Berbera Port provide a strong foundation for deeper strate gic engagement with Washington. For the United States, Somaliland could offer a strategically located partner for strengthening maritime security, protecting international shipping, and responding to growing geopolitical competition in the Red Sea and the Horn of Africa. For Somaliland, closer strategic cooperation with the United States could create opportunities to strengthen its security capabilities, attract investment, expand diplomatic engagement, and advance its long-term objective of bro ader international recognition. The strategic choice for Somaliland is therefore not simply to seek recognition, but to transform its geopolitical advantages into sustainable strategic partnerships. By positioning itself as a reliable partner for the United States in Red Sea security, Somaliland can convert its geographic position into geopolitical leverage while safeguarding its political interests and advancing its path toward broader international recognition . Author: Mohamed Abdisamad Ibrahim Executive Director, Laasgeel Institute for Policy Studies an d Research Analysis (LIPS ) M.A . in Intern ational Relations and Diplomacy Geopolitical Analyst – Horn of Africa .

For Somaliland, Turkey’s close ties with Somalia and opposition to Somaliland’s recognition reflect concerns over its strategic interests in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden, as well as Israel’s growing regional presence and its relations with Somaliland, alongside potential concerns over the surveillance of sensitive facilities in Somalia, including its spaceport and missile-testing facilities . 2. Iran Iran has direct influence in the Red Sea through its regi onal proxy networks notably the Houthis in Yemen, which pose a significant threat to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and the Red Sea by targeting Western and Israeli-linked vessels. Iran’s main interests are to expand its regional influence, counter the Sunni Gulf states, pressure Western powers, and influence critical maritime routes in the Red Sea. For Somaliland , the security situation created by Houthi activity backed Iran increases the strategic importance of its location along the Gulf of Aden and strengthens the potent ial value of maritime security cooperation. 3. Saudi Arabia Saudi Arabia considers the Red Sea to be closely connected to its national security. It has maintained a long-standing rivalry with Iran in order to protect its interests in the Red Sea and the wider region. Saudi Arabia has developed relations with Djibouti and Eritrea and provides military and economic support to Yemen’s internationally recognized government and Sudanese forces led by General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan. Saudi Arabia continues to oppose Somaliland’s recognition and maintains engagement with Somalia, while the UAE and Israel, both partners of Somaliland, and compete for influence in the Red Sea. However, Somaliland continues to seek Saudi and broader Islamic recognition, emphasizing that its relations with Israel do not undermine Arab and Muslim interests. 4. United Arab Emirates (UAE) The UAE has made significant economic investments in Berbera Port and has maintained a military presence there. Its main interests in the Horn of Africa are securing critical Red Sea shipping lanes, expanding commercial logistics, and pro jecting geopolitical influence. For Somaliland, relations with the United Arab Emirates create opportunities for economic cooperation, security partnerships, and broader international engagement . 5. Israel Israel has increasingly developed a strategic presence in the region, particularly following its formal recognition of Somaliland. Israel’s primary interests in the Horn of Africa are securing vital Red Sea shipping lanes, countering threats from Iran and the Houthis, and expanding dip lomatic and security alliances . For Somaliland, cooperation with Israel creates a new diplomatic avenue to broaden its international position, strengthen its security and defense capabilities, and expand engagement with Western countries, particularly the United States . Somaliland’s strategic choice s and Emerging opportunities Somaliland’s formal recognition by Israel in late December 2025 mar ked a significant development in it’s the global stage. However, Somaliland continues to seek broader international recognition, particularly from Western powers led by the United States. Its strategic location along the Gulf of Aden, proximity to the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, extensive coastline, relative political stability, and developing Berbera Port provide a strong foundation for deeper strate gic engagement with Washington. For the United States, Somaliland could offer a strategically located partner for strengthening maritime security, protecting international shipping, and responding to growing geopolitical competition in the Red Sea and the Horn of Africa. For Somaliland, closer strategic cooperation with the United States could create opportunities to strengthen its security capabilities, attract investment, expand diplomatic engagement, and advance its long-term objective of bro ader international recognition. The strategic choice for Somaliland is therefore not simply to seek recognition, but to transform its geopolitical advantages into sustainable strategic partnerships. By positioning itself as a reliable partner for the United States in Red Sea security, Somaliland can convert its geographic position into geopolitical leverage while safeguarding its political interests and advancing its path toward broader international recognition . Author: Mohamed Abdisamad Ibrahim Executive Director, Laasgeel Institute for Policy Studies an d Research Analysis (LIPS ) M.A . in Intern ational Relations and Diplomacy Geopolitical Analyst – Horn of Africa .

items.title: Daawo: Koonfur Galbeed oo Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ku dartay liiska argagixisada
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Wasiirrada Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya oo maanta shir deg-deg ah ku yeeshay magaalada Baydhaba ayaa qaraar kasoo saaray xaaladda maamulkaasi, iyaga oo liiska argagixisada ku daray Madaxweynihii hore ee maamulka Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen iyo ciidamadiisa. Shirka oo uu guddoomiyay Madaxweyne Aadan Madoobe ayaa laga soo saaray qaarar ku aadan xoojinta amniga iyadoo sidoo kale shirka lagu soo bandhigay caddeymaha la xiriira ‘iskaashiga ka dhexeeya Al-Shabaab iyo ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen’ kaas oo hadda dagaal kula jira maamulka Aadan Madoobe. Golaha Wasiirrada Koonfur Galbeed oo ka hadlay dagaalladii ugu dambeeyay ayaa sheegay in loo adeegsaday qaraxyo, ayna si wdajir ah u fuliyeen ciidamada Lafta-gareen iyo maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab. Sidoo kale, golaha ayaa shaaca ka qaaday inay cambaareynayaan falalka argagixiso, rabshadaha hubeysan, qaraxyada iyo isku day kasta oo lagu carqaladeynayo amniga deegaannada Koonfur Galbeed Soomaliya. Intaas kadib golaha ayaa ku dhawaaqay in Lafta-gareen iyo ciidamadiisa ay ku dareen liiska argagixisada, kadib qiimeyn ay ku sameeyeen sheegashadiisii ku aadaneyd weerarradii ay maalmo kahor kusoo qaadeen magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay. “Goluhu markii uu si qoto dheer u falanqeeyay wareysigii uu bixiyay Cabdicasiis kaas oo uu ku sheegay in ciidamadiisu iyo kooxda Al-Shabaab ay si nabad ah u wada joogaan, ugana wada nool yihiin goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin iyo ficillada ay wada sameeyeen wuxuu goluhu si rasmi ah ugu aqoonsaday horjooge Lafta-gareen isaga iyo maleeshiyaadkiisa inay yihiin argagixiso si rasmi ah ugu biiray ulana midoobay Khawaarijta,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Dhanka kale, golaha ayaa farriin u diray dowladda Soomaaliya oo ay ka codsadeen inay xoojiyso taageerada amni ee ay siiso Koonfur Galbeed, waxayna soo jeediyeen in si isku mid ah loola dagaalamo Lafta-gareen iyo Al-Shabaab. “Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Koonfur Galbeed waxay si wadajir ah ula tacaamuli doonaan sida loola tacaamulo kooxdaha argagixisada, sidaas darteed goluhu wuxuu DFS usoo jeedinayaa inay xoojiso taageerada amni iyo ciidan ee dowladda Koonfur Galbeed,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri qaraarka.   The post Daawo: Koonfur Galbeed oo Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ku dartay liiska argagixisada appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Victims of enforced disappearance – list of names should be realised
items.description: VICTIMS OF ENFORCED DISAPPEARANCES – LIST OF NAMES SHOULD BE RELEASED Based on various sources, the estimated number of victims of enforced disappearances who were arrested or surrendered during the last phase of the war is over 18,000. As exhumed skeletons of the victims continue to pile up, the immediate release of a list of victims of enforced disappearances is vital for carrying out scientific processes, such as DNA matching with biological relatives, to identify each set of remains. This process will be the first step toward exploring the circumstances that led to these crimes, identifying the perpetrators, initiating judicial proceedings, and allowing relatives to pay their final respects in a dignified manner. The documents provided below indicate that the number of victims exceeds 18,000: ICRC ‘Over 15,000 missing in Sri Lanka’: Report reveals More than fifteen thousand people were reported missing in Sri Lanka by the end of 2011, according to figures released by the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). The annual report unveiled in Geneva by ICRC President Jakob Kellenberger stated that “thousands remained unaccounted for, leaving relatives without definitive information about their fate” in Sri Lanka. In its report describing the harm that armed conflicts inflict on populations around the world, the ICRC noted that it had been trying to trace 15,780 people in Sri Lanka as of 31 December 2011. The vast majority were men, while tracing cases for 1,494 children and 754 women were also being handled by the ICRC. Only as few as 136 people had been traced to their families. Additionally, the ICRC had visited 17,741 detainees during the preceding year. AHRC SRI LANKA: 15,780 persons have disappeared under the Rajapaksa regime – Asian Human Rights Commission, 06 July 2012 Among those 15,780 persons who went missing, the majority were males, while 1,494 children and 754 females were also included in these reports. http://www.humanrights.asia/news/forwarded-news/AHRC-FAT-021-2012/ AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL Sri Lanka: Provide families of those subject to enforced disappearance with complete lists. https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/asa37/8444/2018/en/ Sri Lanka has one of the world’s highest number of disappearances, with a backlog of between 60,000 and 100,000 alleged disappearances since the late 1980s. Given the lack of accountability for these cases, Amnesty International has noted that there is no shortage of examples of thwarted justice in Sri Lanka. Missing Persons Commission receives over 18,000 complaints (06 June 2014) A Sri Lankan panel probing the disappearance of people during the country’s nearly three-decade long civil war has received nearly 18,600 complaints from the public, a senior official has said. https://adaderana.lk/news/26965 OMP Sri Lanka Has 17,000 Active Missing Persons Cases, Many Connected to LTTE Conflict – Sri Lanka’s Office of Missing Persons (OMP) “We are dealing with 23,352 cases in our database,” the Chairman Mahesh Katulanda said on Thursday while addressing an event to mark the International Day of the Victims of Enforced Disappearances, observed on August 30. He added that there are 16,966 active case files of disappearances after weeding out duplicates and those missing in action. According to an official estimate, around 20,000 people are believed to be missing after the end of the war with the LTTE, which killed over 100,000 people. https://www.deccanchronicle.com/nation/sri-lanka-missing-persons-office-has-nearly-17000-active-cases-1979127 BTF For over a decade, based on credible documentary evidence, the British Tamils Forum (BTF) has consistently called for the release of information and clarification regarding the fate of more than 18,000 Tamil victims who were arrested or surrendered during the final phase of the war. IMMEDIATE ACTION: Release of Information: The international community should exert leverage on Sri Lanka and other stakeholders to release a comprehensive list containing names, dates of disappearance, and the contact details of biological relatives. Relatives of the victims of enforced disappearance need to work with relevant UN institutions to compare lists and ensure all victims are recorded in a single comprehensive database. DNA Matching: A centralised database will enable the rapid identification of exhumed skeletons—such as the 583 found in Chemmani and others discovered elsewhere—using a DNA databank. Without this list, the chances of identifying these remains will be minimized. International DNA Databank: Establish an internationally supervised DNA databank, collect reference samples in Sri Lanka and across the global Tamil diaspora, and carry out the matching process in the United Kingdom or an EU member state. Access for DNA Collection: Sri Lanka must permit the UK or an EU member state to collect DNA samples and match them with skeletons and other physical remains preserved from crime scenes. Forensic Experts Deployment: Immediately deploy accredited forensic anthropologists, pathologists, and legal experts to all identified mass grave sites to ensure full compliance with the Minnesota Protocol and international criminal law standards. Geospatial & Satellite Analysis: Conduct satellite imagery and geospatial analysis across all known and suspected mass grave locations from the conflict and post-conflict periods. Immediate Excavations: Begin immediate excavations at identified sites, including Mandaitivu and other locations highlighted through witness testimonies and forensic evidence. Evidence Protection: Protect and preserve all forensic evidence and crime scenes. Victim Family Involvement: Guarantee the full participation of victims’ families throughout all investigative processes. Unrestricted Oversight: Allow international forensic experts and technical specialists full, unrestricted access to oversee the identification process in compliance with recognised international standards. Transparent Reporting: Issue periodic publications to ensure transparent reporting on victim identification progress, crime execution details, identified perpetrators, and the chain of command. Accountability Investigations: Investigate command responsibility, institutional responsibility, and state responsibility. Remedies & Non-Recurrence: Provide guarantees of non-recurrence and offer effective remedies to affected families. Prompt Return of Remains: Ensure exhumed remains are returned promptly to biological relatives, allowing families to pay their last respects and perform final funeral rites in a dignified manner. Time is critical. The Sri Lankan state’s calculated strategy across successive governments has been to delay actionable items related to justice and accountability. This delay is intended to eventually diffuse pressure from victims’ communities and international bodies, including UN mechanisms, through temporary commissions of inquiry and empty assurances to member states, regional frameworks (such as the EU), and global institutions like the World Bank and IMF. The international community must establish a clear set of actionable items with a time-bound implementation plan to ensure Sri Lanka demonstrates tangible results. CRIMINAL JUSTICE: Ensure Sri Lanka cooperates with the international community on accountability and justice processes (including OSLAP) and agrees to an international criminal justice mechanism. NON-RECURRENCE: Secure a political solution featuring substantial power-sharing, official recognition of the Tamil nation, and the recognition of the legitimate aspirations of the Tamil people. REPARATIONS: Take immediate steps to resettle and repatriate Tamils who fled their traditional homeland, reconstruct the war-torn region, and bring the North-East region up to par with the rest of the island.

items.title: Madaxii sirdoonka Shabaab oo la shaaciyay in la dilay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Hay’adda Nabad-sugidda iyo Sirdoonka Qaranka (NISA) oo kaashanaysa saaxiibada caalamka ayaa howl-gal ka dhacay degmada Jilib ee gobolka Jubbada Dhexe ku dishay mid ka mid ah madaxda sare ee kooxda Al-Shabaab. Howl-galka ayaa dhacay 23-kii August 2026, waxaana lagu dilay Cabdullaahi Xaashi Labajir oo kooxda Al-Shabaab ay u taqaanay Ikhlaas, kaas oo hayay xilka madaxa guud ee sirdoonka kooxda. Sida ay sheegtay NISA, Ikhlaas wuxuu xilka madaxa sirdoonka Al-Shabaab hayay tan iyo 2013-kii, taas oo ka dhigan inuu muddo dheer ka mid ahaa saraakiisha muhiimka ah ee kooxda. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in Ikhlaas uu ka mid ahaa horjoogayaasha ugu halista badan ee hoggaanka sare ee Al-Shabaab, isagoo door muhiim ah ku lahaa howlaha sirdoonka iyo qorsheyaasha amni ee kooxda. NISA ayaa sheegtay inay faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka bixin doonto howl-galka iyo xogta la xiriirta dilka Cabdullaahi Xaashi Labajir (Ikhlaas). Jilib ayaa ah deegaan muhiim ah oo muddo dheer saldhig u ahaa kooxda Al-Shabaab, waxaana howl-galkan ka qeyb qaatay saaxiibada caalamka ee taageera dowladda Soomaaliya. Dilka Ikhlaas ayaa khasaare weyn ku noqon kara qeybta amniyaadka Al-Shabaab, maadaama uu xilka hayay muddo ka badan toban sano, isla markaana uu door ku lahaa shabakadaha iyo howlaha sirdoon ee kooxda. Si kastaba, dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii dambe kordhisay howl-gallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda oo taageera ka helaya saaxiibada caalamka ay beegsanayaan madaxda sare iyo goobaha muhiimka ah ee kooxda. The post Madaxii sirdoonka Shabaab oo la shaaciyay in la dilay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Maxamed Gacal oo ciidan la dul dhigay xilli uu waday qorshe ka dhan ah Qoor-Qoor
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Xiisad siyaasadeed ayaa ka taagan magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimadda Galmudug, kaddib markii ciidamo lagu daadiyey guriga Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada maamulka, Maxamed Gacal. Sida ay sheegayaan ilo-wareedyo ku sugan Dhuusamareeb, ciidamada ayaa la dul dhigay guriga guddoomiyaha xilli uu qorsheynayay inuu furo kalfadhiga Golaha Wakiillada, iyadoo tallaabadan loo aaneynayo khilaaf siyaasadeed oo sii xoogeysanaya. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Guddoomiye Gacal uu doonayay inuu kalfadhiga Golaha furo, isla markaana uu Golaha horkeeno qorshe la xiriira mooshin lagu ridayo xukuumadda uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye (Qoor-Qoor). Ilo-wareedyada ayaa intaas ku daraya in tallaabadan ay ka dhalatay khilaafka u dhexeeya Guddoomiyaha Golaha Wakiillada iyo hoggaanka Galmudug iyo Dowladda Federaalka, kaas oo la xiriira habka loo maareeyay arrimaha siyaasadeed iyo doorashooyinka maamulka. Xiisadda ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Maxkamadda Sare ee Soomaaliya ay laashay natiijooyinkii doorashooyinka Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golayaasha Deegaanka ee Galmudug, kaddib markii ay sheegtay in doorashadii 30-kii Luulyo 2026 aysan waafaqsanayn Dastuurka iyo Sharciga Doorashooyinka dalka. Go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ayaa Galmudug geliyay xaalad siyaasadeed oo cusub, iyadoo maxkamaddu amartay in doorashooyinka maamulka dib loogu celiyo, halka hay’adihii hadda jiray loo oggolaaday inay sii wataan shaqadooda ilaa laga soo dooranayo hay’ado cusub. Guddoomiye Maxamed Gacal oo dhawaan Muqdisho kaga hadlay hanaanka loo maareeyay doorashada Galmudug ayaa muujiyay inuusan ku qanacsanayn habkii Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay arrintaas u wajahday. Arrintan ayaa dab kusii shidaysa xiisadda siyaasadeed ee Galmudug, iyadoo aan weli si rasmi ah loo caddeyn sababta ciidamada loogu daadiyey guriga guddoomiyaha iyo tallaabada xigta ee uu Golaha Wakiilladu qaadi doono. The post Maxamed Gacal oo ciidan la dul dhigay xilli uu waday qorshe ka dhan ah Qoor-Qoor appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland Deepens Trade and Diplomatic Ties with Gulf Partners Amid Push for International Recognition
items.description: Hargeisa Pursues Strategic Economic Partnerships as Recognition Campaign Gains Momentum Hargeisa — Somaliland’s government has intensified its diplomatic and economic outreach to Gulf Cooperation Council member states in recent months, with senior officials holding a series of high-level meetings in the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia aimed at securing both expanded trade relationships and formal or informal recognition of the self-declared republic’s status on the world stage. The renewed push comes as Somaliland’s long-standing pursuit of international recognition enters what officials in Hargeisa are describing as a pivotal phase, with the government seeking to convert years of quiet diplomatic groundwork into tangible political and economic outcomes. The Horn of Africa territory declared independence from Somalia in 1991 but has yet to receive formal recognition from any United Nations member state. Gulf States Emerge as Key Partners Somaliland’s Foreign Ministry has confirmed that delegations traveled to Abu Dhabi and Doha over the past several weeks, engaging with both government counterparts and private sector actors. Officials indicated that discussions covered a broad portfolio of interests, including livestock export agreements, port infrastructure financing, and the possible establishment of consular-level representation — a step short of full diplomatic recognition but one that would significantly boost Hargeisa’s international standing. The UAE, which already maintains deep commercial ties with Somaliland through the DP World-operated Berbera Port and the Berbera Corridor , has emerged as the most active Gulf partner. Emirati officials are said to have expressed continued interest in expanding their investment footprint in Somaliland beyond the port sector, with energy and logistics identified as priority areas. Qatar, meanwhile, has shown interest in supporting humanitarian and development programming as a means of maintaining goodwill with Hargeisa. Saudi Arabia’s engagement has centered primarily on livestock trade. Somaliland’s pastoral economy depends heavily on annual livestock exports to the Arabian Peninsula, and Hargeisa has been pressing Riyadh to formalize import arrangements that would give Somaliland exporters more stable market access and improved sanitary certification pathways. Industry representatives have welcomed the diplomatic attention, noting that unpredictable market access has historically constrained the sector’s growth potential. A Broader Recognition Strategy The Gulf outreach is part of a wider diplomatic strategy that Somaliland’s government has been executing with increasing sophistication. In parallel, Hargeisa has been engaged in ongoing conversations with partners in Europe and the United States, where Somaliland maintains representative offices that function in a quasi-diplomatic capacity despite lacking formal recognition. Government spokespersons have framed the current moment as an opportunity shaped by shifting geopolitical currents. Growing international concern over stability in the Red Sea corridor, combined with renewed attention to the Horn of Africa as a region of strategic competition among global powers, has elevated Somaliland’s profile as a potential partner for states seeking reliable, stable interlocutors in an otherwise volatile neighborhood. Hargeisa has been careful to position itself as a democratic, secular, and cooperative actor — a contrast, officials suggest, to the instability that continues to plague much of the broader Somali political landscape. Economic Diplomacy and Port Development Central to Somaliland’s pitch to Gulf and international partners is the continued development of Berbera as a regional logistics hub. Expansion works at the port have progressed steadily, and officials say throughput volumes have increased markedly over the past two years. The government is actively soliciting additional investment in port-adjacent industrial zones, cold storage facilities, and the road corridor connecting Berbera to the Ethiopian border — an artery of growing importance given the large volumes of goods flowing between the port and landlocked Ethiopia. The Ethiopia-Somaliland port access memorandum of understanding , while subject to ongoing diplomatic complexity, has kept the question of Berbera’s role as a gateway for Ethiopian trade firmly on the regional agenda. Hargeisa continues to view the Ethiopian relationship as foundational to its long-term economic and diplomatic strategy, even as the details of any formal arrangement remain a matter of negotiation. Outlook Analysts following Somaliland’s diplomatic trajectory caution that translating goodwill and informal partnerships into formal recognition remains an exceptionally difficult task within the current architecture of international law and African Union norms. Nevertheless, they note that Somaliland’s incremental approach — building economic interdependence, accumulating goodwill, and demonstrating institutional stability — represents a coherent long-term strategy. Whether Gulf partners or other states will be willing to take the step toward formal recognition in the near term remains to be seen, but for the moment, Hargeisa’s diplomatic calendar has rarely looked more active.       Berbera times

Xisaabiyaha Guud oo shaaciyay in nidaamka mushaharka dowladda lagu xiriirinayo NIRA
items.description: Xafiiska Xisaabiyaha Guud ee Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa Wasaaradda Maaliyadda, Hay’adda Shaqaalaha Rayidka Dowladda iyo Hay’adda Aqoonsiga iyo Diiwaangelinta Qaranka (NIRA) ku wargeliyay qorshe lagu isku xiriirinayo Nidaamka Mushahar-bixinta Dowladda (Payroll/SFMIS) iyo Nidaamka Aqoonsiga Qaranka ee NIRA. Warqad ku taariikhaysan 29-ka Agoosto 2026 ayaa lagu sheegay in hirgelinta nidaamka cusub ay bilaaban doonto 1-da Oktoobar 2026, iyadoo marka hore la sameynayo tijaabo (Pilot Test). Intaas kadib, nidaamka ayaa si tartiib-tartiib ah loogu ballaarin doonaa dhammaan hay’adaha dowladda, iyadoo qorshuhu yahay in la soo gabagabeeyo 31-ka Diseembar 2027. Xafiiska Xisaabiyaha Guud ayaa sheegay in isku-xirka labada nidaam uu muhiim u yahay xaqiijinta xogta shaqaalaha dowladda, hubinta mushaharka iyo la-dagaallanka shaqaalaha aan jirin (ghost workers) iyo khaladaadka ka dhalan kara nidaamka mushahar-bixinta. Warqadda ayaa sidoo kale lagu caddeeyay in shaqaalaha aan hay’adaha NIRA ka diiwaangashanayn ama aan xogtooda si sax ah loo xaqiijin karin aan lagu dari doonin nidaamka mushahar-bixinta marka nidaamka cusub si rasmi ah u dhaqan galo.

items.title: Xamse Cabdi Barre oo Doha kula kulmay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Qatar Sheekh Maxamed Bin Cabdiraxmaan
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa kulan muhiim ah magaalada Doha kula yeeshay dhiggiisa dalka Qatar, Sheekh Maxamed Bin Cabdiraxmaan Bin Qaasim Al Taani, kadib booqasho rasmi ah oo uu ku joogo dalkaas. Kulanka oo ay ka qeybgaleen wasiirro iyo mas’uuliyiin sarsare oo ka tirsan weftiga Soomaaliya, ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda dhaqan-dhaqaale ee dalka, horumarrada Soomaaliya ay gaartay sanadihii u dambeeyay, iyo guulaha laga sameeyay dhinacyada amniga iyo xasilloonida. Labada Ra’iisul Wasaare ayaa sidoo kale si qoto dheer uga wada hadlay arrimaha amniga iyo nabadda caalamka, iyo sidii la isaga kaashan lahaa xal u helista caqabadaha hortaagan habsami u socodka ganacsiga adduunka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Qatar ayaa boggaadiyay horumarka iyo waxqabadka dowladda Soomaaliya, isagoo adkeeyay in xiriirka labada dal uu yahay mid xooggan oo ku dhisan iskaashi iyo wax wada qabsi. Dhankiisa, Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre ayaa dowladda iyo shacabka Qatar uga mahadceliyay taageerada ay u muujiyeen madax-bannaanida dhuleed iyo qaranimada Soomaaliya xilliyadii lagu soo xad-gudbay Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya.

items.title: Safiirka Itoobiya ee Soomaaliya oo Muqdisho ka baxay kadib…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Safiirkii Itoobiya ee Soomaaliya, Suleymaan Dedefo Woshe ayaa ka baxay magaalada Muqdisho, isagoo dib ugu laabtay dalkiisa Itoobiya kadib muddo ku dhow hal sano oo uu ahaa wakiilka diblomaasiyadeed ee Addis Ababa u qaabilsanaa Soomaaliya. Safiirka ayaa lagu sagootiyey munaasabad ay safaaradda Itoobiya ee Muqdisho u sameysay, iyadoo lagu sheegay in uu dhammeystay muddadii uu xilka safiirnimo u hayay Itoobiya ee Soomaaliya. Ka bixitaankiisa ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiriirka labada dal uu marayo marxalad ka duwan tii xiisadda xooggan ee ka dhalatay heshiiskii badda ee Itoobiya iyo Somaliland. Xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Addis Ababa ayaa si weyn u xumaaday horraantii 2024, kaddib markii Itoobiya iyo Somaliland ay kala saxiixdeen is-afgarad ku saabsanaa marin-badeed. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa heshiiskaas ku tilmaantay mid xadgudub ku ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, waxaana Muqdisho ay markaas tallaabooyin diblomaasiyadeed ka qaaday wakiilkii Itoobiya. Soomaaliya ayaa xilligaas dalkeeda ka cayrisay safiirkii Itoobiya, iyadoo dalbatay inuu dalka ka baxo, iyadoo xiisadda ay muddo saameyn ku yeelatay xiriirka siyaasadeed iyo amni ee labada dowladood, inkastoo markii dambe ay bilowdeen dadaallo lagu soo celinayo xiriirkii labada dhinac. Kadib markii xiisaddii diblomaasiyadeed ay hoos u dhacday, Itoobiya ayaa Soomaaliya u soo magacowday Suleymaan Dedefo, taas oo loo arkayay tallaabo ka tarjumeysa dib-u-soo celinta xiriirka rasmiga ah ee labada dal. Labada dowladood ayaa sidoo kale qaaday tallaabooyin lagu xoojinayo wada-hadallada iyo iskaashiga, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, ganacsiga iyo xiriirka labada shacab. Itoobiya iyo Soomaaliya ayaa muddo dheer lahaa xiriir dhow oo dhinacyo badan leh, iyadoo Itoobiya ay kamid tahay dalalka gobolka ee door muhiim ah ku leh arrimaha amniga Soomaaliya. Ciidamada Itoobiya ayaa sidoo kale qayb ka ahaa howlgalladii amniga ee Soomaaliya, inkastoo joogitaanka iyo doorka ciidamada Itoobiya ay marar kala duwan noqdeen arrimo xasaasi ah oo siyaasadeed. Ilaa hadda Itoobiya uma aysan magacaabin Soomaaliya safiir cusub oo beddela Suleymaan Dedefo. items.title: Turkiga oo Laba Markab oo Dagaal u Soo Diray Xeebaha Soomaaliya si Loo Xoojiyo Amniga Badda
items.description: Dowladda Turkiga ayaa laba markab oo ka tirsan ciidankeeda badda u soo dirtay biyaha Soomaaliya iyo gobolka Geeska Afrika, iyada oo sii kordhinaysa joogitaankeeda milatari iyo taageerada amni ee ay siiso Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kaddib markii ay dib u soo cusboonaadeen falalka la xiriira afduubka maraakiibta ee biyaha dalka. Wasaaradda Difaaca Turkiga ayaa shaacisay in labada markab oo lagu kala magacaabo TCG Kemalreis iyo TCG Yzb. Güngör Durmuş ay taageero buuxda siin doonaan Hawlgalka Ciidamada Badda Soomaaliya iyo howlgallada saadka, iyagoo sidoo kale 3-da iyo 4-ta bisha Sebtembar booqan doona dalka Jabuuti. Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Difaaca Turkiga, Zeki Aktürk, ayaa xaqiijiyay in Ankara ay sii wadayso howlaha ku saleysan heshiisyada laba-geesoodka ah, si kor loogu qaado awoodda ciidanka dalka ee dhinacyada la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo burcad-badeednimada. Turkiga, oo xaruntiisa ugu weyn ee tababarka milatariga dibadda ku leh magaalada Muqdisho (TURKSOM), ayaa muddo toban sano ka badan ka mid ahaa bah-wadaagta ugu dhow ee Soomaaliya, isaga oo sannadahan dambe si weyn u ballaariyay iskaashiga badda kaddib heshiis difaac oo ay labada dawladood wada galeen. Imaatinka maraakiibtan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli xasaasi ah oo maamulka Puntland uu dowladda Turkiga ku eedeeyay inay duqeymo dhanka cirka ah ka fulisay xeebaha Gobolka Nugaal labadii toddobaad ee la soo dhaafay, halkaas oo ay ku dhinteen in ka badan 10 qof oo isugu jiray kalluumeysato iyo dad looga shakiyay burcad-badeednimo, inkastoo Ankara aysan wali si toos ah uga jawaabin eedeymahaas.

items.title: Bangiga Qaranka Itoobiya oo Digniin iyo Xannibaad Isugu Daray Xawaalado Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Bangiga Qaranka Itoobiya (NBE) ayaa soo saaray amar iyo digniin culus oo ku saabsan shirkado iyo shabakado xawaaladeed oo uu sheegay inaysan haysan ruqsad sharci ah oo ay kaga shaqeeyaan gudaha dalkaas. Bangiga ayaa tilmaamay in macaamilka lala yeesho shirkadaha aan fasaxa rasmiga ah haysan ay si toos ah uga horimanayso shuruucda iyo nidaamka maaliyadda dalka. Waxa uu ka digay in arrintani ay sababi karto khasaare maaliyadeed oo soo gaara macaamiisha, xannibaad lagu sameeyo xisaabaadka bangiyada, iyo tallaabooyin sharci oo adag oo laga qaado cid kasta oo ku lug yeelata dirista ama qaadashada lacagahaas. Liiska rasmiga ah ee Bangiga Qaranka Itoobiya uu shaaciyay ayaa waxaa ku jira shirkado xawaaladeed oo ay Soomaalidu si baaxad leh u isticmaasho, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin Taaj Financial Service, Amal Express, Bakal, Jubba Express, Amana, Tawakal, iyo Ramad Pay (Kaah). Shirkadahan ayaa door weyn ku lahaa isku-xirka bulshada iyo isu-gudbinta lacagaha ee gobolka Geeska Afrika. Go’aankan ayaa la filayaa inuu saameyn toos ah ku yeesho jaaliyadda ballaaran ee Soomaaliyeed ee ku nool dalka Itoobiya iyo qoysaska noloshoodu ku tiirsan tahay lacagaha dibadda looga soo diro. Bangiga Dhexe ee Itoobiya ayaa ugu baaqay dhammaan dadweynaha inay isticmaalaan keliya hay’adaha maaliyadeed iyo wakiillada haysta shatiga rasmiga ah ee dalkaas.

items.title: Dowladda Soomaaliya oo Sheegtay Qodista Ceelka Shidaalka Curad-1 in La Soo Gabagabeyn Karo Bisha Sebtembar
items.description: Gudoomiyaha Hay’adda Batroolka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Aadan, ayaa shaaciyay in howlaha qodista ceelka shidaalka badda ee Curad-1 ay u socdaan si xawli ah, isla markaana la filayo in la soo gabagabeeyo dhammaadka bisha Sebtembar ee soo socota. Qodista ceelkan, oo ay gacanta ku hayso dowladda Turkiga, ayaa markii hore loo qorsheeyay inay soo idlaato bisha Oktoobar, balse horumarka weyn ee laga gaaray hawsha ayaa suuragelinaya in la dhammaystiro bil ka hor xilligii loo asteeyay. Tallaabadan ayaa muujinaysa hufnaanta iyo xawaaraha ay ku socdaan qalabka iyo kooxaha farsamada ee ku howlan sahminta kheyraadka badda Soomaaliya. Sida uu xaqiijiyay Gudoomiyaha, qodista ayaa haatan gaartay qoto-dheer dhan qiyaastii 3,000 oo mitir, iyadoo bartilmaameedku yahay inay gaarto ilaa 4,000 oo mitir oo ka hooseeya sagxadda badda, taas oo wadarta guud ee dhererka ceelka ka dhigaysa ku dhawaad 7,500 oo mitir. Dhammaan howlgallada ayaa lagu warramay inay u socdaan si waafaqsan heerarka caalamiga ah ee badbaadada iyadoo aan wax cillado farsamo ah la kulmin. Dhammaystirka ceelka Curad-1 ayaa taariikh cusub u ah labada dal, maadaama uu yahay ceelkii ugu horreeyay ee noociisa ah oo qoto-dheer oo uu Turkigu ka qodo meel ka baxsan biyihiisa dhuleed. Mashruucan ayaa la filayaa inuu Soomaaliya u furo fursado maalgashi oo ballaaran iyo bilowga marxalad cusub oo lagu soo saaro kheyraadka dabiiciga ah ee dalka.

items.title: CARE oo Ka Digtay Khatarta Macaluul iyo Xiritaanka Xarumo Caafimaad oo Dalka Ku Yaalla
items.description: Hay’adda gargaarka caalamiga ah ee CARE ayaa soo saartay digniin culus oo ku saabsan xaaladda bini’aadannimo ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo sheegtay in hoos-u-dhaca ku yimid dhaqaalaha gargaarka uu sababay in la xiro xarumo badan oo caafimaad iyo kuwo nafaqayn. Xaaladdan ayaa khatar toos ah ku haysa carruurta yaryar, hooyooyinka, iyo haweenka uurka leh ee ku nool deegaannada ugu nugul dalka. Gudoomiyaha CARE ee Soomaaliya, Ummy Dubow, ayaa tilmaantay in afar xilli-roobaad oo baaqday ay malaayiin qof qarka u saareen xaalad adag, halka daadadka iyo cimilada El Niño ay sii kordhinayaan dhibaatada qoysaska danyarta ah. Waxay xustay in goobo badan oo dalka ah ay hooyooyinku masaafo dheer u lugeeyaan xarumo caafimaad balse ay la kulmaan albaabada oo xiran, iyadoo gaadiidkii gurmadka degdegga ahina ay shidaal la’aan u fadhiyaan. Deegaannada Jubbaland, CARE ayaa lagu qasbay inay dhimato hawlaheeda iyadoo 12 xarun oo ay taageeri jirtay hadda ku soo koobtay hal xarun oo keliya oo ku taal magaalada Kismaayo, waxaana meesha ka baxay 20 kamid ah howlwadeennadeeda caafimaadka. Hoos-u-dhacan ku yimid goobaha adeegga ayaa horseeday in kumanaan qoys ay waayaan daryeelkii aasaasiga ahaa ee ay u baahnaayeen xilliyada adag. Ugu dambeyntii, Hay’adda CARE waxay shaacisay in qorshaheeda gurmadka Soomaaliya uu hadda helay wax ka yar 20% dhaqaalihii loogu talagalay sanadkan. Waxay beesha caalamka iyo deeq-bixiyeyaasha ugu baaqday inay si degdeg ah u soo farageliyaan arrintan una fidiyaan taageero maaliyadeed si loo badbaadiyo nolosha malaayiin qof oo halis ugu jira macaluul iyo cudurro.

items.title: Midowga Afrika oo ciidanka AUSSOM u fasaxay arrintii uu ka qeyliyey Lafta-gareen
items.description: Addis Ababa (Caasimada Online) – Midowga Afrika ayaa AUSSOM u fasaxay inay ciidamada dowladda federaalka kala qeyb-gasho howlgallada militari ee Koonfur Galbeed, xilli madaxweynihii hore Cabdicasiis Laftagareen uu uga digay howlgalka inuu ku lug yeesho khilaafka siyaasadeed ee gobolka. Qoraal gudaha ah oo Midowga Afrika soo saaray 21-kii August, oo ay heshay Caasimada Online , ayaa AUSSOM u oggolaanaya inay dowladda kala qeyb-gasho dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo kooxo hubeysan oo lagu sheegay inay xiriir la leeyihiin kooxdaas. Hase yeeshee, isla qoraalka ayaa AUSSOM ku amraya inay ilaaliso dhex-dhexaadnimadeeda siyaasadeed, kana fogaato “khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee gudaha”. Arrintan ayaa muhiimad gaar ah leh, maadaama dowladda federaalka iyo mas’uuliyiinta Koonfur Galbeed ay ciidamo daacad u ah Laftagareen ku eedeeyeen inay Al-Shabaab kala qeyb-qaateen dagaallo ka dhacay Baydhaba, halka garabkiisu uu si adag u beeniyay eedeynta. Qoraalka ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijinaya in dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay si rasmi ah Midowga Afrika uga codsatay in AUSSOM ay farageliso xaaladda amni ee Koonfur Galbeed. Waaxda Arrimaha Siyaasadda, Nabadda iyo Amniga ee Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa qoraalka, oo summaddiisu tahay CPAPS/B3/779.26 , u dirtay madaxa howlgalka AUSSOM. Cinwaanka qoraalka ayaa si toos ah u xusaya gudbinta warqad ay dowladda federaalka ku codsatay “faragelinta AUSSOM ee xaaladda amni ee Koonfur Galbeed”. Guddiga Midowga Afrika ayaa sheegay inuu si weyn uga walaacsan yahay xaaladda gobolka, isaga oo xusay warar sheegaya inuu jiro “isbahaysi sii kordhaya” oo u dhexeeya maleeshiyaad maxalli ah iyo Al-Shabaab. Waxa uu sheegay in xiriirkaas la sheegay uu horseeday weerarro abaabulan oo lagu qaaday ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya gudaha iyo hareeraha magaalada Baydhaba. Hase yeeshee, qoraalka Midowga Afrika ma magacaabayo maleeshiyaadka uu ku tilmaamay inay xiriir la leeyihiin Al-Shabaab, mana soo bandhigayo caddeymo muujinaya xiriirkaas. Laftagareen oo u digay AU Go’aanka Midowga Afrika ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli dowladda federaalka iyo ciidamo daacad u ah madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen ay ku jiraan khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo mid hubeysan. Garabka Laftagareen ayaa Khamiistii Midowga Afrika uga digay inuu ku lug yeesho iska horimaadka, isagoo sheegay in tallaabadaasi ay dhaawici karto dhex-dhexaadnimada AUSSOM. Waxa uu sidoo kale si adag u diiday eedeymaha ah in ciidamadiisu ay xiriir la leeyihiin Al-Shabaab. Laftagareen ayaa sheegay in dagaalyahannadaasi ay yihiin ciidamo ka tirsan Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed, wuxuuna ka digay in khilaaf siyaasadeed oo gudaha ah loo beddelo qayb ka mid ah dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab. Qoraalka Midowga Afrika hase yeeshee ma magacaabayo Laftagareen, ciidamadiisa ama dhinac kale oo siyaasadeed. Sidoo kale, laguma lifaaqin warqaddii dowladda federaalka ay u dirtay Midowga Afrika ee saldhigga u ahayd codsiga faragelinta AUSSOM. Sidaas darteed, qoraalka keliya ma caddeynayo eedeymaha gaarka ah ama caddeymaha ay dowladda federaalka u gudbisay Midowga Afrika. Waxaa kale oo qoraalka lagu xusay qoraal hore oo madaxa AUSSOM uu diray 19-kii August, balse nuqulka ay heshay Caasimada Online kuma jirin qoraalkaas. Dagaalkii ka dhacay Baydhaba Dagaal culus ayaa 17-kii August ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba, kaas oo dhexmaray ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo dagaalyahanno daacad u ah Laftagareen. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada dowladda ay dileen ku dhowaad 30 dagaalyahan, kadib markii weeraryahanno adeegsanayay gaadiid laga soo buuxiyey walxaha qarxa ay waaberigii weerareen fariisimo dowladeed. Ciidamada federaalka ayaa markii dambe dagaalyahannada ka saaray magaalada, kadib saacado dagaal ah. Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda federaalka iyo maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa markii dambe ku eedeeyey ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen inay Al-Shabaab kala qeyb-qaateen weerarka. Laftagareen ayaa eedeyntaasi beeniyay. Muranka ku saabsan cidda ay yihiin kooxaha hubeysan ayaa hadda noqday qodobka ugu xasaasisan ee go’aanka Midowga Afrika, maadaama AUSSOM loo oggolaaday inay la dagaallanto kooxaha xiriirka la leh Al-Shabaab, balse isla waqtigaas laga mamnuucay inay ku milanto khilaaf siyaasadeed. Amar dhex-dhexaadnimo Midowga Afrika ayaa sheegay in oggolaanshaha la siiyey AUSSOM uu waafaqsan yahay waajibaadka howlgalka ee la dagaallanka argagixisada, ilaalinta shacabka iyo sugidda xarumaha muhiimka ah ee dowladda. Qoraalka ayaa tixraacaya qaraarro ay soo saareen Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo Golaha Nabadda iyo Ammaanka ee Midowga Afrika, kuwaas oo hagaya howlgalka AUSSOM. Waxaa howlgalka lagu faray inuu sii wado taageerada ciidamada Soomaaliya, isagoo dhowraya sharciga caalamiga ah ee bani’aadannimada iyo xeerarka u degsan howlgalladiisa. Hase yeeshee, qoraalka ayaa si cad u kala saaraya howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo kooxaha xiriirka la leh, oo AUSSOM loo fasaxay inay taageerto, iyo khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee laga doonayo inay ka fogaato. Kala saariddaas ayaa ah xudunta muranka hadda taagan. Dowladda federaalka iyo mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ciidamo taageersan Laftagareen ku eedeeyey xiriir iyo wada-shaqeyn Al-Shabaab, halka garabkiisu uu taas beeninayo, kuna adkeysanayo in dagaalka uu yahay khilaaf siyaasadeed oo kala dhexeeya dowladda federaalka. Laftagareen ayaa 30-kii March iska casilay xilka madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, kadib markii ciidamada federaalka ay la wareegeen magaalada Baydhaba. Taageerayaashiisa ayaa tan iyo xilligaas kasoo horjeeday maamulka lagu beddelay, iyagoo ku doodaya in xilka looga qaaday si sharci-darro ah. Khilaafka ayaa tan iyo markaas sababay iska horimaadyo hubeysan oo soo noqnoqday, iyadoo dowladda federaalka iyo garabka Laftagareen ay weli isku hayaan maamulka iyo gacan-ku-haynta Koonfur Galbeed. Midowga Afrika ayaa sidoo kale AUSSOM ku amray inay si joogto ah ula socoto xaaladda amni ee Koonfur Galbeed, isla markaana warbixinno joogto ah u gudbiso xarunta dhexe ee Midowga Afrika. items.title: Puntland: Shaqaalaha Rayidka ah oo 7 Bilood Mushahar La’aan ah
items.description: Garoowe (Raxanreeb Online): Shaqaalaha rayidka ah ee Dowladda Puntland ayaa la sheegay inay muddo toddobo bilood ah wax mushahar ah qaadan, iyadoo xaaladdan lagu tilmaamay muddadii ugu dheereyd ee shaqaalaha Puntland ay xuquuqdooda mushahar la’aan ahaadaan tan iyo 2009-kii. Sida xogta lagu sheegay, sanadkan 2026 shaqaalaha rayidka ah ee Puntland waxay heleen oo keliya laba mushahar, kuwaas oo ahaa labadii ciid, halka bilihii kale ay weli ka maqan yihiin xuquuqdooda. Mushaharka shaqaalaha rayidka ah ee la sheegay inuu ku maqan yahay ayaa lagu qiyaasay $500,000 bishii, taasoo ka dhigan in toddobada bilood ee mushahar la’aanta ay isu geyntoodu gaari karto ku dhowaad $3.5 milyan. Guddoomiyaha Midowga Afrika, Mahmoud Ali Youssouf, ayaa sheegay in amni oo keliya uusan ku filnayn in lagu soo afjaro colaadaha Afrika, balse loo baahan yahay in amniga lagu daro siyaasad, wada-hadal, horumar iyo iskaashi. Youssouf ayaa xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in dalalka Afrika ay xoojiyaan dadaallada nabadeed si loo gaaro yoolka Midowga Afrika ee “Silencing the Guns”, kaas oo ah in qaaradda laga ciribtiro dagaallada iyo colaadaha hubeysan marka la gaaro 2030. Shirka Luanda ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli qaar badan oo kamid ah dalalka Afrika ay wajahaan khilaafaad siyaasadeed, colaado hubeysan, argagixiso iyo caqabado dhinaca amniga ah, kuwaas oo u baahan xalal siyaasadeed iyo iskaashi heer qaaradeed. items.title: DEG-DEG: Duulimaadyadii Nairobi–Muqdisho oo Hakad Galay
items.description: Nairobi (Raxanreeb Online): Diyaaradihii saakay ka soo bixi lahaa Garoonka Caalamiga ah ee Jomo Kenyatta (JKIA) ee magaalada Nairobi, kuna soo jeeday Muqdisho, ayaa ku xaniban garoonka, kaddib markii ay shaqo joojin sameeyeen shaqaalaha garoonka. Shaqo-joojinta ayaa saameyn ku yeelatay howlaha garoonka, iyadoo diyaarado iyo rakaab badan ay wajahaan dib-u-dhac. Waxaa lagu soo warramayaa in ku dhowaad 300 oo Soomaali ah, oo ay ku jiraan mas’uuliyiin kala duwan, ay ku xayiran yihiin garoonka Jomo Kenyatta, iyagoo sugaya in dib loo bilaabo howlaha duulimaadyada. Xaaladda ayaa sidoo kale saameyn ku yeelan karta duulimaadyo kale oo caalami ah oo ka baxaya ama kusoo degaya garoonka, iyadoo rakaabka laga sugayo in shirkadaha diyaaradaha ay ka soo saaraan warar cusub oo ku saabsan jadwalka duulimaadyada. items.title: Xamza oo kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay dhiggiisa Qatar
items.description: Doha (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay dhiggiisa dalka Qatar, Sheekh Maxamed Bin Cabdiraxmaan Bin Jaasim Al Taani, xilli uu booqasho rasmi ah ku joogo dalka Qatar. Kulanka waxaa Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza ku wehliyay wasiirro iyo mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan dowladda Soomaaliya, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada-hadleen xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga labada dal. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza ayaa dhiggiisa Qatar uga warbixiyay xaaladaha dhaqan-dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya, horumarrada la gaaray sanadihii dambe iyo guulaha laga sameeyay dhinacyada amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka. Labada Ra’iisul Wasaare ayaa sidoo kale si qoto dheer uga wada hadlay arrimaha caalamka, gaar ahaan amniga iyo nabadda, iyo sidii labada dal ay uga wada shaqeyn lahaayeen xal u helista caqabadaha saameynaya habsami-u-socodka ganacsiga caalamka. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Qatar, Sheekh Maxamed Bin Cabdiraxmaan Al Taani ayaa dhankiisa bogaadiyay horumarka ay Soomaaliya ku tallaabsatay iyo waxqabadka dowladda, isagoo sheegay in xiriirka labada dal uu yahay mid xooggan oo ku dhisan iskaashi iyo wax-wada-qabsi. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza ayaa dowladda Qatar uga mahadceliyay taageerada ay si joogto ah u siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan mowqifkeedii ku aaddanaa ilaalinta madaxbannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya xilli dalka lagu soo xadgudbay. Sidoo kale waxa uu sheegay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay si weyn u qadarinayaan garab istaagga dowladda iyo shacabka Qatar, iyadoo labada dal ay ka go’an tahay sii xoojinta xiriirkooda iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan. The post Xamza oo kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay dhiggiisa Qatar appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: WAR: Haramcad oo Howlgallo Ka Wada Jiinka Wabiga Shabeelle
items.description: Shabeellaha Dhexe (Raxanreeb Online): Ciidanka Booliiska sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Haramcad ayaa weli wada howlgallo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo ka socda deegaannada Baldooska iyo Alifow, ee ku teedsan jiinka Wabiga Shabeelle. Ciidanka Haramcad ayaa sheegay in dagaal culus oo shalay ka dhacay deegaannadaasi lagu dilay Madaxii Jabhadda Cabdinaasir Farey iyo qaar kamid ah ilaaladiisa, iyadoo ciidamada ay sheegeen inay soo bandhigeen meydadka qaar kamid ah kooxda. Dagaalka ayaa galay maalintii lixaad, waxaana Haramcad ay sheegtay inay gaartay guulo ballaaran oo lagu wiiqayo joogitaanka iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqa Al-Shabaab ee deegaannada ku teedsan jiinka Wabiga Shabeelle. Howlgalladan ayaa qeyb ka ah howlgallo ciidan oo lagu doonayo in kooxda Al-Shabaab looga saaro goobaha ay ku dhuumaaleysanayaan iyo fariisimaha ay ku leeyihiin hareeraha wabiga, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa deegaanka ay sii wadaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada milatari. Faahfaahinta khasaaraha dhinacyada iyo xaaladda dhabta ah ee goobaha dagaalku ka socdo weli si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. The post WAR: Haramcad oo Howlgallo Ka Wada Jiinka Wabiga Shabeelle appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Nin isku dilay goob ganacsi oo ku taalla Puntland
items.description: Ufayn (Caasimada Online) – Nin lagu magacaabi jiray Siciid Maxamed Siciid oo ku magac dheeraa Siciid Gundho ayaa saaka isku dilay goob ganacsi oo ku taalla degmada Ufayn ee gobolka Bari ee maamulka Puntland, sida ay sheegeen ilo kala duwan. Sida xogta laga helayo deegaanka, dhacdadu waxay ka dhacday gudaha goob ganacsi oo ku taalla degmada, iyadoo aan weli si rasmi ah loo shaacin faahfaahinta ku saabsan waxa sababay is-dilka. Ilo deegaanka ah ayaa sheegay in Siciid Gundho muddooyinkii dambe uu ka xanuunsanaa dhimirka, hase yeeshee arrintaasi si rasmi ah looma xaqiijin, waxaana weli socda baaritaanno la xiriira dhacdada. Ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa ammaanka Puntland ayaa gaaray goobta, halkaas oo ay ka sameeyeen baaritaanno hordhac ah oo ku saabsan dhacdada. Ciidamada ayaa sidoo kale goobta ka qaaday haraadiga rasaastii u nafta isku dhaafiyay, iyadoo baaritaanno lagu ogaanayo sida uu hubka ku helay iyo duruufaha ku xeernaa dhacdada. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan sida hubkaasi uu gacantiisa ku galay. Dhacdadan ayaa sidoo kale dib u soo celisay dhacdo hore oo la xiriirta qoyska, iyadoo la sheegay in walaalkiis uu sanadkii 2021 sidaas oo kale isku dilay. Ilaa hadda ma jirto faahfaahin rasmi ah oo kasoo baxday hay’adaha ammaanka Puntland oo ku saabsan dhacdadan, waxaana la filayaa in xog dheeraad ah laga bixiyo marka baaritaanku soo dhammaado. The post Nin isku dilay goob ganacsi oo ku taalla Puntland appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: DF oo Shabaab ka nadiifisay deegaanno muhiim ah oo ku dhow magaalada Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ku guuleysatay in ciidamadeedu ay nadiifiyaan deegaanno ku yaalla inta u dhexeysa degmooyinka Balcad iyo Afgooye, kuwaas oo muddo dheer saldhigyo muhiim ah u ahaa kooxda Al-Shabaab. Deegaannada ku teedsan Wabiga Shabeelle ayaa la sheegay inay kooxda u adeegsan jirtay abaabulka iyo qorsheynta weerarrada, maadaama ay ku yaallaan dhul istiraatiiji ah oo isku xira qaybo ka mid ah gobollada Shabeellaha Dhexe iyo Shabeellaha Hoose. Howl-galka lagu nadiifiyay deegaannadan ayaa dowladda u noqon kara guul muhiim ah oo dhinaca amniga ah, gaar ahaan marka la eego muhiimadda ay leeyihiin waddooyinka iyo deegaannada ku dhow caasimadda Muqdisho. Aagga u dhexeeya Balcad iyo Afgooye ayaa horey u ahaa goob ay ciidamada dowladda iyo Al-Shabaab ku dhex mareen dagaallo culus, iyadoo iska horimaadyadii ka dhacay deegaankaasi ay sababeen khasaare xooggan. Dagaalladaasi waxaa horey loogu waayay saraakiil caan ah oo ka tirsan ciidamada dowladda, waxaana ka mid ahaa Allaha u naxariistee General Farxaan Qaroole, oo ahaa sarkaal si weyn uga qeyb qaatay howl-gallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Gacan-ku-haynta deegaannadan ayaa sidoo kale muhiim u noqon karta dowladda haddii ciidamada ay sii joogteeyaan fariisimaha ay halkaasi ka sameysteen iyo sugida waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee mara deegaanka. Tallaabadan ayaa noqon karta mid muhiim ah oo lagu wiiqo awoodda kooxda ay ku leedahay deegaannada ku dhow Muqdisho iyo marinada isku xira caasimadda iyo gobollada ku xeeran. Waxay sidoo kale kusoo beegmaysaa xilli ciidamada dowladda ay wadaan howlgallo lagu doonayo in lagu ballaariyo deegaannada ay gacanta ku hayaan, iyadoo horay loo nadiifiyay waddada isku xirta Muqdisho iyo Marka. Si kastaba, dib u soo celinta gacan-ku-haynta deegaannada ku dhow Muqdisho ayaa dowladda u abuuri karta fursad ay ku xoojiso amniga caasimadda iyo nawaaxigeeda. Hase yeeshee, guusha howl-galka waxay ku xirnaan doontaa joogteynta ciidamada iyo awoodda ay u leeyihiin inay ka hortagaan isku-day kasta oo Al-Shabaab ay ku doonayso inay dib ugu soo laabato deegaannadaasi. The post DF oo Shabaab ka nadiifisay deegaanno muhiim ah oo ku dhow magaalada Muqdisho appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Xasuuqii Rwanda: Nin Xabsi Daa’in Lagu Xukumay
items.description: Maxkamad ku taalla magaalada The Hague ee dalka Netherlands ayaa 28-kii Agoosto 2026 xabsi daa’im ku xukuntay nin 66 jir ah oo lagu magacaabo Eugène N. , kaddib markii lagu helay dambiyo dagaal iyo xasuuq oo la xiriira dilkii kumannaan Tutsi ah intii uu socday xasuuqii Rwanda ee 1994. Maxkamadda Degmada The Hague ayaa sheegtay in Eugène N., oo xilligaas ahaa masuul maxalli ah oo ka tirsanaa deegaanka Mbazi ee koonfurta Rwanda, uu ka qayb qaatay weerarro lagu qaaday laba bulsho oo u badnaa Tutsi. Guryahooda ayaa la dhacay, qaarna dab ayaa la qabadsiiyay. Dhacdooyinka ugu culus ayaa ka dhacay Byiza Stadium , halkaas oo kumannaan Tutsi ah ay isugu tageen iyagoo aaminsanaa inay halkaas ammaan ka heli doonaan. Sida ay maxkamaddu xaqiijisay, qiyaastii 5,000 ilaa 7,000 qof ayaa markii hore garoonka ku dhuuntay, waxaana 25-kii Abriil 1994 halkaas ka dhacay weerar ay fuliyeen maleeshiyaad Hutu ah iyo ciidamo. Maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay in Eugène N. uu goobta joogay, isla markaana uu dadka weerarka waday ku amray in aan Tutsi ka baxsan garoonka loo oggolaan. Waxa kale oo lagu helay inuu bam-gacmeed ku tuuray dadkii ku jiray garoonka . Dadkii ka badbaaday weerarkii hore ayaa markii dambe lagu dilay ulo iyo baangado, sida ku cad xukunka maxkamadda. Maxkamaddu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in in ka badan 4,000 mayd laga soo saaray xabaalo wadareedyo ku dhow garoonka. Tirada dadka lagu qiyaasay in lagu dilay goobta ayaa ilo kala duwan ku sheegayaan ku dhowaad 3,000, halka maxkamadda Dutch-ku ay xustay in kumannaan qof lagu dilay weerarka iyo in meydad badan laga helay agagaarka garoonka. Garsoorayaashu waxay ku tilmaameen ficillada ninka kuwo muujinaya ixtiraam-darro aad u weyn oo loo geystay nolosha iyo karaamada aadanaha. Waxay sidoo kale go’aamiyeen in dambiyada uu galay ay ahaayeen kuwo leh ujeeddo xasuuq , maadaama aqoonsiga qowmiyadeed ee qofka uu go’aaminayay inuu badbaado iyo in kale. Sidaas darteed, maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay in xabsi daa’im uu yahay ciqaabta keliya ee la jaanqaadi karta culayska dambiyada. items.title: Hoggaanka Fallaagada RSF ee Suudaan oo la sheegay inuu xariir qoto-dheer la leeyahay maamulka Israa’iil
items.description: Warbixin ay baahisay Africa Intelligence ayaa sheegtay in hoggaamiyaha Ciidamada Taageerada Degdegga ah ee Sudan, Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo (Hemedti), uu doonayo inuu sii xoojiyo xiriirrada iyo waddooyinka isgaarsiineed ee uu la leeyahay dhinacyo ku dhow Israa’iil. Warbixintu waxay tilmaamaysaa in Hemedti uu dadaal ugu jiro inuu ballaariyo xiriirrada uu la leeyahay dhinicyo siyaasadeed iyo kuwo diblomaasiyadeed oo Israa’iili ah, iyadoo arrintan lagu sheegay inay qayb ka tahay isku day uu ku raadinayo taageero siyaasadeed iyo mid diblomaasiyadeed oo caalami ah. Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Sudan ay weli ku jirto dagaal iyo qalalaase siyaasadeed iyo mid militari, kaas oo billowday kadib markii uu qarxay dagaalka u dhexeeya ciidanka Suudaan iyo RSF. Dagaalka ayaa sidoo kale Suudaan ka dhigay goob ay quwadaha gobolka iyo kuwa caalamka ku loollamayaan saameyn iyo xulafoba. Hemedti, oo hoggaamiya RSF, ayaa sannadihii u dambeeyay isku dayay inuu dhiso xiriirro dibadeed oo kala duwan, si uu u helo taageero iyo aqoonsi siyaasadeed. Sida ay sheegtay Africa Intelligence, xiriirka lala raadinayo dhinacyada Israa’iil ayaa u muuqda inuu qayb ka yahay dadaalladaas. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, warbixinta laga soo xigtay Sudan Nabaa ma bixin faahfaahin buuxda oo ku saabsan nooca xiriirrada cusub ee Hemedti iyo Israa’iil, cidda uu si gaar ah ula xiriirayo ama waxa ay yihiin heshiisyada ama taageerada la filayo. Arrintan waxay yeelan kartaa muhiimad siyaasadeed oo weyn, maadaama Sudan ay ku jirto dagaal ay dhinacyadu u raadinayaan taageero dibadeed. Haddii xiriirrada Hemedti iyo Israa’iil ah ay dhab ahaan sii qoto dheeraadaan, waxay saameyn ku yeelan karaan xisaabaha siyaasadeed ee dagaalka Sudan iyo xiriirrada uu hoggaamiyaha RSF la leeyahay dalalka kale ee gobolka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee tallaabada Hemedti waxay muujin kartaa in dagaalka Sudan uusan ku koobnayn oo keliya loollan gudaha ah, balse uu sii noqonayo tartan ku saabsan xiriirrada, taageerada iyo saameynta caalamiga ah, iyadoo labada dhinac ee dagaalku ay raadinayaan cid ka caawisa inay xoojiyaan mowqifkooda gudaha iyo dibaddaba. Ciidamada Suudaan ayaa taageero xoogan ka hela dalalka Turkiga, Masar, iyo Sacuudiga, halka xoogagga RSF ay taageeraan Imaaraadka iyo Itoobiya oo labaduba xulufo dhow la ah Israa’iil.
