items.title: Puntland oo beenisay warkii DF, sheegtay in madax furasho la siiyey burcad-badeedda
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Puntland ayaa dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ku eedeysay inay lacag madax-furasho ah siiyeen burcad-badeedkii afduubtay markabka MV LUTUF, si loo sii daayo markabka iyo shaqaalihii la socday. Eedeyntan ayaa si toos ah uga hor imaaneysa war ay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya horay u soo saartay, kaas oo lagu sheegay in ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo kuwa badda ee Turkiga ay markabka ku soo furteen howlgal socday muddo 10 maalmood ah. Wasaaradda Amniga iyo DDR ee Puntland ayaa soo dhoweysay sii deynta markabka oo sita calanka Cameroon iyo shaqaalihii la socday, kuwaas oo gacanta burcad-badeedda ku jiray tan iyo markii markabka lagu qafaashay xeebaha Puntland 17-kii Agoosto. Hase yeeshee, Puntland waxay beenisay in howlgal militari lagu soo furtay markabka. “Ma jirin howlgal ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ama Turkigu ku soo furteen markabka,” ayay wasaaraddu ku tiri bayaan ay soo saartay 29-ka Agoosto. Puntland waxay sheegtay in dowladda federaalka iyo Turkigu ay lacag siiyeen burcad-badeedda si markabka loo sii daayo, balse ma aysan shaacin lacagta la bixiyay, mana soo bandhigin caddeymo madax-bannaan oo lagu xaqiijin karo eedeynta. Laba war oo iska hor imanaya Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada badda Turkiga iyo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ay iska kaashadeen howlgalka lagu soo furtay markabka. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in muddadii 10-ka maalmood ahayd ee howlgalka la burburiyay afar doon oo ay adeegsanayeen burcad-badeedda, halka 14 ka mid ah burcad-badeedda ay ku dhinteen. Sida ay wasaaraddu sheegtay, cadaadiska militari ee joogtada ah ayaa ku qasbay burcad-badeedda haray inay ka baxaan markabka, kadibna ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ay la wareegeen. Wasaaradda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in markabku dib u bilaabay safarkiisa, balse ma aysan faahfaahin ciidamada sida gaarka ah uga qeyb qaatay howlgalka, sida ay u dhinteen 14-ka qof ee lagu tilmaamay burcad-badeedda, iyo in ay jireen wada-hadallo madax-furasho ah. Waxay sheegtay in howlgalka lagu fuliyay heshiiska iskaashiga difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, kaas oo ay qeyb ka yihiin ilaalinta xeebaha, amniga badda iyo la dagaallanka burcad-badeedda. Puntland ayaa dhinaceeda soo bandhigtay sheeko ka duwan tan dowladda federaalka. Wasaaradda Amniga Puntland waxay sheegtay inay si dhow ula socotay xiriirro taleefan oo dhex marayay saraakiil sare oo dowladda federaalka ah iyo burcad-badeedda haysatay MV LUTUF. Waxay ku eedeysay mas’uuliyiin federaal ah inay dhex-dhexaadiyeen bixinta madax-furashada iyo sii deynta markabka, balse ma aysan magacaabin mas’uuliyiintaas, mana aysan soo bandhigin duubis ama caddeymo kale oo ay ku taageerto sheegashadeeda. Warar hore ayaa sheegayay in burcad-badeeddu ay dalbadeen ku dhowaad laba milyan oo dollar si ay u sii daayaan markabka. Waqtigaas ma caddeyn in wada-hadallo rasmi ah billowdeen iyo cidda, haddii ay jirto, ee oggolaatay inay bixiso lacagta. Puntland waxay ku tilmaantay bixinta lacag madax-furasho ah “khalad weyn”, iyadoo sheegtay in arrintaasi dhiirrigelin karto afduubyo kale isla markaana dhaawici karto dadaallada lagula dagaallamayo burcad-badeedda. Markab siday hub Burcad-badeed ayaa 17-kii Agoosto afduubtay MV LUTUF xilli uu marayay meel ka baxsan degmada Eyl ee Puntland, kadibna waxay u kaxeeyeen dhinaca xeebaha gobolka Nugaal. Mas’uul Soomaali ah ayaa hore u sheegay in markabku siday hub Turkigu leeyahay, qalab isgaarsiineed iyo nidaamyo dayax-gacmeed oo ku wajahnaa xarun militari oo Turkigu ku leeyahay Muqdisho. Markabka waxaa la socday 10 shaqaale ah oo kala ahaa lix Hindi ah, hal Turki ah, hal Georgian ah iyo laba Serbian ah oo ilaalo ahaan u shaqeynayay. Afduubka markabka kadib waxaa kordhay dhaqdhaqaaqa ciidamada badda iyo diyaaradaha kormeerka ee Turkiga ee xeebaha Puntland. Wasaaradda Difaaca Turkiga ayaa toddobaadkan sheegtay in Taliska Howlgalka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga uu taageero siinayo hay’adaha Soomaaliya ee la dagaallamaya argagixisada iyo burcad-badeedda, balse waqtigaas ma aysan xaqiijin inay ciidamadeedu qaadeen duqeymo ka dhacay agagaarka markabka. Eedeynta duqeymaha Puntland ayaa sidoo kale dib u cusbooneysiisay eedeynteeda ah in Turkigu qaaday duqeymo ka dhacay xeebaha Garmaal iyo Jiifle intii markabku gacanta ugu jiray burcad-badeedda. Wasaaradda Amniga Puntland waxay sheegtay in duqeymahaas, oo dhacay 18 iyo 20-ka Agoosto, ay ku dhinteen muwaadiniin Soomaali ah, sidoo kalena lagu burburiyay doonyo kalluumeysi. Waxay ku eedeysay Turkiga inuu bartilmaameedsaday dadkaas isagoo ku tuhmay inay doonayeen inay ku biiraan ama caawiyaan burcad-badeedda. Turkigu weli si rasmi ah uma uusan sheegan mas’uuliyadda duqeymahaas. Puntland ayaa horay u sheegtay in ugu yaraan 13 qof lagu dilay labada weerar. Duqeyntii ugu horreysay ee ka dhacday agagaarka Garmaal waxaa lagu dilay afar qof, laba kalena waa lagu dhaawacay. Wararkii hore waxay qaar ka mid ah dadka la dilay ku tilmaameen burcad-badeed, halka qoysaskooda iyo dadka deegaanka ay sheegeen in qaar ay ahaayeen kalluumeysato. Mas’uul Soomaali ah ayaa sheegay in doon yar ay qaad u geysay burcad-badeedda ka hor inta aysan dib ugu soo laaban xeebta, halkaas oo la beegsaday. Weerar kale oo ka dhacay Jiifle ayaa sida ay sheegeen ilo deegaanka ah lagu dilay sagaal qof. Weli muran ayaa ka taagan cidda ay ahaayeen dadka la dilay iyo haddii dhammaantood ay xiriir la lahaayeen burcad-badeedda. Wasiir ku-xigeenka Amniga Puntland Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf Dujana ayaa BBC Somali u sheegay in maamulka Puntland uu hayo caddeymo muujinaya in Turkigu ku lug lahaa weerarrada. “Burcad-badeedda waan la dagaallamaynaa, laakiin dadku xuquuq bay leeyihiin. Qof si fudud looma dili karo,” ayuu yiri. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa bayaankeedii Sabtidii markii ugu horreysay si cad u xaqiijisay in ciidamada badda Turkigu qeyb ka ahaayeen howlgalka lagu soo celiyay MV LUTUF, balse kama aysan hadlin eedeymaha Puntland ee la xiriira duqeymaha. Sidoo kale ma aysan caddeyn in 14-ka qof ee ay sheegtay in lagu dilay howlgalka ay ku jiraan dadkii horay loogu soo warramay inay ku dhinteen duqeymaha xeebaha Puntland. ‘Baaritaan socda’ Puntland waxay sheegtay in hay’adaha dambi-baarista ay gabagabeynayaan baaritaan ku saabsan duqeymaha, iyadoo sheegtay inay Turkiga kala xisaabtami doonto dhimashada dadka ay ku eedeysay inuu dilay. Wasaaradda Amniga Puntland waxay sidoo kale ku tilmaantay arrinta mid is burineysa, iyadoo ku eedeysay Turkiga inuu dhinac ka caawiyay bixinta lacag madax-furasho ah, halka dhinaca kalena uu duqeeyay dad lagu tuhmay inay taageerayeen isla burcad-badeeddaas. Puntland waxay ka digtay in bixinta lacagaha madax-furashada ay maalgelin cusub siin karto burcad-badeedda, isla markaana dhiirrigelin karto afduubyo kale. Waxay ugu baaqday Midowga Yurub, Mareykanka iyo saaxiibada kale ee caalamka inay xoojiyaan iskaashiga ay Puntland kala leeyihiin la dagaallanka burcad-badeedda iyo dambiyada ka dhaca Badweynta Hindiya, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga weli si rasmi ah ugama aysan jawaabin eedeynta cusub ee Puntland ee ah inay lacag madax-furasho ah bixiyeen si loo sii daayo MV LUTUF. Puntland waxay sheegtay in dowladda federaalka iyo Turkigu ay lacag siiyeen burcad-badeedda si markabka loo sii daayo, balse ma aysan shaacin lacagta la bixiyay, mana soo bandhigin caddeymo madax-bannaan oo lagu xaqiijin karo eedeynta. Laba war oo iska hor imanaya Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada badda Turkiga iyo Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ay iska kaashadeen howlgalka lagu soo furtay markabka. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in muddadii 10-ka maalmood ahayd ee howlgalka la burburiyay afar doon oo ay adeegsanayeen burcad-badeedda, halka 14 ka mid ah burcad-badeedda ay ku dhinteen. Sida ay wasaaraddu sheegtay, cadaadiska militari ee joogtada ah ayaa ku qasbay burcad-badeedda haray inay ka baxaan markabka, kadibna ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ay la wareegeen. Wasaaradda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in markabku dib u bilaabay safarkiisa, balse ma aysan faahfaahin ciidamada sida gaarka ah uga qeyb qaatay howlgalka, sida ay u dhinteen 14-ka qof ee lagu tilmaamay burcad-badeedda, iyo in ay jireen wada-hadallo madax-furasho ah. Waxay sheegtay in howlgalka lagu fuliyay heshiiska iskaashiga difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga, kaas oo ay qeyb ka yihiin ilaalinta xeebaha, amniga badda iyo la dagaallanka burcad-badeedda. Puntland ayaa dhinaceeda soo bandhigtay sheeko ka duwan tan dowladda federaalka. Wasaaradda Amniga Puntland waxay sheegtay inay si dhow ula socotay xiriirro taleefan oo dhex marayay saraakiil sare oo dowladda federaalka ah iyo burcad-badeedda haysatay MV LUTUF. Waxay ku eedeysay mas’uuliyiin federaal ah inay dhex-dhexaadiyeen bixinta madax-furashada iyo sii deynta markabka, balse ma aysan magacaabin mas’uuliyiintaas, mana aysan soo bandhigin duubis ama caddeymo kale oo ay ku taageerto sheegashadeeda. Warar hore ayaa sheegayay in burcad-badeeddu ay dalbadeen ku dhowaad laba milyan oo dollar si ay u sii daayaan markabka. Waqtigaas ma caddeyn in wada-hadallo rasmi ah billowdeen iyo cidda, haddii ay jirto, ee oggolaatay inay bixiso lacagta. Puntland waxay ku tilmaantay bixinta lacag madax-furasho ah “khalad weyn”, iyadoo sheegtay in arrintaasi dhiirrigelin karto afduubyo kale isla markaana dhaawici karto dadaallada lagula dagaallamayo burcad-badeedda. Markab siday hub Burcad-badeed ayaa 17-kii Agoosto afduubtay MV LUTUF xilli uu marayay meel ka baxsan degmada Eyl ee Puntland, kadibna waxay u kaxeeyeen dhinaca xeebaha gobolka Nugaal. Mas’uul Soomaali ah ayaa hore u sheegay in markabku siday hub Turkigu leeyahay, qalab isgaarsiineed iyo nidaamyo dayax-gacmeed oo ku wajahnaa xarun militari oo Turkigu ku leeyahay Muqdisho. Markabka waxaa la socday 10 shaqaale ah oo kala ahaa lix Hindi ah, hal Turki ah, hal Georgian ah iyo laba Serbian ah oo ilaalo ahaan u shaqeynayay. Afduubka markabka kadib waxaa kordhay dhaqdhaqaaqa ciidamada badda iyo diyaaradaha kormeerka ee Turkiga ee xeebaha Puntland. Wasaaradda Difaaca Turkiga ayaa toddobaadkan sheegtay in Taliska Howlgalka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga uu taageero siinayo hay’adaha Soomaaliya ee la dagaallamaya argagixisada iyo burcad-badeedda, balse waqtigaas ma aysan xaqiijin inay ciidamadeedu qaadeen duqeymo ka dhacay agagaarka markabka. Eedeynta duqeymaha Puntland ayaa sidoo kale dib u cusbooneysiisay eedeynteeda ah in Turkigu qaaday duqeymo ka dhacay xeebaha Garmaal iyo Jiifle intii markabku gacanta ugu jiray burcad-badeedda. Wasaaradda Amniga Puntland waxay sheegtay in duqeymahaas, oo dhacay 18 iyo 20-ka Agoosto, ay ku dhinteen muwaadiniin Soomaali ah, sidoo kalena lagu burburiyay doonyo kalluumeysi. Waxay ku eedeysay Turkiga inuu bartilmaameedsaday dadkaas isagoo ku tuhmay inay doonayeen inay ku biiraan ama caawiyaan burcad-badeedda. Turkigu weli si rasmi ah uma uusan sheegan mas’uuliyadda duqeymahaas. Puntland ayaa horay u sheegtay in ugu yaraan 13 qof lagu dilay labada weerar. Duqeyntii ugu horreysay ee ka dhacday agagaarka Garmaal waxaa lagu dilay afar qof, laba kalena waa lagu dhaawacay. Wararkii hore waxay qaar ka mid ah dadka la dilay ku tilmaameen burcad-badeed, halka qoysaskooda iyo dadka deegaanka ay sheegeen in qaar ay ahaayeen kalluumeysato. Mas’uul Soomaali ah ayaa sheegay in doon yar ay qaad u geysay burcad-badeedda ka hor inta aysan dib ugu soo laaban xeebta, halkaas oo la beegsaday. Weerar kale oo ka dhacay Jiifle ayaa sida ay sheegeen ilo deegaanka ah lagu dilay sagaal qof. Weli muran ayaa ka taagan cidda ay ahaayeen dadka la dilay iyo haddii dhammaantood ay xiriir la lahaayeen burcad-badeedda. Wasiir ku-xigeenka Amniga Puntland Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf Dujana ayaa BBC Somali u sheegay in maamulka Puntland uu hayo caddeymo muujinaya in Turkigu ku lug lahaa weerarrada. “Burcad-badeedda waan la dagaallamaynaa, laakiin dadku xuquuq bay leeyihiin. Qof si fudud looma dili karo,” ayuu yiri. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa bayaankeedii Sabtidii markii ugu horreysay si cad u xaqiijisay in ciidamada badda Turkigu qeyb ka ahaayeen howlgalka lagu soo celiyay MV LUTUF, balse kama aysan hadlin eedeymaha Puntland ee la xiriira duqeymaha. Sidoo kale ma aysan caddeyn in 14-ka qof ee ay sheegtay in lagu dilay howlgalka ay ku jiraan dadkii horay loogu soo warramay inay ku dhinteen duqeymaha xeebaha Puntland. ‘Baaritaan socda’ Puntland waxay sheegtay in hay’adaha dambi-baarista ay gabagabeynayaan baaritaan ku saabsan duqeymaha, iyadoo sheegtay inay Turkiga kala xisaabtami doonto dhimashada dadka ay ku eedeysay inuu dilay. Wasaaradda Amniga Puntland waxay sidoo kale ku tilmaantay arrinta mid is burineysa, iyadoo ku eedeysay Turkiga inuu dhinac ka caawiyay bixinta lacag madax-furasho ah, halka dhinaca kalena uu duqeeyay dad lagu tuhmay inay taageerayeen isla burcad-badeeddaas. Puntland waxay ka digtay in bixinta lacagaha madax-furashada ay maalgelin cusub siin karto burcad-badeedda, isla markaana dhiirrigelin karto afduubyo kale. Waxay ugu baaqday Midowga Yurub, Mareykanka iyo saaxiibada kale ee caalamka inay xoojiyaan iskaashiga ay Puntland kala leeyihiin la dagaallanka burcad-badeedda iyo dambiyada ka dhaca Badweynta Hindiya, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga weli si rasmi ah ugama aysan jawaabin eedeynta cusub ee Puntland ee ah inay lacag madax-furasho ah bixiyeen si loo sii daayo MV LUTUF. items.title: Daadadkii Nepal oo galaaftay nolosha 734 Qof,  halka 2,498 kalena Weli la la’yahay
items.description: Nepal ayaa wajahaysa mid ka mid ah musiibooyinkii dabiiciga ahaa ee ugu khasaaraha badnaa muddooyinkii dambe, kaddib markii daadad xooggan oo ka dhashay burbur baraf iyo dhagax ah ay ku dhufteen qaybo badan oo dalka ah. Tirada dadka ku dhintay gudaha Nepal ayaa gaartay 734 qof, halka 2,498 qof weli la la’yahay, iyadoo ciidamada iyo kooxaha samatabbixintu ay maalintii shanaad sii wadaan baadigoobka dadka ku xayiran meelaha ay musiibadu sida weyn u saameysay. Daadadka ayaa bilaabmay 26-kii Agoosto, kaddib markii burbur ka dhacay dhulka buuraleyda ah ee u dhow xadka Nepal iyo Tibet uu sababay in biyo, baraf, dhagxaan iyo dhoobo aad u badan ay si xoog leh ugu qulqulaan nidaamyada webiyada Bhotekoshi iyo Trishuli . Qulqulkaas ayaa qaaday guryo, baabuur, waddooyin iyo buundooyin, waxaana sidoo kale burbur xooggan soo gaaray mashaariicda waaweyn ee korontada laga dhaliyo biyaha. Hay’adda Maareynta Masiibooyinka Nepal ayaa sheegtay in 8,186 qof la soo badbaadiyay , iyadoo kumannaan askari iyo shaqaale gurmad ah loo diray goobaha musiibadu ka dhacday. Diyaaradaha qumaatiga u kaca ayaa loo adeegsaday in dadka laga soo saaro tuulooyin iyo goobo ay waddooyinku burbureen, halka gargaar cunto, biyo iyo dawooyin ahna loo gudbinayo dadka ka badbaaday daadadka. Mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu adag ee gurmadku ka socdo waa tunnel-lada ama godadka mashaariicda korontada biyaha , halkaas oo boqolaal shaqaale ah la rumeysan yahay inay ku xayiran yihiin. Dowladda Nepal waxay sheegtay in 933 shaqaale oo ka tirsanaa mashaariicda korontada biyaha ay weli ku jiraan liiska dadka la la’yahay. Ciidamada ayaa isku dayaya inay gaaraan dadka ku xayiran tunnel-lada, waxaana kooxo farsamo oo ka socda Hindiya ay sidoo kale ka qeyb qaadanayaan howlaha samatabbixinta. Howlaha gurmadka ayaa waxaa sii adkeynaya roobabka iyo kororka heerarka biyaha webiyada, ayadoo Maamulka Nepal uu soo saaray digniino cusub oo ku wajahan dadka ku nool agagaarka webiga Bhotekoshi, iyadoo laga cabsi qabo fatahaado kale. Dhul-go’ iyo burburka waddooyinka ayaa sidoo kale go’doomiyay deegaanno badan, taasoo adkeyneysa in kooxaha gurmadku ay si dhulka ah u gaaraan dadka u baahan caawimaadda. Musiibadu kuma eka gudaha Nepal oo keliya, waxaana sidoo kale saameyn weyn uu daadku ku yeeshay dhinaca Tibet ee Shiinaha . Mas’uuliyiinta Shiinaha ayaa sheegay in halkaas ay ku dhinteen 16 qof, halka 546 qofna la la’yahay. Marka Nepal iyo Tibet la isku daro, tirada dhimashada waxay gaartay 750 qof , halka in ka badan 3,000 qof ay weli maqan yihiin. Dhanka dhaqaalaha, khasaaraha ayaa ah mid aad u ballaaran. Wasiirka Maaliyadda Nepal Swarnim Wagle ayaa sheegay in qiyaasta hordhaca ah ee kharashka dib-u-dhiska iyo soo kabashada ay u dhexeyso 4 ilaa 5 bilyan oo dollar , inkastoo qiimeyn dhammeystiran aan weli la sameyn. Qaddarkaasi wuxuu u dhigmaa ku dhowaad toban meelood meel dhaqaalaha Nepal, taasoo muujineysa baaxadda burburka. Burburka ayaa si gaar ah u saameeyay waddooyinka, buundooyinka, guryaha, xarumaha korontada iyo goobaha dalxiiska. Qaybta korontada biyaha laga dhaliyo ayaa muhiim u ah dhaqaalaha Nepal, waxaana waxyeello soo gaartay mashaariic matalaya in ka badan 12 boqolkiiba awoodda koronto-dhalinta dalka . Si kastaba ha ahaatee dhibaatadu ma ahan oo keliya musiibo bani’aadamnimo, balse waxay sidoo kale noqon kartaa caqabad dhaqaale oo muddo dheer saameyn ku yeelata dalka. Hindiya, Shiinaha, Mareykanka, Kanada, Boqortooyada Midowday, Japan iyo Qaramada Midoobay ayaa bixiyay ama ballanqaaday gargaar dhaqaale, qalab iyo khubaro ku takhasusay samatabbixinta, balse dawladda Nepal ayaa si gaar ah u raadinaysaa taageero farsamo oo la xiriirta samata-bixinta tunnel-lada, baaritaanka DNA-da, aqoonsiga meydadka iyo qalabka lagu ogaan karo dadka nool ee ku xayiran burburka .

items.title: 187 kiis oo tacaddi ah oo Soomaaliya laga diiwaangeliyay – Maxay yihiin?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa shaacisay in 187 kiis oo tacaddi ah oo loo geystay haween iyo gabdho laga diiwaangeliyay khadka taageerada haweenka iyo carruurta ee dowladda, tan iyo markii la bilaabay adeeggaas bishii November 2025. Tirada kiisaskan ayaa laga soo uruuriyay wicitaannada ay dhibbanayaasha ama dadka xogta ka haya tacaddiyada u soo gudbiyeen xarunta Helpline 116, taas oo dowladda u sameysay in lagu soo sheego xadgudubyada ka dhanka ah haweenka iyo carruurta. Xildhibaan Ilyaas Sheekh Axmed oo ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ayaa tiradan soo bandhigay xilli baarlamaanka uu dood ka lahaa xeerka la xiriira kufsiga iyo tacaddiyada galmada, isagoo sheegay in khadku uu fududeeyay in dhibbanayaashu si toos ah u soo gudbiyaan dhacdooyinka ay la kulmaan. Sida xogta la shaaciyay, gobolka Banaadir ayaa ah halka ugu badan ee laga soo gudbiyay kiisaska, halka tirada kale laga diiwaangeliyay dowlad-goboleedyada dalka, taas oo muujineysa baahida loo qabo in adeegyada ilaalinta iyo taageerada la gaarsiiyo dhammaan gobollada. Xildhibaanka ayaa sheegay in kiisaska la soo gudbiyay ay muujinayaan baahida loo qabo in la xoojiyo nidaamyada lagu ilaaliyo haweenka iyo gabdhaha, iyo in hay’adaha dowladda ay si degdeg ah uga jawaabaan cabashooyinka ay soo gudbiyaan dhibbanayaasha. Helpline 116 ayaa la aas-aasay bishii November 2025, waxaana loogu tala-galay in haweenka iyo carruurta ay si fudud ugu soo gudbin karaan tacaddiyada, xad-gudubyada iyo xaaladaha kale ee halista ku ah badqabka, iyadoo xogta iyo kiisaska loo gudbiyo hay’adaha ay khuseyso. Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka ayaa sheegtay inay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo adeegyada loogu talagalay dhibbanayaasha, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin gudbinta kiisaska, adeegyada caafimaadka iyo taageerada dhinaca sharciga. Sidoo kale, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa waddo dadaallo lagu horumarinayo sharciga wax ka qabanaya kufsiga iyo tacaddiyada galmada, iyadoo hindise-sharciyeedka dambiyada kufsiga iyo anshax-xumada uu horyaallo Golaha Shacabka, xilli doodda ku saabsan ilaalinta haweenka iyo carruurta ay sii xoogeysaneyso. Wasaaradda Qoyska iyo Horumarinta Xuquuqul Insaanka ayaa sheegtay inay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo adeegyada loogu talagalay dhibbanayaasha, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin gudbinta kiisaska, adeegyada caafimaadka iyo taageerada dhinaca sharciga. Sidoo kale, Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa waddo dadaallo lagu horumarinayo sharciga wax ka qabanaya kufsiga iyo tacaddiyada galmada, iyadoo hindise-sharciyeedka dambiyada kufsiga iyo anshax-xumada uu horyaallo Golaha Shacabka, xilli doodda ku saabsan ilaalinta haweenka iyo carruurta ay sii xoogeysaneyso. Xeerka laftiisu wuxuu sidoo kale dhigaya mabda’a ah in qof aan lagu ciqaabi karin fal aan sharcigu si cad dembi uga dhigin ama ciqaab aan shar

items.title: Safiirkii Itoobiya u fadhiyay Soomaaliya oo Muqdisho ka ambabaxay, ayadoo aan la soo magacaabin Danjire Cusub
items.description: Safiirka Itoobiya u qaabilsanaa Soomaaliya, Suleiman Dedefo, ayaa ka ambabaxay magaalada Muqdisho kaddib markii uu soo dhammeystay muddo xil-diblomaasiyadeed oo wax yar ka badan hal sano qaadatay. Safaaradda Itoobiya ee Muqdisho ayaa Sabtidii, sheegtay in shaqaalaha safaaraddu ay sagootiyeen Dedefo, xilli uu ka dhoofayay caasimadda Soomaaliya, iyadoo safaaraddu ku tilmaantay bixitaankiisa mid ku yimid dhammaystirka muddadiisa xilka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, safaaradda Itoobiya ma aysan shaacin sabab gaar ah oo keentay bixitaanka safiirka, sidoo kalena lama shaacin qofka beddeli doona. Dedefo waxaa loo magacaabay safiirka Itoobiya ee Soomaaliya sannadkii 2025, wuxuuna warqadaha aqoonsiga u gudbiyay Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, 5-tii Agoosto ee isla sanadkaas. Magacaabistiisa ayaa timid xilli labada dal ay dib ugu soo celinayeen xiriirkooda heer safiir, kaddib ku dhowaad hal sano oo uu jiray khilaaf diblomaasiyadeed oo aad u xooggan. Khilaafka u dhexeeyay Muqdisho iyo Addis Ababa wuxuu si weyn u qarxay bishii Janaayo 2024, kaddib markii Itoobiya iyo Somaliland ay kala saxiixdeen heshiis is-afgarad oo ku saabsanaa in Itoobiya ay hesho marin badeed. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa si adag uga hortimid heshiiskaas, iyadoo ku tilmaantay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysatay markii Soomaaliya ay bishii Abriil 2024 dalka ka saartay safiirkii Itoobiya ee xilligaas, Muktar Mohamed Ware, iyadoo sidoo kale diblomaasi kale oo Itoobiyaan ah ku dhawaaqday inuu yahay qof aan dalka laga rabin. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, xiriirka labada dal ayaa bilaabay inuu dib u soo hagaago kaddib dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo ay garwadeen ka ahayd dawladda Turkigu. Bishii Diseembar 2024, Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya waxay magaalada Ankara ku kala saxiixdeen Bayaanka Ankara, kaas oo labada dhinac ay ku xaqiijiyeen ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dal kasta, isla markaana ay ku heshiiyeen in wadahadallo laga yeesho sidii Itoobiya u heli lahayd marin badeed iyadoo la dhowrayo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya. Suleiman Dedefo ayaa lahaa khibrad diblomaasiyadeed oo ballaaran, Kahor inta uusan Soomaaliya iman, wuxuu safiir Itoobiya uga soo noqday Jabuuti, Imaaraadka Carabta iyo Nigeria. Intii uu Jabuuti ka howlgallayay wuxuu sidoo kale guddoomiye ka ahaa guddiga safiirrada ee IGAD, waxaa kale oo uu soo noqday madaxa fulinta ee shirkadda dowladdu leedahay ee Ethio-Engineering Group. Bixitaanka Dedefo ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli xiriirka Muqdisho iyo Addis Ababa uu weli ku jiro marxalad diblomaasiyadeed oo xasaasi ah, gaar ahaan arrinta marin-badeedka Itoobiya iyo heshiisyadii hore ee sababay khilaafka labada dal.

items.title: Dagaal xoogan oo ka dhacay deegaanka Basra oo isku xira Gobolada Shabellooyinka
items.description: Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ayaa waxa uu Sabtidii dagaal culus ku dhex maray deegaanka Basra oo saaran waddada xiriirisa Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose iyo Shabellaha Dhexe, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaano (Labada Shabelle). Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Booliska Sida Gaarka ah u tababaran ee Haramcad ayaa Arbacadii dhaqdhaqaaq ka bilaabay deegaankaasi, oo muhiim u ah sugidda amniga iyo isu socodka Labada Shabelle iyo duleedka Magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoona halkaasi ay ka dhacayeen dagaalo goos goos ah. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in dagaalku uu xoogeystay duhurnimadii shalay, ka dib markii ciidamadu ay ku siqeen dhufeysyada iyo godadka ay Shabaabku horey uga qoteen aagga jiinka Webiga Shabelle. Deegaankan oo ku yaala xadka Labada Shabelle ayaa dhaca qarka uu maro Webiga Shabelle. Wararka la helayo ayaa sheegaya in dagaalku uu soo gaaray xalay fiidkii, isla-markaana ay labada dhinac isku horfadhiyaan goobihii ay ku dagaalameen. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Al Shabaab ayaan weli ka hadlin dagaalka culus ee ka dhacay deegaankaasi iyo xiisadda weli halkaasi ka taagan. Deegaanka Basra, oo ah deegaan istiraatiiji ah, isla-markaana u dhexeeya Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose iyo Shabellaha Dhexe ayaa isku xira Magaalooyinka Afgooye iyo Balcad. Deegaankan oo lagu sheego deegaan beereed aad muhiim u ah ayaa waxaa inta badan ka dhaca iska horimaadyo, marka ay ciidamadu isku dayaan inay daba galaan meelaha ay Shabaabku ka soo tuuraan hoobiyeyaasha. Ciidamada ayaa dhowr jeer oo hore qaaday guluf militari oo qorshuhu ahaa in maleeshiyada lagaga sifeeyo deegaankaasi, balse ay mar kasta natiijadu ku soo dhamaaneysay iyada oo aan la xaqiijin yoolalka dagaalka.

items.title: Why Is Landlocked Ethiopia at the Table on Red Sea and Gulf of Aden Security?
items.description: Nairobi (WDN) — Somalia, Ethiopia, Yemen and Djibouti have held a two-day meeting in Nairobi focused on strengthening maritime security across the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden, a strategic corridor vital to regional and global trade. The meeting, organized by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) with support from the European Union, INTERPOL, the International Maritime Organization (IMO) and IGAD, addressed piracy, illegal fishing, human trafficking, migrant smuggling and drug trafficking, as well as the need for greater intelligence-sharing and coordination among regional security agencies. But the participation of Ethiopia—a landlocked country—stands out. Reports indicate that Eritrea declined to attend, objecting to Ethiopia’s participation which implied that Ethiopia was being considered among the Red Sea countries, while Somalia attended the meeting. Addis Ababa argues that maritime security is directly connected to its economic survival. The overwhelming majority of Ethiopia’s international trade depends on access through Djibouti’s ports, meaning instability in the Red Sea or Gulf of Aden can raise transport and insurance costs, disrupt supply chains and delay critical imports and exports. That economic dependence gives Ethiopia a legitimate interest in the security of regional maritime trade routes. But its participation also carries broader strategic significance at a time when Addis Ababa has repeatedly emphasized its determination to secure reliable and potentially diversified access to the sea. Ethiopian officials called for stronger cooperation among maritime-security institutions and coast guard authorities in Ethiopia, Somalia, Djibouti and Yemen, including the creation of mechanisms for sharing intelligence on maritime threats. The proposal raises an important distinction: economic dependence on maritime routes is not the same as sovereignty over maritime territory . Ethiopia’s landlocked status gives it a strong economic interest in the uninterrupted movement of goods, but it does not give Addis Ababa territorial rights over the waters or coastlines of neighboring states. For Somalia, this distinction is particularly important. Somalia possesses one of the longest coastlines in Africa and occupies a strategically critical position along the Gulf of Aden and Indian Ocean. Any regional maritime-security framework involving Somalia therefore intersects with questions of sovereignty, fisheries, foreign military activity and control of maritime resources. The Nairobi meeting nevertheless reflects a growing reality: maritime insecurity no longer affects only coastal states. Piracy, illicit trafficking, terrorism and disruption of shipping routes can rapidly generate economic consequences far inland. For Ethiopia, whose economy is heavily dependent on external ports, instability at sea can become an economic crisis on land. For Somalia, however, the challenge is more profound. Its strategic coastline is simultaneously a national asset, a security responsibility and an increasingly valuable geopolitical prize. The question for Mogadishu is therefore not whether Ethiopia has an economic interest in maritime security—it clearly does. The more consequential question is whether Somalia can participate in emerging regional maritime-security arrangements from a position of institutional strength, ensuring that cooperation protects Somali sovereignty and marine resources rather than creating new avenues for external influence. As competition intensifies around the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden, Somalia’s coastline is likely to attract growing attention from regional and global powers. The Nairobi meeting is another reminder that what happens at sea is increasingly inseparable from the political and economic future of the Horn of Africa. items.title: Ethiopia’s ambassador to Somalia departs Mogadishu barely a year after appointment
items.description: Ethiopia’s ambassador to Somalia departs Mogadishu barely a year after appointment Ethiopia’s Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary to Somalia, Suleiman Dedefo, has departed Mogadishu after “completion of his tenure” that lasted just over a year after his appointment. The Ethiopian Embassy in Mogadishu said on Saturday, 29 August, that embassy staff bid farewell to Suleiman “upon the completion of his tenure” as he departed the Somali capital. No reason was given for his departure, nor was a successor announced. Suleiman was appointed to the post in 2025 and presented his credentials to Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud on 5 August, restoring ambassador-level representation between the two countries after nearly a year of diplomatic rupture. His appointment followed a period of severe tensions triggered by Ethiopia’s January 2024 memorandum of understanding with Somaliland on securing access to the Sea, which Mogadishu denounced as a violation of Somalia’s sovereignty. The diplomatic rift saw Somalia expel Ethiopia’s ambassador, Muktar Mohamed Ware, in April 2024 and later declare another Ethiopian diplomat persona non grata. Relations began to thaw following the Turkey-brokered Ankara Declaration in December 2024, in which Ethiopia and Somalia reaffirmed respect for each other’s sovereignty and agreed to pursue negotiations over Ethiopia’s maritime access. Suleiman previously served as Ethiopia’s ambassador to Djibouti, the United Arab Emirates and Nigeria, and chaired the IGAD Committee of Ambassadors during his posting in Djibouti. He also served as CEO of the state-owned Ethio-Engineering Group. Addis standard

items.title: Press Release: Northern Salvation Front
items.description: When the apartheid regime of Israel brought its villainous flag and the most oppressive sign of the world today was brought to our shores, we woke up. We woke up to the alarming dark diplomatic cloud on the horizon. Hearing the agony of innocent Palestinian children’s cries; heeding the wailing mothers’ weeping call and feeling for the paralyzed, disinherited, and robbed fathers, we see the North setting itself up for the same perdition, placing itself in the eyes of a hurricane of horror. The pariah state world around (Israel), the same genocidal regime augers no sign of hope nor a diplomatic breakthrough, nor political benefit or economic advantage. It does not come with peace, for it buried it dead in 1948 when it expelled a million Palestinians from their motherland. It has no financial ability to appease anyone but a destructive military machine equipped to steal Palestinian lives and land. It no longer waves the diplomatic muscle it once touted but a technological terror. It saves no lives but takes away in the millions, sheds more innocent tears than the world combined, violates human rights by volumes, pulverizes cities, villages and farms by the thousands. Exporting such a criminal contempt to your house is suicidal. To invite the genocidal, criminally indicted (by the International Criminal Court), Benjamin Netanyahu, to your soil is disdainful. Have you no sense of shame? You have put yourself in a grave; you have buried your claim to legitimacy left to live for; you sacrificed your historical pride, killed the only commodity of credit you have been selling for 35 years, “peace.” The name Israel is synonymous with death and demise. You literally murdered your self-worth and destroyed any diplomatic likelihood. So you sold out your sole pride, pawned your religious faith, what have you received in their place? items.title: MV LUTUF freed off Somalia after Turkey pays ransom to Somali pirates
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – A Cameroon-flagged cargo vessel carrying weapons, armored military vehicles and other equipment bound for Turkey’s military base in Mogadishu was released by Somali pirates on Saturday after Ankara paid a $2.5 million ransom, according to local media and journalists in Somalia’s Puntland state – an account that directly contradicts a federal government claim that the ship was freed through a military operation. The vessel, MV Lutuf, had been held by pirates off the coast of Garmal in the Nugal region of Puntland, Somalia’s semi-autonomous northeastern state, since it was hijacked on August 17 . Competing Accounts of the Release Somalia’s federal Ministry of Defense said in a statement that the ship was released following a joint military operation by the Somali army and the Turkish navy that lasted 10 days and ultimately forced the pirates to let the vessel go. The ministry said the operation left 14 pirates dead. But Puntland’s Ministry of Security, in a separate statement, rejected that version of events outright. It said no military operation led to the ship’s release, and that the pirates freed MV Lutuf voluntarily after receiving the ransom they had demanded. The ministry said the payment was facilitated by members of the Somali federal government, who it said had been in phone contact with the pirates since August 17, the day the ship was seized. Puntland’s regional government strongly condemned the payment of ransom, warning that it risks emboldening pirates and undermining efforts to combat piracy along Somalia’s coast. Puntland Condemns Turkish Navy Killings, Vows Accountability Puntland authorities also condemned attacks in which the Turkish navy killed more than a dozen people off the region’s coast. The regional government said those killed were innocent civilians, and accused Turkey of using as a pretext the claim that the victims were on their way to join the pirates. Puntland said the Turkish navy destroyed fishermen’s boats in the process and vowed that Turkey would be held accountable for what it called an atrocity. Deni’s Earlier Accusations Against Ankara The developments follow accusations levelled days earlier by Puntland President Saeed Abdullahi Deni, who charged that Ankara was responsible for killing innocent fishermen off the regional coast in two separate strikes on August 18 and August 20. Deni said Puntland would not accept its people being killed in such a senseless and cold-blooded manner. Deni further alleged that piracy in the region had been engineered by outside powers seeking a pretext to maintain a presence along the Puntland coast and exploit the region’s maritime resources, including its fisheries. He said the region would fight piracy with the same resolve it applied earlier this year in its campaign against ISIS-Somalia. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Ciidanka Haramcad oo soo bandhigay maydka Cabdinaasir Farey iyo…
items.description: Marka (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada gaarka ah ee Haramcad ayaa weli howlgallo kasii wada gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, kuwaas oo galay maalintii shanaad oo xiriir ah, iyadoo khasaare lixaad leh lagu gaarsiiyay maleeshiyaadka kooxda Al-Shabaab. Ciidamada ayaa maanta dagaal adag la galay dagaalamayaasha Al-Shabaab, kadib markii ay isku fara saareen deegaannada Baldooska iyo Alifow oo ku teedsan jinka Wabiga Shabelle, halkaas oo jab culus lagu gaarsiiyay Khawaarijta. Taliska Ciidanka Gaarka ah ee Haramcad oo warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa sheegay in dagaalka maanta lagu dilay madaxii jabhadda Cabdinaasir Farey iyo qaar ka mid ahaa ilaaladiisa, kuwaas maydadkooda ay soo bandhigeen ciidamada. “Maanta, ciidamadu waxay dagaal adag la galeen maleeshiyaad hubeysan ee khawaarijta Al shabaab oo dhibaato ku hayay shacabka deegaanka. Dagaalka oo socday saacado ayaa lagu dilay madaxii jabhadda, Cabdinaasir Farey, iyo qaar ka mid ahaa ilaaladiisa,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale, ciidamada ayaa howlgalladan ku burburiyay shabakado argagixiso ah iyo fariisimo ay Khawaarijta ku lahaayeen deegaanno ku teedsan wabiga Shabeelle, halkaas oo muddo dheer ay ku dhuumaalaysanayeen. Waxaa kale oo ay ciidamadu gudaha u galeen dhammaan deegaannadii howlgalka laga sameeyay, kadib markii ay ka firxadeen Al-Shabaabkii ku sugnaa, iyaga oo haatan halkaas ka wada baaritaanno lagu xaqiijinayo amniga guud. Howlgalladan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu xaqiijinayo amniga deegaannada ku teedsan Wabiga Shabeelle iyo sidii looga sifeyn lahaa kooxda Al-Shabaab oo weerarro kasoo abaabula halkaasi. Xaaladda ayaa weli kacsan, waxaana haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan laga dareemayaa qaybo badan oo kamid ah Shabeellaha Hoose , iyadoo dhawaan Dowladda Federaalka ah e Soomaliya ay u dirtay ciidamo dheeraad ah. Gobolkan ayaa waxaa ku xooggan maleeshiyada kooxda Al-Shabaab oo badanaa weerarro culus kasoo abaabula, waxaana qorshaha dowladda uu yahay in halkaas laga sifeeyo kooxaha argagixisada. items.title: Madaxweyne Cirro oo kulan la yeeshay siyaasiyyin ka  soo jeeda bariga Sanaag
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa kulan la yeeshay Siyaasiyiin ka soo jeeda Bariga Gobolka Sanaag, kuwaas oo dhawaan dib ugu soo laabtay dalkooda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Madaxweynaha ayaa ugu horrayn siyaasiyiinta si diirran ugu soo dhaweeyey dalkooda, isaga oo uga mahad celiyey go’aanka ay ku doorteen in ay dib ugu soo laabtaan dalkooda iyo dadkooda, kana qayb qaataan nabadaynta, walaalaynta bulshada iyo horumarinta deegaannada ay ka soo jeedaan. Kulanku waxa uu xambaarsanaa farriin siyaasadeed iyo midnimo Qaran oo ku wajahan xoojinta wadajirka ummadda Somaliland, adkaynta amniga iyo xasilloonida bulshada, iyo dhisidda is-afgarad siyaasadeed oo salka ku haya danta guud, nabadda iyo iskaashiga lagu xaqiijinayo mustaqbal wanaagsan oo Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland yeesho. Kulanka waxa Madaxweynaha ku wehelinayey xubno ka tirsan Golaha Wasiirrada, Guddoomiyaha iyo Xoghayaha Guddida Nabadda Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland & mas’uuliyiin kale. Madaxweynuhu waxa uu Siyaasiyiinta ka soo jeeda Bariga Sanaag u xaqiijiyey in ummadda Somaliland aanay kala lahayn xuduudo, isla markaana ay tahay ummad isku dal, isku dad iyo isku dan ah oo aan sinaba u kala maarmi karin, meel kasta oo ay joogaanba. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynuhu waxa uu tilmaamay in Xukuumaddiisa ay ka go’an tahay in muwaadin kasta uu dareemo ka mid ahaanshaha iyo lahaanshaha Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in Xukuumaddu ay mudnaanta koowaad siinayso isu-soo-dhawaanshaha bulshada, wada-tashiga iyo nabadgelyada, isla markaana loo baahan yahay in dalka lagu dhiso wadajir, kalsooni iyo aragti Qaran oo midaysan. Dhankooda, Siyaasiyiintii kulanka ka qaybgalay ayaa Madaxweynaha uga mahad celiyey soo-dhowaynta iyo fursadda uu siiyey in ay si toos ah ula wadaagaan aragtidooda. Waxa ay sidoo kale muujiyeen sida ay uga go’an tahay in ay kaalintooda ka qaataan nabadaynta, midnimada bulshada, horumarinta deegaannadooda iyo xoojinta Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland.

items.title: Xildhibaan Saadaam: Amniga Jilib ka jira iyo kan Muqdisho waa isku mid + Video
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xildhibaan Saadaam Maxamuud Cabdi oo ka tirsan Mudanayaasha Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aaddan amniga magaalada Muqdisho, xilli haatan uu yahay mid deggan. Xildhibaanka oo laga soo doorto Puntland ayaa is barbar dhigay amniga ka jira magaalada Muqdisho iyo kan degmada Jilib ee gobolka Jubbada Dhexe oo ay gacanta ku hayaan Al-Shabaab, isagoo sheegay in labada deegaan ay dhinaca amniga isku mid yihiin, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Saadaam ayaa dowladda ku eedeeyay inay dhibaato ku hayso shacabka, isla markaana ay dhacdo hantidooda, halka Al-Shabaab, sida uu hadalka u dhigay ay shacabka baadaan oo haddana ay laayaan. “Amniga Jilib ka jira iyo kan Muqdisho ka jira waa isku mid. Al-Shabaab dadkee baadaan oo ay laayaan, dowladdana dadkee dhacdaa oo ay xoogtaa,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Saadaam. Wariyeyaasha oo xildhibaanka su’aallo adag ka weydiiyay hadalkiisa ayaa mar kale ku adkeystay mowqifkiisa, isaga oo ku dooday in aysan weli nabad buuxda ahayn magaalada caasimada ah ee Muqdisho. “Dhacdooyinkii Muqdisho ka dhici jiray waa yaraadeen laakiin amni darradii weli waa jirtaa, dadka masaakiinta ahna waa lagu baadaa,” ayuu mar kale ku jawaabay Xildhibaan Saadaam. Hadalka Xildhibaan Saadaam ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli haatan amniga magaalada Muqdisho uu yahay mid wanaagsan, isla markaana dowladda Soomaaliya ay shaqo muuqata ka qabatay sugidda amniga caasimadda, taas oo keentay in isbeddel wayn laga dareemo dhammaan degmooyinka Gobolka Banaadr. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa xoogga saartay xoojinta ciidamada ammaanka, baarista goobaha laga shakiyo iyo ka hortagga falalka amni-darro, taas oo qayb ka noqotay dadaallada lagu ilaalinayo xasilloonida caasimada. items.title: AU clears peacekeepers to join Somalia fight against Southwest Darwish forces
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The African Union Commission has authorized its peacekeeping mission in Somalia to join federal government forces in combat operations against Darwish militia loyal to an ousted Southwest regional president, marking the first time the continental force has been cleared to take a side in a local Somali political dispute. The authorization came in a letter dated August 21 from African Union Commission Chairperson Mahmoud Ali Youssouf, instructing the African Union Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) to fight alongside federal troops against forces commanded by Abdiasis Laftagaren, the ousted president of Somalia’s Southwest regional state, whose Darwish forces have clashed with the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS). “The reported developments demonstrate growing alliance between local armed militias and the Al-Shabaab terrorist group, culminating in coordinated offensives against Somali military formations within and around Baidoa city. The Commission recognizes the imperative to urgently deliver critical support to the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS) to restore stability to the region,” Youssouf wrote. Youssouf is from Djibouti, whose president, Ismail Omar Guelleh, is a close ally and supporter of Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. “In line with its mandate to combat terrorism and reinforce the protection of civilians as well as safeguard key government institutions, AUSSOM is hereby authorized by the Chairperson of the Commission to join the FGS in military operations against the Al-Shabaab terrorist group and its affiliate militias/armed entities in the Southwest State of Somalia,” the letter states. Baidoa attack and unproven Al-Shabaab claims The authorization follows an attack this week in which Laftagaren’s forces briefly seized parts of Baidoa before being pushed back by federal troops. The Somali federal government has accused the Darwish forces of maintaining ties to Al-Shabaab and of coordinating with the militant group in the assault. The government has not provided evidence to support the claim of Al-Shabaab involvement. A break from foreign-forces withdrawal messaging The expanded AUSSOM mandate comes weeks after President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud declared that Somalia is capable of taking over full responsibility for its own security and called on foreign forces to leave the country, saying they would be given a farewell and sent back home with flowers. items.title: Carruur Soomaaliyeed oo u geeriyootay Hilib ay ku sumoobeen
items.description: Muqdisho (WDN) — Qoys Soomaaliyeed ayaa waxaa soo wajahday musiibo murugo leh kaddib markii lagu sheegay inay ku sumoobeen hilib iyo dhuux geel oo laga keenay magaaalada Ceeldheer ee Gobolka Galgaduud, taas oo sababtay geerida laba carruur ah, halka saddex kalena ay hadda ku jiraan isbitaalka. Qoyska ayaa Khamiistii u soo qaaday caruurta Muqdisho kadib markii ay ku sumoobeen cuntada. Sida xogta WardheerNews ay heshay, laba ka mid ah qoyska ayaa geeriyooday, iyada oo midkood uu ku dhintay Ceeldheer ka hor inta aan Muqdisho loo soo gudbin. Saddexda carruur ah ee hadda lagu daweynayo Isbitaalka Dr. Dufle ee Muqdisho. Aabbahood, Xirsi Cusmaan Cumar, ayaa sheegay in qoysku ku noolaa tuulo ku dhow Ceeldheer, isla markaana carruurtiisu ay xanuunsadeen kaddib markii ay cuneen hilib iyo dhuux geel oo muddo meel yaallay. Markii xaaladdoodu kasii dartay, ayuu sheegay in qoyska loo sheegay in aan Ceeldheer laga heli karin daryeel caafimaad oo ku filan, sidaas darteedna Muqdisho loo qaado. Saddexda carruurta ah ayaa ugu dambeyn la geeyay Isbitaalka Dr. Dufle, halkaas oo xaaladdooda si dhow loola socdo. Dr. Cusmaan Dufle ayaa sheegay in carruurtu muujiyeen calaamado caafimaad oo aad u daran oo la jaanqaadi kara sumow. Waxa uu xusay in indhahoodu isu beddeleen cagaar, kaadidooduna ay guduudatay, iyadoo mid ka mid ah carruurta lagu arkay barar ku yimid beerka. “Indhihii ayaa cagaartay, beerkiina wuu bararay. Lix maalmood gudahood ayay laba qof ku dhinteen. Baaritaankii cagaarshowga aan sameynay waxba kama soo bixin. Markii aan waalidka wareysannayna waxay noo sheegeen in carruurta la siiyay cuntadaas laga shakiyay inay sumeysan tahay,” ayuu yiri Dr. Dufle. Dhacdadan ayaa qoyska ku reebtay murugo weyn, iyadoo laba carruur ah ay noloshooda ku waayeen, halka saddex kale ay weli ku jiraan xaalad u baahan daryeel iyo kormeer caafimaad. Dhacdadu waxay sidoo kale oo tusaysaa adeeg iyo daryeel la’aanta shacbiga ee dhinaca dowladda, iyo khatarta ka dhalan karta hilib ama waxyaabo xoolaad oo si aan habboonayn loo kaydiyo ama muddo dheer meel yaalla, gaar ahaan deegaannada miyiga ah ee ay adag tahay in si degdeg ah loo helo adeegyo caafimaad iyo baaritaanno lagu ogaan karo sababta xanuunka. Qoyska, se, tani ma aha oo keliya dhacdo caafimaad—waa masiibo qoys oo qalbiga taabatay: laba carruur ah ayaa geeriyooday, saddex kalena waxay weli ku jiraan gacanta dhakhaatiirta, iyadoo cunto loogu talagalay inay qoyska quudiso ay isu beddeshay sababta murugada iyo khasaaraha aan la qiyaasi karin . items.title: Ciidanka taabacsan Lafta-gareen oo digniin cusub soo saaray – Maxaa soo kordhay?
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Ugaas Xasan Cabdi Maxamed oo ah afhayeenka Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen ayaa maanta soo saaray digniin cusub oo ku aadan xaaladda magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay oo ay horay uga dhaceen dagaallo culus. Afhayeenka oo ku sugan bannaanka magaalada ayaa farriin u diray shacabka, wuxuuna ugu baaqay inay fogaadaan goobaha ay joogaan ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed, si aysan waxyeelo usoo gaarin, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Ugaas Xasan ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in dagaal kasta oo dhaca uu sababi karo waxyeelo soo gaarto dadka rayidka ah, sidaas daraadeedna ay shacabka ugu baaqayaan inay ka feejignaadaan aagga ciidamada. “Walaalayaal reer Baydhabo, waxaan idiinku boorrinaynaa inaad ka feejignaataan kuwa duulanka kuyimid xaafadihiinna dhufeysyada ka qotay, gaar ahaan Salbalaar iyo Afbalaar. Dagaal kasta oo dhaca wuxuu sababi karaa in dhib iyo khasaaro ay soo gaaraan shacabka. Sharfta leh kana fogaada goobaha ay joogaan,” ayuu afhayeenku ku yiri qoraal uu soo saaray. Digniintan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli ay haatan Baydhaba ka taagan tahay xaalad siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo xasaasi ah, iyadoo dhinacyada isku haya maamulka Koonfur Galbeed ay hadallo iska soo horjeeda kasoo saarayaan xaaladda magaalada. Si kastaba, hadalka Ugaas Xasan ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo shacabka magaalada Baydhaba ay wajahayaaan walaac ku aaddan halka ay ku dambeyn karto xiisadda u dhexeysa dhinacyada, gaar ahaan haddii ay xaaladdu kasii darto. Dhinacyada ayaa horay ugu dagaalamay gudaha magaalada iyo daafaheeda, waxaana dagaalkii ugu dambeeyay uu sababay khasaare soo gaaray dadka rayidka ah ee aan waxba galabsan. The post Ciidanka taabacsan Lafta-gareen oo digniin cusub soo saaray – Maxaa soo kordhay? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Uganda’s Planned Exit Exposes Somalia’s Dangerous Military Vacuum
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia is facing a potentially decisive security test: can its government build a national military capable of replacing the foreign forces that have carried much of the burden of the country’s fight against Al-Shabaab? Uganda’s military chief, Gen. Muhoozi Kainerugaba, has announced that Uganda intends to withdraw all its troops from Somalia by August 1, 2027, declaring that no Ugandan People’s Defence Force (UPDF) personnel will remain in the country after that date. “We are completely leaving Somalia on August 1, 2027. There will be no UPDF troops in Somalia after that day,” Kainerugaba said in a post on X on August 28, 2026. Uganda has maintained troops in Somalia since 2007 and has been one of the most important contributors to international security operations against Al-Shabaab. If the announced withdrawal is implemented, it would represent a major blow to Somalia’s security architecture and place enormous pressure on the Somali government to fill the resulting military gap. The announcement also comes at a particularly troubling moment for Somalia. Rather than focusing national political energy on building a professional, adequately equipped and financially sustainable national army, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and opposition leaders remain immersed in seemingly endless negotiations over the electoral system, the electoral commission and even the Constitution. The political dispute is consuming enormous attention at precisely the moment when Somalia should be preparing for the consequences of a shrinking international military presence. Uganda’s announcement should be treated as a warning rather than a distant deadline. Somalia has depended on international military support for nearly two decades. The gradual reduction of foreign forces means the country can no longer assume that external partners will indefinitely provide the troops, logistics, intelligence, air support and operational capabilities required to contain Al-Shabaab. The fundamental question is whether Mogadishu has a credible transition plan. Building an army capable of replacing foreign forces requires far more than recruiting additional soldiers. Somalia needs reliable financing, regular salaries, professional command structures, intelligence capabilities, logistics, communications, medical evacuation, air support and, above all, political cohesion within the security institutions. Without these foundations, a numerical increase in troop strength could create the appearance of preparedness without delivering actual security. Political paralysis while the security clock runs The contrast is increasingly difficult to ignore. Somalia’s political leadership is deeply divided over the rules governing the country’s next election. The government and opposition continue to argue over electoral mechanisms, the composition and legitimacy of the electoral commission and constitutional amendments. Meanwhile, the country’s security environment remains fragile and international military support is under pressure. This creates a dangerous mismatch: Somalia’s politicians are negotiating who will govern the country next, while the country itself is struggling to build the security institutions needed for whoever eventually takes power. The situation is particularly concerning given the political dispute surrounding President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s mandate and the broader constitutional controversy. Mogadishu has also witnessed intense controversy over public land, with government critics alleging that politically connected individuals, including the president and members of his family, have benefited from the appropriation or redevelopment of public property. These allegations should be subjected to independent investigation rather than treated as established fact. But the consequences of large-scale displacement are undeniable. Claims that approximately 750,000 people have been displaced in Mogadishu represent an extraordinary humanitarian and security concern. Mass displacement can destroy livelihoods, deepen resentment and leave young people without employment or stable communities. Such conditions can be exploited by Al-Shabaab for recruitment, intimidation and propaganda. The danger is not that every displaced person will become an insurgent. The danger is that a population that feels abandoned by the state becomes easier for an insurgency to target. Al-Shabaab is not waiting While Somalia’s political class remains locked in negotiations, Al-Shabaab continues to adapt. The group has demonstrated resilience under sustained military pressure and has increasingly shown its ability to shift tactics, exploit weak governance and operate across large parts of the country. A reduction in foreign military support without a corresponding expansion in Somalia’s own capabilities could give the insurgency opportunities to regain territory, expand recruitment networks and increase attacks against government forces and civilian targets. The withdrawal of Uganda would therefore not simply represent the departure of another foreign contingent. It could expose the consequences of Somalia’s failure to prepare for a post-international-security era. The government and opposition have every reason to negotiate an electoral settlement. A legitimate political process is essential to national stability. But Somalia cannot afford to treat the electoral dispute as the country’s only national priority. The government should urgently publish a credible security-transition strategy answering basic questions: How many operational troops does Somalia actually have? How will they be paid? Who will finance their logistics? Who will provide air support and intelligence after international forces withdraw? Which units are capable of independently holding territory? And what is the plan for preventing Al-Shabaab from exploiting the transition? These are not secondary questions. They are questions of national survival. Uganda’s announced withdrawal provides Somalia with almost a year to prepare. Whether that period becomes a window for serious military reform or another year consumed by political confrontation will depend largely on the country’s political leadership. Somalia has spent almost two decades relying on international forces to prevent its security architecture from collapsing. The country cannot assume that this arrangement will continue indefinitely. The real deadline is not August 1, 2027. The real deadline is now. If Somalia’s political leaders continue fighting over electoral rules while failing to build the military institutions capable of protecting the state, the eventual withdrawal of foreign forces could expose a vacuum that Al-Shabaab will be more than willing to fill. items.title: Turkey’s Naval Deployment off Somalia: Security Partnership or a New Contest for Somali Waters?
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Turkey’s decision to deploy two warships to waters off the Horn of Africa has triggered a new debate in Somalia over the real purpose of Ankara’s expanding maritime role—and whether the operation will protect Somalia’s territorial waters or deepen concerns over foreign access to its marine resources. The Turkish Navy is sending the TCG Kemalreis and TCG Yzb. Güngör Durmuş to the region, with the vessels expected to operate from or around Djibouti while supporting Somalia’s federal maritime forces, counter-piracy operations and the protection of maritime supply routes linking the Red Sea, Gulf of Aden and Indian Ocean. Turkey says the deployment is aimed at strengthening cooperation with the Somali federal government and helping combat piracy and terrorism. The move follows renewed concerns over Somali piracy, including the hijacking of the MV Lutuf, a vessel reportedly carrying equipment from Turkey to a Turkish military facility in Mogadishu. But in Somalia, the deployment is being viewed through a far more suspicious lens. Critics, including members of the political opposition, question whether Turkey’s expanding military presence is genuinely designed to protect Somalia’s maritime security or whether Ankara is positioning itself to gain greater access to Somalia’s strategically valuable waters and marine resources. Those concerns have intensified following allegations that Turkish-linked operations could expose local fishing communities to military action. There are also fears among critics that foreign naval operations could contribute to the depletion or exploitation of Somalia’s fisheries while providing limited protection—or even creating additional risks—for Somali fishermen. No independent evidence presented publicly has established that Turkey is deliberately targeting Somali fishermen or seeking to deplete Somalia’s marine resources. Nevertheless, the allegations highlight a broader problem: Somalia lacks the institutional capacity to independently monitor and regulate the activities of foreign military and commercial actors operating in or around its waters. That weakness is precisely what makes the Turkish deployment politically sensitive. Who controls Somalia’s waters? Somalia possesses one of Africa’s longest coastlines and potentially significant fisheries resources, yet its maritime institutions remain underdeveloped after decades of state collapse. The result is a troubling contradiction. Foreign naval forces increasingly operate around Somali waters in the name of security, while Somali fishermen continue to demand stronger protection from illegal fishing and greater control over the country’s marine resources. The question is therefore not simply whether Turkey is helping Somalia fight piracy. It is whether Somalia has the capacity to ensure that every foreign security operation conducted in its maritime domain serves Somali national interests. The Puntland warning Puntland President Said Abdullahi Deni has already warned that foreign military deployments around Somalia’s waters could ultimately be used as a pretext for accessing and exploiting the country’s natural resources. That warning comes amid a deep political confrontation between Puntland and the federal government in Mogadishu. Puntland and other political actors are increasingly skeptical of security agreements negotiated by the federal government, particularly when regional administrations believe they have been excluded from decisions concerning their territorial waters and natural resources. The Turkish deployment therefore risks becoming entangled in Somalia’s wider constitutional and federal dispute. If Mogadishu presents Turkey as a strategic security partner while Puntland or other coastal communities view the deployment as an infringement on their interests, the result could be greater political fragmentation rather than stronger national maritime security. The hijacking of the MV Lutuf has added another layer of uncertainty. Turkish officials have linked their maritime engagement to counter-piracy efforts, while reports indicate that the vessel was carrying Turkish-supplied military and communications equipment destined for Mogadishu. Yet the incident also illustrates how Somalia’s maritime insecurity can quickly become internationalized. A piracy incident involving a vessel allegedly carrying Turkish equipment has now been followed by the deployment of Turkish warships into one of the world’s most strategically sensitive maritime corridors. That sequence inevitably raises questions about whether Somalia is becoming increasingly dependent on foreign powers to police its own coastline. Turkey has invested heavily in Somalia’s security sector and maintains a significant military relationship with Mogadishu. Ankara operates a major military training facility in Somalia and has cultivated close political ties with the federal government. Supporters argue that Turkish assistance is essential to rebuilding Somalia’s military and maritime capabilities. Critics, however, fear that the relationship has become too closely aligned with President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s administration and that Turkish security cooperation may serve Ankara’s strategic interests as much as Somalia’s. That perception could become particularly damaging if Turkish naval operations expand beyond counter-piracy and maritime security into areas affecting fishing, offshore resources or local communities. The issue demands transparency. Somalia should publicly clarify the legal basis, operational boundaries and rules of engagement governing foreign naval forces operating in its waters. It should also explain what safeguards exist to protect civilian fishermen and prevent illegal exploitation of marine resources. Somalia cannot outsource sovereignty The fundamental issue is bigger than Turkey. Somalia cannot rebuild its sovereignty by outsourcing the protection of its sovereignty indefinitely. Foreign military assistance may be necessary while Somali institutions remain weak. But assistance should strengthen Somalia’s own maritime forces—not create permanent dependency. A serious maritime-security strategy should include a capable Somali coast guard, transparent licensing of foreign fishing operations, satellite and radar monitoring, protection for local fishermen, effective prosecution of maritime crimes and a clear legal framework governing foreign military deployments. Without such institutions, Somalia risks becoming a country whose waters are defended by foreign navies while its own fishermen remain politically and economically vulnerable. Turkey may genuinely intend to help Somalia combat piracy and protect maritime routes. But the Somali public is entitled to ask a much broader question: Who ultimately benefits from the security of Somalia’s seas—and who controls the resources beneath them? Until Somalia can answer that question through strong institutions, transparent agreements and accountable national maritime authorities, every foreign warship entering Somali waters will inevitably generate both hope for greater security and fear of another chapter in the exploitation of a country whose strategic coastline has attracted competing powers for centuries. items.title: General Maxamed Sheekh Xasan Xaamud oo loo diray Baydhabo (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Asluubta Soomaaliyeed, General Maxamed Sheekh Xasan Xaamud ayaa galabta gaaray Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta KMG Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Saraakiisha Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Booliska Gobolka Baay iyo kuwa Asluubta ayaa Taliyaha ku soo dhaweeyay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud. War ka soo baxay Xafiiska Taliyaha Ciidanka Asluubta ayaa lagu sheegay in General Xaamud uu safar shaqo ku yimid Baydhabo, isla-markaana uu kormeer ku samayn doono xarumaha ciidamada. Tallaabadan ayaa qayb ka ah tallaabooyinka ay Dowladda Federaalka kaga jawaabeyso codsi uu toddobaadkii hore u soo jeediyay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo la xiriiray in Baydhabo loo soo diro Saraakiil khibrad leh oo ka caawiya howlaha sugidda amniga iyo wixii ciidan ah ee laga maarmi karo. Aadan Madoobe ayaa waxa uu loolan kala dhexeeyaa Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) oo diiday in uu aqoonsado madaxtinimadiisa. Loolanka u dhexeeya maamulka cusub iyo hoggaankii hore ayaa dhabaha u xaaraya xasillooni darro baahsan, oo haddaba la arki karo sida ay u saameynayso amniga iyo xasilloonida Magaalada Baydhabo. Labada garab ayaa mid kasta, waxa uu isku dayayaa in uu awood ciidan iyo mid siyaasadeed ku muujiyo Baydhabo, oo ah xarunta uu maamulku ku shaqeeyo.

items.title: Ethiopia’s Money-Transfer Restriction Raises Alarming Questions for Somali Customers
items.description: Addis Ababa (WDN) – Somalia’s money-transfer companies (Hawala), a vital financial lifeline for Somalis around the world, connecting the diaspora to families, communities, and businesses, have faced significant financial restrictions from the Ethiopian government, threatening an important channel for remittances and cross-border financial support. Ethiopia’s National Bank has issued a striking warning against 17 money-transfer companies operating without authorization to provide remittance services inside the country, exposing a regulatory gap that could leave thousands of customers vulnerable to financial loss, frozen funds and legal complications. Among the companies named by the National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) are seven Somali-owned or Somali-associated money-transfer businesses: Taaj Financial Service, Amal Express, Tawakal Money Services, Amana Express, Ramad Pay/Ramada, Jubba Express and Pay (Kaah). The warning raises an important question: How have money-transfer companies been allowed to serve customers in Ethiopia without the required authorization from the country’s financial regulator? The NBE cautioned that customers using unlicensed operators could face delayed transfers, financial losses and blocked accounts. It also warned that both senders and recipients could potentially face administrative or legal consequences when using unauthorized services. The announcement is particularly significant for the large Somali community in Ethiopia and for diaspora customers who rely on remittance networks to send money to Somalia. For many families, these transfers are not simply commercial transactions—they are essential to household survival. However, the NBE warning does not establish that the companies are illegal businesses everywhere they operate, nor does it necessarily mean they lack licenses in Somalia or other jurisdictions. The specific issue identified by Ethiopia’s regulator is that the companies listed do not have the NBE authorization required to conduct money-transfer operations inside Ethiopia. Nevertheless, the disclosure raises broader questions about oversight of Somalia’s rapidly expanding money-transfer and financial-services sector. Money-transfer companies and banks handle enormous flows of money and occupy a critical position in Somalia’s economy. Their operations therefore require rigorous scrutiny by the Central Bank of Somalia, including verification of licensing, ownership, compliance systems, customer protection, anti-money-laundering controls and the transparency of cross-border transactions. The Ethiopian warning should not be treated merely as a dispute over licensing. It is a reminder that weak regulatory oversight can ultimately expose ordinary customers to serious risks. Although Ethiopia operates a highly government-controlled financial system, with limited scope for an open and competitive financial market, nevertheless, for Somali regulators, the lesson is straightforward: financial institutions and money-transfer companies cannot be allowed to operate in a regulatory grey area. A credible financial system requires strong supervision, transparent licensing and meaningful enforcement—not only when problems emerge abroad, but before Somali customers are put at risk. The NBE has urged the public to use only authorized money-transfer companies. For Somali customers, the warning should serve as a wake-up call—and for financial regulators, a test of whether they are prepared to protect the public and impose accountability on an industry that handles billions of dollars in remittances. The bigger issue is no longer simply who is licensed in Ethiopia. It is whether Somalia’s own financial regulators know exactly who is moving its citizens’ money, under what rules, and with what level of accountability. items.title: Somalia Reopens Doolow Airport After Two-Year Closure
items.description: Doolow (WDN) — After keeping Doolow Airport in Gedo closed for nearly two years, the Federal Government of Somalia has reopened the facility, restoring a vital air link for communities that have endured severe restrictions on movement amid the political confrontation between Mogadishu and the Jubaland administration. The reopening has been welcomed by residents, but it also casts a harsh light on the human cost of what critics describe as the federal government’s use of civil aviation as a political instrument. For two years, residents of Doolow and surrounding communities were effectively cut off from a crucial transportation corridor. The consequences went far beyond inconvenience. The closure severely restricted access to emergency medical care, forcing sick patients and families to undertake long and difficult journeys by road to reach hospitals and specialized medical facilities, particularly in Mogadishu. For mothers traveling with infants, elderly people and critically ill patients, the consequences could be devastating. Residents and local sources have reported cases in which patients struggled for days to reach medical centers, while others allegedly died before receiving adequate treatment. The closure also disrupted trade and the movement of goods. Air transport had provided a faster and more reliable means of bringing commercial supplies into the region, while the alternative of transporting goods by road was slower, more expensive and vulnerable to insecurity and poor infrastructure. The timing and circumstances of the reopening have therefore prompted renewed questions about why a civilian airport serving an entire population was allowed to remain closed for so long. The dispute between Mogadishu and Jubaland has been deeply political, but critics argue that civilian populations should never become collateral damage in a confrontation between governments and political leaders. Restricting access to air transport can have consequences for fundamental rights, particularly the right to access essential healthcare and maintain basic economic and social connections. The reopening of Doolow Airport is undoubtedly good news for residents. Yet it also serves as a reminder of the price ordinary Somalis can pay when political disagreements are allowed to dictate essential public services. For the people of Gedo, the return of aircraft is more than the reopening of an airport. It is the restoration of a lifeline that should never have been severed in the first place. items.title: Ciidamada Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya oo soo furtay markabkii hubka siday
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta shaacisay in ciidamada badda Turkiga, oo kaashanaya Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, ay gacanta burcad-badeedda ka soo furteen markabka xamuulka qaada ee M/V LUTUF , oo hub iyo qalab milateri u siday xarun uu Turkigu ku leeyahay magaalada Muqdisho. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in howlgalka lagu soo furtay markabka uu socday muddo 10 maalmood ah, isla markaana lagu dilay 14 burcad-badeed ah, laguna burburiyay afar doon oo ay adeegsanayeen. Burcad-badeedda ayaa markabka afduubtay 17-kii Agoosto, xilli uu marayay biyaha ka baxsan xeebaha degmada Eyl ee gobolka Nugaal. “Cadaadiska joogtada ah ee ciidamada ayaa ugu dambeyn ku qasbay burcad-badeedda haray inay ka baxaan markabka,” ayay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ku sheegtay war-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay Jimcihii. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada ay la wareegeen gacan-ku-haynta buuxda ee markabka, kaas oo hadda dib u bilaabay safarkiisa. Muxuu markabka siday? M/V LUTUF waa markab xamuul oo sita calanka Cameroon, waxaana iska leh shirkadda Polar Movement Shipping. Markabka ayaa markii la afduubtay ku sii jeeday Muqdisho, isaga oo sida hub Turki ah, qalabka isgaarsiinta iyo qalab la xiriira dayax-gacmeedyada, sida uu horey wakaaladda AP ugu sheegay sarkaal Soomaali ah oo xog-ogaal u ahaa dhacdada. Sarkaalka ayaa sheegay in hubka iyo qalabka kale loo waday xarunta tababarka milateri oo Turkigu ku leeyahay Muqdisho ee TURKSOM. Markabka waxaa saarnaa 10 shaqaale ah oo kala ahaa lix Hindi ah, hal Turki ah, hal Georgian ah iyo laba Serbian ah oo ahaa ilaalo hubeysan. Burcad-badeedda ayaa markabka qabsatay meel qiyaastii saddex mayl-badeed iyo bar u jirta xeebaha degmada Eyl, ka hor inta aysan u kaxeysan dhinaca xeebaha Nugaal. Afduubka markabka ayaa si gaar ah indhaha loogu hayay sababo la xiriira nooca xamuulka uu siday iyo muhiimadda uu Turkigu ku leeyahay tababarka iyo taageerada ciidamada Soomaaliya. Howlgalka Turkiga War-saxaafadeedka maanta kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa markii ugu horreysay si cad dowladda federaalka uga xaqiijisay in ciidamada badda Turkiga ay si toos ah uga qeyb qaateen howlgalka lagu soo furtay markabka. Warar soo baxay maalmo kaddib afduubka ayaa sheegay in maraakiib, diyaarado aan duuliye lahayn iyo helikobtarro lala xiriiriyay Turkiga lagu arkayay agagaarka markabka, xilli cadaadis lagu hayay burcad-badeedda. Intii uu markabku gacanta ugu jiray burcad-badeedda waxaa sidoo kale dhowr jeer duqeymo ay ka dhaceen deegaanno xeebeedka gobolka Nugaal. Mas’uuliyiinta Puntland ayaa Turkiga ku eedeeyay inuu ka dambeeyay qaar ka mid ah duqeymahaas, hase yeeshee xilligaas ma jirin cid si rasmi ah u sheegatay mas’uuliyadda, Turkiguna si cad uma xaqiijin inuu fuliyay. War-saxaafadeedka Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ee maanta ma faahfaahin sida ay u dhinteen 14-ka qof ee ay dowladda ku sheegtay burcad-badeedda, balse wuxuu sheegay in afar doon oo kooxdu adeegsanaysay la burburiyay. Digniin culus Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa sheegtay in falalka burcad-badeednimadu yihiin dambiyo culus oo ciqaab adag leh, waxayna digniin u dirtay dadka ku lugta leh, kuwa taageera iyo cid kasta oo fududeysa falalkaas. Waxay sheegtay in dadka ku lug yeesha burcad-badeednimada lala xisaabtami doono, sharcigana la horgeyn doono. Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in howlgalka lagu soo furtay markabka uu socday muddo 10 maalmood ah, isla markaana lagu dilay 14 burcad-badeed ah, laguna burburiyay afar doon oo ay adeegsanayeen. Burcad-badeedda ayaa markabka afduubtay 17-kii Agoosto, xilli uu marayay biyaha ka baxsan xeebaha degmada Eyl ee gobolka Nugaal. “Cadaadiska joogtada ah ee ciidamada ayaa ugu dambeyn ku qasbay burcad-badeedda haray inay ka baxaan markabka,” ayay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ku sheegtay war-saxaafadeed ay soo saartay Jimcihii. Dowladda ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada ay la wareegeen gacan-ku-haynta buuxda ee markabka, kaas oo hadda dib u bilaabay safarkiisa. Muxuu markabka siday? M/V LUTUF waa markab xamuul oo sita calanka Cameroon, waxaana iska leh shirkadda Polar Movement Shipping. Markabka ayaa markii la afduubtay ku sii jeeday Muqdisho, isaga oo sida hub Turki ah, qalabka isgaarsiinta iyo qalab la xiriira dayax-gacmeedyada, sida uu horey wakaaladda AP ugu sheegay sarkaal Soomaali ah oo xog-ogaal u ahaa dhacdada. Sarkaalka ayaa sheegay in hubka iyo qalabka kale loo waday xarunta tababarka milateri oo Turkigu ku leeyahay Muqdisho ee TURKSOM. Markabka waxaa saarnaa 10 shaqaale ah oo kala ahaa lix Hindi ah, hal Turki ah, hal Georgian ah iyo laba Serbian ah oo ahaa ilaalo hubeysan. Burcad-badeedda ayaa markabka qabsatay meel qiyaastii saddex mayl-badeed iyo bar u jirta xeebaha degmada Eyl, ka hor inta aysan u kaxeysan dhinaca xeebaha Nugaal. Howlgalka Turkiga War-saxaafadeedka maanta kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga ayaa markii ugu horreysay si cad dowladda federaalka uga xaqiijisay in ciidamada badda Turkiga ay si toos ah uga qeyb qaateen howlgalka lagu soo furtay markabka. items.title: Garoonka Diyaaradaha Doolow oo Dib Loo Furay Kaddib Laba Sano
items.description: Garoonka diyaaradaha magaalada Doolow ee gobolka Gedo ayaa maanta dib loo hawlgeliyay, kaddib markii uu muddo ku dhow laba sano xirnaa, iyadoo duulimaadyadii ugu horreeyay ay si rasmi ah uga degeen garoonka. Xiritaanka garoonka ayaa lala xiriiriyay khilaafyo siyaasadeed oo u dhexeeyay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Maamulka Jubbaland. Dib-u-furista garoonka ayaa si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay bulshada gobolka Gedo, gaar ahaan shacabka Doolow oo muddo dheer ku baaqayay in dib loo bilaabo duulimaadyada. Doolow oo ku taalla xuduudda Soomaaliya iyo Itoobiya ayaa ah magaalo istiraatiiji ah oo xiriir la leh isu-socodka Soomaaliya, Itoobiya iyo Kenya. Dib-u-howlgelinta garoonka ayaa la filayaa inay fududeyso isu-socodka dadka, ganacsiga iyo isku-xirka bulshada, iyadoo sidoo kale laga rajeynayo inay wax ka tarto dhaqaalaha gobolka.

items.description: Wafdi ballaadhan oo ka socda Somaliland, oo uu hoggaaminayo Madaxweyne Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa isku diyaarinaya inay u safraan dalka Mareykanka labada toddobaad ee soo socda. items.title: Senator laga soo doorto Puntland oo arrin cajiib ah ka sameeyay Aqalka Sare
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Senator Farxaan Cali Xuseen oo kamid ah Golaha Aqalka Sare ee Baarlamaanka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta si nabadeed ugu bannaanbaxay golaha dhexdiisa, isaga oo eedeymo u jeediyay dowladda. Senatorka oo maanta ka qayb-galay kulankii Aqalka Sare ayaa kasoo muuqday isaga oo watay boor ay ku xardhan yihiin erayo uu ku muujinayo inuu dhammaaday muddo xileedka hay’adaha Dowladda Federaalka. “Muddo xileedku waa dhammaaday (EXPIRED) dowladda xil-gaarsiintu sharciyad cusub ma samayso,” ayuu kusoo qortay boorka Senatorku. Dhinaca kale, Senator Farxaan oo la hadlay warbaahinta ayaa faah-faahin ka bixiyay sababta uu u sameeyay arrintan, isaga oo ku dooday in Baarlamaanka uu yahay xil-gaarsiiye, isla markaana uusan meel marin karin shuruuc cusub. “Maanta waxaa la keenay laba sharci oo cusub iyo xubin la ansixinayo qodobka 103-aad ee dastuurka KMG ah wuxuu leeyahay haddii muddo xileedku dhammaado shaqada joogtada ah oo ku simaha ah ayaa la qaban karaa sharci cusubna lama ansixi karo xubin cusubna laguma soo dari karo, sidaas daraadeed intaas ayay ahayd ujeedayda,” ayuu yiri Senator Farxaan. Xildhibaanka oo hadalkiisa sii wata ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in maanta uu dalka u baahan yahay badbaado, isla markaana ay tahay in laga hadlo arrimaha doorashooyinka oo uu tilmaamay inay ku fashilantay xukuumadda Xamza. “Waxaa laga hadli karaa maanta oo muhiim ah doorashada, xukuumadda hadda jirta waxay ku guul darreysatay in doorasho la qabto,” ayuu raaciyay. Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirta marxlad xasaasi ah oo ka dhalatay xilliga kala guurka, waxaana si weyn isku haya Villa Somalia iyo kooxaha mucaaradka oo isku khilaafay hannaanka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka ka dhacaya dalka.
