items.title: Uganda oo shaacisay xilliga rasmiga ee ay ciidamadeeda kala baxayso Soomaaliya
items.description: Kampala (Caasimada Online) – Taliyaha ciidamada Uganda, Jeneraal Muhoozi Kainerugaba, ayaa shaaciyay in dalkiisa uu dhammaan ciidamadiisa kala bixi doono Soomaaliya marka la gaaro 1-da Agoosto 2027, taas oo haddii ay dhaqan-gasho soo afjari doonta ku dhowaad labaatan sano oo Uganda ay qayb ka ahayd howlgalada amni ee Soomaaliya. “Waxaan gebi ahaanba ka baxaynaa Soomaaliya 1-da Agoosto 2027. Ma jiri doonaan ciidamo UPDF ah oo Soomaaliya jooga wixii ka dambeeya maalintaas,” ayuu Kainerugaba ku yiri qoraal uu Jimcihii 28-ka Agoosto 2026 ku daabacay bartiisa X. Si kastaba, weli ma cadda in waqtiga uu shaaciyay Kainerugaba, oo ah wiilka Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni, uu yahay go’aan ay si rasmi ah u ansixisay dowladda Uganda ama uu yahay mowqif uu isaga ku dhawaaqay. Uganda ayaa tan iyo 2007 ka mid ahayd dalalka ugu waaweyn ee ciidamada ku biiriya howlgalada Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo ciidamadeedu muddo dheer ka qayb qaadanayeen dagaalka lagula jiro kooxda Al-Shabaab. Kainerugaba ayaa horey u sheegay in Uganda ay qorsheyneyso inay ciidamadeeda kala baxdo Soomaaliya kadib ku dhowaad 19 sano oo ay dalka ka howlgaleen. Bishii Febraayo, wuxuu sidoo kale ka digay in Uganda ay ciidamadeeda kala bixi karto Soomaaliya haddii aan xal laga gaarin dhibaatooyinka dhaqaale ee haysta howlgalka Midowga Afrika. Shirkii Kampala iyo mowqifkii Uganda Ku dhawaaqista cusub ayaa imaneysa wax ka yar bil kadib markii Uganda ay martigelisay shir aan caadi ahayn oo ay yeesheen dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya Howlgalka Taageerada iyo Xasillinta Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya ee AUSSOM. Shirkaas oo 31-kii Luulyo 2026 ka dhacay Kampala, Uganda waxay ku baaqday in beesha caalamku sii waddo taageerada nabadda iyo amniga Soomaaliya, iyadoo sidoo kale taageertay dadaallada lagu raadinayo maalgelin joogto ah oo lagu sii wado AUSSOM. Hadalladaas iyo ku dhawaaqista hadda ee Kainerugaba ayaa sii kordhinaya su’aalaha ku saabsan mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM, xilli Soomaaliya la filayo inay si tartiib tartiib ah ula wareegto mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. Mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM, oo ay ku jiraan ku dhowaad 12,000 askari, ayaa wajahaya cadaadis weyn kadib go’aan Mareykanku ku joojinayo taageerada uu siinayo adeegyada saadka iyo howlgalka ee Qaramada Midoobay u fidiso ciidamada Midowga Afrika laga bilaabo bilowga 2027. Mareykanka ayaa bishii Luulyo Midowga Afrika ku wargeliyay inuusan maalgelin doonin howlgalka wixii ka dambeeya 31-ka Diseembar 2026. AUSSOM ayaa si weyn ugu tiirsan taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee dhinacyada cuntada, biyaha, shidaalka, adeegyada caafimaadka iyo gaadiidka ciidamada. Washington waxay sheegtay inaysan diidi doonin in la kordhiyo muddada howlgalka AUSSOM, balse aysan taageeri doonin sii socoshada maalgelinta Qaramada Midoobay ee adeegyada saadka iyo howlgalka. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale dhaliilay sida ay Soomaaliya uga gaabisay inay si buuxda ula wareegto mas’uuliyadda amnigeeda kadib sannado badan oo taageero caalami ah. Go’aankaas ayaa walaac ka dhex abuuray Midowga Afrika iyo diblomaasiyiinta, kuwaas oo ka digaya in AUSSOM ay dhibaato weyn kala kulmi karto sii wadista howlaheeda haddii aan la helin ilo kale oo dhaqaale iyo taageero saadka ah. Machadka Daraasaadka Amniga ee ISS ayaa sidoo kale ka digay in joojinta taageerada Mareykanka ay cawaaqib culus ku yeelan karto AUSSOM, maadaama qeyb weyn oo ka mid ah taageerada muhiimka ah ee howlgalka ay ku tiirsan tahay dhaqaalaha Washington. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sannadihii dambe waday qorshe ay ciidamada Soomaaliyeed si tartiib ah ugula wareegayaan mas’uuliyadda amniga, iyadoo la dhimayo kaalinta ciidamada shisheeye. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa isaguna dhowr jeer sheegay in ciidamada shisheeye aysan Soomaaliya sii joogi karin muddo aan dhammaad lahayn, isla markaana dalku ugu dambeyn ku qasban yahay inuu isagu ilaashado amnigiisa iyo madax-bannaanidiisa. “Waa inaan ciidamada shisheeye ubax qurux badan guddoonsiinno oo dalkooda u dirno,” ayuu horey u yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Haddii Uganda ay ku dhaqaaqdo bixitaanka uu shaaciyay Kainerugaba, tallaabadaas waxay noqon doontaa isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, maadaama Kampala ay muddo ku dhow labaatan sano ka mid ahayd tiirarka ugu waaweyn ee howlgalada militari ee Midowga Afrika ka wado dalka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa isaguna dhowr jeer sheegay in ciidamada shisheeye aysan Soomaaliya sii joogi karin muddo aan dhammaad lahayn, isla markaana dalku ugu dambeyn ku qasban yahay inuu isagu ilaashado amnigiisa iyo madax-bannaanidiisa. “Waa inaan ciidamada shisheeye ubax qurux badan guddoonsiinno oo dalkooda u dirno,” ayuu horey u yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Haddii Uganda ay ku dhaqaaqdo bixitaanka uu shaaciyay Kainerugaba, tallaabadaas waxay noqon doontaa isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, maadaama Kampala ay muddo ku dhow labaatan sano ka mid ahayd tiirarka ugu waaweyn ee howlgalada militari ee Midowga Afrika ka wado dalka. items.title: Ruushka oo dagaalka Ukraine u adeegsaday Gantaal Cusub oo lagu magacaabo Iskander, Xilli uu Horumarinayo Hubkiisa
items.description: Dagaalka u dhexeeya Ruushka iyo Ukraine ayaa galay marxalad cusub, kaddib markii sirdoonka milatariga Ukraine uu sheegay in Ruushku markii ugu horreysay u adeegsaday weerar ka dhan ah Kyiv nooc cusub oo gantaalka ballistic-ga ah ee Iskander, kaas oo loo yaqaan Iskander-1000 ama 9M723-2. Gantaalkan ayaa lagu adeegsaday weerar ka dhacay caasimadda Ukraine xagaagan, iyadoo sirdoonka Ukraine uu sheegay inuu leeyahay masaafo gaareysa ilaa 550 kiiloomitir, taas oo ka badan qiyaastii 390 kiiloomitir ee noocii hore. Gantaalka cusub ayaa lagu sameeyay matoor ka weyn kii hore iyo qalab ridis oo isna la ballaariyay, taasoo u saamaxaysa inuu gaaro bartilmaameedyo ka fog kuwii uu gaari jiray Iskander-M. Horumarkan ayaa muhiim u noqon kara Ruushka, maadaama ciidamada Ukraine ay isku dayayaan inay bartilmaameedsadaan goobaha laga soo tuuro gantaallada Ruushka ka hor inta aan la ridin. Masaafo dheer waxay ciidamada Ruushka u oggolaan kartaa inay gantaallada ka soo ridaan meelo ka sii fog gudaha dhulka Ruushka, taasoo adkeyn karta in Ukraine ay ogaato ama burburiso goobaha laga soo tuurayo. Inkasta oo magaca “Iskander-1000” uu muujinayo masaafo 1,000 kiiloomitir ah, haddana xogta ugu dambeysay ee sirdoonka Ukraine ma xaqiijinayso in nooca hadda la adeegsaday uu gaari karo 1,000 kiiloomitir. Qiyaasta la xaqiijiyay ee la sheegay waa ilaa 550 kiiloomitir, halka fikrado iyo tijaabooyin hore ay tilmaamayeen in nooc mustaqbalka la casriyeeyo uu aragti ahaan gaari karo masaafo u dhow 900 ilaa 1,000 kiiloomitir. Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Ruushka uu sidoo kale sii ballaarinayo adeegsiga gantaallada uu ka helo Kuuriyada Waqooyi, iyadoo Sirdoonka Ukraine uu sheegay in Pyongyang ay Ruushka siisay ku dhowaad 50 gantaal oo KN-23, KN-24 iyo KN-30 ah ilaa July 2026, iyadoo sidoo kale la sheegay in Ruushku bilaabay inuu geeyo lix qalab oo lagu rido gantaallada Kuuriyada Waqooyi gudaha gobolka Voronezh. Gantaallada KN-23 iyo KN-24 ayaa loo adeegsaday dagaalka Ukraine tan iyo dabayaaqadii 2023, waxaana la sheegay inay muuqaal ahaan iyo qaab ahaan u egyihiin gantaallada Iskander-ka Ruushka. dagaalka Ukraine wuxuu sii gelayaa marxalad ay gantaallada ballistic-ga, wax-soo-saarka hubka iyo iskaashiga milatari ee Ruushka iyo Kuuriyada Waqooyi ay door weyn ka ciyaarayaan, iyadoo Isticmaalka cusub ee Iskander-1000 ee Kyiv iyo horumarinta noocyo masaafo dheer leh ay muujinayaan in tartanka hubka ee labada dhinac uu weli sii xoogeysanayo.

items.title: Xog: Al-Shabaab oo shacab ka afduubtay Shabeellaha Dhexe
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab ayaa saacadihii lasoo dhaafay dad shacab ah ka afduubtay deegaanka Warciise ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, sida ay innoo xaqiijiyeen ilo deegaanka ah. Ugu yaraan saddex qof, oo ay ku jiraan hooyo iyo gabadheeda ayay Al-Shabaab ka kaxeysteen deegaanka, iyagoo ula baxay dhulka hawdka ah ee ay ku dhuumaaleystaan. Dadkan ayay kooxda ku eedeysay inay basaasiin u ahaayeen Dowladda Soomaaliya oo dhawaan duqey culus ka fulisay deegaanka Warciise, taas oo lagu dilay horjoogayaal iyo maleeshiyaad ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab. Horjoogayaasha ku baxay weerarkaas waxaa kamid ah Axmed Cali Jimcaale, oo ahaa horjoogihii Khawaarijta ugu magacawnaa degmada Jowhar iyo Geedi Maxamed Nuur Cadde oo isna ahaa horjoogihii kooxda ee deegaannada Dumaaye iyo Dabagaalo, sida ay horay u shaacisay Hay’adda Nabad-sugidda. Dhinaca kale, ciidamada Macawiisleyda ee ku sugan Shabeellaha Dhexe ayaa baaq u diray dowladda dhexe, waxayna ka codsadeen inay ku gacan siiso howlgallada ay ka wadaan gobolkaas oo ay ku xoogan tahay Al-Shabaab. “Dowladda Soomaaliyeed waxaan ka codsaneynaa inay garab iyo gaashaan inoo noqoto oo ay howlgalka nagala qayb qaadato waa howlgal cibaado oo nimankan argagixisada ah looga dulqaado ummadda Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri sarkaal u hadal ciidamada Macawiisleyda ee ku sugan Shabeellaha Dhexe. Macawiisleyda deegaanka ayaa maalmihii ugu dambeeyay howlgallo culus ka wada gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, iyaga oo beegsaday xarumo muhiim ah oo ay dagan yihiin xubnaha Al-Shabaab, kadibna khasaare ku gaarsiisay kooxda. Howlgallada ka socda Shabeellaha Dhexe ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda Al-Shabaab, laguna burburinayo horjoogeyaashooda iyo shabakadaha ay u adeegsadaan abaabulka falalka argagixisada. The post Xog: Al-Shabaab oo shacab ka afduubtay Shabeellaha Dhexe appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maxkamad dharbaaxo culus ku dhufatay kiiska ka dhanka ah Khaalid Sheikh Maxamed
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamad militari oo Mareykan ah ayaa Jimcihii go’aamisay in dacwad-oogayaashu aysan maxkamadda u adeegsan karin qiraallo uu Khaalid Sheikh Mohammed, oo lagu eedeeyay inuu ahaa maskaxdii ka dambeysay weerarradii 11-kii September 2001, u sheegay hay’adda FBI-da. Garsooraha kiiska, Gaashaanle Dhexe Michael Schrama, ayaa sheegay in dowladda Mareykanka ay ku guuldareysatay inay caddeyso in hadalladii uu Mohammed siiyay FBI-da sanadkii 2007 ay ahaayeen kuwo uu si xor ah oo aan cadaadis lahayn u bixiyay. Go’aankan ayaa dharbaaxo weyn ku ah kiiska dacwad-oogayaasha, kuwaas oo qiraalladaas ku tilmaamay qaar ka mid ah caddeymaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay hayaan, xilli Khaalid uu wajahayo dacwad ciqaabteedu gaari karto dil. Khaalid ayaa lagu eedeeyay inuu qorsheeyay afduubkii diyaaradaha ee 11-kii September 2001, kuwaas oo lagu weeraray xaruntii ganacsiga adduunka ee New York iyo Pentagon-ka, halka diyaarad kale ay ku dhacday Pennsylvania. Ku dhowaad 3,000 oo qof ayaa lagu dilay weerarradaas. Go’aanka cusub ayaa yimid laba maalmood kaddib markii garsooraha uu 5-ta June 2028 u asteeyay inay bilaabato maxkamadeynta Khaalid iyo saddex eedeysane oo kale. Hase yeeshee, go’aanka Jimcaha ayaa keeni kara dib-u-dhac kale haddii dacwad-oogayaasha ay racfaan ka qaataan. Sarkaalka ugu sarreeya dacwad-oogayaasha, Rear Admiral Aaron C. Rugh, ayaa sheegay in kooxdiisu ay dib u eegi doonto go’aanka, kaddibna ay go’aan ka gaari doonto inay racfaan qaadato. Garsooraha ayaa dacwad-oogayaasha siiyay shan maalmood oo ay arrintaas ku go’aansadaan, inkastoo ay codsan karaan shan maalmood oo dheeraad ah. Saameynta jirdilka CIA-da Muranka ugu weyn wuxuu ku saabsan yahay in jirdilkii Khaalid loogu geystay xabsiyada qarsoodiga ah ee CIA-da uu saameyn ku yeeshay qiraalladii dambe ee uu siiyay FBI-da. Khaalid waxaa Pakistan lagu qabtay sanadkii 2003, waxaana muddo sanado ah lagu hayay xarumo qarsoodi ah oo CIA-du maamuleysay, halkaas oo lagu sameeyay habab su’aalo weydiin oo aad u daran. Waxaa sanadkii 2006 loo wareejiyay xabsiga Mareykanka ee Guantánamo Bay, Cuba. Dacwad-oogayaasha ayaa hore uga tanaasulay inay isticmaalaan hadalladii uu bixiyay intii uu ku jiray gacanta CIA-da, balse waxay ku doodayeen in qiraalladii uu FBI-da siiyay sanadkii 2007 ay ahaayeen kuwo cusub oo uu si ikhtiyaari ah u bixiyay. Garsoore Schrama ayaa hadda diiday dooddaas. Sida uu qoray New York Times , oo soo xiganaya qareenno arkay xukunka 45-ka bog ka kooban ee aan weli si rasmi ah loo shaacin, garsooraha ayaa sheegay in xaaladdii Khaalid ay weli ahayd sii socoshada saameyntii nafsiyeed iyo cadaadiskii xooggan ee CIA-du hore ugu sameysay. Garsooraha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in saraakiisha FBI-da aysan Khaalid si cad ugu sheegin inuu xaq u leeyahay inuu aamuso, inuu la tashado qareen iyo in hadalladiisa loo adeegsan karo maxkamad. “Dacwad-oogayaashu waxay ku guuldareysteen inay caddeeyaan in hadallada Khaalid ee FBI-da ay ahaayeen kuwo uu si ikhtiyaari ah u bixiyay,” ayuu garsooruhu ku yiri gunaanadka xukunka, sida uu sheegay New York Times . Kiis muddo dheer jiitamayay Qareennada difaaca ayaa muddo dheer ku doodayay in jirdilkii CIA-da, go’doonkii iyo sannadihii uu Khaalid ku jiray xabsi keligiis ah ay dhaawaceen awooddiisa uu si xor ah go’aan ugu gaari lahaa markii FBI-du su’aalaha weydiineysay. Waxay ku doodeen in hababkaas ay Khaalid ku abuureen xaalad uu u baratay inuu baarayaasha u sheego waxa ay doonayaan inay maqlaan. Khaalid sidoo kale ma uusan helin fursad uu qareen kula tashado ilaa muddo dheer kaddib markii uu qiraallada bixiyay. Go’aanka ayaa sii adkeynaya kiis horay ugu dhex jiray muran sharci oo socday muddo ka badan toban sano, gaar ahaan su’aasha ah in caddeymo ka dhashay jirdil loo adeegsan karo maxkamad. Garsoore Schrama weli ma uusan go’aamin qiraallada laba eedeysane oo kale oo kiiska 9/11 ku jira, Walid bin Attash iyo Mustafa al-Hawsawi. Garsoore hore ayaa sanadkii 2025 sidoo kale meesha ka saaray qiraalladii Ammar al-Baluchi, oo ay ilmo-adeer yihiin Khaalid, kaas oo lagu eedeeyay inuu qaar ka mid ah 19-kii afduubayaasha diyaaradaha ka caawiyay dhaqaale iyo safarro. Kiiska weerarradii 11-ka September ayaa ku jiray marxaladaha ka horreeya maxkamadeynta tan iyo markii eedeysanayaasha mar kale maxkamad la soo taagay sanadkii 2012. Dib-u-dhacyada badan waxaa qeyb weyn ka ahaa muranka ku saabsan jirdilkii CIA-da, caddeymaha maxkamadda la hor keeni karo iyo xaaladda caafimaad ee qaar ka mid ah eedeysanayaasha. Go’aanka Jimcaha ayaa yimid wax ka yar laba toddobaad ka hor 25-guurada weerarradii 11-ka September, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah qoysaska dhibbanayaasha ay muddo dheer ka walaacsanaayeen in kiisku uusan weligiis gaarin go’aan kama dambeys ah. items.title: Mareykanka oo loo ogolaaday inuu wada qaato Shidaal dalka Venezuela
items.description: Washington (Raxanreeb Online) Sida uu sheegay Wargeyska The Guardian, madaxweynaha dalka Maraykanka Donald Trump ayaa ku dhawaaqay in uu heshiis la galay masuuliyiinta xilka sida ku meel gaarka ah u joogta ee waddanka Venezuela kuwaas oo u ogolaaday in uu Maraykanku qaato kaydka shidaal ee dalka Venezuela. Waddankan oo haysta kaydka shidaalka ee ugu badan Caalamka ayaa hadda Maraykanka u saxeexay in uu la soo bixi karo 65 Bilyan oo Foosto oo dalkaas ku jirta. Heshiiska oo aan weli macluumaad dheeraad laga bixin ayaa ah mid Maraykanka u suurta gelinaya in uu heli karo Saliid kayd ah oo noqon doonta mid uu u adeegsado danihiisa gaarka ah. Waxa xusid mudan in Maraykanku uu sannadkan horraantiisi xoog ku soo qaatay madaxweynihii dalkaas ka talin jirey ee Nicolas Maduro kaas oo hadda ku xiran xabsiyada waddanka Maraykanka. The post Mareykanka oo loo ogolaaday inuu wada qaato Shidaal dalka Venezuela appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Maxaa Puntland loogu Loollamaya?
items.description: Puntland iyo Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya waxa muddo dheer ka dhexeeyay khilaaf siyaasadeed oo soo noqnoqday, kaas oo mararka qaar ka gudbay muran siyaasadeed oo qura, una gudbay loollan ku saabsan awood qaybsiga khayraadka, dheellitirka siyaasadeed ee dalka, dastuurka iyo jihada uu dalku aadayo. Puntland oo ah maamulkii koowaad ee qayb ka noqda nidaamka federaalka ah ayaa maanta wajahaya cadaadis siyaasadeed oo gudaha ah. Haddaba, weydiimaha taagan waxay yihiin, maxaa Puntland ka dhigaya goob si weyn loogu loollamo? Maxay Dawladda Federaalka ahi ka doonaysaa? Puntland se maxay u heli la’dahay ciidamo midaysan? Sidee Puntland ku dhalatay? Ogosto 1998, waxaa Garoowe lagu yagleelay dhismaha maamulgoboleedka Somaaliyeed ee Puntland, oo ka koobnayd gobollada Bari, Sanaag, Nugaal, Mudug, Sool iyo degmada Buuhoodle. Somaaaliya oo xilligaas wajahaysay dagaallo sokeeye oo daran, hubka oo galay gacanta shacabka iyo qabaa’ilka oo si daran ugu hardamayay awoodda ayaa waxay keentay in ay Puntland ka dhalato duruuftaas cakiran. Waxaana Puntland ududhexaad u ahaa kala nabad gelidda bulshada ku wada nool gudaha gobollada lagu dhisay ee loo yaqaanay Waqooyi Bari oo lagu daray Sanaag, Sool iyo Buuhoodle iyo in ay helaan maamul ilaaliya xuduudaha dhulkooda. Sida ku cad axdigii kowaad ee Puntland lagu dhisay, Garoowe waxa ay baadigoobaysay sidii lagu heli lahaa dawlad Somaaliyeed oo federaal ah, oo aysan awooddu oolin hal meel, taas oo caddaynaysa in ay Puntland raadinayso nidaam awooduhu qaybsan yihiin. Puntland ayaana sidoo kale siyaabo kala duwan u taageeraysay dawladihii kumeelgaarka ahaa ee soo maray dalka, sida dawladdii Cabdulaahi Yuusuf oo ay siin jirtay kab dhaqaale iyo taageero ciidan ilaa laga soo gaaray xiligii ay Muqdisho ka baxday kumeelgaarka, kolkaas oo uu xoogaystay khilaafka u dhaxeeya Garoowe iyo Muqdisho. Kolkii ay Dawladda Soomaaliya ka baxdey kumeelgaarka ayna dhalatay Dawladda Federaalka ah sannadkii 2012, waxaa xoogaystay khilaafaad iyo hardan u dhaxeeya maamulka Puntland iyo Dawladda Federaalka ah, kuwaas oo ay u waaweynaayeen qaybsiga khayraadka, dadaajinta awoodda iyo dhulka. Hardanka dhuleed waxaa sii kordhiyay magaalada Gaalkacyo oo ay sanadahaas Dawladda Federaalku ay qayb ka mid ah ka dhistay maamulka Galmudug, Puntlandna ay qaadacday dhismaha maamulkaas, sidoo kalena ay xiriirkii wada shaqayn u jartay Dawladda Federaalka ah Diiseembar, 2014. Laba sano kadibna waxaa ka dhashay magaalada Gaalkacyo dagaalo sokeeye oo u dhexeeyay Galmudug iyo Puntland, Garoowane waxa ay ku eedaysay in ay dagaalka hurinayso Dawladda Federaalku. Tan iyo xiligaasna khilaafku hadba heer ayaa uu soo taagnaa. Maxay tahay doonista Dawladda Federaalku? Markii uu Madaxweyne Xasan Shiikh Maxamuud yimid Villa Somaaliya May, 2022, waxaa uu inbadan ku dooday in dalku aadaayo doorashooyin qof iyo cod ah oo awoodda dib loogu celinayo dadka iyo in dastuurka la dhammaystirayo lagana gudbayo marxaladdii qabyo qoraalka, taas oo ay Puntland walaac ka muujisay billowgii horeba. Dawladda Federaalka ahi dhinaceeda waxa ay arrintan ku fasiraysaa in aanay ahayn loollan lagu wiiqayo Puntland, balse ay tahay dadaal lagu dhisayo dawlad federaal ah oo leh awood qaran oo midaysan, dastuur dhammaystiran iyo ciidan qaran oo ka madax bannaan maamulgoboleedyada. Muqdisho waxay sidoo kale ku doodaysaa in doorashada qof iyo cod iyo dhamaystirka dastuurku ay yihiin tallaabooyin lagu xoojinayo awoodda shacabka iyo hay’adaha qaranka. Garoowa se waxay arrintan u aragtaa si ka duwan. Waxay ku doodaysaa in isbeddellada dastuurka iyo qaabka loo wajahayo awood qaybsiga ay Dawladda Federaalka ah siinayaan awood ka badan tii lagu heshiiyay, taas oo dhaawici karta mabda’a federaalka iyo awoodaha maamulgoboleedyada. Maarso, 2026, labada gole ee baarlamaanka ayaa ansixiyay wax-ka-bedelka 11 cutub oo ka mid ah dastuurkii kumeelgaarka ahaa, sidoo kale waxa ay ansixiyeen lix qodob oo ku kala jira cutubyada 2aad iyo 4aad, kolkaas guddoomiyaha golaha shacabka ayaa ku dhawaaqay in la soo gabagabeeyay wax-ka-beddelka dastuurka, isla markaana nuqulkani uu noqon doono dastuurka rasmiga ah ee dalka, 8dii Maarsona madaxweynaha ayaa saxiixay. Puntland waa ay ka soo horjeesatay, waxaana ay sheegtay in ay aqoonsan tahay dastuurkii kumeelgaarka ahaa ee lagu heshiiyay 2012. Tan iyo 2022 waxa la saxiixay shan heshiis siyaasadeed oo kala ah awood qaybsiga, nooca garsoorka, federaalaynta maaliyadda, doorashooyinka iyo naqshadda amniga qaranka, heshiisyadan oo asaas u noqday dib u eegista dastuurka la isku khilaafsan yahay. Puntland dhammaan waa ay qaadacday oo ma aysan saxiixin, madaama oo ay u arkaysay in ay awood badan siinayaan Dawladda Federaalka ah. Hardanka Ciidamada Safarkii iyo soodhoweyntii Xasan Shiikh Maxamuud ee Laascanood waxa qayb ka noqday ciidamo sheegay markii koowaad in ay qayb ka yihiin CXS oo fadhiyadoodu kala ahaa magaaloyinka Boosaaso iyo Garoowe. Jimcaale Takar oo maamula ururka Danab ayaa xilligaas warbaahinta u sheegay in uu madaxweynihiisu yahay Firdhiye, tan iyo xiligaas waxaa iska soo daba dhacayay in ciidamo badan oo Puntland gudaheeda ku sugani ay Federaalka iska dhiibaan, Dawladda Federaalkuna waxa ay bilooyin dhawr ah fasaxday mushaharaadka ciidamadaasi. Raysalwasaaraha Somaaliyana waxa uu madal uu joogay bishii todobaad ka sheegay in ay ciidamo qoranayaan isaga oo ka jawabay hadal ka soo yeeray Puntland waxana uu yiri, “Ama diid ama yeel kun baa ka hadli, labaa ka hadli, toban kun, labaatan kun, sodon kun baanu qori waana siinaynaa xuquuqdooda, isdilaaci aduu’’. Maalmo kadib waxa ay Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Somaaliya magacowday Taliyaha qaybta 54aad ee ciidanka xooga Somaaliyeed oo la siiyay Jimcaale Takar kaas oo fadhigiisu noqonayo xerada Ligle ee magaalada Garoowe, taliska ayaana maamulaya ciidamada xoogga Somaaliyeed ee ku kala sugan maamullada Puntland iyo Waqooyi Bari, magacaabistaasina waxa ay noqotay tii ugu horeysay ee Muqdisho ka timaada wixii ka danbeeyay 1991. Julay 21, Puntland ayaa jidka ka xirtay ciidamada PSF oo ka soo baxay magaalada Boosaso una socday xero ay ku leeyihiin magaalada Gaalkacyo, dagaal kooban kaddib waxa ay Puntland gacanta ku dhigtay 8 gaari iyo askar kooban, Ogoosto 5-na Puntland waxa ay gebi ahaanba gacanta ku dhigay xeradii PSF ee Gaalkacyo, afar maalin kaddibna waxa ay ciidamo ka dabagaysay ciidanka difaaca Calmiskaad oo fadhiisin ka dhigtay inta u dhaxaysay degmooyinka Rakoraaxo iyo Xumbays ee gobolka Karkaar oo ugu danbayn wadahadal isugu soo dhiibay Puntland. Sidoo kale waxaa wadahadal isugu soo dhiibay Puntland ciidamo ku sugnaa Xero Istaanbuul Gaalkacayo iyo Jimcaale oo isaguna xeradii Ligle ku wareejiyay Puntland, sidaasna waxa ku soo gabagaboobay ciidamadii ku sugnaa gudaha Puntland ee ka mushahaar qaadanayay Federaalka. Maxaa loogu loollamayaa Puntland? Puntland waa maamul dhaca mid ka mid ah bogcadaha ugu muhiimsan ee Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya, waxa uu isku xiraa labada badood ee Badweynta Hindiya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed taas oo ka dhigan in kala bar xeebaha Somaaliya ay maamusho Puntland, sidoo kale Puntland waxa ay leedahay khayraad muhiim ah oo ay ka mid yihiin dahabka, xijiga, beeraha, xoolaha nool iyo kalluunka oo uu gobolkani qani ku yahay. Puntland waxa ay 28 sanno ee ay jirtay ilaashatay amnigeeda gudaha iyadoo maamusha in kabadan 1000km oo si amni ah loogu safri karo gudaha dhulkeeda, waxa ay gashay dagaallo waaweyn oo ay ku wajahday ururrada Daacish iyo Alshabaab oo ku dagaalamay buuralayda Calmiskaad iyo Calmadow kuwaas oo ay qaarkood guul ka gaartay. Bogcaddaas muhiimka ah ee ay dhacdo iyo qaangaarnimada maamul oo siinaya miisaan siyaasadeed juquraafi iyo dhaqaale ayaa ka dhigaya in Puntland ay isku aragto maamul leh awood gaar ah, ayna wajahdo loollan adag oo ka imanaya Dawladda Federaalka ah ee Somaaliya tan iyo 2012. Halka uu khilaafku salka ku hayo ayaa ah in aan weli si cad loo qeexin qaabdhismeedka federaalka, awood noocee ah ayay Dawladda Federaalku leedahay, awood noocee ah ayuu leeyahay maamulgoboleedku? Inta aan su’aashaas si cad looga heshiin, loollanka u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Garoowe wuxuu sii ahaanayaa mid ka weyn khilaaf siyaasadeed oo xilli gaar ah taagan, wuxuu taabanayaa qaabka ay Soomaaliya u qaybsanayso awoodda iyo mustaqbalka federaalnimadeeda. Inta aan su’aashaas si cad looga heshiin, loollanka u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Garoowe wuxuu sii ahaanayaa mid ka weyn khilaaf siyaasadeed oo xilli gaar ah taagan, wuxuu taabanayaa qaabka ay Soomaaliya u qaybsanayso awoodda iyo mustaqbalka federaalnimadeeda. items.title: Uganda Announces Plan to Withdraw All Troops from Somalia by August 2027
items.description: MOGADISHU— Uganda’s Chief of Defence Forces, General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, has announced that Uganda plans to withdraw all of its troops from Somalia by August 1, 2027, potentially bringing to an end nearly two decades of Ugandan military involvement in the country. Kainerugaba announced the planned withdrawal in a post on X, stating that Uganda would have no troops remaining in Somalia after the stated date. Uganda has been one of the leading contributors to African Union military operations in Somalia since the deployment of its forces in 2007. Over nearly two decades, Ugandan troops have played a prominent role in operations against Al-Shabaab and in efforts to support Somalia’s security institutions. The announcement comes at a critical time for the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), which faces continuing challenges over funding and international support. Questions have also emerged over the mission’s financial sustainability beyond the end of 2026. Despite Kainerugaba’s announcement, the Ugandan government has not yet formally confirmed that August 1, 2027, represents the definitive deadline for the withdrawal of its forces from Somalia. It remains unclear whether the stated date reflects a final government decision or a proposed timeline. The announcement also comes amid renewed diplomatic discussions over Somalia’s political situation. Diplomatic sources have reportedly indicated that Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni has been pressing Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud to pursue an inclusive political dialogue involving key political actors. The reported position of the Ugandan president has been linked by diplomatic sources to wider concerns over political tensions in Somalia and the potential impact of domestic divisions on the country’s security and stability. Any eventual withdrawal of Ugandan forces would represent a major shift in Somalia’s security architecture. Uganda has been a central component of African Union military deployments in the country since 2007, making its forces among the most experienced foreign contingents operating against Al-Shabaab. items.title: Dawladda Soomaaliya oo soo bandhigtay Xubin 11 Sano ka Tirsanaa Al-Shabaab oo Isku Soo Dhiibay Ciidamada Deegaanka Ceelgaras
items.description: Dawladda Soomaaliya ayaa soo bandhigtay nin muddo dheer ka tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab oo isku soo dhiibay ciidamada deegaanka iyo Dawladda ee gobolka Galgaduud. Fiidow Xuseen Daqarre, oo sheegay inuu muddo 11 sano ah ka tirsanaa kooxda Al-Shabaab , ayaa isku soo dhiibay ciidamada deegaanka ee ku sugan Ceelgaras, gobolka Galgaduud . Fiidow ayaa sheegay inuu go’aansaday inuu isaga soo baxo kooxda kadib markii uu fahmay in fikirkii iyo amarkii uu muddada dheer ku jiray aysan ahayn xaqiiqadii uu aaminsanaa. Wuxuu sidoo kale sheegay inuu ka faa’iideystay cafiska ay dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya u fidisay xubnaha iyo horjoogayaasha kooxaha hubeysan ee go’aansada inay ka soo baxaan . Isagoo hadalkiisa sii wata, Fiidow wuxuu sheegay in muddadii uu kooxda ku jiray lagu barayay in dowladda Soomaaliya iyo dadka taageera dowladda ay yihiin dad gaalo ah, isla markaana loo arko inay mudan yihiin in lala dagaallamo oo la ciqaabo. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu sheegay in markii uu muddo dheer ku jiray kooxda uu ugu dambeyn gaaray xaqiiqada, isla markaana uu ogaaday in fikirkaas uu ahaa mid marin-habaabin ah. Fiidow ayaa ugu baaqay xubnaha kale ee weli ku jira Al-Shabaab inay ka faa’iideystaan fursadda loo fidinayo, isla markaana ay iska soo baxaan oo ay isu soo dhiibaan dowladda. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud , ayaa horey ugu baaqay xubnaha Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish ee ka tanaasula fikirka xagjirka ah inay dowladda isku soo dhiibaan, iyadoo loo fidinayo cafis iyo fursad ay dib ugu soo laabtaan bulshada.

items.title: Cudurka Ebola oo ku sii Fidaya meelo Cusub oo ka tirsan Bariga Congo
items.description: Cudurka halista ah ee Ebola ayaa gaaray laba aag caafimaad oo cusub oo ku yaalla bariga Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo (DRC), iyadoo tirada guud ee goobaha uu cudurku saameeyay ay gaartay 60 aag. Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Congo ayaa sheegtay in labada goobood ee cusub ay kala yihiin Biena iyo Manguredjipa, kuwaas oo ku yaalla gobolka North Kivu. Aagaggaas waxaa laga soo sheegay heer dhimasho oo ka sarreeya celceliska guud ee cudurka, iyadoo masuuliyiintu arrintan qayb ahaan ay ku sababeeyeen dib-u-dhaca ku yimid dadaallada wax-ka-qabashada. ilaa hadda Congo ayaa laga diiwaangelisay 5,794 xaaladood oo la xaqiijiyay, halka 2,786 qof ay dhinteen, taasi waxay ka dhigan tahay heer dhimasho oo ku dhow 48 boqolkiiba. Hay’adaha caafimaadka ayaa ku tilmaamay faafitaanka mid aan caadi ahayn oo xawaare sare ku socda, iyadoo dadaallada lagu ogaanayo laguna xakameynayo cudurka ay la halgamayaan in ay la jaanqaadaan fiditaanka Ebola. Colaadaha ayaa adkeynaya gurmadka Dhibaatada waxaa sii xumeynaya colaadaha hubeysan ee ka jira gobollada uu cudurku saameeyay. Barakaca dadka, weerarrada lagu qaado shaqaalaha iyo xarumaha caafimaadka, dhaqdhaqaaqa badan ee dadka iyo kaabayaasha caafimaad ee liita ayaa dhammaantood caqabad ku ah xakameynta cudurka. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sidoo kale ka digtay xaaladda, ayadoo xoghayaha Guud ee QM Antonio Guterres uu sheegay in Ebola uu si ka dhakhso badan dadaallada lagu xakameynayo u fidayo. Sidoo kale Dowladda Congo ayaa sheegtay in halkaas laga xaqiijiyay 122 xaaladood, halka 87 qof ay dhinteen, taasoo ka dhigaysa heerka dhimashada ku dhowaad 69 boqolkiiba. Hay’adda Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) ayaa Beni ka furtay xarun cusub oo lagu daweeyo bukaannada Ebola, si loo kordhiyo awoodda daaweynta iyo in bukaannada si degdeg ah loo gaaro. Si kastaba ha ahaatee Xaaladda Ebola ee Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga ah ee Congo ayaa weli ah mid aad u daran, ayadoo Fiditaanka uu gaaray 60 aag, tirada dhimashaduna gaartay 2,786 qof.

items.title: Sawirro: Jubbaland oo ciidamo cusub kusoo bandhigtay GEDO
items.description: Kismaayo (Caasimada Online) – Dowlad-goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee Jubbaland ayaa Jimchii ciidamo cusub kusoo bandhigtay gobolka Gedo, kuwaas oo tababar loogu soo xiray degmada Doolow ee gobolkaasi. Guddoomiyaha degmada Doolow, Maxamed Xuseen Cabdi (Lafeey) ayaa tababarka u soo xiray ciidamadan oo kamid noqonaya Daraawiishta Jubbaland, kuwaas oo bilihii lasoo dhaafay tababar ciidan oo heer kumaandoos ah ku qaadanayay degmadaasi. Lafey ayaa marka hore hambalyo u diray ciidamada loo soo gabagabeeyay tababarka, wuxuuna kula dardaarmay inay aqoonta iyo xirfadaha ay barteen ugu adeegaan dalkooda iyo dadkooda, maadaama ay hadda howlgalayaan. Sidoo kale wuxuu ciidamada kula dardaarmay inay ilaaliyaan anshaxa, sharafta iyo sumcadda Ciidanka, ayna dhowraan midnimada iyo qarannimada dalka. Waxaa kale oo uu tilmaamay in ciidamada cusub ay sugi doonaan amniga gobolka, ayna ka qayb-qaadan doonaan xoreynta deegaannada ay weli haystaan maleeshiyaadka kooxda Al-Shabaab oo ku xooggan Jubbaland. Guddoomiye Lafeey ayaa ugu dambeyn si gaar ah ugu mahadceliyay hoggaanka ciidamada, gaar ahaan taliyaha amniga Doolow, isaga oo ku ammaanay hoggaan hufan, isku-duubni iyo daacadnimo uu kaga miro-dhaliyay waajibaadka hay’adda sirdoonka iyo Ciidamada Daraawiishta Jubbaland. Soo bandhigidda ciidamadan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo dhawaan isbeddal uu ka dhacay gobolka Gedo, kadib markii ay heshiis wada gaareen maamulka Axmed Madoobe iyo Cabdirashiid Janaan oo ay dowladda u xilsaartay hawlaha gobolkaasi, kaas oo hoggaaminayay ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya. Qorshaha Jubbaland ayaa ah inay isku billaareyso Gedo, si ay mar kale ula wareegto gacan ku haynta degmooyinka ka maqan, hase yeeshee dowladda dhexe ayaa dhankeeda dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wada gobolka, inkastoo hadda xaaladda ay dagan tahay marka loo fiiro maalmihii adkaa ee lasoo maray.   The post Sawirro: Jubbaland oo ciidamo cusub kusoo bandhigtay GEDO appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Uganda to withdraw all UPDF troops from Somalia by August 1, 2027, army chief Says – AUSSOM faces major test
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Uganda is leaving Somalia. All of it, all the way out, on a fixed date – and its army chief said so in the plainest terms Kampala has ever used. General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, Uganda’s Chief of Defence Forces and the son of President Yoweri Museveni, announced on Friday that the Uganda People’s Defence Force (UPDF) will complete a total withdrawal from Somalia by August 1, 2027, ending nearly twenty years of continuous Ugandan military presence in the country. “We are withdrawing completely from Somalia by the 1st of August 2027,” Kainerugaba said. “They will not be UPDF in Somalia after that.” It is the most categorical statement yet from Kampala on ending its role in Somalia’s war against Al-Shabaab. Uganda has threatened to leave before — more than once — with officials arguing each time that Mogadishu has had nearly two decades to build strong institutions and stabilize the country, and has not done it. The Private Ultimatum Behind the Public Deadline The public threat has a private trigger. According to a report by Africa Intelligence, President Museveni personally warned Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud that Uganda would withdraw its forces unless he struck a political settlement with his opposition within one year and ended a domestic political crisis that has kept Somali authorities locked in infighting — time and attention Museveni argued should be going to the security transition and the fight against Al-Shabaab instead. A Mission Running Out of Money Kainerugaba’s deadline lands squarely on top of a second, compounding crisis: AUSSOM, the African Union’s peacekeeping mission in Somalia, is running out of money. The United States has announced it will end its support for UN funding of the mission’s logistics — support that has functioned as AUSSOM’s backbone since the mission began. The UN is already acting on it. UNSOS, the UN Support Office in Somalia that has run those logistics, is preparing to shut down entirely: auctioning off its equipment and laying off staff as it winds down operations, according to the report. The Fear Everyone Is Trying Not to Say Out Loud Put the two crises together — a fixed Ugandan exit date and a peacekeeping mission that is running out of both money and machinery — and the question hanging over Mogadishu is blunt: are Somali forces actually ready to hold the line alone, or does a foreign withdrawal on this timeline hand Al-Shabaab the opening it has been waiting years for? Mogadishu’s Answer: Send Them Home With Flowers Somalia’s government is not hedging. Earlier this month, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud declared that Somalia is ready to take over its own security, and called on foreign forces to leave — saying his government would give them a farewell and send them home with flowers. Kampala has now put a date on the calendar. Whether Mogadishu’s confidence holds up against it — or whether AUSSOM’s collapsing finances force the timeline to move even faster — is now the single most consequential question facing Somalia’s security transition. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Uganda Troop Withdrawal From Somalia Set for 2027
items.description: Kampala – Uganda’s army chief, General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, announced on Friday, August 28, 2026, that the Uganda troop withdrawal from Somalia will be complete by August 1, 2027. He made the statement in a post on the social media platform X. The declaration would end nearly 20 years of Ugandan military involvement in Somalia’s fight against al-Shabab. The announcement lands at a delicate moment for the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia, known as AUSSOM. The mission is already facing a funding crisis after the United States said it would stop backing United Nations logistics for the force from 2027. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has repeatedly said foreign forces cannot stay indefinitely. “We must hand foreign troops beautiful flowers and send them home,” he has said. Somalia, he added, must ultimately protect its own security and sovereignty. If Uganda proceeds with the withdrawal Kainerugaba announced, it would mark a major shift for the African Union mission in Somalia. items.title: Turkish Warships Somalia: Ankara Sends Aid After Hijacking
items.description: The Turkish warships Somalia deployment expanded Friday, as Ankara said it is backing Somali authorities after pirates hijacked a vessel in Somali waters. Two Turkish naval ships will visit Djibouti next week as part of this growing mission. The move comes as pirates continue to hold a hijacked arms ship off Puntland’s coast. Turkish officials have not named the seized vessel or detailed their support. The deployment highlights how deeply Turkey has embedded itself in Somalia’s security landscape. Piracy has resurfaced sharply this year off the Horn of Africa, drawing fresh international alarm. Turkey’s expanding naval footprint, however, has also triggered a diplomatic dispute with Puntland over disputed air strikes near the hijacked ship. Turkish Warships Somalia: Djibouti Visit Confirmed Turkish Defence Ministry spokesperson Zeki Akturk said two vessels, the TCG Kemalreis and TCG Yzb. Gungor Durmus, will dock in Djibouti on September 3-4. The ships will support the Somali Naval Task Group and logistics missions to Somalia. The ministry separately addressed the hijacking. It said Turkish forces in Somalia continue helping the country fight terrorism and piracy under bilateral agreements. According to the ministry, “Necessary support is being provided to the Somali authorities… regarding the incident that occurred in Somali territorial waters.” Officials did not identify the two Djibouti-bound ships as part of any hijacking-related operation. They also declined to specify what assistance Turkey is providing. Turkish Navy Ship F514 docks at the Mogadishu Sea Port following the signing of a defense and economic agreement between Somalia and Turkey in Mogadishu, Somalia April 23, 2024 REUTERS/Feisal Omar Hijacked Arms Ship Still Held Pirates seized the Cameroon-flagged LUTUF on August 17. The ship was about 3.5 nautical miles off Marraya, in Puntland’s Eyl district, before pirates steered it toward the Nugaal coast. A Somali official told the Associated Press the vessel carried Turkish weapons, communications gear and satellite systems. The cargo was bound for a Turkish military training facility in Mogadishu. Its 10-member crew includes six Indian nationals, one Turkish citizen, one Georgian and two Serbian security guards. Pirates have reportedly demanded roughly $2 million for the ship’s release. It remains unclear whether formal negotiations have begun. No party has confirmed agreeing to pay. Air Strikes Spark Dispute With Puntland The hijacking has also triggered controversy over deadly air strikes near the site where pirates are holding the ship. Puntland Deputy Security Minister Abdirahman Yusuf Dujana accused Turkey of carrying out two strikes. According to Dujana, the strikes killed at least 13 people. Dujana also accused Somalia’s federal government of involvement. However, he did not provide independently verifiable evidence linking either government to the attacks. No government or military force has publicly claimed responsibility. Turkey’s Defence Ministry did not directly address the accusations in its Thursday statement. Meanwhile, Somalia’s State Minister for Defence, Omar Ali Abdi, said on August 22 that the federal government was aware of military operations off Puntland and was preparing a report. Puntland has since called for a formal investigation into the strikes. Turkish Warships Somalia: A Widening Naval Role Turkey has steadily built up its military and maritime presence in Somalia. As a result, Ankara now operates under several defence agreements signed with Mogadishu. Turkey’s parliament extended its troop deployment in Somalia last month by two more years, keeping the mandate in force until July 2028. That authorization lets Turkish forces operate in areas agreed with Somalia, including its maritime zones. It also backs efforts against terrorism, piracy, illegal fishing and smuggling. The role rests further on a 10-year defence and economic pact signed in 2024, under which Turkey agreed to help build and train Somalia’s navy. Turkish naval forces are already active off Somalia’s coast. In July, three Turkish warships escorted the drilling ship Cagri Bey and three support vessels. Turkey also runs a major military training base in Mogadishu and has trained Somali security forces for more than a decade. Piracy Resurgence Raises Alarm Turkey’s expanded naval activity comes as piracy resurfaces off Somalia and the Gulf of Aden. The International Maritime Organisation said on August 24 that pirates and armed robbers are holding six vessels and more than 90 seafarers in the region. IMO Secretary-General Arsenio Dominguez called for the immediate release of those held. “We cannot allow the resurgence of piracy in the Gulf of Aden and surrounding waters to go unaddressed,” he said. The International Maritime Bureau recorded 38 piracy and armed robbery incidents worldwide in the first half of 2026. Somali pirates accounted for 94 percent of all crew members taken hostage during that period. The post Turkish Warships Somalia: Ankara Sends Aid After Hijacking first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Uganda oo Shaacisay Xilliga ay Dhammaan Ciidamadeeda Kala Baxayso Soomaaliya
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidamada Difaaca Uganda, Jeneraal Muhoozi Kainerugaba, ayaa ku dhawaaqay in ciidanka Uganda ee ku sugan Soomaaliya ay si buuxda uga bixi doonaan dalka 1-da Agoosto 2027. Jeneraal Muhoozi ayaa qoraal uu 28-kii Agoosto ku baahiyay bartiisa X ku sheegay in wixii ka dambeeya taariikhdaas aysan Soomaaliya ku sii jiri doonin wax ciidamo ah oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Difaaca Uganda (UPDF). Uganda ayaa Soomaaliya ciidamo u dirtay tan iyo 2007, iyadoo noqotay dalkii ugu horreeyay ee ciidamo geeya Soomaaliya xilligii howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AMISOM. Ciidamada Uganda ayaa markii dambe qayb ka noqday ATMIS, waxaana hadda ay ka hawlgalaan AUSSOM. Ku dhawaaqista ayaa timid xilli howlgalka AUSSOM uu wajahayo caqabado dhanka maalgelinta iyo taageerada saadka ah. Shir ay Uganda martigelisay bishii July ayay dalalka ciidamada ku biiriya AUSSOM kaga wada hadleen mustaqbalka howlgalka iyo sidii loo heli lahaa maalgelin waarta. AUSSOM ayaa sidoo kale wajahaya hubanti la’aan ku saabsan taageerada saadka ee Qaramada Midoobay, iyadoo UNSOS lagu wado inuu soo gabagabeeyo hawlgalladiisa 31-ka Diseembar 2026. Saameynta ay Soomaaliya ku yeelan karto Uganda waxay muddo ku dhow labaatan sano door weyn ku lahayd dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab iyo taageerada ciidamada ammaanka Soomaaliya. Sidaas darteed, haddii qorshaha bixitaanka la fuliyo, wuxuu noqon karaa isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada qaab-dhismeedka amniga Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan haddii aan la helin qorshe cad oo lagu buuxinayo kaalinta ciidamada baxaya.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo IFAD oo Xoojinaya Iskaashiga Horumarinta Beeraha
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Saalax Axmed Jaamac, ayaa maanta Muqdisho ku qaabilay Agaasimaha Gobolka ee Sanduuqa Caalamiga ah ee Horumarinta Beeraha (IFAD) u qaabilsan Bariga Dhexe, Waqooyiga Afrika, Yurub iyo Bartamaha Aasiya, Naoufel Telahigue. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo IFAD, iyadoo si gaar ah diiradda loo saaray horumarinta beeraha iyo xoolaha, sugnaanta cuntada iyo la-qabsiga saameynta isbeddelka cimilada. Sidoo kale, Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka iyo Agaasimaha Gobolka ee IFAD ayaa ka wada hadlay taageerada beeraleyda, xoolo-dhaqatada iyo bulshada nugul, iyo sidii loo ballaarin lahaa mashaariicda horumarineed ee IFAD ka fuliso Soomaaliya. Dhinacyadu waxay sidoo kale isla soo qaadeen xoojinta awoodda hay’adaha dowladda iyo kordhinta maalgelinta lagu horumarinayo beeraha, biyaha iyo suuqyada, si loo abuuro fursado dhaqaale oo dheeraad ah, gaar ahaan bulshada reer guuraaga ah. Kulankan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay dadaal ugu jirto xoojinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha iyo yareynta nuglaanta bulshada ee ka dhalata isbeddelka cimilada iyo caqabadaha dhanka sugnaanta cuntada.

items.title: Budhcad badeeda Somaalida oo korodhay
items.description: Kororka burcad-badeednimada ka jirta xeebaha Soomaaliya ayaa sii kordhiyay khatarta haysata maraakiibta ganacsiga, kuwaas oo durba wajahaya cadaadis ka dhashay xannibaadaha badda iyo colaadda ka dhalatay dagaalka Maraykanka iyo Iiraan. Toddobaadkii hore, laba markab oo xamuul ah ayaa muddo afar maalmood gudahood ah lagu afduubtay Gacanka Cadmeed. Taasi waxay tirada maraakiibta la weeraray tan iyo bilowgii sanadkan gaarsiisay ugu yaraan 13. Weerarrada ayaa sidoo kale sababay duqeymo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah oo aan hore loo arag oo lala beegsaday burcad-badeedda. Tani waa kororkii ugu weynaa ee afduubka maraakiibta muddo ka badan toban sano, taas oo dib u soo cusboonaysiisay walaaca laga qabo ammaanka gobolka oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka. “Burcad-badeednimadu mar walba waa dambi ka faa’iideysta fursadda,” ayuu yiri Cumar Maxmuudd, oo ah falanqeeye sare oo Soomaaliya u qaabilsan kooxda International Crisis Group (ICG). “Haatanna burcad-badeeddu waxay u arkaan inay heleen fursad.” Fursaddaas ayaa ka dhalatay saameynta dagaalka iyo xaaladda marinnada biyaha ee gobolka, gaar ahaan meelaha waqooyi ka xiga Soomaaliya. Iiraan iyo Maraykanka ayaa weli isku haya gacan ku haynta marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz. Dhanka kale, xulafada Tehran ee Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa xannibaad bartilmaameed ah ka sameeyay marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, kaas oo muhiim u ah isku socodka maraakiibta u kala goosha Badda Cas. Xannibaadda ayaa la xiriirta khilaaf u dhexeeya Xuutiyiinta iyo Sacuudiga, balse waxay sii kordhisay amni-darrada haysata maraakiibta caalamiga ah. “Waxaan u malaynayaa in burcad-badeeddu aaminsan yihiin in dhacdooyinkan ka socda Hormuz iyo Bab al-Mandab ay ciidamada caalamka ku mashquulin doonaan dhibaatooyinkaas, halkii ay diiradda saari lahaayeen raadinta burcad-badeedda,” ayuu yiri Ku-xigeenka Admiral Ignacio Villanueva Serrano, oo ah taliyaha howlgalka ciidamada badda ee Midowga Yurub ee ilaaliya maraakiibta ka howlgasha xeebaha Soomaaliya. Maraakiibtii ugu dambeysay ee ay burcad-badeeddu afduubteen waxaa ka mid ah markabka MV Lutuf oo sita calanka Cameroon, kaas oo 17-kii August lagu weeraray meel ka baxsan xeebaha Puntland ee Soomaaliya. Dhowr maalmood kaddib, burcad-badeeddu waxay fuuleen markab shidaal qaada oo lagu magacaabo MT Sibu 1, kaas oo sita calanka Eritrea, xilli uu marayay biyaha u dhow Yemen, dhinaca kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed. Afduubka markabka Lutuf ayaa sababay dhacdooyin aan la filayn. 13 nin oo la sheegay inay ka tirsanaayeen shabakad sahayda siisa burcad-badeedda markabka ayaa lagu dilay laba weerar oo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah oo dhacay tan iyo 18-kii August. Ilaa hadda ma jirto cid sheegatay inay ka dambeysay weerarrada, balse mas’uuliyiin deegaanka ah ayaa ku eedeeyay Turkiga, iyagoo sheegay in markabku siday hub laga keenay dalkaas. BBC ayaa ogaatay in Lutuf uu hadda ka mid yahay lix markab oo ay burcad-badeeddu haystaan, kuwaas oo ay ku dalbanayaan madaxfurasho malaayiin doollar ah. Afarta ka mid ah lixdaas markab ayaa ku xiran meel u dhow magaalada kalluumeysiga ee Bander Beyla, oo caan ku ah inay tahay goob ay burcad-badeeddu si weyn uga howlgalaan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, tirada afduubyada hadda ka dhacaya Soomaaliya aad ayay uga hooseysaa heerarkii ugu sarreeyay ee la arkay 15 sano ka hor, xilligaas oo burcad-badeedda Soomaalida ay dhaqaalaha caalamka ka khasaariyeen balaayiin doollar. Sanadkii 2011, burcad-badeedda Soomaalida waxay fuliyeen in ka badan 200 oo weerar, waxaana ay boqolaal shaqaale maraakiib ah u qabsadeen afduub. Jawaab ay si wadajir ah uga bixiyeen ciidamada badda ee dalalka caalamka, oo ay wehelisay amniga gaarka loo leeyahay ee lagu xoojiyay maraakiibta ganacsiga, ayaa si weyn hoos ugu dhigtay dhibaatada burcad-badeednimada. Tallaabooyinkaas ayaa sidoo kale gacan ka geystay xakameynta dib-u-soo-noqoshadii burcad-badeednimada ee dhacday 2023 iyo 2024. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, khubaradu waxay carrabka ku adkeeyeen in inkastoo shabakadaha burcad-badeedda la wiiqay, haddana aysan gebi ahaanba burburin. Arrintan ayaa dhaawacaysa warshadaha kalluumaysiga ee ay ku tiirsan yihiin bulshooyinka ku nool Puntland. Amni-darrada ka jirta biyaha gobolka ayaa keentay in qaar ka mid ah maraakiibta ganacsigu ay kusoo dhowaadaan xeebaha Soomaaliya, xilli ay dhanka koonfureed ugu leexanayaan si ay uga fogaadaan colaadda ka jirta meelaha waqooyi ka xiga. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Mahmood wuxuu sheegay in kooxahaasi ay u badan tahay inay yihiin dambiilayaal, halkii ay xiriir la lahaayeen xulafada Xuutiyiinta ee Iiraan. Laba ka mid ah waxay ka socdaan Turkiga, halka kuwa kale ay ka kala socdaan Spain, Denmark, Maraykanka iyo Hindiya. BBC si madax-bannaan uma xaqiijin karin xogtan. Markabka la afduubtay waxaa saaran qalab milatari oo loogu talagalay howlgalada Turkiga ee Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri mas’uulka dowladda Soomaaliya oo codsaday inaan magaciisa la shaacin. items.fullContent: Kororka burcad-badeednimada ka jirta xeebaha Soomaaliya ayaa sii kordhiyay khatarta haysata maraakiibta ganacsiga, kuwaas oo durba wajahaya cadaadis ka dhashay xannibaadaha badda iyo colaadda ka dhalatay dagaalka Maraykanka iyo Iiraan. Toddobaadkii hore, laba markab oo xamuul ah ayaa muddo afar maalmood gudahood ah lagu afduubtay Gacanka Cadmeed. Taasi waxay tirada maraakiibta la weeraray tan iyo bilowgii sanadkan gaarsiisay ugu yaraan 13. Weerarrada ayaa sidoo kale sababay duqeymo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ah oo aan hore loo arag oo lala beegsaday burcad-badeedda. Tani waa kororkii ugu weynaa ee afduubka maraakiibta muddo ka badan toban sano, taas oo dib u soo cusboonaysiisay walaaca laga qabo ammaanka gobolka oo muhiim u ah ganacsiga caalamka. “Burcad-badeednimadu mar walba waa dambi ka faa’iideysta fursadda,” ayuu yiri Cumar Maxmuudd, oo ah falanqeeye sare oo Soomaaliya u qaabilsan kooxda International Crisis Group (ICG). “Haatanna burcad-badeeddu waxay u arkaan inay heleen fursad.” Fursaddaas ayaa ka dhalatay saameynta dagaalka iyo xaaladda marinnada biyaha ee gobolka, gaar ahaan meelaha waqooyi ka xiga Soomaaliya. Iiraan iyo Maraykanka ayaa weli isku haya gacan ku haynta marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz. Dhanka kale, xulafada Tehran ee Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa xannibaad bartilmaameed ah ka sameeyay marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, kaas oo muhiim u ah isku socodka maraakiibta u kala goosha Badda Cas. items.title: Qorista dhallinyarada la qarameynayo oo laga bilaabayo Afgooye iyo Xudur
items.description: Saraakiil ka kala tirsan Taliska Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka iyo Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ayaa lagu wadaa in ay qorista dhallinyarada loo qaadanayo shaqada ciidamada ka bilaabaan Magaalooyinka Afgooye iyo Xudur ee Gobolada Shabellaha Hoose iyo Bakool. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in Saraakiisha Ciidamada ay dhallinyarada ku xulanayaan caafimaadka jirka, maskaxda iyo dal jaceylka. Saraakiishan ayaa waxay wararku sheegayaan in ay ka jawaabayaan Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo faray in qorista iyo soo xulista dhallinyarada ee laga bilaabay Gobolka Baay, gaar ahaan Magaalada Baydhabo lagu ballaariyo labada gobol ee kale ee Koonfur Galbeed. Aadan Madoobe oo taageero toos ah ka haysta Dowladda Federaalka ayaa diiradda saaraya, sidii uu maamulku ku yeelan lahaa cudud ciidan oo diyaar ah. Maamulka Aadan Madoobe ayaa hadda si weyn ugu tiirsan taageerada Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka ee maamulkiisa ku ilaaliya Magaalada Baydhabo. Aadan Madoobe ayaa doonaya in la helo ciidamo dadka deegaanka ah oo ka qayb qaata sugidda amniga guud ee deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed, la dagaalanka argagixisada iyo cid kasta oo khatar ku ah in uu maamulku si buuxda u shaqeeyo. Aadan Madoobe ayaa mucaaradad kala kulmaya Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) oo ku hanjabay inay ka qabsan doonaan Baydhabo oo saldhig u ah maamulkiisa, isla-markaana ay ku yaallaan Xarumaha Madaxtooyada iyo Baarlamaanka.

Aadan Madoobe oo taageero toos ah ka haysta Dowladda Federaalka ayaa diiradda saaraya, sidii uu maamulku ku yeelan lahaa cudud ciidan oo diyaar ah. Maamulka Aadan Madoobe ayaa hadda si weyn ugu tiirsan taageerada Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka ee maamulkiisa ku ilaaliya Magaalada Baydhabo. Aadan Madoobe ayaa doonaya in la helo ciidamo dadka deegaanka ah oo ka qayb qaata sugidda amniga guud ee deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed, la dagaalanka argagixisada iyo cid kasta oo khatar ku ah in uu maamulku si buuxda u shaqeeyo. Aadan Madoobe ayaa mucaaradad kala kulmaya Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) oo ku hanjabay inay ka qabsan doonaan Baydhabo oo saldhig u ah maamulkiisa, isla-markaana ay ku yaallaan Xarumaha Madaxtooyada iyo Baarlamaanka.

items.title: Two Somali Children die after suspected meat Poisoning, while others hospitalized
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — A Somali family has been struck by tragedy after consuming suspected contaminated camel meat and bone marrow brought from Eldheer in Galgaduud region, leaving two children dead and three others hospitalized in Mogadishu. The family was brought to the capital on Thursday after several members reportedly became seriously ill. According to information obtained by WardheerNews, two family members have died, including one who died in Eldheer before the family was transferred to Mogadishu. Three other children—17-year-old Nimco Hirsi Osman, 15-year-old Omar Hirsi Osman and 10-year-old Dahir Hirsi Osman—are receiving treatment at Dr. Dufle Hospital in Mogadishu. Their father, Hirsi Osman Omar, told Universal Somali TV that the family lives in a village near Eldheer. He said his children became sick after eating camel meat and bone marrow that had reportedly been kept for some time. After seeking treatment in Eldheer, the family was reportedly advised to travel to Mogadishu because adequate medical care was not available locally. The father brought the surviving children to Dr. Dufle Hospital, where doctors are continuing to monitor their condition. Dr. Osman Dufle said the children appeared to have suffered severe symptoms consistent with poisoning. He reported that their eyes had turned greenish and that their urine had become red, while one child’s liver had reportedly become swollen. “Their eyes turned green, and the liver became swollen. Within six days, two of them died. We tested for jaundice but did not find it. When we interviewed the parents, they told us the children had been given the suspected poisoned food,” Dr. Dufle said. The tragedy has left the family devastated, while doctors continue efforts to stabilize the three surviving children. The incident has also raised concerns about food safety and the risks associated with consuming meat or animal products that have been improperly stored or left for prolonged periods, particularly in remote communities where access to emergency medical services and diagnostic facilities remains limited. For the grieving family, however, the immediate reality is far more painful: two children are dead, three remain under medical care, and a meal intended to feed a family has instead brought unimaginable loss. items.title: Dhaqdhaqaaq ciidan oo ka jira Magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Saraakiisha Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo hay’adaha ammaanka kala shaqeynaya dadaalada lagu adkeynayo amniga Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa ciidamo hor leh gaynaya afaafka hore ee magaaladaasi. Baydhabo ayaa ah Xarunta Taliska Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, halkaas oo Taliyaha Qaybta 60aad, G/dhexe Isaaq Aadan Berdaale uu ku abaabulayo ciidamo ay tahay in lagu xoojiyo, kuwii horey ugu sugnaa bannaanada magaalada. Cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Guutada 8aad ee Qaybta 60aad, Polizia Militare, Kumaandooska Gorgor iyo Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ayaa ku sugan kontoroolada laga soo galo magaalada, iyadoo ciidamada ay sidoo kale fariisimo ku leeyihiin hareeraha magaaladaasi. Xoogag ka tirsan Kumaandooska Danab oo Axaddii la geeyay Baydhabo ayaa la filayaa in ay ku biiri doonaan ciidamada degan darafyada magaalada. Saraakiisha Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka ee ku sugan Baydhabo ayaa Jimcihii kormeer dhiirigelin ah ugu tegay Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee amniga magaalada ka ilaaliya geesaheeda. Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaad mooddaa in ay ka hortaggayaan hadalka Khamiistii ka soo yeeray Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ee ku saabsanaa in Dowladda Federaalka ay xoog kula wareegtay magaaladaasi, tallaabadaasi oo kalena ay uga saarayaan. Xiisadaha siyaasadeed iyo amni ee ka taagan Koonfur Galbeed ayaa cawaaqibka ugu horreya ku yeelanaya shacabka ku nool Baydhabo, maadaama uu maamulku ku shaqeeyo magaaladaasi. Xaaladda Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa weli ah mid kacsan oo laga dareemayo cabsi iyo dhaqdhaqaaqyo ciidan. Tani ayaa ka dambeysay, ka dib dagaalkii khasaaraha badan gaystay ee 17-kii bishan ka dhacay magaaladaasi. Xiisadda militari iyo loolanka dhanka awoodda maamulka ee u dhexeeya siyaasiyiinta ayaa dadka reer Baydhabo ku riixaya in ay cabsi la noolaadaan iyo gaabis ku yimaada dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga.

items.title: It Was Inevitable That Hassan Would Become a Warlord
items.description: By Dayib Sh. Ahmed It was inevitable that Hassan Sheikh Mohamud would eventually come to this point. Shortly after his constitutional changes began taking full shape, I wrote a column titled “A Warlord in Disguise: A Critical Analysis of the Second Term of Hassan Sheikh Mohamoud.” More than two years later, I look back at that analysis and ask how much of what I predicted proved to be correct? My argument was centered on one of the most consequential failures of Hassan’s second term, his handling of the relationship between the Federal Government and the Federal Member States. He has also failed to advance national reconciliation among the Somali people or to build strong and effective government institutions. Instead, his administration has pursued the centralization of political power in Mogadishu, undermining the autonomy of the Federal Member States and weakening the federal system he once claimed to support. The consequences were predictable. A government that substitutes confrontation for consensus, centralization for federalism, and political maneuvering for constitutional restraint will inevitably create friction with the people. What we see today is not the product of a single political dispute but the consequence of a political trajectory that has steadily weakened trust in Somalia’s federal system. Moreover, Hassan’s recent one-sided visit to Galkayo reflects his worlodism and raises serious questions about his judgment. His entourage also did not show the political consensus inherent in the federal constitution. Both the ministers of security and interior were absent from his entourage, despite their regional backgrounds. Although, keep in mind, both of them are widely regarded as inept and sycophantic. Yet this was presented as a national delegation. Even the Vice President of Galmudug was not included. More importantly, he did not visit Abudwaaq or any of the other cities, despite them being part of Galmudug State. All these raise a fundamental question Was this truly a national delegation, or a clan-based one? Furthermore, Hassan had an opportunity to build consensus and strengthen national institutions. Instead, his approach has increasingly been defined by centralization, confrontation, and the pursuit of political control. More than two years on, the question is no longer whether the warning was justified, but how far has Hassan traveled down the road I warned about and how close is he now to a political dead end? The path he has chosen, marked by authoritarianism, confrontation, and the erosion of governance, is increasingly leading him toward a dead end. First, Hassan Sheikh’s constitutional term expired on May 15, 2026. Yet, despite the expiration of his constitutional mandate, he has continued to exercise presidential authority, raising serious questions about constitutional legitimacy, the rule of law, and the limits of executive power. A constitutional government cannot function upon the personal whims of a politician. Once a constitutional mandate expires, a country must have a clear and lawful mechanism for transition through a defined electoral timeline. The Hassan administration, however, has failed to establish such a constitutionally legitimate pathway. This creates a dangerous vacuum in which political power can be exercised without a clear constitutional mandate, while authority depends on political coersion rather than the rule of law. Somalia’s history offers a painful warning: the concentration of power and the rejection of lawful political mechanisms were the foremost conditions that contributed to the state’s collapse and civil war in 1991. The lesson should be unmistakable: when constitutional legitimacy is weakened and political authority becomes detached from the law, the state itself becomes vulnerable. Somalia cannot afford to repeat the mistakes that paved the road of self-destruction after a military junta suspended the Constitution. Second, Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has severely weakened the separation of powers, particularly the independence of the legislative branch. Under his leadership, Parliament has increasingly appeared less like an independent institution exercising constitutional oversight and more like a political instrument serving the interests of the President. Unfortunately, Hassan has found what he was looking for in the Former Speaker of Parliament, Adan Mohamed Nur Madobe, was among the warlords associated with the RRA and SRRC during the period of Somalia’s state collapse. He has also been complicit in the controversial constitutional changes, allowing himself and the institution he led to become instruments of Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s political agenda. Moreover, Hassan later handpicked Madobe to serve as his proxy leader in the Southwest regions of Somalia. Madobe has since become one of the most controversial figures in Somalia’s modern political history, particularly amid allegations of corruption, political manipulation, and the abuse of institutional authority. Furthermore, Hassan has now brought another controversial figure into a position of immense political importance: Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur, whose selection as Speaker of the Somali Parliament was, in my view, so politically predetermined that it is difficult to describe it as a genuine election. His elevation has generated serious controversy. According to a former Western intelligence official, who spoke to me on condition of anonymity because of the sensitivity of the matter, Abdulkadir was allegedly connected to Turkish intelligence and was brought into the position with Turkish backing. The same source further alleged that, before traveling to Turkey in 2012, Abdulkadir had previously been a member of Al-Shabaab and was associated with its Amniyat, the organization’s intelligence and security wing, which has been linked to assassinations and bomb attacks. The source also alleged that Abdulkadir was involved in the killing of Abdulle Deerow Isak, a former Speaker of the Somali Parliament in 2000. These are extremely serious allegations, and if substantiated, they would raise profound questions about his background, his political rise, and the circumstances surrounding his selection as Speaker. More fundamentally, the issue goes beyond one individual. If Parliament cannot independently scrutinize the government, question its decisions, and hold the executive accountable, then Somalia’s constitutional system becomes little more than a façade. The principle of separation of powers and institutional checks and balances is being hollowed out, while political loyalty, patronage, and personal interests increasingly replace institutional responsibility. When the President effectively controls the legislature, constitutional government begins to give way to Villa Somalia’s dominance and that is precisely the danger Somalia ultimately face today. Third, he has taken for himself the powers of the Prime Minister and combined them with his own. He has reduced the Prime Minister’s office to a position in which its current holder cannot add anything, reject anything, or exercise any meaningful power of his own. He has failed to understand that there is a purpose behind dividing power: to prevent one person from monopolizing the government and controlling all political power. Unfortunately, the man who currently holds the position of Prime Minister has, by his own conduct, become nothing more than irrelevant. Fourth, the regional states are under attack and have become a mess. The deterioration of relations between Somalia’s Federal Government and the Federal Member States under President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud represents a structural crisis in the country’s post-conflict political architecture. Rather than institutionalizing a cooperative framework of federal governance, executive overreach and coercive interventions from Mogadishu have systematically fractured regional stability, turning federalism into an arena for political dominance. The crisis has been visible in Puntland and Jubaland, where Hassan has maintained a persistent political confrontation since the beginning of his term. He supported the 2023 conflict in Bosaso, the fighting in Garowe in June 2023, and the clashes in Galkayo in August 2026. He even stated While speaking at a mosque in Villa Somalia that Puntland would collapse within 24 days. In Jubaland, he launched an attack, most notably in Ras Kamboni engagement of December 2024 and Gedo region in July 2025. Unfortunately, Somali soldiers crossed the border while retreating from Ras Kamboni, which was a shameful episode. In the South West State, the political crisis surrounding Abdiasis Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen who remained in office for four years without a renewed mandate revealed the transactional nature of his relationship with Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. When Laftagareen served Hassan’s political interests, he enjoyed his support; when he was no longer politically useful, Hassan turned against him by removing him from office. The subsequent military intervention in Baidoa further demonstrated Mogadishu’s coercive approach toward regional authority. Meanwhile, the Galmudug election proved to be more deeply controversial because of the allegations surrounding the final results and the court ruling, which critics argue was influenced by Hassan’s political calculations. Hassan reportedly wanted Libaan Shulaq for the position, but Libaan rejected some of the things Hassan wanted, including what was reportedly an attempt to create unrest in Galkayo between the Galmudug and Puntland communities. These communities are brothers and sisters, and there is no justification for destruction between them; what they need is peace, development, and cooperation. Libaan’s refusal to follow that political direction appears to have created a serious disagreement. This raises an important question. Why has the court chosen this particular moment to intervene in Galmudug when it has not previously exercised the same authority over electoral disputes in South West? If the court’s intervention is genuinely based on constitutional and legal principles, then the same standards should apply consistently South West, regardless of political interests. Otherwise, the selective use of judicial authority shows that the court is not genuinely acting independently; it suggests that there is something behind this move. Think about that: the courts are being used as instruments of political power rather than as independent guardians of the Constitution. Hirshabelle, meanwhile, is deeply divided. Beledweyne and Jowhar have been politically separated, and after more than four years of Hassan’s administration, little has been achieved in terms of institutional and infrastructure development or meaningful reconciliation between the two communities. One cannot ignore the irony that these communities are connected to Hassan’s patrilineal and matrilineal lineages. Then there is Somaliland. Somaliland has moved further away from Somalia’s political framework, particularly after Israel’s recognition. Hassan’s government has failed to mount a coherent national response to what amounts to a glaring attack on national integrity by a foreign government. To many Somalis, this is an extraordinarily serious failure of national responsibility that some even describe as a betrayal of the national interest. After years in office, one must ask: what has this administration actually done to build trust, reconciliation, and cooperation among Somalia’s regions and communities? More broadly, these episodes have continued to expose the fragility of Somalia’s federal arrangements. Through military pressure, executive overreach, and transactional politics, the administration has weakened the constitutional foundations of federalism and replaced political negotiation with coercion. Consequently, instead of fostering national reconciliation and institutional trust, these interventions have deepened mistrust between the center and the regions, leaving Somalia’s federal system increasingly fragmented, unstable, and vulnerable to further conflict. Conclusion: A Tragic Political Destination? Hassan Sheikh entered Somalia’s political arena with a powerful and hopeful slogan: “A Somalia at peace with itself and at peace with the world.” He became the first Somali president to be elected twice through the country’s parliamentary process, rising from a modest background to the highest office in the land. At seventy years of age, however, the question is what legacy he will leave behind. And that is where the tragedy lies. He had an extraordinary opportunity to become a historic figure in Somalia’s political history as a leader who could have reconciled a divided nation, strengthened constitutional institutions, consolidated federalism, and restored public confidence in government. He could have built a legacy remembered for generations. Think about that. Instead, Hassan’s presidency has been defined by confrontation, political patronage, institutional weakness, and strained relations between Mogadishu and the Federal Member States. The very institutions that should constrain political power have increasingly appeared vulnerable to political influence, while national reconciliation has remained elusive. The result is a political system in which mistrust has deepened and the constitutional foundations of federalism have become increasingly fragile. This is what makes the conclusion so painful. If Hassan had used his two terms to leave behind a functioning constitutional order, he could have been remembered as a national statesman and a historic leader. His name could have been associated with reconciliation, institution-building, and national renewal. Places could have been named in his honor, and generations could have spoken of his presidency with pride. But political power is transient. Legacy is permanent. A president may control institutions for a time, but history ultimately judges what he did with that power. Hassan Sheikh entered the political arena promising a Somalia at peace with itself and at peace with the world. Somalia is not at peace with itself, nor is it at peace with the world. What a profoundly unfortunate end it would be if his presidency instead became remembered for deepening political divisions, weakening institutions, and taking Somalia toward the very constitutional dead end that he once had the opportunity to prevent. What a sad end. Dayib Sh. Ahmed Email:  Dayib0658@gmail.com —— Dayib is a writer, political analyst and WardheerNews contributor The post It Was Inevitable That Hassan Would Become a Warlord appeared first on WardheerNews .

Libaan’s refusal to follow that political direction appears to have created a serious disagreement. This raises an important question. Why has the court chosen this particular moment to intervene in Galmudug when it has not previously exercised the same authority over electoral disputes in South West? If the court’s intervention is genuinely based on constitutional and legal principles, then the same standards should apply consistently South West, regardless of political interests. Otherwise, the selective use of judicial authority shows that the court is not genuinely acting independently; it suggests that there is something behind this move. Think about that: the courts are being used as instruments of political power rather than as independent guardians of the Constitution. Hirshabelle, meanwhile, is deeply divided. Beledweyne and Jowhar have been politically separated, and after more than four years of Hassan’s administration, little has been achieved in terms of institutional and infrastructure development or meaningful reconciliation between the two communities. One cannot ignore the irony that these communities are connected to Hassan’s patrilineal and matrilineal lineages. Then there is Somaliland. Somaliland has moved further away from Somalia’s political framework, particularly after Israel’s recognition. Hassan’s government has failed to mount a coherent national response to what amounts to a glaring attack on national integrity by a foreign government. To many Somalis, this is an extraordinarily serious failure of national responsibility that some even describe as a betrayal of the national interest. After years in office, one must ask: what has this administration actually done to build trust, reconciliation, and cooperation among Somalia’s regions and communities? More broadly, these episodes have continued to expose the fragility of Somalia’s federal arrangements. Through military pressure, executive overreach, and transactional politics, the administration has weakened the constitutional foundations of federalism and replaced political negotiation with coercion. Consequently, instead of fostering national reconciliation and institutional trust, these interventions have deepened mistrust between the center and the regions, leaving Somalia’s federal system increasingly fragmented, unstable, and vulnerable to further conflict. Conclusion: A Tragic Political Destination? Hassan Sheikh entered Somalia’s political arena with a powerful and hopeful slogan: “A Somalia at peace with itself and at peace with the world.” He became the first Somali president to be elected twice through the country’s parliamentary process, rising from a modest background to the highest office in the land. At seventy years of age, however, the question is what legacy he will leave behind. And that is where the tragedy lies. He had an extraordinary opportunity to become a historic figure in Somalia’s political history as a leader who could have reconciled a divided nation, strengthened constitutional institutions, consolidated federalism, and restored public confidence in government. He could have built a legacy remembered for generations. Think about that. Instead, Hassan’s presidency has been defined by confrontation, political patronage, institutional weakness, and strained relations between Mogadishu and the Federal Member States. The very institutions that should constrain political power have increasingly appeared vulnerable to political influence, while national reconciliation has remained elusive. The result is a political system in which mistrust has deepened and the constitutional foundations of federalism have become increasingly fragile. This is what makes the conclusion so painful. If Hassan had used his two terms to leave behind a functioning constitutional order, he could have been remembered as a national statesman and a historic leader. His name could have been associated with reconciliation, institution-building, and national renewal. Places could have been named in his honor, and generations could have spoken of his presidency with pride. But political power is transient. Legacy is permanent. A president may control institutions for a time, but history ultimately judges what he did with that power. Hassan Sheikh entered the political arena promising a Somalia at peace with itself and at peace with the world. Somalia is not at peace with itself, nor is it at peace with the world. What a profoundly unfortunate end it would be if his presidency instead became remembered for deepening political divisions, weakening institutions, and taking Somalia toward the very constitutional dead end that he once had the opportunity to prevent. What a sad end. Dayib Sh. items.title: Cross-Border Violence in Awdal and Urgent Appeal Concerning Civilian Protection
items.description: Press Statement Djibouti has pursued territorial ambitions in Awdal since gaining independence in 1977. The current conflict and security crisis in the region have raised serious concerns that these long-standing ambitions are now being pursued through efforts to destabilize Gadaboursi communities, displace the local population, and ultimately assert control over parts of Awdal. There are reports that forces acting under the authority of Djiboutian President Ismaïl Omar Guelleh have infiltrated Awdal and carried out attacks in and around coastal communities, including Lughaya, Geerisa, and Sayla. These attacks have occurred in coordination with forces associated with the Hargeisa administration. These actions are aimed at creating insecurity, forcing civilians from their homes, and facilitating the resettlement of populations from Candhufo and Cadayto in Ethiopia. Local reports describe civilian casualties, the destruction or contamination of wells and other essential infrastructure, the killing of livestock, and damage to livelihoods. These incidents have contributed to growing insecurity among civilian populations and concerns about forced displacement. Taken together, these actions raise concerns about a broader strategy of displacement and demographic change: creating conditions that force established communities from their land and replacing them with other populations in order to alter control of the territory and weaken the social fabric of local communities. The actions of forces operating in the Gadaboursi region are deeply troubling and resemble displacement strategies seen in other geopolitical conflicts, including practices associated with settlement expansion and displacement in the West Bank. We condemn in the strongest possible terms all coordinated military violence against innocent civilians in Awdal, including actions involving Djiboutian forces and the Hargeisa administration. The targeting, displacement, or endangerment of civilians—particularly women and children—must not be tolerated. We call upon the United Nations, the European Union, the African Union, and international human rights organizations to urgently investigate these violences, condemn any aggression or unlawful displacement directed against the Gadaboursi people, and take meaningful steps to protect affected civilian communities and provide them with humanitarian assistance. Dr Ali Ibrahim Bahar Awdal State movement The post Cross-Border Violence in Awdal and Urgent Appeal Concerning Civilian Protection appeared first on WardheerNews .
