items.title: United States Expresses Condolences to the Victims of the Nepal Floods
items.description: United States Expresses Condolences to the Victims of the Nepal Floods Office of the Spokesperson The United States extends its deepest condolences to the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives in the devastating flash floods in the Rasuwa district of Nepal. Our thoughts are with all those affected by this disaster. The State Department is closely monitoring the situation and is deploying a disaster response advisor to the region to support response efforts. The Department will also provide $500,000 in assistance through its global award with Catholic Relief Services, supporting emergency shelter, relief items, and water, sanitation, and hygiene assistance to flood-affected communities. The U.S. Embassy in Kathmandu is working closely with local authorities to locate and assist U.S. citizens in the affected areas. U.S. citizens in Nepal who need urgent assistance related to the flooding should contact the U.S. Embassy at KathmanduACS@state.gov . We strongly encourage U.S. citizens in the affected areas to monitor local news, follow instructions from local authorities, and enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP) at step.state.gov to receive important safety and emergency information. Concerned U.S. citizens seeking information about family members in Nepal should call 1-888-407-4747 toll-free from the United States and Canada, or 1-202-501-4444 from other locations.

items.title: Jubaland oo Shaacisay Natiijada Imtixaanka Shahaadiga Fasalka 8-aad
items.description: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, Hiddaha iyo Tacliinta Sare ee Dowlad-goboleedka Jubaland ayaa ku dhawaaqday natiijada imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ee fasalka 8-aad ee sanad-dugsiyeedka 2025/2026. Sida lagu sheegay xogta natiijada, imtixaanka waxaa u fariistay 5,778 arday, waxaana ku guuleystay 5,720 arday, taas oo u dhiganta 99 boqolkiiba tirada guud ee ardayda imtixaanka gashay. Dhanka kale, 58 arday ayaa ku haray imtixaanka, kuwaas oo ka dhigan 1 boqolkiiba. Natiijada ayaa sidoo kale muujisay in kaalmaha ugu sarreeya ay si weyn ugu guuleysteen gabdhaha, iyadoo 10-ka kaalin ee ugu sarreysa ay ku kala jiraan 11 gabdhood iyo 3 wiil. Shaacinta natiijadan ayaa ka dhigan tallaabo muhiim ah oo loo qaaday dhanka qiimeynta waxbarashada iyo dadaallada lagu horumarinayo tayada waxbarashada ee Jubaland. Xafiiska Imtixaanaadka iyo Shahaadooyinka Jubaland ayaa sidoo kale ardayda u diyaariyay nidaam online ah oo ay kaga hubin karaan natiijooyinkooda.

items.title: Liibaan Shuluq Accepts Supreme Court Ruling as Galmudug Election Is Set for a New Chapter
items.description: Dhuusamareeb —(WDN) – Galmudug presidential candidate Liibaan Axmed Xasan (Liibaan Shuluq) has publicly accepted the Supreme Court’s decision to annul the recent parliamentary and local council elections in Galmudug, saying his political party, JSP, has also accepted the ruling. Liibaan Shuqul, a businessman and qat trader, had been widely portrayed as President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s undisputed candidate for the Galmudug presidency, even before a vote was cast. However, his change of position and the acceptance of the election’s rejection have raised questions, particularly given his earlier opposition to the Supreme Court’s decision and his apparent expectation that he would win the election. Liibaan urged the people of Galmudug to respect the court’s decision and return to the polls when a new election is organized, calling on voters to participate in even greater numbers than before. “The people of Galmudug participated in the previous election in large numbers, and we are now asking them to come out again and vote in even greater numbers,” he said. His acceptance of the ruling, however, does not revive or legitimize the annulled election. The Supreme Court’s verdict remains decisive: the previous vote was declared invalid after the court found that the electoral process had not been conducted in accordance with the Constitution and national electoral law. The ruling therefore leaves the disputed election without legal standing, regardless of how individual candidates or political parties characterize or accept its outcome. The court’s decision also places the focus firmly on what must change before Galmudug votes again. A credible election will require more than simply returning voters to polling stations; it will require an electoral process that is lawful, transparent and capable of withstanding judicial scrutiny. For now, the annulment stands, and the next election must begin from a legally sound foundation rather than attempt to reproduce a process that the Supreme Court has already rejected. Nevertheless, given President Hassan’s track record of clinging to power and seeking to install his political allies in the leadership of the Federal Member States, there is little public confidence that the election will be free and fair. The Supreme Court’s verdict remains decisive: the previous vote was declared invalid after the court found that the electoral process had not been conducted in accordance with the Constitution and national electoral law. The ruling therefore leaves the disputed election without legal standing, regardless of how individual candidates or political parties characterize or accept its outcome. The court’s decision also places the focus firmly on what must change before Galmudug votes again. A credible election will require more than simply returning voters to polling stations; it will require an electoral process that is lawful, transparent and capable of withstanding judicial scrutiny. For now, the annulment stands, and the next election must begin from a legally sound foundation rather than attempt to reproduce a process that the Supreme Court has already rejected. Nevertheless, given President Hassan’s track record of clinging to power and seeking to install his political allies in the leadership of the Federal Member States, there is little public confidence that the election will be free and fair. items.title: FAO-SWALIM oo Digniin ka Soo Saartay 388 Goobood oo uu Webiga Shabeelle Ka Fatahi Karo Xilliga La Filayo El Niño
items.description: FAOSWALIM ayaa shaacisay xog cusub oo ku saabsan xaaladda Webiga Shabeelle, iyadoo Agoosto 2026 lagu diiwaangeliyey 388 meelood oo webiga ah oo leh xaalado la xiriira fatahaad, furfurnaan iyo xannibaado. Xogta ayaa muujinaysa in 150 meelood ay biyuhu ka baxeen jiinka webiga, halka 147 meelood ay yihiin meelo furan, 66 meelood ay la kulmeen fatahaad kanaallo, halka 25 meelood ay yihiin meelo xiran. FAOSWALIM waxay sheegtay in xogtan, oo diiradda lagu saaray meelaha ugu nugul, ay muhiim u tahay diyaargarowga iyo qaadista tallaabooyinka degdegga ah ka hor inta aysan fatahaaduhu dhicin, gaar ahaan xilli la filayo in saameynta El Niño ay sii xoogaysato. Hay’addu waxay sidoo kale sheegtay in la ballaarin doono goobaha xogta laga ururinayo marka la helo kheyraad ku filan, si loo helo sawir dhammaystiran oo ku saabsan xaaladda Webiga Shabeelle iyo khataraha fatahaadaha.

items.title: Guddiga Doorashooyinka oo shaaciyay degmooyinka doorashooyinka Hirshabeelle
items.description: Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (NIEBC) ayaa shaaciyay degmooyinka Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle ee lagu qabanayo doorashooyinka isku-sidka ah ee Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada Hirshabeelle. Guddigu wuxuu sheegay in doorashooyinkan ay ka dhici doonaan lix degmo oo ka tirsan Gobolka Hiiraan iyo lix degmo oo ka tirsan Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Degmooyinka Gobolka Hiiraan waxaa ka mid ah Beledweyne, Jalalaqsi, Buuloburde, Matabaan, Jawiil iyo Farlibaax, halka Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe ay doorashadu ka dhici doonto Jowhar, Balcad, Warsheekh, Cadale, Mahadaay iyo Raage-Ceelle. Sida uu guddigu shaaciyay, guud ahaan 12 degmo oo ka tirsan Hirshabeelle ayaa loo asteeyay inay ka dhacaan doorashooyinka isku-sidka ah ee Golaha Deegaanka iyo Golaha Wakiillada Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle.

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada XFS oo Ansixiyey Xubin Guddiga Dastuurka iyo Dalacsiinta Danjiranimo
items.description: MUQDISHO — Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa kulankoodii maanta ku ansixiyey in Mudane Cabdulqaadir Cali Macallin Cabdullaahi uu noqdo xubin ka tirsan Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Dib-u-eegista iyo Hirgelinta Dastuurka. Sidoo kale, Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa ansixiyey in Mudane Cabdiraxiim Cabdi Abiikar loo dalacsiiyo darajada Danjiranimo. Kulanka Golaha Wasiirrada oo uu shir-guddoomiyey Ku-simaha Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ahna Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Saalax Axmed Jaamac, ayaa lagu faray mas’uuliyiinta la ansixiyey inay si hufan, daacadnimo iyo masuuliyad leh u gutaan waajibaadka loo igmaday. Ansixinta xubinta cusub ee Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Dib-u-eegista iyo Hirgelinta Dastuurka ayaa qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu xoojinayo geeddi-socodka dib-u-eegista iyo hirgelinta Dastuurka Federaalka Soomaaliya.

items.title: Cumar Cabdirashiid oo sheegay in aan dowladda Xasan Sheekh laga aqbali karin…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Cumar Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke ayaa si adag uga hadlay xiisadda dhulka ee ka taagan gudaha caasimadda, xilli ay kordheen howl-gallada burburinta ee ay waddo dowladda. Cumar Cabdirashiid ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay mas’uuliyad ka saaran tahay ilaalinta xuquuqda iyo daryeelka muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed, isagoo walaac ka muujiyay xaaladda dadka laga raray dhulkooda. Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore ayaa si gaar ah u xusay Buulo Elay iyo labada xaafadood ee Tokyo ee degmooyinka Howlwadaag iyo Yaqshiid, halkaas oo uu sheegay in kumannaan qof laga barakiciyay. “Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, waxaa saaran mas’uuliyadda ilaalinta xuquuqda iyo daryeelka muwaadiniinteeda,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaarihii hore Cumar Cabdirashiid. Sidoo kale, waxa uu sheegay in rarista dadkaasi, iyadoo aan lagala tashan, ay tahay arrin aan la aqbali karin, isla markaana murugo ku ah dadka ay sida tooska ah u saameysay. “Barakicinta iyo ka rarista kumannaan qof ee Buulo Elay iyo labada xaafadood ee Tokyo ee degmooyinka Howlwadaag iyo Yaqshiid, iyadoo aan bulshada lagala tashan, waa arrin aan gebi ahaanba la aqbali karin oo murugo leh,” ayuu hadalkiisa sii raaciyay. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli magaalada Muqdisho ay ka socdaan howl-gallo burburin ah, iyadoo arrimaha barakicinta dadka iyo ilaalinta xuquuqda shacabka ay noqdeen kuwo si weyn loo hadal-hayo. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa dhankeeda ku doodeysa in howlaha burburinta ee ka socda degmooyinka Kaaraan iyo Yaaqshiid uu qorshahoodu yahay in la hagaajiyo dhulalka Obasiibooyinka ee ku yaalla degmooyinkaas, si loo qurxiyo, looguna furo waddooyin waa wayn. Duqa Muqdisho, Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) ayaa sidoo kale shaaca ka qaaday in dhulalkaas loo sharciyeynayo dadkii lahaa, isagoo xusay in dadka haysta document-yada aan laga taaban doonin dhulkooda. “Waxaan rabaa hal mid inaan caddeeyo dhulka Obasiibada ah dadkii deganaa ayaa loo sharciyeynayaa Madaxweynaha waxa uu nagu ogyahay waa taas. Qof document haysto dhulkeeda waa lama taabtaan daraadna annaga iyo culimada ayaan ka wada-hadalnay,” ayuu yiri Duqa Muqdisho. Waxa uu intaas kusii daray in qofka uu dhulkiisa ku wayn karo in waddo ay ku timaado, inkastoo uu sheegay in dadkaas loo dajiyay qorshe guud, isla markaana loo sameyn doono dib u dajin rasmi ah. “Qof Obasiibo deggan wuxuu dhulkiisa ku wayn karaa marka jid la bixiyo qof ayuu saameynayaa dadkaas dowladdaa laga rabaa inay maareyso qorshe ayaana loo dajiyay iyadoo kunkii boos ee ugu horreeyay uu gaba-gabo marayo dhanka Gubadley, si dib u dajin loogu sameeyo shacabka,” ayuu yiri Muungaab. items.title: Al-Shabaab Modernizes Its Forces as Somalia Faces a Deepening Political Crisis
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) A new report indicates that Al-Shabaab is quietly strengthening and modernizing elements of its fighting force through military training in Yemen, raising fresh concerns about the group’s ability to adapt while Somalia’s Federal Government remains consumed by constitutional and electoral disputes. According to the report by Century International- From Spoke to Hub: The Houthis in Africa , between 120 and several hundred Al-Shabaab fighters have reportedly received training in Yemen. The instruction included small-arms use, explosives and basic drone operations. The findings suggest that the relationship between Al-Shabaab and Yemen’s Houthi movement has evolved beyond weapons exchanges and logistical contacts toward military training and the transfer of operational knowledge. Some Al-Shabaab fighters are reportedly traveling to Yemen in small groups, while previous UN assessments have also documented members of the group traveling there for military training. The development is significant because Al-Shabaab appears increasingly interested in capabilities that could help it adapt to modern battlefield conditions—particularly the growing use of drones and air operations by Somali government forces and their international partners. However, Century International cautions that there is no evidence that the Houthis have provided Al-Shabaab with their most advanced military systems, including sophisticated surface-to-air missile capabilities. The report draws on nearly 100 interviews, along with documentary evidence, communications records, maritime data and satellite imagery, giving its findings a broader evidentiary base than isolated reports of cooperation. A Strategic Shift The reported training points to a broader evolution within Al-Shabaab. Rather than relying exclusively on its traditional methods of warfare, the group with its increasing financial muscle appears to be investing in specialized skills and adapting to technologies increasingly shaping conflicts across the region. The acquisition of even basic drone capabilities and improved expertise in explosives and small arms could enhance the group’s ability to conduct surveillance, plan attacks and respond to increasingly sophisticated aerial operations. This development comes at a particularly sensitive moment for Somalia. While Al-Shabaab is reportedly investing in training and restructuring elements of its forces, the Federal Government is heavily preoccupied with political disputes over elections, constitutional changes and the legitimacy of the electoral process. That political distraction carries its own security risks. A government consumed by power grasp, disputes over constitutional authority and elections has less political space to maintain national consensus, coordinate federal and state security structures, and concentrate fully on the long-term fight against Al-Shabaab. The contrast is increasingly difficult to overlook: Al-Shabaab appears to be using the regional security environment to acquire new skills and adapt, while Somalia’s political leadership remains locked in an internal struggle over the rules of the state. The reported Yemen connection does not necessarily mean that Al-Shabaab has acquired a dramatically more powerful military capability. But it does demonstrate something potentially more important: the group is learning, adapting and looking beyond Somalia for expertise. For Somalia and its international partners, the warning is clear. Military pressure alone may not be enough if Al-Shabaab continues to modernize its methods while the country remains divided over its constitutional and electoral future. items.title: Cabdicasiis Laftagareen oo beeniyay eedayn uga timid Dowladda Federaalka
items.description: Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ayaa beeniyay in isaga iyo ciidamada taabacsanba ay xiriir la leeyihiin maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Ciidamada ka amarka qaata Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed ayaa la sheegaa in ay si firfircoon u joogaan deegaanada qaar ee hoostaga Magaalada Baydhabo, tani oo keentay tuhun ah inay iskaashi la sameeyeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ee ku sugan bannaanada magaaladaasi. Ciidamada ka soo horjeeda is bedelka siyaasadeed ee ay Dowladda Federaalka ka hirgelisay Baydhabo ayaa 17-kii bishan weeraray magaaladaasi, waxayna Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga sheegtay in weerarkaasi ay ku lug lahaayeen Shabaabka, isla-markaana ay taageerayeen ciidamadii weerarka soo qaaday. Cabdicasiis Laftagareen oo la hadlay BBC, lana weydiiyay su’aal ahayd Al Shabaab xiriir ma idiinka dhexeeyaa ayaa ku jawaabay “Maya.” “Waa been iyo borabagaando iyo hadal aan sal iyo raad lahayn iyo dagaalka oo si xun loo isticmaalayo.” Ayuu yiri Laftagareen. Laftagareen oo sii hadlayay ayaa yiri “Magaalada Baydhabo waa hal magaalo, Shabaab iskooda ayay u weerari karaan, laakiin maalintaasi Isniinta eheydoo 17-kii August, waxa Magaalada Baydhabo soo weeraray way caddahay, dokumentiyadii baa la hayaa, wayna duuban yihiin, Ciidanka Daraawiishta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed bay ahaayeen oo la yaqaanay oo saraakiishoodii iyo askartoodii leh.” Laftagareen ayaa intaasi ku daray “Askartii la tababaray oo 8 sano Shabaab ka waardiyeynayay Baydhabo ayay ahaayeen. Shalay raggii Burjeed iyo Deynuunaay difaaca uga jiray bay ahaayeen oo Shabaab ku celinayay oo kula dagaalayay, wax sabab ah oo maanta Shabaab iyo ayaga ay weerar isku la soo qaadaan baahideeda ahna ma taalo, mana loo baahno.” Laftagareen ayaa weli ku adkeysanaya in uu yahay Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, mana aqoonsana Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo 10-kii bishii June loo doortay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed.

Laftagareen oo sii hadlayay ayaa yiri “Magaalada Baydhabo waa hal magaalo, Shabaab iskooda ayay u weerari karaan, laakiin maalintaasi Isniinta eheydoo 17-kii August, waxa Magaalada Baydhabo soo weeraray way caddahay, dokumentiyadii baa la hayaa, wayna duuban yihiin, Ciidanka Daraawiishta Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed bay ahaayeen oo la yaqaanay oo saraakiishoodii iyo askartoodii leh.” Laftagareen ayaa intaasi ku daray “Askartii la tababaray oo 8 sano Shabaab ka waardiyeynayay Baydhabo ayay ahaayeen. Shalay raggii Burjeed iyo Deynuunaay difaaca uga jiray bay ahaayeen oo Shabaab ku celinayay oo kula dagaalayay, wax sabab ah oo maanta Shabaab iyo ayaga ay weerar isku la soo qaadaan baahideeda ahna ma taalo, mana loo baahno.” Laftagareen ayaa weli ku adkeysanaya in uu yahay Madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, mana aqoonsana Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) oo 10-kii bishii June loo doortay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed.

items.title: Puntland Accuses Turkey of Airstrikes Along Its Coast
items.description: London (WDN) — Puntland authorities have accused Turkey of carrying out a series of unclaimed airstrikes along the Puntland coast following the hijacking of the M/V Lutuf by Somali pirates. Abdirahman Yusuf Dujana, Puntland’s deputy security minister, told BBC Newsday and BBC Somali that Puntland believes Turkey was responsible for the recent strikes. He also alleged that Somalia’s federal government may have been involved. However, he provided no independently verifiable evidence to substantiate the allegations, and no government, military or armed group has officially claimed responsibility for the attacks. The strikes began after pirates seized the Cameroon-flagged M/V Lutuf on August 17 and moved the vessel and its crew toward Puntland’s Nugaal coastline. According to a Somali official cited by the Associated Press, the vessel was carrying Turkish-supplied weapons, communications equipment and satellite technology reportedly destined for a Turkish military training facility in Mogadishu. On August 18, four people were reportedly killed and two wounded in a strike near Garmaal after a small boat returned toward the coast from the direction of the hijacked vessel. While initial reports described those killed as suspected pirates, relatives and local residents said some were fishermen. Another deadly strike was reported on August 23 near Jiifle in Godob-Jiraan district. The district mayor told BBC Somali that nine people were killed, while a local resident who visited the site said he saw eight badly burned bodies. The resident said some of the young men were known locally as fishermen, although he could not establish why they were at sea or whether any were connected to piracy. The responsibility for both strikes remains officially unclaimed. The allegations against Turkey are particularly significant because Ankara previously told the BBC that it had no information about the attacks. Dujana has now directly contradicted that position, claiming Puntland possesses information concerning Turkish movements around the vessel and the surrounding coastline. The BBC said it could not independently verify the claim. Questions have also been raised over the role of Somalia’s federal government. On August 22, State Minister for Defence Omar Ali Abdi told local media that the federal government was aware of military operations and airstrikes along Puntland’s coast and was preparing a comprehensive report. He further stated that any military operation against piracy along Somalia’s coastline would legally require authorization from the federal government, although he did not identify who carried out the strikes or who ordered them. The dispute leaves several critical questions unanswered: Who authorized the attacks? Who carried them out? What intelligence was used to identify the targets? And what measures were taken to protect civilians, particularly fishermen operating along the coast? Puntland says it remains committed to fighting piracy but insists that suspected criminals must be dealt with through lawful procedures. Dujana also called for greater international maritime support, recalling previous cooperation between Puntland and international naval forces during the height of Somali piracy. Puntland authorities say they have arrested foreign nationals allegedly involved in piracy networks and recovered GPS equipment and computers reportedly used to track commercial vessels hundreds of miles offshore. However, the deputy minister said Puntland currently has no direct evidence linking Al-Shabaab or Islamic State to the latest piracy-related activities. The government has requested responses from the Turkish Embassy in Mogadishu and Turkish military officials, as well as Somalia’s federal ministries, regarding the identity of those conducting the strikes and whether the federal government authorized them. For now, the central mystery remains unresolved: a series of deadly attacks has occurred along Puntland’s coast, civilians may have been among the victims, yet no actor has publicly accepted responsibility. items.title: Puntland oo dacwad ka gudbisay Turkiga kadib arrin xasaasi ah oo ay ku eedeysay
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Puntland ayaa si toos ah Turkiga ugu eedeysay inuu mas’uul ka yahay duqeymo maalmihii lasoo dhaafay ka dhacay xeebaha maamulka, xilli burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ay gacanta ku hayaan markabka M/V LUTUF. Markabkan ayuu maamulka Puntland sheegay inuu siday qalab militari oo xiriir la leh Turkiga. Duqeyntan ayaa lagu dilay dad kalluumaysato ah iyo shaqsiyaad looga shakisan yahay inay ka tirsanaayeen burcad-badeedda Soomaalida. Wasiir Ku-xigeenka Amniga Puntland, Cabdiraxmaan Yuusuf Dujaana ayaa sheegay in maamulka uu hayo caddeymo uu ku saleynayo eedeynta loo jeediyay ciidamada Turkiga, inkastoo uusan faah-faahin ka bixin nooca caddeymaha uu sheegay. Dujaana ayaa sheegay in Puntland aysan taageersanayn in la dilo dadka lagu tuhunsan yahay burcad-badeednimada, balse ay aaminsan tahay in burcad-badeedda lagula dagaallamo habraacyo waafaqsan sharciga iyo xeerarka caalamiga ah. Wasiir ku-xigeenka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in arrintan ay la xiriirto xaaladda siyaasadeed ee u dhexeysa Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, taas oo uu sheegay inay saameyn ku yeelan karto xiriirka maamulka iyo dowladda Turkiga. Wuxuu xusay in Puntland ay beesha caalamka u gudbisay qoraallo iyo dukumiintiyo la xiriira waxa ay ku tilmaantay khaladaad ka dhacay xeebaha maamulka, gaar ahaan duqeymaha ay ku eedeysay ciidamada Turkiga. Eedeynta Puntland ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Cumar Cali Cabdi uu horraantii toddobaadkan sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay ka warqabto howl-gallada militari ee ka socda xeebaha Puntland. Cumar ayaa sheegay in dowladda ay diyaarinayso warbixin dhameystiran oo ku saabsan howl-galladaasi, hase yeeshee ma uusan shaacin cidda fulinaysa duqeymaha ka dhacay xeebaha Puntland. Arrintan ayaa sii kordhineysa xiisadda ka taagan xeebaha Puntland, iyadoo weli ay jiraan su’aalo ku saabsan cidda fulisay duqeymaha iyo ujeeddada laga lahaa, xilli markabka M/V LUTUF uu gacanta ugu jiro kooxo Soomaali ah oo lagu tuhunsan yahay burcad-badeednimo. Si kastaba, dowladda Turkiga ayaa dhankeeda horey iskaga fogeysay inay ku lug leedahay duqeynta ka dhacday xeebaha maamulka Puntland. Duqeyntaas ayaa si gaar ah uga dhacday deegaan-xebeedka Jiifle oo hoos-taga degmada Godob-Jiraan ee gobolka Nugaal. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli xeebaha Soomaaliya ay weli ka jiraan falal la xiriira burcad-badeednimo iyo afduubka maraakiibta, iyadoo dowlad-goboleedyada iyo Dowladda Federaalku ay wadaan dadaallo lagu sugayo amniga xeebaha. The post Puntland oo dacwad ka gudbisay Turkiga kadib arrin xasaasi ah oo ay ku eedeysay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Maxay kala yihiin “Afyaaan” iyo “Abwaan”?
items.description: Mar walba oo laga hadlo aqoonta af Soomaaliga, waxa maanka dadka ku soo degdega ereyga “abwaan”. Haddaba, maxaa iska galay “abwaan” iyo “aqoonta afka”? Si aynu labadan u kala saarno, saddex arrimood baynu halka kaga hadlaynaa. Midi waa “dadka afka ku hadla”, midina waa “abwaan”, midda kalana waa “afyaqaan”. Dadka Afka ku Hadla Dadka Soomaaliyeed oo dhammi waxay ku hadlaan af Soomaali. Waxaynu niraahnaa waa afkeennii hooyo. Haddaba, dadkani sidee afka ku kasbadeen? Dadkan afka waa la qaybsiiyaa, waxayna qaybsiintani bilaabataa marka ilmuhu dhasho. Si qofku dadka ku hareeraysan ula xidhiidho, waxa khasab ah in uu kula xidhiidhi karo afka ay ku wada hadlayaan. Iyada oo taas maskaxda lagu hayo ayaa hooyadu ilmaha ku bilowdaa qaybsiinta ereyada aasaasiga ah. Mar walba oo uu qofku sii korana wuxu qaybaa ereyada, sida ay u dhacayaan, sida aan loo oran iyo sida la isu gu xidhiidhiyo. Qaybsiinta afka waxa ka qayb qaata hooyada, xaafadda iyo dadka ina ku hareeraysan. Sidaas baa qof walba ku kasbadaa kuhadalka afka. Tani barasho maaha, waayo, marka qofku afka ku hadlayo xeerar uma kala laha. Qofkani ma kala garan karo sababta ay isku falka u qaateen: “Gabadhdhii waa tagtay” iyo “adigu waad tagtay”. Sidoo kale, ma kala garan karo sababta ay falalkoodu u kala duwan yihiin “Gabadhdhii waa tagtay” iyo “Wiilkii waa tegey”. Waxa uun la qaybsiiyey in sidaa loo hadlo. Bes. Waa kuwaas dadka afka ku hadlaa. Abwaanka Abwaanku waa qof la mid ah dadka sare, wuxuse kaga duwan yahay in uu maanso tirin karo. Tirinta maansadu waa in qofku qaybo sida maansada Soomaalidu u dhisan tahay. Halka dadka aynu kor kaga soo hadalnay ay hadalka qaybayeen, maansayahanku wuxu qaybaa sida meerisyada maansadu u dhacaan. Marka uu muddo dhegeysto maansooyin kala duwan, waxa qofkan u fududaanaysa in uu dib u yiraahdo habdhacii maansada. Tanina waa qaybis. Maansada qof walba waa uu tirin karaa, waxayna ku xidhan tahay in uu muddo dhegeysto maansooyin dad kale tiriyeen. Qofkani in uu ereyada isku aaddin karo ma ahee aqoon ahaan waxba ma dhaamo dadka caadiga ah ee afka qayba. Abwaanka noocan ahi ma garan karo sababta ay maansadu noocyo kala duwan u leedahay, mana fahmi karo cilladda haysata haddii meeris maanso oo jaban la tuso. Kaasina waa abwaanka. Afyaqaan. Afyaqaanku waa qof afka aqoon ahaan u bartay. Waa qof kala garan kara waxa sidaa loo yiraahdo oo aan sidan loo oran. Wuxuu bartaa codadka, qaabdhismeedka ereyada, miisaanka maansada, weedhaynta iyo xeerarka naxweed ee afka. Sida uu buuni Cabdalla Cumar Mansuur hore u sheegay, afka haddii gaadhi laga dhigo labada qof ee aynu kor kaga soo hadalnay waxay noqonayaan dareewallo afka iyo maansada u kaxayn kara sida dareewalku gaadhiga u kexeeyo, halka afyaqaanku ka noqonayo makaanigga garanaya biraha gaadhiga ku jira, bir walbi meesha ay ku jirto iyo waxa ay qabato. Kaxaynta gaadhigu uma baahna in uu qofku yaqaanno biraha gaadhiga ku jira iyo shaqooyinka ay qabtaan, wuxu keliya u baahan yahay in uu yaqaanno sida gaadhiga loo kaxeeyo. Balse dhinaca kale, makaaniggu wuxu garan karaa birta xun, meesha ay ku jirto, sababta ay u xumaatay iyo wax walba oo ku xeeran. Sidaa darteed, afyaqaanku wuxu bartaa xeerarka afku ku shaqeeyo, wuxuna si fudud u soo saari karaa hadba xeerka jaban sida makaanigga gawaadhida. Kaasina waa afyaqaanka. Inta badan saddexdan arrimood waa la isku khaldaa, weliba abwaanka iyo aqoonta afka waa la mataaneeyaa heer ay gaadhdhey in loo qaato in aqoonta afku tahay wax cid gaar ahi leedahay. In la isku khaldo qaybahan waxa keenaya afkeenna oo aan aqoontiisa la baran taas oo keenta in afyaqaanka la la simo qof afka aan waxba uga bilownayn ama isla qofkan danbe aqoon aanu hayn marti looga noqdo oo isaga qudhdhiisu ku jaahwareero “waxa aqoonta afka la yiraahdo”. Haddaba, cidda ay tahay in afka wax laga weyddiiyaa waa cida aqoon ahaan u baratay waana afyaqaanka. Afyaqaanku wuxu baran karaa xeerarka afka lagu hadlo, waxa kale oo uu baran karaa xeerarka maansada. Kaasina waa afyaqaanka. Inta badan saddexdan arrimood waa la isku khaldaa, weliba abwaanka iyo aqoonta afka waa la mataaneeyaa heer ay gaadhdhey in loo qaato in aqoonta afku tahay wax cid gaar ahi leedahay. In la isku khaldo qaybahan waxa keenaya afkeenna oo aan aqoontiisa la baran taas oo keenta in afyaqaanka la la simo qof afka aan waxba uga bilownayn ama isla qofkan danbe aqoon aanu hayn marti looga noqdo oo isaga qudhdhiisu ku jaahwareero “waxa aqoonta afka la yiraahdo”. Haddaba, cidda ay tahay in afka wax laga weyddiiyaa waa cida aqoon ahaan u baratay waana afyaqaanka. Afyaqaanku wuxu baran karaa xeerarka afka lagu hadlo, waxa kale oo uu baran karaa xeerarka maansada. Kaasina waa afyaqaanka. items.title: Burco: Maanta weli way ladan tahee hawga sii darin! waxaan si adag uga digayaa in guddi qabyaaladeed magaallada Burco loo sameeyo
items.description: Burco, maanta weli way ladan tahee hawga sii darin! waxaan si adag uga digayaa in guddi qabyaaladeed magaallada Burco loo sameeyo By Xildhibaan Suldan Jama Nuh Waxaan ka digayaa guddida qabyaaladda ee magaallada Burco laga samaynayo, ee wasiirka Macalin ka waddo. Hore magaallada waxa ragaadiyey qabyaalad ay “cunfi” ugu yeedheen oo xilalka lagu qaybsado. Maayarka, Badhasaabka, iyo Xoghaya, waxa lagu qaybsadaa waa “cunfi” wax official ah maaha ee waa informal practise, hadda se iyadoo maanta taasna meesha laga saaray oo ay dhinac ka rar-tahay, haddana in guddi kale oo qabyaaladeed la sameeyo waa dibudhac iyo burbur kale oo magaaladda lagu ragaadinayo. . 2021 intii aan xildhibaanka noqday , waxaan ka shaqaynayey in bulshada reer Burco isdhexgasho, mid ahaato,, wax wada yeelato, wax wada qabsato oo horumar wada gaadho, waxaan ka soo baxay xisbiga Waddani; waxaan hormuud u ahaa iskaa wax u qabso aan ku dhisnay khayriyadda Burco 14 cisho oo keliya. in badan baan shantaa sano ka shaqeeyey Burco wanaaggeedda, hase yeeshee, maanta wasiirkii xukuumadda ayaa ka shaqaynaya Burco xumaanteeda, burburkeeda iyo kala qaybinteeda,golihii deegaanka ee la soo doortayna qabyaaladeeyo, waa markii koobaad oo gole deegaan oo wax dooranaya ay qabyaalad u kala fadhiisteen, markii aan arkay halka uu wax marinaayo iyo xukuumadda oo aan waxba ka qabanayn baan la yaabay. Maanta wuxuu keenay, inuu yidhaahdo, Guddi Horumarineed u samaynayaa Burco, waxaan weydiinayaa wasiirka, badhasaabka iyo maayarka keebay hoos imanayaan, wasaaradee bay ka mid ahaanayaan, xisbigee bay ka tirsan yihiin, halkee bay maaliyadda ay wax ku hormarinayaan ka helayaan, yaa dhaqaalaha siinaya, ileen xukuumaddaa dhistee, mandate ka ay ku shaqaynayaan yaa siinaya. mise ma garanaysaa guddida horumarinta ee sharciga xeer no 23 ku qoran wuxuu dhigayo! Wasaaradda Dowladaha Hoose intii la sameeyey dib baa loo socdaa, horumarkii Burco ka socday halkii buu ku istaagay, magaalooyinkii oo dhan isbedel aan kala go’ lahayn baa daba loo qabtay, welina loo hayaa. Wasaaradda loogu talo galay horumarinta, waxay noqotay wasaaradda dibudhaca iyo burburinta magaalooyinka, xildhibaanno gole deegaan baa loo doortay ee guddida uu maanta u samaynayo Burco ceriteria dee buu ku soo xulayaa, ma culimaa, ma macalimiin baa, ma madaxyada jaamacadahaa, ma caaqilaa, ma ganacsataa, waa noocee qaabka loo soo xulayaa, miisaanka aan qabyaalad ahayn ee lagu tusmaynayaa muxuu yahay? Guddida Horumarinta ee Burco, waxay timi goor dalku dagaallo sokeeye ka soo kabanayo, xukuumaddu aanay si fiican u shaqaynayn, dhaqaale na haysan, cashuur la ururin jirin, ama maamulku liitay oo uu tahli waayey inuu cashuur urursado – wakhtigaas oo loo baahday in mashaariic waaweyn oo horumarineed la sameeyo. Markaas baa Guddida Horumarinta Togdheer, isxilqaantay oo ay samaysay Jaamacadda Burco, Biriijka Labaad ee Burco, Hospitaalka Dhimirka ee Burco, mashaariicdaas bay samaysay guddidaas horumarinta Togdheer, iskeed- ayey isu xilqaantay, xukuumadi na ma samayn, ganacsato na ma samayn – odayaal indheergarad ah oo badhaasaabbo, maayarro, engineerro, ganacsato, ayaa arkay baahiyaha loo qabo in magaallada horumar la gaadhsiiyo, mashaariiic waaweyn oo dadkoo dhami ka wada faa’iidaanna la sameeyo, dadkii colaadaha sokeeye afeeyeenna dibusoo kabasho loogu sameeyo. Waxa horumarkaa maalgelinta ugu weyn lahaa, qurbajoogta gobolka Togdheer oo aan ka mid ahaa. halkaas baana dakhliga ugu badani ka soo geli jiray. Duruuftaasi maanta ma jirto, Burco na tii shalay maaha, 500 kun oo qof baa ku nool, 9 jaamacadood baa ku yaal, iskuullada lama tirin karo, cusbitaalladu waa saddex dowliya iyo intaas oo gaar loo leeyahay (Private ah). Guddida horumarintu maanta cashuur ma qaadi karto, qurbajoogtuna tii shalay maaha ee waa mid dalka kula joogta oo mashaariicda ay fulinayeen waxay sii socotaa tuulooyinka. Dalka dowlad la doortay oo 400 Milyan oo doolar sannadkii isticmaasha ayaa ka jirta. Goleyaal la doortay oo golaha deegaanku ka mid yahay baa ka jira oo 5 milyan oo doollar maamula. Wasaarad dhan oo wasiir, ku xigeen iyo agaasime leh oo loo sameeyey inay magaalooyinka horumariso, ee sidee ayuu wasiirkii ku keenay inuu guddidiii 1999- oo kale sameeyo. Dibusocod baa lagu jiraa, madaxweyne, dalka adigaa laguu doortee, sidan si ugu dhaan, oo wasiirkan khaldan ee aan qabyaalad iyo dadka inuu madaxa isu geliyo mooyee wax kale ka shaqaynayn ka qabo. Burco, maanta weli way ladan tahay ee hawga sii daran,? waxaan si adag uga digayaa in guddi qabyaaladeed magaallada loo sameeyo, Gole deegaan oo dadku doortay baa jooga, sharci iyo cod ku yimi, xisbiyo kala duwan ka soo baxay oo bulshada oo dhan metela. nin aan la dooran oo xukuumaddu dhisatay oo aan sharci ahayn, wuxuu keeno karo iyo siduu bulshada isugu diri karo ayaan fahmayaa, ee haddii aanad wax kale u tarayn wasiir, sideeda isaga daa, inta meesha aad dhaafaysid. Madaxweyne, Burco maanta guddi uma baahna ee horumar la taaban karo iyo mashaariic bay u baahan tahay, Airport ka oo dib loo dhiso, loona furo, wadada oodweyne oo la bilaabo iyo waddooyinka magaallada soo gala oo la dhiso – wadada Burco ilaa Caynabo; Burco ilaa Balidhiig, Burco ilaa Duruqsi, Burco ilaa Huguf. Burco waxay xukuumadda uga fadhidaa mashaariic horumarineed, ee ugama fadhido guddi horumarineed – Cusbitaalkii weynaa ee aynu dhagax dhignay in la bilaabo, taliskii ciidanka Booliiska ee la dumiyey in dib loo dhiso iyo biriijkii 3aad ee qabyada ahaa iyo kuwo kale ba in loo dhiso ayey Burco u baahan yahay. Allaa Mahad Leh Xildhibaan Suldaan Jaamac Nuux London, UK

items.title: Maxaa looga hadlay kulanka golaha wasiirrada ee XFS  ?
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online) Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Soomaaliya oo maanta yeeshay kulankoodii toddobaadlaha ahaa, ayaa lagaga hadlay xaaladda dalka, gaar ahaan sugidda amniga iyo la-dagaallanka Kooxda Al-shabaab. Kulanka Golaha oo uu Shir guddoomiyey Ku-simaha Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ahna Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku xigeenka Xukuumadda Saalax Axmed Jaamac, ayaa lagu ansixiyey labo heshiis oo dowladdu la gashay dalka Muritaaniya, kuwaas oo kala ah Wadatashiyo Siyaasadeed iyo Iskaashiga Barnaamijka Tababbarka Diblumaasiyadda. Heshiisyadan ayaa la sheegay in mudnaan gaar ah siinayo iskaashiga labada dowladood ee dhinacyada ay khusayso, gaar ahaan tababbarrada diblumaasiyiinta iyo wadatashiyada Arrimaha Siyaasadda oo muhiimad gaar ah u leh dalkeenna, waxa ayna sii xoojinayaan xiriirka labada dal. items.title: Boqolaal Al-Shabaab ah oo u baxay tababar dibedda ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa xeryo ku yaalla dalkaas ku tababartay 120 ilaa dhowr boqol oo dagaalyahanno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo la baray adeegsiga hubka fudud, samaynta walxaha qarxa iyo isticmaalka aasaasiga ah ee diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, sida lagu sheegay warbixin cusub. Warbixinta oo ay soo saartay hay’adda Century International ayaa faahfaahin cusub ka bixisay xiriirka milatari ee sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen, kaas oo khubaro Qaramada Midoobay ah ay daba socdeen tan iyo 2024. Warbixinta oo cinwaan looga dhigay From Spoke to Hub: The Houthis in Africa ayaa sheegtay in saraakiil amni oo Yemeni, Soomaali iyo dalal kale ka tirsan ay ku qiyaaseen tirada dagaalyahannada Al-Shabaab ee Xuutiyiintu ku tababareen Yemen inta u dhexeysa 120 illaa dhowr boqol. Tababarrada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray hubka fudud, samaynta walxaha qarxa ee macmalka ah ee IED-yada loo yaqaan iyo hababka aasaasiga ah ee loo adeegsado diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Tirada ay soo bandhigtay Century International ayaa ka badan tan ay horey si rasmi ah u diiwaan-geliyeen khubarada Qaramada Midoobay. Guddi khubaro ah oo Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Soomaaliya ayaa bishii November 2025 sheegay in afar kooxood oo min 30 dagaalyahan oo Al-Shabaab ah ay u safreen Yemen si loogu soo tababaro sannadkii ka horreeyay. Mid ka mid ah kooxahaas ayaa Soomaaliya ka baxday bishii October 2024, iyada oo ka shiraacatay deked dabiici ah oo ku taalla inta u dhexeysa Baraawe iyo Homboy ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, kahor inta aysan gaarin magaalada Mukalla ee koonfurta Yemen. Dagaalyahannada ayaa kadib loo qaaday deegaan ka baxsan magaalada Xudeyda, halkaas oo muddo ku dhow laba bilood lagu barayay isticmaalka qoryaha, hubka lidka diyaaradaha iyo samaynta qaraxyada macmalka ah, sida uu sheegay guddiga Qaramada Midoobay. Century International ayaa sheegtay in kooxo kale ay markii dambe tageen Yemen, iyada oo saraakiil amni iyo ilo gobolka ah ay cilmi-baarayaasha u sheegeen inay jireen saddex kooxood oo kale oo min 33 dagaalyahan ah. Warbixinta waxaa qoray Peter Salisbury, Nadwa Al-Dawsari iyo Jay Bahadur, waxayna qeyb ka tahay mashruuc cilmi-baariseed muddo laba sano ah socday oo lagu magacaabo Beyond the Axis . Qorayaashu waxay sheegeen inay xogta ku dhiseen ku dhowaad 100 wareysi oo lala yeeshay saraakiil ciidan, amni iyo sirdoon, waxaana sidoo kale la baaray dokumentiyo, diiwaannada taleefannada, xogta maraakiibta la qabtay, sawirrada dayax-gacmeedka iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta. Ninka labada dhinac isku xirayay Caddeymaha ugu muhiimsan ee warbixintu soo bandhigtay waxaa ka mid ah xog la xiriirta Axmed Cilmi Samatar, oo ah nin Soomaali ah oo ciidamada ammaanka Yemen ay ku xireen magaalada Mukalla sannadkii 2024. Warbixinta ayaa Samatar ku tilmaamtay nin ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab oo door dhexdhexaadin ah ka ciyaaray xiriirka kooxda iyo Xuutiyiinta. Century International ayaa sheegtay in Samatar uu intii uu xirnaa qirtay inuu xiriiriye u ahaa labada dhinac. Diiwaannada su’aalo-weydiinta ee ay heleen cilmi-baarayaasha ayaa muujinaya inuu bishii June 2024 socdaal ku maray deegaanno ay Al-Shabaab maamusho, oo ay ku jirto Jilib, isaga oo isku dubbaridayay dhaqdhaqaaqa dad Yemeni ah oo dukumentiyada lagu tilmaamay “marti”. Warbixinta ayaa sheegtay in dadkaas ay ku jireen laba injineer oo milatari oo ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta, kuwaas oo tegay dooxada Jubba si ay xubnaha Al-Shabaab ugu tababaraan samaynta IED-yada, wax ka beddelka diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo dayactirka hubka. Diiwaannada su’aalo-weydiinta ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in Samatar uu ka qeybgalay kulamo looga hadlay “dhammaystirka dukumenti hub” iyo “xulashada ragga tababarka loo dirayo”. Samatar ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inuu fududeeyay safarka illaa 400 oo Soomaali ah oo tegay deegaannada Yemen ee Xuutiyiintu maamulaan si ay u helaan tababar milatari iyo mid fikir. Hase yeeshee, tiradaas 400-ka ah macnaheedu ma aha in dhammaantood ay ahaayeen dagaalyahanno Al-Shabaab ah. Century International ayaa tirada xubnaha Al-Shabaab ee la rumeysan yahay inay tababarka heleen ku qiyaastay 120 ilaa dhowr boqol. Xogtan ayaa la jaanqaadaysa natiijooyin uu bishii October 2025 soo bandhigay guddiga khubarada Qaramada Midoobay ee Yemen, kaas oo sheegay in nin Soomaali ah oo xiriiriye ahaa, laguna xiray Yemen, uu bixiyay xog ku saabsan laba injineer oo Xuutiyiinta ka tirsan oo tegay Jilib. Khubarada Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegay in injineerradaas ay Al-Shabaab ku tababareen samaynta IED-yada, wax ka beddelka diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo dayactirka hubka. Guddiga ayaa xilligaas sheegay in xiriirka labada kooxood uu “horumaray”. Raadinta hubka lidka diyaaradaha Warbixinta cusub ayaa sheegtay in mid ka mid ah waxyaabaha Al-Shabaab ku riixaya xiriirka Xuutiyiinta uu yahay doonista awood ay isaga difaacdo weerarrada cirka. Al-Shabaab ayaa bilowgii 2024 furtay waddooyin xiriir oo ay la yeelato Xuutiyiinta, iyadoo dooneysa inay hesho hubka lidka diyaaradaha iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, sida ay sheegtay Century International. Weerarrada cirka ayaa muddo dheer qeyb muhiim ah ka ahaa howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab ee Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan kuwa ay fuliyaan ciidamada Mareykanka. Xuutiyiinta ayaa dhankooda leh waayo-aragnimo ballaaran oo ku saabsan gantaallada iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, waxaana ay Yemen ku soo rideen dhowr diyaaradood oo nooca MQ-9 Reaper ah oo Mareykanku leeyahay. items.fullContent: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Kooxda Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa xeryo ku yaalla dalkaas ku tababartay 120 ilaa dhowr boqol oo dagaalyahanno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, kuwaas oo la baray adeegsiga hubka fudud, samaynta walxaha qarxa iyo isticmaalka aasaasiga ah ee diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, sida lagu sheegay warbixin cusub. Warbixinta oo ay soo saartay hay’adda Century International ayaa faahfaahin cusub ka bixisay xiriirka milatari ee sii xoogeysanaya ee u dhexeeya Al-Shabaab iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen, kaas oo khubaro Qaramada Midoobay ah ay daba socdeen tan iyo 2024. Warbixinta oo cinwaan looga dhigay From Spoke to Hub: The Houthis in Africa ayaa sheegtay in saraakiil amni oo Yemeni, Soomaali iyo dalal kale ka tirsan ay ku qiyaaseen tirada dagaalyahannada Al-Shabaab ee Xuutiyiintu ku tababareen Yemen inta u dhexeysa 120 illaa dhowr boqol. Tababarrada ayaa diiradda lagu saaray hubka fudud, samaynta walxaha qarxa ee macmalka ah ee IED-yada loo yaqaan iyo hababka aasaasiga ah ee loo adeegsado diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Tirada ay soo bandhigtay Century International ayaa ka badan tan ay horey si rasmi ah u diiwaan-geliyeen khubarada Qaramada Midoobay. Guddi khubaro ah oo Qaramada Midoobay u qaabilsan Soomaaliya ayaa bishii November 2025 sheegay in afar kooxood oo min 30 dagaalyahan oo Al-Shabaab ah ay u safreen Yemen si loogu soo tababaro sannadkii ka horreeyay. Mid ka mid ah kooxahaas ayaa Soomaaliya ka baxday bishii October 2024, iyada oo ka shiraacatay deked dabiici ah oo ku taalla inta u dhexeysa Baraawe iyo Homboy ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose, kahor inta aysan gaarin magaalada Mukalla ee koonfurta Yemen. Dagaalyahannada ayaa kadib loo qaaday deegaan ka baxsan magaalada Xudeyda, halkaas oo muddo ku dhow laba bilood lagu barayay isticmaalka qoryaha, hubka lidka diyaaradaha iyo samaynta qaraxyada macmalka ah, sida uu sheegay guddiga Qaramada Midoobay. Century International ayaa sheegtay in kooxo kale ay markii dambe tageen Yemen, iyada oo saraakiil amni iyo ilo gobolka ah ay cilmi-baarayaasha u sheegeen inay jireen saddex kooxood oo kale oo min 33 dagaalyahan ah. Warbixinta waxaa qoray Peter Salisbury, Nadwa Al-Dawsari iyo Jay Bahadur, waxayna qeyb ka tahay mashruuc cilmi-baariseed muddo laba sano ah socday oo lagu magacaabo Beyond the Axis . Qorayaashu waxay sheegeen inay xogta ku dhiseen ku dhowaad 100 wareysi oo lala yeeshay saraakiil ciidan, amni iyo sirdoon, waxaana sidoo kale la baaray dokumentiyo, diiwaannada taleefannada, xogta maraakiibta la qabtay, sawirrada dayax-gacmeedka iyo dhaqdhaqaaqa maraakiibta. Ninka labada dhinac isku xirayay Caddeymaha ugu muhiimsan ee warbixintu soo bandhigtay waxaa ka mid ah xog la xiriirta Axmed Cilmi Samatar, oo ah nin Soomaali ah oo ciidamada ammaanka Yemen ay ku xireen magaalada Mukalla sannadkii 2024. Warbixinta ayaa Samatar ku tilmaamtay nin ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab oo door dhexdhexaadin ah ka ciyaaray xiriirka kooxda iyo Xuutiyiinta. items.title: Hunger crisis threatens Somalia as floods come on top of drought and conflict
items.description: Hunger crisis threatens Somalia as floods come on top of drought and conflict Conflict-stricken Somalia has been devastated by drought and stark cuts in humanitarian aid this year and is now bracing itself for sweeping floods that could push millions more into starvation. Visiting displacement camps in Kismayo, the Norwegian Refugee Council’s (NRC) Secretary General Jan Egeland warned that the situation is at breaking point. “Entire communities have been waiting months without any help,” Egeland said. “I have met families, women, children and farmers who have lost everything to cycles of drought and hunger. Families are sharing one plate a day of food. Newborns are in danger of dying from malnutrition. Now they are about to be hit by floods, threatening to wipe them out. We cannot turn away and passively allow another catastrophe to hit these families.” Six million people, or one out of every three in Somalia, are facing crisis levels of hunger or worse after consecutive seasons of drought. More than 700,000 people have been displaced this year, over 500,000 by drought alone. MSF warns one of every two children in parts of Southern Somalia are malnourished. At the same time, aid cuts have wiped out support for displaced Somalis. Despite the scale of need, Somalia’s humanitarian response remains 70 per cent underfunded. Now another emergency threatens Somalis. The country’s Deyr rainy season, expected in October, is forecasted to be amplified by the global El Niño which could bring the country’s most severe flooding since 2023. Forecasters warn that this year’s El Niño could rival the floods of 2023, which displaced 1.2 million people, killed 8,000 farm animals, and damaged 11,000 hectares of farmland. “Somalis pay the toll of brutal climate shocks that were in no way of their doing,” Egeland said. “We know that the next shock is coming and we know how hunger turned to famine in the past when Somalia was abandoned. What we don’t have is the funding to act on it.” NRC is calling for: Scaled up humanitarian funding for food security, nutrition, water and sanitation, shelter, and protection services in the worst-affected areas. Immediate investment in flood preparedness: early warning systems, evacuation planning, and protection of critical infrastructure, ahead of the Deyr rains. Cash assistance to help families survive the ongoing hunger crisis. Long-term investment in resilience programming to break the cycle of recurring drought and flood shocks.

items.title: Five Kenyan Herders Freed After Abduction Near Somalia Border
items.description: MANDERA — Five Kenyan pastoralists abducted near the Somalia border by gunmen suspected of links to Al-Shabaab have been released following negotiations led by traditional elders from both sides of the frontier, Kenyan authorities said. The men, all residents of Alungu in Mandera County, were freed on Monday evening after local peace elders coordinated with traditional leaders from Damasa, Somalia, to secure their release. Police said the five were recovered in good health and had been reunited with their families. The herders were among six men reportedly seized earlier on Monday near Wantey Dam in Lafey Sub-County. One of them managed to escape, while the remaining five were taken across the border, according to preliminary reports. The abductors allegedly demanded three goats or 6,000 Kenyan shillings for each captive. Other reports indicated that they had requested one camel per person as an alternative. Authorities have not confirmed whether any ransom was paid or livestock surrendered. Officials attributed the men’s release to sustained negotiations between community elders in Kenya and Somalia. The incident has again highlighted the role of traditional cross-border mediation networks in resolving security disputes and securing the release of abductees in remote frontier areas. The abduction caused renewed concern among communities along the porous Kenya–Somalia border, where the movement of pastoralists and their livestock frequently exposes residents to armed groups operating in the region. Kenyan police said investigations were underway to establish the identities of the abductors and determine the circumstances surrounding the incident. Al-Shabaab has previously been accused of abducting Kenyan nationals for ransom and targeting foreigners in communities near the border. A South Korean couple abducted in the region last year is reportedly still being held in an area of Somalia controlled by the militant group. Wantey Dam and its surrounding areas remain vulnerable to militant activity. Kenyan security forces continue to conduct operations along the border to prevent attacks and counter threats associated with Al-Shabaab. items.title: Guddoomiye Muungaab oo si kulul uga hadlay xiisadda dhulka ee ka taagan Muqdisho
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir, ahna Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho, Mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) oo xalay hoggaamiyay kulan dadweyne oo ka dhacay degmada Warta Nabadda ayaa si kulul uga hadlay xiisadda dhulka ee ka taagan gudaha Caasimada, maadaama ay kordheen howlgallada burburinta ee ay waddo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Muungaab ayaa si gaar ah usoo hadal qaaday howlaha burburinta ee ka socda degmooyinka Kaaraan iyo Yaaqshiid, wuxuuna tilmaamay in qorshaha uu yahay in la hagaajiyo dhulalka Obasiibooyinka ee ku yaalla degmooyinkaas, si loo qurxiyo, looguna furo waddooyin waa wayn. Sidoo kale, Duqa Muqdisho ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in dhulalkaas loo sharciyeynayo dadkii lahaa, wuxuuna dhanka kale sheegay in dadka haysta document-yada in aan la taaban doonin dhulkooda, isla markaana ay arrintaas kala hadleen Culumada Soomaaliyeed. “Waxaan rabaa hal mid inaan caddeeyo dhulka Obasiibada ah dadkii deganaa ayaa loo sharciyeynayaa Madaxweynaha waxa uu nagu ogyahay waa taas. Qof document haysto dhulkeeda waa lama taabtaan daraadna annaga iyo culumada ayaan ka wada-hadalnay,” ayuu yiri Duqa Muqdisho. Waxaa kale oo uu intaas kusii daray “Waxaan rabnaa Kaaraan iyo Yaaqshiid inay lamid noqdaan sida Soona-key, Taleex iyo Tarabuunka oo kale beerta riyada in laga furaa rabnaa”. Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir oo hadalkiisa sii wata ayaa ka hadlay walaaca ay qaban shacabka laga burburiyay guryahooda, wuxuuna tilmaamay in qofka uu dhulkiisa ku wayn karo in waddo ay ku timaado, balse dadkaas loo dajiyay qorshe guud, islamarkaana loo sameyn doono dib u dajin rasmi ah. “Qof Obasiibo deggan wuxuu dhulkiisa ku wayn karaa marka jid la bixiyo qof ayuu saameynayaa dadkaas dowladdaa laga rabaa inay maareyso qorshe ayaana loo dajiyay iyadoo kunkii boos ee ugu horreeyay uu gabagabo marayo dhanka Gubadley, si dib u dajin loogu sameeyo shacabka,” ayuu mar kale yiri Muungaab. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aasayo, iyada oo haatan meeshii ugu sarreysay ay gaartay qaylo dhaanta ka dhalatay burburinta ay waddo dowladda oo si weyn looga dareemay Magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimada dalka. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aasayo, iyada oo haatan meeshii ugu sarreysay ay gaartay qaylo dhaanta ka dhalatay burburinta ay waddo dowladda oo si weyn looga dareemay Magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimada dalka. items.title: Somalia: LUTUF cargo ship hijacker says he’s a US citizen
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – A man identifying himself as one of the Somali pirates holding the hijacked cargo vessel M/V LUTUF off the coast of Somalia told local media he came from the United States and intends to return there once he receives his share of the ransom, in an interview that also disputed official accounts of what the ship is carrying. The Cameroon-flagged LUTUF, owned by Polar Movement Shipping, was seized on August 17 roughly three and a half nautical miles off Marraya in Puntland’s Eyl district by eight armed men. Somali officials and the vessel’s owners have said the ship was carrying weapons, communications and satellite equipment bound for a Turkish military training facility in Mogadishu. Its ten-member crew includes six Indian nationals, one Turkish national, one Georgian and two Serbian security guards. Speaking to local media, the man disputed that account of the cargo. He said the ship is instead carrying weapons, armored military vehicles and cement, and denied it was carrying communications equipment as previously reported. He went further, alleging that the vessel was chartered by “mercenaries” and that its weapons were destined for mercenary groups rather than for the Turkish military base in Mogadishu, as has been widely reported. Neither claim has been independently verified, and it could not be confirmed whether the man had firsthand knowledge of the ship’s manifest or cargo documentation. The man said Somali parliament speaker Abdulkadir Mohamed Nur had contacted the pirates directly and warned them that they would be killed on the spot if they did not release the ship. He argued that the outreach itself undercut the official narrative linking the cargo to Turkey, reasoning that if the weapons belonged to Turkey, Turkish officials – not a Somali parliamentary figure – would be the ones negotiating. This account, like the others attributed to him, could not be independently corroborated, and Somali Guardian has not confirmed that this individual holds or held the position described. In the most unexpected part of the interview, the man said he was originally from the United States and planned to return there after collecting his portion of the ransom. He said he would give 90 percent of his share to poor people, saying he personally had no need for the money. Somali Guardian could not independently verify his nationality, identity or the ransom-distribution claim, and no US, Somali or Puntland authority has commented on it. Competing accounts of the airstrikes The hijacking has been followed by a string of unclaimed airstrikes in the waters and coastline near where the LUTUF was taken. An August 18 strike near Garmaal in Puntland’s Dangoroyo district killed four men after a small boat delivered supplies to the hijacked vessel and turned back toward shore; Puntland authorities identified the dead as civilian fishermen, while initial reports had described them as suspected pirates. A further strike on August 24 in the Jiifle area of Godob-Jiraan district killed at least nine people, according to local officials, again with no country or military force claiming responsibility. Local media reports say Turkish naval vessels have surrounded the LUTUF and have called on the pirates to release the ship in exchange for safe passage. Turkey has not publicly confirmed carrying out any of the strikes; asked about an earlier incident, its foreign ministry told the BBC it had no information about the operation. Puntland’s government has said the civilian toll from the strikes threatens to damage cooperation between its security forces and international partners fighting piracy, and has demanded that the countries responsible for the strikes explain them. The Somali federal government, by contrast, has maintained that those killed were pirates and has defended the strikes attributed to Turkey. The two positions remain unreconciled, and no independent investigation has yet established the identities of those killed in either strike. The status of the LUTUF, its crew and its cargo remained unclear as of Thursday. Somali Guardian will update this story as the account of the pirate’s claims, the parliament speaker’s involvement and the airstrike death tolls are further verified. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Mareykanka oo ku dhowaaqay is-beddel lama filaan ah oo ku yimid dagaalka Iiraan
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa xilligan qorsheyneysa inay ka fogaato weerarro milatari oo cusub oo ay ku qaaddo Iran, iyadoo taa beddelkeeda xoojinaysa cunaqabateynta dhaqaale iyo cadaadiska dhinaca badda, sida ay sheegayaan ilo Mareykan ah. Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka Marco Rubio ayaa dhowaan u sheegay wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda ee dhowr dal oo xulafo la ah Washington in Mareykanku “xilligan” aanu fileyn inuu bilaabo weerarro cusub oo ka dhan ah Iran, sida ay werisay Axios , iyadoo soo xiganaysa sarkaal Mareykan ah iyo il kale oo arrinta la socota. Rubio ayaa la sheegay inuu u sheegay xulafada in maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump uu hadda xoogga saarayo qaabab kale oo cadaadis ah, gaar ahaan cunaqabateynta cusub ee dhaqaale iyo xannibaadda badda ee Mareykanku ku hayo Iran. Isbeddelkan ayaa muujinaya in Washington ay doonayso inay yareyso dagaalka tooska ah, ugu yaraan waqtigan, iyadoo isku dayaysa inay dhaqaale ahaan cadaadis weyn saarto Tehran. Sarkaal Mareykan ah ayaa Axios u sheegay in Rubio uu caddeeyay inaan hadda la qorsheyn dib ugu noqoshada howl-gallo milatari oo ballaaran, balse uusan meesha ka saarin in Mareykanku weerarro qaado haddii Iran ay marka hore weerar ku soo qaaddo. Maamulka Trump ayaa sidoo kale sare u qaaday cunaqabateynta Iran. Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ayaa Isniintii billowday olole cusub oo ay ugu magac dartay “Operation Economic Outcast”, kaas oo lagu bartilmaameedsanayo ilaha dhaqaale ee Tehran iyo dhinacyada ka caawiya inay ka dhuumato cunaqabateynta. Washington ayaa tallaabadan ku dartay shirkado, shaqsiyaad iyo maraakiib lala xiriiriyay Iran, iyadoo sidoo kale ballaarisay khatarta cunaqabateynta labaad ee saaran shirkadaha iyo dalalka sii wada ganacsiga Tehran. Cadaadiska Hormuz Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale rumeysan inuu Iran ka wiiqay awood muhiim ah oo ay ku lahayd marin-biyoodka Hormuz, kaddib howl-gallo lagu nadiifinayo miinooyinka iyo kororka maraakiibta shidaalka ee maraya qaybta koonfureed ee marin-biyoodkaas. Sarkaal labaad oo Mareykan ah ayaa Axios u sheegay in nadiifinta miinooyinka ay tahay isbeddel weyn oo dagaalka ku yimid, maadaama ay meesha ka saareyso qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ahayd awoodda Iran ay cadaadis ugu saari karto suuqyada tamarta caalamka. “Iran waxay lumisay gacantii ay ku haysay marin-biyoodka. Hadda Mareykanka ayaa gacanta ku haya,” ayuu yiri mid ka mid ah saraakiisha Mareykanka ee Axios la hadlay. Saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in tirada booyadaha shidaalka ee ka gudbaya Hormuz ay toddobaadyadii dambe sii kordheysay, arrintaas oo ay Washington u aragto inay hoos u dhigayso awoodda Tehran ee ay ku carqaladeyn karto suuqyada tamarta dunida. Dhanka kale, Mareykanka ayaa sheegaya in xannibaadda badda ay Iran ka jarayso dakhli muhiim u ahaa dowladda. Saraakiisha ayaa Axios u sheegay in labadii toddobaad ee la soo dhaafay aan ku dhowaad wax booyado ah lagu arag jasiiradda Kharg, oo ah xarunta ugu weyn ee Iran ay shidaalkeeda dibadda uga dhoofiso. Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka Tommy Pigott ayaa sheegay in Washington ay dooneyso inay xirto waddo kasta oo dhaqaale oo Tehran u hartay. “Dhaqaalaha Iran wuxuu ku jiraa burbur weyn, ciidamadii maamulkana si ba’an ayaa loo wiiqay,” ayuu yiri Pigott, isagoo intaas ku daray in Mareykanku jarayo “waddo kasta oo dhaqaale oo maamulku weli haysto”. Wuxuu sheegay in Trump uu caddeeyay inaan Iran loo oggolaan doonin inay hesho hub nukliyeer ah, isla markaana madaxweynuhu adeegsan doono agabka uu u arko inay lagama maarmaan yihiin si taas looga hortago. Weli wadahadal ma jiro Isbeddelladan ayaa imanaya xilli ay jiraan dadaallo diblomaasiyadeed oo la doonayo in lagu yareeyo xiisadda u dhexeysa Washington iyo Tehran. Taliyaha ciidamada Pakistan Field Marshal Asim Munir ayaa Axaddii booqday Tehran, halkaas oo uu kula kulmay hoggaanka Iran. Pakistan ayaa tan iyo markii dagaalku billowday door dhexdhexaadin ah ka dhex waday Mareykanka iyo Iran. Telefishinka Al Arabiya ayaa sheegay in Munir uu Trump la hadlay ka hor safarkiisa, isla markaana uu soo jeediyay hindise cusub oo loo gudbin karo dhinaca Iran. Aqalka Cad ma uusan beenin in Trump iyo Munir ay wada hadleen, balse wuxuu sheegay in waqtigan aysan jirin wadaxaajoodyo socda ama la qorsheeyay oo Mareykanka iyo Iran dhexmaraya. “Waqtigan xaadirka ah Iran lama xaajooneyno. Cadaadis ayaan saareynaa,” ayuu sarkaal Mareykan ah u sheegay Axios, isagoo sheegay in cadaadiskaasi ugu dambeyn Tehran dib ugu celin karo miiska wada-hadalka. Sida ay Axios sheegtay, mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka ayaa rumeysan in Iran ay hadda lumisay qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah awooddii ay marin-biyoodka Hormuz ugu adeegsan lahayd gorgortan kasta oo mustaqbalka ah. Sarkaal kale ayaa sheegay in siyaasadda hadda jirta — ka fogaanshaha weerarro cusub iyo xoojinta cadaadiska dhaqaale — la filayo inay sii socoto ugu yaraan ilaa doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe ee Mareykanka, inkastoo howl-gal milatari oo cusub dib loo tixgelin karo kaddib. Ergada Aqalka Cad Steve Witkoff iyo Jared Kushner, oo door muhiim ah ku lahaa wadahadalladii Iran, ayaa sidoo kale la filayaa inay Arbacada booqdaan Taliska Dhexe ee Ciidamada Mareykanka, CENTCOM, si warbixin looga siiyo xaaladda dhulka, sida ay Axios kasoo xigatay il xog-ogaal ah. The post Mareykanka oo ku dhowaaqay is-beddel lama filaan ah oo ku yimid dagaalka Iiraan appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo Booqday Taliska Ciidanka Badda, Kuna Baaqay Diyaargarow Dheeraad ah
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, ayaa booqasho shaqo ku tegay Taliska Ciidanka Badda Soomaaliyeed ee magaalada Muqdisho, isagoo ku baaqay in la xoojiyo iskaashiga, anshaxa iyo diyaargarowga hawlgal ee Ciidanka Badda. Taliyaha ayaa warbixinno ka dhageystay saraakiisha sare ee Ciidanka Badda, kuwaas oo uga warbixiyay howlaha socda, waxqabadka ciidanka iyo dadaallada lagu horumarinayo awoodda Ciidanka Badda si ay si hufan ugu gutaan waajibaadkooda qaran. Booqashada ayaa sidoo kale diiradda lagu saaray qiimeynta xaaladda hawlgal ee Ciidanka Badda iyo meelaha u baahan in la xoojiyo isku-duwidda iyo wada shaqeynta. Sarreeye Guuto Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud ayaa hoggaanka iyo saraakiisha Ciidanka Badda kula dardaarmay inay sare u qaadaan wada shaqeynta gudaha, isla markaana joogteeyaan heer sare oo diyaargarow ah, si ay si wax-ku-ool ah u gutaan waajibaadka loo igmaday. Intii uu booqashada ku guda jiray, Taliyaha ayaa sidoo kale tegay xarunta Horseed Club Sports Complex, halkaas oo uu ku soo indha-indheeyay howlaha ka socda xarunta iyo doorka ay ka qaadato horumarinta ciyaaraha iyo ka-qaybgalka bulshada. Booqashadan ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu xoojinayo hay’adaha amniga iyo tayeynta awoodda Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, si ay si weyn uga qayb qaataan sugidda amniga iyo ilaalinta mas’uuliyadda qaran.

items.title: Golaha Wasiirrada XFS oo Ansixiyey Laba Heshiis oo Muhiim ah oo lala galay Muritaaniya
items.description: Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa maanta yeeshay kulankoodii toddobaadlaha ahaa, kaas oo looga hadlay xaaladda guud ee dalka, gaar ahaan amniga iyo dagaalka lagula jiro Shabaab. Kulanka oo uu shir-guddoomiyey Ku-Simaha Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ahna Ra’iisul Wasaare Ku-xigeenka XFS, Mudane Saalax Axmed Jaamac, ayaa Golaha Wasiirradu ku ansixiyeen laba heshiis oo ay Soomaaliya la gashay dowladda Muritaaniya. Heshiisyada la ansixiyey ayaa kala ah Heshiiska Wada-tashiyada Siyaasadeed iyo Heshiiska Iskaashiga Barnaamijka Tababbarka Diblumaasiyadda. Heshiisyadan ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Muritaaniya, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo wada-tashiyada siyaasadeed iyo horumarinta aqoonta iyo xirfadaha diblumaasiyiinta labada dhinac. Dowladdu waxay sheegtay in heshiisyadu ay gacan ka geysanayaan sii xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada ay danaha wadaagaan.

items.title: Golaha wasiirrada oo ansixiyay heshiisyo lala soo galay dalka…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xubnaha Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Soomaaliya oo maanta yeeshay kulankoodii toddobaadlaha ahaa, ayaa kaga hadlay xaaladda guud ee dalka, gaar ahaan sugidda amniga iyo la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab, iyada oo sidoo kale shirka lagu ansixiyay laba heshiis oo muhiim ah. Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada waxaa guddoomiyay Ra’iisul Wasaare ku-xigeenka 1-aad MudaneSaalax Axmed Jaamac, maadaama uu dalka ka maqan yahay Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre, oo shalay u ambabaxay dalka Qatar. Shirka waxaa sidoo kale si buuxda uga qeybgalay inta badan xubnaha Golaha. Inta uu socday kulanka ayaa waxaa lagu ansixiyey labo heshiis oo dowladda Soomaaliya ay lasoo gashay dalka Muritaaniya, kuwaas oo kala ah Wada-tashiyo Siyaasadeed iyo Iskaashiga Barnaamijka Tababbarka Diblumaasiyadda. Heshiisyadan ayaa mudnaan gaar ah siinaya iskaashiga labada dowladood ee dhinacyada ay khusayso, gaar ahaan tababbarrada diblumaasiyiinta iyo wada-tashiyada arrimaha siyaasadda oo muhiimad gaar ah u leh dalkeenna, waxa ayna sii xoojinayaan xiriirka labada dal. Sidoo kale, Heshiisyadan ayaa la filayaa inay gacan ka geystaan sii xoojinta xiriirka dalalka Soomaaliya iyo Mauritania, isla markaana ay sare u qaadaan wada-shaqeynta labada dal ee dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo diblumaasiyadda. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa muhiimad gaar ah siinaysa horumarinta awoodda iyo aqoonta diblumaasiyiinteeda, iyadoo tababarrada iyo iskaashiga noocan ah ay qeyb ka yihiin dadaallada lagu tayeynayo shaqada diblumaasiyadda Soomaaliya. Mauritania iyo Soomaaliya waxaa xilligan ka dhexeeya xiriir ku dhisan iskaashi iyo danaha ay labada dal wadaagaan, iyadoo labada dowladood ay daneynayaan in la horumariyo wada-shaqeynta dhinacyada siyaasadda, diblumaasiyadda iyo tababarrada. Si kastaba, Ansixinta heshiisyadan cusub ayaa loo arki karaa tallaabo lagu sii xoojinayo xiriirka labada dhinac, laguna ballaarinayo iskaashiga labada dal. The post Golaha wasiirrada oo ansixiyay heshiisyo lala soo galay dalka… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Muxuu Cawad ku tilmaamay go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirkii hore ee Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Axmed Ciise Cawad, ayaa si weyn u bogaadiyay go’aankii Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka ay ku laashay natiijadii doorashooyinkii baarlamaanka iyo goleyaasha deegaanka Galmudug, isaga oo ku tilmaamay tallaabo taariikhi ah oo wax weyn ka beddeli karta dowlad-dhiska Soomaaliya. Cawad ayaa go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare barbar dhigay dhacdooyin waaweyn oo taariikhda Yurub beddelay, isaga oo sheegay in xukunka maxkamaddu uu Soomaaliya u horseedi karo nidaam ay hay’aduhu ku shaqeeyaan dastuurka iyo sharciga, halkii awoodda dowladdu ku koobnaan lahayd rabitaanka shaqsiyaadka hoggaanka haya. “Go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ee Soomaaliya ee lagu laalay doorashadii Galmudug ee Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo aan sharci ahayn, kama yara taariikh ahaan Kacaankii Sharafta lahaa ee Ingiriiska ee 1688 iyo Kacaankii Faransiiska ee 1789,” ayuu Cawad ku yiri qoraal uu ku daabacay bartiisa X. Hadalkan ku saabsan in doorashadu ahayd mid “aan sharci ahayn” waa qiimeynta Cawad, balse Maxkamadda Sare waxay xukunkeeda ku sheegtay in hannaankii doorashada uusan waafaqsaneyn dastuurka iyo sharciga doorashooyinka. Cawad ayaa sheegay inuu rajeynayo in go’aankaasi uu Soomaaliya ku hago waddada dastuur-ku-dhaqanka iyo dowladnimada ku dhisan hay’ado awooddooda ku shaqeeya. “Sida kacdoonnadaas taariikhiga ah, wuxuu, haddii Alle idmo, Soomaaliya saari doonaa waddada dastuur-ku-dhaqanka iyo in hay’aduhu talada yeeshaan, halkii dalka lagu maamuli lahaa rabitaanka iyo amarrada hoggaamiyeyaal doonaya inay kelitalis noqdaan sida Xasan Sheekh,” ayuu yiri. Wasiirkii hore ayaa sidoo kale ammaan u jeediyay garsoorayaasha Maxkamadda Sare, isaga oo sheegay in go’aankooda lagu xusuusan doono kaalinta ay ka qaateen xoojinta hay’adaha dowliga ah iyo madax-bannaanida garsoorka. “Go’aankan taariikhiga ah iyo garsoorayaasha Maxkamadda Sare waxaa jiilasha dambe ku xusuusan doonaan inay jihada saxda ah u jeediyeen geeddi-socodka dowlad-dhiska Soomaaliya, isla markaana dhidib adag u taageen maamul-wanaagga dalkeenna,” ayuu yiri Cawad. Waxa uu garsoorayaasha ugu baaqay inay ku adkaystaan ilaalinta madax-bannaanida garsoorka, isaga oo ku eedeeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud inuu isku dayi karo inuu saameyn ku yeesho hay’addaas. Cawad wax caddeyn ah kuma soo bandhigin qoraalkiisa oo taageeraya eedeyntaas. “Waxaan ku bogaadinayaa garsoorayaasha sharafta leh go’aankan geesinimada leh, waxaana ugu baaqayaa inay ku adkaystaan ilaalinta garsoorka faragelinta Xasan Sheekh, ayna dhowraan madax-bannaanida hay’addan muhiimka u ah mustaqbalka qarankeenna,” ayuu yiri. Guddiga oo aqbalay go’aanka Hadalka Cawad ayaa imanaya xilli Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha uu si rasmi ah u aqbalay go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ee lagu laalay natiijadii doorashooyinkii 30-kii Luulyo ka dhacay Galmudug. Guddiga ayaa sheegay inuu tixgelinayo kaalinta dastuuriga ah ee Maxkamadda Sare, sarreynta sharciga iyo in khilaafaadka doorashooyinka lagu xalliyo hannaan garsoor oo sharci ah, isaga oo tixraacay qodobka 73-aad ee Xeerka Doorashooyinka Qaranka. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay inuu soo muddeyn doono xilliga la qabanayo doorashada ku-celiska ah ee Galmudug, taas oo ka dhigan in go’aankii maxkamaddu uu hadda u gudbay dhinaca fulinta, inkastoo aan weli la shaacin jadwalka cusub. Maxkamadda Sare ayaa 24-kii Agoosto laashay natiijadii doorashooyinka Golaha Wakiillada iyo goleyaasha deegaanka Galmudug, kaddib markii ay sheegtay in habkii loo maamulay loona qabtay uusan waafaqsaneyn dastuurka iyo sharciga doorashooyinka, isla markaana khaladaadkii dhacay ay dhaawaceen hufnaanta iyo xalaalnimada doorashada. Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Baashe Yuusuf Axmed, ayaa sheegay in doorashooyinka aan loo maamulin ama loo qaban si waafaqsan dastuurka iyo sharciga doorashooyinka dalka, isla markaana khaladaadkii dhacay ay si weyn u dhaawaceen hufnaanta, xorriyadda iyo caddaaladda doorashada. Maxkamaddu waxay sidaas darteed waxba kama jiraan ka dhigtay natiijooyinka, waxayna Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka iyo Soohdimaha ku amartay inuu sida ugu dhaqsaha badan u qabto doorashooyin cusub. Hay’adaha hadda ka jira Galmudug ayaa sii shaqeynaya inta laga soo dooranayo kuwo cusub, si looga fogaado firaaq maamul. Dacwadda waxaa Maxkamadda Sare horgeeyay ururka siyaasadeed ee Towfiiq, oo ka mid ahaa dhinacyadii ka qeyb-galay doorashada. Natiijadii hadda la laalay ayaa xisbiga talada haya ee Justice and Solidarity Party (JSP), oo uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, siisay 63 ka mid ah 89-ka kursi ee baarlamaanka Galmudug, taas oo xisbiga siisay aqlabiyad aad u ballaaran. items.title: Axmed Mire Maxamuud  wuxuu wuxuu leeyahay aqoon maamul dhisi oo cajiib ah sida hore loo arkay
items.description: AXMAD MIRE MAXAMAD WUXUU LEEYAY AQOON MAAMUL DHIS OO CAJIIBA SIDII HORE LOO ARKAY. Mujaahid axmad mire maxamad waa mid ka mida ragga ku suntan gobanimadan maanta taagan halgankii lagu xoreeyay, axmad wuxuu kaalin weyn uu ka soo qaatay dagaalladii naafaynta cadowga. Waxa jiray maalmmo cadowgii waddanka haystay ay si xun u jabeen oo lama illaawaan ah sida maalintii guushii balidhiig iyo taallo buur 20.12.1984kii waxay ahayd maalin cadowgu ay si xun u jabeen waxaan filayaa gaadiidka xiryahaas lagu qabtay inay ahaayeen 13 gadiida oo uu ku jiray taangi noociisu ahaa T55 iyo qori pm ah, waa qorigii 31.5.188 hargaysa wacdaraha ka dhigay iyo tikniko kale waan soo koobayaa qoraalka. Axmad waqtiyadii uu xilalka hayay SNM waxa laga gubay saddexdii XARIIQ ee cadawga xariiqa koowaad oo ahaa xuduudaha SNM markay naafaysay (bahdishay) cadowgii waxa iyana la jebiyay xarriiqii labaad oo ahaa talisyada xuduudaha oo laga gaadhay guulo taarikhi sida mucjisooyinkii gunburaha iyo bisiqa. Xarriiqa saddexaad oo ahaa kii lagu soo galay dalka 1988KII oo uu dhaawac halisi ka soo gaadhay burco. Axmad mire maamulka askiriga ah iyo ka medaniga ah intaba wuu yaqaanaa wuxuu qaybta ugu culus ka qaatay maamulkii degmooyinka aagga madiina sida HARADA GOBATOXIL iyo dhoqoshay oo laga sameeyay nidaam ay ku badbaadeen shicibkii soo qaxay. items.title: Qof lagu dhaawacay Saldhigga Booliiska degmada Waabari
items.description: Qof lagu magacaabo Farxaan Ibraahin Abshir ayaa dhaawac fudud ka soo gaaray garabka kadib markii xabad si lama filaan ah uga dhacday qori uu watay mid ka mid ah askarta ka howlgasha Saldhigga Booliiska Waabari ee magaalada Muqdisho sida ay shegeen taliska booliska gobolka Benaadir. Sida lagu sheegay war-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Booliiska, dhacdada ayaa abbaaro 20:50 habeenimo ka dhacday gudaha saldhigga, xilli eedaysanaha uu qoriga la qabsaday askariga. Xabadka ayaa si lama filaan ah uga dhacday qoriga, waxaana ay garabka ka haleeshay Farxaan Ibraahin Abshir, oo Booliisku sheegay in dhaawaciisu yahay mid fudud. Booliisku waxay beeniyeen wararka sheegaya in qof lagu dilay gudaha saldhigga iyo in mayd laga soo saaray, iyagoo sheegay in dhacdada aysan wax dhimasho ah ka dhalan. Booliisku waxa ay sidoo kale sheegeen in baaritaan uu socdo oo ku saabsan sida ay dhacdadu u dhacday.

items.title: Musharraxa JSP oo aqbalay go’aanka Guddiga Doorashooyinka Galmudug
items.description: Musharraxa Xisbiga Caddaaladda iyo Wadajirka (JSP) ee hoggaanka Galmudug, Liibaan Axmed Xasan, ayaa soo dhaweeyay go’aanka Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka iyo Soohdimaha Qaranka ee ku aaddan dib-u-qabashada doorashada Galmudug. Go’aankan ayaa yimid kaddib markii Maxkamadda Sare ay 24-kii Agoosto 2026 laashay natiijadii doorashooyinkii isku sidkanaa ee Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golayaasha Deegaanka Galmudug, iyadoo guddiga doorashooyinkana faray in doorashada dib loogu noqdo. Musharrax Liibaan ayaa mar kale shacabka Galmudug ugu baaqay inay u diyaar garoobaan doorashada, isagoo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in bulshada ay si nabad ah uga qaybqaataan hannaanka doorashada. JSP ayaa hore Liibaan Axmed Xasan ugu magacaabay musharraxa rasmiga ah ee xisbiga uga tartamaya hoggaanka Galmudug ee muddo-xileedka 2026–2031.

items.title: Maxaa ka jira in DIL uu ka dhacay saldhigga degmada Waabari?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Taliska qaybta guud ee Booliska Gobolka Banaadir ee uu hoggaamiyo Macalin Mahdi ayaa faah-faahin ka bixiyay dhacdo xalay ka dhacday ka dhacday saldhigga degmada Waabari ee magaalada Muqdisho. Ugu horreyn taliska ayaa beeniyay in gudaha saldhigga uu ka dhacay dil loo gaystay qof shacab ah, xilli saacadihii ugu dambeeyay la baahiyay warar sheegayay in mayd laga saaray gudaha saldhigga. Warsaxaafadeedka Booliska ayaa si cad loogu beeniyay wararkaasi, iyadoo talisku waxba kama jiraan ku tilmaamay qoraallada lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada. “Waa waxba kama jiraan wararka sheegaya in gudaha Saldhigga Booliiska Waabari ee Booliiska Caasimadda lagu dilay qof, isla markaana mayd laga soo saaray, Warkaasi waa been-abuur aan sal iyo raad lahayn,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka. Taliska qaybta guud ee Gobolka Banaadir ayaa sidoo kale sharraxay sida ay wax u dhaceen, wuxuuna sheegay in fiidkii hore ee xalay rasaas ay ka dhacday qoray uu sitay askari kamid ah ciidanka ilaalada ee saldhigga, kadib markii nin lagu magacaabo Farxaan Ibraahin Abshir uu qoriga la qabsaday askariga, sidaasna uu eedeysanaha kusoo gaaray dhaawac fudud. Waxaa kale oo warsaxaafadeedka lagu sheegay in haatan uu socdo baaritaan dheeraad ah oo ku aadan falkaasi, maadaama uu dhacay fal dhaawac ah. “Abbaaro 20:50, ayaa xabad/ baalooto ka dhacday qoriga uu sitay mid ka mid ah askarta ka howlgasha Saldhigga, kadib markii eedaysane Farxaan Ibraahin Abshir uu qoriga la qabsaday askariga,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri qoraalka. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Xabada si lama filaan ah uga dhacday qoriga ayaa garabka ka haleeshay eedaysanaha oo ah haatan dhaawac fudud, dhacdadaasi wax dhimasho ah kama dhalan, mana jirto mayd laga soo saaray Saldhigga Booliiska Waabari, Waxaa socda baaritaan la xiriira dhacdadaasi”.
