items.title: Bixitaanka QM ee Soomaaliya oo u muuqda inuu billowday
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Qaramada Midoobay ayaa billowday dhimista shaqaalaha iyo diyaarinta iibka qeyb ka mid ah hantida howlgalkeeda Soomaaliya, xilli ay sii xoogeysaneyso dhibaatada dhaqaale ee halista gelisay nidaamka saadka ee lagu taageero howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM. Toban shaqaale rayid ah oo ka tirsan kooxda warfaafinta ee Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay ee AU-UN IST ayaa lagu wargeliyay in qandaraasyadoodu dhammaanayaan 10-ka September, waxaana la filayaa in shaqaale kale ay iyaguna lumiyaan shaqooyinkooda maalmaha soo socda. Tallaabadan ayaa qeyb ka ah qorshe ballaaran oo lagu dhimayo howlaha Xafiiska Taageerada Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya ee UNSOS, kaas oo muddo sanado ah ahaa laf-dhabarta saadka ee ciidamada Midowga Afrika ka jooga Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, UNSOS ayaa billowday diyaarinta iibka qalab badan oo uu howlgalka leeyahay, oo ay ku jiraan gaadiid, qalabka kombiyuutarrada, matoorro, qalab caafimaad, mashiinnada waaweyn ee dhismaha, konteenarro, qalabka hoyga iyo agab kale oo loo adeegsado howlaha ciidamada iyo duulista. Ogeysiis ay UNSOS soo saartay 6-dii Agoosto ayaa shirkadaha xaraashka ka codsaday inay soo gudbiyaan daneyntooda ku aaddan iibinta hantida Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya. Qorshaha ayaa markii hore soconaya muddo saddex bilood ah, iyadoo ay jiraan saddex fursadood oo min saddex bilood ah oo lagu kordhin karo. Inkasta oo iibinta qalabka duugoobay ama aan loo baahnayn ay qeyb caadi ah ka noqon karto maamulka hantida Qaramada Midoobay, haddana tallaabadan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli UNSOS ay wajahayo mustaqbal aan la hubin, taas oo sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in howlaha xafiiska si weyn loo yareeyo ama qaab cusub loo beddelo. Dhaqaale xumo sii xoogeysaneysa UNSOS ayaa bixiya adeegyo muhiim u ah AUSSOM, oo ay ku jiraan sahayda cuntada iyo shidaalka, gaadiidka, duulista, isgaarsiinta, hoyga, adeegyada caafimaadka, daad-gureynta dhaawacyada iyo taageerada injineernimada. Taageeradaas ayaa muhiim u ah ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee ku kala sugan qeybo badan oo ka mid ah koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya. Hase yeeshee, nidaamkan ayaa hadda wajahaya cadaadis dhaqaale oo xooggan. Mareykanka ayaa horraantii July sheegay inuusan taageeri doonin sii wadista maalgelinta UNSOS marka uu dhammaado oggolaanshaha hadda jira ee AUSSOM 31-ka December 2026. Go’aanka Washington ayaa sii adkeeyay dhibaato maalgelin oo horey u haysatay howlgalka Midowga Afrika. Miisaaniyad ku dhow $481 milyan ayaa loo ansixiyay UNSOS sanad-maaliyadeedka socda ee ku eg 30-ka June 2027, balse mustaqbalka isticmaalka lacagtaas qeybta dambe ee sanad-maaliyadeedka ayaa ku xiran go’aanno siyaasadeed iyo kuwo Golaha Ammaanka laga gaarayo mustaqbalka AUSSOM iyo UNSOS. Sanadkii hore, UNSOS wuxuu ku shaqeynayay miisaaniyad ka badan $500 milyan, halka AUSSOM laftiisu u baahan yahay ku dhowaad $190 milyan sanadkii, oo qeyb weyn lagu bixiyo gunnooyinka ciidamada dalalka Afrika ee Soomaaliya ciidamadooda usoo dira. Mas’uuliyiin iyo ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa hadda ka digaya in haddii xal dhaqaale degdeg ah la waayo, dhimista shaqaaluhu aysan ku ekaan doonin shaqaalaha rayidka ah, balse ugu dambeyn ay saameyn karto awoodda lagu taageero ciidamada iyo booliska AUSSOM. “Waxaa la filayaa shaqaale dhimis kale maalmaha soo socda,” ayuu qof xog-ogaal u ah arrintan u sheegay wargeyska The EastAfrican . Soomaaliya oo amniga la wareegeysa Dhibaatadan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli dowladda Soomaaliya ay sheegtay inay sii kordheyso awoodda ciidamada qaranka, ayna dooneyso inay si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka. 16-kii Agoosto, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa deegaanka Xananbuure ee gobolka Galgaduud tababar ugu soo xiray in ka badan 3,000 oo askari oo cusub oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Ciidamadaas ayaa muddo ku dhow hal sano tababar ku qaatay gudaha Soomaaliya, waxaana dowladda ay ku tilmaantay ciidamadii ugu badnaa ee tababar heerkaas ah gudaha dalka ku qaata tan iyo burburkii dowladdii dhexe 1991. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa munaasabaddaas sheegay in Soomaaliya ay gaartay heer ay ciidamadeedu si weyn ula wareegi karaan mas’uuliyadda amniga, isaga oo sidoo kale muujiyay in la joogo waqtigii ciidamada Midowga Afrika si sharaf leh loogu sagootin lahaa dalka. “Waxaan gaarnay meel aan hadda si buuxda ula wareegi karno amnigeenna,” ayuu yiri madaxweynaha, isaga oo sheegay in ciidamada Afrikaanka ah “ubax la guddoonsiiyo” kadibna dalkooda lagu celiyo. Hadalkaas wuxuu muujinayaa mowqifka dowladda ee ah in joogitaanka ciidamada shisheeye uusan sii socon karin muddo aan dhammaad lahayn. Hase yeeshee, dalalka ciidamada ku leh Soomaaliya qaarkood ayaa xaaladda si ka duwan u eegaya. Uganda oo sheegtay inay sii joogeyso Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Uganda Kiryowa Kiwanuka ayaa toddobaadkii hore sheegay in ciidamada Uganda ay Soomaaliya sii joogi doonaan, inkasta oo mustaqbalka AUSSOM iyo maalgelintiisu aanu weli caddayn. Uganda ayaa kumannaan askari ku leh AUSSOM, waxaana sidoo kale Soomaaliya ka jooga ciidamo kale oo ku shaqeeya heshiis laba geesood ah oo u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Kampala. Kiwanuka wuxuu sheegay in qaabka joogitaanka ciidamada Uganda uu isbeddeli karo, balse Kampala ay horey u leedahay heshiis u gaar ah oo ay Soomaaliya kula shaqeyso. “Qaabka aan Soomaaliya ugu sii joogeyno wuu isbeddeli karaa, balse waxaan horey halkaas ugu leenahay ciidan ku jooga heshiis laba geesood ah oo aan Soomaaliya la leenahay,” ayuu yiri. Wuxuu dhinaca kale ku adkeeyay in saaxiibada Soomaaliya ay khasab tahay inay helaan dhaqaale lagu maalgeliyo joogitaanka ama bixitaanka ciidamada si nidaamsan. Ilo ciidan oo Uganda ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Kenya, Itoobiya iyo Masar ay qorsheynayaan inay ciidamo ku sii hayaan Soomaaliya sanadka 2027, inkasta oo aysan jirin xaqiijin rasmi ah oo arrintaas kasoo baxday dhammaan dowladahaas. Haddii ciidamadaasi sii joogaan, su’aasha ugu weyn waxay noqon doontaa cidda bixin doonta saadka, dhaqaalaha iyo adeegyada ay hadda UNSOS siiso. Laba isbeddel oo isku mar socda Waxaa sidoo kale socda dhimista howlgalka siyaasadeed ee Qaramada Midoobay. Howlgalka KMG ah ee Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, UNTMIS, ayaa lagu wadaa inuu howlaha u wareejiyo hay’adaha Soomaaliya iyo kooxda Qaramada Midoobay ee dalka ka shaqeysa marka la gaaro October. Sidaas darteed, laba isbeddel oo waaweyn ayaa isku mar Soomaaliya uga socda: Qaramada Midoobay oo yareyneysa joogitaankeeda, iyo dowladda Soomaaliya oo sheegaysa inay diyaar u tahay inay qaaddo mas’uuliyad amni oo dheeraad ah. Haddii UNSOS si weyn loo yareeyo ama uu meesha ka baxo nidaamka saadka ee uu bixiyo, halka ciidamada AUSSOM qaarkood ay dalka sii joogaan, waxaa loo baahan doonaa hannaan cusub oo lagu maalgeliyo laguna taageero ciidamadaas. Sidoo kale, haddii ciidamada shisheeye ay si dhaqso ah u baxaan, dowladda Soomaaliya waxay wajihi doontaa su’aasha ah in ciidamada qaranku awood u leeyihiin inay isla markiiba buuxiyaan dhammaan goobaha iyo howlaha ay hadda qabtaan ciidamada Midowga Afrika. items.title: Hoggaamiyaha Waqooyi Bari oo kulamo ka wada Qaahira + Sawirro

Kulanka labada mas’uul ayaa looga hadlay xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Masar iyo xaaladda guud ee xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee labada dal, iyadoo sidoo kale la isla eegay arrimaha quseeya iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo waddamada Carabta. Labada dhinac ayaa si gaar ah uga wada-hadlay howlaha Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Qaahira iyo doorka Soomaaliya ku leedahay Jaamacadda Carabta, iyagoo carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la xoojiyo xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo hay’adaha gobolka. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale diiradda lagu saaray ilaalinta midnimada iyo qarannimada Soomaaliya, iyadoo labada mas’uul ay ka wada-hadleen muhiimadda ay leedahay in la dhowro midnimada dhuleed iyo siyaasadeed ee dalka. Hoggaamiye Firdhiye ayaa ugu dambeyn bogaadiyay Danjire Cali Cabdi Awaare iyo howl-wadeennada Safaaradda Soomaaliya ee Qaahira, isagoo ku ammaanay dadaallada ay ugu jiraan horumarinta xiriirka dibadda iyo hirgelinta siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Soomaaliya. Waqooyi Bari Soomaaliya waa dowlad-goboleed xaruntiisu tahay Laascaanood, wuxuuuna ka dhashay dagaalladii Laascaanood ee 2023, xilligaas oo ciidamada Somaliland laga saaray inta badan magaalada iyo deegaanno ku dhow. Deegaannada maamulkan uu ka dhisan yahay ayaa weli ah aag istiraatiiji ah oo xasaasi ah, maadaama ay ka jiraan muranno dhuleed iyo siyaasadeed oo dhinacyo kala duwan ay ku lug leeyihiin, gaar ahaan Somaliland, Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay sheegtay inay diyaar u tahay inay si weyn ula wareegto mas’uuliyadda amniga, iyadoo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu dhowaan tababar u soo xiray in ka badan 3,000 askari . Soomaaliya Oo Wajahaysa Isbeddelka Joogitaanka QM Si kastaba ha ahaatee, bixitaanka ama dhimista taageerada QM weli ma aha bixitaan buuxa, waxaana jira hubanti-la’aan ku saabsan mustaqbalka AUSSOM iyo cidda maalgelin doonta ciidamada Afrikaanka ah . Qaramada Midoobay waxay sheegtay in dhimista maalgelinta ay saamayn ku yeelan karto xaaladda bani’aadannimo, iyadoo 3.8 milyan oo qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha Soomaaliya . Sidoo kale, howlgalka UNTMIS ayaa lagu wadaa inuu hawlihiisa si tartiib ah ugu wareejiyo hay’adaha Soomaaliya iyo kooxda QM ee dalka ka sii shaqeynaysa marka la gaaro bisha Oktoobar 2026 . Tallaabadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan tahay isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada joogitaanka Qaramada Midoobay ee Soomaaliya, taasoo ku soo beegmaysa xilli ay dhaqaale-xumadu saameyn ku yeelatay taageerada caalamiga ah. Maraykanka, oo ah taageeraha ugu weyn ee howlgalka UNSOS, ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu joojin doono maalgelintiisa marka la gaaro Diseembar 31, 2026 . Tani waxay sababtay in UNSOS ay soo saarto qeeymo iibin ah oo ay ku iibinayso qalab ay ka mid yihiin baabuurta, matoorrada, kombuyuutarada, iyo qalabka kale . Dhaqaale-xumo Oo Saameysay Joogitaanka QM Ee Soomaaliya Howlgalka UNTMIS, oo ku wareegay UNSOM bishii Noofambar 2024, waxa uu socon doonaa ilaa 31 Oktoobar 2026, iyadoo loo dhamaystirayo wareejinta hawlihiisa hay’adaha Soomaaliya . Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay sheegtay inay diyaar u tahay inay si weyn ula wareegto mas’uuliyadda amniga, iyadoo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu dhowaan tababar u soo xiray in ka badan 3,000 askari . Soomaaliya Oo Wajahaysa Isbeddelka Joogitaanka QM Si kastaba ha ahaatee, bixitaanka ama dhimista taageerada QM weli ma aha bixitaan buuxa, waxaana jira hubanti-la’aan ku saabsan mustaqbalka AUSSOM iyo cidda maalgelin doonta ciidamada Afrikaanka ah . Qaramada Midoobay waxay sheegtay in dhimista maalgelinta ay saamayn ku yeelan karto xaaladda bani’aadannimo, iyadoo 3.8 milyan oo qof ay ku barakaceen gudaha Soomaaliya . Pakistan: Maxkamad go’aan ka gaartay kiis la xiriira Somalia
items.description: Karachi (Caasimada Online) — Maxkamad gaar ah oo qaabilsan dambiyada la xiriira maandooriyaha oo ku taalla Pakistan ayaa saddex nin ku xukuntay xabsi daa’in, kadib markii lagu helay inay isku dayeen inay Soomaaliya u soo tahriibiyaan in ka badan 1.3 tan oo xashiish ah. Maxkamadda gaarka ah ee Control of Narcotic Substances (CNS) ayaa Adnan, Hamal iyo Nadir ku heshay dambiga ah inay doon kalluumeysi ku hayeen 1,371.740 kiiloogaraam oo xashiish ah, kaas oo sida dacwad-oogayaashu sheegeen loo qorsheeyay in loo soo gudbiyo Soomaaliya. Garsoore Rajesh Chander Rajput ayaa mid kasta oo ka mid ah saddexda nin ku xukumay xabsi daa’in iyo ganaax dhan hal milyan oo rupee-ta Pakistan ah. Haddii aysan bixin ganaaxa, waxaa xukunkooda lagu dari doonaa muddo xabsi oo dheeraad ah. Nin afaraad oo lagu magacaabo Waheed, oo kiiska lala xiriiriyay balse aan weli gacanta lagu dhigin, ayaa maxkamaddu sheegtay in gal-dacwadeedkiisa la hakiyay ilaa laga soo qabto ama uu iskiis isu soo dhiibo. Dacwad-oogaha dowladda Abdul Hanan ayaa maxkamadda u sheegay in hay’adda Pakistan u qaabilsan la-dagaallanka maandooriyaha ee ANF ay heshay xog ku saabsan koox qorsheyneysay inay xaddi badan oo daroogo ah doon dheereysa ku geeyaan badda furan. Sida qorshaha lagu sheegay, Waheed ayaa la rumeysan yahay inuu ahaa wakiilka isku dubbaridayay howlgalka, iyadoo daroogada marka hore doon dheereysa lagu geyn lahaa badda, kadibna lagu wareejin lahaa doon kalluumeysi oo u sii qaadi lahayd Soomaaliya. Xogtaas kadib, ciidamada ANF oo kaashanaya Hay’adda Ammaanka Badaha Pakistan ee PMSA ayaa 17-kii November 2020 howlgal ka sameeyay badda. Waxay halkaas ku heleen doon kalluumeysi oo lagu magacaabo Al-Bilal , taas oo ku sugneyd meel qiyaastii 45 mayl-badeed u jirta xeebta Hawksbay ee Karachi. Ciidamada ayaa gacanta ku dhigay doonta iyo saddexda nin ee hadda la xukumay, waxaana baaritaan lagu sameeyay doonta lagu helay xashiish miisaankiisu dhan yahay 1,371.740 kiiloogaraam. Qareennada difaacayay saddexda nin ayaa maxkamadda ka hor sheegay in eedeysanayaashu aysan waxba ka ogeyn daroogada lagu dhex qariyay doonta, isla markaana si been abuur ah kiiska loogu soo daray. Hase yeeshee, maxkamadda ayaa dooddaas diidday, iyadoo xustay in saddexda nin ay ahaayeen dadka keliya ee doonta saarnaa, isla markaana iyagu gacanta ku hayay oo kaxeynayay markii lagu qabtay badda furan. Maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay inay adag tahay in la rumaysto in dad si buuxda gacanta ugu haya doon ay ka warqabi waayaan xaddi intaas le’eg oo daroogo ah oo saaran. “Marka la eego hab-dhaqanka caadiga ah ee bani’aadamka, aad ayay u adag tahay in dad si gaar ah gacanta ugu haya doon aysan ka warqabin xaddi sidaas u weyn oo maandooriye ah oo lagu dhex qariyay,” ayay maxkamaddu ku sheegtay go’aankeeda. Waxay intaas ku dartay in duruufaha kiisku ay muujinayaan in saddexda nin ay ogaal u haysteen daroogada lagu qabtay doonta. Kiiskan, oo soo bilowday dhammaadkii 2020, ayaa muujinaya adeegsiga marinnada badda ee u dhexeeya Koonfurta Aasiya iyo Bariga Afrika ee tahriibinta maandooriyaha, iyadoo Soomaaliya ay dacwad-oogayaashu ku sheegeen halkii ugu dambeysay ee loo waday shixnaddan. items.title: Ciidamada DANAB oo howl-gallo culus ka wada Shabeellaha Hoose
items.description: Marka (Caasimada Online) – Ciidamada kumaandooska Danab ee xoogga dalka Soomaaliya ayaa howl-gallo ka dhan ah kooxda Al-Shabaab ka wada deegaanno ka tirsan gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ee Koonfur Galbeed. Howl-galladan ayaa ciidamada Danab ku fulinayaan xogo dhinaca amniga ah oo ay ka heleen ilo xog-ogaal ah, iyadoo howl-gallada lagu beegsanayo goobo la rumeysan yahay inay ku sugan yihiin xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab. Ciidamada Danab ayaa waxay howl-gallo ka sameeyeen deegaanno dhowr ah, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin Ceel Bashiir, Farsooley iyo Dudumaay iyo deegaano kale oo hoos yimaada gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose. Sida xogta lagu helayo, ciidamada ayaa intii ay howl-gallada wadeen gacanta ku dhigay dad ay uga shakiyeen inay xiriir la leeyihiin Al-Shabaab, waxaana la sheegay in baaritaanno lagu hayo si loo xaqiijiyo eedeymaha loo jeediyay. Howl-gallada ayaa qeyb ka ah dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ciidan ee Dowladda Federaalka ay ka waddo qeybo ka mid ah Koonfurta iyo Bartamaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ay door weyn ka qaadanayaan dagaalka ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa kamid ah goobaha ay si joogto ah uga dhacaan howl-gallada ciidamada dowladda iyo weerarrada Shabaab, iyadoo dowladda ay muddooyinkii dambe kordhisay howl-gallada lagu doonayo in kooxda looga saaro deegaanada ay weli ku sugan yihiin. Ciidamada Danab ayaa la filayaa inay sii wadaan howl-gallada ka socda gobolka, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka ay sheegtay in mudnaanta la siinayo xoojinta amniga iyo ciribtirka Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan deegaanada istiraatiijiga ah ee ku yaalla Koonfurta Soomaaliya. The post Ciidamada DANAB oo howl-gallo culus ka wada Shabeellaha Hoose appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Hargaysa: Nolol xumo ka dhalatay shaqo joojin lagu sameeyay dad ku tiirsanaa sarifka lacagaha
items.description: (ERGO) – Boqollaal dhallinyaro ah oo ku nool Somaliland ayay soo wajahday shaqo la’aan saameysay waxbarashada, cuntada iyo hab-nololeedkooda kale. Waa xaalad ay wajahayaan tan iyo bishii July ee sanadkan, markaas oo bankiga dhexe ee Somaliland uu joojiyay in lacagaha danabeysan leyskugu diro adeegyada taleefanka ee Zaad iyo e-Dahab. Go’aankan ayaa suuqa ka mamnuucay ganacsatada yaryar oo Bankigu sheegay inaysan diiwaan-gashaneyn, canshuur bixiyaalna aysan aheyn. Waxay dowladdu sheegtay inay sharci darro ku shaqeynayeen, ayna lacagaha ku sarifayeen qiime aan aheyn kan uu jaan-gooyo bankiga dhexe oo ay qasab tahay in loo hoggaan samo. Go’aankan waxaa soo dhoweeyay ganacsatada sariflayaasha ah ee diiwaan-gashan, balse danyarta suuqa ka baxay ayay taabatay noloshooda daruuriga ah. Jimcaale Xasan Saleebaan oo ka mid ah dhallinyarada ku tiirsanayd ayay arrintan dhaxal-siisay inuu ka haro waxbarashada fasalka afaraad ee dugsiga sare ee Today ee magaalada Hargeysa, markii uu awoodi waayay inuu bixiyo $25 oo bishii laga qaadi jiray. Wuxuu sheegay in keligiis aysan ku koobneyn xaaladdu oo ay cunno yiri wajahayaan afar walaalihiis ah iyo labadiisa waalid oo isaga ku tiirsanaa. Hal waqti ayuu xusay in dabka ay ku shitaan kaalmo yar oo ay ka helaan qaraabada oo ah mid aan sii socon doonin. “Wax waqti ah nalama siin oo kedis ayuu nagu noqday go’aanka shaqo joojinta ah. immika xataa dukaamadii na aamini jiray waxba nama siiyaan waayo sarrifkii in nalaga joojiyay ayay og yihiin.” “Ehelkiina haddaad xidhiidhiso wax badanba ku siin-mayaan. Marka arrintan sarrifku saamayn aad u wayn bay noo geysatay.” Sarifka laga xiray ayuu tilmaamay in maalinkii uu ka heli jiray $20 illaa $30, isagoo ku dabari jiray kirada guriga, korontada iyo biyaha oo isku dar bishii ah $60 iyo kharashaadka kale ee nolol-maalmeedka. Jimcaale oo 19 jir ah ayaa sheegay in shaqadan uu billaabay sanadkii 2023, markaas oo uu guursaday walaalkiis ka weyn oo ay ku tiirsanaayeen, kaas oo hadda la tacaalaya qoyska uu dhistay oo uu ka maareeyo miis uu ku wareejiyo kabaha, ayna ku adag tahay inuu biilo laba qoys. “Anaga inan naga wayn ayaa na biili jiray. Inankiina wuu guursaday, ka dib anuu culayskii xaafaddu isoo fuulay. inan aanu asxaab nahay ayaa boqol Doollar ii dhiibay, sidaasaan ku soo galay suuqa. Immika wax rajo ah oo ii muuqda ma jiro, Dowladdii ayaa soo rogtay sharci adag oo aysan ka noqoneyn.” Jimcaale ayaa tilmaamay in shaqo la’aantu ay deg deg u saameysay, sababtuna ay tahay inuusan laheyn keyd dhaqaale, maadaama wixii soo gala uu ku dabari jiray nolosha asaasiga ah ee qoyska. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in duruufaha adag ee soo wajahay qoyska ay warwar joogta ah ku hayaan, maaddaama ay sugayaan walaalo ka yar iyo labadiisa waalid nool xaalado caafimaad oo ah qallal iyo neef qabatin. “Immika waxaan is lahaa dhismaha gal laakiin culeys bay igu noqotay oo maba helin. Markii aan ogaaday in la joojiyay shaqadii aan ku tiirsanaa waxaan dareemay culeys badan iyo murugo, waayo meel aan u dhaqaaqo garan maayo, xirfadna malehi.” Shuruudaha laga doonayo qofka noqonaya sarifle ayaa ah inuu bixiyo $700 oo diiwaan-galin iyo shati qaadasho ah, sidoo kalana uu sanad kasta bixiyo $130 oo canshuur ah. Cawo Aadan Maxamed oo ka mid ah dhallinyarada ganacsigu ka xirmay ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay in bixinta lacagtaas ay ku adkaatay, ayna wayday shaqo kale, taasina ay ku qasabtay inay door biddo in sarifka ay gasho iyadoo aan ogolaansho haysan. Waxay sheegtay inay ku dooratay inuu yahay ganacsi aan maalgalin badan u baahneyn oo ay ku bilowday $50 oo uu siiyay qof ehelkeeda ah. Cawo ayaa xustay in tan iyo markii shaqadaasi joogsatay ay reerka ku adkaatay daboolidda baahiyaha asaasiga ah, gaar ahaan helitaanka cuntada. “Saddexdii wakhti markii hore si fiican baan u heli jirnay. imikana halkii wakhti ayaaba nagu dirqi ah. Noloshii way sii adkaanaysaa, shaqadiina waatanoo way naga istaagtay, marka nolosheenna way iska adag tahay.” Cawo ayaa tilmaamtay in $300 illaa $400 oo bishii soo gali jiray ay ku dabari jirtay waalidkeed iyo saddex walaalaheed ah oo kaligeed ku tiirsanaa. Waxay hadda quutaan raashiin ay soo deynsadaan, iyaduna waa guri joog aan wali helin shaqo kale. Waxay tilmaamtay in sannadkii hore ay sarifka ku biirtay si ay u buuxiso kaalinta aabbaheed oo geeriyooday, iyadoo hooyadeedna sheegtay inay tahay qof aan shaqeyn karin oo la nool xanuunka beer subagga, ayna u awoodi wayday inay isbitaal geyso. “Hadda waxaan dareemay murugo aad u wayn iyo inaan fikiro oo xoog maskaxdii u shaqayso. Wixii aan qaban lahaa, haddey masaxaad tahay, haddey noqoto shaqada dumarka ee cillaan saarka, makeupka, intaba waan raadiyay, wax jawaab ah waan ka waayay.” “Waxay noqotay waji garasho, iyo qabyaalad. Noloshii way iska adkaatay, wixii aan ku tiirsanaana waa layga joojiyay.” Cawo oo 24 jir ah ayaa intaas ku dartay in labo walaalaheed ah dhaqaale la’aan darteed ay waxbarasho la’aan yihiin, markii ay awoodi wayday inay ka dhiibto $20 oo bishii ay ku bixin jirtay iskuul ay ka dhigan jireen magaalada Hargeysa. Dhanka kale Samiira Muxumed Xasan oo ka mid ah dhallinyarada ay shaqo la’aantu saamaysay, waxay tan iyo bishii July raadineysaa sidii ay ku heli laheyd ildhaqaale oo ay ka maareyso qoys ka kooban siddeed qof oo ay ka dabari jirtay sarifka laga joojiyay oo ay ku biirtay labo sano ka hor. Reerka ayaa hadda dabka ku shita raashiin qiimahiisu yahay $90 oo ay soo deynsadeen. Samiira ayaa xustay in haddii uu ka dhammaado aysan haysan wax kale, ayna adag tahay in deyn kale ay soo qaataan iyadoo aan la bixin tii hore. “Sarifka waxaan ka faa’idi jiray maalinkii ugu yaraan $15 illaa $20. Shaqo la’aanta waxaanu ka dhaxalnay waxbarasho la’aanta lix carruur ah oo iga yaryar oo aan ka bixin jirey iskuulka iyo madarasada.” “Madarasada oo aan afartan Doollar kaga bixin jiray iyo iskuulka oo $45 ah.  Wax yaabaha kale ee aan ka sii dhaxalnay waxaa ka mida cuntadii saddexda wakhti la heli jiray oo meesha ka baxday.” Samiira ayaa xustay in waalidkeed oo danyar ah ay duruufo adag ku soo wax bareen. Waxay sheegtay in markii ay dhammeysay dusgiga sare loo waayay dhaqaale ay jaamacad ku dhigato, maantana ay xaaladdu taagan tahay in walaalaheed loo la’yahay lacagtii iskuulka. Waxay sheegtay inaysan isku dhiibi doonin waayaha adag, hadafkeeduna yahay xal u raadinta caqabadaha hor yaalla. Dhallinyarada ay shaqo la’aantu saameysay ayaa ugu baaqay dowladda inay qiimeyso xaaladda oo ay raadiso xal ay ku sii wadan karaan shaqada sarrifka, maadaama boqollaal qoys ay si toos ah ugu tiirsanaayeen. items.fullContent: (ERGO) – Boqollaal dhallinyaro ah oo ku nool Somaliland ayay soo wajahday shaqo la’aan saameysay waxbarashada, cuntada iyo hab-nololeedkooda kale. Waa xaalad ay wajahayaan tan iyo bishii July ee sanadkan, markaas oo bankiga dhexe ee Somaliland uu joojiyay in lacagaha danabeysan leyskugu diro adeegyada taleefanka ee Zaad iyo e-Dahab. Go’aankan ayaa suuqa ka mamnuucay ganacsatada yaryar oo Bankigu sheegay inaysan diiwaan-gashaneyn, canshuur bixiyaalna aysan aheyn. Waxay dowladdu sheegtay inay sharci darro ku shaqeynayeen, ayna lacagaha ku sarifayeen qiime aan aheyn kan uu jaan-gooyo bankiga dhexe oo ay qasab tahay in loo hoggaan samo. Go’aankan waxaa soo dhoweeyay ganacsatada sariflayaasha ah ee diiwaan-gashan, balse danyarta suuqa ka baxay ayay taabatay noloshooda daruuriga ah. Jimcaale Xasan Saleebaan oo ka mid ah dhallinyarada ku tiirsanayd ayay arrintan dhaxal-siisay inuu ka haro waxbarashada fasalka afaraad ee dugsiga sare ee Today ee magaalada Hargeysa, markii uu awoodi waayay inuu bixiyo $25 oo bishii laga qaadi jiray. Wuxuu sheegay in keligiis aysan ku koobneyn xaaladdu oo ay cunno yiri wajahayaan afar walaalihiis ah iyo labadiisa waalid oo isaga ku tiirsanaa. Hal waqti ayuu xusay in dabka ay ku shitaan kaalmo yar oo ay ka helaan qaraabada oo ah mid aan sii socon doonin. “Wax waqti ah nalama siin oo kedis ayuu nagu noqday go’aanka shaqo joojinta ah. immika xataa dukaamadii na aamini jiray waxba nama siiyaan waayo sarrifkii in nalaga joojiyay ayay og yihiin.” “Ehelkiina haddaad xidhiidhiso wax badanba ku siin-mayaan. Marka arrintan sarrifku saamayn aad u wayn bay noo geysatay.” Sarifka laga xiray ayuu tilmaamay in maalinkii uu ka heli jiray $20 illaa $30, isagoo ku dabari jiray kirada guriga, korontada iyo biyaha oo isku dar bishii ah $60 iyo kharashaadka kale ee nolol-maalmeedka. Jimcaale oo 19 jir ah ayaa sheegay in shaqadan uu billaabay sanadkii 2023, markaas oo uu guursaday walaalkiis ka weyn oo ay ku tiirsanaayeen, kaas oo hadda la tacaalaya qoyska uu dhistay oo uu ka maareeyo miis uu ku wareejiyo kabaha, ayna ku adag tahay inuu biilo laba qoys. “Anaga inan naga wayn ayaa na biili jiray. Inankiina wuu guursaday, ka dib anuu culayskii xaafaddu isoo fuulay. inan aanu asxaab nahay ayaa boqol Doollar ii dhiibay, sidaasaan ku soo galay suuqa. Immika wax rajo ah oo ii muuqda ma jiro, Dowladdii ayaa soo rogtay sharci adag oo aysan ka noqoneyn.” Jimcaale ayaa tilmaamay in shaqo la’aantu ay deg deg u saameysay, sababtuna ay tahay inuusan laheyn keyd dhaqaale, maadaama wixii soo gala uu ku dabari jiray nolosha asaasiga ah ee qoyska. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in duruufaha adag ee soo wajahay qoyska ay warwar joogta ah ku hayaan, maaddaama ay sugayaan walaalo ka yar iyo labadiisa waalid nool xaalado caafimaad oo ah qallal iyo neef qabatin. “Immika waxaan is lahaa dhismaha gal laakiin culeys bay igu noqotay oo maba helin. Markii aan ogaaday in la joojiyay shaqadii aan ku tiirsanaa waxaan dareemay culeys badan iyo murugo, waayo meel aan u dhaqaaqo garan maayo, xirfadna malehi.” Shuruudaha laga doonayo qofka noqonaya sarifle ayaa ah inuu bixiyo $700 oo diiwaan-galin iyo shati qaadasho ah, sidoo kalana uu sanad kasta bixiyo $130 oo canshuur ah. Cawo Aadan Maxamed oo ka mid ah dhallinyarada ganacsigu ka xirmay ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay in bixinta lacagtaas ay ku adkaatay, ayna wayday shaqo kale, taasina ay ku qasabtay inay door biddo in sarifka ay gasho iyadoo aan ogolaansho haysan. Waxay sheegtay inay ku dooratay inuu yahay ganacsi aan maalgalin badan u baahneyn oo ay ku bilowday $50 oo uu siiyay qof ehelkeeda ah. Cawo ayaa xustay in tan iyo markii shaqadaasi joogsatay ay reerka ku adkaatay daboolidda baahiyaha asaasiga ah, gaar ahaan helitaanka cuntada. “Saddexdii wakhti markii hore si fiican baan u heli jirnay. imikana halkii wakhti ayaaba nagu dirqi ah. Noloshii way sii adkaanaysaa, shaqadiina waatanoo way naga istaagtay, marka nolosheenna way iska adag tahay.” Cawo ayaa tilmaamtay in $300 illaa $400 oo bishii soo gali jiray ay ku dabari jirtay waalidkeed iyo saddex walaalaheed ah oo kaligeed ku tiirsanaa. Waxay hadda quutaan raashiin ay soo deynsadaan, iyaduna waa guri joog aan wali helin shaqo kale. Waxay tilmaamtay in sannadkii hore ay sarifka ku biirtay si ay u buuxiso kaalinta aabbaheed oo geeriyooday, iyadoo hooyadeedna sheegtay inay tahay qof aan shaqeyn karin oo la nool xanuunka beer subagga, ayna u awoodi wayday inay isbitaal geyso. “Hadda waxaan dareemay murugo aad u wayn iyo inaan fikiro oo xoog maskaxdii u shaqayso. Wixii aan qaban lahaa, haddey masaxaad tahay, haddey noqoto shaqada dumarka ee cillaan saarka, makeupka, intaba waan raadiyay, wax jawaab ah waan ka waayay.” “Waxay noqotay waji garasho, iyo qabyaalad. Noloshii way iska adkaatay, wixii aan ku tiirsanaana waa layga joojiyay.” Cawo oo 24 jir ah ayaa intaas ku dartay in labo walaalaheed ah dhaqaale la’aan darteed ay waxbarasho la’aan yihiin, markii ay awoodi wayday inay ka dhiibto $20 oo bishii ay ku bixin jirtay iskuul ay ka dhigan jireen magaalada Hargeysa. Dhanka kale Samiira Muxumed Xasan oo ka mid ah dhallinyarada ay shaqo la’aantu saamaysay, waxay tan iyo bishii July raadineysaa sidii ay ku heli laheyd ildhaqaale oo ay ka maareyso qoys ka kooban siddeed qof oo ay ka dabari jirtay sarifka laga joojiyay oo ay ku biirtay labo sano ka hor. Reerka ayaa hadda dabka ku shita raashiin qiimahiisu yahay $90 oo ay soo deynsadeen. Samiira ayaa xustay in haddii uu ka dhammaado aysan haysan wax kale, ayna adag tahay in deyn kale ay soo qaataan iyadoo aan la bixin tii hore. “Sarifka waxaan ka faa’idi jiray maalinkii ugu yaraan $15 illaa $20. Shaqo la’aanta waxaanu ka dhaxalnay waxbarasho la’aanta lix carruur ah oo iga yaryar oo aan ka bixin jirey iskuulka iyo madarasada.” “Madarasada oo aan afartan Doollar kaga bixin jiray iyo iskuulka oo $45 ah.  Wax yaabaha kale ee aan ka sii dhaxalnay waxaa ka mida cuntadii saddexda wakhti la heli jiray oo meesha ka baxday.” Samiira ayaa xustay in waalidkeed oo danyar ah ay duruufo adag ku soo wax bareen. Waxay sheegtay in markii ay dhammeysay dusgiga sare loo waayay dhaqaale ay jaamacad ku dhigato, maantana ay xaaladdu taagan tahay in walaalaheed loo la’yahay lacagtii iskuulka. Waxay sheegtay inaysan isku dhiibi doonin waayaha adag, hadafkeeduna yahay xal u raadinta caqabadaha hor yaalla. Dhallinyarada ay shaqo la’aantu saameysay ayaa ugu baaqay dowladda inay qiimeyso xaaladda oo ay raadiso xal ay ku sii wadan karaan shaqada sarrifka, maadaama boqollaal qoys ay si toos ah ugu tiirsanaayeen. items.title: Mareykanka oo Qorsheynaya Inuu Kala Noqdo Fiisooyinka Ilaa 200,000 oo Magangelyo-doon ah
items.description: Maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa qorsheynaya inuu kala noqdo fiisooyinka ganacsiga iyo dalxiiska ee ilaa 200,000 oo ajaanib ah oo ku sugan Mareykanka, kuwaas oo codsaday ama hadda raadinaya magangelyo. Sida ay baahisay Associated Press, qorshahan wuxuu inta badan saameynayaa dadka haysta fiisaha B1 iyo B2, kuwaas oo Mareykanka ku galay safarro ganacsi ama dalxiis, balse markii dambe gudbiyay codsiyo magangelyo. Waaxda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sheegtay inay la shaqeynayso Waaxda Amniga Gudaha (DHS) si loo aqoonsado dadka fiisooyinka noocan ah ku galay Mareykanka, kadibna dalbaday magangelyo. Fiisooyinka la qorsheynayo in la laabto ayaa ah kuwa la bixiyay intii u dhaxaysay 2016 iyo 2026. Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa ku doodeysa in fiisaha B1/B2 loogu talagalay booqashooyin muddo kooban ah, halka codsiga magangelyadu uu muujin karo in qofku doonayo inuu dalka sii joogo. Haddii qorshahan la dhaqan geliyo sida hadda loo qorsheeyay, waxaa la sheegay inuu noqon karo tallaabadii ugu ballaarneyd ee hal mar lagu laalo fiisooyin taariikhda Mareykanka, waxaana la filayaa inuu wajahdo caqabado sharci. Si kastaba, kala noqoshada fiisaha si toos ah ugama dhigna in qof kasta isla markiiba la tarxiilayo. Dadka qaar ee kiisaskooda magangelyo ay weli socdaan ayaa lumin kara heerka fiisaha B1/B2, iyadoo xaaladdooda socdaalka lagu qiimeyn doono habraacyada kale ee socdaalka. Tallaabadan ayaa qayb ka ah siyaasadda ballaaran ee maamulka Trump uu ku adkeynayo nidaamka socdaalka Mareykanka. Bishan Agoosto, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in in ka badan 175,000 fiiso hore loo kala noqday sababo la xiriira dambiyo, jebinta shuruucda ama arrimo kale oo la xiriira amniga iyo siyaasadda socdaalka.

items.title: Dakhliga Al-Shabaab ee Muqdisho oo la sheegay inuu hoos u dhacay iyo tababar ay ka heleen Xuutiyiinta.
items.description: Dakhliga Al-Shabaab ee Muqdisho oo la sheegay inuu hoos u dhacay iyo tababar ay ka heleen Xuutiyiinta. Warbixin cusub oo loo gudbiyey Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in al-Shabaab ay u muuqato inay wax ka beddeshay qaabka ay uga hawlgasho Soomaaliya, iyadoo yareysay tirada weerarrada balse xoogga saartay hawlgallo si gaar ah loo qorsheeyey loona bartilmaameedsaday. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale soo bandhigtay sheegashooyin ku saabsan xiriirka Al-Shabaab ay la leedahay Xuutiyiinta Yemen iyo Al-Qaacida ee Jaziiradda Carabta, tababar la sheegay in boqolaal dagaalyahan loo fidiyey iyo isku dayga kooxda ee helitaanka qalab casri ah oo ay kaga hortagto diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Dukumentigan oo tirsigiisu yahay S/2026/651, lana daabacay 10-kii Agoosto 2026, waa warbixintii 38-aad ee Kooxda Dabagalka Cunaqabateynta ee Qaramada Midoobay, taas oo baarta dhaqdhaqaaqyada Daacish, Al-Qaacida iyo kooxaha xiriirka la leh. Mid ka mid ah qodobbada ugu muhiimsan warbixinta ayaa ah in Al-Shabaab ay u muuqato inay ka leexatay weerarradii tirada badnaa ee la arkay sannadkii 2025. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, kooxda waxay qaadday weerarro ka yar kuwii hore gudaha Muqdisho iyo deegaannada ku dhow, iyadoo hawlgalladeeda ay si weyn ugu urureen Hirshabeelle, Jubada Hoose, Jubada Dhexe, Shabeellaha Hoose iyo Galmudug. Qaramada Midoobay waxay arrintan ku tilmaantay u wareegid “hawlgallo bartilmaameed iyo istiraatiijiyad leh”. Tani waxay muujin kartaa in kooxda ay isku dayeyso inay si taxaddar leh u doorato bartilmaameedyada iyo waqtiga weerarrada, xilli ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadooda ay kordhiyeen duqeymaha iyo hawlgallada ka dhanka ah hoggaanka kooxda. Warbixintu ma faahfaahin noocyada bartilmaameedyada ay Al-Shabaab mudnaanta siinayso ama heerka uu isbeddelkan saameeyey awooddeeda guud.

items.title: From Orphaned Child to Messenger to the World: The Extraordinary Life of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ
items.description: By Abdikarim H. Abdi Buh Few lives in human history have had an impact as profound and enduring as that of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . His story is remarkable not because it began with wealth, privilege, formal education, or political power, but because it began with loss. Muhammad ﷺ was born in Mecca in the sixth century into the Quraysh tribe. His father, Abdullah ibn Abd al-Muttalib, died before his birth, leaving him fatherless from the very beginning. His mother, Aminah bint Wahb, cared for him during his early childhood but died when he was about six years old. He was subsequently cared for by his grandfather, Abd al-Muttalib, and later by his uncle, Abu Talib. From an early age, therefore, Muhammad ﷺ experienced the vulnerability of an orphan. He knew what it meant to grow up without the protection and support of both parents. The Qur’an later recalled this chapter of his life: “ Did He not find you an orphan and give you shelter?” — Qur’an 93:6 The Prophet’s Family: An Only Child, Yet Surrounded by Kinship Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was the only child of Abdullah ibn Abd al-Muttalib and Aminah bint Wahb. The Prophet therefore had no full biological brothers or sisters. There are also no generally recognized paternal half-siblings in the classical accounts, given that his father died before Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was born. However, the Prophet ﷺ did have foster brothers and sisters, reflecting the widespread Arab custom of breastfeeding and fosterage at the time. Among those regarded as his foster siblings were: Hamzah ibn Abd al-Muttalib — his paternal uncle and foster brother through Thuwaybah. Abu Salama (Abdullah ibn Abd al-Asad) — his foster brother through Thuwaybah. Abdullah ibn al-Harith — his foster brother through Halimah al-Sa’diyyah. Anisah bint al-Harith — his foster sister through Halimah al-Sa’diyyah. Shayma (Hudhafah) bint al-Harith — his foster sister through Halimah al-Sa’diyyah. Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was also part of a large extended family through his grandfather, Abd al-Muttalib. His paternal uncles and aunts included such well-known figures as Hamzah, Abu Talib, al-Abbas, Abu Lahab, and Safiyyah. This distinction is important: ProphetMuhammad ﷺ had no full biological siblings, but he was surrounded by an extended family and had several foster siblings. A Childhood Without Formal Schooling Another distinctive aspect of Prophet Muhammad’s ﷺ life was his lack of conventional formal education. Islamic tradition describes him as unlettered, commonly understood to mean that he did not read or write. He did not attend a formal school, university, or religious seminary, nor did he emerge from an established institution of learning with academic credentials. Yet at approximately 40 years of age, the prophet began receiving divine revelation through the Angel Gabriel. The first revelation began with the command: “Read in the name of your Lord who created.” For Muslims, this marked the beginning of the Qur’anic revelation and the prophetic mission of Muhammad ﷺ. The Orphan Who Became a Messenger Prophet Muhammad ﷺ began calling people to the worship of one God and preaching principles of justice, honesty, compassion, charity, moral accountability, and human dignity. His message challenged deeply established religious, social, economic, and tribal structures in seventh-century Arabia. He and his followers consequently faced intense opposition and persecution. Yet the movement continued to grow. In 622 CE, Muhammad ﷺ and his followers migrated from Mecca to Medina in an event known as the Hijra, which became the starting point of the Islamic calendar. In Medina, he emerged not only as a religious leader but also as the leader of a growing community. He helped establish a social and political order that brought diverse groups together under a common framework of faith, responsibility, and mutual obligation. The significance of Prophet Muhammad’s ﷺ mission cannot be measured simply by the number of people who ultimately followed him. His teachings addressed fundamental questions of human dignity, social responsibility, justice, family, charity, leadership, and accountability before God. The Qur’an challenged the idea that wealth, ancestry, or tribal status determined human worth. It called people toward moral responsibility and emphasized accountability before God. What began as a message preached in Mecca and Medina eventually crossed the boundaries of Arabia and reached distant societies and civilizations. From One Man to a Global Faith- A Message That Transformed Society Muhammad ﷺ died in 632 CE, but the faith he preached continued to spread rapidly. Within decades, Islam had reached large parts of the Middle East and North Africa and later expanded into Central Asia, South Asia, Europe, and Southeast Asia. Today, Islam is practiced across virtually every region of the world and is followed by more than two billion people, making it one of the world’s largest religions. The transformation from an orphaned child in Mecca to the central prophetic figure of a global faith remains one of the most consequential stories in religious and human history. Perhaps the most striking element of Muhammad’s ﷺ story is the contrast between his humble beginnings and his extraordinary historical influence. He began life without a father. He lost his mother as a young child. He did not receive conventional formal schooling. He did not begin his prophetic mission with a throne, a powerful army, or an established empire. He began with a message. According to Islamic belief, that message was revelation from God. His followers preserved the revelation in the Qur’an and transmitted his teachings and example through the Sunnah and Hadith. From the perspective of faith, Muhammad ﷺ is regarded by Muslims as the final prophet and messenger of God. From the perspective of history, he became the central figure in the emergence of a civilization that would profoundly shape the religious, intellectual, political, and cultural development of vast regions of the world. The orphan of Mecca became the Prophet ﷺ revered by Muslims across the globe. The man who received no conventional schooling became, according to Islamic belief, the messenger through whom God revealed the Qur’an. The message that began in seventh-century Arabia eventually crossed languages, cultures, continents, and generations. More than fourteen centuries later, his name continues to be spoken by Muslims around the world in prayer and devotion. The prophet’s ﷺ story is ultimately one of extraordinary beginnings: an orphan who grew up without the security of both parents, a man without conventional schooling, and a messenger whose message, according to Islamic faith, transformed Arabia and ultimately reached the far corners of the world. items.fullContent: By Abdikarim H. Abdi Buh Few lives in human history have had an impact as profound and enduring as that of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ . His story is remarkable not because it began with wealth, privilege, formal education, or political power, but because it began with loss. Muhammad ﷺ was born in Mecca in the sixth century into the Quraysh tribe. His father, Abdullah ibn Abd al-Muttalib, died before his birth, leaving him fatherless from the very beginning. His mother, Aminah bint Wahb, cared for him during his early childhood but died when he was about six years old. He was subsequently cared for by his grandfather, Abd al-Muttalib, and later by his uncle, Abu Talib. From an early age, therefore, Muhammad ﷺ experienced the vulnerability of an orphan. He knew what it meant to grow up without the protection and support of both parents. The Qur’an later recalled this chapter of his life: “ Did He not find you an orphan and give you shelter?” — Qur’an 93:6 The Prophet’s Family: An Only Child, Yet Surrounded by Kinship Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was the only child of Abdullah ibn Abd al-Muttalib and Aminah bint Wahb. The Prophet therefore had no full biological brothers or sisters. There are also no generally recognized paternal half-siblings in the classical accounts, given that his father died before Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was born. However, the Prophet ﷺ did have foster brothers and sisters, reflecting the widespread Arab custom of breastfeeding and fosterage at the time. Among those regarded as his foster siblings were: Hamzah ibn Abd al-Muttalib — his paternal uncle and foster brother through Thuwaybah. Abu Salama (Abdullah ibn Abd al-Asad) — his foster brother through Thuwaybah. Abdullah ibn al-Harith — his foster brother through Halimah al-Sa’diyyah. Anisah bint al-Harith — his foster sister through Halimah al-Sa’diyyah. Shayma (Hudhafah) bint al-Harith — his foster sister through Halimah al-Sa’diyyah. Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was also part of a large extended family through his grandfather, Abd al-Muttalib. His paternal uncles and aunts included such well-known figures as Hamzah, Abu Talib, al-Abbas, Abu Lahab, and Safiyyah. This distinction is important: ProphetMuhammad ﷺ had no full biological siblings, but he was surrounded by an extended family and had several foster siblings. A Childhood Without Formal Schooling Another distinctive aspect of Prophet Muhammad’s ﷺ life was his lack of conventional formal education. Islamic tradition describes him as unlettered, commonly understood to mean that he did not read or write. He did not attend a formal school, university, or religious seminary, nor did he emerge from an established institution of learning with academic credentials. Yet at approximately 40 years of age, the prophet began receiving divine revelation through the Angel Gabriel. The first revelation began with the command: “Read in the name of your Lord who created.” For Muslims, this marked the beginning of the Qur’anic revelation and the prophetic mission of Muhammad ﷺ. The Orphan Who Became a Messenger Prophet Muhammad ﷺ began calling people to the worship of one God and preaching principles of justice, honesty, compassion, charity, moral accountability, and human dignity. His message challenged deeply established religious, social, economic, and tribal structures in seventh-century Arabia. He and his followers consequently faced intense opposition and persecution. Yet the movement continued to grow. In 622 CE, Muhammad ﷺ and his followers migrated from Mecca to Medina in an event known as the Hijra, which became the starting point of the Islamic calendar. In Medina, he emerged not only as a religious leader but also as the leader of a growing community. He helped establish a social and political order that brought diverse groups together under a common framework of faith, responsibility, and mutual obligation. The significance of Prophet Muhammad’s ﷺ mission cannot be measured simply by the number of people who ultimately followed him. His teachings addressed fundamental questions of human dignity, social responsibility, justice, family, charity, leadership, and accountability before God. The Qur’an challenged the idea that wealth, ancestry, or tribal status determined human worth. It called people toward moral responsibility and emphasized accountability before God. What began as a message preached in Mecca and Medina eventually crossed the boundaries of Arabia and reached distant societies and civilizations. From One Man to a Global Faith- A Message That Transformed Society Muhammad ﷺ died in 632 CE, but the faith he preached continued to spread rapidly. Within decades, Islam had reached large parts of the Middle East and North Africa and later expanded into Central Asia, South Asia, Europe, and Southeast Asia. Today, Islam is practiced across virtually every region of the world and is followed by more than two billion people, making it one of the world’s largest religions. The transformation from an orphaned child in Mecca to the central prophetic figure of a global faith remains one of the most consequential stories in religious and human history. Perhaps the most striking element of Muhammad’s ﷺ story is the contrast between his humble beginnings and his extraordinary historical influence. He began life without a father. He lost his mother as a young child. He did not receive conventional formal schooling. He did not begin his prophetic mission with a throne, a powerful army, or an established empire. He began with a message. According to Islamic belief, that message was revelation from God. His followers preserved the revelation in the Qur’an and transmitted his teachings and example through the Sunnah and Hadith. From the perspective of faith, Muhammad ﷺ is regarded by Muslims as the final prophet and messenger of God. From the perspective of history, he became the central figure in the emergence of a civilization that would profoundly shape the religious, intellectual, political, and cultural development of vast regions of the world. The orphan of Mecca became the Prophet ﷺ revered by Muslims across the globe. The man who received no conventional schooling became, according to Islamic belief, the messenger through whom God revealed the Qur’an. The message that began in seventh-century Arabia eventually crossed languages, cultures, continents, and generations. More than fourteen centuries later, his name continues to be spoken by Muslims around the world in prayer and devotion. The prophet’s ﷺ story is ultimately one of extraordinary beginnings: an orphan who grew up without the security of both parents, a man without conventional schooling, and a messenger whose message, according to Islamic faith, transformed Arabia and ultimately reached the far corners of the world. items.title: Jabuuti oo kaashanaysa Turkiga iyo Masar ayaa colaad ka hurinaysa galbeedka Somaliland Iyo Sarkaalka u xil saaran
items.description: Waxa soo baxaysa xaqiiqda in dalka Djibouti uu dagaal dadban uu kula jiro dalka iyo shicibka Somaliland Waxa la xaqiijiyay in Kornayl Maxamed Jaama Ducaale oo ah taliyaha ilaalda madaxtooyada Jabuuti uu hub faro badan uu ka soo gudbiyay xadka u dhaxeeya Somaliland iyo Djibouti oo uu keenay deegaanka Gees-tiir sarkalkani ayaa dalka Djibouti iyo xulafadooda u qaabilsan sidii colaad looga abuuri lahaa deegaankasi gobolka Salal. Waxana ay Djibouti, Turkiga, Masar iyo Somalia ay rabaan in ay wiiqaan amniga Somaliland Caawa nin afka soo duubtay ayaa magaaladda Saylac ku dhaawacay nin shicib ah, isla markiiba waxa amaanka la wareegay ciidanka Booliska waxana arinka soo faro galiyay ciidamada kale ee amaanka oo baadhitaan galay culus galay. Amniga magaaladda Saylac iyo nawaaxigeeda ayaa hada sugan nolasha magaaladuna waa caadi wax dhib ah oo jiraana ma jiraan hada Xukuumadda Somaliland ayaa hore amar ugu soo rogtay deegaanadaasi in aan la aqbali doonin qof shicib ah oo hub sita qofkii lagu arkana talaabo laga qaadi doono. Ciidamo xoogan oo kumanaan kun oo askari oo milatari gaashaman ah ayaa ku sugan gobolka Salal ee xuduudka la leh Djibouti Xukuumadda Somaliland waxa ay la socotaa dhaq dhaqaaqyda cadawga. Deegaanadani ayaa nabdoonaa 35 sodonkii sano ee ina soo dhaafay waxana mudooyinkii u danbeeyay deegaankasi ay colaadi ka dhaxaysay shicibka wada dega gobolka Salal colaadaasi oo ay hurinaysay dawlada Djibouti oo ay hore xukumada Somaliland ugu dhaliishay taasi oo hada soo xaqiiqoobaysa.

items.title: MP Cagaweyne Attacks Supreme Court Ruling as Questions Grow Over His Record on Galmudug
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Galmudug MP Abdirahman Cagaweyne has launched a sharp attack on the Supreme Court after it annulled the disputed July elections in the federal member state, accusing the court of issuing an unjustified decision without sufficient evidence. Cagaweyne argued that only the Towfiiq political organization had formally challenged the election and claimed that the alleged irregularities were limited to certain areas. He described the Supreme Court’s decision as “wrong and unjust,” insisting that the court had failed to provide adequate evidence for overturning the results. The MP’s intervention, however, raises broader questions about his understanding of constitutional law and his record as a federal legislator. For much of his tenure, critics say, Cagaweyne has been conspicuously silent on the Federal Government’s controversial electoral agenda, including the one-sided election model promoted by Villa Somalia, which opposition groups and several political stakeholders have condemned as unconstitutional and lacking broad national consensus. He has not been equally vocal when constitutional principles and political inclusiveness were at the center of Somalia’s wider electoral dispute. His sudden criticism of the Supreme Court therefore being viewed less as a principled defense of constitutional governance and more as a political intervention at a particularly sensitive moment. The Supreme Court’s ruling was not based simply on political disagreement. The court found that the Galmudug elections were not conducted in accordance with the Constitution and electoral law and that serious irregularities had undermined the integrity, independence and credibility of the process. That makes the legal issue straightforward: if an election violates the law, Parliamentarians should be defending the law—not attacking the institution tasked with enforcing it. Cagaweyne’s critics also question his record on issues affecting his own constituents. He has faced accusations of failing to speak out when residents from Galmudug in Mogadishu were displaced from public land amid disputed landgrab transactions. Those realities are serious and should be taken and referred to courts. His opponents now argue that his criticism of the Supreme Court comes at a politically convenient time, particularly as questions about his standing among constituents grow. Rather than addressing the substance of the court’s findings, Cagaweyne has focused his attack on the institution itself. That approach does little to answer the fundamental question raised by the ruling: Were the elections conducted according to the law? If the answer is no, then the annulment is not an attack on democracy. It is precisely what the rule of law is supposed to provide—a constitutional mechanism for correcting an unlawful electoral process. For a federal legislator, the responsibility should be clear: defend the Constitution, demand transparent elections and protect the rights of constituents—not simply echo the interests of whoever holds political power in Mogadishu. The Supreme Court has now ordered a fresh electoral process in Galmudug. The real test for Somalia’s political class is whether they will respect that decision and work toward an election whose legitimacy rests on law rather than political influence. items.title: Xog: DF oo qorsheynaysa in 3 magaalo ka hirgeliso saldhigyo ciidan iyo xarumo drones ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa qorsheynaysa in saddex magaalo oo istiraatiiji ah oo ku yaalla bartamaha iyo koonfurta dalka laga hirgeliyo saldhigyo ciidan iyo xarumo laga hago diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee loo yaqaan drones-ka. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, qorshahan ayaa qeyb ka ah diyaar-garowga dowladda ee xaalad kasta oo ka dhalan karta bixitaanka ama hoos u dhaca ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee howl-galka AUSSOM, xilli howl-galka uu wajahayo culeys dhaqaale. Dowladda ayaa doonaysa in ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay yeeshaan awood ay si madax-bannaan ugu howl-galaan goobaha muhiimka ah, si aysan firaaq amni oo halis ah u dhicin. Qorshuhu wuxuu sidoo kale taabanayaa magaalooyin ku yaalla Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan deegaannada ay hadda ku sugan yihiin ciidamada Itoobiya, kuwaas oo la filayo in loo diro cutubyo ka tirsan ciidamada Gorgor si ay si tartiib ah ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga. Saldhigyada iyo xarumaha laga hago drones-ka ayaa loogu tala-galay inay ciidamada ku sugan goobaha howl-galka siiyaan awood dheeraad ah oo dhinacyada kormeerka, sahanka iyo xog-ururinta ah, iyadoo la yareynayo ku-tiirsanaanta amarro ama taageero toos ah oo Muqdisho ka imaata ama laga sugo. Xogta ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamaysa in dowladda ay kordhisay adeegsiga drones-ka xilliyada habeenkii, kuwaas oo kormeer ka sameeya goobaha dagaalka iyo deegaannada istiraatiijiga ah, si loo helo xog dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada kooxaha hubeysan. Awoodda diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ayaa hore uga mid ahayd qorshayaasha amniga Soomaaliya, iyadoo ciidanka xoogga dalka lagu tababaray adeegsiga drones-ka, gaar ahaan dhinacyada kormeerka, sahanka iyo ururinta xogta goobaha ay ka socdaan howl-gallada. Tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale la xiriirta qorshaha dowladda ee lagu xoojinayo joogitaanka ciidamada dowladda ee goobaha muhiimka ah, gaar ahaan kuwa laga yaabo inay ka baxaan ciidamada shisheeye ee qeybta ka ah howl-galka AUSSOM. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa qorshahan ku dooneysa inay kor ugu qaaddo awoodda ciidanka xoogga dalka, si ay si buuxda ugu diyaar garoobaan la wareegidda mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka, xilli mustaqbalka AUSSOM iyo heerka joogitaanka ciidamada Midowga Afrika uu weli yahay arrin muhiim u ah qorshaha amniga Soomaaliya. items.title: Muxuu ka dhigan yahay go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ee doorashooyinka Galmudug?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ee Soomaaliya ay ku laashay natiijooyinkii doorashadii 30-kii Luulyo ka dhacday Galmudug waa mid ka weyn in loo arko oo keliya in doorashada dib loo qabanayo. Waa go’aan taabanaya sharciyadda natiijadii doorashada, awoodda hay’adaha doorashooyinka, mustaqbalka nidaamka doorashooyinka dalka iyo xiriirka u dhexeeya siyaasadda iyo sharciga. Maxkamaddu waxay si cad u sheegtay in doorashooyinkii Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golayaasha Deegaanka ee Galmudug aan loo maamulin ama aan loo qaban si waafaqsan Dastuurka iyo Sharciga Doorashooyinka, sidaas darteedna natiijooyinkii kasoo baxay ay yihiin kuwo aan ansax ahayn. Tani waa qodobka ugu culus ee go’aanka, maadaama maxkamaddu aysan keliya tilmaamin khaladaad farsamo, balse ay si toos ah u burisay natiijadii doorashada. Maxay maxkamaddu dhab ahaan laashay? Marka la yiraahdo maxkamaddu waxay “laashay natiijooyinka”, macnaheedu waa in natiijadii doorashada laga qaaday awooddii sharci ee ay lahayd. Sidaas darteed, kuraastii lagu helay doorashadaas iyo natiijooyinkii lagu dhawaaqay ma sii ahaan karaan saldhig sharci oo lagu dhiso hay’adaha cusub. Tani waa arrin muhiim ah oo dhinacyada siyaasadda looga baahan yahay inay si sax ah u fahmaan. Go’aanku ma aha oo keliya in qaar ka mid ah kuraasta dib loo tiriyo ama khaladaad gaar ah la saxo; maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay in khaladaadkii dhacay ay ahaayeen kuwo aan la sixi karin, isla markaana ay dhaawac weyn u geysteen hufnaanta iyo xalaalnimada doorashada. Sidaas darteed, maxkamaddu waxay dooratay xalka ugu adag oo ah in natiijada la buriyo, doorashadana dib loo qabto. Eedaha musuq-maasuqa iyo khaladaadka Maxkamaddu waxay go’aankeeda ku saleysay mabaadi’da doorasho xor, xalaal iyo caddaalad ah. Tani waxay muujineysaa in doorasho aysan sharci ku noqon karin oo keliya in codad la dhiibo ama natiijo la shaaciyo. Doorasho sharci ah waxay u baahan tahay hannaan la isku halleyn karo, laga bilaabo diiwaangelinta codbixiyeyaasha iyo musharraxiinta ilaa codbixinta, tirinta iyo ku dhawaaqista natiijada. Haddii khaladaadku saameeyaan qaybahaas muhiimka ah, waxaa su’aal la gelin karaa sharciyadda natiijada kasoo baxda. Taasi waa sababta qodobka labaad ee go’aanku muhiim u yahay. Maxkamaddu waxay sheegtay in khaladaadku aysan ahayn kuwo la sixi karo, isla markaana ay saameyn ku yeesheen natiijada doorashada. Tani waxay meesha ka saareysaa fikradda ah in arrintu ahayd qalad yar oo lagu sixi karo sixitaan farsamo. Maxkamadda oo mar kale awood siisay guddiga doorashada Qodobka saddexaad wuxuu Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha saarayaa mas’uuliyad culus, iyadoo maxkamaddu amartay in doorashada dib loo qabto waqtiga ugu dhow ee macquulka ah, balse markan si buuxda loogu hoggaansamo Dastuurka, Sharciga Doorashooyinka iyo xeerarka kale ee khuseeya. Tani waxay guddiga siinaysaa fursad uu ku muujiyo in cashar laga bartay wixii dhacay. Doorashada cusub ma noqon karto nuqul kale oo laga sameeyo tii hore iyadoo magacyada iyo taariikhda oo keliya la beddelayo. Tani waxay noqon kartaa tallaabo dhisaysa kalsoonida shacabka, gaar ahaan xilli Soomaaliya ay isku dayeyso inay horumariso nidaamka doorashooyinka tooska ah. Laakiin kalsoonidaas waxay ku xirnaan doontaa waxa xiga. Haddii doorashada cusub loo qabto si hufan, go’aanka maxkamaddu wuxuu noqon karaa tusaale muujinaya in khalad doorasho lagu sixi karo waddo sharci ah. Doorashadii hore oo la buriyay waxay dib u dhigeysaa natiijadii la filayay, waxayna dhinacyada siyaasadda ku qasbeysaa inay mar kale galaan tartan. Laakiin waxaa jira dhinac wanaagsan: go’aanka maxkamaddu wuxuu dejinayaa xeerka ciyaarta. Dhinacyadu hadda waxay haystaan fursad ay ku galaan doorasho cusub, iyagoo og in hannaanka si gaar ah loo eegayo. Arrinta ugu muhiimsan waxay noqon doontaa in siyaasiyiintu aqbalaan natiijada doorashada cusub haddii loo qabto si waafaqsan sharciga. Haddii dhinac walba uu aqbalo sharciga marka uu isaga dan u yahay oo uu diido marka uu khasaaro, dhibaatada nidaamka doorashada ma dhammaan doonto. Waxay sidoo kale caddeysay in khaladaadka saameeya natiijada aan lagu dabooli karin magaca “doorasho” oo keliya. items.title: Somalia security crisis: UN layoffs, asset auctions signal AUSSOM’s endgame
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – The scaffolding holding up Somalia’s international security operation is coming down, piece by piece, not on a battlefield but inside termination letters and auction notices moving quietly through United Nations procurement channels. The United Nations has begun issuing layoff notices and lining up buyers for mission property in Somalia, the clearest operational evidence yet that a deepening funding crisis has moved from budget spreadsheets into the physical machinery propping up the country’s security architecture, Somali Guardian has established, drawing on reporting by The East African . Ten civilian staff of the African Union-United Nations Information Support Team have been told their contracts will lapse by September 10. Separately, the United Nations Support Office in Somalia – the agency responsible for supplying, transporting, housing and sustaining the African Union’s peacekeeping force – has opened a process to auction off a wide inventory of equipment, from office IT gear and vehicles to heavy construction machinery, medical units, prefabricated accommodation, and hardware tied to military and aviation operations. Those ten jobs are expected to be only the beginning. Officials briefed on the process say further layoffs are likely within days as the support office, which forms the logistical spine of the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia, begins to contract. Civilians first, then the rest The sequence being described privately by insiders is blunt: civilian staff are cut loose first, followed by the support apparatus itself, and potentially – if the funding gap is not closed – the uniformed police and soldiers who depend on that apparatus to eat, move, communicate and receive medical care in the field. That trajectory is what now worries officials and diplomats tracking Somalia’s security transition. Only weeks earlier, the UN’s Under-Secretary-General for Operational Support, Atul Khare, flew from New York to Mogadishu specifically to reassure the support office’s staff, Somali authorities and international partners that the funding uncertainty could still be managed. Since that visit, however, the first tangible signs of a drawdown have surfaced – not through troop movements, but through paperwork. The equipment auction notice was published on August 6, giving prospective bidders a strikingly narrow five-day window to register interest. The support office is seeking to establish a local commercial-sale contract, initially covering three months, with as many as three further three-month extensions available depending on performance. On its face, the notice reads as routine procurement bureaucracy. Its underlying message is not. It signals that Somalia’s international security operation is no longer grappling only with a shortage of money – the UN is actively preparing for the possibility that entire segments of the logistics system itself may need to be wound down. Two decades of dependency, one funding switch For close to twenty years, the machinery sustaining Somalia’s security forces has rested on a dense web of international logistical and financial support. The UN support office sits at the centre of that web, supplying the infrastructure – transport, aviation, medical services, accommodation, communications and engineering – that allows the African Union mission to function at all. That structure is now under direct strain. Washington, historically one of the largest financial backers of the UN support office, pulled its funding at the start of July, converting what had been a slow-burning financing shortfall into an immediate operational emergency. According to Khare, a $481 million budget has already been approved for the financial year running through June 2027. But the United States has signalled it will block any attempt inside the UN Security Council to release that budget for the support office’s use beyond December 31, 2026 – effectively imposing a hard deadline several months earlier than the funding cycle would otherwise suggest. To put the scale of the operation in context: the UN support office ran on a $502 million budget last year, dwarfing the African Union mission’s own $190 million allocation, most of which goes toward reimbursing troop-contributing countries, with smaller shares set aside for death-and-disability compensation and subsistence allowances. The mission’s current authorised strength stands at 11,862 uniformed personnel, including 680 police officers, alongside UN-funded support for up to 85 civilian staff attached to the military and police components. “Expect more staff layoffs in the coming days,” one official familiar with internal planning said. Compounding the pressure, the UN’s separate political mission in the country, the UN Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia, is due to be downgraded into a standard UN Country Office by October – another marker of the shrinking international footprint arriving on a near-identical timeline. Mogadishu says it is ready. Its partners are not so sure While the UN scales back, Somalia’s own political and military signalling is pulling in the opposite direction. On August 16, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud presided over a passing-out parade for more than 3,000 newly trained Somali National Army soldiers in Xananbuure, in Galmudug State’s northern Galgadud region – a ceremony choreographed to project growing self-reliance. Mohamud used the occasion to call openly for African peacekeepers to leave , suggesting the departing troops be sent off with “a bunch of flowers.” Somalia’s security partners appear unconvinced. Just days earlier, Uganda’s Defence Minister, Kiryowa Kiwanuka, declared that Ugandan forces would stay in the country regardless of the AU mission’s uncertain trajectory, speaking on the sidelines of an Eastern Africa Standby Force conference in Kampala. Uganda currently fields 4,500 troops under the AU mission plus a further 2,000 soldiers deployed under a standalone bilateral arrangement with Mogadishu. President Yoweri Museveni has likewise signalled that Kampala and regional partners intend to keep supporting Somalia’s security effort, without detailing how. Kiwanuka indicated the shape of Uganda’s presence would shift over time but stressed that a bilateral channel with Mogadishu already exists independent of the AU framework. He also cautioned that Somalia’s international partners “must find resources” to finance any exit that is orderly rather than chaotic. The result is an increasingly uncomfortable standoff of narratives: Mogadishu insists its forces are ready to assume full responsibility; the AU mission’s finances are deteriorating by the week; the UN logistics network underpinning the entire operation is already shedding staff and liquidating hardware – and yet Uganda, one of the largest troop contributors, says it has no plans to leave. A Ugandan military source told The East African that the country’s military leadership has information indicating Kenya, Ethiopia and Egypt also intend to keep forces in Somalia through 2027. Should that hold, the operative question shifts from whether foreign troops remain in the country to who, if anyone, will pay to keep them there. The United Nations appears to be dismantling the support system that has sustained Somalia’s international security effort for the better part of two decades before any consensus has emerged on what, if anything, will replace it – leaving Mogadishu to confront a stark question: can Somali forces genuinely absorb the security burden at the exact moment the scaffolding beneath the old system is being taken apart, or will the troops who stay behind find themselves operating inside a framework that has yet to be funded at all. Those ten jobs are expected to be only the beginning. Officials briefed on the process say further layoffs are likely within days as the support office, which forms the logistical spine of the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia, begins to contract. Civilians first, then the rest The sequence being described privately by insiders is blunt: civilian staff are cut loose first, followed by the support apparatus itself, and potentially – if the funding gap is not closed – the uniformed police and soldiers who depend on that apparatus to eat, move, communicate and receive medical care in the field. That trajectory is what now worries officials and diplomats tracking Somalia’s security transition. Only weeks earlier, the UN’s Under-Secretary-General for Operational Support, Atul Khare, flew from New York to Mogadishu specifically to reassure the support office’s staff, Somali authorities and international partners that the funding uncertainty could still be managed. Since that visit, however, the first tangible signs of a drawdown have surfaced – not through troop movements, but through paperwork. The equipment auction notice was published on August 6, giving prospective bidders a strikingly narrow five-day window to register interest. The support office is seeking to establish a local commercial-sale contract, initially covering three months, with as many as three further three-month extensions available depending on performance. On its face, the notice reads as routine procurement bureaucracy. Its underlying message is not. It signals that Somalia’s international security operation is no longer grappling only with a shortage of money – the UN is actively preparing for the possibility that entire segments of the logistics system itself may need to be wound down. Two decades of dependency, one funding switch For close to twenty years, the machinery sustaining Somalia’s security forces has rested on a dense web of international logistical and financial support. The UN support office sits at the centre of that web, supplying the infrastructure – transport, aviation, medical services, accommodation, communications and engineering – that allows the African Union mission to function at all. That structure is now under direct strain. Washington, historically one of the largest financial backers of the UN support office, pulled its funding at the start of July, converting what had been a slow-burning financing shortfall into an immediate operational emergency. According to Khare, a $481 million budget has already been approved for the financial year running through June 2027. But the United States has signalled it will block any attempt inside the UN Security Council to release that budget for the support office’s use beyond December 31, 2026 – effectively imposing a hard deadline several months earlier than the funding cycle would otherwise suggest. To put the scale of the operation in context: the UN support office ran on a $502 million budget last year, dwarfing the African Union mission’s own $190 million allocation, most of which goes toward reimbursing troop-contributing countries, with smaller shares set aside for death-and-disability compensation and subsistence allowances. The mission’s current authorised strength stands at 11,862 uniformed personnel, including 680 police officers, alongside UN-funded support for up to 85 civilian staff attached to the military and police components. “Expect more staff layoffs in the coming days,” one official familiar with internal planning said. Compounding the pressure, the UN’s separate political mission in the country, the UN Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia, is due to be downgraded into a standard UN Country Office by October – another marker of the shrinking international footprint arriving on a near-identical timeline. Mogadishu says it is ready. Its partners are not so sure While the UN scales back, Somalia’s own political and military signalling is pulling in the opposite direction. On August 16, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud presided over a passing-out parade for more than 3,000 newly trained Somali National Army soldiers in Xananbuure, in Galmudug State’s northern Galgadud region – a ceremony choreographed to project growing self-reliance. Mohamud used the occasion to call openly for African peacekeepers to leave , suggesting the departing troops be sent off with “a bunch of flowers.” Somalia’s security partners appear unconvinced. Just days earlier, Uganda’s Defence Minister, Kiryowa Kiwanuka, declared that Ugandan forces would stay in the country regardless of the AU mission’s uncertain trajectory, speaking on the sidelines of an Eastern Africa Standby Force conference in Kampala. Uganda currently fields 4,500 troops under the AU mission plus a further 2,000 soldiers deployed under a standalone bilateral arrangement with Mogadishu. President Yoweri Museveni has likewise signalled that Kampala and regional partners intend to keep supporting Somalia’s security effort, without detailing how. Kiwanuka indicated the shape of Uganda’s presence would shift over time but stressed that a bilateral channel with Mogadishu already exists independent of the AU framework. He also cautioned that Somalia’s international partners “must find resources” to finance any exit that is orderly rather than chaotic. The result is an increasingly uncomfortable standoff of narratives: Mogadishu insists its forces are ready to assume full responsibility; the AU mission’s finances are deteriorating by the week; the UN logistics network underpinning the entire operation is already shedding staff and liquidating hardware – and yet Uganda, one of the largest troop contributors, says it has no plans to leave. A Ugandan military source told The East African that the country’s military leadership has information indicating Kenya, Ethiopia and Egypt also intend to keep forces in Somalia through 2027. Should that hold, the operative question shifts from whether foreign troops remain in the country to who, if anyone, will pay to keep them there. The United Nations appears to be dismantling the support system that has sustained Somalia’s international security effort for the better part of two decades before any consensus has emerged on what, if anything, will replace it – leaving Mogadishu to confront a stark question: can Somali forces genuinely absorb the security burden at the exact moment the scaffolding beneath the old system is being taken apart, or will the troops who stay behind find themselves operating inside a framework that has yet to be funded at all. items.title: Somalia’s Supreme Court Throws Out Galmudug Election Results
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s Supreme Court has annulled the results of the July 30 combined parliamentary and local elections in Galmudug, delivering a potentially consequential setback to the election model championed by President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud. The court ruled that the elections were not conducted in accordance with Somalia’s Constitution and electoral laws, rendering the results invalid. The decision effectively places a major legal question mark over an electoral process that critics have accused the federal government of using to advance a predetermined political outcome. Somalia Supreme Court Supreme Court Chief Justice Baashe Yuusuf Axmed said the court found serious irregularities that could not be corrected and that had undermined the integrity, independence and credibility of the electoral process. The court subsequently ordered the Independent National Electoral and Boundaries Commission to restart the electoral process and conduct fresh elections at the earliest practical opportunity. Importantly, the court ruled that Galmudug’s existing institutions should remain in office while preparations for new elections are undertaken, preventing a constitutional vacuum. A Legal Test for Hassan’s Election Blueprint The ruling is likely to reverberate far beyond Galmudug. President Hassan’s administration has promoted a centralized electoral framework based on direct voting, but critics have repeatedly questioned whether the process is genuinely competitive, independent and legally grounded. The Supreme Court’s decision now provides a powerful judicial precedent: an election cannot acquire legitimacy simply because it has been organized and declared by an electoral authority. It must also withstand constitutional and legal scrutiny. That principle could complicate efforts to replicate the Galmudug model elsewhere. Hirshabelle Faces a Different Path The ruling may also offer Hirshabelle an opportunity to avoid being drawn into a similar one-sided electoral process. If the legal standards applied by the Supreme Court are consistently enforced, any future election must demonstrate transparency, inclusiveness, independence and compliance with the law—not merely produce a politically convenient result. For President Hassan’s opponents, that is a significant development. The implications could be even more politically sensitive in South West State, where the federal government has faced accusations of intervening directly in the state’s political affairs. Critics have alleged that President Hassan’s government forcibly engineered a political transition in Baidoa and installed parliamentary Speaker Sheikh Adan Mohamed Nur Madobe as the state’s leader. Those allegations remain politically contested. Nevertheless, the Supreme Court ruling could make it considerably harder for any government-backed electoral arrangement in South West State to escape judicial scrutiny if similar legal challenges are brought. The message from the court is therefore broader than the annulment of one election: electoral power has limits, and political authority cannot substitute for constitutional legality. For supporters of a genuinely competitive electoral process, the ruling represents a moment of relief and renewed hope. It demonstrates that Somalia’s judicial institutions can still act as a check when electoral procedures are challenged on constitutional grounds. The decision does not resolve Somalia’s wider political crisis, but it has undeniably raised the stakes. President Hassan’s election strategy now faces its most important test—not in Villa Somalia, but in the courts and in the constitutional principles that are supposed to govern Somalia’s democratic transition.
