items.title: Turkey Denies Role in Puntland Airstrikes, but Questions Over Its Presence Refuse to Disappear
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Turkey Denies Role in Puntland Airstrikes, but Questions Over Its Presence Refuse to Disappear allegedly targeting individuals linked to the hijacking of the M/V LUTUF. Yet Ankara’s denial has done little to quiet the questions surrounding the attack. A Turkish Foreign Ministry official told BBC Somali that Ankara had no information about airstrikes carried out by Turkish fighter aircraft or drones along the Puntland coast. The statement came amid reports that Turkish aircraft and naval assets had been operating in the vicinity of the vessel after it was hijacked. That coincidence has raised an uncomfortable question: If Turkey was not involved, why were Turkish military assets reportedly operating so close to the scene of the incident? The M/V LUTUF, sailing under the Cameroon flag, was seized by an armed group near Marraya in Puntland’s Eyl district on August 17. According to reports, including an account by the Associated Press, the vessel was allegedly carrying weapons, communications equipment and satellite technology destined for a Turkish military training facility in Mogadishu. Following the hijacking, reports indicated that vessels linked to Turkish interests, along with helicopters and drones, appeared in the area and monitored movements connected to the hijacked ship. Then came the airstrike. The following day, an attack was reported near Garmaal, where a small boat approaching the coast was hit. Four people were reportedly killed and two others wounded. Puntland authorities identified the victims as fishermen, while security sources claimed that those targeted were connected to the group responsible for the M/V LUTUF hijacking. No party has officially claimed responsibility for the strike. A Denial That Raises More Questions Turkey’s denial is striking because, according to available reports, Turkey was the only country whose military assets were publicly reported to have been deployed in the immediate vicinity of the incident. That does not, by itself, establish Turkish responsibility. The presence of Turkish vessels or aircraft does not constitute proof that Ankara ordered or carried out the strike. But it makes the question of who conducted the operation—and under whose authority—all the more difficult to ignore. Puntland has demanded a clear explanation from any foreign government or military force involved in operations along its coastline, particularly regarding who authorized the strikes and what targets were being pursued. Puntland’s Deputy Information Minister, Bile Mohamud Qabowsade, argued that even suspected pirates must be dealt with through established legal procedures and that individuals should not simply be attacked without due process. The Federal Government of Somalia has also acknowledged that military operations and shelling took place along Puntland’s coast. State Minister for Defence Omar Ali Abdi said the federal government was preparing a comprehensive report on the incidents. He further indicated that if military operations against piracy are being conducted along Somalia’s coastline, the Federal Government is the legally authorized institution responsible for approving such operations. That statement introduces another important question: Was Mogadishu informed of the operation, and if so, did it authorize it? If the operation was conducted by a foreign military without authorization from Somalia’s federal authorities, the incident could raise serious questions about national sovereignty. If authorization was granted, the government would be expected to explain the circumstances and the legal basis for the operation. The M/V LUTUF Mystery The controversy cannot be separated from the unusual circumstances surrounding the M/V LUTUF. The vessel was reportedly carrying equipment allegedly destined for a Turkish military facility in Mogadishu. Shortly after its seizure, Turkish-linked military assets reportedly appeared in the area. An attack then occurred in which Puntland says civilians were killed. Turkey now says it has no information about the airstrikes. That sequence of events does not prove Turkish involvement. But it makes an independent investigation all the more necessary. The central questions remain unanswered: Who conducted the strike? Who authorized it? What intelligence was used to identify the target? Were the victims fishermen or suspected pirates? And what role, if any, did Turkish military assets in the area play? Until those questions are answered with credible evidence, speculation will inevitably continue. The incident has also deepened anxiety among coastal communities in Nugaal. Fishermen reportedly fear returning to some of their traditional fishing grounds, worried that they could once again be mistaken for suspected pirates or armed groups. Somalia has every legitimate interest in combating piracy and protecting international shipping. But those objectives cannot come at the expense of civilian lives or national sovereignty. Turkey may insist that it had nothing to do with the attack. But given the reported presence of its military assets near the scene, that denial alone is unlikely to put the controversy to rest. What is now needed is evidence—not denials, accusations or speculation. items.title: SHEEKH SHAAKIR oo si deg deg ah uga fal-celiyay go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Xisbiga Siyaasadeed ee Towfiiq, Sheekh Axmed Shaakir ayaa soo dhaweeyay go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ee Soomaaliya ay ku laashay natiijooyinkii doorashooyinka Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golayaasha Deegaanka ee Galmudug. Sheekh Axmed Shaakir oo shir jaraa’id ku qabtay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa taageerayaasha xisbiga ugu baaqay inay si wanaagsan u soo dhaweeyaan go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare, isagoo sheegay in tallaabadan ay rajo cusub u abuureyso shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Guddoomiyaha ayaa hambalyo u diray taageerayaasha Xisbiga Towfiiq, isagoo sheegay in dadaalkii ay muddo dheer ku bixiyeen arrimaha doorashada uu miro dhalay, isla markaana cabashooyinkii ay gudbiyeen ay maxkamaddu tixgelisay. Waxa uu shacabka Soomaaliyeed ugu baaqay inay go’aanka maxkamadda si nabad ah u soo dhaweeyaan, isagoo ka digay tallaabo kasta oo keeni karta qalalaase ama qalqal-gelin amni xilli dalka uu marayo marxalad siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah. Sheekh Axmed Shaakir ayaa sidoo kale ciidamada qalabka sida iyo Dowladda Federaalka ugu baaqay inay ilaaliyaan amniga iyo badqabka shacabka, gaar ahaan xilli ay qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada muujinayaan rabitaankooda ku aaddan doorasho qof iyo cod ah. Guddoomiyaha Xisbiga Towfiiq ayaa sheegay in xisbigiisu muddo siddeed bilood ah u taagnaa sidii dalka looga hirgelin lahaa doorasho xor iyo xalaal ah, taas oo ku saleysan mabaadi’da iyo habraacyada doorashada. Wuxuu sheegay in dadaallada xisbigu ay ku wajahnaayeen sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa in hannaanka doorashada uu noqdo mid waafaqsan sharciga, isla markaana la dhowro xuquuqda cod-bixiyeyaasha iyo tartamayaasha siyaasadeed. Sheekh Axmed Shaakir ayaa tilmaamay in go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare uu muujinayo in cabashooyinka ay xisbiyada iyo dhinacyada kale ka qabeen hannaanka doorashada aan la iska indha-tiri karin. Maxkamadda Sare ee Soomaaliya ayaa dhawaan ku dhawaaqday in natiijooyinkii doorashooyinka Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golayaasha Deegaanka ee Galmudug oo dhacay 30-kii Luulyo 2026 aysan waafaqsanayn dastuurka iyo sharciga doorashooyinka dalka. Go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ayaa dhaliyay xaalad siyaasadeed oo cusub, iyadoo Xisbiga Towfiiq iyo dhinacyo kale ay ku baaqayaan in doorashada Galmudug lagu qabto hannaan waafaqsan dastuurka iyo shuruucda dalka, si loo helo doorasho loo dhan yahay oo lagu wada qanacsan yahay. items.title: Puntland Warns Against Pirate Ransoms
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Puntland’s government has warned against paying ransom to pirates holding vessels off its coastline, arguing that such payments would only strengthen and encourage the resurgence of piracy. In a statement, Puntland’s Ministry of Fisheries and Marine Resources said ransom payments create a financial incentive for pirate groups and risk turning coastal communities into the victims of a renewed maritime security crisis. The warning comes amid growing concern over a series of piracy incidents off Somalia’s northeastern coast. Six vessels are reportedly being held by armed groups, with demands for ransoms running into millions of dollars. But amid the renewed fight against piracy, an even more troubling question has emerged: who is protecting innocent fishermen caught in the crossfire? Recent airstrikes near Garmaal on Puntland’s Nugaal coast reportedly killed four people and wounded two others. Puntland has said fishermen and local residents were among those affected, while the identity of those responsible for the strikes remains unconfirmed The deaths have transformed what began as a piracy crisis into a broader humanitarian and accountability issue. Local fishing communities depend on the sea for their livelihoods, and the prospect of military operations near their traditional fishing grounds has generated fear among residents. The controversy intensified following the August 17 hijacking of the Cameroon-flagged M/V LUTUF off Puntland. The vessel was reportedly seized near Eyl and later taken toward the Nugaal coast. Reports said Turkish-owned vessels, helicopters and drones were monitoring the area before an airstrike killed four people near Garmaal. However, the identity of those who carried out the strike has not been independently established. Puntland has called on governments and foreign forces involved in anti-piracy operations to explain what happened and to distinguish clearly between legitimate military targets and civilians. The central issue is no longer simply how to defeat piracy. It is how to confront piracy without turning innocent fishermen into collateral damage. Puntland’s warning against ransom payments is understandable: rewarding hostage-takers can perpetuate the business model of piracy. But equally important is ensuring that counter-piracy operations do not create another cycle of fear, displacement and civilian deaths. For coastal families who depend on fishing, the sea is not a battlefield—it is their workplace, their livelihood and often their only source of income. The fight against piracy must therefore protect both ships at sea and the Somali fishermen whose lives depend on those same waters. But amid the renewed fight against piracy, an even more troubling question has emerged: who is protecting innocent fishermen caught in the crossfire? Recent airstrikes near Garmaal on Puntland’s Nugaal coast reportedly killed four people and wounded two others. Puntland has said fishermen and local residents were among those affected, while the identity of those responsible for the strikes remains unconfirmed The deaths have transformed what began as a piracy crisis into a broader humanitarian and accountability issue. Local fishing communities depend on the sea for their livelihoods, and the prospect of military operations near their traditional fishing grounds has generated fear among residents. The controversy intensified following the August 17 hijacking of the Cameroon-flagged M/V LUTUF off Puntland. The vessel was reportedly seized near Eyl and later taken toward the Nugaal coast. Reports said Turkish-owned vessels, helicopters and drones were monitoring the area before an airstrike killed four people near Garmaal. However, the identity of those who carried out the strike has not been independently established. Puntland has called on governments and foreign forces involved in anti-piracy operations to explain what happened and to distinguish clearly between legitimate military targets and civilians. The central issue is no longer simply how to defeat piracy. It is how to confront piracy without turning innocent fishermen into collateral damage. Puntland’s warning against ransom payments is understandable: rewarding hostage-takers can perpetuate the business model of piracy. But equally important is ensuring that counter-piracy operations do not create another cycle of fear, displacement and civilian deaths. For coastal families who depend on fishing, the sea is not a battlefield—it is their workplace, their livelihood and often their only source of income. The fight against piracy must therefore protect both ships at sea and the Somali fishermen whose lives depend on those same waters. items.title: Xog: Xasan Sheekh, Xamza iyo Mahad Salaad oo ka shiraya go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa gaaray hoyga uu magaalada Muqdisho ka degan yahay Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre, halkaas oo uu ka bilowday kulan xasaasi ah oo looga hadlayo xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Galmudug. Kulanka ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka ay maanta laashay natiijooyinkii doorashooyinka Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golayaasha Deegaanka ee maamulka Galmudug. Waxaa la filayaa in kulanka uu ku biiro Taliyaha Hay’adda Nabad-sugidda iyo Sirdoonka Qaranka (NISA), Mahad Maxamed Salaad, iyadoo ay sidoo kale suuragal tahay inay ka qeyb-galaan mas’uuliyiin kale oo dowladda ka tirsan. Maxkamadda Sare ayaa sheegtay in doorashooyinkii Galmudug ee dhacay 30-kii Luulyo 2026 aysan waafaqsanayn dastuurka iyo sharciga doorashooyinka dalka, taasoo keentay in la laalo natiijooyinkii kasoo baxay. Maxkamaddu waxay sidoo kale amartay guddiga doorashada inuu dib ugu laabto hannaanka doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee Galmudug, isla markaana uu doorashooyinka ku qabto waqtiga ugu dhow ee macquulka ah. Go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ayaa Galmudug ka abuuray xaalad siyaasadeed oo cusub, waxaana Dowladda Federaalka laga filayaa inay qiimeyso tallaabooyinka xiga ee la qaadi karo, gaar ahaan sidii loo maareyn lahaa hannaanka doorashooyinka maamulka. Kulanka madaxweynaha iyo ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmaya xilli dowladda ay wajaheyso caqabado siyaasadeed iyo amni, iyadoo socdaan dadaallo lagu xoojinayo xasilloonida dalka iyo wada-shaqeynta dhinacyada siyaasadda. Si kastaba, Madaxda dowladda ayaa la filayaa inay si gaar ah uga arrinsadaan saameynta go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare iyo waxa laga yeelayo doorashooyinka maamulka Galmudug, oo qabsoomida dadaal badan gelisay dowladda dhexe. items.title: Guddoomiyaha Dayniile oo soo soo saaray amar culus oo la xiriira waddooyinka degmada
items.description: Mogadishu (Caasimada Online) — Guddoomiyaha Degmada Dayniile, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Macallin Xuseen, ayaa soo saaray amar ku saabsan nadaafadda, bilicda deegaanka iyo xoojinta amniga waddooyinka waaweyn ee degmada, isagoo shacabka iyo ganacsatada ugu baaqay inay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan maamulka degmada. Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu faray in dhulka ku yaalla hareeraha laamiyada waaweyn laga nadiifiyo geedaha iyo dhirta si aan qorshaysnayn uga baxda, kuwaas oo sababi kara in waddooyinka iyo hareerahooda ay noqdaan goobo aan si wanaagsan loo arki karin, isla markaana caqabad ku noqda sugidda amniga iyo bilicda deegaanka. Sidoo kale, muwaadiniinta leh dhulka ku dhow waddooyinka ayaa lagu amray inay dayactiraan oo hagaajiyaan dhulkooda, isla markaana, haddii ay awoodaan, ay derbiyo ku wareejiyaan dhulalkooda si loo ilaaliyo nadaafadda, bilicda iyo nidaamka deegaanka. Dhanka kale, Guddoomiyaha Degmada Dayniile ayaa shacabka iyo ganacsatada ka codsaday inay maamulka degmada kala shaqeeyaan hirgelinta qorshahan, si loo helo deegaan nadiif ah, qurux badan oo amni leh. Guddoomiyuhu wuxuu si gaar ah ugu adkeeyay in guri kasta iyo goob kasta oo ganacsi hortooda lagu rakibo nalal, si habeenkii loo helo iftiin ku filan oo gacan ka geysta sugidda amniga, ilaalinta hantida shacabka iyo fududeynta dhaqdhaqaaqa dadka. Amarkan ayaa si gaar ah u khuseeya laamiyada waaweyn ee Degmada Dayniile, oo ay ka mid yihiin Laamiga Dheer ee Dayniile iyo Laamiga Oodweyne. Ganacsatada ku ganacsata hareeraha waddooyinkaas ayaa lagu wargeliyay inay afaafka hore ee goobahooda ganacsi ku rakibaan nalal. Maamulka Degmada Dayniile ayaa sheegay in tallaabooyinkan ay qayb ka yihiin qorshaha lagu hagaajinayo bilicda deegaanka, kor loogu qaadayo nadaafadda, laguna xoojinayo amniga, si loo abuuro jawi wanaagsan oo ay shacabka iyo ganacsatadu si nabad ah ugu noolaadaan uguna shaqaystaan. Ugu dambayn, Maamulka Degmada Dayniile ayaa digniin u diray cid kasta oo ku xadgudubta ama aan u hoggaansamin amarkan, isagoo sheegay in qofkii ama ganacsigii diida fulinta awaamiirta maamulka laga qaadi doono tallaabo waafaqsan xeerarka iyo go’aannada maamulka degmada. The post Guddoomiyaha Dayniile oo soo soo saaray amar culus oo la xiriira waddooyinka degmada appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: WAR: Duqayn Lagu Beegsaday Koox Looga Shakisanyahay inay Saad u Siday Burcad-badeedda
items.description: Xeebaha Puntland (Raxanreeb Online): Duqayn laga fuliyay deegaan xeebeed ayaa lagu beegsaday koox la sheegay inay saad iyo sahay u siday burcad-badeed Soomaali ah oo afduubtay markab kusoo wajahnaa Soomaaliya. Wararka hordhaca ah ayaa sheegaya in ku dhowaad 10 qof ay ku dhinteen duqaynta, taas oo noqonaysa mid kamid ah weerarradii ugu khasaaraha badnaa ee lala beegsado kooxaha burcad-badeedda muddadii u dambeysay. Dhacdadan ayaa si weyn looga hadal hayaa baraha bulshada, iyadoo weli aan si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin cidda fulisay duqaynta, goobta saxda ah ee weerarku ka dhacay iyo cidda ay ahaayeen dadka la beegsaday. Weerarkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xeebaha Puntland ay ka jiraan dhaqdhaqaaqyo la xiriira burcad-badeednimo iyo afduubka maraakiibta, iyadoo sidoo kale dhowr markab lagu soo warramay inay gacanta ugu jiraan kooxaha burcad-badeedda. Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ayaa laga sugayaa dhinacyada amniga iyo maamulka Puntland. items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo loo gudbiyey Hindise-Sharciyeedka Dhismaha Golaha Culimada Soomaaliyeed
items.description: Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka u gudbisay Hindise-Sharciyeedka Dhismaha Golaha Culimada Soomaaliyeed, kaas oo hadda galaya hannaanka ansixinta dastuuriga ah. Wasiirka Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka, Sheekh Mukhtaar Roobow Cali, oo Golaha Shacabka ka hor jeediyey khudbad ku saabsan hindise-sharciyeedka, ayaa sheegay in dhismaha Golaha Culimada Soomaaliyeed uu muhiim u yahay mideynta Culimada Soomaaliyeed, xoojinta doorkooda bulshada iyo horumarinta wada-tashiga u dhexeeya Dowladda iyo Culimada. Hindise-sharciyeedkan ayaa ka kooban saddex cutub iyo 30 qodob, kuwaas oo qeexaya aasaaska sharciyeed, qaab-dhismeedka, waajibaadka iyo shaqooyinka Golaha Culimada Soomaaliyeed. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in ujeeddada hindise-sharciyeedku tahay in la sameeyo hannaan qaran oo sharciyad iyo isla-xisaabtan leh, kaas oo ka shaqeeya danta dalka, diinta iyo toosinta bulshada. Intii uu Golaha Shacabka ka hadlayey, Wasiir Mukhtaar Roobow ayaa tilmaamay in Golaha Culimada Soomaaliyeed uu door muhiim ah ka qaadan karo xoojinta midnimada Culimada, nabadda iyo dib-u-heshiisiinta, iyo xalinta khilaafaadka bulshada. Sidoo kale, wuxuu sheegay in Golaha uu gacan ka geysan karo wacyigelinta diineed iyo akhlaaqda bulshada, iyo ka hortagga marin-habaabinta diinta iyo afkaarta xagjirnimada wata. Hindise-sharciyeedka ayaa ka hor inta aan Baarlamaanka loo gudbin soo maray hannaan wadatashi iyo dib-u-eegis sharci, iyadoo Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka ay hadda ka dalbatay Golaha Shacabka inuu meel mariyo. Wasiirka ayaa xusay in ansixinta sharcigan ay muhiim u tahay xoojinta doorka Culimada Soomaaliyeed, nabadda, wadajirka bulshada iyo iskaashiga Dowladda iyo Culimada. Hindise-sharciyeedka ayaa hadda sugaya in Golaha Shacabka uu ka doodo, kadibna uu maro marxaladaha kale ee uu dhigayo hannaanka sharci-dejinta dalka.

Hindise-sharciyeedkan ayaa ka kooban saddex cutub iyo 30 qodob, kuwaas oo qeexaya aasaaska sharciyeed, qaab-dhismeedka, waajibaadka iyo shaqooyinka Golaha Culimada Soomaaliyeed. Wasaaraddu waxay sheegtay in ujeeddada hindise-sharciyeedku tahay in la sameeyo hannaan qaran oo sharciyad iyo isla-xisaabtan leh, kaas oo ka shaqeeya danta dalka, diinta iyo toosinta bulshada. Intii uu Golaha Shacabka ka hadlayey, Wasiir Mukhtaar Roobow ayaa tilmaamay in Golaha Culimada Soomaaliyeed uu door muhiim ah ka qaadan karo xoojinta midnimada Culimada, nabadda iyo dib-u-heshiisiinta, iyo xalinta khilaafaadka bulshada. Sidoo kale, wuxuu sheegay in Golaha uu gacan ka geysan karo wacyigelinta diineed iyo akhlaaqda bulshada, iyo ka hortagga marin-habaabinta diinta iyo afkaarta xagjirnimada wata. Hindise-sharciyeedka ayaa ka hor inta aan Baarlamaanka loo gudbin soo maray hannaan wadatashi iyo dib-u-eegis sharci, iyadoo Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka ay hadda ka dalbatay Golaha Shacabka inuu meel mariyo. Wasiirka ayaa xusay in ansixinta sharcigan ay muhiim u tahay xoojinta doorka Culimada Soomaaliyeed, nabadda, wadajirka bulshada iyo iskaashiga Dowladda iyo Culimada. Hindise-sharciyeedka ayaa hadda sugaya in Golaha Shacabka uu ka doodo, kadibna uu maro marxaladaha kale ee uu dhigayo hannaanka sharci-dejinta dalka.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo La Wareegaysa Mas’uuliyadda Horumarinta Nidaamka Cadaaladda Kadib Soo Afjaridda Hawlihii UNTMIS
items.description: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Cadaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Macallin Maxamuud, ayaa maanta ka qeyb galay kulan lagu soo xirayay hawlihii UNTMIS ee taageerada Soomaaliya ee dhinacyada cadaaladda iyo adeegyada xabsiyada. Kulanka ayaa waxaa ka qeyb galay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Dowlad-goboleedyada, wakiillo ka socday Qaramada Midoobay iyo UNTMIS, hay’adaha cadaaladda iyo asluubta, iyo bah-wadaagta caalamiga ah ee taageerta Soomaaliya. Wasiir Xasan Macallin ayaa uga mahadceliyay Qaramada Midoobay, UNTMIS iyo bah-wadaagta kale taageerada ay Soomaaliya ka siiyeen horumarinta hay’adaha cadaaladda iyo adeegyada xabsiyada, dhismaha awoodda hay’adaha iyo xoojinta ku dhaqanka sarreynta sharciga. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in soo afjaridda hawlihii UNTMIS ay Soomaaliya u tahay marxalad muhiim ah oo lagu sii xoojinayo mas’uuliyadda Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, isaga oo caddeeyay in dowladda ay ka go’an tahay sii wadidda horumarinta nidaamka cadaaladda iyo hay’adaha qaranka. Waxa uu sidoo kale adkeeyay in aqoonta, khibradda iyo awoodda hay’adaha dalka laga dhisay intii ay UNTMIS ka shaqeynaysay Soomaaliya ay noqon doonaan saldhig muhiim ah oo lagu sii horumarinayo nidaamka cadaaladda. Wasiirku wuxuu tilmaamay in Soomaaliya ay ka sii ambaqaadi doonto halka ay hay’adaha cadaaladda iyo adeegyada xabsiyadu gaareen, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo in hay’adaha qaranku si buuxda ula wareegaan masuuliyadda horumarinta iyo tayeynta adeegyadaas. Kulanka ayaa sidaas ku soo gunaanaday marxalad ka mid ah taageeradii UNTMIS ee dhinacyada cadaaladda iyo adeegyada xabsiyada, iyadoo la adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii wado wada-shaqeynta iyo iskaashiga hay’adaha dowladda iyo bah-wadaagta Soomaaliya.

items.title: Somalia Deploys Danab Commandos to Baidoa Amid Rising Security Threats
items.description: BAIDOA —Somalia’s Federal Government has deployed additional Danab commandos to Baidoa and its surrounding areas as authorities step up security following a series of attacks targeting the southwestern city. The deployment comes amid reported assaults by Al-Shabaab militants and armed groups loyal to Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed Laftagareen, the former leader of South West State. Federal authorities say the pro-Laftagareen militias operate from positions on the outskirts of Baidoa. Laftagareen continues to claim that he is the legitimate leader of South West State, despite being driven from Baidoa by federal and local forces on 30 March 2026. The Federal Government said its forces had killed numerous Al-Shabaab fighters and members of the pro-Laftagareen militias during recent operations. The Ministry of Defence also said troops had seized armoured vehicles from the militias, claiming that the vehicles had previously been captured from Al-Shabaab. Security forces have increased their presence across Baidoa, with additional checkpoints established along major roads and other strategic locations. The government said the measures are aimed at protecting civilians, securing key infrastructure and preventing further attacks. items.title: Turkiga oo kala caddeeyay in uu fuliyay duqeyntii Puntland ka dhacday iyo in kale
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Turkiga ayaa iska fogeysay inay ku lug leedahay duqeyn khasaare nafeed ka dhashay oo ka dhacday xeebaha maamulka Puntland. Sarkaal ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga oo la hadlay BBC-da ayaa sheegay in Ankara aysan haynin wax xog ah oo ku saabsan duqeyntaas, taas oo lagu dilay dad kalluumaysato ah iyo shaqsiyaad looga shakisan yahay inay ka tirsanaayeen burcad-badeedda Soomaalida. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in Ankara ay beeninayso eedeymaha lagula xiriiriyay duqeynta ka dhacday deegaan-xeebeedka Jiifle oo hoos taga degmada Godob-Jiraan ee gobolka Nugaal. Aaggaasi ayaa la sheegay in maalmo ka hor la geeyay markabka M/V LUTUF, oo burcad-badeed ay horraantii toddobaadkii hore afduubteen. Hadalkan ayaa yimid kaddib markii maamulka Puntland uu si adag uga hadlay duqeynta, isagoo sheegay in dadka lagu dilay ay ku jireen dad rayid ah iyo kalluumaysato, uuna si cad uga soo horjeestay beegsiga noocan ah. Wasiir-ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Puntland, Bile Maxamuud Qabowsade ayaa cambaareeyay dhacdada, isagoo sheegay in haddii dadka la beegsaday ay ahaayeen dambiilayaal ay jiraan habraacyo sharci ah oo loo maro soo qabashadooda iyo maxkamadeyntooda. “Qof haddii uu dambiile yahay, waxaa jira habraacyo sharci ah oo loo maro,” ayuu yiri wasiir ku-xigeenka. Wararka laga helayo gobolka Nugaal ayaa sheegaya in shalay duqeyn ka dhacday deegaanka Jiifle oo hoos taga degmada Godob-Jiraan lagu dilay sagaal qof. Si kastaba, weli lama oga cidda si rasmi ah u fulisay weerarka iyo nooca diyaaradaha loo adeegsaday. Dhanka kale, maalmihii lasoo dhaafay waxaa xeebaha Puntland laga soo sheegayay duqeymo lala xiriiriyay diyaarado dagaal oo lagu tuhunsan yahay inay leeyihiin Turkiga. Wararka ayaa sheegayay in bartilmaameedku ahaa goob lagu haystay markabka MV LUTUF, oo la sheegay inuu u raran yahay Turkiga. Duqeymaha iyo wararka la xiriira howl-galka ayaa cabsi ku abuuray dadka deegaanka, gaar ahaan bulshada ku nool deegaannada xeebaha Puntland. Qaar ka mid ah dadka deegaanka ayaa la sheegay inay ka hayaameen goobihii ay ku noolaayeen, iyagoo ka baqaya in mar kale la bartilmaameedsado. Inkasta oo eedeymaha ku saabsan duqeymaha lala xiriirinayo diyaaradaha Turkiga ay soo baxeen, haddana Ankara waxay sheegtay inaysan haynin wax xog ah oo xaqiijinaya in duqeymahaasi ay ahaayeen kuwo ay fulisay dowladda Turkiga. Arrintan ayaa sii kordhisay su’aalaha ku saabsan cidda ka dambeysay weerarka. Si kastaba, dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli xeebaha Soomaaliya ay weli ka jiraan falal la xiriira burcad-badeednimo iyo afduubka maraakiibta, iyadoo dowlad-goboleedyada iyo Dowladda Federaalka ay wadaan dadaallo lagu sugayo amniga xeebaha. The post Turkiga oo kala caddeeyay in uu fuliyay duqeyntii Puntland ka dhacday iyo in kale appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Banka dhexe ee Somaliland oo horumar weyn ka sameeyay dhismaha nidaam maaliyaddeed  casri ah
items.description: Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Baanka Dhexe ee Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, Mudane Xamse Cabdiraxmaan Khayre, ayaa sheegay in Somaliland ay horumar weyn ka samaysay dhismaha nidaam maaliyaddeed oo casri ah, kaas oo kasbaday kalsooni iyo aqoonsi dhinaca hay’adaha maaliyaddeed ee caalamka. Guddoomiye ku xigeenka oo waraysi gaar ah siiyey wargeyska The Advocate Post ayaa tilmaamay in Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland uu doonayo inuu sumcadda iyo kalsoonida hay’adaha maaliyaddeed ee dalka u beddelo fursado wax ku ool ah oo Somaliland lagu gaadhsiinayo xidhiidho maaliyaddeed oo caalami ah. Xamse Khayre ayaa sheegay in istaraatiijiyadda Baanka Dhexe ku dhisan tahay u hoggaansanaanta xeerarka maaliyaddeed, hufnaanta maamulka keydka lacagaha qalaad, casriyeynta nidaamka lacag-bixinta iyo xoojinta kalsoonida Shilinka Somaliland. Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Baanka Dhexe waxa uu sheegay in aqoonsiga maaliyaddeed lagu horumarin karo xidhiidho lala sameeyo bangiyada caalamiga ah, iskaashi lala yeesho bangiyada dhexe ee dalalka kale, iyo xoojinta hababka lagula dagaallamo dhaqaalaha sharci-darrada ah iyo maalgelinta argagixisada. Guddoomiye Xamse Khayre wuxuu xusay in Baanka Dhexe uu daraasaynayo mustaqbalka lacagta Somaliland, iyadoo la odorasayo sidii loo samayn lahaa lacag qaddaadiic ah, taasina u baahan tahay wada-shaqayn rasmi ah oo lala yeesho Hay’adda Caymiska Qaranka. Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka ayaa sidoo kale iftiimiyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in si cad loo kala saaro hawlaha bangiyada ganacsiga iyo shaqada Baanka Dhexe, si loo xaqiijiyo madaxbannaanida iyo hufnaanta siyaasadda lacagta. Ugu dambayntii, Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Baanka Dhexe ee Somaliland, Xamse Cabdiraxmaan Khayre, ayaa muujiyey in Baanka Dhexe uu xoogga saarayo dhismaha nidaam maaliyadeed oo hufan, la isku halayn karo, isla markaana la jaan qaadaya caalamka.

items.title: Sheekh Aadan Madoobe oo amray dagaal ka dhan ah ciidamada Lafta-gareen iyo…
items.description: Baydhabo (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Madoobe ayaa soo gaba-gabeeyay kulamo uu la yeeshay saraakiisha ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed, isagoo amray in la bilaabo howl-gallo ka dhan ah ciidamada taabacsan Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen iyo maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab. Howl-gallada ayaa lagu sheegay inay qeyb ka yihiin qorshe lagu sugayo amniga magaalada iyo nawaaxigeeda, iyadoo ciidamada loo diyaarinayo inay ka hortagaan weerarro iyo falal amni-darro ah oo ka dhaca gudaha Baydhabo iyo deegaanada ku xeeran. Kulamadii uu Aadan Madoobe la yeeshay saraakiisha amniga ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saaray xaaladda amni ee magaalada, iyo qorshayaasha lagu xoojinayo difaaca Baydhabo iyo waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee ku hareeraysan. Aadan Madoobe ayaa horey Dowladda Federaalka uga dalbaday ciidamo dheeraad ah oo ka qeyb qaata sugidda amniga Baydhabo, iyadoo shalay magaalada laga dejiyay ciidamo cusub oo qeyb ka noqonaya qorshaha amni ee la diyaariyay. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, Aadan Madoobe ayaa ciidamada federaalka iyo kuwa Koonfur Galbeed oo intooda badan ka yimid ciidankii badbaadada Koonfur Galbeed faray inay fariisimo cusub ka sameystaan duleedka magaalada. Ciidamada ayaa loo diyaarinayaa howl-gallo lagu beegsanayo goobaha iyo saldhigyada laga soo abaabulo weerarrada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo xoojinta difaaca magaalada iyo sugidda waddooyinka muhiimka ah. Ilo xog-ogaal ah ayaa sheegay in Dowladda Federaalka ay fulisay ballamo ay horey ula gashay Aadan Madoobe oo ku saabsanaa taageerada farsamo iyo amni ee lagu xoojinayo ammaanka Baydhabo. Qorshahan ayaa sidoo kale qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagula dagaallamayo Al-Shabaab iyo ciidamada daacadda u ah hoggaamiyihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Lafta-gareen, iyadoo xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee maamulka ay weli tahay mid xasaasi ah. items.title: DEG-DEG: Maxkamadda Sare oo Laashay Natiijadii Doorashada Galmudug
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Raxanreeb Online): Maxkamadda Sare ee Soomaaliya ayaa laashay natiijadii doorashadii isku-sidkanayd ee maamulka Galmudug, taas oo uu ku guuleystay urur-siyaasadeedka JSP, iyadoo musharraxa ururka uu ahaa ganacsade Liibaan Axmed. Maxkamadda ayaa sheegtay in natiijada doorashada aysan waafaqsanayn sharciga, waxaana ay amartay in doorashada dib loo celiyo. Dacwadda ka dhanka ahayd natiijada doorashada waxaa gudbiyay Sheekh Shaakir, oo kamid ahaa musharraxiintii ku tartamay doorashada. Go’aankan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Galmudug ay ku jirto marxalad siyaasadeed oo xasaasi ah, iyadoo la filayo in dib-u-celinta doorashadu ay dhaliso dood iyo loollan siyaasadeed cusub oo ku saabsan hannaanka doorashada iyo cidda xaqa u leh inay ka qeybqaadato. Go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ayaa sidoo kale yeelan kara saameyn siyaasadeed oo ka baxsan Galmudug, maadaama doorashooyinka dowlad-goboleedyadu ay qeyb ka yihiin hannaanka cusub ee doorashooyinka tooska ah ee Soomaaliya. items.title: DEG-DEG: Laalidda Natiijada Doorashada Galmudug oo Xiisad Siyaasadeed Abuurtay
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Raxanreeb Online): Go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ee Soomaaliya ay ku laashay natiijada doorashada Galmudug ayaa dhaliyay xiisad siyaasadeed, iyadoo arrintan ay saameyn ku yeelan karto geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka tooska ah ee dalka. Xildhibaan Cagaweyne, oo Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya ku metela Galmudug, ayaa si adag uga horyimid go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare, isagoo ku tilmaamay mid aan caddaalad ahayn. “Go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare ay maanta soo saartay waa dulmi, wax caddayn iyo faahfaahin ah oo ay sheegtayna ma jirto,” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Cagaweyne. Xildhibaanka ayaa sheegay in doodda Xisbiga Towfiiq ay markii hore ku saleysneyd goobo cayiman, balse uu ku eedeeyay in laalidda guud ee doorashada ay ka dambeyso arrimo siyaasadeed oo ka dhan ah hannaanka doorashada tooska ah. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in go’aanka Maxkamadda uu dhaawac ku yahay doorashadii Galmudug, isagoo ku dooday in laga shaqeynayo in khilaaf iyo kala qaybsanaan laga dhex abuuro bulshada Galmudug. “Waxa doorashada loo laalay waa dagaal looga soo horjeedo doorashada tooska ah ee dalka ka socoto iyo doorashadii quruxda badnayd ee ka dhacday Maamulka Galmudug, waxaana laga shaqeynayaa in dadka reer Galmudug la isku diro, lagana shaqeeyo fidno iyo firaaq maamul,” ayuu yiri. Go’aanka Maxkamadda Sare iyo hadallada kasoo yeeraya dhinacyada siyaasadda ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya ay ku jirto marxalad xasaasi ah oo la xiriirta doorashooyinka iyo hannaanka siyaasadeed ee dalka, iyadoo murannada ka dhasha doorashooyinka dowlad-goboleedyada ay si toos ah u saameyn karaan jawiga siyaasadeed ee heer federaal. The post DEG-DEG: Laalidda Natiijada Doorashada Galmudug oo Xiisad Siyaasadeed Abuurtay appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: MW Xasan Sheekh: “Nolol Silic ah ayaan ku Soo Koray”
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa ka sheekeeyay duruufihii adkaa ee uu ku soo koray iyo noloshii carruurnimo ee uu soo maray. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in aabbihii uu ahaa curyaan, isaga oo xusay in markii dambe uu ku koray agoonnimo, isla markaana qoyskoodu aysan haysan hanti badan. “Xasan Gurguurte waxa laygu baxshay, aabbahay curyaan ayuu ahaa, markii dambena agoonnimo ayaan ku koray. Hanti laba sac baan lahayn, iyagaa naloo maali jirey…” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in duruufaha dhaqaale iyo xaaladda qoyska aysan qofka ka hor istaagin inuu mustaqbal wanaagsan gaaro. “In aad qof noqoto kuma xirna in waalidkaa hanti iyo aqoon lahaayeen,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Hadalkan Madaxweynaha ayaa xambaarsan farriin ku saabsan adkeysiga, waxbarashada iyo dadaalka qofka, isagoo tusaale uga dhigay waaya-aragnimadiisa nololeed in qofku uu guul gaari karo xitaa haddii uu ku soo koray duruufo adag. items.title: DEG-DEG: Türkiye oo Sheegtay inaysan Waxba Kala Socon Duqaymaha Xeebaha Nugaal
items.description: Nugaal (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Türkiye ayaa sheegtay in aysan wax xog ah ka hayn duqaymaha maalmihii lasoo dhaafay ka dhacay xeebaha gobolka Nugaal ee Puntland, sida ay werisay BBC. Ilaa saddex duqaymood ayaa laga soo sheegay xeebaha Nugaal, kuwaas oo sababay dhimasho iyo dhaawac, iyadoo wararka hordhaca ah ay sheegayaan in in ka badan 10 qof ay ku dhinteen. Duqaymaha ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xeebaha Puntland ay ku sugan yihiin kooxo burcad-badeed Soomaali ah oo la sheegay inay gacanta ku hayaan lix markab, kuwaas oo qaar kamid ah lagu soo warramay inay sidaan hub, shidaal iyo badeecooyin kale. Dhanka kale, Dowladda Hindiya ayaa xiriir iyo wada-hadal la furtay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo dadaal ugu jirta sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa badqabka muwaadiniinteeda saaran maraakiibta ay burcad-badeeddu gacanta ku hayaan. Puntland ayaa iyaduna sheegtay in ay jiraan xoogag shisheeye oo door ku leh soo laba-kaclaynta burcad-badeedda Soomaalida, iyadoo maamulka uu sheegay inuu si adag ula dagaallamayo kooxaha burcad-badeedda. Inkasta oo Türkiye ay sheegtay inaysan waxba kala socon duqaymaha, cidda dhab ahaan fulisay weerarrada weli si rasmi ah looma caddeyn, waxaana socda dadaallo lagu ogaanayo sababta iyo cidda ka dambeysa. items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Shacab careysan ayaa maanta u daatay bogga Villa Somalia, kadib markii lasoo geliyay sawirrada kulan dhiirrigelin ah oo uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh la qaatay 10-kii arday ee kaalmaha hore ka galay imtixaanka shahaadiga ah ee fasalka 12-aad ee dugsiyada sare dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa ardayda uu la kulmay ku ammaanay dadaalkooda, adkaysigooda iyo natiijada wanaagsan ee ay ka soo hooyeen imtixaanka, waxa uuna kula dardaarmay in ay sii laba-jibaaraan dadaalkooda waxbarasho. Sidoo kale, wuxuu u ballanqaaday in arday kasta oo daneynaya in uu dalka gudhiisa ka sii wato waxbarashadiisa uu heli doono fursad waxbarasho oo bilaash ah, si loo dhiirrigeliyo haldoorka aqoonta iyo jiilka cusub ee dalka hoggaamin doona. Intaas kadib waxaa fal-celin aan caadi ahayn ay ka dhalatay kulankan oo kusoo aaday, xilli xasaasi ah oo ay taagan tahay xiisad ka dhalatay howlaha burburinta iyo barakicinta ee ay weli dowladdu ka wado magaalada Muqdisho. Shacab ka careysan arrintan ayaa qarqiyay bogga Villa Somalia, taas oo keentay in Madaxtooyadu dareento cadaadis xoogan oo ugu dambeyn ku qasbay in qaybta comment-yada laga xiro sawirrada ay soo gelinayaan shacabka. Wariye Maxamed Cabdi Muudey oo ka hadlay arrintan ayaa sheegay in fal-celinta dadweynaha ay muujineyso kala fogaanshaha Madaxweynaha iyo shacabka, isaga oo xusay in Villa Somalia ay u adkeysan weyday dareenka dadweynaha la barakiciyay. “Falcelinta bulshada ee post‑kan waxay muujinaysaa in Madaxweynaha iyo shacabka ay aad u kala fog yihiin. Waxa kale oo xanuun leh in maamulayaasha bogga villa Somalia aysan u adkeysan karin sawirrada falcelinta, kana xareen si ay uga fogaadaan cadaadiska bulshada”. Maxamed Cabdullahi: “Way mudanyihiin in la dhiirigiliyo lkn waxay kasii mudnaayeen in guryihii ay daganayeen aan laga barakicin”. Faysal Xuseen: “Ummadda masaakiinta ah ee midnight Cagaf-cagafta aad la dul taagan tahay ka xishoo”. Jibriil Maxamed: “Maxaad u xirateen qeybta sawirrada marka comments ka la joogo”. Cumar Cabdalle: “Madaxweyne ma la socotaa dhaca, dilka iyo qixinta lagu hayo lagu hayo, Aakhiro adiga ayaa wax lagaa weydiinaa Madaxweyne?”. Dr. Cabdiqaasim Salaad: “Barakiciye qeybta sawirrada fur”. Maxamed Dhoore “Kuwaan kama duwano kuwii aad shalay dhashiikayaasha la dhacday ee guryadooda kasoo barakicisay iyo kuwa isbitaallada jiifa”. items.title: Guddiga Qaran ee Horumarinta Xirfadaha iyo Shaqo-abuurka oo Shirkiisii Ugu Horreeyay Yeeshay
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa guddoomiyay shirkii ugu horreeyay ee Guddiga Qaran ee Horumarinta Xirfadaha iyo Shaqo-abuurka, kaas oo looga hadlay dardargelinta qorshayaasha lagu horumarinayo xirfadaha dhallinyarada iyo abuurista fursado shaqo oo waara. Kulanka ayaa lagu soo bandhigay waajibaadka guddiga, qorshaha qaran ee isku-dubbaridka horumarinta xirfadaha iyo shaqo-abuurka, iyo hawlaha mudnaanta leh ee la doonayo in la fuliyo. Wasaaradda Shaqada iyo Arrimaha Bulshada ayaa sidoo kale soo bandhigtay Siyaasadda Barashada Farsamada iyo Tababarka Xirfadaha, taas oo lagu doonayo in lagu kobciyo xirfadaha shaqaalaha, isla markaana la waafajiyo baahida suuqa shaqada iyo fursadaha dhaqaale ee dalka. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamse ayaa sheegay in horumarinta xirfadaha iyo shaqo-abuurku u baahan yihiin hannaan qaran oo mideysan, iyadoo Dowladda Federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada, ganacsiga gaarka loo leeyahay iyo bahwadaagta horumarintu ay iska kaashadaan isku-xirka xirfadaha, baahida suuqa shaqada iyo maalgashiga. Dowladdu waxay sheegtay in ujeeddada ugu weyn ay tahay in dadaallada iyo maalgashiyada ka socda dalka loo beddelo natiijooyin la cabbiri karo, kuwaas oo horseeda xirfado tayo leh, shaqooyin waara iyo koboc dhaqaale oo loo dhan yahay. Guddiga ayaa la filayaa inuu door muhiim ah ka qaato isku-dubbaridka qorshayaasha shaqo-abuurka iyo horumarinta xirfadaha, gaar ahaan sidii dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed loogu diyaarin lahaa fursadaha ka jira suuqa shaqada gudaha iyo kuwa soo koraya.

items.title: Somalia’s Supreme Court Annuls Galmudug Election Results, Orders Fresh Vote
items.description: MOGADISHU — Somalia’s Supreme Court has annulled the results of the election held in Galmudug and ordered the Independent National Electoral Commission to conduct a fresh vote. Announcing the ruling, Chief Justice Bashe Yusuf Ahmed said the Court had identified serious procedural irregularities that could not be remedied without rerunning the election. He said the manner in which the poll was conducted had undermined public confidence in the integrity of the electoral process. Following a comprehensive review of the case, the Court determined that invalidating the results and holding a new election was the only appropriate course of action. Several political organisations that contested the Galmudug election had earlier rejected the preliminary results announced by the National Electoral Commission. The groups subsequently called for peaceful demonstrations to voice their objections and demand that their concerns be addressed. items.title: Daawo: Muxuu Deni ka yiri duqeynta lala beegsaday burcad badeedda Puntland?
items.description: Garoowe (CaasimadaOnline) – Madaxweynaha Dowlad-goboleedka Puntland, Mudane Saciid Cabdullahi Deni oo xalay ka qayb-galay kulan dadweyne oo ka dhacay degmada Jariiban ee Gobolka Mudug ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda amni ee ka taagan Puntland, gaar ahaan dhacdooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ee lagu beegsaday burcadbadeedda ku sugan deegaannada maamulkaas, kadib markii lagu duqeeyay labadii maalmood ee lasoo dhaafay. Saciid Deni ayaa sheegay in Puntland aysan raalli ka ahayn sida ay wax u dhaceen, isaga oo shaaca ka qaaday in qof kasta oo xadgudub geysta ay tahay in loo maro waddo sharci ah, halkii tallaabooyin kale laga qaadi lahaa. “Annagu raalli kama nihin sida ay wax u dhaceen, aad baan uga xumahay, maxaa yeelay qofka haddii uu dembi galo, xadgudub uma baahno, dambigana wuxuu leeyahay waddo loo maro,” ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha Puntland. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay in loo baahan yahay in si dhab ah loo wajaho xaaladda dhalinyarada ku lug yeelan karta falalka amni-darrada, isaga oo intaas ku daray haddii aan wax laga qaban ay xaaladdu keeni karto dhibaato kale. Waxaa kale oo uu bulshada deegaanka oo ay ugu horreeyaan odayaasha ugu baaqay in wax laga qabto xaaladda wiilashaasi “Dhinaca kale, wiilasha haddii aan qaban wayno dhibaato ayay leedahay,” ayuu khudbaddiisa ku yiri Saciid Deni. Dhinaca kale, Waxa uu sheegay in dhalinyaradaasi ay yihiin wiilashii deegaanka, sidaas darteedna loo baahan yahay qorshe cad oo wax looga qabanayo xaaladda, iyada oo shacabka iyo waxgaradkana laga doonayo inay qayb ka qaataan. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Puntland ay wajahaysay xaalad amni oo cakiran, iyadoo maalintii shalay ay dhaceen duqeymo laga fuliyay deegaano ka tirsan Puntland, kuwaas oo hadal-heyn iyo walaac ka dhex abuuray bulshada. Duqeymaha ayaa kusoo kordhay xaalad amni oo horey u kacsanayd, waxaana jira baaqyo loo jeedinayo dhinacyada ay khuseyso si looga fogaado tallaabo kasta oo xaaladda sii murjin karta, isla markaana la sameeyo hannaan lagu xallin karo khilaafaadka iyo falalka amni-darrada ah. items.title: Kalluumeysto barakac ku ah Muqdisho oo ka cabanaya xirfad la’aan ka dhan ah shaqadooda
items.description: (ERGO) – Dhallinyaro badan oo ka soo jeeda qoysas soo barakacay iyo danyar deegaan ah ayaa si maalinle ah ugu kalluumeysi taga xeebaha magaalada Muqdisho. Ma haystaan doonyo, shabaag weyn iyo agabyo kale oo ka caawiya inay helaan kalluun badan. Waxay adeeg sadaan fiilooyin afka hore looga xiray bir qaloocan iyo shabaag yar. Shaqo la’aanta ayaa ku riixday in nolol maalmeedka ay ka raadiyaan kalluumeysiga oo aysan u haysan agab ku habboon iyo qibrad ku filan, balse dadaalkoodu wuxuu suurta galiyay in qoysaskooda ay ka saaraan cunno yari, ayna iska bixiyaan waxbarashada. Dhallinyaradaas waxaa ka mid ah Shuceyb Axmed Xuseen oo 34 jir ah. wuxuu sheegay in maalin kasta uu ka lugeeyo xerada uu deggan yahay ee Saacid oo ku taalla degmada Dayniile, si uu kalluun uga soo dabto xeebta Geelaq ee degmada Xamarweyne. Wuxuu xusay in shaqadan uu bishii ka helo dhaqaale u dhexeeya $100 illaa $150, kaas oo uu tilmaamay inuu wax ka badalay nolosha qoyskiisa, walaalihiis iyo waalidkiis oo kaligiis ku tiirsan. “Ugu yaraan laba jeer maalintii ayaan wax cunaa, haddii aysan saddex jeer noqon. Markii hore nin baaga muundo ayaan ahaa, wax badan aan hayn oo oo marna wax hela, marna waaya.  Hadda xaaladdaydu way isbeddeshay. Labo qoys ayaan ka billaa shaqadan.” Wuxuu ku shaqeystaa agab ka kooban fiilo afka hore bir qalloocan looga xiray oo uu ku gatay $28 oo uu ku caawiyay nin ay qaraabo yihiin. Kama tago goobta, isagoo hadba kalluunka ugu dhaca dabinka u soo saara bannaanka, xarigga ayuu biyaha dib ugu celiyaa, si mid kale uu u jillaabto. Waa howl uu ka doortay gaari gacan uu ku shaqeyn jiray, kaas oo sheegay in dhaqaalaha ka soo gali jiray oo aan ka badneyn $2 maalinkii uu ugu filnaan waayay in hal waqti ay dabka ku shitaan maalinkii. Hadda ayuu xusay inay helaan cunto ku filan, waloow uu sheegay in shaqadu ay tahay mid dhib badan oo uu ka shaqeeyo aroortii illaa gabal dhaca. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in xeebta oo ka fog uu labo saac u sii lugeeyo, intaas oo kalana ay ku qaadato soo noqoshadu. Waxaa jira gaadiid u kala goosha oo lagu raaco $1, balse waxaa isaga ka hor taagan dhaqaale yari, maadaama lacagta soo gasha aysan u qeyb samin biilka iyo gaari raaca. Noocyada kalluunka ee uu soo jillaabto ayuu u iib geeyaa suuqyada Muqdisho, iyadoo wixii u gadmi waaya uu sheegay in qoysku ay karsadaan. “Badda mar wax badan ayaa laga helaa oo way fiican tahay. Marna xagaa ayaa jira oo dabeyl ayay leedahay, markaas wax fiican lagama helo. Intaan xagaaga aheyn waxaan ka helaa kalluun fiican oo nolol maalmeedka aan ku maareeyo.” Shuceyb ayaa ah aabbaha saddex carruur ah oo sidoo kale dabara nolosha lix carruur ah oo la dhashay iyo labadiisa waalid. Wuxuu tilmaamay in carruurtiisu aysan waxbarasho gaarin, balse uu walaashii bishii ka dhiibo $8 oo ay ku dhigato iskuul hoose. Xerada Saacid ee degmada Dayniile ayay soo degeen bishii June ee sannadkii 2024. Waxay ka soo barakaceen miyiga gobolka Hiiraan ee bartamaha Soomaaliya oo ay ku wajaheen colaad iyo abaar ay ku waayeen boqol neef oo ah geel, ari iyo lo’ ay noloshoodu ku tiirsaneyd. Shuceyb ayaa xusay in hankiisu yahay sidii uu qoyska uga saari lahaa nolosha hubanti la’aanta ah. is bedelkaas ayuu doonayaa inuu ka dhalliyo kalluumeysiga oo yoolkiisu yahay inuu u helo qalab kor u qaada wax soo saarkiisa. Xeebaha gobolka Banaadir ee Gubadley, Geeleq, Kaaraan iyo Jasiira oo ka tirsan gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ayay inta badan ka kalluumeystaan dhallinyaradan. Xuseen Maxamed Yuusuf oo ka mid ah ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in xeebahan ay ku door bideen inay yihiin kuwo magaalada dhexdeeda ah oo aan fogeyn oo leh qarar kalluunku dugsodo. Xuseen, waa 19 jir curad u ah qoys danyar ah oo ku nool degmada Gubadley ee magaalada Muqdisho. Dhaqaalaha ka soo gala kalluumeysiga oo maalinkii ah $10 ayuu tilmaamay in soddon Doollar uu bishii iskaga bixiyo waxbarashada, inta kalana uu ku caawiyo qoyska. Wuxuu sheegay in duruufaha nololeed ee qoysku wajahayay ay ku qasabtay in shaqadan uu billaabo, si uu u garab istaago aabbihiis oo ku shaqeeya bishii dhaqaale aan dabooli karin baahida reerka oo ah $170 oo ka soo gasha Hoteel uu waardiye ka yahay. Xuseen ayaa ah arday habeenkii dhigta waxbarashada aan nidaamiga ahayn (Non-formal education), maadaama uu shaqeeyo maalinkii. “Habeenkii waxaan bartaa English-ka. acagta aan maalintii shaqada ka helo, qayb ayaan private-ka is kaga bixiyaa, qaybna family-ga ayaan siiyaa. Waxaa ku dhiiri galiyay dhallinyaro saaxibadiis ah oo uga horeeyay, kuwaas oo ka caawiyay inuu barto habka loo kalluumeysto. Wuxuu adeegsadaa shabaag yar oo uu badda ku tuurto. Ma yaqaan si loogu dabaasho biyaha uu maalin kasta qarka u fadhiyo ama uu gudaha u galo illaa xaddi aan liqi karin. Wuxuu sheegay inuu aad uga baqo qatarta badda oo uusan aqoon xeelad looga badbaado. “Mararka qaar hirka oo kacsan ayaan isku dayaa inaan kalluun kala soo baxo badda, anigana dabaal ma aqaan. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in shaqadan ay tahay tii ugu horeysay oo uu ka shaqeeyo, uuna ka helay dhiiri galin, maaddama uu markii hore ahaa qof waalidkiis culeys ku ah oo aan is dabari karin, halka maanta uu yahay qof tiisa ku filan oo waalidkiis iyo walaalihiis caawinaya. Wuxuu xusay in dhallinyaradan ay ka go’an tahay inay badalaan noloshooda, balse ay wajahayaan caqabado agab la’aan ah, taas oo ay u baahan yihiin in laga taageero si ay u kor dhiyaan wax soo saarkooda. “Mudnaan ayaan siinaa dhallinyarada, sababtoo ah iyagoo aan laheyn xirfad badeed ayay ku dhiiradeen inay badda wax ka soo saartaan. items.fullContent: (ERGO) – Dhallinyaro badan oo ka soo jeeda qoysas soo barakacay iyo danyar deegaan ah ayaa si maalinle ah ugu kalluumeysi taga xeebaha magaalada Muqdisho. Ma haystaan doonyo, shabaag weyn iyo agabyo kale oo ka caawiya inay helaan kalluun badan. Waxay adeeg sadaan fiilooyin afka hore looga xiray bir qaloocan iyo shabaag yar. Shaqo la’aanta ayaa ku riixday in nolol maalmeedka ay ka raadiyaan kalluumeysiga oo aysan u haysan agab ku habboon iyo qibrad ku filan, balse dadaalkoodu wuxuu suurta galiyay in qoysaskooda ay ka saaraan cunno yari, ayna iska bixiyaan waxbarashada. Dhallinyaradaas waxaa ka mid ah Shuceyb Axmed Xuseen oo 34 jir ah. wuxuu sheegay in maalin kasta uu ka lugeeyo xerada uu deggan yahay ee Saacid oo ku taalla degmada Dayniile, si uu kalluun uga soo dabto xeebta Geelaq ee degmada Xamarweyne. Wuxuu xusay in shaqadan uu bishii ka helo dhaqaale u dhexeeya $100 illaa $150, kaas oo uu tilmaamay inuu wax ka badalay nolosha qoyskiisa, walaalihiis iyo waalidkiis oo kaligiis ku tiirsan. “Ugu yaraan laba jeer maalintii ayaan wax cunaa, haddii aysan saddex jeer noqon. Markii hore nin baaga muundo ayaan ahaa, wax badan aan hayn oo oo marna wax hela, marna waaya.  Hadda xaaladdaydu way isbeddeshay. Labo qoys ayaan ka billaa shaqadan.” Wuxuu ku shaqeystaa agab ka kooban fiilo afka hore bir qalloocan looga xiray oo uu ku gatay $28 oo uu ku caawiyay nin ay qaraabo yihiin. Kama tago goobta, isagoo hadba kalluunka ugu dhaca dabinka u soo saara bannaanka, xarigga ayuu biyaha dib ugu celiyaa, si mid kale uu u jillaabto. Waa howl uu ka doortay gaari gacan uu ku shaqeyn jiray, kaas oo sheegay in dhaqaalaha ka soo gali jiray oo aan ka badneyn $2 maalinkii uu ugu filnaan waayay in hal waqti ay dabka ku shitaan maalinkii. Hadda ayuu xusay inay helaan cunto ku filan, waloow uu sheegay in shaqadu ay tahay mid dhib badan oo uu ka shaqeeyo aroortii illaa gabal dhaca. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in xeebta oo ka fog uu labo saac u sii lugeeyo, intaas oo kalana ay ku qaadato soo noqoshadu. Noocyada kalluunka ee uu soo jillaabto ayuu u iib geeyaa suuqyada Muqdisho, iyadoo wixii u gadmi waaya uu sheegay in qoysku ay karsadaan. “Badda mar wax badan ayaa laga helaa oo way fiican tahay. Marna xagaa ayaa jira oo dabeyl ayay leedahay, markaas wax fiican lagama helo. Intaan xagaaga aheyn waxaan ka helaa kalluun fiican oo nolol maalmeedka aan ku maareeyo.” Shuceyb ayaa ah aabbaha saddex carruur ah oo sidoo kale dabara nolosha lix carruur ah oo la dhashay iyo labadiisa waalid. items.title: Ilkaha oo ka mid ah qaybaha ugu adag ee jidhka bini’aadamka
items.description: Ilkaha waxay ka mid yihiin qaybaha ugu adag ee jidhka bini’aadamka, waxayna awood u leeyihiin inay sii jiraan muddo aad u dheer ka dib marka ay dhinto qofka, taasoo ka dhigaysa kuwo muhiim u ah cilmi-baarista qadiimiga iyo cilmiga dambiyada . Dahaarka sare ee iligga, oo loo yaqaan enamel-ka, ayaa ah maaddada ugu adag ee jidhka bini’aadamka, waxaana uu ka kooban yahay 96% macdan, gaar ahaan kalsiyam iyo fosfoor . Cilmi-baarayaasha waxay sheegayaan in enamel-ku uu awood u leeyahay inuu u adkaysto sanado badan oo cunid, cadaadis, isbeddelka heerkulka, iyo saameynta cuntada iyo bakteeriyada. Sida laga soo xigtay Dr. Estelle Lazer, oo ah khubaro ku takhasusay cilmiga qadiimiga, ilkuhu waxay noqdaan qaybta ugu adag ee jidhka ka dib dhimashada, waxayna sii jiri karaan kumanaan sano . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, in la yiraahdo ilkuhu waa qaybta ugu dambeysa ee jidhka, waa wax la fududeeyay. Sida ay caddaynayaan khubarada, ilkuhu waxay uga adag yihiin unugyada jilicsan sida murqaha, maqaarka, iyo xubnaha gudaha, laakiin waxay ku xiran tahay jawiga ay ku jiraan. Qoyaanka, aashitada ciidda, heerkulka, iyo bakteeriyada ayaa dhammaantood saameyn ku yeelan kara xaaladda ilkaha . Waxaa intaa dheer, enamel-ka laftiisa waa mid adag, laakiin ma aha mid aan la burburin karin. Aashito xooggan ayaa si tartiib ah u milmi kara macdanta ku jirta, gaar ahaan ciidda aashitada leh. Qaybta kale ee muhiimka ah ee iligga waa dentin-ka, oo ka hooseeya enamel-ka, kaas oo ka jilicsan oo ay ku jirto maaddooyin dabiici ah oo fara badan, taasoo ka dhigaysa mid u nugul burburka . Gudaha iligga waxaa ku jira xudunta, oo ay ku jiraan neerfayaasha, xididdada dhiigga, iyo unugyada jilicsan, kuwaas oo aad uga jilicsan lakabyada sare. Ilkuhu waxay sii jiri karaan muddo aad u dheer, waxayna noqon karaan caddayn muhiim ah oo loo adeegsado cilmi-baarista qadiimiga iyo cilmiga dambiyada. Saynisyahannadu waxay baari karaan ilkaha si ay u ogaadaan cuntadii dadkii hore, caafimaadkooda, asalkooda juquraafiyeed, iyo xitaa qaybo ka mid ah taariikh nololeedkooda . Duraankoodu waxa uu sidoo kale sharxayaa sababta ilkuhu ay had iyo jeer uga dhex muuqdaan hadhaagii qadiimiga ah, xitaa ka dib marka ay unugyada kale baaba’an. Xaalado deegaan oo wanaagsan, ilkuhu waxay sii jiri karaan kumanaan sano. Sida laga soo xigtay cilmi-baaris dhow, enamel-ka ilkuhu waxay u adkaystaan isbeddelka deegaanka ka dib dhimashada ka badan lafaha, taasoo ay ugu wacan tahay maaddooyinka dabiiciga ah ee yar iyo qaab-dhismeedkooda gaarka ah . items.title: Supreme Court Annuls Galmudug Election Results
items.description: Somalia’s Federal Supreme Court has annulled the Galmudug election results. The court made the ruling on Monday. Judges found that the July 30 vote broke the constitution and the electoral law. Chief Justice Bashe Yusuf Ahmed announced the decision in Mogadishu. He also ordered a new election. This ruling matters for Somalia. Galmudug held its first direct election on July 30. The Galmudug election results are now void. That raises new doubts about Somalia’s shift to one-person, one-vote elections. It also adds strain between Mogadishu and Galmudug’s leaders. Supreme Court Judge, Bashe Yusuf Ahmed What the Court Decided Chief Justice Bashe Yusuf Ahmed announced the ruling after judges heard the case. They reviewed the evidence closely. Baashe said the vote broke Somalia’s constitution. “The elections were not administered in line with the constitution and the electoral law,” Baashe said, according to the court’s statement. Judges said the errors could not be fixed. They said the errors damaged the vote’s integrity. That damage reached the final results, the court said. Why the Galmudug Election Results Were Voided The July 30 election was a big moment for Galmudug. It was the state’s first direct vote. Citizens picked local council members and state lawmakers. Voting took place in 11 districts. Those districts sit in the Mudug and Galgaduud regions. However, tension built for months before the vote. Federal officials and Galmudug’s government disagreed on how to run the process. Critics also questioned the election body’s independence. As a result, judges found the flaws too serious. They chose to void the whole result instead of a partial fix. What Happens Next in Galmudug The court gave clear orders. It told Somalia’s electoral commission, the NIEBC, to hold a new vote. It said the commission must act soon. The new vote must follow the constitution and the electoral law. It must also follow related rules. Until then, the Galmudug election results remain void. Meanwhile, current Galmudug officials will stay in their posts. This avoids a gap in local government. New, lawfully elected officials will replace them later. Read more: Political tension builds ahead of Galmudug vote Read more: Somalia’s roll-out of one-person, one-vote elections Political Stakes for Somalia’s Federal System Galmudug is no stranger to political disputes. Its leaders and Mogadishu have clashed before over power and elections. This ruling reopens old tensions at a fragile time. This is the first time Galmudug election results have been annulled since direct voting began. Somalia’s federal government wants direct voting nationwide. Galmudug was only the second state to try it, after Southwest State. So a failed vote here matters beyond Galmudug’s borders. Meanwhile, Somalia is also preparing for national elections. Tensions between federal and state leaders remain high. As a result, many will watch closely to see if the rerun goes smoothly. Learn more from the National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission and the UN Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia . It said the commission must act soon. The new vote must follow the constitution and the electoral law. It must also follow related rules. Until then, the Galmudug election results remain void. Meanwhile, current Galmudug officials will stay in their posts. This avoids a gap in local government. New, lawfully elected officials will replace them later. Read more: Political tension builds ahead of Galmudug vote Read more: Somalia’s roll-out of one-person, one-vote elections Political Stakes for Somalia’s Federal System Galmudug is no stranger to political disputes. Its leaders and Mogadishu have clashed before over power and elections. This ruling reopens old tensions at a fragile time. This is the first time Galmudug election results have been annulled since direct voting began. Somalia’s federal government wants direct voting nationwide. Galmudug was only the second state to try it, after Southwest State. So a failed vote here matters beyond Galmudug’s borders. Meanwhile, Somalia is also preparing for national elections. Tensions between federal and state leaders remain high. As a result, many will watch closely to see if the rerun goes smoothly. Learn more from the National Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission and the UN Transitional Assistance Mission in Somalia . items.title: Somalia’s Supreme Court Annuls Galmudug Election Results, Orders Fresh Vote
items.description: Somalia’s Supreme Court on Monday annulled the results of Galmudug’s concurrent parliamentary and local council elections, ruling that the electoral process failed to comply with the country’s Constitution and election laws.

items.title: Maxkamadda Sare oo laashay natiijada doorashadii Galmudug
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka ayaa maanta go’aan cuus ka soo saartay doorashooyinkii isku sidkanaa ee Golaha Wakiillada iyo Goleyaasha Deegaanka ee dhawaan ka dhacay Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, kuwaas oo dhaliyay muran soo kala dhex-galay ururradii ka qayb-galay iyo guddiga madaxa-bannaan doorashooyinka iyo soohdimaha. Guddoomiyaha Maxkamadda Sare, Baashe Yuusuf Axmed ayaa ku dhowaaqay in maxkamaddu ay baabi’isay natiijada doorashooyinkaas, isaga oo shaaca ka qaaday in aan loo maamulin, loona qaban si waafaqsan dastuurka iyo sharciga doorashooyinka dalka. “Maxkamaddu waxya go’aamisay in doorashooyinkii isku sidkanaa ee Golaha wakiilada iyo Goleyaasha Deegaanka ee 30-kii Luulyo ka dhacay Dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug aan loo maamulin, loona qaban si waafaqsan dastuurka iyo sharciga doorashooyinka dalka, sidaas darteedna ay tahay natiijadeeda mid aan sax ahayn oo waxba kama jiraan ah” ayuu yiri Guddoomiye Baashe. Sidoo kale, wuxuu intaas ku daray in maxkamaddu ogaatay in khaladaadkii dhacay ay dhaawac weyn u geysteen hufnaanta doorashada, taas oo saameysay natiijadeeda, isla markaana laga soo qaaday waxba kama jiraan. “Waxaa kale oo maxkamadda go’aamisay in khaladaadkii dhacay ay ahaayeen kuwa aan la sixi karin, isla markaana dhaawac wayn u gaystay hufnaanta xornimada iyo xalaalnimada doorashooyinka saameyn tabana ku yeeshay natiijadooda,” ayuu sii raaciyay guddoomiyuhu. Dhanka kale, Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka waxay amartay guddiga doorashada in uu dib ugu noqdo doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee Galmudug, isaga oo ku qabanayo waqtiga ugu dhow ee macquulka ah. Waxaa kale oo ay Maxkamadda sheegtay in inta lagu guda jiro diyaarinta iyo qabashada doorashada cusub ay shaqada sii wadayaan hay’adaha hadda ka jira Galmudug, si looga hortago firaaq dastuuri oo uu galo maamulkaasi. Si kastaba, Go’aankan xasaasiga ah ayaa saameyn weyn ku yeelan kara xaaladda siyaasadeed ee Galmudug iyo guud ahaan dalka, taas oo uga sii dareysa xaaladda cakiran ee ka dhalatay marxaladda kala guurka ee lagu jiro. items.title: Gunfire, bulldozers and f-16 jets: Inside Somalia’s bloody midnight raid that emptied a Mogadishu slum
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s federal security forces killed at least five people and wounded more than ten others in Mogadishu on Sunday, local media reported, during a violent operation to forcibly clear the Tookiyo settlement in the capital’s Yaqshid district – one of the bloodiest eruptions yet in a widening campaign of slum demolitions that has left the city’s poorest residents with nowhere to go. The operation began shortly after midnight on Saturday and stretched into Sunday, as security forces moved into the settlement to force out residents ahead of planned demolitions. Crowds of residents met the advancing troops with a hail of stones in a desperate bid to hold their ground. Witnesses said the response was disproportionate and indiscriminate: soldiers opened fire on the densely packed neighbourhood, scattering the crowd in panic. Disturbing video footage circulating widely on social media appeared to show government “technical” pickup trucks mounted with DShK heavy machine guns – weapons designed for anti-aircraft use – being fired into the residential area, a tactic residents said was intended to terrorise rather than merely disperse. Adding to the sense of siege, journalists and opposition leaders reported low-altitude flights by Turkish Air Force F-16 fighter jets over the neighbourhood during the operation. They characterised the flights as a show of force coordinated between Ankara and the federal government, intended to intimidate residents already bracing for the loss of homes they say they have no way to replace. Beyond opening fire on residents at point-blank range, security forces have also been accused of storming homes and beating occupants – including children, the elderly and women – inside during a raid residents described as carried out with impunity. “Cowards” who “flee” Al-Shabaab, opposition leader says Former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, a prominent opposition leader, delivered a scathing condemnation of the security units involved, accusing them of battlefield cowardice against Al-Shabaab militants that he said stood in stark contrast to their brutality against unarmed civilians in Tookiyo. He said the same forces who abandon their positions when deployed against the insurgency had instead sought to appear heroic by opening fire on defenceless residents. Land sold to the politically connected, journalists say At the heart of the anger driving the unrest is a familiar and bitter grievance: residents and journalists say the land being cleared in Tookiyo has already been sold off to wealthy, politically connected buyers, including a close relative of the president. That same figure, Himilo TV journalists said in a video posted on Facebook, was previously tied to a similar demolition at Mogadishu’s Siinaay market, where the cleared land was likewise funneled into private hands. Also named in the allegations is a former Banadir regional land-tax director, who was previously charged with corruption before a regional court. The government has defended its wider clearance campaign by insisting the capital will not be allowed to harbour informal slums and that all such settlements will eventually be cleared. But that position has drawn mounting criticism from residents, rights advocates and opposition figures who say the state has offered no answer to the most basic question raised by its own policy: where are displaced families supposed to go, and what, if anything, has been offered in place of the homes being destroyed. A pattern beyond the slums Residents say the demolitions extend beyond informally settled land. Authorities have also sold privately owned properties – including plots for which occupants hold legal title – to wealthy businessmen, displacing hundreds of families from homes they legally own. Security forces carried out the evictions by force, residents say, leaving many of the families destitute. Even government allies break ranks The scale of public anguish has drawn criticism even from voices generally sympathetic to the administration. Sheikh Bashir Ahmed Salad, one of the most prominent pro-government religious scholars, recently issued a pointed condemnation of the land seizures, calling on the authorities to fear God and cease abusing their power against the poor and defenceless. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Somalia Accelerates National Skills Development to Tackle Youth Unemployment
items.description: Mogadishu – The Federal Government of Somalia has formally accelerated its national strategy for skills development and job creation, with the newly established National Committee for Skills Development and Employment holding its inaugural meeting today. The committee, composed of representatives from 13 federal ministries, convened to discuss a coordinated approach to equipping Somali workers with market-relevant competencies and addressing the country’s chronic unemployment challenges. The initiative signals a major policy shift toward tackling one of Somalia’s most pressing socio-economic issues: a rapidly growing youth population with limited access to formal employment opportunities. With an estimated 70 percent of Somalis under the age of 30, the government faces immense pressure to create sustainable livelihoods and reduce the economic vulnerabilities that extremist groups exploit for recruitment. Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre appointed the committee on July 18, 2026, tasking it with coordinating federal efforts across multiple sectors to bridge the gap between education, training, and labor market needs. The committee, chaired by the Prime Minister’s Office, brings together ministries including Education, Labor , Agriculture, Commerce, and Telecommunications to ensure a unified policy framework. Following the virtual meeting, committee officials outlined a comprehensive strategy focusing on digital technology, ICT, manufacturing, agriculture, livestock, and business innovation. The plan emphasizes aligning training programs with market demands and technological changes, moving away from generic curricula toward targeted, industry-specific skill development. “We are committed to building a skilled workforce that can meet domestic needs and reduce our heavy reliance on imported labor and services,” a senior official from the Prime Minister’s Office told reporters after the meeting, speaking on condition of anonymity. “This is a critical step toward economic self-sufficiency and sustainable development.” The initiative is expected to prioritize youth and women, who face the highest barriers to employment. By fostering entrepreneurship and technical skills, the government aims to expand the tax base, attract investment, and create a more resilient economy that can withstand external shocks. The inaugural session lays the groundwork for implementation, with the committee expected to develop a detailed action plan in the coming weeks, including identifying priority sectors for investment and establishing partnerships with the private sector and international donors. This comprehensive approach reflects a recognition that job creation must be central to Somalia’s broader state-building and stabilization efforts. items.title: Kooxda haysata markabkii hubka u soo siday Muqdisho oo soo bandhigtay dalab culus
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xog soo baxaysa ayaa sheegaysa in kooxda burcad-badeedda ah ee gacanta ku haysa markabka M/V LUTUF ay dalbatay lacag madax-furasho ah oo ku dhow laba milyan oo dollar, si loo sii daayo markabka iyo shaqaalaha saaran. Dalabka madax-furashada ayaan weli si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin, balse wuxuu kusoo aadayaa iyadoo xaaladda M/V LUTUF ay sii jiitamayso, isla markaana falalka burcad-badeednimada Soomaalida ay si muuqata dib ugu soo xoogeysanayaan xeebaha Soomaaliya, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo biyaha ku dhow Yemen. M/V LUTUF, oo wata calanka Cameroon, ayaa 17-kii Agoosto lagu qafaashay meel qiyaastii 3.5 mayl-badeed u jirta Marraya oo ka tirsan degmada Eyl ee Puntland. Siddeed nin oo hubeysan ayaa la sheegay inay markabka fuuleen, kadibna u jiheeyeen dhinaca xeebaha gobolka Nugaal. Markabka waxaa saarnaa 10 qof oo shaqaale ah, kuwaas oo kala ah lix Hindi ah, hal Turki ah, hal Georgian ah iyo laba Serbian ah oo ilaalo ahaan u saarnaa. Sarkaal Soomaali ah, oo codsaday in aan la magacaabin, ayaa sheegay in markabku siday hub, qalabka isgaarsiinta iyo qalabka dayax-gacmeedka oo ku wajahnaa xarunta tababarka ciidamada Turkiga ee Muqdisho ee TURKSOM. Dowladda Turkiga si rasmi ah ugama hadlin faahfaahinta shixnadda. Dhacdadan ayaa yeelatay xasaasiyad dheeraad ah maadaama shixnadda lagu sheegay qalab militari. Wararka soo baxay maalmo kadib qafaashada ayaa sheegay in laba markab oo laga leeyahay Turkiga ay ku dhowaadeen goobta lagu hayey LUTUF, halka diyaarado helikobtarro iyo drones ah ay la socdeen dhaqdhaqaaqa markabka. 18-kii Agoosto, doon yar oo qaad u geysay kooxda haysata markabka ayaa dib ugu laabatay xeebta, waxaana wax yar kadib halkaas ka dhacay duqeyn lagu dilay afar qof laguna dhaawacay laba kale. Ilaa hadda si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin cidda fulisay weerarkaas iyo in dadka la dilay ay xiriir la lahaayeen kooxdii markabka qabsatay. Burcad-badeednimada oo dib usoo laabatay Kiiska LUTUF ma aha dhacdo gooni ah. Saddex maalmood kadib, 20-kii Agoosto, lix nin oo hubeysan ayaa qabsaday markabka shidaalka M.T. Sibu 1, xilli uu marayey meel qiyaastii 136 mayl-badeed bari kaga beegan magaalada Al Mukalla ee Yemen, kadibna waxay usoo jiheeyeen dhinaca xeebaha Puntland. Sibu 1 waxaa saarnaa 20 shaqaale ah, oo 16 ka mid ah ay yihiin Hindi. Markabka ayaa sidoo kale horey cunaqabateyn uga saarneyd dowladda Mareykanka, oo ku eedeysay inuu qeyb ka ahaa maraakiib loo adeegsado dhoofinta shidaalka Iran si looga baxsado cunaqabateynta. Qabsashada Sibu 1 waxay tirada maraakiibta ganacsiga ee burcad-badeedda Soomaalida qabsadeen tan iyo 21-kii Abriil gaarsiisay lix: Honor 25, Sward, Eureka, Asana, LUTUF iyo Sibu 1. Honor 25 ayaa la qabsaday 21-kii Abriil, Sward 26-kii Abriil, Eureka 2-dii May, halka Asana la qabsaday 17-kii July. Dhammaadkii July, howlgalka Midowga Yurub ee ATALANTA wuxuu sheegay in afarta markab ee ugu horreeyey weli lagu hayey meel u dhow xeebaha waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya, iyadoo tobannaan shaqaale ah ay gacanta ugu jireen burcad-badeedda. Tani waxay muujineysaa in waxa markii hore loo arkayey weerarro goos-goos ah ay hadda isu beddelayaan hannaan joogto ah oo dib u soo celinaya walaacii muddo ka badan toban sano ka hor ka jiray xeebaha Soomaaliya. Hay’adda International Maritime Bureau ayaa sheegtay in qeybtii hore ee 2026 dunida laga diiwaangeliyey 38 dhacdo oo burcad-badeednimo iyo weerarro hubeysan oo ka dhacay badda, oo shan ka mid ahi ahaayeen qafaalasho markab. Burcad-badeedda Soomaalida ayaa mas’uul ka ahaa 94% shaqaalihii maraakiibta ee dunida afduub ahaan loo haystay muddadaas. Soo noqoshada burcad-badeednimada waxaa loo aaneynayaa dhowr arrimood oo is biirsaday. Waxaa ka mid ah hoos u dhaca joogitaanka ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah, maraakiib dagaal oo loo weeciyey xiisadaha ka jira Badda Cas iyo Bariga Dhexe, iyo kooxaha burcad-badeedda oo mar kale awood u yeeshay inay helaan dhaqaale, doonyo iyo shabakado dhulka ka taageera. Ganacsi horey u sameeyey boqolaal milyan Dalabka ku dhow labada milyan ee dollar ee hadda laga soo sheegayo LUTUF wuxuu dib u xusuusinayaa qaabkii ganacsi ee burcad-badeedda Soomaalida xilligii ay ugu xoogga badnaayeen. Daraasad ballaaran oo Bankiga Adduunka, Xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee Daroogada iyo Dambiyada – UNODC – iyo INTERPOL ay soo saareen 2013, laguna magacaabay Pirate Trails , ayaa lagu qiyaasay in intii u dhexeysay Abriil 2005 iyo Diseembar 2012 lacag u dhexeysa $339 milyan iyo $413 milyan lagu bixiyey madax-furashada maraakiib ay burcad-badeeddu ka qabsadeen Soomaaliya iyo Geeska Afrika. Mudadaas waxaa la qafaashay 179 markab, waxaana burcad-badeednimadu isu beddeshay ganacsi abaabulan oo ay ka qeyb qaataan ragga weerarka fulinaya, maalgeliyeyaasha bixiya kharashka howlgalka, dadka sahayda keena, waardiyeyaasha xeebaha iyo kuwa wada wada-xaajoodyada madax-furashada. Lacagta ugu badan ma aysan ku ekaan ragga hubeysan ee markabka fuula. Baaritaanka Pirate Trails wuxuu muujiyey in lacagaha madax-furashada loo kala gudbin jiray shabakado ballaaran, iyadoo qaar ka mid ah maalgeliyeyaasha iyo qabanqaabiyeyaasha ay qaadan jireen saamiga ugu weyn. Lacagahaas ayaa kadib loo marin jiray lacag caddaan ah, xawaalado iyo ganacsiyo kale. Celceliska madax-furashada markabkiiba ayaa 2011 iyo 2012 gaarayey qiyaastii $4.9 milyan, taas oo muujineysa heerka dhaqaale ee ay burcad-badeednimadu gaartay xilligii ugu sarreeyey. Burcad-badeednimada Soomaaliya ayaa si weyn hoos ugu dhacday wixii ka dambeeyey 2012, kadib markii la kordhiyey ciidamada badda ee caalamiga ah, maraakiibta ganacsigu qaateen ilaalo hubeysan iyo tallaabooyin amni oo adag, halka ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo kuwa maamul goboleedyaduna cadaadis saareen saldhigyadii xeebaha. Hase yeeshee, dhacdooyinka isdaba-joogga ah ee 2026 ayaa hadda abuuraya cabsi ah in kooxihii iyo shabakadihii ganacsigan saldhigga u ahaa ay mar kale helayaan fursad ay dib ugu soo nooleeyaan nidaamkii qafaalashada maraakiibta iyo dalabka madax-furashada ee muddo sanado ah halista weyn ku ahaa marinnada ganacsiga ee ku dhow Soomaaliya.
