items.title: Turkey Seeks Interpol Red Notice for Netanyahu as Gaza and Syria Disputes Escalate
items.description: Ankara (WDN) — Turkey has dramatically escalated its confrontation with Israel, launching a legal campaign seeking an Interpol Red Notice for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over a criminal case linked to the interception of the Global Sumud Flotilla, which was carrying humanitarian aid toward Gaza. Turkish Justice Minister Akın Gürlek said his ministry had asked the Interior Ministry to initiate the Interpol process against Netanyahu and Israeli official Afek Moskovitch. The request follows arrest warrants issued by an Istanbul court on July 14 in a case involving 35 defendants. According to Gürlek, the defendants are accused of serious crimes arising from the alleged interception and detention of activists aboard the Gaza-bound flotilla in international waters. The charges include genocide, crimes against humanity, torture, intentional injury, aggravated deprivation of liberty, property destruction and hijacking of means of transportation. These remain allegations in a Turkish domestic proceeding, not convictions. Turkey’s move is significant, but a Red Notice is not itself an international arrest warrant. It is a request to police forces worldwide to locate a wanted person and potentially detain them temporarily pending extradition or other legal proceedings. Each country ultimately decides what action to take under its own laws. That means Netanyahu would not automatically be arrested if Interpol issues the notice. However, it could complicate his international travel and expose him to potential detention in jurisdictions that choose to act on the request. Gürlek said Ankara would use every available legal avenue to pursue accountability and would not allow those accused of serious crimes to benefit from what he described as a “shield of impunity.” Netanyahu Strikes Back at Erdoğan Israel has responded with equal force. Netanyahu’s office accused Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan of hypocrisy and described him in highly inflammatory terms, while accusing his government of supporting Hamas, suppressing political opponents and destabilizing the region. Israel also rejected Ankara’s allegations and said it would continue defending its security interests. The exchange underscores how far relations between Ankara and Jerusalem have deteriorated since the Gaza war. The legal confrontation comes at a particularly volatile moment in Turkish-Israeli relations, with Syria emerging as another major arena of strategic competition. Israel recently struck the Abu al-Duhur military airfield in Syria’s Idlib province, amid concerns over Turkey’s growing military presence and influence in Syria. Ankara condemned the Israeli action and rejected claims that Turkish forces posed a threat to Israel. The dispute reflects competing visions for Syria’s postwar order. Turkey has developed close ties with Syria’s new government, while Israel is increasingly concerned about Ankara’s expanding military footprint and regional influence. From Diplomatic Rift to Legal Confrontation Turkey and Israel once maintained substantial diplomatic and economic ties. The Gaza war, however, transformed the relationship into one of the region’s most bitter confrontations. Ankara has emerged as one of Israel’s most vocal critics over its military campaign in Gaza, while Israel has repeatedly accused Erdoğan of supporting Hamas. The dispute has now moved beyond political rhetoric. A domestic criminal case in Istanbul, arrest warrants, an attempted Interpol action and an escalating confrontation over Syria have created a new and potentially consequential front between the two governments. For Netanyahu, the immediate question is whether Interpol will approve Turkey’s request and, if so, how individual countries respond. For Erdoğan, the move represents an effort to use Turkey’s domestic judicial system and international law to increase pressure on Israel. What began as a diplomatic rupture over Gaza is increasingly becoming a multidimensional confrontation—legal, political, military and strategic—with consequences extending well beyond the borders of Turkey and Israel. items.title: Ethiopia’s Constitutional Debate: Abiy Ahmed Accused of Seeking Presidential Powers and a Weaker Federal System
items.description: Addis Ababa (WDN) — Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed is reportedly seeking a sweeping overhaul of the country’s political system that could transform Ethiopia from a parliamentary federation into a presidential system and give the head of state significantly greater executive authority. Under the reported proposal, Abiy could seek to become Ethiopia’s first president with full executive powers and serve two six-year terms. If adopted, the proposal would represent one of the most consequential changes to Ethiopia’s constitutional order since the current federal system was established. The reported initiative is part of a broader debate over constitutional reform that has emerged within Ethiopia’s National Dialogue process and the ruling Prosperity Party. From Parliamentary Rule to Presidential Power Ethiopia currently operates under a parliamentary system in which the Prime Minister is the head of government, while the president is largely a ceremonial head of state. The prime minister is elected by the House of Peoples’ Representatives, normally from the political party or coalition that commands a majority. The proposed shift would fundamentally alter that arrangement. A presidential system would concentrate executive authority in the presidency and could significantly strengthen the central government, particularly if the president were given a direct electoral mandate and broad powers over national institutions. Reports indicate that some participants in the National Dialogue on August 13 proposed replacing the existing parliamentary system with a presidential model. Abiy himself reportedly raised the issue in July 2026 when addressing members of the Prosperity Party, emphasizing the idea that the country’s leader should be limited to two terms. Critics, however, question whether term limits alone would provide sufficient protection against excessive concentration of power if the presidency itself were granted substantially greater constitutional authority. The proposed constitutional changes have also raised concerns about the future of Ethiopia’s federal structure. Ethiopia’s federal system gives significant constitutional powers to regional states, including authority over matters of self-government and cultural and political affairs. One of the most controversial provisions is Article 39, which recognizes the right of Ethiopia’s nations, nationalities and peoples to self-determination, including the right to secession. For decades, Article 39 has effectively served as the federation’s ultimate constitutional exit door—a powerful guarantee intended to reassure Ethiopia’s diverse nationalities that membership in the federation is not irrevocable. Any attempt to remove, weaken or substantially restrict that provision would therefore have implications far beyond constitutional wording. It would raise a fundamental question: Can Ethiopia remain a genuinely federal state if the regions’ ultimate constitutional safeguard is removed while executive authority is simultaneously concentrated at the center? Critics of the reported proposals fear that the combination of a powerful presidency and reduced regional autonomy could gradually transform Ethiopia’s federal system into a more centralized state. Such a change could alter the balance between Addis Ababa and the regional governments, particularly in areas involving political representation, security, resource management and regional self-government. Supporters of constitutional reform, however, may argue that a presidential system could provide greater political stability, clearer executive accountability and a more direct relationship between voters and national leadership. The central issue is therefore not simply whether Ethiopia should change its political system, but how much power should be concentrated at the federal level and what constitutional safeguards should remain in place to protect the regions. Article 39: The Constitutional Exit Door The debate surrounding Article 39 is potentially even more sensitive. The provision has long been one of the defining features of Ethiopia’s federal constitution. It recognizes the rights of nations, nationalities and peoples to self-determination, including secession under constitutional procedures. Removing or weakening that provision would eliminate what many regard as the federation’s ultimate guarantee that regional identities and political aspirations cannot simply be overridden by the central government. For opponents of the proposed changes, the danger is clear: a stronger presidency combined with a weaker federal structure and a diminished Article 39 could fundamentally redistribute power from Ethiopia’s regions to Addis Ababa. Ethiopia is therefore approaching a potentially historic constitutional debate. A transition from parliamentary government to an executive presidency would not merely change the title of the country’s leader. It would redefine the relationship between the executive, parliament, regional states and the electorate. If accompanied by restrictions on regional autonomy and changes to Article 39, the reforms could represent an even deeper transformation—the movement away from Ethiopia’s current multinational federal model toward a more centralized political order. For Abiy Ahmed, the proposed two-term limit could provide a framework for a new presidential era. For Ethiopia’s regional states, however, the more consequential question may be what happens to their constitutional powers once the center becomes significantly stronger. The debate is ultimately about more than who occupies the presidential palace. It is about where power resides—and whether Ethiopia’s federal compact will be strengthened, fundamentally rewritten, or gradually hollowed out from the center. items.title: Xukuumadda oo u hanjabtay  ninka Burco mudaharaadka kaga dhawaaqay
Farmaajo oo arrin xasaasi ah ka dalbaday Xasan Sheekh kadib markii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Maxamed Cabdullahi Maxamed (Farmaajo) oo warsaxaafadeed soo saaray ayaa ka hadlay xaaladda adag ee ka taagan magaalada Muqdisho, gaar ahaan barakicinta iyo dhulboobka sii xoogeysanaya ee ka socda caasimada. Farmaajo oo weerar ku qaaday Dowladda Federaalka ayaa fal-bahallnimo ku tilmaamay in saq-dhexe guryaha laga dumiyo shacabka, gaar ahaan dadka danta yar, wuxuuna tallaabadan ku sifeeyay mid ka fog damiirka bani’aadannimo iyo dareenka Muslimnimo. “Dhul boobka xargaha goostay iyo barakicinta joogtada ah ee lagu hayo bulshada caasimadda waa masiibo halis ah. In saq dhexe guryohooda lagu kor dumiyo muwaadiniin isugu jira carruur, haween, waayeel iyo qoysas danyar ah waa fal bahalnimo ah oo ka fog damiirka bani’aadannimo iyo dareenka Muslimnimo” ayuu ku yiri qoraalkiisa. Dhanka kale Farmaajo ayaa farriin u diray Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh isag oo ka codsaday inuu joojiyo dhulboobka ka socda Muqdisho iyo barakicinta lagu hayo shacabka. “Madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisu dhammaaday waxaan ugu baaqaynaa in uu si degdeg ah u joojiyo dhul boobka, barakicinta shacabka iyo adeegsiga sharcidarrada ah ee ciidamada iyo hay’adihii dowladda oo uu ka dhigay aalad uu ku barakiciyo, marna ku cabburiyo muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee uu dulmiyey,” ayuu mar kale yiri Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka. Waxaa kale oo uu kusii daray “Ma jiro qiil iyo marmarsiinyo uu Madaxweynaha muddo xileedkiisu dhammaaday uu u heli karo in uu muwaadiniin Soomaaliyeed habeen madow guryahooda xoog uga saaro, hantidoodana uu hortooda ku burburiyo, isaga oo ciidamadii qaranka u adeegsanaya.” Ugu dambayn, Farmaajo ayaa xusay inuu garab taagan yahay qoysaska guryahooda laga dumiyey, kuwa la barakiciyey iyo dhammaan muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee ku dhaqan caasimadda Muqdisho ee,”la dulmiyey”, kuwaas oo u taagan difaaca xaqooda iyo karaamadooda”. Bayaanka, Madaxweyne hore Farmaajo waxaa ka horreeyay qaylo dhaan kale oo ay galabta mucaaradka kasoo saareen dhulboobka ka socda magaalada Muqdisho, iyaga oo si gaar ah u cambaareeyay weerar xalay lagu qaaday xaafadda Tookiyo ee degmada Yaaqshiid oo maanta burburin lagu bilaabay. The post Farmaajo oo arrin xasaasi ah ka dalbaday Xasan Sheekh kadib markii… appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Fal-celin aan caadi ahayn oo ka dhalatay tallaabo uu maanta qaaday Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Fal-celin aan caadi ahayn ayaa ka dhalatay tallaaboo uu maanta uu qaaday Ra’iisul wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre, kadib markii uu kormeer shaqo ku tagay Wasaaradda Qorsheynta, Maalgashiga iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalah, taasi oo hoggaamineysa diyaarinta warbixinta wax-qabadka xukuumadda DanQaran ee 2022 illaa 2026. Xamza ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in xukuumaddiisa muddadii ay jirtay ku tallaabsatay guulo wax-ku-ool ah, kuwaas oo ay saldhig u yihiin Qorshaha Isbeddelka Qaranka iyo Hiigsiga Qarni-jirka ah ee 2060, oo ah aragti ka timid madaxda sare ee dalka. “Waxa aan doonaynaa in laga wada shaqeeyo horumarka Qaranka, hirgalinta hiigsiga dalkeenna iyo midnimada ummadda, waxa aan hubaa in meesha aan u soconno ay fogtahay oo aysan dhowayn, wali kow ma joogno waxa ina sugaya jid-dheer oo u baahan samir iyo adkaysi, waxa aynu u soconnaa Soomaali mid ah”. ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre. Booqashadan ayaa kusoo aaday xilli xasaasi ah oo xiisad xooggan ay ka taagan tahay magaalada Muqdisho, taas oo ka dhalatay burburinta ay dowladda Soomaaliya ka wado caasimada oo kusii fiday xaafado horleh. Haddaba sidee looga fal-celiyay tallaabada uu qaaday Ra’iisul wasaaraha? Cabdinaasir Al-cadaala: “Mas’uuliyadda laguu dhiibay ma aha sharaf aad ku faanto oo keliya ee waa amaanad lagaa xisaabin doono. Qofkii dayaca waxa loo dhiibay, ha ogaado in maalinta uu awoodda hayay ay dhammaan doonto, balse xisaabta masuuliyadda ay hortiisa taagnaan doonto”. Xuseen Faarax: “Illahay been ayaad ka sheegtay, annaga waad na sirtay ee ma Illahay ayaad rabtay inaa sirto?”. Cabdiqani Warsame: “Dadka maatada ah ee aad barakicineysaan joojiya , waxqabad meesha ku mahaysaan”. Axmed Xirsi: “Siyaasadda aad usoo aaday inaad Jannada ku gasho maanta Xamsow reerkaaga Masar ayay ku dagan yihiin saq-dhexena reeraha aad guryayaha ugu daadanaysaan sidii burcaddii barakacinaysan laynaysaan boobaysaan Illahay waa idin jeeeda, waana caadil”. Cabdalle Rooble: “Mudane Raisul wasaare ummadda been waad u sheegi kartaa lkn Allah been uma sheegi kartid warkaada iyo wacaalkada ismalahan”. Ifraax Maxamuud: “Waxaad raali ka noqotay barakicinta masaakiinta adigoo raali gelinaya bini’aadam waxba ku dheereyn Allah ka cabso raysul wazaare xukuumadaada maatada yaan lagu hoos dulmin”. The post Fal-celin aan caadi ahayn oo ka dhalatay tallaabo uu maanta qaaday Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Haddaba sidee looga fal-celiyay tallaabada uu qaaday Ra’iisul wasaaraha? Cabdinaasir Al-cadaala: “Mas’uuliyadda laguu dhiibay ma aha sharaf aad ku faanto oo keliya ee waa amaanad lagaa xisaabin doono. Qofkii dayaca waxa loo dhiibay, ha ogaado in maalinta uu awoodda hayay ay dhammaan doonto, balse xisaabta masuuliyadda ay hortiisa taagnaan doonto”. Xuseen Faarax: “Illahay been ayaad ka sheegtay, annaga waad na sirtay ee ma Illahay ayaad rabtay inaa sirto?”. Cabdiqani Warsame: “Dadka maatada ah ee aad barakicineysaan joojiya , waxqabad meesha ku mahaysaan”. Axmed Xirsi: “Siyaasadda aad usoo aaday inaad Jannada ku gasho maanta Xamsow reerkaaga Masar ayay ku dagan yihiin saq-dhexena reeraha aad guryayaha ugu daadanaysaan sidii burcaddii barakacinaysan laynaysaan boobaysaan Illahay waa idin jeeeda, waana caadil”. Cabdalle Rooble: “Mudane Raisul wasaare ummadda been waad u sheegi kartaa lkn Allah been uma sheegi kartid warkaada iyo wacaalkada ismalahan”. Ifraax Maxamuud: “Waxaad raali ka noqotay barakicinta masaakiinta adigoo raali gelinaya bini’aadam waxba ku dheereyn Allah ka cabso raysul wazaare xukuumadaada maatada yaan lagu hoos dulmin”. items.title: Mucaaradka oo war culus kasoo saaray diyaarado dowladda maanta u adeegsatay…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xubnaha Madasha Samatabixinta Soomaaliyeed oo galabta shir ku yeeshay magaalada Muqdisho ayaa ka hadlay tallaabadii ugu dambeysay ee ay dowladda qaaday, gaar ahaan howlgallada burburinta ee weli kasii socda qaar kamid ah degmooyinka Gobolka Banaadir. Siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ayaa mar kale qaylo dhaan culus kasoo saaray dhulboobka socda, iyaga oo eedeymo u jeediyay Dowladda Federaalka ah ee uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Xubnaha Madasha Samatabixinta ayaa si gaar ah uga hadlay howlgalkii maanta lagu beegsaday Tookiyada degmada Yaaqshiid, waxayna tacsi u direen ehelladii dadkii ku dhintay halkaas, iyaga oo kuwa dhaawaca u rajeeyay caafimaad deg-deg ah. Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Cosoble Cali oo goobta ka hadlay ayaa sheegay inay garab taagan yihiin dadka la barakiciyay oo uu tilmaamay in loo adeegsaday hubkii iyo ciidamada dowladda, loona soo kacsaday diyaarado, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. “Qofka isagoo hantidiisa difaacanaya dhinta Jannada ayuu galayaa, shacabka naftooda ha difaacdaan, qoray iyo dhagax wax kasta oo ay heli karaan, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh nin ka xishoonaayo hantida shacabka maaha, guryihiina ayuu u soo socdaa, wuxuu gaaray heer diyaarad uu ku argagax galiyo dad maras ah” ayuu yiri Xildhibaan Cabdulqaadir Cosoble. Dhankiisa, Madaxweynihii hore ee Galmudug Cabdikariin Xuseen Guuleed oo ka hadlay shirka jaraa’id ayaa farriin culus u diray shacabka Muqdisho, wuxuuna ugu baaqay inay kacaan, isla markaana ay ka hortgaan dulmiga. “Shacabka ha kacaan, intaan ka badan Xasan Sheekh looma adkaysan karo, Dowladd ma’ahan midan hadda jirta,” ayuu yiri Cabdikariin Xuseen Guuleed. Ra’iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Cali Khayre ayaa isna u digay saraakiisha iyo ciidamada dowladda ee qaybta ka ah howlaha burburinta, wuxuuna sheegay in berri lagula xisaabtami doono dhibaatada ay maanta gaystaan “Saraakiisha ciidanka ee qaybta ka ah dulmiga socda ogaada waa idin naqaana, ma qarsanidiin, hanoqonina maliibaanayaashii lagu liibaanay,” ayuu yiri Xasan Cali Khayre. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, iyada oo todobaadyadii ugu dambeeyay ay mar kale soo rogaal celisay xiisadda dhulalka ee Muqdisho, waxaana ugu dambeysay maanta oo cagta la mariyay xaafadda Tookiyo e degmada Yaaqshiid, kadib markii xalay saq-dhexe lagu daadiyay ciidamo dheeraad ah. items.title: Guddoomiye Muungaab oo qaaday tallaabo la xiriirta cabashooyinka dhulalka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Gobolka Banaadir ahna Duqa Magaalada Muqdisho, Mudane Xasan Maxamed Xuseen (Muungaab) oo maanta oo axad ah Aqalka Dowladda Hoose ee Xamar kulan wadi-tashi ah kula qaatay Wasiirka Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka XFS, Sheikh Mukhtaar Roobow Cali, Wasiir-kuxigeenka Wasaaradda, iyo Hoggaanka Midawga Golayaasha Culumada Soomaaliyeed ayaa qaaday tallaabo culus oo la xiriirta xiisadda dhulalka ee haatan ka taagan gudaha caasimada. Ujeedka kulankan ayaa ahaa in dowladda iyo culumada Soomaaliyeed ay si wadajir ah uga tashadaan maareynta iyo xal-u-helidda cabashada shacabka ee la xiriirta dhulka, xilli ay magaalada Muqdisho ka socdaan dadaallo la sheegay in owladdu ay dib ugu habeynayso dhulalka danta guud iyo Obasiibooyinka ku yaalla qaar kamid ah degmooyinka Gobolka Banaadir. Inta uu socday kulanka ayaa sidoo kale falanqeyn iyo dood dheer kadib, waxaa kasoo baxay saddex qodob oo xasaasi ah oo ay soo saareen Duqa Muqdisho iyo culumada oo la kulmay, kuwaas oo kala ;- 1. Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa soo dhaweeyay talooyinka culumada ee ku saabsan arrimaha dhulka gaarka loo leeyahay, waxaana uu Maamulku hoosta ka xarriiqay in ilaalinta milkiyadda sida gaarka loo leeyahay ay tahay arrin mar waliba mudnaan gooni ah u leh Maamulka, isla markaana aanan marnaba la ogolayn in lagu xadgudbo dhul ay shacab leeyihiin. 2. Midawga Golayaasha Culumaa’uddiinka Soomaaliyeed waxay qireen in dowladdu ay xaq sharci ah u leedahay maamulidda, bixinta, iyo dib-u-qaabeynta dhulka danta guud iyo Obasiibooyinka, iyadoo la ilaalinayo maslaxadda caamka ah, lana tixgelinayo dadka danyarta ah. 3. Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir waxa uu caddeynayaa in uu mar walba diyaar u yahay dhegeysiga iyo xal-u-helidda cabashada muwaaddiniinta, arrintaas oo ay u xilsaaran yihiin Guddiyo heer Maamul ah (sida Guddiga Xalinta Khilaafaadka Dhulka), iyo guddiyo gaar ah oo ay ku jiraan Culumaa’udiinka iyo bulshada qeybaheeda kale. Ugu dambeyn, Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, Wasaaradda Awqaafta iyo Arrimaha Islaamka, iyo Culumaa’uddiinka Soomaaliyeed waxa ay isla qaateen in la joogteeyo iska-war-qabka lana xoojiyo wada-shaqaynta dhexdooda ah oo ku salaysan danta Diinta, Dadka, iyo Dalka, sida lagu sheegay bayaan kasoo baxay kulanka oo lagu shaaciyay bigga rasmiga ah ee Gobolka Banaadir. Muqdisho ayaa waxaa haatan ka taagan xaalad adag oo ka dhalatay howlaha burburinta e dhulalka, waxaana ugu dambeeyay maanta oo shacab fara badan laga barakiciyay xaafadda Tookiyo ee degmada Yaaqshood oo xalay saq-dhexe la geeyay ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa ammaanka ee dowladda Soomaaliya.   The post Guddoomiye Muungaab oo qaaday tallaabo la xiriirta cabashooyinka dhulalka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somalia defends Turkish drone strike Puntland says killed civilians
items.description: MOADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s State Minister of Defense, Omar Ali Abdi, on Saturday broke the federal government’s silence over alleged Turkish drone strike that killed at least four people off the coast of Garmaal, in Puntland’s Nugaal region, defending the operation while questioning Puntland’s account that the victims were civilian fishermen rather than pirates. Speaking to journalists in Mogadishu, Abdi said the federal government had prior knowledge of the strike and asked whether Puntland authorities had evidence that those killed were in fact civilians and not pirates. His remarks marked the first time Somalia’s federal government has publicly addressed the incident since reports of the strike first surfaced on August 18. Early media accounts had reported that the strike targeted and killed four pirates allegedly involved in the hijacking of the Cameroon-flagged vessel LUTUF, which was transporting weapons and communications equipment destined for Turkey’s military base in Mogadishu. Subsequent reporting, however, cast doubt on that account, with later reports identifying all those killed as civilians. The shifting narrative drew a sharp rebuke from Somalia’s former Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdisaed Muse, who accused Turkey of carrying out what he described as a “ massacre .” Facing mounting public pressure, Puntland authorities issued a statement on Friday formally identifying the victims as civilians and calling on the country responsible for the strike to explain why it had targeted them. The regional administration described the killings as intolerable and warned that the incident risked damaging cooperation between its security agencies and international partners engaged in combating piracy in Somali waters and the wider Gulf of Aden. Puntland further alleged that external actors were supporting piracy activity in the region in an effort to damage the administration’s reputation and undermine its progress on security. Turkey, toward which fingers have so far been pointed over the strike, has not issued any public comment on the incident. Somalia’s federal government, meanwhile, has defended the operation, stating that it was informed of the strike in advance. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Somalia Promises Investigation into Puntland Coastal Airstrikes as Sovereignty Questions Mount
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — The Federal Government of Somalia has for the first time publicly addressed reports of recent airstrikes along the Puntland coast, saying it is gathering information and preparing a comprehensive report on the incidents. State Minister for Defense Omar Ali Abdi, speaking to the media in Mogadishu, said the government was closely monitoring the situation and would take appropriate action once its assessment was complete. “A comprehensive report will be issued, God willing,” Omar said. The statement follows Puntland’s condemnation of what it described as strikes by international warships in the Garmaal area on August 18 and 20, which the regional administration said affected fishermen and damaged civilian property. Puntland has demanded clarification over who carried out the strikes and why, warning that military operations near fishing communities could endanger civilians whose livelihoods depend on the sea. The Defence Ministry’s statement raises a fundamental question: Were the reported operations authorized or coordinated with the Somali government, or were foreign forces acting independently? Omar stressed that the Federal Government has the legal authority to determine military operations targeting piracy along Somalia’s coastline. If the strikes were part of an international anti-piracy operation, Mogadishu will need to clarify whether it was informed or had authorized the mission, what the intended targets were, and what measures were taken to protect civilians. The government has not yet identified the vessels or forces involved. Puntland says the strikes occurred in areas used by local fishermen and caused damage to civilian property. The claims have not yet been independently verified. The allegations are particularly sensitive because coastal communities in Puntland rely heavily on fishing for their livelihoods. Any military activity near fishing grounds therefore carries the risk of civilian casualties and economic losses. Puntland has warned that efforts to combat piracy must not result in legitimate fishermen being mistaken for pirates or civilian communities becoming collateral damage. Piracy and Sovereignty Somalia’s coastline has long been associated with piracy, although attacks declined dramatically from their peak. Recent reports of hijackings and attempted hijackings have nevertheless renewed concerns that pirate networks could be reorganizing. International naval forces have operated off Somalia for years to protect commercial shipping and combat piracy. Their operations, however, also raise questions about sovereignty, authorization and accountability when military action takes place near Somali territory. The Federal Government must now balance the need to support international efforts against piracy with its responsibility to protect Somalia’s territorial sovereignty and civilian population. The Defence Ministry’s promised report could be critical in establishing what happened. Key questions remain: Who carried out the strikes? What were the targets? Who authorized the operation? Were Somali and Puntland authorities informed? And were civilians or their property harmed? Omar said the government would take appropriate measures once the facts were established, although he did not specify whether those measures would be diplomatic, legal or related to regulating foreign military operations along Somalia’s coast. If civilian casualties or property damage are confirmed, calls for an independent investigation and accountability are likely to grow. For now, Puntland maintains that fishermen and civilian property were affected, while Mogadishu says it is investigating the incidents. The forthcoming report will be closely watched—not only for what it reveals about the coastal strikes, but also for what it says about Somalia’s authority over foreign military operations conducted within or near its territorial waters. items.title: Ciidanka Danab oo la geeyay Magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka ayaa maanta ciidamo ka tirsan Kumaandooska Danab ka dejisay Magaalada Baydhabo, si ay uga qayb qaataan dadaalada lagu xasillinayo magaaladaasi. Ciidamadan oo la socday diyaarad ka timid dhinaca Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa ka degay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamadan ay ka tirsan yihiin ciidamo cusub oo Danab ah, isla-markaana Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud uu 4-tii bishan tababar ugu soo xiray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Gaashaanle Xasan Tuure (Ex Ballidoogle) ee Gobolka Shabellaha Hoose. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in ciidamadan ay hadda ku sugan yihiin Xarunta Taliska Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee Baydhabo, isla-markaana la gayn doono duleedka magaalada oo fariisimo ay ka sameysan doonaan. Kumaandooska Danab ayaa waxay xoojin u noqonayaan Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ee ka hawlgala magaaladaasi. Tallaabadan ayay Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uga jawaabeysaa codsi dhawaan uga yimid Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe). Aadan Madoobe oo Arbacadii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh kula kulmay Muqdisho ayaa weydiistay in loo soo diro ciidamada laga maarmi karo. Aadan Madoobe ayaa xiriir adag la leh Dowladda Federaalka, taasoo si dhow ula shaqeynaysa maamulkiisa cusub.

items.title: Maxaa kasoo baxay wada-hadalladii guddoomiye Jaamac iyo xildhibaanada mucaaradka?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimadda Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan xarunta Villa Hargeysa, waxaa maanta lagu soo gabagabeeyay wada-hadallo xasaasi ah oo maalmihii lasoo dhaafay u dhexeeyay Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) iyo xubno matalayay xildhibaannada mucaaradka oo tabashooyin ka qabay habka loo maamulayo howlaha Golaha. Wadahadalladan oo ku qabsoomay jawi deggan ayaa looga arrinsaday sidii loo dardargelin lahaa hawlaha Baarlamaanka, loona xoojin lahaa wada-shaqeynta xildhibaannada. Warsxaafadeed kasoo baxay guddonka sare ee Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya ayaa lagu faah-faahiyay qodobada ay isku raaceen dhinacyada, waxaana kamid ah;- Dhexdhexaadnimada Golaha: In Goluhu u ahaado mid dhexdhexaad u ah dhammaan dhinacyada, isla markaana si buuxda loo ilaaliyo loona dhowro Xeer-hoosaadka Golaha Shacabka. Midnimada Golaha: In la xoojiyo midnimada, wadajirka iyo wada-shaqeynta Xildhibaannada, si hawlaha sharci-dejinta, Matalaadda iyo korjoogteynta hay’adaha Dowladda ay ugu socdaan si habsami leh oo wax-ku-ool ah si waafasan qodobka 7aad ee xeerhoosaadka Golaha Shacabka. Xildhibaan kasta oo ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka uu xaq u leeyahay inuu si xor ah u cabbiro aragtidiisa iyo fikirkiisa, iyadoo la dhowrayo Qodobka 28aad ee Xeer-hoosaadka Golaha. Ilaalinta xaadirista fadhiyada Golaha: Guddoomiyaha iyo Xildhibaanada Mucaaradka waxay isku raaceen in si wadajir ah looga soo qaybgalo fadhiyada Golaha, si waafaqsan qodobka 23aad, farqigiisa 1aad ee Xeer-hoosaadka Golaha Shacabka. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) iyo xildhibaannada muccaaradka ayaa ugu dambeeyan waxay ugu baaqeen dhammaan xildhibaannada Soomaaliyeed inay ilaaliyaan sharafta iyo karaamada Baarlamaanka, xoojiyaan wadajirka Golaha, kana shaqeeyaan danta guud iyo matalaadda shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Tan iyo markii dhawaan xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka loo doortay Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ayaa waday dadaalo guud oo lagu mideynayo golaha, si loo soo afjaro khilaafaadka ka dhex-taagan xubnaha Baarlamaanka.   The post Maxaa kasoo baxay wada-hadalladii guddoomiye Jaamac iyo xildhibaanada mucaaradka? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur Galbeed oo Kenya ka dalbaday in la soo xiro Laftagareen
items.description: Wasiirka Amniga Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Cismaan Isaaq Maxamed, ayaa dowladda Kenya ugu baaqay inay soo xirto madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen, isla markaana u soo gacan geliso dowladda Soomaaliya. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in Laftagareen lagu eedeeyay inuu mas’uul ka yahay weerarradii iyo qaraxyadii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhabo, isagoo dalbaday in loo maro Interpol si loogu soo celiyo Soomaaliya oo lala xisaabtamo. Baaqan ayaa yimid kaddib dagaallo culus oo Baydhabo ka dhacay, kuwaas oo ay ku lug lahaayeen ciidamo taabacsan Laftagareen iyo ciidamada dowladda Federaalka iyo Koonfur Galbeed. Ciidamada dowladda ayaa markii dambe dib ula wareegay goobihii ay dagaalladu ka dhaceen. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale ku eedeysay xoogagga Laftagareen inay weerarka kaashadeen xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, isla markaana ay adeegsadeen gaadiid walxaha qarxa laga soo buuxiyay. Eedeymahan si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin, mana jirto xukun maxkamadeed oo Laftagareen ku caddeeyay eedahaas. Laftagareen ayaa tan iyo markii uu Baydhabo ka baxay ku sugnaa Kenya, iyadoo khilaafka u dhexeeya isaga iyo dowladda Federaalka uu muddo bilo ah ka dhashay arrimaha dastuurka iyo doorashada.

items.title: DEG-DEG: Xildhibaannada Mucaaradka iyo Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo Heshiis Gaaray
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Xildhibaanno ka tirsan mucaaradka, oo u badan kuwa kasoo jeeda Puntland iyo Jubbaland, iyo Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka ayaa la sheegay inay heshiis ka gaareen sidii loo xoojin lahaa midnimada iyo wada-shaqeynta Golaha Shacabka. Sida wararku sheegayaan, dhinacyadu waxay isku raaceen in xildhibaannadu si dhammaystiran uga wada qaybqaataan fadhiyada Golaha, isla markaana Golaha Shacabku noqdo gole mideysan oo dhexdhexaad ah. Heshiiskan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xildhibaannadan mucaaradka ah ay horey u sheegeen inaysan aqoonsanayn muddo-xileedka dheeriga ah iyo doorashadii Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka. Haddii heshiiskan uu hirgalo, wuxuu noqon karaa tallaabo lagu yareynayo khilaafka siyaasadeed ee gudaha Baarlamaanka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isku dayayaan inay Golaha ku soo celiyaan wada-shaqeyn iyo isku-duubni. items.title: DEG-DEG: In Ka Badan 5 Qof oo Lagu Dilay Duqayn Ka Dhacday Xeebaha Puntland
items.description: Nugaal (Raxanreeb Online): Sida ay sheegayaan ilo xog-ogaal ah, in ka badan shan qof ayaa maanta lagu dilay duqayn ka dhacday deegaan xeebeedyo ka tirsan Puntland, gaar ahaan meel ku dhow halka uu hadda ku sugan yahay markab ay kooxo burcad-badeed ahi qabsadeen toddobaadkii hore. Markabka ayaa lagu soo warramay inuu sido qalab milatari iyo agab kale, oo ay ku jiraan qalab la xiriira gantaallo, qalab dhisme iyo saanad milatari oo lagu sheegay inay leeyihiin Türkiye. Xogtan weli ma helin xaqiijin rasmi ah oo madax-bannaan. Ilo amni ayaa sheegay in duqaynta maanta loo aaneynayo Türkiye, hase yeeshee Ankara weli si rasmi ah uma aysan xaqiijin ama uga hadlin eedeymahaas. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli Puntland ay maalin ka hor cambaareysay duqaymaha ka dhacaya xeebaha gobolka Nugaal, iyadoo maamulka uu sheegay in falalkaasi ay dhaawacayaan dadaallada Puntland ee la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda. Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Puntland ay qaadayso tallaabooyin cusub oo ka dhan ah burcad-badeedda, xilli kooxahaasi ay gacanta ku hayaan dhowr markab oo lagu soo warramay inay ku sugan yihiin xeebaha Puntland. Dhanka kale, waxaa jira warar sheegaya in shaqsiyaad Soomaali ah ay xiriir la sameeyeen kooxaha burcad-badeedda, iyagoo ka dalbaday inay markabka ka fogaadaan dhinaca Puntland, ayna ka fogaadaan sawirro laga qaado markabka iyo gudaha qaybihiisa. Wararka qaar ayaa intaas ku daraya in shirkadda markabka iska leh ay burcad-badeedda u ballanqaadday lacag madax-furasho ah haddii ay u hoggaansamaan dalabyada qaarkood. Hase yeeshee, faahfaahinta heshiiskaas iyo cidda ka dambeysa weli si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Xaaladda ayaa weli ah mid xasaasi ah, waxaana muhiim ah in la helo xaqiijin rasmi ah oo ku saabsan cidda fulisay duqaynta, tirada khasaaraha iyo nooca xamuulka markabka, ka hor inta aan xogaha hordhaca ah loo qaadan xaqiiqo rasmi ah. items.title: Mareykanka oo Soomaaliya ka qaaday xayiraaddii fiisaha
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Mareykanka ayaa meesha ka saartay xayiraaddii fiisaha ee saarnayd muwaadiniinta Soomaaliya, kaddib go’aan ka soo baxay garsoore ka tirsan maxkamadaha Mareykanka oo tallaabadii hore ku tilmaantay mid sharci darro ah oo aan waafaqsanayn nidaamka federaalka. Garsoore Janet Vargas ayaa go’aankeeda ku sheegtay in xayiraadda fiisaha ay ahayd tallaabo ka dhalatay siyaasad uu maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump horey u dejiyay, taasoo Soomaaliya ku dartay liiska 75 dal oo Mareykanku u diiday dal-ku-galkiisa. Garsooraha ayaa sidoo kale su’aal gelisay awoodda Xoghayaha Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka uu u leeyahay inuu farageliyo habka loo bixiyo fiisaha, iyadoo ku baaqday in la kala saaro siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda iyo danaha qaranka iyo xuquuqda dadka codsanaya fiisaha. Go’aankan ayaa ka dhigan in muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ay mar kale heli karaan fursad ay ku dalbadaan fiisaha Mareykanka, iyadoo xayiraaddii hore ay caqabad weyn ku noqotay dadka doonayay inay u safraan dalkaas. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa bishii Janaayo ee sanadkan joojisay ama xaddiday bixinta fiisaha muwaadiniinta dalal ay Soomaaliya ka mid tahay, iyadoo tallaabadaas lagu saleeyay siyaasadaha cusub ee maamulka Donald Trump. Dalalka kale ee xayiraaddu saameysay waxaa ka mid ahaa Brazil, Colombia, Uruguay, Bosnia, Albania, Pakistan iyo Bangladesh iyo waddamo kale oo ku jiray liiska maamulka Mareykanka. Maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa xayiraadahaas kala kulmay dhaleeceyn xooggan oo uga timid dhinacyo siyaasadeed iyo hay’ado kala duwan, kuwaas oo ku doodayay in siyaasaddaasi ay si aan caddaalad ahayn u saameyneyso muwaadiniinta dalal gaar ah. Go’aanka cusub ayaa Soomaaliya u noqon kara isbeddel muhiim ah, maadaama xayiraadda fiisaha ay muddo saameyn ku yeelanaysay isu socodka dadka Soomaaliyeed iyo Mareykanka, iyadoo sidoo kale la filayo inuu fududeeyo safarrada dadka haysta baasaboorka Soomaaliya ee buuxiya shuruudaha fiisaha Mareykanka. items.title: Mogadishu’s “forced” eviction Turns into War
items.description: The demolition of homes in Tookiyo neighbourhood, in Mogadishu’s Yaqshiid district, has triggered tensions and clashes between government forces and local residents who opposed the operation. The demolitions began around midnight and were still continuing, with local reports saying nearly 10 people had been injured in the confrontation. The operation has raised concerns among residents over the fate of families living in the area and renewed a wider dispute over land ownership and evictions in parts of Mogadishu. Residents say they have lived in Tookiyo for decades and are demanding clarity over the legal basis for the demolitions. Government forces were accompanied by workers carrying tools used to dismantle the corrugated iron roofing of homes, according to residents and local reports. Several houses occupied by civilians were reportedly targeted during the operation. Tensions escalated when some residents attempted to prevent the demolitions. The confrontation reportedly led to violence between the security forces and residents, with reports of gunfire in the area. Local sources said nearly 10 people were injured in the clashes, including civilians. Reports of fatalities have also circulated, but the number of deaths has not been independently verified. Residents said they were particularly concerned about families who could be left without shelter if the demolitions continue. Some said they had lived in the neighbourhood for many years and had no immediate alternative accommodation. One resident said the community wanted authorities to clarify who legally owns the land before homes are demolished, arguing that families should not be removed without a clear legal process and adequate consideration for those affected. The Somali government has not yet issued an official statement specifically addressing the operation in Tookiyo or the reported injuries. Local reports have, however, linked the demolitions to wider efforts by authorities to reclaim land considered government property. The developments come amid continuing disputes over land ownership and evictions in Mogadishu, where residents in several areas have raised concerns about demolitions and displacement. The situation in Tookiyo remains tense, with residents worried that further demolitions could lead to additional confrontations and displacement. The immediate challenge for authorities is how to resolve the dispute over the land while preventing further violence and protecting civilians who live in the affected area. items.title: Burburinta guryaha Tookiyo oo xiisad dhalisay
items.description: Howlgal lagu burburinayo guryo ay degan yihiin dad rayid ah ayaa saacado ka hor ka bilowday xaafadda Tookiyo ee degmada Yaaqshiid, Muqdisho, iyadoo ciidamada dowladda ay goobta ku sugan yihiin, waxaana iska horimaad dhex maray ciidamada iyo qaar ka mid ah dadka deegaanka oo ka hor yimid burburinta. Wararka deegaanka ayaa sheegaya in ku dhawaad 10 qof ay ku dhaawacmeen rabshadaha. Dhacdadan ayaa dib u soo noolaysay muranka muddooyinkii dambe ka taagnaa lahaanshaha dhulka iyo burburinta guryaha Muqdisho. Dowladda ayaa sheegaysa in dhulalka qaar ay yihiin hanti dowladeed, halka dadka deegaanka ay ku adkeysanayaan inay muddo dheer ku noolaayeen goobahaas. Sida ay sheegeen dadka deegaanka, ciidamo ka tirsan dowladda ayaa howlgalka wada, waxaana la socda rag adeegsanaya burusyo iyo qalab kale oo lagu furfurayo saqafka jiingadaha iyo guryaha. Xiisadda ayaa sii korortay markii qaar ka mid ah dadka deegaanka ay isku dayeen inay ka hor yimaadaan burburinta. Wararka laga helayo goobta ayaa sheegaya in xaaladdu isu beddeshay iska horimaad, iyadoo la maqlay rasaas. Ku dhawaad 10 qof ayaa la sheegay inay ku dhaawacmeen iska horimaadka, waxaana ku jira dad rayid ah. Tirada saxda ah ee dadka dhintay ama dhaawacmay si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin, waxaana sidoo kale weli aan la caddeyn wararka sheegaya dhimasho. Dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay inay walaac weyn ka qabaan burburinta guryahooda iyo halka ay ku dambeyn doonaan qoysaska ku noolaa xaafadda. Qaar ayaa ku doodaya in qoysaskoodu ay deegaanka ku noolaayeen muddo tobannaan sano ah. Mid ka mid ah dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in dadka ku nool Tookiyo aysan haysan meel kale oo ay si degdeg ah ugu guuraan, isla markaana ay doonayaan in marka hore si cad loo qeexo cidda sharci ahaan leh dhulka. Dhanka kale, warbixinno maxalli ah ayaa sheegaya in dowladda ay goobta u aragto dhul ay leedahay, taas oo qayb ka ah dadaallada lagu soo celinayo dhulalka ay hay’adaha dowladda u arkaan hanti guud. Dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya weli si rasmi ah ugama hadlin dhacdadan gaarka ah. Dhacdada Tookiyo waxay ku soo beegmaysaa xilli muranka dhulka iyo barakicinta dadka deggan qaybo ka mid ah Muqdisho uu noqday arrin xasaasi ah. Bilihii la soo dhaafay waxaa jiray cabashooyin la xiriira burburinta iyo qorshayaal dadka looga rarayo dhulal ay muddo dheer degganaayeen. Wararka hadda laga helayo Tookiyo ayaa sheegaya in xiisadda ay weli taagan tahay, iyadoo dadka deegaanka iyo ciidamada dowladda ay ku sugan yihiin xaalad kacsan. Su’aasha ugu weyn ee hadda taagan ayaa ah sida loo xallin doono muranka lahaanshaha dhulka, iyadoo aan xaaladdu horseedin khasaare kale oo soo gaara dadka rayidka ah. Dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay inay walaac weyn ka qabaan burburinta guryahooda iyo halka ay ku dambeyn doonaan qoysaska ku noolaa xaafadda. Qaar ayaa ku doodaya in qoysaskoodu ay deegaanka ku noolaayeen muddo tobannaan sano ah. Mid ka mid ah dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in dadka ku nool Tookiyo aysan haysan meel kale oo ay si degdeg ah ugu guuraan, isla markaana ay doonayaan in marka hore si cad loo qeexo cidda sharci ahaan leh dhulka. items.title: Xog: Kulankii FARMAAJO iyo Shariif oo khilaaf ka dhex abuuray Golaha Mustaqbalka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Isbaheysiga mucaaradka ee Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa iska fogeeyey kulan gaar ah oo Khamiistii dhexmaray madaxweynayaashii hore ee Soomaaliya Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo iyo Shariif Sheekh Axmed, kaas oo ka dhacay hoyga Shariif Sheekh Axmed ee magaalada Muqdisho. Xubno ka tirsan Golaha Mustaqbalka oo ku sugan Muqdisho iyo Nairobi, kuwaas oo codsaday inaan magacyadooda la shaacin, ayaa sheegay in aysan horay uga warqabin kulanka, isla markaana uusan ahayn kulan lagu matalayey isbaheysiga. Ilo xog-ogaal ah oo ku dhow labada madaxweyne hore ayaa xaqiijiyey in kulanka Farmaajo iyo Shariif uu socday ku dhowaad saddex saacadood, iyadoo inta badan diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda siyaasadeed ee dalka iyo muranka weli ka taagan hannaanka doorashooyinka. Sida ay sheegayaan ilo wareedyadu, Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa Farmaajo kala hadlay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la isu soo dhoweeyo mowqifyada dhinacyada mucaaradka ee arrimaha doorashada, si cadaadis siyaasadeed loo saaro madaxda dowladda federaalka looguna qasbo inay heshiis doorasho la gaaraan mucaaradka. Kulanka ayaan, sida xogtu tilmaamayso, lagu soo qaadin suurta-galnimada in Farmaajo uu ku biiro Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed, inkastoo kulanka labada madaxweyne hore uu sare u qaaday hadal-heynta ku saabsan isbaheysiyada siyaasadeed ee laga yaabo inay sameysmaan ka hor doorashooyinka dalka. Xiriirka Shariif iyo Farmaajo Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa ah hoggaamiyaha Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed, hase yeeshee sidoo kale wuxuu xiriir toos ah la leeyahay Farmaajo iyo siyaasiyiinta ku xeeran madasha Nabad iyo Nolol. Xiriirkaas ayaa Shariif ka dhigaya siyaasi awood u leh inuu isku xiro labada dhinac, xilli kala duwanaansho uu weli ka jiro qaabka mucaaradku uga falcelinayo qorshaha doorasho ee dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Ilo ku dhow dhaq-dhaqaaqyada siyaasadeed ayaa sheegaya in Shariif uu hadda qiimeynayo sida ay isu beddelayaan isbaheysiyada siyaasadeed, gaar ahaan xiriirka u dhexeeya Golaha Mustaqbalka iyo Nabad iyo Nolol. Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa muddooyinkii dambe hormuud ka ahaa mucaaradka ka soo horjeeda hannaanka doorasho ee dowladda federaalka, isaga oo ku adkeysanaya in heshiis siyaasadeed oo loo dhan yahay laga gaaro qaabka dalka loogu gudbayo doorashooyinka soo socda. Dhanka kale, Nabad iyo Nolol ayaa horey u soo bandhigtay aragti doorasho oo dhinacyo badan uga dhow qorshaha ay dowladda federaalka ku riixeyso geeddi-socodka doorashooyinka. Arrintaas ayaa cadaadis cusub saartay mowqifka Golaha Mustaqbalka, maadaama labada garab ee waaweyn ee mucaaradka aysan si buuxda isku mowqif uga ahayn qaabka doorashada. Wada-hadallada doorashooyinka Kulanka Farmaajo iyo Shariif ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli ilo siyaasadeed iyo khubaro la socda arrimaha doorashooyinka ay sheegayaan in wada-hadallada lagu raadinayo heshiis siyaasadeed ay galayaan marxalad xasaasi ah. Waxaa sidoo kale sii xoogeysanaya dhaq-dhaqaaqyada lagu dhisayo isbaheysiyo cusub iyo isku soo dhowaanshaha musharrixiinta iyo kooxaha siyaasadeed, iyadoo dhinac kasta uu isku diyaarinayo marxaladda xigta ee loolanka doorashada. Inkasta oo Golaha Mustaqbalka uu iska fogeeyey kulanka Khamiistii, haddana wada-hadalka Farmaajo iyo Shariif ayaa muujinaya in xiriirka iyo wadatashiyada u dhexeeya siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ay sii socdaan, xilli ay weli kala duwan yihiin aragtiyaha laga qabo hannaanka doorashada. Waxa hadda isha lagu hayaa in kulanka labada madaxweyne hore uu horseedi doono kulamo kale ama isku soo dhowaansho rasmi ah oo dhex mara Nabad iyo Nolol iyo Golaha Mustaqbalka, iyo in kale. Isbeddel kasta oo ku yimaada xiriirka labada garab ayaa saameyn weyn ku yeelan kara miisaanka siyaasadeed ee mucaaradka iyo awoodda uu ku leeyahay wada-hadallada dowladda federaalka ee ku saabsan doorashooyinka soo socda. The post Xog: Kulankii FARMAAJO iyo Shariif oo khilaaf ka dhex abuuray Golaha Mustaqbalka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Gunfire in Mogadishu as Security Forces Confront Residents Resisting Evictions
items.description: MOGADISHU— Tensions erupted on Sunday in Mogadishu’s Yaqshid district after federal security forces launched an operation in the Tookiyo neighbourhood, triggering protests and an exchange of gunfire with local residents. Residents said the operation was linked to efforts to clear homes and properties in the area that authorities reportedly intend to reclaim for government use. Witnesses told Raxanreeb that residents gathered to oppose the operation, prompting security forces to move in to disperse the protesters. The confrontation later escalated, with gunfire reported in the neighbourhood. Local residents said several people were wounded during the unrest, although the number of casualties has not been independently verified. Federal authorities have yet to issue an official statement detailing the operation or confirming any deaths or injuries. A video widely circulated on social media appears to show a member of the security forces opening fire towards a civilian during the confrontation. A distressed woman can be heard pleading with the officer not to shoot a young man she identifies as her son. Raxanreeb has not independently verified the circumstances surrounding the footage. Residents accused the government of using force to remove families from disputed properties, arguing that some of those affected have legally occupied their homes for years and should not be displaced without due process. The incident has heightened tensions in Yaqshid and renewed scrutiny over land disputes and eviction operations in Mogadishu, where competing claims over public and privately held property have repeatedly caused confrontations between authorities and local communities. The federal government has not yet provided details on the legal basis for the operation, the status of the disputed properties or whether compensation or alternative arrangements have been offered to affected residents. The situation in Tookiyo remained tense as security forces maintained a presence in the area. items.title: Ciidamada oo xoog ku raray dadkii deganaa xaafadda Tookiyo ee Degmada Yaaqshiid
items.description: Ciidanka Booliska Gobolka Banaadir iyo Xoogaga Polizia Militare ayaa saqdii dhexe ee xalay gudaha u galay xaafadda Tookiyo ee Degmada Yaaqshiid ee Gobolka Banaadir. Ciidamada oo fulinaya amarka Dowladda Hoose ee Xamar ayaa xoog ku galay guryaha qoysas badan, iyaga oo faray in ay si dhakhsa ah alaabahooda uga qaataan. Ciidamada ayaa qoysaska ku wargeliyay in la duminayo guryahooda, si looga sameeyo waddooyin ay dadku maraan. Arrintan ayaa waxay wax naxdin ah ku noqotay qoysaskaasi, oo ku dooday in ay si sharci ah u leeyihiin guryahooda oo sanad kasta ay ka dhiibayeen canshuurta uu qaado Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir, isla-markaana aan maalin qura loo jeedin digniin ku saabsan in la burburin doono iyo inay dowladda siineyso meelo kale oo ay deggaan. Xaafadda Tookiyo ayaa waxaa hareeyay rabshado xoog leh oo halkaasi ku dhex maray qoysaskii la doonayay in guryahooda laga raro iyo ciidamada, ka dib markii dadku ay xaqiiqsadeen inaanu jirin wax qorshe ah oo dowladda ay dib-u-dejin ugu sameynayso. Dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in dad shacab ah ay ku dhinteen, kuwo kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen rasaastii ay adeegsanayeen ciidamada, inkastoo laamaha amniga aysan wax war ah ka soo saarin tirada dadka wax ku noqday shaqaaqada ka dhacday xaafaddaasi. Dhanka kale ciidamada ayay saacado ka dib u suurtagashay in ay goobta ka raraan qoysaskii deganaa, oo qaarkood agabyadooda ku qaatay gaadiid, qaar kalena ay la baxeen iyaga oo madaxa iyo gacmaha ku wata. Ciidamada oo watay gaadiidka dagaalka iyo cagafyo ayaa xiray dhammaanba waddooyinka soo gala xaafadda, mana jirin cid gudaha u geli kartay xaafadda aan ka ahayn dadkii laga saarayay. Habka uu Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir u maamulayo guryaha iyo dhulalka Muqdisho ayaa dareen iyo cabsi ka abuuray gudaha magaalada, iyadoo dadweynaha qaar ay cabsi ka muujinayaan in guryahooda la dumiyo ama dhulalka ay lahaayeen ay la wareegto Dowladda Federaalka, iyadoo aysan jirin cid ilaalineysa xuquuqdooda.

items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa maanta kulan gaar ah la yeeshay safiirka Boqortooyada Ingiriiska u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Danjire Charles King oo ay ka wada-hadleen arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan xaaladda guud ee dalka. Kulanka ayaa lagu soo bandhigay warbixinno ku saabsan xaaladda abaaraha ka jira dalka iyo cabsi laga qabo fatahaado culus oo ay sababaan roobabka Dayrta, kuwaas oo la filayo inay dhowaan ka bilowdaan qeybo ka mid ah gobollada Soomaaliya. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa guddiga ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in bulshada Soomaaliyeed laga wacyigeliyo khataraha fatahaadaha, gaar ahaan dadka ku nool deegaannada ku dhow wabiyada iyo dhulka biyo-mareennada ah. Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa sidoo kale tilmaamay baahida loo qabo in la xoojiyo diyaar-garowga iyo ka jawaabista xaaladaha degdegga ah, iyadoo la sameynayo qorsheyaal lagu yareynayo khasaaraha ka dhalan kara fatahaadaha iyo abaaraha. Guddiga Sare ee Maamulka Sanduuqa Qaranka ee Maareynta Khataraha Masiibooyinka ayaa kulanka ku soo bandhigay warbixinno ku saabsan heerka diyaar-garowga dowladda ee ka jawaabista masiibooyinka iyo xaaladaha degdegga ah. Sidoo kale, guddiga ayaa soo bandhigay qorshe lagu wacyigelinayo bulshada ku nool hareeraha wabiyada iyo dhulka hoose ee halista ugu jira fatahaadaha, si loo yareeyo saameynta ay roobabka xooggan ku yeelan karaan dadka iyo hantidooda. items.title: Robots humanoid ah oo loo adeegsan karo ilaalinta xuduudda
items.description: Shirkad Mareykan ah oo soo saarta robots-ka humanoid-ka ah ayaa sheegtay in robot-keeda Phantom mustaqbalka loo adeegsan karo ilaalinta iyo sahminta xuduudda koonfureed ee Mareykanka, gaar ahaan dhulalka adag ee ay ku adkaan karto in ay maraan askarta, gaadiidka iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Aasaasaha iyo madaxa shirkadda Foundation, Sankaet Pathak, ayaa sheegay in shirkaddu ay tiknoolajiyadan horey ugu soo bandhigtay saraakiil ka tirsan Waaxda Amniga Gudaha Mareykanka, DHS. Hase yeeshee, qorshahan weli ma gaarin heer heshiis rasmi ah. DHS waxay sheegtay inaysan hadda la lahayn Foundation heshiis rasmi ah, barnaamij tijaabo ah ama qandaraas firfircoon oo ay shirkaddu si toos ah ula leedahay waaxda. Pathak ayaa sheegay in Foundation ay wadahadallo la leedahay hay’ado dhowr ah oo ka tirsan amniga qaranka Mareykanka, oo ay ku jiraan Ciidanka Cirka, Ciidanka Badda, Ciidanka Dhulka iyo DHS. Shirkaddu waxay rajaynaysaa in robots-ku mustaqbalka ay qabtaan hawlo ay hadda dadka ama qalabka kale ku adkaato inay si joogto ah u fuliyaan. Phantom waxaa loogu talagalay inuu si iskiis ah ugu dhaqaaqi karo dhul aan sinnayn, uu kala saari karo dadka iyo caqabadaha kale, isla markaana uu sameyn karo khariidad ku saabsan deegaanka uu ku shaqeynayo. Sida qorshaha shirkaddu dhigayo, robot-ku ma qaadan doono go’aanka ugu dambeeya ee tallaabo laga qaadayo qof ama dhacdo uu arko. Halkii, wuxuu ogaan karaa dhaqdhaqaaq muhiim ah, u gudbin karaa digniin saraakiisha, kadibna dadka ayaa go’aamin doona waxa xiga. “Waxay ogaan doonaan, kadibna way calaamadeyn doonaan, qofkuna wuxuu go’aamin doonaa tallaabada xigta,” ayuu Pathak u sheegay Fox News Digital, isagoo sharraxayay sida uu u arko doorka robots-ka. Shirkaddu waxay si gaar ah u danaynaysaa meelaha fog iyo kuwa khatarta badan, oo ay ku jiraan dhul buuraley ah iyo tunnel-lada xuduudda hoosteeda. Fikradda ayaa ah in robot-ku uu halkaas ka fuliyo sahmin, halka saraakiishu ay ku sii sugnaadaan meel ammaan ah. “Ujeeddadayada ugu weyn waa in saraakiisheena lagu hayn karo meel ammaan ah, halka robots-kuna ay sii wadaan ilaalinta 24 saacadood maalintii,” ayuu Pathak sheegay. Foundation ayaa sidoo kale qorshaynaysa nooc cusub oo Phantom ah oo ka adkaysi badan xaaladaha dibadda. Shirkaddu waxay sheegtay in nooca cusub loo qorsheeyay inuu noqdo mid aan biyuhu iyo boodhku si fudud u waxyeellayn, taas oo wax ka qabanaysa qaar ka mid ah xaddidaadaha nooca hadda jira. Pathak wuxuu sheegay in tijaabo xaddidan ay bilaaban karto xitaa waqti dhow, iyadoo la ballaarin karo haddii nidaamku si wanaagsan u shaqeeyo. Laakiin waqtigan xaadirka ah, arrintu weli waxay ku jirtaa heerka horumarinta iyo wada-xaajoodka. Waxaa kale oo jira su’aalo la xiriira heerka madax-bannaanida loo oggolaan karo robots-ka noocan ah, gaar ahaan marka ay timaaddo hawlgallada amniga. Foundation waxay sheegtay in qorshaha dhow aanu ahayn in Phantom uu iskiis u gaaro go’aanno fulineed. Pathak wuxuu intaas ku daray in shirkaddu diyaar u noqon karto inay robots-ka hubeyso haddii dowladda federaalku codsato, inkastoo qorshaha hadda la sheegay uu diiradda saarayo oo keliya ilaalinta iyo sahminta. Haddii mustaqbalka la geeyo xuduudda, robots-ka humanoid-ka ah waxay beddeli karaan qaabka loo kormeero meelaha adag, iyagoo qaadan kara qaar ka mid ah hawlaha khatarta ah ama culus, halka go’aannada muhiimka ah ay weli gacanta ugu jiraan saraakiisha aadanaha. The post Robots humanoid ah oo loo adeegsan karo ilaalinta xuduudda first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Aadan Madoobe oo Baydhabo Shir Amni Ku Guddoomiyey
items.description: Baydhabo (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed, Sheekh Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe), ayaa magaalada Baydhabo ku guddoomiyey shir looga hadlay xoojinta amniga deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed iyo ka hortagga weerarrada Al-Shabaab. Shirka waxaa looga hadlay xaaladda guud ee amniga iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha amniga, si looga hortago falalka amni-darro iyo weerarrada kooxda Al-Shabaab. Madaxweyne Aadan Madoobe ayaa hay’adaha amniga faray inay laba jibaaraan dadaallada lagu sugayo amniga, isla markaana ay si dhow ula shaqeeyaan bulshada. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale shacabka Koonfur Galbeed ugu baaqay inay la shaqeeyaan ciidamada iyo hay’adaha amniga, ayna soo gudbiyaan xog kasta oo gacan ka geysan karta ka hortagga weerarrada iyo sugidda nabadgelyada. Shirkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli magaalada Baydhabo iyo deegaanada ku xeeran ay ka jiraan xaalado amni oo u baahan feejignaan iyo iskaashi dheeraad ah. items.title: RW Xamsa: “Soomaaliya Waxay Ku Socotaa Jidkii Barwaaqada” — Xilli Qoysas Barakacayaal ah ay Waddooyinka Jiifaan
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ku socoto jidka barwaaqada iyo horumarka, iyadoo dowladda ay sheegtay inay waddo qorshayaal lagu horumarinayo dalka. Hase yeeshee, hadalka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli hooyooyin iyo carruur Soomaaliyeed lagu arkay waddooyinka Muqdisho, kaddib markii la sheegay in saakay laga barakiciyay guryahoodii. Qoysaskan ayaa wajahay xaalad adag, iyadoo carruur badan ay ka maqnaadeen iskuulladii iyo dugsi Qur’aankii ay dhigan jireen, waxaana sidoo kale jira walaac laga qabo xaaladda nololeed iyo helitaanka cunto ee qoysaska barakacay. Arrintan ayaa dhalinaysa su’aalo ku saabsan sida loo waafajin karo hadallada dowladda ee ku saabsan barwaaqada iyo horumarka iyo xaaladda qoysaska nugul ee wajahaya barakaca iyo duruufaha nololeed ee adag. Horumarka dalka laguma cabbiri karo oo keliya mashaariicda iyo kobaca dhaqaalaha, balse waxaa sidoo kale muhiim ah in la eego xaaladda qoysaska danyarta ah, amniga, adeegyada bulshada, waxbarashada iyo awoodda dadka ay ku heli karaan nolol aasaasi ah. items.title: Mudug oo Si Diiran u Soo Dhaweeyay Madaxweyne Deni
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Dowladda Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa si weyn loogu soo dhaweeyay Gobolka Mudug, iyadoo shacabka iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada ay muujinayeen taageero iyo soo dhoweyn ay u sameynayaan Madaxweynaha. Soo dhoweynta ayaa ka dhacday magaalada Gaalkacyo, waxaana ka qeybgalay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Puntland, maamulka gobolka iyo degmada, saraakiisha ciidamada iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Madaxweyne Deni ayaa intii uu ku sugnaa Mudug kulamo la qaatay qeybaha bulshada iyo saraakiisha dowladda, isagoo ka hadlay amniga, horumarinta gobolka, dowladnimada iyo xaaladda guud ee Puntland. Safarka Madaxweynaha ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli uu Gobolka Mudug ka socdo dhaqdhaqaaq siyaasadeed iyo mid bulsho, iyadoo Deni uu sheegay in shacabka gobolka ay door muhiim ah ku leeyihiin dowladnimada Puntland. items.title: DEG-DEG: Maxkamad Mareykan ah oo Baabi’isay Hakintii Fiisaha 75 Dal, Soomaaliya Ku Jirto
items.description: Washington (Raxanreeb Online): Garsoore ka tirsan Maxkamadda Degmada Federaalka ee Manhattan, Jeannette A. Vargas, ayaa 21-kii Agoosto 2026 meesha ka saartay siyaasaddii maamulka Madaxweyne Donald Trump ee hakisay bixinta fiisooyinka socdaalka (immigrant visas) ee muwaadiniinta 75 dal, oo ay Soomaaliya kamid tahay. Garsooraha ayaa go’aamisay in siyaasaddaasi ay ahayd mid ka hor imaanaysa sharciga, isla markaana Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka Marco Rubio uu ka tallaabay awooddii sharciga ahayd ee uu ku lahaa arrintaas. Hakinta ayaa la dhaqan geliyay bishii Janaayo 2026, iyadoo Dowladda Mareykanku ku doodday in dadka ka imanaya dalalkaas ay u badan tahay inay ku tiirsanaadaan adeegyada bulshada. Soomaaliya waxay kamid ahayd 75-ka dal ee lagu daray liiska. Go’aanka cusub wuxuu sidoo kale saameynayaa diidmooyin fiiso oo lagu saleeyay siyaasaddaas oo keliya, kuwaas oo maxkamaddu amartay in dib loo eego iyadoo kiis kasta si gaar ah loo qiimeynayo. Hase yeeshee, tani macnaheedu ma aha in Soomaalidu si toos ah hadda ugu safri karaan Mareykanka. Qof kasta oo doonaya inuu galo Mareykanka weli wuxuu u baahan yahay inuu buuxiyo shuruudaha fiisaha iyo socdaalka ee khuseeya xaaladdiisa. Sidoo kale, dowladda Mareykanka waxay awood u leedahay inay racfaan ka qaadato go’aanka maxkamadda, sidaas darteed xaaladda sharciyeed way is beddeli kartaa. Qodob muhiim ah: Warka ku saabsan garsoorihii kubadda cagta Soomaaliyeed Cumar Cartan iyo in hadda uu si toos ah u safri karo Mareykanka kama dhalanayo go’aankan keliya; qof kasta xaaladdiisa fiiso ayaa si gaar ah loo qiimeeyaa. items.title: Kenya oo laga dalbaday in ay Lafta-gareen usoo dhiibto DF
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Amniga maamulka Koonfur Galbeed, Cismaan Isaaq Maxamed, ayaa dowladda Kenya ka dalbaday inay xirto madaxweynihii hore ee maamulkaas Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed Laftagareen, isla markaana loo soo gacan geliyo dowladda Soomaaliya. Wasiirka oo ka hadlay xaaladda amni ee magaalada Baydhaba iyo dagaalladii culus ee dhowaan ka dhacay ayaa Laftagareen ku eedeeyay inuu mas’uul ka yahay weerarro iyo qaraxyo ka dhacay magaalada, isaga oo sheegay inay tahay in lagula xisaabtamo. “Waxaan dowladda Kenya ka codsaneynaa inay soo xirto Cabdicasiis Laftagareen, kadibna iyada oo loo marayo Interpol loogu soo gacan geliyo dowladda Soomaaliya, si loola xisaabtamo,” ayuu yiri wasiirka. Hadalka wasiirka ayaa imanaya maalmo kadib dagaal culus oo Isniintii ka dhacay Baydhaba, kaas oo ciidamada daacadda u ah Laftagareen ay weerar ku qaadeen fariisimo ay magaalada ku lahaayeen ciidamada dowladda federaalka iyo kuwa maamulka Koonfur Galbeed. Ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen ayaa intii uu dagaalku socday gudaha u galay qeybo ka mid ah magaalada, waxaana saraakiil u hadashay ay xilligaas sheegteen inay la wareegeen Baydhaba. Hase yeeshee, dhowr saacadood oo dagaal ah kadib ayay ciidamada dowladda dib ula wareegeen goobihii ay maleeshiyaadku galeen, waxaana dagaalka ka dhashay dhimasho iyo dhaawac soo kala gaaray dhinacyadii dagaallamay iyo dadka rayidka ah. Laftagareen ayaa isla maalintaas bogaadiyey ciidamada daacadda u ah, isaga oo sheegay in howlgalka ay Baydhaba ka fuliyeen uu ahaa mid lagu doonayay in lagu soo celiyo amniga iyo kala dambeynta, laguna soo afjaro waxa uu ku tilmaamay joogitaanka sharci-darrada ah ee ciidamo ku sugan magaalada. Dowladda federaalka ayaa dhankeeda sheegtay in weerarka lagu qaaday Baydhaba ay ka qeyb qaateen maleeshiyaad daacad u ah Laftagareen iyo xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, iyadoo sheegtay in weerarka lagu adeegsaday gaadiid laga soo buuxiyey walxaha qarxa. Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur Galbeed ayaa hadda sii xoojiyey eedeymahaas, isaga oo ciidamada taageersan madaxweynihii hore ku eedeeyay inay xiriir la leeyihiin Al-Shabaab, isla markaana ay qeyb ka yihiin amni-darrada ka jirta Baydhaba. “Markii hore waxaan u heysannay inay yihiin walaalaheen tabasho qaba, laakiin hadda waxaan aragnay dad hubeysan oo xiriir la leh Al-Shabaab. Haddii ay isa soo dhiibaan, waxaa la marinayaa habraaca loo maro dadka kasoo goosta Al-Shabaab,” ayuu yiri. Wasiirka ayaa sidaas ku sheegay in dagaalyahannada taageersan Laftagareen ee isa soo dhiiba loola dhaqmi doono hab la mid ah kan dowladda ay kula dhaqanto xubnaha Al-Shabaab ee kasoo goosta kooxda. Eedeymaha ku saabsan xiriirka ciidamada Laftagareen iyo Al-Shabaab si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin, mana jiro illaa hadda go’aan maxkamadeed oo lagu xaqiijiyey eedeymaha loo jeediyey madaxweynihii hore. Xiisadda hadda ka taagan Baydhaba waxay salka ku haysaa khilaaf siyaasadeed oo muddo bilo ah u dhexeeyey Laftagareen iyo dowladda federaalka. Bishii Maarso, maamulkii Laftagareen ayaa xiriirka u jaray dowladda federaalka kadib khilaaf xooggan oo ka dhashay arrimaha dastuurka iyo doorashooyinka. Ciidamada dowladda federaalka ayaa 30-kii Maarso la wareegay Baydhaba, waxaana isla maalintaas Laftagareen ku dhawaaqay inuu iska casilay xilka madaxweynaha Koonfur Galbeed, kadibna uu ka baxay magaalada. Laftagareen ayaa tan iyo xilligaas ku sugnaa Kenya, halka ciidamo iyo saraakiil weli daacad u ah ay ku sugnaayeen deegaanno ka baxsan Baydhaba, iyadoo marar kala duwan ay soo baxayeen dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ciidan iyo isku dhacyo. Weerarkii Isniintii ayaa noqday isku daygii ugu weynaa ee ciidamada taageersan Laftagareen ay tan iyo bishii Maarso ku galaan Baydhaba, wuxuuna khilaafkii siyaasadeed mar kale u beddelay iska horimaad militari oo toos ah. items.title: Deni: “Mudug Waxaan U Abaal-gudayaa, Waxay U Qalmaan Laba Gobol iyo Ka Badan”
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Dowladda Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa sheegay in shacabka Gobolka Mudug ay door weyn ku leeyihiin dhismaha iyo dowladnimada Puntland, isla markaana ay mudan yihiin in loo abaalgudo kaalintii ay soo qaateen. Madaxweyne Deni ayaa tilmaamay in shacabka Mudug ay wax badan geliyeen dowladnimada, isagoo sheegay in gobolka uu leeyahay muhiimad gaar ah oo siyaasadeed iyo bulsho. “Gobolka Mudug waan u abaal-gudayaa, dadkiisu wax badan ayey gashadeen dowladnimada, waxay u qalmaan laba gobol iyo ka badan,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Deni. Hadalkan ayaa yimid xilli Madaxweyne Deni uu ku sugnaa gobolka Mudug, halkaas oo uu kulamo iyo kormeerro kala duwan kula yeeshay qeybaha bulshada iyo saraakiisha Dowladda Puntland. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Britain oo ka wada hadlay Dagaalka Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa maanta xafiiskiisa Muqdisho ku qaabilay Safiirka Boqortooyada Ingiriiska u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Danjire Charles King. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xaaladda amniga Soomaaliya, howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish, iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa taageerada Britain ay siiso hay’adaha amniga Soomaaliya. Labada dhinac ayaa sidoo kale ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Britain ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, iyadoo diiradda la saaray horumarinta awoodda ciidamada iyo yareynta khatarta kooxaha argagixisada. Wasiir Fiqi ayaa dowladda Britain uga mahadceliyay taageerada iyo garab-istaagga ay Soomaaliya siiso, isaga oo kulanka ku tilmaamay qayb ka mid ah wadatashiyada joogtada ah ee labada dal ee ku saabsan amniga iyo la-dagaallanka argagixisada.

items.title: Imaaraadka oo nin Soomaali ah u gacan geliyay Netherlands
items.description: Amsterdam (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Isutagga Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa Netherlands u gacan gelisay nin Soomaali ah oo haysta dhalashada dalkaas, kaas oo horey loogu xukumay dambiyo la xiriira ka ganacsiga daroogada, dhaqidda lacagaha iyo dambiyada abaabulan. Ninkan ayaa muddo baxsad ahaa, waxaana si gaar ah u raadinayay ciidamada Booliska Netherlands ee qaabilsan soo qabashada dadka dalka ka baxsada kaddib marka lagu rido xukunnada maxkamadaha. Sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiinta Netherlands, ninkan ayaa lagu qabtay Imaaraadka Carabta, kaddib markii dowladda Netherlands ay la shaqeysay hay’adaha ammaanka ee dalkaas si loo xaqiijiyo in dib loogu soo celiyo Netherlands. Ninkan ayaa oggolaaday habka degdegga ah ee maxkamad-dhiibidda, taasoo fududeysay inaan la marin hannaan dheer oo sharci ah, isla markaana si dhaqso ah loogu soo celiyo Netherlands. Mas’uuliyiinta Netherlands ayaa xaqiijiyay in ninkan uu subaxnimadii Jimcaha ka degay garoonka diyaaradaha Schiphol ee magaalada Amsterdam, halkaas oo loo qaaday si uu u sii wato xukunkii hore loogu riday. Maxkamadda Degmada Waqooyiga Netherlands ayaa bishii November 2022 ninkan ku xukuntay lix sano oo xabsi ah, kaddib markii lagu helay dambiyo la xiriira ka ganacsiga daroogada, dhaqidda lacagaha iyo ku lug lahaanshaha dambiyada abaabulan. Sida ay sheegtay Xafiiska Xeer Ilaalinta Dadweynaha Netherlands, ninkan ayaa weli u harsanaa 2,025 maalmood oo xabsi ah, taasoo u dhiganta ku dhowaad shan sano iyo lix bilood, waxaana hadda lagu wadaa inuu inta ka dhiman xukunkiisa ku qaato xabsiyada Netherlands. items.title: Somali Government Tightens Security Across Mogadishu After Recent Explosions
items.description: MOGADISHU— The Federal Government of Somalia has reinforced security measures across Mogadishu following a series of explosions reported in parts of the capital last week, none of which caused casualties. Security personnel have been increased at checkpoints throughout the city, with officers carrying out more extensive inspections of vehicles and passengers. Additional forces have also been deployed to residential neighbourhoods, where patrols and security searches are underway. Authorities have further intensified night-time operations across several districts of the Banadir region as part of efforts to prevent further attacks and strengthen security in the capital. The government has not yet released details on the outcome of the operations or confirmed whether any suspects have been detained. Multiple sources told Raxanreeb that the militarily trained police unit has resumed active security duties and is participating in the ongoing operations across Mogadishu. The unit had previously played a role in maintaining security in the capital. The heightened security presence comes amid renewed concerns over stability in Mogadishu following the recent explosions and reflects broader efforts by federal authorities to strengthen surveillance, patrols and security controls across the city. items.title: Kenya Urged to Arrest Laftagareen, Hand Him to Somalia
items.description: Baidoa – South West State’s Security Minister, Osman Isaaq Mohamed, has called on Kenya to arrest Laftagareen, the region’s former president, and extradite him to Somalia. Multiple Somali outlets reported the demand, made Thursday. The minister was addressing the security crisis in Baidoa after the deadliest clashes the city has seen since March. He accused former President Abdiaziz Hassan Mohamed “Laftagareen” of responsibility for recent attacks and bombings in the city. He said Laftagareen must face accountability for the violence. The demand to arrest Laftagareen lands at a tense moment for Somalia’s federal system. Baidoa has become the flashpoint in a months-long power struggle between the federal government and the man who once ran South West State. Last week’s battle for the city was the most serious armed confrontation since that dispute began. As a result, a political rift has hardened into open military conflict, with regional and diplomatic consequences that reach well beyond one city. Minister’s Direct Appeal to Nairobi Minister Mohamed did not soften his language. He said South West authorities want Kenya to detain the former leader and route him back to Somalia through Interpol’s international channels so that he can be held accountable. No Kenyan government official has publicly responded to the request as of this writing. The Battle That Preceded the Ultimatum The minister’s ultimatum came days after Baidoa’s fiercest fighting since March. Fighters loyal to Laftagareen entered the city from two directions before dawn on Monday, Aug. 17, and attacked positions held by federal forces, Reuters reported, citing a resident and a military officer. Laftagareen’s spokesperson, Hassan Mohamed, claimed on Facebook that the former president’s forces had captured Baidoa’s city center and called on federal troops to surrender. That claim could not be independently verified, Reuters noted. Federal forces later said they had driven the attackers out after hours of fighting. “I saw 10 dead people, including four civilians and six soldiers from both groups,” a local elder, Farah Ibrahim, told Reuters. Somalia’s Defence Ministry said its forces killed roughly 30 attackers and described them using a term the government applies to Islamist militants. It accused Laftagareen’s forces of fighting alongside Al-Shabaab and said the attackers used vehicles loaded with explosives, according to Al Jazeera’s report on the ministry’s statement. That casualty figure is the military’s own count and has not been independently verified. The fighting hit a city already under severe strain. A July survey by Médecins Sans Frontières found that one in four children in Baidoa’s displacement camps suffered from severe malnutrition, Reuters reported. Al-Shabaab Ties Alleged as Minister Hardens Stance Minister Mohamed escalated the federal side’s accusations this week. He said fighters loyal to the former president initially looked like aggrieved kinsmen but now show clear links to Al-Shabaab. Those who surrender, he said, would go through the same process used for Al-Shabaab defectors. Neither the minister’s claim nor the Defence Ministry’s account of an Al-Shabaab link has been independently verified. No court has confirmed any of the accusations against Laftagareen or his loyalists. Roots of the Baidoa Crisis Monday’s battle did not emerge from nowhere. It grew out of a political feud that has simmered since March. Laftagareen’s administration severed ties with the federal government that month, following a dispute over elections, constitutional changes, and the distribution of power between Mogadishu and the regional states. Federal forces then seized Baidoa on March 30. Laftagareen resigned as South West president the same day and left for Kenya. He has been based in Nairobi ever since. Meanwhile, forces and officials still loyal to him remained active outside Baidoa. Sporadic clashes and troop movements continued in the months that followed, keeping the standoff alive without a decisive break, until Monday’s assault turned it back into direct military confrontation. Background: Interpol, Extradition, and Precedent Interpol is a policing-cooperation body, not a court, so a “red notice” alone would not resolve the case. Any handover would still require a legal and diplomatic process between Kenya and Somalia, weighing the underlying charges and each country’s extradition rules. Kenya has used Interpol channels against Somalia-linked suspects before: in 2013, Interpol issued a notice at Kenya’s request for a British citizen wanted in connection with explosives charges after the Westgate mall attack in Nairobi.
