items.title: Somalia Does Not Need Another Closed-Door Deal
items.description: Why the Republic Needs a Third Way Between Central Domination and Permanent Fragmentation ? I have spent much of my professional life inside the rooms where Somalia’s fate is negotiated. I have also seen how agreements that appear durable at the negotiating table can unravel quickly when they lack broader political legitimacy. In those rooms, the language is always polished. Leaders and envoys speak of constitutional mandates, security architecture, electoral models, and federal compacts. But behind the diplomatic decorum lies a recurring, cynical habit: whenever an administration runs out of constitutional time, the political class retreats into a closed room to carve up the state into temporary shares. Today in Mogadishu, that exact script is playing out again. Four factions are haggling behind closed doors over an electoral framework, trading leverage, testing red lines, and calculating private guarantees. Meanwhile, outside that room, the executive apparatus pushes forward with unilateral manoeuvres across the Federal Member States, pretending that decrees can substitute for national consensus. Let us be unequivocal:  The future of the Somali Republic will not be settled by another backroom auction, nor will it be coerced by unilateral decree. A procedural pact among a handful of political elites will not save this country. What Somalia needs is not another temporary truce; it needs a structural transformation in how power, security, and the economy are governed. It needs  The Third Way . The Trap: Domination vs. Fragmentation After years of watching these cycles repeat, I have become convinced that Somalia is trapped between two approaches that have repeatedly failed to produce lasting stability: The first is  central coercion  – the illusion in Villa Somalia that national authority can be manufactured through top-down constitutional amendments, expired mandate extensions, and parallel security formations deployed to intimidate member states. But force is not authority. You cannot unify a federal republic by shredding the constitutional autonomy of its states. Parallel security chains do not project power; they invite tactical defeat, erode military discipline, and waste resources that belong on the frontlines against insurgency. The second is  permanent regional obstruction  – answering executive overreach solely through boycotts, localised resistance, and tactical factional alliances. Grievance is not a governing program. Tactical resistance can veto a bad decree, but it cannot build national courts, guarantee a soldier’s salary, secure trade routes, or protect the integrity of the state. Somalia does not have to choose between executive domination from the centre and endless fragmentation at the periphery. That false choice is where the old politics dies – and where  The Third Way  begins. The Three Pillars of The Third Way The Third Way is not a weak compromise or an exercise in splitting the difference. It is an institutional framework designed to replace political improvisation with sovereign rule of law. It rests on three non-negotiable pillars: 1. Federal Consent Before National Coercion Federal authority is legitimate when it is constitutional, agreed, and accountable; state authority is legitimate when it is constitutional, peaceful, and nationally responsible. National unity cannot be decreed from a palace. Experience has shown that institutions imposed without broad consent often struggle to command lasting legitimacy. Constitutional, electoral, and security arrangements cannot be settled while key Federal Member States, parliamentary chambers, traditional elders, and civil society are shut outside the room. Disagreement must have a structured, lawful path toward resolution before it turns into armed confrontation. 2. A Public Payroll and an Undivided Security Command A soldier’s salary is not an administrative afterthought; it is the bedrock of national discipline and sovereign dignity. A constitutional republic cannot tolerate parallel armed units operating as private political instruments. Every soldier, police officer, and intelligence operative must be verified through biometric, audited public payroll systems and answer strictly to a lawful, constitutional chain of command. National security resources must be directed entirely at protecting citizens and countering threats to the state – never at intimidating political rivals or securing an unconstitutional mandate. 3. A Sovereign Commercial Code Somalia welcomes foreign investment, but our sovereign assets are not for sale. Under a Sovereign Commercial Code, every concession, port contract, fisheries license, natural resource agreement, and public-private partnership will be subject to strict public law, open procurement, and beneficial ownership transparency. Our national infrastructure and trade corridors must never serve as private bargaining chips in elite political deals. International partnerships should support Somalia’s development while respecting its sovereignty and independent decision-making. Investment must strengthen the Republic, not purchase it. A State Grounded in Reality True statecraft is measured by what citizens feel on the ground, not what politicians sign in luxury suites. In Somalia, citizens have often learned to judge government not by promises or communiqués, but by whether institutions function when they are needed most. For the trader moving goods from Beledweyn to Mogadishu, the state is real when illegal checkpoints are dismantled and official commerce is protected. For the family of an officer in Bakool, the state is real when a salary arrives on time without political deduction. For our youth, the state is real when enterprise and public service offer a future worth staying for. A leadership capable of uniting this country must be capable of speaking to it in all its richness – bridging our regions in Maxaa and Maay, honouring our historical covenants, and treating every community not as scenery for political theatre, but as the sovereign foundation of the nation. The Mandate of Transition The closed-door talks in Mogadishu may conclude as all such talks do: with temporary accommodations that expire the moment personal ambitions clash. We are not waiting for an invitation to join another backroom bargain. We are offering the Somali nation an institutional roadmap that outlasts the individuals currently clinging to office. Whether Somalia embraces this path remains a matter for its citizens and leaders to decide. What is increasingly clear, however, is that sustainable stability will require institutions strong enough to outlast any individual administration. A State Grounded in Reality True statecraft is measured by what citizens feel on the ground, not what politicians sign in luxury suites. In Somalia, citizens have often learned to judge government not by promises or communiqués, but by whether institutions function when they are needed most. For the trader moving goods from Beledweyn to Mogadishu, the state is real when illegal checkpoints are dismantled and official commerce is protected. For the family of an officer in Bakool, the state is real when a salary arrives on time without political deduction. For our youth, the state is real when enterprise and public service offer a future worth staying for. A leadership capable of uniting this country must be capable of speaking to it in all its richness – bridging our regions in Maxaa and Maay, honouring our historical covenants, and treating every community not as scenery for political theatre, but as the sovereign foundation of the nation. The Mandate of Transition The closed-door talks in Mogadishu may conclude as all such talks do: with temporary accommodations that expire the moment personal ambitions clash. We are not waiting for an invitation to join another backroom bargain. We are offering the Somali nation an institutional roadmap that outlasts the individuals currently clinging to office. Whether Somalia embraces this path remains a matter for its citizens and leaders to decide. What is increasingly clear, however, is that sustainable stability will require institutions strong enough to outlast any individual administration. By Nuradin Dirie , Presidential candidate The post Somalia Does Not Need Another Closed-Door Deal appeared first on Daily Somalia .

items.title: Gaalkacyo: Saciid Deni oo maanta goobjoog u noqday guryo la dumiyey
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Dowlad-goboleedka Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni ayaa kormeer ku tegay goobaha ay biyuhu fariistaan ee bartamaha magaalada Gaalkacyo. Kormeerka ayaa la xiriiray qorshaha lagu hagaajinayo biyo-mareennada magaalada, iyadoo madaxweynaha uu indha-indheeyay goobaha ay ka socdaan howlaha lagu xallinayo caqabadaha ka dhasha biyaha roobka. Xilliga uu Siciid Deni booqashada ku tagayay goobahaasi waxaa ka socday shaqooyin isugu jiray baneyn iyo dumin dhismayaal, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu sameynayo marin-biyoodyo ay biyuhu si habsami leh u maraan. Goobahan ayaa horey loo calaamadeeyay kaddib markii injineerro baaritaanno ku sameeyeen dhulka iyo marinnada biyaha ee magaalada, iyagoo qiimeeyay meelaha ugu habboon ee laga sameyn karo biyo-mareennada. Ujeeddada kormeerka ayaa ahayd in Madaxweynaha Puntland uu xog-ogaal u noqdo xaaladda shaqada ka socota goobahaasi iyo qorshaha maamulka ee lagu horumarinayo nidaamka biyo-saarka magaalada Gaalkacyo. Siciid Deni ayaa warbixinno ka dhageystay guddoonka gobolka, maamulka degmada iyo taliska qaybta, kuwaas oo ku sugnaa goobaha ay ka socdaan howlaha duminta iyo furista marin-biyoodyada. Mas’uuliyiinta ayaa Madaxweynaha uga warbixiyay halka ay marayaan howlaha iyo caqabadaha jira, iyadoo la isla eegay tallaabooyinka loo baahan yahay si loo dardar-geliyo mashruuca biyo-saarka magaalada. Ugu dambeyn, Siciid Deni ayaa ugu baaqay bulshada iyo hay’adaha ay khuseyso inay ka qeyb qaataan mashaariicda biyo-saarka Gaalkacyo, si loo helo magaalo nadiif ah oo leh hannaan biyo-saar oo casri ah, lana jaanqaadaysa dunida horumartay. items.title: Who Governs Somalia’s Seas? Piracy, Foreign Force and the Political Economy of Maritime Disorder
items.description: By Abdisaid M. Ali Reports of a possible Turkish strike against suspected hijackers along Puntland’s coast present a dangerous test of Somalia’s sovereignty. The M/V LUTUF was reportedly seized 3.5 nautical miles off Marraya. Turkish vessels approached the area as aircraft maintained surveillance. An airstrike later killed four people, wounding two. Responsibility for the strike remains open, as does the victims’ involvement. Location determines the governing law. At 3.5 nautical miles, the seizure falls under Somali jurisdiction as armed robbery at sea. International piracy authority applies beyond national jurisdiction. Turkey’s 2026 naval mandate likewise applies beyond Somalia’s territorial waters. Public reporting identifies the seizure location; the strike location awaits confirmation. A foreign use of force within Somalia requires valid Somali consent, Security Council authority or lawful self defence. The conduct of any operation then engages necessity, proportionality, protection of life and public accountability. Public reporting has yet to identify the legal basis or authorising institution. Confirmation of Turkish responsibility would therefore raise a direct question about who authorised foreign force, under what limits and through which mechanism of accountability. Sovereignty becomes real when national institutions control these decisions. The episode exposes a wider imbalance. Foreign forces can monitor Somali waters using advanced aircraft and naval vessels. International trawlers extract marine resources under fragmented scrutiny. Piracy triggers warships, aircraft and international coordination. Illegal, unreported and unregulated fishing, opaque licensing, damaged livelihoods receive a weaker response. This imbalance echoes what our IGAD fieldwork revealed during the height of Somalia’s piracy crisis. From 2008 to 2010, I served as senior research team leader for an IGAD programme. I led the work that produced the Somalia Inland Strategy to Prevent and Counter Piracy for 2010 to 2015. Ours was the sole international research team at the time to enter the places then described as “pirate havens.” Fieldwork covered Eyl, Bosaso, Garowe and the wider Nugal region. Interviews drew participants from the Puntland government, security institutions, justice authorities, traditional leaders, religious figures, fishing communities and prisons. In Eyl, we visited former pirate centres, examining the shore networks sustaining piracy. That research showed that piracy extended far beyond crime at sea. It rested on an inland political economy linking international financiers, regional financiers, recruiters, negotiators, armed protectors, corrupt facilitators and coastal communities facing few legitimate economic opportunities. Industrial fishing entered this system as both grievance and enabling structure. The enabling chain Unlicensed vessels operate beside licensed fleets that enter coastal grounds, conceal catches, use prohibited gear or exceed quotas. Some industrial trawlers carry government documents while breaching Somalia’s fisheries law. Violations take the form of trawling or incursions into waters reserved for Somali fishermen. A licence establishes permission to fish. Its public value depends on credible surveillance, stock assessment and catch verification. Some activity is plainly illegal. Other operations hold formal authority yet remain poorly regulated, environmentally destructive and socially costly. Many international trawlers depend on Somali agents, licence brokers, political contacts, armed guards, coastal suppliers and informal payment networks. Their money sustains intermediaries who convert weak public authority into private protection. Somali brokers arrange licences, local representation, payments, political protection and contact with coastal authorities. Trawler owners benefit from these arrangements. They also carry responsibility for the legal compliance of their licences, agents and operations. Some officials at federal or Puntland level issue overlapping, opaque or improperly priced licences. Public authority becomes private access for incumbents. Owners profit; brokers receive commissions; officials collect revenue or side payments; coastal communities inherit depleted fishing grounds with few visible benefits. Armed Somali guards discourage fishermen from approaching, provide knowledge of patrol movements and connect vessels to coastal power networks. Their presence allows foreign operators to fish under weak public surveillance. The seizure of a Chinese trawler in 2024, after its Somali guards reportedly joined local armed men, illustrates how hired protection can mutate into armed predation. The same skills, weapons, boats & coastal contacts used to protect a trawler can be redirected towards seizing it. Opaque ownership arrangements, disabled tracking systems, concealed catches and incursions beyond authorised zones further weaken enforcement. Such practices blur the boundary between licensed commerce and organised maritime illegality. Industrial vessels that enter artisanal grounds or destroy local gear strip income from coastal communities. They deepen the belief that foreign interests receive stronger protection than Somali fishermen. Pirate networks turn that grievance into recruitment, local tolerance and claims of coastal defence. Present day piracy remains an organised ransom enterprise, separate from community fisheries enforcement. Pirate groups have seized Yemeni, Iranian and other fishing vessels for use as mother ships. These vessels provide fuel, food, navigation equipment, concealment and longer endurance at sea. They allow attacks on commercial shipping farther offshore. Industrial fishing therefore contributes through extraction, grievance and logistical opportunity. Responsibility remains unequal. Vessel owners profit from access. Officials authorise it. Brokers arrange protection. Guards enforce private claims at sea. Pirates convert grievance into violence and ransom. Each actor occupies a different position within the same maritime economy. Selective enforcement at sea International naval missions protect navigation, responding quickly when commercial vessels are attacked. Their mandates prioritise observation of suspicious fishing, leaving enforcement of Somali fisheries law to national authorities. This creates a visible imbalance. A hijacked merchant ship attracts warships, aircraft and international coordination. A trawler entering Somali coastal waters can make repeated incursions under weak enforcement. Somali authorities retain primary responsibility for fisheries enforcement. Fragmented authority across federal and Puntland institutions permits overlapping licences, producing uneven control. The wider imbalance reveals an architecture designed around the safety of international commerce. Coastal communities see marine wealth leave their waters as foreign shipping receives extensive protection. This perception strengthens the narrative used by pirate groups. Reclaiming maritime authority Puntland should replace the licensing system controlled by the presidency with an independent statutory fisheries authority. Published criteria should govern every licence. Fees should pass through the Treasury. A public register and annual audit should record every vessel, owner, agent, permitted species, authorised zone, quota, fee and expiry date. Coastal districts and fishing associations should receive a defined share of revenue. Puntland should enforce the trawling ban across Somali waters, protecting the coastal zone extending 24 nautical miles. Continuous vessel tracking, electronic catch reporting, gear inspection and port verification should become licence conditions. Foreign industrial fishing for bottom dwelling species should pause pending independent stock assessments. Performance bonds, prosecution of the enabling chain and court ordered confiscation should give enforcement real weight. A permanent maritime enforcement unit should coordinate surveillance and prosecution, confiscate vessels after serious violations, return a defined share of revenue to coastal communities and preserve legitimate trade with Yemeni buyers. Yemeni vessels can purchase Somali catches while foreign crews remain outside protected coastal grounds. This distinction supports local livelihoods, protects an established trading economy and strengthens compliance. Established under President Abdirahman Farole during the 2010 to 2011 piracy emergency, the Puntland Maritime Police Force (PMPF) was designed to strike pirate networks onshore, protect marine resources and police Puntland’s coast. Puntland should withdraw the PMPF from domestic political disputes and restore its original maritime mandate. Under statutory civilian oversight, the PMPF should protect coastal communities, enforce fisheries law, suppress piracy and confront illegal fishing. The central issue is maritime governance, encompassing foreign force, resource extraction and piracy. Somalia’s sovereignty at sea will become credible when public institutions govern access, apply the law impartially, protect coastal livelihoods and control every decision involving foreign force. Abdisaid M. Ali ———– Abdisaid is the chairperson of Lomé Peace and Security Forum and Former Somalia’s Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Somalia. items.title: The U.S. Military Shift in Berbera Changes Everything
Somalia oo wajahaysa halis amni kadib khatar ku wajahan…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Digniinaha kasoo baxaya saraakiisha iyo diblomaasiyiinta reer Galbeedka ee ku saabsan mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM waxay taabanayaan meel aad uga xasaasi badan doodda ku saabsan maalgelinta ciidamada Midowga Afrika. Su’aasha dhabta ahi waxay tahay waxa dhici kara haddii ciidamada ku sugan goobaha fogfog ay waayaan shidaal, raashin, caafimaad, gaadiid iyo saadka kale ee u saamaxaya inay sii joogaan. Arrintu waxay kusoo beegmeysaa xilli Soomaaliya weli ku jirto marxalad kala-guur oo amni, iyadoo dowladda federaalka ay dooneyso in ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si tartiib ah ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda guud ee amniga. Qorshahaas, inkastoo uu yahay himilo muhiim ah wuxuu ku tiirsan yahay in ciidamada Soomaaliya ay helaan awood ay ku qabsadaan, ku sugaan kuna maamulaan dhul ballaaran. Saadka oo noqday laf-dhabarta dagaalka Dagaal lagula jiro koox hubeysan sida Al-Shabaab laguma guuleysto oo keliya tirada askarta ama hubka ay haystaan. Saldhig ku yaalla meel fog wuxuu u baahan yahay shidaal joogto ah, cunto, biyo, dawo, gaadiid, isgaarsiin iyo awood lagu daadgureeyo askarta dhaawacma. Haddii mid ka mid ah silsiladahaas uu go’o, saldhigga wuxuu si tartiib ah u lumin karaa awooddii uu ku shaqeyn lahaa. Ciidamo tiro badan oo aan haysan saadka lagama maarmaanka ah ma noqon karaan ciidan si joogto ah u haysta dhul ay koox hubeysan ku sugan tahay ama weerarro ka fulin karto. Taasi waa sababta walaaca laga qabo UNSOS uusan u ahayn arrin farsamo oo keliya. Taageerada ay bixiso xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay waxay qayb ka tahay awoodda AUSSOM ay ku joogto goobaha ay ciidamadu ku sugan yihiin, gaar ahaan meelaha ka fog xarumaha waaweyn ee magaalooyinka. Khatar ku wajahan saldhigyada fogfog Saldhigyada fogfog ayaa ah kuwa ugu nugul marka saadka la yareeyo. Waxay inta badan ku yaallaan deegaanno ay Al-Shabaab si fiican u taqaan, halka waddooyinka iyo isku socodka dhulka ay noqon karaan kuwo halis ah. Haddii ciidamada AUSSOM ay awoodi waayaan inay si joogto ah u helaan shidaal, raashin iyo qalab kale, waxaa dhici karta in saldhigyo qaar la yareeyo ama laga baxo. Taasi waxay abuuri kartaa firaaq amni oo aan u baahnayn in Al-Shabaab ay dagaal weyn ku qaaddo si ay uga faa’iideysato. Kooxdu waxay horey uga faa’iideysatay xaalado ay ciidamada dowladda ama kuwa shisheeye ka baxeen deegaano ay horay uga talin jirtay. Sidaas darteed, bixitaan kasta oo aan lahayn qorshe cad oo lagu wareejinayo amniga wuxuu kordhin karaa halista in kooxda ay dib ugu soo laabato dhulkaas. Dhinaca kale, bixitaankii ciidamada Itoobiya ee qeybta ka ahaa AUSSOM ee degmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Baay wuxuu tusaale u yahay xaaladda laga cabsi qabo. Dadka deegaanka ayaa walaac ka muujiyay bixitaanka ciidamada, waxaana hadda taagan su’aasha ah cidda si dhab ah u buuxin karta booska ay baneeyeen. Haddii ciidamada Soomaaliya ay si degdeg ah ula wareegi waayaan saldhigyada iyo goobaha muhiimka ah, Al-Shabaab waxay heli kartaa fursad ay ku kordhiso dhaq-dhaqaaqeeda. Taasi macnaheedu ma aha in kooxdu si toos ah ula wareegi doonto magaalo kasta oo ciidamo shisheeye ka baxaan, balse firaaq kasta wuxuu siin karaa meel ay ka ballaariso weerarradeeda iyo cabsi-gelinta bulshada. Casharka muhiimka ah ee Buurhakaba ayaa ah in wareejinta amnigu aysan noqon karin oo keliya in calanka ama magaca ciidanka la beddelo. Ciidanka beddelaya waa inuu haystaa awoodda saadka, sirdoonka, dabagalka iyo gurmadka degdegga ah. Ciidanka Soomaaliya oo weli wajahaya caqabado Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay sameysay dadaallo lagu dhisayo ciidanka xoogga dalka, waxaana jira cutubyo awood u yeeshay inay ka qeyb qaataan howlgallo culus. Hase yeeshee, awoodda dagaal ee ciidanka iyo awoodda uu ugu shaqeyn karo si madax-bannaan muddo dheer waa laba arrimood oo kala duwan. Ciidan wuxuu dhul qabsan karaa isagoo helaya taageero dibadeed, balse su’aashu waxay tahay inuu awood u leeyahay inuu dhulkaas muddo dheer haysto. Arrintan ayaa ah halka ugu weyn ee kala-guurka amni ee Soomaaliya lagu tijaabin doono. Haddii AUSSOM ay is-dhimto iyadoo ciidamada Soomaaliya aan loo diyaarin inay si buuxda u buuxiyaan boosaska bannaan, waxaa dhici karta in qorshihii kala-guurka uu isu beddelo dib-u-noqosho amni. Taasi waxay noqon kartaa xaalad aad uga khatar badan dib u dhac ku yimaada jadwalka siyaasadeed ee howlgalka. Si kastaba, marka ciidamo shisheeye ka baxaan deegaan, kooxdu waxay sidoo kale ka faa’iideysan kartaa xogta ay ka hesho bulshada iyo shabakadaha ay ku leedahay miyiga. Taasi waxay u fududeyn kartaa inay dib u dhisto xiriirro iyo awood ay horay uga lumisay. Sidaas darteed, firaaqa amni ma aha oo keliya dhul aan askari joogin. Waa fursad ay kooxdu ku ballaarin karto dhaq-dhaqaaqeeda, ku ururin karto xog, ku weerari karto ciidamada iyo inay shacabka ku qanciso in dowladda aysan awood u lahayn inay ilaaliso. Maalgelin beddel ah oo noqotay lama huraan Haddii Mareykanku dhab ahaan yareeyo ama joojiyo maalgelinta la xiriirta UNSOS, su’aasha ugu weyn waxay noqonaysaa cidda qaadaysa kharashka ka dhasha adeegyadaas. Soomaaliya kaligeed ma fududa inay si degdeg ah u buuxiso baahida dhaqaale ee howlgal ballaaran oo kumannaan askari ku shaqeeyaan. Midowga Afrika iyo Qaramada Midoobay waxay u baahan doonaan inay helaan ilo dhaqaale oo la isku halleyn karo. items.title: DFS oo Caddeysay Mowqifkeeda ku Aaddan Qubrus
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi ah u caddeysay inay aqoonsan tahay madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Qubrus, iyadoo sheegtay in mowqifka rasmiga ah ee Soomaaliya uu yahay mid waafaqsan xeerarka caalamiga ah iyo qaraarrada Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in Soomaaliya ay mar kale muujisay ixtiraamka ay u hayso madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Qubrus, isla markaana ay raacayso sharciga caalamiga ah iyo qaraarrada Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Bayaanka ayaa sidoo kale xusay in Soomaaliya ay horey u aqbashay qaraarrada Golaha Ammaanka ee ku saabsan Qubrus, gaar ahaan qaraarrada tirsigoodu yahay 541 (1983) iyo 550 (1984). Wasaaradda ayaa si cad u sheegtay in qoraal ama aragti shaqsiyeed aysan metelin mowqifka rasmiga ah ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo taasi kusoo beegmaysa qoraal uu dhawaan Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ku muujiyay taageero ku aaddan Waqooyiga Qubrus ee ay Türkiye taageerto. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sheegtay in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ay tahay hay’adda u xilsaaran dejinta iyo ku dhawaaqista siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo ugu baaqday dhammaan hay’adaha iyo mas’uuliyiinta dowladda inay dhowraan awoodaha iyo waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee hay’adaha kala duwan. Bayaanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay sii wadi doonto taageerada ay u hayso mabda’a Axsaabta Qaranka ee Midowga Afrika, oo ay kamid yihiin madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee dalalka. Arrintan ayaa meesha ka saaraysa in hadalkii Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka loo fasirto inuu yahay mowqif rasmi ah oo ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka qaadatay xaaladda Qubrus. items.title: Kalluumeysatada Garmaal oo Ka Cabtay Duqeymo Lagu Burburiyay Doonyo
items.description: Nugaal (Raxanreeb Online): Kalluumeysatada deegaanka Garmaal ee gobolka Nugaal ayaa sheegay inay habeenkii xalay la kulmeen duqeymo lagu burburiyay doonyo ay ku xiranayeen xeebta. Kalluumeysatada ayaa sheegay in dhacdadan ay timid kaddib weerarro hore oo lagu beegsaday doonyo kale, kuwaas oo sababay dhimasho iyo burbur. Waxay sheegeen in xaaladda amni ee xeebaha ay keentay inay si weyn uga baqaan inay badda u baxaan, maadaama ay jirto cabsi laga qabo maraakiib iyo weerarro lagu beegsanayo doonyaha. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli la sheegay in dhowr markab oo ay afduubteen burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ay ku sugan yihiin aagga xeebaha Puntland, iyadoo wararka qaar ay sheegayaan in qaar kamid ah maraakiibtaasi ay xambaarsan yihiin hub iyo shidaal. Ilaa hadda, ma jiro dal si rasmi ah u sheegtay mas’uuliyadda duqeymaha, sidoo kalena ma jirto faahfaahin rasmi ah oo ka soo baxday Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ama maamulka Puntland oo ku saabsan dhacdooyinka. Soo laba-kaclaynta falalka burcad-badeednimada ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay xiisadaha ka jira Bariga Dhexe iyo Badda Cas ay mashquuliyeen xoogaggii iyo howlgaladii caalamiga ahaa ee muddooyinkii dambe diiradda saarayay la-dagaallanka burcad-badeedda Soomaaliya. items.title: Burcad-badeed Soomaali ah oo Qabsaday Markab Lala Xiriirinayo Iiraan iyo Xuutiyiinta
items.description: Puntland (Raxanreeb Online): Warbixin lagu daabacay The New York Times ayaa lagu sheegay in burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ay gacanta ku dhigeen markab shidaal oo dhawaan lagu afduubtay xeebaha Yemen, kaas oo la sheegay inuu ku rarnaa shidaal ama xamuul lala xiriirinayo Iiraan iyo Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Markabka ayaa lagu soo warramay inuu ku safrayay calanka Eritrea, waxaana burcad-badeedda ay markii dambe u jiheeyeen dhinaca xeebaha Soomaaliya. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay dib u soo xoogeysanayaan weerarrada burcad-badeedda Soomaalida ee ka dhaca biyaha ku dhow Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Wararka ayaa sidoo kale sheegaya in burcad-badeeddu ay hadda gacanta ku hayaan in ka badan shan markab oo lagu hayo xeebaha Puntland, kuwaas oo sida la sheegay qaarkood xambaarsan yihiin shidaal, hub ama badeecooyin kale. Haddii xogtan la xaqiijiyo, waxay muujin kartaa in burcad-badeedda Soomaalidu ay dib ugu soo laabteen goob istiraatiiji ah oo muhiim u ah Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badweynta Hindiya, xilli maraakiib badan ay ka fogaanayaan qaar kamid ah waddooyinka mara Badda Cas sababo amni awgood. Si kastaba, faahfaahinta ku saabsan cidda iska leh markabka, xamuulka uu siday iyo xiriirka uu la leeyahay Iiraan ama Xuutiyiinta waxay u baahan yihiin xaqiijin dheeraad ah oo rasmi ah. items.title: Xiisadda Türkiye iyo Israa’iil: Soomaaliya ma noqon kartaa goobta xigta ee loollanka?
items.description: Xiisadda u dhexeysa Türkiye iyo Israa’iil ayaa maalmahan si weyn u sii xoogeysatay. Dowladda Türkiye waxay hadda codsatay in Interpol ay soo saarto Red Notice oo ku saabsan Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israa’iil Benjamin Netanyahu, iyadoo arrintan la xiriirisay dacwad ka socota maxkamad ku taalla Istanbul oo ku saabsan weerarkii lagu qabtay maraakiib gargaar oo u socday Gaza. Dhanka kale, loollanka labada dal wuxuu si muuqata uga soo baxay Suuriyada, halka Israa’iil ay dhawaan duqeysay saldhig ku yaalla waqooyi-galbeed Suuriya, iyadoo ay sheegtay inay ka walaacsan tahay joogitaanka milatari ee Türkiye; Ankara ayaa cambaareysay tallaabadaas. Maxay Soomaaliya arrintan uga khuseysaa? Soomaaliya waxay Türkiye la leedahay xiriir amni iyo istiraatiiji ah oo sii xoogeysanaya. Baarlamaanka Türkiye ayaa bishii July kordhiyay muddada ciidamada Türkiye ay Soomaaliya ku joogayaan ilaa July 2028, iyadoo howlgalka uu ku saabsan yahay taageerada amniga iyo dib-u-dhiska awoodda difaaca Soomaaliya. Waxaa intaas dheer, Türkiye waxay si cad u taageertay midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan arrinta Somaliland. Türkiye waxay cambaareysay booqashadii sarkaal Israa’iili ah ee Hargeysa, waxayna sheegtay inay taageerayso midnimada dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Sidaas darteed, haddii loollanka Türkiye iyo Israa’iil uu sii fido, Geeska Afrika iyo Soomaaliya waxay yeelan karaan muhiimad istiraatiiji ah, laakiin hadda ma jirto caddeyn muujinaysa in Soomaaliya ay noqonayso goob ay labada dal si toos ah ugu dagaallamaan. Waxa ugu macquulsan in loollanku Soomaaliya uga muuqdo diblomaasiyad, saameyn siyaasadeed, amni iyo tartan istiraatiiji ah, halkii si toos ah looga arki lahaa iska horimaad militari. Su’aasha ugu weyn waxay noqonaysaa: haddii Türkiye ay sii ballaariso joogitaankeeda Soomaaliya, Israa’iilna ay sii kordhiso danaha ay ka leedahay Geeska Afrika iyo Badda Cas, Soomaaliya ma awoodi doontaa inay dhexdhexaad ka ahaato loollanka quwadahaas, mise waxay si tartiib ah ugu dhex milmi doontaa tartankooda? items.title: TURKIGA oo waaran soo qabasho u jaray Netanyahu
items.description: Istanbul (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Turkiga ayaa soo saartay amar caalami ah oo lagu doonayo in lagu soo xiro Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu, iyadoo tallaabadan qeyb ka tahay baaritaan ay Ankara ka waddo dhacdo la xiriirta doon gargaar oo u socotay Gaza. Wasiirka Caddaaladda Turkiga Akin Gurlek ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in amar qabasho caalami ah loo sameeyay Netanyahu, kaddib markii ciidamada Israel ay bishii May dhexda ka qabteen doon siday gargaar loogu waday dadka ku nool Gaza. Doonta ayaa lagu waday inay gaarsiiso gargaar bani’aadamnimo dadka Gaza, kuwaas oo muddo dheer wajahaya xaalad bani’aadamnimo oo aad u adag. Ciidamada Israel ayaa qabtay doonta, waxaana la xiray boqolaal ka mid ah dadka u ololeynayay gaarsiinta gargaarka. Gurlek ayaa sheegay in baaritaanka Turkiga uu diiradda saarayo dhacdadaas iyo tallaabooyinka ay ciidamada Israel ka qaadeen dadka saarnaa doonta. Ankara ayaa u aragta in dhacdadu ay u baahan tahay baaritaan dhinaca sharciga ah. Tallaabadan ayaa sii xoojinaysa cadaadiska sharci iyo diblomaasiyadeed ee Turkiga ay ku hayso hoggaanka Israel, xilli xiriirka labada dal uu si weyn u xumaaday sababo la xiriira dagaalka Gaza. Turkiga ayaa horay u soo saartay amarro qabasho oo ka dhan ah Netanyahu iyo saraakiil kale oo sare oo Israel ah, iyadoo lagu eedeeyay dambiyo la xiriira waxa Ankara ku tilmaantay xasuuq ka dhacay Gaza. Dowladda Israel ayaa si adag uga hortimid eedeymaha noocaas ah, iyadoo marar badan ku dooday in howlgalladeeda milatari ay yihiin kuwo looga gol leeyahay la-dagaallanka Xamaas iyo sugidda amniga Israel. Arrinta amarka cusub ayaa ku soo beegmaysa iyadoo dagaalka Gaza uu dhaliyay cambaareyn caalami ah, gaar ahaan marka laga hadlayo xaaladda dadka rayidka ah, burburka kaabayaasha iyo caqabadaha hortaagan gaarsiinta gargaarka bani’aadamnimo. Tallaabada Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale sare u qaadi karta xiisadda diblomaasiyadeed ee u dhexeysa Ankara iyo Tel Aviv, iyadoo Turkiga uu ka mid yahay dowladaha sida aadka ah uga hadlay dagaalka Gaza iyo xaaladda bani’aadamnimo ee ka dhalatay. Horey, Maxkamadda Caalamiga ah ee Dambiyada (ICC) ayaa Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu ugu jartay waaran soo qabasho, iyadoo waddamada xubnaha ka ah maxkamadda ay qaarkood saxiixeen heshiis ku waajibinaya inay fuliyaan amarka qabashada. items.title: Lama oga in ay Somalia yeelan doonto shiidaal  by Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in aan weli si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin karin in Soomaaliya laga heli doono shidaal ganacsi ahaan looga faa’iidaysto. Inkastoo Xasan uu muujiyay rajo weyn oo ku aaddan natiijooyinka sahminta iyo qodista ceelasha shidaalka ee dalka ka socda, haddana natiijada kama dambaysta ah ee sahminta ay ah tan go’aamin doonta in Soomaaliya leedahay kayd shidaal oo ganacsi ahaan laga faa’iidaysan karo. Madaxweynaha ayaa tilmaamay in dadaallada hadda socda ay weli ku jiraan marxalad sahamin iyo qiimeyn. “Soomaaliya inay shidaal yeelanayso weli lama oga, laakiin rajadeennu aad ayay u sarreysaa,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in muddada soo socota la filayo in la qodo ceelal kale, iyadoo dowladda Soomaaliya ay rajaynayso in natiijooyinka kasoo baxa sahminta shidaalka ay noqdaan kuwo wax weyn ka beddela dhaqaalaha dalka. Haddii la xaqiijiyo kayd shidaal oo ganacsi ahaan looga faa’iidaysan karo, Soomaaliya waxay heli kartaa fursad cusub oo lagu kordhin karo dakhliga dowladda, lagu abuuri karo shaqooyin, isla markaana lagu maalgelin karo adeegyada bulshada iyo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha. Si kastaba, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa ka digay in rajada laga qabo shidaalka aan loo qaadan xaqiiqo la xaqiijiyay, isagoo mar kale carrabka ku adkeeyay in natiijooyinka sahminta iyo qodista ceelasha ay yihiin kuwa go’aamin doona mustaqbalka kheyraadkaas. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa hore u sheegtay inay filayso natiijooyin rajo leh dhammaadka sanadkan, kadib markii Turkiga uu billaabay qodis badeedkii ugu horreeyay ee shidaal iyo gaas ah oo laga sameeyo xeebaha Soomaaliya. Markabka qodista shidaalka ee Çağrı Bey ayaa bishii April gaaray xeebaha Muqdisho, si uu u bilaabo qodista ceelka Curad-1, oo loo arko mid ka mid ah tillaabooyinka ugu waaweyn ee Soomaaliya ay u qaaday dhinaca sahminta shidaalka badda. Wasiirka Batroolka iyo Macdanta Soomaaliya, Daahir Shire Maxamed ayaa sheegay in xogtii laga soo ururiyay sahanka dhul-badeedka la dhammeystiray, lana fasiray, isla markaana hadda si rasmi ah loo bilaabay qodista ceelkii ugu horreeyay. Ceelka la qodayo ayaa la filayaa inuu gaaro qoto dhan 7,500 mitir, taas oo ka dhigaysa mid ka mid ah howlaha qodista badda ee ugu qotada dheer caalamka. Wasiirka ayaa markaas sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay rajo wanaagsan ka qabto in natiijooyin muuqda la helo dhammaadka sanadkan, inkastoo uu ka gaabsaday inuu saadaaliyo baaxadda kaydka shidaal ama gaas ee laga yaabo in laga helo. Mashruucan ayaa Soomaaliya u ah tijaabo weyn oo ku saabsan awooddeeda shidaal iyo gaas, halka Turkigana uu u yahay howl-galkiisii ugu horreeyay ee qodis badeed qoto dheer ah oo uu ka sameeyo meel ka baxsan biyihiisa. Labada dal ayaa rajeynaya in iskaashigan uu Soomaaliya u furo albaab dhaqaale oo cusub, isla markaana uu Turkiga ka caawiyo ballaarinta doorkiisa tamareed ee Geeska Afrika.   Source Caasimadda

items.title: Mogadishu’s Land Crisis: Are the Clerics Challenging Power—or Protecting It?
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s Union of Councils of Scholars has spoken out over the growing number of complaints surrounding land seizures, home demolitions and disputed property ownership in Mogadishu. But for many residents, the statement raises a more troubling question: Are the clerics genuinely challenging the authorities responsible for the crisis, or are they providing political cover for the government? The scholars have called for disputes to be taken to the courts, for ownership documents to be verified and for citizens to avoid taking the law into their own hands. On paper, those are reasonable principles. On the ground, however, many Mogadishu residents argue that they bear little resemblance to the reality they face. Critics say Somalia’s judicial institutions remain too weak and dysfunctional to provide meaningful protection in many property disputes. They question where an ordinary citizen is supposed to turn when a bulldozer arrives before dawn, accompanied by heavily armed security forces, to demolish a home before the owner has had a meaningful opportunity to challenge the decision. For residents facing such circumstances, simply being told to “go to court” can sound less like justice and more like an instruction to surrender. A Crisis Far Bigger Than a Legal Dispute Land in Mogadishu is not merely a commercial commodity. For thousands of families, it represents their home, livelihood, security and accumulated wealth. Critics of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s government accuse state authorities and politically connected interests of using government power to facilitate the seizure, transfer or redevelopment of valuable land. These allegations require no independent investigation and documentary verification, but the scale and persistence of public complaints have made the issue impossible to dismiss as isolated disputes. Some opposition voices and civil-society actors have also linked government land policies to large-scale displacement in the capital, with claims that more than 760,000 residents have been displaced or otherwise affected by land-related demolitions and dispossession. That figure should be independently verified, but the broader phenomenon of displacement is visible enough to have become a major source of public anger. For families who lose their homes, the question is not whether a title document can eventually be examined by a court. The immediate question is who will protect them when the demolition machinery arrives? The scholars’ appeal for calm and legal proceedings would carry greater weight if Somalia had a judiciary capable of consistently providing swift, independent, and credible remedies. Instead, critics argue that the statement risks appearing detached from the realities experienced by ordinary citizens. The public is asking a much harder question: Where is the moral authority of the scholars when citizens allegedly lose their homes through the use of state power? Rather than simply advising victims to preserve documents and seek judicial remedies, critics expected the clerics to demand an immediate moratorium on disputed demolitions, independent investigations into land transfers, public disclosure of government land records, and accountability for officials who abuse their authority. They expected the religious leadership to stand visibly beside vulnerable citizens—not merely issue statements urging them to remain patient. The criticism goes further. Some sections of the public increasingly view the clerics as another institution unwilling to confront President Hassan Sheikh’s administration directly. Their critics argue that the scholars’ carefully worded appeals ultimately place the burden on victims while avoiding direct accountability for those accused of using government authority to dispossess them. That perception has led some residents to describe the scholars as functioning less as an independent moral voice and more as an extension of the government’s political messaging—an image critics have also applied to senior government officials, including Defence Minister Ahmed Macallin Fiqi. Whether that perception is fair or not, it is politically damaging. Religious scholars who are expected to speak for justice risk losing public credibility if citizens believe they are protecting those in power rather than challenging abuses of power. Citizens Need Protection, Not Just Advice There is an important distinction between calling on citizens to “take the law into their own hands” and calling on them to peacefully organize, document abuses, demand accountability, and defend their constitutional rights. No responsible institution should encourage citizens to confront armed forces violently. But neither should citizens be expected to remain silent when they believe their constitutional rights are being violated. The scholars could have urged affected communities to organize peacefully, establish documentation committees, seek independent legal assistance, petition parliament and local authorities, demand public hearings, engage civil society and journalists, and insist that disputed demolitions be suspended until ownership is independently determined. That would be a meaningful defense of the rule of law. The land crisis presents a test not only for President Hassan Sheikh’s government, but also for Somalia’s religious, judicial, and political institutions. If the government believes its land policies are lawful, it should publish the relevant records, explain the legal basis for disputed acquisitions, identify the beneficiaries of transferred land, and allow independent scrutiny. If the judiciary is functioning effectively, it should demonstrate that citizens can obtain urgent protection before their homes are destroyed—not after the bulldozers have left. And if the clerics truly intend to defend justice, they must do more than tell victims to seek remedies that may not exist in practice. The people of Mogadishu do not need lectures about the rule of law. They need the rule of law to work. They need protection before the bulldozer arrives, accountability after abuses occur, and institutions strong enough to ensure that political power cannot determine who keeps a home and who loses one. Until that happens, every statement about land disputes will be judged against the reality on the streets of Mogadishu—and against the growing perception that those who should speak for the victims are instead speaking around the government. items.title: Opposition Talks Advance as Nabad & Nolol and Future Council Seek Common Election Position
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Discussions between the Nabad & Nolol political bloc and the Future Council are making cautious progress, with the two opposition groupings reportedly reaching agreement on one key issue, while another remains under discussion and Nabad & Nolol has attached a condition to a proposed joint initiative. According to information obtained by WardheerNews through reports on Somali Media, a delegation from the Future Council visited the residence of former President Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed “Farmaajo” on Thursday night. The delegation included former Galmudug President Abdikarim Hussein Guled, former NISA Director Abdullahi Sanbalashe, and MP Geele, all members of the Future Council. MP Abdishakur Mire also attended the meeting alongside Farmaajo. The delegation reportedly conveyed a message from senior Future Council leaders, calling for the opposition to harmonize its positions on the upcoming elections and the political transition period. The initiative appears aimed at preventing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud from exploiting divisions within the opposition to extend or strengthen his political position. Farmaajo welcomed the proposal, according to sources familiar with the discussions, and expressed support for developing a unified opposition position. He also emphasized that his political stance was not driven by personal hostility toward any particular individual. Following the meeting, the Future Council reportedly proposed that Nabad & Nolol and the Future Council jointly determine the membership of a proposed technical task force tasked with advancing discussions on the electoral and transitional arrangements. Nabad & Nolol is said to have accepted the proposal in principle, but attached a condition that the task force membership be divided equally on a 50–50 basis between the two opposition blocs. While this issue appears to have moved closer to agreement, a broader and potentially more consequential question remains under discussion: whether all opposition forces can agree on a single electoral model. Sources say efforts are continuing to determine whether the wider opposition can present a common position on the type of election Somalia should hold, an issue that has become one of the central fault lines in the country’s ongoing political crisis. Farmaajo and Sharif Hold Separate Meeting Meanwhile, former Presidents Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed Farmaajo and Sharif Sheikh Ahmed held a meeting on Tuesday at the headquarters of the Himilo Qaran political organization. The two former presidents reportedly agreed on the need to increase political pressure on President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud to accept an inclusive electoral agreement involving all major political stakeholders. The meeting comes as opposition groups attempt to consolidate their positions amid continuing uncertainty over Somalia’s electoral roadmap and the country’s broader political transition. The ongoing dialogue between Nabad & Nolol and the Future Council is reportedly being coordinated by former minister Cabdirahman Dheere, who has been tasked with organizing the meetings between the two opposition camps. The emerging discussions could mark an important step toward overcoming divisions among Somalia’s opposition groups. However, major differences remain, particularly over the electoral model, the composition of the proposed technical task force, and the broader terms of any political agreement with the Federal Government. If the opposition succeeds in reaching a unified position, it could significantly alter the political balance ahead of the next electoral phase. Conversely, continued disagreement could provide the Federal Government with greater room to maneuver as the political contest over elections and the transition intensifies. The delegation reportedly conveyed a message from senior Future Council leaders, calling for the opposition to harmonize its positions on the upcoming elections and the political transition period. The initiative appears aimed at preventing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud from exploiting divisions within the opposition to extend or strengthen his political position. Farmaajo welcomed the proposal, according to sources familiar with the discussions, and expressed support for developing a unified opposition position. He also emphasized that his political stance was not driven by personal hostility toward any particular individual. Following the meeting, the Future Council reportedly proposed that Nabad & Nolol and the Future Council jointly determine the membership of a proposed technical task force tasked with advancing discussions on the electoral and transitional arrangements. Nabad & Nolol is said to have accepted the proposal in principle, but attached a condition that the task force membership be divided equally on a 50–50 basis between the two opposition blocs. While this issue appears to have moved closer to agreement, a broader and potentially more consequential question remains under discussion: whether all opposition forces can agree on a single electoral model. Sources say efforts are continuing to determine whether the wider opposition can present a common position on the type of election Somalia should hold, an issue that has become one of the central fault lines in the country’s ongoing political crisis. Farmaajo and Sharif Hold Separate Meeting Meanwhile, former Presidents Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed Farmaajo and Sharif Sheikh Ahmed held a meeting on Tuesday at the headquarters of the Himilo Qaran political organization. The two former presidents reportedly agreed on the need to increase political pressure on President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud to accept an inclusive electoral agreement involving all major political stakeholders. The meeting comes as opposition groups attempt to consolidate their positions amid continuing uncertainty over Somalia’s electoral roadmap and the country’s broader political transition. The ongoing dialogue between Nabad & Nolol and the Future Council is reportedly being coordinated by former minister Cabdirahman Dheere, who has been tasked with organizing the meetings between the two opposition camps. The emerging discussions could mark an important step toward overcoming divisions among Somalia’s opposition groups. However, major differences remain, particularly over the electoral model, the composition of the proposed technical task force, and the broader terms of any political agreement with the Federal Government. If the opposition succeeds in reaching a unified position, it could significantly alter the political balance ahead of the next electoral phase. Conversely, continued disagreement could provide the Federal Government with greater room to maneuver as the political contest over elections and the transition intensifies. items.title: Museveni Again Pressures Hassan Sheikh Over Somalia’s Political Crisis
items.description: Kampala (WDN) — Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni has once again publicly criticized Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, accusing him of failing to resolve the political disputes between his government and the opposition. In remarks published by African Intelligence , Museveni reportedly warned that Uganda could withdraw its troops from Somalia if President Hassan fails to reach a political settlement with his opponents. This is not the first time Museveni has attempted to pressure the Somali president over the country’s deepening political crisis, particularly the dispute over elections and the political transition following the expiration of Hassan’s constitutional mandate. The latest warning follows a previous summit hosted by Museveni in Kampala, where an attempt was reportedly made to include Somalia’s internal political dispute in the meeting’s final communiqué. President Hassan strongly objected, arguing that Somalia’s domestic political affairs should not be addressed in a forum involving foreign governments. Hassan reportedly made his position clear during the summit, telling Museveni and the conference organizers that Somalia’s internal political disagreements were a matter for Somalis to resolve. He immediately demanded that the reference be removed from the communiqué, and the disputed language was subsequently dropped. Museveni’s latest intervention therefore represents a renewed attempt to exert political pressure on Mogadishu by linking Uganda’s military presence in Somalia to progress in the country’s political dialogue. Uganda remains an important troop-contributing country to Somalia’s international security mission, making any threat of withdrawal potentially significant for the country’s already fragile security environment. However, President Hassan appears unlikely to welcome external involvement in negotiations with Somalia’s opposition. His position so far has been that disputes over elections, constitutional arrangements and the political transition should be resolved through a Somali-led process rather than through pressure or mediation by individual foreign governments. Museveni’s comments nevertheless underscore the growing international concern over Somalia’s unresolved political crisis and the potential consequences it could have for both governance and security. Maxay ka dhigan tahay in wasiir iska casilay DF uu dib ugu laabto shaqadiisa?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiiru-dowlaha Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Soomaaliya, Saadaad Caliyow ayaa dib ugu laabtay shaqadiisa kaddib markii uu ka haray tartankii doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Arrintan waxay dhalisay hadal-hayn xooggan iyo su’aalo hor leh, inkastoo Saadaad uu sheegay in warqaddii istiqaaladda ee uu gudbiyay aan laga aqbalin, sidaasna uu shaqada ugu laabtay. Marka hore, waxaa muhiim ah in la kala saaro laba arrimood: qofka oo ku dhawaaqa inuu is-casilay iyo istiqaalad si rasmi ah u dhaqan gashay. Labadaasi isku macne ma aha. Haddii mas’uul uu warqad istiqaalad gudbiyo, balse xafiiska ama hay’adda awoodda u leh magacaabistiisa aysan aqbalin, waxaa suurtagal ah in xilkiisii sharci ahaan sii socdo. Sida uu Saadaad Caliyow sheegay, warqaddiisa istiqaaladda lama aqbalin, taasoo ka dhigan in dhinaca dowladda aan loo arkin inuu si rasmi ah uga baxay xilka. Sidaas darteed, dib ugu laabashadiisa shaqada waxay noqon kartaa natiijo ka dhalatay in istiqaaladdii aysan helin oggolaanshihii loo baahnaa. Maxaa ka dambeeyay istiqaaladda? Si kastaba, waqtiga ay arrintani dhacday ayaa ah mid mudan in si gaar ah loo eego. Saadaad Caliyow wuxuu istiqaaladda ku dhawaaqay xilli uu rabay inuu galo tartanka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, taasoo ka dhigan in xilka fulinta iyo hamigiisa siyaasadeed ay is dul saarnaayeen. Istiqaaladdaas waxaa loo fasiran karaa inay ahayd isku day uu ku doonayay inuu kala saaro xilkiisa dowladda iyo tartanka uu galay. Tani waa arrin siyaasadeed oo la fahmi karo, maadaama xil sare oo dowladda ah iyo u tartamidda hoggaanka baarlamaanka ay abuuri karaan dood ku saabsan dhex-dhexaadnimada iyo isticmaalka awoodda dowladda. Markii uu tartankii ka haray, xaaladda ayaa is beddeshay. Maadaama sababtii ugu weynayd ee uu xilka uga tegay meesha ka baxday, dib ugu laabashada wasaaradda waxay noqotay waddo macquul ah, haddii istiqaaladdii aan hore loo aqbalin. Maxaa laga filayaa dowladda? Dowladda Federaalka waxaa looga baahan yahay inay caddeyso nidaamka lagu maareeyay istiqaaladda. Haddii aan la aqbalin, waa in la caddeeyo cidda diiday, sababta loo diiday iyo in mas’uulka si rasmi ah loogu wargeliyay inuu xilka sii wato. Tani ma aha arrin ku kooban Saadaad Caliyow. Waa tusaale muujin kara sida dowladda u maareyso istiqaaladaha mas’uuliyiinta marka ay jiraan isbeddello siyaasadeed ama tartamo doorasho. Haddii mas’uul kasta uu awood u leeyahay inuu ku dhawaaqo istiqaalad, haddana si fudud ugu laabto xafiiska iyadoo uusan jirin habraac cad, waxaa dhaawacmi kara fahamka dadweynaha ee nidaamka maamulka dowladda. Saadaad Caliyow wuxuu sidoo kale tusaale u yahay sida siyaasadda Soomaaliya ay mararka qaar isugu dhex milmaan xilalka dowladda iyo tartamada siyaasadeed. Dhacdadani waxay xukuumadda siinaysaa fursad ay ku caddeyso habraacyada xilalka. Waa muhiim in la ogaado in mas’uulku marka uu istiqaalad gudbiyo uu weli yahay mas’uul shaqeynaya ilaa laga aqbalo, mise warqadda lafteedu ay leedahay saameyn sharci ah. Haddii jawaabtu noqoto in aqbalaad rasmi ah loo baahan yahay, waxaa habboon in nidaamkaas si joogto ah loogu dabaqo dhammaan mas’uuliyiinta. Taasi waxay meesha ka saari kartaa fasiraadaha siyaasadeed ee ku saabsan in qof gaar ah loo oggolaaday wax aan cid kale loo oggolaan. Si kastaba, dib ugu laabashada Saadaad Caliyow ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha waxay u muuqataa marka laga duulo hadalkiisa inay ka dhalatay in istiqaaladdii uu gudbiyay aan la aqbalin iyo inuu ka haray tartankii Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Sidaas darteed, dhacdadu ma aha oo keliya sheeko ku saabsan mas’uul xilka iska casilay oo haddana ku soo noqday ee waxay taabaneysaa sida Soomaaliya u maareyso xilalka dowladda, tartanka siyaasadeed iyo habraaca istiqaaladaha. items.title: Sanctioning Ecuador-Based Cocaine Network Linked to Violent Gangs and Mexican Cartels
items.description: Sanctioning Ecuador-Based Cocaine Network Linked to Violent Gangs and Mexican Cartels Press Statement Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, Spokesperson August 20, 2026 Stopping the flow of drugs to the United States is one of the Trump Administration’s highest priorities. Today, the United States sanctioned an Ecuador-based network of 15 individuals and entities and identified 10 Ecuador-based fishing vessels as blocked property for their role in trafficking thousands of kilograms of cocaine each month from South America to Mexico, destined for distribution in our homeland. Today’s actions expose and disrupt the deepening convergence between Ecuador’s most violent terrorist organizations and major Mexico-based cartels, including the Foreign Terrorist Organizations (FTO) Sinaloa Cartel and Cártel de Jalisco Nueva Generación (CJNG), which have accelerated the flow of cocaine into the United States. The network targeted today also maintains ties to two Ecuador-based terrorist organizations – Los Choneros and Los Lobos – that the Department of State designated as FTOs in September 2025. These trafficking operations generate billions of dollars annually for cartels responsible for a significant share of the deadly drugs flowing into our communities. The United States will continue to use all our tools to dismantle the cartels profiting at the expense of American lives. Today’s action is being taken pursuant to Executive Order (E.O.) 14059, which targets the international proliferation of illicit drugs and their means of production, and E.O. 13224, as amended, which targets terrorists and their supporters. For more information on today’s action, see the Department of the Treasury’s press release .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh: Lama oga in Soomaaliya ay yeelan doonto shidaal
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa sheegay in aan weli si rasmi ah loo xaqiijin karin in Soomaaliya laga heli doono shidaal ganacsi ahaan looga faa’iidaysto. Inkastoo Xasan uu muujiyay rajo weyn oo ku aaddan natiijooyinka sahminta iyo qodista ceelasha shidaalka ee dalka ka socda, haddana natiijada kama dambaysta ah ee sahminta ay ah tan go’aamin doonta in Soomaaliya leedahay kayd shidaal oo ganacsi ahaan laga faa’iidaysan karo. Madaxweynaha ayaa tilmaamay in dadaallada hadda socda ay weli ku jiraan marxalad sahamin iyo qiimeyn. “Soomaaliya inay shidaal yeelanayso weli lama oga, laakiin rajadeennu aad ayay u sarreysaa,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in muddada soo socota la filayo in la qodo ceelal kale, iyadoo dowladda Soomaaliya ay rajaynayso in natiijooyinka kasoo baxa sahminta shidaalka ay noqdaan kuwo wax weyn ka beddela dhaqaalaha dalka. Haddii la xaqiijiyo kayd shidaal oo ganacsi ahaan looga faa’iidaysan karo, Soomaaliya waxay heli kartaa fursad cusub oo lagu kordhin karo dakhliga dowladda, lagu abuuri karo shaqooyin, isla markaana lagu maalgelin karo adeegyada bulshada iyo kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha. Si kastaba, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa ka digay in rajada laga qabo shidaalka aan loo qaadan xaqiiqo la xaqiijiyay, isagoo mar kale carrabka ku adkeeyay in natiijooyinka sahminta iyo qodista ceelasha ay yihiin kuwa go’aamin doona mustaqbalka kheyraadkaas. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa hore u sheegtay inay filayso natiijooyin rajo leh dhammaadka sanadkan, kadib markii Turkiga uu billaabay qodis badeedkii ugu horreeyay ee shidaal iyo gaas ah oo laga sameeyo xeebaha Soomaaliya. Markabka qodista shidaalka ee Çağrı Bey ayaa bishii April gaaray xeebaha Muqdisho, si uu u bilaabo qodista ceelka Curad-1, oo loo arko mid ka mid ah tillaabooyinka ugu waaweyn ee Soomaaliya ay u qaaday dhinaca sahminta shidaalka badda. Wasiirka Batroolka iyo Macdanta Soomaaliya, Daahir Shire Maxamed ayaa sheegay in xogtii laga soo ururiyay sahanka dhul-badeedka la dhammeystiray, lana fasiray, isla markaana hadda si rasmi ah loo bilaabay qodista ceelkii ugu horreeyay. Ceelka la qodayo ayaa la filayaa inuu gaaro qoto dhan 7,500 mitir, taas oo ka dhigaysa mid ka mid ah howlaha qodista badda ee ugu qotada dheer caalamka. Wasiirka ayaa markaas sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay rajo wanaagsan ka qabto in natiijooyin muuqda la helo dhammaadka sanadkan, inkastoo uu ka gaabsaday inuu saadaaliyo baaxadda kaydka shidaal ama gaas ee laga yaabo in laga helo. Mashruucan ayaa Soomaaliya u ah tijaabo weyn oo ku saabsan awooddeeda shidaal iyo gaas, halka Turkigana uu u yahay howl-galkiisii ugu horreeyay ee qodis badeed qoto dheer ah oo uu ka sameeyo meel ka baxsan biyihiisa. Labada dal ayaa rajeynaya in iskaashigan uu Soomaaliya u furo albaab dhaqaale oo cusub, isla markaana uu Turkiga ka caawiyo ballaarinta doorkiisa tamareed ee Geeska Afrika. Wasiirka ayaa markaas sheegay in dowladda Soomaaliya ay rajo wanaagsan ka qabto in natiijooyin muuqda la helo dhammaadka sanadkan, inkastoo uu ka gaabsaday inuu saadaaliyo baaxadda kaydka shidaal ama gaas ee laga yaabo in laga helo. Mashruucan ayaa Soomaaliya u ah tijaabo weyn oo ku saabsan awooddeeda shidaal iyo gaas, halka Turkigana uu u yahay howl-galkiisii ugu horreeyay ee qodis badeed qoto dheer ah oo uu ka sameeyo meel ka baxsan biyihiisa. Labada dal ayaa rajeynaya in iskaashigan uu Soomaaliya u furo albaab dhaqaale oo cusub, isla markaana uu Turkiga ka caawiyo ballaarinta doorkiisa tamareed ee Geeska Afrika. items.title: U.S. Sanctions Smuggling Network for Qods Force and Hizballah
items.description: Press Statement Thomas “Tommy” Pigott, Spokesperson August 20, 2026 For decades, the Iranian regime has used Hizballah to spread terror throughout the Middle East. Today, the U.S. Department of the Treasury is renewing its designation of Hizballah for its actions in support of Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps-Qods Force (IRGC-QF). Treasury is also designating ten individuals that are part of a network responsible for transferring cash between the IRGC-QF and Hizballah. The network uses couriers traveling on commercial airline flights between Lebanon, Turkiye, the UAE, and Iran to move hundreds of millions of dollars, enabling the regime to obtain foreign currency illicitly, evade sanctions, and fund Hizballah. The investigation and disruption of this network are the result of close coordination and collaboration with our Turkish partners. The United States will not relent in targeting Iran’s financial support networks, including those enabling Hizballah to threaten peace, undermine the sovereignty of the Lebanese state, and endanger the security of our regional allies. Today’s action is being taken pursuant to the counterterrorism authority, Executive Order (E.O.) 13224, as amended. The Department of State designated Hizballah as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist (SDGT) pursuant to E.O. 13224 on October 31, 2001. The Department of State designated Hizballah as a Foreign Terrorist Organization (FTO) pursuant to section 219 of the Immigration and Nationality Act on October 8, 1997. The Department of the Treasury designated the IRGC-QF as an SDGT pursuant to E.O. 13224 on October 25, 2007. The Department of State designated the IRGC-QF as an FTO pursuant to section 219 of the Immigration and Nationality Act on April 8, 2019. For more information on today’s action, see the Department of the Treasury’s press release .

DF oo kala caddeysay in ay aqoonsatay kala go’a Qubrus kadib tallaabadii Jaamac
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa caddeysay in mowqifkeeda ku aaddan qadiyadda Qubrus uu weli yahay mid aan isbeddelin, isla markaana uu ku salaysan yahay Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay iyo midka khuseeya qaraarrada ee Golaha Ammaanka ee QM. Bayaan kasoo baxay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa lagu muujiyay ixtiraamka buuxa ee Soomaaliya ay u hayso madax-bannaanida, gobannimada, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Qubrus, iyadoo la raacayo sharciga caalamiga ah iyo kan khuseeya qaraarrada ee Golaha Ammaanka ee QM, oo ay ku jiraan qaraarrada tirsigoodu yahay 541 (1983) iyo 550 (1984). Wasaaradda ayaa si cad u sheegtay in qoraal shakhsi ah oo dhawaan baraha bulshada lagu baahiyay uusan matalin siyaasadda rasmiga ah ee dowladda Soomaaliya, isla markaana aan loo fasiran karin inuu yahay isbeddel ku yimid siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee dalka. “Qoraalkaasi ma ahayn aqoonsi loo sameeyay cid ama maamul gaar ah oo ka jira waqooyiga Qubrus, mana jirto wax go’aan ah oo ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya qaadatay oo lagu beddelaayo mowqifkeeda rasmiga ah ee ay muddada dheer ku taagnayd,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaanka dowladda. Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa dhawaan xiriir la sameeyey dhiggiisa Qubrusta Waqooyiga ee Turkigu taageero, taas oo dhalisay dood diblomaasiyadeed iyo in loo dhigo isbeddel ku yimid mowqifkii Soomaaliya ee Jamhuuriyadda Qubrus, taas oo maanta markale cadeysay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda. Hoos ka aqriso bayaanka wasaaradda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay caddeyneysaa, kaddib tixraacyadii iyo hadalladii dhowaan ka soo baxay doodaha dadweynaha, in mowqifkeeda ku aaddan qadiyadda Qubrus uu weli yahay mid aan isbeddelin, isla markaana uu ku salaysan yahay Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay iyo midka khuseeya qaraarrada ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxay mar kale sheegeysaa ixtiraamka buuxa ee ay u hayso madax bannaanida, gobannimada, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Qubrus, iyadoo la raacayo sharciga caalamiga ah iyo kan khuseeya qaraarrada ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay, oo ay ku jiraan Qaraarrada tirsigoodu yahay 541 (1983) iyo 550 (1984). Sidaasi darteed Qoraalka shakhsiga ah ee baraha bulshada lagu baahiyay ee arrintaan loo tixraacay ma matalaayo, mana loo fasiran karo inuu yahay wax ka beddel ku yimid siyaasadda arrimaha dibadda ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Qoraalkaasi ma ahayn aqoonsi loo sameeyay cid ama maamul gaar ah oo ka jira waqooyiga Qubrus, mana jirto wax go’aan ah oo ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya qaadatay oo lagu beddelaayo mowqifkeeda rasmiga ah ee ay muddada dheer ku taagnayd. Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay mar kale carabka ku adkeeyneysaa taageeradeeda joogtada ah ee ku aaddan in qadiyadda Qubrus lagu gaaro xal nabadeed, isla markaana ku salaysan wada xaajood waara, iyadoo hoos imanaysa dhexdhexaadinta iyo dadaalada Qaramada Midoobay, lana waafajinaayo sharciga caalamiga ah iyo kan khuseeya qaraarrada Golaha Ammaanka. Dowladda Soomaaliya waxaa weli si buuxda uga go’an ilaalinta mabaadi’da Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay iyo in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo si nabad ah. items.title: Cirro oo shaaciyey in uu rabo in Somaliland uu ka dhigo Jabuuti-da cusub – Sidee?
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Somaliland, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro) ayaa ka hadlay qorshayaasha xukuumaddiisa ee ku aaddan amniga Badda Cas, horumarinta ganacsiga gobolka iyo dadaallada lagu raadinayo aqoonsi caalami ah, isagoo sheegay inuu doonayo in Somaliland ay ka faa’iidaysato muhiimadda istiraatiijiga ah ee xeebteeda. Cirro oo waraysi siiyay majaladda caanka ah ee The Economist xilli uu booqasho ku joogay magaalada Nairobi ee Kenya ayaa xusay inay Berbera tahay xarun muhiim u ah ganacsiga gobolka, gaar ahaan isu socodka badeecadaha u kala goosha Geeska Afrika iyo suuqyada caalamka. The Economist ayaa sheegtay in Cirro uu doonayo in Itoobiya ay kordhiso isticmaalka dekedda Berbera, taasoo ka caawin karta Somaliland inay xoojiso doorkeeda ganacsi, isla markaana Itoobiya oo aan lahayn xeeb ay hesho marin kale oo ay u adeegsato ganacsigeeda caalamiga ah. Dekedda Berbera ayaa waxaa ka socda maalgashi ballaaran oo ay sameysay shirkadda laga leeyahay Imaaraadka Carabta, waxaana Somaliland ay dooneysaa in dekeddaasi ay noqoto mid ka mid ah marinnada ugu muhiimsan ee ganacsiga Itoobiya iyo guud ahaan Geeska Afrika. Wareysiga ayaa sidoo kale lagu xusay rabitaanka Somaliland ee ah in Mareykanku saldhig milatari ka sameysto Berbera. Sida The Economist qortay, saldhig noocaas ah wuxuu Washington siin karaa meel istiraatiiji ah oo uu kaga hawlgalo gobolka, gaar ahaan haddii uu go’aansado inuu dib u bilaabo duqaymaha ka dhanka ah Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Majaladda ayaa sidoo kale xustay in si weyn loo rumaysan yahay in helitaanka xarumo milatari oo ku dhow Berbera uu qeyb ka ahaa arrimaha lagu xiriiriyay heshiiskii ay Israa’iil la gashay Somaliland markii ay aqoonsatay Somaliland bishii December. Cirro ayaa Somaliland tusaale ahaan ugu soo qaatay Jabuuti oo ah dal yar oo ku yaalla meel istiraatiiji ah oo u dhow marin-biyoodka Badda Cas, balse hoy u ah saldhigyo ay isticmaalaan quwadaha waaweyn sida Mareykanka, Shiinaha iyo Faransiiska. Jabuuti ayaa sidoo kale dhaqaale badan ka hesha adeegyada dekedaheeda iyo saldhigyada ciidamada shisheeye, iyadoo Itoobiya ay ka mid tahay dalalka sida weyn ugu tiirsan dekedaha dalkaas. Somaliland ayaa doonaysa inay qaabkan oo kale uga faa’iidaysato juqraafi ahaan muhiimadda Berbera. “Waxa aanu doonaynaa in Somaliland ay noqoto Jabuuti-da cusub,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Cirro, isagoo qeexaya aragtida xukuumaddiisa ee ku aaddan in Somaliland ay isku mar uga faa’iidaysato fursadaha amni, ganacsi iyo maalgashi ee ka jira gobolka. Qorshahan ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli xukuumadda Somaliland ay xoogga saareyso sidii ay u soo jiidan lahayd quwadaha caalamka iyo maalgashadayaasha, iyadoo aqoonsi caalami ah uu weli yahay mid ka mid ah ajandayaasha ugu waaweyn ee Madaxweyne Cirro. Haddii qorshayaashaas hirgalaan, Berbera waxay noqon kartaa xudunta istiraatiijiyadeed ee Somaliland ay ku doonayso inay ku xoojiso xiriirka caalamka iyo doorkeeda Geeska Afrika. items.title: Kulaylka cimilada iyo biyo yari isbiirsaday oo nolol adag galiyay reer-guuraaga Galgaduud
items.description: (ERGO) – Qorrax kulul, dhul ooman ah iyo biyo qaali ah oo dadku awoodi la’ yihiin. Waa sawirka nololeed ee maanta ka jira deegaanno badan oo ka tirsan gobolka Galgaduud, halkaas oo boqollaal qoys oo xoolo dhaqato ah la hal gamayaan biyo yari sii xoogeysatay. Abaar daba dheeraatay, roob yari soo noqnoqotay iyo kayd biyo oo aan jirin ayaa saamayn ku yeeshay nolosha dadka iyo xoolaha ay dhaqdaan. Deegaanada Balli-khayre, Balli-sonkor, Miirxaylay iyo Ballicad oo hoos taga degmada Cadaado waxay dhammaan lee yihiin biyo qabadyo dabiici ah, balse maanta xooluhu waxay u dhimanayaan harraad, dadka inta awoodana waxay gadanayaan biyo qaali ah oo laga soo dhaamiyo meelo fog. Balliyadan looma sameyn kannaalo biyaha uga soo qaada meelo kala duwan, gunta hoose kuma leh firaash, sida bac iyo wax la mid ah oo ka hor taga in dhulku cabo biyaha. Roob yaridu waxay keentay in biyo kooban ay galaan balliyada, kuwaasna ay dhaqso u dhammaadaan, dhulka oo nuugay darteed. Xaaladan waxay ka dhigtay xoolo dhaqatada halkan ku nool in sanooyin dhowr ah ay wajahayaan biyo yari soo noqnoqotay oo sii darsata xilligga jiilaalka ama abaarta. Xoolaha oo nacfi leh waxay dadka ka dhigi jireen kuwo iibsan kara biyaha, balse hadda dadku waxay iskugu jiraan kuwo baaruhu ceyrteeyeen iyo in dhaqda xoolo nafaqadoodu liidato, daaq iyo biyo ku filan oo aysan helin darteed. Axmed Aadan Xasan oo ku nool deegaanka Balli-khayre ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in qoyskiisa oo ka kooban 11 ah ay awoodi la’ yihiin inay iibsadaan biyaha oo fuustadii la gadayo $6. Booyado ayaa ka soo dhaamiya deegaanka Miirjiiclay oo qiyaastii 30 km u jira. Wuxuu   sheegay in maalintii oo dhan ay ku tiirsan yihiin 10 illaa 20 liitir oo ay ku caawiyaan deriskooda. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay u isticmaalaan oo kaliya cabitaan iyo cunto karin, ayna meesha ka baxday dhardhaqid, qubeys iyo nadaafad kale. “Deegaanka biyo yaridu waligeed way ka soo jirtay marba heer maraysay, hadda way usii daran tahay. Biyuhu aad bay u yaryihiin oo lama heloo oon ley aad u xun weeye. items.title: DF ma si hoose ayey Turkiga ugala macaamilaysa kheyraadka dalka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa beenisay inay dooneyso inay si hoose ugala macaamisho Turkiga kheyraadka dalka, xilli Ankara ay gacanta ku hayso mashruuca soo saarista shidaalka. Wasiirka Batroolka iyo Kheyraadka Macdanta Soomaaliya, Daahir Shire Maxamed oo ka hadlay iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga ee dhinacyada kheyraadka dabiiciga ah ayaa si cad u sheegay in labada dal aysan doonayn inay qariyaan heshiisyada iyo wada shaqeynta ka dhaxeysa. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in iskaashiga kheyraadka dabiiciga ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga uu yahay mid si dhow ay ula socdaan bulshada caalamka, isla markaana aan labada dhinac wax sir ah ka lahayn waxa ay ka wada shaqeynayaan. Daahir Shire ayaa tilmaamay in xiriirka labada dhinac uu muddooyinkii dambe ka gudbay heerkii saaxiibtinimada, isagoo sheegay inuu maanta gaaray heer uu ku tilmaamay xiriir walaaltinimo iyo iskaashi istiraatiiji ah. “Saaxiibka dhabta ahi waa marka uu kula joogo xilliga xaaladdu adag tahay. Turkiga waxay ka gudubtay saaxiibtinimo, waxayna u gudubtay walaaltinimo,” ayuu yiri wasiir Daahir Shire. Wuxuu xusay in booqashadii uu Madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ku yimid Muqdisho bishii August 2011 ay ku soo beegantay xilli Soomaaliya ay ku jirtay xaalad adag, isla markaana dalka uu wajahayay dhibaatooyin amni, siyaasadeed iyo bani’aadantinimo. Sida uu sheegay wasiirku, xilligaas dalal badan oo caalamka ah ayaa ka fogaaday xaaladda Soomaaliya, iyagoo ka walaacsanaa in dhibaatooyinka dalka ay saameyn ku yeeshaan ama ay iyaga soo gaaraan. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu sheegay in Ankara ay xilligaas Soomaaliya garab istaagtay, iyadoo xiriirka labada dal uu markii hore ku bilowday kaalmo bini’aadantinimo, balse uu sannadihii xigay isu beddelay iskaashi dhinacyo badan taabanaya. Iskaashigaas ayaa sida uu sheegay wasiirku hadda ku fiday dhinacyada amniga, madax-bannaanida, maalgashiga iyo kheyraadka dabiiciga ah, iyadoo Ankara ay ka mid noqotay dalalka sida weyn uga qeyb qaata taageerada Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale wasiirka ayaa sheegay in labada dal ay doonayaan in kheyraadka dabiiciga ah ee dalka uu ugu dambeyn faa’iido u noqdo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. “Qeybsiga kheyraadka naga dhexeeya Turkiga iyo Soomaaliya waa mid aynaan qarin karin, waana mid dunidu ay indhaha ku hayso,” ayuu yiri wasiirka. Ugu dambeyntiina, waxa uu rajo ka muujiyay in iskaashiga labada dal uu sii xoogeysan doono, isla markaana mustaqbalka dhow la arki doono natiijooyin waaweyn oo ka dhasha maalgashiga iyo wada-shaqeynta Muqdisho iyo Ankara, gaar ahaan dhinacyada kheyraadka dabiiciga ah iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha dalka. items.title: Maxaa ka run ah digniinta Museveni ee Xasan Sheekh iyo khilaafka labada madaxweyne?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Saacadihii la soo dhaafay waxaa baraha bulshada iyo warbaahinta qaar si weyn loogu faafiyay warar ku saabsan khilaaf xooggan oo u dhexeeya Madaxweynaha Uganda, Yoweri Museveni iyo Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kaas oo lagu xiriiriyay joogitaanka ciidamada Uganda ee Soomaaliya. Wararka la faafiyay ayaa lagu sheegay in Madaxweyne Museveni uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ku wargeliyay inuu heshiis la gaaro mucaaradka, haddii kale ay Uganda ciidamadeeda kala bixi doonto Soomaaliya. Hadalkan ayaa loo soo bandhigay qaab u muuqda digniin cusub oo Uganda ay u jeedisay dowladda Soomaaliya. Hase yeeshee, xogta ay heshay Caasimada Online ayaa muujineysa in hadalkaasi uusan ahayn mid cusub oo saacadihii la soo dhaafay ka soo baxay Madaxweyne Museveni, balse uu asal ahaan ka soo jeedo shir hore oo ka dhacay magaalada Kampala. Sida xogtu tilmaamayso, shirkii Kampala waxaa ka dhashay dood la xiriirta war-murtiyeedka shirka, iyadoo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu markaas diiday in lagu daro qodob la xiriira arrimaha gudaha Soomaaliya. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay hadal uu Madaxweyne Museveni ka jeediyay goobta. Museveni oo markaas ka hadlay xaaladda ka taagan Soomaaliya ayaa Xasan Sheekh ku cadaadinayay in war-murtiyeedka lagu soo daro qodob ku saabsan in xal degdeg ah laga gaaro xiisadda siyaasadeed ee ka dhalatay doorashooyinka, inkastoo markii dambe Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu ka raalli-geliyay qodobkii uu diiday. “Ciidamadeenna Soomaaliya ayay ku dhintaan, xuduud lama lihin, balse dano ayaa naga dhexeeya,” ayuu markaas hadalkiisa sii raaciyay Museveni. Hadalkaas ayaa shalay dib u soo baxay kaddib markii warbaahinta African Intelligence ay ka qortay xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo amni ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo warbixinteeda ay sidoo kale taabatay khilaafaadka gudaha dalka iyo caqabadaha dhaqaale ee la xiriira maalgelinta howlgalka AUSSOM. Si kastaba, warbaahinta qaar ee gudaha dalka ayaa hadalka Museveni u soo bandhigtay sidii digniin cusub oo ka soo baxday dowladda Uganda, taasoo abuurtay faham ah in Kampala ay hadda qorsheynayso inay ciidamadeeda kala baxdo Soomaaliya haddii dowladda federaalka aysan heshiis la gaarin mucaaradka, taas oo gebi ahaanba ah “wax xaqiiqada ka fog”. Dowladda Uganda ayaa haatan xoojinaysa xiriirkeeda Soomaaliya, iyadoo si cad u muujisay muhiimadda ciidamadeedu u leeyihiin amniga Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Uganda ayaa maalin ka hor sheegay in ciidamada Uganda ay sii joogi doonaan Soomaaliya xitaa haddii ciidamada Midowga Afrika ay dalka ka baxaan, kaddib heshiis laba-geesood ah oo ay gaareen Soomaaliya iyo Uganda. Arrintan ayaa muujinaysa sida ay muhiim u tahay in warbaahinta gudaha ay xil iska saarto waxa ay baahinayso, ayna ka taxaddarto wararka xaqiiqada laga fogeeyay. Sideedaba, waa in la kala saaraa hadal hore oo Madaxweyne Museveni jeediyay, warbixin cusub oo falanqayn ah iyo go’aan rasmi ah oo dowladda Uganda ay hadda qaadatay. Sidaas darteed, hadalka Museveni looma fasiri karo si toos ah inuu yahay go’aan cusub oo Uganda ay ku sheegtay inay ciidamadeeda kala baxayso Soomaaliya. Maadaama Uganda ay ka mid tahay dalalka ugu waaweyn ee ciidamadoodu qeybta ka yihiin howlgalka AUSSOM, isla markaana ay muddo dheer taageeraysay dowladda Soomaaliya iyo dagaalka lagula jiro Al-Shabaab, arrintani waxay leedahay muhiimad gaar ah. Sidaas darteed, go’aan rasmi ah oo Kampala ka soo baxa wuxuu yeelan lahaa saameyn weyn oo amni iyo mid siyaasadeed.
