items.title: Maamulka Dhuusamareeb Oo Soo Saaray Go’aanno Ku Saabsan Bilicda Magaalada Iyo Dhismayaasha Laamiga
items.description: Maamulka dowladda hoose ee magaalada Dhuusamareeb, xarunta dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, ayaa soo saaray go’aanno iyo amarro cusub oo lagu hagaajinayo bilicda guud ee magaalada, gaar ahaan dhismayaasha iyo goobaha ganacsiga ee ku teedsan waddada laamiga ah ee dhowaan dib-u-dhiska lagu sameeyay. Duqa magaalada Dhuusamareeb, Cabdiraxmaan Cali Maxamed (Geedaqorow), oo arrintan faahfaahinayay, ayaa caddeeyay in tallaabadani ay salka ku hayso sidii loo ilaalin lahaa muuqaalka caasimadda kaddib dadaalladii ballaarnaa ee lagu bixiyay dhismaha wadada laamiga ah. Dib-u-dhiska Guryaha Qadiimiga Ah Maamulka ayaa milkiilayaasha guryaha iyo dhismayaasha ku yaalla hareeraha laamiga ku amray inay dhisaan ama dayactiraan dhismayaasha burbursan iyo kuwa ka samaysan jiingadaha, si loogu beddelo dhismayaal dhagax ah oo bilicda kor u qaadaya. Masaafada U Dhaxaysa Dhismayaasha Iyo Laamiga Waxaa la faray ganacsatada iyo dadweynaha in meelaha bannaan ee u dhexeeya hantidooda iyo waddada laamiiga ah ay dhigaan daamurka yar-yar ama interlock-ga (dhagaxa laamiga la saaro), iyadoo la raacayo qorshaha dowladda hoose. Xalinta Guryaha Maqan Maamulka ayaa sheegay in sharcigu u oggolaanayo dowladda hoose inay wakiil ka noqoto dadka maqan ama hantida aan cidi joogin, iyadoo shirkado ama maalgashadayaal loo diri doono inay dhisaan goobahaas si aysan u noqon meelo foolxumo ku abuura waddada dhexmarto caasimadda. Xaaladda Ganacsatada Yar-yar (Haweenka Qudaarta) Iyadoo la tixgelinayo duruufaha nololeed ee ganacsatada danyarta ah, gaar ahaan haweenka qudaarta ku iibiya hareeraha waddada, maamulku wuxuu ballanqaaday in loo diyaarinayo suuqyo gaar ah oo ay si habaysan oo ganacsi ku dheehan tahay ugu adeegi karaan bulshada. Maamulka caasimadda ayaa hoosta ka xariiqay in ujeeddada amarradani aysan ahayn in dadka lagu dhibo balse ay tahay in kor loo qaado heerka magaalo-madaxnimo ee Dhuusamareeb, iyadoo qof walba loogu baaqay inuu ka qeyb qaato horumarka iyo bilic-soo-celinta magaalada.

items.title: WFP Oo Shaacisay In 6 Milyan Oo Soomaali Ah Ay Wajahayaan Cunto-Yari Ba’an
items.description: Barnaamijka Cunnada Adduunka ee Qaramada Midoobay (WFP) ayaa ka digay in lix milyan oo qof oo Soomaaliyeed ay wajahayaan cunto-yari ba’an, xilli ay si weyn hoos ugu dhacday maalgelinta loo heli karo howlaha gargaarka bani’aadannimo. Ku-simaha Agaasimaha Fulinta WFP, Carl Skau, ayaa sheegay in hay’addu hadda haysato toban-meelood meel dhaqaalihii ay haysatay sannadkii 2022, markaas oo gurmad ballaaran oo caalami ahi gacan ka geystay in Soomaaliya laga baajiyo macluul. Dhaqaale-yaraanta jirta ayaa WFP ku qasabtay inay gargaarka nafaqada ku koobto carruurta xaaladdoodu ugu daran tahay, iyadoo aanay hay’addu awoodin inay ballaariso taageerada ay gaarsiiso qoysaska kale ee nugul. WFP waxay saadaalisay in 1.9 milyan oo carruur Soomaaliyeed oo da’doodu ka yar tahay shan sano ay sannadkan la kulmi karaan nafaqo-darro ba’an. Ku dhowaad 500,000 oo ka mid ah carruurtaas ayaa la filayaa inay u baahdaan daaweyn degdeg ah oo la xiriirta nafaqo-darro aad u daran. Saameynta cunto-yarida ayaa si weyn looga dareemayaa xarumaha caafimaadka iyo nafaqada ee ku yaalla Muqdisho. Xarunta Feynuus ee degmada Kaxda ayaa maalin kasta qaabbisha inta u dhexeysa 250 iyo 350 bukaan, kuwaas oo u badan haween iyo carruur ka soo barakacay gobollada dalka. Maamulka xarunta ayaa sheegay in ku dhowaad toban xarumood oo caafimaad iyo nafaqo ah oo ku yaallay deegaannada ku dhow ay xirmeen kadib markii la dhimay maalgelintii bani’aadannimo. Arrintan ayaa cadaadis dheeraad ah saartay xarumaha kooban ee weli shaqeynaya. Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Qaranka, Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle, ayaa xaaladda cuntada dalka ku tilmaamay mid aad looga walaaco. Hay’addu waxay sheegtay in qiyaastii laba milyan oo qof ay u baahan yihiin gargaar degdeg ah. Abaarta daba dheeraatay, colaadaha, barakaca, kororka qiimaha cuntada iyo shidaalka iyo hoos u dhaca kaalmada caalamiga ah ayaa lagu tilmaamay sababaha ugu waaweyn ee sii xumeynaya xaaladda. Amni-darrada ka jirta qaybo ka mid ah dalka ayaa sidoo kale adkaynaysa in gargaarka la gaarsiiyo bulshooyinka ku nool deegaannada fog. WFP waxay sheegtay inay haysato shaqaalaha iyo awoodda farsamo ee lagu ballaarin karo howlaha gurmadka, balse ay u baahan tahay dhaqaale dheeraad ah. Hay’addu waxay uga digtay beesha caalamka in dib-u-dhac ku yimaada maalgelintu uu khatar gelin karo nolosha malaayiin qof, gaar ahaan carruurta, haweenka uurka leh iyo qoysaska barakacayaasha ah. Inkasta oo xaaladda lagu tilmaamay cunto-yari ba’an, WFP ma aysan shaacin in Soomaaliya si rasmi ah looga diiwaangeliyey macluul. Hase yeeshee, hay’adaha gargaarka ayaa ku baaqaya in tallaabo degdeg ah la qaado si looga hortago in xaaladdu gaarto heer ka sii daran.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo caddeysay mowqifkeeda ku aaddan Qubrus
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa si rasmi ah u caddeysay in mowqifkeeda ku aaddan arrinta Qubrus uusan waxba iska beddelin, kaddib hadal dhawaan ka soo baxay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo dhaliyay dood ku saabsan siyaasadda Soomaaliya ee Qubrus. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ee Soomaaliya ayaa bayaan ay soo saartay ku sheegtay in Soomaaliya ay si buuxda u ixtiraamayso madaxbannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Jamhuuriyadda Qubrus, iyadoo mowqifkaas ku saleysan Axdiga Qaramada Midoobay iyo qaraarrada Golaha Ammaanka ee QM, gaar ahaan qaraarrada 541 ee 1983 iyo 550 ee 1984. Wasaaraddu waxay sidoo kale caddeysay in xiriir ama qoraal shaqsiyeed oo dhawaan la sameeyay uusan matalin isbeddel ku yimid siyaasadda rasmiga ah ee dowladda Soomaaliya. “Ma jiro wax go’aan ah oo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay ku beddeshay mowqifkeeda,” ayay Wasaaraddu ku adkaysay bayaankeeda. items.title: Xog: DF oo qorsheynaysa dib u furista garoonka Doolow
items.description: Doolow (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa lagu wadaa inay dib u amarto furitaanka garoonka diyaaradaha ee magaalada Doolow, kaas oo muddo ku dhow laba sano u xirnaa sababo la xiriira khilaaf siyaasadeed iyo xiisado ka jiray gobolka Gedo. Sida ay Caasimada Online u xaqiijiyeen ilo xog-ogaal ah, dowladda ayaa maalmaha soo socda qaadeysa tallaabada lagu fasaxayo garoonka, kaddib markii ay socdaan dadaallo lagu xallinayo khilaafkii sababay xiritaankiisa. Xogta la helayo ayaa sheegeysa in uu wada-hadal gaar ah dhexmaray Guddoomiyaha degmada Doolow-Lafeey iyo Xafiiska Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, kaas oo diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda garoonka iyo sidii dib loogu bilaabi lahaa howlihiisa. Labada dhinac ayaa lagu soo warramayaa inay isku afgarteen in garoonka si toos ah loo fasaxo maalmaha soo socda, iyadoo dowladda federaalka ay qaadi doonto tallaabada rasmiga ah ee lagu amrayo dib u furitaankiisa. Garoonka Doolow ayaa muddo dheer muhiim u ahaa isku socodka dadka iyo gaadiidka cirka ee gobolka Gedo, waxaana xiritaankiisu saameyn ku yeeshay isu socodka dadka deegaanka iyo adeegyada la xiriira duulimaadyada. Xiritaanka garoonka ayaa salka ku hayay xiisad siyaasadeed oo muddo ka taagnayd gobolka Gedo, taasoo qeyb ka ahayd khilaafka u dhexeeyay dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo maamulka Jubaland. Khilaafka labada dhinac ayaa saameyn ku yeeshay arrimo badan oo la xiriira maamulka iyo amniga gobolka, iyadoo Doolow uu ka mid noqday goobihii uu si toos ah u saameeyay loollanka siyaasadeed ee dowladsa dhexe iyo maamulka Jubaland. Dib u furista garoonka ayaa noqon karta tallaabo lagu yareynayo saameynta culeyska ka dhashay xiritaanka garoonka oo ka mid ahaa garoomada muhiimka ah ee gobolka, kaasi oo muddo dheer xirnaa. Waxaa sidoo kale la filayaa in dib u furista garoonka Doolow ay fududeyso isu socodka dadka ku nool gobolka Gedo iyo deegaanada kale ee dalka, iyadoo shirkadaha diyaaradaha ay heli doonaan fursad ay dib ugu bilaabaan duulimaadyadii garoonka. Si kastaba, tallaabada rasmiga ah ee dib loogu furayo garoonka ayaa la filayaa inay soo baxdo maalmaha nagu soo food leh, iyadoo arrintan ay qeyb ka tahay dadaallada dowladdu dooneyso inay hoos ugu dhogto xiisadaha siyaasadeed ee ka jira gobolka Gedo. items.title: Culimada Soomaaliyeed oo dalbaday in baaris la bilaabo, uuna Xasan degdeg u joojiyo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Midowga Golayaasha Culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa kulan ay ku yeesheen magaalada Muqdisho uga hadlay cabashooyinka isa soo taraya ee la xiriira dhulalka iyo guryaha laga duminayo qaybo ka mid ah caasimadda. Culimadu waxay dowladda uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ugu baaqeen inay si degdeg ah u joojiso tallaabo kasta oo lagu duudsinayo muwaadiniinta xuquuqdooda milkiyadeed. Culimadu waxay sheegeen in kulankooda si gaar ah looga hadlay cabashooyin badan oo ay bulshada ka heleen, kuwaas oo la xiriira muranno dhul iyo guryo ah oo ka taagan magaalada Muqdisho, sidaas darteedna ay baaqan degdegga ah soo saareen. Waxay tilmaameen in qaar ka mid ah dadka cabashada soo gudbiyay ay haystaan dukumiintiyo ay ku caddeynayaan lahaanshaha hantidooda, balse ay sheegeen in haddana muran laga geliyay milkiyaddooda ama laga qaaday hantidooda. Sidoo kale, culimadu waxay sheegeen in qaar ka mid ah dadka ay cabashadu quseyso lagu soo rogay lacago aan lahayn saldhig sharci oo cad, taasoo ay ku tilmaameen arrin u baahan in si dhab ah loo baaro. Waxay carrabka ku adkeeyeen in hantida qofka aan looga qaadi karin awood, amar maamul ama cabsi gelin, haddii aan la marin hannaan sharci iyo garsoor oo caddaalad ah, iyagoo ku baaqay in la ilaaliyo xuquuqda muwaadiniinta. Midowga Golayaasha Culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa baaq u diray Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Ra’iisul Wasaaraha, maamulka gobolka Banaadir iyo hay’adaha ay khuseyso arrimaha dhulka, iyagoo ka dalbaday inay si madax-bannaan u baaraan dhammaan cabashooyinka la xiriira dhulalka iyo guryaha. Culimadu waxay sidoo kale ku baaqeen in lala xisaabtamo cid kasta oo lagu helo ku-takrifal awoodeed, boob hantiyeed ama musuq-maasuq, iyagoo sheegay in ilaalinta hantida muwaadiniintu ay muhiim u tahay xasilloonida bulshada iyo kalsoonida shacabka. Dhanka kale, waxay garsoorka ugu baaqeen inuu si madax-bannaan oo caddaalad ah uga shaqeeyo khilaafaadka dhulka, halka ganacsatada, nootaayooyinka iyo dilaaliinta ay uga digeen inay ku lug yeeshaan hanti lagu helay dulmi iyo xaq-darro. Midowga Golayaasha Culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegay in haddii aan si degdeg ah wax looga qaban cabashooyinka soo noqnoqday ay qaadi doonaan tallaabooyinka ay u arkaan inay ku habboon yihiin xaaladda, iyagoo ku adkeystay baahida loo qabo in la dhowro xuquuqda milkiyadeed iyo sharciga. Baaqa ka soo baxay culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa imanaya xilli dowladda ay magaalada Muqdisho ka wado banneeynta dhulka danta guud, iyadoo markii dambe ay isa soo tarayeen wararka sheegaya in qaab awood ah dad shacab ah looga raray dhul aan dan-guud ahayn. Horay siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ayaa baaqyo uga soo saaray arrimaha dhulka danta guud iyo tallaabooyinkii ugu dambeeyay ee dowladda sida qasabka ah uga saaraysay shacabka deggen dhulkaasi, kuwaas oo sanado badan ay degganaayeen. Madaxdii hore iyo siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ayaa dhul-boob u arka waxa ka socda magaalada Muqdisho ee caasimadda dalka, iyagoo si adag u cambaareeyay barakicinta shacabka ee ay dowladdu ku howlan tahay. items.title: Warbixin sheegaysa in kooxda Alshabaab ay tababar ka heshay Xuutiyiinta Yemen
items.description: Xogo laga helay dakhliga ay Al-Shabaab ka uruurin jireen Muqdisho iyo tababar ay ka heleen Xuutiyiinta Yemen. Warbixin cusub oo loo gudbiyey Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa sheegtay in al-Shabaab ay u muuqato inay wax ka beddeshay qaabka ay uga hawlgasho Soomaaliya, iyadoo yareysay tirada weerarrada balse xoogga saartay hawlgallo si gaar ah loo qorsheeyey loona bartilmaameedsaday. Warbixintu waxay sidoo kale soo bandhigtay sheegashooyin ku saabsan xidhiidhka Al-Shabaab ay la leedahay Xuutiyiinta Yemen iyo Al-Qaacida ee Jaziiradda Carabta, tababar la sheegay in boqolaal dagaalyahan loo fidiyey iyo isku dayga kooxda ee helitaanka qalab casri ah oo ay kaga hortagto diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn. Dukumentigan oo tirsigiisu yahay S/2026/651, lana daabacay 10-kii Agoosto 2026, waa warbixintii 38-aad ee Kooxda Dabagalka Cunaqabateynta ee Qaramada Midoobay, taas oo baarta dhaqdhaqaaqyada Daacish, Al-Qaacida iyo kooxaha xiriirka la leh. Mid ka mid ah qodobbada ugu muhiimsan warbixinta ayaa ah in Al-Shabaab ay u muuqato inay ka leexatay weerarradii tirada badnaa ee la arkay sannadkii 2025. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, kooxda waxay qaadday weerarro ka yar kuwii hore gudaha Muqdisho iyo deegaannada ku dhow, iyadoo hawlgalladeeda ay si weyn ugu urureen Hirshabeelle, Jubada Hoose, Jubada Dhexe, Shabeellaha Hoose iyo Galmudug. Qaramada Midoobay waxay arrintan ku tilmaantay u wareegid “hawlgallo bartilmaameed iyo istiraatiijiyad leh”. Tani waxay muujin kartaa in kooxda ay isku dayeyso inay si taxaddar leh u doorato bartilmaameedyada iyo waqtiga weerarrada, xilli ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadooda ay kordhiyeen duqeymaha iyo hawlgallada ka dhanka ah hoggaanka kooxda. Warbixintu ma faahfaahin noocyada bartilmaameedyada ay Al-Shabaab mudnaanta siinayso ama heerka uu isbeddelkan saameeyey awooddeeda guud.

items.title: Ciidamada oo xiraya meelaha bannaan ee laga soo galo Magaalada  Baydhabo
items.description: Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa Magaalada Baydhabo ka wada dadaalo wax looga qabanayo amniga jilicsan ee ka jira Xarunta Gobolka Baay ee Baydhabo. Saraakiisha Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo kaashanaya Booliska, Nabad Sugidda, Birmadka iyo Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ayaa qaadaya tallaabooyin dheeraad ah, oo ay ku hagaajinayaan sugidda amniga magaalada iyo isku-dubaridka howlaha ciidamada. Wariyeyaasha ayaa soo sheegaya in Saraakiisha Militariga ay ciidamo geeyeen meelaha ay tahay in la ilaaliyo ee laga soo galo Baydhabo. Marka laga soo tago kontoroolada laga soo galo magaalada iyo fariisimaha kale ee ciidamada ku leeyihiin duleedyadeeda ayaa waxaa jira waddooyin aan ahayn kuwa tooska ah ee dadku ka soo galaan Baydhabo, laakiin ciddii kala taqaana deegaanka ay ka soo geli karto magaalada, waana kuwaas meelaha hadda la rabo in la buuxiyo. Ciidamada ayaa xiray waddooyinka ciriiriga ee bannaanada Baydhabo, intii ay socdeen Doorashooyinka Koonfur Galbeed, inkastoo ciidamadu aysan baaqi ku sii ahaanin goobahaasi doorashada ka dib. Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed ayaa dooneysa in meesha laga saaro walaaca amni ee soo food-saaray shacabka ku dhaqan Magaalada Baydhabo ee Xarunta KMG Koonfur Galbeed. Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe) ayaa dhinaca Dowladda Federaalka ka sugaya taageero xoojin ah. Aadan Madoobe oo Arbacadii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud kula kulmay Caasimadda Muqdisho ayaa ka codsaday in la soo gaarsiiyo ciidamo dheeraad ah iyo saraakiil amni oo khibrad u leh habaynta iyo sugidda amniga, taasoo uu Madaxweynuhu ka aqbalay. Masuuliyiinta Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga iyo Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa la filayaa in ay ciidamo cusub u daabuli doonaan magaaladaasi. Taageeradan ayaa muujineysa in Villa Somalia ay dhabarka u ridaneyso in maamulka uu hoggaamiyo Aadan Madoobe uu si buuxda u guto waajibaadkiisa shaqo.

items.title: Markab hub Turkigu leeyahay u siday Muqdisho oo la afduubtay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ayaa xeebaha Puntland ku afduubtay markab xamuul oo siday hub, qalabka isgaarsiinta iyo qalab dayax-gacmeed oo loo waday xarun tababar milateri oo Turkigu ku leeyahay magaalada Muqdisho, sida uu sheegay sarkaal Soomaali ah. Markabka oo lagu magacaabo M/V LUTUF , isla markaana sita calanka Cameroon, ayaa la afduubtay Isniintii isaga oo marayay meel qiyaastii saddex mayl-badeed iyo bar u jirta Murcaanyo oo ka tirsan degmada Eyl ee gobolka Nugaal, sida ay Khamiistii baahisay wakaaladda wararka Associated Press (AP). Sarkaalka Soomaaliga ah oo AP la hadlay, balse codsaday inaan magaciisa la shaacin sababo la xiriira xasaasiyadda arrinta, ayaa sheegay in koox burcad-badeed ah ay markabka u kaxeysteen dhinaca xeebaha Nugaal. Markabka oo ay leedahay shirkadda Polar Movement Shipping ayaa sida xogta la helay xambaarsanaa hub loo waday xarun tababar milateri oo Turkigu ku leeyahay Muqdisho, waxaana sidoo kale saarnaa qalab isgaarsiin iyo qalab la xiriira dayax-gacmeedyada. Toban qof ayaa markabka shaqaale ka ahaa, kuwaas oo kala ahaa lix Hindi ah, hal Turki ah, hal Georgian ah iyo laba Serbian ah oo ahaa ilaalo hubeysan. Ilaa hadda dowladda Turkiga si rasmi ah ugama hadlin dhacdadan, waxaana sidoo kale aan la ogeyn xaaladda shaqaalaha markabka iyo halka uu ku dambeeyay hubkii iyo qalabkii uu siday. Sarkaalka ayaa sheegay in siddeed burcad-badeed ah ay la wareegeen markabka, kadibna ay u jiheeyeen xeebta u dhow Garmaal oo ka tirsan degmada Dangoroyo. Kooxdan ayaa sidoo kale lala xiriirinayaa afduubkii markabka M/V SWARD ee dhacay 26-kii April, sida uu sheegay sarkaalka. Wararka ayaa intaas ku daraya in laba markab oo Turkigu leeyahay ay markii dambe u dhowaadeen M/V LUTUF, halka diyaarado helicopter ah iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee Turkiga ay kor kala socdeen xaaladda markabka. Maalintii Talaadada, doon yar oo ay saarnaayeen laba nin ayaa u tagtay markabka, iyadoo gaarsiisay qaad. Markii doontaasi dib ugu soo laabatay xeebta, duqeyn cirka ah ayaa dhacday, waxaana lagu dilay afar qof, halka laba kalena lagu dhaawacay, sida uu sheegay sarkaalka la hadlay AP. Ma cadda cidda fulisay duqeynta iyo in dadka la dilay ay ka tirsanaayeen kooxda afduubatay markabka. AP ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in aysan si madax-bannaan u xaqiijin karin dhammaan faahfaahinta dhacdada. Afduubka markab kale Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli ay mar kale sare u kacday khatarta burcad-badeedda ka howlgasha xeebaha Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Khamiistii, lix nin oo hubeysan ayaa sidoo kale xoog ku fuulay markab shidaal oo marayay Gacanka Cadmeed, kadibna waxay la wareegeen oo u jiheeyeen dhinaca Soomaaliya, sida ay sheegtay hay’adda UK Maritime Trade Operations. Markabka ayaa markii hore sheegay in doon aan la aqoonsan ay kusoo dhowaatay meel qiyaastii 136 mayl-badeed bari kaga beegan magaalada Mukalla ee Yemen. UKMTO ayaa markii dambe sheegtay in lix nin oo hubeysan ay fuuleen markabka, la wareegeen, ayna “u jiheynayaan Soomaaliya”. Weli lama xaqiijin in kooxdaasi ay yihiin burcad-badeed Soomaali ah iyo in dhacdadu xiriir la leedahay afduubka M/V LUTUF. Dhacdooyinka cusub ayaa yimid iyadoo afar markab oo kale ay horey gacanta ugu hayeen burcad-badeed ku sugan xeebaha waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya. Howlgalka Midowga Yurub ee Operation Atalanta ayaa 29-kii July sheegay in maraakiibta MT HONOUR 25, M/V SWARD, MT EUREKA iyo MT ASANA ay weli ku jiraan gacanta kooxaha burcad-badeedda, isla markaana lagu hayo meel u dhow xeebaha Soomaaliya. Guud ahaan 67 shaqaale ah ayaa ku jiray afarta markab, sida uu sheegay howlgalka Midowga Yurub, kaas oo sheegay inuu si dhow ula socdo xaaladdooda isla markaana xiriir la leeyahay ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo shirkadaha leh maraakiibta. Afduubka M/V LUTUF ayaa si gaar ah xasaasi u ah, maadaama hubka iyo qalabka uu siday loo waday xarun milateri oo Turkigu ku leeyahay Muqdisho. Turkiga ayaa muddo sanado ah kamid ahaa dalalka sida weyn u taageera dib-u-dhiska ciidamada Soomaaliya, waxaana xarunta TURKSOM ee Muqdisho lagu tababaray kumannaan askari iyo saraakiil Soomaali ah. Bishii July, baarlamaanka Turkiga ayaa laba sano oo kale kordhiyay howlgalka ciidamadiisa ee Soomaaliya ilaa July 2028, iyadoo ciidamada Turkiga loo oggolaaday inay taageeraan Soomaaliya dhinacyada la-dagaallanka argagixisada, burcad-badeedda, kalluumeysiga sharci-darrada ah iyo tahriibka. Afduubka markabka hubka u siday Muqdisho ayaa sidaas darteed noqonaya caqabad cusub oo dhinaca amniga badda ah, xilli kooxaha burcad-badeeddu mar kale muujinayaan awood ay ku qabsan karaan maraakiibta maraysa xeebaha Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. The post Markab hub Turkigu leeyahay u siday Muqdisho oo la afduubtay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: QM oo shaacisay sida DF u wiiqday dhaqaalihii Shabaab ee Muqdisho iyo weeraradii
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Warbixin cusub oo loo gudbiyey Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ayaa shaaca ka qaaday isbeddel lagu arkay qaabka ay Al-Shabaab uga hawlgasho Soomaaliya, iyadoo kooxda ay yareysay tirada weerarrada qaarkood, balse xoogga saartay hawlgallo si gaar ah loo qorsheeyey oo leh bartilmaameedyo istiraatiiji ah. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale muujisay hoos u dhac weyn oo ku yimid lacagihii Al-Shabaab ka ururin jirtay magaalada Muqdisho, xilli ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadooda ay kordhiyeen cadaadiska dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo duqeymaha cirka. Dokumentigan oo tirsigiisu yahay S/2026/651, lana daabacay 10-kii Agoosto 2026, ayaa ah warbixintii 38-aad ee Kooxda Taageerada Falanqeynta iyo Dabagalka Cunaqabateynta ee Qaramada Midoobay, taas oo dabagasha dhaqdhaqaaqyada Daacish, Al-Qaacida iyo kooxaha xiriirka la leh. Warbixintu waxay xogta ku saleysay macluumaad iyo qiimeyn ay gudbiyeen dowladaha xubnaha ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ilaa 9-kii Juun 2026. Mid ka mid ah qodobbada sida gaarka ah Soomaaliya u khuseeya ayaa ah isbeddelka lagu arkay xeeladda weerarrada Al-Shabaab. Kooxda ayaa sanadkii 2025 sare u qaaday weerarradeeda, balse warbixinta cusub waxay sheegtay inay hadda u muuqato inay ka leexatay weerarro badan oo joogto ah, una wareegtay hawlgallo tiro ahaan ka yar balse si gaar ah loo qorsheeyey. Gudaha iyo hareeraha Muqdisho waxaa laga diiwaangeliyey weerarro ka yar kuwii hore, iyadoo hawlgallada kooxda ay si weyn ugu urureen HirShabeelle, Jubada Hoose, Jubada Dhexe, Shabeellaha Hoose iyo Galmudug. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa arrintan ku tilmaantay u wareegid hawlgallo “bartilmaameed iyo istiraatiijiyad leh”. Isbeddelkan ayaa imanaya xilli dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadeeda ay kordhiyeen duqeymaha cirka iyo hawlgallada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo hoggaanka iyo xarumaha Al-Shabaab. Warbixintu, si kastaba, ma faahfaahin noocyada bartilmaameedyada ay kooxdu hadda mudnaanta siineyso ama heerka uu isbeddelkan saameeyey awooddeeda guud ee dagaal. Hoggaamiyeyaal laga dilay kooxda Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in ciidamada Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadooda ay horumar ka sameeyeen wiiqidda qaar ka mid ah hoggaanka Al-Shabaab. Cabdullaahi Cismaan Maxamed Caddow, oo loo yaqaannay Injineer Ismaaciil, ayaa la dilay bishii Diseembar 2025. Qaramada Midoobay waxay sheegtay inuu mas’uul ka ahaa hawlgallada qaraxyada macmalka ah ee kooxda. Cabdullaahi Xasan Cabdi Cosoble, oo lagu naaneysi jiray Cabdullaahi Wadaad, kana shaqeynayey dhinaca maaliyadda Al-Shabaab, ayaa la dilay bishii Janaayo. Maxamed Sahal Idl, oo loo yaqaannay Abuu Usaama, loona magacaabay inuu beddelo Cabdullaahi Wadaad, ayaa isna la dilay bishii Febraayo, sida warbixintu sheegtay. Inkasta oo xubnahan muhiimka ah laga dilay, warbixintu waxay sheegtay in hoggaamiyaha guud ee Al-Shabaab, Axmed Diiriye, uu weli firfircoon yahay, laguna tuhmayo inuu ku sugan yahay koonfurta Soomaaliya. Dhaqaalaha Al-Shabaab oo hoos u dhacay Isbeddelka kale ee weyn ee warbixintu tilmaantay wuxuu khuseeyaa dhaqaalaha kooxda. Qaramada Midoobay waxay sheegtay in dhaqaalaha Al-Shabaab uu weli adkeysi leeyahay, laakiin lacagaha ay kooxdu ururiso ay hoos u dhaceen. Lacagaha Al-Shabaab ka ururin jirtay Muqdisho ayaa markii hore lagu qiyaasay inta u dhexeysa 12 milyan ilaa 15 milyan oo dollar bishii, balse hadda waxay hoos ugu dhaceen qiyaastii shan milyan ilaa sagaal milyan oo dollar bishii. Warbixintu waxay hoos u dhacaas qeyb ahaan ku xiriirisay tallaabooyinka amni ee laga hirgeliyey Muqdisho. Abaaraha ka jira Jubbaland, Shabeellaha Hoose iyo Shabeellaha Dhexe ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inay saameeyeen ilaha dhaqaale ee kooxda. Warbixintu ma faahfaahin habka saxda ah ee lagu xisaabiyey qiyaasaha lacagahaas, waxaana xogta laga soo xigtay qiimeyn ay gudbiyeen dalalka xubnaha ka ah Qaramada Midoobay. Xundubeey muxuu ku fasiray hoos u dhaca? BBC-da ayaa Xasan Xundubeey Jimcaale, wasiirkii hore ee amniga gudaha Soomaaliya, wax ka weydiisay waxa sababay hoos u dhaca lagu sheegay lacagaha ay Al-Shabaab ka ururiso Muqdisho. Xundubeey ayaa sheegay in arrintaas ay qeyb weyn ka qaateen tallaabooyin dowladda Soomaaliya ay muddooyinkii dambe ku bartilmaameedsaneysay ilaha dhaqaalaha kooxda. “Horta waxaa jira dadaal xooggan oo ay dowladda Soomaaliya ku qaadday dhaqaale-ururinta raggaas, akoonnadooda iyo meelaha ay wax dhigtaan oo la daba galay, iyo shirkado been-abuur ah oo la daba galay. Tiro badan oo akoonno ah ayaa la xiray,” ayuu yiri Xasan Xundubeey. Waxa uu intaas ku daray inay sidoo kale yaraatay awooddii iyo cabsidii Al-Shabaab ku lahayd magaalada Muqdisho, taas oo sida uu sheegay adkeysay in kooxdu sidii hore lacag uga ururiso ganacsatada iyo qeybaha kale ee bulshada. Xundubeey ayaa sidoo kale hoos u dhaca weerarrada Muqdisho ku xiriiriyey adkeynta ammaanka caasimadda. Waxa uu sheegay in tallaabooyinka cusub ay aad u adkeeyeen in gawaarida qaraxyada sida ay gudaha magaalada si fudud uga hawlgalaan. “Kaamirooyinka CCTV aad ayay uga qeyb qaateen ammaanka magaalada,” ayuu yiri. Waxa uu sidoo kale tilmaamay in duqeymaha cirka iyo hawlgallada joogtada ah ee lagu bartilmaameedsanayo Al-Shabaab ay cadaadis dheeraad ah saareen awoodda kooxda. Xiriirka Yemen oo walaac dhaliyey Inkasta oo warbixintu tilmaameyso cadaadis Al-Shabaab ka soo wajahay gudaha Soomaaliya, haddana waxay soo bandhigtay walaac kale oo ku saabsan xiriirka kooxda ee dibadda. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale muujisay hoos u dhac weyn oo ku yimid lacagihii Al-Shabaab ka ururin jirtay magaalada Muqdisho, xilli ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadooda ay kordhiyeen cadaadiska dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo duqeymaha cirka. Dokumentigan oo tirsigiisu yahay S/2026/651, lana daabacay 10-kii Agoosto 2026, ayaa ah warbixintii 38-aad ee Kooxda Taageerada Falanqeynta iyo Dabagalka Cunaqabateynta ee Qaramada Midoobay, taas oo dabagasha dhaqdhaqaaqyada Daacish, Al-Qaacida iyo kooxaha xiriirka la leh. Warbixintu waxay xogta ku saleysay macluumaad iyo qiimeyn ay gudbiyeen dowladaha xubnaha ka ah Qaramada Midoobay ilaa 9-kii Juun 2026. Mid ka mid ah qodobbada sida gaarka ah Soomaaliya u khuseeya ayaa ah isbeddelka lagu arkay xeeladda weerarrada Al-Shabaab. Kooxda ayaa sanadkii 2025 sare u qaaday weerarradeeda, balse warbixinta cusub waxay sheegtay inay hadda u muuqato inay ka leexatay weerarro badan oo joogto ah, una wareegtay hawlgallo tiro ahaan ka yar balse si gaar ah loo qorsheeyey. Gudaha iyo hareeraha Muqdisho waxaa laga diiwaangeliyey weerarro ka yar kuwii hore, iyadoo hawlgallada kooxda ay si weyn ugu urureen HirShabeelle, Jubada Hoose, Jubada Dhexe, Shabeellaha Hoose iyo Galmudug. Qaramada Midoobay ayaa arrintan ku tilmaantay u wareegid hawlgallo “bartilmaameed iyo istiraatiijiyad leh”. Isbeddelkan ayaa imanaya xilli dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibadeeda ay kordhiyeen duqeymaha cirka iyo hawlgallada lagu bartilmaameedsanayo hoggaanka iyo xarumaha Al-Shabaab. Warbixintu, si kastaba, ma faahfaahin noocyada bartilmaameedyada ay kooxdu hadda mudnaanta siineyso ama heerka uu isbeddelkan saameeyey awooddeeda guud ee dagaal. Cabdullaahi Cismaan Maxamed Caddow, oo loo yaqaannay Injineer Ismaaciil, ayaa la dilay bishii Diseembar 2025. Qaramada Midoobay waxay sheegtay inuu mas’uul ka ahaa hawlgallada qaraxyada macmalka ah ee kooxda. Maxamed Sahal Idl, oo loo yaqaannay Abuu Usaama, loona magacaabay inuu beddelo Cabdullaahi Wadaad, ayaa isna la dilay bishii Febraayo, sida warbixintu sheegtay. items.title: Maxay Uganda taallo ugu dhistay walaalka Netanyahu? – Maxaase dhacay 1976-kii?
items.description: Entebbe (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Uganda ayaa dood xooggan kala kulmeysa go’aan ay taallo ugu dhistay Yonatan Netanyahu, oo ahaa walaalka Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Israel Benjamin Netanyahu, kaas oo lagu dilay howlgal ay ciidamada Israel sanadkii 1976 ka fuliyeen garoonka Entebbe ee dalkaas. Taallada oo laga sameeyay naxaas ayaa horraantii bishan Agoosto laga daah-furay xaruntii hore ee garoonka Entebbe, halkaas oo Yonatan Netanyahu lagu dilay isaga oo hoggaaminayay ciidamadii Israel ee fuliyay howlgalka lagu soo furtay rakaab lagu haystay diyaarad la afduubtay. Taliyaha ciidamada Uganda, General Muhoozi Kainerugaba, oo ah wiilka ugu weyn Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni, ayaa amray dhismaha taallada, isaga oo sheegay in loogu talagalay xuska 50 guurada howlgalka Entebbe iyo in lagu maamuuso geesinimadii Yonatan Netanyahu. Taallada ayaa muujineysa Yonatan oo taagan, qori gacanta ku haysta, waxaana laga dhisay goobtii uu ka dhacay mid ka mid ah dhacdooyinkii ugu muranka badnaa taariikhda xiriirka Uganda iyo Israel. Daah-furka taallada ayaa yimid maalmo ka hor inta aanu baarlamaanka Uganda ansixin qorshe ciidamada dalkaas loogu dirayo Marinka Gaza, si ay qayb uga noqdaan Ciidamada Caalamiga ah ee Xasilinta ee loo qorsheeyay dhulka Falastiin. Isku soo aadka labada arrimood ayaa dib u soo celiyay dood ku saabsan xiriirka sii xoogeysanaya ee Kampala iyo Israel, gaar ahaan iskaashiga dhinacyada amniga iyo milatariga. General Kainerugaba ayaa munaasabadda ka sheegay in taalladu aysan ahayn oo keliya xusuus loo sameeyay askari dhintay, balse ay astaan u tahay waxa uu ku tilmaamay geesinimo, badbaadinta dadka aan waxba galabsan iyo u hoggaansanaanta waajibaadka. Hase yeeshee, dhismaha taallada ayaa sidoo kale dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan sida dowladda Uganda maanta u fasireyso howlgal militari oo Israel ay gudaha dalkaas ka fulisay iyada oo aan oggolaansho ka haysan xukuumaddii xilligaas jirtay. Maxaa ka dhacay Entebbe? 27-kii June 1976, xubno ka tirsanaa Jabhadda Xoreynta Falastiin ee PFLP iyo koox Jarmal ah ayaa afduubtay diyaarad ay lahayd Air France oo ka soo duushay Tel Aviv kuna sii jeeday Paris. Diyaaradda oo siday 248 qof ayaa ugu dambeyn la geeyay garoonka Entebbe ee Uganda, halkaas oo dowladdii Madaxweyne Idi Amin ay u oggolaatay afduubayaasha inay ku haystaan rakaabka. Inta badan rakaabkii aan Israa’iiliyiinta ahayn ayaa markii dambe la sii daayay, halka afduubayaashu ay sii haysteen Israa’iiliyiin iyo dad kale oo Yuhuud ah, iyaga oo dalbanayay in la sii daayo maxaabiis Falastiiniyiin ah. Dowladda Israel ayaa dhinac wada-hadallo kula jirtay afduubayaasha, laakiin isla waqtigaas waxay diyaarineysay howlgal militari oo qarsoodi ah. 3-dii July, ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Israel ayaa kumannaan kiiloomitir u duulay Uganda, waxayna weerareen garoonka Entebbe. Howlgalka waxaa lagu soo badbaadiyay in ka badan 100 qof oo la haystay, waxaana lagu dilay dhammaan afduubayaashii iyo tobannaan askari oo Uganda u dhashay. Yonatan Netanyahu, oo hoggaaminayay ciidamadii weerarka qaaday, ayaa noqday askariga keliya ee Israel looga dilay howlgalka. Israel gudaheeda, howlgalka oo markii hore loo bixiyay “Operation Thunderbolt” ayaa noqday mid ka mid ah howlgallada militari ee ugu caansan taariikhda dalkaas, waxaana markii dambe loogu magac daray “Operation Jonathan” si loogu maamuuso Yonatan Netanyahu. Dhimashada Yonatan ayaa sidoo kale saameyn weyn ku yeelatay nolosha siyaasadeed ee walaalkiis Benjamin Netanyahu, oo sanadihii xigay caan ku noqday ololaha ka dhanka ah waxa Israel ugu yeerto argagixisada, kahor inta aanu siyaasadda si buuxda ugu biirin. Cambaareyn-tii hore ee Uganda Markii howlgalka dhacay, dowladda Uganda iyo Ururkii Midowga Afrika ee OAU waxay si adag u cambaareeyeen Israel, iyaga oo weerarka ku tilmaamay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Uganda. Xiriirka Israel iyo Uganda ayaa xilligaas marayay heer aad u hooseeya. Israel waxay xiriir dhow la lahayd Uganda sanadihii ugu horreeyay ee madax-bannaanida dalkaas, waxayna gacan ka geysatay tababarka ciidamada iyo booliska, iyo dhismaha qaar ka mid ah kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah. Idi Amin ayaa markii uu afgambiga kula wareegay awoodda sanadkii 1971 xiriir wanaagsan la lahaa Israel, balse xaaladda ayaa si degdeg ah isu beddeshay. Sanadkii 1972, Amin ayaa jaray xiriirkii diblomaasiyadeed ee Israel, dalka ka saaray la-taliyayaashii militari iyo muwaadiniintii Israa’iiliyiinta ahaa, wuxuuna xoojiyay xiriirka uu la lahaa dalalka Carabta iyo ururrada Falastiiniyiinta. Sidaas darteed, howlgalka Entebbe waxaa Uganda iyo dalal badan oo Afrikaan ah xilligaas looga arkayay weerar ay quwad shisheeye ku soo qaaday dal Afrikaan ah. Taallada oo dhalisay caro xooggan Konton sano kadib, dowladda Uganda ayaa hadda meel ka duwan ka istaagtay dhacdadaas. Qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta iyo aqoonyahannada Uganda ayaa ku doodaya in taallo loo dhiso taliyihii ciidamada shisheeye ee gudaha Uganda ku dilay askar Ugandheys ah ay dhaawaceyso xusuusta qaranka iyo madax-bannaanida dalka. Asuman Kiyingi, oo horay uga soo noqday wasiiru-dowlaha arrimaha dibadda ee Uganda, ayaa ka mid ah dadka sida adag uga hor yimid taallada. Waxa uu ku tilmaamay astaanteeda mid “walaac leh”, isaga oo ku baaqay in meesha laga saaro. Kiyingi ayaa sheegay inay dhib ku tahay in dowladda Uganda ay sharaf u sameyso taliyihii ciidan shisheeye oo dalka soo galay oggolaansho la’aan, halka aan maamuus la mid ah loo sameyn askartii Uganda ee ku dhimatay iyaga oo difaacaya garoonka Entebbe. General Kainerugaba ayaa isaguna isku dayay inuu kala saaro askartii Uganda ee halkaas ku dhimatay iyo dowladdii Idi Amin ee ay u adeegayeen. Waxa uu sheegay in askarta Uganda ay u dagaallameen waxa ay u arkayeen inay tahay waajibaadkooda, balse xukuumaddii Idi Amin ay ahayd “kaligii-talisnimo arxan daran” oo aan matalin shacabka Uganda. Xiriirka Kampala iyo Israel Tan iyo markii Yoweri Museveni uu awoodda qabtay 1986, xiriirka Uganda iyo Israel ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah u soo hagaagay, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, milatariga iyo ganacsiga. Museveni ayaa dhowr jeer booqday Israel, halka Benjamin Netanyahu uu sanadkii 2016 booqday Entebbe, xilli la xusayay 40 guurada howlgalka. Museveni ayaa markaas sheegay in Idi Amin uu ku qaldanaa inuu taageero haystayaasha, isla markaana Israel ay xaq u lahayd inay badbaadiso muwaadiniinteeda. Hadalkaas wuxuu muujiyay sida ay dowladda Uganda ee maanta jirta uga fogaatay mowqifkii dowladdii Amin ee ku aaddanaa dhacdadii Entebbe. Si kastaba, xiriirka dhow ee Israel iyo Uganda macnaheedu ma noqon in Kampala ay gebi ahaan taageerto siyaasadaha Israel ee ku wajahan Falastiiniyiinta. Uganda waxay weli taageertaa dhismaha dowlad Falastiini ah, waxayna dhowr jeer Qaramada Midoobay ka taageertay qaraarro lagu dhaliilayo Israel. Sanadkii 2024, Uganda waxay u codeysay qaraar Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay uu ku dalbanayay in Israel ay soo afjarto joogitaankeeda sharci-darrada ah ee dhulka Falastiin ee la haysto. Kampala sidoo kale weli kama aysan jawaabin codsi uu Netanyahu horay ugu jeediyay Uganda oo ahaa inay safaaraddeeda Israel u wareejiso magaalada Qudus. Haddana, dhismaha taallada Yonatan Netanyahu iyo qorshaha ciidamada Uganda loogu dirayo Gaza ayaa muujinaya in xiriirka amni ee Kampala iyo Israel uu galay marxalad cusub, xilli dagaalka Gaza iyo siyaasadda Israel ee dhulka Falastiin ay weli yihiin arrimo muran xooggan ka dhex dhaliya qaaradda Afrika. Inta badan rakaabkii aan Israa’iiliyiinta ahayn ayaa markii dambe la sii daayay, halka afduubayaashu ay sii haysteen Israa’iiliyiin iyo dad kale oo Yuhuud ah, iyaga oo dalbanayay in la sii daayo maxaabiis Falastiiniyiin ah. Dowladda Israel ayaa dhinac wada-hadallo kula jirtay afduubayaasha, laakiin isla waqtigaas waxay diyaarineysay howlgal militari oo qarsoodi ah. 3-dii July, ciidamada sida gaarka ah u tababaran ee Israel ayaa kumannaan kiiloomitir u duulay Uganda, waxayna weerareen garoonka Entebbe. Howlgalka waxaa lagu soo badbaadiyay in ka badan 100 qof oo la haystay, waxaana lagu dilay dhammaan afduubayaashii iyo tobannaan askari oo Uganda u dhashay. Yonatan Netanyahu, oo hoggaaminayay ciidamadii weerarka qaaday, ayaa noqday askariga keliya ee Israel looga dilay howlgalka. Israel gudaheeda, howlgalka oo markii hore loo bixiyay “Operation Thunderbolt” ayaa noqday mid ka mid ah howlgallada militari ee ugu caansan taariikhda dalkaas, waxaana markii dambe loogu magac daray “Operation Jonathan” si loogu maamuuso Yonatan Netanyahu. Dhimashada Yonatan ayaa sidoo kale saameyn weyn ku yeelatay nolosha siyaasadeed ee walaalkiis Benjamin Netanyahu, oo sanadihii xigay caan ku noqday ololaha ka dhanka ah waxa Israel ugu yeerto argagixisada, kahor inta aanu siyaasadda si buuxda ugu biirin. Cambaareyn-tii hore ee Uganda Markii howlgalka dhacay, dowladda Uganda iyo Ururkii Midowga Afrika ee OAU waxay si adag u cambaareeyeen Israel, iyaga oo weerarka ku tilmaamay xadgudub ka dhan ah madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Uganda. Xiriirka Israel iyo Uganda ayaa xilligaas marayay heer aad u hooseeya. Israel waxay xiriir dhow la lahayd Uganda sanadihii ugu horreeyay ee madax-bannaanida dalkaas, waxayna gacan ka geysatay tababarka ciidamada iyo booliska, iyo dhismaha qaar ka mid ah kaabeyaasha muhiimka ah. Idi Amin ayaa markii uu afgambiga kula wareegay awoodda sanadkii 1971 xiriir wanaagsan la lahaa Israel, balse xaaladda ayaa si degdeg ah isu beddeshay. Sanadkii 1972, Amin ayaa jaray xiriirkii diblomaasiyadeed ee Israel, dalka ka saaray la-taliyayaashii militari iyo muwaadiniintii Israa’iiliyiinta ahaa, wuxuuna xoojiyay xiriirka uu la lahaa dalalka Carabta iyo ururrada Falastiiniyiinta. Sidaas darteed, howlgalka Entebbe waxaa Uganda iyo dalal badan oo Afrikaan ah xilligaas looga arkayay weerar ay quwad shisheeye ku soo qaaday dal Afrikaan ah. Taallada oo dhalisay caro xooggan Konton sano kadib, dowladda Uganda ayaa hadda meel ka duwan ka istaagtay dhacdadaas. Qaar ka mid ah siyaasiyiinta iyo aqoonyahannada Uganda ayaa ku doodaya in taallo loo dhiso taliyihii ciidamada shisheeye ee gudaha Uganda ku dilay askar Ugandheys ah ay dhaawaceyso xusuusta qaranka iyo madax-bannaanida dalka. Asuman Kiyingi, oo horay uga soo noqday wasiiru-dowlaha arrimaha dibadda ee Uganda, ayaa ka mid ah dadka sida adag uga hor yimid taallada. Waxa uu ku tilmaamay astaanteeda mid “walaac leh”, isaga oo ku baaqay in meesha laga saaro. Kiyingi ayaa sheegay inay dhib ku tahay in dowladda Uganda ay sharaf u sameyso taliyihii ciidan shisheeye oo dalka soo galay oggolaansho la’aan, halka aan maamuus la mid ah loo sameyn askartii Uganda ee ku dhimatay iyaga oo difaacaya garoonka Entebbe. General Kainerugaba ayaa isaguna isku dayay inuu kala saaro askartii Uganda ee halkaas ku dhimatay iyo dowladdii Idi Amin ee ay u adeegayeen. Waxa uu sheegay in askarta Uganda ay u dagaallameen waxa ay u arkayeen inay tahay waajibaadkooda, balse xukuumaddii Idi Amin ay ahayd “kaligii-talisnimo arxan daran” oo aan matalin shacabka Uganda. Xiriirka Kampala iyo Israel Tan iyo markii Yoweri Museveni uu awoodda qabtay 1986, xiriirka Uganda iyo Israel ayaa si tartiib tartiib ah u soo hagaagay, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, milatariga iyo ganacsiga. Museveni ayaa dhowr jeer booqday Israel, halka Benjamin Netanyahu uu sanadkii 2016 booqday Entebbe, xilli la xusayay 40 guurada howlgalka. Museveni ayaa markaas sheegay in Idi Amin uu ku qaldanaa inuu taageero haystayaasha, isla markaana Israel ay xaq u lahayd inay badbaadiso muwaadiniinteeda. Hadalkaas wuxuu muujiyay sida ay dowladda Uganda ee maanta jirta uga fogaatay mowqifkii dowladdii Amin ee ku aaddanaa dhacdadii Entebbe. Si kastaba, xiriirka dhow ee Israel iyo Uganda macnaheedu ma noqon in Kampala ay gebi ahaan taageerto siyaasadaha Israel ee ku wajahan Falastiiniyiinta. Uganda waxay weli taageertaa dhismaha dowlad Falastiini ah, waxayna dhowr jeer Qaramada Midoobay ka taageertay qaraarro lagu dhaliilayo Israel. Sanadkii 2024, Uganda waxay u codeysay qaraar Golaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay uu ku dalbanayay in Israel ay soo afjarto joogitaankeeda sharci-darrada ah ee dhulka Falastiin ee la haysto. Kampala sidoo kale weli kama aysan jawaabin codsi uu Netanyahu horay ugu jeediyay Uganda oo ahaa inay safaaraddeeda Israel u wareejiso magaalada Qudus. Haddana, dhismaha taallada Yonatan Netanyahu iyo qorshaha ciidamada Uganda loogu dirayo Gaza ayaa muujinaya in xiriirka amni ee Kampala iyo Israel uu galay marxalad cusub, xilli dagaalka Gaza iyo siyaasadda Israel ee dhulka Falastiin ay weli yihiin arrimo muran xooggan ka dhex dhaliya qaaradda Afrika. items.title: Laba nin oo Al Shabaab ah oo toogasho lagu dilay gudaha Degmada Mahadaay
items.description: Ciidanka Booliska ee ka hawlgala Degmada Mahadaay ee Gobolka Shabellaha Dhexe ayaa xalay toogasho ku dilay laba nin oo lagu sheegay inay ahaayeen xubno ka tirsan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Saraakiisha Booliska Hirshabelle ayaa sheegay in raggaasi ay doonayeen inay miinooyin ku aasaan agagaarka Suuqa Xoolaha ee degmadaasi, lana dilay iyaga oo falkaasi ku guda jira. Taliyaha Saldhiga Booliska Degmada Mahadaay, Gaashaanle Saleebaan Maxamed Cumar (Cowsey) ayaa sheegay in ciidamadu ay si qorsheysan u fuliyeen hawlgalkaasi, isla-markaana ay ku guuleysteen inay ka hortaggaan khatarta miinooyinkaasi. Taliyaha ayaa tilmaamay in ciidamadu ay si feejigan uga hortaggeen miinooyinkaasi oo sida uu sheegay inay labadaasi nin damacsanaayeen inay ku waxyeelaayaan shacabka iyo ciidamada amniga. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in mid ka mid ah miinooyinkan oo laba ahaa ay qaraxday, middii kalena ay ciidamadu goobta ka qaadeen. Saraakiisha laamaha amniga ayaa soo bandhigay muuqaalka labada nin ee lagu dilay Degmada Mahadaay. Waa wax naadir ah in ciidamadu ay dilaan amaba ay qabtaan xubnaha ka tirsan Al Shabaab, kolka ay miinooyinka ku aasayaan waddooyinka iyo goobaha ay dadku ku badan yihiin.

items.title: Armed men seize oil tanker off Yemen, divert it toward Somalia: UK maritime agency
items.description: Six armed men seized control of an oil tanker in the Gulf of Aden off Yemen and redirected it toward Somalia, the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said Thursday. The UKMTO said on US social media platform X that they “have received confirmation that the tanker has been boarded by six armed persons who are now in control of the vessel and redirecting (it) to Somalia.” Authorities are investigating the incident, the agency added, advising vessels transiting the area to exercise caution and report suspicious activity. The agency had earlier reported a tanker “broadcast a distress call on VHF 16 that they have been approached by an unauthorized vessel whilst travelling west in the Gulf of Aden.” As of 1145GMT, there was no information on the identity of the tanker or its whereabouts, and no group had claimed responsibility for the incident. Regional maritime routes, particularly the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden, have faced heightened tensions following the Yemeni Houthi group’s announcement in July that it will impose a ban on vessels linked to Saudi Arabia. Saudi Arabia later announced the formation of a defensive maritime coalition to protect freedom of navigation in the Bab al-Mandab Strait. The coalition includes the US, Yemen, Kuwait, Oman, Jordan, Sudan, Morocco, the Maldives, Bangladesh, and New Zealand. Since 2015, Saudi Arabia has led a coalition supporting Yemen’s internationally recognized government, while Iran is accused of supporting the Houthis, who have controlled several provinces and cities, including the capital Sanaa, since 2014. Piracy was also widespread off Somalia’s coast from 2008 to 2018 before declining. Incidents began rising again in late 2023 amid heightened regional security tensions. Anadolu.

items.description: ” 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐓𝐚𝐢𝐰𝐚𝐧 𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐅𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐂𝐨𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐓𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐂𝐃𝐈𝐂 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐁𝐚𝐧𝐤 𝐨𝐟 𝐒𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐏𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩” The Diplomatic Mission of the Republic of Somaliland in Taiwan welcomed Dr. Tien-Mu Thomas Huang, Chairman of Taiwan’s Central Deposit Insurance Corporation (CDIC), and his delegation for a high-level meeting focused on strengthening financial cooperation between Somaliland and Taiwan. Chairman Huang was accompanied by Ms. Annie Cheng, President; Ms. Yvonne Y. Fan, Executive Vice President; and Ms. Margaret Chuang, Director of the International Relations & Research Office. The meeting follows the recent signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between CDIC and the Bank of Somaliland, establishing a formal framework for closer cooperation, knowledge and experience sharing, and continued engagement in the areas of deposit insurance, depositor protection, and financial stability. During the meeting, both sides held productive and wide-ranging discussions on matters of mutual interest and explored opportunities to further deepen institutional cooperation. The Somaliland Diplomatic Mission expressed its appreciation to Chairman Huang and his delegation for their visit and kind words, emphasizing the importance Somaliland places on its growing relationship with CDIC. The two sides also expressed their commitment to building a strong, lasting, and increasingly substantive partnership, alongside continued engagement between CDIC and the Bank of Somaliland. The expanding cooperation in the financial sector represents another important dimension of the broader and steadily deepening relationship between the Republic of Somaliland and Taiwan (ROC). #Somaliland #Taiwan #CDIC #BankofSomaliland #FinancialCooperation

items.title: Interview with the President of Somaliland:The president hopes this will bring international recognition for the would-be state
items.description: Somaliland wants to help secure the Red Sea   The president hopes this will bring international recognition for the would-be state Irro, man on a mission Photograph: Getty Images Aug 20th 2026 | Nairobi | 4 min read Listen to this story A bdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi is an ambitious man. In December 2024 the 70-year-old former diplomat (pictured), who is better known as Irro, was sworn in as president of Somaliland, a breakaway republic that declared independence from Somalia in 1991. Last year he was the would-be country’s leader when Somaliland was formally recognised by Israel, the first nation to do so. “The world has been ignoring Somaliland for 35 years,” Irro tells The Economist . He wants outsiders to take a closer look. Map: The Economist Irro’s pitch centres on the Red Sea. The trade route has been a mess of late, with shipping menaced by the Houthis, an Iran-backed militia that rules much of Yemen. Speaking this month during a visit to Nairobi, Kenya’s capital, Irro says Somaliland can help secure the strategic waterway by offering military bases to global powers along its coastline. Once trade can flow unmolested again, he wants Somaliland’s main port at Berbera to be the primary gateway to the markets of the Horn of Africa. “Our message is that we are a responsible partner” in security and trade, says Irro. He suggests that Somaliland could, in effect, be the new Djibouti. That tiny port-state rakes in some $125m a year by renting out slices of its coastline to foreign armies. America, China and France (among others) have bases there. It also earns many multiples of that amount in annual port fees paid by landlocked Ethiopia, which depends on Djibouti for most of its international trade. Irro wants a slice of both Djiboutian cakes. He is trying to persuade Ethiopia to use Berbera, where the United Arab Emirates ( UAE ) has built a new harbour, as its main outlet to the sea. He also wants to entice America to set up a military base there. That would give America more options if it chooses to resume its war against the Houthis, whom it bombed intensively last year. Access to military facilities around Berbera is widely believed to have been part of the deal Israel struck with Irro when it recognised Somaliland in December. Some reports suggest that America and Israel may already be developing a military presence at Berbera, with covert support from the UAE , which operates an existing base there. Irro denies such reports. “There is no Israeli or American presence yet,” he says. But the UAE has another base at the port of Bosaso in Puntland, a neighbouring semi-autonomous province of Somalia, where unconfirmed reports suggest Israel is also embedded. As competition for military properties on the Red Sea heats up, Irro says he would be willing to offer both Israel and America bases at Berbera “if they are interested”. Next month Irro will visit Washington, where he hopes to have a tête-à-tête with Donald Trump. Were that to happen, he would become the first president of Somaliland to meet directly with an American counterpart. “We expect the recognition of the United States some time in the future,” says Irro, adding that Somaliland anticipates recognition from at least one more country “before the end of the year”. Irro’s ambitions are ruffling regional feathers. Djibouti is irked by Somaliland’s desire to barge in. Irro hints that his northern neighbour is trying to “destabilise” his country, presumably by supporting hostile militias on the border. Relations with Somalia are even more strained. Mr Irro claims Somalia, which considers Somaliland a renegade province, has plans to mobilise troops along the southern frontier. “This is not a peace recipe,” he adds. It does not help that Israel and Turkey, a patron of Somalia, are increasingly hostile to each other. Turkey has long been trying to mediate between Somalia and Somaliland, yet numerous rounds of talks in Ankara and Istanbul have failed. “Next time they can happen in Tel Aviv,” chortles Irro, who seems unbothered by the prospect of a proxy war. Yet America may well be reluctant to stir the pot by recognising Somaliland. The Houthis, meanwhile, have threatened to attack any Israeli military installation in the statelet. An American base there could become a target, too. That would shatter the reputation for peace and stability on which Somaliland has long built its case for international recognition. But “there is nothing free in the world,” says Irro. He seems willing to pay a price to put his country on the map—the question is, how high? ■ Source Economist

items.title: Madaxweynaha  Somaliland oo socdaal rasmi ah ku tagi doona dalka Maraykanka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Md. Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), ayaa la filayaa inuu bisha soo socota ee September 2026 uu safar shaqo ku tago dalka Maraykanka. Wargeyska The Economist oo waraysi la yeeshay Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa sheegay in Madaxweynaha Somaliland uu rajaynayo inuu kulan fool-ka-fool ah la yeesho Donald Trump oo ah Madaxweynaha Maraykanka. Waxaanu Wargeysku intaas ku daray in haddii kulankaasi dhaco wuxuu Madaxweyne Cirro noqon doonaa madaxweynihii ugu horreeyey ee Somaliland ee si toos ah ula kulma Nadaxweyne Maraykan ah. “Waxaan filaynaa in Maraykanku mustaqbalka aqoonsado Somaliland,” ayuu yidhi Madaxweyne Cirro, isagoo intaas ku daray inay Somaliland filayso in ugu yaraan hal dal oo kale aqoonsado “ka hor dhammaadka sannadkan 2026. Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa waraysigan si kaftan ah ugu sheegay in wadahadalka Somaliland iyo Soomaaliya ay marka xiga ka qabsoomi doonaan Tel Aviv oo Israa’iil ah. Hadalkan Madaxweynaha Somaliland ayaa sida wargeysku sheegay ah kaftan xambaarsan fariin siyaasadeed. Hadalkan Madaxweyne Cirro ayaa daba socda wada-xaajoodyadii fashilmay ee Turkigu hore ugu qabtay Somaliland iyo Soomaaliya.

items.title: Fiqi ma wuxuu isku beddelay afhayeenka dowladda – aaway shaqadii gaashaandhigga?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa muddooyinkii dambe si joogto ah uga falcelinayay hadallada kasoo baxaya mucaaradka iyo siyaasiyiinta dhaliila dowladda. Wasiirka ayaa si joogta ah u weerarayay mucaaradka, taasoo dhalisay in la is weydiiyo: Fiqi ma wuxuu dhab ahaan isu arkayaa afhayeenka siyaasadeed ee dowladda? Arrintan ayaa si gaar ah u muuqata marka la eego qoraallada uu wasiirku ku daabaco baraha bulshada. Halkii uu xoogga saari lahaa shaqada wasaaradda uu hoggaamiyo iyo warbixinnada la xiriira amniga dalka. Wasiir Fiqi wuxuu marar badan si toos ah ugu jawaabaa dadka dhaliila dowladda, isaga oo difaacaya waxqabadka maamulka iyo siyaasadaha Villa Soomaaliya. Qoraalkiisii ugu dambeeyay uu ku daabaco barahiisa bulshada wuxuu ku weeraray siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka, oo ku sifeeyay “adeegayaal shisheeye”, oo u kireysan cadowga, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Fiqi wuxuu sheegay in sumcadda Soomaaliya ay maalinba maalinta ka dambeysa kor u kacayso, duniduna ay kusoo qulquleyso dalka, halka uu dhaliilay kuwa uu ku tilmaamay inay dalal kale u kiraysan yihiin oo shacabka u sheegaya in Soomaaliya aysan xor ahayn ama Al-Shabaab qabsanayso. Wasiir amni oo galay doorka doodda siyaasadeed Dooddu ma aha in wasiirku xaq u lahayn inuu difaaco dowladda uu ka tirsan yahay. Wasiir kasta wuxuu leeyahay xaq iyo waajib uu kaga hadlo siyaasadda dowladda, gaar ahaan marka uu ka hadlayo arrimaha hoos yimaada wasaaraddiisa. Laakiin marka jawaab-celinta siyaasadeed ay noqoto hawl joogto ah waxaa soo baxaya su’aasha ah halka uu ku dhammaanayo doorka wasiirka, halka uu ka bilaabanayo doorka afhayeenka dowladda. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga waxaa horyaalla mas’uuliyad culus oo amni. Ciidamada xoogga dalka, dagaalka Al-Shabaab, dhismaha awoodda ciidamada, xaaladda goobaha dagaalka iyo xiriirka milatari ee Soomaaliya iyo dalalka taageera ayaa ah arrimo u baahan feejignaan iyo waqti badan. Sidaas darteed, marka wasiirka difaacu si joogto ah uga dhex muuqdo doodaha siyaasadeed ee mucaaradka, waxaa macquul ah in shacabka iyo siyaasiyiintu is weydiiyaan haddii waqtiga iyo awoodda wasiirka ay si ku filan ugu baxayaan shaqada amniga, mise qayb ka mid ah shaqadiisa ayaa isu beddeshay la-dagaallanka hadallada siyaasadeed. Dhanka kale, su’aashu ma aha oo keliya waxa wasiirku yiri, balse waa haddii qaabka uu uga jawaabayo mucaaradka uu dhab ahaan u adeegayo danaha dowladda. Siyaasadda casriga ah, jawaab kasta waxay leedahay kharash iyo faa’iido, waxaana muhiim ah in la ogaado goorta la jawaabayo iyo goorta aamusnaantu ka waxtar badan tahay. Maxaa laga filayaa Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga? Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga waxaa laga filayaa inuu shacabka siiyo xog ku saabsan xaaladda amniga, horumarka ciidamada, caqabadaha dagaalka iyo qorshaha lagu xoojinayo awoodda ciidanka. Waxa kale oo laga doonayaa inuu si cad uga hadlo waxa dowladda ka qabatay goobaha ay ciidamada ku sugan yihiin iyo meelaha ay wali ka jiraan caqabado. Taasi macnaheedu ma aha in Fiqi uusan ka hadli karin siyaasadda. Hase yeeshee, haddii hadallada siyaasadeed ee uu kaga jawaabayo mucaaradka ay ka bataan warbixinnada la xiriira shaqada wasaaradda, waxaa dhaawacmi karta kala sarreynta mudnaanta. Wasiir awood leh wuxuu dowladda u difaaci karaa si ka waxtar badan marka uu soo bandhigo natiijooyin la cabbiri karo. Tusaale ahaan, haddii dowladda ay horumar ka sameyso dagaalka Al-Shabaab, waxaa ka xoog badan in shacabka loo sheego waxa laga qabtay goobaha dagaalka, halkii lagu mashquuli lahaa in siyaasiga mucaaradka ah loogu jawaabo hadal kale. Dowladda oo u baahan fariin mideysan Dhanka kale, waxaa la fahmi karaa sababta Fiqi iyo mas’uuliyiin kale ay uga falcelinayaan hadallada mucaaradka. Soomaaliya waxay ku jirtaa marxalad siyaasadeed oo aad u xasaasi ah, gaar ahaan doodaha ku saabsan doorashooyinka, dastuurka, amniga iyo xiriirka dowladda federaalka iyo maamul-goboleedyada. Xukuumad kasta waxay u baahan tahay inay yeelato awood ay ku difaacdo siyaasaddeeda. Laakiin difaacaas wuxuu noqdaa mid waxtar badan marka ay jiraan shaqsiyaad si rasmi ah loogu igmaday xiriirka warbaahinta iyo sharaxaadda siyaasadaha dowladda. Haddii wasiir kasta uu noqdo afhayeen u gaar ah oo maalin kasta ka jawaaba mucaaradka, waxaa dhalan karta fariimo kala duwan iyo dood aan lahayn xarun keliya oo laga maamulo. Taasi waxay mararka qaar adkeyn kartaa halkii ay ka fududeyn lahayd isgaarsiinta dowladda. Si kastaba, xukuumad kasta waxaa ugu dambeyn lagu qiimeeyaa waxqabadka ay sheeganeyso ee laguma qiimeeyo sida wanaagsan ee ay uga jawaabto dhaliisheeda. Haddii dowladda ay leedahay waxqabad muuqda, shaqadaas ayaa lafteedu noqon karta jawaabta ugu xooggan ee mucaaradka. Haddii amniga hagaago, dhaqaalaha kobco, adeegyada dowladda kordhaan, hay’adaha dowladdu shaqeeyaan, doorasho la isku raacsan yahayna qabsoonto, doodda mucaaradka waxay si dabiici ah u lumin kartaa qayb ka mid ah awooddeeda. Taasi waa “jawaabta” ugu adag ee siyaasadeed. Doorashada qof iyo cod Inta badan wasiir Fiqi wuxuu qoraalladiisa ugu difaacaya hanaanka lagu muransan yahay ee doorasho qof iyo cod, isagoo marwalba sheega in mucaaradku ku qasban yahay aqbalka hanaankan doorasho. Haddii dowladda ay dhab ka tahay doorasho qof iyo cod, doodda ugu weyn waa in la helo hannaan siyaasadeed oo la isku raacsan yahay, xeerar cad, hay’ad doorasho oo lagu kalsoon yahay iyo jawi amni oo u saamaxaya shacabka inay codkooda dhiibtaan. Mucaaradka oo lagu tilmaamo “calaacalayaal” ma xallinayso khilaafka doorashada. Sidoo kale dowladda oo si joogto ah uga jawaabta dhaliisha mucaaradka ma dhiseyso kalsooni siyaasadeed. Waxa wax ka beddeli kara xaaladda waa heshiis siyaasadeed iyo nidaam doorasho oo dhinacyadu si dhab ah ugu wada qanci karaan. Isku soo wada duubo, Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay wasiir gaashaandhig oo si adag uga shaqeeya dhismaha ciidamada iyo sugidda amniga, halka dowladda ay u baahan tahay afhayeen iyo hannaan isgaarsiineed oo si nidaamsan uga jawaaba dagaalka siyaasadeed. items.title: Somalia Mourns After Brothers and a Child Die in Separate Incidents
items.description: Badhan/Hargeisa (WDN) — Somalia has been shaken by two deeply tragic incidents in which members of the same families lost their lives in separate parts of the country, highlighting once again the devastating consequences that can follow when family disputes, land conflicts and personal crises descend into violence. In the Bari region, in Ceeldaahir, a small town near Badhan, along the road leading to the port city of Bosaso. a man reportedly killed his own brother on Wednesday following a dispute over land ownership or its use. Preliminary reports indicate that the two brothers had been involved in a disagreement over a piece of land before the dispute escalated into physical violence, ultimately ending in a death that has left the local community shocked and grieving. The identities of the two brothers and the precise circumstances surrounding the killing have not yet been officially released. Details concerning the suspect’s current status are also unclear. For residents of Ceeldaahir, the incident has brought profound sadness, particularly because the victim and alleged perpetrator were members of the same family. The tragedy is a painful reminder of how disputes over land—a source of growing tension in many Somali communities—can escalate from disagreements into irreversible violence. Another Family Tragedy in Hargeisa The incident in Ceeldaahir came only hours after another disturbing death was reported in Hargeisa, where a father was allegedly involved in the killing of his nine-year-old son. According to reports, the child was fatally struck with a stone during an incident that has shocked the local community. Somaliland police were reportedly able to apprehend the father following the incident. Some reports have suggested that the man may have been suffering from a mental health condition, although this has not been independently confirmed and should not be treated as an established explanation for the tragedy. Whatever the circumstances, the death of a nine-year-old child at the hands of his own father has generated widespread sorrow and disbelief. A child who should have been protected by his family instead became the victim of an unimaginable act of violence. A Sobering Reminder: Two Lives Lost, Two Communities Grieving The two incidents occurred in different places and appear to have had very different circumstances. Yet they share one heartbreaking feature: people from the same families turning against one another with fatal consequences. In Ceeldaahir, a dispute over land reportedly ended with one brother killing another. In Hargeisa, a young child lost his life in an incident involving his father. Both cases remain subject to further investigation, and many details have yet to be officially confirmed. But together, they raise difficult questions about how Somali communities respond to disputes, family tensions and vulnerable individuals facing personal or psychological crises. Land disputes are among the most persistent sources of conflict in Somalia. Where formal documentation, trusted dispute-resolution mechanisms and accessible courts are weak, disagreements over ownership and boundaries can easily become personal and, in extreme cases, violent. Traditional elders, religious leaders and judicial institutions can play an important role in preventing such disputes from reaching that point. The Hargeisa tragedy raises another equally important issue: the need for families and communities to recognize and respond to serious mental-health problems before they develop into situations that could place vulnerable people, particularly children, at risk. For the families involved, these are not political stories or statistics. They are personal tragedies. One family is mourning a brother who reportedly died following a dispute over land. Another is mourning a nine-year-old child whose life ended in circumstances that have left an entire community searching for answers. May Allah have mercy on those who lost their lives and give their families strength and patience. The tragedies should also serve as a warning that disputes that appear manageable can become catastrophic when dialogue breaks down, when anger replaces restraint, or when vulnerable people do not receive the protection they need. No piece of land is worth a human life. And no family should have to bury its own because a disagreement was allowed to become violence. items.title: Digniin cusub oo laga soo saaray culeyska AUSSOM iyo fursadda Al-Shabaab
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Saraakiil iyo diblomaasiyiin reer Galbeed ah ayaa ka digaya in haddii aan la helin ilo dhaqaale oo kale ay adkaan karto in ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya ay sii joogaan saldhigyada ku yaalla deegaanada fogfog, taasoo abuuri karta firaaq amni oo ay Al-Shabaab ka faa’iidaysato. Digniintan ayaa timid xilli Mareykanka uu qorsheynayo inuu joojiyo maalgelinta xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee taageera howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya, UNSOS, kaas oo door muhiim ah ka qaata howlaha saadka ee ciidamada AUSSOM. UNSOS ayaa ciidamada howl-galka siiya adeegyo muhiim ah oo ay ka mid yihiin shidaal, raashin, biyo, gaadiid iyo adeegyo caafimaad, kuwaas oo muhiim u ah in ciidamada ay si joogto ah uga howlgalayaan goobaha ay ku sugan yihiin. Saraakiil iyo khubaro amni ayaa aaminsan in hoos u dhac ku yimaada adeegyadaas uu si gaar ah u saameyn karo saldhigyada ku yaalla meelaha ka fog xarumaha waaweyn, halkaas oo helitaanka sahayda iyo adeegyada kale uu durba yahay caqabad. Ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee ku howlgala AUSSOM ayaa door muhiim ah ka qaata taageerada ciidamada dowladda Soomaaliya iyo haynta deegaanada laga saaro Al-Shabaab, gaar ahaan goobaha ay ciidamada Soomaaliyeed weli u baahan yihiin taageero dheeraad ah. Hase yeeshee, khubarada ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada Soomaaliya aysan weli awood buuxda u yeelan inay si madax-bannaan u fuliyaan hawlgallo ballaaran, isla markaana muddo dheer ku sii hayaan dhulka ay dib uga qabsadaan Al-Shabaab. Sida laga soo xigtay warbixino laga qoray xaaladda amni ee dalka, Al-Shabaab ayaa horey uga faa’iidaysatay meelaha ay ciidamada Midowga Afrika ama ciidamada dowladda ka baxeen, iyadoo mararka qaar dib ula wareegtay deegaano horay looga saaray. Arrintan ayaa sare u qaadaysa walaaca laga qabo in bixitaan ama hoos u dhac ku yimaada awoodda AUSSOM uu kooxda Al-Shabaab u abuuro fursad ay ku kordhiso weerarradeeda, gaar ahaan deegaanada aan weli laga dhisin awood amni oo joogto ah. Saraakiil Soomaali ah iyo kuwo reer Galbeed ah ayaa sidaas darteed aaminsan in taageerada saadka ay tahay qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah awoodda howlgalka, isla markaana maalgelin la’aantu ay wiiqi karto joogitaanka ciidamada meelaha fogfog. UNSOS ayaa hadda taageerta ku dhowaad 12,000 oo ka tirsan ciidamada howlgalka, iyadoo adeegyada ay bixiso ay si toos ah ugu xiran yihiin awoodda ciidamada AUSSOM ay ugu shaqeeyaan saldhigyada iyo goobaha ay gacanta ku hayaan. Haddii aan la helin maalgelin beddel ah ka hor inta uusan dhaqan-gelin go’aanka Mareykanka, khubarada ayaa ka digaya in howlgalka uu wajihi karo caqabado waaweyn, xilli dagaalka Al-Shabaab uu weli ka socdo qeybo badan oo Soomaaliya ah. Walaaca ayaa sidoo kale taabanaya qorshaha dowladda Soomaaliya ee ah in si tartiib ah mas’uuliyadda amniga loogu wareejiyo ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo AUSSOM loogu talagalay inay taageerto kala-guurkaas, ilaa ciidamada dalka ay awood buuxda u yeeshaan sugidda amniga. Maalgelin la’aanta ayaa sidaas darteed noqon karta caqabad hor leh oo ku timaadda qorshaha kala-guurka amni, iyadoo Midowga Afrika iyo dalalka taageera Soomaaliya ay wajahaan baahida loo qabo in la helo dhaqaale lagu sii wado howlgalka. Dhawaan ayay ahayd markii ciidamada Itoobiya ee qeybta ka ah howlgalka AUSSOM ay ka baxeen degmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Baay, tallaabadaas oo dhalisay walaac xooggan oo ku saabsan xaaladda amni ee degmada iyo suuragalnimada in Al-Shabaab ay dib ugu soo laabato. Dadka ku nool Buurhakaba ayaa walaac ka muujiyay bixitaanka ciidamada Itoobiya, iyadoo xaaladdan ay tusaale u tahay caqabadaha ka dhalan kara haddii ciidamada AUSSOM ay ka baxaan deegaano aysan weli ciidamada Soomaaliyeed awood buuxda ugu filnayn inay si madax-bannaan u sugaan amnigooda. Sidaas darteed, khubaradu waxay ku adkeysanayaan in qorshe cad oo maalgelin iyo kala-guur amni ah loo baahan yahay si looga fogaado firaaq amni oo ay Al-Shabaab ka faa’iidaysato. Xogta wada-hadallo xasaasi ah oo dhexmaray Golaha Mustaqbalka iyo Farmaajo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ayaa wada-hadallo la yeeshay madaxweynihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo, iyagoo doonaya in la mideeyo awoodda mucaaradka si ay door weyn uga yeeshaan hannaanka doorashada federaalka. Wada-hadalladan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallo siyaasadeed oo lagu doonayo in mucaaradka Soomaaliyeed ay yeeshaan mowqif mideysan, gaar ahaan cidda noqonaysa xubnaha ugu badan ee Guddiga Jihaynta Doorashada Federaalka. Arrintan ayaa soo baxday kaddib dhex-dhexaadin ay sameeyeen dhinacyada beesha caalamka, taas oo la sheegay inay isku soo dhoweysay dowladda federaalka iyo mucaaradka, iyadoo labada dhinac ay isku afgarteen mabda’a ah in dalka loo jihayno doorasho toos ah. Sida xogaha la helayo ay tilmaamayaan, waxaa hadda la isla oggol yahay in doorashada soo socota lagu qabto nidaam toos ah, iyadoo sidoo kale la doonayo in dalka uu yeesho hal guddi oo maamula doorashada, taasoo meesha ka saaraysa guddiyo kala duwan oo dhinacyadu ku murmaan. Hase yeeshee, heshiiska guud ayaa weli waxaa hortaagan laba qodob oo muhiim ah, kuwaas oo kala ah cidda yeelanaysa awoodda ugu badan ee Guddiga Jihaynta Doorashada iyo waqtiga rasmiga ah ee la qabanayo doorashada federaalka. Villa Soomaaliya ayaa la sheegay inay beesha caalamka u gudbisay mowqif ah in xisbiyada ay hoggaamiyaan madaxweynihii hore Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo iyo ra’iisul wasaarihii hore Cumar Cabdirashiid Cali Sharmaarke ay dhankeeda yihiin, sidaas darteedna ay xaq u leedahay inay hesho aqlabiyadda xubnaha Guddiga Jihaynta Doorashada. Mowqifkaas ayaa dhaliyay inuu Golaha Mustaqbalka dib ula xiriiro siyaasiyiin ay hore uga soo horjeedeen, gaar ahaan Farmaajo iyo Cumar Cabdirashiid, iyadoo hadafka ugu weyn uu yahay in la mideeyo awoodda mucaaradka iyo saamaynta ay ku yeelan karaan guddiga doorashada. Dhinaca kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa ku adkeysanaya in la dhammeystiro muddada dheeriga ah ee uu siinayo dastuurka cusub, taasoo dowladda u aragto inay qeyb ka tahay qorshaha siyaasadeed iyo dastuuriga ah ee dalka. Mucaaradka ayaa iyagu doonaya in doorashada la qabto ka hor bilowga sanadka 2027, iyagoo ka digaya in muddo dheeri ah loo sameeyo hay’adaha dowladda iyadoo aan la gaarin heshiis siyaasadeed oo ay dhinacyada oo dhan ku wada qanacsan yihiin. Khilaafka waqtiga doorashada iyo awoodda Guddiga Jihaynta Doorashada ayaa sidaas darteed weli ah caqabadda ugu weyn ee hortaagan heshiis siyaasadeed oo dhameystiran, iyadoo dadaallada beesha caalamka iyo wada-hadallada dhinacyadu ay socdaan si loo helo hannaan ay dhinacyadu si wadajir ah ugu wada qanacsan yihiin. items.title: Somali Federal Lawmaker Vows to Follow the Will of the Somaliland People Over Somali Unity
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — A senior Somali opposition politician representing Somaliland in the Federal Parliament has openly declared that he will support whatever political future the people of Somaliland choose, injecting a striking new dimension into Somalia’s increasingly contentious debate over national unity, federalism and Somaliland’s long-standing demand for independence. MP Kooshin, who represents Somaliland in the House of the People and is also associated with the opposition-led Future Council, made the remarks in an interview with Shabeelle TV. Asked directly about his position on Somaliland’s aspirations and the question of independence, Kooshin gave an unusually straightforward answer. “I want what my people want. I am there to represent them.” Pressed further by the interviewer about whether he supported the wishes of the people of Somaliland, Kooshin reiterated his position: “Whatever they want, I want.” The statement is significant because it comes from a sitting member of Somalia’s Federal Parliament—a national institution whose constitutional mandate is based on representing the Somali people and preserving the country’s federal political order. Kooshin’s remarks therefore raise a fundamental question: what happens when the political preferences of a parliamentarian’s constituents collide with the constitutional position of the state he serves? A Parliamentarian Caught Between Two Political Realities The comments expose one of the most complicated realities of Somalia’s political system. Somaliland has governed itself separately from Mogadishu since declaring its independence in 1991. While the Federal Government of Somalia continues to regard Somaliland as part of the Somali Republic, Somaliland’s authorities maintain that the territory is an independent state and have pursued international recognition for decades. Yet Somaliland-origin politicians continue to occupy positions within Somalia’s federal institutions. Kooshin’s statement brings that contradiction into unusually sharp focus. His message appears to be that his primary political obligation is to the wishes of the people he represents, even when those wishes may diverge fundamentally from national unity. That is a politically consequential distinction. It suggests that representation, identity and political loyalty in Somalia’s federal institutions cannot always be reduced to a simple question of whether a politician supports the central government’s position. Kooshin’s remarks come at a moment when Somalia’s political landscape is already experiencing intense debate over the future structure of the state. The Federal Government and opposition groups remain deeply divided over constitutional reforms, elections, federalism and the distribution of political authority between Mogadishu and the Federal Member States. At the same time, relations between Mogadishu and Somaliland remain among the most sensitive political issues in the Horn of Africa. The dispute is no longer confined to diplomatic statements between Hargeisa and Mogadishu. It increasingly intersects with Somalia’s internal political competition, particularly as politicians from different regions attempt to balance national institutions with the interests of the communities they represent. Kooshin’s remarks illustrate that tension in unusually direct terms. At the heart of Kooshin’s argument is a principle familiar to democratic politics: elected representatives are expected to reflect the interests and political aspirations of their constituents. But Somalia’s political circumstances make that principle particularly complicated. If the majority of people represented by a parliamentarian support Somaliland’s independence, can that representative be expected to advocate for a unified Somali state? Conversely, if a parliamentarian believes that national unity is constitutionally fundamental, how should that representative respond if constituents demand a different political future? These questions have no easy answers. They go directly to the unresolved constitutional and political relationship between Somalia and Somaliland. Government dysfunction and eroding Somali unity For supporters of Somali unity, Kooshin’s statement may be viewed as deeply troubling. They could argue that members of the Federal Parliament should defend the constitutional integrity and territorial unity of Somalia regardless of regional political preferences. For others, however, his position could be interpreted differently—as an acknowledgment that political legitimacy ultimately depends on the consent and aspirations of the people being represented. That distinction is particularly important in a country where political disputes have repeatedly emerged because national institutions and regional political interests have moved in different directions. The statement may therefore deserve attention not simply as another opposition criticism of the Federal Government, but as a window into the deeper structural challenges confronting Somalia’s federal experiment. Somalia’s unity debate cannot ultimately be resolved through political declarations alone. Nor can the relationship between Mogadishu and Somaliland be settled simply by insisting that one side is right and the other must submit. The underlying political question remains unresolved: Can Somalia construct a federal system in which regional identities, local political aspirations and national institutions can coexist without continually producing constitutional crises? Kooshin’s remarks suggest just how difficult that challenge remains. A politician sitting in Somalia’s national parliament is publicly saying that his political position will follow the wishes of the people of Somaliland. That statement may be uncomfortable for advocates of a centralized conception of Somali unity. But it also forces a broader conversation about what representation actually means in a divided and politically contested state. For Somalia, the issue is ultimately larger than one parliamentarian. It is about whether national unity is sustained primarily by constitutional declarations—or by a political settlement in which citizens across the country’s disputed and autonomous regions genuinely believe their voices, identities and aspirations have a place. Until that question is answered, Somalia’s debate over unity, federalism and Somaliland’s future will remain one of the defining political struggles shaping the country’s next chapter. Government dysfunction and eroding Somali unity For supporters of Somali unity, Kooshin’s statement may be viewed as deeply troubling. They could argue that members of the Federal Parliament should defend the constitutional integrity and territorial unity of Somalia regardless of regional political preferences. For others, however, his position could be interpreted differently—as an acknowledgment that political legitimacy ultimately depends on the consent and aspirations of the people being represented. That distinction is particularly important in a country where political disputes have repeatedly emerged because national institutions and regional political interests have moved in different directions. The statement may therefore deserve attention not simply as another opposition criticism of the Federal Government, but as a window into the deeper structural challenges confronting Somalia’s federal experiment. Somalia’s unity debate cannot ultimately be resolved through political declarations alone. Nor can the relationship between Mogadishu and Somaliland be settled simply by insisting that one side is right and the other must submit. The underlying political question remains unresolved: Can Somalia construct a federal system in which regional identities, local political aspirations and national institutions can coexist without continually producing constitutional crises? Kooshin’s remarks suggest just how difficult that challenge remains. A politician sitting in Somalia’s national parliament is publicly saying that his political position will follow the wishes of the people of Somaliland. That statement may be uncomfortable for advocates of a centralized conception of Somali unity. But it also forces a broader conversation about what representation actually means in a divided and politically contested state. For Somalia, the issue is ultimately larger than one parliamentarian. It is about whether national unity is sustained primarily by constitutional declarations—or by a political settlement in which citizens across the country’s disputed and autonomous regions genuinely believe their voices, identities and aspirations have a place. Until that question is answered, Somalia’s debate over unity, federalism and Somaliland’s future will remain one of the defining political struggles shaping the country’s next chapter.
