items.title: Syria Refuses to Remove Newly Discovered Nuclear Materials as Questions Over Assad-Era Program Resurface
items.description: Damascus (WDN) — Syria’s new government has rejected calls to remove nuclear materials recently discovered at a previously undisclosed site, saying the material will remain under Syrian control while allowing international inspectors to examine and verify its condition. The decision has reignited scrutiny of Syria’s controversial nuclear history and raised fresh questions about what remains of the secretive nuclear activities allegedly pursued during the rule of former President Bashar al-Assad. Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shibani said the government would retain custody of the material inside Syria and insisted that it does not currently pose a threat to the population or environment. At the same time, Damascus has indicated that it is prepared to cooperate with the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and allow international monitoring of the material. Al-Shibani also argued that Syria retains the right to use nuclear materials for peaceful and civilian purposes, provided such activities remain subject to international safeguards and IAEA oversight. The position reflects a delicate balancing act by Syria’s new authorities: demonstrating cooperation with international nuclear inspectors while simultaneously asserting national sovereignty over material that could shed light on one of the most controversial chapters of the country’s recent history. A Discovery with a Troubling History The significance of the discovery lies largely in Syria’s past. During Bashar al-Assad’s presidency, Syria faced longstanding international allegations that it had pursued undeclared nuclear activities. Those suspicions intensified after Israel destroyed a facility in Deir al-Zour in 2007, in an airstrike that Israeli and other intelligence assessments said had targeted a covert nuclear reactor. The facility was widely suspected of having been constructed with assistance from North Korea, although Damascus denied operating a clandestine nuclear weapons program. The destruction of the Deir al-Zour site left major unanswered questions about the extent of Syria’s nuclear activities, the origin of related materials and whether other undeclared facilities existed elsewhere in the country. Those questions have now acquired renewed importance. IAEA Returns to Syria The IAEA has confirmed access to the newly identified location as part of a broader effort to investigate Syria’s historical nuclear activities and determine the origin and purpose of nuclear-related materials discovered there. IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi has said inspectors encountered a substantial quantity of nuclear material at a previously undisclosed Syrian site, describing the amount in terms of tons. The scale of the discovery makes verification particularly important. Inspectors will need to establish precisely what the material is, where it came from, how it was stored, whether it was previously declared to international authorities and what it was intended to be used for. Those questions could ultimately determine whether the discovery represents remnants of legitimate civilian activity, material associated with Syria’s former nuclear program, or evidence of activities that were never fully disclosed. For now, there is insufficient publicly available evidence to draw a definitive conclusion. The Syrian government’s position appears carefully calculated. Damascus does not want the material transferred out of the country, but neither does it appear to be rejecting international scrutiny. Instead, the government says it will retain control while allowing the IAEA to inspect and verify the material. That approach could allow Syria to demonstrate cooperation with the international community without surrendering control over potentially valuable nuclear resources. Al-Shibani has emphasized that the materials are not currently considered dangerous and that Syria is willing to place their handling under international safeguards. The government also insists that Syria has the sovereign right to pursue peaceful nuclear activities in the future. That position is likely to attract close international attention. Security Concerns Go Beyond the Nuclear Material The discovery is significant not only because of what the material may reveal about Syria’s past, but also because of the country’s current security environment. Syria remains politically fragile, while its relationship with Israel continues to be highly sensitive. Israel has historically viewed any Syrian military or nuclear capability with particular concern, especially given the two countries’ longstanding conflict and the broader regional rivalry involving Iran and other actors. The timing of the nuclear discovery is therefore particularly consequential. On 18 August 2026, Israel also carried out strikes on the Abu al-Duhur military base in northwestern Syria, an action the United States criticized as an unnecessary escalation that did little to advance regional stability. Reports of previously undisclosed nuclear materials inside Syria inevitably carry an additional security dimension. Any uncertainty surrounding the material’s origin, purpose or intended use could become a source of concern for Israel and other regional governments. What Happened During the Assad Era? Perhaps the most important question is also the most difficult to answer. Where did the material come from? The second question follows immediately: What was it intended for? And behind both lies the larger historical question: How much of Syria’s nuclear activities during the Assad era has actually been uncovered and disclosed? The IAEA’s renewed investigation could provide some of the answers. Syria is not publicly known to possess an operational nuclear weapons stockpile, and there is no established evidence that Damascus maintained a functioning nuclear arsenal. But the history of undeclared nuclear-related activities has ensured that international investigators remain skeptical of incomplete explanations. The discovery of a large quantity of nuclear material at a previously undisclosed site therefore makes full verification essential. A Test for Syria’s New Government For Syria’s new leadership, the issue represents an important test. Damascus has an opportunity to demonstrate that it is prepared to cooperate transparently with international institutions and address unresolved questions inherited from the Assad era. At the same time, the government clearly wants to avoid allowing the discovery to become an argument for foreign intervention or a challenge to Syrian sovereignty. Its current position attempts to strike that balance: the material will remain in Syria, the Syrian government will retain responsibility for it, and the IAEA will be allowed to inspect and verify it. Whether that formula will satisfy the international community remains uncertain. Ultimately, the credibility of Syria’s position will depend not on political assurances but on what international inspectors discover. If the material proves to be benign civilian material that can be fully accounted for, the controversy may gradually subside. If investigators uncover links to previously undeclared nuclear activities, however, the discovery could reopen one of the most sensitive chapters of Syria’s modern history. For now, the mystery remains. The material is there. The IAEA has access. And the most consequential questions—where it came from, why it was stored there and what it was originally intended for—remain unanswered. The investigation may determine not only what Syria inherited from the Assad era, but also how much of that legacy the new government is prepared to confront in full view of the world. items.title: Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo taageero dheeraad ah siineysa Aadan Madoobe
items.description: Dowladda Federaalka ayaa taageero hor leh siineysa Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, Aadan Maxamed Nuur (Aadan Madoobe), tani oo lagu adkeynayo amniga iyo difaaca Magaalada Baydhabo. Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa asal ahaan taageero siyaasadeed iyo mid amni la garab joogtay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, laakiin waxa uu markan codsanaya kaalmo dheeraad, si loo xoojiyo xasilloonida iyo difaaca Baydhabo, xilli uu maamulkiisu wajahayo xiisado siyaasadeed iyo militari oo uga imanaya taageereyaasha Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen), iyadoona labada dhinac aad mooddo inay ku loolamayaan gacan ku haynta magaaladaasi. Aadan Maxamed Nuur oo maalmahaanba booqasho ku joogay Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa Arbacadii la kulmay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isagoo warbixin ka siiyay xaaladda guud ee deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed. Ilo wareedyo ayaa sheegaya in Aadan Madoobe uu Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka weydiistay in loo soo diro Saraakiil khibrad leh oo ka caawiya howlaha sugidda amniga iyo in wixii ciidamo ah ee laga maarmi karo in la keeno magaalada, isla-markaana uu Madaxweynuhu ka aqbalay codsigaas. Aadan Madoobe ayaa xalay Caasimadda Muqdisho kula kulmay Xildhibaanada Labada Aqal ee deegaan doorashadoodu tahay Koonfur Galbeed, waxaana sidoo kale kulanka ka qaybgalay Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdiqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), Gudoomiye Kuxigeenka 2aad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow iyo Raysal Wasaare Kuxigeenka 2aad ee Xukuumadda Federaalka, Jibriil Cabdirashiid Xaaji Cabdi. “Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xaaladda guud ee ka jirta deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga, horumarinta iyo xoojinta dowladnimada. Waxaa kulanka diiradda lagu saaray, sidii si wadajir ah looga shaqayn lahaa horumarka, amniga, xasilloonida iyo danta guud ee shacabka Koonfur Galbeed, iyadoo la xoojinayo wada-shaqaynta iyo isku-duubnida masuuliyiinta iyo siyaasiyiinta ka soo jeeda deegaanada Koonfur Galbeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Madaxtooyada Koonfur Galbeed. Aadan Madoobe oo afartii sano ee u dambeysay ku magacawnaa Gudoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Somaliya ayaa 10-kii bishii June loo doortay Hoggaamiyaha Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed. Aadan Madoobe ayaa Muqdisho ka wada shirar siyaasadeed, oo uu ku xaqiijinayo taageero uu salka ugu dhigo maamulka uu hoggaamiyo. Villa Somalia ayaa weli si dhow ula shaqeynaysa maamulkiisa cusub, si looga horleexiyo caqabadaha horgudban.

items.title: Wasaarada A/Dibadda oo si weyn loogu dhalleeceeyay arrin ay maanta sameysay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa soo saartay war-saxaafadeed ay ku sheegtay inay si weyn uga xun tahay burbur ka dhacay goob macdanta dahabka laga qodo oo ku taalla tuulada Zamboye ee galbeedka Jamhuuriyadda Afrikada Dhexe. Wasaaradda ayaa sheegtay in burburkaasi ay ku dhinteen in ka badan boqol qof, halka dad kalena weli la la’yahay. Wasaaradda ayaa iyadoo ku hadlaysa magaca dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, tacsi tiiraanyo leh u dirtay dowladda iyo shacabka Jamhuuriyadda Afrikada Dhexe, gaar ahaan qoysaska ay ka geeriyoodeen qaar ka mid ah eheladooda. “Iyadoo labada dal ay yihiin xubno ka wada tirsan Midowga Afrika, dowladda Soomaaliya waxay garab taagan tahay Jamhuuriyadda Afrikada Dhexe xilligan adag ee murugada leh, waxayna u muujinaysaa garab-istaag dadka ku dhaawacmay iyo dhammaan kuwa ku hawlan gurmadka socda,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka wasaaradda. Intaas kaddib, war-saxaafadeedka ayaa la kulmay dhaleeceyn xooggan oo uga timid qaar ka mid ah bulshada Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo dowladda ku canaantay sida ay uga tacsiyeyn dhibaatooyinka gudaheeda ee sababa dhimashada. Inkastoo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ay dowladda Soomaaliya u qaabilsan tahay xiriirrada dibadda, haddana shacabka ayaa si aan caadi ahayn uga falceliyay tallaabadan, iyagoo su’aalo ka keenay mudnaanta ay dowladdu siisay tacsi loo diray dal shisheeye xilli dalka gudihiisa ay ka dhacayaan dhacdooyin sababa dhimashada dad Soomaaliyeed. Falcelinta shacabka ayaa si weyn ugu baaqday in dowladda ay sidoo kale si la mid ah uga hadasho, uga tacsiyeeyso, ugana damqato dhibaatooyinka iyo khasaaraha ka dhaca gudaha Soomaaliya. Cabdullaahi Cabdicasiis ayaa yiri: “Dadka Soomaaliyeed ee meelwalba ku dhibaataysan maad ka hadashaan ama ka tacsiyeysan intaydan Central Africa isku qaadin.” “Dilka dhalinyarada reer Koonfur Afrika wax ka hadlaayo ma aragteen,” ayuu yiri Maxamed Aamiin Garaad oo kamid ah dadka ka falceliyay war-saxaafadeedka wasaaradda oo lasoo dhigay barteeda Facebook. Mahad Jakarta: “Wasaaradii tacsiyo iyo hambalyeyn miyey u sameysan tahay waa yaabe. War kuwaan miyeynan xilkas ahayn, miyaanan lala xisaabtameyn.” Maxamed Jiinow Xasan ayaa isna waxa uu yiri: “Kuwa Turkiga uu Puntland ku layaay tacsi uma bahno miyaa, Afrikantaas ayaa ka naxsan tihiin.” Si kastaba, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa waxay u aragtaa tacsi u dirista dalalka ay Soomaaliya xiriirka la leedahay inay ka mid tahay waajibaadka diblomaasiyadeed, maadaama Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Afrikada Dhexe ay labaduba xubin ka yihiin Midowga Afrika, ayna leeyihiin xiriir rasmi ah. Inkastoo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ay dowladda Soomaaliya u qaabilsan tahay xiriirrada dibadda, haddana shacabka ayaa si aan caadi ahayn uga falceliyay tallaabadan, iyagoo su’aalo ka keenay mudnaanta ay dowladdu siisay tacsi loo diray dal shisheeye xilli dalka gudihiisa ay ka dhacayaan dhacdooyin sababa dhimashada dad Soomaaliyeed. Falcelinta shacabka ayaa si weyn ugu baaqday in dowladda ay sidoo kale si la mid ah uga hadasho, uga tacsiyeeyso, ugana damqato dhibaatooyinka iyo khasaaraha ka dhaca gudaha Soomaaliya. Cabdullaahi Cabdicasiis ayaa yiri: “Dadka Soomaaliyeed ee meelwalba ku dhibaataysan maad ka hadashaan ama ka tacsiyeysan intaydan Central Africa isku qaadin.” “Dilka dhalinyarada reer Koonfur Afrika wax ka hadlaayo ma aragteen,” ayuu yiri Maxamed Aamiin Garaad oo kamid ah dadka ka falceliyay war-saxaafadeedka wasaaradda oo lasoo dhigay barteeda Facebook. Mahad Jakarta: “Wasaaradii tacsiyo iyo hambalyeyn miyey u sameysan tahay waa yaabe. War kuwaan miyeynan xilkas ahayn, miyaanan lala xisaabtameyn.” Maxamed Jiinow Xasan ayaa isna waxa uu yiri: “Kuwa Turkiga uu Puntland ku layaay tacsi uma bahno miyaa, Afrikantaas ayaa ka naxsan tihiin.” Si kastaba, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda ayaa waxay u aragtaa tacsi u dirista dalalka ay Soomaaliya xiriirka la leedahay inay ka mid tahay waajibaadka diblomaasiyadeed, maadaama Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Afrikada Dhexe ay labaduba xubin ka yihiin Midowga Afrika, ayna leeyihiin xiriir rasmi ah. items.title: A fuel Tanker Seized in the Gulf of Aden
items.description: Mogadishu ( WDN) — A fuel tanker has reportedly been seized in the Gulf of Aden after six-armed men boarded the vessel and took control of its movement, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), raising fresh concerns over maritime security along one of the world’s most strategically important shipping routes. UKMTO said the incident occurred approximately 136 nautical miles east of Al Mukalla, Yemen, after the tanker reported an emergency situation when an unauthorized boat approached the vessel. In an updated advisory, UKMTO said six-armed individuals subsequently boarded the tanker and took control of the ship, directing it toward the Somali coast. Authorities are investigating the incident. The identity of the vessel has not yet been disclosed. Its name, flag, cargo and the precise condition of its crew remain unknown. A New Maritime Security Concern The incident is particularly significant because the Gulf of Aden is a critical maritime corridor linking the Red Sea and the Indian Ocean. Thousands of commercial vessels pass through the region each year, making the security of the waterway vital to international trade and energy supplies. The reported seizure also comes amid renewed concerns over piracy and armed attacks in waters off Somalia and Yemen. Maritime security organizations have recorded a series of recent incidents involving commercial vessels in the wider region, suggesting that the threat to shipping has not disappeared despite years of international naval patrols and counter-piracy operations. A recent UKMTO update indicated that four commercial vessels remain in the hands of hijacking groups, including MT Honour 25, MV Sward, MT Eureka and MT Asana. The latest incident therefore adds to an increasingly troubling maritime-security picture along the Somali coast and the Gulf of Aden. One important detail remains unresolved. UKMTO has not identified the attackers as Somali pirates. The agency has described them only as six-armed men who boarded and took control of the vessel. Their nationality, affiliation and motives have not been officially established. That distinction is important. Although the waters around Somalia have experienced a resurgence of piracy, it would be premature to attribute this particular incident to Somali pirates without confirmation from maritime authorities or other reliable sources. The attackers could potentially be linked to piracy networks, criminal groups or another armed organization operating in the region. At this stage, however, there is insufficient information to determine who they are or what they intend to do with the vessel. The Somalia Connection The reported decision to steer the tanker toward Somalia is nevertheless likely to attract considerable attention. Somalia’s long coastline has historically provided opportunities for pirate groups to hide hijacked vessels and hold crews while negotiating ransom demands. Recent incidents involving vessels seized in the region have revived concerns that criminal networks may once again be attempting to exploit gaps in maritime security. The reported movement of the tanker toward Somalia could therefore become a critical element of the investigation. Authorities will need to establish whether the vessel is being taken toward a known piracy area, whether the attackers intend to demand a ransom, and whether the incident is connected to other recent hijackings. For shipping companies, the incident represents another reminder that maritime security risks remain unpredictable. The Gulf of Aden has already been affected by multiple security threats in recent years, including piracy, attacks on commercial shipping and wider regional instability. The latest seizure demonstrates how quickly a vessel can move from a routine commercial voyage to a potentially dangerous hostage situation. Until the identities and intentions of the armed men are established, maritime authorities are likely to urge commercial operators to maintain heightened vigilance, particularly when operating near the Somali coastline and other areas considered vulnerable to armed boarding attempts. For now, the most important questions remain unanswered: Who are the six-armed men? Why did they seize the tanker? Where are they taking it—and what will happen to the crew? The answers could determine whether this was an isolated criminal incident or another indication of a broader resurgence of maritime insecurity in the waters surrounding Somalia and the Gulf of Aden. items.title: Maxaa looga hadlay kulanka Jaamac uu guddoomiyay ee ka dhacay Villa Hargeysa?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddiga Joogtada ah ee Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa kulankooda toddobaadlaha ah ku yeeshay xarunta Guddoonka iyo Guddiyada ee Villa Hargeysa. Kulanka waxaa shir guddoomiyay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), waxaana ku wehliyay Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow. Guddoomiye Jaamac oo kulanka furay ayaa xubnaha guddiga warbixin ka siiyay kulan uu la yeeshay guddi xildhibaanno ah oo wakiil ka ah xildhibaannada mucaaradka, isagoo sidoo kale ka warbixiyay dhambaallo hambalyo ah oo uu ka helay guddoomiyeyaasha baarlamaannada dalalka caalamka, hay’adaha iyo ururrada caalamiga ah. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale xubnaha la wadaagay warbixin ku saabsan howlaha guud ee Golaha Shacabka iyo arrimaha horyaalla, iyadoo kulanka lagu falanqeeyay shaqada baarlamaanka iyo waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee golaha. Intaas kadib, Xoghayaha Guud ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdulle (Jaabiri) ayaa guddoomiyaha iyo xubnaha kale ee guddiga la wadaagay warbixin ku saabsan hindise-sharciyeedyada horyaalla guddiyada golaha. Xoghayaha ayaa sidoo kale ka warbixiyay hindise-sharciyeedyadii soo maray akhrinnada kala duwan, iyadoo guddoomiyeyaasha guddiyada laga dhageystay warbixinno ku saabsan shuruucda ay gacanta ku hayaan iyo marxaladaha ay marayaan. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu eegay jadwalka loo qorsheeyay in hindise-sharciyeedyada iyo shuruucda ay guddiyadu gacanta ku hayaan loo horgeeyo kulamada Golaha Shacabka, si loo sii ambaqaado howlaha sharci-dejinta. Guddoomiye Jaamac oo kulanka soo xiray ayaa xubnaha Guddiga Joogtada ah kula dardaarmay inay ka shaqeeyaan midnimada iyo wadajirka golaha, si uu u guto waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah, isagoo ballanqaaday in golaha uu ku hoggaamin doono si waafaqsan xeer-hoosaadka iyo shuruucda u degsan. items.title: Somalia ex- FM Accuses  Turkey  Of Massacre
items.description: Somalia’s former Foreign Minister Abdisaed Muse Ali is accusing Turkey of carrying out a “massacre” after a reported drone strike near Garmaal in Puntland killed four Somali men. Initial local reports described the dead as suspected pirates linked to the hijacking of the cargo vessel Lutuf. But that account is now being challenged by residents, who say the four were innocent fishermen with no connection to piracy. Puntland authorities have yet to publicly clarify who the men were, while Turkey has not acknowledged carrying out the strike or responded to the civilian-casualty accusations. Ali accused Ankara of injecting “brutal aggression” into Somali politics and also blasted Puntland’s leadership for remaining over the deaths. Source: Somali Guardian

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Dayniile oo ku guuleystay abaal-marinta Somali Leadership Awards 2026
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Degmada Dayniile, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Macallin Xuseen, ayaa ku guuleystay Somali Leadership Awards 2026 – Special Leadership Award (SLA Winner 2026), taas oo lagu maamuusay hoggaamintiisa, dadaallada horumarineed iyo adeegyada uu u fidiyo bulshada degmada. Abaalmarintan ayaa loo arkaa aqoonsi loo sameeyay dadaallada maamulka Degmada Dayniile ee dhinacyada horumarinta deegaanka, bilicda degmada, nadaafadda, amniga iyo xoojinta adeegyada bulshada. Guusha Guddoomiyaha ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Degmada Dayniile ay ka socdaan dadaallo lagu horumarinayo bilicda iyo adeegyada aasaasiga ah, iyadoo maamulka degmada uu xoogga saarayo sidii shacabka loogu abuuri lahaa deegaan ammaan ah, nadiif ah oo leh adeegyo muhiim u ah bulshada. Guddoomiyaha Degmada Dayniile ayaa sheegay in abaalmarinta uusan u arkin mid isaga ku kooban, balse ay tahay guul ay wada leeyihiin shacabka degmada, kuwaas oo uu sheegay inay door muhiim ah ka qaataan dadaallada horumarineed. “Guushan waxay ii tahay sharaf weyn, balse waxaan u arkaa inay tahay guul u soo hoyatay Degmada Dayniile iyo shacabkeeda. Waxaan sii wadi doonnaa dadaalka, hoggaanka hufan iyo adeegga shacabka, si aan u gaarno horumar iyo guulo ka waaweyn kuwa maanta,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiyaha. Mid ka mid ah meelaha maamulka Degmada Dayniile uu mudnaanta siinayo ayaa ah nadaafadda iyo bilicda deegaanka, kuwaas oo muhiim u ah caafimaadka bulshada iyo muuqaalka caasimadda Muqdisho. Dadaallada maamulka ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa wacyigelinta bulshada, hagaajinta goobaha dadweynaha, nadaafadda waddooyinka iyo suuqyada, iyo ka hortagga qashinka lagu daadiyo goobaha aan loogu talagelin. Maamulka ayaa sidoo kale xoogga saaraya sidii bulshada loogu dhiirrigelin lahaa inay si toos ah uga qaybqaataan ilaalinta deegaanka ay ku nool yihiin. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda amniga shacabka, isaga oo tilmaamay in amni la’aan aysan suurtagal noqon karin in la gaaro horumar waara. Degmooyinka caasimadda Muqdisho ayaa door muhiim ah ku leh xasilloonida magaalada, waxaana muhiim ah in maamulka hoose, hay’adaha amniga iyo bulshada ay si dhow uga wada shaqeeyaan sugidda amniga iyo xal u helidda caqabadaha ka jira deegaanka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa xusay in wada-shaqeynta shacabka iyo laamaha amniga ay muhiim u tahay dhismaha deegaan nabdoon oo ay bulshadu si wanaagsan ugu noolaan karto. Maamulka Degmada Dayniile ayaa aaminsan in horumar waara aan lagu gaari karin dadaal dowladeed oo keliya, balse uu u baahan yahay iskaashi dhex mara maamulka, shacabka, ganacsatada, dhalinyarada iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Abaalmarinta la guddoonsiiyay Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidaas darteed loo arki karaa dhiirrigelin ku wajahan sii wadidda dadaallada lagu horumarinayo adeegyada bulshada iyo deegaanka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in guusha uu helay ay si weyn ugu xiran tahay taageerada iyo ka qaybqaadashada shacabka Dayniile. Abaalmarinta Somali Leadership Awards 2026 – Special Leadership Award ayaa noqonaysa dhiirrigelin cusub oo ku aaddan shaqada maamulka Degmada Dayniile, iyadoo Guddoomiyuhu caddeeyay in aqoonsigan uusan noqon doonin meel lagu soo afjaro dadaallada, balse uu noqon doono sabab loo sii xoojiyo adeegga shacabka. Waxa uu ballanqaaday in maamulka degmada uu sii wadi doono dadaallada ku aaddan amniga, nadaafadda, bilicda, adeegyada bulshada, midnimada iyo horumarka degmada. Guushan ayaa sidoo kale iftiiminaysa doorka muhiimka ah ee hoggaanka degmooyinku ku leeyihiin horumarinta magaalooyinka iyo adeegyada maalinlaha ah ee shacabka. Iyadoo Degmada Dayniile ay wajahdo baahiyo iyo caqabado dhinacyada adeegyada aasaasiga ah, nadaafadda, amniga iyo kaabayaasha bulshada, ayaa laga sugayaa in aqoonsigan cusub loo beddelo dadaallo dheeraad ah oo si toos ah uga faa’iideeya shacabka. Guusha Guddoomiyaha Degmada Dayniile ee Somali Leadership Awards 2026 ayaa sidaas ku noqotay bog cusub oo dhiirrigelin u ah maamulka iyo shacabka degmada, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo in guusha abaalmarinta laga dhigo mid horseedda waxqabad iyo horumar muuqda. The post Guddoomiyaha Dayniile oo ku guuleystay abaal-marinta Somali Leadership Awards 2026 appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Waxa uu ballanqaaday in maamulka degmada uu sii wadi doono dadaallada ku aaddan amniga, nadaafadda, bilicda, adeegyada bulshada, midnimada iyo horumarka degmada. Guushan ayaa sidoo kale iftiiminaysa doorka muhiimka ah ee hoggaanka degmooyinku ku leeyihiin horumarinta magaalooyinka iyo adeegyada maalinlaha ah ee shacabka. Iyadoo Degmada Dayniile ay wajahdo baahiyo iyo caqabado dhinacyada adeegyada aasaasiga ah, nadaafadda, amniga iyo kaabayaasha bulshada, ayaa laga sugayaa in aqoonsigan cusub loo beddelo dadaallo dheeraad ah oo si toos ah uga faa’iideeya shacabka. Guusha Guddoomiyaha Degmada Dayniile ee Somali Leadership Awards 2026 ayaa sidaas ku noqotay bog cusub oo dhiirrigelin u ah maamulka iyo shacabka degmada, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo in guusha abaalmarinta laga dhigo mid horseedda waxqabad iyo horumar muuqda. items.title: Madaxweynaha oo waftiyo u diray  bariga dalka  oo u kuur galaaya xaalada
items.description: Wefti uu hoggaamijayo Wasiirka Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Khadar Xuseen Cabdi oo ay weheliyaan Agaasimayaal Guud, Guddoomiyeyaal iyo masuuliyiin kala duwan, ayaa safar shaqo ku jooga magaalada Burco ee xarunta Gobolka Together. Wasiirka iyo weftigiisa, waxay xalay kulan la qaateen qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Togdheer, kuwaasi oo iska xog-waraystay xaaladaha Gobolka Togdheer. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada ayaa ka qaybgelaya xafladda qallin-jabinta Jaamacadda Burco oo ay maanta ku beegan tahay qallin-jabinteedu. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada JSL Khadar Xuseen Cabdi, ayaa la filayaa inuu gelinka dambe ee maanta safar ugu baxo magaalada Oodweyne ee xarunta Gobolka Daad-madheedh. Wasiirka Madaxtooyada iyo weftiga la socda, ayaa la filayaa inay mashaariic cusub ka dhagax-dhigaan Gobolka Daad-madheedh, isla markaana ay shirar la qaataan hal-doorka bulshada reer Daad-madheedh. Geesta kale, wefti ka socda Xukuumadda JSL ayaa maalmihii u dambeeyey ku sugnaa Gobolka Sanaag, waxayna shirar la qaateen qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Gobolka Sanaag. Weftiyadan ka socda Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ee ku sugan Gobolada Bariga, ayaa qayb ka ah dedaalada ay Xukuumadda Madaxweyne Cirro ugu jirto horumarka dalka iyo sidii bulshada looga xog-waraysan lahaa baahiyaha degaannada ay ku nool yihiin.

items.title: Iiraan oo dil toogasho ah ku fulisay nin ajnabi ah oo lagu helay…
items.description: Tehran (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Iiraan ayaa ku dhawaaqday inay fulisay xukun dil ah oo lagu riday nin ay ku sheegtay muwaadin ajnabi ah, kaas oo lagu eedeeyay inuu door ku lahaa dibadbaxyo rabshado wata oo bishii Janaayo ka dhacay magaalada Isfahan. Ninka la dilay ayaa lagu magacaabi jiray Ghaem Hosseini oo sidoo kale loo yaqaanay “Arian”, waxaana dowladda Iiraan ay ku eedeysay inuu ku lug lahaa falal ay ku sheegtay inay khatar ku yihiin amniga qaranka iyo nabadgelyada guud. Hay’adda wararka Tasnim oo xiriir dhow la leh dowladda Iiraan ayaa sheegtay in Hosseini lagu helay dambiyo la xiriira rabshadihii ka dhacay magaalada Isfahan, iyadoo garsoorka dalka uu sheegay in ninkaasi ahaa “muwaadin ajnabi ah”, balse lama shaacin dalkii uu u dhashay. Sida lagu sheegay warbixinnada rasmiga ah, dacwadda lagu soo oogay Hosseini waxay la xiriirtay “ku lug lahaanshaha dembiga ka dhacay Fagaaraha Alikhani ee Isfahan”, halkaas oo ay ka dhaceen dibadbaxyo iyo iska horimaadyo u dhexeeyay dibadbaxayaasha iyo ciidamada ammaanka. Eedaha loo jeediyay waxaa sidoo kale ka mid ahaa hub la bixid iyo cabsi gelin, abuurista amni-darro guud iyo mid baahsan iyo falal ay dowladda ku tilmaantay kuwo ka dhan ah badqabka jireed ee dadka iyo amniga qaranka. Ghaem Hosseini ayaa sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta dowladda, lagu eedeeyay inuu door ku lahaa dilka afar askari oo ka tirsanaa ciidamada booliska Iiraan. Wakaaladda wararka Mizan ayaa xustay in intii uu socday baaritaanka uu qirtay inuu joogay mudaaharaadyadii ka dhacay Fagaaraha Alikhani, isla markaana uu watay hub. Xukunka dilka ah ayaa la fuliyay kaddib markii kiiska Hosseini uu soo maray nidaamka maxkamadaha Iiraan. Maxkamadda Sare ee dalka ayaa dib u eegtay kiiska kaddib markii racfaan laga qaatay xukunka, balse ugu dambeyn waxay ansixisay go’aankii maxkamadda hoose. Hosseini ma ahayn qofka keliya ee kiiskan lala xiriiriyay. Warbaahinta dowladda ayaa sheegtay in Abolfazl Sepahi, Amir Hossein Safari, Erfan Esfandiari iyo Gol Mohammad Mohammadi horay loogu fuliyay xukuno dil ah oo la xiriira isla kiiska. Sidoo kale, Shervin Bagherian, Amir Hossein Maleki iyo Alireza Sepahi ayaa lagu helay dambiyo la xiriira dhacdooyinkii ka dhacay Fagaaraha Alikhani, sida ay sheegtay warbaahinta dowladda. Dowladda Iiraan ayaa dhacdooyinkaas ku tilmaantay falal rabshado wata oo khatar ku ahaa amniga, halka dhinacyada kale ay muddo dheer dhaliil ka muujinayeen sida dowladda Iiraan ula dhaqanto dadka lagu soo eedeeyo inay ku lug leeyihiin dibadbaxyada. Fulinta xukunka Ghaem Hosseini ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli si weyn loo kordhiyay fulinta xukunnada dilka ah ee Iiraan, gaar ahaan kaddib markii uu billowday dagaalka u dhexeeya Iiraan, Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil 28-kii Febraayo. Garsoorka Iiraan ayaa tan iyo markaas xukunno dil ah ku fuliyay tobannaan qof oo lagu soo oogay eedo kala duwan, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin basaasnimo iyo la-shaqeynta Mareykanka ama Israa’iil. Waxaa sidoo kale xukunno dil ah lagu fuliyay qaar ka mid ah dadka lagu xiray dibadbaxyadii ka dhacay qeybo badan oo dalka ah bishii December, iyadoo dowladda ay sheegtay in dadkaasi ku lug lahaayeen falal amni-darro iyo rabshado. Xukunka lagu fuliyay Ghaem Hosseini ayaa mar kale soo jiitay dareenka ku aaddan sida Iiraan ula macaamisho dadka lagu eedeeyo dambiyada amniga qaranka, gaar ahaan kuwa lala xiriiriyo dibadbaxyada. Dowladda ayaa ku adkeysanaysa in kiisaska noocan ah loo maray hannaan maxkamadeed, halka dhaleeceeyayaashu ay walaac ka muujiyaan adeegsiga xukunka dilka ee kiisaska siyaasadeed iyo kuwa la xiriira mudaharaadyada. items.title: Dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya oo 3.1% Kordhay
items.description: Muqdisho, 20 Agoosto 2026 — Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa kulankoodii toddobaadlaha ahaa ku yeeshay Muqdisho, iyadoo kulanka lagu soo bandhigay warbixinno la xiriira dhaqaalaha, amniga iyo difaaca dalka. Kulanka oo uu shir-guddoomiyay Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa si gaar ah looga dhageystay Wasaaradda Maaliyadda warbixin ku saabsan xisaab-xirka sanadeedka 2025, horumarinta dhaqaalaha, kordhinta canshuuraha gudaha iyo dib-u-habaynta nidaamka maaliyadeed ee dowladda. Warbixinta Wasaaradda Maaliyadda ayaa lagu sheegay in dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya uu kordhay 3.1 boqolkiiba, iyadoo kobacaas lagu cabbiray halbeegga wax-soo-saarka guud ee dalka (GDP). Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa sheegay in muhiimad gaar ah ay leedahay in Soomaaliya gaarto isku-filnaansho dhaqaale, iyadoo xoogga la saarayo kordhinta wax-soo-saarka gudaha, ka faa’iidaysiga khayraadka dalka, kobcinta dakhliga gudaha iyo dhiirrigelinta maalgashiga. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leeyihiin daah-furnaanta maaliyadeed, isla-xisaabtanka iyo ilaalinta hantida dowladda. Dhanka kale, Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa ammaanay Wasaaradda Maaliyadda, kaddib qiimeyn uu sameeyay Xafiiska Hanti-dhowrka Guud oo, sida lagu sheegay warbixinta, Wasaaradda siiyay qiimeynta “Aragti Nadiif ah”, taas oo lagu tilmaamay heerka ugu sarreeya ee qiimeynta hufnaanta maaliyadeed. Golaha Wasiirrada ayaa sidoo kale lagu wargeliyay xaaladda amniga dalka iyo howlgalladii ugu dambeeyay ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, iyadoo dowladda sheegtay in ciidamada ay horumar ka sameeyeen goobaha dagaalka isla markaana ay khasaarooyin gaarsiiyeen kooxda Al-Shabaab. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa ayaa ugu dambeyn sheegay in dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya uu si tartiib ah uga soo kabanayo caqabadihii hore, isagoo xusay in dowladda ay hiigsanayso in dalka uu mustaqbalka gaaro isku-filnaansho dhaqaale oo yareeya ku-tiirsanaanta kaalmada dibadda.

items.title: Maxay ka dhigan tahay in Xasan Sheekh uu aqoonsiga ka guddoomo safiirro aan….?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa shalay waraaqaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay toddobo safiir , kuwaas oo intooda badan aan safaarado ku lahayn Muqdisho, balse Soomaaliya uga wakiil ah safaaradahooda ku yaalla dalal kale oo gobolka ah. Marka hore, tani waxay u muuqan kartaa arrin diblomaasiyadeed oo caadi ah, balse marka si dhow loo eego waxay xambaarsan tahay fariin ka weyn xafladda waraaqaha aqoonsiga. Dal marka uu safiir u magacaabo Soomaaliya, xitaa haddii safiirkaasi uusan Muqdisho deggenayn, wuxuu si rasmi ah u muujinayaa in uu aqoonsan yahay muhiimadda xiriirka uu la leeyahay dowladda Soomaaliya. Safiir aan deggenayn muxuu yahay? Safiirrada shalay waraaqaha aqoonsiga looga guddoomay Villa Soomaaliya intooda badan waa safiirro aan Soomaaliya deggenayn, kuwaas oo diblomaasiyadda loogu yeero “non-resident ambassadors” . Waxay Soomaaliya uga shaqeeyaan safaarad ku taalla dal kale, iyadoo ay xilalkooda ku jiraan dhowr dal. Tusaale ahaan, safiirka Brazil u fadhiya Kenya, João Alfredo dos Anjos Junior ayaa sidoo kale loo aqoonsan yahay Soomaaliya iyo dalal kale. Sidoo kale, safiirka Hindiya ee Kenya, Dr. Adarsh Swaika ayaa Soomaaliya loo magacaabay, halka safiirka Mali uu fadhigiisu yahay Itoobiya, haddana uu Soomaaliya ka yahay wakiil diblomaasiyadeed. Qaabkan wuxuu dalalka u fududeeyaa inay xiriir rasmi ah la yeeshaan Soomaaliya, iyagoo aan kharashka iyo mas’uuliyadda ku bixin furitaanka safaarad joogto ah. Sidaas darteed, aqoonsiga safiirku waa tallaabo diblomaasiyadeed oo rasmi ah, balse ma laha isla heerka joogitaanka maalinlaha ah ee safaarad Muqdisho ku taalla. Maxay tani uga dhigan tahay Soomaaliya? Dhinaca Soomaaliya, magacaabista safiirrada noocan ah waxay ka dhigan tahay in Muqdisho ay sii haysato xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo firfircoon oo ay la leedahay dalal ku kala yaalla qaarado kala duwan, inkastoo aysan dalalkaasi Muqdisho ku lahayn joogitaan rasmi ah. Inkastoo arrintan laga fahmi karo in dalalkaasi aysan doonayn inay Soomaaliya ka maqnaadaan marka laga hadlayo arrimaha siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha, amniga iyo iskaashiga caalamiga ah, haddana waxay sidoo kale muujinaysaa heerka muhiimad ee Soomaaliya ay u leedahay dalalkaasi. Xitaa haddii safiirkoodu Nairobi, Addis Ababa ama Jabuuti ka shaqeeyo, dowladda Soomaaliya ugu yaraan waxay weli leedahay marin rasmi ah oo ay kula xiriirto dowladahaas. Si kastaba, waxaa muhiim ah in aan la isku khaldin aqoonsiga safiir aan deggenayn iyo furitaanka safaarad. Labaduba waa xiriir diblomaasiyadeed, laakiin heerka joogitaanka iyo awoodda ay ku leeyihiin Muqdisho way kala duwan yihiin. Aljeeriya oo ka duwan lixda dal ee kale Arrinta ugu muuqata ee liiskan ku jirta waa safiirka Aljeeriya, Mohamed Alim. Sababtu waa in Aljeeriya ay waddo dib-u-furista safaaraddeeda Muqdisho, taasoo ka dhigaysa xaaladdeeda mid ka duwan tan safiirrada kale ee waraaqaha aqoonsiga laga guddoomay. Haddii safaaradda Aljeeriya dib uga howlgasho Muqdisho, xiriirka labada dal wuxuu yeelan karaa joogitaan diblomaasiyadeed oo toos ah. Taasi waxay fududeyn kartaa in labada dowladood ay si joogto ah uga wada shaqeeyaan arrimaha siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha, waxbarashada iyo amniga. Dib-u-furista safaaraddu waxay sidoo kale leedahay qiime siyaasadeed. Safaarad joogto ah waxay dal u oggolaanaysaa inuu si dhow ula socdo xaaladda dalka uu xiriirka la leeyahay, isla markaana uu si degdeg ah uga jawaabo isbeddellada siyaasadeed iyo arrimaha quseeya muwaadiniintiisa. Sababta dalalku safaaradaha ugu hayn waayaan Muqdisho Su’aasha kale ee muhiimka ahi waa sababta toddobada safiir ee la aqoonsaday ay intooda badan uga shaqeynayaan dalal kale. Arrintan waxaa saameyn kara dhowr arrimood oo ay ka mid yihiin kharashka hawlgalka safaarad, baaxadda xiriirka labada dal iyo qiimeynta xaaladda amni. Dalalka qaar waxay door bidaan inay hal safaarad oo gobolka ku taalla ka maamulaan dhowr dal. Kenya iyo Itoobiya ayaa labaduba noqday xarumo muhiim u ah diblomaasiyadda gobolka, waxaana safiirro badan oo u fadhiya dalalkaas loo aqoonsadaa Soomaaliya. Tani macnaheedu ma aha in dalalkaasi aysan dan ka lahayn Soomaaliya. Mararka qaar waxay ka tarjumaysaa habka ay dowladdu u maamusho kheyraadkeeda diblomaasiyadeed iyo sida ay u kala mudnaanta siiso dalalka ay xiriirka la leedahay. Maxaa ka dhalan kara joogitaanka diblomaasiyadeed? Safiir aan Muqdisho deggenayn wuxuu awood u leeyahay inuu si rasmi ah u metelo dalkiisa, balse joogitaan la’aanta magaalada waxay xaddidi kartaa xiriirka joogtada ah ee maalinlaha ah. Safaarad joogto ah waxay si toos ah ula falgeli kartaa wasaaradaha, hay’adaha dowladda, ganacsatada iyo bulshada rayidka ah. Tani waxay Soomaaliya ka dhigaysaa inay dan gaar ah ka yeelato soo jiidashada dalal badan oo doonaya inay safaarado ka furtaan Muqdisho. Haddii xaaladda amni iyo tan dhaqaale ay sii hagaagaan, waxaa suuragal ah in qaar ka mid ah safaaradaha ku shaqeeya qaabka aan deggenayn ay mustaqbalka dib ugu soo laabtaan Muqdisho. Arrintaas ayaa muhiim u noqon karta Soomaaliya, maadaama safaaraduhu aysan ahayn oo keliya xafiisyo siyaasadeed. Waxay sidoo kale noqdaan xarumo fududeeya ganacsiga, maalgashiga, deeqaha, waxbarashada iyo xiriirka shacabka. Si kastaba, in toddobo safiir hal mar waraaqahooda aqoonsiga looga guddoomo Muqdisho waxay sidoo kale muujinaysaa in caasimadda Soomaaliya ay weli tahay xarunta rasmiga ah ee xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee dalka. Xitaa safiirrada aan dalka deggenayn waxaa waajib ku ah inay aqoonsigooda u gudbiyaan madaxda dowladda Soomaaliya. Tani waxay muhiim u tahay muuqaalka dowladda federaalka ee caalamka. Safiirku marka uu waraaqaha aqoonsiga u gudbinayo Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya wuxuu si rasmi ah ula macaamilayaa dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, dowladda Soomaaliya waa inay fursaddan uga faa’iideysataa xiriirro wax-ku-ool ah oo ka baxsan xafladaha diblomaasiyadda. Waraaqaha aqoonsigu waa bilow, halka qiimaha dhabta ah ee xiriirku uu ku xirnaan doono waxa labada dhinac ka qabtaan kadib. Xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo loo baahan yahay in la dhaqaajiyo Brazil, Hindiya, Mali, Myanmar, Nigeria iyo Pakistan waa dalal leh awood, khibrad iyo xiriirro caalami ah oo Soomaaliya wax uga tari kara dhinacyo kala duwan. Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay inay xiriirradaas u beddesho iskaashi la taaban karo. Hindiya waxay leedahay khibrad dhinacyada waxbarashada, caafimaadka, tiknoolajiyadda iyo ganacsiga. Brazil waxay Soomaaliya la yeelan kartaa iskaashi ku saabsan beeraha, wax-soo-saarka iyo khibradaha horumarineed. Pakistan-na waxay horey uga muuqataa dhinaca iskaashiga difaaca iyo tababarka ciidamada. Sidoo kale, Nigeria, Mali iyo Myanmar waxay noqon karaan dhinacyo Soomaaliya kala shaqeyn kara arrimo kala duwan oo ku xiran danaha labada dal. Sidaas darteed, safiirro badan oo loo aqoonsado Soomaaliya waxay noqon karaan fursad diblomaasiyadeed oo la adeegsan karo, haddii dowladda ay si qorsheysan u dhaqaajiso xiriirradaas. Ugu dambeyn, in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu waraaqaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay safiirro aan badankood Soomaaliya ku lahayn safaarado joogto ah waxay muujinaysaa laba xaqiiqo. Midda koowaad waa in Soomaaliya weli leedahay xiriir diblomaasiyadeed oo ballaaran; tan labaadna waa in joogitaanka diblomaasiyadeed ee Muqdisho uusan weli la jaanqaadin tirada xiriirrada rasmiga ah ee dalka. Aljeeriya oo waddo dib-u-furista safaaraddeeda waxay noqon kartaa tusaale muujinaya jihada mustaqbalka. Haddii amniga, siyaasadda iyo jawiga maalgashiga ay sii hagaagaan, dalal kale ayaa laga yaabaa inay dib u qiimeeyaan joogitaankooda Muqdisho. Sidaas darteed, xafladda shalay ma ahayn oo keliya in Madaxweynaha loo gudbiyo waraaqo aqoonsi, waxay ahayd sawir muujinaya sida Soomaaliya loogu soo laabanayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed ee gobolka iyo dunida, iyadoo weli ay taagan tahay su’aasha ah goorta safiirrada badan ee la aqoonsaday ay Muqdisho ka dhigan doonaan xarunta joogtada ah ee shaqadooda. Haddii xiriirradaas loo beddelo safaarado, maalgashi iyo iskaashi muuqda, Soomaaliya waxay ka faa’iideysan kartaa furitaanka cusub ee diblomaasiyadeed ee hadda muuqda. items.title: From Forest to Fuel: The Environmental Cost of Somalia’s Charcoal Trade
items.description: By Abdiqani Haji Abdi Somalia’s charcoal trade remains a major driver of deforestation and environmental degradation, as large numbers of trees are cut to meet domestic and commercial demand for charcoal. The destruction of forests is accelerating land degradation, increasing vulnerability to drought and climate shocks, and undermining the livelihoods of communities that depend on healthy ecosystems. Despite efforts to curb the trade, weak enforcement and continued demand have allowed the charcoal economy to persist, raising urgent questions about how Somalia can balance energy needs with the protection of its rapidly diminishing natural resources. Several vehicles transporting charcoal have reportedly been set on fire recently near the settlement of Warmaxan along the road linking Wanlaweyn and Afgooye, highlighting a growing and increasingly dangerous struggle over Somalia’s charcoal trade and the rapid destruction of the country’s remaining forests. The incident comes amid mounting concern over the large-scale cutting of trees across parts of Lower Shabelle, where charcoal producers and timber traders are reportedly clearing forests at an accelerating rate. Trees are being cut not only to produce charcoal but also to supply construction timber to markets in Mogadishu and elsewhere. Local sources say the trade has become increasingly organized, with trees felled in large quantities before the wood is divided between charcoal production and construction materials. What was once a small-scale survival activity has increasingly evolved into a lucrative commercial enterprise—with potentially devastating consequences for Somalia’s already fragile environment. A Forest Crisis Hiding in Plain Sight Somalia has suffered decades of environmental degradation caused by drought, desertification, conflict, displacement and weak natural-resource management. Charcoal trade The country’s forests and rangelands are not merely sources of fuel and timber. They provide protection against soil erosion, support livestock production, help retain moisture and contribute to the ecological balance on which rural communities depend. Yet across parts of Lower Shabelle, residents say trees are disappearing at an alarming rate. Every truckload of charcoal represents more than a commercial commodity. Behind it are trees that may have taken years to grow but can be destroyed within minutes. The consequences are long-term. Deforestation can accelerate soil degradation, reduce pasture, increase exposure to drought and contribute to the loss of agricultural productivity. For communities already struggling with climate shocks and insecurity, environmental destruction can further undermine livelihoods. Who Is Benefiting? The charcoal trade has also generated serious allegations of corruption and political protection. Residents, environmental activists and other observers have repeatedly alleged that individuals with connections to influential Federal Government officials are involved in, or benefit financially from, the charcoal and timber business. Some of these allegations have circulated extensively on Somali social media, where individuals and networks alleged to be connected to the trade have been publicly identified. However, claims of direct involvement by senior government officials require independent investigation and documentary evidence before they can be treated as established facts. The persistence of such allegations nevertheless raises a fundamental question: How can a large and visible trade continue along major transportation routes without some degree of protection, tolerance or corruption within the enforcement system? That question deserves a serious answer from the authorities. Many are also asking – where are the environmental institutions? The apparent weakness of environmental enforcement is particularly troubling because Somalia has government institutions whose responsibilities include protecting forests, rangelands, agriculture and natural resources. Yet residents in affected areas say they rarely see effective government intervention against large-scale tree cutting. The ministries responsible for livestock, forestry, rangelands and agriculture have an important role in protecting Somalia’s natural environment. But without adequate resources, personnel, monitoring systems and political authority, environmental laws can exist largely on paper. That creates a dangerous vacuum. And wherever state institutions fail to enforce the law, someone else eventually fills the space. Al-Shabaab Steps into the Vacuum Al-Shabaab, which maintains significant influence in parts of Lower Shabelle, has increasingly targeted charcoal production and transportation. The group has attacked charcoal trucks and burned vehicles involved in the trade, presenting its campaign as an effort to stop environmental destruction. The irony is difficult to ignore. An armed organization that rejects the authority of the Somali state has effectively positioned itself as an enforcer of environmental rules in areas where legitimate government institutions have struggled to do so. But Al-Shabaab’s methods are hardly an environmental solution. Destroying vehicles, threatening traders and using violence to impose regulations cannot substitute for functioning environmental governance. At the same time, the group’s ability to intervene demonstrates how profoundly the absence of effective state institutions has distorted the relationship between security, commerce and natural-resource management. The lesson is stark: when government disappears from the enforcement landscape, armed groups can impose their own rules. The Checkpoint Question The movement of charcoal toward Mogadishu also raises questions about the security checkpoints along the Afgooye corridor. Sources familiar with the trade allege that charcoal trucks are allowed to pass through checkpoints after making payments to security personnel. Such practices would suggest that corruption is helping sustain a trade that is environmentally destructive and potentially subject to government restrictions. The issue deserves investigation. The Afgooye–Wanlaweyn corridor is an important transportation route connecting communities in Lower Shabelle with Mogadishu. If large numbers of charcoal and timber trucks are moving along these roads, it is reasonable to ask how they are passing through security and administrative controls. Who authorizes them? Who inspects their cargo? Who collects the money? And where does that money ultimately go? These questions cannot simply be dismissed as political accusations. They concern the protection of Somalia’s natural resources and the integrity of public institutions. Burning Trucks Are a Symptom, Not a Solution- The destruction of charcoal trucks may stop individual shipments, but it does not solve the underlying problem. The people cutting trees are responding to economic incentives. The traders are responding to demand. The transporters are responding to profit. And communities facing poverty may have few alternatives to participating in the charcoal economy. That means the solution cannot depend solely on military action or the destruction of vehicles. Somalia needs a broader strategy combining environmental enforcement, alternative livelihoods, sustainable energy options, community-based forest management and stronger regulation of commercial timber and charcoal markets. Without those measures, the cycle will continue. A National Crisis Demanding Accountability The Federal Government’s silence over the latest incident is increasingly difficult to overlook. The authorities have yet to provide a comprehensive public explanation regarding the burning of the charcoal vehicles near Warmaxan, the allegations surrounding corruption in the trade, or the broader destruction of forests in Lower Shabelle. If the government genuinely intends to protect Somalia’s environment, it must demonstrate that commitment through action. That means investigating credible allegations of corruption, strengthening environmental agencies, monitoring transportation corridors, prosecuting illegal deforestation and ensuring that local communities have alternatives to environmentally destructive livelihoods. It also means confronting those who profit from the destruction of Somalia’s natural resources—regardless of their political connections. The burning trucks near Warmaxan may appear at first glance to be another security incident on a dangerous road. But the smoke rising from those vehicles represents something much larger. It is the smoke of a country watching its forests disappear while the institutions responsible for protecting them struggle to enforce even the most basic environmental rules. Somalia cannot afford to lose its forests while simultaneously losing the institutional capacity required to protect them. The charcoal trade is therefore not merely an environmental issue. It is a question of governance, corruption, security, poverty and the future survival of communities already living on the front lines of climate change . If the state does not act, Somalia risks reaching a point where there will be fewer forests left to protect—and fewer institutions capable of protecting them. The charcoal trade has also generated serious allegations of corruption and political protection. Residents, environmental activists and other observers have repeatedly alleged that individuals with connections to influential Federal Government officials are involved in, or benefit financially from, the charcoal and timber business. Some of these allegations have circulated extensively on Somali social media, where individuals and networks alleged to be connected to the trade have been publicly identified. However, claims of direct involvement by senior government officials require independent investigation and documentary evidence before they can be treated as established facts. The persistence of such allegations nevertheless raises a fundamental question: How can a large and visible trade continue along major transportation routes without some degree of protection, tolerance or corruption within the enforcement system? That question deserves a serious answer from the authorities. Many are also asking – where are the environmental institutions? The apparent weakness of environmental enforcement is particularly troubling because Somalia has government institutions whose responsibilities include protecting forests, rangelands, agriculture and natural resources. Yet residents in affected areas say they rarely see effective government intervention against large-scale tree cutting. The ministries responsible for livestock, forestry, rangelands and agriculture have an important role in protecting Somalia’s natural environment. But without adequate resources, personnel, monitoring systems and political authority, environmental laws can exist largely on paper. That creates a dangerous vacuum. And wherever state institutions fail to enforce the law, someone else eventually fills the space. Al-Shabaab Steps into the Vacuum Al-Shabaab, which maintains significant influence in parts of Lower Shabelle, has increasingly targeted charcoal production and transportation. The group has attacked charcoal trucks and burned vehicles involved in the trade, presenting its campaign as an effort to stop environmental destruction. The irony is difficult to ignore. An armed organization that rejects the authority of the Somali state has effectively positioned itself as an enforcer of environmental rules in areas where legitimate government institutions have struggled to do so. But Al-Shabaab’s methods are hardly an environmental solution. Destroying vehicles, threatening traders and using violence to impose regulations cannot substitute for functioning environmental governance. At the same time, the group’s ability to intervene demonstrates how profoundly the absence of effective state institutions has distorted the relationship between security, commerce and natural-resource management. The lesson is stark: when government disappears from the enforcement landscape, armed groups can impose their own rules. The Checkpoint Question The movement of charcoal toward Mogadishu also raises questions about the security checkpoints along the Afgooye corridor. Sources familiar with the trade allege that charcoal trucks are allowed to pass through checkpoints after making payments to security personnel. Such practices would suggest that corruption is helping sustain a trade that is environmentally destructive and potentially subject to government restrictions. The issue deserves investigation. The Afgooye–Wanlaweyn corridor is an important transportation route connecting communities in Lower Shabelle with Mogadishu. If large numbers of charcoal and timber trucks are moving along these roads, it is reasonable to ask how they are passing through security and administrative controls. Who authorizes them? Who inspects their cargo? Who collects the money? And where does that money ultimately go? These questions cannot simply be dismissed as political accusations. They concern the protection of Somalia’s natural resources and the integrity of public institutions. Burning Trucks Are a Symptom, Not a Solution- The destruction of charcoal trucks may stop individual shipments, but it does not solve the underlying problem. The people cutting trees are responding to economic incentives. The traders are responding to demand. The transporters are responding to profit. And communities facing poverty may have few alternatives to participating in the charcoal economy. That means the solution cannot depend solely on military action or the destruction of vehicles. Somalia needs a broader strategy combining environmental enforcement, alternative livelihoods, sustainable energy options, community-based forest management and stronger regulation of commercial timber and charcoal markets. Without those measures, the cycle will continue. A National Crisis Demanding Accountability The Federal Government’s silence over the latest incident is increasingly difficult to overlook. The authorities have yet to provide a comprehensive public explanation regarding the burning of the charcoal vehicles near Warmaxan, the allegations surrounding corruption in the trade, or the broader destruction of forests in Lower Shabelle. If the government genuinely intends to protect Somalia’s environment, it must demonstrate that commitment through action. That means investigating credible allegations of corruption, strengthening environmental agencies, monitoring transportation corridors, prosecuting illegal deforestation and ensuring that local communities have alternatives to environmentally destructive livelihoods. It also means confronting those who profit from the destruction of Somalia’s natural resources—regardless of their political connections. The burning trucks near Warmaxan may appear at first glance to be another security incident on a dangerous road. But the smoke rising from those vehicles represents something much larger. It is the smoke of a country watching its forests disappear while the institutions responsible for protecting them struggle to enforce even the most basic environmental rules. Somalia cannot afford to lose its forests while simultaneously losing the institutional capacity required to protect them. The charcoal trade is therefore not merely an environmental issue. It is a question of governance, corruption, security, poverty and the future survival of communities already living on the front lines of climate change . If the state does not act, Somalia risks reaching a point where there will be fewer forests left to protect—and fewer institutions capable of protecting them. items.title: Somalia ‘coming close to another famine’ amid conflict and climate shocks
items.description: Somalia is facing a worsening hunger crisis after repeated failed rainy seasons devastated crops, killed livestock and depleted water supplies. Already struggling to contain a two-decade-old insurgency by the al Shabaab militant group and stave off famine, the federal government has been facing growing armed resistance from state governments. In February, the Somali government and the United Nations said about 6.5 million people in the country faced acute hunger due to drought. It comes amid significant cuts in funding of aid agencies working in Somalia. UNICEF Global Spokesperson James Elder said the country was coming close to another famine. Speaking on RTÉ’s Today programme with Sharon Tobin, he said, “people are enduring multiple and repeated climate shocks”, as well as dealing with widespread conflict. He said hundreds of health and nutrition facilities have closed due to cuts to aid funding. “We’ve seen aids cuts that are pretty much unprecedented since the UN was founded, but I didn’t think we’d see them have the impact they’re having as quickly as they are.” He said: “The cost of war in Iran is about food and fertilizer, fuel that people need and those cuts in aid are very stark and we’re seeing the impact very, very quickly.” Mr Elder added: “The injustice in a way is staggering for people here; the climate crisis is playing a huge role.” Half a million people displaced According to the United Nations, more than half a million people were displaced in Somalia in the first three months of 2026, with drought driving virtually all of the movement. Women and children accounted for about 85% of those displaced. The crisis is reviving fears of a repeat of Somalia’s 2022 near-famine, but aid agencies say the response is being constrained by severe funding shortfalls. Funding to tackle acute malnutrition in parts of Somalia has dropped by more than 80% this year, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) has said. MSF Health Adviser Mitchell Sangma said the United States had cut its support to aid agencies in the country from $70 million last year to no funding this year, leaving aid groups struggling to respond as needs rise. Other Western donors have also cut funding. “This year we have admitted 22,000 nutrition cases, more than 80% higher than last year. When we need this massive scale-up in intervention measures, we are seeing less interest from donor support,” Mr Sangma said. MSF has said there is only about $300 million available for Somalia from donors, compared to $2.2 billion that was provided by donors in 2022 when a similar drought situation was experienced. “The world cannot wait for a famine declaration before acting,” said Allara Ali, MSF’s project coordinator in Somalia. “Action is needed now to prevent loss of lives.” RTE.

items.title: Shir looga hadlay xaaladda amni ee dalka oo Muqdisho lagu qabtay
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa shir guddoomiyay kulanka toddobaadlaha ah ee hoggaannada, qaybaha iyo fadhiyada madaxa-bannaan ee Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xaaladda amniga guud ee dalka, iyadoo saraakiisha ka qeybgalay ay warbixinno ka bixiyeen hawlgalladii amni ee ciidamada Boolisku qeybta ka ahaayeen. Saraakiishu waxay si gaar ah uga warbixiyeen guulihii laga gaaray howlgalkii lagu soo afjaray weerarkii ay K maleeshiyaad ay isbahaysteen ku qaadeen magaalada Baydhabo, kaas oo lagu sheegay inay doonayeen inay khalkhal geliyaan amniga ka jira Koonfur Galbeed. Taliyaha Booliska, Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa sidoo kale Hoggaanka Baarista Dambiyada (CID) iyo Qeybta Guud ee Gobolka Banaadir faray inay dardargeliyaan dadaallada looga hortagayo falalka ka hor imanaya anshaxa iyo dhaqanka suuban, gaar ahaan kuwa ay mararka qaar ku kacaan dhalinyaradu. Taliyaha ayaa bulshada ku bogaadiyey wada-shaqeynta ay la leeyihiin laamaha amniga iyo sida ay ula wadaagaan xogaha la xiriira falalka amni-darrada iyo kuwa bulshada waxyeellada u leh. Kulanka ayaa kusoo dhammaaday iyadoo hoggaanka Boolisku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay xoojinta amniga, la-dagaallanka falalka dembiyada iyo sii wadista wada-shaqeynta shacabka iyo laamaha amniga.

items.title: Koox hubeysan oo markab xamuul ah u soo afduubatay dhanka Soomaaliya
items.description: Koox hubeysan ayaa la wareegtay markab xamuul ah oo marayay Gacanka Cadmeed, waxaana markabka loo leexiyay dhanka Soomaaliya, sida ay xaqiijisay Hay’adda Hawlgallada Ganacsiga Badda ee UK (UKMTO). UKMTO ayaa sheegtay in markabku uu ku sugnaa qiyaastii 136 mayl-badeed oo bari ka xigta magaalada Al-Mukalla ee Yemen, xilli uu galbeed ugu safrayay Gacanka Cadmeed. Markabka ayaa markii hore diray fariin degdeg ah kadib markii ay u soo dhawaatay doon aan la aqoonsan. Warbixin dambe oo ay soo saartay UKMTO ayaa xaqiijisay in lix qof oo hubeysan ay fuuleen markabka, gacantana ku dhigeen, kadibna ay beddeleen jihadii uu ku socday, iyagoo u leexiyay dhanka Soomaaliya. Hay’adaha ammaanka ayaa haatan baaraya dhacdada. Ilaa hadda lama shaacin magaca markabka, jinsiyadda shaqaalaha saaran ama xaaladdooda, sidoo kalena ma jirto koox si rasmi ah u sheegatay mas’uuliyadda dhacdadan. UKMTO waxay maraakiibta kale ee ku safraya aagga uga digtay inay taxaddar dheeraad ah muujiyaan oo ay soo sheegaan dhaqdhaqaaq kasta oo shaki leh. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli ay dib u soo xoogeysanayaan weerarrada burcad-badeedda ee xeebaha Soomaaliya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. 17-kii Agoosto, markabkii xamuulka ahaa ee Lutuf ayaa lagu qabsaday meel u dhow xeebaha Soomaaliya, kadib markii siddeed qof oo hubeysan ay la wareegeen. Dhacdadii maanta waxay sare u qaadaysaa walaaca laga qabo amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara Gacanka Cadmeed, gaar ahaan xilli gobolka uu wajahayo xiisado amni oo ka dhashay weerarrada Xuutiyiinta Yemen iyo khilaafaadka ka taagan Bariga Dhexe. Ilaa hadda, lama xaqiijin in kooxda markabka qabsatay ay yihiin burcad-badeed Soomaali ah ama koox kale. Baaritaanka hay’adaha amniga ayaa socda.

items.title: Somalia ex-FM accuses Turkey of Puntland ‘massacre’
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s former Foreign Affairs Minister, Abdisaed Muse Ali, accused Turkey on Thursday of carrying out a “massacre” of Somali nationals on Puntland’s coast, escalating a row over a drone strike that killed four suspected pirates near Garmaal, in the northeastern region’s Nugaal area. “The massacre of Somali citizens on Puntland’s coast is a brutal act of aggression that the Turkish government has injected into Somalia’s politics,” Ali said in a post on X. He reserved further criticism for Puntland’s own leadership, saying regional authorities had failed to publicly address the deaths in Garmaal. “What troubles me even more is that Puntland’s current leadership sits in office yet has never once spoken about the youth massacred in Garmaal,” he added. Daily Somalia and other local outlets reported on Tuesday that the four dead men were suspected pirates believed to have taken part in the hijacking of the cargo vessel Lutuf a day earlier, and had taken a small boat toward the shore to gather supplies when they were struck. That account has since been challenged. Residents in the area now say the four were innocent fishermen killed in cold blood, with no connection to the Lutuf hijacking or any act of piracy. Puntland’s regional administration has issued no official statement either confirming the men’s involvement in piracy or clarifying whether those killed were civilians, leaving the competing accounts unresolved. Turkey has not responded to the accusation that it carried out the strike or that it killed civilians. Ankara has a longstanding practice of not publicly discussing its airstrikes in Somalia and has never claimed responsibility for individual strikes, maintaining silence even in cases where its drones are reported to have killed dozens of civilians. Anger over civilian casualties from Turkish airstrikes has been building in Somalia. Days before the Garmaal strike, footage circulated on social media showing residents burning a Turkish flag in protest, accusing Ankara’s strikes of killing livestock and rural herders in Southwest State. Turkey has not responded to that incident either, continuing a pattern of silence on strikes local communities describe as deadly. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Masar oo Itoobiya Digniin Adag Ka Soo Saartay Biyo-xireennada Nile
items.description: Qaahira (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Masar ayaa digniin adag ka soo saartay qorshayaasha Itoobiya ay ku dhisayso biyo-xireenno dheeraad ah oo laga sameeyo Webiga Nile, gaar ahaan qaybta Buluugga ah ee Nile. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar, Badr Abdelatty, ayaa sheegay in dalkiisu uu difaacan doono xuquuqdiisa biyaha Nile, isla markaana uusan oggolaan doonin tallaabooyin uu sheegay inay halis gelin karaan saamiga biyaha ee Masar. Masar iyo Itoobiya ayaa muddo dheer isku khilaafsanaa Biyo-xireenka Weyn ee Renaissance-ka Itoobiya (GERD), oo Itoobiya ay ka dhistay Webiga Buluugga ah ee Nile. Qaahira ayaa horey uga soo saartay digniino iyo walaac ku saabsan biyo-xireenka, iyadoo ku doodaysa in mashruucu saameyn ku yeelan karo biyaha ay Masar ku tiirsan tahay. Itoobiya dhankeeda waxay sheegtay in biyo-xireenku muhiim u yahay koronto-soo-saarka iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha dalka, isla markaana uusan loogu talagelin in lagu waxyeelleeyo dalalka hoose ee Webiga Nile. Xiisadda cusub ayaa kusoo beegmaysa iyadoo Masar iyo Itoobiya ay weli isku khilaafsan yihiin habka loo maareynayo biyaha Nile iyo biyo-xireennada Itoobiya, taasoo arrinta ka dhigaysa mid xasaasi ah oo saameyn ku leh xiriirka labada dal. items.title: DEG-DEG: Doorashada Hirshabeelle oo Dib u Dhacday
items.description: Jowhar (Raxanreeb Online): Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha (GMDQS) ayaa ku dhawaaqay in dib loo dhigay doorashada Golaha Wakiillada Hirshabeelle, taas oo markii hore qorshuhu ahaa in la qabto 20-ka Agoosto 2026. Sida ku cad warqad uu guddigu soo saaray 19-ka Agoosto 2026, dib-u-dhaca ayaa yimid kaddib markii guddigu qiimeeyay xaaladda diyaar-garowga doorashada iyo arrimaha la xiriira hirgelinta doorashooyinka. Guddigu wuxuu sheegay in dib-u-dhaca ay sabab u yihiin qodobo ay kamid yihiin: Diyaargarowga cod-bixiyeyaasha oo weli ka socda afar degmo oo ka tirsan Gobolka Hiiraan. In loo baahan yahay waqti dheeraad ah oo lagu wacyigeliyo laguna tababaro qaybaha kala duwan ee doorashada. In loo baahan yahay waqti dheeraad ah oo lagu soo gudbiyo liisaska musharraxiinta doorashada. Guddiga ayaa sheegay in dhammaan daneeyayaasha doorashooyinka Hirshabeelle ay heli doonaan waqti dheeraad ah si loo dhammeystiro howlaha ka harsan doorashada. Ilaa hadda guddigu ma shaacin taariikh cusub oo rasmi ah oo loo asteeyay qabashada doorashada Golaha Wakiillada Hirshabeelle. items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Dowladda Pakistan ayaa sii wada wada-hadallada ku saabsan iskaashiga difaaca, heshiisyada milatari iyo kordhinta awoodda Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliya. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga XFS, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Safiirka Pakistan u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Marwo Aqsa Nawaz, iyadoo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca ee labada dal. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale looga hadlay hirgelinta is-afgaradyada labada dhinac iyo dardargelinta wada-shaqeynta ku saabsan tababarka, tayeynta iyo dhismaha awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Labada dhinac ayaa si gaar ah uga wada hadlay horumarinta Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo sidoo kale la isla eegay ballaarinta iskaashiga amniga iyo la-dagaallanka argagixisada, iyadoo lagu saleynayo danaha wadajirka ah iyo is-ixtiraamka labada dal. Kulanka waxaa goob joog ka ahaa Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji, iyo U-qeybsanaha Arrimaha Difaaca ee Safaaradda Pakistan, Korneyl Maxamed Inam Khattak. Wada-hadalladan ayaa muujinaya in Soomaaliya ay raadineyso in ay sii xoojiso awoodda iyo tayada Ciidanka Cirka, iyadoo Pakistan ay kamid tahay dalalka ay Soomaaliya kala shaqeynayso dhinacyada tababarka, qalabaynta iyo dhismaha awoodda ciidanka. items.title: DEGDEG: Madaxa Sirdoonka Ecuador iyo 6 Qof oo Kale oo Ku Dhintay Shil Diyaaradeed oo Kenya Ka Dhacay+SAWIRO
items.description: Kenya (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxa Xarunta Sirdoonka Qaranka Ecuador, Michele Sensi-Contugi Ycaza, ayaa ku geeriyooday shil diyaaradeed oo ka dhacay gobolka Samburu ee waqooyiga Kenya. Shilka ayaa dhacay 19-kii Agoosto 2026, kaddib markii diyaarad nooca helicopter-ka ah ay ku burburtay deegaanka u dhow Mount Ololokwe, xilli ay ku guda jirtay safar dalxiis. Wararka la xaqiijiyay ayaa sheegaya in diyaaradda ay saarnaayeen 7 qof, oo ay ku jiraan lix rakaab ah iyo duuliyihii. Dhammaantood ayaa ku geeriyooday shilka. Michele Sensi-Contugi, oo ahaa madaxa sirdoonka Ecuador, ayaa safarka ku weheliyay xaaskiisa Stephany Hollihan, iyadoo sidoo kale diyaaradda saarnaayeen muwaadiniin Mareykan ah. Diyaaradda ayaa ahayd Eurocopter EC130 B4, waxaana maamuleysay shirkadda Lady Lori Helicopters. Waxay ka duushay deegaanka Loisaba, iyadoo ku wajahneyd aagga webiga Ewaso Nyiro markii shilku dhacay. Sababta rasmiga ah ee keentay shilka weli lama xaqiijin, waxaana socda baaritaan ay wadaan hay’adaha duulista iyo ammaanka Kenya. items.title: Successful Somalia drought response protects livelihoods and food sources for pastoral families
items.description: Successful Somalia drought response protects livelihoods and food sources for pastoral families On World Humanitarian Day (19 Aug) we celebrate together with Abdisalan Salah, a pastoralist and a beneficiary of the FAO’s recent drought response project that successfully protected livelihoods for pastoral families. May 2026. Erigavo, Sanaag. Camels, the most prized livestock among Somali pastoralists, become increasingly vulnerable to disease during droughts as dwindling pasture weakens their bodies and immunity. In Somaliland’s eastern Sanaag region, livestock represent livelihood, food, and financial security for pastoral families. For 42-year-old Abdisalan Salah, the drought sweeping across the country since 2025 has put all three at risk. “My family consists of eight people, and our livelihood depends entirely on livestock,” Abdisalan says. Like many pastoralists in the area, he keeps a mixed herd of camels, cattle, goats, and sheep; but when consecutive rainy seasons failed to deliver adequate rainfall, life became increasingly difficult. “The drought has had a serious impact on our household,” he recalls. “Meat and milk production have both declined, putting our family’s livelihood into crisis.” Equally damaging effects have been felt throughout Abdisalan’s community as water sources have dried up, grazing land has shrunk, and livestock has become weakened from hunger and thirst. As animals gather around the few remaining areas with pasture and water, the risk of disease increases. “We did not receive enough rainfall during either the Deyr or the Gu seasons,” says Abdisalan. “Rain fell only in isolated areas, causing people and livestock to gather there. As a result, diseases were more likely to spread.” The worsening conditions forced some families to leave in search of better livestock grazing. Abdisalan was among them. “At one point, I moved about 20 kilometres away,” he says. The journey offered little relief. His animals continued to lose weight, milk production stopped for some, and disease rates intensified. “Some animals became thin and weak, some fell sick, and others died,” he says. “Because they suffered from hunger, their immune systems weakened, making them more vulnerable to disease. May 2026. Erigavo, Sanaag. Abdillahi Abdi Eid and his team of Ministry of Livestock veterinarians treat animals suffering from parasites, malnutrition, injuries, and pneumonia in this campaign. ©FAO/Abdillahi Hassan Jama But as the crisis peaked, support arrived thanks to a partnership between FAO and the Somaliland Ministry of Livestock and Rural Development (MoLRD), with funding from the United Nations Central Emergency Response Fund. Over six weeks, veterinary teams treated nearly 230,000 animals belonging to nearly 3,000 households in Erigabo district. “At first, we could not tell whether the animals were simply suffering from the effects of the drought or whether they were sick,” Abdisalan explains. “But the results were quickly visible after they received treatment. “We have observed a significant improvement in the overall health and productivity of our animals. “Consequently, milk production has increased, enhancing household food security and nutrition. This has contributed to better health and well-being for our families while also strengthening our livelihoods through improved livestock performance.” May 2026. Erigabo, Sanaag. A veterinarian from Somaliland’s Ministry of Livestock and Rural Development injects a sick goat. Before administering treatment, veterinarians interview livestock owners and examine animals to assess their health needs. ©FAO/Abdillahi Hassan Jama. Abdisalan’s family borrowed money to keep them afloat during this exacting period before receiving cash assistance from FAO alongside the veterinary assistance they received. “We are very grateful to FAO for this support,” he says. “They came to us during a very difficult time and provided cash assistance when we needed it most.” The family has now been able to meet urgent needs but also to protect their future. “We used it to buy water and food, repay some family debts, and pay school fees,” Abdisalan said. Today, conditions remain challenging, but there are signs of recovery. Recent rainfall has brought renewed optimism, and communities are taking steps to prepare for future droughts. “We are producing and storing hay and other animal fodder for future use,” says Abdisalan. “We are also planning to build water catchments so we can harvest and store rainwater during the rainy season.” These efforts, combined with continued support and improved livestock health, are helping families rebuild their resilience. Standing beside his recovering herd, Abdisalan reflects on the difficult months behind him and the hopes he now holds for the future. “We are optimistic,” he says. “We have received some rainfall. Although it has not been much, it gives us hope. Our hopes for the future are high.” May 2026. Abdisalan Salah at his sheep’s enclosure in Erigavo district in Sanaag which is renowned as Somaliland’s leading sheep-producing region. ©FAO/Abdillahi Hassan Jama

items.title: Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada oo maanta lagu soo bandhigay in is-beddel weyn uu ku yimid…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) — Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Soomaaliya oo maanta yeeshay kulankoodii toddobaadlaha ahaa, ayaa lagu soo bandhigay warbixinno kala duwan oo la xiriira dhaqaalaha, amniga iyo difaaca dalka, iyadoo uu guddoomiyay Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre. Inta uu socday kulanka Golaha ayaa waxaa lagu soo bandhigay warbixin ku saabsan amniga dalka , taas oo muujisay isbeddel togan oo laga sameeyay sugidda amniga iyo howlgalladii ugu dambeeyay ee ay fuliyeen ciidamada qalabka sida ee Qaranka Soomaaliyeed, kuwaasi oo horumar la taaban karo ka sameeyay goobaha la dagaalka, isla markaana jab xooggan gaarsiiyey Khawaarijta. Sidoo kale, Golaha ayaa warbixin dhammaystiran ka dhagaystay Wasaaradda Maaliyadda, taasi oo ku saabsan Xisaab-xirka sanadeedka 2025, iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha dalka, canshuuraha gudaha iyo dib-u-habeynta Maaliyadeed ee dowladda Soomaaliya. Warbixinta wasaaradda ayaa lagu sheegay in uu kordhay dhaqaalaha dalka boqolkiiba 3.1% gaar ahaan hal-beegga GDP-ga ee lagu qiyaaso dakhliga guud ee dalka soo gala. Intaas kadib Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza oo warbixinta kadib golaha hadal kooban u jeediyay ayaa sheegay sida ay muhiim u tahay in dadka Soomaaliyeed ay gaaraan isku filnaansho dhaqaale, ka faa’ideysiga wax-soo-saarka dalka, khayraadka kale, kordhinta dakhli-uruurinta gudaha, dhiirrgalinta maalgashiga, xoojiyo daah-furnaanta dhaqaale iyo isla-xisaabtanka, iyo waliba beekhaaminta raasumaalka. Xamza ayaa sidoo kale Wasaaradda ku ammaanay qiimeyntii uu ku sameeyay Xafiiska Hanti-Dhawrka Guud oo markii ugu horreeysay maamulka maaliyadda dowladda siisay qiimeynta lagu magacaabo Aragti Nadiif ah oo ah tan ugu sarreysa oo ka tarjumeysa hufnaan. Ugu dambeyn, Ra’iisul wasaaraha ayaa xusay in arrimaha dhaqaalaha dalka uu si weyn uga soo kabanayo isla markaana uu gaari doono isku filnaan dhaqaale oo lagaga maarmi doono kaalmo shisheeye, taasi oo tarjumaysa adkeysiga bulshada Soomaliyeed.
