items.title: Taliye sare iyo ciidankiisa oo ka goostay Somaliland kuna biiray maamulka Waqooyi Bari
items.description: Ceerigaabo (Caasimada Online) – Sarkaal sare oo ka tirsanaa ciidamada Somaliland ayaa Arbacadii isaga baxay ciidanka maamulkaas, isaga oo ku biiray ciidamada Dowlad-goboleedka Waqooyi Bari ee Soomaaliya, xilli uu sii xoogeysanayo loollanka loogu jiro gacan-ku-haynta deegaanno ka tirsan gobolka Sanaag. Gaashaanle Sare Cali Axmed Ismaaciil, oo loo yaqaan Ashkato, kana ahaa taliyaha ciidamada Somaliland ee deegaanka Yubbe, ayaa isaga iyo askar la socotay gaaray degmada Fiqi-Fuliye, halkaas oo lagu soo dhaweeyay xarunta Taliska Qeybta 12-aad ee ciidamada Daraawiishta Waqooyi Bari. Mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan maamulka Waqooyi Bari ayaa xaqiijiyay ku biirista sarkaalkan, iyaga oo sheegay inuu horey ula soo xiriiray mas’uuliyiin iyo wasiirro ka tirsan maamulka, kahor inta uusan go’aansan inuu ka baxo ciidamada Somaliland. Cali Ashkato oo ka hadlay sababta keentay go’aankiisa ayaa sheegay inuu tixgeliyay aragtida bulshada uu kasoo jeedo iyo mowqifka ay dhawaan qaateen madax-dhaqameedka deegaankiisa, kuwaas oo taageero u muujiyay maamulka Waqooyi Bari. Waxa uu sheegay in wada-hadallo uu la yeeshay mas’uuliyiinta maamulka ay ugu dambeyn horseedeen inuu si rasmi ah ugu biiro ciidamada Daraawiishta. Xog aan helnay ayaa sheegeysa in sarkaalka uu Fiqi-Fuliye la gaaray gaari ciidan oo qori culus ku rakiban yahay iyo ku dhowaad 10 askari oo ku hubeysan hubka fudud, hase yeeshee xogtaas si madax-bannaan looma xaqiijin. Goosashada Ashkato ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli gobolka Sanaag uu noqday mid ka mid ah meelaha ugu waaweyn ee uu ka socdo loollanka siyaasadeed iyo midka ciidan ee u dhexeeya Somaliland iyo maamulka cusub ee Waqooyi Bari. Maamulka Waqooyi Bari ayaa ka dhashay maamulkii SSC-Khaatumo, oo awooddeeda siyaasadeed iyo ciidan si weyn u korortay kadib dagaalkii Laascaanood ee 2023, kaas oo ciidamada Somaliland looga saaray magaalada Laascaanood iyo inta badan bariga gobolka Sool. items.title: Sidee looga fal-celiyay dib u dhaca doorashada HirShabelle?
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Fal-celin aan caadi ahayn ayaa ka dhalatay dib u dhaca ku yimid jadwalka doorashada Maamul-goboleedka HirShabelle, kadib markii uu guddiga doorashooyinka shaaciyay in muddo kooban dib loo dhigay waqtiga doorashada. Guddiga ayaa ku wargeliyay dhammaan daneeyayaasha doorashada iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed in doorashada isku-sidkan ee Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golayaasha Deegaanka ee Dowlad-goboleedka HirShabelle lagu sameeyay dib-u-dhac kooban, si loo dhammaystiro hawlaha muhiimka u ah doorashooyinkaas oo markii hore loo qorsheeyay inay qabsoomaan 20-ka bishan August ee 2026. Warqad kasoo baxday Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa lagu shaaciyay sababaha dib loogu dhigay doorashada HirShabelle, iyada oo lagu soo koobay saddex qodob oo xasaasi ah, kuwaas oo kala ah;- 1. Diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaasha oo weli ka socota afar degmo oo ka tirsan Gobolka Hiiraan. 2. In urrurada siyaasadda loo baahan yahay in la siiyo fursad ay taageerayaashooda ku abaabulaan, si ay si wax-ku-ool ah uga qayb galaan hawlaha doorashooyinka. 3. In urrurada siyaasadda fursad loo siiyo soo gudbinta liisaska musharraxiinta doorashada. Haddaba sidee looga fal-celiyay dib u dhaca doorashada HirShabelle?. Yuusuf Jimcaale: “Horay ayaa u sheegay in doorashada golaha deegaanka iyo golaha wakiilada HirShabelle waqtiga aad qabateen aysan ku dhacaynin”. Aways Yare: “Aaway doorashadii Galmudug ee guddoonka Baarlamaanka iyo tii Madaxtooyadii, tan HirShabelle hanoo dambeysee*. Maxamuud Goode: “War been baad sheegeysiin wax diiwaangelin ah oo socoto ma jirto”. Cabdicasiis Guure: “Degmooyinka aadka loogu diyaar garoobayo jadwalkan adib u dhigay waxaa ka mid ah degmooyinka Farlibaax iyo Beledweyne oo shacabka ku nool ay haatan fahmeen una soo wada jeesteen inay kaararka doorashada wada qaataan”. Cumar Bayle: “Qof aan miyir qabin miyaa waxaan soo qoray? halkee doorasho joogtaa timirtii horaa dab loo waayay maqli jiray”. Cabdiwahaab Faragaab: “Maxaad dib ugu dhigaysaan awalba kululeysadiina wadateene maa one day is dhaafisaan!”. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan oo tallaabo cusub u qaaday iskaashiga difaaca + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Soomaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa Arbacadii kulan gaar ah la yeeshay Safiirka Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Pakistan u fadhiya magaalada Muqdisho, Marwo Aqsa Nawaz, isaga oo kala hadlay arrimo ku aadan xoojinta xiriirka labada dal. Fiqi iyo Marwo Aqsa Nawaz ayaa kulankooda si gaar ah diiradda ugu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan, hirgelinta Is-afgaradka labada dal, iyo sidii loo dardargelin lahaa wada-shaqeynta dhinacyada tababarka, tayeynta iyo dhismaha awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada-hadlay horumarinta Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed iyo ballaarinta iskaashiga amniga iyo la-dagaallanka argagixisada, iyadoo lagu saleynayo danaha wadajirka ah iyo is-ixtiraamka labada dal. Kulanka ayaa daba socda heshiis cusub oo dhanka iskaashiga difaaca ah oo ay labada dowladood wada galeen horraantii bishaan, kaas oo ay wada saxiixeen Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi, oo booqasho rasmi ah ku tegay magaalada Islamabad, halka Pakistan uu u saxiixay Wasiirka Difaaca, Mudane Khawaja Muhammad Asif. Heshiiskaas ayaa ah mid lagu xoojinayo wada shaqeynta dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, iyada oo sidoo kale lagu horumarinayo awoodda ciidamada. Is-afgaradkan ayaa dhigaya in labada dhinac ay iska kaashadaan la-dagaallanka argagixisada, tababarrada ciidamada, is-weydaarsiga khibradaha, aqoonta milatari, kobcinta awoodaha difaaca iyo xoojinta wada-shaqeynta amniga. Waxaa kale oo uu saxiixa is-afgaradka muujiyay sida ay Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan uga go’an tahay xoojinta xiriirkooda istaraatiijiyadeed iyo ballaarinta iskaashiga labada dal ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, isagoo saldhig u noqonaya wada-shaqeyn wax ku ool ah oo u adeegta danaha labada dhinac. Si kastaba, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa horay sidaan oo kale heshiisyo difaac ula soo gashay dalalka Turkiga, Masar iyo waddamo kale oo saaxib la ah Soomaaliya. items.title: Heavy Night Operation Destroys Al-Shabaab Weapons Stockpiles in Bay Region
items.description: BAIDOA— Regional authorities in South West State announced that security forces conducted a targeted operation and airstrike against Al-Shabaab strongholds on the outskirts of Baidoa, located in the Bay region. According to an official statement issued by the South West State Ministry of Security, local security forces executed the planned operation at approximately 10:00 PM. The strike targeted three key facilities utilized by the insurgent group, situated roughly 30 kilometers outside the regional capital. The ministry confirmed that the operation resulted in the deaths of 18 Al-Shabaab members, with numerous others wounded. The primary objective was the dismantling of strategic bases, which led to the destruction of significant stockpiles of weaponry and military equipment housed at the sites. “We are sharing with the people of Baidoa the severe blow dealt to the Al-Shabaab militia overnight,” the Ministry of Security said in a statement. Officials added that security forces remain on high alert and are continuing operations across the surrounding areas to secure the territory and prevent any attempts by the group to regain a foothold in the targeted locations. items.title: Ugu yaraan 7 qof oo ku Geeriyooday shil diyaaradeed oo ka dhacay Kenya
items.description: Ugu yaraan 7 qof ayaa ku dhintay shil diyaaradeed oo ka dhacay waqooyiga Kenya, kadib markii helicopter dalxiis ah uu ku burburay deegaanka Samburu County , iyadoo dhammaan dadkii saarnaa ay dhinteen. Shilka ayaa dhacay xilli helicopter-ku uu ku guda jiray safar dalxiis oo ku wajahnaa deegaanka Loisaba Conservancy , oo ka mid ah goobaha caanka ku ah safari-ga iyo duurjoogta Kenya. Sida ay sheegeen mas’uuliyiinta Kenya, helicopter-ka oo ahaa nooca Eurocopter EC130 B4 , ayaa xilliga shilka ka duulay Loisaba isagoo ku sii jeeday dhanka deegaanka Ewaso Nyiro ee Samburu County. Diyaaradda ayaa dhacday abaare 9:13 subaxnimo , iyadoo saarnaayeen lix rakaab ah iyo hal duuliye, waxaana la xaqiijiyay in aysan jirin cid ka badbaadday. Dadka ku dhintay shilka waxaa ku jiray Michele Sensi-Contugi , oo ahaa madaxa Xarunta Sirdoonka Qaranka Ecuador, iyo xaaskiisa Stephany Hollihan , oo iyaduna haysatay dhalashada Mareykanka iyo Ecuador. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in shan muwaadiniin Mareykan ah ay ka mid ahaayeen toddobada qof ee ku dhintay shilka. Safaaradda Mareykanka ee Kenya ayaa sheegtay inay xiriir la leedahay mas’uuliyiinta dalkaas, isla markaana ay bixinayso taageerada qunsuliyadeed ee loo baahan yahay qoysaska dhibbanayaasha. Dhibbanayaasha waxaa sidoo kale ka mid ahaa José Alberto Suárez , oo ahaa masuul sare oo ka tirsanaa shabakadda telefishinka Telemundo ee Mareykanka, iyo Roger Duarte , oo ahaa ganacsade ka soo jeeday Miami. Shilku wuxuu ka dhacay dhul buuraley ah oo adag, meel u dhow Mount Ololokwe , taasoo caqabad ku noqotay howlaha gurmadka iyo soo kabashada meydadka. Laanqeyrta Cas ee Kenya ayaa sheegtay in dadaallada lagu gaarayo goobta shilka ay adkeeyeen dhulka qallafsan iyo dab ka kacay goobta , inkastoo kooxaha gurmadka ay bilaabeen howlaha baaritaanka iyo soo kabashada. Hay’adaha duulista Kenya iyo mas’uuliyiinta kale ee ay khusayso ayaa bilaabay baaritaan lagu ogaanayo waxa sababay burburka helicopter-ka iyo xaaladdii diyaaradda ka hor inta aysan dhicin. Shilka ayaa dhacay xilli helicopter-ku uu ku guda jiray safar dalxiis oo ku wajahnaa deegaanka Loisaba Conservancy , oo ka mid ah goobaha caanka ku ah safari-ga iyo duurjoogta Kenya. Dhibbanayaasha waxaa sidoo kale ka mid ahaa José Alberto Suárez , oo ahaa masuul sare oo ka tirsanaa shabakadda telefishinka Telemundo ee Mareykanka, iyo Roger Duarte , oo ahaa ganacsade ka soo jeeday Miami. items.title: Doorashada HirShabelle oo dib u dhac uu ku yimid + Sababta
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka ayaa waxaa muddo kooban dib loogu dhigay doorashooyinka isku sidkan ee Dowlad-goboleedka Soomaaliyeed ee HirShabelle. Guddiga ayaa isaga oo gudanaya waajibaadkiisa shaqo ayaa ku wargeliyay dhammaan daneeyayaasha doorashada iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed in doorashada isku-sidkan ee Golaha Wakiillada iyo Golayaasha Deegaanka ee Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle lagu sameeyay dib-u-dhac kooban, si loo dhammeystiro hawlaha muhiimka u ah doorashooyinkaas oo markii hore loo qorsheeyay inay qabsoomaan 20-ka bishan August ee 2026. Warqadda kasoo baxday Guddiga Madaxa-bannaan ee Doorashooyinka Qaranka iyo Soohdimaha ayaa lagu shaaciyay sababaha dib loogu dhigay doorashada HirShabelle, iyada oo lagu soo koobay saddex qodob oo xasaasi ah, kuwaas oo kala ah;- 1. Diiwaangelinta cod-bixiyeyaasha oo weli ka socota afar degmo oo ka tirsan Gobolka Hiiraan. 2. In urrurada siyaasadda loo baahan yahay in la siiyo fursad ay taageerayaashooda ku abaabulaan, si ay si wax-ku-ool ah uga qayb galaan hawlaha doorashooyinka. 3. In urrurada siyaasadda fursad loo siiyo soo gudbinta liisaska musharraxiinta doorashada. Sidoo kale, warsaxaafadeedka ayaa lagu sheegay in Guddiga Doorashooyinka uu laba todobaad gudahood ku shaacin doono jadwalka cusub, kaas oo lagu caddeyn doono xilliga rasmiga ah ee ay qabsoomeyso doorashadu. “Sidaa darteed, Guddigu waxa uu ku wargelinayaa dhammaan daneeyayaasha doorashada isku-sidkan ee Dowlad-goboleedka Hirshabeelle in muddo laba todobaad gudahood ah uu ku shaacin doono jadwalka doorashada iyo xilliga ay qabsoomayso,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri bayaanka. Doorashada HirShabelle oo si weyn isha loogu hayo ayaa waxaa weli ka taagan dood culus, iyada oo ay mar kale soo laba kacleysay tabashada reer Hiiraan oo doonaya kursiga ugu sarreeya maamulka, halka Madaxweyne Cali Guudlaawe iyo kooxdiisa oo ku xiran Villa Somalia ay mar kale u ololeynayaan soo laabasho, si ay usii hoggaamiyaan Dowlad-goboleedka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa laga war sugayaa halka uu ku dambeyn doono loollanka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya dhinacyada isku haya hoggaanka iyo mustaqbalka HirShabeelle. Screenshot The post Doorashada HirShabelle oo dib u dhac uu ku yimid + Sababta appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Iiraan oo Mareykanka ku eedeysay argagixisanimo dhaqaale
items.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Iiraan ayaa si adag uga hadlay siyaasadda dhaqaale ee Mareykanka, isagoo ku eedeeyay Washington inay waddo tallaabooyin uu ku tilmaamay argagixiso dhaqaale, kuwaas oo sida uu sheegay khatar ku ah dhaqaalaha caalamka iyo madaxbannaanida dalalka. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in cadaadiska dhaqaale ee Mareykanka uusan saameyn ku yeelanayn oo keliya Iran, balse uu halis ku yahay nidaamka dhaqaalaha caalamka iyo awoodda dowladuhu u leeyihiin inay si madax-bannaan u maamulaan arrimahooda dhaqaale. Wuxuu sidoo kale dhaliilay sii wadista siyaasadaha uu ku tilmaamay kuwo fashilmay, isagoo sheegay in ku adkeysiga waddadaas ay horseedi karto guuldarrooyin hor leh isla markaana ay sii kordhin karto caro ka dhalata shacabka Iiraan. Dhanka kale, wasiirku wuxuu sheegay in waxa loogu yeero “Maalinta Guusha Dhaqaale” aysan ahayn guul dhab ah, balse uu ku tilmaamay isku day lagu doonayo in shacabka iyo caalamkaba looga jeediyo dareenka dhibaatooyinka gudaha ee ka jira Mareykanka. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli xiisadda Iiraan iyo Mareykanka ay weli aad u sarrayso, iyadoo cunaqabateynaha iyo cadaadiska dhaqaale ay muddo dheer qeyb ka ahaayeen khilaafka u dhexeeya labada dowladood.

items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan oo ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga
items.description: Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Axmed Macallin Fiqi, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Safiirka Pakistan u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Aqsa Nawaz, iyadoo kulanka diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta iskaashiga difaaca iyo amniga ee labada dal. Kulanka ayaa si gaar ah looga hadlay sidii loo dardargelin lahaa hirgelinta is-afgaradyada labada dhinac, iyadoo xoogga la saaray iskaashiga dhinacyada tababarka, tayeynta iyo dhismaha awoodda Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Sidoo kale, labada dhinac ayaa ka wada hadlay horumarinta Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed iyo sidii loo ballaarin lahaa wada-shaqeynta amniga, gaar ahaan la-dagaallanka argagixisada, iyadoo la tixgelinayo danaha wadajirka ah iyo ixtiraamka madax-bannaanida labada dal. Kulanka ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada Soomaaliya ay ku xoojinayso iskaashiga ay la leedahay dalalka saaxiibka ah ee dhinacyada difaaca iyo amniga, iyadoo la doonayo in la kordhiyo tababarka iyo tayeynta ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Waxaa kulanka goob joog ka ahaa Taliyaha Ciidanka Cirka Soomaaliyeed, Sarreeye Guuto Cabdirisaaq Maxamuud Xaaji, iyo U-qeybsanaha Arrimaha Difaaca ee Safaaradda Pakistan, Kornayl Maxamed Inam Khattak. Kulanka ayaa kusoo dhammaaday is-afgarad ku saabsan sii wadista wada-shaqeynta iyo dardargelinta qorshayaasha lagu xoojinayo xiriirka difaaca iyo amniga ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo waraaqaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay toddobo safiir oo cusub
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada Muqdisho ka guddoomay waraaqaha aqoonsiga toddobo safiir oo cusub oo dalalkooda u soo magacaabeen Soomaaliya, iyadoo tallaabadan ay qeyb ka tahay dadaallada lagu xoojinayo xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee Soomaaliya iyo dalalka caalamka. Safiirrada cusub ayaa ka kala socday Aljeeriya, Brazil, Hindiya, Mali, Myanmar, Nigeria iyo Pakistan, waxayna kala yihiin Mohamed Alim oo ah safiirka Aljeeriya, Joao Alfredo Dos Anjos oo matalaya Brazil, Dr. Adarsh Swaika oo ah safiirka Hindiya, Dr. Madou Diallo oo ka socda Mali, Aung Min Oo oo matalaya Myanmar, Danlami Ibrahim oo ah safiirka Nigeria iyo Aqsa Nawaz oo ah safiirka Pakistan. Intii ay munaasabadda ka socotay xarunta Madaxtooyada Soomaaliya, safiirradu waxay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uga warbixiyeen qorshayaashooda iyo mudnaanta ay siinayaan xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga dalalkooda iyo Soomaaliya. Madaxweynaha ayaa dhankiisa ku boorriyay safiirrada cusub inay muddada ay xilalka hayaan ka shaqeeyaan sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa xiriirka labada dhinac, gaar ahaan dhinacyada siyaasadda, ganacsiga, maalgashiga, horumarinta, amniga iyo arrimaha bulshada. Safiirrada ayaa sidoo kale Madaxweynaha soo gaarsiiyay farriimo iyo salaan ay uga sideen madaxda dalalkooda, iyagoo caddeeyay sida ay uga go’an tahay dowladahooda in la sii xoojiyo xiriirka laba geesoodka ah iyo iskaashiga ay la leeyihiin Soomaaliya. Munaasabadda ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli Soomaaliya ay waddo dadaallo lagu ballaarinayo xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga dhaqaale ee ay la leedahay dalalka Afrika, Aasiya iyo Koonfurta Ameerika. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale dooneysa inay xiriirrada caalamiga ah u beddesho iskaashi wax-ku-ool ah oo horseeda ganacsi, maalgashi, amni iyo horumar.

items.title: Haweeney 84 jir ah oo si mucjiso ah looga badbaadiyay burburka dhul gariir saddex maalmood ka hor ka dhacay Indonesia
items.description: Haweeney 84 jir ah oo curyaan ah ayaa si mucjiso ah nolol loogu helay iyadoo ku hoos jirta burburka gurigeeda, saddex maalmood kaddib dhulgariir xooggan oo ku dhuftay jasiiradda Flores iyo deegaannada ku dhow. Haweeneyda oo lagu magacaabo Paulina Pobi ayaa ku noolayd jasiirad yar oo waqooyiga ka xigta Flores, gurigeeda oo ka mid ahaa boqollaal dhisme oo ku dumay dhulgariirka, ayaa waxaa hoostiisa ku aasnayd haweeneyda kadib markii ay soo dumeen darbiyada bamboo-ga ah. Qoyskeeda ayaa markii hore u maleynayay in Paulina la badbaadiyay oo loo qaaday goob dadka barakacay lagu ururiyay, hase yeeshee, markii ay dib ugu laabteen guriga, waxay heleen iyadoo weli ku hoos jirta burburka. Mas’uul maxalli ah oo lagu magacaabo Rudolfus Riba ayaa sheegay in maadaama haweeneydu ay curyaan ahayd oo aysan awoodin inay dhaqaaqdo ama hadasho, ay qaadatay ilaa maalintii afaraad in qoyskeedu ay helaan. Riba ayaa sheegay in xaaladdeedu ay wanaagsan tahay, iyadoo aan wax dhaawac ah soo gaarin, balse ay xoogaa tabar-darnayd maadaama aysan wax cunin ama cabin muddo dhowr maalmood ah. Qoyskeeda ayaa dhacdada ku tilmaamay wax u eg mucjiso. Dhulgariirka oo cabbirkiisu ahaa 7.7 magnitude ayaa sababay dhimashada ugu yaraan 73 qof, halka in ka badan 900 qof ay ku dhaawacmeen. Ku dhowaad 60,000 qof ayaa sidoo kale ka barakacay guryahooda, sida ay sheegtay hay’adda maareynta musiibooyinka Indonesia ee BNPB. Hay’adda cilmiga dhulka iyo saadaasha Indonesia ee BMKG ayaa sheegtay in tan iyo markii dhulgariirku dhacay la diiwaangeliyay in ka badan 3,000 dhulgariir oo daba socda, kuwaas oo ugu yaraan 86 ka mid ah ay ahaayeen kuwo ay dadka deegaanka dareemi karaan. Dhanka kale, dowladda Indonesia ayaa sheegtay in tan iyo Sabtidii la gaarsiiyay dadka ay musiibadu saameysay ku dhowaad 400 tan oo gargaar ah, oo isugu jira cunto, biyo iyo dawooyin. Indonesia ayaa ka mid ah dalalka dunida sida joogtada ah ula kulma dhulgariirrada, maadaama ay ku taallo waxa loo yaqaan “Pacific Ring of Fire”, oo ah dhul ay ku badan yihiin dhaqdhaqaaqyada dhulka iyo foolkaanayaasha, kuna fidsan Japan, Koonfur-bari Aasiya iyo qaybo badan oo Badweynta Baasifigga ah.

items.title: Soomaaliya oo ka qeyb gashay Shirweynaha 7-aad ee Warbaahinta Afrika iyo Shiinaha
items.description: Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulfataax Qaasim Maxamuud, ayaa magaalada Beijing uga qeyb galay furitaanka rasmiga ah ee Shirweynaha 7-aad ee Iskaashiga Warbaahinta Afrika iyo Shiinaha. Shirweynaha waxaa ka qeyb galaya wasiirrada warfaafinta, madaxda hay’adaha warbaahinta iyo mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka kala socda dalalka Afrika iyo Shiinaha, iyadoo looga hadlayo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa iskaashiga dhinacyada warbaahinta iyo is-dhaafsiga khibradaha. Ajandaha shirweynaha ayaa si gaar ah diiradda loogu saarayaa casriyeynta hay’adaha warbaahinta, adeegsiga tiknoolajiyadda cusub, horumarinta xirfadaha shaqaalaha warbaahinta iyo is-weydaarsiga aqoonta iyo khibradaha. Wasiir Cabdulfataax Qaasim Maxamuud ayaa lagu wadaa inuu shirweynaha ka jeediyo khudbad uu kaga hadlayo horumarka warbaahinta gobolka, muhiimadda xoojinta iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Shiinaha ee dhinaca warbaahinta iyo dadaallada lagu horumarinayo awoodda hay’adaha warbaahinta Soomaaliya. Sidoo kale, inta uu ku sugan yahay magaalada Beijing, Wasiirka ayaa kulammo la yeelanaya mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda Shiinaha iyo qaar ka mid ah wasiirrada warfaafinta ee dalalka Afrika ee ka qeyb galaya shirweynaha. Kulamadaasi ayaa lagu wadaa in looga hadlo sidii loo sii xoojin lahaa wada-shaqeynta, tababarrada, horumarinta tiknoolajiyadda warbaahinta iyo is-dhaafsiga khibradaha u dhexeeya Soomaaliya, Shiinaha iyo dalalka kale ee Afrika. Shirweynaha Afrika iyo Shiinaha ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada lagu kobcinayo xiriirka labada dhinac, gaar ahaan doorka warbaahinta ee horumarinta xiriirka, is-fahamka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Afrika iyo Shiinaha.

items.title: Sacuudiga oo billaabay arrin sii xumeyneysa xiisadda kala dhaxeysa Imaaraadka Carabta
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa sare u qaaday hubinta iyo kormeerka lagu sameynayo lacagaha laga diro boqortooyada ee ku wajahan Imaaraadka Carabta, tallaabo muujinaysa in khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale ee labada dal uu galay heer cusub. Sida ay ku warrantay wakaaladda Reuters, bankiyada Sacuudiga ayaa hadda lacagaha loo dirayo Imaaraadka marinaya baaritaanno dheeraad ah oo dhinaca shuruucda iyo la-dagaallanka dambiyada maaliyadeed ah, kuwaas oo sida caadiga ah lagu dabaqo waddamada loo arko inay khatar sare ka leeyihiin dhaqdhaqaaqyada lacagaha sharci-darrada ah. Saddex qof oo arrintan si toos ah xog-ogaal ugu ah ayaa Reuters u sheegay in tallaabooyinkan, oo aan si rasmi ah loo shaacin, ay Imaaraadka geliyeen liiska in ka badan lix waddan oo gobolka ku yaalla oo hay’adaha Sacuudigu u arkaan kuwo u baahan hubin maaliyadeed oo dheeraad ah. Ganacsato dhowr ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay inay la kulmeen dhibaatooyin markii ay isku dayeen inay lacag u diraan Imaaraadka, iyadoo wareejinno lacageed oo ku baxayey lacago kala duwan ay bangiyada Sacuudigu dib u dhigeen ama dib ugu celiyeen dirayaasha iyada oo aan loo sheegin sabab cad. Bangiga Dhexe ee Sacuudiga ayaa Reuters u sheegay in aysan jirin “xayiraado toos ah oo lagu soo rogay waddamo gaar ah”, halka mas’uul ka tirsan dowladda Imaaraadka uu sheegay in Wasaaradda Dhaqaalaha ee dalkaasi aysan helin cabashooyin uga yimid shirkadaha gaarka loo leeyahay oo la xiriira dib-u-dhac aan caadi ahayn oo ku yimid wareejinta lacagaha labada dal. Hase yeeshee, warbixinta Reuters ayaa sii xoojineysa walaaca muddooyinkii dambe ka jiray ganacsatada iyo maalgashadayaasha gobolka ee ku saabsan in khilaafka u dhexeeya Riyadh iyo Abu Dhabi uu hadda si toos ah u saameynayo xiriirka ganacsi. Bishii hore, Financial Times ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in lacagaha ay bankiyada Sacuudiga u dirayaan akoonnada ku yaalla Imaaraadka, gaar ahaan kuwa shirkadaha iyo shaqsiyaadka ku leh Dubai, dib loo celinayey ama la hakinayey tan iyo bishii May. Maamule reer galbeed ah oo ka tirsan shirkad caafimaad oo fadhigeedu yahay Dubai ayaa FT u sheegay in dhowr lacagood oo ay u soo dirtay shirkad muddo dheer macaamil kala dhexeyn jiray oo Sacuudiga ku taalla ay bangiyada Sacuudigu xannibeen kadibna dib u celiyeen. Khilaaf meelo badan gaaray Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka ayaa muddo dheer ahaa laba saaxiib oo aad isugu dhow, waxaana ay iska kaashadeen arrimo badan oo siyaasadeed, amni iyo dhaqaale oo gobolka Khaliijka ah. Hase yeeshee, sannadihii ugu dambeeyay waxaa soo ifbaxayay khilaafyo sii kordhaya oo ku saabsan Yemen, siyaasadda shidaalka, saameynta gobolka iyo xiriirka ay la leeyihiin quwadaha caalamka. Xiisadda ayaa si weyn u soo shaac baxday bishii December, markii Sacuudi Carabiya ay duqeyn cirka ah ku bartilmaameedsatay shixnad qalab militari oo Imaaraadku u waday Golaha Kumeel-gaarka Koonfurta Yemen (STC), oo ah urur gooni-u-goosad ah oo Abu Dhabi taageero. Dhacdadaas kadib, taageerayaasha labada dowladood ee baraha bulshada, falanqeeyayaasha iyo qaar ka mid ah warbaahinta ayaa galay dagaal afka ah oo aan hore loogu baran xiriirka labada dal. Bishii March, Imaaraadka ayaa xannibay akoonnada X ee telefishinka Al-Arabiya ee Sacuudiga, taas oo noqotay calaamad kale oo muujisay sida khilaafka labada dhinac uu uga gudbay kulamada qarsoodiga ah una soo baxay fagaaraha dadweynaha. Kala duwanaanshahooda ayaa sidoo kale muuqday intii uu socday dagaalka Iran. Imaaraadka ayaa qaatay mowqif aad u adag oo ku wajahan Tehran, iyadoo warbixinno la daabacay ay sheegeen inuu si firfircoon uga qeyb qaatay howlgalada militari ee ka dhanka ahaa Iran. Sacuudiga, dhankiisa, wuxuu qaaday siyaasad dheellitiran, isagoo cambaareeyay weerarrada Iran ay ku qaaday waddamada Khaliijka, isla markaana u oggolaaday Mareykanka inuu adeegsado saldhigga King Fahd ee magaalada Taif, balse dhinaca kale ku cadaadiyay in xal diblomaasiyadeed laga gaaro dagaalka, isaga oo wadahadallo la xiriira arrintaas u marayay Pakistan. Loollanka saliidda oo xoogeystay Khilaafka labada dal ayaa sidoo kale si weyn uga dhex muuqday suuqa tamarta. Bishii May, Imaaraadka ayaa ka baxay Ururka Dalalka Dhoofiya Shidaalka ee OPEC kadib ku dhowaad 60 sano oo uu xubin ka ahaa ururka ay Sacuudi Carabiya hoggaamiso. Abu Dhabi ayaa kadib sare u qaaday wax-soo-saarkeeda shidaalka, tallaabo sii kordhisay tartanka dhaqaale ee labada waddan. Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka ayaa sidoo kale sannadihii dambe ku tartamayay sidii mid kasta uu xarun ganacsi iyo maalgashi ugu noqon lahaa gobolka, iyadoo Riyadh ay shirkadaha caalamiga ah ku cadaadineysay inay xarumahooda gobolka u soo wareejiyaan Sacuudiga si ay u helaan qandaraasyada dowladda. Dubai ayaa muddo dheer ahayd xarunta ugu weyn ee ganacsiga iyo maaliyadda Bariga Dhexe, balse Sacuudiga ayaa hadda isku dayaya inuu qayb weyn ka helo maalgelinta iyo ganacsiga caalamiga ah ee gobolka. Middle East Eye ayaa bishii July xaaladda labada dal ku tilmaantay “dagaal dhaqaale oo daal badan”, iyadoo sheegtay in qaar ka mid ah madaxda shirkadaha ay bilaabeen inay diyaarsadaan qorshayaal kale oo ganacsi haddii xiriirka Riyadh iyo Abu Dhabi uu kasii xumaado. Adkeynta cusub ee lagu sameeyay wareejinta lacagaha ayaa sidaas darteed noqon karta mid ka mid ah tallaabooyinka ugu muuqda ee muujinaya in khilaafkii siyaasadeed ee labada quwadood ee Khaliijka uu hadda si tartiib ah ugu sii gudbayo ganacsiga, bangiyada iyo dhaqaalaha. items.title: Lubnaan oo Suuriya u gacan geliyay Jeneraal hore oo ka tirsanaa ciidankii Bashaar Al-Asad
items.description: Dowladda Lubnaan ayaa mas’uuliyiinta Suuriya ku wareejisay Jeneraal hore oo sare uga tirsanaa ciidankii dowladdii Bashaar Al-Asad, kaas oo wajahaya eedeymo la xiriira dil, jirdil iyo dambiyo kale oo culus. Jeneraalka la wareejiyay ayaa lagu magacaabaa Cadel Ciise (Adel Issa) , oo 67 jir ah. Wuxuu horey u ahaa taliyihii Qaybta 17-aad ee ciidanka Suuriya, waxaana markii dambe loo magacaabay hoggaaminta ciidamada dhulka ee gobolka Deir ez-Zur. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha Suuriya ayaa xaqiijisay in Ciise lagu wareejiyay gacanta dowladda Suuriya, iyadoo sheegtay in amar qabasho oo kasoo baxay Suuriya uu ku eedeynayo dambiyo ay ka mid yihiin dil ula kac ah, fududeynta dembi culus, dilka in ka badan laba qof, jirdil sababay dhimasho iyo falal lagu hurinayay dagaal sokeeye iyo colaado kooxeed. Kiiska Jeneraalka ayaa loo gudbin doonaa garsoore baaritaan oo ku sugan Dimishiq, kaas oo go’aamin kara in dacwadda loo gudbiyo maxkamad dembiyeed si loo qaado maxkamadeyn rasmi ah. Wararka ay soo xigatay Reuters ayaa sheegaya in Cadel Ciise uu beeniyay dhammaan eedeymaha loo jeediyay. Waxaa la xiray 8-dii Agoosto , kaddib markii uu tegay safaaradda Suuriya ee magaalada Beyruut si uu uga shaqeysto arrimo la xiriira waraaqihiisa. Mas’uuliyiinta safaaradda ayaa markii ay ogaadeen inuu yahay qof ay Suuriya dooneyso, waxay arrinta u gudbiyeen xafiiska xeer-ilaalinta Lubnaan, waxaana halkaas ka dib lagu qabtay. Wareejinta Jeneraal Ciise ayaa noqoneysa markii ugu horreysay ee Lubnaan ay Suuriya ku wareejiso sarkaal militari oo hore uga tirsanaa nidaamkii Bashaar Al-Asad tan iyo markii xukuumaddii Al-Asad ay burburtay dhammaadkii 2024. Dowladda cusub ee Suuriya, oo uu hoggaamiyo Madaxweyne Axmed Al-Sharaa , ayaa muddooyinkii dambe cadaadis ku saareysay Lubnaan inay tallaabo ka qaaddo saraakiishii hore ee militariga iyo amniga ee u qaxay dalkaas kaddib burburkii nidaamkii Al-Asad. Bishii Janaayo, mas’uuliyiinta Suuriya ayaa saraakiisha amniga Lubnaan u gudbiyay liis ay ku jiraan in ka badan 200 oo sarkaal oo sare oo ka tirsanaa dowladdii hore , kuwaas oo Damascus ay dooneyso in loo soo qabto. Dhanka kale, maxkamad ku taalla Dimishiq ayaa horraantii bishan xukun dil ah, isagoo maqan, ku ridday Bashaar Al-Asad, iyadoo lagu soo oogay eedeymo ay ka mid yihiin dil, xarig sharci-darro ah iyo jirdil. Al-Asad ayaa hadda ku nool magaalada Moscow.

items.title: Israel Arms Somaliland
Soomaali kiis xasaasi ah loogu maxkamadeynayo UK
items.description: London (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamad ku taalla dalka Ingiriiska ayaa dambi ku heshay nin Soomaali ah oo u safray Soomaaliya isaga oo doonayay inuu ku biiro kooxda Daacish, balse ku guuldarreystay inuu gaaro goobaha ay kooxdaasi kaga sugan tahay Puntland. Mohamed Mohamoud, oo 22 jir ah, deggenaa magaalada Bristol, ayaa lagu helay inuu diyaarinayay falal argagixiso, kaddib maxkamadeyn ka dhacday Winchester Crown Court. Mohamoud ayaa inkiray eedda ah inuu diyaarinayay falal argagixiso, balse wuxuu qirtay inuu isku dayay inuu ku biiro Daacish. Xeer-ilaaliyeyaasha ayaa maxkamadda u sheegay in Mohamoud uu Soomaaliya u safray bishii Janaayo 2025, isaga oo doonayay inuu gaaro dagaalyahannada Daacish ee ku sugan dhulka buuraleyda ah ee Puntland, gaar ahaan deegaannada ku dhow magaalada Boosaaso. Naomi Parsons oo kiiska ku mataleysay xeer-ilaalinta ayaa sheegtay in Mohamoud uu xagjir noqday intii uu ku noolaa Britain, isla markaana uu qaatay fikradaha kooxda Daacish. Waxay sheegtay in ujeeddadiisu aysan ku koobneyn oo keliya inuu kooxda ku biiro, balse uu sidoo kale doonayay inuu dagaallamo oo uu naftiisa u huro kooxda. “Wuxuu lahaa rabitaan xooggan oo ah inuu Soomaaliya ku laabto, kuna biiro Daacish iyo dagaalyahannada ka howlgala buuraha ku dhow Boosaaso, waqooyiga Puntland,” ayay maxkamadda u sheegtay Parsons. Sida ay xeer-ilaalintu sheegtay, Mohamoud ayaa marka hore isku dayay inuu helo xiriir u fududeeya ku biirista kooxda, balse markii uu ku guuldarreystay ayuu haddana goostay inuu Soomaaliya u safro, isaga oo 30-kii Janaayo 2025 ka duulay Britain. Maxkamadda ayaa sidoo kale loo sheegay inuu la xiriiray barnaamij sirdoon macmal ah oo ay adeegsadaan xubno la sheegay inay Daacish u qaabilsan yihiin kala saarista iyo qiimeynta dadka doonaya inay kooxda ku biiraan. Inkasta oo Mohamoud uu haystay tikidh soo-noqosho oo ku beegnaa 3-dii Maarso, xeer-ilaalintu waxay sheegtay in fariimo ay heleen baarayaashu ay muujinayeen inuusan markii hore qorsheyneyn inuu Britain dib ugu laabto. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu ugu dambeyn ku guuldarreystay inuu gaaro kooxda, arrintaas oo xeer-ilaalintu ku xiriirisay howlgallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada ee xilligaas ka socday Soomaaliya. Puntland ayaa muddadaas wadday howlgallo ballaaran oo ka dhan ah Daacish, gaar ahaan buuraha Calmiskaad ee gobolka Bari, halkaas oo kooxda ay saldhigyo ku lahayd. Mohamoud ayaa Britain dib ugu laabtay 3-dii Maarso 2025. Xeer-ilaalintu waxay sheegtay inuu xitaa markii uu dib ugu noqday Britain sii waday xiriirkii uu la lahaa dadkii uu doonayay inay ka caawiyaan ku biirista Daacish. Fariin loo soo bandhigay maxkamadda ayuu ku sheegay inuu diyaar u yahay inuu Soomaaliya dib ugu laabto marka loogu yeero. Mohamoud oo isaguna maxkamadda ka hor hadlay ayaa sheegay inuu Soomaaliya ku dhashay, balse waalidkiis ay kala tageen markii uu saddex jir ahaa, kaddibna isaga iyo walaalkiis ka yar ay la noolaadeen hooyadood labaad oo ku sugneyd Imaaraadka Carabta. Wuxuu sheegay inuu muddo u kala noolaa Soomaaliya iyo Imaaraadka, ka hor inta uusan 2020, isaga oo 16 ama 17 jir ah, u guurin Bristol si uu ula noolaado hooyadiis. Mohamoud ayaa sheegay inuu kulliyad ka bartay Ingiriisiga, xisaabta iyo cunto-karinta, isla markaana uusan markii hore si weyn ugu xirneyn arrimaha diinta. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu maxkamadda u sheegay inuu markii dambe bilaabay daawashada muuqaallo diimeed oo lagu baahiyo YouTube, gaar ahaan kanaal lagu magacaabo BlackBeardGuy. Wuxuu sheegay in muuqaallo “xagjir ah” oo uu ka daawaday YouTube iyo TikTok ay kordhiyeen xiisihiisa diinta iyo fikirka ah inuu ku biiro Daacish. Xeer-beegtida Winchester Crown Court ayaa ugu dambeyn ku heshay dambiga ah diyaarinta falal argagixiso. Xukunka lagu ridayo Mohamoud ayaa la filayaa in maxkamaddu ku dhawaaqdo marxaladda xigta ee kiiska. The post Soomaali kiis xasaasi ah loogu maxkamadeynayo UK appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ganacsiga malabka oo bog cusub oo nololeed u furay danyar ku nool Shabeellaha hoose
items.description: (ERGO) – Ku dhawaad 80 dhallinyaro oo ku nool magaalada Marka ee gobolka Shabeellaha Hoose ayaa fursad shaqo abuur oo guulaystay ka helay ka ganacsiga malabka shinnida oo ay billaabeen lixdii bil ee la soo dhaafay. Abuukar Dhayib Nuux oo ah curadka qoys sideed qof ka kooban wuxuu subaxdii ilaa gabbal-dhicii lug ku soo maraa xaafadaha magaalada isaga oo gacmaha ku wata caagado uu ka buuxdo malab leh cabbiro kala duwan. Wuxuu shaqadan qabtaa xilli ay dad ka harsanayaan fallaaraha caddeeda. Wuxuu albaabada u garaacaa guryaha isaga oo raadinaya cid ka gadata. Waxaa u dheer inuu tago goobaha ganacsiyada iyo barkulannada bulshada. Shaqadan ayaa u suuragelisay isku filnaan. Ninkan ayaa tilmaamay in hawshan ay u noqotay il dhaqaale oo isaga iyo qoyskiisa ay kaga baxeen nolol xumo ay la halgamayeen. Wuxuu xusay inuu awood u yeeshay maaraynta baahiyaha aasaasiga ah. “Shaqadan waxay iga fududeysay culeysyo badan; kirada guriga inaan iska bixiyo, layrka inaan bixiyo, daawada aabbahay oo xanuunsan inaan iibsado, iyo walaalahay oo aabbahay iskuulka ka bixin jiray inaan hadda anigu ka bixiyo, iyagoo dhigta dugsi dhexe.” Ninkan ayaa sheegay inay shaqadan ka caawisay saddex walaalihii ah bishii  juun inuu ka diiwaan galiyay iskuulka  Alnuur,  isaga bille uga bixiya  $18 wadartooda. Abuukar ayaa Radio Ergo u sheegay in shaqadan uu billaabay bishii Febraayo ee sanadkan, markii uu aabbihii  oo reerka u xoogsi tagi jiray uu la dhul-dhacay  cudurka qallalalka oo uu ku sheegay dhakhtar loo geeyay. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay muteen nolol adag markii uu sariir-yaal noqday maaddaama uu ahaa qofka keliya reerka u dhaqdhaqaaqa. Wuxuu isku hawlay sidii uu masuuliyadda walaalihii iyo hooyadii ula wareegi lahaa. Ninkan ayaa intaas ku daray inuu ka ganacsiga malabka ku dhiirraday markii uu helay $150 oo dayn ah. Wuxuu xusay inuu maanta yeeshay macaamiil badan, isaga oo ku qiimeeyay ganacsigiisa hanti u dhiganta $1,400. Abuukar ayaa shaqadan maalin kasta ka hela dakhli gaaraya $10. Wuxuu tilmaamay in dhaqaalaha soo gala marka laga tago biilka inuu u suuragalisay inuu dib u galo jaamacadda uu qarashkeeda horey u bixin waayay. Hadda wuxuu dhigtaa simistarka 3aad. “Shaqadan ka hor culeysyo badan ayaa i haystay. Jaamacad ayaan dhiganayay, laakiin markii aabbahay xanuunsaday lacagtii waxbarashada waa la waayay, waxaana joojiyay semesterkii labaad.” “Hadda markii ay shaqadu ii hagaagtay dib ayaan ugu laabtay waxbarashadii jaamacadda. Alxamdulillaah, shaqadan wax badan ayay ka beddeshay nolosheennii hore.” Ninkan ayaa xusay in halkii litir ee malabka ah uu ku iibiyo $16, balse dadka uu uga iibiyo hab shub-shub ah, iyadoo qof kasta laga iibiyo inta uu awoodo. Abuukar ayaa tilmaamay in malabka uu iibiyo uu uga yimaado deegaanno hoostaga magaalada Marka, halkaas oo shinida lagu dhaqdo. Wuxuu xusay in qorshihiisa xiga uu yahay inuu sameysto goob lagu xanaaneeyo shinida. “Waxaan ku hamiyayaa inaan noqdo ganacsade weyn. Hadda waxaan ahay ganacsade yar, balse waxaan jeclahay inaan sameysto xero lagu dhaqdo shinida oo aan kamid noqdo dadka soo saara malabka hamigaas ayaan leeyahay.” Qoyska Abuukar oo weligood ka soo mid ahaa danyarta magaalada ayay shaqadan u noqotay mid u furmay bog cusub oo nololeed. Ninkan ayaa sheegay inuu ku hamminayo inuu qoyskiisa iyo naftiisa uu horumar ka gaarsiiyo ganacsigan. Dadka faa’iidada dhaqaale ka sameeya ka ganacsiga malabka waxaa ka mid ah Liibaan Haashim Nuune. Wuxuu sheegay in shaqadan ay u suuragelisay qoyskiisa oo ka kooban toddobo qof inay helaan cunno saddex waqti ah. Liibaan ayaa tilmaamay in shaqadan ay u fududeysay shan walaalihii ah inay helaan waxbarasho, isagoo bishii ka bixiya isku darkooda $25. Wuxuu xusay in ganacsiga malabka uu ku bilaabay $100 oo uu soo amaahday, isla markaana maanta uu ka sameeyo dakhli wanaagsan. Wuxuu iska guday deyntii uu ku bilaabay. Wuxuu ku qiimeeyay ganacsigiisa maanta qiimo dhan $1,650. Ninkan ayaa xusay inuu ganacsigan soo waday tan iyo bishii April ee sanadkan, xilligaas oo uu la wareegay mas’uuliyadda qoyskiisa, markii walaalkiis oo curadka reerka ahaa uu tahriib u baxay, kaas oo uu tilmaamay inaan ilaa hadda meelna lagu ogeyn. “Aabbe hadda ma joogo, wuu naga dhintay. Wiil aniga iga weyn ayaa xaafadda hayay, isagana wuu tahriibay. Shan carruur ah iyo hooyadood ayaa xaafadda jooga. Aniga ayaa hadda walaalkood weyn ah, Ilaah ka sokow aniga ayaa wax la iga sugaa.” Liibaan ayaa sheegay in  maalintii ugu horreysay ee uu faa’iido ka helay ganacsigiisa uu dareemay farxad aad u weyn iyo kalsooni ah inuu keligii meell iska soo saari karo, taas oo ku dhiirrigelisay inuu sii wado. Wuxuu sheegay in ka hor inta uusan bilaabin shaqadan uu talo iyo xog ka uruuriyay dhalinyaro hore uga shaqeynaysay, kuwaas oo u tilmaamay in laga heli karo dhaqaale daboola nolol maalmeedka. Liibaan ayaa sheegay in malabka uu ka keeno deegaanka Siinaay ee duleedka magaalada Marka u jira qiyaastii 18 km. Wuxuu xusay in markii hore qoyskoodu ay ku noolaayeen guri burbursan oo hal qol ka koobnaa kaasi oo ay si ku meel gaar ah u deganaayeen, balse maanta ay deggan yihiin guri kiro ah oo laba qol ka kooban, oo uu bishii ka dhiibo $30. Ninkan ayaa sheegay in ganacsiga malabka uu leeyahay caqabado, gaar ahaan macaamiisha qaarkood oo mararka qaar deyn ku qaata, kuwaas oo uu xusay inay ku dhibaan lacag, taas oo shaqadiisa sii socoshadeeda dhib ku ah, maaddaama uu isku celceliyo faa’iidada iyo lafaha. Liibaan wuxuu fariin u diray dhallinyarada ay shaqo la’aantu hayso, isagoo ku boorriyay inaysan liidin shaqooyinka yaryar, maaddaama ay noqon karaan jidka lagu gaaro horumar dhaqaale. “Dhalinyarada waxaan leeyahay shaqooyinka yaryar yaanay yasin ee ha galaan, maxaa yeelay shaqooyinka yaryar hadhow way koraan. Qofka maanta ganacsigiisu yar yahay berri wuxuu noqon karaa ganacsade meel fog gaaray.” Qoyska liibaan shaqadan uu maanta ku jiro waxay u noqotay wado ay kaga baxeen nolol xumo heysatay sannado badan, wuxuu tilmaamay in ganacsigan wareejinta ah uu qorsheynayo inuu ka guuro isla markaana uu iibsado xarun loogu soo hagaago  oo magaalada dhexdeeda ah. Dhanka kale, Maxamed Xuseen Maxamed oo ah guddoomiyaha guddi ay ku mideysanyihiin dadka ka ganacsada malabka ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay inay sii kordhayaan tirada da’yarta  shaqo  abuurka ka sameysanaya ganacsigan ee degmada ku nool. Wuxuu xusay in malabka caqabadaha la soo gudboonaada ay ugu weyntahay xilliga uu suuqa ka yaraado taas oo ay ugu wacan tahay xilli roobaadka marka la gaaro oo ay adkaato in la helo noocyada la jecel yahay ee laga keeno miyiga fog. “Malabka cad badanaa wuxuu nooga yimaadaa Tiyeeglow, Beydhaba, Bay iyo Bakool dhulkaas ayuu nooga yimaadaa. Malabka gaduudka isna waxaa laga helaa Sh.Hoose iyo Hiiraan, maaddaama dhulkii fogyahay waddooyinkiina  raf yihiin caqabadaas ku qabnaa.” Shaqooyinka yaryar ee ay samaynstaan dhallinyarada ayaa qeyb ka qaadan kara bilidda hab nololkooda iyo kan qoysaskooda balse waxay u baahan yihiin taageero dhaqaale iyo in lagu kabo talooyin iyo aqoon kor u qaada kartidooda ganacsiga. Wuxuu shaqadan qabtaa xilli ay dad ka harsanayaan fallaaraha caddeeda. Wuxuu albaabada u garaacaa guryaha isaga oo raadinaya cid ka gadata. Waxaa u dheer inuu tago goobaha ganacsiyada iyo barkulannada bulshada. Shaqadan ayaa u suuragelisay isku filnaan. Ninkan ayaa tilmaamay in hawshan ay u noqotay il dhaqaale oo isaga iyo qoyskiisa ay kaga baxeen nolol xumo ay la halgamayeen. Wuxuu xusay inuu awood u yeeshay maaraynta baahiyaha aasaasiga ah. “Shaqadan waxay iga fududeysay culeysyo badan; kirada guriga inaan iska bixiyo, layrka inaan bixiyo, daawada aabbahay oo xanuunsan inaan iibsado, iyo walaalahay oo aabbahay iskuulka ka bixin jiray inaan hadda anigu ka bixiyo, iyagoo dhigta dugsi dhexe.” Ninkan ayaa sheegay inay shaqadan ka caawisay saddex walaalihii ah bishii  juun inuu ka diiwaan galiyay iskuulka  Alnuur,  isaga bille uga bixiya  $18 wadartooda. Abuukar ayaa Radio Ergo u sheegay in shaqadan uu billaabay bishii Febraayo ee sanadkan, markii uu aabbihii  oo reerka u xoogsi tagi jiray uu la dhul-dhacay  cudurka qallalalka oo uu ku sheegay dhakhtar loo geeyay. Wuxuu tilmaamay inay muteen nolol adag markii uu sariir-yaal noqday maaddaama uu ahaa qofka keliya reerka u dhaqdhaqaaqa. Wuxuu isku hawlay sidii uu masuuliyadda walaalihii iyo hooyadii ula wareegi lahaa. Ninkan ayaa intaas ku daray inuu ka ganacsiga malabka ku dhiirraday markii uu helay $150 oo dayn ah. Wuxuu xusay inuu maanta yeeshay macaamiil badan, isaga oo ku qiimeeyay ganacsigiisa hanti u dhiganta $1,400. Abuukar ayaa shaqadan maalin kasta ka hela dakhli gaaraya $10. Wuxuu tilmaamay in dhaqaalaha soo gala marka laga tago biilka inuu u suuragalisay inuu dib u galo jaamacadda uu qarashkeeda horey u bixin waayay. Hadda wuxuu dhigtaa simistarka 3aad. “Shaqadan ka hor culeysyo badan ayaa i haystay. Jaamacad ayaan dhiganayay, laakiin markii aabbahay xanuunsaday lacagtii waxbarashada waa la waayay, waxaana joojiyay semesterkii labaad.” “Hadda markii ay shaqadu ii hagaagtay dib ayaan ugu laabtay waxbarashadii jaamacadda. Alxamdulillaah, shaqadan wax badan ayay ka beddeshay nolosheennii hore.” Ninkan ayaa xusay in halkii litir ee malabka ah uu ku iibiyo $16, balse dadka uu uga iibiyo hab shub-shub ah, iyadoo qof kasta laga iibiyo inta uu awoodo. Abuukar ayaa tilmaamay in malabka uu iibiyo uu uga yimaado deegaanno hoostaga magaalada Marka, halkaas oo shinida lagu dhaqdo. Wuxuu xusay in qorshihiisa xiga uu yahay inuu sameysto goob lagu xanaaneeyo shinida. “Waxaan ku hamiyayaa inaan noqdo ganacsade weyn. Hadda waxaan ahay ganacsade yar, balse waxaan jeclahay inaan sameysto xero lagu dhaqdo shinida oo aan kamid noqdo dadka soo saara malabka hamigaas ayaan leeyahay.” Qoyska Abuukar oo weligood ka soo mid ahaa danyarta magaalada ayay shaqadan u noqotay mid u furmay bog cusub oo nololeed. Ninkan ayaa sheegay inuu ku hamminayo inuu qoyskiisa iyo naftiisa uu horumar ka gaarsiiyo ganacsigan. Dadka faa’iidada dhaqaale ka sameeya ka ganacsiga malabka waxaa ka mid ah Liibaan Haashim Nuune. Wuxuu sheegay in shaqadan ay u suuragelisay qoyskiisa oo ka kooban toddobo qof inay helaan cunno saddex waqti ah. Liibaan ayaa tilmaamay in shaqadan ay u fududeysay shan walaalihii ah inay helaan waxbarasho, isagoo bishii ka bixiya isku darkooda $25. Wuxuu xusay in ganacsiga malabka uu ku bilaabay $100 oo uu soo amaahday, isla markaana maanta uu ka sameeyo dakhli wanaagsan. Wuxuu iska guday deyntii uu ku bilaabay. Wuxuu ku qiimeeyay ganacsigiisa maanta qiimo dhan $1,650. Ninkan ayaa xusay inuu ganacsigan soo waday tan iyo bishii April ee sanadkan, xilligaas oo uu la wareegay mas’uuliyadda qoyskiisa, markii walaalkiis oo curadka reerka ahaa uu tahriib u baxay, kaas oo uu tilmaamay inaan ilaa hadda meelna lagu ogeyn. “Aabbe hadda ma joogo, wuu naga dhintay. Wiil aniga iga weyn ayaa xaafadda hayay, isagana wuu tahriibay. Shan carruur ah iyo hooyadood ayaa xaafadda jooga. Aniga ayaa hadda walaalkood weyn ah, Ilaah ka sokow aniga ayaa wax la iga sugaa.” Liibaan ayaa sheegay in  maalintii ugu horreysay ee uu faa’iido ka helay ganacsigiisa uu dareemay farxad aad u weyn iyo kalsooni ah inuu keligii meell iska soo saari karo, taas oo ku dhiirrigelisay inuu sii wado. Wuxuu sheegay in ka hor inta uusan bilaabin shaqadan uu talo iyo xog ka uruuriyay dhalinyaro hore uga shaqeynaysay, kuwaas oo u tilmaamay in laga heli karo dhaqaale daboola nolol maalmeedka. Liibaan ayaa sheegay in malabka uu ka keeno deegaanka Siinaay ee duleedka magaalada Marka u jira qiyaastii 18 km. Wuxuu xusay in markii hore qoyskoodu ay ku noolaayeen guri burbursan oo hal qol ka koobnaa kaasi oo ay si ku meel gaar ah u deganaayeen, balse maanta ay deggan yihiin guri kiro ah oo laba qol ka kooban, oo uu bishii ka dhiibo $30. Ninkan ayaa sheegay in ganacsiga malabka uu leeyahay caqabado, gaar ahaan macaamiisha qaarkood oo mararka qaar deyn ku qaata, kuwaas oo uu xusay inay ku dhibaan lacag, taas oo shaqadiisa sii socoshadeeda dhib ku ah, maaddaama uu isku celceliyo faa’iidada iyo lafaha. Liibaan wuxuu fariin u diray dhallinyarada ay shaqo la’aantu hayso, isagoo ku boorriyay inaysan liidin shaqooyinka yaryar, maaddaama ay noqon karaan jidka lagu gaaro horumar dhaqaale. “Dhalinyarada waxaan leeyahay shaqooyinka yaryar yaanay yasin ee ha galaan, maxaa yeelay shaqooyinka yaryar hadhow way koraan. Qofka maanta ganacsigiisu yar yahay berri wuxuu noqon karaa ganacsade meel fog gaaray.” Qoyska liibaan shaqadan uu maanta ku jiro waxay u noqotay wado ay kaga baxeen nolol xumo heysatay sannado badan, wuxuu tilmaamay in ganacsigan wareejinta ah uu qorsheynayo inuu ka guuro isla markaana uu iibsado xarun loogu soo hagaago  oo magaalada dhexdeeda ah. Dhanka kale, Maxamed Xuseen Maxamed oo ah guddoomiyaha guddi ay ku mideysanyihiin dadka ka ganacsada malabka ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay inay sii kordhayaan tirada da’yarta  shaqo  abuurka ka sameysanaya ganacsigan ee degmada ku nool. Wuxuu xusay in malabka caqabadaha la soo gudboonaada ay ugu weyntahay xilliga uu suuqa ka yaraado taas oo ay ugu wacan tahay xilli roobaadka marka la gaaro oo ay adkaato in la helo noocyada la jecel yahay ee laga keeno miyiga fog. “Malabka cad badanaa wuxuu nooga yimaadaa Tiyeeglow, Beydhaba, Bay iyo Bakool dhulkaas ayuu nooga yimaadaa. Malabka gaduudka isna waxaa laga helaa Sh.Hoose iyo Hiiraan, maaddaama dhulkii fogyahay waddooyinkiina  raf yihiin caqabadaas ku qabnaa.” Shaqooyinka yaryar ee ay samaynstaan dhallinyarada ayaa qeyb ka qaadan kara bilidda hab nololkooda iyo kan qoysaskooda balse waxay u baahan yihiin taageero dhaqaale iyo in lagu kabo talooyin iyo aqoon kor u qaada kartidooda ganacsiga. The post Ganacsiga malabka oo bog cusub oo nololeed u furay danyar ku nool Shabeellaha hoose appeared first on Radio Ergo - Somali Humanitarian News and Information .

items.title: Qoysas laga raray xero barakac oo duleedka Garowe ku wajahaya dhibaato nolol xumo
items.description: (ERGO) – Biyo yari, cunno xumo, hoy la’aan ayay wajahayaan in ka badan kun qoys oo horraantii bishiii July laga barakiciyay xeryaha Habeelle ee duleedka magaalada Garoowe oo ay deganaayeen. Arrintaas ayaa qabsatay, markii dadkii lahaa dhulka ay deganaayeen ay ku amreen in ay guuraan. Waxay faro marnaan ku tageen dhul bannaan oo aan lahayn dhamaan adeegyada aas-aasiga. Muctaad Ibraahim Xasan oo ka mid ah waxay Raadiyow Ergo u sheegtay in qoyskeeda oo 11 qof ka kooban ay ku sugan yihiin nolol xumo dhinac walbo leh. Waxay ku tiirsan yihiin dayn aan joogta ahayn oo ay ka hesho qaar ka mid ah ganacsatadii yar yara ee xerada oo mehradahoodi ka billawday deegaanka cusub oo ay u soo barakaceen. Waxay tilmaamtay in qatooyo mutaan marka ay ka waayaan. “Xalay ayaa ugu danbaysay carruurtayda inaan dhabka u shido. Hadda oo ay saacado tahay 11-ka galabnimo ayaan markaan ohinta carruurta ka joogi waayay nus kilo digir dayn ah u soo qaaday. Ma shaqeeyo, magaaladii aan ka shaqaysan jirnay waa ka soo foganay. Wax kale oo aan meel ka helno ma jirta. Xogayga wixii aan ku soo helo ayaan markii hore dabka ku shidan jirnay.” Muctaad ayaa sheegtay in ay horay nolosha qoyska oo kaligeed ku tiirsan, maaddaama carruurteeda agoon yihiin ay ku maarayn jirtay shaqooyin dhar dhaqis iyo qashin qaadis aan joogta ahayn oo ay maalinkii ka heli jirtay $4, balse ay hadda meesha ka baxeen. Waxaa sababay deeganka ay imaadeen oo qiyaastii 8 km u jira magaalada Garoowe iyo in haysan $0.5 oo qofkiiba uu ku raaco gawaarida dadka qaada. Arrintan oo horseeday in qoyskeeda uu dabka ka damo ayay sheegtay in walwal ku beertay hayeeshe aysan xal u hayn, faro marnaanta haysa awgeed. Qoyskeeda badan darteed waxay tilmaamtay in aysan horray wax kayd ah samaysan oo wixii dhaqaale ah oo ay heshay ay ku dabari jirtay baahiyaha qoyska. Xaaladdan ayaa sababtay in ay reerka ku soo rarto $20 oo ah oo ku caawiyay ganacsade ay u dan sheegatay. Haweenaydaan ayaa tilmaamtay in labo toddobaad la siiyay si ay u baneeyaan dhulka xerada, taas oo keentay in aysan helin fursad ay ku tabaabushaystaan. “Dadkii dhulka laha ayaa naga soo kiciyay. Noo baneeya dhulkeena waa u bahanahay ayay dhaheen. Waa u sheegnay inaan waxbo haysan lakiin ma dhagaysan cabashadeena. Dhibaatooyin badan ayaa nagu haysta meesha aan nimid hadda. Cunto, biyo iyo suul toona ma haysano.” Muctaad ayaa tilmaamtay in cunno xumada ay u dheer tahay biyo yari. Waxay ku tiirsan yihiin jirgaan ay hadbo qoys ka soo baryaan dadka awooda in ay iibsadaan. Waxay tilmaamtay in aysan hayn $0.4 oo jirgaankii biyaha macaan ay iibiso barkaad gaar loo leeyahay. Dhanka kale waxaa haysa hoy la’aan. Waxay xustay in ay soo rarteen jingadihi iyo alwaxyadii qol ay ku lahayeen xerada Shabeelle oo ay daganayeen ku dhawaad 18 sano, hasa ahaate ay la’adahay wax ay ku dhisteen. Carruurteeda ayay sheegtay in ay la hoydaan habeenkii dadka dariska la ah ee awooday in ay guriyaha dhistaan iyadana ay banaanka dhigato sijaayaad, maalinkiina ay harsadaan geedo aan har fiican lahayn. Hoy la’aanta darteed waxay sheegtay in ay u nugul yihiin qabowga habeenkii iyo qoraxda maalintii. Xaaladdan darteed haweeynadan ayaa xustay in ay waxbarasho la’aan ka noqdeen afar carruur ah oo waxbarasho bilaash ka heli jiray iskuul xerada ku yaallay oo ay taageeraysay wasaarada waxbarashada Puntland. Waxay sheegtay in meesha ay yimaadeen aysan lahayn wax iskuullo ah, aysanna awoodin in ay ku darto dugsiyada magaalada. Carruurteeda oo dhiganayay fasallada labaad, saddexaad iyo shanaad ee dugsiga hoose dhexe ayay ka cabsi qabta in ay halkaas waxbarashada kaga haraan. Dhanka kale waxay xustay in ku dhawaad labo toddobaad oo ay xaaladdan wajahayaan lagu yeeshay $25 oo dayn ah, maaddaama aysan awoodin in ay guddo waxay ka cabsi qabta in daymo cusub loo diido. Marka laga soo tago qoysas kooban oo ganacsiyadoodi iyo guriyahoodi dib uga dhistay deegaanka cusub, kuwaas oo ehelladooda ay caawiyeen inta badan reeraha la barakiciyay ayaa ka siman nolol xumada. Waxay si kadis ah ku waayeen adeegyo bilaash ah iyo shaqooyin ay ku maarayn jireen nolosha oo ay ku haysteen xerada Shabeelle. Cabdiraxmaan Xasan Muudeey oo ah aabbaha qoys ka kooban 12 qof ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in ay ku sugan yihiin nolol xumo liidato. Ninkaan oo dhismaha guriyaha ka shaqayn jiray ayaa xusay in tan iyo bilawgii sanadkaan uusan wax shaqo ah qaban. Waxaa sababay xanuun ku soo booday oo uu sheegay in dhaqatirtu u sheegeen in uu nerfo yahay, kaas oo sababay in uu gacan iyo lug naafo ka noqdo. Tan iyo xilligaas wuxuu tilmaamay in ay dabka ku shidan jireen $3 oo ay xaaskiisa ka soo heli jirtay shaqooyin dhar dhaqis ah, taas oo Iyana meesha ka baxday tan iyo bartamihii bishii hore. Waxay hadda ku tiirsan yihiin kaalmo ay xaaskiisa ka soo hesho xaafadaha nolol dhaama oo ay hadbo qoys u dan sheegato, taas oo aan joogta ahayn kuna filnayn qoyskiisa badan. “10 cunug nin aabbahood ah oo ay wax ka sugayaan ee isagana cuuryaan ah baahida iyo dhibka haysta waa dareemi karta. Nolol maalmeedka ma haysano. Anigii ilmaha u shaqeynayay waa fadhistay oo curyaan ayaan noqday. Wixii aan helno ayaan qado ama casho ka dhigana. Halkaas mar ayaan dabka shidana.” Cabdiraxmaan ayaa sheegay in cunno xumada ay u dheer tahay hoy la’aan. Buushah ay ku lahaayeen xerada Shabeelle ayay iskaga soo tageen, markii ay waayeen wax ay ku rartaan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in ay wada gabaadsadan buush ay ka dhisteen callalo dhamaad ah iyo ullo la isku geeyay, kaas oo aan wada qaadin reerkiisa badan, hasa ahaate ay dantu dhaafin wayday. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay in uu meesha ka baxay MCH wasaarada caafimaadka ay tageeri jirtay oo xerada ku yallay, kaas oo ay carruurtiisa iyo xaaskiisa ka heli jireen dhamaan adeegyada caafimaad. Wuxuu walac ka muujiyay inuusan dhaqaale u hayn adeegyadaas hadda ayna isaga dib ugu soo noqdeen. Waxaa Cabdiraxmaan barakaca uga waxbarasho beelay 7 carruur ah oo iskuul hoose, dhexe iyo dugsi Qur’aan bilaash ah u haystay. “Dugsi Qur’aan iyo iskuul labaduba waa ii dhigan jireen carruurta. Hadda sidaan xaaladdan u galnay wax ay dhigtaan malahan guri-joog ayay noqdeen. Meesha aan nimid dugsi Qur’aan iyo iskuul midna maleh. Aad ayay muhiim iigu leedahay in ay waxbarasho ii helaan.” Qoyska Cabdiraxmaan ayaa ku dhawaad 20 sano ku nool xerada Shabeelle ee lagu amray in ay ka guuraan hadda. Wuxuu sheegay in muddadaas ay si bilaash ah ku dagnayeen dhulka oo ay dad gaar ah lahaayeen. Dhanka kale Cabdi Macallin Saabiir oo ah guddoomiyaha xeradii laga soo raray dadkaan ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in ay xaalad liidato ku wajahayan meesha ay tageen. Wuxuu xusay in ay u badan yihiin carruur, haween, naafo iyo dad wayeel ah oo aan xamali karin xaaladda la soo gudboonatay. “Dadkan waa soo barakaceen. Dhulkii ay deganaayeen dad baa iska lahaa. Qarkood waxay ku nool yihiin alwaxyo la dhisay lakiin kor ka banaan. Dadka qaar habeenkii banaannada ayay seexday. Koronto la’aan iyo mugdi ayaa jira.” Xarumo cafimaad malahan meesha. Magaalada ayay dadka ka shaqaynsan jireen oo u dhawayd markii hore. hadda waa naga fog tahay nagaalada waana adag tahay in ay gaaran dadka.” Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in dadka la barakiciyay ay gaarayaan 1,042 qoys. Wuxuu xusay in xaaladda dadkaan ay la wadaageen maamulka magaalada Garoowe iyo hay’addaha samafalka, hasa haate aysan wax jawaab ah ka helin. Waxaa sababay xanuun ku soo booday oo uu sheegay in dhaqatirtu u sheegeen in uu nerfo yahay, kaas oo sababay in uu gacan iyo lug naafo ka noqdo. Tan iyo xilligaas wuxuu tilmaamay in ay dabka ku shidan jireen $3 oo ay xaaskiisa ka soo heli jirtay shaqooyin dhar dhaqis ah, taas oo Iyana meesha ka baxday tan iyo bartamihii bishii hore. Waxay hadda ku tiirsan yihiin kaalmo ay xaaskiisa ka soo hesho xaafadaha nolol dhaama oo ay hadbo qoys u dan sheegato, taas oo aan joogta ahayn kuna filnayn qoyskiisa badan. “10 cunug nin aabbahood ah oo ay wax ka sugayaan ee isagana cuuryaan ah baahida iyo dhibka haysta waa dareemi karta. Nolol maalmeedka ma haysano. Anigii ilmaha u shaqeynayay waa fadhistay oo curyaan ayaan noqday. Wixii aan helno ayaan qado ama casho ka dhigana. Halkaas mar ayaan dabka shidana.” Cabdiraxmaan ayaa sheegay in cunno xumada ay u dheer tahay hoy la’aan. Buushah ay ku lahaayeen xerada Shabeelle ayay iskaga soo tageen, markii ay waayeen wax ay ku rartaan. Wuxuu tilmaamay in ay wada gabaadsadan buush ay ka dhisteen callalo dhamaad ah iyo ullo la isku geeyay, kaas oo aan wada qaadin reerkiisa badan, hasa ahaate ay dantu dhaafin wayday. Ninkaan ayaa sheegay in uu meesha ka baxay MCH wasaarada caafimaadka ay tageeri jirtay oo xerada ku yallay, kaas oo ay carruurtiisa iyo xaaskiisa ka heli jireen dhamaan adeegyada caafimaad. Wuxuu walac ka muujiyay inuusan dhaqaale u hayn adeegyadaas hadda ayna isaga dib ugu soo noqdeen. Waxaa Cabdiraxmaan barakaca uga waxbarasho beelay 7 carruur ah oo iskuul hoose, dhexe iyo dugsi Qur’aan bilaash ah u haystay. “Dugsi Qur’aan iyo iskuul labaduba waa ii dhigan jireen carruurta. Hadda sidaan xaaladdan u galnay wax ay dhigtaan malahan guri-joog ayay noqdeen. Meesha aan nimid dugsi Qur’aan iyo iskuul midna maleh. Aad ayay muhiim iigu leedahay in ay waxbarasho ii helaan.” Qoyska Cabdiraxmaan ayaa ku dhawaad 20 sano ku nool xerada Shabeelle ee lagu amray in ay ka guuraan hadda. Wuxuu sheegay in muddadaas ay si bilaash ah ku dagnayeen dhulka oo ay dad gaar ah lahaayeen. Dhanka kale Cabdi Macallin Saabiir oo ah guddoomiyaha xeradii laga soo raray dadkaan ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in ay xaalad liidato ku wajahayan meesha ay tageen. Wuxuu xusay in ay u badan yihiin carruur, haween, naafo iyo dad wayeel ah oo aan xamali karin xaaladda la soo gudboonatay. “Dadkan waa soo barakaceen. Dhulkii ay deganaayeen dad baa iska lahaa. Qarkood waxay ku nool yihiin alwaxyo la dhisay lakiin kor ka banaan. Dadka qaar habeenkii banaannada ayay seexday. Koronto la’aan iyo mugdi ayaa jira.” Xarumo cafimaad malahan meesha. Magaalada ayay dadka ka shaqaynsan jireen oo u dhawayd markii hore. hadda waa naga fog tahay nagaalada waana adag tahay in ay gaaran dadka.” Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in dadka la barakiciyay ay gaarayaan 1,042 qoys. Wuxuu xusay in xaaladda dadkaan ay la wadaageen maamulka magaalada Garoowe iyo hay’addaha samafalka, hasa haate aysan wax jawaab ah ka helin. items.title: Qaraxyo argagax ku abuuray shacabka oo laga maqlay Baydhabo
items.description: Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa waxaa xalay abaare 10:00pm laga maqlay illaa saddex qarax oo ahaa hoobiyeyaal. Militariga Itoobiya ee qaybta ka ah Hawlgalka Midowga Afrika ee AUSSOM ayaa hoobiyeyaasha ka riday xeradooda oo ku dhex taal Madaxtooyada Baydhabo. Jugta hoobiyeyaashan ayaa argagax geliyay dadka deegaanka, ka hor inta aan la ogaan inay ahaayeen hoobiyeyaal laga tuuray Madaxtooyada, iyadoo dadku ay muddo ku jahwareersanaayeen, waxa ay yihiin qaraxyadaasi oo laga maqlay magaalada oo dhan. Saraakiisha Taliska Qaybta 60aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa kuu sheegaya in hoobiyeyaasha lagu garaacay goob ku taala duleedka waqooyi bari ee magaalada, isla-markaana ay ku sugnaayeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dadka reer Baydhabo ayaa noqday kuwo ay dhegta u taagan tahay, wixii ka dambeeyay dagaalkii ay dadka badani ku dhinteen ee Isniintii ka dhacay magaaladaasi. Ciidamada taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) oo lagu eedeeyay inay garabsanayaan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ayaa hadaf ka dhiganaya magaaladan, maadaama ay ogyihiin inuu maamulku ku shaqeeyo, isla-markaana ay ku yaallaan Xarumaha Madaxtooyada iyo Baarlamaanka. Baydhabo waa magaalada ugu weyn, uguna dadka badan Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ee Somaliya. Inkastoo xaaladda magaalada ay tahay mid degan, haddana dareenka dadka ayaa ah mid weli kacsan, iyaga oo ka cabsi qaba dagaal kale.

items.title: Somaliland and the Red Sea Corridor
items.description: Major (Ret) Andrew Fox The United Kingdom should recognise Somaliland as an independent state, a recommendation that would have been easier to avoid a few years ago, when London could still treat Somaliland as a useful but unresolved anomaly. Such a position is harder to sustain now. Israel’s recognition of Somaliland in December 2025 ended the fiction that the status quo is frozen. The question for the UK is no longer whether recognition will ever become a live policy issue. It is a question of whether Britain will shape that debate or allow others to define it for narrower regional purposes. READ OUR REPORT

items.title: Home schooling in Hargeisa expands opportunity for education
items.description: For 23-year-old Asma Ismail Ahmed, teaching is no longer confined to the classroom. Every afternoon, she goes from home to home in Hargeisa, teaching children and adults who were unable to attend school because of financial constraints or limited access to schools. Asma began the service in May as part of a group of eight young teachers, visiting densely populated neighbourhoods across the city where there are few schools. The work provides her with a source of income and enables those who otherwise miss out to get educated. Each family pays between $5 and $10 a month, depending on what they can afford. “We first explain to the parents what we teach and the lessons we can help their children with. We also show them how we teach and give them a short trial period so they can see the changes and progress their children are making. Once a family is satisfied with the way we teach, they then help us connect with other families,” Asma explained. Her interest in teaching began when she was in middle school. Teaching now earns her between $150 and $200 a month that supports her family of six, who have also faced their own hardship. Asma became the main provider for the household after her father, who worked as a house painter, lost his job with a company in February. After several difficult months during which the family struggled to afford food, she began taking on the teaching work. She is now able to cover household food costs and contribute to the education of her younger siblings. “Financial hardship was the main reason I took this step. At the same time, we knew this service would benefit the community because many families cannot afford to send all their children to expensive schools. So this work helps both us and the community,” she said. Demand for the service is growing as more families learn about it through the teachers’ door-to-door outreach. “We try to teach each person according to their level of knowledge and what suits them. For a young child, we make the lessons simple and interesting, and we encourage them with kind words and praise,” she said. “For adults, we show them that education has no age limit and that learning can help them in their daily lives.” A committee oversees the programme with nearly 200 young teachers, organised into different groups, now earning an income through home-based teaching. Most are recent secondary school graduates, like Nuura Ali Ahmed, 20, who joined the programme after completing secondary school at Sheikh Ali Ibrahim School this year. She teaches in more than 40 homes across Hargeisa, mornings and afternoons, earning $200 to $300 a month. She contributes towards her family’s food, electricity and water, whilst saving up for her own education. “My plan is to join university once I have enough money. I want to continue my education, but I don’t want to stop this work. If I get more clients, I would like to bring other young people into the work so that they can also earn an income,” she told Radio Ergo. “I would advise young people not to wait only for formal employment. Everyone has knowledge or a skill that can benefit the community. If you have been educated, teach others. I started this work with the little knowledge I had, but today it helps me support my family and continue my education.” Nuura began teaching in April and initially struggled to gain the trust of some parents. She said continued engagement and explanation of the programme eventually convinced more families to enrol their children. The teachers work independently across Hargeisa, responding to the shortage of affordable education in some neighbourhoods. Families with limited incomes are offered lessons at lower rates. Each household typically has at least three learners, including children and adults. Malyuun Omar Hussein, a parent, has enrolled her seven children, the youngest aged five. She bought a blackboard and other learning materials for the lessons held at home and pays $5 a month, about a quarter of what it would cost to send the children to school. “My children are now students. They have been receiving lessons for two months,” she said. “They charge us a small and affordable fee to teach the children. It has benefited us, and the children understand the lessons well.” Malyuun said she was considering giving up on the children’s educations because school fees of around $6 per child were difficult for the family to afford. Her husband, whose work is irregular, is the main source of household income. The children are studying mathematics, Somali language, social studies and other basic lessons at home. Seeing their progress has encouraged Malyuun to consider joining the lessons herself. Ergo

items.title: Turkish Warship Reportedly Strikes Men Returning from Hijacked Lutuf
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — A dramatic and potentially dangerous escalation has reportedly unfolded along Somalia’s southern coastline after a Drones off a Turkish naval vessel positioned near the hijacked cargo ship Lutuf allegedly opened fire on a group of men returning from the vessel, killing four and injuring two others. According to information obtained by WardheerNews, the six men had traveled to the Lutuf aboard a small boat, reportedly providing services or supplies to the vessel while it remained under the control of Somali pirates. The men were reportedly attacked after returning to the shoreline. Sources say the strike occurred shortly after the group reached the coast and was carried out by a Turkish warship operating near the location of the hijacked Lutuf. Four of the six men were reportedly killed, while the remaining two sustained injuries. The circumstances surrounding the incident remain unclear, and there has been no official statement from the Turkish government, the Somali Federal Government or Puntland authorities confirming that a Turkish vessel carried out the strike. The reported attack, if confirmed, would represent a remarkable escalation in Turkey’s involvement in the unfolding Lutuf piracy crisis. A Naval Response Takes a Dramatic Turn The Lutuf was seized by Somali pirates earlier this week after being intercepted off Somalia’s southern coast. The pirates reportedly used another vessel, the Sward, which had previously come under their control, to facilitate the operation. The situation has now developed into a much larger maritime standoff. According to information available to WardheerNews, three vessels—the Lutuf, Sward and Asana—are currently being held in the Garmaal area, where the pirates are reportedly maintaining control over the ships while demanding ransom payments. The presence of Turkish naval forces near the hijacked vessels has added an entirely new dimension to the crisis. Rather than simply being a conventional piracy incident, the confrontation now appears to involve a powerful foreign naval force operating close to vessels controlled by armed pirates along Somalia’s coastline. The reported deaths of four men have intensified concerns over what is happening around the hijacked vessels. According to sources, the six men were traveling in a small boat and had approached the Lutuf to provide services to those aboard the vessel. After completing their task, they reportedly returned toward the shoreline. It was during or shortly after their return that they came under attack. The exact circumstances remain unknown. Were they mistaken for pirates? Was the vessel they were using considered a threat? Did the Turkish warship have intelligence indicating that armed individuals were operating from the shoreline? Or was the incident connected to an attempt to prevent supplies or assistance from reaching the hijacked ship? Those questions remain unanswered. The involvement of the Sward may also be critical to understanding the latest development. Sources indicate that the pirates who seized the Lutuf had previously taken control of the Sward and subsequently used it in the operation against the cargo vessel. The two vessels are now reportedly being held in the same coastal area, alongside the Asana. The pirates have reportedly demanded ransom payments for the release of the vessels and their crews. This means that the Turkish naval presence may now be aimed not simply at monitoring the Lutuf, but at disrupting the pirates’ wider maritime network and preventing the hijacked vessels from being moved or resupplied. Why Has Turkey Become So Involved? The reported strike also raises the central question surrounding the Lutuf crisis: why is Turkey taking such an unusually aggressive interest in this particular vessel? As previously reported, there are indications that the Lutuf could be carrying cargo connected to Turkish commercial, construction or strategic activities in Somalia. Those reports have not been independently verified. But if the vessel is carrying Turkish-owned or strategically sensitive equipment, Ankara may regard its recovery as a matter extending beyond ordinary commercial piracy. Turkey already maintains a significant military and security relationship with Somalia and has invested heavily in the country’s infrastructure, maritime security and defense institutions. The reported presence of Turkish warships near the Lutuf therefore represents a potentially important demonstration of Ankara’s willingness to protect its interests along Somalia’s coastline. Silence From Authorities Perhaps most striking is the absence of an official explanation. No government has publicly accepted responsibility for the reported strike. WardheerNews attempted to obtain information from Puntland officials regarding the incident but was unable to reach officials capable of providing an immediate response. The lack of official information has left residents and observers attempting to reconstruct events from fragmentary reports emerging from the coastline. That uncertainty is particularly troubling given the reported loss of life. If a foreign naval vessel did carry out the strike, the incident would raise serious questions about the rules of engagement being applied in Somali territorial waters, the intelligence behind the operation and the status of civilians or service providers operating near hijacked vessels. The Lutuf crisis has already demonstrated that Somali piracy, despite years of international efforts to suppress it, has not disappeared entirely. But the reported Garmaal strike suggests something potentially more serious: the return of piracy could now be drawing a direct military response from one of Somalia’s most powerful foreign security partners. Three vessels remain reportedly under pirate control. Ransom demands remain unresolved. And four people are now reportedly dead following an incident whose circumstances have yet to be publicly explained. For Somalia, the stakes are no longer limited to the safe release of hijacked ships. The country is now facing questions about foreign military operations along its coastline, the protection of civilian lives, the authority of local administrations and the increasingly complex security interests surrounding its strategic waters. Until Ankara, Mogadishu or Puntland provides a clear account of what happened at Garmaal, one disturbing question will remain at the center of the crisis: What exactly happened when those six men came ashore—and why did a Turkish warship reportedly open fire? items.title: Hassan Sheikh Says Somalia Is Ready to Take Full Security Responsibility as Foreign Forces Prepare to Leave
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud has declared that the time has come for Somalia’s armed forces to assume full responsibility for the country’s security as international troops gradually reduce their presence, presenting the graduation of thousands of newly trained soldiers as evidence of growing national military capacity. The President made the remarks during a graduation ceremony at the Xananbuure military training center in Galgaduud, where thousands of soldiers who had undergone nearly a year of training graduated. The Federal Government described the graduating class as the largest single group of Somali troops trained inside the country at this level since the collapse of Somalia’s central government in 1991. Addressing the recruits, Hassan Sheikh urged them to uphold military discipline, protect national unity and defend Somalia’s sovereignty. “Our time has come. It is time for us to assume responsibility,” the President said. The declaration comes at a critical moment for Somalia’s security transition. The future of the African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM) remains uncertain, while the mission’s current United Nations authorization is due to expire at the end of December 2026. Somalia is therefore under increasing pressure to demonstrate that its own security institutions can assume responsibilities previously carried by international forces. The Reality Beyond the Graduation Ceremony The graduation represents an important development for Somalia’s military institutions, but the reality on the ground remains considerably more complicated. Training thousands of soldiers is one thing. Deploying them effectively, supplying them, maintaining discipline, protecting their bases, coordinating intelligence and ensuring that they can hold territory after military operations is another. Somalia continues to face a determined Al-Shabaab insurgency capable of conducting complex attacks, exploiting weaknesses in government-controlled areas and maintaining influence across parts of the countryside. The central challenge is therefore not simply whether Somalia can produce more soldiers. It is whether the state can build a military institution capable of sustaining operations over time. Previous military campaigns have demonstrated that government forces can capture territory but have sometimes struggled to consolidate those gains once frontline units move forward or international support is reduced. That makes logistics, command and control, intelligence, local cooperation and post-operation governance just as important as battlefield strength. The Xananbuure graduates are expected to play an important role in security operations across central Somalia, where government forces and local partners continue to confront Al-Shabaab. Their deployment will provide an early test of whether Somalia’s expanding military training programs are translating into sustainable operational capability. The government has increasingly emphasized the development of a larger, more professional national army as international forces gradually reduce their role. But the transition carries considerable risks. If newly trained forces are deployed without adequate logistical support, reliable command structures and sufficient intelligence, increased troop numbers alone may not produce the desired security gains. Conversely, if the government succeeds in combining the new recruits with experienced commanders, effective intelligence networks, community cooperation and sustained financial support, the expanded force could represent an important step toward genuine security self-reliance. The Moment of Truth President Hassan Sheikh’s message at Xananbuure reflects an important national aspiration: Somalia wants to become responsible for its own security rather than remain indefinitely dependent on foreign forces. But that ambition will ultimately be judged not at graduation ceremonies, but on the roads, in rural communities and on the front lines. The real test will be whether these soldiers can protect civilians, hold territory, prevent Al-Shabaab from returning to areas cleared by government forces and maintain security after international troops withdraw. For Somalia, the countdown has effectively begun. With international military support facing an uncertain future, the country has less time to transform newly trained soldiers into a professional, sustainable and nationally trusted security force. The graduation at Xananbuure may therefore be more than a ceremony. It may be an early measure of whether Somalia is genuinely ready to stand on its own—or whether the transition from international security assistance to national responsibility will prove more difficult than political speeches suggest. items.title: Jaamac oo digniin culus u diray xildhibaannada, kuna dhawaaqay tallaabo uu qaadayo
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa digniin adag u diray xildhibaannada sida joogtada ah uga maqnaada fadhiyada golaha. Guddoomiyaha cusub ayaa sheegay in si buuxda loo dhaqan-gelin doono xeer-hoosaadka baarlamaanka, isagoo si cad u sheegay in aan la aqbali doonin hab-dhaqanka xildhibaannada qaarkood, kuwaas oo kulanka yimaada, is xaadiriya, kaddibna isaga baxa hoolka fadhiga, taasoo uu sheegay inay saameyn ku yeelatay shaqada iyo howlaha Golaha Shacabka. “Xildhibaannada sabab la’aanta uga maqan kulamada Golaha xeer-hoosaadka ayaa lala tiigsan doonaa. Mana la aqbali doono xildhibaan inta uu yimaado, is xaadiriya, kaddibna iska baxa,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiye Jaamac. Digniinta Guddoomiyaha ayaa kusoo beegmeysa xilli ay soo noq-noqdeen cabashooyinka la xiriira xaadiritaanka xildhibaannada iyo dib u dhaca ku yimaada fadhiyada Golaha Shacabka, kuwaas oo mararka qaar furmi waaya waqtigii loo qorsheeyay. Jaamac ayaa sheegay in maalmahan qaar ka mid ah fadhiyada Golaha ay ku furmeen tiro ku dhow 140 xildhibaan, halka tirada guud ee Golaha Shacabka ay tahay 275 xildhibaan. Tiradan ayaa ka dhigan in xildhibaanno badan aysan si joogto ah uga qeybgelin kulamada, taasoo caqabad ku noqon karta shaqada Golaha iyo ansixinta qodobbada u baahan kooram sharci ah. Sida uu dhigayo xeerka baarlamaanka, fadhiyada Golaha Shacabka waxay u baahan yihiin kooram sharci ah, si doodaha, akhrinta iyo ansixinta sharciyada iyo go’aannada kale ay u noqdaan kuwo waafaqsan nidaamka baarlamaanka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa xildhibaannada ku boorriyay inay si buuxda uga qeyb qaataan shaqada golaha, isagoo xusay in baarlamaanka looga baahan yahay inuu guto waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah ee la xiriira sharci dejinta iyo matalaadda shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in la diyaariyay xeerar lagu nidaaminayo xaadiritaanka, maqnaanshaha iyo anshaxa xildhibaannada, kuwaas oo loogu talagalay in lagu hagaajiyo habsami u socodka shaqada Golaha Shacabka. “Waxaa saacaddaan laga bilaabo farayaa xoghayaha inuu digniinta u gudbiyo qof walba oo aan imaan waqtiga xeer-hoosaadku oggol yahay,” ayuu yiri Jaamac. Si kastaba, Guddoomiyaha ayaa sheegay in la tixgelin doono duruufaha bani’aadamnimada ee xildhibaannada, isagoo tilmaamay in qofka qaba xaalad caafimaad, safar ama sabab kale oo la aqbali karo uu heli karo fasax. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay in xildhibaan aan haysan fasax rasmi ah oo ka maqnaada fadhiyada ama dib uga soo xaadira waqtigii loo asteeyay uu wajihi doono digniin iyo tallaabo waafaqsan xeer-hoosaadka golaha. Tallaabadan ayaa imaaneysa xilli Golaha Shacabka ay horyaallaan arrimo siyaasadeed iyo sharciyeed oo muhiim ah, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin sharciyada la xiriira doorashooyinka, amniga iyo dib u habeynta hay’adaha dowladda. Sidoo kale, Golaha ayaa la filayaa inuu ka shaqeeyo ajandayaal kale oo masiiri ah oo u baahan ka qeybgal buuxa oo ay sameeyaan xildhibaannada, maadaama go’aannada qaarkood ay saameyn ku yeelan karaan jihada siyaasadeed iyo dowladnimo ee dalka. Guddoomiyaha ayaa ugu dambeyn ku adkeeyay xildhibaannada inay si joogto ah uga qeybqaataan kulamada holaha, si baarlamaanka uu u guto waajibaadkiisa dastuuriga ah, isla markaana uu si hufan ugu shaqeeyo matalaadda shacabka.
