items.title: Somaliland Officer Defects to North Eastern State with Soldiers and Military Vehicle in Rare Public Break
items.description: Sanaag (WDN) — In a striking and highly unusual development, a senior military officer serving with Somaliland’s security forces has publicly announced his defection before leaving his post and crossing into the neighboring North Eastern State, taking with him a military vehicle and a small contingent of soldiers. The officer, identified as Colonel Ali Ashkato, reportedly left his position in Yubbe, in Sanaag region, accompanied by around 10 soldiers and a military vehicle, before safely reaching territory administered by North Eastern State. What makes the development particularly notable is not simply the defection itself, but the manner in which it unfolded. Sinior Somaliland soldiers defects Northeast State Rather than quietly abandoning his post, Colonel Ashkato reportedly announced his decision publicly while still in Yubbe, declaring that he was leaving Somaliland’s security forces before subsequently departing the area with the troops under his command. The move represents an unusually open break with the security establishment in Somaliland and could carry political significance beyond the relatively small number of personnel involved. Colonel Ashkato and his soldiers were reportedly received in the Fiqi-Fuliye area, where officials from North Eastern State welcomed the defecting officer and his unit. The reception included the North Eastern State’s Minister of Interior and senior security officials, who formally welcomed the colonel and the soldiers accompanying him. Images and reports of the reception have attracted attention because the officer arrived not as an individual seeking refuge, but as a commander accompanied by armed personnel and a military vehicle. For North Eastern State authorities, the development provides an opportunity to demonstrate that Somaliland’s military presence in parts of Sanaag remains vulnerable to defections, particularly among communities with strong political and traditional ties to the wider Somali federal system. For Somaliland, however, the defection could raise questions about morale, command cohesion and the loyalty of forces stationed in contested or politically sensitive areas. A Symbolic Defection The significance of the incident extends beyond the number of soldiers involved. Sanaag remains one of the most politically contested areas in northern Somalia, with competing territorial and administrative claims involving Somaliland, Puntland and the newly established North Eastern State. Against that backdrop, the decision of a Somaliland military officer to openly cross into territory controlled by a rival administration carries considerable symbolic weight. The fact that Colonel Ashkato reportedly made his decision publicly before departing also makes the episode unusual. Military defections are often conducted quietly because officers and soldiers fear retaliation, detention or reprisals. In this case, the officer appears to have deliberately transformed his departure into a public political statement. Colonel Ashkato is reportedly from the Warsangeli community, specifically the Nuux Cumar, Jibriil Axmed and Reer Fiqi lineage. His background adds another layer to the political significance of the move because the Warsangeli community has historically maintained strong social and political connections across Sanaag and the broader Puntland and North Eastern regions. However, the defection should not automatically be interpreted as evidence of a broader communal shift. Individual military defections can reflect a combination of political, professional, security and personal considerations, and the motivations behind Colonel Ashkato’s decision have not been independently established. A Warning Sign for Somaliland? For North Eastern State, the arrival of the colonel and his troops is likely to be portrayed as evidence of growing confidence and influence in areas where competing authorities have long contested political control. For Somaliland, the episode presents a more uncomfortable picture. A military officer publicly declaring his departure, taking personnel and equipment with him, and then receiving an official welcome from a neighboring administration inevitably raises questions about the effectiveness of Somaliland’s command structures in contested territories. Whether the incident remains an isolated defection or becomes the beginning of a wider movement among security personnel remains unclear. But one thing is certain: Colonel Ali Ashkato did not simply leave. He announced his departure, crossed the political divide with his men and military vehicle, and was publicly received on the other side. In the highly contested political landscape of northern Somalia, that makes this small military defection a development with potentially much larger political implications. items.title: Koonfur Galbeed oo diiday in la adeegsado wararka garabka Laftagareen
items.description: Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa bahda Saxaafadda ka dalbatay inay ka hortagto faafinta wararka kuwa hurinaya qalalaasaha amni iyo fekerka xagjirnimada. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Koonfur Galbeed, Nuur Siidow Baaba oo maanta Wariyeyaasha kula hadlayay Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa sheegay in aanay Saxaafaddu soo xigan karin wararka kuwa doonaya sida uu yiri inay abuuraan qalalaase amni iyo fekerka xagjirka ah. “Waxaan rabnaa inaan si gaar ah dardaaran guud u siino bahda Saxaafadda in aanay soo xigan karin kuwa doonaya inay abuuraan qalalaase amni iyo fekerka xagjirka ah inaanay soo xigan hadalkooda.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale shacabka ugu baaqay inay is dejiyaan, isla-markaana ay ka fogaadaan wararka aan la xaqiijin iyo xogaha loo adeegsado buu yiri in lagu abuuro cabsi iyo kala shaki. “Waxaan shacabka ugu baaqaynaa inay is dejiyaan, kana fogaadaan wararka aan la xaqiijin iyo xogaha loo adeegsado in lagu abuuro cabsi iyo kala shaki.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka. Mar uu Wasiir Baaba ka hadlayay, waxa xilligan xasaasiga ah loo baahan yahay ayaa yiri “Xilliyadan adag waxaa muhiim ah in bulshadu ay is garab-taagto nabadda, dowladnimada iyo hay’adaha sharciga ah, isla-markaana ay xogta saxda ah ka qaadato ilo rasmi ah.” Cabsi dhinaca amniga ah ayaa soo food-saartay shacabka ku dhaqan Magaalada Baydhabo, taas oo ka dhalatay weerarkii ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen ay Isniintii ku soo qaadeen magaaladaasi. Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa dagaal culus bartamaha magaalada kula galay taageereyaasha Laftagareen. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab oo is garabsanaya ay soo weerareen magaalada, inkastoo Laftagareen uu warkaasi beeniyay. “Dhammaan wararka sheegaya in Ciidanka Daraawiishta lagu tilmaamo koox xagjir ah waa warar marin habaabin ah oo been ah, kuwaas oo qiil loogu raadinayo in Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhamaaday Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu si sharci darro ah u isticmaalo qalabka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayuu Laftagareen ku sheegay qoraal uu habeenkii Isniinta soo saaray. Laftagareen ayaa sheegay in weerarka ay gaysteen Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ee isaga la safan, isla-markaana uu ahaa hawlgal uu sheegay in magaalada looga sifeynayay, waxa uu ku sheegay ciidamada sida gardarrada ah ugu soo duulay. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa 30-kii bishii March la wareegay amniga Baydhabo, taasoo keentay in Laftagareen uu ku dhawaaqo inuu xilka iska casilay, ka dib markii isla maalintaasi uu diyaarad ka raacay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud ee Baydhabo. Hase yeeshee tallaabada meesha looga saaray maamulkiisii ayaa sababtay inay magaaladu gasho xaalad hubanti la’aan amni ah, waana marxalad ka duwan muddadii uu Laftagareen maamulka hoggaaminayay.

Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale shacabka ugu baaqay inay is dejiyaan, isla-markaana ay ka fogaadaan wararka aan la xaqiijin iyo xogaha loo adeegsado buu yiri in lagu abuuro cabsi iyo kala shaki. “Waxaan shacabka ugu baaqaynaa inay is dejiyaan, kana fogaadaan wararka aan la xaqiijin iyo xogaha loo adeegsado in lagu abuuro cabsi iyo kala shaki.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka. Mar uu Wasiir Baaba ka hadlayay, waxa xilligan xasaasiga ah loo baahan yahay ayaa yiri “Xilliyadan adag waxaa muhiim ah in bulshadu ay is garab-taagto nabadda, dowladnimada iyo hay’adaha sharciga ah, isla-markaana ay xogta saxda ah ka qaadato ilo rasmi ah.” Cabsi dhinaca amniga ah ayaa soo food-saartay shacabka ku dhaqan Magaalada Baydhabo, taas oo ka dhalatay weerarkii ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen ay Isniintii ku soo qaadeen magaaladaasi. Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed ayaa dagaal culus bartamaha magaalada kula galay taageereyaasha Laftagareen. Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sheegtay in ciidamada taabacsan Laftagareen iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab oo is garabsanaya ay soo weerareen magaalada, inkastoo Laftagareen uu warkaasi beeniyay. “Dhammaan wararka sheegaya in Ciidanka Daraawiishta lagu tilmaamo koox xagjir ah waa warar marin habaabin ah oo been ah, kuwaas oo qiil loogu raadinayo in Madaxweynaha waqtigiisu dhamaaday Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu si sharci darro ah u isticmaalo qalabka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayuu Laftagareen ku sheegay qoraal uu habeenkii Isniinta soo saaray. Laftagareen ayaa sheegay in weerarka ay gaysteen Ciidanka Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed ee isaga la safan, isla-markaana uu ahaa hawlgal uu sheegay in magaalada looga sifeynayay, waxa uu ku sheegay ciidamada sida gardarrada ah ugu soo duulay. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa 30-kii bishii March la wareegay amniga Baydhabo, taasoo keentay in Laftagareen uu ku dhawaaqo inuu xilka iska casilay, ka dib markii isla maalintaasi uu diyaarad ka raacay Garoonka Diyaaradaha Shaati-gaduud ee Baydhabo. Hase yeeshee tallaabada meesha looga saaray maamulkiisii ayaa sababtay inay magaaladu gasho xaalad hubanti la’aan amni ah, waana marxalad ka duwan muddadii uu Laftagareen maamulka hoggaaminayay.

items.title: Shirkii Golaha Wasiirrada Somaliland Iyo wixii lagaga wada hadlay
items.description: Fadhigii 72-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland oo uu Shir-guddoominayey Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Maxamed Cabdillaahi (Cirro), oo uu wehelinayo Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi ayaa maanta ka qabsoomay Qasriga Madaxtooyada JSL. Qodobbada lagaga wada hadlay Fadhiga 72-aad ee Shirka Golaha Wasiirrada Jammhuuriyadda Somaliland waxa ka mid ahaa: 𝟏. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐆𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐞𝐞 𝐀𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Amniga Qaranka, Mudane Cabdalle Maxamed Carab ayaa Golaha siiyey warbixin la xidhiidha xaaladda guud ee amniga iyo xasilloonida dalka, isaga oo sheegay in ammaanka guud ee dhammaan Gobollada dalka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland uu yahay mid sugan, isla markaana aanay jirin wax qalalaase ama xasilooni darro ah nooc kasta oo ay tahayba, marka laga reebo fal dambiyeedyada maalinlaha ah ee ka dhex dhaca bulshada. 𝟐. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐃𝐡𝐚𝐪𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐃𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha JSL, Mudane Cabdilaahi Xasan Aadan ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey xaaladda guud ee dhaqaalaha dalka. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 19.08.2026-ka si rasmi ah loo daah-furay Xeerka Maamulka Maaliyadda Qaranka, Xeer Lr.75, kaasi oo kaabis iyo wax-ka-beddel lagu sameeyey. Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Xeerka Maamulka Maaliyaddu uu muhiim u yahay xoojinta nidaamka maamulka iyo maaraynta hantida ummadda, maadaama uu Xeerkani saldhig u yahay nidaam maaliyadeed oo dawli ah oo sharci ah, hufan, isla markaana leh isla-xisaabtan iyo daah-furnaan maaliyadeed. Dhinaca kale, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay in Wasaaradda Maaliyadda iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaaluhu ay diyaarisay nidaam cusub oo electronic ah oo loogu talagalay casriyeynta iyo midaynta maamulka iyo hab-raacyada Dukumentiyada qiimaha lacageed leh ee ay bixiyaan Wasaaraha iyo Hay’adaha Dawladdu, sida: Liisamada (Licenses), Ruqsadaha (Permits) iyo Shahaadooyinka (Certificates). Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha la wadaagay diyaarinta Miisaaniyadda Qaranka ee 2027-ka, in Wasaaradaha iyo Hay’adaha Dawladda loo diray Wareegtada diyaarinta iyo soo gudbinta Miisaaniyadda. Ugu dambayn, Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha Wasiirrada la wadaagay booqasho hawleed uu ku tagay Berbera, si uu ugu kuurgalo hab-sami-u-socodka hawlaha iyo adeegyada Dekedda Berbera, isaga oo kulammo is-daba-joog ah (28.07 ilaa 08.08.2026-ka) la yeeshay Hay’adda Maamulka Dekedaha Somaliland, DP World, Rugta Ganacsiga iyo daneeyeyaasha Dekedda Berbera, kulamadaasi oo diiradda lagu saaray caqabadaha ka jira xagga dejinta iyo rogista badeecadaha saaran Doonyaha iyo Maraakiibta. 𝟑. 𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐛𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐈𝐬𝐛𝐞𝐝𝐝𝐞𝐥𝐤𝐚 𝐐𝐢𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐒𝐡𝐢𝐝𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚 Wasiirka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Dalxiiska JSL, Mudane Cabdiraxmaan Xasan Nuur ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada uga xog-warramay xaaladda iyo isbeddelka qiimaha shidaalka dalka. Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in qiimaha baatroolku uu kor u kacay, halka qiimaha naaftada aanu isbeddelin, taasoo daruuri u ah nolosha bulshada, sida wax-soo-saarka Warshadaha, gaadiidka dadweynaha, gaadiidka qaada Xamuulka iwm. Wasiirku waxa uu Golaha u sheegay in korodhka qiimaha baatroolka uu ku xidhan yahay kaydkii dalka yaallay oo yaraaday iyo baahida loo qabo in si masuuliyad leh loo maareeyo kaydka haatan jira, inta laga sugayo shidaal cusub oo soo socda. Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in Wasaaraddu ay si joogto ah ula socoto xaaladda, wadashaqayn dhawna la leedahay ganacsatada Shidaalka iyo Kaalmaha Shidaalka, iyada oo la isla qaatay in si taxaddir leh loo maareeyo kaydka jira, si loo xaqiijiyo joogtaynta adeegga, isla markaana laga hortago gabaabsi xagga Shidaalka ah, iyada oo mudnaan gaar ah la siinayo xasilloonida suuqa iyo ilaalinta danaha bulshada JSL. Dhanka naaftada, Wasiirku waxa uu sheegay in uu dalka yaallo kayd ku filan muddada dhow, isla markaana la filayo in shidaal cusub soo gaadho dalka toddobaadka soo socda. 𝟒. 𝐌𝐮𝐬𝐡𝐤𝐢𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐮𝐮𝐫𝐭𝐚 𝐚𝐚𝐧 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧 𝐃𝐚𝐫𝐲𝐞𝐞𝐥 𝐖𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐝 𝐨𝐨 𝐬𝐢𝐢 𝐛𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐲𝐬𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐬𝐚𝐚𝐦𝐚𝐲𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐚𝐲 𝐤𝐮 𝐥𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐚𝐡𝐚𝐲 𝐛𝐮𝐥𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐝𝐚: Wasiirka Shaqada, Arrimaha Bulshada iyo Qoyska JSL, Marwo Milgo Maxamed Cilmi (Milgo Sanbalooshe) iyo Wasiirka Diinta iyo Awqaafta, Mudane Sheekh Cabdullaahi-Baashe Daahir Jaamac ayaa si qoto dheer uga hadlay mushkiladda sii kordhaysa ee la xidhiidha carruurta aan helin Daryeel Waalid, iyaga oo muujiyey dareen iyo walaac ku aaddan masiirka nololeed iyo mustaqbalka ubadkan iyo saamaynta ay arrintani ku yeelan karto qaab-nololeedka bulshada. Labada Wasiir waxa ay carrabka ku adkeeyeen in arrintani tahay masuuliyad wadareed, loona baahan yahay in Qaran ahaan, Caqiido ahaan iyo Sharci ahaanba wax laga qabto, bulshadana arrintan si dhab ah looga wacyigeliyo. Labada Wasiir waxa ay ku baaqeen in la xoojiyo ilaalinta carruurta aan helin Daryeelka Waalidka, la joogteeyo tallaabooyinka lagaga hortagayo arrimahan, si ay ubadkani u helaan daryeel nololeed, mustaqbal iyo masuuliyad Qaran oo ay mudan yihiin. 𝟓. 𝐗𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐝𝐚 𝐊𝐨𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐦𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐚 𝐁𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐠𝐮𝐮𝐝 𝐚𝐡𝐚𝐚𝐧 𝐝𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚, 𝐜𝐚𝐪𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐝𝐚𝐡𝐚 𝐣𝐢𝐫𝐚 𝐢𝐲𝐨 𝐱𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐚: Wasiirka Wasaaradda Tamarta iyo Macdanta JSL, Mudane Axmed Jaamac Barre ayaa Golaha Wasiirrada warbixin ka siiyey xaaladda korontada dalka, gaar ahaan magaalada Berbera, caqabadaha jira iyo xalalka loo baahan yahay. Wasiirku waxa uu xusay in koronto joogto ah oo la isku hallayn karo ay muhiim u tahay horumarka dalka, gaar ahaan magaalada Berbera oo ah magaalo xeebeed leh cimilo aad u kulul, korontaduna ay tahay mudnaanta koowaad ee nolosha bulshada, Berbera oo ah xarun dhaqaale iyo ganacsi oo muhiim ah dalka. Waxa uu tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la helo xalal waara iyo maalgelinta koronto joogto ah, la awoodi karo oo la isku hallayn karo, si loo daboolo baahida sii kordhaysa ee bulshada iyo koboca dhaqaalaha dalka.

items.title: Somalia’s Opposition Warns of Deepening Crisis
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Somalia’s political crisis took an increasingly alarming turn this week as senior opposition leaders delivered some of their strongest criticism yet of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, accusing his administration of deepening insecurity, displacing vulnerable communities and failing to address the country’s worsening humanitarian and political challenges. Speaking at separate press conferences in Mogadishu, leaders of the opposition-led Future Council expressed growing frustration and warned that Somalia is being pushed toward a dangerous political and humanitarian crossroads. Former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire, one of the leading figures in the opposition coalition, expressed deep pessimism over the direction of the country under President Hassan Sheikh, whose constitutional mandate the opposition maintains has expired. Khaire warned that Somalia could be moving toward a serious humanitarian crisis, arguing that government policies in Mogadishu have contributed to widespread displacement and destruction of homes. “What Hassan is doing in Mogadishu poses a threat to the unity of the country,” Khaire said, alleging that government actions had displaced hundreds of thousands of families and resulted in the destruction of approximately 150,000 sites. The figures cited by Khaire could not be independently verified, and the Federal Government has not publicly endorsed them. Nevertheless, his remarks highlight the increasingly bitter political dispute surrounding land, displacement and urban redevelopment in Mogadishu. A Government Accused of Turning Against Its Own Citizens Khaire argued that the fundamental responsibility of a government is to protect its citizens and territory—not to make vulnerable communities the victims of political and administrative decisions. He contrasted the government’s responsibilities toward Somalia’s borders with what he described as its treatment of people living in those border areas and within the capital. His broader argument was that legitimate political authority derives from citizens coming together to establish institutions, define territory, protect their rights and govern through agreed laws. Instead, he accused the Federal Government of failing to adequately protect Somalia’s territorial boundaries while simultaneously taking actions that, in his view, harm citizens living within them. The accusation goes to the heart of Somalia’s wider political crisis: what does government authority mean if citizens increasingly experience the state as a source of insecurity rather than protection? Former President Sheikh Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, another prominent Future Council leader, delivered an equally forceful message during a separate press conference in Mogadishu. Sharif argued that Somalia’s political situation has reached a point at which opposition leaders can no longer simply observe events without taking action. “We cannot continue sitting and watching. We must take action because responsibility has collapsed with those entrusted with leadership,” Sharif said. At the same time, however, the former president called on Hassan Sheikh to return to the negotiating table and seek a political settlement. “You have done what you could do. Save the country and return to the negotiating table,” Sharif said. His appeal reflects the central dilemma facing Somalia’s opposition: whether to continue pursuing negotiations with the Federal Government or move toward more confrontational political action. Land, Displacement and the Human Cost Sharif also accused the Hassan Sheikh administration of forcing residents in Mogadishu from their homes, alleging that some communities had effectively been given a choice between surrendering their properties or facing displacement. The allegations come amid continuing controversy over land ownership, public property, urban redevelopment and the displacement of low-income communities in Mogadishu. For families who have lived in parts of the capital for decades, the issue is not merely political. It is existential. A house is often a family’s largest—and sometimes only—asset. Losing it can mean losing access to schools, employment, social networks and the community structures that provide informal protection and support. This is why allegations of forced displacement have become particularly politically sensitive. The opposition’s accusations extend beyond individual allegations of land seizures or displacement. They reflect a much broader argument that Somalia’s institutions are failing to provide the political consensus and protection expected from a functioning state. The country is simultaneously confronting an Al-Shabaab insurgency, economic pressures, displacement, political polarization and an unresolved dispute over the constitutional and electoral order. Against this backdrop, accusations that government policies are contributing to displacement or social instability carry particularly serious implications. The Federal Government has yet to provide a comprehensive response to the latest allegations cited by the opposition. For President Hassan Sheikh, the challenge is therefore no longer simply defending individual government policies. It is restoring public confidence in the state’s intentions and demonstrating that political authority can coexist with accountability, dialogue and protection of citizens’ rights. The Road Ahead The opposition’s message is increasingly clear: Somalia cannot remain indefinitely trapped between political confrontation and institutional uncertainty. Sharif’s call for Hassan Sheikh to return to dialogue suggests that a negotiated settlement remains possible. But the language used by the opposition also indicates that patience is wearing thin. Whether the government chooses confrontation, continued political maneuvering or renewed negotiations could determine the next chapter of Somalia’s political crisis. For ordinary Somalis, however, the debate is ultimately less about political personalities than about survival. They want security. They want homes that cannot be taken from them without due process. They want functioning institutions. And they want leaders who recognize that political power is temporary, while the consequences of government decisions can last for generations. That may be the most important message emerging from the opposition’s latest warnings: Somalia’s political crisis is no longer confined to Parliament, Villa Somalia or opposition meetings. Increasingly, its consequences are being felt in the homes and livelihoods of ordinary citizens. WardheerNews The post Somalia’s Opposition Warns of Deepening Crisis appeared first on WardheerNews .

items.title: Duq magaalo oo Mexico ah oo “guursaday” yaxaas si loo raadiyo barwaaqo
items.description: MEXICO — Inta badan aroosyadu waxay ku dhammaadaan laba qof oo is dhaarsada, balse magaalo yar oo ku taalla koonfurta Mexico ayaa sanad kasta martigelisa xaflad ka duwan kuwa kale. San Pedro Huamelula ee gobolka Oaxaca, duqa magaalada ayaa xaflad dhaqameed ku “guursada” yaxaas-dumar, iyadoo dadka deegaanka ay rumeysan yihiin in munaasabaddan ay kaalin ka qaadato keensashada barwaaqo, roob iyo wax-soo-saar wanaagsan. Xafladda sanadkan oo dhacday 30-kii Juun ayaa duqa magaalada Daniel Gutierrez lagu arkay isagoo ka qeybgalaya munaasabadda, halka yaxaaska loo diyaariyey sida aroosad, laguna labisay dhar cad oo aroos. Dadka deegaanka ayaa yaxaaska u bixiyay magaca Miguelana Estela del Mar Zavaleta Ramirez , waxaana sidoo kale loogu yeeraa “Princess Girl”. Munaasabadda ayaa ka bilaabata in yaxaaska lagu dhex maro magaalada, iyadoo dadka ay la socdaan muusig, ciyaaro iyo dhar dhaqameed. Ugu dambeyn waxaa la gaarsiiyaa goobta xafladda, halkaas oo lagu sameeyo guurka astaanta ah. Xitaa waxaa dhacda in duqu uu yaxaaska dhunkado, taasoo noqota qaybta ugu caansan ee xafladda, isla markaana sanad kasta sawirradeedu ay gaaraan warbaahinta caalamka. Maxaa ka dambeeya guurka aan caadiga ahayn? Inkasta oo muuqaalka xafladdu dadka dibadda uga muuqan karo wax lala yaabo, haddana dadka San Pedro Huamelula waxay u arkaan qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah dhaqankooda. Dhaqankan oo la rumeysan yahay inuu soo jiray in ka badan 230 sano , ayaa astaan u ah xiriirka ka dhexeeya laba bulsho oo asal ahaan ka soo jeeda Oaxaca Chontal iyo Huave. Sida ku cad sheekada dhaqanka, yaxaasku wuxuu matalaa amiirad ka tirsan bulshada Huave, halka duqa magaaladu uu matalo boqorka Chontal. Guurka labada dhinac ayaa sidaas loogu xusuustaa heshiis iyo nabad dhex martay labada bulsho qarniyo ka hor. Codsi loo jeedinayo dabeecadda Dadka deegaanka waxay sidoo kale xafladda u arkaan duco loogu baryayo in deegaanka uu helo wax-soo-saar wanaagsan. Waxay rajeynayaan roob ku filan, kalluun badan iyo dalag wanaagsan, iyadoo xafladdu ay qayb ka tahay dabaaldegyo dhowr maalmood soconaya oo ay ka mid yihiin muusig, ciyaaro iyo munaasabado dhaqameed. “Annaga waxay noo tahay xaflad aan Hooyada Dhulka iyo Abuuraha kaga codsaneyno barwaaqo ku timaadda dalagyadeenna, kalluumeysigeenna iyo wax kasta oo gobolkeennu soo saari karo,” ayuu Reuters u sheegay Luis Manuel Lopez, oo ka mid ah dadka deegaanka. Dhaqan indhaha dunida soo jiita Sanad kasta, xafladdu waxay magaalada San Pedro Huamelula ka dhigtaa meel ay indhaha ku hayaan warbaahinta gudaha iyo tan caalamka. Sawirrada duqa magaalada oo ag taagan yaxaaska aroosadda loo labisay ayaa si weyn loo faafiyaa, waxaana xafladdu noqotay mid ka mid ah dhaqamada ugu yaabka badan ee Mexico laga yaqaan. Laakiin dadka deegaanka, munaasabaddan kama dhigna oo keliya muuqaal soo jiidasho leh. Waxay u tahay hab ay ku ilaalinayaan dhaqankooda, ku xusuustaan taariikhdooda, isla markaana ay ku muujiyaan rajada ay ka qabaan sanad nabad, barwaaqo iyo wax-soo-saar leh. Sidaas awgeed, waxa dunida inteeda kale uga muuqda “duq magaalo oo guursanaya yaxaas” ayaa San Pedro Huamelula uga dhigan xaflad qarniyo soo jirtay oo isku xiraysa dhaqan, nabad, dabeecad iyo rajada bulshada ee mustaqbal wanaagsan. The post Duq magaalo oo Mexico ah oo “guursaday” yaxaas si loo raadiyo barwaaqo first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Maxay yihiin 7 safiir ee Xasan Sheekh maanta ka guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga? + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta xarunta Madaxtooyada Qaranka warqadaha aqoonsiga danjirenimo kaga guddoomay safiirro cusub oo ka socda toddobo dal. Safiirrada cusub ee Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyaddu ka guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga ayaa kala ah: Danjire Mohamed Alim – Aljeeriya Danjire Joao Alfredo Dos Anjos – Brazil Danjire Dr. Adarsh Swaika – Hindiya Danjire Dr. Madou Diallo – Mali Danjire Aung Min Oo – Myanmar Danjire Danlami Ibrahim – Nigeria Danjire Aqsa Nawaz – Pakistan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Danjireyaasha cusub ka dhageystay warbixinno ku saabsan qorshayaashooda iyo mudnaanta ay siinayaan xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo dalalka ay matalaan. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray fursadaha lagu horumarin karo xiriirrada diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo toddobada dal, iyadoo la xoojinayo iskaashiga dhinacyada kala duwan ee labada dhinac. Madaxweynaha ayaa safiirrada cusub u rajeeyay inay muddada ay xilalkooda hayaan kaalin wanaagsan ka qaataan xoojinta xiriirka saaxiibtinimo ee Soomaaliya iyo dalalkooda. Xasan Sheekh ayaa si gaar ah u xusay muhiimadda iskaashiga dhinacyada siyaasadda, dhaqaalaha, horumarinta, amniga iyo arrimaha bulshada, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ah xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo dalalka caalamka. Safiirrada cusub ayaa dhankooda Madaxweynaha soo gaarsiiyay farriimo iyo salaan ay ka sideen madaxda dalalkooda, iyagoo muujiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay ka shaqeynta horumarinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga kala dhexeeya Soomaaliya. The post Maxay yihiin 7 safiir ee Xasan Sheekh maanta ka guddoomay warqadaha aqoonsiga? + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Rebalancing Ethiopia’s Federal Order: Multinational Federalism, Self-Government, Equal Citizenship, and Shared Prosperity
items.description: By Faisal Omer; Former parliament member of Somali region Abstract Since 1991, Ethiopia has transformed from a highly centralized state into a federal order that constitutionally recognized the rights of the country’s “nations, nationalities, and peoples.” The 1995 Constitution established extensive regional self-government, collective rights, and self-determination while seeking to preserve national unity. Although this settlement addressed some important historical grievances concerning political recognition, cultural identity, territorial governance, and autonomy, more than three decades of experience have revealed persistent challenges, including ethnic polarization, territorial disputes, minority protection, fiscal dependence, uneven development, weak intergovernmental coordination, resource competition, and tensions between collective identity and equal citizenship. This article argues that these challenges reflect not the inherent failure of federalism, but an enduring imbalance between self-rule and shared rule. Ethiopia’s most viable constitutional trajectory therefore lies neither in centralized homogenization nor in preserving an unreformed federal order, but in developing a rebalanced multinational federation that combines meaningful regional self-government with equal citizenship, effective shared institutions, enforceable minority protections, equitable fiscal arrangements, cooperative intergovernmental relations, and inclusive national political participation. Drawing on scholarship on multinational federalism, territorial autonomy, consociationalism, self-determination, decentralization, and conflict management, as well as comparative experiences from India, Canada, Belgium, Switzerland, and Nigeria, the article develops an institutional framework for this rebalancing. It treats collective rights and individual citizenship as complementary principles: regional autonomy should protect identity and self-government without producing exclusion, while common citizenship should strengthen national solidarity without requiring cultural or political homogenization. Fiscal federalism and natural-resource governance are central to this framework. Although the 1995 Constitution contains important provisions concerning natural-resources, these provisions do not establish a sufficiently detailed, predictable, transparent, and constitutionally protected framework for sharing the benefits of natural-resource development among the federal government, producing regions, and affected communities. This gap is becoming increasingly significant as Ethiopia expands oil, natural-gas, mining, and related industrial activities. The article concludes that Ethiopia’s constitutional future should pursue integration without assimilation, autonomy without isolation, and national solidarity without central domination. A rebalanced multinational federation can provide a framework in which diversity, regional self-government, and equal citizenship reinforce one another, transforming Ethiopia’s pluralism from a source of zero-sum competition into a foundation for democratic stability and shared prosperity. 1. Introduction Few constitutional questions have been more consequential for modern Ethiopia than how to reconcile political unity with deep linguistic, cultural, historical, religious, and territorial diversity. The central challenge is not diversity itself, but the institutional framework through which diverse communities are recognized, represented, and governed. Historically, Ethiopian state-building relied heavily on centralized authority. While this promoted administrative integration and state consolidation, it also generated persistent grievances concerning political inclusion, cultural recognition, territorial governance, and access to political and economic power. The 1991 political transition and the adoption of the 1995 Constitution marked a fundamental departure from this model. By constitutionally recognizing the rights of Ethiopia’s “nations, nationalities, and peoples,” the Constitution established a federal system centered on regional self-government and collective rights. Article 39 recognizes self-determination and self-government, while Article 40 establishes important principles concerning land and natural resources. Federalism thus became not merely an instrument of administrative decentralization, but a constitutional response to Ethiopia’s longstanding national question. Often described as ethnic or ethnonational federalism (Turton 2006; Vaughan 2003), the system has produced important achievements, including greater regional and local self-government, recognition of linguistic and cultural identities, broader political representation, and improvements in aspects of public-service delivery (Faguet, Khan, and Kanth 2021). At the same time, it has faced persistent challenges, including ethnic polarization, territorial disputes, competition over political power and resources, minority insecurity, uneven development, and tensions between regional and federal authorities. A central paradox has therefore emerged: a constitutional system designed to accommodate diversity has sometimes operated through political institutions and practices that intensify identity-based competition . During the EPRDF period, this tension was reinforced by the coexistence of constitutionally defined regional autonomy and a highly centralized party structure. As a result, formal self-government did not always translate into effective political autonomy. The weakening of the EPRDF system subsequently exposed institutional tensions that had previously been managed through party discipline rather than fully developed federal mechanisms. The post-2018 period has consequently demonstrated both the potential and the vulnerability of Ethiopia’s federal settlement. The fundamental constitutional question is therefore not simply whether federalism should be retained or abolished, but how Ethiopia can preserve meaningful self-government while building a political community in which all citizens enjoy equal constitutional membership. This article advances multinational federalism as a framework for addressing this challenge. It argues that Ethiopia need not choose between collective identity and national citizenship. Instead, its constitutional order should enable regional and cultural identities to coexist with, and contribute to, an inclusive Ethiopian citizenship. The article advances four principal arguments. First, Ethiopia’s central institutional challenge is an imbalance between self-rule and shared rule. Second, collective rights and individual citizenship should be understood as complementary rather than competing principles. Third, sustainable federal accommodation requires institutions extending beyond territorial autonomy, including minority protection, fiscal equalization, structured intergovernmental cooperation, equitable natural-resource governance, and inclusive national institutions. Fourth, the current period of political and constitutional deliberation provides an opportunity to refine the federal order without abandoning the significant achievements of the post-1991 constitutional settlement. Methodologically, the article adopts a conceptual and comparative approach, drawing on constitutional provisions, federalism scholarship, comparative experiences, institutional documents, and empirical research on decentralization, fiscal federalism, political inclusion, natural-resource governance, and regional development. It uses these materials to develop an institutional framework for rebalancing Ethiopia’s federation around three mutually reinforcing objectives: meaningful self-government, equal citizenship, and shared national prosperity. items.fullContent: By Faisal Omer; Former parliament member of Somali region Abstract Since 1991, Ethiopia has transformed from a highly centralized state into a federal order that constitutionally recognized the rights of the country’s “nations, nationalities, and peoples.” The 1995 Constitution established extensive regional self-government, collective rights, and self-determination while seeking to preserve national unity. Although this settlement addressed some important historical grievances concerning political recognition, cultural identity, territorial governance, and autonomy, more than three decades of experience have revealed persistent challenges, including ethnic polarization, territorial disputes, minority protection, fiscal dependence, uneven development, weak intergovernmental coordination, resource competition, and tensions between collective identity and equal citizenship. This article argues that these challenges reflect not the inherent failure of federalism, but an enduring imbalance between self-rule and shared rule. Ethiopia’s most viable constitutional trajectory therefore lies neither in centralized homogenization nor in preserving an unreformed federal order, but in developing a rebalanced multinational federation that combines meaningful regional self-government with equal citizenship, effective shared institutions, enforceable minority protections, equitable fiscal arrangements, cooperative intergovernmental relations, and inclusive national political participation. Drawing on scholarship on multinational federalism, territorial autonomy, consociationalism, self-determination, decentralization, and conflict management, as well as comparative experiences from India, Canada, Belgium, Switzerland, and Nigeria, the article develops an institutional framework for this rebalancing. It treats collective rights and individual citizenship as complementary principles: regional autonomy should protect identity and self-government without producing exclusion, while common citizenship should strengthen national solidarity without requiring cultural or political homogenization. Fiscal federalism and natural-resource governance are central to this framework. Although the 1995 Constitution contains important provisions concerning natural-resources, these provisions do not establish a sufficiently detailed, predictable, transparent, and constitutionally protected framework for sharing the benefits of natural-resource development among the federal government, producing regions, and affected communities. This gap is becoming increasingly significant as Ethiopia expands oil, natural-gas, mining, and related industrial activities. The article concludes that Ethiopia’s constitutional future should pursue integration without assimilation, autonomy without isolation, and national solidarity without central domination. A rebalanced multinational federation can provide a framework in which diversity, regional self-government, and equal citizenship reinforce one another, transforming Ethiopia’s pluralism from a source of zero-sum competition into a foundation for democratic stability and shared prosperity. 1. Introduction Few constitutional questions have been more consequential for modern Ethiopia than how to reconcile political unity with deep linguistic, cultural, historical, religious, and territorial diversity. The central challenge is not diversity itself, but the institutional framework through which diverse communities are recognized, represented, and governed. Historically, Ethiopian state-building relied heavily on centralized authority. While this promoted administrative integration and state consolidation, it also generated persistent grievances concerning political inclusion, cultural recognition, territorial governance, and access to political and economic power. The 1991 political transition and the adoption of the 1995 Constitution marked a fundamental departure from this model. By constitutionally recognizing the rights of Ethiopia’s “nations, nationalities, and peoples,” the Constitution established a federal system centered on regional self-government and collective rights. Article 39 recognizes self-determination and self-government, while Article 40 establishes important principles concerning land and natural resources. Federalism thus became not merely an instrument of administrative decentralization, but a constitutional response to Ethiopia’s longstanding national question. Often described as ethnic or ethnonational federalism (Turton 2006; Vaughan 2003), the system has produced important achievements, including greater regional and local self-government, recognition of linguistic and cultural identities, broader political representation, and improvements in aspects of public-service delivery (Faguet, Khan, and Kanth 2021). At the same time, it has faced persistent challenges, including ethnic polarization, territorial disputes, competition over political power and resources, minority insecurity, uneven development, and tensions between regional and federal authorities. A central paradox has therefore emerged: a constitutional system designed to accommodate diversity has sometimes operated through political institutions and practices that intensify identity-based competition . During the EPRDF period, this tension was reinforced by the coexistence of constitutionally defined regional autonomy and a highly centralized party structure. As a result, formal self-government did not always translate into effective political autonomy. The weakening of the EPRDF system subsequently exposed institutional tensions that had previously been managed through party discipline rather than fully developed federal mechanisms. The post-2018 period has consequently demonstrated both the potential and the vulnerability of Ethiopia’s federal settlement. The fundamental constitutional question is therefore not simply whether federalism should be retained or abolished, but how Ethiopia can preserve meaningful self-government while building a political community in which all citizens enjoy equal constitutional membership. This article advances multinational federalism as a framework for addressing this challenge. It argues that Ethiopia need not choose between collective identity and national citizenship. Instead, its constitutional order should enable regional and cultural identities to coexist with, and contribute to, an inclusive Ethiopian citizenship. The article advances four principal arguments. First, Ethiopia’s central institutional challenge is an imbalance between self-rule and shared rule. Second, collective rights and individual citizenship should be understood as complementary rather than competing principles. Third, sustainable federal accommodation requires institutions extending beyond territorial autonomy, including minority protection, fiscal equalization, structured intergovernmental cooperation, equitable natural-resource governance, and inclusive national institutions. Fourth, the current period of political and constitutional deliberation provides an opportunity to refine the federal order without abandoning the significant achievements of the post-1991 constitutional settlement. Methodologically, the article adopts a conceptual and comparative approach, drawing on constitutional provisions, federalism scholarship, comparative experiences, institutional documents, and empirical research on decentralization, fiscal federalism, political inclusion, natural-resource governance, and regional development. It uses these materials to develop an institutional framework for rebalancing Ethiopia’s federation around three mutually reinforcing objectives: meaningful self-government, equal citizenship, and shared national prosperity. items.title: DFS oo Booliis Geysay Ceeldheer, Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo Furimaha Loo Dirayo
items.description: Ceeldheer (Raxanreeb Online): Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ciidamo Booliis ah geysay degmada Ceeldheer ee gobolka Galgaduud, dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug, kuwaas oo la wareegaya mas’uuliyadda sugidda amniga degmada. Ciidamada Booliiska ayaa lagu soo dhaweeyay degmada Ceeldheer, iyadoo la sheegay in loo xilsaaray howlgallada amniga iyo ilaalinta kala dambeynta. Tallaabadan ayaa qeyb ka ah qorshe lagu xoojinayo amniga deegaanada ay Dowladda Federaalka iyo ciidamada dowladda dib ula wareegeen. Sida ay sheegeen ilo kala duwan, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa sidoo kale waddo qorshe lagu gaarsiinayo ciidamo Booliis ah degmooyin kale oo dhawaan laga saaray gacanta Al-Shabaab, iyadoo saldhigyo Booliis oo ku yaalla deegaanadaas dib loo dayactiray ama loo diyaariyay in ciidamadaasi ka howlgalaan. Qorshahan ayaa ujeeddadiisu tahay in Ciidanka Booliiska ay qaataan mas’uuliyadda amniga magaalooyinka iyo degmooyinka, halka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka loo qorsheynayo in xoogga lagu saaro furimaha hore iyo howlgalada milatari ee ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab. Tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale qeyb ka noqon karta qorshaha Dowladda Federaalka ee kala saaraya waajibaadka ciidanka milatariga iyo booliiska, si ciidamada Xoogga Dalka ay u dardargeliyaan howlgalada ka socda furimaha dagaalka, halka Booliisku ay diiradda saaraan sugidda amniga iyo kala dambeynta gudaha degmooyinka. items.title: Haweeney Ruush ah oo 27 jeer uur qaaday, 69 carruur ah dhashay
items.description: Taariikhda waxaa ku xusan haweeney Ruush ah oo la sheegay inay 27 jeer uurtay, waxayna dhashay 69 carruur ah, taasoo ka dhigaysa tirada ugu badan ee carruurta ay hal haweeney dhasho taariikhda la duubay. Haweeneydan oo la aqoonsaday Valentina Vassilyeva, oo ahayd xaaskii ugu horreysay ee nin beeraley ah oo Ruush ah, ayaa waxay dhashay 16 laban-laab, 7 saddex-laab, iyo 4 afar-laab, kuwaas oo isku dara 69 carruur ah oo ka soo baxay 27 uur oo keliya. Waxay ahayd qarnigii 18-aad, waqti ka hor dhallaanka casriga ah, cisbitaalada ama daryeelka uurka ee maanta la heli karo. Guinness World Records ayaa weli ku qoran kiiskan sida tirada ugu badan ee carruurta ay hal haweeney dhasho. Inkastoo taariikhdu ay tahay mid qarni yaal leh, taariikhyahanadu ma xaqiijin karaan faahfaahin kasta si waafaqsan heerarka casriga ah. Laakiin haddii diiwaannada ay saxan yihiin, tirooyinku way adag tahay in la fahmo: 27 uur, 69 carruur ah, iyo in ku dhowaad dhammaan dhalmada ay ku jireen in ka badan hal ilmo. Dhalmada Valentina Vassilyeva waxay ahayd mid aan caadi ahayn, maadaama ay si joogto ah u dhashay laban-laab, saddex-laab iyo afar-laab, waxayna noqotay mid ka mid ah xaaladaha ugu cajiibsan taariikhda. Inkastoo aan la garanayn sida ay uga badbaaday dhalmo kasta, waxay noqotay astaan loogu talagalay carruurta badan ee taariikhda. The post Haweeney Ruush ah oo 27 jeer uur qaaday, 69 carruur ah dhashay first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: DF oo ciidan cusub geysay Ceeldheer iyo ujeedka ka dambeeya
items.description: Ceeldheer (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ciidamo ka tirsan booliska Soomaaliyeed geysay degmada Ceeldheer ee gobolka Galgaduud ee dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Ciidamada booliska ayaa halkaas loo geeyay si ay ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga degmada oo ay horay u hayeen ciidamada xoogga dalka. Ciidamadan oo soo dhaweyn loogu sameeyay degmada ayaa waxaa la sheegay in loo xil saaray sugidda amniga iyo ilaalinta xarumaha muhiimka ah, iyadoo tallaabadan qeyb ka tahay qorshe lagu xoojinayo nabadgelyada deegaanka. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, Dowladda Federaalka ayaa qorsheynaysa in ciidamo boolis ah la geeyo degmooyin dhowaan laga saaray gacanta Al-Shabaab, iyadoo dib u habeyn lagu sameeyay saldhigyada iyo goobaha ay ciidamadaasi ka howlgalayaan. Qorshahan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada dowladda ay ku doonayso in ciidamada booliska ay si weyn uga qeyb qaataan sugidda amniga deegaanada laga xoreeyay Al-Shabaab, halka ciidamada militariga loo diyaarinayo howlo kale oo la xiriira dagaalka. Dowladda ayaa qorsheyneysa in ciidamada xoogga dalka loo wareejiyo furimaha hore ee dagaalka, si ay u dardargeliyaan howl-gallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo howl-gallada lagu doonayo in lagu xoojiyo ammaanka deegaanada ku dhow goobaha dagaalka. Tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmeysa xilli ciidamada qalabka sida ee Soomaaliya ay muddooyinkii dambe u diyaar garoobayeen inay si buuxda ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga dalka, iyadoo ciidamada Midowga Afrika ee howl-galka AUSSOM ay qorsheynayaan inay yareeyaan ama soo afjaraan joogitaankooda. Si kastaba, Ceeldheer ayaa ka mid ah degmooyinka Galmudug ee muddooyinkii dambe ay ciidamada dowladdaiyo kuwa deegaanka ay ka wadeen dadaallo lagu xoojinayo amniga, waxaana la filayaa in keenista booliska ay sare u qaaddo awoodda maamulka iyo sugidda amniga degmada. The post DF oo ciidan cusub geysay Ceeldheer iyo ujeedka ka dambeeya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo waraaqaha aqoonsiga ka guddoomay Safiiro cusub (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Madaxweynaha Somaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa maanta waraaqaha aqoonsiga ee safiirnimo ka guddoomay toddobo Safiir, ka dib markii siyaabooyin kala duwan uu ugu qaabilay Xarunta Madaxtooyada Qaranka ee Magaalada Muqdisho. Madaxweynaha ayaa munaasabad lagu qabtay Villa Somalia waraaqaha kaga guddoomay Safiiradan, oo mid ka mid ah ay haweeney tahay. Safiiradan ayaa kala ah:- 1-Danjire Mohamed Alim – Aljeeriya 2-Danjire Joao Alfredo Dos Anjos – Brazil 3-Danjire Dr. Adarsh Swaika – Hindiya 4-Danjire Dr. Madou Diallo – Mali 5-Danjire Aung Min Oo – Myanmar 6-Danjire Danlami Ibrahim – Nigeria 7-Danjire Aqsa Nawaz – Pakistan Aqsa Nawaz oo ah haweeneyda keliya ee ka dhex muuqatay Safiirada uu Madaxweynuhu qaabilay ayaa hadda ahayd Safiirka Pakistan ee Jabuuti. Haweeneydan ayaa waxay kaloo soo noqotay Qunsulka Guud ee Pakistan ee Magaalada Milan ee dalkaasi Talyaaniga, intii u dhexeysay May 2022 iyo August 2025. Bishii September ee sanadkii hore ayay Islamabad u soo magacawday inay noqoto Safiirka Pakistan ee Jabuuti. “Madaxweynaha ayaa Danjireyaasha ka dhageystay warbixinno ku saabsan qorsheyaashooda iyo mudnaantooda ku aaddan xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ka dhexeeya Somaliya iyo dalalka ay matalaan.” Ayaa lagu yiri war ka soo baxay Xafiiska Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Dhankooda, Safiirada cusub ayaa Madaxweynaha soo gaarsiiyay farriimo iyo salaan ay ka sideen madaxda dalalkooda, iyaga oo muujiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay ka shaqeynta horumarinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Somaliya iyo dalalka ay matalaan.” Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Safiiradan u rajeeyay in muddada ay xilalkooda hayaan ay kaalin wanaagsan ka qaataan xoojinta xiriirka saaxiibtinimo ee Somaliya iyo dalalkooda, sida lagu sheegay warka.

Warka ayaa lagu sheegay “Dhankooda, Safiirada cusub ayaa Madaxweynaha soo gaarsiiyay farriimo iyo salaan ay ka sideen madaxda dalalkooda, iyaga oo muujiyay sida ay uga go’an tahay ka shaqeynta horumarinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga Somaliya iyo dalalka ay matalaan.” Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Safiiradan u rajeeyay in muddada ay xilalkooda hayaan ay kaalin wanaagsan ka qaataan xoojinta xiriirka saaxiibtinimo ee Somaliya iyo dalalkooda, sida lagu sheegay warka.

items.title: Al-Shabaab Torches Convoy After Extortion Ring Bust
items.description: Al-Shabaab operatives set fire to six freight trucks carrying charcoal from the Lower Shabelle and Hiran regions on Wednesday as the convoy was traveling toward the capital, Mogadishu. Photographs obtained from the area depict the commercial vehicles engulfed in flames along the road connecting Wanlaweyn and Afgooye in the Lower Shabelle region. A transport driver interviewed by Raxanreeb stated that armed militants ambushed the vehicles along the primary transit corridor between Wanlaweyn and Afgooye. The driver, who spoke on the condition of anonymity due to security concerns, reported that the trucks were destroyed by members of Al-Shabaab’s Hisbah unit operating at local checkpoints. He noted that the destroyed vehicles belonged to members of the Gaaljecel, Habar Gidir, and Murusade clans. According to sources cited by Raxanreeb, Al-Shabaab had routinely extracted tax payments from charcoal transporters using an intermediary drivers’ committee to process the collections. However, operational conditions shifted last week after the U.S.-backed Danab Special Forces apprehended two key members of that committee, identified as Ahmed Somali and Osman Jawjawley. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye: Xiriir 15 Sano Jirsaday oo Xadhko Adag Yeeshay
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa ka qeybgalay munaasabad lagu xusayay 15 sano oo kasoo wareegtay markii uu si weyn u xoogaystay xiriirka iyo iskaashiga diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye. Xiriirka labada dal wuxuu galay marxalad cusub sanadkii 2011, xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahaysay abaar ba’an iyo xaalad bani’aadantinimo oo aad u adag. Türkiye ayaa xilligaas si weyn uga qeyb qaadatay dadaallada gurmadka iyo taageerada shacabka Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo booqashadii uu Madaxweynaha Türkiye Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ku yimid Muqdisho ay noqotay dhacdo taariikhi ah oo muujisay heerka uu xiriirku gaaray. Tan iyo 2011, xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye wuxuu ka gudbay kaalmo bani’aadantinimo oo keliya, wuxuuna isu beddelay iskaashi ballaaran oo dhinacyo badan leh, oo ay kamid yihiin amniga, difaaca, waxbarashada, caafimaadka, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga, maalgashiga iyo horumarinta hay’adaha dowladda. Türkiye ayaa sidoo kale door muuqda ku leh tababarka iyo tayeynta ciidamada Soomaaliyeed, iyadoo magaalada Muqdisho ay ku taallo Akadeemiyadda TURKSOM, oo lagu tababaro ciidamada Soomaaliya. Dhanka dhaqaalaha, ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga, labada dal ayaa sannadihii lasoo dhaafay ballaariyay xiriirkooda, iyadoo shirkado iyo hay’ado Turkish ah ay ka qeyb qaateen mashaariic kala duwan oo Soomaaliya laga hirgeliyay. Munaasabadda ayaa sidoo kale lagu muujiyay in xiriirka labada dal uusan ku koobnayn oo keliya iskaashi dowladeed, balse uu ku saleysan yahay xiriir taariikhi ah, walaaltinimo iyo xiriir dad iyo dad ah oo sii xoogeysanayay tan iyo 2011. Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa munaasabadda ka sheegay muhiimadda ay Soomaaliya u leedahay sii xoojinta xiriirka Türkiye, iyadoo labada dhinac ay doonayaan in iskaashigooda loo gudbiyo marxalad cusub oo ku dhisan danaha labada dal, horumar, amni iyo iskaashi waara. 15-ka sano ee lasoo dhaafay ayaa sidaas darteed noqday xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye uu si weyn isu beddelay, laga soo bilaabo gurmadkii bani’aadantinimo ee 2011 ilaa iskaashi istiraatiiji ah oo maanta taabanaya dhinacyo badan oo nolosha iyo dowladnimada Soomaaliya ah. items.title: The Economist: “Muqdisho oo ka baxaysa sumcaddii xumayd ee ahayd magaalada ugu halista badan!”
items.description: Muddo dheer, magaca Muqdisho wuxuu warbaahinta caalamka uga dhex muuqday qaraxyo, weerarro hubaysan iyo waddooyin cabsi darteed u xirma marka habeenku soo dhaco. Haatan, muuqaal kale ayaa soo baxaya, maqaaxiyo saqda dhexe ka dib furan, waddooyin ciriiri noqday iyo dhismayaal dhaadheer oo si xawli ah uga dhex baxaya magaalada. Wargeyska The Economist ayaa qiimayn uu 13kii Agoosto daabacay ku sheegay in Muqdisho aanay mar dambe mutaysan “sumcadda dilka” ee muddada dheer la xiriirtay. Dooddiisu waxay ku salaysan tahay hoosudhac weyn oo ku yimid weerarrada al‑Shabaab ee caasimadda, 144 weerar oo la diiwaangeliyey rubucii saddexaad ee 2022 ayaa noqday shan weerar rubucii labaad ee 2026. Marka tiro ahaan loo eego, waa hoosudhac ka badan 96%. Waa isbeddel aan la fududaysan karin, gaar ahaan magaalo ay sannado yar ka hor dadka deggani ku noolaan jireen su’aasha ah halka uu weerarka xiga ka dhici doono ee aanay su’aashu ahayn in weerar dhici doono iyo in kale. Hasayeeshee, tiradaasi waxay dhalinaysaa laba su’aalood oo kala duwan: maxaa Muqdisho ka beddelay, hoosudhaca weerarraduna ma caddaynayaa in al‑Shabaab la wiiqay? Amni laga dareemayo nolosha maalinlaha ah Isbeddelka Muqdisho kuma koobna xogta hay’adaha amniga. Waxaa laga dheehan karaa habeenkii magaalada, dhaqdhaqaaqa ganacsiga iyo dhismayaasha cusub. Maqaaxiyo iyo hudheello ayaa shaqeeya ilaa saacadaha dambe; waddooyinka qaarna waxaa habeenkii buuxiya dhallinyaro, qoysas iyo ganacsato. Dhanka kale, dhismaha dabaqyada dhaadheer iyo xarumaha ganacsigu wuxuu muujinayaa in maalgeliyayaal Soomaaliyeed ay mustaqbalka magaalada ku dhiirranayaan. Mid ka mid ah tusaalooyinka ay The Economist xustay waa Dahab Tower, oo ah dhisme 26 dabaq ah, looguna talagalay guryo, suuq, goob jimicsi iyo masjid. Dhismaha noocan ahi ma aha oo keliya isbeddelka muuqaalka magaalada; wuxuu sidoo kale tilmaamayaa in ganacsatadu hantidooda ku maalgelinayaan qorshayaal muddo dheer jira. Kobocaas waxaa garab socda magaaloobid aad u xawli badan. Bangiga Adduunku wuxuu sheegay in 54% dadka Soomaaliya ay hadda ku nool yihiin magaalooyinka, kuwaas oo sannadkii ku fidaya qiyaastii 4.3% heer ka sarreeya celceliska Afrika. Kobocani wuxuu magaalada siinayaa dhaqdhaqaaq dhaqaale, laakiin wuxuu sidoo kale culays saarayaa waddooyinka, guryaha, nadaafadda iyo adeegyada kale ee dadweynaha. Maxaa weerarrada dhimay? Qiimaynta The Economist waxay isbeddelka qayb ahaan la xiriirisay iskudarka sirdoon xoogaystay, kaamirooyinka ammaanka, diiwaangelinta elektaroonigga ah ee gaadiidka iyo ciidamo sirdoon oo lagu baahiyey magaalada. Kaamirooyinka qarsoon ee CCTV ayaa lagu xiray waddooyinka iyo meherado badan, iyada oo la doonayo in lagula socdo dhaqdhaqaaqa gaadiidka iyo dadka looga shakiyo weerarrada. Diiwaangelinta gaadiidka iyo adkaynta kontaroolladuna waxay sii yarayn karaan fursadda gaari qarax siday si fudud ugu gudbi karo bartamaha magaalada. Taageerada Turkiga ayaa iyaduna qayb ka ah sawirka. Turkigu wuxuu Soomaaliya ka taageeraa tababarka ciidamada, dhismaha awoodda sirdoonka iyo qalabaynta hay’adaha ammaanka. Sannadkii 2017 ayuu Muqdisho ka furay xaruntiisa tababarka ciidan ee ugu weyn meel ka baxsan dalkiisa, halka shirkado Turki ahi ay maamulaan dekedda iyo garoonka diyaaradaha Muqdisho. Sida uu qoray The Economist, diblomaasi reer Galbeed ah oo Muqdisho jooga ayaa Turkiga ku ammaanay qayb weyn oo ka mid ah horumarka amniga. Hase yeeshee, horumarku kuma koobna taageero shisheeye: waxaa jira waaya-aragnimo ay hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed ka kororsadeen qaababka ay al‑Shabaab dadka, qaraxyada iyo hubka magaalada ku soo geliso. In Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu 1dii Luulyo munaasabad dadweyne kaga qaybgalay isgoys hore weerarro loogu bartilmaameedsaday ayaa iyaduna noqotay astaan siyaasadeed oo muujinaysa kalsoonida ay dawladdu ka qabto xaaladda caasimadda. Tirada yar ma la macne tahay koox daciiftay? Halkan ayaa taxaddarku ka bilaabmayaa. Hoosudhaca weerarrada Muqdisho si toos ah ugama dhigna in awoodda Al‑Shabaab guud ahaan burburtay. Kooxdu weli waxay degaanno iyo marinno sahay ku leedahay miyiga koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya, waxayna awood u leedahay inay weerarro waaweyn ku qaaddo saldhigyada ciidamada iyo magaalooyinka ka baxsan caasimadda. Falanqeeyayaal ay soo xigatay The Economist ayaa sheegaya in yaraanta weerarradu ka dhalan karto beddelka xeeladaha kooxda, ee aanay khasab ahaan ka dhalan tabardarrideeda. Urur hubaysan wuxuu go’aansan karaa inuu weerarrada magaalo muddo yareeyo, inta uu awooddiisa ku ururinayo furimaha dagaalka, dib isu abaabulayo ama sugayo fursad siyaasadeed iyo amni. Xogta ACLED waxay hore u muujisay in al‑Shabaab ay marka ay cadaadis kala kulanto meel ka mid ah dalka u wareejin karto hawlaheeda degaanno kale. Sidaas awgeed, amniga Muqdisho waa in lagu qiimeeyaa waxa magaalada gudaheeda ka dhacaya iyo awoodda kooxda ee dalka intiisa kale labadaba. Waxaa kale oo xusid mudan in hirgelinta kaamirooyinka ammaanku aanay ku iman kharash la’aan. ACLED waxay 2024 diiwaangelisay weerarro iyo dilal loo geystay dad rayid ah oo Al‑Shabaab ku eedaysay inay kaamirooyinka CCTV-ga ku rakibeen meheradahooda. Taasi waxay muujinaysaa in tallaabooyinka amnigu mararka qaarkood ganacsatada iyo shaqaalaha u abuureen halis ay kooxdu si gaar ah ugu bartilmaameedsato. Guul muuqata oo u baahan in la joogteeyo Qiimaynta cusub ee Muqdisho waxay saxaysaa sawir caalami ah oo marar badan magaalada ku koobay qarax iyo burbur. Caasimaddu maanta ma aha magaaladii 2010, 2017 ama xitaa 2022. Hoosudhaca weerarrada, soo kabashada nolosha habeennimo iyo maalgashiga dhismuhu waa horumar dhab ah oo ay dadka Muqdisho nololmaalmeedkooda ka dareemayaan. Laakiin sumcaddu mararka qaarkood si ka dheereeya ayay isu beddeshaa xaqiiqada, mararka qaarkoodna way ka gaabisaa. Cinwaanka The Economist wuxuu Muqdisho siinayaa aqoonsi ay muddo sugaysay, hasayeeshee joogtaynta isbeddelku waxay ku xirnaan doontaa in horumarka amniga laga dhigo mid hay’adeed—oo aan ku tiirsanayn oo keliya kontaroollo, kaamirooyin iyo feejignaan ku meelgaar ah. Muqdisho waxay ka sii baxaysaa sumcaddii magaalo dhimasho; welise waxaa taagan hawsha ka adag: in ammaanka caasimadda loo beddelo nabad waarta oo gaarta dalka intiisa kale.

Hase yeeshee, horumarku kuma koobna taageero shisheeye: waxaa jira waaya-aragnimo ay hay’adaha Soomaaliyeed ka kororsadeen qaababka ay al‑Shabaab dadka, qaraxyada iyo hubka magaalada ku soo geliso. In Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu 1dii Luulyo munaasabad dadweyne kaga qaybgalay isgoys hore weerarro loogu bartilmaameedsaday ayaa iyaduna noqotay astaan siyaasadeed oo muujinaysa kalsoonida ay dawladdu ka qabto xaaladda caasimadda. Tirada yar ma la macne tahay koox daciiftay? Halkan ayaa taxaddarku ka bilaabmayaa. Hoosudhaca weerarrada Muqdisho si toos ah ugama dhigna in awoodda Al‑Shabaab guud ahaan burburtay. Kooxdu weli waxay degaanno iyo marinno sahay ku leedahay miyiga koonfurta iyo bartamaha Soomaaliya, waxayna awood u leedahay inay weerarro waaweyn ku qaaddo saldhigyada ciidamada iyo magaalooyinka ka baxsan caasimadda. Falanqeeyayaal ay soo xigatay The Economist ayaa sheegaya in yaraanta weerarradu ka dhalan karto beddelka xeeladaha kooxda, ee aanay khasab ahaan ka dhalan tabardarrideeda. Urur hubaysan wuxuu go’aansan karaa inuu weerarrada magaalo muddo yareeyo, inta uu awooddiisa ku ururinayo furimaha dagaalka, dib isu abaabulayo ama sugayo fursad siyaasadeed iyo amni. Xogta ACLED waxay hore u muujisay in al‑Shabaab ay marka ay cadaadis kala kulanto meel ka mid ah dalka u wareejin karto hawlaheeda degaanno kale. Sidaas awgeed, amniga Muqdisho waa in lagu qiimeeyaa waxa magaalada gudaheeda ka dhacaya iyo awoodda kooxda ee dalka intiisa kale labadaba. Waxaa kale oo xusid mudan in hirgelinta kaamirooyinka ammaanku aanay ku iman kharash la’aan. ACLED waxay 2024 diiwaangelisay weerarro iyo dilal loo geystay dad rayid ah oo Al‑Shabaab ku eedaysay inay kaamirooyinka CCTV-ga ku rakibeen meheradahooda. Taasi waxay muujinaysaa in tallaabooyinka amnigu mararka qaarkood ganacsatada iyo shaqaalaha u abuureen halis ay kooxdu si gaar ah ugu bartilmaameedsato. Guul muuqata oo u baahan in la joogteeyo Qiimaynta cusub ee Muqdisho waxay saxaysaa sawir caalami ah oo marar badan magaalada ku koobay qarax iyo burbur. Caasimaddu maanta ma aha magaaladii 2010, 2017 ama xitaa 2022. Hoosudhaca weerarrada, soo kabashada nolosha habeennimo iyo maalgashiga dhismuhu waa horumar dhab ah oo ay dadka Muqdisho nololmaalmeedkooda ka dareemayaan. Laakiin sumcaddu mararka qaarkood si ka dheereeya ayay isu beddeshaa xaqiiqada, mararka qaarkoodna way ka gaabisaa. Cinwaanka The Economist wuxuu Muqdisho siinayaa aqoonsi ay muddo sugaysay, hasayeeshee joogtaynta isbeddelku waxay ku xirnaan doontaa in horumarka amniga laga dhigo mid hay’adeed—oo aan ku tiirsanayn oo keliya kontaroollo, kaamirooyin iyo feejignaan ku meelgaar ah. Muqdisho waxay ka sii baxaysaa sumcaddii magaalo dhimasho; welise waxaa taagan hawsha ka adag: in ammaanka caasimadda loo beddelo nabad waarta oo gaarta dalka intiisa kale.

items.title: Wasiirka Warfaafinta Soomaaliya oo Beijing Kula Kulmay Wasiirka Raadiyaha iyo Telefishinka Shiinaha+SAWIRO
items.description: Beijing (Raxanreeb Online): Wasiirka Warfaafinta, Dhaqanka iyo Dalxiiska Soomaaliya, Cabdulfataax Qaasim Maxamuud, ayaa caawa magaalada Beijing kulan gaar ah kula qaatay Wasiirka Raadiyaha iyo Telefishinka Shiinaha, Marwo Cao Shumin. Labada wasiir ayaa ka wada hadlay xoojinta iskaashiga, wada-shaqeynta iyo wax-wada-qabsiga labada dowladood, gaar ahaan dhinacyada warbaahinta iyo dhaqanka. Wasiir Cabdulfataax Qaasim ayaa dowladda iyo shacabka Shiinaha uga mahadceliyay soo dhoweynta loo sameeyay, isagoo soo bandhigay sida Wasaaradda Warfaafinta Soomaaliya ay uga go’an tahay horumarinta iyo casriyeynta waaxda warbaahinta. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la ballaariyo iskaashiga labada dhinac, si loo horumariyo warbaahinta, dhaqanka iyo adeegyada la xiriira isgaarsiinta iyo tebinta wararka ee Soomaaliya. items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo ku adkeystay arrin cabsi xooggan ka muujiyeen mucaaradka
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa ka hadlay qorshaha dowladda ee xakamaynta hubka lagu haysto magaalooyinka dalka, isagoo sheegay in aan la aqbali karin in hub lagu dhex haysto magaalooyinka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in ciidamada dowladda ay yihiin kuwa xaqa u leh inay hub qaataan, halka dadka aan ka tirsanayn hay’adaha dowladda laga doonayo inay hubka dhigaan oo ay u hoggaansamaan shuruucda dalka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa tilmaamay in dowladda ay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin lagu xakameynayo hubka sida gaarka ah loogu haysto magaalooyinka, isagoo sheegay inay iman doonto maalin ay dowladdu gacanta ku dhigi doonto hubka ay dadka qaar ku haystaan guryahooda. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli siyaasiyiin iyo xubno mucaaradka ka tirsan ay walaac xooggan ka muujinayaan qorshaha dowladda ee ku aaddan xakamaynta hubka, iyagoo qaba in hubku muhiim u yahay amnigooda gaarka ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in dowladda aysan weli awood buuxda u lahayn inay hubka kala wareegto dhammaan dadka ku haysta guryahooda, inkastoo uu rajo ka muujiyay in arrintaas la gaari doono. “Shabaab waan dilaynaa oo waan is dirirsanahay, Daacish-na waan la dagaalamaynaa. Ninkii qori usoo qaata ee raba inuu dadka dilo waan la diriraynaa. Qofku fikirkiisa xor ayuu u yahay 100%, dastuurkuna wuu tilmaamayaa, laakiin qoryo hala isku soo qaato meel ay ku qoran tahay ma jirto,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Sidoo kale wuxuu sheegay inay jiraan mas’uuliyiin laga dhaadhicin la’yahay in waddanku ammaan yahay, isagoo ku adkeystay in xaaladda amni ee caasimaddu ay wax badan iska beddeshay. Mucaaradka dowladda ayaa horey uga digay qorshahan, iyagoo ku dooday in hubka ay u haystaan is-difaac, isla markaana haddii ay hubka dhigaan ay noqon karaan bartilmaameed sahlan oo ay kooxaha argagixisada, gaar ahaan Al-Shabaab, weerari karaan. items.title: Israel oo joojisay heshiisiyad hubka ay la lahayd Qatar
items.description: Israa’iil waxay joojisay heshiisyada hubka ee ay la lahayd Qatar; go’aanku wuxuu khuseeyaa heshiisyo shan sano ah. Sidaasi waxa lagu baahiyay I24 – gaar ahaan boga ay ku leeyihiin barta X. Wadamada Carabta badidooda ayaa xidhiidh ganacsi la leh dawlada Israel kuwaasi oo ay ugu horeryaan dalalka Masar,Saudi Arabia, Qatar iyo kuwo kalaba. Waxa nasiib daro ah in dalalkaasi ay Somaliland ku colaadiyaan xidhiidhka saxiibtinimo ee ay dhawaan yeesheen labada dal ee Somaliland iyo Israel. Xidhiidhkaasi oo ah mid qoto dheer oo waligii jiri doona waxana haboon in dhamaan dalalka Carabta iyo Turkugba ay raacaan wadada ay ay qaaday Israel ee ahaa in Somaliland mar kale loo aqoonsado dal madax banaan.

items.title: War naxdin leh oo kasoo kordhay dagaalkii Baydhaba + Video
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Macluumaad dheeraad ah ayaa kasoo baxaya khasaaraha ka dhashay dagaalkii maalin ka hor ka dhacay gudaha magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta gobolka Baay, kaas oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka iyo kuwa taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Khasaaraha ayaa haatan sii kordhaya, iyadoo ay isa soo tarayaan warbixinada ka imaanaya magaalada Baydhaba, halkaas oo laga dareemayo saameynta dagaalkii Isniintii lasoo dhaafay ka dhacay magaaladaasi. Telefishinka Universal oo booqday goobihii lagu dagaalamay aya tegay xero barakacayaal ah oo ku taalla magaalada, taas oo uu saameeyay gaari qarax ah oo la sheegay inuu halkaasi ku qarxay, waxaana ku dhintay 6 qof oo shacab ah. Dadka ku dhintay qaraxa waxaa ka mid ahaa hooyo korinaysay carruur agoon ah oo lagu magacaabi jiray Mayrow Cabdullaahi Uudey iyo laba carruur ah oo ay dhashay, kadib markii qaraxu ku haleelay gurigooda oo cowshado ka sameysnaa. Qaar kamid ah dadka deegaanka oo maanta aasay dadkii ku geeriyooday musiibadaasi ayaa la hadlay Universal TV, iyagoo sheegay inay aad uga argagaxeen dhibaatada ka dhacday halkaasi. “Meeshaan waxaa nooga dhintay lix qof, waxaana ku jiray hooyo iyo laba carruur ah oo ay dhashay,” ayay tiri haweeney kamid ah dadka deegaanka. Sidoo kale Maxamed Aadan Maxamed oo kamid dadka ku nool kaamka ay mashaqadu ka dhacday ayaa ka sheekeeyay sida ay wax u dhaceen. “Gaariga qaraxa watay oo nimanka kor ay la yimaadeen ayaa dhibaatadan na gaarsiiyay, waxaana nagu dhacay guri la’aan iyo ilmo la’aan”. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya oo soo bandhigtay warbixin xasaasi ah oo ku aadan dagaalkii ka dhacday Baydhaba ayaa sheegtay inay ka qayb-qaateen maeeshiyaad ka tirsan Al-Shabaab, waxaana ay baahisay baahisay sawirro laga soo qaaday goobta oo ay kusoo bandhigtay illaa 4 caddeymood oo waa wayn, kuwaas oo ay ku jiraan gaadiid qaraxyo ka buuxaan oo la adeegsaday iyo naftood-haligayaal ka tirsan Khawaarijta oo la sheegay inay is qarxiyeen. items.title: Xukuumadda Soomaaliya oo bogaadisay xiriirka kala dhaxeeya Turkiga
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa ka qayb-galay munaasabad lagu xusayey xiriika ku salaysan iskaashi diblumaasiyadeed iyo walaaltinnimo ee ka dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda aan walaalaha nahay ee Türkiye, kaasi oo 15 sano ay ka soo wareegtay markii dib-loo sii xoojiyey. items.title: Baydhabo oo lagu soo bandhigay maxaabiis laga qabtay kooxihii weerarka soo qaaday
items.description: Laamaha amniga ayaa maanta maxaabiistan ku soo bandhigay Xarunta Taliska Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Baay ee Magaalada Baydhabo, iyadoona uu maamulku sheegay in lagu qabtay dagaalkii Isniintii ka dhacay magaaladaasi. Wasiirka Warfaafinta Koonfur Galbeed, Nuur Siidow Baaba ayaa Warbaahinta u akhriyay warsaxaafadeed uu maamulku ka soo saaray weerarkii ay maalin ka hor magaalada ku soo qaadeen ciidamada taageersan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen). Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in hawlgalo ay ciidamada ammaanka isla maalintaasi ka sameeyeen magaalada ay ku soo qabqabteen xubno ka tirsan buu yiri qolyihii Khawaarijta iyo Khawaarij kalkaalka, oo uu ula jeedo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab iyo ciidamada u daacadda ah Laftagareen. “Ciidamada amniga ayaa hawlgaladii 17-kii bishan August ka dhacay Magaalada Baydhabo ku soo qabqabtay xubno ka tirsan qolyihii Khawaarijta iyo Khawaarij kalkaalka, hubkoodii iyo sida aad aragteen gaari loogu talagalay in lagu dhibaateeyo guud ahaan shacbiga Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan reer Koonfur Galbeed.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka. Wasiirka ayaa tilmaamay in xubnaha la hayo la horgayn doono sharciga, iyadoo la ilaalinayo xuquuqdooda. “Dadka la qabtay waxaa la marin doonnaa habraacyadii sharciga ahaa, iyadoo si buuxda loo dhowrayo xuquuqdooda, lana marin doono shuruucda dalka.” Ayuu yiri Wasiirka Warfaafinta Koonfur Galbeed. Wasiirka oo sii hadlayay ayaa wada hadal ugu baaqay garabka Laftagareen, waxaana uu yiri “Kuwa doonaya inay wiiqaan dowladnimada reer Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya, qalalaasana ka dhex abuuraan bulshada dhexdeeda ama shacabka u horseedaan cabsi iyo amni darro, waxaan leenahay dalku ma lahan waddo kale oo mustaqbal lagu gaari karo, marka laga reebo nabadda, wada hadal iyo dowladnimo. Khilaaf kasta oo jira waxaa lagu xalin karaa miiska wada hadalka, balse laguma xalin karo hub uruursi, rabshad, cabsi gelin iyo iska horimaad. Dowladda Koonfur Galbeed Somaliya cidna dagaal lama dooneyso, cidna cadaawad gaar ah uma hayso, laakiin dowladda waxaa saaran waajib aan laga tanaasuli karin, oo ah ilaalinta nolosha shacabka reer Koonfur Galbeed, hantidooda, amnigooda iyo sharciga dalka.” Wasiir Baaba ayaa intaasi ku daray “Dowladdu waxay diyaar u tahay inay soo dhaweyso wada hadal kasta oo dhab ah oo lagu doonayo nabad iyo xal waara, balse wada hadalku waa inuu ku dhisnaadaa ixtiraamka sharciga, ilaalinta shacabka iyo aqoonsiga hay’adaha dowladda. Cid kasta oo nabadda dooraneysa albaabka wada hadalka waa uu furan yahay. Cid kasta oo sharciga jebiineysa waxaa lagu la xisaabtami doonnaa sharciga. Cid kasta oo shacabka cabsi gelineysa, dowladdu waxay gudan doontaa waajibaadkeeda dastuuriga ah, ee ah ilaalinta shacabka iyo amnigooda.” Baaba ayaa Warbaahinta ka soo muuqday, iyadoo ay garbihiisa taagnaayeen Wasiirka Amniga Koonfur Galbeed, Isaaq Maxamed Isaaq (Koosaar) iyo Taliyaha Qaybta Booliska Gobolka Baay, Korneyl Mukhtaar Maxamed Dugudow. Maxaabiistan oo 53 nin gaarayay ayaa markii dambe lagu celiyay goobtii lagu hayay.

items.title: Ceeldaahir iyo Hargeysa: Dhacdooyin Naxdin Leh oo Soo Kordhaya
items.description: Bari/Hargeysa (Raxanreeb Online): Magaalada Ceeldaahir ee gobolka Bari ayaa maanta laga soo sheegay dhacdo naxdin leh, kaddib markii nin lagu soo warramay inuu dilay walaalkiis, iyadoo la sheegay in muran ka dhashay dhul uu sababay falka. Dhanka kale, magaalada Hargeysa waxaa xalay ka dhacday dhacdo kale oo naxdin leh, iyadoo sida la sheegay oday uu dilay ilmihiisa. Labadan dhacdo ayaa walaac ka abuuraya bulshada, iyadoo ay soo badanayaan falalka rabshadaha ah ee ka dhasha khilaafaadka qoysaska, dhulka iyo arrimo kale oo bulshada dhexdeeda ah. Dhacdooyinka noocan ah ayaa mar kale muujinaya muhiimadda ay leedahay in khilaafaadka lagu xalliyo wada-hadal iyo hannaan sharci, si looga hortago in muran uu isu beddelo falal waxyeello leh. items.title: Golaha Shacabka oo Digniin Ka Soo Saaray Xildhibaanada Ka Maqan Fadhiyada
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), oo uu wehliyo Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow, ayaa shir guddoomiyey kulanka 4-aad ee Kalfadhiga 8-aad ee Golaha Shacabka. Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa sheegay in xildhibaanada sabab la’aan uga maqnaada fadhiyada Golaha lala tiigsan doono xeer-hoosaadka Golaha, isagoo sidoo kale sheegay inaan la aqbali doonin xildhibaanada is xaadariya balse kulanka isaga baxa. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale lagu dhaariyey Wasiir Ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, Mudane Cusmaan Maxamed Cabdi. Kulanka oo ku furmay kooram dhan 140 xildhibaan ayaa Golaha Shacabka lagu marsiiyey akhrinta koowaad Borotokoollada Dheeraadka ah ee kaabaya Afarta Axdi ee Geneva ee 1949-kii, kuwaas oo ay soo gudbisay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah. Sidoo kale, Xildhibaanadu waxay akhrinta labaad marsiiyeen Hindise Sharciyeedka Wax-ka-beddelka Qaybta 6-aad ee Sharciga Iibka Qaranka. items.title: Xildhibaan Kooshin: “Waxaan Rabaa Waxa Dadkayga Somaliland Ay Rabaan”
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Xildhibaan Kooshin, oo Somaliland ku metela Golaha Shacabka Federaalka Soomaaliya, ayaa sheegay inuu taageersan yahay rabitaanka dadka uu metelo, isagoo sheegay inuu aaminsan yahay in Soomaaliya ay kala tagtay xilligii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Xildhibaanka oo la hadlay Shabeelle TV ayaa sheegay: “Dadkayga aan metelo (Somaliland) waxa ay rabaan ayaan rabaa, iyagaan meesha u joogaa.” Markii wariyuhu weydiiyay mowqifkiisa ku aaddan dadka Somaliland iyo arrinta madaxbannaanida, Xildhibaan Kooshin ayaa ku jawaabay in uu taageersan yahay waxa ay dadkiisu rabaan, isagoo yiri: “Waxay rabaan baan la rabaa.” Xildhibaan Kooshin ayaa kamid ah xubnaha sare ee Golaha Mustaqbalka ee mucaaradka, iyadoo hadalladiisu kusoo beegmayaan xilli ay Soomaaliya ka taagan yihiin doodo siyaasadeed oo la xiriira midnimada dalka, Somaliland iyo mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. items.title: Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye oo Xusaya 15 Sano oo Iskaashi ah+SAWIRO
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya, Xamse Cabdi Barre, ayaa furay munaasabad lagu xusayay 15 sano oo iskaashi iyo xiriir dhow ah oo u dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Jamhuuriyadda Türkiye. Xiriirka labada dal ayaa si weyn u xoogeystay kaddib taageeradii Türkiye ay Soomaaliya siisay xilligii abaartii 2011, waxaana tan iyo xilligaas uu noqday mid kamid ah iskaashiyada ugu muhiimsan ee Soomaaliya la leedahay dalalka caalamka. Munaasabadda waxaa sidoo kale ka qeyb galay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, Cabdisalaam Cabdi Cali, Wasiirka Batroolka iyo Kheyraadka Macdanta, Dahir Shire Maxamed, Wasiirka Caddaaladda iyo Arrimaha Dastuurka, Xasan Macallin, iyo Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha iyo Federaalka, Cali Yuusuf Xoosh. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah, Cabdisalaam Cabdi Cali, ayaa xaqiijiyay sida ay Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay xoojinta iyo sii qotomeynta xiriirka ay la leedahay Türkiye, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ballanqaadeen in iskaashiga loo gudbiyo marxalad cusub. Munaasabadda ayaa lagu xusay 15 sano oo iskaashi, taageero iyo guulo wadajir ah, iyadoo la adkeeyay in xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Türkiye uu sii ahaan doono mid ku dhisan iskaashi, taageero iyo dano labada dhinac ah. items.title: Daawo: Aabe wiilkiisa si arxan darro ah ugu dilay Hargeysa
items.description: Hargeysa (Caasimada Online) – Faah-faahinno dheeraad ah ayaa kasoo baxaya dhacdo argagax leh oo xalay ka dhacday degmada Maxamed Mooge ee magaalada Hargeysa, kadib markii Aabe uu si arxan darro ah halkaasi ugu dilay wiilkiisa oo 10 sano jir ahaa. Qaar kamid ah dadka deegaanka oo la hadlay MM Soomaali TV ayaa ka warbixiyay sida ay wax u dhaceen, iyagoo sheegay inay aad uga argagaxeen falka naxdinta leh ee ka dhacay xaafaddooda. Hooyo Farax oo goobjoog u ahayd dhacdada ayaa sheegtay in wiilka oo lagu magacaabo Cali, uu ku soo daahay masjidka, waxayna tilmaantay in markii uu guriga yimid uu Aabihii, oo aad u caraysnaa gacanta ku dhigay, kadibna uu dhagax ku dilay canugga yar. “Wiilka wuu qabtay wuxuu geliyay labadiisa lugood dhexdooda, kadibna jilbaha ayuu ka saaray xabadka wuxuu watay dhagax oo uu saddex jeer wajiga kaga dhuftay anigu waxay indhaheygu qabteen isaga oo canuga jiidayo wuxuuna dhigay waddada isaga oo saaray dhagax wayn markiiba inankii maskaxda iyo dhulka ayaa isku dhagay,” ayay tiri Hooyo Farax oo kamid ahayd dadka dariska ah. Sidoo kale, oday kamid ah dadka deegaanka ayaa sheegay in Aabaha uu xanuunsanaa, isagoo intaa ku daray in dadka deegaanka ay isugu soo baxeen goobta uu dilku ka dhacay, kadib markii ay ka argagaxeen dhacdada naxdinta leh ee loo geystay wiilka yar. “Meeshaan waxaa ka dhacay arrin murugo leh Aabe wiilkiisii oo 10 jir ah ku dilay, welibasi arxan darro ah, waxaana la yiri waalidkaas waa xanuunsanayay,” ayuu isna yiri odey kamid ah dadka deegaanka. Dhinaca kale, waxaa goobta gaaray ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa ammaanka Somaliland, kuwaas oo la wareegay kiiska, isla markaana bilaabay baaritaan ku aaddan dhacdadaasi oo hadal-heyn xooggan ka dhalisay warbaahinta iyo baraha bulshada. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dhacdadan ayaa si weyn looga hadal hayaa warbaahinta iyo baraha bulshada Soomaalida, iyadoo si weyn loo sugayo natiijada baaritaanka ay wadaan ciidamada Booliska Maamulka Somaliland. The post Daawo: Aabe wiilkiisa si arxan darro ah ugu dilay Hargeysa appeared first on Caasimada Online .
