items.title: NISA Confirms Airstrike on Al-Shabaab Gathering in Middle Shabelle
items.description: MOGADISHU— Somalia’s National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA) has confirmed that an airstrike was carried out in the Fiidow area of Middle Shabelle region, targeting a location where suspected Al-Shabaab members were reportedly holding a meeting. In a statement issued following the operation, NISA said the strike caused casualties among those targeted, but the agency did not provide an official figure for the number of militants killed or wounded. According to NISA, the operation was conducted in coordination with Somalia’s international security partners, who continue to support the Federal Government in aerial operations against Al-Shabaab. Somali security forces are responsible for gathering and providing intelligence on suspected militant positions, which is then used to identify and assess potential targets. Post-strike assessments are subsequently conducted to determine the scale of casualties and damage resulting from such operations. The United States and Türkiye are among Somalia’s international partners providing military and security support, including assistance with aerial operations targeting Al-Shabaab positions. The latest strike comes as Somali security forces, backed by international partners, continue operations aimed at disrupting Al-Shabaab’s command structures, movements and operational capabilities across Middle Shabelle and other parts of the country. items.title: Caddeymo xasaasi ah oo la helay kadib dagaalkii Baydhaba + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Warbixin cusub oo ay daabacday warbaahinta ku hadasha afka dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa waxaa lagu shaaciyay xog xasaasi ah oo la xiriirta dagaalkii Isniintii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale lagu soo bandhigay astaamo muujinayo in weerarkii ciidamada taabacsan Lafta-gareen ku qaadeen magaaladaasi ay ka qayb-qateen maleeshiyaad ka tirsan kooxda Al-Shabaab. Sidoo kale, warbaahinta ayaa baahisay sawirro laga soo qaaday goobta uu dagaalku ka dhacay, waxayna kusoo bandhigtay illaa 4 caddeymood oo waa wayn oo ay ku jiraan gaadiid qaraxyo ka buuxaan oo la adeegsaday iyo naftood-haligayaal ka tirsan Khawaarijta oo la sheegay inay is qarxiyeen. Hoos ka akhriso Warbixinta :- 1. Intii uu weerarku socday, waxaa is-qarxiyey ilaa saddex gaari oo ay wateen naftood-haligayaal ka tirsan Khawaarijta, waxaana goobaha ay isku qarxiyeen laga helay qaybo ka mid ah haraadiga Qaraxyada iyo xubnaha jirka dhagar-qabayaashii nafta is dhaafsiiyay. 2. Weerarka waxaa loo adeegsaday gaadiid lagu rakibay biraha aysan rasaastu karin, waxaana qaar ka mid ah gaadiidkaas loo adeegsaday qarxyada, halka kuwo kalena gacanta lagu dhigay. 3. Qaar ka mid ah gaadiidkii dagaalka ee gacanta lagu dhigay waxaa laga helay agab lagu yaqaan Khawaarijta, sida calankooda iyo walxaha qarxa ee macmalka ah. 4. Khawaarijtu waxay miinooyin ku aaseen waddooyinkii ay magaalada ka soo galeen. Ciidamada ammaanka ayaa miinooyinkaas ogaaday, waxayna ku guulaysteen inay si nabadgelyo leh dhulka uga soo saaraan, iyagoo aan qarxin. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa si cad u sheegtay in tallaabo adag laga qaadi doono maleeshiyaadkii cadowga iyo Khawaarijta naf-la-caariga ah ku soo hoggaamiyey magaalada Baydhabo. Khawaarijta ayaa lagu jabiyey dagaalkii shalay ay la galeen Ciidanka Qaranka iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed, waxaana gacanta lagu dhigay tiro maxaabiis ah oo qorshuhu yahay in cadaaladda la horgeeyo. The post Caddeymo xasaasi ah oo la helay kadib dagaalkii Baydhaba + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: The Economist Acknowledges Shift in Mogadishu’s Security Landscape
items.description: The Economist, a leading international publication that previously described Somalia’s state-building project as “broken” and warned that Mogadishu risked falling to Al-Shabaab, has now published a new report acknowledging significant security improvements in the capital. The report, titled “Mogadishu no longer deserves its deadly reputation,” marks a major shift in the publication’s perspective, with data showing that Al-Shabaab attacks in Mogadishu have declined to unprecedented levels. The new report is significant because it represents a major change in how a prominent international publication views Somalia’s capital, confirming what Somalis have long been saying: that the city is transforming and security is improving. The Economist’s data shows that Al-Shabaab attacks in the capital fell from 144 recorded in the third quarter of 2022 to just 5 in the second quarter of 2026. The decline in attacks has been attributed to security measures including the expansion of CCTV cameras, electronic registration for vehicle checks, and the presence of intelligence officers who have been widely deployed. New construction is rapidly transforming Mogadishu, with the Dahab Tower a 26-storey building containing apartments, a mall, a gym and a mosque expected to open this year. The report begins with an incident from six years ago, highlighting the story of a Mogadishu resident who ventured into the city center one night. The following night, a suicide attack at the same location killed seven civilians. That incident exemplified the security situation at the time, with Mogadishu residents living in constant fear that anywhere they went could become the next target. The security shift is not only about fewer attacks; it also affects how people live in the city and how they experience safety. The Economist’s assessment shows that Mogadishu today is different from what it was just a few years ago. The decline in Al-Shabaab attacks, the revival of urban activity, and the improving sense of security all indicate that the capital is recovering from years of fear and violence. However, the report’s central message is that while Mogadishu is moving away from its reputation as a city of death, maintaining the progress achieved and ensuring lasting security remain the biggest challenges ahead. The post The Economist Acknowledges Shift in Mogadishu’s Security Landscape first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: The Economist oo Daaha Ka Rogtay Isbeddelka Amniga Caasimadda Soomaaliya
items.description: Majalladda caalamiga ah ee The Economist, oo sanadkii hore ku sheegtay in mashruuca dowlad-dhiska Soomaaliya uu yahay mid “burburay” iyo in Muqdisho ay halis ku jirto inay gacanta ku dhacdo Al-Shabaab , ayaa hadda soo saartay warbixin cusub oo aqoonsanaysa horumarka amni ee caasimadda. Warbixintan cusub, oo cinwaankeedu yahay “Mogadishu no longer deserves its deadly reputation” , waxay muujinaysaa isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada aragtida majalladda, iyadoo tirakoobyadu ay caddaynayaan in weerarrada Al-Shabaab ee Muqdisho ay hoos u dhaceen heer aan horay loo arag. Warbixintan cusub waxay muhiim u tahay sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan tahay isbeddel weyn oo ku yimaada aragtida majalladda caalamiga ah, waxayna xaqiijinaysaa waxa ay Soomaalidu muddo dheer sheegaysay: in caasimaddu tahay mid is-beddeleysa oo horumarka amni ka socda. Tirakoobyada The Economist waxay muujinayaan in weerarrada Al-Shabaab ee caasimadda ay hoos u dhaceen 144 weerar oo la duubay rubuci 3aad ee 2022 , ilaa 5 oo keliya rubuci 2aad ee 2026 . Hoos u dhaca weerarrada ayaa loo aaneynayaa tallaabooyin amni oo ay ka mid yihiin fidinta kamaradaha CCTV-ga, diiwaangelinta elektarooniga ah ee baarista baabuurta lamaanaha, iyo joogitaanka saraakiil sirdoon ah oo si weyn loo baahiyay . Dhismaha cusub ayaa si xawli ah uga socda Muqdisho, iyadoo Dahab Tower, oo ah dhisme 26 dabaq ah oo ka kooban guryo, dukaan weyn, jimicsi iyo masaajid, la filayo inuu sanadkan furmo . Warbixintu waxay ku bilowday dhacdo ka dhacday Muqdisho lix sano ka hor, iyadoo soo qaadatay qisada Saakin Abdi, oo ah qof magaalada ku nool oo habeen u-jalaato doontay bartamaha Muqdisho. Habeenki xigay, isla goobti ayaa waxaa ka dhacay weerar ismiidaamin ah oo lagu dilay toddobo qof oo rayid ah . Dhacdadaasi ayaa tusaale u ah xaaladdii amni ee caasimadda xilligaas, iyadoo dadka Muqdisho ay ku noolaayeen cabsi ah in goob kasta oo ay joogaan ay noqon karto bartilmaameed xiga. Isbeddelka amni ma aha oo keliya tirada weerarrada oo yaraatay; wuxuu sidoo kale taabanayaa habka ay dadka ugu nool yihiin magaalada iyo sida ay u dareemaan amniga. Qiimeynta The Economist waxay muujinaysaa in Muqdisho ay maanta ka duwan tahay sidii ay ahayd dhowr sano ka hor. Hoos-u-dhaca weerarrada Al-Shabaab, soo kabashada dhaqdhaqaaqa magaalada iyo dareenka amni ee soo hagaagaya ayaa tilmaamaya in caasimaddu ay ka soo kabanayso sannado badan oo ay hareeyeen cabsi iyo rabshado. Si kastaba, farriinta ugu muhiimsan ee warbixintu waa in Muqdisho ay ka sii fogaanayso sumcad-darradii ahayd magaalada geerida badan, balse ilaalinta horumarka la gaaray iyo xaqiijinta amni waara ayaa weli ah caqabadda ugu weyn ee hortaalla Muqdisho. The post The Economist oo Daaha Ka Rogtay Isbeddelka Amniga Caasimadda Soomaaliya first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Texas teacher cries after high school students fail to write
items.description: Darius Williams, a teacher at Wheatley High School in Houston, Texas, has sparked a nationwide conversation after posting an emotional video of himself crying over his students’ struggles. Williams teaches 17- and 18-year-old seniors, many of whom are able to express themselves clearly in conversation but face significant difficulties when asked to put their thoughts into writing. The incident occurred early in the school year when Williams gave his class a short reading passage followed by a simple writing exercise. Several students struggled to complete the task. What surprised Williams was that the same students could articulate their opinions, engage in debates, and make strong verbal arguments, but when it came to writing, they fell short. After class, Williams recorded himself in tears, speaking about how heartbreaking it was to see students on the verge of graduation still lacking fundamental literacy skills they should have developed years earlier. The video quickly went viral, sparking a much larger conversation about education gaps in the United States. The situation raised an important question: How can students spend more than a decade in school and still reach their final year without mastering basic reading and writing? For Williams, the experience was more than just a classroom challenge; it was a painful reminder of how critical early intervention and support can be. He hopes his video will encourage more discussion about how to better prepare students for the future. The post Texas teacher cries after high school students fail to write first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Xog: Dalkee maal-geliyey ciidanka uu Xasan tababarka ugu soo xiray GALMUDUG
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Xog dheeri ah ayaa ka soo baxeysa tababar ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya u soo xirtay ku dhowaad 3,000 oo askari oo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, kuwaas oo muddo ku dhow hal sano tababar ku qaadanayay xerada Xananbuure ee gobolka Galgaduud. Tirada askarta tababarka dhammeystay ayaa lagu tilmaamay kooxdii ugu ballaarneyd ee heerkan oo kale gudaha Soomaaliya lagu tababaro tan iyo burburkii dowladdii dhexe sanadkii 1991-kii, iyadoo dowladda ay tallaabadan qeyb ka dhigeyso qorshaha dib-u-dhiska ciidamada qaranka. Askarta, oo laga soo kala xulay deegaanno kala duwan oo dalka ah, ayaa muddadii tababarka lagu barayay xeeladaha aasaasiga ah ee dagaalka, anshaxa iyo shuruucda ciidamada, adeegsiga hubka iyo xirfado kale oo muhiim u ah shaqada ciidanka. Tababarka waxaa bixiyay macallimiin militari oo ka kala socday Ukraine, Romania iyo Sudan, waxaana barnaamijka maalgelisay dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya. Barnaamijkan ayaa qeyb ka ah heshiis ay Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudi Carabiya gaareen bishii Febraayo, kaas oo dhigaya in la tababaro ilaa 5,000 oo askari oo Soomaaliyeed. Munaasabadda lagu soo xirayay tababarka waxaa ka qeyb galay madax ka tirsan dowladda federaalka iyo dowlad-goboleedyada, saraakiil ciidan iyo wakiillo ka socday Sacuudi Carabiya oo qeyb ka ahaa la-socodka barnaamijka. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, oo guddoomiyay munaasabadda, ayaa tababarka ciidamada ku tilmaamay astaan muujineysa dib-u-soo-kabashada hay’adaha dowladda iyo dadaalka lagu dhisayo ciidan Soomaaliyeed oo awood u leh inuu dalkiisa difaaco. “Ciidamadani waxay matalayaan soo-kabashada dowladnimada iyo dib-u-dhiska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in awoodda Soomaaliya ay gudaha dalka ugu tababarto tiro badan oo askar ah ay muujineyso horumar laga sameeyay isku-filnaanshaha dhinaca ciidamada. Arrintan ayaa kusoo aadeysa xilli dowladda federaalka ay dooneyso in ciidamada Soomaaliyeed ay si tartiib ah ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda buuxda ee amniga dalka, iyadoo howlgalka ciidamada Midowga Afrika uu wajahayo qorshe dhimis iyo kala-guur ah. Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa sanadihii dambe kordhisay dadaallada lagu tababarayo laguna qalabeynayo ciidamada, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in ciidanka qaranku ay si weyn ula wareegaan howlgallada ka dhanka ah Al-Shabaab iyo sugidda goobaha ay hadda taageerada ka bixiyaan ciidamada shisheeye. Hase yeeshee, dhismaha ciidan tiro iyo tayo leh keliya ma xallinayo caqabadaha muddada dheer haystay ciidamada Soomaaliya. Waxaa weli muhiim ah in dowladda ay joogteyso mushaharka ciidamada, hubka iyo rasaasta safafka hore, sahayda, daryeelka askarta iyo nidaam awood u leh inuu ciidanka tababaran ku sii hayo shaqada. Sidaas darteed, tababarka kumannaanka askari ee Xananbuure wuxuu dowladda u yahay tallaabo weyn oo dhinaca dhismaha ciidamada ah, balse guusha muddada dheer waxay ku xirnaan doontaa sida ciidamadan loo qalabeeyo, loo maareeyo looguna diyaariyo inay si joogto ah ula wareegaan mas’uuliyadda amniga Soomaaliya. items.title: Macallin Texas ah oo ooyay ka dib markii ardayda sare ay wax qori wayeen
items.description: Darius Williams, oo ah macallin ku sugan Dugsiga Sare ee Wheatley ee Houston, ayaa noqday mid ay dadku ka hadlaan ka dib markii uu duubay isaga oo ooyaya, isagoo ka hadlaya sida ay u adag tahay in ardaydiisa 17 iyo 18 jirka ah ay la kulmaan dhibaatooyin aasaasi ah oo ku saabsan akhriska iyo qorista. Williams ayaa sheegay in ardaydiisa ay si fiican u hadli karaan oo ay u sheegi karaan fikradahooda, laakiin marka la weydiiyo inay wax qoraan ay dhibaato weyn la kulmaan . Sheekadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay soo kordhisay dood weyn oo ku saabsan waxbarashada iyo farqiga u dhexeeya ardayda, iyadoo la isweydiinayo sida ay suurtagal u tahay in ardaydu 12 sano ku qaataan dugsiga, balse ay gaadhaan fasalka sare iyagoo weli la kulma dhibaatooyin aasaasi ah oo ku saabsan xirfadaha akhriska iyo qorista. Williams ayaa duubay isaga oo ooyaya, isagoo ka hadlaya sida ay u adag tahay in la arko ardayda ku dhow inay ka qalin jebiyaan dugsiga sare iyagoon haysan xirfadihii la filayey inay horay u yeeshaan . Ardayda qaarkood ayaa la kulmay dhibaatooyin ku saabsan akhriska iyo qorista, inkastoo ay si fiican u hadli karaan oo ay u sheegi karaan fikradahooda . Tani waxay muujinaysaa in ay jiraan caqabado ku saabsan sida ardayda loo baro xirfadaha aasaasiga ah, iyo in ay jiraan farqi u dhexeeya hadalka iyo qoraalka. Williams, oo macallin ka ah dugsiga Wheatley, ayaa sheegay in dhacdadani ay ka dhigtay mid ka duwan caqabadaha fasalka, waxaanay u ahayd xasuusin murugo leh oo ku saabsan muhiimadda ay leedahay in la helo taageero iyo faragelin hore. Wuxuu rajaynayaa in muqaalkiisa uu dadka ugu dhiirrigeliyo inay ka wada hadlaan sida waxbarashada looga dhigi karo mid loo dhan yahay oo arday kasta u diyaarsa . The post Macallin Texas ah oo ooyay ka dib markii ardayda sare ay wax qori wayeen first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Muqdisho oo laga xusayo 15 sano guuradii ka soo wareegtay markii uu dib u xoogaystay xariika Soomaaliya iyo Turkigu ?
items.description: Munaasabad ballaaran oo lagu xusayo dib u curashadii xariirka istiraatiijiga ah ee Soomaaliya  iyo Turkiga oo hadda jirsaday 15 sano oo xiriir iyo iskaashi diblomaasiyadeed oo qoto dheer ah  ayaa ka dhacday magaalada Muqdisho, iyadoo ay ka qeyb galeen mas’uuliyiin sare oo ka tirsan dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, saraakiil iyo diblomaasiyiin ka socday dowladda Turkiga. Munaasabadda ayaa lagu soo bandhigay taariikhda xiriirka labada dal iyo waxqabadkii ka dhashay iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga muddadii 15-ka sano ahayd ee lasoo dhaafay. Xiriirka labada dal ayaa si weyn dib ugu soo xoogaystay 2011-kii, xilli Soomaaliya ay wajahaysay xaalad bani’aadannimo oo aad u adag, oo ay ka jireen abaaro ba’an iyo dagaallo, gaar ahaan dagaalladii u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo Al-Shabaab ee ka socday qeybo ka mid ah magaalada Muqdisho. Xilligaas, Soomaaliya waxaa hoggaaminayay dowladdii KMG ahayd ee uu madaxweynaha ka ahaa Shariif Sheekh Axmed, iyadoo Turkigu uu noqday mid ka mid ah dalalkii si weyn uga jawaabay xaaladda Soomaaliya. Madaxweyne Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ayaa sannadkii 2011 soo booqday Muqdisho, booqashadaas oo loo arkay mid muhiim u ahayd dib-u-soo-nooleynta xiriirka labada dal iyo muujinta taageerada Turkiga ee Soomaaliya xilli dalka uu ku jiray xaalad adag. Muddooyinkii lasoo dhaafay, iskaashiga Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga wuxuu ku fiday dhinacyo kala duwan, oo ay ka mid yihiin gargaarka bani’aadannimo, horumarinta dhaqaalaha, amniga, waxbarashada, caafimaadka iyo tababarka ciidamada Soomaaliyeed. Turkiga ayaa door muuqda ku leh tababarka iyo dhismaha awoodda ciidamada Soomaaliya, iyadoo Ankara ay tababartay cutubyo ka tirsan ciidamada Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin ciidamada Gorgor, oo door ka qaatay howlaha amniga iyo la-dagaallanka Al-Shabaab. Mas’uuliyiintii ka hadlay munaasabadda ayaa xusay in xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiga uu ka gudbay iskaashi diblomaasiyadeed oo keliya, isla markaana uu noqday xiriir ku dhisan saaxiibtinimo, walaaltinimo iyo iskaashi istiraatiiji ah. Turkiga ayaa sidoo kale Muqdisho ku leh safaarad iyo xarumo kala duwan oo ka shaqeeya xoojinta xiriirka labada dal, halka Soomaaliya iyo Turkiguna ay sannadihii dambe kordhiyeen iskaashiga dhinacyada siyaasadda, amniga iyo horumarinta.

items.title: NISA oo howlgal ka dhan ah Al-Shabaab ka fulisay deegaanka Fidow
items.description: Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabad Sugidda Qaranka Soomaaliyeed (NISA), iyadoo taageero ka heleysa saaxiibbo caalami ah, ayaa sheegtay inay howlgal qorshaysan ka fulisay deegaanka Fidow ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. Sida lagu sheegay war kasoo baxay NISA, howlgalka ayaa lagu bartilmaameedsaday guri ay hay’addu sheegtay in xubno ka tirsan Al-Shabaab ay ku dhuumaaleysanayeen, ayadoo NISA ay sheegtay in xubnihii ku jiray guriga lagu dilay howlgalka. Hay’addu faahfaahin dheeraad ah kama bixin tirada dadka lagu dilay howlgalka, cidda ay ahaayeen ama nooca taageerada ay ka heshay saaxiibbada caalamiga ah.

items.title: Dowladda Federaalka oo ciidamo hor leh u daabushay Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Wararka ka imanaya waqooyiga Gobolka Galgaduud ayaa sheegaya in cutubyo ka tirsan ciidamadii tababarka loogu soo xiray Dugsiga Tababarka Ciidamada ee Xananbuure ay Dowladda Federaalka u dhaqaajisay jiidda hore ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Ciidamadan oo loogu talagalay inay la dagaalamaan maleeshiyada ayaa waxaa Axaddii tababarka u soo xiray Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in ciidamada ka qalabka qaatay Xerada Militariga Xananbuure ay ka qayb qaadanayaan hawlgalka militari ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan ee lagu xoreynayo dhulka ka maqan gacanta qaranka. Dhaqaaqooda cusub ayaa wuxuu ku aaddan yahay xoojinta guluf ballaaran oo ka dhan ah maleeshiyada Al Shabaab, iyagoo taageeraya ciidamadii maalmahaanba ku sugnaa duleedka deegaanka Teedaan. Wararka ayaa intaasi ku daraya in Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud oo tan iyo Jimcihii ku sugan deegaanada Galmudug ay ka go’an tahay in ciidamadu ay dib ugu laabtaan Teedaan, oo ay ka soo baxeen 2-dii bishan, markaas oo ay Al Shabaab la wareegtay. Sarkaal ka tirsan Saraakiisha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo codsaday inaanan magaciisa Warbaahinta loo adeegsan ayaa inoo sheegay in qorshaha la dejiyay uu yahay inay ciidamadu sidoo kale xoreeyaan Degmooyinka Maxaas iyo Moqokori. Shabaabka ayaa dagaalo culus 7-dii iyo 27-kii bishii July ee sanadkii 2025 ku qabsaday Moqokori iyo Maxaas. Gobolka Hiiraan ayaa ah meesha ay hadda dhaqdhaqaaqa ugu xoogan ka wadaan Ciidamada Militariga iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka.

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka BJFS oo kulan la yeeshay Safiirka Sacuudiga ee Soomaaliya
items.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa xafiiskiisa kulan kula qaatay Safiirka Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ahmed Mohammed Almowallad. Kulanka ayaa diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xiriirka iyo iskaashiga ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Boqortooyada Sacuudi Carabiya, iyadoo labada dhinac ay ka wada hadleen xiriirka soo jireenka ah iyo walaaltinimada labada dal. Safiirka Sacuudiga ayaa ugu horreyn Guddoomiye Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur ugu hambalyeeyey doorashadiisa xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ee BJFS, isagoo u rajeeyey inuu si wanaagsan uga soo baxo waajibaadka loo igmaday. Dhinaca kale, Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka ayaa dowladda Sacuudi Carabiya uga mahadceliyey taageerada joogtada ah ee ay la garab taagan tahay dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Kulanka ayaa sidoo kale muujiyey muhiimadda ay labada dhinac siinayaan sii xoojinta xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed, walaaltinimo iyo iskaashi ee Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudi Carabiya, kaas oo muddo dheer soo jiray.

items.title: Wasiir FIQI oo si kulul ugu jawaabay mucaaradka DF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya, Mudane Axmed Macallin Fiqi ayaa si kulul ugu jawaabay xubnaha mucaaradka ee Madasha Samatabixinta Soomaaliyeed, kuwaas oo shalay shir jaraa’id oo ka dhan ah dowladda ku qabtay hoteelka Jasiira ee magaalada Muqdisho. Mucaaradka aya si weyn u dhaliilay sida ay wax u waddo dowladda, gaar ahaan arrimaha doorashooyinka iyo howlaha burburinta ee weli ka socda caasimada. Wasiir Fiqi oo inta badan difaaca xukuumadda uu ka tirsan yahay, ayaa si dadban ugu jawaabay mucaaradka, isagoo adeegsaday sheeko uu ka sheegay isbitaalka Laasareeti ee lagu daryeelo dadka qaba xanuunnada dhimmirka. Fiqi ayaa sheegay in xubnaha Madasha ay toddobaadyadii lasoo dhaafay aamusnaayeen, balse ay hadda dib u bilaabeen catowgoodii, isaga oo tilmaamay inay u baahan yihiin daawada dhabta ah oo uu ku sheegay doorasho qof iyo cod ah. “Madasha calaacalka dhowrkii todobaad ee la soo dhaafay waa aasmunaayeen waxaa loo qaatay in ay soo bogsanayaan, balse ha iska boodboodaan, waxaa la gaari doonaa mar ay daawada dhabta ah qaataan taasoo ah “doorasho qof iyo cod ah,” ayuu yiri Wasiir Axmed Macallin Fiqi. Hoos ka akhriso qoraalka oo dhammaystiran;- Kooxdii madasha Calaacalka oo shidaal lagu soo shubay oo waxaan arkay Shalay galab catowgii dib u bilowday. Waxaa la iiga sheekeeyey sheekooyin ka dhacay isbitaalkii Laasareeti ee lagu daryeeli jiray dadka xanuunka dhimirka qaba!. Waqti waqtiyada ka mid ah ayaa waxaa soo booqday Dhakhtar wasaaradda caafimaadka ka socday ayadoo markii loogu warbixiyay in bukaanadii intoodii badnayd soo bogsanayaan, waxaana la galiyay qol lagu soo uruuriyay intoodii ugu fiicnayd, oo ay ku jireen koox bukaanno ah, waxay isla markiiba dhakhtarkii indhihiisu qabteen saddex nin oo waalan oo boodboodaya. Wuxuu weydiiyey kii koowaad: Maxaad u boodboodaysaa? Wuxuu yiri: Waxaan ahay Rah. Kii labaad ayuu weydiiyey: — Adiguna? Wuxuu asna ku jawaabay: — Aniguna Rah ayaan ahay. Markaas ayuu weydiiyay kii saddexaad: — Adiguna Rah miyaad tahay? Wuxuu yiri:— Maya, anigu waxaan ahay dhakhtar! Dhakhtarkii ayaa farxay oo yiri: — Ugu dambayn qof miyir qaba ayaan helay! Ninkii saddexaad ayaa hal mar la soo booday: — Haa waa aniga kaas, oo waxaan sugayaa inta ay labadan Rah boodboodka ka dhammeysanayaan si aan warqadda daawada ugu qoro! Madasha calaacalka dhowrkii todobaad ee la soo dhaafay waa aasmunaayeen waxaa loo qaatay in ay soo bogsanayaan, balse ha iska boodboodaan, waxaa la gaari doonaa mar ay daawada dhabta ah qaataan taasoo ah “doorasho qof iyo cod ah”. The post Wasiir FIQI oo si kulul ugu jawaabay mucaaradka DF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Sheekh Shariif oo sheegay cidda qaadaysa mas’uuliyadda dagaalkii Baydhaba + Video
items.description: Baydhaba (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynihii hore ee dowladdii ku-meel-gaarka ahayd, Sheekh Shariif Sheekh Axmed, ayaa si adag uga hadlay dagaalkii Isniintii ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba ee xarunta Gobolka Baay, kaas oo u dhexeeyay ciidamada dowladda iyo kuwa taabacsan Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed Soomaaliya, Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Lafta-gareen). Sheekh Shariif ayaa wax laga xumaado ku tilmaamay dagaallada soo noqnoqday ee ka dhacay magaalada Baydhaba, oo ah xarunta ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Dowlad-goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, wuxuuna tacsi u diray ehellada iyo qoysaska dadkii ku dhintay dagaalkii Isniintii, isaga oo sidoo kale caafimaad deg-deg ah u rajeeyay dadka ku dhaawacmay. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynihii hore ee dalka ayaa mas’uuliyadda wixii ka dhacay Baydhaba dusha uga tuuray Dowladda Federaalka, isaga oo ku eedeeyay inay si khaldan u maareysay isbeddelkii siyaasadeed ee ka dhacay magaaladaas, taas oo uu sheegay inay horseedday xaaladda adag ee maanta taagan. “Baydhaba dad ayaa ku dhintay, dad ayaa qaxay, kuwo kalena waa dhaawacmeen. Mas’uuliyaddee waxaas ku dhacayaan? Mas’uuliyadda dowladda ayay ku dhacayaan. Isbeddel haddii la sameynayo, waxaa la sameyn karay isbeddel heshiis lagu yahay oo dadku ay aqbaleen,” ayuu yiri Sheekh Shariif. Waxaa kale oo uu sii raaciyay, “Reer Koonfur Galbeed inaan isha ka fiirsanno oo aan ka aamusno waa dadnimo xumo, waana ogtihiin inaan ka dignay.” Dhinaca kale, waxa uu soo hadal qaaday khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ka taagan hannaanka doorashooyinka dalka, isaga oo tilmaamay in ilaa iyo hadda aan laga gaarin wax heshiis ah oo ay dhinacyada siyaasadda iyo Dowladda Federaalku si wadajir ah ugu qancaan. Sheekha ayaa sidoo kale eedeymo u jeediyay dowladda dhexe, gaar ahaan sida ay u wajahayso doorashooyinka ka socda qaar ka mid ah Dowlad-goboleedyada dalka. Waxa uu sheegay in Dowladda Federaalku aysan si siman ula dhaqmin dhinacyada siyaasadda, isaga oo su’aal geliyay habka ay dowladdu u maareyneyso doorashooyinka dalka. “Doorashada quruxdeedu waa heshiis. Haddii aan heshiis la ahayn, doorasho kasta oo la sheego macno ma sameyneyso. Laaluushka waagii hore ma gaari jirin baadiyaha. Codka meeqo ayaa la kala gadanayay markii ugu dambeysay? 50 doollar. Sow xaaraan looma geyn dadkaasi?” ayuu mar kale yiri Sheekh Shariif. The post Sheekh Shariif oo sheegay cidda qaadaysa mas’uuliyadda dagaalkii Baydhaba + Video appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Qatar Charity Empowers Needy Families Economically In Somalilan
items.description: MENAFN – Gulf Times) With the support of philanthropists, Qatar Charity (QC), in co-operation with Somaliland’s ministry of employment, social affairs and family, delivered economic empowerment projects benefiting 113 persons from the most vulnerable groups in Hargeisa. The initiative is part of the QC’s development efforts to promote sustainable livelihoods, reduce unemployment, and support self-reliance among low-income families. The distributed projects, which included clothing shops, grocery stores selling food supplies and vegetables, fish and seafood marketing ventures, taxis, motorcycles, three-wheeled vehicles, and barber shops, were selected following an assessment of beneficiaries’ needs and local market requirements to enhance their prospects for success and sustainability. Somaliland’s Minister of Employment, Social Affairs and Family Milgo Mohamed Elmi lauded the project and its role in supporting needy families and strengthening economic and social stability. She affirmed that economic empowerment initiatives are among the most effective solutions for addressing the livelihood challenges faced by many unemployed or low-income families, and added that empowering 113 male and female beneficiaries at this stage reflects the importance of partnership between government institutions and humanitarian and development organisations. Elmi also commended Qatar Charity’s efforts to implement projects with sustainable impact, contributing to building beneficiaries’ capacities and enabling them to become self-reliant in securing their livelihoods. Abdulfattah Adam Moalim, the director of the QC office in Somalia, affirmed that the project embodies Qatar Charity’s commitment to promoting self-sufficiency and supporting the most vulnerable groups through development projects that provide stable sources of income and open new prospects for beneficiaries to build a better future. He said that women, particularly female breadwinners and mothers of orphans, accounted for a large proportion of the project’s beneficiaries. Kaysi Barkhad Abdi, beneficiary of a men’s barber shop project, said:“I had been unemployed for a long time and was looking for an opportunity that would enable me to provide for my family’s needs.” “Today, I feel that I have begun a new chapter in my life after receiving this project,” Abdi said.“I extend my thanks to Qatar Charity and the generous donors for this opportunity, which has given me hope and confidence in the future.”

items.title: Faa’iidada la ogaaday ee uu leeyahay koobka shaaha ah ee aad ka tuurto maalintii
items.description: Daraasad cusub oo la sameeyay ayaa daaha ka qaadday in cabbitaanka koob shaaha ah ama kafee ah maalin kasta ay kaa ilaalin karto da’da, sidoo kalena ay ka hortagi karto daciifnimada jirka iyo gabowga. Sida uu daabacay wargeyska The Telegraph ee ka soo baxa Ingiriiska, daraasaddan waxaa sameeyay koox ka socotay Jaamacadda Qaranka ee Singapore, waxaana ka qayb qaatay 12,000 oo qof, oo da’doodu u dhaxayso 45 ilaa 74 jir, kuwaas oo shaah cabayey muddo 20 sano ah. Ka qaybgalayaasha Daraasadda ee da’doodu ay tahay celcelis ahaan 53, jir ayaa la waydiiyay sida cabitaanka shaaha iyo qaxwaha u caawiyay iyo awoodda ay ka helaan marka ay cabaan . Sid0o kale dadka da’doodu gaadhay 73 jir ayaa waxa la waydiiyay su’aalo la xariira shaaha iyo kaalinta uu ka qaatay xoojinta jirka iyo awoodda . Cilmi-barayaashu waxay sheegeen in ay jiraan dhawr arrimood oo muujinaya qofka la ildaran tabar-darrida jireed oo ah mid da’ ay keentay, miisaanka oo yaraada, daal, gaabiska socodka , iyo daciifnimada murqaha kuwaas oo dhaaman shaahu xoojin karo. Cilmi baaristu waxay muujiyeen in 84 boqolkiiba ka qaybgalayaashu ay sheegeen in ay si joogto ah u cabbaan kafeega, halka 12 boqolkiiba ay sheegeen in ay cabbeen shaaha. In ka badan saddex-meelood laba oo ah (68.5 boqolkiiba) waxay tilmaameen in ay cabaan maalinkii hal koob kafeega ah , halka 42.2 boqolkiiba ay cabaan laba ilaa saddex koob maalintii, ayada oo 4.9 boqolkiiba ay cabbaan 4 koob ama ka badan maalintii. Natiijooyinka waxay muujiyeen in cabbitaanka kafeega ama shaaha ee da’da dhexe qofka ku jira ay waxtar u leedahay, waxaana daraasadda lagu sheegay in kafeega uu aad u wanaagsan yahay marka labadooda la is barbardhigo. Daraasadan la daabacay ayaa xaqiijisay in cabbitaanka laba ilaa saddex koob oo kafee ah maalin kasta ay si weyn u dheerayn karto nolosha qofka .Dadka ku nool daafaha caalamka ayaa cabayay shaaha iyo kafeega kumanaan qarni ka hor iyagoo u arka inuu wanaagsan yahay. Daraasado badan ayaa muujiyay in shaaha uu kaalin mug leh ka qaato habka difaaca jirka, la dagaalanka caabuqyada sababa bararka, xanuunada kansarka iyo wadna xanuunka.Khubarada cuntada ee dalka Maraykanka ayaa horay shaaca uga qaaday in Shaaha uu jirka u leeyahay faa’iido caafimaad oo ay ka mid tahay korriinka jirka. items.title: Walaac cusub oo dhinaca amniga oo ka jira Magaalada Baydhabo
items.description: Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa waxaa ka jira guux ku saabsan in xoogaga taageersan Madaxweyne Cabdicasiis Xasan Maxamed (Laftagareen) ay markan weerarada ka abaabuli karaan gudaha magaaladaasi, ka dib weerarkii xooganaa ee Isniintii ay ku soo qaadeen magaalada. Dadka ku nool magaalada ayaa waxay ka cabsi qabaan in weeraro kale laga abaabulo gudaha magaalada. Cabsidan ayaa timid, ka dib dagaalkii cuslaa ee maalin ka hor ka dhacay bartamaha magaalada, iyadoo aan gudaha Baydhabo laga samayn hawlgal sifayn ah. Ciidamada magaalada soo weeraray ayaa Baydhabo ka soo galay hal jiho, balse markii laga saarayay bartamaha magaaladaasi ayay uga baxeen jihooyin kala duwan, kuwaas oo qaarkood la tuhunsan yahay in ay weli ku sugan yihiin magaalada. Weerarku wuxuu ahaa mid ka xoogan weerarkii ay sidaan oo kale 30-kii bishii May gudaha ugu soo galeen magaalada, marka aad eegto saacadaha uu socday iyo khasaaraha nafeed ee uu gaystay. Taageereyaasha Laftagareen ee Isniintii isku soo fidiyay magaalada ayaa isugu jiray ciidamo ka tirsanaa Daraawiishta Koonfur Galbeed iyo maleeshiyaad ku heyb ah Laftagareen, inkastoo Wasaaradda Gaashaandhiga ay sheegtay in ciidamo daacad u ah Madaxweynihii hore ee Koonfur Galbeed iyo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ay si wadajir ah u soo weerareen magaalada. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijiyay in weerarka laga soo qaaday bannaanka magaalada, isla-markaana ay ku lug lahaayeen maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Dadka reer Baydhabo ayaa walaac ka muujinaya in ciidamada hubeysan ee la tuhunsan yahay inay ku sugan yihiin magaalada ay ka sameeyaan qalqalgelin amni. Dadku waxay ka welwelsan yihiin inaanu amnigu ahayn mid sugan, isla-markaana aan hal dhinac gacanta ugu jirin, taasna ay halis ku tahay ammaankooda iyo in si nabad ah loogu noolaado magaalada. Baydhabo ayaa waxaa ka socdo kulamo looga hadlayo ammaanka iyo suurtagalnimada in la qaado tallaabooyin dheeraad ah oo lagu xasillinayo magaalada. Magaalada Baydhabo ayaa waxaa ku sugan shan nooc oo ka tirsan Ciidamada Dowladda Federaalka, oo kala ah Gorgor, Polizia Militare, Haramcad, NISA iyo Ciidanka Guutada 8aad, Qaybta 60aad ee Xoogga Dalka. Ciidamadan ayaa waxaa magaalada ku wehlinaya ciidamo kale oo ka tirsan kuwa Dowlad Goboleedka Koonfur Galbeed, oo isugu jira Booliska iyo Nabad Sugidda Baydhabo, Birmadka iyo Ciidanka Daraawiishta. Is bedelka siyaasadeed iyo amni ee ay Dowladda Federaalka 30-kii bishii March ka sameysay Baydhabo ayaa magaalada ku soo kordhiyay dhacdooyin amni darro. Dowladda Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo khilaaf siyaasadeed uu kala dhexeeyay Ex Madaxweyne Laftagareen ayaa maamulkiisii ka saartay Baydhabo, taas oo keentay in magaaladu gasho xiisado amni, iska horimaadyo hubeysan iyo cabsi soo wajahday dadka shacabka ah.

items.title: Waa dalkee dalka aqbalay 1200 00 qof oo laga masaafurinaayo dalka Maraykanka?
items.description: Liberia waxay oggolaatay inay qaabisho ilaa 1,200 qof oo laga masaafurinayo Maraykanka, kuwaas oo aan asal ahaan u dhalan Liberia, muddo hal sano ah. Tani waxay ka mid tahay heshiisyada ugu waaweyn ee noocan ah, iyadoo Maraykanku sii adkaynayo siyaasaddiisa ka dhanka ah socdaalka sharci-darrada ah. Dadka la keenayo waxay ka iman doonaan Afrika, Waqooyiga Ameerika, Koonfurta Ameerika iyo Kariibiyaanka. Kooxdii ugu horreysay oo ka kooban 20 qof ayaa la filayaa inay Liberia gaaraan Khamiista. Mas’uuliyiinta Liberia waxay sheegeen in dadkaas la baaray ka hor intaan la keenin, waxaana la sheegay in badankoodu ay galeen xadgudubyo la xiriira sharciga socdaalka. Dadka la keenayo waxay sidoo kale heli doonaan fursad ay magangelyo uga codsadaan Liberia, ama ay dalka uga baxaan haddii ay doonayaan. Dowlado kale oo Afrikaan ah ayaa iyaguna hore u bilaabay inay qaabilaan dad Maraykanku masaafurinayo oo aan si sharci ah loogu celin karin dalalkoodii.

items.title: Somalia ex-president blames govt for Baidoa bloodshed that left 30 dead
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Somalia’s former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed on Tuesday placed sole responsibility for the deadly fighting in Baidoa on the federal government of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, arguing that the violence was the direct consequence of a change of power imposed by force in Southwest State this past March. Sharif, addressing the escalating crisis in the regional capital, described Monday’s clashes as unfortunate and said they represented something that he, fellow opposition figures, and any person of sound conscience could never stop condemning. The former head of state said his objections to the federal government’s handling of Southwest State were neither new nor selective. He recalled that he had opposed Mogadishu’s move to extend the tenure of regional state leaders, including that of Southwest’s former president, Abdiaziz Laftagaren, and had likewise objected when federal authorities subsequently used force to remove Laftagaren’s administration and install a leadership of their own choosing in the region. Addressing President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud directly, Sharif appealed for restraint and reconciliation. Whatever has been done, he said, whether right or wrong, the moment has come to return to the table of dialogue before it becomes too late – before the country fragments to a point beyond recovery. Death Toll and Clashes The fighting in Baidoa left at least 30 people dead, the overwhelming majority of them combatants drawn from federal government troops on one side and forces loyal to ousted Southwest State leader Abdiaziz Laftagaren on the other. Fighters loyal to Laftagaren briefly seized parts of the town before being driven out in a federal counter-attack on Monday. Disputed Government Claims In the aftermath of the clashes, the federal government displayed dead bodies and detainees it said it had captured from forces opposing it, along with what it described as captured military vehicles. Officials characterized those killed and captured as members of Al-Shabaab. However, the government has so far produced no independent evidence to substantiate that claim. Former local officials in Baidoa who reviewed the images of the dead and detained said they recognized the individuals as fighters belonging to Laftagaren’s Darwish forces, the paramilitary units that had served under his administration, rather than as members of the Al-Qaeda-linked militant group. The government also presented the burned wreckage of a vehicle, which it said was evidence of a suicide car bombing carried out during the assault. Somali Guardian could not independently verify this claim, and the evidence presented falls short of establishing it conclusively. Separately, media reports circulating in the early hours of Monday’s attack indicated that a federal military base on the outskirts of Baidoa had come under assault, with a number of government vehicles at the site set ablaze during the fighting. This raises the possibility that the charred wreckage displayed by authorities originated from the government’s own vehicles lost in the battle, rather than from a militant-detonated car bomb – a discrepancy that has not been addressed, and no additional physical evidence of a suicide bombing, such as blast-pattern debris consistent with an explosive-laden vehicle, has been produced. Election Model Under Fire Sharif also turned his criticism toward the federal government’s approach to regional elections, likening its process to results predetermined and delivered by a single individual rather than shaped through genuine competition – a model, he said, that cannot be accepted. He pointed to the recent elections held in Southwest State and Galmudug as examples, alleging that authorities had extended patterns of corruption into rural areas, offering individual voters payments of $50 in exchange for their votes. Such a process, he asked, could not reasonably be called an election. The former president said the essence and beauty of any credible election lies in its being agreeable to all sides and genuinely inclusive. Where those qualities are absent, he said, the exercise cannot be regarded as an election at all. He called on the federal government to reach a negotiated settlement with other political stakeholders over the country’s unresolved electoral disputes. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Ajnabi ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab oo u soo gacan galay dowladda
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga Xukuumadda Soomaaliya oo war-saxaafadeed soo saartay ayaa sheegtay inuu u soo gacan galay dagaalyahan ajnabi ah oo ka tirsanaa maleeshiyaadka kooxda Al-Shabaab ee ka dagaallanta gudaha Soomaaliya. Qoraalka ayaa lagu sheegay in ninkan oo u dhashay qowmiyadda Oromada ee dalka Itoobiya uu isku soo dhiibay ciidamada deegaanka Quracjoome ee gobolka Bakool, kadib markii uu ka soo goostay Al-Shabaab. Ninkan oo wareysi bixiyay ayaa magaciisa ku sheegay Mufti, balse waxaa kooxda looga dhex yaqaannay Cumar, isaga oo sheegay in muddo 4 sano ah uu ka tirsanaa maleeshiyaadka kooxda, kana dagaallamayay gudaha dalka Soomaaliya. “Waxaa ciidamada deegaanka Quracjoome ee gobolka Bakool isku soo dhiibay mid ka mid ah argagixisada ajnabiga ah ee Khawaarijtu si sharci-darro ah dalka ugu soo gelisay. Ninkan oo ka soo jeeda qowmiyadda Oromada ee dalka Itoobiya, magaciisana ku sheegay Mufti, ayaa markii uu Soomaaliya soo galay loo bixiyay magaca Cumar, wuxuuna muddo 4 sano iyo bil ah ka tirsanaa kooxda Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Al-Shabaab ayaa ajaaniibta dalka ku soo gelisa marin-habaabin iyo been-abuur ku saabsan diinta Islaamka, taas oo xubnaha ka mid noqda kooxda ku noqota layaab marka ay arkaan dhaqanka iyo ficillada ka baxsan diinta Islaamka iyo dhaqanka bini’aadamka, sida ay sheegtay Wasaaradda Gaashaandhigga. Waxaa kale oo ay intaas ku sii dartay: “Arrintaas ayaa mararka qaar keenta inay kooxda ka soo baxsadaan, iskuna soo dhiibaan ciidamada dowladda, ama ay kooxdu disho marka ay ogaato inay doonayaan inay isaga baxaan.” Muddooyinkii u dambeeyay, dowladda Soomaaliya iyo saaxiibada caalamiga ah ayaa kordhiyay howlgallada lagu beegsanayo argagixisada, taas oo keentay inay culays dareemaan maleeshiyaadka kooxda, oo qaarkood horay isugu soo dhiibay Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka. Is-dhiibidda ninkan ayaa sidoo kale ku soo beegmeysa xilli gobolka Bakool uu weli ka mid yahay meelaha Al-Shabaab ay saameynta ku leedahay, gaar ahaan dhulka miyiga ah iyo qaar ka mid ah waddooyinka isku xira degmooyinka gobolka. items.title: Imaaraadka oo joojiyay ganacsiga iyo macaamilka Iiraan, ka dib weerar lagu eedeeyay Tehran
items.description: Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa ku dhawaaqday in si ku-meel-gaar ah loo hakiyay dhammaan is-weydaarsiga ganacsi iyo macaamilka maaliyadeed ee kala dhexeeya Iiraan, iyadoo tallaabadan lagu sheegay inay socon doonto ilaa amar dambe. Wakaaladda wararka rasmiga ah ee Imaaraadka, WAM, ayaa sheegtay in go’aanka uu ku dhawaaqay agaasimaha isgaarsiinta istiraatiijiga ah ee Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Imaaraadka. Ilaa hadda, dowladda Imaaraadku ma aysan bixin faahfaahin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan muddada iyo shuruudaha lagu joojinayo tallaabadan. Go’aanka ayaa yimid saacado kadib markii Wasaaradda Difaaca Imaaraadka ay sheegtay in nidaamyada difaaca dalka ay ogaadeen laba gantaal oo ballistic ah oo laga soo riday Iran, kuwaas oo lagu tilmaamay inay bartilmaameedsanayeen maraakiibta iyo isu-socodka badda. Xiisadda u dhexeysa Iiraan iyo dalalka gobolka ayaa sare u kacday kaddib markii Mareykanka iyo Israel ay qaadeen weerarro wadajir ah oo ka dhan ah Iiraan. Tehran ayaa iyaduna kaga jawaabtay oo beenisay weerarkaas lagu qaaday goobo ku yaalla dalal gobolka ah, oo uu Imaaraadku ka mid yahay, iyadoo dalkaasi martigeliyo xarumo iyo hanti militari oo Mareykanku leeyahay.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh: Soomaaliya waxay u baahan tahay in loo gudbo doorasho qof iyo cod ah
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa si faahfaahsan uga hadlay marxaladihii kala duwanaa ee ay soo martay doorashada Soomaaliya iyo qorshaha dowladda federaalka ee ku aaddan in dalka loo gudbiyo nidaamka doorashada qof iyo cod. Madaxweynaha oo khudbad ka jeediyay munaasabad lagu qabtay magaalada Gaalkacyo ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya muddo ku dhow labaatan sano ay ku soo jirtay nidaam doorasho dadban, kaas oo uu tilmaamay inuu lahaa caqabado iyo xaddidaadyo siyaasadeed. Waxa uu sheegay in dalka laga soo maray heerar kala duwan oo doorasho, kuwaas oo ay ka mid ahaayeen xulista odayaasha dhaqanka, soo xulista xildhibaannada iyo nidaamyo kale oo tirada dadka doorashada ka qeybgalaya si tartiib ah loo kordhiyay. Madaxweynaha ayaa xusay in markii hore odayaasha dhaqanku ay door weyn ku lahaayeen soo xulista baarlamaanka, iyadoo markii dambe nidaamkaas loo beddelay hab ay tiro kooban oo ka mid ah beelaha u matalaan xulista xildhibaannada. Sidoo kale, waxa uu sheegay in marxaladihii dambe la ballaariyay tirada dadka ka qeybqaadanaya doorashada, iyadoo lagu daray boqolaal qof oo magaalooyinka ka qeybgalaya habka xulashada. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in horumarradaas ay ahaayeen tallaabooyin lagu doonayay in si tartiib ah loogu gudbo nidaam doorasho oo shacabka si toos ah uga qeybqaataan. Madaxweynaha ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in hadda loo baahan yahay in dadaalka dowladda iyo hay’adaha siyaasadda lagu saleeyo hirgelinta doorasho qof iyo cod ah, taas oo uu ku tilmaamay tallaabada xigta ee loo baahan yahay in Soomaaliya qaaddo. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in nidaamka doorashooyinka dadban uu muddo dheer dalka ka jiray, balse uu leeyahay caqabado ay muhiim tahay in laga gudbo, iyadoo la raadinayo hannaan doorasho oo shacabka si toos ah ugu lug yeeshaan. Hadalka Madaxweynaha ayaa ku soo beegmaya xilli doorashada iyo qaabka loo maareynayo doorashada soo socota ay ka mid yihiin arrimaha ugu waaweyn ee siyaasadda Soomaaliya, iyadoo ay jiraan kala aragti duwanaansho u dhexeeya dowladda federaalka, dowlad-goboleedyada iyo qaar ka mid ah dhinacyada siyaasadda. Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ku adkeysanaysa in doorashada qof iyo cod ay tahay waddada lagu xoojin karo ka qeybgalka shacabka iyo hannaanka dimuqraadiyadeed, halka dhinacyo siyaasadeed ay weli ka qabaan walaacyo la xiriira waqtiga, habka loo hirgelinayo iyo heshiiska siyaasadeed ee loo baahan yahay.

items.title: Trump oo sheegay inaysan jirin wax wada-hadal ah oo u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iraan
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay in aysan hadda jirin wax wada-hadal ama qorshe wada-hadal oo u dhexeeya Mareykanka iyo Iiraan, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan khilaafaadka ku saabsan mustaqbalka marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Hormuz. Trump ayaa qoraal uu soo dhigay baraha bulshada ku sheegay in aysan jirin wax wada-hadal ah oo socda ama loo qorsheeyay oo u dhexeeya Washington iyo Tehran. Waxa uu sidoo kale sheegay in xannibaadda ciidamada badda ee lagu hayo dekedaha Iiraan ay weli socato, halka uu ku adkeystay in Marinka Hormuz uu furan yahay oo shaqeynayo. Hadalkan ayaa ka duwanaa sheegashadii Trump ee maalin ka hor, markaas oo uu sheegay in Mareykanku uu waday wada-hadallo dadban oo lala lahaa Ciidanka Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan (IRGC), ayadoo Tehran ay si degdeg ah u beenisay sheegashadaas. Xiisadda ayaa sii xoogeysanaysa iyadoo Iiraan iyo Cumaan ay wada-hadallo ka wadaan sidii loo maareyn lahaa xaaladda Marinka Hormuz, halka Trump uu horey ugu hanjabay in tallaabo militari laga qaadi karo Cumaan haddii ay farageliso arrinta marin-biyoodka.

items.title: Magaalada Gaalkacyo oo ka gudubtay khatartii dagaal ee soo wajahday
items.description: Shacabka ku dhaqan Magaalada Gaalkacyo ee Gobolka Mudug ayaa hadda dareemaya xasillooni iyo deganaan, ka dib markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu shalay galab soo geba-gabeeyay booqashadii uu ku tegay magaaladaasi. Dareenka shacabka ku nool labada dhinac ee Galmudug iyo Puntland ayaa aad u kacsanaa saddexdii maalmood ee la soo dhaafay, oo ay ku jirto muddadii Madaxweynuhu uu ku sugnaa koonfurta Gaalkacyo. Xaaladda kacsanaanta ayaa si isku mid ah looga dareemay koonfurta iyo waqooyiga magaalada oo laba maamul ay ka jiraan, ka dib markii Puntland ay Axaddii ciidamo ku soo daadisay qaybta ay ka maamusho magaalada, iyadoo diidan in Madaxweynuhu uu soo booqdo magaaladaasi, taas oo keentay in Galmudug ay dhinaceeda gasho xaalad feejignaan ah. Dowlad Goboleedyada Puntland iyo Galmudug ayaa siyaabooyin kala duwan ciidamadooda ugu soo daadiyay waddooyinka magaalada ee labada dhinac la isaga kala gudbo, waxaana uu gaabis ku yimid dhaqdhaqaaqii dadka iyo ganacsiga ee Gaalkacyo. Dadka ayaa aad uga cabsi qabay in safarka Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka uu sababo dagaal ballaaran oo ka dhex qarxa labada maamul ee ka wada arrimiya magaaladaasi, bacdamaa ay ogyihiin cawaaqibka ay colaadda noocaasi ahi ku yeelaneyso nabad ku wada noolaanshaha magaalada. Madaxweynaha ayaa keliya booqday koonfurta Gaalkacyo, iyadoona ay Puntland ka hor istaagtay in uu soo booqdo dhinaca waqooyi ee magaalada, xilli uu halkaasi ku sugan yahay Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Maxamed (Deni). Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo Talaadadii ka hadlayay qado sharaf wafdigiisa loogu sameeyay koonfurta magaalada ayaa sheegay in safarkiisu uu la xiriiro xoojinta nabadda iyo midnimada dadka Soomaaliyeed. Booqashadan ayaa ah middii ugu horreysay ee Madaxweynuhu uu ku tago Magaalada Gaalkacyo, muddo labaatan sano ah. Madaxweynaha ayaa dib ugu laabtay Caasimadda Muqdisho, halkaas oo uu ku soo geba-gabeeyay booqashadii uu ku marayay deegaanada Galmudug. Safarkan oo dhowr maalmood qaatay ayuu Madaxweynuhu uu Jimcihii ka bilaabay Magaalada Dhuusamareeb, wuxuuna ku soo geba-gabeeyay Gaalkacyo. Xaaladda caadiga ah ee ay ku soo laabatay Gaalkacyo ayaa dadka u suurtagelineysa inay qabsadaan shaqooyinkooda maalinlaha ah. Gaalkacyo waa magaalo xasaasi ah oo laba maamul oo kala duwan ay ka arrimiyaan, waana magaalada keliya ee dalka ee aan lahayn hal maamul.

items.title: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo ciidamada ku booqday duleedka Teedaan (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka ee Xoogga Dalka, General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar ayaa gelinkii dambe ee Talaadadii gaaray aagga deegaanka Teedaan ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Taliyaha ayaa kormeeray difaacyada hore ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ee ku sugan duleedka deegaanka Teedaan. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo Sabtidii ka soo dhaqaaqay deegaanka Bukure ayaa soo dul degay deegaanka Teedaan, oo maleeshiyada Al Shabaab ay la wareegeen 2-dii bishan. “Taliyaha waxaa socdaalka ku wehliyay Taliyaha Taliska Tababarada iyo Doctrine-ka Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed, General Axmed Ciise Axmed iyo Saraakiil ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed.” Ayaa lagu yiri war xalay ka soo baxay Taliska Militariga. Taliyaha Qaybta 27aad ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, Cali Axmed Xaashi (Cagey) ayaa warka lagu sheegay inuu Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka iyo Saraakiisha kale uu warbixin ka siiyay xaaladda ciidamada iyo hawlgalada ka dhanka ah Al Shabaab. General Sahal Cabdullaahi Cumar, Taliyaha Ciidanka Dhulka oo ciidamada la hadlay ayaa ku amaanay naf-hurnimada iyo sida ay ugu taagan yihiin difaaca dalka. Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo kaashanaya kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee Macawiisley ayaa bariga Gobolka Hiiraan ka wado dhaqdhaqaaqyo ay ugu diyaargaroobayaan guluf ballaaran, oo la doonayo in lagu wiiqo awoodda Al Shabaab. Warbaahinta ayaa fahamsan in Taliska Militariga uu ciidamo xoojin ah geeyay deegaanada u dhexeeya Magaalooyinka Matabaan iyo Maxaas ama Teedaan iyo Matabaan, kuwaas oo la rabo inay gacan ka gaystaan hawlgalka dib loogu qabanayo Teedaan. Teedaan waa deegaan istiraatiiji ah oo isku xira Magaalooyinka Beledweyne, Matabaan iyo Maxaas, waana deegaan muhiim u ah isu socodka dadka iyo ganacsiga ee Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Galgaduud. Shabaabka ayaa waxay u muuqdaan kuwo si aad ah ugu dagaalami doono deegaankaasi, marka aad eegto in gurmad xoog leh ay isaga keeneen Gobolada Shabellaha Dhexe iyo Galgaduud, sida Magaalooyinka Aadan Yabaal iyo Ceelbuur, waase laga yaabaa inay dib uga baxaan Teedaan, haddii ay qiimeeyaan in xaaladdu ay adkaan doonto, si ay uga baxsadaan hawlgal hawada ah oo lagu taageerayo ciidamada dhulka.

items.title: Kor u qaadidda dhaqanka iyo wax-barashada dhallinta Soomaalida ee Minnesota! W/Q Axmed-Yaasiin Max’ed Sooyaan.
items.description: Kor u qaadidda dhaqanka iyo wax-barashada dhallinta Soomaalida ee Minnesota! W/Q Axmed-Yaasiin Max’ed Sooyaan alle_yaqaan99@yahoo.co.uk Mareykanka qaxootinimo baan ku nimid waana laynagu soo dhoweeyay! Minnesota waa gobolka ay ku noolyihiin tirada ugu badan ee shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee u soo haajiray dalka Maraykanka, waxaana lagu sheegaa 100 kun ilaa 107 kun mujtamac gaaraya oo Soomaali ah inuu deegaan u yahay oo lagu soo dhoweeyay. Mujtamaca intaas la eg, waxay runtii soo dhoweyn iyo qaabilaad aad u wanaagsan ay ka haleen isla mar ahaantaasna fursadaha nolosha la qaybsadeen guud ahaan dadkii Mareykanka ahaa ee ay yu yimaadeen iyo gaar ahaan shacabka gobolka Minnesota ee ay ku soo dageen. Soomaalida ku dhaqan Minnesota, waxay iyagana noqdeen dad is xil qaama laguna tilmaami karo inay kaalintoodii ka soo baxeen, marka laga eego dhaqsaha kobaca ay sameeyeen, xagga bulshada, wax-barashada, shaqada, iyo fahamka dhaqanka dalka, waa suuro gal in weli waxyaabo badan ay tebiyaan marka ay timaado baahidooda gaarka ah ee la xiriirta, dhaqankooda, iyo nidaamkii nololeed ee ay ku soo koreen, ama ay ka yimaadeen ee dalkoodii, iyadoo waliba ay ku dadaaleen inuusan lumin qaab nololeedkoodii ku dhowaad nus qarni oo ay hadda joogaan, taasoo marka aad fiiriso magaalooyinka ay kaga noolyihiin Gobolka Minnesota aad ku arkayso xusul-duubka iyo dadaalka ay ugu jiraan arrinkaas, iyagoo dhinnaca kalana nolosha la qaybsanay dadka soo dhoweeyay. Waxaa qasab ah meel walba oo bulshada joogto inaad ku aragto ama aad ka heleyso, misaajiddo, maqaayado cunto Soomaali lagu sameeyo, dugsiyo qur’aanka ilmaha loogu dhigo, dukaamo dharka ama cuntada lagu iibinayo ay yihiin kuwii Soomaalidu lahayd. Waxaa iyadana xusuid mudan in wax barashada caamka ah ee dalka ka jirta ay qayb ka yihiin oo ilmaha ay aadaan iskuullada dad-weynaha, (public school) waxaa kale oo jira iskuullada dad- weynaha ee madaxa bannaan (public charter schools) oo iyaguna ah qayb kale oo ka mid ah iskuullada dad-weynaha oo loo oggolaaday inay furtaan, laakiin ku shaqeeya heshiis shaqo oo gaar ah, heshiisyadaas oo u oggolaanaya madax bannaani ay muhaajiriinta ay Soomaalidu ka midka tahay ay ku maamulaan waxyaabaha qarkood sida manhajka iyo qaabka wax-barista ilmaha, taasoo markaas xoogaa suuro gal ka dhigta in bulshooyinka soo haajiray ama laga tiro badanyahay ay helaan hab ay ku ilaashadaan inta awoodooda ah aqoonsigooda ummadeed iyo dhaqankooda. Waxaa arrin lagu faani karo ah in badan oo ka mid ah dhallin-yarada mujtamaca Soomaliyeed ee qaxootinimmada ku yimid dalka Maryakanka inay waalidiintu kula dadaaleen inay ilmaha baraan diintooda iyo dhaqankoodii wanaagsanaa ee hiddihii awoowayaashood, hasa ahaatee mar kasta arrintaas waxay ahayd mid u baahan dadaal dheeri ah iyo in xoog badan la gesho, taasi macnaheedu ma aha in waalidku ka gaabiyay ama aysan gelin muruq iyo maskax, waxaase jira cadaadisyo dhowr ah oo is biirsaday oo arrintaas inta badan dib u dhac ku haya, sida; nidaamka shaqada iyo shaqaalaha, oo waalidiinta badankood dakhliga ay ku tiirsanyihiin uu ka yimaado shaqo ay ka qaataan mushaar, in badan oo ka mid ahna ay ka shaqeeyaan ama qabtaan shaqooyin mururq-maal oo ay addimmadooda isticmaalayaan, taasna waxaa ka dhasha in dadaalka waalidku uusan la socon karin xawliga ay xaalladaha baahiyada ilmaha gaarsiisanyihiin, iyo inuusan helin waqti ku fillan baahida waalidnimo ee uu ilmuhu dareemayo, ama koriimo ahaan ay tahay inuu waalidka wax ka barto. Arrinta kale ee iyadana saameynta weyn leh waxay tahay wax-barashada maadiga oo intii badaneyd waqtiga maalinimo qaadata, isla mar ahaantaasna sabab u noqotay inaan waqti ku filan loo helin dugsiga qur’aanka, iyo kullano bulsho oo qabsooma ama qoysku uu helo waqti ku fillan si uu sheeko u wadaagi karo iyadoo waliba wax-barashada maadiga ah ay tahay mid qasab ah oo ilmaha aan laga reebi karin ama uusan diidi kareyn ilaa uu dugsiga sare ka dhameeyo, waxaana mararka qaarkood dhacda in ilmo diiday inay iskuulka aadaan lagu qoro ciidamo booliis ah oo subax kasta iskuulka geeya. Waxaa xusid mudan in dalka laga dhaqan geliyay 2002-2015kii, Qaynuunka ahaa No Child left behind ma jiro ilmo gadaal lagu dhaafayo! Sidaasoo kale waalidiinta Soomaaliyeed waxay dadaal weyn ku bixiyeen in ilmaha aysan ka harin wax-barashada maaddiga ah, waxayna gaarsiiyeen heerarka ugu sareeya ee heer jaamacadeed, waxaana Alle mahaddii ah in maanta laga helayo dhallin-yarada bulshada Soomaaliyeed qeyabaha kala duwan ee bahda aqoonta. Arrintan ayaa waxaa inta badan suuro geliyay xil-kasnimmadaiyo dhaqanka wanaagsan ee aabbaha iyo hooyada Soomaaliyeed iyo soo dhoweynta nidaamka siyaasadeed ee wax-barashada Mareykanka ee ay qaybta ka yihiin. Kaalinta wanaagsan ee dugsiyada qur’aanka, iyo dadaallada misaajidda! Marka aad eegto kaalinta uu dugsiga qur’aanka ku jiro iyo meesha uu u buuxiyay ilamaha Soomaalida ah ma aha mid aad qiyaastaada iyo malahaga oo keliya aad ku cabbiri karto, toddobaadkii waa labo maalin oo keliya, saacad ahaanna waa 6saac. Macallimiinta dugsyada qur’aanka dhiga, waxaa la oran karaa 85% wax ku dhow bay ku guuleysteen inay ilmaha yar ku ilaaliyaan dhaqanka wanaagsan, waxaana intaas dheer oo aysan dad badan fahamsaneyn ilmaha joogistooda dugsiga saacadahaas kooban ee todobaadkii oo dhan mar keliya ah, marka laga reebo barashada qur’aanka iyo diinta oo iyagu ah muhimadda dugsiga loo geeyay, waxay ilmaha kullanka ay iyaga kulmayaan ka helayaan inay dareemaan jiritaanka mujtamac ahaan iyo nuxurka bulshanimo ee ay baahidiisa qabaan si ka duwan marka ay joogaa iskullada iyo munaasabadaha iyo meelaha fagaarayaasha ah. Waxaa dhanka kale ilmuhu baranayaa dhaqan Islaami ah, oo ku xiriirnaya ardayda kale ee dugsiga dhigata. Waxaa sidaasoo kale ilmuhu ka helayaa dhiiranaan iyo inuu leeyahay mujtamac uu isku haleeyo oo kaalinta uu uga baahanyahay u buuxin kara isla markaasna tirsanaya kaalintiisa, wuxuu yeelanayaa xiriir saaxiibtanimo oo ku tiirsan dhaqankiisa naftiisana kalsooni ay ku qabto oo uu u yaqaan inay aabbihii iyo hooyadii leeyihiin. Waxaana talo wanaagsan ah in dugsiga qur’aanka ilmaha lagu baro qorista iyo aqrinta iyo ku hadalka Af-Soomaaliga, waana arrin sahlan oo la sameyn karo, uga yaraan haddii ardayga la siiyo waqtiyo gaar ah oo ka baxsan xilliga Qur’aanka ama hadba sida markaas u haboon dugsigaas. Dugsiga qur’aanka faa’idooyinka laga helay waxaa laga garan dhaqanka guurka iyo xiriirka dhallin-yarada ka dhexeeya, waxaa laga garan karaa xiriir waalidka iyo dhallinta ka dhexeeya, waxaa laga garan karaa hufnaanta iyo daacadnimmada dhallinta ka muuqda, mararka qaarkood dugsiga qur’aanka waxaa la oran karaa waa naadiga dhallin-yarada ay isku arkaan. Waxaa iyadana xusid mudan in dhaqammadaas aan ka sheekeynay dabeecad ahaan ay ka dhashaan kulummada dhallin-yarada marka ay helaan dabeecad ahaan xaalad midda dugsiga oo kale ah oo dhaqan islaamnimo ah. Dugsiyada Qur’aanka, waxay kale oo ku ammaananyihiin intooda badan inaysan ardayda agoonta ah ee dhigata ee aan awoodin inay iska bixiyaan lacagta wax-barashada aysan waxba kharja ah ka qaadin oo lacag la’aan ay wax ku baraan, sidaasoo kalana ay jiraan qoysas dan-yar ah oo iyagana aan ilmahooda waxba laga qaadin, kaalintaas deeqsinimmada ah waxay gacan ka geysatay in si dhib yar oo aan walaac lahayn waalidka uu ilmihiisa ugu helo wax-barashadii uu u baahnaa ee diinta iyo dhaqanka, waxaa iyadana la ii sheegay inay jiraan dad aan badneyn oo ganacsato ah aan helin magacyadooda inay qaar ka mid ah dugsiyada ka kabaan kharashaadka adeegyada. Ardayda roon-roon waa inay arday sii ahaadaan! Waa dhibaato wax laga qaban karo, mana aha in ilmihii wax-barashadoodii lagu soo tacbayay ay noqoto Hal Bacaad Lagu Lisay! Sida webiyadii SHabeelle iyo Jubba ay ku soo dhammaato meel aan waxba laga dheefeyn!…Misaajidda iyo Dugsiyada Qur’aanka, waxaa looga baahanyahay in ardayda oo dhan ay muddada ay baranayaan Qur’aanka aysan xaddidin da’da ilmaha, oo ardayga loo oggolaado intii uu doono wato barashada Qur’aanka. Sidaas si la mid ahna aan ardayga dhaqankiisa oo xummaado iyo edeb daro ama dhago-adeyg, iyo inuu is bido inuu weynaaday aan looga eryin dugsiga. Waa laga yaabaa in dugsiyo aan badneyn ay leeyihiin nidaam wax barasho oo da’ kasta oo ka mid ah mujtamaca ay ka helayaan heerka aqoonta ay u baahanyihiin, hasa ahaatee waxaa waalidiin badan dhibaato ku noqotay in ilmaha Dugsiyada Qur’aanka marka ay xoogaa da’dooda soo roonaato waliba iyagoo meel fiican ka soo gaaray barashadii qur’aanka isla markaasna wax-barashadii raba uu dugsiga ku dadaalo inuu ardayga isaga tago dugsiga iyadoo aan si rasmi ah loogu sheegeyn ama aan loola bareereyn. Sida aan ku ogaanay xogaha aan ururinay ayaa waxay cadeynayaan in arrintaas ay tahay xaqiiqo jirta, sababtuna waxay tahay in ardayda qaarkood marka ay soo weynaadaan ay la soo baxaan dabeecado adag oo aysan macallimiinta wax ku bari kareyn sida; inuusan waxba ka maqal macallinka, inuu la murmo, inuu diido wixii uu macallinka faro, taasoo ay ka dhalato baqdin ah inay saameyn ku yeelato ardayda yar-yar oo ay kaga daydaan. Mar haddii uu xalka sidaas yahay waxaa loo baahanyahay dugsiyada inay ka fekeraan tallaabo kale oo aan ahayn in ardayga marka uu soo weynaado dugsiga laga eryo, tallaabooyin la socon kara sida ardaygu u fekerayo iyo dhaqanka ardayga Mareykanka jooga ama ha ahaado mid qur’aan baranaya ama ha ahaado mid wax kale baranaya, isla markaasna ay la yimaadaan talo iyo siyaasad uusan ardayga dugsiga uga didin dugsigana siinaysa awood u suurto gelisay inuu wax-barashadiisa dhameyst, macallimiintana u sahleysa inay wax baraan.kara sida ardaygu u fekerayo iyo dhaqanka ardayga Mareykanka jooga ama ha ahaado mid qur’aan baranaya ama ha ahaado mid wax kale baranaya, isla markaasna ay la yimaadaan talo iyo siyaasad uusan ardayga dugsiga uga didin dugsigana siinaysa awood u suurto gelisay inuu wax-barashadiisa dhameyst, macallimiintana u sahleysa inay wax baraan. Waxyaabaha muhiimka ah ee looga baahnyahay inay dugsiyada ka fekeraan si ardayga marka uu soo weynaado wax barashadiisa u wato waxaa ka mid ah in ardayga marka uu soo weynaado, loo abuuro xaalad uu mas’uuliyad ku dareemayo, taasoo la bilaabaneysa marka ay ka soo muuqdaan dabeecadahaas aan horay u soo sheegnay, sida iyadoo marka uu casharka u dhammado isla markiiba loo diro inuu caawiyo ardayda yar-yar, ama laga dhigo Kabiir gacan siiya macallinka. Waxaa sidaas oo kale la soo qaadan karaa nidaamka iskuullada oo ah inuu dugsigu yeesho koox xagga dhaqanka iyo aadaabta qaabilsan, qof arrimaha bulshada qaabilsan (Social Worker) kaasoo marka ardayga uu dhego adeygo ama uu macallinka iyo kooxda dhaqank iyo adaabta isku soo taago, ama uu ku af celiyo isaga loo geynayo ardayga, kaasoo markaas daraasadeynaya dabeecadaha iyo xiriirka bulsho ee ardaygaas oo u uku jiro xiriirka uu la leeyahay adayda kale, noloshiisa guriga, haddii ay jirto baahi gaar ah…Waxaa kale oo qasab ah inuu dugsi qur’aanku yeesho La-Taliye ardayda ka la taliya sida uu u baran karo diinta, Qur’aanka, iyo waxyaabaha ka caawin kara (Counsellor) kuwaasoo ay qasab tahay inay yihiin dad u taba-baran shaqooyinkaas oo ay u dheertahay aqoon diineed iyo dhaqan wanaagsan, oo faham qoto dheer u leh dhaqanka ilmaha iyo xaaladaha ku meeran. Marka ay timaado xagga akhlaaqda iyo adaabta ardayga soo weynaaday ee 15-20 jirka ah looga baahanyahay, si ardaygaas ugu hoggaansamo dhaqanka iyo dabeecada laga rabo dugsiga, oo qur’aanka barashadiisa uu u wato, waa in la helo qof marka hore fahmi kara baahida ardayga, iyo dabeecadaha uu ku barbaaray ee ka dhaadhacsan. Waxyaabaha ugu muhiimsan ee ilmaheena in la baro ay tahay waxaa ugu horeeya Waalid Muxuu yahay?! Marar badan waxaad arkeysaa dad leh, ilmaha ha loo sheekeeyo, waqti ha la geliyo, ha lala socdo, cunto ha la siiyo…. DHammaantood waa taloooyin wanaagsan oo runtii waa kaalin wax ku ool ah,dhinaca kalana ka mid ah xilka waalidka, laakiin waxaa xaqiiqdu ay tahay ilamaha inaysan intaas ku fahmi kareyn macnaha waalidnimmada iyo in loo diyaarinayo sidii ay u yeelan lahaayeen dhaqan wanaagsan oo guntiisu tahay Xil-Kasnimo, sababtu waxay tahay intaas waa inta caruurta Mareykanka ah ay dhaqan ahaan ogyihiin una heystaan in waalid loogu yahay, ama ay tahay xuquuq uu qaynuunka dalka siiyay, oo haddi uusan waalidka u sameyn ay dowladda xil iska saareyso, oo marar badan baa waxaa dhacda in cunuggu uu u dacwoodo macallinkiisa iskuulka “Hooyo waa I caaysay! Aabbe ilama hadlo! Meelaha lagu ciyaaro layma geeyo! Aaabbe xaasid buu igu yahay!” taasi waxay ku tusaysaa ardayga inuusan aqoon macnaha waalidnimo ee dhaqankeena, ee khuseysa xuquuqda waalidka iyo ilmaha, iyo in ilamaha ay tahay inuu baari u noqdo waalidka, iyo inay tahay ilamaha inuu qaan gaaro isagoo kaalinta xilkiisa garanay. Waxaad xusid mudan in ilmaha ay waxyaabo badan ka bartaan iskuulka, ilaa heer gaarsiisan inay turjuman karaan eraydada oo waliba kuwooda roon-roon ee iskuullada sare ama xtaa dhexe ay qaynuun ahaan u qeexi karaan. Marka qofka Arrimaha Bulshada u qaabilsan dugsiga, iyo midka La-Taliyaha ah, waa inay yihiin dad aad u yaqaan diin ahaan iyo dhaqan ahaan arrimaha qoyska iyo barbaarinta ilmaha, oo ay gaarsiisanyihiin inay diinta ku dabaqi karaan aqoonta maadiga iyo taba-barrada ay ku soo qaateen xirfadahaas. Waalid Waxaa xasuus mudan oo in maanka lagu hayo tahay in ilmaha loo macneeyo waalid waxa uu yahay. Waxaa ilmaha loo sheegaa waalidka baari u noqo, laakiin waxaa ka horeysa inuu ilmuhu fahmo oo dugsiga lagu baro macnaha waalid leeyahay, oo looga sheekeeyo dhibka ay hooyadu ka soo martay, sida loo soo koriyay, marxaladaha koriimmadiisa ay soo martay, iyo dadaalka uu waalidku ka soo maray. In ilmaha la baro Alle raali ahaanshihiisa iyo inuu ku jeclaado inay ku xirantahay baarinimmada waalidka, in la baro oo la xasuusiyo sida wanaagsan ee ay u soo koriyeen iyo dadaalka ay ka soo mareen, in ilmaha loo sheego oo lagu baraarujiyo inay waalidkood saaxiib la noqdaan oo soo dhoweystaan,oo uga sheekeeyaan waxyaabaha ay ku fekerayaan, in la fahamsiiyo cannaanta iyo qeyllada inaysan cadaawad (sida ay yiraahdaan MEAN) ahayn, mararka qaarkoodna ay tahay dhaqan ka jira dalkii laakiin waalidka uu jecelyahay ilmihiisa, iyo in baarinimmada waalidka ay tahay isku haynta xoogga guriga iyo in walaalaha ay gaaraan nolol wanaagsan. DHammaan weedhahaas waa in logu celceliyaa oo mar kasta la maqashiiyaa. Casharrada noocaas ah waxaa ku haboon bixintooda qof jecel oo u jajaban u sheekeynta iyo wax ka dhaadhicinta ilmaha, isla markaasna adeegsan kara luuqad taabanaysa qalbiga ilmaha. Sidaas si la mid ahna waa in la baraa caasinimmada iyo waalidka lala murmo ama lagu af celiyo ciqaabaha iyo cirib xummada ka dhalaneyso oo ay ugu horeyso burburka iyo dhibaatooyinka qoyska. Waxana wanaagsan, inaan la badin ka sheekeynta caasinimmada haddii aysan jirin munaasabad ama dhacdo la saxayo. In ilmaha la baro qiimaha iyo waxa uu waalidka u yahay ilmihiisa, waxay xoojinaysaa kaalinta uu waalidka ka qaadan karo wax-barashada iyo ku barbaarinta dhaqanka wanaagsan ee ilmaha. Ilmaha macanaha waalidnimo marka uu sidaas u fahmo, oo uu garowsadao mudanaanta iyo qiimaha uu waalidku leeyahay, ayuu waalidka inuu u sheekeeyo, wax u sheego, waqti geliyo, meelo u wad-wado ilmuhuna ka barto waalidka ay suurto gal tahay. DHinaca kalana waxaa ilmahu helayaan kalsooni iyo inay ku dhiirradaan inay waalidka la soo fariistaan, wax weyddiiyaan, wax u sheegaan, taas macnaheeda waxaa weeye, wax u sheegista ilmaha waxaa ka horeeya in ilmaha marka fahamsanyahay Aabbe waxa uu yahay iyo Hooyo waxa ay tahay, iyo waxa ay isaga u yihiin, waana in qofka Socialworker ah iyo qofka Counselor-ka is moodsiin ilmuhu inay macno ahaan iyo dhaqan ahaan garanayaan Waalidnimmada. Waa in la baraa waalid kale oo xaq ku leh inuu jiro; adeerkii, abtigii, eeddadii, habr-yartii, awoowe, ayeeyo iyo in xiriirka walaalaha ku dhisanayahay is ixtiraam iyo in qofba midka uu ka weynyahay talada uga dambeeyoiyo guud ahaan rixinimmada. Dugsiyada qur’aanka markay iskuullada fasax yihiin Waxaa arrin dhiiri gelin mudan ah in Dugsiyada Qur’aanka ay ka fekeraan diyaarinta barnaamijo muddada seddexda bil ee dhow-dhow ah ee ardayda iskuullada fasaxa ka yihiin, xilligaas waa fursad muhiim ah oo ardayda loo sameyn karo in labadii maalmood ee dugsiga ay ardayda imaaneysay ee Sabtiga iyo Axadda loogu daro maalin ama labo maalin oo kale, oo waqtiga barashada Qur’aanka xoogaa la kordhiyo iyada oo haddii qiime lagu dariyana uusan noqon qiimahaas mid macno dila ujeeddadii barnaamijka ee ahayd in ardayda waqtigaas looga faa’ideeyo, waana in dugsiga iyo macallimiinta ay huraan wax weyn. Waxaa kaloo dugsiga ama misaajidka uu sameyn karaa inay bilaabaan casharo ilmaha loogu talo galay oo habeen kasta ama maalin kasta ka baxa misaajidka ama hadba sida ugu badan; seddex habeen/maalin ama afar habeen/maalin hadba intii awoodu oggolaato. Waxaa kale oo dugsiyadu sameyn karaan inay ilmaha u diyaariyaan waxyaabo la xiriira xagga ciyaaraha iyo tartamo daraasaadka Islaamiga ah oo loo qabto dugsiyada. Waxaana dhacda inta badan, in marka ugu horeyso uu ilmaha ka tago afkii u gaarka ahaa bulshadiisa, waana calaammadda ugu horeysa uguna muhiimsan ee caddeynaysa in ilmuhu uu dhaqankiisii ka tegay ama intiisii badneyd ka lumay, waayo afka wuxuu ku dhisanyahay macneynta dareenka, sharafta, ceebta, fiicnaanta, xummaanta, murugada, farxadda, iyo magacyada, iyo tilmaamaha iyo sifayaasha intaas aan soo sheegnay oo dhan, oo sifahooda uu macneynayo dhaqanka bulshada.
