Independent reporting has confirmed that Puntland forces seized a federal-aligned military compound in Galkayo after heavy fighting on August 5. In the days that followed, garrisons at several federal military bases in Bosaso and Armo also surrendered, according to the account provided by officials and clan leaders. The developments are part of a wider Puntland effort to consolidate control over security institutions. Recent analysis has likewise described Puntland as moving to consolidate its control following the Galkayo confrontation. Puntland warns against federal security presence Puntland authorities say the forces taken over during the campaign will be rehabilitated, trained and equipped before being incorporated into a unified command under the Puntland government. The administration has also said that forces registered as part of the Somali National Army or other federal government security agencies will not be allowed to maintain a presence in Puntland. Those who attempt to continue operating under direct federal authority, Puntland authorities have warned, will face consequences similar to those imposed on the PSF in Galkayo. The confrontation has already deepened the divide over whether federally registered forces can operate independently inside a federal member state. Mogadishu, for its part, has defended the federal military’s authority and the right of Somali citizens to serve in the national army. Somalia’s defence minister recently visited soldiers wounded in the August 5 Galkayo fighting and defended their integration into the Somali National Army. A wider Mogadishu – Puntland power struggle The latest military realignments come amid a longstanding political and security dispute between Puntland and Somalia’s federal government. Relations have deteriorated sharply as Puntland authorities have increasingly resisted what they regard as attempts by Mogadishu to extend direct control over security institutions and political affairs in the region. The latest confrontation also follows reports that Somalia’s federal leadership had been planning to oust Puntland’s leadership in a manner similar to the military operation that culminated in the removal of Southwest State President Abdiasis Laftagaren in March. Against that backdrop, Takar’s return to Puntland carries significance well beyond the movement of a single military commander. It removes a federally appointed commander from Mogadishu’s chain of command, brings his Danab forces back under Puntland authority and reinforces Garowe’s campaign to eliminate competing military command structures inside the region. For Puntland, the move strengthens its effort to place the region’s armed forces under one command. For Mogadishu, it represents another contraction of the federal government’s direct military reach in a region where it has long sought to establish a stronger foothold. And for Somalia’s already strained federal system, the dispute over who controls soldiers, bases and chains of command in Puntland has become an increasingly consequential test of the balance of power between the federal government and its member states. items.title: NISA oo dishay laba horjooge iyo ilaaladooda + Magacyada
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Warsaxaafadeed kasoo baxay Hay’adda NISA ee Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa lagu faah-faahiyay howlgal qorsheysan oo maanta ka dhacay duleedka magaalada Jowhar ee caasimada Maamul Goboleedka HirShabelle. NISA ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in howlgalkan oo ay ka qayb-qaateen saaxibada caalamiga ah lagu dilay 9 xubnood oo ay ku jiraan laba horjooge oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta, kuwaas oo ku sugnaa deegaanka Warciise ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe. “Ciidanka Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA), oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamka, ayaa howlgal qorsheysan oo ka dhacay deegaanka Warciise, oo 25 KM u jira magaalada Jowhar ee Gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, ku dilay sagaal dhagarqabe oo ka tirsanaa Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab, oo ay ku jireen laba horjooge,” ayaa lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Sidoo kale, Hay’adda ayaa shaacisay magacayada horjoogayaasha la dilay, waxayna kala yihiin Axmed Cali Jimcaale, oo ahaa horjoogihii Khawaarijta ugu magacawnaa degmada Jowhar iyo Geedi Maxamed Nuur Cadde oo isna ahaa horjoogihii kooxda ee deegaannada Dumaaye iyo Dabagaalo, sida lagu sheegay qoraalka. “Horjoogeyaasha howlgalka lagu dilay ayaa kala ahaa Axmed Cali Jimcaale, oo ahaa horjoogihii Khawaarijta ugu magacawnaa degmada Jowhar, iyo Geedi Maxamed Nuur Cadde, oo ahaa horjoogihii kooxda ee deegaannada Dumaaye iyo Dabagaalo. Labadan horjooge ayaa muddo lagu daba jiray xogtooda iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyadooda,” ayaa mar kale lagu yiri warsaxaafadeedka. Waxaa kale oo lasii raaciyay “Howlgalka ayaa sidoo kale lagu dilay toddobo dhagarqabe oo ka tirsanaa maleeshiyaadka waxa ay ugu yeeraan xisbada ee deegaanka Warciise, kuwaas oo la socday horjoogeyaasha la beegsaday. Howlgalka ayaa u dhacay sidii loo qorsheeyay, waxaana Khawaarijta lagu gaarsiiyay jab culus”. Howlgalkan ayaa qeyb ka ah dadaallada joogtada ah ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda kooxda Al-Shabaab, laguna burburinayo horjoogeyaashooda iyo shabakadaha ay u adeegsadaan abaabulka falalka argagixisada. Hay’adda Nabadsugidda Qaranka ayaa ugu dambeyn baaq u dirtay shacabka, waxayna ka codsatay inay soo war geliyaan khatar kasta oo amni oo ay la kulmaan, si looga hortago. “Fadlan muwaadin, wixii khatar amni ah ama macluumaad la xiriira Khawaarijta Al-Shabaab iyo Daacish la wadaag NISA: 199 | 0770 747474 | 0620 545454,” ayaa lagu soo gabagabeeyay warsaxaafadeedka. Muddooyinkii u dambeeyay dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa kordhisay howlgallada lagu beegsanayo argagixisada, kadib markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu mar kale iclaamiyay dagaal ka dambeys ah oo lagu qaadayo kooxda Al-Shabaab. The post NISA oo dishay laba horjooge iyo ilaaladooda + Magacyada appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Puntland Accuses Hassan Sheikh of Fueling Tensions in Galkayo, Places Security Forces on Alert
items.description: Garowe (WDN) — Puntland has issued a strongly worded warning accusing Somalia’s Federal Government and President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud of pursuing political and security moves that could destabilize Puntland, particularly the strategically sensitive city of Galkayo. In a statement released Thursday evening, Puntland said it was closely monitoring what it described as preparations for a possible visit by President Hassan Sheikh to southern Galkayo, which is administered by Galmudug. Puntland warned that the reported visit should not be viewed as a routine presidential engagement, arguing that it could carry political implications capable of inflaming tensions in a city that has long stood as both a symbol of division and an important example of coexistence between Puntland and Galmudug communities. The administration went further, alleging that the Federal Government was attempting to manipulate political dynamics in Galkayo and create divisions among communities that have spent years working to preserve an uneasy but increasingly important peace. Puntland’s warning carries particular weight because of Galkayo’s history. The divided city has endured repeated episodes of armed conflict, resulting in deaths, injuries and displacement. Over the years, however, political leaders, traditional elders and civil society groups on both sides have invested considerable effort in maintaining coexistence and preventing renewed violence. Puntland therefore urged the leadership and population of southern Galkayo to remain committed to peace and warned against actions that could reopen old wounds. The administration also praised residents and authorities in southern Galkayo for their role in maintaining stability and called for continued cooperation between Puntland and Galmudug. But behind the language of cooperation lies a growing political confrontation between Puntland and Mogadishu. Puntland Puts Forces on Alert One of the most significant elements of the statement was Puntland’s announcement that its security forces had been placed on full alert . The administration said additional security measures would be implemented across Puntland, with particular attention to Galkayo and surrounding areas. Puntland did not specify what additional measures were being prepared, but the decision signals that authorities regard the situation as sufficiently serious to warrant heightened security readiness. The administration also warned President Hassan Sheikh that, in its view, he would bear responsibility for any conflict or security disorder that might result from developments in Puntland. The Federal Government had not, at the time of publication, issued a response to the allegations. The dispute over Galkayo is only one part of a much broader confrontation between Puntland and the Federal Government. The two sides remain sharply divided over Somalia’s federal system, constitutional amendments, electoral arrangements and the distribution of powers between the Federal Government and Federal Member States. Relations have deteriorated further in recent weeks following Puntland’s campaign against security personnel it says were recruited by the Federal Government from Puntland territory. Puntland has argued that those forces were recruited and trained without authorization from the regional administration and has maintained that many of the personnel and their weapons have subsequently been brought under Puntland’s command. The Federal Government’s position on the issue remains central to the wider dispute over who has constitutional authority over security forces recruited within Federal Member States. Why Galkayo Matters Galkayo occupies an unusually sensitive position in Somalia’s political and security landscape. The city is divided administratively between Puntland and Galmudug, yet its communities remain deeply interconnected through trade, family ties and daily economic activity. It has also repeatedly served as a venue for peace conferences and political dialogue between the two administrations. That history makes Galkayo particularly vulnerable to political escalation. A confrontation there would not necessarily remain a local dispute. It could rapidly become a broader federal confrontation, drawing Puntland and Mogadishu into another cycle of political and security tension. For that reason, Puntland’s latest warning should be viewed against the backdrop of Somalia’s increasingly polarized political environment. Puntland’s statement reflects a growing fear that political competition between Mogadishu and the Federal Member States is increasingly spilling into the security arena. The administration’s decision to place its forces on alert, coupled with its unusually direct warning to the President, illustrates how seriously Puntland views the reported plans surrounding Galkayo. The immediate question is whether the Federal Government will respond through dialogue or confrontation. For now, Galkayo remains the critical pressure point. A city once synonymous with conflict has gradually become a testing ground for whether Puntland and Galmudug can preserve coexistence despite their political differences. The fear in Puntland is that a confrontation between federal and regional authorities could undo years of painstaking peace-building. And with relations between Puntland and Mogadishu already at one of their most difficult points in years, Galkayo may once again find itself standing at the intersection of Somalia’s unresolved political and constitutional crisis. items.title: Safiirka Soomaaliya ee Sudan oo waraaqaha aqoonsiga looga  guddoomay Khartoum
items.description: Khartoum – Safiirka cusub ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya u qaabilsan Jamhuuriyadda Sudan, Danjire Dr. Axmed Jaamac Cumar, ayaa si rasmi ah waraaqihiisa aqoonsiga Danjirenimo ugu gudbiyay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Madaxbannaanida Ku-meel-gaarka ah ee Sudan ahna Taliyaha Guud ee Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, Jeneraal Abdel Fattah al-Burhan. Munaasabadda ayaa ka dhacday Madaxtooyada Jamhuuriyadda ee magaalada Khartoum, waxaana goob joog ka ahaa Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Sudan, Muhyiddin Saalim. Danjire Axmed Jaamac Cumar ayaa noqday safiirkii ugu horreeyay ee waraaqaha aqoonsiga Danjirenimo lagu guddoomayo Madaxtooyada Khartoum tan iyo markii uu dagaalka Sudan billowday, taas oo muujinaysa dib-u-soo-noqoshada howlaha diblomaasiyadeed ee xarunta caasimadda. Tallaabadan ayaa sidoo kale loo arkaa mid muujinaysa xiriirka taariikhiga ah iyo iskaashiga dhow ee Soomaaliya iyo Sudan, oo ay ka dhexeeyaan xiriirro siyaasadeed, bulsho iyo waxbarasho oo soo jireen ah. Danjire Axmed Jaamac Cumar ayaa horey bishii Abriil 2026 nuqullo ka mid ah waraaqihiisa aqoonsiga ugu gudbiyay Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Sudan, taas oo qayb ka ahayd hannaanka rasmi ah ee aqoonsigiisa. Munaasabadda Khartoum waxay xoojinaysaa joogitaanka diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya ee Sudan iyo muhiimadda ay Muqdisho siinayso sii wadidda xiriirka labada dal xilli Sudan ay weli ku jirto xaalad dagaal iyo kala-guur siyaasadeed.

items.title: Wasaarada arrimaha dibadda oo iska difaacday eedeymo culus oo uga yimid…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cabdi Cali (Dhaay) ayaa ka hadlay eedeymo culus oo uga yimid Xafiiska Hanti-dhowrka Guud ee Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo ku saabsanaa habraacyada wasaaraddu u martay dirista qaar ka mid ah diblomaasiyiinta iyo shaqaalaheeda. Warbixinta Hantidhowrka ayaa lagu sheegay in 14 diblomaasi loo diray dalka dibaddiisa, iyadoo aan si buuxda loo waafajin dhammaan shuruudihii iyo habraacyadii looga baahnaa, halka 19 shaqaale oo kale loo diray howlo diblomaasiyadeed iyagoo aan qaadan tababarradii looga baahnaa shaqooyinka loo magacaabay. Qodobada ku jira warbixinta ayaa dhaliyay su’aalo ku saabsan habka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda u maamusho xulashada, magacaabista iyo dirista shaqaalaheeda diblomaasiyadeed, gaar ahaan marka la eego shuruudaha xirfadeed iyo tababarrada looga baahan yahay shaqaalaha loo diro safaaradaha iyo qunsuliyadaha. Wasiir Cabdisalaan Dhaay ayaa sheegay in Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Xafiiska Hanti-dhowrka Guud ay haatan ku jiraan wada-hadal iyo is-dhaafsi xogeed, si loo fahmo qodobada lagu soo bandhigay warbixinta, loona kala caddeeyo meelaha ay labada dhinac ku kala aragti duwan yihiin. Wasiirka ayaa xusay in shaqaalaha diblomaasiyadeed ee Soomaaliya loo diro dalalka dibadda ay yihiin shaqaale ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda, kuwaas oo lagu qiimeeyo aqoontooda, khibraddooda iyo shuruudaha looga baahan yahay xilalka loo magacaabayo. Sida uu sheegay Wasiir Dhaay, marka la magacaabayo diblomaasi loo dirayo dal gaar ah waxaa la tixgeliyaa dhowr arrimood, kuwaas oo ay ka mid yihiin aqoonta iyo khibradda qofka, nooca shaqada loo dirayo iyo xaaladda dalka ama deegaanka uu ka howlgeli doono. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale beeniyay in shaqaalaha Soomaaliyeed ee loo diro dibadda aysan helin tababarro ku filan oo la xiriira shaqada diblomaasiyadda, isagoo sheegay in shaqaalaha loo diyaariyo waajibaadka loo igmaday. “Diblomaasiyiintu waxay maraan tababarro la xiriira diblomaasiyadda iyo howlaha shaqadooda,” ayuu yiri wasiirka, isagoo intaas ku daray in ay jiraan tababarro kale oo ku xiran waajibaadka iyo goobta uu qofku ka howlgeli doono. Cabdisalaan Dhaay ayaa tilmaamay in aqoonta luqaduhu ay sidoo kale ka mid tahay qodobada lagu tixgeliyo xulashada iyo dirista diblomaasiyiinta Soomaaliyeed, gaar ahaan marka loo baahan yahay in qofku si hufan ula shaqeeyo dowladda iyo bulshada dalka loo dirayo. items.title: NISA oo sheegtay in howlgal ka dhacay Jowhar lagu dilay 9 xubnood oo Al-Shabaab ah
items.description: Ciidanka Hay’adda Sirdoonka iyo Nabadsugidda Qaranka (NISA), oo kaashanaya saaxiibada caalamka, ayaa howlgal qorsheysan oo ka dhacay deegaanka Warciise, oo 25 KM u jira magaalada Jowhar ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, ku dilay sagaal xubnood oo ka tirsanaa Al-Shabaab, oo ay ku jireen laba horjooge. Horjoogeyaasha howlgalka lagu dilay ayaa kala ahaa Axmed Cali Jimcaale, oo ahaa horjoogihii Shabaab ugu magaca weynaa degmada Jowhar, iyo Geedi Maxamed Nuur Cadde, oo ahaa horjoogihii kooxda ee deegaanada Dumaaye iyo Dabagaalo. Labadan horjooge ayaa muddo lagu daba jiray xogtooda iyo dhaq-dhaqaaqyadooda. Howlgalka ayaa sidoo kale lagu dilay toddobo dhagarqabe oo ka tirsanaa maleeshiyooyinka, waxaana laga helay hub iyo agab ciidan. Howlgalka ayaa u dhacay sidii loo qorsheeyay, waxaana Shabaablagu gaarsiiyay jab culus. Howlgalkan wuxuu qeyb ka yahay dadaallada joogtada ah ee lagu wiiqayo awoodda Shabaab laguna burburinayo horjoogeyaasooda iyo shabakadaha ay u adeegsadaan abaabulka falalka argagixisada. NISA waxay shacabka ugu baaqday inay sii xoojiyaan wada shaqeynta hay’adda, si loo ciribtiro kooxaha argagixisada ah.

items.title: Min Hargeysa ilaa Balligubadle Safar dalxiis ah ayaannu ku tagnay Balligubadle, C
items.description: Min Hargeysa ilaa Balligubadle Safar dalxiis ah ayaannu ku tagnay Balligubadle, Caasimadda gobolka Hawd. Waxaa i weheliyey dhakhtar Qurbejoo ah iyo weriye. Xirfaddu macno Uma lahayn safarka maadaama uu ahaa dal iyo dad-barash. Cid gaar ah lama aannu sii ballamin. Toos ayaannu quraacdii ka dib u ambabaxnay. Quraacda waannu isku qabannay in aannu magaalada ka sii quraacanno iyo in aannu tuulooyinka ka sii quraacanno. Balse waa la iga batay oo waxaannu ka sii quraacannay magaalada. Intii aannu quraacanaynay ayuu qof ka mid ah shaqaalihii makhaayaddu, na waydiiyey furihii gaadhigayaga, si uu jidka ugu banneeyo baabuur kale. Waannu siinnay, balse waxa uu nagu soo noqday isaga oo argagaxsan. “Waar gaadhigii, hore iyo gadaalba waan ka duqeeyey. Waa runtii balse ma ahayn dhaawacyo uu safarku u baaqanayey. Gaadhigu kiro-ammaano ayuu ahaa. Kollay halkaas waxoogaa culays ah ayaa ninkii shaqaalaha ahaa u soo hoyday, annagana werwer xagga ammaanada ah. Abbaaro siddeeddii subaxnimo ayaannu qabsannay jidka. Waddada isku xidha Hargeysa iyo Balli-gubadle waxaa ka socota shaqo waddo-dhis oo xawli ah. In badanna waaba la dhisay laamiga. Dhammaystirka waddadani wax weyn ayuu ka beddeli doonaa isu-socodka iyo horumarka, waana guul u soo iftiimaysa dadka deegaanka. Waxaannu sii marnay Hargeysa ka dib, habaasweyn, ka dib Jibaaqo, ka dib magaalo Xaali, ka dib gumburaha, dabadeedna Balligubadle Waxaannu ku hakannay Gumburaha oo ugu weyneyd intii ka sokeysay. Waxay ku taal cidhifka soke ee banka gumburaha. Magaca gumburo waa buuro yaryar ama haaro ku teedsan duleedka tuulada, sida naloo sheegay. Tuuladan waxaa ka soo jeeda Sheekh Maxamed Sheekh Cumar Dirir Oo uu deggenaan jiray aabbihii iyo qoyskoodu. Haddii aannu waydiinay dadka kale ee Caanka ah ee tuuladan ku abtirsada, waxaa naloo tiriyey culimo aad u badan oo aannu ilaa tobaneeyo diiwaangelinnay sida: 1- Sheekh Maxamed Sheekh Cumar dirir 2- sheekh cumar Dirir iyo dhawr walaalladii ahaa 3- sheekh Cabdiweli oo magaalada ugu xisaabsan Awliyadii nebi Ammaanka iyo nasrada. iyo Qaar kale oo badan. Jirtoo magaaladu ku faanaysay sooyaal culimo oo mudan tixraac, haddana si weyn ayaa looga qayilayey goor barqo ah. Qaadku waa musiibo ummadeed oo u baahan fiiro gaar ah. Midhkaas, hoosta ha laga xarriiqo. Midhadhka aan qayilin waxaa oogadooda ka muuqanaya ladnaan iyo caafimaad. Hore ayaannu ugu sii soconnay. Waxaannu galnay Balli-gubadle. Magacu waxaa uu ka soo jeedaa, balli loogu magacdaray nin gubadle la odhan jiray. yacnii Balligii Gubadle. Waxaa naloo sheegay in reer Gubadle sii dhaqanyihiin. Magaalada waxaa dhex mara xadka Somaliland iyo dawlad-deegaanka Soomaalida. Laakiin waa magaalo keli ah. Marka dhinaca Somaliland laga soo galo, waxaad dareemaysaa horumar. Waddooyin laami ah oo dhisan. Guryo dawladeed oo muuqanaya, sida ka gobolka, baanka, xeer ilaaliyaha, khayriyada, booliska, ciidanka iyo qaar kale oo badan. Dhismayaal shicib oo fara badan masaajiddo waaweyn. Jidka laga galo aad baa loo qurxiyey. Judhiiba waxaannu fadhiisannay makhaayad hablo haystaan oo aannu ka shaahaynay. Waxaannu kula yara sheekaysannay nin oday ah oo leh weji wanaagsan oo bilaa balwad ah. Wuxuu noo sheegay in uu yahay 67 jir, ubadka uu dhalay ee u nooli yihiin 17 ay badankoodu hanaqaadeen. Wuxuu ahaa hayb ahaan jufada Maxaad-fanax. Wuxuu noo sheegay in magaaladan la wada dego oo aanay u gaar ahayn Arab balse Sacad Muuse iyo Garxajisba ay deggenyihiin, sida uu hadalka u dhigay. Annaga oo halkii fadhina, waxaa noogu yimid agaasimaha isbitaalka magaalada dr Cabdixakiim Maxamed oo helay xogtayada. Waxaa uu na geeyey isbitaalka magaalada oo si waaangsan u qalabaysan. Wuxuu noo sheegay in 24ka saacadoodba uu dhakhtarku furanyahay, shaqaaluhuna isbeddelaan., shaybaadhku uu shaqaynayo, qaybta ummusha iyo waadhka la xiddhiidhsani shaqaynayaan, xitaa waadhadhka kale shaqaynayaan. Shaqaaluhu waxay soo shaqagelidda iyo bixitaanka ku diiwaangeliyaan mishiin derbiga ku dheggen. Mid ka mid ah waadhadhka oo aannu galnay waxaa yaallay sariiro cusub. Waxaa naloo sheegay in ay qalabkaas iibisay gabadh keli ah oo qurbajoog ahi. Ilaahay khayr badan ha ugu beddelo wixii ay bixisay maal, maskax iyo dadaal kaleba. Dumarkeennu waa waxtar, meel kasta iyo goor kasta. Waxaan ku qiyaasay qarashka sariirahaa oo toban ku dhawaa, in ay dadka qaar ku gubaan xaflad ay habeen tageen. Agaasimaha isbitaalka waxa aannu waydiinnay, baahida ugu degdeg badan ee aragtidiisa uu isbitaalku qabo. Wuxuu noo sheegay laba arrimood oo aan ahayn kuwa keli ah ee loo baahanyahay balse uu jeclaan lahaa in uu arko iyaga oo dhammaystirmay: 1- Baanka kaydka dhiigga. Kaas ma haysto isbitaalku, waanu u baahanyahay. 2- Deryka dhulka isbitaalka. Isbitaalku wuxuu ku yaallaa badhtamaha magaalada. wuxuu haystaa dhul wanaagsan oo badankiisu aannu deyrnayn. Dhul ka badan Hal bolog oo uu isbitaalku leeyahay, ayaan deyrnayn. Haddii dhulkaaas loo deyro isbitaalka, magaalada iyo deegaanka waa uu ku filnaan karaa 50ka sano ee soo socda. Waxaan ku darsanayaa: Wakhtigan hadda la joogo, waxaa dadka lagu salliday dhulkii oo dan gaar ah loo qaato. Waa musiibo ka jirta dhammaan geyiga Soomaaliyeed. Waxaan ku baaqayaa in isbitaalkaas si degdeg ah loogu xidho dhulkiisa si meesha looga saaro werwer kasta, isla markaana loogu kaydiyo jiilasha dambe. ugu badnaan 30 kun oo dollar ayaa deyr wanaagsan ku wareejin kara inta bannaan. Waxaa bixin kara qof ama10 qof ama 30 qof. Haddii bulshada loo bandhigana waa 300 oo qof oo min 100 doollar ku deeqa. ama 1000 qof oo min 30 doollar ku darsada. Haddii aad niyadda geliso in aad hawshaas ku darsato sadaqo jaari ah, waxaan isku kiin xidhi ciddii hawshaas u kacda. Agaasimaha Isbitaalka waxaan guddoonsiiyey dhowr buug oo aan islahaa aad dhigtid maktabadda akhriska ee magaalada balse waxaa ii caddaatay in aanay magaaladu lahayn makhtabad dadweyne. Agaasimuhu si sharaf leh ayuu noo maamuusay, waaanu mahadsanyahay. Maadama oo ay Balli-gubadle ahayd xaruntii ururkii dhaqdhaqaaqa waddaniga Soomaaliyeed ee SNM iyo goobtii lagu doortay guddoomiyihii ugu dambeeyey ee Cabdiraxmaan-tuur, sidoo kalena laga soo abaabulay jabhadihii SPM ee Axmed Cumar-jees iyo USC ee janaraal Caydiid, waxaa nala soo tusay: Saldhiggii snm, meeshii ay taallay idaacaddii Halgan ee snm iyo meeshii uu ka dhacay shirki ballaadhnaa ee lagu doortay Guddoomiye Cabdiraxmaan Axmed Cali. Goobtani waa beer lagu magacaabo beerta Ilma Carwo. Markii aan magaca Carwo maqlay waxaan toos ugu xidhiidhiyey Xirsi Cige Gorse (Xirsi-Carwo) oo aan sannadkii 2025 ku booqday Matxafka taariikhiga ee Sweden ee loo yaqaan Ethnographic Museum, raadkii laga reebay carwooyinkii uu hoggaamin jiray dhammaadkii 1800-lladii. Qisooyinka carwooyinkii ku wareegi jiray Yurub iyo Ameerika waa qiso dheer oo yaable. Beertaas ilam Carwo iyo beerta galbeed ka xigta ee Ilma Faarax-jire dhexdooda waxaa laga dhisay taallo yar oo ku dhextaal guri yar deyrkii oo lagu xusayo SNM. Booqashadii dalxiiska ahayd, ee Balligubadle, halkaas ayey noogu dhammaatay, ka dibna waxaannu u jihaysannay dhinaca Sallaxlay oo mudan qormo kale. Mohamed Abdibashiir Xirsi Guuleed

Annaga oo halkii fadhina, waxaa noogu yimid agaasimaha isbitaalka magaalada dr Cabdixakiim Maxamed oo helay xogtayada. Waxaa uu na geeyey isbitaalka magaalada oo si waaangsan u qalabaysan. Wuxuu noo sheegay in 24ka saacadoodba uu dhakhtarku furanyahay, shaqaaluhuna isbeddelaan., shaybaadhku uu shaqaynayo, qaybta ummusha iyo waadhka la xiddhiidhsani shaqaynayaan, xitaa waadhadhka kale shaqaynayaan. Shaqaaluhu waxay soo shaqagelidda iyo bixitaanka ku diiwaangeliyaan mishiin derbiga ku dheggen. Mid ka mid ah waadhadhka oo aannu galnay waxaa yaallay sariiro cusub. Waxaa naloo sheegay in ay qalabkaas iibisay gabadh keli ah oo qurbajoog ahi. Ilaahay khayr badan ha ugu beddelo wixii ay bixisay maal, maskax iyo dadaal kaleba. Dumarkeennu waa waxtar, meel kasta iyo goor kasta. Waxaan ku qiyaasay qarashka sariirahaa oo toban ku dhawaa, in ay dadka qaar ku gubaan xaflad ay habeen tageen. Agaasimaha isbitaalka waxa aannu waydiinnay, baahida ugu degdeg badan ee aragtidiisa uu isbitaalku qabo. Wuxuu noo sheegay laba arrimood oo aan ahayn kuwa keli ah ee loo baahanyahay balse uu jeclaan lahaa in uu arko iyaga oo dhammaystirmay: 1- Baanka kaydka dhiigga. Kaas ma haysto isbitaalku, waanu u baahanyahay. 2- Deryka dhulka isbitaalka. Isbitaalku wuxuu ku yaallaa badhtamaha magaalada. wuxuu haystaa dhul wanaagsan oo badankiisu aannu deyrnayn. Dhul ka badan Hal bolog oo uu isbitaalku leeyahay, ayaan deyrnayn. Haddii dhulkaaas loo deyro isbitaalka, magaalada iyo deegaanka waa uu ku filnaan karaa 50ka sano ee soo socda. Waxaan ku darsanayaa: Wakhtigan hadda la joogo, waxaa dadka lagu salliday dhulkii oo dan gaar ah loo qaato. Waa musiibo ka jirta dhammaan geyiga Soomaaliyeed. Waxaan ku baaqayaa in isbitaalkaas si degdeg ah loogu xidho dhulkiisa si meesha looga saaro werwer kasta, isla markaana loogu kaydiyo jiilasha dambe. ugu badnaan 30 kun oo dollar ayaa deyr wanaagsan ku wareejin kara inta bannaan. Waxaa bixin kara qof ama10 qof ama 30 qof. Haddii bulshada loo bandhigana waa 300 oo qof oo min 100 doollar ku deeqa. ama 1000 qof oo min 30 doollar ku darsada. Haddii aad niyadda geliso in aad hawshaas ku darsato sadaqo jaari ah, waxaan isku kiin xidhi ciddii hawshaas u kacda. Agaasimaha Isbitaalka waxaan guddoonsiiyey dhowr buug oo aan islahaa aad dhigtid maktabadda akhriska ee magaalada balse waxaa ii caddaatay in aanay magaaladu lahayn makhtabad dadweyne. Agaasimuhu si sharaf leh ayuu noo maamuusay, waaanu mahadsanyahay. Maadama oo ay Balli-gubadle ahayd xaruntii ururkii dhaqdhaqaaqa waddaniga Soomaaliyeed ee SNM iyo goobtii lagu doortay guddoomiyihii ugu dambeeyey ee Cabdiraxmaan-tuur, sidoo kalena laga soo abaabulay jabhadihii SPM ee Axmed Cumar-jees iyo USC ee janaraal Caydiid, waxaa nala soo tusay: Saldhiggii snm, meeshii ay taallay idaacaddii Halgan ee snm iyo meeshii uu ka dhacay shirki ballaadhnaa ee lagu doortay Guddoomiye Cabdiraxmaan Axmed Cali. Goobtani waa beer lagu magacaabo beerta Ilma Carwo. Markii aan magaca Carwo maqlay waxaan toos ugu xidhiidhiyey Xirsi Cige Gorse (Xirsi-Carwo) oo aan sannadkii 2025 ku booqday Matxafka taariikhiga ee Sweden ee loo yaqaan Ethnographic Museum, raadkii laga reebay carwooyinkii uu hoggaamin jiray dhammaadkii 1800-lladii. Qisooyinka carwooyinkii ku wareegi jiray Yurub iyo Ameerika waa qiso dheer oo yaable. Beertaas ilam Carwo iyo beerta galbeed ka xigta ee Ilma Faarax-jire dhexdooda waxaa laga dhisay taallo yar oo ku dhextaal guri yar deyrkii oo lagu xusayo SNM. Booqashadii dalxiiska ahayd, ee Balligubadle, halkaas ayey noogu dhammaatay, ka dibna waxaannu u jihaysannay dhinaca Sallaxlay oo mudan qormo kale. Mohamed Abdibashiir Xirsi Guuleed

items.title: Shiinaha oo ciidamo cusub u soo  diray Gacanka Cadmeed iyo biyaha Soomaaliya
items.description: Dowladda Shiinaha ayaa Gacanka Cadmeed iyo biyaha Soomaaliya u soo dirtay cutubkeedii 49-aad ee ciidamada badda, taas oo qeyb ka ah howlgalka joogtada ah ee Beijing ay ka waddo sugidda amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga iyo la dagaallanka burcad-badeedda ee xeebaha Soomaaliya. Wasaaradda Difaaca Shiinaha ayaa sheegtay in cutubkan cusub uu ka ambabaxay deked militari oo ku taalla magaalada Sanya ee gobolka Hainan subaxnimadii 12-ka Agoosto 2026. Maraakiibta ka qeyb qaadanaysa howlgalka Ciidanka cusub waxaa hoggaaminaya markabka dagaalka ee Kunming (Hull 172), oo ah nooca Type 052D ee burburiyeyaasha gantaallada hagaya. Waxaa sidoo kale qeyb ka ah markabka dagaalka Yueyang, oo ah markab nooca frigate-ka ah, iyo markabka sahayda iyo taageerada fog ee Luomahu. Saddexda markab ayaa ah kuwo ay Shiinuhu si madax-bannaan u naqshadeeyeen una dhiseen, waxaana inta badan laga soo xulay ciidamada badda ee hoos yimaada Taliska Tiyaatarka Koonfureed ee Ciidanka Xoreynta Dadka Shiinaha (PLA). Cutubka waxaa kale oo la socda laba diyaaradood oo qumaatiga u kaca oo saaran maraakiibta iyo tobannaan askari oo ka tirsan ciidamada howlgalada gaarka ah. Cutubka 49-aad ayaa la filayaa inuu kala wareego cutubkii 48-aad ee ciidamada badda Shiinaha, kaas oo howlgalka ka waday gobolka tan iyo bishii Oktoobar 2025. Hawlaha ugu muhiimsan ee cutubka cusub waxaa ka mid noqon doona ilaalinta maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara Gacanka Cadmeed, ka hortagga burcad-badeedda iyo bixinta gargaar haddii maraakiibta ay la kulmaan xaalado degdeg ah. Gacanka Cadmeed ayaa muhiimad gaar ah u leh ganacsiga caalamiga ah, maadaama uu yahay marin isku xira Badweynta Hindiya iyo Badda Cas, iyadoo maraakiib badan oo u kala goosha Aasiya, Afrika iyo Yurub ay isticmaalaan waddadan. Shiinaha ayaa joogitaan ciidan-badeed oo joogto ah ku lahaa Gacanka Cadmeed iyo biyaha Soomaaliya tan iyo Diseembar 2008, xilli ay beesha caalamku kordhisay dadaallada lagu ilaalinayo maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara xeebaha Soomaaliya. Beijing waxay joogitaankeeda ku salaysaa qaraarrada Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay iyo baahida loo qabo in la ilaaliyo amniga waddooyinka muhiimka ah ee maraakiibta caalamiga ah. Warbaahinta dowladda Shiinaha ee Xinhua ayaa sheegtay in howlgalada ciidamada badda Shiinaha ay ilaa hadda ku lug yeesheen ilaalinta in ka badan 7,000 markab oo Shiinaha iyo dalal kale laga leeyahay, iyadoo ciidamada Shiinuhu ay sidoo kale sameeyeen hawlgallo samatabixin, ilaalin iyo gargaar ay siiyeen maraakiib ay xaalado adag ku qabsadeen. Ka hor inta aysan ka ambabixin Shiinaha, ciidamada cutubka 49-aad waxay sameeyeen tababarro gaar ah oo lagu diyaarinayay xaaladaha ay la kulmi karaan inta ay howlgalka ku jiraan. Tababarada waxaa diiradda lagu saaray adeegsiga hubka, isku-duwidda howlgalada ilaalinta maraakiibta iyo buuxinta sahayda iyadoo maraakiibtu ay badda ku jiraan. Shiinuhu wuxuu sheegay in tababaradaasi ay ku salaysnaayeen xaalado halis ah oo suuragal ah, si ciidamada loogu diyaariyo inay si degdeg ah uga jawaabaan khataraha ka dhasha howlgalka. Dirista cutubka 49-aad waxay muujinaysaa in Shiinuhu uu weli muhiimad weyn siinayo amniga Gacanka Cadmeed iyo biyaha ku dhow Soomaaliya. Joogitaanka maraakiibta dagaalka ee dal awood weyn leh sida Shiinaha ayaa sidoo kale ka tarjumaya muhiimadda istiraatiijiyadeed ee marin-biyoodka, gaar ahaan xilli amniga Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed uu saameyn ku yeelan karo ganacsiga caalamiga ah iyo isu socodka maraakiibta. Howlgalka cusub ayaa sidaas darteed noqonaya qeyb kale oo ka mid ah joogitaanka muddada dheer ee ciidamada badda Shiinaha ee xeebaha Soomaaliya, iyadoo Beijing ay sheegtay in mudnaanta koowaad ay tahay ilaalinta maraakiibta iyo sugidda amniga marin-biyoodka caalamiga ah.

items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo ka degay Dhuusamareeb + Sawirro
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa maanta gaaray magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimadda dowlad-goboleedka Galmudug. Madaxweynaha iyo wafdigiisa ayaa waxaa si diiran ugu soo dhaweeyay Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye, mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka iyo Galmudug iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada magaalada Dhuusamareeb. Safarka Madaxweynaha ayaa ku qotoma xoojinta dadaallada dowladda Federaalka ee dhismaha iyo tayeynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, iyadoo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu ka qeyb-geli doono munaasabad lagu soo xirayo tababarka cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha ayaa inta uu ku sugan yahay Galmudug sidoo kale daah-furi doona mashaariic horumarineed oo laga hirgeliyay deegaannada dowlad-goboleedka, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ah qorshayaasha lagu dardargelinayo adeegyada bulshada iyo horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha. Mashaariicdan ayaa lagu sheegay inay qeyb ka yihiin dadaallada Dowladda Federaalka ee lagu horumarinayo adeegyada aasaasiga ah, iyadoo diiradda lagu saarayo baahiyaha bulshada iyo xoojinta kaabeyaasha muhiimka u ah horumarka deegaanada Galmudug. Sidoo kale, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa kulamo la qaadan doona qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Galmudug, isagoo dhageysan doona aragtidooda, baahiyahooda dowladnimo iyo talooyinkooda ku aaddan horumarka iyo amniga. Kulamada Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale diiradda lagu saari doonaa arrimaha dowlad-dhiska, xoojinta amniga iyo iskaashiga Dowladda Federaalka iyo Galmudug, iyadoo safarkiisa uu qeyb ka yahay socdaallada uu ku tagayo dowlad-goboleedyada dalka. The post Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo ka degay Dhuusamareeb + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Hassan Sheikh Welcomes New Speaker, Hails Parliament’s Role in Strengthening Somalia’s Institutions
items.description: Mogadishu(WDN) — President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud and PM Hamza attended a state dinner in Mogadishu honoring the newly elected Speaker of Somalia’s House of the People, Abdulqadir Mohamed Nur. Addressing the gathering, President Hassan highlighted what he described as important progress in Somalia’s state-building efforts, including the strengthening of government institutions, development of the country’s legal framework, and adoption of laws intended to provide a lasting foundation for governance and the protection of the national interest. The President praised the leadership and members of the Federal Parliament for fulfilling their constitutional responsibilities, emphasizing that an effective legislature is central to building a state governed by law, accountability and institutional order. Hassan Sheikh also congratulated Speaker Abdulqadir on his election and the confidence placed in him by members of Parliament. He urged the new Speaker to carry out his constitutional responsibilities with efficiency, integrity and a strong sense of public responsibility, expressing hope that his leadership would contribute to strengthening Somalia’s legislative institutions and broader state-building process. With Somalia facing deep political instability, the new Speaker has a formidable task ahead. The opposition maintains that both the parliamentary and presidential mandates have expired, placing the Speaker at the center of a growing constitutional and political crisis. His immediate challenge will be to safeguard Parliament’s independence, uphold the Constitution, and help forge a credible political consensus. items.title: Xaggee Bay Aadeen Dadkii Puntland?
items.description: Tirada dadka ku nool Puntland ayaa la sheegay inay si weyn hoos ugu dhacday muddadii toddobada sano ahayd ee uu Madaxweyne Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni hoggaaminayay maamulka Puntland, sida ay muujinayaan xog iyo tirakoobyo la soo bandhigay. Magaalada Boosaaso ayaa sannadkan lagu sheegay inay ku nool yihiin 232,410 qof, iyadoo 124,893 kamid ah lagu tilmaamay dad barakacayaal ah, sida lagu xusay tirakoobkii 2024. Marka laga reebo dadka barakacayaasha ah, tirada dadka kale ee magaalada ku nool waxay noqonaysaa 107,517 qof. Marka loo eego tirada magaalooyinka kale ee Soomaaliya, Boosaaso waxay ka dambaysaa Muqdisho oo lagu qiyaasay 4,399,430 qof, Hargeysa 1,593,542, Kismaayo 461,302, Burco 427,013, Baydhabo 420,281, Boorama 363,753, Wanlaweyn 314,824, Marka 299,906, Beledweyne 291,630 iyo Jowhar 257,210. Xog kale ayaa tilmaamaysa in shirkadda PEPCO ay guddiga horumarinta magaalada Boosaaso ku wareejisay 19,823 saacadood bishii Abriil ee sannadkan, kuwaas oo isugu jira saacado adeegga korontada ah ee guryaha iyo goobaha ganacsiga. Haddii dhammaan saacadahaas loo qaato inay yihiin guryo degaan ah, waxaa laga qiyaasi karaa tirada dadka magaalada ku nool. Waxaa sidoo kale muhiim ah in la xuso in xogtaasi aysan si buuxda u daboolayn xeryaha barakacayaasha, taas oo ka dhigan in tirada guud ee dadka Boosaaso ku nool ay ka duwanaan karto qiyaasahaas. Boosaaso ayaa horey loogu qiyaasi jiray inay sanadihii 2019 ku noolaan jireen dad gaaraya 615,000 ilaa 700,000 oo qof. Haddii hoos-u-dhaca la sheegay uu sii socdo, waxaa la saadaalinayaa in tirada dadka magaalada ay mustaqbalka si weyn u yaraato. Garoowe iyo Magaalooyinka Kale Hoos-u-dhaca dadka ayaa sidoo kale lagu sheegay caasimadda Puntland ee Garoowe, oo lagu qiyaasay inay ku nool yihiin 94,975 qof. Tiradan ayaa wax yar ka badan dadka lagu qiyaasay magaalada Ceeldaahir, oo lagu sheegay 61,629 qof. Xogta korontada ayaa iyaduna loo adeegsaday in lagu sameeyo qiyaas ku saabsan tirada guryaha iyo dadka ku nool Garoowe. Sida xogta lagu xusay, sanadkii 2020 waxaa jiray ku dhowaad 13,000 saacadood oo koronto ah oo adeeg u ahaa guryaha iyo goobaha ganacsiga. Haddii saacadahaas loo qaato inay matalayaan tirada guryaha, iyadoo celcelis ahaan lix qof lagu qiyaaso guri kasta, tiradu waxay noqon lahayd ku dhowaad 78,000 qof. Xaggee Bay Aadeen Dadkii? items.title: Puntland oo Ciidamo Federaalka ah Ku Biirisay Ciidankeeda
items.description: Puntland (Raxanreeb Online): Puntland ayaa sii wadda soo xerogelinta ciidamada mushaharka ka qaata Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kuwaas oo muddooyinkii u dambeeyay ku sugnaa deegaanno ka tirsan Puntland. Puntland ayaa si rasmi ah ciidamadeeda ugu biirisay ciidamo ku sugnaa deegaanka Kur-ilaalo ee gobolka Karkaar, kuwaas oo sida xogta lagu sheegay ka amar qaadanayay mid kamid ah siyaasiyiinta taageera Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Gobollada Mudug, Karkaar iyo Bari ayaa hadda kamid noqday deegaannada ay ka socdaan dhaqdhaqaaqyada la xiriira ciidamada Federaalka, iyadoo Puntland ay waddo qorshe ay ku mideyneyso ciidamada ku sugan deegaanadeeda. Tallaabadan ayaa loo arkaa guul siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo u soo hoyatay maamulka uu hoggaamiyo Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan khilaafaadka u dhexeeya Puntland iyo Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. items.title: Dufcaddii 5-aad ee Darawiishta oo Tababar Loo Soo Xiray
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Wasiirka Amniga Gudaha ee Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdullaahi Sheekh Ismaaciil (Fartaag), Taliyaha Ciidanka Boliiska Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, iyo Madaxa Hawlgalka Midowga Yurub ee Soomaaliya (EUCAP Somalia), Kęstutis Lančinskas, ayaa si rasmi ah u soo xiray tababarka Dufcadda 5-aad ee Ciidanka Darawiishta. Ciidamada ayaa tababarka lagu baray anshaxa ciidannimo, fulinta howlgallada khatarta ah, maaraynta hubka, ilaalinta xuquuqda aadanaha, iyo sidii gargaar loo siin lahaa ciidamada iyo shacabka waxyeelladu kasoo gaarto goobaha dagaalka. Tababarka ayaa sidoo kale loogu talagalay in ciidamada laga dhigo kuwo isku duuban, ilaaliya nidaamka iyo kala dambeynta, isla markaana u shaqeeya si waafaqsan habraacyada Ciidanka Boliiska Soomaaliyeed. Taliyaha Ciidanka Boliiska Soomaaliyeed, S/Guuto Asad Cismaan Cabdullaahi, ayaa ciidamada qalin-jabiyay ugu hambalyeeyay guusha ay gaareen, isagoo kula dardaarmay inay ilaaliyaan sharafta iyo anshaxa ciidanka, dhowraan sharciga, isla markaana waajibaadkooda u gutaan si daacadnimo iyo masuuliyad leh. items.title: Tahriibayaasha Itoobiyaanka ah oo Ku Sii Kordhaya Boosaaso
items.description: Boosaaso (Raxanreeb Online): Tirada muhaajiriinta Itoobiyaanka ah ee magaalada Boosaaso uga sii gudba dhanka Yemen ayaa si weyn u korortay, iyadoo warbixin cusub oo ay soo saartay IOM lagu sheegay in tiradu ku dhowaad saddex jibbaarantay. Saddexdii bilood ee ugu horreysay 2025, waxaa Boosaaso maray ku dhowaad 6,400 qof, halka muddadii u dhiganta 2026 ay tiradu gaartay 18,600 qof, taasoo muujinaysa koror dhan 189%. Tiradan ayaa sidoo kale ka sarreysa heerkii ugu badnaa ee horey loo diiwaangeliyay, kaas oo ahaa 17,900 qof saddexdii bilood ee ugu dambeeyay 2024. Kororka ayaa lala xiriiriyay adkeynta xannibaadaha iyo shuruudaha gelitaanka Jabuuti, taasoo muhaajiriinta ku riixday inay adeegsadaan waddooyin kale oo dhulka ah. Muhaajiriintu waxay maraan waddooyinka isku xira Boorama, Wajaale, Hargeysa, Berbera, Burco, Ceerigaabo iyo Boosaaso, iyagoo ugu dambeyn u gudba Yemen. Warbixinta ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in Boosaaso ay ku sugan yihiin qiyaastii 2,200 carruur ah oo aan cidina la socon, kuwaas oo wajahaya khataro ay kamid yihiin tacaddi iyo xadgudubyo kale. items.title: Somaliland, AFRICOM Hold Talks on Maritime Security and Defense Cooperation
items.description: Hargeisa (WDN) — Defense officials from Somaliland and the U.S. Africa Command (AFRICOM) are engaged in active discussions aimed at strengthening cooperation on maritime security, defense, and regional stability. Bashir Good, Somaliland’s representative in the United States, told Fox News that the talks are progressing positively and are focused particularly on expanding cooperation between Somaliland and the United States on maritime security. Good emphasized Somaliland’s strategic location along the Gulf of Aden and its readiness to deepen security cooperation with Washington, particularly amid growing concerns over instability and threats affecting the Red Sea and wider Horn of Africa region. The discussions follow recent high-level exchanges between the two sides. An AFRICOM delegation recently visited Somaliland, while a Somaliland delegation led by the territory’s Minister of Defense traveled to AFRICOM headquarters in Stuttgart, Germany. During the meetings, officials discussed defense cooperation, maritime security, regional stability, and the strategic importance of the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. The talks come as maritime security has become an increasingly important concern in the region, with the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden serving as critical international shipping routes while facing growing security challenges. For Somaliland, deeper engagement with AFRICOM could provide an opportunity to strengthen its security capabilities and raise its strategic profile with Washington. For the United States, Somaliland’s location offers potential strategic value in monitoring maritime activity and responding to emerging security threats across the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea corridor. The extent to which the discussions will translate into formal defense cooperation remains unclear, but the growing frequency of high-level contacts signals a potentially significant expansion of security engagement between Somaliland and the United States. items.title: When the Bulldozer Comes Home: Two State Journalists Turn Critics
items.description: Mogadishu (WDN) — Two veteran journalists who spent years working for Somalia’s state media and defending government policies have now become outspoken critics of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s displacement policies after reportedly finding themselves and their families among those affected by demolitions in Mogadishu. Mustaf War Caddeeye and Ismaaciil Orange, who reportedly worked for the national media for nearly two decades, have recently spoken through independent media against the government’s ongoing land-clearance operations. The irony is difficult to miss. For years, they were among the voices defending the government while other Somalis watched their homes demolished. Now that the bulldozer has reportedly reached their own neighborhoods, their tone has changed dramatically. Their experience raises an uncomfortable question: how different might their position be if government policies had never reached their own doorstep? Critics may accuse them of discovering the importance of accountability only after becoming victims themselves. But their personal experience also gives them an opportunity to expose what many displaced families have been saying for years. The issue, however, should go beyond these two journalists. Every Somali citizen deserves protection of their property, due process and the right to challenge government decisions—regardless of whether they support or oppose the administration. The government should therefore answer basic questions: Who owns the disputed land? Who authorized the demolitions? Were residents given lawful notice? Were compensation and legal remedies provided? And who ultimately benefits from the cleared properties? The episode offers a powerful lesson in politics and journalism: government power may appear distant when it is used against someone else. But once the bulldozer reaches your own home, the meaning of accountability suddenly becomes very personal. Somalia should not need every citizen to experience displacement before demanding justice for those who already have. items.title: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo bogaadiyey Baarlamaanka, kana hadlay horumarka Soomaaliya iyo mas’uuliyadda hortaalla Golaha Shacabka
items.description: Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa Muqdisho kaga qeyb galay munaasabad sharaf ah oo lagu maamuusay xildhibaannada iyo hoggaanka Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya. Madaxweynaha ayaa khudbaddiisa ku ammaanay Baarlamaanka hadda jira, isaga oo isbarbardhig ku sameeyay xaaladdii iyo hab-dhaqankii baarlamaannadii hore iyo sida uu sheegay in Golaha Shacabka maanta u shaqeeyo. Xasan Sheekh ayaa sheegay in baarlamaannadii hore mararka qaar ay ka dhex dhici jireen buuq iyo is-qabqabsi, iyadoo doodaha qaarkood ay gaari jireen heer qalabka baarlamaanka iyo miisaska shaqada la waxyeelleeyo. Madaxweynaha ayaa xusay in Baarlamaanka maanta uu kaga duwan yahay kuwii hore in xildhibaannadu ay xoogga saarayaan doodaha iyo shaqada sharci-dejinta, gaar ahaan arrimaha khuseeya shacabka Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Golaha Shacabka ay horyaallaan masuuliyado muhiim ah inta ka harsan muddada xilka, gaar ahaan arrimaha la xiriira geeddi-socodka siyaasadeed, doorashooyinka iyo nidaamka xisbiyada siyaasadeed ee dalka. Wuxuu hambalyo iyo bogaadin gaar ah u jeediyay hoggaanka Golaha Shacabka iyo xildhibaannada, isaga oo tilmaamay in xilka ay hayaan uu yahay mas’uuliyad culus oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka dalka iyo wax ka qabashada caqabadaha horyaalla Soomaaliya. Dhanka kale, Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ku tallaabsanayso horumar dhinacyo badan leh, gaar ahaan diblomaasiyadda, dowlad-dhiska iyo soo kabashada hay’adaha qaranka. Xasan Sheekh ayaa qiray in dunidu ay xilligan wajahayo caqabado iyo dhibaatooyin badan, balse uu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay ku jirto marxalad soo kabasho ah, isla markaana ay horay uga gudubtay dhibaatooyin badan oo muddo dheer dalka ka jiray. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale carrabka ku adkeeyay in shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay xaq u leeyihiin inay yeeshaan aragtiyo kala duwan, isla markaana ay si xor ah uga hadlaan arrimaha dalka. items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo Gaaray Dhuusamareeb
items.description: Galmudug (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa gaaray magaalada Dhuusamareeb, caasimadda Galmudug, halkaas oo si diiran loogu soo dhaweeyay Madaxweynaha Galmudug, Axmed Cabdi Kaariye, mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan Dowladda Federaalka iyo Galmudug iyo qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Safarka Madaxweynaha ayaa diiradda lagu saarayaa xoojinta dadaallada dowladda ee dhismaha iyo tayeynta Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, iyadoo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu ka qeyb geli doono munaasabad lagu soo xirayo tababarka cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka Soomaaliyeed. Inta uu ku sugan yahay Galmudug, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa sidoo kale daah-furi doona mashaariic horumarineed oo laga hirgeliyay deegaannada maamulka, kuwaas oo qeyb ka ah qorshayaasha lagu dardargelinayo adeegyada dadweynaha iyo horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo bulshada. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale kulamo la qaadan doona qeybaha kala duwan ee bulshada Galmudug, isagoo dhageysan doona aragtidooda, baahiyahooda iyo talooyinkooda ku aaddan horumarka, amniga, dowlad-dhiska iyo mustaqbalka dalka. The post Xasan Sheekh oo Gaaray Dhuusamareeb appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Guddoomiye Jaamac oo digniin kasoo saaray fara-gelin shisheeye oo uu sheegay in…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) ayaa shaaciyay in Soomaaliya ay wajahayso fara-gelin shisheeye oo uu ku tilmaamay mid lagu rabo in dalka lagu sii hayo ku-tiirsanaan iyo daciifnimo siyaasadeed. Jaamac oo ka hadlayay munaasabad xalay lagu soo dhaweynayay ayaa sheegay in dalka uu marayo marxalad xasaasi ah, taas oo ay sabab u yihiin ku-tiirsanaanta gargaarka dibadda, xaaladda dhaqaale, khatarta kooxaha hubeysan, kala-qaybsanaanta bulshada iyo siyaasado uu ku tilmaamay kuwo aan dalka wax hore u socod ah u lahayn. Guddoomiyaha ayaa xusay in isbeddellada siyaasadeed ee socda ay keeni karaan caqabado iyo kala-aragti duwanaansho, balse uu muhiim yahay in la isku dayo waddooyin cusub oo lagu wajahayo caqabadaha jira, iyadoo natiijada ugu dambeysana loo daynayo qaddarka Alle. Waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyay in Soomaaliya ay uga gudbi karto caqabadaha haysta oo keliya isku-duubni, is-aaminaad, isu-tanaasul iyo wada-shaqeyn, isagoo sheegay inuu dadaal gelin doono sidii Golaha Shacabka uu u noqon lahaa gole mideysan oo si dhab ah u matala shacabka Soomaaliyeed. “Waxaa na haysata waqti kooban oo isla markaana xasaasi ah, waxaana ku shaqeyn doonnaa aragti iyo farsamo, si aan u hoggaamiyo Golaha Shacabka oo isku duuban, si dhab ahna u matala shacabka Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiye Jaamac. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Golaha Shacabka ay saaran tahay mas’uuliyad culus, maadaama uu yahay hay’adda wakiilka ka ah shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo dowlad-goboleedyada dalka, isagoo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la ilaaliyo midnimada iyo wadajirka baarlamaanka. “Waqtiga haray waa mid kooban oo xasaasi ah, sidaas darteed waxaa loo baahan yahay in baarlamaanku si hufan uga shaqeeyo mas’uuliyadda ka saaran, isla markaana uu door muuqda ka qaato xallinta caqabadaha siyaasadeed ee dalka,” ayuu yiri Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka. items.title: The Mecca Pact and Somaliland’s Rising Geopolitical Value
items.description: Gulaid Yusuf The Mecca Pact and Somaliland’s Rising Geopolitical Value “From Mecca to Bab el-Mandeb: Geopolitics, Diplomacy, and Strategic Competition in the Red Sea.” From Gulf Security to Horn Strategy: The Mecca Pact and Somaliland’s Rising Geopolitical Value The Saudi Arabia – Türkiye – Pakistan defense pact is reshaping the strategic map from the Gulf to the Horn of Africa . For Israel , India , the UAE and the United States , Somaliland is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore. The signing of the Saudi Arabia–Türkiye–Pakistan Joint Defense Agreement in Mecca on 7 August 2026 should not be viewed simply as another bilateral or regional defense arrangement. Its significance lies in the geography surrounding it. The three countries are creating a new institutional framework for security cooperation at a moment when the Middle East is undergoing a major strategic transformation. The agreement’s collective-defense principle—under which an armed attack against one participant is treated as an attack against all three—gives the relationship a degree of strategic weight that goes beyond their existing bilateral ties. Turkish officials have emphasized that the agreement is defensive and is not directed against a particular country. It would therefore be premature to describe it as a formal anti- Iran or anti-Israel alliance. But the agreement nevertheless matters because it institutionalizes a convergence among three states whose strategic interests increasingly intersect across the Middle East, Arabian Sea and Indian Ocean . And that convergence does not stop at the Red Sea . It reaches toward the Gulf of Aden , Bab el-Mandeb and the Horn of Africa. That is where Somaliland enters the equation. A security system is emerging from the Gulf to the Horn The traditional division between Middle Eastern politics and Horn of Africa geopolitics is becoming increasingly difficult to sustain. The Persian Gulf , Arabian Sea, Gulf of Aden, Bab el-Mandeb, Red Sea and Suez Canal are not independent strategic theaters. They form an interconnected maritime system through which energy, trade, military deployments and geopolitical influence move. A disruption in the Red Sea affects the Suez Canal. Instability around Yemen affects shipping entering the Gulf of Aden. Security developments in Saudi Arabia influence calculations along the Red Sea coast. Military cooperation between Türkiye and Somalia affects the western side of the Gulf of Aden. Port investments in Berbera connect the Gulf with the Horn. And the strategic interests of India, Israel, the UAE, Ethiopia and the United States increasingly intersect across the same geography. The Mecca agreement should therefore be interpreted as part of this wider process. Its importance is not simply that Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan have signed a defense pact. Its importance is that a new regional security network is becoming more institutionalized at precisely the moment when maritime competition around the Red Sea is intensifying. The strategic question is consequently no longer confined to who controls the Gulf or who influences Yemen. It increasingly concerns who can shape the wider network connecting the Middle East, the Red Sea, the Horn of Africa and the western Indian Ocean. Türkiye’s Horn strategy gives the agreement an African dimension Türkiye is particularly important in this equation because it already possesses a significant strategic presence on the African side of the Gulf of Aden. Ankara ‘s relationship with Somalia has developed into one of its most important security and political partnerships in Africa. Turkish military training, defense cooperation and political engagement have given Ankara substantial influence in Mogadishu . This matters because Türkiye is not approaching the Horn from a distance. It already has strategic depth there. The Mecca agreement therefore gives an existing Turkish regional presence a broader geopolitical context. Türkiye’s relationship with Somalia is also relevant to Somaliland. Ankara has traditionally supported Somalia’s territorial-integrity position and has opposed moves that could lead to Somaliland’s international recognition. This creates a strategic contrast between two emerging poles on the western side of the Gulf of Aden. One is centered on Mogadishu and Türkiye. The other is increasingly centered on Hargeisa , Berbera and the networks connecting Somaliland with Ethiopia, the UAE, Israel and potentially India. This does not mean that these two systems must inevitably become military rivals. But it does mean that the strategic geography of the Horn is becoming more competitive. Berbera is changing Somaliland’s strategic value The most important element of Somaliland’s strategic position is not recognition alone. It is Berbera . The development of Berbera Port and the Berbera–Ethiopia corridor has transformed Somaliland’s geographical position into a functioning logistical asset. This is what can be understood as Corridor Power : the ability of a strategically located territory to increase its geopolitical importance by connecting ports, infrastructure, trade routes, economic hinterlands and security networks. Somaliland possesses several components of this power simultaneously. Its coastline places it on the Gulf of Aden. Berbera converts that geography into port and logistical capacity. The corridor toward Ethiopia connects the coast to one of Africa’s largest landlocked economies. And its expanding relations with Israel, the UAE and Ethiopia give the port a diplomatic and strategic dimension. These relationships reinforce one another. The port creates economic value. The corridor creates continental relevance. Economic relevance generates external interests. External interests create security considerations. Security considerations increase diplomatic engagement. And diplomatic engagement can eventually influence recognition. That is why Somaliland should not be viewed simply through the conventional question of whether it is recognized as a sovereign state. Its strategic importance is increasingly being produced by connectivity. Israel’s recognition changed the calculation Israel’s recognition of Somaliland on 26 December 2025 fundamentally changed the diplomatic environment surrounding the territory. Before recognition, Somaliland’s international status could largely be treated as a frozen diplomatic question. After recognition, it became a strategic question with an established precedent. Recognition did not automatically produce international consensus. Somalia continues to reject Somaliland’s independence, and many states remain cautious about changing the regional status quo. But Israel’s decision demonstrated that a major external power was prepared to connect Somaliland’s diplomatic status with its own strategic interests. For Israel, geography is difficult to ignore. Somaliland lies on the southern side of the Gulf of Aden, close to the maritime system leading toward Bab el-Mandeb and the Red Sea. For a country whose security and commercial interests are directly affected by instability in the Red Sea, developments on the opposite side of the maritime corridor matter. The significance of Somaliland for Israel therefore goes beyond diplomatic symbolism. It potentially concerns maritime security, intelligence, early warning, commercial shipping and the wider security environment surrounding the southern Red Sea. Israel’s recognition should consequently be understood as more than a bilateral diplomatic decision. It can also be interpreted as an attempt to establish a political relationship with a strategically positioned actor at a critical point in the emerging Red Sea security architecture. The UAE and Ethiopia provide the economic bridge The UAE is central to this transformation because Abu Dhabi ‘s relationship with Somaliland has been built around ports, logistics and commercial infrastructure. Berbera is particularly important because it links maritime access to a continental market. That market is Ethiopia. For Addis Ababa , maritime diversification is a strategic necessity. Ethiopia’s dependence on Djibouti for most of its maritime trade creates a concentration of logistical vulnerability. The Berbera corridor provides another potential route. This does not mean Ethiopia will abandon Djibouti. The more rational strategy is diversification. For Ethiopia, multiple maritime options mean greater resilience and greater bargaining power. For Somaliland, Ethiopia provides something equally important: economic depth. A port without a hinterland has limited strategic value. A port connected to a major continental economy is considerably more important. This is why Berbera should be understood not as an isolated port but as part of a larger maritime–continental corridor. The UAE’s investment, Ethiopia’s maritime requirements and Somaliland’s geographical position therefore reinforce one another. The result is a strategic network that exists independently of whether all participating states agree on Somaliland’s final political status. India cannot ignore the western Indian Ocean The Mecca agreement also introduces a major Indian dimension. Pakistan’s participation means that the new security arrangement is no longer purely Middle Eastern. It extends into the strategic environment of the Arabian Sea and western Indian Ocean. For India, this is significant. New Delhi ‘s interests extend westward from the Arabian Sea through the Gulf of Aden and Red Sea toward the Suez Canal and Mediterranean . The security of these maritime routes is directly connected to India’s energy supplies and trade. The emergence of a stronger Saudi–Türkiye–Pakistan security relationship therefore creates an additional incentive for India to examine the strategic geography of the southern Red Sea. Somaliland offers India something distinctive. It sits close to the Gulf of Aden and provides a potential platform for maritime cooperation without requiring India to immediately transform its relationship with Somaliland into a military alliance. Maritime-domain awareness, port cooperation, commercial investment, coast-guard cooperation, anti-piracy efforts and diplomatic engagement could all deepen India’s presence. Recognition is ultimately a political decision. But strategic engagement does not have to wait for recognition. This distinction is increasingly important. The emerging strategic network The significance of Somaliland becomes clearest when these relationships are viewed together. The emerging network can be understood through several connected corridors. The maritime corridor runs through the Gulf of Aden and Bab el-Mandeb toward the Red Sea and Suez. The continental corridor connects Berbera to Ethiopia. The commercial corridor links Berbera with UAE investment and global logistics. The diplomatic corridor connects Somaliland with Israel, the UAE and Ethiopia, with India potentially becoming an additional node. And the security corridor is developing through growing concern over maritime threats, intelligence, surveillance and the protection of commercial shipping. These corridors do not constitute a formal alliance. That is precisely why they are important. Modern geopolitical competition does not always take the form of formal military blocs. Influence can be accumulated through ports, infrastructure, logistics, trade, technology, intelligence, diplomatic recognition and strategic partnerships. The power of a network comes from the connections between its nodes. Somaliland’s importance therefore derives not simply from what it is, but from what it connects. The United States faces a strategic choice Washington must also reconsider whether Somaliland can continue to be treated primarily through the lens of Somalia policy. The regional environment has changed. The United States now faces an increasingly complex strategic environment involving Iran, the Houthis , Saudi Arabia, Türkiye, Pakistan, Israel, India, the UAE, Ethiopia and China . The Red Sea has become an important arena of strategic competition. In this environment, Somaliland’s geographical position deserves greater attention. This does not necessarily mean that Washington must immediately recognize Somaliland. A more immediate question is whether the United States should develop a comprehensive strategy toward Berbera, maritime security and Somaliland’s role in the western Indian Ocean. The danger of strategic delay is that infrastructure, commercial interests and security partnerships can become entrenched. Once a regional network becomes institutionalized, joining it becomes more expensive than participating during its formation. This is the deeper significance of the current moment. Recognition is becoming a question of strategic architecture The central mistake would be to treat Somaliland’s recognition as an isolated diplomatic issue. For Israel , India , the UAE and the United States , Somaliland is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore. The signing of the Saudi Arabia–Türkiye–Pakistan Joint Defense Agreement in Mecca on 7 August 2026 should not be viewed simply as another bilateral or regional defense arrangement. Its significance lies in the geography surrounding it. The three countries are creating a new institutional framework for security cooperation at a moment when the Middle East is undergoing a major strategic transformation. The agreement’s collective-defense principle—under which an armed attack against one participant is treated as an attack against all three—gives the relationship a degree of strategic weight that goes beyond their existing bilateral ties. Turkish officials have emphasized that the agreement is defensive and is not directed against a particular country. It would therefore be premature to describe it as a formal anti- Iran or anti-Israel alliance. But the agreement nevertheless matters because it institutionalizes a convergence among three states whose strategic interests increasingly intersect across the Middle East, Arabian Sea and Indian Ocean . And that convergence does not stop at the Red Sea . It reaches toward the Gulf of Aden , Bab el-Mandeb and the Horn of Africa. That is where Somaliland enters the equation. A security system is emerging from the Gulf to the Horn The traditional division between Middle Eastern politics and Horn of Africa geopolitics is becoming increasingly difficult to sustain. The Persian Gulf , Arabian Sea, Gulf of Aden, Bab el-Mandeb, Red Sea and Suez Canal are not independent strategic theaters. They form an interconnected maritime system through which energy, trade, military deployments and geopolitical influence move. A disruption in the Red Sea affects the Suez Canal. Instability around Yemen affects shipping entering the Gulf of Aden. Security developments in Saudi Arabia influence calculations along the Red Sea coast. Military cooperation between Türkiye and Somalia affects the western side of the Gulf of Aden. Port investments in Berbera connect the Gulf with the Horn. And the strategic interests of India, Israel, the UAE, Ethiopia and the United States increasingly intersect across the same geography. The Mecca agreement should therefore be interpreted as part of this wider process. Its importance is not simply that Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan have signed a defense pact. Its importance is that a new regional security network is becoming more institutionalized at precisely the moment when maritime competition around the Red Sea is intensifying. The strategic question is consequently no longer confined to who controls the Gulf or who influences Yemen. It increasingly concerns who can shape the wider network connecting the Middle East, the Red Sea, the Horn of Africa and the western Indian Ocean. Türkiye’s Horn strategy gives the agreement an African dimension Türkiye is particularly important in this equation because it already possesses a significant strategic presence on the African side of the Gulf of Aden. Ankara ‘s relationship with Somalia has developed into one of its most important security and political partnerships in Africa. Turkish military training, defense cooperation and political engagement have given Ankara substantial influence in Mogadishu . This matters because Türkiye is not approaching the Horn from a distance. It already has strategic depth there. The Mecca agreement therefore gives an existing Turkish regional presence a broader geopolitical context. Türkiye’s relationship with Somalia is also relevant to Somaliland. Ankara has traditionally supported Somalia’s territorial-integrity position and has opposed moves that could lead to Somaliland’s international recognition. This creates a strategic contrast between two emerging poles on the western side of the Gulf of Aden. One is centered on Mogadishu and Türkiye. The other is increasingly centered on Hargeisa , Berbera and the networks connecting Somaliland with Ethiopia, the UAE, Israel and potentially India. This does not mean that these two systems must inevitably become military rivals. But it does mean that the strategic geography of the Horn is becoming more competitive. Berbera is changing Somaliland’s strategic value The most important element of Somaliland’s strategic position is not recognition alone. It is Berbera . The development of Berbera Port and the Berbera–Ethiopia corridor has transformed Somaliland’s geographical position into a functioning logistical asset. This is what can be understood as Corridor Power : the ability of a strategically located territory to increase its geopolitical importance by connecting ports, infrastructure, trade routes, economic hinterlands and security networks. Somaliland possesses several components of this power simultaneously. Its coastline places it on the Gulf of Aden. Berbera converts that geography into port and logistical capacity. The corridor toward Ethiopia connects the coast to one of Africa’s largest landlocked economies. And its expanding relations with Israel, the UAE and Ethiopia give the port a diplomatic and strategic dimension. These relationships reinforce one another. The port creates economic value. The corridor creates continental relevance. Economic relevance generates external interests. External interests create security considerations. Security considerations increase diplomatic engagement. And diplomatic engagement can eventually influence recognition. That is why Somaliland should not be viewed simply through the conventional question of whether it is recognized as a sovereign state. Its strategic importance is increasingly being produced by connectivity. Israel’s recognition changed the calculation Israel’s recognition of Somaliland on 26 December 2025 fundamentally changed the diplomatic environment surrounding the territory. Before recognition, Somaliland’s international status could largely be treated as a frozen diplomatic question. After recognition, it became a strategic question with an established precedent. Recognition did not automatically produce international consensus. Somalia continues to reject Somaliland’s independence, and many states remain cautious about changing the regional status quo. But Israel’s decision demonstrated that a major external power was prepared to connect Somaliland’s diplomatic status with its own strategic interests. For Israel, geography is difficult to ignore. Somaliland lies on the southern side of the Gulf of Aden, close to the maritime system leading toward Bab el-Mandeb and the Red Sea. For a country whose security and commercial interests are directly affected by instability in the Red Sea, developments on the opposite side of the maritime corridor matter. The significance of Somaliland for Israel therefore goes beyond diplomatic symbolism. It potentially concerns maritime security, intelligence, early warning, commercial shipping and the wider security environment surrounding the southern Red Sea. Israel’s recognition should consequently be understood as more than a bilateral diplomatic decision. It can also be interpreted as an attempt to establish a political relationship with a strategically positioned actor at a critical point in the emerging Red Sea security architecture. The UAE and Ethiopia provide the economic bridge The UAE is central to this transformation because Abu Dhabi ‘s relationship with Somaliland has been built around ports, logistics and commercial infrastructure. Berbera is particularly important because it links maritime access to a continental market. That market is Ethiopia. For Addis Ababa , maritime diversification is a strategic necessity. Ethiopia’s dependence on Djibouti for most of its maritime trade creates a concentration of logistical vulnerability. The Berbera corridor provides another potential route. This does not mean Ethiopia will abandon Djibouti. The more rational strategy is diversification. For Ethiopia, multiple maritime options mean greater resilience and greater bargaining power. For Somaliland, Ethiopia provides something equally important: economic depth. A port without a hinterland has limited strategic value. A port connected to a major continental economy is considerably more important. This is why Berbera should be understood not as an isolated port but as part of a larger maritime–continental corridor. The UAE’s investment, Ethiopia’s maritime requirements and Somaliland’s geographical position therefore reinforce one another. The result is a strategic network that exists independently of whether all participating states agree on Somaliland’s final political status. India cannot ignore the western Indian Ocean The Mecca agreement also introduces a major Indian dimension. Pakistan’s participation means that the new security arrangement is no longer purely Middle Eastern. It extends into the strategic environment of the Arabian Sea and western Indian Ocean. For India, this is significant. New Delhi ‘s interests extend westward from the Arabian Sea through the Gulf of Aden and Red Sea toward the Suez Canal and Mediterranean . The security of these maritime routes is directly connected to India’s energy supplies and trade. The emergence of a stronger Saudi–Türkiye–Pakistan security relationship therefore creates an additional incentive for India to examine the strategic geography of the southern Red Sea. Somaliland offers India something distinctive. It sits close to the Gulf of Aden and provides a potential platform for maritime cooperation without requiring India to immediately transform its relationship with Somaliland into a military alliance. Maritime-domain awareness, port cooperation, commercial investment, coast-guard cooperation, anti-piracy efforts and diplomatic engagement could all deepen India’s presence. Recognition is ultimately a political decision. But strategic engagement does not have to wait for recognition. This distinction is increasingly important. The emerging strategic network The significance of Somaliland becomes clearest when these relationships are viewed together. The emerging network can be understood through several connected corridors. The maritime corridor runs through the Gulf of Aden and Bab el-Mandeb toward the Red Sea and Suez. The continental corridor connects Berbera to Ethiopia. The commercial corridor links Berbera with UAE investment and global logistics. The diplomatic corridor connects Somaliland with Israel, the UAE and Ethiopia, with India potentially becoming an additional node. And the security corridor is developing through growing concern over maritime threats, intelligence, surveillance and the protection of commercial shipping. These corridors do not constitute a formal alliance. That is precisely why they are important. Modern geopolitical competition does not always take the form of formal military blocs. Influence can be accumulated through ports, infrastructure, logistics, trade, technology, intelligence, diplomatic recognition and strategic partnerships. The power of a network comes from the connections between its nodes. Somaliland’s importance therefore derives not simply from what it is, but from what it connects. The regional environment has changed. items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo xaqiijiyay arrin muhiim ah xilli walaac xooggan ay qabto Puntland
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa xaqiijiyay in Dowladda Federaalka aysan cid Soomaali ah u hayn colaad, xilli walaac amni muujinayaan maamullada qaar. Xasan ayaa xusay in khilaafaadka siyaasadeed ee dalka ka jira aysan ku saleysneyn deegaan, qabiil ama shaqsi, isagoo sheegay in dowladda ay diyaar u tahay inay ka hortagto cid kasta oo isku dayda inay dhiig daadiso, qalqal-geliso amniga ama dhaawac u geysato midnimada dalka. Madaxweynaha ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in Dowladda Federaalka aysan doonayn inay dhiig daadiso ama colaad abuurto, balse ay waajib ku tahay inay ilaaliso amniga, sharciga iyo xasilloonida dalka. Wuxuu sidoo kale ka digay hadallo iyo ficillo uu sheegay inay kicin karaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed, dibna u soo noolayn kara boogihii hore. “Ma jiro qof Soomaali ah oo ay dowladda iyo mas’uuliyiinteedu colaad u hayaan. Muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed meel kasta oo ay joogaan waday dowladda u hayso wanaag, waxtar, sharaf iyo karaamo,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh. Madaxweynaha ayaa sheegay in waajibka koowaad ee Dowladda Federaalka uu yahay ilaalinta sharciga, midnimada dalka iyo xaqiijinta in Soomaaliya ay hal dhinac u wada socoto, sidaas darteedna aysan jirin naceyb ama colaad cid gaar ah u hayso dowladda dhexe. “Qof kasta xor ayuu u yahay inuu cabbiro fikirkiisa iyo aragtidiisa,” ayuu yiri Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo sidoo kale tilmaamay muhiimadda in laga fogaado hadallo uu ku tilmaamay kuwo dadka kicinaya ama dib u xoqaya boogihii hore ee bulshada Soomaaliyeed. Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda ayaa ugu dambeyntiina ugu baaqay shacabka Soomaaliyeed inay ka shaqeeyaan wanaagga, nabadda iyo midnimada dalka. Si kastaba, hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli Puntland ay ka digtay colaad abuur ay sheegtay in Dowladda Federaalka ka waddo magaalada Gaalkacyo, kaasi oo ay la xiriirisay safarka madaxweynuhu ku tegayo deegaannada maamulka Galmudug. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa Xasan Sheekh lagu eedeeyay inuu weli wado “abaabul colaad ka dhan ah Puntland”, waxaana maamulka uu sheegay inuu si dhow ula socdo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada la xiriira safarkiisa Galmudug. “Dowladda Puntland waxay si dhow ula socotaa abaabulada qorshaysan ee uu Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud wado, waxayna ka digaysaa qorshaha safarka Xasan Sheekh uu ku imaanayo Koonfurta Gaalkacyo ee Dowladda Galmudug,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Puntland waxay ku doodday in safarkaasi uu leeyahay ujeeddo lagu doonayo in qalalaase looga abuuro Gaalkacyo, oo muddooyinkii dambe ka soo kabaneysay colaado iyo xiisado soo noqnoqday. Maamulka ma uusan soo bandhigin caddeymo muujinaya in safarka Xasan Sheekh uu la xiriiro qorshe militari ama qalalaase, Dowladda Federaalkuna weli kama aysan jawaabin eedeymaha cusub ee Puntland. The post Xasan Sheekh oo xaqiijiyay arrin muhiim ah xilli walaac xooggan ay qabto Puntland appeared first on Caasimada Online .
