items.title: Joint Statement on the Sixth Meeting of the Joint Security Coordination Mechanism for the Peace Agreement
items.description: Joint Statement on the Sixth Meeting of the Joint Security Coordination Mechanism for the Peace Agreement Between the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Republic of Rwanda Office of the Spokesperson The text of the following statement was released by the Governments of the United States of America, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Republic of Rwanda, the State of Qatar, the Republic of Togo (as the African Union mediator), and the African Union Commission on the occasion of the sixth Joint Security Coordination Mechanism meeting held this week in Geneva, Switzerland. On August 12-13, 2026, representatives from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Rwanda (the Parties), along with the United States, Qatar, Togo (as the African Union mediator) and the African Union Commission convened the sixth meeting of the Joint Security Coordination Mechanism (JSCM) at the U.S. Mission in Geneva, Switzerland. The DRC and Rwanda agreed to advance two initiatives to strengthen monitoring and verification of Washington Accords implementation on the ground. The parties requested that the United States consider these two initiatives and provide feedback at the next JSCM. The parties agreed to a trilateral planning conference in October 2026 that will culminate in a revised Operations Order guiding their coordinated efforts. The African Union Commission presented on the outcomes of the African Union High-Level Meeting in Gaborone, Botswana, held July 24-25, 2026. The DRC presented its Disarmament, Demobilization, and Reintegration (DDR) Plan for the Forces Démocratiques de Libération du Rwanda (FDLR) and responded to questions from JSCM members. Following the DRC’s presentation, the JSCM held a virtual session with the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the DRC (MONUSCO) to draw on its operational experience conducting DDR in the region. The Governments of the DRC and Rwanda expressed their appreciation to the United States, Qatar, Togo, and the African Union Commission for their support throughout the peace process and agreed to reconvene for the next JSCM on September 16 –17 in Geneva.

The DRC and Rwanda agreed to advance two initiatives to strengthen monitoring and verification of Washington Accords implementation on the ground. The parties requested that the United States consider these two initiatives and provide feedback at the next JSCM. The parties agreed to a trilateral planning conference in October 2026 that will culminate in a revised Operations Order guiding their coordinated efforts. The African Union Commission presented on the outcomes of the African Union High-Level Meeting in Gaborone, Botswana, held July 24-25, 2026. The DRC presented its Disarmament, Demobilization, and Reintegration (DDR) Plan for the Forces Démocratiques de Libération du Rwanda (FDLR) and responded to questions from JSCM members. Following the DRC’s presentation, the JSCM held a virtual session with the United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission in the DRC (MONUSCO) to draw on its operational experience conducting DDR in the region. The Governments of the DRC and Rwanda expressed their appreciation to the United States, Qatar, Togo, and the African Union Commission for their support throughout the peace process and agreed to reconvene for the next JSCM on September 16 –17 in Geneva.

items.title: Masar iyo Itoobiya oo ku biiraya heshiiska difaaca Makkah
items.description: Masar iyo Itoobiya ayaa ku biiraya heshiiska difaaca Makkah ee dhawaan lagu saxiixay dalka Sacuudiga. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Masar, Badr Abdelatty, ayaa sheegay in ku biirista heshiisyo difaac oo caalami ah ay u baahan tahay in marka hore si taxaddar leh loo eego dhinacyada sharciga iyo dastuurka dalka. Abdelatty oo shir jaraa’id kula qabtay dhiggiisa Turkiga, Hakan Fidan, magaalada New Alamein ee Masar, ayaa sheegay in Qaahira horay loogu wargeliyay Heshiiska Wadajirka Difaaca ee Makkah, kaas oo ay dhowaan kala saxiixdeen Sacuudiga, Türkiye iyo Pakistan. Wasiirka ayaa sheegay in Masar ay qayb ka tahay qaab-dhismeed iskaashi oo ay ku mideysan yihiin afarta dal, isagoo xusay in xiriirka Masar la leedahay Sacuudiga, Türkiye iyo Pakistan uu yahay mid xooggan oo aan ku koobnayn dhinaca siyaasadda. Dhankiisa, Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Türkiye Hakan Fidan ayaa muujiyay rajada ah in Masar iyo Itoobiya ay ku biiraan heshiiska, isaga oo sheegay in taariikhda iyo juqraafiyadda Türkiye iyo Masar ay labada dal saarayso mas’uuliyad weyn oo ku aaddan nabadda iyo xasilloonida gobolka. Heshiiska Makkah ee ay kala saxiixdeen Sacuudiga, Türkiye iyo Pakistan ayaa dhigaya in saddexda dal ay xoojiyaan iskaashiga iyo awoodda wadajirka ah ee ka hortagga gardarrada. Sidoo kale, weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal ayaa heshiisku u aqoonsanayaa weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Masar ayaa hadda sheegtay in ka hor inta aysan go’aan ka gaarin ku biirista heshiiskan, loo baahan yahay dib-u-eegis sharci iyo mid dastuuri ah, taasoo muujinaysa in Qaahira aysan weli qaadan go’aan kama dambeys ah.

items.title: R/W Xamza oo soo jeedin yaab leh oo la xiriirta TikTok u direy xildhibaannada BF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa ugu baaqay xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka inay furtaan akoonno TikTok ah. Xamza ayaa tilmaamay in xildhibaanka aan akoon ku lahayn baraha bulshada, sida TikTok ama aan ka sameysan, uusan garanayn sida uu baarlamaanka uga mid noqon karo. Xamza ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay munaasabad lagu maamuusayay Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka, wuxuuna si gaar ah ugu boorriyay xildhibaannada inay ka faa’iideystaan TikTok, oo kamid ah baraha bulshada ee sida weyn looga isticmaalo Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan dunida. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa tusaale u soo qaatay Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo toddobaadkan loo doortay xilkaas, isagoo sheegay inuu hore uga dhex muuqday TikTok. Jaamac ayaa muuqaal uu hore ugu baahiyay TikTok wuxuu noqday mid si weyn loogu xusuusto Guddoomiyaha cusub, kaas oo uu isku dulsaaray mid ka mid ah heesaha caanka ah ee maamulka Galmudug. Heesta uu muuqaalkaasi ku jiray ayaa sidoo kale keentay in Jaamac lagu xasuusto ereyo ka mid ahaa: “Maanta oo kalena madaxaa na furan”, taas oo noqotay naaneys ay dad badan ku garanayaan. “Qof kasta oo idinka kamid ah waa inuu TikTok furtaa. Qof aan TikTok furin sida uu baarlamaanka ugu jiri karo ma garanayo, bal horta TikTok furta,” ayuu yiri Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza Cabdi Barre. Hadallada Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa muujinaya sida baraha bulshada, gaar ahaan TikTok ay ugu sii kordhayaan muhiimadda ay ku leeyihiin isgaarsiinta iyo gaarsiinta fariimaha bulshada, iyadoo siyaasiyiinta Soomaaliya ay si isa soo taraysa uga dhex muuqdaan baraha noocan ah. Si kastaba, TikTok oo fikraddiisa la sameeyay sannadkii 2016, si rasmi ahna loo shaaciyay 2017 ayaa noqday mid kamid ah apps-ka sida weyn loo isticmaalo, laguna gaarsiiyo muuqaallo malaayiin qof. The post R/W Xamza oo soo jeedin yaab leh oo la xiriirta TikTok u direy xildhibaannada BF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: SoDMA iyo UK oo Ka Wada Hadlay Gurmadka Musiibooyinka
items.description: Muqdisho (Raxanreeb Online): Guddoomiyaha Hay’adda Maareynta Musiibooyinka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed (SoDMA), Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle, ayaa kulan la yeeshay Agaasimaha Horumarinta Boqortooyada Midowday (UK), Chris Pycroft. Kulanka ayaa looga hadlay xaaladda bani’aadannimo ee Soomaaliya, khataraha ka dhasha isbeddelka cimilada iyo saadaasha El Niño, iyo sidii loo xoojin lahaa diyaar-garowga iyo awoodda Soomaaliya ee wax looga qabanayo musiibooyinka. Agaasimaha Horumarinta UK, Chris Pycroft, ayaa xaqiijiyay in Boqortooyada Midowday ay ka go’an tahay sii wadidda taageerada Soomaaliya iyo bulshada nugul, gaar ahaan xilliyada dalka ay soo wajahaan xaalado bani’aadannimo iyo khataro ka dhasha isbeddelka cimilada. Guddoomiyaha SoDMA, Maxamuud Macallin Cabdulle, ayaa dhankiisa uga mahadceliyay dowladda UK taageerada joogtada ah ee ay siiso Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan dhinacyada gargaarka bani’aadannimo, diyaar-garowga musiibooyinka iyo xoojinta adkeysiga bulshada. The post SoDMA iyo UK oo Ka Wada Hadlay Gurmadka Musiibooyinka appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Sida Roon Rabbigaa Ogaaday!
items.description: Nin doon yar ku kalluumeysan jiray ayaa mar kasta ka caban jiray shaqada uu hayo iyo dakhliga yar ee uu ka heli jiray. Wuxuu had iyo jeer Alle ka baryi jiray in uu ugu beddelo wax ka kheyr badan. Maalin maalmaha ka mid ah, dabeyl xoog leh ayaa ku dhufatay badda, waxayna ka baabi’isay doontiisii yareyd. Ninkii wuxuu ku go’doonsanaa jasiirad cidlo ah, cid uu kaalmo ka heli karana ma jirin. Maalin kasta wuxuu Alle ka baryi jiray in uu meeshaas ka badbaadiyo, balse cidna uma iman. Wuxuu urursaday wixii uu heli karay, wuxuuna ka dhistay meel yar oo uu kaga gabado qabowga iyo roobka. Maalin galab ah, isagoo ugaarsi kasoo noqday, ayuu arkay hoygiisii oo dab qabsaday. Wax kasta oo uu urursaday oo uu kaydsadayna way ku gubteen. Aad ayuu u murugooday, wuxuuna gacmaha kor u taagay isagoo leh: “Ilaahow, maxaan sameeyay? Maxay wax walba sidan iigu dhacayaan? Goormaan dhibkan ka baxayaa?” Ninkii ugu dambayn wuu suuxay. Markii uu soo toosayna wuxuu isku arkay isagoo saaran markab. Wuxuu kabtanka weydiiyay sida ay ku heleen. Kabtankii ayaa ugu jawaabay: “Annagoo badweynta mareynay ayaan meel fog ka aragnay qiiq badan. Waxaan go’aansannay inaan u soo leexanno si aan u ogaanno halka uu qiiqu ka imanayo. Sidaas ayaan adiga kuugu helnay. Haddii aynaan arki lahayn qiiqa dabka, meesha kuma soo leexan lahayn, kumana heli lahayn.” Ninkii wuxuu kabtanka uga sheekeeyay xaaladdiisa iyo sida uu noloshiisa oo dhan uga shaqeyn jiray badda, isagoo sheegay in xirfadda keliya ee uu yaqaanay ay ahayd kalluumeysiga iyo shaqada badda. Kabtankii iyo shaqaalihii markabka ayaa u fidiyay fursad uu markabka uga shaqeeyo, isaga oo helay shaqo iyo dakhli wanaagsan. Sidaas ayuu ninkii ku bilaabay nolol cusub, isagoo markii dambe fahmay in wixii uu u arkayay musiibo ay noqdeen jidkii uu kaga baxay dhibaatadii. Casharka Nolosha Nolosha waxaa mararka qaar kugu dhacaya dhibaatooyin aad u aragto kuwo aan xal lahayn. Waxaad u maleyn kartaa in wax walba kaa lumeen, laakiin mararka qaar waxa aad u aragto musiibo ayaa noqon kara albaabka uu Alle kuu furayo ee kheyrka. Waxaan Alle ka barynaa isbeddel, nolol wanaagsan iyo fursado cusub. Laakiin marka imtixaan yar nala soo gudboonaado, mararka qaar waxaa naga yaraada sabriga, dulqaadka iyo tawakkulka. Waxaa laga yaabaa in waxa aad maanta ka murugaysan tahay uu berri noqdo sababta farxaddaada. Waxaa laga yaabaa in albaab kuu xirmay uu yahay sababta aad ugu heli lahayd albaab ka kheyr badan. Alle SWT wuxuu Qur’aanka Kariimka ah ku yiri: “Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad necebtihiin wax isagoo kheyr idiin ah, waxaana laga yaabaa inaad jeclaataan wax isagoo shar idiin ah. Eebbe ayaa og, idinkuna ma ogidin.” (Al-Baqarah: 216) Sidaas darteed, marka ay noloshu kugu adkaato, ha degdegin inaad tiraahdo “wax walba way iga xumaadeen.” Waxaa laga yaabaa in waxa maanta ku dhaawacaya uu yahay jidka uu Alle kuugu diyaarinayo wax aad berri uga mahadceliso. Sabriga, ducada iyo tawakkulka ha ka quusan. Sida aad wax u aragto ma aha mar walba sida ay xaqiiqadu tahay; Rabbigaa og waxa adiga kuu kheyr badan. The post Sida Roon Rabbigaa Ogaaday! appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

Eebbe ayaa og, idinkuna ma ogidin.” (Al-Baqarah: 216) Sidaas darteed, marka ay noloshu kugu adkaato, ha degdegin inaad tiraahdo “wax walba way iga xumaadeen.” Waxaa laga yaabaa in waxa maanta ku dhaawacaya uu yahay jidka uu Alle kuugu diyaarinayo wax aad berri uga mahadceliso. Sabriga, ducada iyo tawakkulka ha ka quusan. Sida aad wax u aragto ma aha mar walba sida ay xaqiiqadu tahay; Rabbigaa og waxa adiga kuu kheyr badan. items.title: Shan arrimood oo sahlan oo aad ku yarayn karto baruurta caloosha
items.description: Dad badan ayaa gymka aada si ay u yareeyaan baruurta caloosha, laakiin qaarkood dhab ahaantii dheg uma dhigaan waxa loo baahan yahay in la sameeyo. Dufanka caloosha ayaa ah walaac ku badan dhalinyarada ka welwelsan muuqaalkooda iyo caafimaadkooda. Dufanka ku uruuray calooshooda awgiis ma xiran karaan dhar raaxo leh oo iyaga ku habboon. Dhibaatadani kaliya maaha xirashada dharka aad jeceshahay. Waxa la caddeeyey in dufanka calooshu uu khatar caafimaad keeni karo. Xayrtaasi waxay sababi kartaa dhibaatooyin caafimaad oo badan oo halis ah, oo ay ku jiraan dhiig karka, sonkorta dhiigga oo kacda, iyo dhibaatooyinka kolestaroolka. Cuduradani waxay ka yimaadaan baruurta ku taal aagga caloosha. Waxa kale oo ay kordhisaa halista nooca 2-aad ee sonkorowga iyo cudurrada wadnaha. Dufanka caloosha ayaa sidoo kale soo saara borotiin kale oo loo yaqaan angiotensin. Barootiinkani waxa uu keeni karaa in xididdada dhiigga ay yaraadaan iyo dhiig karka. Sidaa awgeed, halista waallida, neefta, iyo noocyada kansarka qaarkood ayaa kordha Si loo yareeyo dufanka caloosha, waxaa muhiim ah in diirada la saaro qodobbada muhiimka ah qaarkood. 1. Wakhtiga u dhexeeya cashada iyo wakhtiga jiifka Laguma talin in aad wax cunto laba ilaa saddex saacadood ka hor hurdada. Kaloriyada cuntada la isticmaalo maalintii waxaa loo beddelaa tamar hawl maalmeedka. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, cuntooyinka la isticmaalo fiidkii uma shaqeeyaan si la mid ah wakhtiyada kale. Sidaa darteed waxay bilaabi doonaan in dufan lagu kaydiyo jirka, waxayna u horseedi doonaan koror miisaan. 2. Qaado cunto dheeli tiran Markaad isticmaasho cuntooyinka hodanka ku ah fiber-ka, si degdeg ah uma gaajoon doontid. Haddii cuntadaadu ka kooban tahay fiber, marinka cuntada ee calooshaada ilaa xiidmahaaga waa is dhimi doonaa. Tani waxay kuu ogolaanaysaa inaad dheregsanaato muddo dheer. Ku dar borotiinka cuntadaada. Waxay kaa dhigaysaa inay dhereg ku hayso waqti dheer, waxayna yaraynaysaa rabitaanka cuntada fudud. Ku dar cuntooyinka hodanka ku ah borotiinka sida ukunta, misirta, caano, farmaajo, caano fadhi, kalluunka, iyo digaaga, cuntadaada maalinlaha ah. 3. Ka fogow cuntooyinka sida aadka ah loo warshadeeyey ee Carb ku badan yahay 4. Hurdo kugu filan seexo Haddii aadan helin hurdo kugu filan, waxay saameyn kartaa hormoonnadaada gaajada, waxayna kaa dhigi kartaa Inaad firfircoonaato oo aad samayso jimicsi jireed ama nooc kasta oo tababar ah waxay caawisaa gubida kalooriyada. Tani waxay kaa caawinaysaa yaraynta baruurta, gaar ahaan baruurta ku ururta caloosha agagaarkeeda. Hawlaha maalinlaha ah sida socodka degdega ah, orodka, baaskiil wadidda, dabaasha ama yoga ma aha oo kaliya inay caawiyaan yaraynta baruurta, laakiin sidoo kale waxay dedejiyaan dheef-shiid kiimikada.

items.title: War ka cusub isbaheysiga ay Soomaaliya ku biirtay iyo Turkiga oo ku dhowaaqay in…
items.description: Ankara (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Turkiga ayaa markii ugu horreysay xaqiijisay inay qeyb ka tahay dadaallada lagu dhisayo isbahaysi ciidan oo dalal badan ay ku mideysan yihiin, kaas oo lagu ilaalinayo isu-socodka maraakiibta Badda Cas iyo marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab. Wasaaradda Difaaca Turkiga ayaa Khamiista sheegtay in Ankara ay ka qeybgaleyso kulamo ay Sacuudi Carabiya hormuud ka tahay oo lagu dhisayo qaab iskaashi militari oo lagu sugo marin-biyoodka muhiimka u ah ganacsiga caalamka. Reuters ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay in Turkigu uu ka qeybgalayo kulamada Jeddah ee lagu dhisayo isbahaysigan. “Casuumad ka timid Sacuudi Carabiya awgeed, 28-kii July waxaa Riyadh lagu qabtay kulan farsamo oo looga hadlay sidii loo xaqiijin lahaa xorriyadda isu-socodka maraakiibta ee marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab, waxaana 30-kii July 2026 xigay kulan ay yeesheen taliyeyaasha ciidamada,” ayay tiri Wasaaradda Difaaca Turkiga. Wasaaradda ayaa intaas ku dartay in wafdi Turki ah uu Khamiista magaalada Jeddah uga qeybgalay kulan kale oo lagu sii ambaqaadayo dhismaha isbahaysiga. “Shaqadu waxay la socotaa mas’uuliyiinta Sacuudi Carabiya si loo yareeyo xiisadda gobolka Khaliijka loona xaqiijiyo in ganacsiga caalamiga ah uu si aan kala go’ lahayn u socdo,” ayay wasaaraddu tiri. Iskaashiga Ankara iyo Riyadh Tallaabadan ayaa timid wax ka yar toddobaad kadib markii Turkiga, Sacuudi Carabiya iyo Pakistan ay magaalada Makkah ku kala saxiixdeen heshiis difaac oo cusub, kaas oo dhigaya in weerar lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo arko weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. Ankara ayaa Khamiista sidoo kale faahfaahin ka bixisay sida heshiiskaas loo dhaqan-gelin doono, iyadoo sheegtay in la dhisi doono hannaan ay si joogto ah ugu wada shaqeynayaan wasiirrada difaaca, wasiirrada arrimaha dibadda iyo taliyeyaasha ciidamada saddexda dal. Waxaa sidoo kale qorshuhu yahay in la qabto dhoolatusyo militari oo wadajir ah oo ay ka qeyb qaataan ciidamada cirka, badda iyo dhulka, iyadoo iskaashiga lagu ballaarinayo difaaca cirka, diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, dagaalka elektaroonigga ah iyo teknoolajiyada sirdoonka macmalka ah. Ilo fadhigoodu yahay Ankara oo la hadlay Middle East Eye ayaa rumeysan in Badda Cas ay noqon karto meesha ugu horreysa ee si muuqata looga arko iskaashiga militari ee cusub ee Turkiga iyo Sacuudi Carabiya. Arrintaas ayaa macno gaar ah yeelaneysa marka la eego muhiimadda Bab al-Mandab, oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isla markaana ah marin muhiim u ah maraakiibta u kala goosha Aasiya, Bariga Dhexe iyo Yurub. Soomaaliya oo qeyb ka ah qorshaha Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa dhammaadkii bishii July martigelisay shir looga hadlay dhismaha isbahaysigan, iyadoo Riyadh loo asteeyey xarunta joogtada ah ee iskaashiga cusub. Dalalka lagu sheegay inay qeyb ka yihiin waxaa ka mid ah Soomaaliya, Turkiga, Pakistan, Masar, Jabuuti, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Jordan, Bangladesh, Comoros iyo Yemen, iyadoo Sacuudigu hoggaaminayo dadaalka. Qorshaha ayaa dhigaya in dalalka xubnaha ka ahi ay iska kaashadaan xog-wadaagga, qorsheynta howlgallada, tababarrada, dhoolatusyada iyo howlgallada badda, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay ilaalinta Bab al-Mandab, Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Ka qeybgalka Soomaaliya ayaa ah mid muhiim ah, maadaama dalka uu leeyahay xeebta ugu dheer qaaradda Afrika, isla markaana biyihiisu ku yaallaan marin isku xira Badweynta Hindiya iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Isbahaysiga cusub ayaa sidoo kale kusoo beegmaya xilli ammaanka Badda Cas uu si weyn uga sii darayo, kadib hanjabaado iyo weerarro ay Xuutiyiinta Yemen ku bartilmaameedsadeen maraakiibta maraysa gobolka. Xiisadda Badda Cas oo sare u kacday Xuutiyiinta ayaa 20-kii July ku dhawaaqay waxa ay ugu yeereen “go’doomin badeed” oo ka dhan ah Sacuudi Carabiya, iyagoo sheegay inay jawaab uga bixinayaan tallaabooyinka Riyadh ee Yemen. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa dhinaceeda sheegtay inay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin lagu ilaalinayo maraakiibteeda ganacsi ee mara Bab al-Mandab, waxayna ku gooddisay inay si xooggan uga jawaabi doonto khatar kasta oo lagu beegsado isu-socodka badda. Muhiimadda Badda Cas ayaa sii korortay tan iyo markii ay qalalaasaha gobolka saameeyeen marin-biyoodka Hormuz, taas oo Sacuudiga ku qasabtay inuu qeybo badan oo shidaalkiisa ah u weeciyo dekedaha ku yaalla dhinaca Badda Cas. Taasi waxay Bab al-Mandab ka dhigtay marin aad uga muhiimsan sidii hore, maadaama carqalad kale oo halkaas ka dhacda ay saameyn ku yeelan karto dhoofinta shidaalka, ganacsiga caalamka iyo maraakiibta u kala goosha Badda Cas iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Ku biiritaanka Turkiga ee isbahaysiga ayaa sidaas darteed muujinaya in Ankara iyo Riyadh aysan iskaashigooda cusub ku koobeynin heshiis siyaasadeed oo keliya, balse ay bilaabayaan inay u beddelaan iskaashi militari oo ka muuqda goobaha ay labada dal u arkaan kuwa ugu muhiimsan ammaanka gobolka. Sacuudi Carabiya ayaa dhinaceeda sheegtay inay qaadi doonto tallaabooyin lagu ilaalinayo maraakiibteeda ganacsi ee mara Bab al-Mandab, waxayna ku gooddisay inay si xooggan uga jawaabi doonto khatar kasta oo lagu beegsado isu-socodka badda. Muhiimadda Badda Cas ayaa sii korortay tan iyo markii ay qalalaasaha gobolka saameeyeen marin-biyoodka Hormuz, taas oo Sacuudiga ku qasabtay inuu qeybo badan oo shidaalkiisa ah u weeciyo dekedaha ku yaalla dhinaca Badda Cas. Taasi waxay Bab al-Mandab ka dhigtay marin aad uga muhiimsan sidii hore, maadaama carqalad kale oo halkaas ka dhacda ay saameyn ku yeelan karto dhoofinta shidaalka, ganacsiga caalamka iyo maraakiibta u kala goosha Badda Cas iyo Badweynta Hindiya. Ku biiritaanka Turkiga ee isbahaysiga ayaa sidaas darteed muujinaya in Ankara iyo Riyadh aysan iskaashigooda cusub ku koobeynin heshiis siyaasadeed oo keliya, balse ay bilaabayaan inay u beddelaan iskaashi militari oo ka muuqda goobaha ay labada dal u arkaan kuwa ugu muhiimsan ammaanka gobolka. items.title: Judge lifts order on Somalia TPS, clearing way for deportations
items.description: A Massachusetts-based federal judge on Friday lifted her stay in a case brought by Somali holders of temporary protected status (TPS), clearing the way for the Trump administration to begin deporting them.

items.title: Qoys maalintii ka saara Gadbad bariis ah si ay ugu qadeeyaan
items.description: Degmada Anantapur ee gobolka Andhra Pradesh, waxaa ku nool qoys ballaaran oo isku jira oo ka kooban lix jiil. Qoyskan waxay u baahan yihiin 50 kiilo oo bariis ah si ay cunto uga dhigtaan hal maalin. Haddii ay rabaan inay Axadda sameystaan cunto gaar ah, waa inay qalaan ido. Haddii ay rabaan inay fiidkii cunaan ‘bhajiya’ (cunto shiilan oo bur laga sameeyo), waa inay diyaariyaan 15 kiilo oo bur ah. Sababtoo ah qoyskan kama koobna 21 qof, balse waxaa ku nool 83 qof. Kooxda BBC-da ayaa u safartay Kurlapalli si ay maalinta ula qaataan qoyskan ballaaran, iyagoo baranaya sida xubnahan badan ay u wada nool yihiin iyo waxyaabaha ay si wadajir ah u qabtaan. Kurlapalli waxay toddobo kiiloomitir u jirtaa magaalada Kalyandurg. Tuuladan waxaa ku yaalla 400 oo guri, waxaana ku nool dad gaaraya 2,000 oo qof. Markaad soo gasho tuulada oo aad dhanka midig u leexato, waxaad arki doontaa laba guri oo waaweyn oo waddada ku jeeda. Qoyskan ballaaran ayaa ku wada nool labadaas guri. Waxa ugu horreeya ee aad aragto markaad gasho guriga labada dabaq ah ee dhinaca waddada ku yaalla waa jikada. Dhinaca dambena waxaa ku yaalla dhisme laba dabaq ah oo loo isticmaalo bakhaar ama meel gaadiidka la dhigto. Gurigan ka soo horjeedkiisa waxaa ku yaalla dhisme kale oo saddex dabaq ah, waddadaas marka lagu sii socdana waxaa ku yaalla guri kale oo leh dhul weyn oo bannaan. Goobtaas waxaa la dhigaa gaadiidka waaweyn sida taraaktarrada iyo basaska. Hadda saddexdan guri kuma filna qoyska, waxayna dhisayaan guri afraad. Qoyskan ballaaran waxay inta badan ku tiirsan yihiin beerashada. Dhammaan xubnaha qoysku si wadajir ah ayay u beertaan dhulka, waxayna sidoo kale dhaqdaan xoolaha caanaha laga helo iyo idaha. Sidee bay duqeyda qoyskan ballaaran go’aannada u gaaraan?   Madaxda qoyskan wadajirka ah, oo ka kooban 83 xubnood, waa Hanumantharayudu iyo Mutyalappa. Iyaga ayaa qaata dhammaan go’aannada la xiriira beeraha iyo ganacsiga, laga bilaabo hawlaha caanaha laga soo lisayo xoolaha ilaa shaqada beeraha. Madaxa qoyska, Hanumantharayudu, ayaa sheegay inay mas’uuliyad ka saaran tahay sidii uu nolol maalmeed ugu abuuri lahaa xubin kasta oo ka tirsan qoyskan ballaaran. Wuxuu sheegay inaanu jirin qof guriga ku jira, oo ay ku jiraan seeddigiis Mutyalappa, oo ka hor imaanaya hadalkiisa, isla markaana qof kastaa uu ixtiraamo. “Geeridii aabbahay iyo awoowgay ka dib, culeyskii qoyska ayaa igu soo dhacay. Tan iyo markaas, aniga ayaa kaligey daryeelayay qoyskan. Carruurta waxbarasho ayaan u helnaa, inta kalena hawlaha beeraha ayaan u dhiibnaa”. Wuxuu yiri, “Waxaan u wada noolnahay si wadajir ah annagoo qof walba u qoondeyneyna shaqadiisa iyo mas’uuliyaddiisa. Ilaa hadda, ma jiraan wax dhibaatooyin ama khilaaf ah oo naga dhex jira”. “Dhammaanteen si wadajir ah ayaan u shaqeynay. Wax kasta oo aan iraahdo way sameeyaan.” “Xitaa seeddigey ayaa i dhegeysta. Inkastoo aniga iyo seeddigeyba aan leenahay wiilal badan, haddana ma jiro qof hadal soo celiya”. Sidee bay qoys 83 qof ah u wada nool yihiin? Mutyalappa wuxuu sheegay inay sidan u wada noolaayeen tan iyo waqtigii awoowgood, ayna ku dadaalayaan inay sidaas ku sii socdaan mustaqbalka. “Waxaan nahay afar nin oo gabdho walaalaheen ah qaba iyo laba nin oo walaalo ah. Waxaan sidan u wada noolaynay tan iyo waqtigii awoowgeen. Waxaan ku dadaalnaa inaan sidan u sii wadno mustaqbalka sidoo kale. Subaxdii ayaan wada kulannaa, qof walbana waxaan u xil saarnaa shaqadiisa gaarka ah”. Wuxuu intaas ku daray, “Waxaan qabannaa dhammaan hawlaha guriga, laga bilaabo cuntada iyo cabitaanka ilaa dhaqidda dharka. Waxaan sidoo kale shaqaaleysiinnaa dad dibadda ka yimid si ay shaqada nooga caawiyaan”. “Carruurta ay dhaleen ragga walaalaha nala ah ayaan gurigeenna ku korinnaa, waxaana ula dhaqannaa sidii carruurteenna oo kale. Sidaas ayay wax walba u shaqeeyaan”. Mutyalappa wuxuu sheegay in midnimadan ay sabab u tahay sida qoyskiisa, oo markii hore ku noolaa saboolnimo, ay maanta ugu nool yihiin nolol wanaagsan. “Bilowgii, waxaan la kulannay saboolnimo aad u daran. Xitaa ma aynaan haysan buste aan huwanno, waxaana haysannay oo kaliya cunto yar oo aan cunno. Sidaas ayaan maanta heerkan ku gaarnay. Tani waxay suurtogal noqotay oo kaliya sababtoo ah dhammaanteen waan wada joognay”. “Haddaan kala tagi lahayn, weligeen heerkan ma gaari lahayn. Guriga aan hadda ku noolnahay waxaa lagu dhisay lacag dhan 20 crore oo rupees ah.” “Ma suurtowdeen tan haddii aan keligayo ahaan lahayn? Aabbahay wuxuu lahaa dhul dhan 60 acre, geeridiisa ka dibna, dhammaanteen waxaan si wadajir ah u iibsannay 75 acre oo kale”. “Taasi waa sababta aan qof walba ugu sheegno, ‘Ha kala tagina; haddii aan sidan isku raacsanahay, wax walba way hagaagayaan'” ayuu yiri. Mahesh, oo mas’uul ka ah maamulka qoyska, ayaa sheegay in xilliga ay shaaha subaxdii cabbayaan, labada qof ee hoggaanka haya ay go’aansadaan cidda qabanaysa shaqo kasta. Wuxuu yiri “Aabbahay waa Hanumantharayudu. Odayaasha oo dhami waxay fariistaan si ay subaxdii shaah u cabbaan, waxayna wada hadlaan muddo nus saac ah. Kadibna waxaan go’aansannaa cidda loo xilsaarayo shaqo kasta”. “Shaqadaydu waa dayactirka gaadiidka iyo keenista alaabta muhiimka ah ee guriga looga baahan yahay. Walaalkayga kale wuxuu gaari yar ku raraa dalagga aan beeranno, sida yaanyada, wuxuuna u qaadaa suuqa si uu u iibiyo”. Sidan ayaan u qaybsannaa shaqooyinkeenna sida beerashada, dhaqashada idaha iyo daryeelka lo’da. Ilaa hadda, wax dhibaato ah ma qabno”. Madaxa qoyska, oo ahaa Chimmala Nagappa (awoowga Hanumantharayudu), ayaa ahaa madaxii jiilka koowaad ee qoyskan. Wuxuu lahaa laba xaas, wuxuuna gabadhii xaaskiisa koowaad u guuriyay Yellappa. Tan iyo xilligaas, Yellappa wuxuu ahaa nin gurigaas ku nool isagoo ah wiilka soddogga loo yahay. Ka dib, xaaska labaad ayaa dhashay laba wiil iyo laba gabdhood oo kale. Yellappa wuxuu lahaa afar wiil iyo laba gabdhood, iyagoo dhammaantoodna si wadajir ah u wada noolaa. Geeridii Yellappa iyo Nagappa ka dib, hadda dhaxlayaashooda Hanumantharayudu iyo Muthyalappa ayaa ah odayaasha qoyska, iyaguna qaata go’aamada. Muthyalappa ma qabto wax shaqo ah oo aan ka ahayn shaqada boosta qaadaha. Subaxdii, ka dib marka ay dhammaystiraan hawlaha maalinlaha ah, xubnaha qoyska qaarkood waxay aadaan beeraha. Qaar kalena waxay aadaan xagga xoolaha. Qaarkood waxay lisaan lo’da, halka kuwa kalena ay daryeelaan idaha, ururiyaan saxarada xoolaha, oo ay nadiifiyaan xerooyinka. Haweenka guriga ayaa qaabilsan hawlaha cunto karinta. Carruurta oo dhami waxay guriga ka baxaan subaxdii si ay dugsiga u aadaan. Hanumantharayudu wuxuu sheegay in si looga fogaado khilaaf kasta oo dhexdooda ka dhalan kara, inay arooskooda si wadajir ah ugu qabsadaan guriga dhexdiisa. Waxaan ballanqaad ahaan u sameeyay inaan wiilkayga Mahesh halkaas ugu guuriyo”. “Haddii aan ku dari lahaa gabar mid ka mid ah wiilashayda oo kaliya, waxaa iman lahaa khilaaf iyo hadallo oranaya, ‘Wuxuu u guuriyey wiilkiisa oo kaliya, kuwa kalena wuu ka tagay’. Sidaa darteed, dhammaan sagaalkii nin ee dhallinyarada ahaa ee qoyska ayaan isla waqti isku mid ah u kaxeynay goobtii diiniga ahayd, waana u guurinay”. Xurguf la’aanta xaasaska wiilasha iyo soddohyada Qoyskan ballaaran waxaa sidoo kale ku jira lix aayo iyo 14 gabdhood oo wiilashu qabaan. Hase yeeshee, Mahesh wuxuu sheegay inuusan weligiis arkin haweenka gurigiisa oo is haysta ama is qabsanaya. Anuradha, oo ah haweeneyda ugu weyn qoyska, ayaa tiri “Annaga oo ah lixdaas aayo iyo 14-ka cgabdhood, si aad u wanaagsan ayaan u wada noolnahay. Qaarkeen waxay ka shaqeeyaan beerta, qaarna guriga ayay ka shaqeeyaan. Cidna dhibaato ma abuurto”. “Haddii wax dhacaan, isla markiiba waan xallinaa. Qaarkood way hadal badan yihiin, laakiin wax kale ma sameeyaan”. “Xitaa haddii ay dhacdo in khilaaf ama dood dhex marto, dib ayay u heshiiyaan. Gabi ahaanba ma aha dad is-qabsada”. “Way faraxsan yihiin, wayna qoslaan, iyagoo hawlahooda gaarka ah wata”. Rajeshwari waxay sheegtay in xitaa haddii ay dhacdo is-khilaaf kooban, qof kastaa uu fiidkii dib ula midoobo qoyska oo ay waqti farxad leh wada qaataan. “Waxaan ahay jiilka shanaad ee qoyskan. Waxaan ahay gabadhaugu weyn carruurta awoowga loo yahay, awoowe ayaana wax i soo barayey tan iyo carruurnimadaydii”. “Maanta, haddii ay jiraan hal ama laba walaalo ah, way kala qaybsamaan sababo la xiriira hanti. Laakiin tuuladeenna, dadku waxay ku faanaan xaqiiqda ah in 83 qof ay weli si wadajir ah u wada nool yihiin”. Bbc somali

Laakiin tuuladeenna, dadku waxay ku faanaan xaqiiqda ah in 83 qof ay weli si wadajir ah u wada nool yihiin”. Bbc somali

items.title: Museveni says Uganda’s Somalia mission was solidarity with Ethiopia, not Somalia
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – President Yoweri Museveni has said Uganda’s nearly two-decade military deployment in Somalia was driven primarily by solidarity with Ethiopia – whose forces invaded Somalia in 2006 to remove the Islamic Courts Union from power in Mogadishu – rather than by any direct stake in Somalia’s own stability. Museveni made the remarks last month at the Second Extraordinary Summit of Heads of State of Troop-Contributing Countries to the African Union Support and Stabilisation Mission in Somalia (AUSSOM), held at Speke Resort Munyonyo in Kampala. “Uganda does not have a border with Somalia. When, therefore, we decided to involve ourselves in Somalia it was out of principle and strategy,” Museveni told the summit. He cited opposition to what he called “Islamic chauvinism” spreading from Somalia and Sudan as a first reason, and solidarity with Ethiopia as a second, explaining that Addis Ababa had faced attacks linked to the countries. Uganda became the first country to deploy troops to Somalia in 2007, under what was then the African Union Mission in Somalia (AMISOM), the predecessor to AUSSOM. The remarks came as the summit’s participants – Uganda, Ethiopia, Kenya, Djibouti, Egypt and Burundi – confronted a funding crisis threatening the mission’s survival. The United Nations Support Office in Somalia (UNSOS), which supplies logistics for AU peacekeepers, is set to end its mandate on December 31, 2026, after the United States informed the African Union on July 1 that it would not support renewal of the mission’s mandate at the UN Security Council. Uganda’s Chief of Defence Forces, Gen. Muhoozi Kainerugaba, told the summit’s military chiefs’ session that “these are difficult circumstances, but they also call for our unity, creativity, and resolve,” and urged urgent preparation for an African-led alternative to UNSOS support. African Union Commission Chairperson Mahmoud Ali Youssouf said the AU remained committed to mobilising the political, diplomatic and financial resources needed to sustain the mission. Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud thanked Museveni for convening the summit and described Uganda as “one of Somalia’s strongest pillars.” The summit was not without friction. Analyst Rashid Abdi of Nairobi-based Sahan Research said Mohamud pressed successfully to have language on dialogue with Somali opposition figures softened in the summit’s final communique, calling it evidence Mohamud “knows how to get what he wants” through pressure tactics — a separate dispute that surfaced during the same three-day gathering. Museveni’s solidarity remarks have circulated widely on Somali social media, where they have drawn criticism from users who describe Ethiopia’s 2006–2009 presence in Somalia as an occupation, rather than a stabilisation effort, responsible for thousands of civilian deaths and widespread destruction of property and numerous human rights abuses. Current Somali federal officials have previously used similar language to describe that period. Neither Somalia’s federal government nor the African Union Commission has issued a formal response addressing Museveni’s solidarity framing specifically. Why Museveni’s Words Matter More Than He May Have Intended Nineteen years and, by conservative estimates, billions of dollars into an AU mission whose principal financiers — the United States and European Union — have consistently framed their support around building a stable, democratic Somalia free of Al-Shabaab, Museveni’s Kampala remarks are the clearest on-record admission yet that troop-contributing states and Western donors were never rowing in the same direction. Regional publication Horn Review, assessing the same remarks, described Museveni’s framing as a “diplomatic miscalculation” that exposed “the instrumental nature of Uganda’s commitment” at precisely the moment Mogadishu was seeking reassurance of a Somalia-centred partnership — concluding that Uganda–Somalia relations are now more likely to be marked by tension than restored trust for the remainder of the mission’s lifespan. That assessment matters beyond bilateral optics. Researchers who track Al-Shabaab’s propaganda apparatus — including studies conducted for the UN mission in Somalia — have long documented the group’s core recruitment narrative: that Somali government forces and their AU allies are proxies serving foreign interests rather than genuine partners in Somali sovereignty. Ethiopia’s 2006 invasion is widely cited among regional security analysts as a catalytic moment in Al-Shabaab’s own rise, having scattered the Islamic Courts Union and handed its hardline, sharia-driven nationalist wing — the faction that would become Al-Shabaab — a grievance narrative it has never relinquished. A senior AU troop-contributing head of state now explicitly linking his own twenty-year deployment to solidarity with that same invasion supplies that narrative fresh, unforced material — delivered not by a militant spokesman but by an allied president at an official summit. For Washington and Brussels, the timing sharpens an already difficult calculation. Both are weighing whether to keep underwriting a mission now facing the loss of its UN logistics backbone at year’s end. Museveni’s own account of his government’s motives raises a question donors will now find harder to avoid: if the coalition’s troop contributors were never unified around Somalia’s stated recovery goals, what — after nineteen years, thousands of Somali and peacekeeper deaths, and no completed handover to Somali national forces — was the funding actually building toward. This analysis reflects the assessment of Horn Review and independent research on Al-Shabaab’s propaganda methodology; it does not represent the editorial position of Somali Guardian.

items.title: Jaamac oo loo sameeyay maamuus heer sare ah iyo madaxweyne Xasan oo…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa xalay ka qeyb-galay munaasabad casho sharaf ah oo lagu soo dhaweynayay Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac). Munaasabadda ayaa ahayd mid lagu maamuusayay Guddoomiyaha cusub, waxaana ka qeyb-galay mas’uuliyiin ka tirsan dowladda iyo xubno kale oo qeyb ka ah hay’adaha dowladda Soomaaliya. Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo khudbad ka jeediyay munaasabadda ayaa dul istaagay guulaha muhiimka ah ee laga gaaray dowlad-dhiska, xoojinta nidaamka dowladnimada iyo meel-marinta shuruucda dhaxal-reebka ah. Waxa uu xusay in tallaabooyinkii la qaaday sannadihii la soo dhaafay ay saldhig u noqdeen xoojinta hay’adaha dowladda, horumarinta nidaamka sharciyeed iyo ilaalinta danta guud ee qaranka. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale ku ammaanay Guddoonka iyo xubnaha Golaha Shacabka Baarlamaanka Federaalka Soomaaliya shaqada ay ka qabteen gudashada waajibaadkooda dastuuriga ah. Xasan Sheekh ayaa tilmaamay in sharci-dejintu ay laf-dhabar u tahay dowladnimo ku dhisan nidaam, isla-xisaabtan iyo kala dambeyn, isaga oo adkeeyay muhiimadda ay leedahay in hay’adaha dowladda ay si hufan u gutaan waajibaadkooda. Ugu dambayn, Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa Guddoomiyaha cusub ugu hambalyeeyay xilka loo doortay iyo kalsoonida ay xubnaha Golaha Shacabka ku aamineen, isaga oo u rajeeyay in uu si hufan, daacadnimo iyo masuuliyad leh u guto waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee loo igmaday. items.title: Reer-guuraa Galgaduud oo ka cabanaya cudur ka dilaya xoolaha oo il-dhaqaale u ah
items.description: (ERGO) – Cudurro ka laynaya geela, ari-cadka iyo idaha ayay maaro u la’yihiin xoolo dhaqato ku nool deegaannada Xodayga, Ballicad iyo Jaleel oo hoos taga degmada Caabudwaaq ee gobolka Galgaduud. Xaaladdan oo saamayn nololeed ku yeelatay ayaa haysay tan iyo bishii May. Maxamed Aadan Dhoore oo ku nool deegaanka Xodayga wuxuu sheegay in ay ka dhinteen 50 neef oo geel iyo ari isugu jira. Waxaa ka xanuunsan oo uusan rajo badan ka qabin soo bogsashadooda 18 neef oo ka mid ah 37 uga haray xoolihiisa. Wuxuu xusay in ay u wehliyaan daaq la’aan iyo biyo yari xaaladda ku sii adkeeyay. Saddex xilli oo aysan roobabwanaagsan helin ayaa sababay inay nacfi beelaan. Ishiisii ugu muhiimsanayd ee dhaqaale oo meesha ka baxday ayaa cunno xumo, biyo yari iyo baahiyo kale u horseeday qoyskiisa. “Xoolihii lagu tiirsanaa waa weynay, gadashadii iyo wax soo saarkii aan ka heli jirnay ma jiro oo nacfigoodii wuu xumaaday, reerkii 3 waqti wax karsan jiray hal mar ayuu ku soo koobmay. Cashada ayaa lagu soo aruuray. Maalinkii qado iyo quraac midna ma leh, daruufuhu aad bay u adag yihiin.” Maxamed ayaa sheegay in qoyskiisa oo 14 qof ah ay hal mar dabka ku shitaan kaalmo aan joogto ahayn oo ay ku caawiyaan ehehlkooda degan magaalada Caabudwaaq. Haddii aysan waxba ka helin wuxuu xusay in ay qatooyo ku joogaan, maaddaama aysan doorasho kale haysan. Ninkaan ayaa tilmaamay in dukaamo uu dayn ka qaadan jiray ay buugiisa xireen dhamaadkii bishii Juun. Waxaa lagu yeeshay in ka badan $700 oo uusan hayn qaab uu ku bixiyo, balse joogto loo waydiiyo. Horraan wuxuu iska bixin jiray, marka ay xooluhu u doogsadaan. Roob yarida iyo cudurrada xoolaha ayaa isku raacay mana jirto meel kale oo dhaqaale uu ka soo galo, taas oo quus galisay. Calaamadaha arigiisa ka muuqda wuxuu ku sheegay jadeeco madow iyo sambab, balse ma jiro dhaqtar u xaqiijiyay, halka cudurka geela ku dhacay uusan aqoon. “Neefka waa madoobaanayaa. Feeraha ayaa laga ahyaa. Arigu aad buu iskaga baqtiyaa muddo yar, geeluna wuu qandhanayaa wuu iska fariisanayaa, si kasta oo aan ogos ugu durnay wax isbeddel ah wuu yeelan waayay, madaaqayo wuu fariisanyo qaarka hore ayaa laga hayaa.” Maxamed ayaa sheegay in billowgii uu xoolihiisa ku duray daawooyin uu soo dayntay. Wax isbeddel ah markii uu ka waayay lacagtiina ku badatay ayuu ka joojiyay. Wuxuu tilmaamay in aysan tuulada joogin dhaqaatiirta, uusanna awoodin in uu meel kale uga keeno. Hal geeliisa ka irmaanayd oo carruurta uu cadays uga heli jiray ayaa ka dhimatay dhamaadkii May muddo ay xanuunsanayd kadib. Nirig ka hartay ayuu xusay in ay bil kadib dhimatay. Cudurrada, dhaqaale xumada iyo daruufta qoyska ayaa rajo beel galiyay. Ninkaan oo in ka badan 30 sano xoolo dhaqato ku ahaa miyiga gobolka Galgaduud ayaa sheegay in aysan waligood la kulmin xaaladaan oo kale. Ma leh xirfad uu magaalo uga shaqaysto xoolihiina way dhaafeen. “Baahidu siyaado weeye. Barakac in aan noqono ayaan ka baqaynaa. Barakaca waxaa keenaya duruufta na haysata oo dadkii kuma noolaan karo waa nagu adag tahay. Geel iyo ari ayaan dhaqan jirnay labadiina waa na dhaafeen. Noloshu aad bay u xumaatay.” Maxamed ayaa sheegay in ay dhibaato ku qabaan helitaanka biyaha. Waxay 24 saac isku celceliyaan 20 liitar oo ay ka soo dayntaan ceel gaar loo leeyahay oo u jira qiyaastii 3 km. Kuma filna, balse xal kale ma haystaan. Dusha ayuu ku soo qaadaa, maaddaama uusan gaadiid lahayn. Qoyskiisa oo muddo dheer ka mid ahaa reer guuraaga gobolka Galgaduud ayuu sheegay in ay culaysyada isku biirsaday la qabsan la’yihiin. Dhanka kale Cabdirisaaq Shaaciye Aadan oo ku nool deegaanka Jaleel oo qiyaastii 15 km dhanka waqooyi kaga beegan degmada Caabudwaaq ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in cudurka kaga dhacay xoolaha uu sababay in ay daruufo adag wajahayaan qoyskiisa oo 11 qof ah. Waxay ku tiirsan yihiin kiilooyin raashin ah oo uu ka soo bixiyo $3 illaa $5 oo toddobaadkii uu ka helo shaqo dhagax jabin ah oo si dhib ah uu ku helo. Maalmaha uu waayo wuxuu tilmaamay in ay gaajo ku joogaan carruurtiisa oo 3 jir uu ugu yar yahay. “Saddexda waqti mar ama labo ayaa wax la cunaa. Suuq neef la gaysan karo ma jiro, hilib kama helaysid, caano ma lahan. Neefkii rimanaa wuu baqtiyay ama ilmihii ayuu soo tuuray. Xooluhu naq ay ku irmaanaadaan ma helin. Nacfigoodii iyo iyagii waa israaceen, waxa joogaana rajo ma leh.” Cabdirisaaq ayaa sheegay in 300 neef oo geel iyo ari isugu jira oo noloshoodu ay ku tiirsanayd ay uga hartay 46 aan cad, caano iyo suuq gayn midna lahayn. Qaar ayaa jiran, halka ay joogto ugu baahan yihiin quudin iyo waraabin uusan u awoodin qarash uu uga bixiyo. Wuxuu qoyskiisa u awoodi layahay biyo halkii fuusto la iibiyo $8, taas oo caqabad kale ku ah. Waxay maalinkii dhowr liitar ka soo baryaan dadka dhaama. Cabdirisaaq ayaa xusay in labadii bil ee ugu danbaysay ay ka xanuunsadeen 3 carruurtiisa ka mid ah. Dhqaale xumada ayaa ka hor taagan in uu baaritaan iyo daawo u helo. Wuxuu aaminsan yahay in gaajada, haraadka yo daruufaha kale ay ka qaadeen nafaqo xumo. “Ilmuhu waa shumayaan sacadaan aan kula hadlayo waa jirran yihiin. Carruur noogama dhiman, laakiin aad ayay u dhibaataysan yihiin oo tabar darro ayaa haysa. Waxaa u dheer qandho ku soo noqnoqonaysa kuwa u dhexeeya hal sano illaa 12 jir. Wax aan kula tacaalo uma hayo. Daawo uma raadin karo, wax aan gaari ku saaro waan u waayay.” Cabdirisaaq ayaa xusay in xaaladahan isku biirsaday ay uga waxbarasho beeleen labo carruur ah oo dugsi Qur’aan uga dhigan jiray tuulada. Bishii June ayaa la soo eryay, markii uusan labo bil bixin min $3 oo qofkiiba uu ka dhiibi jiray. Qur’aanka oo gabo gabo u marayay ayuu ka cabsi qabo in uu ka lumo. Wuxuu sheegay inuusan hayn fursad uu ugu aqriyo, maaddama wax ay cunaan uu raadinayo. Qoyskiisa oo noloshooda oo dhan miyiga ku qaatay ayuu sheegay in ay la qabsan la’yihiin xaaladaan adag. Gallad Maxamed Ibraaahim oo bartay xanaanada xoolaha oo aan la wadaagnay calaamadaha ay dadkaan ku arkeen xoolahooda ayaa sheegay in ay noqon karaan sambab, jadeeco, sumow iyo xajiin. Isbeddelka cimilka, isku guurka reer miyiga iyo daruufo ka dhashay daaq xumada ayuu xusay inay keeni karaan. “Xoolaha waa in ay biyo nadiif ah siiyaan, quudin ku filan, cunno nafaqo ay ka helayaan, neefkii jirrana laga dhex saaro. Haddii ay ku arkaan qufac, dhareer ama neef-qabatin in ay isticmaalaan daawooyinka antibiyootiga iyo ogsada ayaan kula talinayaa, xoolahooda in ay xilli hore talaalaan iyo in ay dhaqaatiir la xariiraan marka ay calaamadaha ku arkaan.” Gallad ayaa ku taliyay inay iskaashadaan reer guuraagu si ay wadajir daawayn ugu helaan xoolahooda, sidoo kalena loo baahan yahay kaalinta dowlada iyo cid kasta oo xilligaan adag garab u noqon karta dadkaan oo saamaynta cudurada ka dhashay ay nolol xumo u horseeday. Cudurrada xoolaha, abaaraha iyo saamaynta isbeddellada cimiladu keento waxay ka mid yihiin caqabado waa weyn oo sanadihii danbe ay wajahayaan xoolo dhaqatadu. Waxaa ku adkaata xal u helida dhibaatooyinkaan, maaddaama aysan hayn aqoon iyo dhaqaale midna. Calaamadaha arigiisa ka muuqda wuxuu ku sheegay jadeeco madow iyo sambab, balse ma jiro dhaqtar u xaqiijiyay, halka cudurka geela ku dhacay uusan aqoon. “Neefka waa madoobaanayaa. Feeraha ayaa laga ahyaa. Arigu aad buu iskaga baqtiyaa muddo yar, geeluna wuu qandhanayaa wuu iska fariisanayaa, si kasta oo aan ogos ugu durnay wax isbeddel ah wuu yeelan waayay, madaaqayo wuu fariisanyo qaarka hore ayaa laga hayaa.” Maxamed ayaa sheegay in billowgii uu xoolihiisa ku duray daawooyin uu soo dayntay. Wax isbeddel ah markii uu ka waayay lacagtiina ku badatay ayuu ka joojiyay. Wuxuu tilmaamay in aysan tuulada joogin dhaqaatiirta, uusanna awoodin in uu meel kale uga keeno. Hal geeliisa ka irmaanayd oo carruurta uu cadays uga heli jiray ayaa ka dhimatay dhamaadkii May muddo ay xanuunsanayd kadib. Nirig ka hartay ayuu xusay in ay bil kadib dhimatay. Cudurrada, dhaqaale xumada iyo daruufta qoyska ayaa rajo beel galiyay. Ninkaan oo in ka badan 30 sano xoolo dhaqato ku ahaa miyiga gobolka Galgaduud ayaa sheegay in aysan waligood la kulmin xaaladaan oo kale. Ma leh xirfad uu magaalo uga shaqaysto xoolihiina way dhaafeen. “Baahidu siyaado weeye. Barakac in aan noqono ayaan ka baqaynaa. Barakaca waxaa keenaya duruufta na haysata oo dadkii kuma noolaan karo waa nagu adag tahay. Geel iyo ari ayaan dhaqan jirnay labadiina waa na dhaafeen. Noloshu aad bay u xumaatay.” Maxamed ayaa sheegay in ay dhibaato ku qabaan helitaanka biyaha. Waxay 24 saac isku celceliyaan 20 liitar oo ay ka soo dayntaan ceel gaar loo leeyahay oo u jira qiyaastii 3 km. Kuma filna, balse xal kale ma haystaan. Dusha ayuu ku soo qaadaa, maaddaama uusan gaadiid lahayn. Qoyskiisa oo muddo dheer ka mid ahaa reer guuraaga gobolka Galgaduud ayuu sheegay in ay culaysyada isku biirsaday la qabsan la’yihiin. Dhanka kale Cabdirisaaq Shaaciye Aadan oo ku nool deegaanka Jaleel oo qiyaastii 15 km dhanka waqooyi kaga beegan degmada Caabudwaaq ayaa Raadiyow Ergo u sheegay in cudurka kaga dhacay xoolaha uu sababay in ay daruufo adag wajahayaan qoyskiisa oo 11 qof ah. Waxay ku tiirsan yihiin kiilooyin raashin ah oo uu ka soo bixiyo $3 illaa $5 oo toddobaadkii uu ka helo shaqo dhagax jabin ah oo si dhib ah uu ku helo. Maalmaha uu waayo wuxuu tilmaamay in ay gaajo ku joogaan carruurtiisa oo 3 jir uu ugu yar yahay. “Saddexda waqti mar ama labo ayaa wax la cunaa. Suuq neef la gaysan karo ma jiro, hilib kama helaysid, caano ma lahan. Neefkii rimanaa wuu baqtiyay ama ilmihii ayuu soo tuuray. Xooluhu naq ay ku irmaanaadaan ma helin. Nacfigoodii iyo iyagii waa israaceen, waxa joogaana rajo ma leh.” Cabdirisaaq ayaa sheegay in 300 neef oo geel iyo ari isugu jira oo noloshoodu ay ku tiirsanayd ay uga hartay 46 aan cad, caano iyo suuq gayn midna lahayn. Qaar ayaa jiran, halka ay joogto ugu baahan yihiin quudin iyo waraabin uusan u awoodin qarash uu uga bixiyo. Wuxuu qoyskiisa u awoodi layahay biyo halkii fuusto la iibiyo $8, taas oo caqabad kale ku ah. Waxay maalinkii dhowr liitar ka soo baryaan dadka dhaama. Cabdirisaaq ayaa xusay in labadii bil ee ugu danbaysay ay ka xanuunsadeen 3 carruurtiisa ka mid ah. Dhqaale xumada ayaa ka hor taagan in uu baaritaan iyo daawo u helo. Wuxuu aaminsan yahay in gaajada, haraadka yo daruufaha kale ay ka qaadeen nafaqo xumo. “Ilmuhu waa shumayaan sacadaan aan kula hadlayo waa jirran yihiin. Carruur noogama dhiman, laakiin aad ayay u dhibaataysan yihiin oo tabar darro ayaa haysa. Waxaa u dheer qandho ku soo noqnoqonaysa kuwa u dhexeeya hal sano illaa 12 jir. Wax aan kula tacaalo uma hayo. Daawo uma raadin karo, wax aan gaari ku saaro waan u waayay.” Cabdirisaaq ayaa xusay in xaaladahan isku biirsaday ay uga waxbarasho beeleen labo carruur ah oo dugsi Qur’aan uga dhigan jiray tuulada. Bishii June ayaa la soo eryay, markii uusan labo bil bixin min $3 oo qofkiiba uu ka dhiibi jiray. Qur’aanka oo gabo gabo u marayay ayuu ka cabsi qabo in uu ka lumo. Wuxuu sheegay inuusan hayn fursad uu ugu aqriyo, maaddama wax ay cunaan uu raadinayo. Qoyskiisa oo noloshooda oo dhan miyiga ku qaatay ayuu sheegay in ay la qabsan la’yihiin xaaladaan adag. Gallad Maxamed Ibraaahim oo bartay xanaanada xoolaha oo aan la wadaagnay calaamadaha ay dadkaan ku arkeen xoolahooda ayaa sheegay in ay noqon karaan sambab, jadeeco, sumow iyo xajiin. Isbeddelka cimilka, isku guurka reer miyiga iyo daruufo ka dhashay daaq xumada ayuu xusay inay keeni karaan. “Xoolaha waa in ay biyo nadiif ah siiyaan, quudin ku filan, cunno nafaqo ay ka helayaan, neefkii jirrana laga dhex saaro. Haddii ay ku arkaan qufac, dhareer ama neef-qabatin in ay isticmaalaan daawooyinka antibiyootiga iyo ogsada ayaan kula talinayaa, xoolahooda in ay xilli hore talaalaan iyo in ay dhaqaatiir la xariiraan marka ay calaamadaha ku arkaan.” Gallad ayaa ku taliyay inay iskaashadaan reer guuraagu si ay wadajir daawayn ugu helaan xoolahooda, sidoo kalena loo baahan yahay kaalinta dowlada iyo cid kasta oo xilligaan adag garab u noqon karta dadkaan oo saamaynta cudurada ka dhashay ay nolol xumo u horseeday. Cudurrada xoolaha, abaaraha iyo saamaynta isbeddellada cimiladu keento waxay ka mid yihiin caqabado waa weyn oo sanadihii danbe ay wajahayaan xoolo dhaqatadu. Waxaa ku adkaata xal u helida dhibaatooyinkaan, maaddaama aysan hayn aqoon iyo dhaqaale midna. items.title: Pakistan oo dalbatay in la sii daayo badmaaxiinta dalkaas u dhashay oo lagu haysto Soomaaliya
items.description: Dowladda Pakistan ayaa dalbatay in la xoojiyo dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee lagu doonayo in xorriyaddooda lagu soo celiyo 10 badmaaxiin Pakistani ah oo muddo bilo ah lagu haysto Soomaaliya. Ra’iisul Wasaare ku-xigeenka ahna Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Pakistan, Ishaq Dar, ayaa Khamiistii shir heer sare ah ku qabtay Islamabad, kaas oo looga hadlay xaaladda badmaaxiinta iyo dadaallada socda ee lagu doonayo in si nabad ah lagu sii daayo. Badmaaxiintan ayaa ka mid ahaa shaqaalihii markabka shidaalka ee MT Honour 25, oo ah markab ka babanayay calanka Palau, kaas oo 21-kii Abriil lagu qafaashay xeebaha Puntland, Soomaaliya. Markabka waxaa saarnaa 17 shaqaale ah, waxaana 10 ka mid ah ay ahaayeen Pakistani, halka shaqaalaha kale ay u dhasheen Indonesia, India iyo Sri Lanka. Dowladda Pakistan ayaa sheegtay in Wasiir Ishaq Dar uu faray hay’adaha ay khuseyso inay sii xoojiyaan xiriirka iyo wada-shaqeynta hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo mas’uuliyiinta Soomaaliya, si loo helo waddo lagu xaqiijin karo sii deynta iyo soo celinta badmaaxiinta. Islamabad ayaa sidoo kale sheegtay in xaaladda si dhow loola socdo, iyadoo rajaynaysa in dadaallada diblomaasiyadeed ee joogtada ah iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada ay horseedi doonaan natiijo wanaagsan iyo in badmaaxiintu si nabad ah ugu laabtaan dalkooda. Pakistan ayaa horay ula xiriirtay dowladda Soomaaliya, waxaana bishii June Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya, Cabdisalaan Cali Dhaay, uu sheegay in Soomaaliya ay sii waddo dadaallada lagu raadinayo xal iyo sii deynta badmaaxiinta.

items.title: Puntland oo ku dhawaaqday inay heegan gelisay ciidankeeda ka hor safarka Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Gaalkacyo (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Puntland ayaa heegan buuxa gelisay ciidamadeeda, iyadoo si adag uga digtay safar ay sheegtay in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu qorsheynayo inuu ku tago koonfurta magaalada Gaalkacyo ee dhinaca Galmudug. War-saxaafadeed kasoo baxay Madaxtooyada Puntland ayaa Xasan Sheekh lagu eedeeyay inuu weli wado “abaabul colaad ka dhan ah Puntland”, waxaana maamulka uu sheegay inuu si dhow ula socdo dhaq-dhaqaaqyada la xiriira safarkiisa Galmudug. “Dowladda Puntland waxay si dhow ula socotaa abaabulada qorshaysan ee uu Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud wado, waxayna ka digaysaa qorshaha safarka Xasan Sheekh uu ku imaanayo Koonfurta Gaalkacyo ee Dowladda Galmudug,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Puntland waxay ku doodday in safarkaasi uu leeyahay ujeeddo lagu doonayo in qalalaase looga abuuro Gaalkacyo, oo muddooyinkii dambe ka soo kabaneysay colaado iyo xiisado soo noqnoqday. Maamulka ma uusan soo bandhigin caddeymo muujinaya in safarka Xasan Sheekh uu la xiriiro qorshe militari ama qalalaase, dowladda federaalkuna weli kama aysan jawaabin eedeymaha cusub ee Puntland. Wararka jira waxay sheegayaan in Xasan Sheekh uu qorsheynayo safar uu ku tagayo Galmudug, gaar ahaan Dhuusamareeb iyo deegaanka Xananbuure, halkaas oo la filayo inuu tababar ugu soo xiro cutubyo ka tirsan ciidanka xoogga dalka oo loo diyaariyay dagaalka Al-Shabaab. Waxa kale oo la filayaa inuu la kulmo madaxda Galmudug. Ma jiro ilaa hadda xaqiijin rasmi ah oo dowladda federaalka kasoo baxday oo ku saabsan inuu booqan doono koonfurta Gaalkacyo. Puntland ayaa dhankeeda maamulka iyo shacabka Galmudug, gaar ahaan kuwa koonfurta Gaalkacyo, uga mahadcelisay waxa ay ku tilmaantay kaalintii ay ka qaateen ilaalinta nabadda magaalada. Waxay sidoo kale ugu baaqday madaxda iyo bulshada Galmudug inay ka hortagaan tallaabo kasta oo ay u arkaan inay dib u hurin karto xiisadda. “Waxayna ugu baaqaysaa Maamulka iyo Shacabka Galmudug ee Koonfurta Gaalkacyo in ay ka hortagaan isku dayada cusub ee Xasan Sheekh wado,” ayaa lagu yiri war-saxaafadeedka. Dowladda Puntland ayaa sidoo kale shaacisay inay ciidamadeeda gelisay xaalad feejignaan sare ah, iyadoo aan faahfaahin ka bixin tallaabooyinka dheeraadka ah ee ay qaadi karto. “Dowladda Puntland waxay heegan buuxa galisay Ciidamada Difaaca Puntland, waxayna dadweynaha Reer Puntland ku wargelinaysaa in ay u diyaar garoobaan in Dowladdu qaadayso tallaabooyin dheeri ah oo lagu adkeynayo amniga guud ahaan Puntland, gaar ahaan amniga Magaalada Gaalkacyo iyo deegaanada hoos yimaada,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraalka. Hadalkan ayaa imaanaya xilli khilaafka siyaasadeed iyo midka amni ee u dhexeeya Puntland iyo dowladda federaalka uu toddobaadyadii ugu dambeeyay si weyn ugu soo ururay gobolka Mudug. 4-tii Agoosto waxaa koonfurta Gaalkacyo laga dejiyay hub ay Puntland sheegtay in dowladda federaalka ay u waday ciidamo ku sugan dhinaceeda magaalada. Hubkaas ayaa markii dambe gacanta u galay koox hubeysan, waxaana halkaas ka dhacay iska-horimaad. Maalintii xigtay, ciidamada Puntland ayaa dagaal la galay ciidamo ka tirsan PSF oo la sheegay inay taageero ka haysteen dowladda federaalka, kaddibna waxay la wareegeen xeradii ay ciidankaasi kaga sugnaayeen waqooyiga Gaalkacyo. Dhacdooyinkaas ayaa sare u qaaday walaaca laga qabo in muranka siyaasadeed ee Muqdisho iyo Garoowe uu isu beddelo loollan amni oo si toos ah uga dhex muuqda Gaalkacyo. Magaaladu waxay leedahay taariikh xasaasi ah. Puntland iyo Galmudug ayaa sannadihii 2015 iyo 2016 ku dagaallamay Gaalkacyo, ka hor inta aan heshiisyo xabbad-joojin iyo hannaan amni oo wadajir ah lagu dhisin magaalada. Heshiiskii Gaalkacyo ee 2017 ayaa horseeday sameynta qaabab amni oo labada dhinac ka wada shaqeeyaan, waxaana magaalada sanadihii dambe ka jiray xasillooni ka wanaagsan tii hore. Taasi ayaa sharxaysa sababta dhaq-dhaqaaq kasta oo ciidan ama hub cusub oo magaalada soo gala uu si gaar ah u kiciyo walaac siyaasadeed iyo mid bulsho. Khilaafka hadda jira wuxuu sidoo kale qeyb ka yahay muran ka ballaaran Gaalkacyo. Puntland iyo Villa Somalia ayaa muddo dheer isku hayay wax ka beddelka dastuurka, hannaanka doorashooyinka iyo awood-qeybsiga federaalka. Puntland waxay war-saxaafadeedkeeda Xasan Sheekh ugu yeertay “Madaxweynihii hore ee Dowladda Federaalka”, taas oo ka tarjumaysa mowqifkeeda ah in muddo-xileedkiisii afarta sano ahaa uu dhammaaday 15-kii May 2026. War-saxaafadeedka Puntland wuxuu ugu dambeyn farriin u diray bulshada Soomaaliyeed, dalalka deriska iyo beesha caalamka, isagoo sheegay in Xasan Sheekh uu mas’uul ka noqon doono wixii colaad ama qalalaase ah ee ka dhasha xaaladda. Hadalka cusub ayaa sidaas ku sii kordhinaya xiisad horay u jirtay, iyadoo indhaha hadda lagu hayo safarka Madaxweynaha ee Galmudug iyo sida ay labada dhinac u maareyn doonaan xaaladda xasaasiga ah ee Gaalkacyo. The post Puntland oo ku dhawaaqday inay heegan gelisay ciidankeeda ka hor safarka Xasan Sheekh appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Somaliland Cabinet Weighs Security Concerns and Plans to Expand Health Services
items.description: HARGEISA, Somaliland — Somaliland’s Council of Ministers held its 71st session at the presidential palace on Thursday, with Vice President Mohamed Ali Aw Abdi chairing the meeting in his capacity as acting president. The cabinet reviewed the country’s security situation, health services and a proposed national media policy, according to a statement issued after the meeting. Security situation Interior and National Security Minister Abdalle Mohamed Arab briefed the cabinet on the overall security situation, saying security across Somaliland remained stable and that there was no widespread unrest or instability in the regions. He also updated ministers on ongoing efforts to strengthen peace, community relations and national security in the Awdal and Salel regions. According to the minister, a government delegation of ministers and senior officials has been visiting western regions as part of efforts to advance peace and reconciliation initiatives. He said communities in Awdal and Salel had expressed a strong desire for peace, coexistence and lasting stability, adding that a sustainable solution could be achieved through dialogue and community consensus. Health services and medical infrastructure Health Development Minister Dr. Hussein Bashir Hirsi briefed the cabinet on the overall state of health services and the ministry’s recent activities, including working visits to Togdheer and Saahil regions. During his visit to Burco, the minister officially launched the second phase of the Better Life programme, which supports 28 health facilities in Togdheer, including hospitals and maternal and child health centres. He also visited Berbera in Saahil region to assess healthcare services, existing needs and areas requiring further intervention. The minister said his ministry had delivered CT-scan machines to Saahil and Sanaag, which he said would improve medical diagnosis and help address healthcare needs in the two regions. He reaffirmed the ministry’s plans to expand healthcare services, strengthen medical infrastructure and improve access to quality healthcare across Somaliland’s regions and districts. Cabinet reviews national media policy Information, Culture and National Guidance Minister Barkhad Jama Hirsi (Batuun) presented the cabinet with an overview of the proposed National Media Policy. He said the policy aims to promote a free, independent, responsible and professional media sector capable of responding to public needs and supporting Somaliland’s national objectives. The minister said the Office of the Attorney General had determined that the proposed policy was consistent with the constitution and laws of Somaliland. He also told ministers that the policy would seek to strengthen understanding and cooperation between the media, the public and government institutions, while contributing to national security and the protection of public morals. The minister asked members of the Council of Ministers to review and discuss the draft National Media Policy.

items.title: Muxuu yahay dhambaalka DF Soomaaliya u dirtay Pakistan?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa hambalyo iyo bogaadin u dirtay dowladda iyo shacabka Pakistan, iyadoo munaasabadda 79-aad ee xorriyadda dalkaas loo dabaaldegayo. Shacabka iyo dowladda Pakistan ayaa maanta u dabaaldegaya sanad-guurada 79-aad ee ka soo wareegtay markii ay dalkaasi xornimadiisa ka qaatay gumeystihii Ingiriiska. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee Soomaaliya ayaa sheegtay in dowladda iyo shacabka Soomaaliyeed ay la qeybsanayaan shacabka Pakistan farxadda munaasabadda muhiimka ah. “Munaasabadda 79-aad ee sanad-guurada Xorriyadda Jamhuuriyadda Islaamiga ah ee Pakistan awgeed, Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda iyo Iskaashiga Caalamiga ah ee JFS waxay hambalyo iyo bogaadin u diraysaa Dowladda iyo shacabka Pakistan,” ayaa lagu yiri qoraal ka soo baxay wasaaradda. Pakistan ayaa 14-kii Agoosto sanadkii 1947-kii xornimadeeda ka qaadatay Ingiriiska, iyadoo tan iyo xilligaas 14-ka Agoosto loo dabaal-dego maalinta xorriyadda dalka. Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Soomaaliya ayaa sidoo kale xaqiijisay sida ay dowladda Soomaaliya uga go’an tahay xoojinta xiriirka saaxiibtinimo iyo iskaashiga labada dhinac ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan. Wasaaraddu waxay xustay in Soomaaliya ay dooneyso in la sii horumariyo xiriirka iyo danaha labada dal, gaar ahaan iskaashiga u dhexeeya labada dowladood iyo shacabka walaalaha ah ee Soomaaliya iyo Pakistan. items.title: Iiraan oo lagu eedeeyay weerarro lagu qaaday laba markab oo uu leeyahay Imaaraadku
items.description: Dowladda Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa si adag u cambaareysay Iiraan, kaddib markii ay sheegtay in laba markab oo xiriir la leh shirkadda qaranka shidaalka ee Abu Dhabi, ADNOC, oo la weeraray xilli ay marayeen Marin-biyoodka Hormuz. ADNOC ayaa xaqiijisay in labada markab la weeraray fiidnimadii Khamiista, balse shirkaddu sheegtay in xaaladda markii dambe la xakameeyay, ayadoo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Imaaraadku ay sheegtay in aan wax dhaawac ah laga soo sheegin weerarka. Imaaraadku wuxuu weerarka ku tilmaamay fal cadowtinimo ah, isagoo si gaar ah ugu eedeeyay Iiraan inay bartilmaameedsatay maraakiibta ADNOC. Abu Dhabi ayaa sidoo kale ku tilmaantay isku day kasta oo lagu doonayo in Marin-biyoodka Hormuz loo adeegsado cadaadis dhaqaale inuu yahay “burcad-badeednimo” iyo khatar toos ah oo ku wajahan xasilloonida gobolka iyo amniga tamarta adduunka, balse Iiraan weli ma aysan bixin jawaab rasmi ah oo ku saabsan eedeymaha Imaaraadka. Weerarkan ayaa yimid maalmo kaddib markii Imaaraadku uu sheegay in markab kale oo ADNOC ah lagu weeraray isla marin-biyoodka, ayadoo weerarkaasina, sida ay sheegtay Abu Dhabi, wax dhaawac ah aanu geysan. Marin-biyoodka Hormuz ayaa noqday meel si weyn loogu loollamayo tan iyo markii uu billowday dagaalka Mareykanka iyo Israa’iil ee ka dhanka ah Iiraan bishii Febraayo.

items.title: Israa’iil oo xaqiijisay dilka sarkaal sare oo ka tirsanaa Xamaas
items.description: Gaza (Caasimada Online) – Israa’iil ayaa xaqiijisay inay duqeyn ku dishay Jamal Abu Kamil, oo ay sheegtay inuu ahaa sarkaal sare oo ka tirsanaa booliska magaalada Gaza, xilli ay sii xoogeysanayaan dadaallada lagu doonayo in lagu hirgeliyo qorshe cusub oo lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka Gaza. Ciidanka Difaaca Israa’iil (IDF) ayaa sheegay in Abu Kamil uu ahaa taliye ka tirsan Xamaas, isla markaana uu ku lug lahaa weerarradii 7-dii Oktoobar, iyagoo ku eedeeyay inuu qorsheeyay oo fuliyay falal ay Israa’iil ku tilmaantay “weerarro argagixiso”. Dhimashada sarkaalka ayaa horay waxaa u shaacisay Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha ee Gaza oo sheegtay in gaarigiisa lala beegsaday weerar cirka ah. Wasaaraddu waxay Israa’iil ku eedeysay inay isku dayayso inay Gaza ka abuurto fowdo iyo qalalaase hor leh. IDF ayaa markii dambe xaqiijisay weerarka, iyadoo ku adkaysatay in bartilmaameedku ahaa Abu Kamil, kaas oo ay ku sheegtay inuu door ku lahaa howlaha amni iyo militari ee Xamaas. Dhacdadan ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump uu sheegay in Golaha Nabadda uu gaaray heshiis ku saabsan hub ka dhigista buuxda ee Xamaas iyo dhammaan kooxaha hubaysan ee ka howlgala Marinka Gaza. Trump ayaa sheegay in heshiiskaasi uu qeyb ka yahay qorshe ballaaran oo lagu soo afjarayo colaadda, isla markaana tallaabada hub-dhigista ay tahay qodob muhiim u ah marxaladda xigta ee qorshaha nabadeed. Ururka Xamaas ayaa aqbalay qorshaha Golaha Nabadda ee dhigaya in Gaza gabi ahaanba laga dhigo meel ka caagan hubka kooxaha hubaysan, sida uu sheegay sarkaal sare oo ka tirsan ururka. Sarkaalkan ayaa sheegay in bayaan rasmi ah oo arrintaasi ku saabsan la soo saari doono. Hase yeeshee, Xamaas weli si rasmi ah uma faahfaahin dhammaan qodobada heshiiska ama sida loo fulinayo hub-dhigista, halka dhinaca Israa’iil aysan weli si rasmi ah uga jawaabin hadalka laga soo xigtay Xamaas. Trump ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Israa’iil ay ka bixi doonto Marinka Gaza marka hub-dhigista si buuxda loo dhammeeyo, taas oo uu ku tilmaamay qayb muhiim ah oo ka mid ah qorshaha lagu soo afjarayo dagaalka. Madaxweynaha Mareykanka ayaa heshiiska ku tilmaamay “tallaabo muhiim ah” oo horseedi karta in ugu dambeyn Gaza ay maamusho dowlad cusub oo Falastiini ah, taas oo ka duwan qaabkii maamul ee jiray muddadii colaadda. Horumarradan ayaa imanaya xilli xaaladda Gaza ay weli tahay mid xasaasi ah, iyadoo indhaha caalamka ay ku jeedaan tallaabooyinka xiga ee Xamaas, Israa’iil iyo Mareykanka, iyo in qorshaha hub-dhigista uu dhab ahaan u horseedi karo xabbad-joojin waarta iyo isbeddel siyaasadeed oo ka dhaca Gaza. The post Israa’iil oo xaqiijisay dilka sarkaal sare oo ka tirsanaa Xamaas appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ra’yi ururin shaacisay tirada boqolkiiba shacabka Somalia ee raba doorasho qof iyo cod ah
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Daraasad cusub oo laga sameeyey lix magaalo oo Soomaaliya ah ayaa muujisay in boqolkiiba 88 dadka la wareystay ay doonayaan in madaxweynaha xiga ee dalka lagu soo doorto nidaamka qof iyo cod, xilli uu weli muran xooggan ka taagan yahay qaabka loo wajahayo doorashada soo socota. Daraasad oo ay sameysay Somali Public Agenda , iyadoo la kaashaneysa Somali Dialogue Platform , ayaa lagu cabbiray aragtida bulshada ee doorashooyinka, sharciyadda siyaasadeed, dowladnimada iyo geeddi-socodka dastuurka. Waxaa intii u dhaxeysay May iyo June la wareystay 928 qof oo ku kala nool Muqdisho, Garoowe, Kismaayo, Baydhaba, Dhuusamareeb iyo Jowhar. Natiijada ugu weyn ayaa noqotay taageerada loo hayo in laga gudbo nidaamkii doorashooyinka dadban, oo muddo dheer awoodda doorashada madaxweynaha gacanta u gelinayey xildhibaannada, halka soo xulista baarlamaankana ay door weyn ku lahaayeen beelaha iyo ergooyinkooda. Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii dambe isku dayeysay inay dib ugu laabato doorashooyin dadweyne, waxaana bishii December 2025 Muqdisho ka dhacay doorashada goleyaasha degmooyinka, taas oo dowladda ku tilmaantay tallaabo loo qaaday hirgelinta qof iyo cod. Xubin ka tirsan guddiga doorashooyinka, Cabdshakuur Abib Hayir, ayaa xilligaas sheegay in doorashadu ay muujineyso in “Soomaaliya cagaheeda isku taagayso oo ay hore u socoto.” Doorasho toos ah, balse xasillooni Hase yeeshee, sahanka cusub wuxuu muujinayaa in dadka taageersan qof iyo cod aysan doonayn in arrintaas lagu galo xaalad keeni karta qalalaase siyaasadeed ama amni. Boqolkiiba 82 dadka la wareystay ayaa sheegay in nabadda iyo xasilloonida ay ka mudan yihiin ballaarinta ka qeybgalka shacabka xilliga kala-guurka madaxweynaha, halka boqolkiiba 18 ay dhinaca kale doorteen ka qeybgalka dadweynaha. Sidoo kale, boqolkiiba 65 ayaa sheegay inay doorbidayaan in la sugo doorasho qof iyo cod ah, xitaa haddii diyaarinteedu dib u dhigto waqtiga doorashada. Boqolkiiba 35 ayaa iyaguna sheegay inay mudan tahay in la ilaaliyo muddo-xileedka, xitaa haddii taasi ka dhigan tahay inaan la qaban karin doorasho toos ah. Markii su’aasha laga dhigay in jadwalka siyaasadeed la ilaaliyo iyo in marka hore la xaqiijiyo nabad iyo amni, farqiga jawaabuhu aad ayuu u yaraaday. Boqolkiiba 52 ayaa doortay in mudnaanta la siiyo nabadda iyo xasilloonida, halka boqolkiiba 48 ay sheegeen in geeddi-socodka lagu socdo waqtigiisa, iyadoo aan la kordhin muddo-xileedyada. Ra’yi uruurintan ayaa xoojineysa doodda madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu muddo ku dheganaa ee ah in shacabku ka daaleen in loo soo xulo cidda maamuleysa, oo ay doorbidayaan in ay ayaga soo doortaan. Khilaafka siyaasadeed oo xoogeysanaya Natiijooyinkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli khilaaf culus uu dowladda iyo mucaaradka uga dhexeeyo dastuurka, muddo-xileedka hay’adaha federaalka iyo qaabka loo qabanayo doorashada. Baarlamaanka ayaa bishii Maarso ansixiyey wax-ka-beddello dastuurka ah oo muddo-xileedka hay’adaha federaalka ka dhigay shan sano, halkii uu markii hore ahaa afar sano. Mucaaradka ayaa diiday in isbeddelkaas lagu dabaqo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, wuxuuna ku adkeysanayaa in muddo-xileedkii afarta sano ahaa ee lagu doortay uu dhammaaday bishii May. Khilaafka ayaa bishii June gaaray heer gacan ka hadal ah, kadib markii ciidamada dowladda iyo ciidamo lala xiriiriyey mucaaradka ay ku dagaallameen Muqdisho, xilli ay socdeen diyaar-garowga dibadbaxyo looga soo horjeeday sii joogitaanka madaxweynaha. Madaxweynihii hore Shariif Sheekh Axmed ayaa xilligaas dowladda ku eedeeyey inay “si sharci-darro ah u beddeshay dastuurka.” Wada-hadallo la doonayey in lagu soo afjaro khilaafka ayaan ilaa hadda miro dhalin. Wareeggii ugu dambeeyey ee bishii July dhex maray dowladda iyo mucaaradka ayaa kusoo dhammaaday heshiis la’aan, iyadoo la isku mari waayey qaabka doorashada, cidda maamuleysa iyo sida looga hirgelinayo dowlad-goboleedyada. Si kastaba, dhinacyadu kuma kala foga fikradda ah in shacabka cod yeeshaan sida ay ugu kala fog yihiin qaabka loo fulinayo. Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed ee mucaaradka ayaa isaguna taageeray in shacabka ay si toos ah u doortaan xildhibaannada, balse wuxuu soo jeediyey in kuraasta baarlamaanka lagu sii saleeyo nidaamka awood-qeybsiga beelaha ee 4.5. “Habka cusub wuxuu waafaqsan yahay xaqa muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ay u leeyihiin inay si xor ah oo toos ah u doortaan wakiilladooda, iyadoo la ilaalinayo nidaamka matalaadda beelaha ee 4.5,” ayuu goluhu sheegay. Taasi waxay ka dhigan tahay in doodda hadda taagan aysan ahayn qof iyo cod iyo doorasho dadban oo keliya, balse ay dhinacyadu isku hayaan sida doorashada tooska ah loo qabanayo iyo heshiiska siyaasadeed ee lagu gelayo. Nidaamka 4.5 oo su’aal la geliyey Sahanka ayaa sidoo kale muujiyey in dadka la wareystay ay si weyn uga soo horjeedaan in beel lagu saleeyo cidda qabaneysa xilalka dowladda. items.fullContent: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Daraasad cusub oo laga sameeyey lix magaalo oo Soomaaliya ah ayaa muujisay in boqolkiiba 88 dadka la wareystay ay doonayaan in madaxweynaha xiga ee dalka lagu soo doorto nidaamka qof iyo cod, xilli uu weli muran xooggan ka taagan yahay qaabka loo wajahayo doorashada soo socota. Daraasad oo ay sameysay Somali Public Agenda , iyadoo la kaashaneysa Somali Dialogue Platform , ayaa lagu cabbiray aragtida bulshada ee doorashooyinka, sharciyadda siyaasadeed, dowladnimada iyo geeddi-socodka dastuurka. Waxaa intii u dhaxeysay May iyo June la wareystay 928 qof oo ku kala nool Muqdisho, Garoowe, Kismaayo, Baydhaba, Dhuusamareeb iyo Jowhar. Natiijada ugu weyn ayaa noqotay taageerada loo hayo in laga gudbo nidaamkii doorashooyinka dadban, oo muddo dheer awoodda doorashada madaxweynaha gacanta u gelinayey xildhibaannada, halka soo xulista baarlamaankana ay door weyn ku lahaayeen beelaha iyo ergooyinkooda. Soomaaliya ayaa muddooyinkii dambe isku dayeysay inay dib ugu laabato doorashooyin dadweyne, waxaana bishii December 2025 Muqdisho ka dhacay doorashada goleyaasha degmooyinka, taas oo dowladda ku tilmaantay tallaabo loo qaaday hirgelinta qof iyo cod. Xubin ka tirsan guddiga doorashooyinka, Cabdshakuur Abib Hayir, ayaa xilligaas sheegay in doorashadu ay muujineyso in “Soomaaliya cagaheeda isku taagayso oo ay hore u socoto.” Doorasho toos ah, balse xasillooni Hase yeeshee, sahanka cusub wuxuu muujinayaa in dadka taageersan qof iyo cod aysan doonayn in arrintaas lagu galo xaalad keeni karta qalalaase siyaasadeed ama amni. Boqolkiiba 82 dadka la wareystay ayaa sheegay in nabadda iyo xasilloonida ay ka mudan yihiin ballaarinta ka qeybgalka shacabka xilliga kala-guurka madaxweynaha, halka boqolkiiba 18 ay dhinaca kale doorteen ka qeybgalka dadweynaha. Sidoo kale, boqolkiiba 65 ayaa sheegay inay doorbidayaan in la sugo doorasho qof iyo cod ah, xitaa haddii diyaarinteedu dib u dhigto waqtiga doorashada. Boqolkiiba 35 ayaa iyaguna sheegay inay mudan tahay in la ilaaliyo muddo-xileedka, xitaa haddii taasi ka dhigan tahay inaan la qaban karin doorasho toos ah. Markii su’aasha laga dhigay in jadwalka siyaasadeed la ilaaliyo iyo in marka hore la xaqiijiyo nabad iyo amni, farqiga jawaabuhu aad ayuu u yaraaday. Boqolkiiba 52 ayaa doortay in mudnaanta la siiyo nabadda iyo xasilloonida, halka boqolkiiba 48 ay sheegeen in geeddi-socodka lagu socdo waqtigiisa, iyadoo aan la kordhin muddo-xileedyada. Ra’yi uruurintan ayaa xoojineysa doodda madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu muddo ku dheganaa ee ah in shacabku ka daaleen in loo soo xulo cidda maamuleysa, oo ay doorbidayaan in ay ayaga soo doortaan. Khilaafka siyaasadeed oo xoogeysanaya Natiijooyinkan ayaa kusoo aadaya xilli khilaaf culus uu dowladda iyo mucaaradka uga dhexeeyo dastuurka, muddo-xileedka hay’adaha federaalka iyo qaabka loo qabanayo doorashada. Baarlamaanka ayaa bishii Maarso ansixiyey wax-ka-beddello dastuurka ah oo muddo-xileedka hay’adaha federaalka ka dhigay shan sano, halkii uu markii hore ahaa afar sano. Mucaaradka ayaa diiday in isbeddelkaas lagu dabaqo Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, wuxuuna ku adkeysanayaa in muddo-xileedkii afarta sano ahaa ee lagu doortay uu dhammaaday bishii May. Khilaafka ayaa bishii June gaaray heer gacan ka hadal ah, kadib markii ciidamada dowladda iyo ciidamo lala xiriiriyey mucaaradka ay ku dagaallameen Muqdisho, xilli ay socdeen diyaar-garowga dibadbaxyo looga soo horjeeday sii joogitaanka madaxweynaha. items.title: Dani oo ku gacan saydhay in uu la kulmo Xasan Sheekh
items.description: Madaxweyne Deni,waa iska diiday codsigiisii ahaa aan kulano. Galkacyo,ayuu codsaday inta Mw Deni joogo in uu ugu yimaado oo ay ku kulmaan. Qoor-qoor,ayuuna soo dirsaday oo fariinta dhexdhexaadinta waday,waase la diiday fariintii Qoor-qoor keenay. Markii Mw Deni uga adkaaday loolankii siyaasada iyo amniga,ayuu sidii caadada uhayad uwareegay baryo isa suuxin iyo isbahdilid. Haatan isaga iyo Qoor-qoor,waxay kusoo socdaan Baraxley-Galkacyo Maalinka Axada ah,halka Libaan Shuluqna Maanta kusoo wajahan yahay. Ninka aan ka hadlayo,waa Xasan Shiikh oo aan khayr ula soo socon Galkacyo, kadib markii ay ka fashilantay colaadii uu abaabulay oo laga adkaaday qaswadayaashii uu adeegsanayay. Mar kale,waxaan leenahay reer Galmudug Ninkaas yuusan idin soo dhexmarin ee iska badbaadsha sidii aad horay iskaga badbaadiseen. Waa shar wade weyn. JQ.
