items.title: Ilhan Omar’s Primary Win: A Path to a Fifth House Term in the U.S. Congress
items.description: Minneapolis (WDN)- U.S. Representative Ilhan Omar has won the Democratic primary for Minnesota’s 5th Congressional District, securing the party’s nomination and clearing a major hurdle on her path toward seeking a fifth term in the U.S. House of Representatives. lhan is one of President Trump’s most outspoken critics, consistently pushing back against his attacks on her Somali heritage and immigrant background. She has become a prominent defender of her roots, confronting Trump whenever he uses his public platform to target her, Somalia, or the broader Somali-American community. Ilham secured more than 80 percent of the vote in a decisive victory over her Democratic challengers. The victory reinforces Omar’s position in a heavily Democratic district centered on Minneapolis, where she has built a strong political base since first entering Congress in 2019. With more than 95 percent of ballots counted, unofficial results showed Omar with 122,640 votes, followed by Julie Trang Le with 10,201 and Latonya T. Reeves with 9,131. Other candidates included Abena McKenzie and Nate Schluter. Omar’s victory was particularly significant given that primary elections in heavily Democratic districts often determine the eventual representative. Minnesota’s 5th District is strongly Democratic and encompasses Minneapolis and surrounding communities. A Dominant Primary Victory Omar, a fourth-term Democrat and prominent progressive voice in Congress, defeated a field that included Le, a former federal prosecutor, and Reeves, a labor and political activist. The scale of the victory left little doubt about Omar’s continued strength among Democratic voters in the district. Her performance also strengthens her position within the progressive wing of the Democratic Party, where she remains one of the most recognizable members of the group known as “The Squad.” The nomination puts Omar in position to seek another term in the November general election. On the Republican side, John Nagel won the party’s primary with approximately 52.1 percent of the vote. If the results are formally certified, Nagel is expected to face Omar in the November general election. The November contest will therefore provide another national political test for Omar, whose career has attracted considerable attention both inside Minnesota and across the United States. Yet the political landscape of the 5th District remains strongly favorable to Democrats. Omar won reelection in 2024 with roughly 74 percent of the general-election vote, underscoring the challenge facing any Republican seeking to unseat her. Omar’s latest primary victory marks another important chapter in a political career that has made her one of the most prominent Somali-American figures in U.S. politics. If she wins in November, Omar would begin a fifth term in Congress, further cementing her place in Minnesota’s political history and extending the influence of one of the most prominent progressive voices in the Democratic Party. For now, the primary result represents a clear message from Democratic voters in Minnesota’s 5th District: Ilhan Omar remains their preferred candidate. The next test comes in November. items.title: Puntland Political Council Calls for Urgent Peaceful Resolution to Kodmo Tensions
items.description: Garowe (WDN ) — The Puntland Council of Politicians and Intellectuals, composed of 26 members, has called for an immediate and peaceful resolution to tensions in Kodmo, in Rako-Raaxo District of Karkaar Region, warning that renewed armed confrontation could have serious consequences for Puntland’s security and stability. In a statement, the council urged the Puntland administration to prioritize dialogue and consult directly with traditional elders and community leaders in the affected area, emphasizing that a negotiated settlement would be preferable to armed confrontation. The council warned that renewed violence could not only put civilian lives at risk but also deepen internal divisions at a particularly sensitive time for Puntland. Warning Against a New Security Crisis The council cautioned that internal conflict could create opportunities for militant groups still operating in the Cal Miskaad mountains, allowing them to exploit political and security divisions within Puntland. The warning comes amid continuing security challenges in parts of the region, where authorities have been seeking to consolidate state control and prevent the emergence of competing armed formations. The council stressed that any security measures, including disarmament initiatives, must be based on broad social consensus rather than unilateral action. “Any disarmament process requires a social agreement, inclusive consultation, and clear laws to guide its implementation,” the council said. It argued that sustainable security cannot be achieved through force alone and that community confidence and cooperation are essential to maintaining long-term stability. Appeal to Puntland’s Leaders and Society The council called on Puntland’s traditional elders, religious scholars, business leaders, politicians, and wider civil society to play an active role in preventing further escalation. It urged all sides to place the interests of Puntland’s peace, unity, and statehood above political or factional considerations. The statement reflects growing concern that localized disputes could develop into broader confrontations if they are not addressed through dialogue and community-based mediation. For Puntland, the immediate challenge is therefore not simply resolving the dispute in Kodmo, but ensuring that the crisis does not become another source of instability in a region already facing significant security pressures. The council’s appeal ultimately centers on a simple warning: Puntland cannot afford to allow internal divisions to weaken its security institutions or create openings for armed extremist groups. A negotiated settlement supported by traditional leaders, community participation, and a clear legal framework may offer the most sustainable path toward preventing further bloodshed and preserving Puntland’s hard-won stability. items.title: Somali power play or genuine development effort for Somaliland?
Qarax ka dhacay Dekedda Rotterdam iyo booliska oo ka hadlay
items.description: Qarax ayaa Khamiistan ka dhacay Dekedda Rotterdam, iyadoo hal qof uu ku dhintay, dhowr kalena ay ku dhaawacmeen, sida ay sheegeen Booliska Netherlands. Boolisku waxay sheegeen in qaraxu uu ka dhacay dekedda, isla-markaana la xiray goobta, si loo ogaado waxa sababay qaraxa. Qoraal ay soo dhigeen baraha bulshada ayay ku sheegeen in qaraxu uu u muuqdo mid ka dhashay shil shaqo xilligan, iyagoon faahfaahin dheeraad ah bixin. Shil shaqo ayaa waxaa loola jeedaa ama uu ka dhigan yahay in dhacdadu aanay ahayn mid si ula kac ah loo gaystay ama weerar la soo abaabulay, balse ay tahay shil ku yimid khalad farsamo, inta lagu guda jiray howl maalmeedka shaqada. Afhayeenka Booliska Rotterdam, Daan Valkenburg ayaa mar dambe sheegay inaanan weli la gaarin wax gunaanad rasmi ah oo ku aaddan natiijada dhacdada, isla-markaana aan meesha laga saari karin dhammaan ku-tala-galada suurtagalka ah. Baareyaasha ayaan weli aqoon sababta dhabta ah ee ka dambeysa qaraxa, baaritaankuna uu weli socdo. Dekedda Rotterdam (Port of Rotterdam) oo ku taala Galbeedka Netherlands ayaa ah dekedda ugu mashquulka badan, uguna weyn Yurub.

items.title: Puntland: Waqooyi Bari waxay maxaabiista Somaliland ka dhigatay ‘mashiinka lacagta’
items.description: Garoowe (Caasimada Online) – Puntland ayaa walaac xooggan ka muujisay xaaladda maxaabiista ciidamada maamulka Somaliland ee ku xiran magaalada Laascaanood, iyadoo ku eedeysay maamulka Waqooyi Bari inuu maxaabiista u adeegsado dano siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale. Wasiirka Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha Puntland, Maxamuud Caydiid Dirir ayaa sheegay in maxaabiista laga helo dhaqaale, isagoo su’aal geliyay habka loo maareeyo lacagaha loogu tala-galay daryeelkooda. “Maxaabiista waa sac caano badan. Waa la maalayaa. Red Cross (Bisha Cas) ayaa halkii askari maalintii looga qaataa sagaal dollar. Dhowr boqol oo kun ayaa bishii maamulka ku qaataa maxaabiista, oo ay u dheer tahay dawadooda. Nimanka Magafe ahaan ayaa loo haystaa ee siyaasad looma haysto,” ayuu yiri Caydiid. Wasiirka ayaa ku eedeeyay maamulka Waqooyi Bari in halkii maxaabiista loo mari lahaa hannaan sharci ah, loo adeegsanayo dano dhaqaale, isagoo ku baaqay in si cad loo baaro dambiyada loo haysto maxbuus kasta. Caydiid ayaa si gaar ah u xusay dhacdooyinkii dilalka iyo tacaddiyada ee la xiriiray dagaalladii Laascaanood, isagoo sheegay in haddii maxaabiista loo haysto dambiyo ay tahay in loo maro hannaan caddaaladeed oo cad, laguna saleeyo eedeymo iyo xog rasmi ah. “Haddii maxaabiista la maxkamadeynayo waa in lagu maxkamadeeyo dambiyadii ay galeen oo runta la sheego,” ayuu yiri wasiir Caydiid, isagoo ku baaqay in la caddeeyo dambiyada loo haysto maxbuus kasta. Wasiirka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in qaar ka mid ah maxaabiista ay u baahan yihiin daryeel caafimaad, gaar ahaan kuwa qaba dhaawacyada iyo xanuunnada kale, wuxuuna ku baaqay in si gaar ah loo qiimeeyo xaaladdooda caafimaad. Maamulka Waqooyi Bari ayaa gacanta ku haya boqolaal maxaabiis ah oo ka tirsan ciidamada Somaliland, kuwaas oo lagu qabtay dagaalkii Laascaanood ee 25-kii Agoosto 2023, xilligaas oo ciidamada Somaliland laga saaray saldhigga Goojacadde kaddib dagaallo muddo bilo ah ka socday magaalada. Dagaalka Laascaanood ayaa sababay khasaarooyin kala duwan, waxaana kadib dagaallada soo noq-noqday ay xaaladdu isu beddeshay in maamulka Waqooyi Bari uu gacanta ku dhigo ciidamo iyo saraakiil ka tirsan Somaliland. Waqooyi Bari ayaa hore u sheegay in sii deynta ama is-weydaarsiga maxaabiista uu ku imaan karo heshiis siyaasadeed iyo nabadeed oo dhexmara dhinacyada, isagoo sidoo kale dalbaday in Somaliland ay ka tanaasusho sheegashada ay ku leedahay gobolka Sool, taas oo si adag u diidan tahay Hargeysa. items.title: Haybad Qaran oo Burbur Qarka u Saaran

items.title: New Gedo Power Shift as SNA Commander Returns to Beled Hawo
items.description: BELED HAWO— The commander of the Somali National Army’s 43rd Division, Colonel Osman Haji, arrived in the border town of Beled Hawo on Thursday after spending several months in Mogadishu. Colonel Haji landed at the airstrip inside the UK military training facility in Beled Hawo, according to local sources. His arrival is understood to be part of a new Federal Government plan aimed at strengthening the presence of Somali National Army forces in the Gedo region. Sources say recent talks between the Somali National Army leadership and Abdirashid Janan resulted in an understanding that would allow the Federal Government to deploy additional military officers and troops to Beled Hawo. The development signals renewed efforts by the Federal Government to expand and consolidate its security presence in Gedo, a strategically important region bordering Kenya and Ethiopia. items.title: Xasan Sheekh iyo Guudlaawe oo Kulmay, Heshiisna La Filayo
items.description: Hirshabeelle (Raxanreeb Online): Kulankii Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo Madaxweynaha Hirshabeelle Cali Cabdullaahi Xuseen (Cali Guudlaawe) ayaa soo idlaaday, iyadoo la sheegay in dib la isugu soo laaban doono marka Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu kasoo laabto Dhuusamareeb. Warar ku dhow kulanka ayaa sheegaya in Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh uu faray wasiirro iyo siyaasiyiin horey uga soo horjeeday Cali Guudlaawe inay la heshiiyaan Madaxweynaha Hirshabeelle. Sida xogaha lagu helayo, Cali Balcad ayaa kamid noqday siyaasiyiinta Madaxweynaha xiriirka la leh ee la sheegay inay heshiis la gaareen Cali Guudlaawe. Arrintan ayaa dhalisay su’aalo ku saabsan mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee Cali Guudlaawe iyo inuu weli haysto fursad uu ku sii wadan karo xilka Madaxweynaha Hirshabeelle. Ilaa hadda ma jiraan warar madax-bannaan oo xaqiijinaya ama beeninaya xogtan, balse wararka la helayo ayaa muujinaya in rajada Cali Guudlaawe ee sii joogista xilka ay soo xoogeysaneyso. items.title: Wasaaradda Qorshaynta oo hay’adaha aan dawliga ahayn u soo bandhigtay…
items.description: 𝗪𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗤𝗼𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗮𝘆𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝗼𝗼 𝗛𝗮𝘆’𝗮𝗱𝗮𝗵𝗮 𝗔𝗮𝗻 𝗗𝗮𝘄𝗹𝗶𝗴𝗮 𝗮𝗵 𝗨 𝗦𝗼𝗼 𝗕𝗮𝗻𝗱𝗵𝗶𝗴𝘁𝗮𝘆 𝗤𝗮𝗯𝘆𝗼-𝗾𝗼𝗿𝗮𝗮𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗦𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗤𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗸𝗮 𝗲𝗲 𝗗𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗴𝗮𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗤𝗶𝘆𝗮𝗺𝗮𝘆𝗻𝘁𝗮 Wasaaradda Qorshaynta iyo Horumarinta Qaranka ayaa maanta hay’adaha aan dawliga ahayn ee kala duwan, oo ay ka mid yihiin hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay, hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo hay’adaha maxalliga ah, u soo bandhigtay qabyo-qoraalka Siyaasadda Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimaynta, si ay hay’adahaasi uga qaybqaataan dib-u-eegista, talo-bixinta iyo dhamaystirka siyaasadda. Kulanka wadatashiga ah oo lagu qabtay Magaalada Hargeysa, ayaa si rasmi ah u daah-furay 𝗔𝗴𝗮𝗮𝘀𝗶𝗺𝗮𝗵𝗮 𝗪𝗮𝗮𝘅𝗱𝗮 𝗗𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗴𝗮𝗹𝗸𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗤𝗶𝗶𝗺𝗮𝘆𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝗲𝗲 𝗪𝗮𝘀𝗮𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗱𝗮 𝗤𝗼𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗮𝘆𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝗶𝘆𝗼 𝗛𝗼𝗿𝘂𝗺𝗮𝗿𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗮 𝗤𝗮𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗸𝗮, 𝗠𝘂𝗱𝗮𝗻𝗲 𝗖𝗮𝗯𝗱𝗶𝗿𝗮𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗶𝗱 𝗚𝗲𝗲𝗱𝗶, waxaana ka qaybgalay masuuliyiin iyo wakiillo ka socday hay’adaha Qaramada Midoobay, hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo hay’adaha maxalliga ah. Ujeeddada kulanka ayaa ahayd in hay’adaha aan dawliga ahayn lala wadaago qabyo-qoraalka Siyaasadda Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimaynta, lana siiyo fursad ay kaga qaybqaataan geeddi-socodka diyaarinta siyaasadda, iyagoo soo jeedinaya talooyin, aragtiyo iyo talo-bixinno lagu horumarinayo qabyo-qoraalka. Intii uu kulanku socday, waxaa ka qaybgalayaasha loo soo bandhigay qodobbada muhiimka ah ee qabyo-qoraalka Siyaasadda Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimaynta, iyadoo sidoo kale la qabtay dood-wadaagyo ay hay’adaha ka qaybgalay kaga dhiibteen aragtiyahooda, talooyinkooda iyo khibradahooda ku aaddan nidaamka dabagalka iyo qiimaynta mashaariicda iyo barnaamijyada horumarineed. Wadatashigan ayaa qayb muhiim ah ka ah geeddi-socodka diyaarinta Siyaasadda Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimaynta, iyadoo ujeeddadu tahay in la helo siyaasad loo dhan yahay oo ka tarjumaysa baahiyaha iyo waayo-aragnimada dhinacyada kala duwan ee ku hawlan horumarinta dalka. Siyaasaddan oo ah mid heer qaran ah ayaa xoojinaysa nidaamka dabagalka iyo qiimaynta mashaariicda iyo barnaamijyada horumarineed ee laga maalgeliyo deeqaha iyo miisaaniyadda qaranka, waxayna gacan ka geysanaysaa kor u qaadista isla-xisaabtanka, hufnaanta iyo waxtarka mashaariicda horumarineed. Sidoo kale, Siyaasadda Qaranka ee Dabagalka iyo Qiimayntu waxay muhiim u tahay in la helo xog iyo caddayn la isku halayn karo oo lagu salayn karo go’aannada, qorshayaasha iyo siyaasadaha horumarineed ee dalka, iyadoo la xoojinayo wada-shaqaynta iyo isku-duwidda hay’adaha dawladda iyo hay’adaha aan dawliga ahayn ee ka shaqeeya horumarinta Somaliland.

items.title: Mid ka mid ah golaha wasiirrada DF oo is casilay
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Wasiir ku-xigeenkii Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Xukuumadda Soomaaliya, Xildhibaan Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Axmed (Abuukaate), ayaa si rasmi ah ugu dhawaaqay inuu iska casilay xilkii uu ka hayay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, kadib qoraal uu soo saaray. Wasiir ku xigeenka ayaa warqad uu soo saaray oo ku taariikheysan maanta oo ah 13 August 2026 ku caddeeyay inuu iska casilay xilkii Wasiir ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha, balse ma shaacin sababta rasmiga ah ee ka dambeysa is casilaaddiisa. “Waxaan si rasmi ah isaga casilay xilka Wasiir ku-xigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha ee XFS,” ayaa ku yiri warqadda uu soo saaray Abuukaate. Sidoo kale wuxuu uga mahadceliyay madaxda dowladda fursadda ay u siiyeen inuu ka mid noqdo xukuumadda Dan-Qaran isaga oo xusay inuu fursaddaas u arkayay mid uu ugu adeego guud ahaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed. “Waxaan u mahadcelinayaa madaxda dalka fursadda ay ii siiyeen inaan ugu adeego bulshada Soomaaliyeed,” ayuu sii raaciyay qoraalkiisa. Is-casilaadda Xildhibaan Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Axmed (Abuukaate) ayaa kusoo beegmaysa xilli ay dalka ka socdaan isbeddello siyaasadeed iyo kuwo maamul, is la markaana Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ay waddo qorshayaal iyo howlaha la xiriira hannaanka shaqada hay’adaha dowladda. Dhanka kale ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay xukuumadda Ra’iisul wasaare Xamza oo ku aadan tagista Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Axmed (Abuukaate) oo maanta banneeyay xilkii uu ka hayay Wasaaradda Ganacsiga. Si kastaba, ha’ahaatee lama oga tallaabada xigta ee ay qaadi doonto dowladda Soomaaliya iyo cidda beddeli doonta Wasiir ku-xigeenka casilay oo ka mid ahaa Xildhibaannadii aadka ugu ololaleenaysay Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) oo loo doortay Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. The post Mid ka mid ah golaha wasiirrada DF oo is casilay appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Wasiir ka tirsan Xukuumadda Raysal Wasaare Barre oo is casilay
items.description: Wasiir Kuxigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga & Warshadaha Xukuumadda Federaalka, Maxamuud Cabdullaahi Axmed (Abukaate) ayaa maanta shaaciyay inuu iska casilay xilkaasi. “Maanta oo ay taariikhdu tahay 13 Agosto 2026, waxaan si rasmi ah isaga casilay xilka Wasiir Kuxigeenka Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Somaliya. Waxaan u mahadcelinayaa madaxda dalka fursadda ay ii siiyeen in aan ugu adeego bulshada Soomaaliyeed.” Ayuu Maxamuud Abukaate ku sheegay warqad uu ku saxiixnaa. Maxamuud Abukaate ayaan sheegin sababta uu xilkaasi isaga casilay, mana jirto wax falcelin ah oo Xafiiska Raysal Wasaare Xamse Cabdi Barre uu ka bixiyay is casilaaddiisa. Xilkan ayaa loo magacaabay bishii March ee sanadkii 2025, waxayna tallaabada uu isaga casilay ay imaneysaa, iyadoo muddooyinkii u dambeeyay uu xiriir wanaagsan la lahaa Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. Maxamuud Abukaate waa Xildhibaan ka tirsan Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Federaalka, waxaana bishii April ee sanadkii 2022 markii 2aad la guddoonsiiyay shahaadada Xildhibaanimo. Maxamuud Abukaate ayaa ah siyaasi laga soo doorto Dowlad Goboleedka Hirshabelle, waxayna deegaan doorashadiisu tahay Magaalada Beledweyne ee Xarunta Gobolka Hiiraan, wuxuuna ku fadhiyaa kursiga uu tirsigiisu yahay HOP#006.

items.title: Xasan Sheekh oo Galmudug Booqanaya, Ciidanka Puntland Kasoo Goostayna La Kulmaya
items.description: Galmudug (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, ayaa booqanaya Galmudug, halkaas oo uu ku tagayo xeryo ay ku sugan yihiin qaar kamid ah ciidamadii kasoo baxay Gaalkacyo iyo deegaanno kale oo Puntland ah. Sida xogtu sheegeyso, ciidamadaasi ayaa loo wareejiyay Galmudug kaddib markii Puntland ay u qabatay muddo 48 saacadood ah inay isu soo dhiibaan, iyadoo markii dambe la go’aamiyay in lagu soo dhaweeyo gudaha Galmudug. Qaar kamid ah ciidamada ayaa xilli habeen ah kasoo baxay xeryihii ay ku sugnaayeen Gaalkacyo, oo ay kamid ahayd xerada Barda-dheere, halkaas oo la sheegay in loogu diyaarinayay howlgal ka dhan ah Puntland. Intooda badan ayaa lagu hayaa gobolka Galgaduud, gaar ahaan xero ku taalla deegaanka Xananbuure. Booqashada Madaxweynaha ayaa lagu wadaa in loo bixiyo xaflad lagu soo xirayo tababar, maadaama Xananbuure ay sidoo kale tababar ku qaadanayeen ciidamo kale oo horey loo soo sheegay. Inkastoo Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka uu horey u soo xiray tababarka ciidamadaasi, haddana waxaa la filayaa in Madaxweynaha uu la hadlo ciidamada, isagoo u ballanqaadi doona in la siin doono xuquuqdooda iyo waajibaad qaran oo loo xilsaaro. items.title: Daawo: Xaalad adag oo ka taagan Waabari kadib markii…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Xaaladda degmada Waabari ee gobolka Banaadir ayaa maanta aad u kacsan, kadib markii ay isku dhaceen ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya iyo shacabka deggan xaafadda Buulo Eelaay oo ka tirsan laanta Hantiwadaag ee degmadasi. Ciidamada ayaa saaka ku jarmaaday xaafaddan, waxayna dumis ku qoreen guryihii shacabka, taas oo keentay inay isku dhacaan iyaga iyo dadka deegaanka. Muuqaallo lagu baahiyay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinayo ciidamada oo rasaas nool nool u adeegsanaya shacabka oo diidan in la dumiyo guryahooda, lagana barakacayo xaafaddaasi oo ah isku raran ah oo ku taalla bartamaha Muqdisho. Hooyo kamid ah dadka deegaanka oo hadashay Shabelle Tv ayaa sheegtay in xaafadda aysan ahayn dhul dowladeed ama obasiibo, isla markaana ay dowladda Soomaaliya uga baaqayaan inay ka dayso beegsiga iyo barakicinta. “Annaga waxaan daganahay xaafad ab ka ab wixii na dhalay ayaa 90 jir ah annaga ayaan kusii xigno marka maanta in nala barakiciyo ma ogolin, dowladda waxaan ka codsaneynaa xaafaddii obasiibo ah ay raadsato annaga xaafadeenna ammaan ha naloo siiyo,” ayay tiri hooyo kamid ah dadka deegaanka. Sidoo kale, waxa ay intaas ku dartay in shaqaaqadii maanta ka dhacday degmada Waabari ay waxyeelo kasoo gaartay hooyo waayeel ah, sidoo kalena la xir xiray wiilashoodii, kadib markii ciidamadu ay xoog iyo rasaas nool nool u adeegsadeen shacbaka. “Khsaare waa jiraa oo gabar ayaa laamiga ku dhaawacantay lug iyo gacan ayay xabad uga dhacday wiilashii oo dhana waa naga wateen,” ayay raacisay. Dhacdadan ayaa kamid ah shaqaaqooyin horay uga dhacay xaafado ku yaalla magaalada Muqdisho oo ay burburin ka sameysay dowladda Soomaaliya, waxaana weli sii socda howlgalka lagu barakicinayo shacabka caasimada. Mudane Jibriil Afyare ayaa la wareegay mas’uuliyadda Waaxda Siyaasadda, Qorsheynta iyo Cilmi-baarista, isagoo xilka kala wareegay Agaasimihii hore, Mudane Mohamed Mahmud Colad. 5. items.title: Puntland oo cudud ciidan ka heshay Degmada Saaxo (SAWIRRO)
items.description: Dowlad Goboleedka Puntland ayaa maanta qarameysay ciidamada dadka deegaanka ee ku sugan Degmada Saaxo ee galbeedka Gobolka Mudug. Puntland ayaa si rasmi ah u diiwaangelisay ciidamada deegaanka iyo hubkoodaba, iyadoo ciidamadan oo boqolaal gaaraya ay ku biirayaan Daraawiishta Puntland. Arrintan ayaa qayb ka ah qorshaha lagu xoojinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida deegaanada Puntland, gaar ahaan Gobolka Mudug, laguna mideynayo awoodda ciidamada ee ka hawlgala gudaha Puntland. Qorshaha lagu xoojinayo amniga Puntland ayaa ah mid dib-u-habayn loogu sameynayo Ciidamada Qalabka Sida, iyadoo laga hortagayo fara-gelinta amni ee ay Puntland ku eedeysay Dowladda Federaalka inay ku hayso maamulkaasi. Tallaabadan ayaa ku soo aadeysa, xilli Saraakiisha Ciidamada Puntland ay Gobolka Mudug, qaybta Puntland ka wadaan diiwaangelin lagu sameynayo ciidamada ku sugan gobolkaasi. Madaxweyne Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni oo habeenkii Sabtida Magaalada Gaalkacyo kula kulmay Saraakiisha Ciidamada Puntland ee ka hawlgala gobolkaasi ayaa kula dardaarmay adkaynta amniga Puntland, isla-markaana ay xoojiyaan wada-shaqaynta, feejignaanta iyo waajibaadka ka saaran sugidda amniga. Madaxweyne Deni oo 5-tii bishan shir jaraa’id ku qabtay Magaalada Garoowe ayaa ciidamada ay Dowladda Federaalka ka qoratay deegaanada Puntland ku booriyay inay isa soo dhiibaan, isla-markaana ay ka mid noqdaan ciidamada kale ee Puntland. Puntland ayaa diidan in ciidamo aan ka amar qaadan maamulka ay ka hawlgalaan deegaanadeeda.

items.title: Sheekh Cali Wajiis oo dood culus ka keenay nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Sheekh Cali Maxamuud Xasan (Wajiis), oo kamid ah culimada Soomaaliyeed ayaa ka hadlay arrimo xasaasi ah oo ku aadan nidaamka federaalka ee dalka ayaa soo jeediyay in dib-u-habeyn lagu sameeyo qaabka dowlad-goboleedyada dalka iyo sida loo qaybsado awoodaha dowladda dhexe iyo maamullada. Sheekh Cali Wajiis ayaa sheegay in nidaamka federaalka Afrika uu leeyahay laba qaab oo waaweyn, kuwaas oo uu ku kala saaray mid ku dhisan isir iyo mid ku dhisan deegaan. Sheekha ayaa xusay in nidaamka xilligan ku haboon Soomaaliya uu yahay midka deegaanka, isaga oo soo jeediyay in dib loogu dhiso 18-kii gobol ee uu ka koobnaa dalka. “Nidaamka Federaalka Africa 5 dowladood ayaa ka qaadatay, isagoo 2 nooc ah 1- mid ku dhisan isir ama Qabyaalad, waana lagu hoobtay Ethiopia iyo Somalia ayaa qaatay colaado ayaana laga dhaxlay. 2- mid ku dhisan deegaan South Africa, Kenya iyo Nigeria ayaa qaatay gobolo ayuu ku dhisanyahay, waana maamul heer gobol oo leesu doorto, dalkana awooddiisa difaac amni iyo diyaasadeed dowladda dhexe ayaa heysa, waana kan Soomaaliya ku habboon iney qaadato, sidaa darteed 18 kii gobol in dib loogu dhiso ayey ahayd xilligii dastuurku furnaay laakiin ilduuf ayaa dhacay ee dowladda soo socota fursaddaas ha qaadato,” ayuu yiri Sheekha oo qoraal soo saaray. Dhanka kale, Sheekh Cali Wajiis ayaa sheegay in xal u helidda khilaafaadka ka dhashay nidaamka federaalka ay muhiim u tahay mustaqbalka siyaasadeed ee dalka, wuxuuna ku taliyay in Dastuurka si cad loogu qeexo qaabka ay dowlad-goboleedyadu u dhismi karaan. “Deeganaanshaha dalku wuxuu ku jiraa in xal loo helo dhibaatada federaalku ku kala qoqobay bulshadeenna waxay ahayd in Dastuurka lagu qoro inta uu furnaay (Dowlad goboleedku waxey ka dhismi kartaa hal gobol iyo wixii ka badan), taasoo Xal u noqon lahayd isku raranka gobolada is qaadan la, iyo beelaha isku heesta hoggaaminta goboladaas.” Waxaa kale oo uu ku baaqay in doorashooyinka dowlad-goboleedyada loo maro hannaan xor ah oo la isku raacsan yahay, kadibna hoggaamiyeyaasha cusub ee kasoo baxa ay la shaqeyso Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. “Haddii fursaddaas dowladdu ka ilduuftay hadda waa inay tartanka Madaxweyne goboleedyada si xor ah loo qabtaa cidna aan loo xirin ciddii la doortana dowladdu toos ula mucaamishaa si khilaafaadku usoo dhammaadaan, doorashooyinkuna u noqdaan kuwa la’isku raaco oo soo saara madax lala shaqeeyo,” ayuu qoraalkiisa kusoo gabagabeeyay. The post Sheekh Cali Wajiis oo dood culus ka keenay nidaamka federaalka Soomaaliya appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Soomaaliya oo qorshaynaysa maalgelin dhan 35 Milyan oo Dollar ah si loo kobciyo dhoofinta sisinta iyo kalluunka
items.description: Dowladda Soomaaliya ayaa qorshaynaysa in dalka lagu soo jiito ugu yaraan 35 milyan oo dollar oo maalgelin cusub ah oo lagu horumarinayo wax-soo-saarka, farsamaynta iyo dhoofinta sisinta iyo kalluunka , iyadoo tallaabadan qayb ka tahay qorshe qaran oo shan sano ah oo ku saabsan kobcinta ganacsiga iyo wax-soo-saarka dalka. Wasaaradda Ganacsiga iyo Warshadaha ayaa qabatay kulan-wada-tashi ah oo lagu dhammaystirayo laguna ansixinayo Qorshaha Qaran ee 2026–2030 , kaas oo diiradda saaraya sidii wax-soo-saarka Soomaaliya loogu kordhin lahaa qiime dheeraad ah ka hor inta aan loo dhoofin suuqyada gudaha, kuwa gobolka iyo kuwa caalamka. Qorshahan ayaa sidoo kale lagu doonayaa in wax laga qabto caqabadaha hortaagan silsiladaha wax-soo-saarka, gaar ahaan farsamaynta badeecadaha, tayada, kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha, maalgelinta iyo helitaanka suuqyo joogto ah. Sida qorshaha lagu sheegay, dowladda waxay hiigsanaysaa in barnaamijkan lagu taageero 300 ganacsi , isla markaana la sameeyo ugu yaraan 80 xiriir ganacsi oo u dhexeeya soo-saareyaasha Soomaaliyeed iyo iibsadayaasha , iyadoo la filayo in barnaamijku abuuro ku dhowaad 1,200 fursadood oo shaqo . Hindisahan waxaa taageeraya Enhanced Integrated Framework (EIF) oo hoos yimaada Ururka Ganacsiga Adduunka (WTO), iyadoo taageero farsamo laga helayo ESAMI-TRAPCA , oo ah hay’ad gobolka ka shaqaysa dhisidda awoodda ganacsiga iyo maalgashiga. Sisinta ayaa ka mid ah wax-soo-saarka beeraha ee Soomaaliya ee muhiimka u ah dhoofinta. Hase yeeshee, qayb weyn oo ka mid ah wax-soo-saarka dalka ayaa weli ka baxa iyadoo aan si weyn gudaha loogu farsamayn. Dowladdu waxay doonaysaa in la kordhiyo awoodda dalka ee nadiifinta, farsamaynta, baakadaynta iyo kaydinta sisinta , taas oo ganacsatada Soomaaliyeed u suuragelin karta inay qiime badan ka helaan badeecadda halkii ay si toos ah uga dhoofin lahaayeen wax-soo-saar aan la farsamayn. Farsamaynta gudaha ayaa sidoo kale abuuri karta shaqooyin dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan warshadaynta, gaadiidka, kaydinta, baakadaynta iyo suuq-geynta. Dhanka kale, kalluumaysiga ayaa ah mid ka mid ah qaybaha Soomaaliya ka caawin kara kala-duwanaanshaha dhaqaalaha iyo abuurista shaqooyin, gaar ahaan bulshada ku nool deegaannada xeebaha. Soomaaliya oo leh xeeb dheer ayaa haysata fursad weyn oo ay kaga faa’iidaysan karto kheyraadka badda, balse waxaa weli jira caqabado ay ka mid yihiin kaabayaal qaboojin iyo kaydin, xarumo farsamaynta kalluunka, nidaamyada hubinta tayada, shahaadooyinka badeecadaha iyo helitaanka suuqyada caalamiga ah .

items.title: Mareykanka oo ku dhawaaqay tallaabo ka sii dari karta colaadda kala dhaxeysa Iran
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) – Xoghayaha Difaaca Mareykanka, Pete Hegseth ayaa sheegay in ciidamada dalkiisa ay sii wadi karaan xannibaadda dekedaha Iran muddo kasta oo loo baahdo, iyadoo uu sii xoogeysanayo dhaq-dhaqaaqa milatari ee Mareykanka ee gobolka. Hegseth oo wariyeyaasha kula hadlayay Panama ayaa sheegay in ciidamada badda Mareykanka ay awood u leeyihiin inay sii wadaan howl-galka, xilli walaac laga muujinayo muddada uu markabka diyaaradaha qaada ee USS Abraham Lincoln ku sii jiri doono howlgalka. “Ciidamadeenna badda waxay xannibaaddan sii wadi karaan muddo aan xad lahayn, sababtoo ah waxaan maraakiibta u kala wareejinnaa gudaha iyo dibadda, sidii aan horey u sameyn jirnay ayaan mustaqbalkana u sii sameyn doonno,” ayuu yiri Hegseth. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo beegmaya iyadoo warbaahinta caalamka ay soo tabineyso qorshayaal la xiriira isbeddel lagu sameynayo maraakiibta dagaalka ee Mareykanka ka howlgala gobolka, gaar ahaan beddelka Abraham Lincoln oo howlgalkiisa ku jiray in ka badan 250 maalmood. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in markabka diyaaradaha qaada ee USS George Washington loo qorsheynayo inuu beddelo Abraham Lincoln, taas oo qeyb ka noqon karta qorshaha Mareykanka ee joogteynta awooddiisa badeed iyo hawlgallada ka socda agagaarka Iran. items.title: Xog: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo ku wajahan Dhuusamareeb + Qorshihiisa
items.description: Dhuusamareeb (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud iyo wafdi uu hoggaaminayo ayaa la filayaa in saacadaha soo socda ay u ambabaxaan gudaha magaalada Dhuusamareeb ee caasimada Galmudug, halkaas oo laga dareemayo qaban-qaabada soo dhaweyntiisa. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in qorshaha Madaxweynaha uu yahay inuu berri tababar usoo xiro cutubyo ka tirsan Milatariga Soomaaliya oo lagu diyaariyay deegaanka Xananbuure ee gobolka Galgaduud, kuwaas oo ka qayb-qaadanaya dagaalka Al-Shabaab. Mas’uuliyiin horudhac ah Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh ayaa haatan gaaray Galmudug, kuwaas oo tegay Dhuusamareeb iyo deegaanka Xananbuure oo ah meesha lagu soo xirayo tababarka ciidamada cusub ee Xoogga Dalka. Sidoo kale, Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya ayaa inta uu joogo Dhuusamareeb la kulmi doono madaxda Galmudug iyo qaybaha bulshada oo uu kala hadli doono arrimaha ammaanka iyo doorashooyinka maamulkaas oo maraya meel wanaagsan. Safarka Xasan Sheekh ayaa dhanka kale kusoo aadayo xilli xasaasi ah, isla markaana la filayo in Galmudug ay ka dhacdo doorashada Madaxweynaha maamulkaas oo haatan galaangal xoogga ay ku leedahay dowladda dhexe. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya ayaa maalmihii dambeeyay wadday isku dabarid xooggan oo ku aadan arrimaha ciidamada, si loo xoojiyo awoodooda, si ay ula wareegaan amniga dalka, maadaama la qorsheynayo in dalka ay ka baxaan ciidamada shisheeye ee ku jira howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya. Ciidamada AUSSOM ayaa mar kale bilaabay inay wareejiyaan saldhigyadooda, waxaana ugu dambeeyay ciidamadii Itoobiya ee maalmo ka hor ka baxay saldhiggoodii degmada Buurhakaba ee gobolka Baay, iyaga oo ku wareejiyay Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka. Sababaha ugu wayn ee bixitaanka ciidamadan shisheeye ayaa waxaa soo dadajiyay dhaqaale xumada uu wajahayo howlgalkan Midowga Afrkla oo hadda wajahaya mid kamid ah caqabadihii ugu adkaa ee abid soo mara howlgalka. items.title: Rabshado ka dhacay Degmada Waaberi ee Gobolka Banaadir
items.description: Ciidanka Booliska Gobolka Banaadir ayaa maanta dad shacab ah ku rasaaseeyay Degmada Waaberi, xilli dadkaasi ay dhigayeen bannaanbax ay kaga soo horjeedaan in guryahooda la burburiyo. Ciidamada ayaa saaka dadka ku dhaqan xaafadda Buulo Eelaay ee degmadaasi ku wargeliyay in ay ka guuraan guryahooda, ugu dambayn maalinta Jimcaha, iyagoo u sheegay in haddii kale xoog lagu burburin doono. Dadka deegaanka oo ku kadsoomay amarkaasi ayaa dhigay bannaanbax ay kaga soo horjeedaan in laga barakiciyo guryahooda, tani oo keentay in Ciidanka Booliska ay rasaas nool nool u adeegsadaan dadkaasi, si loo kala eryo. Dadkan ayaa ka cabanaya in si sharci darro ah lagu burburinayo guryahooda, iyagoo haysta dokumentiyo sharci ah, isla-markaana uu Maamulka Gobolka Banaadir diidan yahay in uu eego, si loo xaqiijiyo milkiliyadda ay u leeyihiin guryahaasi. Muuqaalo la soo dhigay baraha bulshada ayaa muujinaya rabshado ka dhacay xaafaddaasi, markii shacabku ay bilaabeen inay waddooyinka xiraan, isla-markaana ay taayaro ku gubaan. Muuqaalada ayaa laga arki karay ciidamada oo rasaasta nool nool u adeegsanaya qoysaska ka hortagaya in si xoog ah guryahooda lagu qaato. Laba qof oo midi ay haweeney tahay ayaa ku dhaawacmay rasaasta ay fureen Ciidanka Booliska Gobolka Banaadir, oo iyaga loo adeegsanayo Hawlgalka Cagafta ee lagu burburiyo guryaha ay dadka shacabka ahi degan yihiin. Hawlgalka Cagafta ee lagu dumiyo guryaha shacabka ee ku yaal Muqdisho ayaa dhaliyay cabsi, walaac iyo carro xoogan. Dadka reer Muqdisho ayaa dareemay dhibaato iyo in aan la ilaalin xuquuqdooda iyo hantidooda. Madaxda sare ee dalka ayaa lagu dhaliilaa inaysan tixgelin walaaca iyo cabashada ay qabaan dadweynaha.

items.title: Turkey will arrest and exile Somalia’s opposition leaders if defiance continues, warns veteran diplomat
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – Turkey will move to arrest and exile Somalia’s opposition leaders, including former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed, should they persist in their defiance of President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s disputed term extension, a veteran Somali diplomat has warned. Hussein Ali Duale, widely known as Ambassador Awil, made the claim in an interview with Geed Fadhi media, arguing that President Mohamud has ceded sweeping concessions to Ankara — including offshore oil blocks and Somalia’s exclusive economic zone — in exchange for unconditional Turkish backing, whether directed against regional states or opposition politicians. Duale described Turkey as a state that pursues its own interests without regard for democratic norms, and said Ankara would not hesitate to detain opposition figures who mount serious resistance to Mohamud’s plans. Any such arrests, he said, would be carried out under the pretext that the detainees were undermining Somalia’s security, with those held then exiled under house arrest in Ankara. His remarks echo accusations opposition figures have leveled at Turkey for months, accusing Ankara of aligning itself fully with President Mohamud in ways they say serve neither Somalia’s interests nor, ultimately, Turkey’s own long-term investment in the country. In June, opposition leaders alleged that Turkish-supplied suicide drones and weaponry were used in strikes on compounds housing former President Sharif Sheikh Ahmed and former Prime Minister Hassan Ali Khaire. The two men were reportedly organizing protests against the government’s term extension at the time; the opposition says the compounds were attacked pre-emptively, before any demonstration could take place. Duale is not the only prominent Somali voice to accuse Ankara of enabling authoritarian rule in Mogadishu while extracting the country’s natural resources. Senator and academic Abdi Ismail Samatar has separately accused Turkey of acting as a “resource pirate” in Somali waters. “Turkish vessels are prospecting and drilling for oil in Somali waters. This is exceptionally alarming as the entire affair is illegal,” Samatar said, adding that President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and his government are aware that the defense and petroleum agreements underpinning the activity are, in his words, fraudulent. Samatar noted that Somalia’s parliament has never been shown the text of either agreement, and argued that Turkey’s decision to proceed with exploration regardless amounts to complicity with what he called “an illegitimate and derelict regime” in Mogadishu. He further accused Villa Somalia of relying on Turkish military resources to sustain what he described as a corrupt administration whose constitutional mandate expired. “Ankara has found solace in silence, but the Somali people will not forget Türkiye’s great deception,” Samatar said. Neither the Turkish embassy in Mogadishu nor Villa Somalia has publicly responded to the specific allegations raised by Duale or Samatar. Turkey has previously defended its role in Somalia as one of development partnership, security cooperation and counterterrorism support, and has not commented on claims that it facilitated attacks on opposition figures or entered into undisclosed resource agreements. The allegations surface against the backdrop of Somalia’s deepening constitutional crisis. President Mohamud’s term formally expired on May 15, and parliament’s mandate lapsed a month earlier, but Mohamud has said he intends to remain in office until May 2027 under constitutional amendments extending presidential and parliamentary terms from four years to five — a move the opposition rejects as unconstitutional. Talks brokered at Mogadishu’s Halane compound, with American and British diplomats mediating, collapsed without resolving the standoff. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Trump sees law as obstacle to third term
items.description: US President Donald Trump said he would like to run for a third term as president of the United States, but acknowledged that the country’s constitution prevents him from doing so. Trump made the remarks at Andrews Air Force Base after a reporter asked him about the possibility of running for president again. He said many people want him to continue leading the country, but noted that the US Constitution limits the number of times a president can be elected. The US Constitution, specifically Article 22, states that no one can be elected to the presidency more than twice. This limit was approved in 1951, after Franklin D. Roosevelt became the first president to win more than two terms. Trump, who first became president in 2017, won re-election in 2024, and his second term is expected to end in January 2029. Although Trump has repeatedly raised the idea of ​​running for a third term, his latest remarks have drawn widespread attention, as he acknowledged that current law would prevent such a plan. When asked if he was formally withdrawing from a third term, Trump did not directly answer, but moved on to the next question. Trump’s remarks have already sparked a new debate about the future of American politics and whether the constitutional two-term limit could ever be changed. The post Trump sees law as obstacle to third term first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Trump Oo Sharciga U Arka Caqabad Ku Hortaagan Xil Saddexaad
items.description: Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa sheegay inuu jeclaan lahaa inuu mar saddexaad u tartamo madaxtinimada Mareykanka, balse uu qiray in sharciga dalka uu arrintaasi caqabad ku yahay. Trump ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay saldhigga ciidamada ee Andrews, kaddib markii wariye uu weydiiyay su’aal ku saabsan suuragalnimada inuu mar kale u tartamo xilka madaxweynaha. Wuxuu sheegay in dad badan ay doonayaan inuu sii hoggaamiyo dalka, balse uu xusay in dastuurka Mareykanka uu xaddidayo tirada jeer ee madaxweyne loo dooran karo. Dastuurka Mareykanka, gaar ahaan Qodobka 22-aad, ayaa dhigaya in qof aan loo dooran karin xilka madaxweynaha wax ka badan laba jeer. Xaddidaaddan ayaa la ansixiyay sanadkii 1951-kii, kaddib markii Franklin D. Roosevelt uu noqday madaxweynihii ugu horreeyay ee dalka ee xilka ku guuleysta in ka badan laba jeer. Trump, oo markii ugu horreysay madaxweyne noqday 2017, ayaa mar kale ku guuleystay doorashadii 2024-ka, waxaana muddadiisa labaad la filayaa inay dhammaato Janaayo 2029. Inkasta oo Trump uu horey dhowr jeer u soo hadal qaaday fikradda ah inuu mar saddexaad tartamo, hadalkiisa cusub ayaa si weyn u soo jiitay dareenka, maadaama uu qiray in sharciga hadda jira uu ka hor istaagayo qorshahaas. Markii su’aal kale lagu weydiiyay inuu si rasmi ah uga tanaasulayo tartanka saddexaad, Trump si toos ah ugama jawaabin, balse wuxuu u gudbay su’aasha xigtay. Hadalka Trump ayaa durba dhaliyay dood cusub oo ku saabsan mustaqbalka siyaasadda Mareykanka iyo haddii mar uun wax laga beddeli karo xaddidaadda dastuuriga ah ee labada xilli. items.title: Italy Donates Six Armoured Vehicles to Somali Police
items.description: Italy is set to donate six armoured vehicles formerly used by the Italian Carabinieri to the Somali police force, under a bilateral defence cooperation agreement signed between the two governments. The transfer of the six VM-90P vehicles, valued at more than 170,000 euros ($198,000), was approved by the Foreign Affairs and Defence committees of Italy’s Chamber of Deputies and Senate on July 29, just before Parliament’s summer recess . The Italian Defence Ministry has confirmed the donation will not add any extra costs to its defence budget . The donation comes as Somalia continues its efforts to strengthen the capacity of its national security forces and gradually assume greater responsibility for the country’s security . Italy and Somalia have maintained a formal defence partnership since signing a General Cooperation Agreement in Rome in September 2013, which took effect in July 2016 and remains in force with no fixed expiration date . The VM-90Ps have been declared out of service by the Carabinieri Logistics Inspectorate due to their age, high maintenance costs and limited operational capabilities . They have been progressively replaced by the newer VTLM Lince light multirole tactical vehicles . Italian defence officials have described the vehicles as technically obsolete, having entered the logistics cycle between 1996 and 2004 . Their underbody protection was designed primarily against small arms fire and shrapnel, not mines or improvised explosive devices—a limitation that proved tragically fatal in 2006 when an IED struck a VM90P in Nasiriyah, Iraq, killing four Italian soldiers and one Romanian soldier . Italy’s Military Code permits the free transfer of defence equipment declared out of service to developing countries and other eligible recipients, provided the relevant parliamentary committees give their approval . Somalia is classified as a least developed country by the UN Committee for Development Policy . This is not Italy’s first contribution to Somali security forces. In 2025, Rome transferred equipment worth approximately 50,000 euros, including riot-control gear, uniforms, personal equipment, stationery and hygiene supplies . A second shipment of similar value is currently awaiting authorisation . The agreement between the two countries aims to strengthen cooperation between their armed forces, improve defence capabilities and enhance security coordination, while also facilitating the exchange of equipment to improve interoperability The post Italy Donates Six Armoured Vehicles to Somali Police first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: DF Soomaaliya oo ciidamo dheeraad ah u daabushay HirShabeelle + Ujeedka
items.description: Jowhar (Caasimada Online) – Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa saacadihii lasoo dhaafay ciidamo u daabushay deegaanno ka tirsan maamulka HirShabelle oo haatan ay ka socdaan abaabulka howlgallo culus oo ka dhan ah maleeshiyaadka kooxda Al-Shabaab. Ciidamada ayaa qaybtood waxay gaareen aagga degmada Raage Ceelle ee gobolka Shabeellaha Dhexe, waxaana wehlinayay saraakiil ka tirsan Ciidamada Xoogga Dalka oo isku dabaridaya abaabulka ka socda halkaasi. Saraakiisha ayaa durbo kulamo ka bilaabay magaalada, kuwaas oo ay la yeelanayaan qaybaha bulshada, si ay ugu bandhigaan qorshahooda la xiriira dagaalka Al-Shabaab ee ka bilaabanaya deegaannada HirShabelle. Dhanka kale, ciidamo ka tirsan kuwa dowladda oo gaaray gobolka Hiiraan ayaa iyana dhaq-dhaqaaqyo ka wada gobolkaas oo todobaadkii hore uu ka dhacay dagaal qaraar oo ay la galeen maleeshiyaadka Al-Shabaab oo la wareegay deegaanka Teedaan ee gobolkaasi. Ujeedka ciidamada ayaa ah inay dib u xoreeyaan deegaannada ay soo galeen Al-Shabaab, si loogu soo celiyo gacanta dowladda Soomaaliya. Xaaladda ayaa haatan kacsan, waxaana meelo kala duwan oo kamid ah gobolka laga dareemayaa dhaq-dhaqaaqyo iska soo horjeedo oo u dhexeeyo labada dhinac. Arrimahan ayaa kusoo aasayo, iyada oo dhawaan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud uu iclaamiyay dagaal kama dambeys ah oo lagu qaado kooxaha Khawaarijta, si mar kale loo bilaabo howlgallada dalka looga xoreynayo argagixisada. The post DF Soomaaliya oo ciidamo dheeraad ah u daabushay HirShabeelle + Ujeedka appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Militariga Somaliya oo ciidamo xoojin ah geeyay bariga Gobolka Hiiraan
items.description: Cutubyo ka tirsan Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka oo safar dhinaca dhulka ah uga ambabaxay Magaalada Muqdisho ayaa gaaray jiidda hore ee bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Ciidamadan oo wata gaadiidka dagaalka ayaa halkaasi loogu diray inay xoojiyaan ciidamada kale ee Militariga Somaliya iyo kuwa Difaaca Shacabka ee loogu talagalay inay la dagaalamaan maleeshiyada Al Shabaab. Taliska Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayaa wada qorshe ay ciidamadu dib ugu la wareegayaan deegaanka Teedaan, oo ay ka soo baxeen 2-dii bishan, markaas oo Al Shabaab ay qabsatay. General Ibraahim Maxamed Maxamuud, Taliyaha Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka ayay wararku sheegayaan in uu riixayo guluf ballaaran oo lagu xaqiijinayo amniga iyo xasilloonida bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Wararka ayaa sheegaya in maleeshiyaad fara-badan oo kuwa Al Shabaab ah lagu arkayo deegaanada u dhexeeya Degmada Maxaas iyo Teedaan, isla-markaana ay Shabaabku dhufeysyo kaga jiraan bannaanada deegaankaasi Teedaan. Teedaan ayaa ah deegaan istiraatiiji ah oo xiriiriya Magaalooyinka Matabaan, Beledweyne iyo Maxaas, waana deegaan muhiim u ah nabadda iyo ganacsiga ee Gobolada Hiiraan iyo Galgaduud. Shabaabka ayaa isku dayaya, sidii ay u sii haysan lahaayeen Teedaan, si aysan halis ugu iman joogitaankooda Maxaas iyo Moqokori, oo ah laba magaalo oo waaweyn oo haatan ay ka haystaan bariga Gobolka Hiiraan. Shabaabku waxay ogyihiin in haddii laga qabsado Teedaan ay ciidamadu kala jari karaan gurmadka iyo saadkooda ee Maxaas iyo Moqokori. Labada dhinac ayaa ahmiyad gaar ah siinaya gacan ku haynta Teedaan, waxaana cabsi laga qabaa in uu halkaas ka qarxo dagaal culus.

items.title: Qorshaha Mareykanka ka leeyahay saldhigga Soomaaliya
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) – Qorshaha Mareykanka uu ku ballaarinayo joogitaankiisa milateri ee magaalada Boosaaso wuxuu u muuqdaa mid ka weyn dagaalka muddada dheer uu Washington kula jiro kooxaha Daacish iyo Al-Shabaab ee Soomaaliya, sida ay sheegayaan fallanqeeyayaal. Boosaaso waxay ku taallaa meel istaraatiiji ah oo ku foorarta Gacanka Cadmeed, kana soo horjeedda Yemen, iyadoo sidoo kale aan ka fogeyn marin-biyoodka Baab Al-Mandab ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Muhiimadda goobtaas ayaa sii kordheysa xilli dagaalka Iran uu saameyntiisa ku sii fidinayo Badda Cas, Xuutiyiinta Yemen-na ay kordhiyeen weerarrada iyo hanjabaadaha ka dhanka ah maraakiibta iyo danaha Sacuudiga. Taasi waxay Boosaaso u beddeli kartaa meel Mareykanku kaga shaqeyn karo laba jiho: gudaha Soomaaliya oo uu kula dagaallamayo Daacish iyo dhinaca kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed, halkaas oo Yemen iyo Badda Cas ay noqdeen meel sii kordheysa muhiimaddeeda milateri. Bilowgii bishan, taliyaha ciidamada howlgallada gaarka ah ee Mareykanka ee Afrika, Major General Claude Tudor, ayaa Boosaaso heshiis kula saxiixday madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, kaas oo maamulka Puntland sheegay inuu horseedayo ballaarinta joogitaanka ciidamada Mareykanka ee magaalada. “Qodobka heshiiska wuxuu dhigaya in Mareykanku ballaarin doono saldhiggiisa milateri ee Boosaaso, si loo xoojiyo howlgallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada iyo ilaalinta ammaanka badaha,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan kooban oo kasoo baxay Puntland. Faahfaahinta heshiiska lama shaacin, qoraalkiisa oo dhanna lama soo bandhigin. Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika, AFRICOM, ayaan sidoo kale si rasmi ah u xaqiijin heshiiska markii ugu horreysay ee wararkiisu soo baxeen. Hase yeeshee, waqtiga heshiiska la galay iyo halka uu saldhiggu ku yaallo ayaa bixinaya sawir ka ballaaran dagaalka Daacish. Boosaaso iyo dagaalka Badda Cas Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa 20-kii July ku dhawaaqay xannibaad badeed ay sheegeen inay ku soo rogayaan Sacuudiga, waxaana tan iyo markaas kordhay weerarrada iyo hanjabaadaha ka dhanka ah maraakiibta shidaalka iyo xarumaha Sacuudiga ee ku yaalla xeebaha Badda Cas. Arrintaas ayaa durba saameyn ku yeelatay isu-socodka maraakiibta. Reuters ayaa Arbacadii sheegtay in maraakiib badan oo shidaalka Sacuudiga ka qaada dekedda Yanbu ay daminayaan qalabka lagu ogaado goobta ay marayaan, si ay uga fogaadaan in la bartilmaameedsado. Tirada maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara Baab Al-Mandab ayaa sidoo kale hoos u dhacday. Boosaaso waxay ku taallaa dhinaca kale ee marin-biyoodkan. Diyaaradaha, qalabka sirdoonka iyo ciidamada gaarka ah ee halkaas laga hawlgeliyo waxay si dhow ula socon karaan Gacanka Cadmeed iyo koonfurta Yemen. Michael Woldemariam, oo wax ka dhiga Jaamacadda University of Maryland kana tirsan Atlantic Council, ayaa Responsible Statecraft u sheegay in xiisaha cusub ee Washington ee Puntland ay adag tahay in laga fahmo wax ka baxsan muhiimadda sii kordheysa ee Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo ammaanka marin-biyoodka. Cameron Hudson, oo hore uga soo shaqeeyay Golaha Amniga Qaranka Mareykanka, ayaa isna sheegay in Washington laga yaabo inay hadda aragto baahi muddo dheer ah oo loo qabo saldhig Mareykanku si toos ah u maamulo. Sababta kale ayaa ah Jabuuti. Camp Lemonnier oo ku yaalla Jabuuti waa saldhigga ugu weyn ee joogtada ah ee Mareykanku ku leeyahay Afrika, waana xarunta ugu muhiimsan ee howlgallada Washington ee Geeska Afrika. Hase yeeshee, dowladda Jabuuti ayaa xaddidday in dhulkeeda loo adeegsado weerarro ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta Yemen, iyadoo ka cabsi qabta in dalka lagu soo jiido dagaalka iyo inuu noqdo bartilmaameed aargoosi. Taasi waxay Mareykanka ku qasbeysaa inuu qiimeeyo meelo kale oo siin kara xorriyad howlgaleed oo ka badan tan uu Jabuuti ku haysto. Boosaaso waxay noqon kartaa mid ka mid ah meelahaas. Mareykanku Boosaaso kuma cusba Joogitaanka Mareykanka ee Boosaaso ma aha mid hadda bilaabanaya. Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa sannado adeegsanayay magaalada iyo xarumaha milateri ee halkaas ku yaalla, gaar ahaan saldhigga ku dhow garoonka diyaaradaha Boosaaso oo muddo dheer xiriir la lahaa Imaaraadka Carabta. Hudson wuxuu sheegay in Puntland horey loogu adeegsan jiray meel laga abaabulo howlgallada Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya. Saldhigga ayaa sannadihii dambe si weyn loo ballaariyay. Baaritaanno ay Middle East Eye sameysay ayaa horay u sheegay in goobta lagu rakibay raadaarro, bakhaarro ammaan ah oo hubka lagu keydiyo, hangarro diyaaradeed, xarumo caafimaad iyo kaabayaal qaabili kara diyaaradaha waaweyn ee xamuulka. Boosaaso ayaa sidoo kale magaceedu kusoo baxay dagaalka Sudan. Middle East Eye ayaa baaritaanno hore ku sheegtay in duulimaadyo iyo sahay milateri oo Boosaaso sii maray ay qayb ka ahaayeen shabakad taageero gaarsiisa ciidamada RSF ee dagaalka kula jira ciidanka Sudan. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa markii dambe xaqiijiyay jiritaanka duulimaadyo u dhexeeya Boosaaso iyo Sudan, inkasta oo Imaaraadka uu beeniyay inuu hub siiyo RSF. Laakiin Mareykanka, qiimaha Boosaaso kuma koobna Yemen ama Badda Cas. Buuraleyda gobolka Bari waxaa sannado badan saldhigyo ku lahaa Daacish, waxaana ciidamada Puntland tan iyo dhammaadkii 2024 waday howlgalkii ugu ballaarnaa ee ay kooxdaas ku qaadaan. Mareykanka ayaa howlgalladaas ku taageeray duqeymo cirka ah, taasoo Boosaaso ka dhigeysa xarun sahay iyo howlgallo oo si toos ah ugu dhow goobaha ay Daacish kaga sugan tahay waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya. Saldhig la ballaariyo wuxuu sidaas ku yeelan karaa laba shaqo oo isku mar ah: dagaalka kooxaha hubeysan ee gudaha Soomaaliya iyo ilaalinta danaha Mareykanka ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas. Muqdisho oo dhinac laga maray Su’aasha xasaasiga ah waxay tahay cidda Mareykanku heshiiska la galay. Heshiiska waxaa shaacisay Puntland, mana jirto wax muujinaya in dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay qayb ka ahayd wada-hadallada lagu gaaray. Arrintaas ayaa dib usoo celisay doodda ku saabsan awoodda dowlad-goboleedyada ay u leeyihiin inay si gaar ah ula galaan dowlado shisheeye heshiisyo la xiriira joogitaanka ciidamada iyo ammaanka. Puntland ayaa bishii Maarso 2024 ku dhawaaqday inay kala laabatay kalsoonidii iyo aqoonsigii hay’adaha federaalka kadib markii baarlamaanka Soomaaliya meel mariyay wax-ka-beddello dastuurka lagu sameeyay oo Puntland si weyn uga soo horjeesatay. Khilaafka labada dhinac ayaa tan iyo markaas sii xoogeystay, iyadoo bilihii ugu dambeeyay uu xitaa gaaray isku dhacyo iyo muran ka dhashay ciidamada iyo xarumaha amniga ee Puntland. Falanqeyn ay sameysay Critical Threats Project ayaa sheegtay in xiisadda ciidamada ee billowday bishii June aysan meesha ka saarin khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ballaaran ee u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Garoowe. Sidaas darteed, heshiis weyn oo milateri oo Washington ay si toos ah ula gasho Puntland ma aha oo keliya arrin amni. Wuxuu sidoo kale leeyahay miisaan siyaasadeed. Mareykanku wuxuu si rasmi ah u taageeraa madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, balse muddo dheer wuxuu xiriir toos ah la lahaa dowlad-goboleedyada, isaga oo isla waqtigaas xiriir dhow la leh dowladda federaalka. Responsible Statecraft waxay sheegtay in heshiiska Boosaaso uu tallaabadaas gaarsiin karo heer cusub, gaar ahaan haddii Mareykanku dhiso xarun weyn oo uu si madax-bannaan uga howlgeliyo Puntland. Istaraatiijiyad cusub Arrintan waxay kusoo beegmeysaa xilli Mareykanku dib u qaabeynayo qaabka uu Soomaaliya ula macaamilayo. Duqeymaha Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya ayaa aad u kordhay xilligii labaad ee Donald Trump. Responsible Statecraft waxay sheegtay in Mareykanku fuliyay 124 duqeyn sannadkii 2025, halka 78 kale la fuliyay ilaa hadda sanadkan 2026 — tiro aad uga badan heerarkii xukuumaddii Joe Biden. Dhanka kale, Washington ayaa July ku dhawaaqday inaanay taageeri doonin sii socoshada xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee taageera howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya marka oggolaanshaha hadda jira dhammaado 31-ka December. Go’aankaas ayaa walaac ka dhaliyay mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM. Waxa sidaas kasoo baxaya sawir istaraatiijiyadeed oo is beddelaya: Mareykanka oo yareynaya ku tiirsanaanta qaab-dhismeedyada waaweyn ee caalamiga ah, balse dhinaca kale xoojinaya awooddiisa uu si toos ah u fuliyo duqeymo iyo howlgallo gaar ah. Boosaaso arrintaas waxay siineysaa meel ku habboon. Waxay u dhowdahay saldhigyada Daacish ee Puntland, waxay si toos ah ugu foorartaa Gacanka Cadmeed, waxayna u dhowdahay Yemen iyo Baab Al-Mandab xilli Badda Cas ay isu beddeleyso goob dagaal oo sii weynaanaysa. Laakiin faa’iidadaas milateri waxay Washington u yeelan kartaa kharash siyaasadeed. Haddii Mareykanku ballaariyo joogitaankiisa Boosaaso isaga oo heshiiska si toos ah ula galay Puntland xilli xiriirka Garoowe iyo Muqdisho uu marayo heer aad u hooseeya, waxaa sii xoogeysan karta doodda ah in Washington ay dhinac marayso dowladda dhexe, isla markaana ay sii xoojineyso kala fogaanshaha siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Sidaas darteed, waxa ka socda Boosaaso waxaa laga yaabaa inuusan ahayn oo keliya cutub cusub oo dagaalka Mareykanka ee Daacish. Waxay sidoo kale noqon kartaa calaamad muujineysa in xeebaha Soomaaliya ay Washington uga sii gudbayaan goob ay ka fuliso dagaalka argagixisada, una noqonayaan qayb ka mid ah istaraatiijiyad milateri oo ka bilaabanta Geeska Afrika, ka gudubta Gacanka Cadmeed, kuna fidsan Badda Cas iyo colaadda sii ballaaranaysa ee Bariga Dhexe. Boosaaso waxay ku taallaa meel istaraatiiji ah oo ku foorarta Gacanka Cadmeed, kana soo horjeedda Yemen, iyadoo sidoo kale aan ka fogeyn marin-biyoodka Baab Al-Mandab ee isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Muhiimadda goobtaas ayaa sii kordheysa xilli dagaalka Iran uu saameyntiisa ku sii fidinayo Badda Cas, Xuutiyiinta Yemen-na ay kordhiyeen weerarrada iyo hanjabaadaha ka dhanka ah maraakiibta iyo danaha Sacuudiga. Taasi waxay Boosaaso u beddeli kartaa meel Mareykanku kaga shaqeyn karo laba jiho: gudaha Soomaaliya oo uu kula dagaallamayo Daacish iyo dhinaca kale ee Gacanka Cadmeed, halkaas oo Yemen iyo Badda Cas ay noqdeen meel sii kordheysa muhiimaddeeda milateri. Bilowgii bishan, taliyaha ciidamada howlgallada gaarka ah ee Mareykanka ee Afrika, Major General Claude Tudor, ayaa Boosaaso heshiis kula saxiixday madaxweynaha Puntland Saciid Cabdullaahi Deni, kaas oo maamulka Puntland sheegay inuu horseedayo ballaarinta joogitaanka ciidamada Mareykanka ee magaalada. “Qodobka heshiiska wuxuu dhigaya in Mareykanku ballaarin doono saldhiggiisa milateri ee Boosaaso, si loo xoojiyo howlgallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada iyo ilaalinta ammaanka badaha,” ayaa lagu yiri bayaan kooban oo kasoo baxay Puntland. Faahfaahinta heshiiska lama shaacin, qoraalkiisa oo dhanna lama soo bandhigin. Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika, AFRICOM, ayaan sidoo kale si rasmi ah u xaqiijin heshiiska markii ugu horreysay ee wararkiisu soo baxeen. Hase yeeshee, waqtiga heshiiska la galay iyo halka uu saldhiggu ku yaallo ayaa bixinaya sawir ka ballaaran dagaalka Daacish. Boosaaso iyo dagaalka Badda Cas Xuutiyiinta Yemen ayaa 20-kii July ku dhawaaqay xannibaad badeed ay sheegeen inay ku soo rogayaan Sacuudiga, waxaana tan iyo markaas kordhay weerarrada iyo hanjabaadaha ka dhanka ah maraakiibta shidaalka iyo xarumaha Sacuudiga ee ku yaalla xeebaha Badda Cas. Arrintaas ayaa durba saameyn ku yeelatay isu-socodka maraakiibta. Reuters ayaa Arbacadii sheegtay in maraakiib badan oo shidaalka Sacuudiga ka qaada dekedda Yanbu ay daminayaan qalabka lagu ogaado goobta ay marayaan, si ay uga fogaadaan in la bartilmaameedsado. Tirada maraakiibta ganacsiga ee mara Baab Al-Mandab ayaa sidoo kale hoos u dhacday. Boosaaso waxay ku taallaa dhinaca kale ee marin-biyoodkan. Diyaaradaha, qalabka sirdoonka iyo ciidamada gaarka ah ee halkaas laga hawlgeliyo waxay si dhow ula socon karaan Gacanka Cadmeed iyo koonfurta Yemen. Michael Woldemariam, oo wax ka dhiga Jaamacadda University of Maryland kana tirsan Atlantic Council, ayaa Responsible Statecraft u sheegay in xiisaha cusub ee Washington ee Puntland ay adag tahay in laga fahmo wax ka baxsan muhiimadda sii kordheysa ee Badda Cas, Gacanka Cadmeed iyo ammaanka marin-biyoodka. Cameron Hudson, oo hore uga soo shaqeeyay Golaha Amniga Qaranka Mareykanka, ayaa isna sheegay in Washington laga yaabo inay hadda aragto baahi muddo dheer ah oo loo qabo saldhig Mareykanku si toos ah u maamulo. Sababta kale ayaa ah Jabuuti. Camp Lemonnier oo ku yaalla Jabuuti waa saldhigga ugu weyn ee joogtada ah ee Mareykanku ku leeyahay Afrika, waana xarunta ugu muhiimsan ee howlgallada Washington ee Geeska Afrika. Hase yeeshee, dowladda Jabuuti ayaa xaddidday in dhulkeeda loo adeegsado weerarro ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta Yemen, iyadoo ka cabsi qabta in dalka lagu soo jiido dagaalka iyo inuu noqdo bartilmaameed aargoosi. Taasi waxay Mareykanka ku qasbeysaa inuu qiimeeyo meelo kale oo siin kara xorriyad howlgaleed oo ka badan tan uu Jabuuti ku haysto. Boosaaso waxay noqon kartaa mid ka mid ah meelahaas. Mareykanku Boosaaso kuma cusba Joogitaanka Mareykanka ee Boosaaso ma aha mid hadda bilaabanaya. Ciidamada Mareykanka ayaa sannado adeegsanayay magaalada iyo xarumaha milateri ee halkaas ku yaalla, gaar ahaan saldhigga ku dhow garoonka diyaaradaha Boosaaso oo muddo dheer xiriir la lahaa Imaaraadka Carabta. Hudson wuxuu sheegay in Puntland horey loogu adeegsan jiray meel laga abaabulo howlgallada Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya. Saldhigga ayaa sannadihii dambe si weyn loo ballaariyay. Baaritaanno ay Middle East Eye sameysay ayaa horay u sheegay in goobta lagu rakibay raadaarro, bakhaarro ammaan ah oo hubka lagu keydiyo, hangarro diyaaradeed, xarumo caafimaad iyo kaabayaal qaabili kara diyaaradaha waaweyn ee xamuulka. Boosaaso ayaa sidoo kale magaceedu kusoo baxay dagaalka Sudan. Middle East Eye ayaa baaritaanno hore ku sheegtay in duulimaadyo iyo sahay milateri oo Boosaaso sii maray ay qayb ka ahaayeen shabakad taageero gaarsiisa ciidamada RSF ee dagaalka kula jira ciidanka Sudan. Wasiirka Gaashaandhigga Soomaaliya ayaa markii dambe xaqiijiyay jiritaanka duulimaadyo u dhexeeya Boosaaso iyo Sudan, inkasta oo Imaaraadka uu beeniyay inuu hub siiyo RSF. Laakiin Mareykanka, qiimaha Boosaaso kuma koobna Yemen ama Badda Cas. Buuraleyda gobolka Bari waxaa sannado badan saldhigyo ku lahaa Daacish, waxaana ciidamada Puntland tan iyo dhammaadkii 2024 waday howlgalkii ugu ballaarnaa ee ay kooxdaas ku qaadaan. Mareykanka ayaa howlgalladaas ku taageeray duqeymo cirka ah, taasoo Boosaaso ka dhigeysa xarun sahay iyo howlgallo oo si toos ah ugu dhow goobaha ay Daacish kaga sugan tahay waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya. Saldhig la ballaariyo wuxuu sidaas ku yeelan karaa laba shaqo oo isku mar ah: dagaalka kooxaha hubeysan ee gudaha Soomaaliya iyo ilaalinta danaha Mareykanka ee Gacanka Cadmeed iyo Badda Cas. Muqdisho oo dhinac laga maray Su’aasha xasaasiga ah waxay tahay cidda Mareykanku heshiiska la galay. Heshiiska waxaa shaacisay Puntland, mana jirto wax muujinaya in dowladda federaalka Soomaaliya ay qayb ka ahayd wada-hadallada lagu gaaray. Arrintaas ayaa dib usoo celisay doodda ku saabsan awoodda dowlad-goboleedyada ay u leeyihiin inay si gaar ah ula galaan dowlado shisheeye heshiisyo la xiriira joogitaanka ciidamada iyo ammaanka. Puntland ayaa bishii Maarso 2024 ku dhawaaqday inay kala laabatay kalsoonidii iyo aqoonsigii hay’adaha federaalka kadib markii baarlamaanka Soomaaliya meel mariyay wax-ka-beddello dastuurka lagu sameeyay oo Puntland si weyn uga soo horjeesatay. Khilaafka labada dhinac ayaa tan iyo markaas sii xoogeystay, iyadoo bilihii ugu dambeeyay uu xitaa gaaray isku dhacyo iyo muran ka dhashay ciidamada iyo xarumaha amniga ee Puntland. Falanqeyn ay sameysay Critical Threats Project ayaa sheegtay in xiisadda ciidamada ee billowday bishii June aysan meesha ka saarin khilaafka siyaasadeed ee ballaaran ee u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo Garoowe. Sidaas darteed, heshiis weyn oo milateri oo Washington ay si toos ah ula gasho Puntland ma aha oo keliya arrin amni. Wuxuu sidoo kale leeyahay miisaan siyaasadeed. Mareykanku wuxuu si rasmi ah u taageeraa madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya, balse muddo dheer wuxuu xiriir toos ah la lahaa dowlad-goboleedyada, isaga oo isla waqtigaas xiriir dhow la leh dowladda federaalka. Responsible Statecraft waxay sheegtay in heshiiska Boosaaso uu tallaabadaas gaarsiin karo heer cusub, gaar ahaan haddii Mareykanku dhiso xarun weyn oo uu si madax-bannaan uga howlgeliyo Puntland. Istaraatiijiyad cusub Arrintan waxay kusoo beegmeysaa xilli Mareykanku dib u qaabeynayo qaabka uu Soomaaliya ula macaamilayo. Duqeymaha Mareykanka ee Soomaaliya ayaa aad u kordhay xilligii labaad ee Donald Trump. Responsible Statecraft waxay sheegtay in Mareykanku fuliyay 124 duqeyn sannadkii 2025, halka 78 kale la fuliyay ilaa hadda sanadkan 2026 — tiro aad uga badan heerarkii xukuumaddii Joe Biden. Dhanka kale, Washington ayaa July ku dhawaaqday inaanay taageeri doonin sii socoshada xafiiska Qaramada Midoobay ee taageera howlgalka Midowga Afrika ee Soomaaliya marka oggolaanshaha hadda jira dhammaado 31-ka December. Go’aankaas ayaa walaac ka dhaliyay mustaqbalka howlgalka AUSSOM. Waxa sidaas kasoo baxaya sawir istaraatiijiyadeed oo is beddelaya: Mareykanka oo yareynaya ku tiirsanaanta qaab-dhismeedyada waaweyn ee caalamiga ah, balse dhinaca kale xoojinaya awooddiisa uu si toos ah u fuliyo duqeymo iyo howlgallo gaar ah. Boosaaso arrintaas waxay siineysaa meel ku habboon. Waxay u dhowdahay saldhigyada Daacish ee Puntland, waxay si toos ah ugu foorartaa Gacanka Cadmeed, waxayna u dhowdahay Yemen iyo Baab Al-Mandab xilli Badda Cas ay isu beddeleyso goob dagaal oo sii weynaanaysa. Laakiin faa’iidadaas milateri waxay Washington u yeelan kartaa kharash siyaasadeed. Haddii Mareykanku ballaariyo joogitaankiisa Boosaaso isaga oo heshiiska si toos ah ula galay Puntland xilli xiriirka Garoowe iyo Muqdisho uu marayo heer aad u hooseeya, waxaa sii xoogeysan karta doodda ah in Washington ay dhinac marayso dowladda dhexe, isla markaana ay sii xoojineyso kala fogaanshaha siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya. Sidaas darteed, waxa ka socda Boosaaso waxaa laga yaabaa inuusan ahayn oo keliya cutub cusub oo dagaalka Mareykanka ee Daacish. Waxay sidoo kale noqon kartaa calaamad muujineysa in xeebaha Soomaaliya ay Washington uga sii gudbayaan goob ay ka fuliso dagaalka argagixisada, una noqonayaan qayb ka mid ah istaraatiijiyad milateri oo ka bilaabanta Geeska Afrika, ka gudubta Gacanka Cadmeed, kuna fidsan Badda Cas iyo colaadda sii ballaaranaysa ee Bariga Dhexe. items.title: Madaxda Xuutiyiinta oo loo daad gureenayo goobo ammaan ah.
items.description: Wargeyska Sacuudiga laga leeyahay ee Asharq Al-Awsat ayaa sheegay in saraakiil ka tirsan Xuutiyiinta oo taageero ka hela Iiraan loo daadgureynayo goobo ammaan ah. Wargeysku wuxuu intaas ku daray in taliyeyaasha Ilaalada Kacaanka Islaamiga ah ee Iiraan (IRGC) ay si dhow ula socdaan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada kooxda iyo culeyska iyo weerarrada sii kordhaya ee kaga imaanaya kooxda isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo, kaas oo taageera dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, iyadoo la filayo in isbahaysigu uu bartilmaameedsado saraakiisha sare ee Xuutiyiinta ee dhinacyada amniga, milatariga iyo dowladda, taas oo jawaab u ah tallaabooyinkooda. Sacuudiga ayaan weli xaqiijin sheegashada Xuutiyiinta ee ku saabsan weerar lagu qaaday markab militari oo Sacuudigu leeyahay iyo weerarro dhimasho sababay oo lagu qaaday ciidamada Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo ka dhacay deegaannada ay dowladda Yemen maamusho 11-kii Agoosto. Wakaaladda wararka Saba oo ay maamulaan Xuutiyiintu ayaa soo xigatay afhayeenka milatariga kooxda, Yahya Saree, isaga oo sheegay in ciidamada Xuutiyiintu ay qaadeen “weerarro sax ah” oo lagu beegsaday “goobo ay ku urursnaayeen ciidamada cadowga Sacuudiga, bakhaarro hub iyo xarumo talis” oo ku yaalla Al-Mokha iyo xerada Tadaween ee gobolka Ma’rib. Waxa uu intaas ku daray in Xuutiyiintu ay bartilmaameedyadaas ku weerareen tiro badan oo gantaallo ballistic ah iyo diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn, ayna dileen dad badan, oo ay ku jiraan muwaadiniin Sacuudiyaan ah. Afhayeenka Xuutiyiinta ayaa carrabka ku adkeeyay in kooxdu ay sii wadi doonto weerarrada ka dhanka ah ciidamada Sacuudiga, kuwaas oo uu sheegay in loo diray Yemen si ay “u sii xoojiyaan colaadda oo ay ula wareegaan gacan ku haynta dalka”.

items.title: Sababta xasaasiga ah ee Sacuudiga u diiday in Masar ku biirto heshiiska Makkah
items.description: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) — Sacuudiga ayaa ka hor yimid in Masar lagu daro isbahaysiga cusub ee difaaca ee uu la saxiixday Turkiga iyo Pakistan, inkasta oo Ankara ay dadaal xooggan ku bixisay sidii Qaahira qayb uga noqon lahayd heshiiska, sida ay sheegeen ilo Sacuudi ah oo arrinta xog-ogaal u ah. Saddex ilo-wareed oo Sacuudi ah oo la hadlay Middle East Eye ayaa sheegay in Riyadh aysan doonayn in Masar ay xilligan ku biirto heshiiska, iyagoo arrinta ku sababeeyey kalsooni-darro sii kordhaysa oo Boqortooyadu ka qabto dowladda Madaxweyne Cabdifataax Al-Sisi iyo waxa ay u aragto hoos u dhac ku yimid miisaankii istiraatiijiyadeed iyo midkii militari ee Qaahira. Mid ka mid ah ilaha, oo hore lataliye sare ugu ahaa boqortooyada Sacuudiga, ayaa sheegay in mowqifka Riyadh uu yahay in Masar aan lagu darin heshiiska “ugu yaraan hadda”. Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makkah waxaa 7-dii Agoosto magaalada barakeysan ee Makkah ku saxiixay Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Maxamed bin Salmaan, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif. Heshiisku wuxuu dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsado weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. In kasta oo heshiiska loo arko tallaabo weyn oo lagu dhisayo nidaam cusub oo amni oo gobolka ah, haddana faahfaahinta ku saabsan xaaladaha sida tooska ah u dhaqaajinaya waajibaadka difaaca iyo qaabka ciidamada saddexda dal u wada hawlgeli doonaan weli si buuxda looma caddeyn. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in Riyadh ay isbahaysiyo noocan ah u aragto hab ay ku xoojin karto awoodda ay kaga hortagayso khataraha gobolka, gaar ahaan kuwa kaga imanaya Xuutiyiinta Yemen iyo kooxaha kale ee Iran taageerto. Khilaaf soo jiitamayay Ilo-wareedyada Sacuudiga ayaa sheegay in diidmada Masar aysan ka dhalan oo keliya qiimeyn militari, balse ay salka ku hayso caro muddo soo urureysay oo Riyadh ay ka qabto siyaasadaha dowladda Sisi. Sacuudiga wuxuu ka mid ahaa dowladihii ugu weynaa ee dhaqaale ahaan garab istaagay Qaahira markii militariga uu hoggaaminayey Sisi uu 2013 xukunka ka tuuray madaxweynihii hore Maxamed Mursi. Riyadh waxay isla sannadkaas ansixisay gargaar shan bilyan oo dollar ah, iyadoo taageerada Sacuudiga iyo dalal kale oo Khaliijka ah ay sanadaha xigay gaartay balaayiin dollar. Hase yeeshee, ilaha la hadlay Middle East Eye ayaa sheegay in madaxda Sacuudigu aaminsan yihiin in taageeradaas aysan la socon garab istaag siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo u dhigma. Waxay si gaar ah farta ugu fiiqeen doorka Masar ee dagaalkii muddada dheer Sacuudigu kula jiray Xuutiyiinta Yemen, kaas oo ay ku tilmaameen mid “kooban oo aan lagu kalsoonaan karin”. Waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in Riyadh ay ka carootay qaabka Masar ula dhaqantay Imaaraadka Carabta intii uu socday dagaalka Iran, xilli xiriirka Sacuudiga iyo Abu Dhabi uu horey cadaadis xooggan ugu jiray. Masar waxay dalalka Khaliijka u dirtay nidaamyo difaaca cirka ah intii uu socday dagaalka Iran, waxaana diyaaradaha dagaalka Rafale ee Masar la geeyey Imaaraadka, sida uu qoray Wall Street Journal. Hase yeeshee, ilaha Sacuudiga ayaa sheegay in Riyadh ay si gaar ah uga xumaatay in Madaxweyne Sisi uu dhowr jeer xiriir dhow la yeeshay hoggaanka Imaaraadka muddadaas, iyagoo ku doodaya in taageerada Qaahira ee Abu Dhabi ay ka muuqatay mid ka xoog badan tan Riyadh. Doorka Imaaraadka Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa iyadoo xiriirka Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka uu sanadkan si weyn uga xumaaday arrimaha Yemen. Khilaafka ayaa si cad usoo baxay markii xoogagga gooni-u-goosadka Koonfurta Yemen ee uu Imaaraadku taageero ay dabayaaqadii 2025 ballaariyeen dhulka ay maamulaan, taas oo horseedday in ciidamo uu Sacuudigu taageero ay tallaabo militari qaadaan. Reuters ayaa xilligaas ku tilmaantay dhacdada khilaaf weyn oo ka dhex qarxay labada quwadood ee Khaliijka. Ilo-wareedyada Middle East Eye ayaa sheegay in Riyadh ay sidoo kale ka walaacsan tahay siyaasado kale oo Imaaraadku ka wado gobolka, kuwaas oo Sacuudigu u arko inay mararka qaar lid ku yihiin danaha Masar lafteeda. Waxay ka mid dhigeen xiriirka istiraatiijiyadeed ee Abu Dhabi iyo Israel, taageerada ay siisay Itoobiya xilliyada khilaafka biyo-xireenka GERD, eedeymaha la xiriira taageerada Ciidamada Gurmadka Degdegga ah ee RSF ee Sudan, iyo joogitaanka iyo maalgashiga Imaaraadka ee Somaliland oo ka tirsan Soomaaliya. Mid ka mid ah ilaha ayaa sheegay in iyadoo siyaasadahaas qaarkood si toos ah u taabanayaan danaha Qaahira, haddana xiriirka dhow ee Sisi iyo Abu Dhabi uu sii kordhiyey shakiga Riyadh ka qabto in Masar tahay saaxiib istiraatiiji ah oo lagu kalsoonaan karo. Rabitaanka Turkiga Mowqifka Sacuudiga ayaa ka duwan kan Turkiga. Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Turkiga Hakan Fidan ayaa Sabtidii Masar ku tilmaamay “saaxiib dabiici ah”, isagoo sheegay inuu rumeysan yahay in Qaahira mustaqbalka kusoo biiri karto isbahaysiga marka la xalliyo arrimaha farsamo ee haray. Ilo Turki ah ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Ankara ay si weyn uga shaqeysay sidii Masar loogu dari lahaa heshiiska. Hase yeeshee, ilaha Sacuudiga ayaa meesha ka saaray sheegashada ah in Qaahira lafteedu ay go’aansatay inaysan ku biirin. La-taliyihii hore ee boqortooyada ayaa ku tilmaamay arrintaas mid “lagu qoslo”, isagoo ku dooday in Sisi uu si weyn u daneyn lahaa ka mid noqoshada heshiiska, gaar ahaan faa’iidooyinka siyaasadeed iyo dhaqaale ee uu ka heli karo. “Go’aan-qaadayaasha hoggaanka waxay walaac weyn ka qabaan daacadnimada Sisi,” ayuu yiri, isaga oo sheegay in madaxda Sacuudigu aysan u arkin hoggaanka Masar mid lagu aamini karo heerka ay u aaminaan Turkiga iyo Pakistan. Ilaha ayaa sidoo kale ku dooday in Ankara iyo Islamabad ay heshiiska kusoo kordhinayaan awood militari oo Riyadh u aragto mid muuqata. Turkiga wuxuu leeyahay warshado difaac oo si xawli ah u kobcaya, oo ay ka mid yihiin diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn iyo nidaamyo hub oo heer sare ah, halka Pakistan ay leedahay ciidan ballaaran, warshado hub iyo awood nukliyeer. Marka la barbar dhigo labadaas dal, ilaha Sacuudiga ayaa su’aal geliyey heerka ay ciidamada Masar maanta diyaar ugu yihiin dagaal casri ah iyo awoodda warshadaha difaaca ee dalka. Mid ka mid ah ayaa ku dhaliilay militariga Masar inuu waqti iyo dhaqaale badan geliyo ganacsiyo rayid ah, isagoo yiri shaqada ciidanku ay tahay inuu horumariyo “awooddiisa wax-soo-saarka militariga” halkii uu ku mashquuli lahaa maamulidda warshadaha cuntada. items.fullContent: Riyadh (Caasimada Online) — Sacuudiga ayaa ka hor yimid in Masar lagu daro isbahaysiga cusub ee difaaca ee uu la saxiixday Turkiga iyo Pakistan, inkasta oo Ankara ay dadaal xooggan ku bixisay sidii Qaahira qayb uga noqon lahayd heshiiska, sida ay sheegeen ilo Sacuudi ah oo arrinta xog-ogaal u ah. Saddex ilo-wareed oo Sacuudi ah oo la hadlay Middle East Eye ayaa sheegay in Riyadh aysan doonayn in Masar ay xilligan ku biirto heshiiska, iyagoo arrinta ku sababeeyey kalsooni-darro sii kordhaysa oo Boqortooyadu ka qabto dowladda Madaxweyne Cabdifataax Al-Sisi iyo waxa ay u aragto hoos u dhac ku yimid miisaankii istiraatiijiyadeed iyo midkii militari ee Qaahira. Mid ka mid ah ilaha, oo hore lataliye sare ugu ahaa boqortooyada Sacuudiga, ayaa sheegay in mowqifka Riyadh uu yahay in Masar aan lagu darin heshiiska “ugu yaraan hadda”. Heshiiska Difaaca Wadajirka ah ee Makkah waxaa 7-dii Agoosto magaalada barakeysan ee Makkah ku saxiixay Dhaxal-sugaha Sacuudiga Maxamed bin Salmaan, Madaxweynaha Turkiga Recep Tayyip Erdogan iyo Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Pakistan Shehbaz Sharif. Heshiisku wuxuu dhigaya in weerar hubeysan oo lagu qaado mid ka mid ah saddexda dal loo aqoonsado weerar lagu qaaday dhammaantood. In kasta oo heshiiska loo arko tallaabo weyn oo lagu dhisayo nidaam cusub oo amni oo gobolka ah, haddana faahfaahinta ku saabsan xaaladaha sida tooska ah u dhaqaajinaya waajibaadka difaaca iyo qaabka ciidamada saddexda dal u wada hawlgeli doonaan weli si buuxda looma caddeyn. Reuters ayaa sheegtay in Riyadh ay isbahaysiyo noocan ah u aragto hab ay ku xoojin karto awoodda ay kaga hortagayso khataraha gobolka, gaar ahaan kuwa kaga imanaya Xuutiyiinta Yemen iyo kooxaha kale ee Iran taageerto. Khilaaf soo jiitamayay Ilo-wareedyada Sacuudiga ayaa sheegay in diidmada Masar aysan ka dhalan oo keliya qiimeyn militari, balse ay salka ku hayso caro muddo soo urureysay oo Riyadh ay ka qabto siyaasadaha dowladda Sisi. Sacuudiga wuxuu ka mid ahaa dowladihii ugu weynaa ee dhaqaale ahaan garab istaagay Qaahira markii militariga uu hoggaaminayey Sisi uu 2013 xukunka ka tuuray madaxweynihii hore Maxamed Mursi. Riyadh waxay isla sannadkaas ansixisay gargaar shan bilyan oo dollar ah, iyadoo taageerada Sacuudiga iyo dalal kale oo Khaliijka ah ay sanadaha xigay gaartay balaayiin dollar. Hase yeeshee, ilaha la hadlay Middle East Eye ayaa sheegay in madaxda Sacuudigu aaminsan yihiin in taageeradaas aysan la socon garab istaag siyaasadeed iyo mid amni oo u dhigma. Waxay si gaar ah farta ugu fiiqeen doorka Masar ee dagaalkii muddada dheer Sacuudigu kula jiray Xuutiyiinta Yemen, kaas oo ay ku tilmaameen mid “kooban oo aan lagu kalsoonaan karin”. Waxay sidoo kale sheegeen in Riyadh ay ka carootay qaabka Masar ula dhaqantay Imaaraadka Carabta intii uu socday dagaalka Iran, xilli xiriirka Sacuudiga iyo Abu Dhabi uu horey cadaadis xooggan ugu jiray. Masar waxay dalalka Khaliijka u dirtay nidaamyo difaaca cirka ah intii uu socday dagaalka Iran, waxaana diyaaradaha dagaalka Rafale ee Masar la geeyey Imaaraadka, sida uu qoray Wall Street Journal. Hase yeeshee, ilaha Sacuudiga ayaa sheegay in Riyadh ay si gaar ah uga xumaatay in Madaxweyne Sisi uu dhowr jeer xiriir dhow la yeeshay hoggaanka Imaaraadka muddadaas, iyagoo ku doodaya in taageerada Qaahira ee Abu Dhabi ay ka muuqatay mid ka xoog badan tan Riyadh. Doorka Imaaraadka Arrintan ayaa kusoo beegmeysa iyadoo xiriirka Sacuudiga iyo Imaaraadka uu sanadkan si weyn uga xumaaday arrimaha Yemen. Khilaafka ayaa si cad usoo baxay markii xoogagga gooni-u-goosadka Koonfurta Yemen ee uu Imaaraadku taageero ay dabayaaqadii 2025 ballaariyeen dhulka ay maamulaan, taas oo horseedday in ciidamo uu Sacuudigu taageero ay tallaabo militari qaadaan. Reuters ayaa xilligaas ku tilmaantay dhacdada khilaaf weyn oo ka dhex qarxay labada quwadood ee Khaliijka. Ilo-wareedyada Middle East Eye ayaa sheegay in Riyadh ay sidoo kale ka walaacsan tahay siyaasado kale oo Imaaraadku ka wado gobolka, kuwaas oo Sacuudigu u arko inay mararka qaar lid ku yihiin danaha Masar lafteeda. Waxay ka mid dhigeen xiriirka istiraatiijiyadeed ee Abu Dhabi iyo Israel, taageerada ay siisay Itoobiya xilliyada khilaafka biyo-xireenka GERD, eedeymaha la xiriira taageerada Ciidamada Gurmadka Degdegga ah ee RSF ee Sudan, iyo joogitaanka iyo maalgashiga Imaaraadka ee Somaliland oo ka tirsan Soomaaliya.
