items.title: Why Washington May Finally Recognise Somaliland
items.description: The meeting between Somaliland President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi and Major General Claude K. Tudor Jr., commander of US Special Operations Command Africa (SOCAFRICA), to discuss security cooperation and strategic interests in the Horn of Africa suggests that United States (US) recognition of Somaliland may be increasingly likely. As the crisis in Iran and the resulting uncertainty surrounding the Strait of Hormuz continue to disrupt global trade and security, US partnership with Somaliland is no longer merely a diplomatic possibility but rather a geopolitical necessity. As the crisis in Iran and the resulting uncertainty surrounding the Strait of Hormuz continue to disrupt global trade and security, US partnership with Somaliland is no longer merely a diplomatic possibility but rather a geopolitical necessity. Since declaring independence from Somalia in 1991 , Somaliland has functioned as a de facto independent state without receiving international recognition. Despite maintaining democratic institutions, ensuring internal stability, and exercising effective control over its territory, no country has formally recognised Somaliland. This began to change when Israel became the first country to formally recognise Somaliland in December 2025. Although Somaliland previously established diplomatic relations with Taiwan and Ethiopia , neither has reached the level of formal recognition. Yet, shifting geopolitical realities in the Middle East and the Horn of Africa are creating conditions that could fundamentally increase its importance and lead Washington to recognise Somaliland as well. Somaliland’s Geographic Importance for the US The crisis in Iran, which began over Iran’s nuclear programme, has gradually transformed into a wider contest over maritime dominance across the Middle East. While Hormuz remains the centre of gravity, the conflict is steadily moving towards the Bab El-Mandeb Strait . Bab el-Mandeb is one of the world’s most strategically significant maritime chokepoints, linking the Gulf of Aden with the Red Sea. As it carries nearly 12 percent of global trade , including several million barrels of oil, any disruption in the strait would increase freight costs, insurance premiums, fuel consumption, and supply chain costs, as seen during the Red Sea shipping crisis of 2024-25 . The principal source of this threat is the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen. Over the past two years, the Houthis have transformed maritime coercion into an effective instrument of geopolitical influence. Armed with anti-ship ballistic missiles, drones, naval mines and advanced surveillance capabilities supported by Iran, the group has repeatedly targeted commercial shipping in the Red Sea. Now, the prospect of the Houthis eventually regulating maritime traffic or imposing transit fees through Bab el-Mandeb appears increasingly plausible. Washington therefore has a strategic interest in maintaining freedom of navigation through Bab el-Mandeb. Ensuring secure access to the Red Sea, however, would require reliable regional partners capable of supporting sustained military and logistical operations. It is precisely in this context that Somaliland emerges as an increasingly attractive strategic partner. Somaliland occupies one of the most advantageous geographic positions in the region. Stretching over 850 km along the Gulf of Aden, Somaliland overlooks one of the busiest maritime corridors connecting the Indian Ocean with the Mediterranean. Its greatest strategic asset is the Port of Berbera . Over the past decade, Berbera has undergone major modernisation, transforming it into one of the most capable deep-water ports on Africa’s eastern coast. The adjoining airfield, originally constructed during the Cold War, has also been upgraded and can support large military aircraft. Together, these facilities provide an ideal logistics hub for naval deployments, intelligence operations and maritime surveillance. From an American military perspective, Berbera offers several operational advantages. From an American military perspective, Berbera offers several operational advantages. Naval vessels engaged in securing Bab el-Mandeb could be resupplied without relying exclusively on facilities in Djibouti. Air assets conducting surveillance over Yemen or anti-Houthi missions could operate from a location considerably closer to the theatre of operations. Moreover, a larger American presence in Berbera would diversify Washington’s military footprint in the Horn of Africa at a time when strategic competition with both China and Russia is intensifying. Somaliland as a Strategic Counterweight to China The importance of Berbera becomes even greater when viewed alongside China’s expanding regional influence. Beijing has steadily strengthened its strategic position through its military base in Djibouti, extensive infrastructure investments and deepening political engagement with Somalia. China may use airspace restrictions as a tool to isolate Somaliland. Recently, Beijing attempted to prevent the Taiwanese president from travelling to Eswatini by restricting Taiwanese aircraft from using routes through neighbouring countries. The episode in Eswatini could serve as a warning of how Beijing may seek to use airspace restrictions to limit Taiwan’s engagement with other countries. Measures including restrictions on aircraft carrying American officials, tighter visa controls and efforts to limit international engagement with Somaliland may be employed as instruments of geopolitical pressure, restricting US access to Somaliland. For the US, recognising Somaliland could act as a counter to Chinese influence in the region in multiple ways. For the US, recognising Somaliland could act as a counter to Chinese influence in the region in multiple ways. In 2020, Somaliland established formal diplomatic ties with Taiwan despite intense opposition from Beijing. China reportedly attempted to persuade Somaliland to reverse its decision with substantial financial incentives, yet Hargeisa defied Chinese pressure. Since then, Somaliland has increasingly aligned itself with partners such as Taiwan, the United Arab Emirates and Israel, while resisting Chinese political pressure. From Washington’s perspective, Somaliland represents one of the few openly pro-Western actors in a region where Chinese influence is yet to become entrenched. Economic considerations further strengthen the strategic argument. Somaliland possesses considerable untapped reserves of critical minerals and rare-earth elements , resources that are becoming increasingly important as the United States seeks to reduce its dependence on Chinese-controlled supply chains. American recognition could create opportunities for Western companies in mining, logistics and infrastructure. As Washington intensifies efforts to diversify global supply chains for strategic minerals, Somaliland could emerge as an important alternative partner. The Case for US Recognition Counterterrorism is another compelling factor. Although Somaliland is overwhelmingly Muslim, it has consistently rejected Islamist extremism. Unlike neighbouring Somalia, which continues to struggle against the militant group Al-Shabaab , Somaliland has enjoyed relative stability. For the US, this presents an opportunity similar to previous partnerships with local forces in other parts of the Middle East. Rather than relying solely on fragile central governments, Washington has increasingly worked with capable local actors sharing common security objectives. Somaliland’s security institutions and political stability make it a potentially valuable partner for counterterrorism operations across the Horn of Africa. If the conflict surrounding Iran continues to expand westward and Bab el-Mandeb becomes the next major arena of geopolitical competition, the US will require dependable partners positioned at the centre of this emerging maritime theatre. Somaliland offers geographical advantages, political stability, military utility, counterterrorism cooperation, critical mineral potential and alignment with American strategic interests in countering both Iran and China. Given current developments in the region, US recognition of Somaliland appears increasingly likely. Samir Bhattacharya is an Associate Fellow at the Observer Research Foundation.

items.title: Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Austrian Foreign Minister Meinl-Reisinger
items.description: Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Austrian Foreign Minister Meinl-Reisinger Office of the Spokesperson August 11, 2026 The following is attributable to Spokesperson Thomas Pigott: Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with Austrian Foreign Minister Beate Meinl-Reisinger today in Washington. The Secretary and Foreign Minister discussed ways to ensure European security and uphold national sovereignty, including protecting critical technologies. Secretary Rubio welcomed Austria’s election to the UN Security Council and highlighted areas of shared interests.

items.title: United States Mobilizes Life-Saving Response to Colombia Earthquake
items.description: United States Mobilizes Life-Saving Response to Colombia Earthquake Office of the Spokesperson August 11, 2026 The Trump Administration has mobilized an immediate response following the devastating 7.4 magnitude earthquake that struck regions of Colombia on August 10. Within hours of the earthquake, the Department of State announced $15.5 million in life-saving emergency shelter, food, and protection assistance, in addition to post-earthquake structural assessments. The Department also activated a Disaster Assistance Response Team (DART), which includes humanitarian experts from across the State Department. Members of the DART began arriving in Colombia the day of this devastating earthquake, underscoring the Department’s commitment to immediate, life-saving action in the critical hours following natural disasters in our hemisphere. The State Department continues to liaise with Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella and the Colombian government as it assesses the impacts of and responds to this earthquake. Disaster Assistance Response Team Deployment The Department is deploying a DART to provide world-class disaster response expertise, technical and programmatic support, operational leadership, and on-the-ground coordination. The DART is responsible for assessing conditions, identifying humanitarian needs, and leading the U.S. Government’s disaster response. The DART is working closely with existing Department assistance personnel, as well as diplomats at our Embassy in Bogota to coordinate with local authorities and partner organizations. Life-Saving Humanitarian Assistance Through Trusted Partners In response to the earthquake, the State Department is mobilizing an initial $15.5 million in life-saving emergency shelter, food, and protection assistance, in addition to post-earthquake structural assessments through trusted partners, including Catholic Relief Services (CRS), the International Organization for Migration, Miyamoto International, the UN World Food Program, and World Vision. Of the $15.5 million in life-saving assistance, $3 million provided through CRS draws from the previously announced CRS global assistance award . With funding already on hand through its global award, CRS can respond immediately through support from the State Department. Additionally, as part of the Department’s $3.8 billion contribution to the UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), the United States provided $200 million to the Colombia Pooled Fund, which OCHA can use to address earthquake-related needs as well as preexisting humanitarian needs in Colombia. Supporting Americans in Colombia The Trump Administration has no higher priority than the safety and security of Americans. The Department of State is working tirelessly to provide consular assistance to U.S. citizens and their families in the affected areas. Americans in Colombia should enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP) at STEP.state.gov to receive safety and security updates from the U.S. Embassy. They should follow @TravelGov and @USEmbassyBogota on social media for the latest information. The U.S. State Department’s Bureau of Consular Affairs maintains a call center for Americans seeking information or assistance in connection with the Colombia earthquake: call from within the United States 888-407-4747, or from all other locations +1 202-501-4444.

items.title: Somalia’s Northeast Seeks Federal Pay Amid Puntland Tensions
items.description: (Raxanreeb Online) — The Waqooyi Bari administration has called on the Federal Government of Somalia to provide salaries for its security forces, following the reported failure of a federal plan to deploy federal troops within Puntland. MP Kilwa said the Waqooyi Bari security forces require financial support from the Federal Government and urged Mogadishu to take responsibility for their salaries. He linked the request to ongoing political and security developments in areas under the Puntland administration. The remarks come amid continuing political tensions between the Federal Government of Somalia and Puntland, particularly over security arrangements, governance, and the division of powers between the federal authorities and Federal Member States. Disagreements over the deployment, financing and command of security forces remain among the key issues affecting relations between Mogadishu and Puntland. The post Somalia’s Northeast Seeks Federal Pay Amid Puntland Tensions appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Xamza oo kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay wafdi sare oo ka socda Qatar + Sawirro
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa qaabilay wafdi ka socday Dowladda Qatar, oo uu hoggaaminayay La-taliye Sare ahna Agaasime ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Qatar, Talaal Binu Rashiid Al-Hajri. Wafdiga Qatar ayaa Soomaaliya u joogay arrimo la xiriira maalgashiga wax-soo-saarka cuntada iyo dhinaca caafimaadka, iyagoo sidoo kale shalay heshiis dhinacyo badan ah la saxiixday Wasaaradda Qorsheynta, Maalgashiga iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha. Kulanka ayaa wafdigu salaan sharafeed ugu yimid Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamza, iyagoo sidoo kale la wadaagay farriimo ay ka wadeen madaxda Dowladda Qatar. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa wafdiga oo uu wehliyay Safiirka Qatar u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Cabdullaahi Bin Saalim Al-Nucaymi, uga warbixiyay horumarrada ay Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka samaysay dhinacyada amniga, dhaqaalaha iyo adeegyada dadweynaha. Xamza Cabdi Barre ayaa sidoo kale bogaadiyay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga xooggan ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Qatar, isaga oo tilmaamay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta xiriirka labada dal. Dhinaca kale, booqashada wafdiga Qatar ayaa kusoo beegantay xilli Soomaaliya ay xoogga saarayso soo jiidashada maalgashiga shisheeye, gaar ahaan dhinacyada wax-soo-saarka, caafimaadka iyo horumarinta dhaqaalaha. Heshiisyada iyo wada-hadallada labada dhinac ayaa la filayaa inay horseedaan iskaashi dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan maalgashiga iyo mashaariicda horumarineed, iyadoo Qatar ay ka mid tahay dalalka xiriirka dhow la leh Soomaaliya. The post Xamza oo kulan muhiim ah la yeeshay wafdi sare oo ka socda Qatar + Sawirro appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Trump oo si qarsoodi ah uga baxay Turkiga kadib hanjabaad Iran ah
items.description: Madaxweynaha Maraykanka Donald Trump ayaa bishii hore si qarsoodi ah uga baxay dalka Turkiga isagoo wata diyaarad milateri oo ka duwan Air Force One, kadib markii sirdoonka Maraykanku uu helay macluumaad ku saabsan hanjabaad dhimasho oo ka imanaysa Iran . Tallaabadan ammaan ee aan caadiga ahayn ayaa la sameeyay intii uu ka soo qayb galayay shirkii NATO ee magaalada Ankara, waxaana lagu sameeyay qaab khiyaano ah oo ay ku jirtay inuu ku dhex qariyo baabuur cunto gee ah oo garoonka diyaaradaha . Khatarta ayaa loo arkay mid dhab ah, kadib markii sirdoonka Maraykanku uu ogaaday in Iran ay la socotay meesha uu Trump ku sugan yahay Ankara, oo ay ku jirto dabaqa uu ku jiray hotelka . Waxa kale oo la soo sheegay in hanjabaaddu ay ku saabsanayd in diyaaradda Madaxweynaha lagu garaaco gantaal . Trump ayaa markii dambe xaqiijiyay in hay’adaha ammaanku ay ku waaniyeen inuu diyaarad beddelo, isagoona sheegay: “Waxaan u socdaa sida ay Hay’adda Sirta Ilaalinta iyo ciidanku doonaan. Waxay rabeen inaan duullo diyaarad kale, duulimaad kale” . Si loo fuliyo qorshahan khiyaanada ah, Trump ayaa markii hore si rasmi ah u soo fuulay Air Force One hortii kamaradaha, isaga oo ku dhawaaqay inuu diyaaraddii hore ku sii jeedo Ingiriiska “si uu u xuso waqtiyadii hore” . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, wax yar ka dib waxa lagu soo degay baabuur cunto gee ah oo garoonka, kaas oo u geeyay diyaarad C-32A ah oo yar . Diyaaraddii Air Force One waxay sii duushay iyadoo ay saarneen saraakiil sare, shaqaale iyo wariyeyaal, kuwaas oo aan waxba ka ogeyn in madaxweynuhu uusan ku jirin . Wariyeyaashii ku socday Air Force One ayaa la sheegay in lagu amray inay xidhaan daaqadaha qaybtooda . Xubno ka mid ah shaqaalaha Aqalka Cad ayaa sidoo kale la rumeysan yahay inay aaminsanaayeen in Trump uu diyaaraddaas ku jiro . Diyaaraddii C-32A oo siday Trump waxay timid Ingiriiska 10:20 fiidnimo, halka Air Force One ay timid daqiiqado yar ka dib . Markii warfiyayaasha ay mar dambe su’aal ka weydiiyeen Trump sababta daaqadaha loo xidhay, waxa uu iska yiri waxay ku jireen “duulimaad khatar ah,” laakiin ma uu shaacin inuu si qarsoodi ah ugu safray diyaarad kale . Aqalka Cad ayaa difaacay tallaabooyinka ammaanka, isagoo sheegay in madaxweynuhu uu yahay bartilmaameedka cadawga Maraykanka, isla markaana hay’aduhu ay isticmaalaan qalab kasta oo ay haystaan si ay uga ilaaliyaan . The post Trump oo si qarsoodi ah uga baxay Turkiga kadib hanjabaad Iran ah first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Al-Shabaab claims deadly IED attack on Somali army truck near Mubarak
items.description: MOGADISHU (Somaliguardian) – More than a dozen Somali army personnel were killed on Monday when a military truck carrying troops was struck by an improvised explosive device (IED) near the town of Mubarak in Somalia’s Lower Shabelle region, according to reports. The attack targeted a Somali military vehicle travelling between Awdhegle and Mubarak, two locations where Somali forces maintain bases after capturing the areas several months ago with the assistance of Ugandan ground forces and Turkish air force. Al-Shabaab claimed responsibility for the bombing, saying its attack killed over 20 Somali soldiers and wounded dozens of others. The reported death toll, however, remained disputed. Prominent Somali journalist Abdalle Ahmed Mumin put the number of soldiers killed at 30 and reported that many others were injured. Images following the attack showed the wreckage of the targeted military truck left along the road, underscoring the force of the blast. Reports also indicated that a military commander was among those killed. Somalia’s government has not yet issued a public comment on the attack, and there is therefore no independent government confirmation of the casualty figures claimed by Al-Shabaab or reported by Mumin. The bombing comes as Al-Shabaab intensifies attacks across southern and central Somalia, challenging Somali forces in areas where government troops have sought to consolidate territorial gains against the militant group. The attack also comes at a sensitive moment for Somalia’s security campaign, with African Union troop-contributing countries preparing to draw down their forces ahead of December. The strike near Mubarak highlights the continuing threat facing Somali forces along key routes in the southern and central regions, where military positions and recently captured territory remain vulnerable to insurgent attacks. For the Somali army, the deadly bombing represents another serious challenge as it works to maintain control of territory recovered from Al-Shabaab while the broader regional security presence undergoes a planned transition. Contact us: info@somaliguardian.com

items.title: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka oo si rasmi ah xilka ula wareegay
items.description: Guddoomiyaha cusub ee Golaha Shacabka ee Baarlamaanka Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa maanta si rasmi ah ula wareegay xilka Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Munaasabad ka dhacday xarunta Guddoonka iyo Guddiyada ee Villa Hargeysa ayaa lagu qabtay xafladda xil-wareejinta, waxaana ka qeyb galay Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Koowaad ee Golaha Shacabka, Marwo Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar, Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad, Mudane Cabdullaahi Cumar Abshirow, iyo mas’uuliyiin kale. Guddoomiye Ku-xigeenka Labaad ayaa uga mahadceliyey Guddigii Doorashada Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka shaqadii ay qabteen, isagoo sidoo kale ammaanay hoggaankii iyo howlihii ay soo qabatay Marwo Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar intii ay ahayd Kusimaha Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka. Marwo Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar ayaa dhankeeda uga mahadcelisay Guddigii Doorashada, iyadoo adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay wada shaqeynta iyo sii ambaqaadidda howlaha Golaha Shacabka. Guddoomiyaha cusub, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa sheegay inuu Golaha Shacabka ku hoggaamin doono caddaalad, hufnaan iyo wadajir, isagoo mudnaanta siinaya xoojinta shaqada sharci-dejinta, ilaalinta doorka dastuuriga ah ee Golaha iyo ka shaqeynta danta guud. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale ugu baaqay dhammaan Xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka inay si wadajir ah uga qeyb qaataan gudashada waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee loo igmaday, si loo xaqiijiyo yoolalka iyo himilooyinka Golaha Shacabka. Xil-wareejintan ayaa ku soo beegantay kaddib doorashadii Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, iyadoo Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) uu hadda si rasmi ah u bilaabay hoggaaminta Golaha.

Marwo Sacdiya Yaasiin Xaaji Samatar ayaa dhankeeda uga mahadcelisay Guddigii Doorashada, iyadoo adkaysay muhiimadda ay leedahay wada shaqeynta iyo sii ambaqaadidda howlaha Golaha Shacabka. Guddoomiyaha cusub, Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac), ayaa sheegay inuu Golaha Shacabka ku hoggaamin doono caddaalad, hufnaan iyo wadajir, isagoo mudnaanta siinaya xoojinta shaqada sharci-dejinta, ilaalinta doorka dastuuriga ah ee Golaha iyo ka shaqeynta danta guud. Guddoomiyaha ayaa sidoo kale ugu baaqay dhammaan Xildhibaannada Golaha Shacabka inay si wadajir ah uga qeyb qaataan gudashada waajibaadka dastuuriga ah ee loo igmaday, si loo xaqiijiyo yoolalka iyo himilooyinka Golaha Shacabka. Xil-wareejintan ayaa ku soo beegantay kaddib doorashadii Guddoomiyaha Golaha Shacabka, iyadoo Cabdulqaadir Maxamed Nuur (Jaamac) uu hadda si rasmi ah u bilaabay hoggaaminta Golaha.

items.title: Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa oo qaabilay wafdi ka socday Dowladda Qatar
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Mudane Xamsa Cabdi Barre, ayaa maanta qaabilay wafdi ka socday Dowladda Qatar oo uu hoggaaminayay La-taliye Sare ahna Agaasime ka tirsan Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Qatar, Mudane Talaal Binu Rashiid Al-Hajri. Wafdiga ayaa Soomaaliya u yimid arrimo la xiriira maalgashiga wax-soo-saarka cuntada iyo horumarinta adeegyada caafimaadka. Waxa kale oo ay shalay heshiis dhinacyo badan ah la saxiixeen Wasaaradda Qorsheynta, Maalgashiga iyo Horumarinta Dhaqaalaha Soomaaliya. Kulanka ay la yeesheen Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa ahaa salaan sharafeed, iyadoo wafdigu ay soo gaarsiiyeen Ra’iisul Wasaare Xamsa farriimo ay ka wadeen madaxda Dowladda Qatar. Ra’iisul Wasaaraha ayaa wafdiga, oo uu ku wehliyay Safiirka Qatar ee Soomaaliya, Cabdullaahi Bin Saalim Al-Nucaymi, uga warbixiyay horumarrada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya ka samaysay dhinacyada amniga, kobcinta dhaqaalaha iyo adeegyada bulshada. Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa sidoo kale bogaadiyay xiriirka diblomaasiyadeed iyo iskaashiga xooggan ee ka dhexeeya Soomaaliya iyo Qatar, isagoo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay sii xoojinta xiriirka labada dal iyo iskaashiga dhinacyada horumarinta iyo maalgashiga. Kulankan ayaa kusoo beegmaya xilli Soomaaliya iyo Qatar ay sii xoojinayaan iskaashiga labada dhinac, gaar ahaan maalgashiga, wax-soo-saarka cuntada iyo adeegyada caafimaadka.

items.title: Albania Appoints World’s First AI Minister to Fight Corruption
items.description: Albania has appointed Diella, a virtual AI minister, to oversee all public procurement in a radical effort to eliminate corruption, making it the first country in the world to use artificial intelligence at a ministerial level. Prime Minister Edi Rama announced the move stating that the AI minister would ensure every single public tender is 100% corruption-free, replacing human decision-making with algorithms designed to eliminate bias bribes and political influence. This move is significant because it represents a new approach to governance and anti-corruption efforts, using technology to bring unprecedented transparency to how taxpayer money is spent. Diella, a woman dressed in traditional Albanian clothing, was first created in January 2025 to assist citizens with government services through the e-Albania platform. She has already processed 36,600 digital documents and nearly 1,000 services. Prime Minister Rama stated that Diella would oversee all government contract decisions, claiming she would ensure that public funds are spent with 100% transparency. He added: “Diella is the first non-human member but made by artificial intelligence.” The AI minister has also addressed parliament, stating: “The real threat to the constitution has never been machines but the inhuman decisions of those in power.” However, the appointment has sparked mixed reactions. Some experts have warned that AI is not a magic solution for corruption, as technology is only as effective as the people who create and manage it. There are also concerns about accountability when important decisions are made by an AI system, as well as questions about Diella’s actual effectiveness. Opposition leader Sali Berisha has described the move as unconstitutional and a publicity stunt, arguing that corruption cannot be controlled through Diella. Albania’s government continues its efforts to fight corruption, which is one of the key requirements for its European Union membership bid. The post Albania Appoints World’s First AI Minister to Fight Corruption first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Xuska Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Dhallinyarada Adduunka
items.description: Maanta oo kale, 12ka Agoosto, sannad kasta waxa adduunweynaha looga dabbaaldegaa xuska Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Dhallinyarada Adduunka. Sannadkii 1999kii Qaramada Midoobay ayaa u astaysay Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Dhallinyarada, iyada oo la raacayo Qaraarka 54/120. Munaasabaddani waa madal caalami ah oo lagu qiimeeyo awoodda, hal-abuurka iyo waxsoosaarka dhallinyarada, iyadoo si gaar ah loo tixgelinayo saamaynta baaxadda leh ee ay ku leeyihiin isbeddellada dhaqandhaqaale, siyaasadeed iyo tegnolojiyadeed ee dunida maanta. Maalinta Dhallinyarada Adduunka waxay ka curatay Shirweynihii Wasiirradii u xilsaarnaa dhallinyarada oo ka dhacay magaalada Lisbon ee dalka Bortugaal, sannadkii 1998. Ka dib dib-u-eegis iyo falanqayn ay sameeyeen xeeldheerayaal iyo hay’ado caalami ah, Qaramada Midoobay ayaa go’aamisay in 12ka Ogoosto loo aqoonsado weyn oo lagu soo bandhigo baahiyaha, caqabadaha iyo guulaha ay gaareen dhallinyarada caalamku. Sannad kasta, xusku wuxuu xanbaarsan yahay mawduuc gaar ah oo ka tarjumaya baahiyaha dhallinyarada ee xilliyada kala duwan iyo isbeddellada jira. Mawduucyadaas waxaa ka mid ah adeegsiga aaladaha dhijitaalka ah si ay dhallinyaradu u helaan horumar waara, in la adkeeyo ka qaybqaadashada dhallinyarada ee go’aannada masiiriga ah iyo dib-u-habaynta iyo tayaynta waxbarashada si ay u waafaqdo baahiyaha dhallinyarada qarnigan joogta. Ujeeddada guud ee maalintan ayaa ah in dawladaha, hay’adaha caalamiga ah iyo bulshada rayidka ah lagu baraarujiyo muhiimadda ay leeyihiin maaraynta dhibaatada shaqo la’aanta, helitaanka waxbarasho tayo leh iyo kaqaybgalinta dhallinyarada go’aannada heer qaran. Dhallinyarada maanta waxay ka dhigan yihiin awoodda ugu weyn ee qaabaysa mustaqbalka aadanaha, maadaama ay yihiin jiilkii ugu tiro badnaa taariikhda. Dhallinyaradu waxay hormuud u yihiin isbeddellada dhanka tegnoolajiyada, maadaama ay ku soo koreen ama ay ku korayaan dunida dhijitaalka ah oo ay si fudud u xiriiriyaan fikradaha cusub. Sida ay sheegtay Qaramada Midoobay (UN), dunida maanta waxaa ku nool ku dhowaad 1.2 bilyan oo dhallinyaro ah oo da’doodu u dhexeyso 15 ilaa 24 sano, tanina waxay muujinaysaa in saamayntoodu ka muuqato meel kasta oo ay joogaan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, dhallinyaradu waxay maanta wajahayaan xaalado kakan iyo caqabado kala duwan oo ku xiran dibudhaca ama horumarka bulshada iyo waddamada ay ka soo jeedaan. Dunida soo koraysa, gaar ahaan qaaradda Afrika, waxaa ka jira fursado waaweyn oo ku aaddan dhiirrigelinta iyo koruqaadista xirfadaha cusub ee dhallinyarada hibada leh, iyadoo saamaynta fikirka dhallinyarada ay ka muuqato dhinacyada ganacsiga dhijitaalka ah iyo dadaallada bulshada ee dhinaca waxsoosaarka ah. Waxaa intaas dheer, Bangiga Adduunka (World Bank) wuxuu sheegay in maalgashiga aqoonta, caafimaadka iyo shaqa-abuurka dhallinyaradu uu yahay furaha ugu muhiimsan ee waddamadu ku gaari karaan horumar dhaqaale oo waara. Markaan u soo laabanno taariikhda dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed, waxa ay safka hore kaga jiraan isbeddelladii waaweynaa ee ka dhacay dalkeenna. Laga soo bilaabo 15kii Maajo 1943dii, waxaa jiray saddex iyo toban dhallinyaro ah oo taariikhda Soomaaliya baal dahab ah ka galay. Dhallinyaradaas waxa ay aasaaseen Naadigii Dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed ee Somali Youth Club (SYC). Isbahaysigaas ay dhallinyaradu sameeyeen wuxuu ahaa matoorkii unkay gobannimadii dalka, iyagoo ku dhiirraday in ay qaadaan tallaabo aan hore loo qaadin. Waxa ay garawsadeen in ay iskuduubni kaga guuleysteen gumaysigii iyo xukunkii gumeystaha ee dalka maamulayay. Guushaas waxay caddayn u tahay in dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed, marka ay leeyihiin iskuduubni iyo midnimo, ay beddeli karaan jihada ummadda Soomaaliyeed. Xaaladda ay maanta dhallinyarada Soomaaliyeed ku sugan yihiin waa mid meel fiican sii maraysa. Dhallinyaradeennu qiyaas ahaan waxay boqolkiiba toddobaatan ka yihiin tirada guud ee bulshada dalka, iyagoo ka qaybqaata awoodaha, shaqooyinka iyo isbeddellada ugu weyn ee dalka ka dhaca. Wasaaradaha iyo hay’adaha dawliga ah iyo ururrada bulshada ee madaniga ah ayay dhallinyaradu door weyn ku leeyihiin. Waxaa jira wasaarado inta badan ka shaqeeya sidii ay dhallinyaradu uga shaqayn lahaayeen horumarkooda, taas oo ay ka mid tahay Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada iyo Ciyaaraha. Inta badan waxa ay dhallinyarada u abuurtaa fursado shaqo, waxbarasho iyo fursado ay ku soo bandhigi karaan hal-abuurkooda. Waxa ay sidoo kale dhallinyarada siisaa ama u abuurtaa madallo waaweyn oo fikir-wadaag iyo aqoonkororsi ah. Intaas waxaa dheer, dhallinyarada waxaa fursad loo siiyaa in ay la kulmaan ama ay wax isweydaarsadaan dhallinyarada dhiggooda ah ee daafaha kale ee adduunweynaha ku nool. Dhallinyaradu waxa ay inta badan garab-istaag u muujiyaan dadka danyarta ah ama haysta dhibaatooyinka gaarka ah, iyaga oo muujinaya garab-istaag iyo isku-xirnaan buuxda. Xilliyada ay dhacaan abaaraha ama fatahaadaha noocooda kala duwan, dhallinyaradu waxa ay gurmad u fidiyaan dadka ay waxyeelladu gaarto, iyaga oo adeegsanaya aaladaha kala duwan ee baraha bulshada si ay dhaqaale, taageero iyo garab-istaag ugu ururiyaan dadka ay dhibaatadu saamayso. Sidoo kale, waxaa jira dhallinyaro tiro badan oo u taagan wacyigelinta bulshada, haddii ay noqon lahayd dhinaca waxbarashada, waxsoosaarka iyo degaanka. Waxay horseedeen mashruucyo dhirbeereed, nadiifinta xeebaha iyo ilaalinta degaanka, kuwaas oo hoos u dhigaya saamaynta isbeddelka cimilada iyo masiibooyinka dabiiciga ah. Dhallinyaradu waxay, sidoo kale, door firfircoon ka ciyaaraan geeddisocodka dhismaha nabadda iyo xallinta khilaafaadka. Waddammada soo maray dagaallada ama weli ku jira xaaladaha kala guurka ah, dhallinyaradu waxa ay qayb ka yihiin dhisidda madallo lagu wadahadalyo; waa kuwo soo saara maqaallo iyo suugaan dhiirrigelisa wadajirka, kana qaybqaata dhisidda xiriirka bulshada ku nool degaannada kala duwan. Dhiirrigelinta wadahadallada, isdhaafsiga dhaqanka iyo mashaariicda ciyaaraha ayaa muujisay in dhallinyaradu ay yihiin dabarka isku xira qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Inkasta oo ay jiraan guulo waaweyn iyo rajooyin badan, haddana dhallinyarada adduunka iyo kuwa Soomaaliyeedba waxay wajahayaan caqabado dhowr ah oo u baahan in la xalliyo. Waxaa ugu horreeya shaqo la’aanta, maadaama awoodda ganacsiyadu aad u yar tahay oo aanay dabooli karin tirada ballaaran ee dhallinyarada ka soo baxa jaamacadaha iyo iskuullada waxbarashada sannad kasta. Dhinaca kale, dhallinyarada waxaa haysata dhibaatada tahriibka, taas oo naftooda halis gelin karta. Haddaba, Maalinta Dhallinyarada Adduunka waa maalin lagu weyneeyo lagu na dhiirrigeliyo qof kasta oo dhallinyaro ah oo haddana halgamaya, lehna hammi fog oo ah in uu gaaro meelo sare. Maalintan weyn, waa in madaxda iyo hoggaamiyayaasha dunida, dawladaha iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshadu ay dhallinyarada u abuuraan fursad ay wax kaga beddelaan noloshooda. Taasi waxa ay dhallinyarada u noqonaysaa shidaalin iyo in ay dedaalkooda sii laba jibaaraan. Marka dhallinyarada la siiyo agabkii ay wax ku qabsan lahaayeen, aqoonta iyo xorriyadda hal-abuurka, waxay xallin karaan dhibaatooyinka ugu adag.

Waddammada soo maray dagaallada ama weli ku jira xaaladaha kala guurka ah, dhallinyaradu waxa ay qayb ka yihiin dhisidda madallo lagu wadahadalyo; waa kuwo soo saara maqaallo iyo suugaan dhiirrigelisa wadajirka, kana qaybqaata dhisidda xiriirka bulshada ku nool degaannada kala duwan. Dhiirrigelinta wadahadallada, isdhaafsiga dhaqanka iyo mashaariicda ciyaaraha ayaa muujisay in dhallinyaradu ay yihiin dabarka isku xira qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshada. Inkasta oo ay jiraan guulo waaweyn iyo rajooyin badan, haddana dhallinyarada adduunka iyo kuwa Soomaaliyeedba waxay wajahayaan caqabado dhowr ah oo u baahan in la xalliyo. Waxaa ugu horreeya shaqo la’aanta, maadaama awoodda ganacsiyadu aad u yar tahay oo aanay dabooli karin tirada ballaaran ee dhallinyarada ka soo baxa jaamacadaha iyo iskuullada waxbarashada sannad kasta. Dhinaca kale, dhallinyarada waxaa haysata dhibaatada tahriibka, taas oo naftooda halis gelin karta. Haddaba, Maalinta Dhallinyarada Adduunka waa maalin lagu weyneeyo lagu na dhiirrigeliyo qof kasta oo dhallinyaro ah oo haddana halgamaya, lehna hammi fog oo ah in uu gaaro meelo sare. Maalintan weyn, waa in madaxda iyo hoggaamiyayaasha dunida, dawladaha iyo qaybaha kala duwan ee bulshadu ay dhallinyarada u abuuraan fursad ay wax kaga beddelaan noloshooda. Taasi waxa ay dhallinyarada u noqonaysaa shidaalin iyo in ay dedaalkooda sii laba jibaaraan. Marka dhallinyarada la siiyo agabkii ay wax ku qabsan lahaayeen, aqoonta iyo xorriyadda hal-abuurka, waxay xallin karaan dhibaatooyinka ugu adag.

items.title: Kulan dhex maray Danjiraha Somaliland u jooga Imaaraadka iyo ka u jooga Israel
items.description: Danjirayaasha Somaliland iyo Israel ee UAE oo kulan gaar ah yeeshay Danjiraha Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland u fadhiya Imaaraadka Carabta, Amb Mascuud Cali Xasan, ayaa kulan gaar ah la yeeshay danjiraha dawladda Israel u fadhiya Imaaraadka Carabta, Amb Yossi Shelley. items.title: Albania oo magacawday Wasiirka AI ee ugu horreeya adduunka
items.description: Ra’iisul Wasaaraha Albania, Edi Rama, ayaa magacaabay wasiirka ugu horreeya adduunka ee uu dhalay Artificial Intelligence (AI), kaas oo loo magacaabay Diella. Wasiirkan dhijitaalka ah ayaa loo xilsaaray inuu kormeero dhammaan howlaha qandaraaska dawliga ah si uu uga dhigo kuwo 100% hufan oo aan musuqmaasuq lahayn . Tallaabadan ayaa ka dhigtay Albania dal ugu horreeya adduunka ee isticmaala AI heer wasiir si uu ula dagaallamo musuqmaasuqa . Tallaabadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan tahay isku day cusub oo lagu doonayo in lagu hagaajiyo hufnaanta maamulka iyo la dagaallanka musuqmaasuqa iyadoo la adeegsanayo tignoolajiyadda casriga ah. Diella, oo ah haweeney lagu soo bandhigay dharka dhaqanka Albania, waxaa markii hore la sameeyay Janaayo 2025 si ay uga caawiso dadka adeegsiga rasmiga ah ee barta e-Albania iyadoo ilaa hadda soo saartay 36,600 dokumenti dhijitaal ah iyo ku dhawaad 1,000 adeeg . Ra’iisul Wasaare Rama ayaa sheegay in Diella ay leedahay awood ay ku kormeerto dhammaan go’aannada qandaraaska dawliga ah isagoona ku tilmaamay inay suurtogelin doonto in lacagaha dawliga ah ay noqdaan kuwo 100% daah-furan. Waxa uu intaas ku daray: “Diella waa xubintii ugu horreysay ee aan jir ahaan u jirin balse ay sameysay Artificial Intelligence” . Wasiirka AI ayaa sidoo kale la sheegay inuu la hadlay baarlamaanka, isagoo sheegay: “khatarta dhabta ah ee dastuurka marna ma aha mashiinnada, balse waa go’aannada aan bini’aadamnimada lahayn ee kuwa xoogga haya” . Si kastaba ha ahaatee magacaabista Diella waxay kicisay falcelinno kala duwan. Qaar ka mid ah khubarada ayaa ka digay in AI aysan ahayn xal sixir ah oo lagu xallin karo musuqmaasuqa iyadoo ay ugu wacan tahay in tignoolajiyadu ay tahay mid uun sida ay u wanaagsan yihiin dadka abuura oo maamula . Sidoo kale, waxaa jira welwel ku saabsan sida looga jawaabi doono su’aasha mas’uuliyadda marka go’aanno muhiim ah laga qaato nidaam AI ah, iyadoo ay jirtaan sidoo kale su’aalo ku saabsan waxqabadka dhabta ah ee Diella iyo haddii ay tahay mid wax ku ool ah . Dhanka kale hoggaamiyaha mucaaradka Sali Berisha, ayaa ku tilmaamay talaabadan mid aan dastuuri ahayn oo loogu talagalay inay soo jiito dareenka, isagoo sheegay inaysan suurtogal ahayn in lagu xakameeyo musuqmaasuqa iyada oo loo marayo Diella . Dowladda Albania ayaa sii wadda dadaalladeeda ay kula dagaallamayso musuqmaasuqa, taasoo ah mid ka mid ah shuruudaha ugu muhiimsan ee ay uga midowdo Midowga Yurub . The post Albania oo magacawday Wasiirka AI ee ugu horreeya adduunka first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Daawo: Xasan oo weerar culus ku qaaday mucaaradka DF
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya, Mudane Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud oo maanta khudbada dheer ka jeediyay xafladda qalin-jabinta saddexda dufcadood ee Machadka Sare ee Daraasaadka Amniga iyo Istaraatiijiyadda Qaranka ayaa weerar culus oo dhanka afka ah ku qaaday siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ee kasoo horjeedo dowladdiisa. Xasan Sheekh ayaa ku eedeeyay siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka ah ee haatan dhaq-dhaqaaqyada ka wada magaalada Muqdisho inay dalka dib ugu celinayaan marxaladihii adkaa ee lasoo maray, isla markaana ay doonayaan in loo dhaqmo sida xilligii hoggaamiye kooxeedyadu awoodda ku lahaayeen caasimadda. Madaxweynaha ayaa sidoo kale farriin culus u diray shacabka Soomaaliyeed, wuxuuna ugu baaqday inay u istaagaan horumarka dalka, ayna garab istaagaan dowladdooda. “Nimanaa maanta waxay ku adkeysanayaan oo bannaanka ay la taagan yihiin inay weli hoggaamiye kooxeed ahaadaan siyaasad aan la garanayn institution aan lahayn qaabka go’aanka loo gaaro aan la garaneyn,” ayuu yiri Xasan Sheekh. Sidoo kale wuxuu sii raaciyay “Dadka Soomaaliyeed waxaan leeyahay kaca oo baraaruga nidaam sameysta siyaasadda waa waxa na haystaa dhaqaaluhu waa socdaa dadku waa ganacsanaayaan tacliintana waa soo noolaatay”. Hadalkan ayaa kusoo aadayo, xilli xasaasi ah oo Villa Soomaaliya iyo mucaaradka ay isku hayaan hannaanka loo wajahayo doorashooyinka iyo wax ka beddelka lagu sameeyay dastuurka ku-meel-gaarka ah ee dalka. Labada dhinac ayaa hadda u ballansan in dib loo amba qaado wada-hadalladii u socday, oo ay dhex-dhexaadineyso beesha caalamka, si xal loo gaaro. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, wada-hadallada ayaa si rasmi ah dib loo bilaabayaa todobaadka soo socda, iyadoo qorshuhu yahay inay is arkaan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka, oo ka wada-hadli doono doodaha la xiriira nooca doorasho ee xilligan ka dhici karta dalka. Dhowaan xubnaha beesha caalamka ee dhex-dhexaadinta wada ayaa kulan la yeeshay Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka oo ay ka hadleen arrimaha la xiriira doorashooyinka waddanka iyo sida ay u noqon karaan kuwo lagu heshiiyo. The post Daawo: Xasan oo weerar culus ku qaaday mucaaradka DF appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Garsoore Cumar Cartan oo taariikh ka sameynaya UEFA Super Cup
items.description: Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed ee heerka caalami, Cumar Cabduqaadir Cartan, ayaa caawa taariikh cusub ka sameynaya kubadda cagta Yurub, isagoo noqonaya garsoorihii ugu horreeyay ee aan Yurub ka soo jeedin ee dhex-dhexaadiya kulanka UEFA Super Cup. Kulankan weyn, oo caawa 10:00 PM habeenimo ka dhici doona magaalada Salzburg ee dalka Austria, waxaa isaga hor imaanaya Paris Saint-Germain, oo ku guuleysatay UEFA Champions League, iyo Aston Villa oo qaaday UEFA Europa League . Tallaabadan ayaa muhiim u ah sababtoo ah waxay ka dhigan tahay guul taariikhi ah oo sharaf u ah Soomaaliya iyo guud ahaan qaaradda Afrika, iyadoo Cartan uu ku soo laabtay heer sare kadib markii loo diiday inuu galo Mareykanka si uu uga qayb qaato Koobka Adduunka bishii Juun . Garsoore Cartan, oo 34 jir ah, ayaa ku jira liiska garsoorayaasha caalamiga ah ee FIFA tan iyo sannadkii 2018, waxaana sannadkii 2025 loo magacaabay Garsooraha ugu fiican Afrika . Cartan ayaa laga saaray garsoorayaashii Koobka Adduunka ka dib markii uu yimid Miami International Airport, waxaana loo sheegay inuu “xiriir la leeyahay tuhmanayaal ka tirsan kooxo argagixiso ah” . Si kastaba ha ahaatee, UEFA ayaa ku magacaabay garsooraha kulanka Super Cup shan maalin ka dib, iyadoo ay ugu wacan tahay heshiis iskaashi oo u dhexeeya UEFA iyo CAF . Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya, Cali Cabdi Maxamed, ayaa guul weyn ku tilmaamay in Cartan iyo labadiisa caawiye oo kasoo kala jeeda Jabuuti iyo Kenya loo doorto inay dhex-dhexaadiyaan kulankan . Indhaha taageerayaasha Soomaaliyeed iyo kuwa Afrika ayaa caawa ku sii jeeda garoonka Red Bull Arena ee Salzburg, halkaas oo Garsoore Cumar Cabduqaadir Cartan uu magaca Soomaaliya ku qori doono bog cusub oo taariikhi ah oo kubadda cagta Yurub ah . The post Garsoore Cumar Cartan oo taariikh ka sameynaya UEFA Super Cup first appeared on Radio Dalsan .

items.title: Somali Journalist Released After 39 Days in NISA Detention
items.description: MOGADISHU – Somali journalist and Xogbile media founder Mascuud Warsame has been released after spending 39 days in detention by Somalia’s National Intelligence and Security Agency (NISA), according to the Somali Journalists Syndicate (SJS). SJS said Warsame was detained in Mogadishu on 30 June 2026 and released on 8 August without being charged or brought before a court. According to SJS, Warsame said he was initially taken to a police station in Hodan district before being transferred to a NISA detention facility near Mogadishu port. He told the journalists’ union that he was repeatedly questioned about his social media activity and reports published by Xogbile that were critical of the leadership of Southwest State. SJS said Warsame described being held in a dark and hot cell with limited access to his family. According to his account to the union, his health deteriorated during detention and he collapsed twice before being taken to a doctor under armed guard. SJS said Warsame was suffering from fever and weakness when he was released and was later diagnosed with malaria and allergic conditions. SJS welcomed Warsame’s release but raised concerns over his prolonged detention without charge, judicial appearance or regular access to family and legal representation. The union called on Somali authorities to end what it described as the use of intelligence and security agencies to intimidate or arbitrarily detain journalists and urged authorities to respect media freedom and due process. He told the journalists’ union that he was repeatedly questioned about his social media activity and reports published by Xogbile that were critical of the leadership of Southwest State. SJS said Warsame described being held in a dark and hot cell with limited access to his family. According to his account to the union, his health deteriorated during detention and he collapsed twice before being taken to a doctor under armed guard. SJS said Warsame was suffering from fever and weakness when he was released and was later diagnosed with malaria and allergic conditions. SJS welcomed Warsame’s release but raised concerns over his prolonged detention without charge, judicial appearance or regular access to family and legal representation. The union called on Somali authorities to end what it described as the use of intelligence and security agencies to intimidate or arbitrarily detain journalists and urged authorities to respect media freedom and due process. items.title: Ilyaas Lugatoor oo Garoowe Kaga Qaybgalay Maalinta Dhallinyarada SAWIRO
items.description: Garoowe (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka Puntland, Ilyaas Cismaan Lugatoor, ayaa maanta ka qayb galay munaasabadda Maalinta Caalamiga ah ee Dhallinyarada Adduunka, oo lagu qabtay magaalada Garoowe. Munaasabadda waxaa soo qabanqaabiyay Dalladda Dhallinyarada Puntland (PYAN), iyadoo kaashanaysa Wasaaradda Dhallinyarada, Ciyaaraha iyo Dalxiiska Puntland. Hal-ku-dhigga sanadkan ayaa ahaa “Doorka Dhallinyarada ee Horumarinta Nabadda, Wax ka Qabashada Isbeddelka Cimilada iyo Shaqo Abuurka”, iyadoo munaasabadda looga hadlay doorka dhallinyarada ee nabadda, horumarka, xasilloonida bulshada iyo wax ka qabashada saameynta isbeddelka cimilada. Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka ayaa bogaadiyay dhallinyarada Puntland iyo kaalinta ay ka qaataan arrimaha kala duwan ee bulshada, isagoo sheegay in dhallinyaradu yihiin mustaqbalka dalka iyo dadka, isla markaana ay Puntland muhiimad gaar ah siinayso. Munaasabadda waxaa sidoo kale ka qayb galay xubno ka tirsan goleyaasha Puntland, dhallinyarada, ururrada bulshada rayidka ah iyo marti-sharaf kale. items.title: Xog: Maxaa ka cusub wada-hadallada DF iyo mucaaradka?
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Waxaa la filayaa in maalmaha soo socda dib loo amba qaado wada-hadallada u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka ah ee Soomaaliya iyo kooxaha mucaaradka, oo ay dhex-dhexaadineyso beesha caalamka. Sida ay ogaatay Caasimada Online, wada-hadallada ayaa si rasmi ah dib loo bilaabayaa todobaadka soo socda, iyadoo qorshuhu yahay inay is arkaan Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka, oo ka wada-hadli doono doodaha la xiriira nooca doorasho ee xilligan ka dhici karta dalka. Labada dhinac ayaa ayaa hadda ku kala qaybsan nooca doorasho iyo qaabka ay u qabsoomayso, waxayna horay aragtiyadooda ugu gudbiyeen wakiillada beesha caalamka ee haatan dhex-dhexaadinta ka wada magaalada Muqdisho. Wararka ayaa intaas kusii daraya in kulamada la qorsheeyay todobaadka soo socda ay beesha caalamka kusoo bandhigi doonto nooca doorasho ee ay u aragto in laga qaban karo dalka, maadaama mucaaradka iyo dowladda ay isku khilaafeen go’aan ka gaaristeeda. Sida qorshuhu yahay wakiilada caalamka ayaa shaacin doono doorasho ka duwan kuwa ay gudbiyeen Dowladda Federaalka iyo Mucaaradka, balse lama oga in ay ku qancayaan dhinacyada isku haya hannaanka ay wax loo wado. Dhowaan xubnaha beesha caalamka ee dhex-dhexaadinta wada ayaa kulan la yeeshay Guddiga Doorashooyinka Qaranka oo ay ka hadleen arrimaha la xiriira doorashooyinka waddanka iyo sida ay u noqon karaan kuwo lagu heshiiyo. Si kastaba, Soomaaliya ayaa haatan ku jirta marxalad adag oo ka dhalatay isgoyska siyaasadeed ee ay taagan tahay, taas oo mugdi sii gelinaysa mustaqbalka dalka, maadaama aan weli si cad loo ogeyn jihada uu dalku u socdo. items.title: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Somaliland oo kulan la yeeshay safiirka dawladda Denmark
items.description: Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, Mudane Maxamed Cali Aw Cabdi, ayaa kulan muhiim ah Qasriga Madaxtooyada kula yeeshay Safiirka Dowladda Denmark, Mudane Steen Sonne Andersen, kulankaasi oo diiradda lagu saaray xoojinta xidhiidhka iyo iskaashiga u dhexeeya Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland iyo Denmark, gaar ahaan dhinacyada amniga iyo xasilloonida, horumarinta bulshada, kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, dimuqraadiyadda iyo doorashooyinka. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka waxa kulanka ku wehelinayey Wasiirka Madaxtooyada, Wasiirka Qorshaynta iyo Horumarinta Qaranka, Agaasimaha Guud ee Arrimaha Dibedda, Afhayeenka Madaxweynaha iyo Xoghayaha gaarka ah ee Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL ayaa Safiirka uga mahad naqay taageerada dhaqaale iyo ta horumarineed ee ay Dawladda Denmark siiso Somaliland, isaga oo xusay in iskaashiga noocan ahi uu door muhiim ah ka qaato horumarinta adeegyada bulshada, kobcinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha, xoojinta amniga iyo kobcinta Hay’adaha Dimuqraadiyadda iyo Doorashooyinka. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL waxa uu Safiirka ku adkeeyey muhimadda ay leedahay in Denmark ay sii xoojiso taageerada dhaqaale ee ay siiso Somaliland, gaar ahaan mashaariicda sida toos ah u taabanaya nolosha bulshada, horumarinta kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha iyo adkaynta Dawladnimada iyo nidaamka dimuqraadiyadda. Dhinaca kale, Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL ahna ku-simaha Madaxweynaha, waxa uu carrabka ku adkeeyey muhiimadda ay leedahay in Dawladda Denmark, Dalalka Iskaandineefiyanka iyo Midowga Yurub ay si dhab ah u qiimeeyaan xaaladda siyaasadeed iyo ta juqraafiyeed ee ka jirta Geeska Afrika, isla markaana ay gar-waaqsadaan xaqiiqada ka jirta Somaliland oo ah dal leh Hay’ado Qaran oo adag, nidaam dimuqraadiyadeed, nabadgelyo iyo Dawladnimo muddo dheer soo dhismaysay. Madaxweyne ku-xigeenka JSL waxa uu Safiirka Dawladda Denmark ku baraarujiyey in Somaliland ay mudan tahay in xaqiiqadeeda siyaasadeed loo wajaho si dhab ahaan ka tarjumaysa rabitaanka Shacabka JSL iyo kaalinta muhiimka ah ee ay Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ku leedahay nabadda, xasilloonida iyo guud ahaanba amniga Gobolka Geeska Afrika, gaar ahaan sugidda amniga marinnada istaraatiijiga ah ee Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed. Isaguna dhankiisa, Safiirka Denmark, Mudane Steen Sonne Andersen ayaa bogaadiyey amniga, xasilloonida, horumarka iyo hannaanka dimuqraadiga ah ee ka hana-qaaday Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland, isaga oo xusay muhiimadda ay leedahay in la sii xoojiyo iskaashiga labada dhinac. Safiirku waxa uu xaqiijiyey in Dawladda Denmark ay sii wadi doonto taageerada mashaariicda horumarineed ee waxtarka u leh bulshada Somaliland, gaar ahaan sii xoojinta taageerada ay Denmark muddada dheer ku lahayd Sanduuqa Horumarinta Somaliland (SDF), oo ah Sanduuq muhiim u ah maalgelinta mashaariicda horumarineed ee la jaanqaadaya arrimaha mudnaanta u leh Qaranka Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland. Kulanka waxa Safiirka ku wehelinayey madaxii hore ee Hay’adda DANIDA Somaliland (Mathias Kjaer), madaxa cusub ee DANIDA ⁠(Camilla Christensen) iyo Cabdiqani Maxamed Xuseen (Political Officer). Kulanka ayaa ku soo dhammaaday is-faham iyo aragti wadaag ku saabsan sii xoojinta iskaashiga iyo wada shaqaynta labada dhinac, iyada oo Jamhuuriyadda Somaliland ay muujisay in ay ka go’an tahay dhismaha xidhiidh caalami ah oo ku salaysan iskaashi waxtar leh, dano-wadaag iyo hiigsiga himilo horumarineed oo waarta.

items.title: Sacdiya Bajaaj oo maanta la sii daayay kadib markii go’aan…
items.description: Muqdisho (Caasimada Online) – Maxkamadda Racfaanka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa maanta xorriyadeeda dib u siisay Sacdiya Macallin Cali (Sacdiya Bajaaj) oo ay horay Maxkamadda Gobolka ugu soo xukuntay saddex sano oo xarig ah. Qareennada difaacayay Sacdiya ayaa soo qaatay racfaan, kadibna waxaa guda gashay Maxkamadda Racfaanka Gobolka oo maanta burisay xukunkii hore, iyada oo sheegtay in aan loo cuskan asbaab sharci ah. Garsooraha Maxkamadda ayaa ku dhawaaqay inay xor tahay Sacdiya Bajaaj oo in ka badan 100 maalmood ku xirneyd Xabsiga Dhexe ee Xamar. Intaas kadib waxaa warbaahinta la hadlay mid kamid ah qareennada u doodayay Sacdiya oo sheegay inay ku faraxsan yihiin go’aanka ay gaartay Maxkamadda. “Annaga markii hore waxaan aaminsaneyn in Sacdiya ay bari tahay aynaan fal dambiyeen gelin, Maxkamadda waxaa u cadaatay waana lasii daayay,” ayuu yiri Abuukaate Maxamed Sheekh oo u doodayay Sacdiya Macallin Cali. Fadhigga Maxkamadda waxaa maanta goobjoog ahaa ehellada Sacdiya Bajaaj, dadweyne isaga kala yimid xaafadaha Muqdisho iyo Wariyeyaasha oo soo tabinayay xukunka kasoo baxay Maxkamadda Racfaanka Gobolka Banaadir. Gabdhahan oo caan ka noqotay baraha bulshada ayaa horay si wayn uga soo muuqan jirtay warbaahinta, waxaana sidoo kale marar badan ay ka qayb gashay kulamo ay qabteen mucaaradka oo looga soo horjeeday Dowladda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, sii deynta Sacdiyo Macallin Cali ayaa dhalisay falcelin ballaaran, iyadoo dad badan oo Soomaaliyeed ay si weyn usoo dhaweeyeen xorriyaddeeda, kuna tilmaameen tallaabo farxad iyo rajo gelisay bulshada. Gabdhahan oo caan ka noqotay baraha bulshada ayaa horay si wayn uga soo muuqan jirtay warbaahinta, waxaana sidoo kale marar badan ay ka qayb gashay kulamo ay qabteen mucaaradka oo looga soo horjeeday Dowladda. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, sii deynta Sacdiyo Macallin Cali ayaa dhalisay falcelin ballaaran, iyadoo dad badan oo Soomaaliyeed ay si weyn usoo dhaweeyeen xorriyaddeeda, kuna tilmaameen tallaabo farxad iyo rajo gelisay bulshada. items.title: Hargeysa oo Laga Dareemayo Yaraanta Weelasha Cuntada
items.description: Hargeysa (Raxanreeb Online): Magaalada Hargeysa ayaa bishii u dambaysay laga dareemayay yaraanta weelasha hal mar la isticmaalo ee cuntada safaariga lagu qaato, kuwaas oo loo yaqaan “One Time Use”. Qaar ka mid ah ganacsatada ayaa yaraanta weelashan ku sababeeyay xidhnaanshaha marinnada muhiimka ah ee ay badeecaduhu uga soo geli jireen Somaliland. Qaar kamid ah hoteellada iyo maqaaxiyaha ayaa hadda cuntada macaamiisha ku ridaya bac, taas oo walaac ka dhalisay badqabka iyo nadaafadda cuntada. Meelaha weli laga heli karo weelashan ayaa iyaguna qiimahooda kor u qaaday, iyadoo la sheegay inay mararka qaar laba jibbaar ka badan yihiin qiimihii hore. Weelashan waxaa badanaa laga sameeyaa aluminium khafiif ah (aluminium foil), waxaana lagu farsameeyaa mashiinno gaar ah oo aluminium-ka lagu cadaadiyo laguna qaabeeyo. Waa kuwo fudud, kulaylka u adkaysta, isla markaana dib loo warshadayn karo. Dalalka sida weyn u soo saara weelashan waxaa kamid ah Shiinaha, Hindiya iyo Turkiga, waxaana suuqyada Somaliland lagu keenaa iyadoo dibadda laga soo dhoofiyo. items.title: Mareykanka ma wuxuu billaabay inuu dhinac maro DF kadib tallaabadii lama filaanka?
items.description: Boosaaso (Caasimada Online) — Horraantii bishan Agoosto, taliyaha ugu sarreeya ciidamada gaarka ah ee Mareykanka ee Afrika ayaa heshiis amni saxiixay isaga iyo madaxweynaha Puntland — oo ah maamul iskiis isu maamula oo ku yaalla waqooyi-bari Soomaaliya — si loo ballaariyo saldhigga milatari ee Mareykanka ee halkaas ku yaalla. Heshiiska ayaa bannaanka yimid kaddib bayaan kooban oo kasoo baxay dowladda Puntland. “Sida ku cad heshiiska, Mareykanku wuxuu ballaarin doonaa saldhiggiisa milatari ee Boosaaso si loo wanaajiyo howlgallada ka dhanka ah argagixisada, loogana qeyb qaato ilaalinta amniga badaha,” ayay Dowladda Puntland ee Soomaaliya ku sheegtay bayaan. “Dowladda Puntland waxaa ka go’an la-dagaallanka argagixisada iyo khatar kasta oo waxyeello u geysan karta amniga, xasilloonida iyo horumarka Puntland, Soomaaliya iyo Geeska Afrika.” Faahfaahin aad u yar ayaa laga hayaa heshiiskan, mana jiro qoraal rasmi ah oo shaacsan loo baahiyay, iyadoo sidoo kale uusan weli xaqiijin Taliska Mareykanka ee Afrika (AFRICOM) ama mas’uul kale oo ka tirsan dowladda Mareykanka. “Qaabka aan rasmiga ahayn ee arrintan loo maray aad ayey muhiim u tahay,” ayay tiri Samar Al-Bulushi, oo professor ku-xigeenka cilmiga anthropology-ga ee Jaamacadda California, Irvine, isla markaana ah cilmi-baare ka tirsan Quincy Institute. “Haddii Mareykanku doonayo inuu ku adkeysto sheegashadiisa — oo u muuqata inay sheegasho keliya tahay — ee ah inuu ixtiraamayo madax-bannaanida dowladda Soomaaliya, markaas aragti ahaan ma ahayn inuu heshiisyo rasmi ah la galo maamulladan ismaamulka ah.” Heshiiska ayaa lagu soo warramayaa in laga wada xaajooday iyada oo aan wax door ah laga siin dowladda dhexe ee Muqdisho — oo maamulka Puntland aanu aqoonsaneyn awooddeeda — taasoo muujineysa isbeddel muuqda oo ah dhanka sida loola macaamilayo dowlad-goboleedyada ku yaalla darafyada federaalka Soomaaliya, iyadoo loo qaadanayo dhinacyo madax-bannaan oo si toos ah heshiisyo loola geli karo. Inkastoo heshiiska laftiisu aanu caddeyn badan lahayn, haddana wuxuu muujinayaa jihada cusub ee ay suuragalka tahay in ay qaadeyso siyaasadda maamulka Trump ee Geeska Afrika. Khubaradu waxay sheegayaan in waxa ugu weyn ee arrintan riixaya ay tahay ballaarashada dagaalka Iran oo gaaray Badda Cas, halkii uu ka ahaan lahaa falcelin ku saabsan dhacdooyinka gudaha Soomaaliya. Hase yeeshee, tallaabadan waxay sidoo kale halis u tahay inay sii qoto-dheereyso khilaafka u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo dowlad-goboleedyada ay muddo dheer ku adkayd dowladda dhexe inay isku hayso. Xiriirka Mareykanka ee maamulladan ma aha mid gebi ahaanba cusub. Cameron Hudson, oo ah falanqeeye horeyna uga soo shaqeeyay agaasimaha arrimaha Afrika ee Golaha Amniga Qaranka Mareykanka, ayaa sheegay in Mareykanku muddo sannado ah Puntland u adeegsanayay meel uu kasoo abaabulo howlgallada gudaha Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan isagoo adeegsanaya saldhig ay Imaaraadka Carabta maamulaan oo ku yaalla magaalada dekedda ah ee Boosaaso. “Mareykanku waxay u badan tahay inuu hadda arko baahi muddo dheer ah oo ah inuu gobolka ku yeesho saldhig si buuxda isaga ugu gaar ah, isaga ayaana si buuxda u maamula,” ayuu Hudson yiri, isagoo sheegay in tallaabadan ay u badan tahay inay muujineyso koror ku yimaada duqeymaha milatari ee gudaha Soomaaliya ama inay qeyb ka tahay dadaal ballaaran oo lagula tacaalayo khataraha sii kordhaya ee gobolka. Washington ayaa sannado badan Soomaaliya ka wadday siyaasad loo yaqaan “dual-track”, taasoo ay isku mar ku taageerto dowladda dhexe ee Soomaaliya ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, isla markaana xiriir toos ah la dhisato maamul goboleedyada iyo kuwa maxalliga ah ee ka baxsan Muqdisho, sida Puntland ama Somaliland. AFRICOM waxay sheegtay inaysan qorsheyneyn inay saldhig milatari ka dhisto Somaliland, inkastoo qaar ka mid ah xildhibaannada Jamhuuriga ee Congress-ka ay Trump ugu baaqeen inuu aqoonsado madax-bannaanida maamulkaas. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale dhowaan noqday xubinta keliya ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ee aan cambaareyn aqoonsigii Israel ee Somaliland. Xiriirka lala leeyahay maamullada ku yaalla darafyada Soomaaliya ayaa yeeshay muhiimad istaraatiiji ah oo cusub tan iyo markii dagaalka Iran uu ku fiday Badda Cas. Kaddib markii Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay ku dhawaaqeen 20-kii July inay xannibaad dhinaca badda ah ku soo rogi doonaan Sacuudi Carabiya, gudaha Badda Cas, taasoo ay sheegeen inay jawaab u tahay weerarro cusub oo kaga yimid Riyadh, Washington iyo xulafadeeda ayaa raadinayay siyaabo looga hortagi karo in xannibaaddaasi sii carqaladeyso silsiladda sahayda adduunka. Saldhig ku yaalla Boosaaso wuxuu ciidamada Mareykanka u dhoweyn karaa furintaas dagaalka. “Maamulka Trump waxaa laga yaabaa inuu dib uga fiirsanayo qaabka uu ula macaamilayo Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri Ahmed Ibrahim, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay anthropology-ga bulshada iyo dhaqanka, isla markaana wax badan ka qoray Geeska Afrika. Muddo sannad iyo bar ah, maamulka Trump wuxuu inta badan ka fogaaday inuu ballaariyo joogitaankiisa dhulka ee Bariga Afrika, ayuu yiri Ibrahim, isaga oo taa beddelkeeda xoogga saaray duqeymaha diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee lagula dagaallamayo kooxaha argagixisada sida Al-Shabaab. Trump ayaa sannadkii hore Soomaaliya ka fuliyay rikoor dhan 124 duqeyn, waxaana intaas u dheer 78 duqeyn oo kale oo la fuliyay ilaa hadda 2026, taasoo aad uga badan 51-kii duqeyn ee guud ahaan la fuliyay muddadii Madaxweyne Joe Biden xilka hayay. Inkastoo tallaabadani ay muujin karto isbeddel ku yimid habka Mareykanku ula macaamilayo Soomaaliya, dagaalka Iran iyo saameyntiisa ayaa ah waxa ugu weyn ee arrintan dedejinaya, sida uu sheegay Michael Woldemariam, oo ah professor ku-xigeen ka tirsan Jaamacadda Maryland, isla markaana ah cilmi-baare sare oo aan deegaan aheyn oo ka tirsan Atlantic Council. “Arrintan runtii waxaa keliya oo lagu fahmi karaa marka laga eego su’aasha Badda Cas,” ayuu yiri. “Way igu adag tahay inaan fahmo waxa macquulka ka dhigaya arrintan haddii aanay jirin diiradda sii kordheysa ee lagu hayo Badda Cas, Khaliijka iyo arrimaha amniga badaha.” Fikirkaas ayaa sharxi kara sababta Puntland, halkii ay ka ahaan lahayd Jabuuti oo xuduud la leh waqooyi-galbeed Soomaaliya, ay u noqotay mid ka mid ah saaxiibada ay Washington doorbideyso marka ay dooneyso inay ballaariso marin-u-helkeeda agagaarka marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab — oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isla markaana ay maraan 10 ilaa 12 boqolkiiba maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamka — sida ay sheegtay Al-Bulushi. Jabuuti waxay martigelisaa Camp Lemonnier, oo ah saldhigga joogtada ah ee ugu weyn Mareykanka ku leeyahay qaaradda Afrika, balse dowladdeedu waxay xariiq cad sameysay tan iyo markii uu billowday dagaalka Israel ee Gaza iyo weerarradii xigay ee Badda Cas, iyadoo Washington u sheegtay inaysan saldhigga ciidanka badda ee dalkeeda uga duuli karin weerarro ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta, sababo la xiriira cabsi laga qabo in arrintaasi Jabuuti kusoo jiiddo dagaalka. Saldhigga Puntland ayaa AFRICOM siin kara dabacsanaan howlgaleed oo noocaas ah. Al-Bulushi waxay qorshahan bilowga ah ku tilmaantay mid ka tarjumaya xiriir “milatari-ilaa-milatari ah”, kaasoo u muuqda inuu inta badan meesha ka saarayo wakiillada la soo doortay, diblomaasiyiinta ama mas’uuliyiinta siyaasadeed ee labada dhinac. “Arrintani waxay dib ugu laabaneysaa maamulkii koowaad ee Trump iyo kaddib maamulkii Biden, kuwaasoo ciidamada Mareykanka, gaar ahaan AFRICOM, siiyay awood aad u ballaaran oo aan ku koobneyn oo keliya inay galaan wada-xaajoodyo oo ay heshiisyo gaaraan, balse sidoo kale inay howlgallo ka fuliyaan dhulka iyaga oo aan la tashan qeybaha kale ee dowladda Mareykanka,” ayay tiri. Hudson wuxuu sheegay in ballaarinta saldhigga Puntland ay qeyb ka noqon karto dadaal ballaaran oo taliska dagaalka uu ku doonayo inuu “qiil ugu sameeyo jiritaankiisa”, isagoo xusay in AFRICOM la sheegay inay ka mid aheyd hay’adihii la qorsheynayay in la dhimo ama la baabi’iyo bilowgii xilliga Trump, balse tan iyo markaas uu qaaradda ka helay ujeeddo cusub. Saraakiisha AFRICOM ayaa sidoo kale la kulmay madaxda Jubaland, oo ah dowlad-goboleed kale oo federaal ah oo aan aqoonsaneyn awoodda Muqdisho, maalmo ka hor inta aysan dowladda Puntland ku dhawaaqin heshiiskan. Dadaalladan ayaa xoojin kara hannaan halis u ah inuu sii qoto-dheereeyo kala qeybsanaanta uu Mareykanku sheegayo inuu doonayo in la xalliyo. “Waxaan abuureynaa saadaal iyadu iskeed isu rumeyneysa,” ayuu yiri Hudson. “Haddii aan ka cabanno tabar-darrida iyo kala qeybsanaanta, dabadeedna aan hakino taageeradii dowladda dhexe oo aan xoojino maamullada ku yaalla darafyada, markaas waxaan dedejineynaa isla arrinta aan sida ugu weyn uga cabaneyno.” Woldemariam wuxuu ku doodayaa in siyaasadda Soomaaliya ay durba u socotay jihada xasillooni-darrada ka hor heshiiskan, isagoo tilmaamay khilaafaadka aan weli la xallin ee ku saabsan isbeddellada dastuurka, kuwaasoo hakiyay wada-shaqeyntii Muqdisho iyo maamullada ka go’ay. “Ma hubo in iskaashiga amni ee lala yeesho Puntland ama Somaliland uu xaaladda sii xumeynayo. Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan durba joogno heer aad looga walaaco,” ayuu yiri. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu weli ka digayaa jihada ay qaadan karto siyaasadda gobolka ee Mareykanka kaddib ballaarinta saldhigga milatari ee Puntland. “Qiiq badan ayaa halkan ka muuqda,” ayuu yiri Woldemariam. “Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u soconno jihada joogitaanka Mareykanka ee si weyn loo ballaariyay dhammaan xeebaha Badda Cas ee Geeska Afrika. Ugu dambeyn, qaabka uu joogitaankaasi yeelan doono wali lama oga.” The post Mareykanka ma wuxuu billaabay inuu dhinac maro DF kadib tallaabadii lama filaanka? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

Hase yeeshee, tallaabadan waxay sidoo kale halis u tahay inay sii qoto-dheereyso khilaafka u dhexeeya Muqdisho iyo dowlad-goboleedyada ay muddo dheer ku adkayd dowladda dhexe inay isku hayso. Xiriirka Mareykanka ee maamulladan ma aha mid gebi ahaanba cusub. Cameron Hudson, oo ah falanqeeye horeyna uga soo shaqeeyay agaasimaha arrimaha Afrika ee Golaha Amniga Qaranka Mareykanka, ayaa sheegay in Mareykanku muddo sannado ah Puntland u adeegsanayay meel uu kasoo abaabulo howlgallada gudaha Soomaaliya, gaar ahaan isagoo adeegsanaya saldhig ay Imaaraadka Carabta maamulaan oo ku yaalla magaalada dekedda ah ee Boosaaso. “Mareykanku waxay u badan tahay inuu hadda arko baahi muddo dheer ah oo ah inuu gobolka ku yeesho saldhig si buuxda isaga ugu gaar ah, isaga ayaana si buuxda u maamula,” ayuu Hudson yiri, isagoo sheegay in tallaabadan ay u badan tahay inay muujineyso koror ku yimaada duqeymaha milatari ee gudaha Soomaaliya ama inay qeyb ka tahay dadaal ballaaran oo lagula tacaalayo khataraha sii kordhaya ee gobolka. Washington ayaa sannado badan Soomaaliya ka wadday siyaasad loo yaqaan “dual-track”, taasoo ay isku mar ku taageerto dowladda dhexe ee Soomaaliya ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay, isla markaana xiriir toos ah la dhisato maamul goboleedyada iyo kuwa maxalliga ah ee ka baxsan Muqdisho, sida Puntland ama Somaliland. AFRICOM waxay sheegtay inaysan qorsheyneyn inay saldhig milatari ka dhisto Somaliland, inkastoo qaar ka mid ah xildhibaannada Jamhuuriga ee Congress-ka ay Trump ugu baaqeen inuu aqoonsado madax-bannaanida maamulkaas. Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale dhowaan noqday xubinta keliya ee Golaha Ammaanka ee Qaramada Midoobay ee aan cambaareyn aqoonsigii Israel ee Somaliland. Xiriirka lala leeyahay maamullada ku yaalla darafyada Soomaaliya ayaa yeeshay muhiimad istaraatiiji ah oo cusub tan iyo markii dagaalka Iran uu ku fiday Badda Cas. Kaddib markii Xuutiyiinta Yemen ay ku dhawaaqeen 20-kii July inay xannibaad dhinaca badda ah ku soo rogi doonaan Sacuudi Carabiya, gudaha Badda Cas, taasoo ay sheegeen inay jawaab u tahay weerarro cusub oo kaga yimid Riyadh, Washington iyo xulafadeeda ayaa raadinayay siyaabo looga hortagi karo in xannibaaddaasi sii carqaladeyso silsiladda sahayda adduunka. Saldhig ku yaalla Boosaaso wuxuu ciidamada Mareykanka u dhoweyn karaa furintaas dagaalka. “Maamulka Trump waxaa laga yaabaa inuu dib uga fiirsanayo qaabka uu ula macaamilayo Soomaaliya,” ayuu yiri Ahmed Ibrahim, oo ah khabiir ku takhasusay anthropology-ga bulshada iyo dhaqanka, isla markaana wax badan ka qoray Geeska Afrika. Muddo sannad iyo bar ah, maamulka Trump wuxuu inta badan ka fogaaday inuu ballaariyo joogitaankiisa dhulka ee Bariga Afrika, ayuu yiri Ibrahim, isaga oo taa beddelkeeda xoogga saaray duqeymaha diyaaradaha aan duuliyaha lahayn ee lagula dagaallamayo kooxaha argagixisada sida Al-Shabaab. Trump ayaa sannadkii hore Soomaaliya ka fuliyay rikoor dhan 124 duqeyn, waxaana intaas u dheer 78 duqeyn oo kale oo la fuliyay ilaa hadda 2026, taasoo aad uga badan 51-kii duqeyn ee guud ahaan la fuliyay muddadii Madaxweyne Joe Biden xilka hayay. Inkastoo tallaabadani ay muujin karto isbeddel ku yimid habka Mareykanku ula macaamilayo Soomaaliya, dagaalka Iran iyo saameyntiisa ayaa ah waxa ugu weyn ee arrintan dedejinaya, sida uu sheegay Michael Woldemariam, oo ah professor ku-xigeen ka tirsan Jaamacadda Maryland, isla markaana ah cilmi-baare sare oo aan deegaan aheyn oo ka tirsan Atlantic Council. “Arrintan runtii waxaa keliya oo lagu fahmi karaa marka laga eego su’aasha Badda Cas,” ayuu yiri. “Way igu adag tahay inaan fahmo waxa macquulka ka dhigaya arrintan haddii aanay jirin diiradda sii kordheysa ee lagu hayo Badda Cas, Khaliijka iyo arrimaha amniga badaha.” Fikirkaas ayaa sharxi kara sababta Puntland, halkii ay ka ahaan lahayd Jabuuti oo xuduud la leh waqooyi-galbeed Soomaaliya, ay u noqotay mid ka mid ah saaxiibada ay Washington doorbideyso marka ay dooneyso inay ballaariso marin-u-helkeeda agagaarka marin-biyoodka Bab al-Mandab — oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isla markaana ay maraan 10 ilaa 12 boqolkiiba maraakiibta ganacsiga caalamka — sida ay sheegtay Al-Bulushi. Jabuuti waxay martigelisaa Camp Lemonnier, oo ah saldhigga joogtada ah ee ugu weyn Mareykanka ku leeyahay qaaradda Afrika, balse dowladdeedu waxay xariiq cad sameysay tan iyo markii uu billowday dagaalka Israel ee Gaza iyo weerarradii xigay ee Badda Cas, iyadoo Washington u sheegtay inaysan saldhigga ciidanka badda ee dalkeeda uga duuli karin weerarro ka dhan ah Xuutiyiinta, sababo la xiriira cabsi laga qabo in arrintaasi Jabuuti kusoo jiiddo dagaalka. Saldhigga Puntland ayaa AFRICOM siin kara dabacsanaan howlgaleed oo noocaas ah. Al-Bulushi waxay qorshahan bilowga ah ku tilmaantay mid ka tarjumaya xiriir “milatari-ilaa-milatari ah”, kaasoo u muuqda inuu inta badan meesha ka saarayo wakiillada la soo doortay, diblomaasiyiinta ama mas’uuliyiinta siyaasadeed ee labada dhinac. “Arrintani waxay dib ugu laabaneysaa maamulkii koowaad ee Trump iyo kaddib maamulkii Biden, kuwaasoo ciidamada Mareykanka, gaar ahaan AFRICOM, siiyay awood aad u ballaaran oo aan ku koobneyn oo keliya inay galaan wada-xaajoodyo oo ay heshiisyo gaaraan, balse sidoo kale inay howlgallo ka fuliyaan dhulka iyaga oo aan la tashan qeybaha kale ee dowladda Mareykanka,” ayay tiri. Hudson wuxuu sheegay in ballaarinta saldhigga Puntland ay qeyb ka noqon karto dadaal ballaaran oo taliska dagaalka uu ku doonayo inuu “qiil ugu sameeyo jiritaankiisa”, isagoo xusay in AFRICOM la sheegay inay ka mid aheyd hay’adihii la qorsheynayay in la dhimo ama la baabi’iyo bilowgii xilliga Trump, balse tan iyo markaas uu qaaradda ka helay ujeeddo cusub. Saraakiisha AFRICOM ayaa sidoo kale la kulmay madaxda Jubaland, oo ah dowlad-goboleed kale oo federaal ah oo aan aqoonsaneyn awoodda Muqdisho, maalmo ka hor inta aysan dowladda Puntland ku dhawaaqin heshiiskan. Dadaalladan ayaa xoojin kara hannaan halis u ah inuu sii qoto-dheereeyo kala qeybsanaanta uu Mareykanku sheegayo inuu doonayo in la xalliyo. “Waxaan abuureynaa saadaal iyadu iskeed isu rumeyneysa,” ayuu yiri Hudson. “Haddii aan ka cabanno tabar-darrida iyo kala qeybsanaanta, dabadeedna aan hakino taageeradii dowladda dhexe oo aan xoojino maamullada ku yaalla darafyada, markaas waxaan dedejineynaa isla arrinta aan sida ugu weyn uga cabaneyno.” Woldemariam wuxuu ku doodayaa in siyaasadda Soomaaliya ay durba u socotay jihada xasillooni-darrada ka hor heshiiskan, isagoo tilmaamay khilaafaadka aan weli la xallin ee ku saabsan isbeddellada dastuurka, kuwaasoo hakiyay wada-shaqeyntii Muqdisho iyo maamullada ka go’ay. “Ma hubo in iskaashiga amni ee lala yeesho Puntland ama Somaliland uu xaaladda sii xumeynayo. Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan durba joogno heer aad looga walaaco,” ayuu yiri. Hase yeeshee, wuxuu weli ka digayaa jihada ay qaadan karto siyaasadda gobolka ee Mareykanka kaddib ballaarinta saldhigga milatari ee Puntland. “Qiiq badan ayaa halkan ka muuqda,” ayuu yiri Woldemariam. “Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u soconno jihada joogitaanka Mareykanka ee si weyn loo ballaariyay dhammaan xeebaha Badda Cas ee Geeska Afrika. Ugu dambeyn, qaabka uu joogitaankaasi yeelan doono wali lama oga.” The post Mareykanka ma wuxuu billaabay inuu dhinac maro DF kadib tallaabadii lama filaanka? appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Ilhaan Cumar oo Minnesota Guul Ka Gaartay
items.description: USA (Raxanreeb Online): Waxaa si xamaasad leh uga socda dalka Mareykanka doorashooyinka isreeb-reebka xisbiyada, kuwaas oo lagu kala saarayo musharraxiinta xisbiyada u matali doona doorashada guud ee la qorsheynayo inay dalkaas ka dhacdo dabayaaqada sannadkan. Gobolka Minnesota ayaa kamid ah meelaha sida weyn loogu loollamayo, iyadoo dhawaan lasoo gabagabeeyay doorashooyin loogu tartamayay kuraas kala duwan. Xildhibaannadda Soomaaliyeed Ilhaan Cumar ayaa ku guuleysatay doorashada isreeb-reebka Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ee degmada 5-aad ee Minnesota, iyadoo heshay in ka badan 80% codadkii la dhiibtay, kana adkaatay musharraxiintii la tartamay. Sidoo kale, Amy Klobuchar ayaa ku soo baxday tartanka Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ee Minnesota, iyadoo horey u ahayd Senator gobolka ku matasha Aqalka Sare ee Mareykanka. Mid kamid ah Soomaalida ka qeyb gashay codeynta ayaa sheegay in bulshada Soomaaliyeed ay si weyn u taageereen Ilhaan Cumar, isagoo yiri: “Anaga maba naqaan cid la tartameysay Ilhaan, iyada ayaan u codeynay oo aan guusha u rabnay.” The post Ilhaan Cumar oo Minnesota Guul Ka Gaartay appeared first on Raxanreeb Online .

items.title: Deni oo Xarigga Ka Jaray Waddada Bacaadweyn-Gaalkacyo
items.description: Mudug (Raxanreeb Online): Madaxweynaha Puntland, Siciid Cabdullaahi Deni, ayaa shalay si rasmi ah xarigga uga jaray wejiga koowaad ee waddada laamiga ah ee isku xirta Bacaadweyn iyo Gaalkacyo ee gobolka Mudug. Qaybta la dhameystiray ee waddada ayaa dhererkeedu yahay 20 KM, iyadoo ay marto deegaannada Heemo, Cagaaran, Horogle iyo Laanta-dusmada. Mashruucan ayaa lagu sheegay in lagu hirgeliyay cashuurtii shacabka oo dib loogu celiyay horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha Puntland. Shirkadda Kebarco Construction Co ayaa dhistay 13 KM oo kamid ah waddada, halka shirkadda Albaashi ay dhistay 7-da KM ee kale. items.title: Maxay goosashada Janan ka beddeli kartaa xaaladda Gedo?
items.description: Beledxaawo (Caasimada Online) – Falcelin iyo hadal-heyn xooggan ayaa ka dhalatay goosashada Cabdirashiid Janan oo mar kale dib ula midoobay maamulka Jubbaland, kadib markii uu ka baxay garabka Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Janan ayaa hadda ahaa Taliyaha NISA ee gobolka Gedo, wuxuuna wada-hadal hoose la galay Axmed Madoobe, kaas oo dhaliyay inay wada gaaraan heshiis rasmi ah. Siyaasiga Cabdisataar Xasan Cali oo ka hadlay arrinta Cabdirashiid Janaan ayaa shaaca ka qaaday in goosashadiisa aysan waxba ka beddeli doonin xaaladda Gedo, sababo la xiriira siyaasadaha is diidan ee weli ka jira gobolkaasi. “Cabdirashiid Janan in fikikiisa uu isbeddalay kuma imaaneyso xasilloonida gobolka Gedo, waana wax guur guuraayo siyaasadaha gobolkan sida dabeyshii oo kale,” ayuu yiri siyaasi Cabdisataar Xasan Cali oo la hadlay Radio Kulmiye. Sidoo kale, wuxuu tilmaamay arrinta gobolka Gedo ay lamid tahay xaaladda reer Hiiraan oo iyana tabasho ka qaba maamul goboleedka HirShabelle. “Xaaladda gobolka Gedo waxay la mid tahay arrinta gobolka Hiiraan oo ka cowda maamulka HirShabelle marka siyaasado guur guuraayo ayaa ka jira labadaas gobol oo ka kala tirsan HirShabelle iyo Jubbaland,” ayuu sii raaciyay. Illaa iyo hadda ma jiro wax hadal ah oo kasoo baxay Dowladda Federaalka oo ku aadan arrinta Cabdirashiid Janan oo haatan u wareegay dhanka Jubbaland, waxaana la filayaa in dhowaan uu la kulmo Madaxweyne Axmed Madoobe. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Janan oo ah nin siyaasad ahaan isbedbeddala, ayaa horay sidaan oo kale dhabarka uga jabiyay dowladdii Madaxweyne Farmaajo, xilligaasna dib ula heshiiyay Axmed Madoobe, isaga oo mar kale maanta ku sameeyay Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud. items.title: Ugu yaraan 15 qof oo ku geeriyooday doon rakaab oo ku degtay Harada Kariba ee Zimbabwe
items.description: Ugu yaraan 15 qof ayaa ku dhintay, halka 27 qof oo kale weli la la’yahay, kadib markii doon rakaab oo buux-dhaaf ah ay ku rogmatay Harada Kariba ee dalka Zimbabwe. Hay’adda Ilaalinta Madaniga ah ee Zimbabwe ayaa sheegtay in shilku dhacay Talaadadii, xilli doonta ay la kulantay mowjado xooggan. Sida hay’addu sheegtay, ugu yaraan 77 qof ayaa la soo badbaadiyey, ayadoo doontani ay u kala gooshi jirtay magaalada Kariba ee waqooyiga Zimbabwe iyo jasiirado iyo xeryo kalluumeysi oo ku yaalla harada. Saraakiishu waxay sheegeen in doontu sidday dad ka badan awooddeedii loogu talagalay oo ahayd 90 qof. Tirada saxda ah ee dadka saarnaa doonta weli lama xaqiijin, balse hay’adaha Zimbabwe waxay sheegeen in diiwaanka tigidhada uu muujinayo in ay saarnaayeen ugu yaraan 114 rakaab ah oo qaangaar ah iyo shan shaqaale ah. Booliska qaranka Zimbabwe ayaa sheegay in hawlgallada baadigoobka iyo samatabbixintu ay socdaan, ayadoo warbaahinta dowladda ee ZBC ay baahisay muuqaallo muujinaya doonyo xawaare sare ku socda oo ku wajahan doon u muuqata inay rogmatay, iyadoo diyaarad nooca helicopter-ka ah ay hawada ka dul wareegaysay goobta. Koox ka shaqaysa baaritaanka biyaha hoostooda ayaa sidoo kale loo diray harada si ay uga qaybqaadato raadinta dadka la la’yahay. Markhaati lagu magacaabo Maxton Kanhema, oo la hadlay AFP, ayaa sheegay in doonta safarkeeda bilowday xilli cimiladu xumayd, wuxuuna intaa ku daray in hir xooggan laga yaabo inuu ku dhuftay doonta, taasoo keentay in matooradeedu istaagaan. Haradu waxay ka samaysantay dhismaha biyo-xireenka Kariba oo lagu xannibay webiga Zambezi dabayaaqadii 1950-meeyadii iyo bilowgii 1960-meeyadii,waxayna dherer ahaan ka badan tahay 200km, halka meelo ka mid ah ballaceedu gaarayo ku dhowaad 40km. Shilkan ayaa mar kale soo bandhigay khatarta ka dhalan karta isku-darka rakaab badan, xaalado cimilo oo adag iyo safarrada gaadiidka biyaha, iyadoo hawlgallada baadigoobka dadka la la’yahay ay weli socdaan.

items.title: Maxkamadda Rafcaanka Gobolka Banaadir oo Maanta Go’aan ka Soo Saaraysa Dacwadda Sacadiya Bajaaj
items.description: Maxkamadda Rafcaanka Gobolka Banaadir ayaa maanta la filayaa inay go’aan ka soo saarto dacwadda Sacadiya Bajaaj, oo wajahaysa eedeymo la xariira kicin dadweyne iyo aflagaado ka dhan ah madaxda qaranka, sida ay xeer-ilaalintu sheegtay. Sacadiya Bajaaj ayaa horey Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir ugu xukuntay saddex sano oo xabsi ah, kaddib fadhiyo kala duwan oo ay kiiskeeda ka yeelatay. Qareennada Sacadiya ayaa racfaan ka qaatay xukunkaasi, iyagoo Maxkamadda Rafcaanka ka dalbaday in dib loo eego go’aankii Maxkamadda Gobolka Banaadir, isla markaana la buriyo ama wax laga beddelo xukunkii saddexda sano ahaa. Dacwaddan ayaa muddooyinkii u dambeeyay si weyn loo hadal hayay, gaar ahaan baraha bulshada, iyadoo dad badan ay si dhow ula socdeen marxaladaha kala duwan ee kiiska iyo xaaladda Sacadiya oo muddo ku jirtay xabsiga. Maanta ayaa indhaha lagu hayaa go’aanka Maxkamadda Rafcaanka, iyadoo qareennada iyo dhinacyada kale ee kiiska ay sugayaan xukunka kama dambaysta ah ee ay maxkamaddu ka gaari doonto racfaanka. Go’aanka Maxkamadda Rafcaanka ayaa noqon doona mid muhiim u ah Sacadiya Bajaaj iyo qareennadeeda, kuwaas oo rajeynaya in xukunkii hore la buriyo ama wax laga beddelo, halka dhinaca kale ay maxkamaddu qiimeyn doonto doodihii iyo caddeymihii la horgeeyay intii ay socotay dacwaddu.
