items.title: Sida yaabka leh ee Trump uga baxsaday shirqoolkii Iran ku khaarajin rabtay ee Ankara
items.description: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa bishii hore si qarsoodi ah loogu dhex qariyay konteenar lagu qaado cuntada diyaaradaha, lagana dejiyay diyaaradda Air Force One, kadib markii saraakiisha Mareykanka ay heleen xog lagu kalsoonaan karo oo sheegeysay in Iiraan ay dooneysay in ay khaarajiso. Howlgalka oo ka dhacay Turkiga 8-dii July, kadib shir madaxeedkii NATO, ayaa qeyb ka ahaa qorshe marin-habaabin ah oo si degdeg ah loo diyaariyay, sida ay sheegeen laba sarkaal oo sare oo Mareykan ah oo la hadlay New York Times . Trump ayaa markii hore isaga oo ay duubayaan kaamiradaha galay mid ka mid ah diyaaradaha duugga ah ee Air Force One, taas oo wariyeyaasha iyo dadweynuhu u qaateen inuu Britain ugu duulayo. Laakiin markii wariyeyaasha la socday madaxweynaha ay dhinaca kale diyaaradda kaga mashquulsanaayeen fuulitaanka, Trump ayaa si qarsoodi ah looga saaray dhinaca kale. Saraakiisha ayaa sheegay in konteenar wiish sare loogu qaado, oo caadi ahaan loo adeegsado in cuntada iyo agabka kale lagu geliyo diyaaradaha, loo adeegsaday in madaxweynaha laga soo dejiyo dhinaca aanay wariyeyaashu arki karin. Waxaa kadib lagu qaaday gaari waxaana loo wareejiyay diyaarad militari oo saddexaad, taas oo si qarsoodi ah uga qaaday Turkiga kuna geysay Britain. Washington Post ayaa markii hore werisay in diyaaraddaas ay ahayd C-32A, oo ah nooca militariga ee Boeing 757. Sidee qorshaha u dhacay? Trump iyo saraakiishiisa ayaa xilligaas si shaacsan u sheegay inuu Turkiga kaga baxayo diyaaradda duugga ah ee Air Force One halkii uu isticmaali lahaa Boeing 747-8 cusub oo Qatar ay siisay Mareykanka. Trump wuxuu wariyeyaasha u sheegay inuu diyaaradda hore u raacayo “xusuustii hore darteed”. Muuqaal ayaa laga duubay isaga oo albaabka bidix ka galaya diyaaradda, halka wariyeyaasha la socda ay iyaguna fuuleen iyagoo rumeysnaa in madaxweynuhu gudaha ku jiro. Laakiin diyaaraddaas waxaa dhab ahaantii loo adeegsaday marin-habaabin ahaan iyo in lagu khaldo Iiraan. Wariyeyaasha iyo qaar ka mid ah shaqaalaha Aqalka Cad looma sheegin in Trump uusan diyaaradda la socon, taas oo ka dhigtay kuwo iyagoo aan ogeyn qeyb ka noqday qorshaha lagu qarinayay halka uu madaxweynuhu ku sugnaa. Markii diyaaradda duugga ah ay Turkiga ka kacday, wariyeyaasha saarnaa waxaa sidoo kale lagu amray inay xirtaan daahyada daaqadaha. Diyaaradda ayaa 10:16 habeenimo ka degtay saldhigga ciidamada Mareykanka ee Mildenhall ee Britain. Hase yeeshee, Trump ayaa xilligaas hore Britain ugu yimid diyaaraddii militariga ee qarsoodiga ahayd. Waxaa gaari looga soo qaaday diyaaraddaas, kadibna dib loogu geeyay Air Force One-ka, oo uu ka galay albaab kale. Qiyaastii 40 daqiiqo kadib ayuu Trump kasoo degay albaabka sare ee Air Force One iyadoo wariyeyaashu daawanayaan, taas oo abuurtay muuqaal muujinayay inuu diyaaraddaas Turkiga kaga yimid. Kadib ayuu garoonka lug uga gudbay diyaaradda cusub ee Qatar ay siisay, taas oo isaga iyo wariyeyaashu Washington ugu duuleen. Hanjabaad Iran laga helay Qorshaha ayaa la sheegay in saacado gudahood lagu diyaariyay kadib markii saraakiisha Mareykanka ay go’aamiyeen in halista Iran ay tahay mid dhab ah. Trump ayaa intii uu Turkiga joogay lagu wargeliyay khatarta, waxaana howlgalka ku lug lahaa koox kooban oo saraakiil sare ah. Waxaa ka mid ahaa xoghayaha difaaca Pete Hegseth iyo guddoomiyaha Taliyeyaasha Guud ee ciidamada Mareykanka, General Dan Caine. Warbixinnadii hore ayaa diiradda saarayay ammaanka diyaaradda Boeing 747-8 ee Qatar ay siisay Mareykanka, taas oo aan weli lagu rakibin dhammaan qalabka difaaca ee ku jira diyaaradaha kale ee madaxweynaha. Laakiin dadka xog-ogaalka ah ayaa sheegay in hanjabaadda Iran aysan ku koobneyn diyaaraddaas. Waxay sheegeen in Trump lagu bartilmaameedsanayay diyaaradda kasta oo uu ku safri lahaa, taas oo keentay in saraakiishu adeegsadaan dhowr heer oo marin-habaabin ah. Markii Trump la weydiiyay sababta diyaaraddii hore uu uga raacay Turkiga, wuxuu sheegay inuu doonayay in ciidamada Mareykanka ee ku sugan Britain ay arkaan diyaaradda cusub. Wariyeyaashu waxay sidoo kale weydiiyeen sababta loogu amray inay daahyada daaqadaha xiraan. Trump wuxuu sheegay inuusan ogeyn hanjabaad gaar ah, balse uu muddo dheer bartilmaameed u ahaa Iran. “Aniga ayaa lambarka koowaad kaga jira liiskooda, idinka ka hor,” ayuu yiri. Trump iyo hanjabaadaha Iran Trump iyo qaar ka mid ah la-taliyeyaashiisa ayaa muddo sanado ah wajahaya shirqoolo lala xiriirinayo Iran. Xiisadda ayaa si weyn u korortay kadib markii Trump uu muddadiisii koowaad ee madaxtinimada uu amray weerarkii 2020 lagu dilay General Qassem Soleimani, oo ahaa taliyihii ciidamada Quds ee Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran. Intii lagu jiray ololihii doorashada 2024, saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale helay xog sirdoon oo muujineysay in Iran ay weli dooneyso inay waxyeello u geysato Trump. Arrintaas ayaa mararka qaar keentay in ololihiisa lagu isticmaalo diyaarado marin-habaabin ah, iyadoo Trump lagu qaadi jiray diyaarad qarsoodi ah halka shaqaalihiisu ay raacayeen diyaaraddiisa gaarka ah. Maamulka madaxweynihii hore Joe Biden ayaa xagaagii 2024 kordhiyay ilaalinta Trump kadib xog cusub oo ku saabsan qorshayaal lagu dili karo. Trump ayaa isla sanadkaas ka badbaaday laba isku day dil oo aan lala xiriirin Iran, mid ka dhacay Butler, Pennsylvania, iyo mid kale oo dhacay bishii September. Howlgalkii Turkiga ayaa haddana ahaa mid aan caadi ahayn, maadaama ay aad dhif u tahay in madaxweynaha Mareykanka si qarsoodi ah loo raro iyadoo wariyeyaasha rasmiga ah ee la socda aanay ogeyn halka uu dhab ahaantii ku sugan yahay. Saraakiisha amniga ayaa ku doodaya in marka khatar toos ah jirto, ilaalinta madaxweynaha ay ka horreyso in dadweynaha iyo saxaafadda loo sheego faahfaahinta dhaq-dhaqaaqiisa. items.fullContent: Washington (Caasimada Online) — Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump ayaa bishii hore si qarsoodi ah loogu dhex qariyay konteenar lagu qaado cuntada diyaaradaha, lagana dejiyay diyaaradda Air Force One, kadib markii saraakiisha Mareykanka ay heleen xog lagu kalsoonaan karo oo sheegeysay in Iiraan ay dooneysay in ay khaarajiso. Howlgalka oo ka dhacay Turkiga 8-dii July, kadib shir madaxeedkii NATO, ayaa qeyb ka ahaa qorshe marin-habaabin ah oo si degdeg ah loo diyaariyay, sida ay sheegeen laba sarkaal oo sare oo Mareykan ah oo la hadlay New York Times . Trump ayaa markii hore isaga oo ay duubayaan kaamiradaha galay mid ka mid ah diyaaradaha duugga ah ee Air Force One, taas oo wariyeyaasha iyo dadweynuhu u qaateen inuu Britain ugu duulayo. Laakiin markii wariyeyaasha la socday madaxweynaha ay dhinaca kale diyaaradda kaga mashquulsanaayeen fuulitaanka, Trump ayaa si qarsoodi ah looga saaray dhinaca kale. Saraakiisha ayaa sheegay in konteenar wiish sare loogu qaado, oo caadi ahaan loo adeegsado in cuntada iyo agabka kale lagu geliyo diyaaradaha, loo adeegsaday in madaxweynaha laga soo dejiyo dhinaca aanay wariyeyaashu arki karin. Waxaa kadib lagu qaaday gaari waxaana loo wareejiyay diyaarad militari oo saddexaad, taas oo si qarsoodi ah uga qaaday Turkiga kuna geysay Britain. Washington Post ayaa markii hore werisay in diyaaraddaas ay ahayd C-32A, oo ah nooca militariga ee Boeing 757. Sidee qorshaha u dhacay? Trump iyo saraakiishiisa ayaa xilligaas si shaacsan u sheegay inuu Turkiga kaga baxayo diyaaradda duugga ah ee Air Force One halkii uu isticmaali lahaa Boeing 747-8 cusub oo Qatar ay siisay Mareykanka. Trump wuxuu wariyeyaasha u sheegay inuu diyaaradda hore u raacayo “xusuustii hore darteed”. Muuqaal ayaa laga duubay isaga oo albaabka bidix ka galaya diyaaradda, halka wariyeyaasha la socda ay iyaguna fuuleen iyagoo rumeysnaa in madaxweynuhu gudaha ku jiro. Laakiin diyaaraddaas waxaa dhab ahaantii loo adeegsaday marin-habaabin ahaan iyo in lagu khaldo Iiraan. Wariyeyaasha iyo qaar ka mid ah shaqaalaha Aqalka Cad looma sheegin in Trump uusan diyaaradda la socon, taas oo ka dhigtay kuwo iyagoo aan ogeyn qeyb ka noqday qorshaha lagu qarinayay halka uu madaxweynuhu ku sugnaa. Markii diyaaradda duugga ah ay Turkiga ka kacday, wariyeyaasha saarnaa waxaa sidoo kale lagu amray inay xirtaan daahyada daaqadaha. Diyaaradda ayaa 10:16 habeenimo ka degtay saldhigga ciidamada Mareykanka ee Mildenhall ee Britain. Hase yeeshee, Trump ayaa xilligaas hore Britain ugu yimid diyaaraddii militariga ee qarsoodiga ahayd. Waxaa gaari looga soo qaaday diyaaraddaas, kadibna dib loogu geeyay Air Force One-ka, oo uu ka galay albaab kale. Qiyaastii 40 daqiiqo kadib ayuu Trump kasoo degay albaabka sare ee Air Force One iyadoo wariyeyaashu daawanayaan, taas oo abuurtay muuqaal muujinayay inuu diyaaraddaas Turkiga kaga yimid. Kadib ayuu garoonka lug uga gudbay diyaaradda cusub ee Qatar ay siisay, taas oo isaga iyo wariyeyaashu Washington ugu duuleen. Hanjabaad Iran laga helay Qorshaha ayaa la sheegay in saacado gudahood lagu diyaariyay kadib markii saraakiisha Mareykanka ay go’aamiyeen in halista Iran ay tahay mid dhab ah. Trump ayaa intii uu Turkiga joogay lagu wargeliyay khatarta, waxaana howlgalka ku lug lahaa koox kooban oo saraakiil sare ah. Waxaa ka mid ahaa xoghayaha difaaca Pete Hegseth iyo guddoomiyaha Taliyeyaasha Guud ee ciidamada Mareykanka, General Dan Caine. Warbixinnadii hore ayaa diiradda saarayay ammaanka diyaaradda Boeing 747-8 ee Qatar ay siisay Mareykanka, taas oo aan weli lagu rakibin dhammaan qalabka difaaca ee ku jira diyaaradaha kale ee madaxweynaha. Laakiin dadka xog-ogaalka ah ayaa sheegay in hanjabaadda Iran aysan ku koobneyn diyaaraddaas. Waxay sheegeen in Trump lagu bartilmaameedsanayay diyaaradda kasta oo uu ku safri lahaa, taas oo keentay in saraakiishu adeegsadaan dhowr heer oo marin-habaabin ah. Markii Trump la weydiiyay sababta diyaaraddii hore uu uga raacay Turkiga, wuxuu sheegay inuu doonayay in ciidamada Mareykanka ee ku sugan Britain ay arkaan diyaaradda cusub. Wariyeyaashu waxay sidoo kale weydiiyeen sababta loogu amray inay daahyada daaqadaha xiraan. Trump wuxuu sheegay inuusan ogeyn hanjabaad gaar ah, balse uu muddo dheer bartilmaameed u ahaa Iran. “Aniga ayaa lambarka koowaad kaga jira liiskooda, idinka ka hor,” ayuu yiri. Trump iyo hanjabaadaha Iran Trump iyo qaar ka mid ah la-taliyeyaashiisa ayaa muddo sanado ah wajahaya shirqoolo lala xiriirinayo Iran. Xiisadda ayaa si weyn u korortay kadib markii Trump uu muddadiisii koowaad ee madaxtinimada uu amray weerarkii 2020 lagu dilay General Qassem Soleimani, oo ahaa taliyihii ciidamada Quds ee Ilaalada Kacaanka Iran. Intii lagu jiray ololihii doorashada 2024, saraakiisha Mareykanka ayaa sidoo kale helay xog sirdoon oo muujineysay in Iran ay weli dooneyso inay waxyeello u geysato Trump. Arrintaas ayaa mararka qaar keentay in ololihiisa lagu isticmaalo diyaarado marin-habaabin ah, iyadoo Trump lagu qaadi jiray diyaarad qarsoodi ah halka shaqaalihiisu ay raacayeen diyaaraddiisa gaarka ah. Maamulka madaxweynihii hore Joe Biden ayaa xagaagii 2024 kordhiyay ilaalinta Trump kadib xog cusub oo ku saabsan qorshayaal lagu dili karo. Trump ayaa isla sanadkaas ka badbaaday laba isku day dil oo aan lala xiriirin Iran, mid ka dhacay Butler, Pennsylvania, iyo mid kale oo dhacay bishii September. Howlgalkii Turkiga ayaa haddana ahaa mid aan caadi ahayn, maadaama ay aad dhif u tahay in madaxweynaha Mareykanka si qarsoodi ah loo raro iyadoo wariyeyaasha rasmiga ah ee la socda aanay ogeyn halka uu dhab ahaantii ku sugan yahay. Saraakiisha amniga ayaa ku doodaya in marka khatar toos ah jirto, ilaalinta madaxweynaha ay ka horreyso in dadweynaha iyo saxaafadda loo sheego faahfaahinta dhaq-dhaqaaqiisa. items.title: Qoysas danyar ah oo soo kabasho ganacsi ka helay waddo cusub oo laga dhisay Badhan
items.description: (ERGO) –  In ka badan labo boqol oo qoys oo ku nool magaalada Baran ee gobolka Sanaag ayaa ka soo kabtay nolol xumo markii ay ganacsiyo yaryar ka furteen xaafaddooda saddexdii bil ee la soo dhaafay. Arrintaas ayaa u suuragashay markii waddo jay ah la saaray xaafadda Galbeed oo ay ku nool yihiin.  Qoysaskan oo ahaa danyar ayaa markii waddada la dhisay xaafaddooda ka furtay ganacsiyo, taas oo u horseeday isbeddel nololeed. Faadumo Maxamuud Shire waxay qol ka mid ah guri labo qol ah oo ay deganaayeen ka furatay dukaan ay ku iibiso raashinka, dharka dumarka iyo bagaash .   Waxay xustay in fikraddan ay ku dhalatay markii gurigeedu uu noqday kan ugu horreeya ee ku yaalla waddada, ayna aragtay ganacsiyada sida xooggan ugu soo batay hareeraha jidka. Waxay xustay in ganacsigeeda cusub ay maalintii ka hesho ugu yaraan $8 oo faa’iido ah, taas oo nolol wanaagsan u horseedday.  “Nolosheenu waa heerka u sareeyay, weligay meeshan ma filanayn, nolol xumadii waan ka baxnay, waa ii shaqeeya ganacsigii, faa’iido xoog leh ayaan ka helaa maalin kasta. Waddadaan annagoo mugdi ku jirna ayay na iftiimisay.”  Faadumo, oo keligeed korisa lix carruur agoon ah, ayaa sheegtay in ka hor ganacsiga ay ku tiirsanaayeen taageero yar oo ay siin jireen dad ay ehel yihiin, taas oo aan ku filnayn. Waxay xustay in maalmaha qaar ay waayi jirtay wax ay dabka u saarto.  Ganacsigeeda oo ay furtay horraantii May ayay sheegtay inuu yeeshay macaamiil, taas oo keentay inuu koro si xawli ah muddo kooban. Waxay tilmaantay in marba marka ka dambaysa uu sii korayo ganacsiga xaafadda oo ay qayb ka tahay, taas oo sare u qaadda halgankeeda.  Waxay xustay in dukaankeeda ay ku maalgelisay lacag ay bangi dayn uga qaadatay, iyadoo gurigeeda rahan u dhigatay si lacagtaas loogu siiyo, haddii ay celin wayso. Go’aankaas oo ay u qaadatay si geesinimo leh ayaa u horseeday hadafkii ay ku taamaysay.  “Lacagtaa anniga oo aan shilling haysanin ayaa la ii siiyay. $500 ayay ahayd, iyadaan ku bilaabay, dhamaana waan iska celiyay. Lacagtaa markaas aan helay ganacsigu wuu ii ballaartay, waana sii fidiyay oo sii gallay. Wax weyn bay ii tartay xaqiiqdii.”  Faadumo ayaa sheegtay in ganacsigeedu uu hadda ku kacayo qiimo ay ku qiyaastay $2,000, taas oo ah faa’iido aad u xooggan marka loo eego muddada uu shaqaynayay. Waxay xustay inay qorshaynayso inay sii ballaariso.  Dhanka kale, haweenaydan waxay sheegtay in guulaha ay ka gaartay ganacsiga ay u dheertahay inay waxbarasho ku dartay saddex ka mid ah carruurteeda, kuwaas oo horay ay u gayn waysay dhaqaale xumada darteed. Waxay bishii ka dhiibtaa $30, taas oo aan culays ku hayn. Arrintaas waa mid ay kala siman yihiin dhammaan dadka ganacsiyada samaystay oo si isku mid ah u hantay faa’iido wax ku ool ah. Xaafaddan oo awal ahayd meel isku raran ah oo ay ku nool yihiin dadka danyarta ah ayaa isku beddeshay suuqa ugu weyn ee magaalada ku yaalla.  Dadkii horay u deganaa ayaa fursaddaas si isku mid ah uga faa’iidaystay, iyada oo qof kasta uu gurigiisa u beddelay goob ganacsi. Kaltuun Cumar Xasan waxay balbalo ay bagaash iyo shaah ku iibiso ka samaysatay guri ay leeyihiin dad ay qaraabo yihiin hortiisa.  Haweenaydan oo kaligeed korsata 10 carruur ah oo lagu furay oo aan lagu daryeelin ayaa sheegtay in muddo labo bil iyo bar ah ay ganacsiga waddo. Waxay ka soo kabteen nolol xumo ay wajahayeen oo ay ugu horraysay cunno xumo.  “Markii aan waddadan jirin iyo maanta ganacsigu waa kala duwan yahay noloshuna waa kala duwan tahay. Waxa ugu yar waxa waaye gawaarida waddada maraysa biyaha iyo cuntada ayay xitaa iga sii gataan oo wax badan ayay nagu soo kordhisay.”  Qoyska Kaltuun ayaa labo sano ka hor ka soo barakacay miyiga magaalada Baran oo ay deganaayeen, markii daaq xumo ka dhalatay roob yari ay ku dhaafeen 140 ari ah oo ay dhaqanayeen. Waxay ilmaheeda ku masruufaysay wax ay ku caawiyaan dadka magaalada oo ay ku dhex wareegaysay, iyada oo dulsaar ku ahayd qoys ay qaraabo yihiin oo siiyay hal qol.  Noloshaas adkayd ayay sheegtay inay hadda ka saartay ilmaheeda, iyada oo u kiraysay labo qol oo ay bishii ka dhiibto $30. Waxay sidoo kale qorshaynaysaa inay hesho guri ay iyadu leedahay, waxayna maalin kasta meel dhigtaa in ka mid ah lacagta ay hesho si ay uga dhabayso hamigeeda.  Kaltuun inay maaraysay nolosha qoyskeeda waxa u dheer inay bishii Juun waxbarasho ku dartay afar ka mid ah carruurteeda, kuwaas oo ay bishii ka bixiso $40. Maaddaama uu hana qaaday ganacsigeeda, waxay sheegtay inay naawilayso inay kuwa kalena gayso bilaha soo aaddan.  “Walaal Carruurta iskuul iyo dugsi ayay ii dhigtaan. Aniga waxaan u ordayaa in aan ilmahayga caafimaadkooda, waxbarashadooda iyo cuntadooda aan keeno waana helaa Alxamdullilaah wax kasta oo aan u baahdo. Miyiga aniga iyo carruurtaba waan ka raysannay.” Kaltuun ayaa sheegtay in ganacsigeedu uu haysto macaamiil badan maaddaama ay ka mid tahay ganacsatadii ugu horraysay ee maqaaxi ka furta waddada. Waxay ku beegantay xilli ay magaalada u soo guurayaan dadka ka soo xagaa-baxaya magaalada Boosaaso.  Waxay sheegtay in hadda ay iska celisay $800 oo ay ganacsiga ku billowday, taas oo ay daymiyeen dad qaraabo ah. Waxay xustay in hadda ay doonayso inay sii ballaariso maqaaxida oo ay kiraysato goob weyn oo ku filan, maaddaama macaamiisheedu ay sii kordhayaan.  Haweenaydan oo ah 40 jir nolosheeda oo dhan ku soo qaadatay miyiga ayaa sheegtay inay ku faraxsan tahay inuu guul gaaray ganacsigeedii ugu horreeyay. Waxay aaminsan tahay hadda inay maamuli karto dhaqaale intaas ka badan maaddaama ay faham fiican heshay.  Waxay sheegtay in ganacsigeeda cusub uu hadda ka wax-soo-saar badan yahay xoolihii ay dhaqanayeen, oo waayadii dambe ay curyaamiyeen abaaraha soo laalaabtay. Waxay xustay in haddii ay ganacsiga sii waddo ay aaminsan tahay inay gaari karto heer aad uga sarreeya halka ay maanta joogto.  Fursadda ay heleen dadkan danyarta ah, oo aan markii hore ganacsiyo ka hirgelin karin magaalada ayaa timid markii la hirgeliyay waddadan oo ay maalgelisay Safaaradda Ingiriiska ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo kaashanaysa Sanduuqa Somalia Stability Fund iyo Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Waddooyinka Puntland.  Ujeeddada barnaamijkan ayaa ah in la ballaariyo isku socodka iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha deegaannada soo koraya, sida uu sheegay Maxamed Muuse Cali oo dawlada hoose ee degmada Baran u xilsaartay barnaamijkan.  Dadka ku nool xaafadaan oo markii hore ahaa danyar aan dabka si joogto ah u shidan karin ayaa muddo kooban ku gaaray heer aad uga wanaagsan noloshii hore taas oo muujisay muhiimadda ay leeyihiin horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha oo ay jidadku ka midka yihiin. The post Qoysas danyar ah oo soo kabasho ganacsi ka helay waddo cusub oo laga dhisay Badhan appeared first on Radio Ergo - Somali Humanitarian News and Information .

Waxay xustay in haddii ay ganacsiga sii waddo ay aaminsan tahay inay gaari karto heer aad uga sarreeya halka ay maanta joogto.  Fursadda ay heleen dadkan danyarta ah, oo aan markii hore ganacsiyo ka hirgelin karin magaalada ayaa timid markii la hirgeliyay waddadan oo ay maalgelisay Safaaradda Ingiriiska ee Soomaaliya, iyadoo kaashanaysa Sanduuqa Somalia Stability Fund iyo Wasaaradda Gaadiidka iyo Waddooyinka Puntland.  Ujeeddada barnaamijkan ayaa ah in la ballaariyo isku socodka iyo kaabeyaasha dhaqaalaha deegaannada soo koraya, sida uu sheegay Maxamed Muuse Cali oo dawlada hoose ee degmada Baran u xilsaartay barnaamijkan.  Dadka ku nool xaafadaan oo markii hore ahaa danyar aan dabka si joogto ah u shidan karin ayaa muddo kooban ku gaaray heer aad uga wanaagsan noloshii hore taas oo muujisay muhiimadda ay leeyihiin horumarinta kaabayaasha dhaqaalaha oo ay jidadku ka midka yihiin. items.title: Ugu yaraan 6 Qof oo Lagu Dilay Weerar ay Xuutiyiintu Ka Geysteen Marinka Bab al-Mandab
items.description: Ugu yaraan lix qof ayaa ku dhintay, 10 kalena ku dhaawacmeen weerar ay Xuutiyiinta Yemen ku qaadeen markab ganacsi oo laga leeyahay Masar, xilli uu marayay marin-biyoodka istiraatiijiga ah ee Bab al-Mandab, sida ay sheegtay dowladda Yemen ee caalamku aqoonsan yahay. Weerarka oo dhacay Talaadadii ayaa lagu qaaday markabka Tihamah, waxaana masuuliyiinta Yemen ay sheegeen in Xuutiyiintu ku dhufteen saddex gantaal oo ballistic ah. Gantaallada ayaa sababay dab xooggan iyo burbur weyn oo soo gaaray markabka, ayadoo wasaaradda Gaadiidka Yemen ay sheegtay in dadka dhintay ay ku jiraan saddex muwaadin oo Pakistan u dhashay iyo hal muwaadin oo Indonesia ah. Laba askari oo ka tirsan ciidamadii gurmadka ayaa iyaguna lagu dilay weerar labaad sida ay sheegeen ilaalada xeebaha Yemen, oo Tilmaamay in markii ciidamada gurmadku bilaabeen daadgureynta shaqaalaha markabka iyo dadka ku dhaawacmay weerarkii hore, Xuutiyiintu ay markabka ku soo rideen gantaal kale. Gantaalka labaad ayaa ku dhacay goobtii uu ka socday howlgalka samatabbixintu, waxaana halkaas ku dhintay laba askari, taas oo tirada Guud ka dhigtay 6 dhimasho ah iyo 10 dhaawac ah. Bab al-Mandab waa marin-biyood muhiim ah oo isku xira Badda Cas iyo Gacanka Cadmeed, isla markaana muhiim u ah isu-socodka maraakiibta ganacsiga ee u kala goosha Aasiya, Bariga Dhexe iyo Yurub. Weerarrada sii kordhaya ayaa sare u qaadaya walaaca laga qabo in amniga maraakiibta ganacsiga uu mar kale si weyn u xumaado, iyadoo khatartaasi ay saameyn ku yeelan karto ganacsiga iyo dhaqaalaha caalamka. .

items.title: Cumar Cartan oo taariikh cusub ka dhigaya kubadda cagta Yurub
items.description: Salzburg (Caasimada Online) – Garsooraha Soomaaliyeed ee heerka caalami Cumar Cabduqaadir Cartan ayaa caawa taariikh cusub ka sameynaya kubadda cagta Yurub, kaddib markii loo doortay inuu dhex-dhexaadiyo mid ka mid ah kulamada ugu waaweyn ee xilli-ciyaareedka kubadda cagta qaaradda Yurub. Cartan ayaa garsoore ka noqonaya kulanka weyn ee UEFA Super Cup, kaas oo lagu qabanayo magaalada Salzburg ee dalka Austria, iyadoo ay isku wajahayaan labada kooxood ee ku guuleystay tartamada waaweyn ee UEFA. Kulanka ayaa waxaa wada ciyaaraya Paris Saint-Germain (PSG), oo xilli-ciyaareedkii hore ku guuleysatay UEFA Champions League, iyo Aston Villa, oo qaaday UEFA Europa League. Labada kooxood ayaa isku arki doona kulan xiiso badan, iyadoo indhaha taageerayaasha kubadda cagta Yurub iyo kuwa caalamka ay si gaar ah ugu jeedaan garoonka iyo shaqada garsoore Cumar Cartan. Cumar Cartan ayaa noqonaya garsoorihii ugu horreeyay ee aan Yurub kasoo jeedin ee loo igmado inuu dhex-dhexaadiyo kulanka UEFA Super Cup, taas oo ka dhigaysa dhacdadan mid xusuus gaar ah ku leh taariikhda garsoorka kubadda cagta. Guddoomiyaha Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya, ahna Madaxweyne Ku-xigeenka CECAFA Cali Cabdi Maxamed, ayaa guul weyn ku tilmaamay in Garsoore Cumar Cartan iyo labadiisa caawiye oo kasoo kala jeeda dalalka Bariga iyo Bartamaha Afrika, loo doorto inay dhex-dhexaadiyaan kulanka weyn ee UEFA Super Cup Fursaddan ayaa sare u qaadaysa magaca Soomaaliya, iyadoo garsoore Soomaaliyeed uu helay kalsoonida hay’adaha ugu sarreeya kubadda cagta Yurub, si uu u maamulo kulan ay ka qeybgalayaan kooxaha ugu magaca weyn qaaradda. Guushan ayaa muujineysa horumarka uu sameeyay Cartan sannadihii lasoo dhaafay iyo sida uu uga mid noqday garsoorayaasha Afrika ee awoodda u leh inay ka shaqeeyaan kulamada heerka ugu sarreeya ee kubadda cagta caalamka. Cumar Cabduqaadir Cartan oo 34 jir ah ayaa ku jira liiska garsoorayaasha caalamiga ah ee FIFA tan iyo sannadkii 2018. Sannadkii 2025-ka ayaa loo magacaabay Garsooraha ugu fiican Afrika, isaga oo noqday mid ka mid ah garsoorayaasha ugu sarreeya qaaradda Afrika iyo guud ahaan caalamka, waxaana sidoo kale muddadii uu ku jiray garsoorka uu dhex-dhexaadiyay kulamo badan oo heer caalami ah. Si kastaba, Guusha Cumar Cartan ayaa si gaar ah muhiim u noqonaysa marka la xuso dhacdadii dhowaan ka horreysay ee uu ku waayay fursaddii uu kaga qeyb geli lahaa Koobka Adduunka 2026, kaddib markii Mareykanka uu u diiday inuu dalka galo, inkastoo uu haystay fiiso sax ah. Mas’uuliyiinta Mareykanka ayaa xilligaas ku sababeeyay go’aanka walaac la xiriiray xaqiijinta xogtiisa, halka FIFA ay markii dambe xaqiijisay inuusan ka qeyb geli karin tartanka. The post Cumar Cartan oo taariikh cusub ka dhigaya kubadda cagta Yurub appeared first on Caasimada Online .

items.title: Qorax madoobaad la filaayo in uu dunida ka dhaco
items.description: Qorrax madoobaad la filayo maanta iyo meelaa uu ka dhici doono. Waxaa Arbacada maanta ah, 12-ka Agoosto la filayaa inuu ka dhaco qaybo kala duwan oo dunida ah qorrax madoobaad. Meelaha qaar ayaa laga arki doonaa madoobaad buuxa, halka meelo kalana laga arki doono madoobaad qayb ah. Haddii aadan si toos ah xitaa u arki karin, waxaa jiri doono muuqaallo cajiib ah oo ay suurtagal tahay in laga baahiyo meelo kala duwan oo dunida ah. Madoobaadka qorraxda ayaa dhaca marka dayaxu u dhaxeeyo dhulka iyo qorraxda, taas oo xannibaysa qayb ama dhammaan iftiinka qorraxda ee ina soo gaara. Noocyo kala duwan ayaa jira oo madoobaadka qorraxda ah. Nooca aad arki doonto wuxuu ku xiran yahay meesha aad ka joogto Dhulka iyo masaafada u dhexeysa Dayaxa iyo Dhulka. Madoobaadka qorraxda ee xiga ayaa la filayaa inuu dhico Arbacada, 12-ka Agoosto. Madoobaadka buuxa ayaa la filayaa in laga arki doonaa: Waqooyiga Ruushka, Greenland, Iceland, Isbayn iyo Boortaqiiska. Madoobaadkan lagama arki doono Turkiga. Madoobaadka qorraxda ee xiga ee laga daawan karo Turkiga wuxuu noqon doonaa madoobaad qayb ahaan ah, kaas oo dhici doona 2-da Agoosto, 2027. Sida ay sheegtay NASA, madoobaadka buuxa wuxuu ka bilaaban doonaa duhurnimada meel yar oo fog oo ku taalla waqooyiga Ruushka. Kadibna iyadoo Dhulku wareegayo, madoobaadku wuxuu u gudbi doonaa dhinaca Isbayn, halkaas oo laga arki doono fiidkii wax yar ka hor qorrax-dhaca. Muddada madoobaadka buuxu waxay noqon doontaa mid aad u gaaban, wax ka yar laba daqiiqo iyo bar. Qaybo ka mid ah waqooyiga Maraykanka, Kanada, waqooyi-galbeed Afrika, iyo meelo badan oo Yurub ah waxay arki doonaan madoobaad qayb ahaan ah, iyadoo meelo qaarkood in ka badan 90% Qorraxda la dabooli doono. Dhacdadan waxay sii noqon doontaa mid gaar ah, maadaama qaybo ka mid ah Afrika iyo qaaradda Yurub ay arki doonaan madoobaad ku beegan qorrax-dhac, taas oo macnaheedu yahay in Qorraxdu qayb ahaan madoobaan doonto iyadoo dhacaysa.

items.title: Ilhan Omar oo ku guuleysatay in ka badan 80% codadka doorashada hordhaca ah ee Congress-ka Mareykanka
items.description: Xildhibaanad Ilhaan Cumar ayaa si weyn ugu guuleysatay doorashada hordhaca ah ee Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ee degmada 5-aad ee Congress-ka gobolka Minnesota, iyadoo heshay in ka badan 80% codadka. Guushan ayaa u oggolaanaysa inay mar kale noqoto musharraxa Xisbiga Dimuqraadiga ee degmada 5-aad doorashada guud ee bisha November 2026. Degmadan oo ay ku jirto magaalada Minneapolis ayaa lagu tilmaamaa mid ka mid ah degmooyinka ugu taageerada badan Dimuqraadiga ee Minnesota iyo guud ahaan Mareykanka. Ilhaan, oo Congress-ka Mareykanka ku matalaysay degmadan tan iyo 2018-kii, ayaa markan wajahday tartan adag oo ay la gashay musharraxiinta kala ah: Julie T. Le, Abena McKenzie, Latonya Reeves iyo Nate Schluter. Guusha ayaa sidoo kale muhiim u ah Ilhaan iyadoo ololaheeda siyaasadeed uu muddo dheer ku salaysnaa arrimo ay ka mid yihiin socdaalka, xuquuqda bulshada iyo siyaasadda Mareykanka ee Bariga Dhexe. Xogta doorashada ayaa muujinaysa in ay heshay taageero aad u ballaaran oo ka timid cod-bixiyayaasha degmada, ayadoo warbixinnada la helayo ay sidoo kale xusayaan in ay ololahan wajahday iyada oo aan taageero ka helin AIPAC oo ah urur saameynta weyn ku leh siyaasadda Mareykanka ee la xiriirta Israa’iil. Arrintan ayaa ka dhigtay ololaheeda mid si gaar ah loo hadal hayo, maadaama Ilhaan ay muddo dheer si adag u dhaleecaynaysay siyaasadda Israa’iil iyo dagaalka marinka Qasa. Doorashada hordhaca ah ayaa ahayd tallaabada koowaad; balse Ilhaan weli waxay u baahan tahay inay ku guuleysato doorashada guud ee November si ay u sii haysato kursigeeda Congress-ka.

items.title: Somali PM calls for new approach to international engagement
items.description: Mogadishu, Somalia — Somali Prime Minister Hamza Abdi Barre has called on United Nations agencies, donors and international organisations working in Somalia to change their approach, saying the country should no longer be treated as a transitional state.

items.title: Madaxweyne Zelenskyy oo safiir u magacaabay Somalia
items.description: Kyiv (Caasimada Online) – Madaxweynaha Ukraine Volodymyr Zelenskyy ayaa Yuriy Tokar, oo ah safiirka dalkiisa u fadhiya Kenya, u magacaabay inuu sidoo kale noqdo safiirka Ukraine u qaabilsan Soomaaliya, xilli Kyiv ay sii ballaarineyso xiriirkeeda diblomaasiyadeed ee Afrika. Magacaabista ayaa lagu xaqiijiyay wareegto madaxweyne oo tirsigeedu yahay 717/2026, taas oo Zelenskyy saxiixay 11-ka August, laguna daabacay bogga rasmiga ah ee madaxtooyada Ukraine. Wareegtada ayaa dhigaysa in Yuriy Lyubomirovich Tokar, oo hadda ah safiirka Ukraine ee Kenya, uu isla xilkaas ka qaban doono Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay in Ukraine aysan Muqdisho u soo dirin safiir gaar ah oo cusub, balse Tokar uu sii joogi doono Kenya, isaga oo halkaas ka qaabilsanaan doona Soomaaliya. Nidaamkan ayaa dalalku inta badan adeegsadaan marka aysan safaarad joogto ah ku lahayn waddan, iyadoo safiir ku sugan dal kale oo gobolka ah loo igmado inuu xiriirkaas diblomaasiyadeed maamulo. Magacaabista Tokar ayaa ku soo beegmaysa xilli xiriirka Soomaaliya iyo Ukraine uu sannadihii dambe sii muuqday. Bishii November 2025, safiirka Soomaaliya ee Ukraine, Mohamed Abdullahi Ahmed, oo isna aan dalkaas si joogto ah u deggeneyn, ayaa waraaqihiisa aqoonsiga gudbiyay, waxaana Zelenskyy xilligaas uga mahadceliyay Soomaaliya mowqifkeeda ku aaddan madax-bannaanida iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Ukraine. Ukraine ayaa dhankeeda sidoo kale si cad u taageertay madax-bannaanida, midnimada iyo wadajirka dhuleed ee Soomaaliya. Labada dal ayaa sidoo kale xiriirkoodu taabtay dhinaca sugnaanta cuntada. items.title: Somalia’s Post-Federal Governance Map
items.description: By Isha Qarsoon Four months ago, President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud declared that Somalia had moved from a Provisional Constitution (PC) to a Final Constitution. The declaration followed constitutional amendments adopted by Parliament without three steps explicitly required by the PC: agreement with the Federal Member States (FMSs) on the division of powers and resources, consultation with the states and the public, and ratification by the Somali people. In two essays published shortly thereafter, Isha Qarsoon  argued that the amendments had not completed Somalia’s federal project. Instead, they had replaced the federal bargain embodied in the PC with a different constitutional order that unilaterally reallocates powers among the Federal Government (FGS), the FMSs and local governments newly established as a separate constitutional tier carved out of the FMS constitutional domain under the PC. The amendments also changed presidential and parliamentary terms from four years to five. What has happened in the four months since is more revealing than the new constitutional text. Hassan Sheikh was elected to a four-year term and had previously said the new arrangement would apply to the next government. He nevertheless claimed the fifth year for himself and began implementing the amended Constitution. One of its most consequential provisions created a Supreme Judicial Council with broad authority over the courts, and the government has begun nominating its members for parliamentary approval. Yet both the President and Parliament remain in office only because the new five-year term has been applied to the current incumbents. Parliament is now being asked to approve a Judicial Council that will help constitute and govern the new judiciary. If the amendments were unconstitutionally adopted, the defect therefore extends well beyond the President’s fifth year. It reaches Parliament’s continued tenure and the federal laws it passes, the Judicial Council it approves, and ultimately the judiciary that Council will help create, reproducing the original constitutional defect across the executive, legislature and judiciary. President Hassan Sheikh More immediately, Villa Somalia is using that additional year to reshape who governs the FMSs before the next federal election. The Constitution does not authorize the federal president to choose state leaders, remove incumbents he no longer supports or reorganize regional politics around his preferred candidates. No other law gives him that authority. Yet Hassan Sheikh is intervening directly in state political processes, using federal money, appointments, security forces and the power of the presidency. The FMSs remain formally autonomous, but Mogadishu is increasingly deciding who leads them. Yet even as Villa Somalia consolidates political control over the institutions and state governments it can reach, the FGS remains unable to govern much of the country it claims. Puntland has further consolidated its self-government. Jubaland continues to operate outside effective federal control. Somaliland remains beyond Mogadishu’s reach. Northeast State is aligned with Mogadishu but geographically separated from it and contested by both Puntland and Somaliland. Across much of central and southern Somalia, Al-Shabaab continues to govern territory that is part of Somalia. Together, these developments show how differently Somalia is governed from the country described in the amended Constitution. That Constitution created a new map of its own, adding local governments as a separate constitutional tier and weakening the autonomy of the FMSs. But even that is not the map by which Somalia is actually governed. This essay describes the country as it exists in practice. Start in Somaliland. For more than three decades, little has changed. Hargeisa has governed itself since its declared secession in 1991. Mogadishu has neither negotiated a settlement that brought Somaliland back into the state nor changed the situation by force. Somalia continues to claim Somaliland as part of the Republic, and the international community continues to recognize that claim. Neither fact changes who governs there. Somaliland remains entirely outside Mogadishu’s reach. The Northeast State lies between Somaliland and Puntland. Mogadishu recognizes and supports it, while Hargeisa and Garowe claim all or parts of its territory. The FGS presented its creation as an expansion of the federal order into northern Somalia. It also gave Villa Somalia another regional administration aligned with Mogadishu and another possible source of support in the next federal election. Yet the new state is cut off by land from the federal center. Any overland route from Mogadishu must cross Hirshabelle and Galmudug, where government control is already interrupted, and then Puntland, which has rejected the presence of federal forces in its territory. Somaliland offers no alternative route for the FGS. Federal officials can still fly into Las Anod, assuming air access remains open, but ordinary life depends on roads. Goods, traders, patients, students and families move into Somaliland or through Puntland, and anyone traveling overland toward the rest of the Federal Republic must pass through Puntland. Federal recognition may give a small political class appointments and direct access to Villa Somalia, but it does not change where Northeast State sits or how its people move. That leaves Northeast State politically tied to Mogadishu but physically dependent on its neighbors. It will need working relations with Garowe, Hargeisa or both regardless of its relationship with the FGS. Recognition changed its political status, not its geography. How long that arrangement can last is uncertain. Farther east is Puntland. Unlike Somaliland, it does not claim independence from Somalia. Unlike Northeast State, it does not look to Mogadishu to sustain its political position. Garowe governs Puntland through its own institutions, commands its own forces and decides who may organize armed units inside its territory. Its recent declaration that no federal forces remain in Puntland merely acknowledged that Mogadishu no longer exercises military authority there. Even before the latest clashes, Puntland was turning increasingly toward itself rather than Mogadishu. Its twenty-eighth anniversary was marked by unusually elaborate celebrations of Puntland’s institutions, security forces and political identity. It was not a declaration of independence, but the celebration showed how far Puntland has moved from the federal center. The speeches, ceremonies and displays focused on Puntland’s government, its forces and its future, not on its place in a functioning federal system. South of Puntland lies the part of the country most often described as the FGS’s base. That description is misleading. South West, Galmudug and Hirshabelle have not been tied to Mogadishu through an agreed and functioning federal arrangement. Villa Somalia has instead increasingly shaped their leadership, political succession and the arrangements through which regional power is exercised. South West is the clearest example of how selectively Villa Somalia invokes constitutional authority. Hassan Sheikh treated the new five-year federal term as extending his own presidency, although he had been elected for four years. But when Abdiaziz Laftagareen resisted Mogadishu’s constitutional and electoral program, the FGS declared his mandate expired and rejected the political process organized by South West itself. Federal forces moved into Baidoa, Laftagareen resigned, and Villa Somalia took control of the succession. The process that followed produced a president backed by Hassan Sheikh’s party after major candidates withdrew and complained that the result had been arranged in advance. The issue was not adherence to a new constitutional order. It was who controlled the political outcome. Galmudug is beginning to follow South West’s path. Ahmed Qoorqoor supported Hassan Sheikh’s constitutional program, but Villa Somalia did not support him for another term. Relations deteriorated when Qoorqoor resisted federal interference in Galmudug’s security command. Hassan Sheikh’s party then selected Libaan Shuluq as its candidate. Qoorqoor initially refused to step aside as Mogadishu challenged his control over the state’s security forces. After weeks of pressure and negotiations over his departure, he withdrew from the race and endorsed the FGS’s electoral plans. The prime minister then traveled to Dhusamareb as Villa Somalia pressed ahead with Shuluq’s candidacy. In Abudwaq, opponents of the federally backed candidate warned: “We will not be treated like Baidoa.” In Hirshabelle, Hassan Sheikh’s involvement is even more direct. He played a central role in creating the state during his first presidency and has repeatedly intervened in its leadership. On August 4, he met the Hawadle ugaas and senior politicians to discuss who should become the next Hirshabelle president. The Hawadle leadership reportedly left the choice of its candidate to Hassan Sheikh himself. Since the presidency is expected to pass to a Hawadle candidate, the federal president now has a direct role in choosing who may next govern the state. South West, Galmudug and Hirshabelle are the three FMSs where Villa Somalia has gone furthest in determining who governs. In South West, it forced a change of leadership. In Galmudug, it has pushed aside an incumbent it no longer supports. In Hirshabelle, Hassan Sheikh is now directly involved in choosing the next president. The states remain formally autonomous, but decisions over who leads them are increasingly being made in Mogadishu. But controlling a state presidency does not mean governing the state. A president backed by Villa Somalia may sit in Baidoa, Dhusamareb or Jowhar while large areas beyond the capital remain outside his government’s reach. Government authority is concentrated in the main towns and along some roads. In parts of Galmudug, Hiraan and Middle Shabelle, government forces cannot move freely, secure the roads or prevent Al-Shabaab from exercising authority over local communities. Al-Shabaab fills that gap with government of its own. It collects taxes, controls movement, settles disputes and enforces its decisions. Its reach extends even into some government-held towns, where businesses and residents pay it because the government cannot protect them from retaliation. Its rule is coercive and illegitimate, but in many communities it is the authority people encounter in their daily lives. A map showing all of Galmudug, Hirshabelle and South West as governed from Mogadishu therefore bears little resemblance to the country on the ground. Farther south is Jubaland. It remains part of Somalia in law, but Kismayo does not take political or military direction from Villa Somalia. When Mogadishu rejected Ahmed Madobe’s reelection and sent federal forces into Jubaland, the regional government resisted. Federal troops were defeated at Ras Kamboni in December 2024, and hundreds crossed into Kenya. Madobe remained in office and Mogadishu failed to remove him. The defeat did not create Jubaland’s autonomy. It exposed the limits of federal power. Mogadishu could issue decrees and arrest warrants against Madobe, but it could not enforce them in Kismayo. It sent federal troops to change who governed Jubaland and failed. That separates Jubaland from South West, Galmudug and Hirshabelle, where Villa Somalia has been able to shape who governs. Somaliland remains outside Mogadishu’s authority. Puntland governs itself and rejects the present federal arrangement. Northeast State is recognized by Mogadishu but separated from it by territory the FGS does not control. In South West, Galmudug and Hirshabelle, Villa Somalia has increasingly shaped who governs, even as large parts of those states remain beyond the reach of federal and regional authorities. Jubaland remains part of Somalia, but Mogadishu has failed to determine who governs there. This is Somalia’s governance map four months after Hassan Sheikh declared the provisional constitutional era over. It is not the map set out in the Constitution he declared final. It is the country as it exists today. items.title: Somalia and Qatar seek deeper economic ties and investment opportunities
items.description: Mogadishu, Somalia — Somalia and Qatar have discussed ways to deepen economic and investment cooperation, as Mogadishu seeks to attract greater foreign investment to support development and reconstruction.
